In the beginning of God’s creating the skies
and the earth

english.text:
In the beginning of God’s creating the skies
and the earth

translation.text: In the beginning when God created the heavens and the earth,

verses.english:
when the earth had been shapeless
and formless, and darkness was on the face of the deep,
and God’s spirit was hovering on the face of the water

verses.english:
And God said, “Let there be light.”

And there was light.

And God said, “Let there be light.”

And there was light.

And God saw the light, that it was good

And God separated between the light

And the darkness.

and water.”

And God said, “Let the waters be concentrated under the skies into one
place, and let the land appear.”

And it was so.

And God created the big sea serpents
and all the living beings that creep, with which the water swarmed, by
their kinds, and every winged bird by its kind.
And God saw that it was good.

translation.text: So God created the great sea monsters and every living creature that bird of every kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.english:
And God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the water in the seas,
and let the birds multiply in the earth.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר פְּרוּ
וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הַמַּיִם בַּיַּמִּים
וְהָעוֹף יִרֶב בָּאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the water in the seas,
and let the birds multiply in the earth.”

translation.text: God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."

verses.english: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

english.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

translation.text: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.

verses.english:
And God said, “Let the earth bring out living beings by their kind,
domestic animal and creeping thing
and wild animals of the earth by their kind.”
And it was so.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה לְמִינָהּ בְּהֵמָה
וָרֶמֶשׂ וְחַיְתוֹ אֶרֶץ לְמִינָהּ
וַיְהִי כֵן

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה לְמִינָהּ בְּהֵמָה וָרֶמֶשׂ וְחַיְתוֹ אֶרֶץ לְמִינָהּ וַיְהִי כֵן

english.text:
And God said, “Let the earth bring out living beings by their kind,
domestic animal and creeping thing
and wild animals of the earth by their kind.”
And it was so.

translation.text: And God said, "Let the earth bring forth living creatures of every kind: cattle and creeping things and wild animals of the earth of every kind." And it was so.

verses.english:
And God made the wild animals of the earth by their kind
and the domestic animals by their kind
and every creeping thing of the ground by their kind.
And God saw that it was good.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת חַיַּת הָאָרֶץ לְמִינָהּ
וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ וְאֵת כָּל רֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טוֹב

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת חַיַּת הָאָרֶץ לְמִינָהּ וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ וְאֵת כָּל רֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טוֹב

english.text:
And God made the wild animals of the earth by their kind
and the domestic animals by their kind
and every creeping thing of the ground by their kind.
And God saw that it was good.

translation.text: God made the wild animals of the earth of upon the ground of every kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.english:
And God said, “Let us make a human, in our image, according to our
likeness, and let them dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and the domestic animals
and all the earth and all the creeping things that creep on the earth.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה אָדָם בְּצַלְמֵנוּ כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ
וְיִרְדּוּ בִדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם
וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבְכָל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכָל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה אָדָם בְּצַלְמֵנוּ כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ וְיִרְדּוּ בִדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבְכָל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכָל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God said, “Let us make a human, in our image, according to our
likeness, and let them dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and the domestic animals
and all the earth and all the creeping things that creep on the earth.”

translation.text: Then God said, "Let us make humankind in our image, according to the earth."

verses.english:
And God created the human in His image. He created it in the image of
God; He created them male and female.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם בְּצַלְמוֹ בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים בָּרָא
אֹתוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בָּרָא אֹתָם

english.text:
And God created the human in His image. He created it in the image of
God; He created them male and female.

translation.text: So God created humankind in his image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

verses.english:
And God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it
and dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and every animal that creeps on the earth.”

וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אֱלֹהִים פְּרוּ
וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁהָ
וּרְדוּ בִּדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם
וּבְכָל חַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת עַל הָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אֱלֹהִים פְּרוּ וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁהָ וּרְדוּ בִּדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבְכָל חַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת עַל הָאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it
and dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and every animal that creeps on the earth.”

translation.text: God blessed them, and God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over every living thing that moves upon the earth."

And God said, “Here, I have placed all the vegetation that produces seed
that is on the face of all the earth for you
and every tree, which has in it the fruit of a tree producing seed. It
will be food for you

and every tree, which has in it the fruit of a tree producing seed. It
will be food for you

and for all the birds of the skies

And God saw everything that He had made,
and, here, it was very good. And there was evening
and there was morning, the sixth day.

And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy because
he ceased in it from doing all His work, which God had created.

God
made skin garments for the human and his woman and dressed them.

verses.translation: And the LORD God made garments of skins for the man and for his wife, and clothed them.

And YHWH
God
said, “Here, the human has become like one of us, to know good and bad.

and eat and live forever:”

And YHWH
God

God

And he expelled the human. And he had the sphinxes and the flame of a revolving sword reside
at the east of the garden of Eden to watch over the way to the tree of life.

english.text:
And he expelled the human. And he had the sphinxes and the flame of a revolving sword reside
at the east of the garden of Eden to watch over the way to the tree of life.

translation.text: He drove out the man; and at flaming and turning to guard the way to the tree of life.

verses.english:
And the human had known Eve, his woman,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain,
and said, “I’ve created a man with YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וְהָ

\hJיָדַע
אֶת חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת קַיִן וַתֹּאמֶר קָנִיתִי אִישׁ אֶת יְהֹוָה

hebrew.text: וְהָ אָדָם יָדַע אֶת חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת קַיִן וַתֹּאמֶר קָנִיתִי אִישׁ אֶת יְהֹוָה

english.text:
And the human had known Eve, his woman,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain,
and said, “I’ve created a man with YHWH.”

translation.text: Now the man knew his wife Eve, and she conceived and bore Cain, saying, "I have produced a man with the help of the LORD."

verses.english:
And she went on to give birth to his brother, Abel.
And Abel was a shepherd of flocks,
and Cain was a worker of ground.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּסֶף לָלֶדֶת אֶת אָחִיו אֶת הָבֶל וַיְהִי הֶבֶל רֹעֵה צֹאן וְקַיִן הָיָה עֹבֵד אֲדָמָה

hebrew.text: וַתֹּסֶף לָלֶדֶת אֶת אָחִיו אֶת הָבֶל וַיְהִי הֶבֶל רֹעֵה צֹאן וְקַיִן הָיָה עֹבֵד אֲדָמָה

english.text:
And she went on to give birth to his brother, Abel.
And Abel was a shepherd of flocks,
and Cain was a worker of ground.

translation.text: Next she tiller of the ground.

verses.english:
And it was at the end of some days
and Cain brought an offering to YHWH from
the fruit of the ground.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיָּבֵא קַיִן מִפְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיָּבֵא קַיִן מִפְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה

english.text:
And it was at the end of some days
and Cain brought an offering to YHWH from
the fruit of the ground.

translation.text: In the course of time Cain brought to the LORD an offering of the fruit of the ground,

verses.english:
And Abel brought, as well, from the firstborn of his flock and their fat.
And YHWH paid attention to Abel and his offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶבֶל הֵבִיא גַם הוּא מִבְּכֹרת צֹאנוֹ וּמֵחֶלְבֵהֶן וַיִּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶל הֶבֶל וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ

hebrew.text: וְהֶבֶל הֵבִיא גַם הוּא מִבְּכֹרת צֹאנוֹ וּמֵחֶלְבֵהֶן וַיִּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶל הֶבֶל וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ

english.text:
And Abel brought, as well, from the firstborn of his flock and their fat.
And YHWH paid attention to Abel and his offering.

translation.text: and Abel for his part brought of the firstlings of his flock, their fat portions. And the LORD had regard for Abel and his offering,

verses.english:
And to Cain and his offering he did not pay attention.
And Cain was very upset, and his face was fallen.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל קַיִן וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ לֹא שָׁעָה וַיִּחַר לְקַיִן מְאֹד וַיִּפְּלוּ פָּנָיו

hebrew.text: וְאֶל קַיִן וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ לֹא שָׁעָה וַיִּחַר לְקַיִן מְאֹד וַיִּפְּלוּ פָּנָיו

english.text:
And to Cain and his offering he did not pay attention.
And Cain was very upset, and his face was fallen.

translation.text: but for Cain and his offering he had no regard. So Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Cain, “Why are you upset,

and why has your face fallen?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קָיִן לָמָּה חָרָה לָךְ וְלָמָּה נָפְלוּ פָנֶיךָ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קָיִן לָמָּה חָרָה לָךְ וְלָמָּה נָפְלוּ פָנֶיךָ

english.text:
And YHWH said to Cain, “Why are you upset,

and why has your face fallen?”

translation.text: The LORD fallen?

verses.english:
Is it not that if you do well you'll be raised,
and if you don't do well then sin crouches at the threshold?
And its desire will be for you.
And you'll dominate it.
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא אִם תֵּיטִיב שְׂאֵת וְאִם לֹא תֵיטִיב לַפֶּתַח חַטָּאת רֹבֵץ וְאֵלֶיךָ תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ וְאַתָּה תִּמְשׁל בּוֹ

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא אִם תֵּיטִיב שְׂאֵת וְאִם לֹא תֵיטִיב לַפֶּתַח חַטָּאת רֹבֵץ וְאֵלֶיךָ תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ וְאַתָּה תִּמְשׁל בּוֹ

english.text:
Is it not that if you do well you'll be raised,
and if you don't do well then sin crouches at the threshold?
And its desire will be for you.
And you'll dominate it.

translation.text: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin is lurking at the door; its desire is for you, but you must master it."

verses.english:
And Cain said to his brother Abel.
And it was while they were in the field,
and Cain rose against Abel his brother
and killed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹתָם בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּקם קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹתָם בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּקם קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ

english.text:
And Cain said to his brother Abel.
And it was while they were in the field,
and Cain rose against Abel his brother
and killed him.

translation.text: Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let us go out to the field." And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel, and killed him.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Cain,
“Where is Abel your brother?”
And he said, “I don’t know.
Am I my brother’s watchman?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קַיִן אֵי הֶבֶל אָחִיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵר אָחִי אָנֹכִי

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קַיִן אֵי הֶבֶל אָחִיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵר אָחִי אָנֹכִי

english.text:
And YHWH said to Cain,
“Where is Abel your brother?”
And he said, “I don’t know.
Am I my brother’s watchman?”

translation.text: Then the LORD said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" He said, "I do not know; am I my brother's keeper?"

verses.english:
And He said, “What have you done? The sound!
Your brother’s blood is crying to me from the ground!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָ קוֹל דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ צֹעֲקִים אֵלַי מִן הָאֲדָמָה

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָ קוֹל דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ צֹעֲקִים אֵלַי מִן הָאֲדָמָה

english.text:
And He said, “What have you done? The sound!
Your brother’s blood is crying to me from the ground!

translation.text: And the LORD said, from the ground!

verses.english:
And now you’re cursed from the ground that opened its mouth
to take your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אָרוּר אָתָּה מִן הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר פָּצְתָה אֶת פִּיהָ לָקַחַת אֶת דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ מִיָּדֶךָ

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אָרוּר אָתָּה מִן הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר פָּצְתָה אֶת פִּיהָ לָקַחַת אֶת דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ מִיָּדֶךָ

english.text:
And now you’re cursed from the ground that opened its mouth
to take your brother’s blood from your hand.

translation.text: And now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.

verses.english:
When you work the ground it won’t continue to give its potency to you.
You’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֹסֵף תֵּת כֹּחָהּ לָךְ נָע וָנָד תִּהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֹסֵף תֵּת כֹּחָהּ לָךְ נָע וָנָד תִּהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ

english.text:
When you work the ground it won’t continue to give its potency to you.
You’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth.”

translation.text: When you till the ground, it will no longer yield to you its strength; you will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth."

verses.english: And Cain said to YHWH, “My crime is greater than I can bear.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל יְהֹוָה גָּדוֹל עֲוֺנִי מִנְּשֹׂא

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל יְהֹוָה גָּדוֹל עֲוֺנִי מִנְּשֹׂא

english.text: And Cain said to YHWH, “My crime is greater than I can bear.

translation.text: Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment is greater than I can bear!

verses.english:
Here, you’ve expelled me from the face of the ground today
and I’ll be hidden from your presence,
and I’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth,
and anyone who finds me will kill me.”
verses.hebrew: הֵן גֵּרַשְׁתָּ אֹתִי הַיּוֹם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּמִפָּנֶיךָ אֶסָּתֵר וְהָיִיתִי נָע וָנָד בָּאָרֶץ וְהָיָה כל מֹצְאִי יַהַרְגֵנִי

hebrew.text: הֵן גֵּרַשְׁתָּ אֹתִי הַיּוֹם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּמִפָּנֶיךָ אֶסָּתֵר וְהָיִיתִי נָע וָנָד בָּאָרֶץ וְהָיָה כל מֹצְאִי יַהַרְגֵנִי

english.text:
Here, you’ve expelled me from the face of the ground today
and I’ll be hidden from your presence,
and I’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth,
and anyone who finds me will kill me.”

translation.text: Today you have meets me may kill me."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him,
“Therefore: anyone who kills Cain,
he’ll be avenged sevenfold.”
And YHWH set a sign for Cain
so that anyone who finds him would not strike him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה לָכֵן כּל הֹרֵג קַיִן שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקָּם וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה לְקַיִן אוֹת לְבִלְתִּי הַכּוֹת אֹתוֹ כּל מֹצְאוֹ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה לָכֵן כּל הֹרֵג קַיִן שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקָּם וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה לְקַיִן אוֹת לְבִלְתִּי הַכּוֹת אֹתוֹ כּל מֹצְאוֹ

english.text:
And YHWH said to him,
“Therefore: anyone who kills Cain,
he’ll be avenged sevenfold.”
And YHWH set a sign for Cain
so that anyone who finds him would not strike him.

translation.text: Then the LORD said to him, "Not so! put a mark on Cain, so that no one who came upon him would kill him.

verses.english:
And Cain went out from YHWH’s presence
and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא קַיִן מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ נוֹד קִדְמַת עֵדֶן

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא קַיִן מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ נוֹד קִדְמַת עֵדֶן

english.text:
And Cain went out from YHWH’s presence
and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

translation.text: Then Cain went away from the presence of the LORD, and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

verses.english:
And Cain knew his wife,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch.
And he was a builder of a city,
and he called the name of the city
like the name of his son: Enoch.

\hJקַיִן
אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ וַיְהִי בֹּנֶה עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר כְּשֵׁם בְּנוֹ חֲנוֹךְ

hebrew.text: וַ יָדַע קַיִן אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ וַיְהִי בֹּנֶה עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר כְּשֵׁם בְּנוֹ חֲנוֹךְ

english.text:
And Cain knew his wife,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch.
And he was a builder of a city,
and he called the name of the city
like the name of his son: Enoch.

translation.text: Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch; and he built a city, and named it Enoch after his son Enoch.

verses.english:
And Irad was born to Enoch,
and Irad fathered Mehuya-el,
and Mehuya-el fathered Metusha-el,
and Metusha-el fathered Lamech.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלֵד לַחֲנוֹךְ אֶת עִירָד וְעִירָד יָלַד אֶת מְחוּיָאֵל וּמְחִויאֵל יָלַד אֶת מְתוּשָׁאֵל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵל יָלַד אֶת לָמֶךְ

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּלֵד לַחֲנוֹךְ אֶת עִירָד וְעִירָד יָלַד אֶת מְחוּיָאֵל וּמְחִויאֵל יָלַד אֶת מְתוּשָׁאֵל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵל יָלַד אֶת לָמֶךְ

english.text:
And Irad was born to Enoch,
and Irad fathered Mehuya-el,
and Mehuya-el fathered Metusha-el,
and Metusha-el fathered Lamech.

translation.text: To Enoch was born Methushael, and Methushael the father of Lamech.

verses.english:
And Lamech took two wives.
The one’s name was Adah,
and the second’s name was Zillah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ לֶמֶךְ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם הָאַחַת עָדָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית צִלָּה

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ לֶמֶךְ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם הָאַחַת עָדָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית צִלָּה

english.text:
And Lamech took two wives.
The one’s name was Adah,
and the second’s name was Zillah.

translation.text: Lamech took Zillah.

verses.english:
And Adah gave birth to Jabal.
He was father of tent-dweller and cattleman.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה אֶת יָבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי יֹשֵׁב אֹהֶל וּמִקְנֶה

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה אֶת יָבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי יֹשֵׁב אֹהֶל וּמִקְנֶה

english.text:
And Adah gave birth to Jabal.
He was father of tent-dweller and cattleman.

translation.text: Adah bore Jabal; he was the ancestor of those who live in tents and have livestock.

verses.english:
And his brother’s name was Jubal.
He was father of every player of lyre and pipe.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יוּבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי כּל תֹּפֵשׂ כִּנּוֹר וְעוּגָב

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יוּבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי כּל תֹּפֵשׂ כִּנּוֹר וְעוּגָב

english.text:
And his brother’s name was Jubal.
He was father of every player of lyre and pipe.

translation.text: His brother's name was Jubal; he was the ancestor of all those who play the lyre and pipe.

verses.english:
And Zillah, too, gave birth to Tubal-Cain,
forger of every implement of bronze and iron.
And Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.
verses.hebrew: וְצִלָּה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה אֶת תּוּבַל קַיִן לֹטֵשׁ כּל חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל וַאֲחוֹת תּוּבַל קַיִן נַעֲמָה

hebrew.text: וְצִלָּה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה אֶת תּוּבַל קַיִן לֹטֵשׁ כּל חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל וַאֲחוֹת תּוּבַל קַיִן נַעֲמָה

english.text:
And Zillah, too, gave birth to Tubal-Cain,
forger of every implement of bronze and iron.
And Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.

translation.text: Zillah bore Tubalcain, who made all kinds of bronze and iron tools. The sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

verses.english:
And Lamech said to his wives:
Adah and Zillah, listen to my voice,
Wives of Lamech, hear what I say.
For I’ve killed a man for a wound to me
And a boy for a hurt to me,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֶמֶךְ לְנָשָׁיו עָדָה וְצִלָּה שְׁמַעַן קוֹלִי נְשֵׁי לֶמֶךְ הַאְזֵנָּה אִמְרָתִי כִּי אִישׁ הָרַגְתִּי לְפִצְעִי וְיֶלֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִי

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֶמֶךְ לְנָשָׁיו עָדָה וְצִלָּה שְׁמַעַן קוֹלִי נְשֵׁי לֶמֶךְ הַאְזֵנָּה אִמְרָתִי כִּי אִישׁ הָרַגְתִּי לְפִצְעִי וְיֶלֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִי

english.text:
And Lamech said to his wives:
Adah and Zillah, listen to my voice,
Wives of Lamech, hear what I say.
For I’ve killed a man for a wound to me
And a boy for a hurt to me,

translation.text: Lamech said to his wives: "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; you wives of Lamech, listen to what I say: a young man for striking me.

verses.english:
For Cain will be avenged sevenfold
And Lamech seventy-seven.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקַּם קָיִן וְלֶמֶךְ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה

hebrew.text: כִּי שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקַּם קָיִן וְלֶמֶךְ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה

english.text:
For Cain will be avenged sevenfold
And Lamech seventy-seven.

translation.text: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy-sevenfold."

verses.english:
And Adam knew his wife again,
and she gave birth to a son,
and she called his name Seth
“because God put another seed for me
in place of Abel because Cain killed him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע אָדָם עוֹד אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת כִּי שָׁת לִי אֱלֹהִים זֶרַע אַחֵר תַּחַת הֶבֶל כִּי הֲרָגוֹ קָיִן

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע אָדָם עוֹד אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת כִּי שָׁת לִי אֱלֹהִים זֶרַע אַחֵר תַּחַת הֶבֶל כִּי הֲרָגוֹ קָיִן

english.text:
And Adam knew his wife again,
and she gave birth to a son,
and she called his name Seth
“because God put another seed for me
in place of Abel because Cain killed him.”

translation.text: Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, because Cain killed him."

verses.english:
And a son was born to Seth, him as well,
and he called his name Enosh.

Then it was begun to invoke the name YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וּלְשֵׁת גַּם הוּא יֻלַּד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ
אָז הוּחַל לִקְרֹא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה

hebrew.text: וּלְשֵׁת גַּם הוּא יֻלַּד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ
אָז הוּחַל לִקְרֹא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה

english.text:
And a son was born to Seth, him as well,
and he called his name Enosh.
Then it was begun to invoke the name YHWH.

verses.translation: To Seth also a son was born, and he the LORD.

verses.english:
This is the Book of Records of the Human. In the day of
God’s creating a human, He made it in the likeness of God.
verses.hebrew: זֶה סֵפֶר תּוֹלְדֹת אָדָם בְּיוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם בִּדְמוּת אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֶה סֵפֶר תּוֹלְדֹת אָדָם בְּיוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם בִּדְמוּת אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
This is the Book of Records of the Human. In the day of
God’s creating a human, He made it in the likeness of God.

translation.text: This is the list of the descendants of Adam. When God created humankind, he made them in the likeness of God.

verses.english:
He created them male and female, and He blessed them and
called their name “Human” in the day of their being
created.
verses.hebrew: זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בְּרָאָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָם אָדָם בְּיוֹם הִבָּרְאָם׃

hebrew.text: זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בְּרָאָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָם אָדָם בְּיוֹם הִבָּרְאָם׃

english.text:
He created them male and female, and He blessed them and
called their name “Human” in the day of their being
created.

translation.text: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them "Humankind" when they were created.

verses.english:
And the human lived a hundred thirty years, and he
fathered in his likeness—like his image—and called his
name Seth.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אָדָם שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בִּדְמוּתוֹ כְּצַלְמוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אָדָם שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בִּדְמוּתוֹ כְּצַלְמוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת׃

english.text:
And the human lived a hundred thirty years, and he
fathered in his likeness—like his image—and called his
name Seth.

translation.text: When Adam had lived one hundred thirty years, he became the Seth.

verses.english:
And the human’s days after his fathering Seth were eight
hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי אָדָם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שֵׁת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי אָדָם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שֵׁת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And the human’s days after his fathering Seth were eight
hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years; and he had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of the human’s days that he lived were nine
hundred years and thirty years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי אָדָם אֲשֶׁר חַי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי אָדָם אֲשֶׁר חַי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of the human’s days that he lived were nine
hundred years and thirty years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years; and he died.

verses.english:
And Seth lived five years and a hundred years, and he
fathered Enosh.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי שֵׁת חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי שֵׁת חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ׃

english.text:
And Seth lived five years and a hundred years, and he
fathered Enosh.

translation.text: When Seth had lived one hundred five years, he became the father of Enosh.

verses.english:
And Seth lived after his fathering Enosh seven years and
eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי שֵׁת אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי שֵׁת אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Seth lived after his fathering Enosh seven years and
eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: Seth lived after the birth of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Seth’s days were twelve years and nine hundred
years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי שֵׁת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי שֵׁת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Seth’s days were twelve years and nine hundred
years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years; and he died.

verses.english: And Enosh lived ninety years, and he fathered Cainan.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אֱנוֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת קֵינָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אֱנוֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת קֵינָן׃

english.text: And Enosh lived ninety years, and he fathered Cainan.

translation.text: When Enosh had lived ninety years, he became the father of Kenan.

verses.english:
And Enosh lived after his fathering Cainan fifteen years
and eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אֱנוֹשׁ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת קֵינָן חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אֱנוֹשׁ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת קֵינָן חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Enosh lived after his fathering Cainan fifteen years
and eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: Enosh lived after the birth of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Enosh’s days were five years and nine hundred
years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Enosh’s days were five years and nine hundred
years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years; and he died.

verses.english: And Cainan lived seventy years, and he fathered Mahalalel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי קֵינָן שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת מַהֲלַלְאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי קֵינָן שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת מַהֲלַלְאֵל׃

english.text: And Cainan lived seventy years, and he fathered Mahalalel.

translation.text: When Kenan had lived seventy years, he became the father of Mahalalel.

verses.english:
And Cainan lived after his fathering Mahalalel forty years
and eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי קֵינָן אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת מַהֲלַלְאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי קֵינָן אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת מַהֲלַלְאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Cainan lived after his fathering Mahalalel forty years
and eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: Kenan lived after the birth of Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Cainan’s days were ten years and nine hundred
years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי קֵינָן עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי קֵינָן עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Cainan’s days were ten years and nine hundred
years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.

verses.english:
And Mahalalel lived five years and sixty years, and he
fathered Jared.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי מַהֲלַלְאֵל חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת יָרֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי מַהֲלַלְאֵל חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת יָרֶד׃

english.text:
And Mahalalel lived five years and sixty years, and he
fathered Jared.

translation.text: When Mahalalel had lived sixty-five years, he became the father of Jared.

verses.english:
And Mahalalel lived after his fathering Jared thirty years
and eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי מַהֲלַלְאֵל אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת יֶרֶד שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי מַהֲלַלְאֵל אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת יֶרֶד שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Mahalalel lived after his fathering Jared thirty years
and eight hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: Mahalalel lived after the birth of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Mahalalel’s days were ninety-five years and
eight hundred years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Mahalalel’s days were ninety-five years and
eight hundred years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years; and he died.

verses.english:
And Jared lived sixty-two years and a hundred years, and
he fathered Enoch.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי יֶרֶד שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי יֶרֶד שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ׃

english.text:
And Jared lived sixty-two years and a hundred years, and
he fathered Enoch.

translation.text: When Jared had lived one hundred sixty-two years he became the father of Enoch.

verses.english:
And Jared lived after his fathering Enoch eight hundred
years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי יֶרֶד אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת חֲנוֹךְ שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי יֶרֶד אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת חֲנוֹךְ שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Jared lived after his fathering Enoch eight hundred
years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: Jared lived after the birth of Enoch eight hundred years, and had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Jared’s days were sixty-two years and nine
hundred years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Jared’s days were sixty-two years and nine
hundred years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years; and he died.

verses.english:
And Enoch lived sixty-five years, and he fathered
Methuselah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת מְתוּשָׁלַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת מְתוּשָׁלַח׃

english.text:
And Enoch lived sixty-five years, and he fathered
Methuselah.

translation.text: When Enoch had lived sixty-five years, he became the father of Methuselah.

verses.english:
And Enoch walked with God after his fathering Methuselah
three hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ חֲנוֹךְ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת מְתוּשֶׁלַח שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ חֲנוֹךְ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת מְתוּשֶׁלַח שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Enoch walked with God after his fathering Methuselah
three hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: Enoch walked with God after the birth of Methuselah three hundred years, and had other sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Enoch’s days were sixty-five years and three
hundred years.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And all of Enoch’s days were sixty-five years and three
hundred years.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

verses.english:
And Enoch walked with God, and he was not, because God
took him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ חֲנוֹךְ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֵינֶנּוּ כִּי לָקַח אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ חֲנוֹךְ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֵינֶנּוּ כִּי לָקַח אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Enoch walked with God, and he was not, because God
took him.

translation.text: Enoch walked with God; then he was no more, because God took him.

verses.english:
And Methuselah lived eighty-seven years and a hundred
years, and he fathered Lamech.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי מְתוּשֶׁלַח שֶׁבַע וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת לָמֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי מְתוּשֶׁלַח שֶׁבַע וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת לָמֶךְ׃

english.text:
And Methuselah lived eighty-seven years and a hundred
years, and he fathered Lamech.

translation.text: When Methuselah had lived one hundred eighty-seven years, he became the father of Lamech.

verses.english:
And Methuselah lived after his fathering Lamech eighty-two
years and seven hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי מְתוּשֶׁלַח אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת לֶמֶךְ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי מְתוּשֶׁלַח אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת לֶמֶךְ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Methuselah lived after his fathering Lamech eighty-two
years and seven hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: Methuselah lived after the birth of daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Methuselah’s days were sixty-nine years and
nine hundred years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי מְתוּשֶׁלַח תֵּשַׁע וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי מְתוּשֶׁלַח תֵּשַׁע וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Methuselah’s days were sixty-nine years and
nine hundred years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixtynine years; and he died.

verses.english:
And Lamech lived eighty-two years and a hundred years, and
he fathered a son
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי לֶמֶךְ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי לֶמֶךְ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בֵּן׃

english.text:
And Lamech lived eighty-two years and a hundred years, and
he fathered a son

translation.text: When Lamech had lived one hundred eighty-two years, he became the father of a son;

verses.english:
and called his name Noah, saying, “This one will console
us from our labor and from our hands’ suffering from the
ground, which YHWH has cursed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ נֹחַ לֵאמֹר זֶה יְנַחֲמֵנוּ מִמַּעֲשֵׂנוּ וּמֵעִצְּבוֹן יָדֵינוּ מִן הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אֵרְרָהּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ נֹחַ לֵאמֹר זֶה יְנַחֲמֵנוּ מִמַּעֲשֵׂנוּ וּמֵעִצְּבוֹן יָדֵינוּ מִן הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אֵרְרָהּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and called his name Noah, saying, “This one will console
us from our labor and from our hands’ suffering from the
ground, which YHWH has cursed.”

translation.text: he named him Noah, saying, "Out of the ground and from the toil of our hands."

verses.english:
And Lamech lived after his fathering Noah ninety-five
years and five hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי לֶמֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת נֹחַ חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי לֶמֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת נֹחַ חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Lamech lived after his fathering Noah ninety-five
years and five hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: Lamech lived after the birth of daughters.

verses.english:
And all of Lamech’s days were seventy-seven years and
seven hundred years. And he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל יְמֵי לֶמֶךְ שֶׁבַע וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל יְמֵי לֶמֶךְ שֶׁבַע וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Lamech’s days were seventy-seven years and
seven hundred years. And he died.

translation.text: Thus all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventyseven years; and he died.

verses.english:
And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah fathered
Shem, Ham, and Yaphet.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי נֹחַ בֶּן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָפֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי נֹחַ בֶּן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָפֶת׃

english.text:
And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah fathered
Shem, Ham, and Yaphet.

translation.text: After Noah was five hundred years old, Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.english:
And it was when humankind began to multiply on the face of the ground
and daughters were born to them:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי הֵחֵל הָאָדָם לָרֹב עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּבָנוֹת יֻלְּדוּ לָהֶם

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי הֵחֵל הָאָדָם לָרֹב עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּבָנוֹת יֻלְּדוּ לָהֶם

english.text:
And it was when humankind began to multiply on the face of the ground
and daughters were born to them:

translation.text: When people began to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

verses.english:
and the sons of the gods saw the daughters of humankind,
that they were attractive,
and they took women, from all they chose.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנוֹת הָאָדָם כִּי טֹבֹת הֵנָּה וַיִּקְחוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרוּ

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנוֹת הָאָדָם כִּי טֹבֹת הֵנָּה וַיִּקְחוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרוּ

english.text:
and the sons of the gods saw the daughters of humankind,
that they were attractive,
and they took women, from all they chose.

translation.text: the sons of God saw that they were fair; and they took wives for themselves of all that they chose.

verses.english:
And YHWH said,
“My spirit won’t stay in humankind forever,
since they’re also flesh;
and their days shall be a hundred twenty years.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לֹא יָדוֹן רוּחִי בָאָדָם לְעֹלָם בְּשַׁגַּם הוּא בָשָׂר וְהָיוּ יָמָיו מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה

And YHWH saw that human bad was multiplied in the earth,
and every inclination of their heart’s thoughts
was only bad all the day.

english.text:
And YHWH saw that human bad was multiplied in the earth,
and every inclination of their heart’s thoughts
was only bad all the day.

translation.text: The LORD saw that the wickedness of humankind was great in the only evil continually.

verses.english:
And YHWH regretted that He had made humankind in the earth.
And He was grieved to His heart.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה כִּי עָשָׂה אֶת הָאָדָם בָּאָרֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּב אֶל לִבּוֹ

english.text:
And YHWH regretted that He had made humankind in the earth.
And He was grieved to His heart.

translation.text: And the LORD was sorry that he had made humankind on the earth, and it grieved him to his heart.

verses.english:
And YHWH said,
“I’ll wipe out the human whom I’ve created from the face of the earth,
from human to animal to creeping thing,
and to the bird of the skies,
because I regret that I made them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶמְחֶה אֶת הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָאתִי מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָה עַד רֶמֶשׂ וְעַד עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי נִחַמְתִּי כִּי עֲשִׂיתִם

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶמְחֶה אֶת הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָאתִי מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָה עַד רֶמֶשׂ וְעַד עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי נִחַמְתִּי כִּי עֲשִׂיתִם

And YHWH said,
“I’ll wipe out the human whom I’ve created from the face of the earth,
from human to animal to creeping thing,
and to the bird of the skies,
because I regret that I made them.”

translation.text: So the LORD said, "I will blot out from the earth the human beings I have created — for I am sorry that I have made them."

english.text: But Noah had found favor in YHWH’s eyes.

translation.text: But Noah found favor in the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
These are the records of Noah:
Noah was a virtuous man.
He was unblemished in his generations.
Noah walked with God.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת נֹחַ נֹחַ אִישׁ צַדִּיק תָּמִים הָיָה בְּדֹרֹתָיו אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים הִתְהַלֶּךְ נֹחַ

english.text:
These are the records of Noah:
Noah was a virtuous man.
He was unblemished in his generations.
Noah walked with God.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.

verses.english:
And Noah fathered three sons:
Shem, Ham, and Yaphet.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָפֶת

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָפֶת

english.text:
And Noah fathered three sons:
Shem, Ham, and Yaphet.

translation.text: And Noah had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.english:
And the earth was corrupted before God,
and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָס

hebrew.text: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָס

english.text:
And the earth was corrupted before God,
and the earth was filled with violence.

translation.text: Now the earth was corrupt in God's sight, and the earth was filled with violence.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה נִשְׁחָתָה כִּי הִשְׁחִית כּל בָּשָׂר אֶת דַּרְכּוֹ עַל הָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה נִשְׁחָתָה כִּי הִשְׁחִית כּל בָּשָׂר אֶת דַּרְכּוֹ עַל הָאָרֶץ

translation.text: And God saw that the earth was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon the earth.

verses.english:
And God said to Noah,
“The end of all flesh has come before me,
because the earth is filled with violence because of them.
And here: I’m destroying them with the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים לְנֹחַ קֵץ כּל בָּשָׂר בָּא לְפָנַי כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חָמָס מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְהִנְנִי מַשְׁחִיתָם אֶת הָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים לְנֹחַ קֵץ כּל בָּשָׂר בָּא לְפָנַי כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חָמָס מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְהִנְנִי מַשְׁחִיתָם אֶת הָאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God said to Noah,
“The end of all flesh has come before me,
because the earth is filled with violence because of them.
And here: I’m destroying them with the earth.

translation.text: And God said to Noah, "I have determined to make an end of all flesh, for the earth is filled with the earth.

verses.english:
Make yourself an ark of gopher wood,
make rooms with the ark,
and pitch it outside and inside with pitch.
verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ תֵּבַת עֲצֵי גֹפֶר קִנִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת הַתֵּבָה וְכָפַרְתָּ אֹתָהּ מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ בַּכֹּפֶר

hebrew.text: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ תֵּבַת עֲצֵי גֹפֶר קִנִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת הַתֵּבָה וְכָפַרְתָּ אֹתָהּ מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ בַּכֹּפֶר

english.text:
Make yourself an ark of gopher wood,
make rooms with the ark,
and pitch it outside and inside with pitch.

translation.text: Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and out with pitch.

verses.english:
And this is how you shall make it:
three hundred cubits the length of the ark,
fifty cubits its width,
and thirty cubits its height.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַתֵּבָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ

hebrew.text: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַתֵּבָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ

english.text:
And this is how you shall make it:
three hundred cubits the length of the ark,
fifty cubits its width,
and thirty cubits its height.

translation.text: This is how you are to cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

verses.english:
You shall make a window for the ark,
and you shall finish it to a cubit from the top,
and you shall make the ark’s entrance in its side.
You shall make lower, second, and third stories for it.
verses.hebrew: צֹהַר תַּעֲשֶׂה לַתֵּבָה וְאֶל אַמָּה תְּכַלֶּנָּה מִלְמַעְלָה וּפֶתַח הַתֵּבָה בְּצִדָּהּ תָּשִׂים תַּחְתִּיִּים שְׁנִיִּם וּשְׁלִשִׁים תַּעֲשֶׂהָ

hebrew.text: צֹהַר תַּעֲשֶׂה לַתֵּבָה וְאֶל אַמָּה תְּכַלֶּנָּה מִלְמַעְלָה וּפֶתַח הַתֵּבָה בְּצִדָּהּ תָּשִׂים תַּחְתִּיִּים שְׁנִיִּם וּשְׁלִשִׁים תַּעֲשֶׂהָ

english.text:
You shall make a window for the ark,
and you shall finish it to a cubit from the top,
and you shall make the ark’s entrance in its side.
You shall make lower, second, and third stories for it.

translation.text: Make a roof for the ark, and finish it to a cubit above; and put the door of the ark in its side; make it with lower, second, and third decks.

verses.english:
And I, here: I’m bringing the flood, water on the earth,
to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life from under the skies.
Everything that is in the earth will expire.

english.text:
And I, here: I’m bringing the flood, water on the earth,
to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life from under the skies.
Everything that is in the earth will expire.

translation.text: For my part, I am going to flesh in which is the breath of life; everything that is on the earth shall die.

verses.english:
And I shall establish my covenant with you.
And you’ll come to the ark,
you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

english.text:
And I shall establish my covenant with you.
And you’ll come to the ark,
you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

translation.text: But I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall come into the ark, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives with you.

verses.english:
And of all the living, of all flesh,
you shall bring two of each to the ark
to keep alive with you.
They shall be male and female.
verses.hebrew: וּמִכּל הָחַי מִכּל בָּשָׂר שְׁנַיִם מִכֹּל תָּבִיא אֶל הַתֵּבָה לְהַחֲיֹת אִתָּךְ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה יִהְיוּ

hebrew.text: וּמִכּל הָחַי מִכּל בָּשָׂר שְׁנַיִם מִכֹּל תָּבִיא אֶל הַתֵּבָה לְהַחֲיֹת אִתָּךְ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה יִהְיוּ

english.text:
And of all the living, of all flesh,
you shall bring two of each to the ark
to keep alive with you.
They shall be male and female.

translation.text: And of every living thing, of all flesh, you shall bring two of every female.

verses.english:
Of the birds by their kind
and of the domestic animals by their kind,
of all the creeping things of the ground by their kind,
two of each will come to you to keep alive.
verses.hebrew: מֵהָעוֹף לְמִינֵהוּ וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ מִכֹּל רֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ שְׁנַיִם מִכֹּל יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ לְהַחֲיוֹת

hebrew.text: מֵהָעוֹף לְמִינֵהוּ וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ מִכֹּל רֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ שְׁנַיִם מִכֹּל יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ לְהַחֲיוֹת

english.text:
Of the birds by their kind
and of the domestic animals by their kind,
of all the creeping things of the ground by their kind,
two of each will come to you to keep alive.

translation.text: Of the birds according to their kinds, and of the animals them alive.

verses.english:
And you, take some of every food that will be eaten
and gather it to you,
and it will be for you and for them for food.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קַח לְךָ מִכּל מַאֲכָל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְאָסַפְתָּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהָיָה לְךָ וְלָהֶם לְאכְלָה

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה קַח לְךָ מִכּל מַאֲכָל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְאָסַפְתָּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהָיָה לְךָ וְלָהֶם לְאכְלָה

english.text:
And you, take some of every food that will be eaten
and gather it to you,
and it will be for you and for them for food.”

translation.text: Also take with you every kind of food that is eaten, and store it up; and it shall serve as food for you and for them."

verses.english:
And Noah did it.
According to everything that God commanded him,
he did so.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ נֹחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן עָשָׂה

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ נֹחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן עָשָׂה

english.text:
And Noah did it.
According to everything that God commanded him,
he did so.

translation.text: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Noah, “Come, you and all your
household, into an ark, for I’ve seen you as virtuous in
front of me in this generation.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לְנֹחַ בֹּא אַתָּה וְכל בֵּיתְךָ אֶל הַתֵּבָה כִּי אֹתְךָ רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק לְפָנַי בַּדּוֹר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לְנֹחַ בֹּא אַתָּה וְכל בֵּיתְךָ אֶל הַתֵּבָה כִּי אֹתְךָ רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק לְפָנַי בַּדּוֹר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Noah, “Come, you and all your
household, into an ark, for I’ve seen you as virtuous in
front of me in this generation.

translation.text: Then the LORD said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and all your this generation.

verses.english:
Of all the pure animals, take seven pairs, man and his
woman; and of the animals that are not pure, two, man and
his woman.
verses.hebrew: מִכֹּל הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהוֹרָה תִּקַּח לְךָ שִׁבְעָה שִׁבְעָה אִישׁ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא טְהֹרָה הִוא שְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: מִכֹּל הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהוֹרָה תִּקַּח לְךָ שִׁבְעָה שִׁבְעָה אִישׁ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא טְהֹרָה הִוא שְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Of all the pure animals, take seven pairs, man and his
woman; and of the animals that are not pure, two, man and
his woman.

translation.text: Take with you seven pairs of all clean animals, the male and its mate;

verses.english:
Also of the birds of the skies seven pairs, male and
female, to keep seed alive on the face of the earth.
verses.hebrew: גַּם מֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם שִׁבְעָה שִׁבְעָה זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה לְחַיּוֹת זֶרַע עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם מֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם שִׁבְעָה שִׁבְעָה זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה לְחַיּוֹת זֶרַע עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Also of the birds of the skies seven pairs, male and
female, to keep seed alive on the face of the earth.

translation.text: and seven pairs of the birds of the air also, male and female, to keep their kind alive on the face of all the earth.

verses.english:
Because in seven more days I’ll rain on the earth, forty
days and forty nights, and I’ll wipe out all the substance
that I’ve made from on the face of the earth.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לְיָמִים עוֹד שִׁבְעָה אָנֹכִי מַמְטִיר עַל הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה וּמָחִיתִי אֶת כּל הַיְקוּם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לְיָמִים עוֹד שִׁבְעָה אָנֹכִי מַמְטִיר עַל הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה וּמָחִיתִי אֶת כּל הַיְקוּם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Because in seven more days I’ll rain on the earth, forty
days and forty nights, and I’ll wipe out all the substance
that I’ve made from on the face of the earth.”

translation.text: For nights; and every living thing that I have made I will blot out from the face of the ground."

verses.english: And Noah did according to all that YHWH had commanded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ נֹחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ נֹחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: And Noah did according to all that YHWH had commanded him.

translation.text: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.

verses.english:
And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood was,
water on the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹחַ בֶּן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וְהַמַּבּוּל הָיָה מַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֹחַ בֶּן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וְהַמַּבּוּל הָיָה מַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood was,
water on the earth.

translation.text: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

verses.english:
And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives
with him came to the ark from before the waters of the
flood.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא נֹחַ וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּנְשֵׁי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ אֶל הַתֵּבָה מִפְּנֵי מֵי הַמַּבּוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא נֹחַ וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּנְשֵׁי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ אֶל הַתֵּבָה מִפְּנֵי מֵי הַמַּבּוּל׃

english.text:
And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives
with him came to the ark from before the waters of the
flood.

translation.text: And Noah with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives went into the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

verses.english:
Of the animals that were pure and of the animals that were
not pure, and of the birds and every one that creeps on
the ground,
verses.hebrew: מִן הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהוֹרָה וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנָּה טְהֹרָה וּמִן הָעוֹף וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר רֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: מִן הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהוֹרָה וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנָּה טְהֹרָה וּמִן הָעוֹף וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר רֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Of the animals that were pure and of the animals that were
not pure, and of the birds and every one that creeps on
the ground,

translation.text: Of clean animals, and of animals that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creeps on the ground,

verses.english:
they came by twos to Noah, to the ark, male and female, as
God had commanded Noah.
verses.hebrew: שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם בָּאוּ אֶל נֹחַ אֶל הַתֵּבָה זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֱלֹהִים אֶת נֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם בָּאוּ אֶל נֹחַ אֶל הַתֵּבָה זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֱלֹהִים אֶת נֹחַ׃

english.text:
they came by twos to Noah, to the ark, male and female, as
God had commanded Noah.

translation.text: two and two, male and female, went into the ark with Noah, as God had commanded Noah.

verses.english:
And seven days later the waters of the flood were on the
earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְשִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וּמֵי הַמַּבּוּל הָיוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לְשִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וּמֵי הַמַּבּוּל הָיוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And seven days later the waters of the flood were on the
earth.

translation.text: And after seven days the waters of the flood came on the earth.

verses.english:
In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second
month, in the seventeenth day of the month, on this day
all the fountains of the great deep were split open, and
the apertures of the skies were opened.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְחַיֵּי נֹחַ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִבְקְעוּ כּל מַעְיְנֹת תְּהוֹם רַבָּה וַאֲרֻבֹּת הַשָּׁמַיִם נִפְתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְחַיֵּי נֹחַ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִבְקְעוּ כּל מַעְיְנֹת תְּהוֹם רַבָּה וַאֲרֻבֹּת הַשָּׁמַיִם נִפְתָּחוּ׃

english.text:
In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second
month, in the seventeenth day of the month, on this day
all the fountains of the great deep were split open, and
the apertures of the skies were opened.

translation.text: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the great deep burst forth, and the windows of the heavens were opened.

verses.english:
And there was rain on the earth, forty days and forty
nights.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגֶּשֶׁם עַל הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַגֶּשֶׁם עַל הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
And there was rain on the earth, forty days and forty
nights.

translation.text: The rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.english:
In this very day Noah came, and Shem and Ham and Yaphet,
Noah’s sons, and Noah’s wife and his sons’ three wives
with them to the ark,
verses.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּא נֹחַ וְשֵׁם וְחָם וָיֶפֶת בְּנֵי נֹחַ וְאֵשֶׁת נֹחַ וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת נְשֵׁי בָנָיו אִתָּם אֶל הַתֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּא נֹחַ וְשֵׁם וְחָם וָיֶפֶת בְּנֵי נֹחַ וְאֵשֶׁת נֹחַ וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת נְשֵׁי בָנָיו אִתָּם אֶל הַתֵּבָה׃

english.text:
In this very day Noah came, and Shem and Ham and Yaphet,
Noah’s sons, and Noah’s wife and his sons’ three wives
with them to the ark,

translation.text: On the very wife and the three wives of his sons entered the ark,

verses.english:
they and all the wild animals by their kind and all the
domestic animals by their kind and all the creeping
animals that creep on the earth by their kind and all the
birds by their kind, all fowl, all winged things.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה וְכל הַחַיָּה לְמִינָהּ וְכל הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ וְכל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ לְמִינֵהוּ וְכל הָעוֹף לְמִינֵהוּ כֹּל צִפּוֹר כּל כָּנָף׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה וְכל הַחַיָּה לְמִינָהּ וְכל הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ וְכל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ לְמִינֵהוּ וְכל הָעוֹף לְמִינֵהוּ כֹּל צִפּוֹר כּל כָּנָף׃

english.text:
they and all the wild animals by their kind and all the
domestic animals by their kind and all the creeping
animals that creep on the earth by their kind and all the
birds by their kind, all fowl, all winged things.

translation.text: they and every kind — every bird, every winged creature.

verses.english:
And they came to Noah, to the ark, by twos of all flesh in
which was the breath of life,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל נֹחַ אֶל הַתֵּבָה שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם מִכּל הַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ רוּחַ חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל נֹחַ אֶל הַתֵּבָה שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם מִכּל הַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ רוּחַ חַיִּים׃

english.text:
And they came to Noah, to the ark, by twos of all flesh in
which was the breath of life,

translation.text: They went into the ark life.

verses.english:
and those that came were male and female; some from all
flesh came, as God had commanded him. And YHWH closed it
for him.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּאִים זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה מִכּל בָּשָׂר בָּאוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּסְגֹּר יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבָּאִים זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה מִכּל בָּשָׂר בָּאוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּסְגֹּר יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדוֹ׃

english.text:
and those that came were male and female; some from all
flesh came, as God had commanded him. And YHWH closed it
for him.

translation.text: And those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the LORD shut him in.

verses.english:
And the flood was on the earth for forty days, and the
waters multiplied and raised the ark, and it was lifted
from the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמַּבּוּל אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְבּוּ הַמַּיִם וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת הַתֵּבָה וַתָּרם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַמַּבּוּל אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְבּוּ הַמַּיִם וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת הַתֵּבָה וַתָּרם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the flood was on the earth for forty days, and the
waters multiplied and raised the ark, and it was lifted
from the earth.

translation.text: The flood continued forty days on the earth; and the waters increased, and bore up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.

verses.english:
And the waters grew strong and multiplied very much on the
earth, and the ark went on the face of the waters.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְבְּרוּ הַמַּיִם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד עַל הָאָרֶץ וַתֵּלֶךְ הַתֵּבָה עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְבְּרוּ הַמַּיִם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד עַל הָאָרֶץ וַתֵּלֶךְ הַתֵּבָה עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And the waters grew strong and multiplied very much on the
earth, and the ark went on the face of the waters.

translation.text: floated on the face of the waters.

verses.english:
And the waters had grown very, very strong on the earth,
so they covered all the high mountains that are under all
the skies.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּיִם גָּבְרוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיְכֻסּוּ כּל הֶהָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמַּיִם גָּבְרוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיְכֻסּוּ כּל הֶהָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And the waters had grown very, very strong on the earth,
so they covered all the high mountains that are under all
the skies.

translation.text: The waters swelled so mightily on covered;

verses.english:
Fifteen cubits above, the waters grew stronger, and they
covered the mountains.
verses.hebrew: חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה מִלְמַעְלָה גָּבְרוּ הַמָּיִם וַיְכֻסּוּ הֶהָרִים׃

hebrew.text: חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה מִלְמַעְלָה גָּבְרוּ הַמָּיִם וַיְכֻסּוּ הֶהָרִים׃

english.text:
Fifteen cubits above, the waters grew stronger, and they
covered the mountains.

translation.text: the waters swelled above the mountains, covering them fifteen cubits deep.

verses.english:
And all flesh that creep on the earth—of the birds and of
the domestic animals and of the wild animals and of all
the swarming creatures that swarm on the earth, and all
the humans—expired.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְוַע כּל בָּשָׂר הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ בָּעוֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבַחַיָּה וּבְכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ וְכֹל הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְוַע כּל בָּשָׂר הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ בָּעוֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבַחַיָּה וּבְכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ וְכֹל הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
And all flesh that creep on the earth—of the birds and of
the domestic animals and of the wild animals and of all
the swarming creatures that swarm on the earth, and all
the humans—expired.

translation.text: And all flesh died that moved on the earth, swarm on the earth, and all human beings;

verses.english:
Everything that had the breathing spirit of life in its
nostrils, everything that was on the ground, died.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַת רוּחַ חַיִּים בְּאַפָּיו מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בֶּחָרָבָה מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַת רוּחַ חַיִּים בְּאַפָּיו מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בֶּחָרָבָה מֵתוּ׃

english.text:
Everything that had the breathing spirit of life in its
nostrils, everything that was on the ground, died.

translation.text: everything on dry land in whose nostrils was the breath of life died.

verses.english:
And He wiped out all the substance that was on the face of
the earth, from human to animal to creeping thing and to
bird of the skies, and they were wiped out from the earth,
and just Noah and those who were with him in the ark were
left.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמַח אֶת כּל הַיְקוּם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָה עַד רֶמֶשׂ וְעַד עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיִּמָּחוּ מִן הָאָרֶץ וַיִּשָּׁאֶר אַךְ נֹחַ וַאֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמַח אֶת כּל הַיְקוּם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָה עַד רֶמֶשׂ וְעַד עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיִּמָּחוּ מִן הָאָרֶץ וַיִּשָּׁאֶר אַךְ נֹחַ וַאֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה׃

english.text:
And He wiped out all the substance that was on the face of
the earth, from human to animal to creeping thing and to
bird of the skies, and they were wiped out from the earth,
and just Noah and those who were with him in the ark were
left.

translation.text: He blotted out every animals and creeping things and birds of the air; they were blotted out the ark.

verses.english:
And the water grew strong on the earth a hundred fifty
days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְבְּרוּ הַמַּיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמְאַת יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְבְּרוּ הַמַּיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמְאַת יוֹם׃

english.text:
And the water grew strong on the earth a hundred fifty
days.

translation.text: And the waters swelled on the earth for one hundred fifty days.

verses.english:
And God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all
the domestic animals that were with him in the ark, and
God passed a wind over the earth, and the water decreased.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת נֹחַ וְאֵת כּל הַחַיָּה וְאֶת כּל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת נֹחַ וְאֵת כּל הַחַיָּה וְאֶת כּל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all
the domestic animals that were with him in the ark, and
God passed a wind over the earth, and the water decreased.

translation.text: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all the blow over the earth, and the waters subsided;

verses.english:
And the fountains of the deep and the apertures of the
skies were shut, and the rain was restrained from the
skies.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּכְרוּ מַעְיְנֹת תְּהוֹם וַאֲרֻבֹּת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּכָּלֵא הַגֶּשֶׁם מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסָּכְרוּ מַעְיְנֹת תְּהוֹם וַאֲרֻבֹּת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּכָּלֵא הַגֶּשֶׁם מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And the fountains of the deep and the apertures of the
skies were shut, and the rain was restrained from the
skies.

translation.text: the fountains of the heavens was restrained,

verses.english:
And the waters went back from on the earth, going back
continually, and the water receded at the end of a hundred
fifty days.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הָלוֹךְ וָשׁוֹב וַיַּחְסְרוּ הַמַּיִם מִקְצֵה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמְאַת יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הָלוֹךְ וָשׁוֹב וַיַּחְסְרוּ הַמַּיִם מִקְצֵה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמְאַת יוֹם׃

english.text:
And the waters went back from on the earth, going back
continually, and the water receded at the end of a hundred
fifty days.

translation.text: and the waters gradually receded from the earth. At the end of one hundred fifty days the waters had abated;

verses.english:
And the ark rested in the seventh month, in the
seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּנַח הַתֵּבָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ עַל הָרֵי אֲרָרָט׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּנַח הַתֵּבָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ עַל הָרֵי אֲרָרָט׃

english.text:
And the ark rested in the seventh month, in the
seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.

translation.text: ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

verses.english:
And the water went on receding until the tenth month. In
the tenth month, in the first of the month, the tops of
the mountains appeared.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּיִם הָיוּ הָלוֹךְ וְחָסוֹר עַד הַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בָּעֲשִׂירִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ נִרְאוּ רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמַּיִם הָיוּ הָלוֹךְ וְחָסוֹר עַד הַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בָּעֲשִׂירִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ נִרְאוּ רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים׃

english.text:
And the water went on receding until the tenth month. In
the tenth month, in the first of the month, the tops of
the mountains appeared.

translation.text: The waters continued to the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.

verses.english:
And it was at the end of forty days, and Noah opened the
window of the ark that he had made.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וַיִּפְתַּח נֹחַ אֶת חַלּוֹן הַתֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וַיִּפְתַּח נֹחַ אֶת חַלּוֹן הַתֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
And it was at the end of forty days, and Noah opened the
window of the ark that he had made.

translation.text: At the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made

verses.english:
And he let a raven go, and it went back and forth until
the water dried up from the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָעֹרֵב וַיֵּצֵא יָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב עַד יְבֹשֶׁת הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָעֹרֵב וַיֵּצֵא יָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב עַד יְבֹשֶׁת הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And he let a raven go, and it went back and forth until
the water dried up from the earth.

translation.text: and sent out the raven; and it went to and fro until the waters were dried up from the earth.

verses.english:
And he let a dove go from him to see whether the waters
had eased from the face of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה מֵאִתּוֹ לִרְאוֹת הֲקַלּוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה מֵאִתּוֹ לִרְאוֹת הֲקַלּוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And he let a dove go from him to see whether the waters
had eased from the face of the earth.

translation.text: Then he sent out the dove from him, to see if the waters had subsided from the face of the ground;

verses.english:
And the dove did not find a resting place for its foot,
and it came back to him to the ark, for waters were on the
face of the earth, and he put out his hand and took it and
brought it to him to the ark.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא מָצְאָה הַיּוֹנָה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלָהּ וַתָּשׁב אֵלָיו אֶל הַתֵּבָה כִּי מַיִם עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֵא אֹתָהּ אֵלָיו אֶל הַתֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא מָצְאָה הַיּוֹנָה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלָהּ וַתָּשׁב אֵלָיו אֶל הַתֵּבָה כִּי מַיִם עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֵא אֹתָהּ אֵלָיו אֶל הַתֵּבָה׃

english.text:
And the dove did not find a resting place for its foot,
and it came back to him to the ark, for waters were on the
face of the earth, and he put out his hand and took it and
brought it to him to the ark.

translation.text: the ark, for the waters were still on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took it and brought it into the ark with him.

verses.english:
And he waited still another seven days, and he again let a
dove go from the ark.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּחֶל עוֹד שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אֲחֵרִים וַיֹּסֶף שַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה מִן הַתֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחֶל עוֹד שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אֲחֵרִים וַיֹּסֶף שַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה מִן הַתֵּבָה׃

english.text:
And he waited still another seven days, and he again let a
dove go from the ark.

translation.text: the ark;

verses.english:
And the dove came to him at evening time, and here was an
olive leaf torn off in its mouth, and Noah knew that the
waters had eased from the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו הַיּוֹנָה לְעֵת עֶרֶב וְהִנֵּה עֲלֵה זַיִת טָרָף בְּפִיהָ וַיֵּדַע נֹחַ כִּי קַלּוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו הַיּוֹנָה לְעֵת עֶרֶב וְהִנֵּה עֲלֵה זַיִת טָרָף בְּפִיהָ וַיֵּדַע נֹחַ כִּי קַלּוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the dove came to him at evening time, and here was an
olive leaf torn off in its mouth, and Noah knew that the
waters had eased from the earth.

translation.text: and the dove came back to him in the evening, and there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf; so Noah knew that the waters had subsided from the earth.

verses.english:
And he waited still another seven days, and he let a dove
go, and it did not come back to him ever again.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיָּחֶל עוֹד שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אֲחֵרִים וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה וְלֹא יָסְפָה שׁוּב אֵלָיו עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיָּחֶל עוֹד שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אֲחֵרִים וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה וְלֹא יָסְפָה שׁוּב אֵלָיו עוֹד׃

english.text:
And he waited still another seven days, and he let a dove
go, and it did not come back to him ever again.

translation.text: Then he waited another seven days, and sent out the dove; and it did not return to him any more.

verses.english:
And it was in the six hundred and first year, in the first
month, in the first of the month: the water dried from on
the earth. And Noah turned back the covering of the ark
and looked, and here the face of the earth had dried.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּאַחַת וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ חָרְבוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ וַיָּסַר נֹחַ אֶת מִכְסֵה הַתֵּבָה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה חָרְבוּ פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּאַחַת וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ חָרְבוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ וַיָּסַר נֹחַ אֶת מִכְסֵה הַתֵּבָה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה חָרְבוּ פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And it was in the six hundred and first year, in the first
month, in the first of the month: the water dried from on
the earth. And Noah turned back the covering of the ark
and looked, and here the face of the earth had dried.

translation.text: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, on the first day of the ground was drying.

verses.english:
And in the second month, in the twenty-seventh day of the
month, the earth dried up.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יָבְשָׁה הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יָבְשָׁה הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And in the second month, in the twenty-seventh day of the
month, the earth dried up.

translation.text: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

verses.english: And God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל נֹחַ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל נֹחַ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And God spoke to Noah, saying,

translation.text: Then God said to Noah,

verses.english:
“Go out from the ark, you and your wife and your sons and
your sons’ wives with you.
verses.hebrew: צֵא מִן הַתֵּבָה אַתָּה וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּבָנֶיךָ וּנְשֵׁי בָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: צֵא מִן הַתֵּבָה אַתָּה וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּבָנֶיךָ וּנְשֵׁי בָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ׃

english.text:
“Go out from the ark, you and your wife and your sons and
your sons’ wives with you.

translation.text: "Go with you.

verses.english:
Bring out with you all the living things that are with
you, of all flesh, of the birds and of the domestic
animals and of all the creeping animals that creep on the
earth, and they will swarm in the earth and be fruitful
and multiply on the earth.”
verses.hebrew: כּל הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר אִתְּךָ מִכּל בָּשָׂר בָּעוֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבְכל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ (הוצא) [הַיְצֵא] אִתָּךְ וְשָׁרְצוּ בָאָרֶץ וּפָרוּ וְרָבוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר אִתְּךָ מִכּל בָּשָׂר בָּעוֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבְכל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ (הוצא) [הַיְצֵא] אִתָּךְ וְשָׁרְצוּ בָאָרֶץ וּפָרוּ וְרָבוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Bring out with you all the living things that are with
you, of all flesh, of the birds and of the domestic
animals and of all the creeping animals that creep on the
earth, and they will swarm in the earth and be fruitful
and multiply on the earth.”

translation.text: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all multiply on the earth."

verses.english:
And Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons’
wives with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא נֹחַ וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּנְשֵׁי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא נֹחַ וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּנְשֵׁי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons’
wives with him.

translation.text: So Noah went out with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives.

verses.english:
All the living things, all the creeping animals and all
the birds, all that creep on the earth went out from the
ark by their families.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַחַיָּה כּל הָרֶמֶשׂ וְכל הָעוֹף כֹּל רוֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיהֶם יָצְאוּ מִן הַתֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַחַיָּה כּל הָרֶמֶשׂ וְכל הָעוֹף כֹּל רוֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיהֶם יָצְאוּ מִן הַתֵּבָה׃

english.text:
All the living things, all the creeping animals and all
the birds, all that creep on the earth went out from the
ark by their families.

translation.text: And every animal, every creeping thing, and families.

verses.english:
And Noah built an altar to YHWH, and he took some of each
of the pure animals and of each of the pure birds, and he
offered sacrifices on the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן נֹחַ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקַּח מִכֹּל הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה וּמִכֹּל הָעוֹף הַטָּהוֹר וַיַּעַל עֹלֹת בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן נֹחַ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקַּח מִכֹּל הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה וּמִכֹּל הָעוֹף הַטָּהוֹר וַיַּעַל עֹלֹת בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Noah built an altar to YHWH, and he took some of each
of the pure animals and of each of the pure birds, and he
offered sacrifices on the altar.

translation.text: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

verses.english:
And YHWH smelled the pleasant smell, and YHWH said to His
heart, “I won’t curse the ground on account of humankind
again, because the inclination of the human heart is bad
from their youth, and I won’t strike all the living again
as I have done.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרַח יְהֹוָה אֶת רֵיחַ הַנִּיחֹחַ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל לִבּוֹ לֹא אֹסִף לְקַלֵּל עוֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה בַּעֲבוּר הָאָדָם כִּי יֵצֶר לֵב הָאָדָם רַע מִנְּעֻרָיו וְלֹא אֹסִף עוֹד לְהַכּוֹת אֶת כּל חַי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרַח יְהֹוָה אֶת רֵיחַ הַנִּיחֹחַ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל לִבּוֹ לֹא אֹסִף לְקַלֵּל עוֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה בַּעֲבוּר הָאָדָם כִּי יֵצֶר לֵב הָאָדָם רַע מִנְּעֻרָיו וְלֹא אֹסִף עוֹד לְהַכּוֹת אֶת כּל חַי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH smelled the pleasant smell, and YHWH said to His
heart, “I won’t curse the ground on account of humankind
again, because the inclination of the human heart is bad
from their youth, and I won’t strike all the living again
as I have done.

translation.text: again destroy every living creature as I have done.

verses.english:
All the rest of the earth’s days, seed and harvest, and
cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night
will not cease.”
verses.hebrew: עֹד כּל יְמֵי הָאָרֶץ זֶרַע וְקָצִיר וְקֹר וָחֹם וְקַיִץ וָחֹרֶף וְיוֹם וָלַיְלָה לֹא יִשְׁבֹּתוּ׃
