english.text:
Here, your servant has found favor in your eyes, and
you’ve magnified your kindness that you’ve done for me,
keeping my soul alive, and I’m not able to escape to the
mountain, in case the bad thing will cling to me and I’ll
die.

translation.text: your servant has found favor with you, and you the hills, for fear the disaster will overtake me and I die.

verses.english:
Here, this city is close to flee there, and it’s small.
Let me escape there—isn’t it small?—and my soul will
live.”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נָא הָעִיר הַזֹּאת קְרֹבָה לָנוּס שָׁמָּה וְהִוא מִצְעָר אִמָּלְטָה נָּא שָׁמָּה הֲלֹא מִצְעָר הִוא וּתְחִי נַפְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה נָא הָעִיר הַזֹּאת קְרֹבָה לָנוּס שָׁמָּה וְהִוא מִצְעָר אִמָּלְטָה נָּא שָׁמָּה הֲלֹא מִצְעָר הִוא וּתְחִי נַפְשִׁי׃

english.text:
Here, this city is close to flee there, and it’s small.
Let me escape there—isn’t it small?—and my soul will
live.”

translation.text: Look, that city is near enough to flee to, and it is a little one. Let me escape there — is it not a little one? — and my life will be saved!"

verses.english:
And He said to him, “Here, I’ve granted you this thing,
too, that I won’t overturn the city of which you spoke.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נָשָׂאתִי פָנֶיךָ גַּם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הפְכִּי אֶת הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נָשָׂאתִי פָנֶיךָ גַּם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הפְכִּי אֶת הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
And He said to him, “Here, I’ve granted you this thing,
too, that I won’t overturn the city of which you spoke.

translation.text: He said to him, "Very well, I grant you this favor too, and will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

verses.english:
Quickly, escape there, because I can’t do a thing until
you get there.” On account of this the city’s name was
called Zoar.
verses.hebrew: מַהֵר הִמָּלֵט שָׁמָּה כִּי לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר עַד בֹּאֲךָ שָׁמָּה עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר צוֹעַר׃

hebrew.text: מַהֵר הִמָּלֵט שָׁמָּה כִּי לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר עַד בֹּאֲךָ שָׁמָּה עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר צוֹעַר׃

english.text:
Quickly, escape there, because I can’t do a thing until
you get there.” On account of this the city’s name was
called Zoar.

translation.text: Hurry, escape there, for I can do nothing until you arrive there." Therefore the city was called Zoar.

verses.english: The sun rose on the earth, and Lot came to Zoar.
verses.hebrew: הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָצָא עַל הָאָרֶץ וְלוֹט בָּא צֹעֲרָה׃

hebrew.text: הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָצָא עַל הָאָרֶץ וְלוֹט בָּא צֹעֲרָה׃

english.text: The sun rose on the earth, and Lot came to Zoar.

translation.text: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

verses.english:
And YHWH rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and on
Gomorrah, from YHWH out of the skies.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הִמְטִיר עַל סְדֹם וְעַל עֲמֹרָה גּפְרִית וָאֵשׁ מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הִמְטִיר עַל סְדֹם וְעַל עֲמֹרָה גּפְרִית וָאֵשׁ מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and on
Gomorrah, from YHWH out of the skies.

translation.text: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

verses.english:
And He overturned these cities and all of the plain and
all of the residents of the cities and all the growth of
the ground.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וְאֵת כּל הַכִּכָּר וְאֵת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הֶעָרִים וְצֶמַח הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וְאֵת כּל הַכִּכָּר וְאֵת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הֶעָרִים וְצֶמַח הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And He overturned these cities and all of the plain and
all of the residents of the cities and all the growth of
the ground.

translation.text: and he overthrew those cities, and all the ground.

verses.english:
And his wife looked behind him, and she was a pillar of
salt!
verses.hebrew: וַתַּבֵּט אִשְׁתּוֹ מֵאַחֲרָיו וַתְּהִי נְצִיב מֶלַח׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּבֵּט אִשְׁתּוֹ מֵאַחֲרָיו וַתְּהִי נְצִיב מֶלַח׃

english.text:
And his wife looked behind him, and she was a pillar of
salt!

translation.text: But Lot's wife, behind him, looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where
he had stood in YHWH’s presence,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַד שָׁם אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַד שָׁם אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where
he had stood in YHWH’s presence,

translation.text: Abraham went early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD;

verses.english:
and he gazed at the sight of Sodom and Gomorrah and at the
sight of all the land of the plain. And he saw: and, here,
the smoke of the land went up like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁקֵף עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְעַל כּל פְּנֵי אֶרֶץ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עָלָה קִיטֹר הָאָרֶץ כְּקִיטֹר הַכִּבְשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁקֵף עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְעַל כּל פְּנֵי אֶרֶץ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עָלָה קִיטֹר הָאָרֶץ כְּקִיטֹר הַכִּבְשָׁן׃

english.text:
and he gazed at the sight of Sodom and Gomorrah and at the
sight of all the land of the plain. And he saw: and, here,
the smoke of the land went up like the smoke of a furnace.

translation.text: and he looked down toward Sodom and the land going up like the smoke of a furnace.

verses.english:
And it was, when God destroyed the cities of the plain,
that God remembered Abraham and let Lot go from inside the
overthrow: at the overthrowing of the cities in which Lot
lived.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁחֵת אֱלֹהִים אֶת עָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת לוֹט מִתּוֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָה בַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בָּהֵן לוֹט׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁחֵת אֱלֹהִים אֶת עָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת לוֹט מִתּוֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָה בַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בָּהֵן לוֹט׃

english.text:
And it was, when God destroyed the cities of the plain,
that God remembered Abraham and let Lot go from inside the
overthrow: at the overthrowing of the cities in which Lot
lived.

translation.text: So it was that, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, God when he overthrew the cities in which Lot had settled.

verses.english:
And Lot went up from Zoar and lived in the mountain, and
his two daughters with him, because he feared to live in
Zoar, and he lived in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל לוֹט מִצּוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהָר וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו עִמּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא לָשֶׁבֶת בְּצוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמְּעָרָה הוּא וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל לוֹט מִצּוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהָר וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו עִמּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא לָשֶׁבֶת בְּצוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמְּעָרָה הוּא וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And Lot went up from Zoar and lived in the mountain, and
his two daughters with him, because he feared to live in
Zoar, and he lived in a cave, he and his two daughters.

translation.text: Now Lot went up out of Zoar and settled in the hills with his two daughters, for he was afraid to stay in Zoar; so he lived in a cave with his two daughters.

verses.english:
And the firstborn said to the younger one, “Our father is
old, and there’s no man in the earth to come to us in the
way of all the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה אָבִינוּ זָקֵן וְאִישׁ אֵין בָּאָרֶץ לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ כְּדֶרֶךְ כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה אָבִינוּ זָקֵן וְאִישׁ אֵין בָּאָרֶץ לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ כְּדֶרֶךְ כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the firstborn said to the younger one, “Our father is
old, and there’s no man in the earth to come to us in the
way of all the earth.

translation.text: And the firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is not a man on earth to come in to us after the manner of all the world.

verses.english:
Come on, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s lie
with him and make seed live from our father.”
verses.hebrew: לְכָה נַשְׁקֶה אֶת אָבִינוּ יַיִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָה עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: לְכָה נַשְׁקֶה אֶת אָבִינוּ יַיִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָה עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

english.text:
Come on, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s lie
with him and make seed live from our father.”

translation.text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, our father."

verses.english:
And they made their father drink wine in that night, and
the firstborn came and lay with her father. And he did not
know of her lying down and her getting up.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יַיִן בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַתָּבֹא הַבְּכִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב אֶת אָבִיהָ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקוּמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יַיִן בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַתָּבֹא הַבְּכִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב אֶת אָבִיהָ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקוּמָהּ׃

english.text:
And they made their father drink wine in that night, and
the firstborn came and lay with her father. And he did not
know of her lying down and her getting up.

translation.text: So they made their father drink wine that night; and she lay down or when she rose.

verses.english:
And it was on the next day, and the firstborn said to the
younger one, “Here, I lay with my father last night. Let’s
make him drink wine tonight as well, and you come and lie
with him, and we’ll make seed live from our father.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה הֵן שָׁכַבְתִּי אֶמֶשׁ אֶת אָבִי נַשְׁקֶנּוּ יַיִן גַּם הַלַּיְלָה וּבֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה הֵן שָׁכַבְתִּי אֶמֶשׁ אֶת אָבִי נַשְׁקֶנּוּ יַיִן גַּם הַלַּיְלָה וּבֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

english.text:
And it was on the next day, and the firstborn said to the
younger one, “Here, I lay with my father last night. Let’s
make him drink wine tonight as well, and you come and lie
with him, and we’ll make seed live from our father.”

translation.text: On the next day, the firstborn said to the younger, "Look, I lay last night with my father; let us make him may preserve offspring through our father."

verses.english:
And they made their father drink wine in that night as
well, and the younger one got up and lay with him, and he
did not know of her lying down and her getting up.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ גַּם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יָיִן וַתָּקם הַצְּעִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב עִמּוֹ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקֻמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ גַּם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יָיִן וַתָּקם הַצְּעִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב עִמּוֹ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקֻמָהּ׃

english.text:
And they made their father drink wine in that night as
well, and the younger one got up and lay with him, and he
did not know of her lying down and her getting up.

translation.text: So they made their him; and he did not know when she lay down or when she rose.

verses.english: And Lot’s two daughters became pregnant by their father.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהֲרֶיןָ שְׁתֵּי בְנוֹת לוֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהֲרֶיןָ שְׁתֵּי בְנוֹת לוֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text: And Lot’s two daughters became pregnant by their father.

translation.text: Thus both the daughters of Lot became pregnant by their father.

verses.english:
And the firstborn gave birth to a son and called his name
Moab. He is the father of Moab to this day.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד הַבְּכִירָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מוֹאָב הוּא אֲבִי מוֹאָב עַד הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד הַבְּכִירָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מוֹאָב הוּא אֲבִי מוֹאָב עַד הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the firstborn gave birth to a son and called his name
Moab. He is the father of Moab to this day.

translation.text: the Moabites to this day.

verses.english:
And the younger one, she too gave birth to a son and
called his name ben-Ammi. He is the father of the children
of Ammon to this day.
verses.hebrew: וְהַצְּעִירָה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן עַמִּי הוּא אֲבִי בְנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַצְּעִירָה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן עַמִּי הוּא אֲבִי בְנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the younger one, she too gave birth to a son and
called his name ben-Ammi. He is the father of the children
of Ammon to this day.

translation.text: The younger also bore a son and named him Ben-ammi; he is the ancestor of the Ammonites to this day.

verses.english:
And Abraham traveled from there to the Negeb country
and lived between Kadesh and Shur and resided in Gerar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע מִשָּׁם אַבְרָהָם אַרְצָה הַנֶּגֶב וַיֵּשֶׁב בֵּין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין שׁוּר וַיָּגר בִּגְרָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע מִשָּׁם אַבְרָהָם אַרְצָה הַנֶּגֶב וַיֵּשֶׁב בֵּין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין שׁוּר וַיָּגר בִּגְרָר׃

english.text:
And Abraham traveled from there to the Negeb country
and lived between Kadesh and Shur and resided in Gerar.

translation.text: From there Abraham journeyed toward the region of the Negeb, and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While residing in Gerar as an alien,

verses.english:
And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, “She’s my sister.”
And Abimelek, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ גְּרָר וַיִּקַּח אֶת שָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ גְּרָר וַיִּקַּח אֶת שָׂרָה׃

english.text:
And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, “She’s my sister.”
And Abimelek, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.

translation.text: of Gerar sent and took Sarah.

verses.english:
And God came to Abimelek in a night dream and said to him,
“Here, you’re dead over the woman whom you took, for she’s
a man’s wife!”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנְּךָ מֵת עַל הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתָּ וְהִוא בְּעֻלַת בָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנְּךָ מֵת עַל הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתָּ וְהִוא בְּעֻלַת בָּעַל׃

english.text:
And God came to Abimelek in a night dream and said to him,
“Here, you’re dead over the woman whom you took, for she’s
a man’s wife!”

translation.text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream whom you have taken; for she is a married woman."

verses.english:
And Abimelek had not come close to her, and he said, “My
Lord, will you kill a virtuous nation as well?
verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא קָרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי הֲגוֹי גַּם צַדִּיק תַּהֲרֹג׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא קָרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי הֲגוֹי גַּם צַדִּיק תַּהֲרֹג׃

english.text:
And Abimelek had not come close to her, and he said, “My
Lord, will you kill a virtuous nation as well?

translation.text: Now Abimelech innocent people?

verses.english:
Didn’t he say to me, ‘She’s my sister’? And she—she,
too—said, ‘He’s my brother.’ I did this in my heart’s
innocence and in my hands’ cleanness.”
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא הוּא אָמַר לִי אֲחֹתִי הִוא וְהִיא גַם הִוא אָמְרָה אָחִי הוּא בְּתם לְבָבִי וּבְנִקְיֹן כַּפַּי עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא הוּא אָמַר לִי אֲחֹתִי הִוא וְהִיא גַם הִוא אָמְרָה אָחִי הוּא בְּתם לְבָבִי וּבְנִקְיֹן כַּפַּי עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת׃

english.text:
Didn’t he say to me, ‘She’s my sister’? And she—she,
too—said, ‘He’s my brother.’ I did this in my heart’s
innocence and in my hands’ cleanness.”

translation.text: Did he not himself say to me, 'She is my sister'? And she herself said, 'He is my brother.' I did this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands."

verses.english:
And God said to him in the dream, “I, too, knew that you
did this in your heart’s innocence; and I, too, held you
back from sinning against me. On account of this, I didn’t
let you touch her.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלֹם גַּם אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי בְתם לְבָבְךָ עָשִׂיתָ זֹּאת וָאֶחְשֹׂךְ גַּם אָנֹכִי אוֹתְךָ מֵחֲטוֹ לִי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיךָ לִנְגֹּעַ אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלֹם גַּם אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי בְתם לְבָבְךָ עָשִׂיתָ זֹּאת וָאֶחְשֹׂךְ גַּם אָנֹכִי אוֹתְךָ מֵחֲטוֹ לִי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיךָ לִנְגֹּעַ אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And God said to him in the dream, “I, too, knew that you
did this in your heart’s innocence; and I, too, held you
back from sinning against me. On account of this, I didn’t
let you touch her.

translation.text: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart; did not let you touch her.

verses.english:
And now, give the man’s wife back, because he’s a prophet,
and he’ll pray for you. And live! And if you don’t give
back, know that you will die, you and all that you have.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הָשֵׁב אֵשֶׁת הָאִישׁ כִּי נָבִיא הוּא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְךָ וֶחְיֵה וְאִם אֵינְךָ מֵשִׁיב דַּע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת אַתָּה וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הָשֵׁב אֵשֶׁת הָאִישׁ כִּי נָבִיא הוּא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְךָ וֶחְיֵה וְאִם אֵינְךָ מֵשִׁיב דַּע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת אַתָּה וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

english.text:
And now, give the man’s wife back, because he’s a prophet,
and he’ll pray for you. And live! And if you don’t give
back, know that you will die, you and all that you have.”

translation.text: Now then, return the man's wife; for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you shall live. But if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you and all that are yours."

verses.english:
And Abimelek got up in the morning and called to all his
servants and spoke all these things in their ears, and the
people were very afraid.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקְרָא לְכל עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקְרָא לְכל עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Abimelek got up in the morning and called to all his
servants and spoke all these things in their ears, and the
people were very afraid.

translation.text: So Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants and told them all these things; and the men were very much afraid.

verses.english:
And Abimelek called Abraham and said to him, “What have
you done to us, and how did I sin against you, that you
brought a big sin over me and over my kingdom? You’ve done
things with me that are not done!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְאַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ וּמֶה חָטָאתִי לָךְ כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלַי וְעַל מַמְלַכְתִּי חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה מַעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵעָשׂוּ עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְאַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ וּמֶה חָטָאתִי לָךְ כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלַי וְעַל מַמְלַכְתִּי חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה מַעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵעָשׂוּ עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
And Abimelek called Abraham and said to him, “What have
you done to us, and how did I sin against you, that you
brought a big sin over me and over my kingdom? You’ve done
things with me that are not done!”

translation.text: ought not to be done."

verses.english:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you
did this thing?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה רָאִיתָ כִּי עָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה רָאִיתָ כִּי עָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you
did this thing?”

translation.text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What were you thinking of, that you did this thing?"

verses.english:
And Abraham said, “Because I said, There just isn’t the
fear of God in this place, and they’ll kill me on account
of my wife.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם כִּי אָמַרְתִּי רַק אֵין יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַהֲרָגוּנִי עַל דְּבַר אִשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם כִּי אָמַרְתִּי רַק אֵין יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַהֲרָגוּנִי עַל דְּבַר אִשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
And Abraham said, “Because I said, There just isn’t the
fear of God in this place, and they’ll kill me on account
of my wife.’

translation.text: Abraham said, "I did it because I thought, There is no fear of God at all in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.

verses.english:
And also she is, in fact, my sister, my father’s daughter
but not my mother’s daughter, and she became a wife to me.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אמְנָה אֲחֹתִי בַת אָבִי הִוא אַךְ לֹא בַת אִמִּי וַתְּהִי לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אמְנָה אֲחֹתִי בַת אָבִי הִוא אַךְ לֹא בַת אִמִּי וַתְּהִי לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And also she is, in fact, my sister, my father’s daughter
but not my mother’s daughter, and she became a wife to me.

translation.text: Besides, she is indeed my sister, became my wife.

verses.english:
And it was when God had me roam from my father’s house,
and I said to her, This will be your kindness that you’ll
do with me: to every place where we come, say about me,
“He’s my brother.”‘”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִתְעוּ אֹתִי אֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית אָבִי וָאֹמַר לָהּ זֶה חַסְדֵּךְ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשִׂי עִמָּדִי אֶל כּל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָבוֹא שָׁמָּה אִמְרִי לִי אָחִי הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִתְעוּ אֹתִי אֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית אָבִי וָאֹמַר לָהּ זֶה חַסְדֵּךְ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשִׂי עִמָּדִי אֶל כּל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָבוֹא שָׁמָּה אִמְרִי לִי אָחִי הוּא׃

english.text:
And it was when God had me roam from my father’s house,
and I said to her, This will be your kindness that you’ll
do with me: to every place where we come, say about me,
“He’s my brother.”‘”

translation.text: And when God caused me to wander from my father's house, I said to her, 'This is the kindness you must do me: at every place to which we come, say of me, He is my brother.'"

verses.english:
And Abimelek took sheep and oxen and servants and maids,
and he gave them to Abraham, and he gave Sarah, his wife,
back to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַיִּתֵּן לְאַבְרָהָם וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ אֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַיִּתֵּן לְאַבְרָהָם וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ אֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abimelek took sheep and oxen and servants and maids,
and he gave them to Abraham, and he gave Sarah, his wife,
back to him.

translation.text: Then them to Abraham, and restored his wife Sarah to him.

verses.english:
And Abimelek said, “Here’s my land in front of you. Live
wherever it’s good in your eyes.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הִנֵּה אַרְצִי לְפָנֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ שֵׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הִנֵּה אַרְצִי לְפָנֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ שֵׁב׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said, “Here’s my land in front of you. Live
wherever it’s good in your eyes.”

translation.text: Abimelech said, "My land is before you; settle where it pleases you."

verses.english:
And to Sarah he said, “Here, I’ve given a thousand weights
of silver to your brother. Here, it’s a covering of eyes
for you with everyone with you, and you’re justified with
everyone.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְשָׂרָה אָמַר הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לְאָחִיךְ הִנֵּה הוּא לָךְ כְּסוּת עֵינַיִם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ וְאֵת כֹּל וְנֹכָחַת׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשָׂרָה אָמַר הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לְאָחִיךְ הִנֵּה הוּא לָךְ כְּסוּת עֵינַיִם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ וְאֵת כֹּל וְנֹכָחַת׃

english.text:
And to Sarah he said, “Here, I’ve given a thousand weights
of silver to your brother. Here, it’s a covering of eyes
for you with everyone with you, and you’re justified with
everyone.”

translation.text: To Sarah he said, "Look, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver; it vindicated."

verses.english:
And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek and his
wife and his maids, and they gave birth,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּרְפָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאַמְהֹתָיו וַיֵּלֵדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּרְפָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאַמְהֹתָיו וַיֵּלֵדוּ׃

english.text:
And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek and his
wife and his maids, and they gave birth,

translation.text: Then Abraham prayed to God; and God healed bore children.

verses.english:
because YHWH had held back every womb of Abimelek’s house
on account of Sarah, Abraham’s wife!
verses.hebrew: כִּי עָצֹר עָצַר יְהֹוָה בְּעַד כּל רֶחֶם לְבֵית אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל דְּבַר שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עָצֹר עָצַר יְהֹוָה בְּעַד כּל רֶחֶם לְבֵית אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל דְּבַר שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָהָם׃

english.text:
because YHWH had held back every womb of Abimelek’s house
on account of Sarah, Abraham’s wife!

translation.text: For the LORD had closed fast all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

verses.english:
And YHWH took account of Sarah as He had said, and YHWH
did to Sarah as He had spoken.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה פָּקַד אֶת שָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמָר וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לְשָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה פָּקַד אֶת שָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמָר וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לְשָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH took account of Sarah as He had said, and YHWH
did to Sarah as He had spoken.

translation.text: The LORD dealt with Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did for Sarah as he had promised.

verses.english:
And Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Abraham in his old age at the appointed time that God had
spoken.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם בֵּן לִזְקֻנָיו לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם בֵּן לִזְקֻנָיו לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Abraham in his old age at the appointed time that God had
spoken.

translation.text: Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.english:
And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to
him, to whom Sarah had given birth for him: Isaac.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁם בְּנוֹ הַנּוֹלַד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ שָׂרָה יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁם בְּנוֹ הַנּוֹלַד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ שָׂרָה יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to
him, to whom Sarah had given birth for him: Isaac.

translation.text: Abraham gave the name Isaac to his son whom Sarah bore him.

verses.english:
And Abraham circumcised Isaac, his son, at eight days old,
as God had commanded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמל אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמל אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Abraham circumcised Isaac, his son, at eight days old,
as God had commanded him.

translation.text: And Abraham commanded him.

verses.english:
And Abraham was a hundred years old when Isaac, his son,
was born to him.
verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abraham was a hundred years old when Isaac, his son,
was born to him.

translation.text: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

verses.english:
And Sarah said, “God has made laughter for me. Everyone
who hears will laugh for me.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שָׂרָה צְחֹק עָשָׂה לִי אֱלֹהִים כּל הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִצְחַק לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שָׂרָה צְחֹק עָשָׂה לִי אֱלֹהִים כּל הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִצְחַק לִי׃

english.text:
And Sarah said, “God has made laughter for me. Everyone
who hears will laugh for me.”

translation.text: Now Sarah said, "God has brought laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh with me."

verses.english:
And she said, “Who would have said to Abraham, ‘Sarah has
nursed children’? Yet I’ve given birth to a son in his old
age.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר מִי מִלֵּל לְאַבְרָהָם הֵינִיקָה בָנִים שָׂרָה כִּי יָלַדְתִּי בֵן לִזְקֻנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר מִי מִלֵּל לְאַבְרָהָם הֵינִיקָה בָנִים שָׂרָה כִּי יָלַדְתִּי בֵן לִזְקֻנָיו׃

english.text:
And she said, “Who would have said to Abraham, ‘Sarah has
nursed children’? Yet I’ve given birth to a son in his old
age.”

translation.text: And she said, "Who I have borne him a son in his old age."

verses.english:
And the boy grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a big
feast in the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַיִּגָּמַל וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְרָהָם מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל בְּיוֹם הִגָּמֵל אֶת יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַיִּגָּמַל וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְרָהָם מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל בְּיוֹם הִגָּמֵל אֶת יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And the boy grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a big
feast in the day that Isaac was weaned.

translation.text: The child grew, and was weaned; and Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.english:
And Sarah saw the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, whom she had
borne to Abraham, fooling around.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא שָׂרָה אֶת בֶּן הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְאַבְרָהָם מְצַחֵק׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא שָׂרָה אֶת בֶּן הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְאַבְרָהָם מְצַחֵק׃

english.text:
And Sarah saw the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, whom she had
borne to Abraham, fooling around.

translation.text: But Sarah saw the son of Hagar Isaac.

verses.english:
And she said to Abraham, “Drive this maid out—and her son,
because the son of this maid will not inherit with my son,
with Isaac.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לְאַבְרָהָם גָּרֵשׁ הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת בְּנָהּ כִּי לֹא יִירַשׁ בֶּן הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת עִם בְּנִי עִם יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לְאַבְרָהָם גָּרֵשׁ הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת בְּנָהּ כִּי לֹא יִירַשׁ בֶּן הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת עִם בְּנִי עִם יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And she said to Abraham, “Drive this maid out—and her son,
because the son of this maid will not inherit with my son,
with Isaac.”

translation.text: So she said to Abraham, "Cast out this slave woman with her son; for the son of this slave woman shall not inherit along with my son Isaac."

verses.english:
And the thing was very bad in Abraham’s eyes in regard to
his son.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּעֵינֵי אַבְרָהָם עַל אוֹדֹת בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּעֵינֵי אַבְרָהָם עַל אוֹדֹת בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
And the thing was very bad in Abraham’s eyes in regard to
his son.

translation.text: The matter was very distressing to Abraham on account of his son.

verses.english:
And God said to Abraham, “Let it not be bad in your eyes
about the boy and about your maid. Everything that Sarah
tells you: listen to her voice; because seed for you will
be called by Isaac.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם אַל יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עַל הַנַּעַר וְעַל אֲמָתֶךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלֶיךָ שָׂרָה שְׁמַע בְּקֹלָהּ כִּי בְיִצְחָק יִקָּרֵא לְךָ זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם אַל יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עַל הַנַּעַר וְעַל אֲמָתֶךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלֶיךָ שָׂרָה שְׁמַע בְּקֹלָהּ כִּי בְיִצְחָק יִקָּרֵא לְךָ זָרַע׃

english.text:
And God said to Abraham, “Let it not be bad in your eyes
about the boy and about your maid. Everything that Sarah
tells you: listen to her voice; because seed for you will
be called by Isaac.

translation.text: But God said to Abraham, "Do not be distressed because of the as she tells you, for it is through Isaac that offspring shall be named for you.

verses.english:
And I’ll make the maid’s son into a nation as well,
because he’s your seed.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת בֶּן הָאָמָה לְגוֹי אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ כִּי זַרְעֲךָ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶת בֶּן הָאָמָה לְגוֹי אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ כִּי זַרְעֲךָ הוּא׃

english.text:
And I’ll make the maid’s son into a nation as well,
because he’s your seed.”

translation.text: As for the son of the slave woman, I will make a nation of him also, because he is your offspring."

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning and took bread and
a bottle of water and gave to Hagar—he put them on her
shoulder—and the boy and he sent her off. And she went and
strayed in the Beer-sheba wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח לֶחֶם וְחֵמַת מַיִם וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הָגָר שָׂם עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וְאֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּתַע בְּמִדְבַּר בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח לֶחֶם וְחֵמַת מַיִם וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הָגָר שָׂם עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וְאֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּתַע בְּמִדְבַּר בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
And Abraham got up early in the morning and took bread and
a bottle of water and gave to Hagar—he put them on her
shoulder—and the boy and he sent her off. And she went and
strayed in the Beer-sheba wilderness.

translation.text: So Abraham rose early in the putting it on her shoulder, along with the child, and sent her away. And she departed, and wandered about in the wilderness of Beersheba.

verses.english:
And the water was finished from the bottle, and she thrust
the boy under one of the shrubs,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְלוּ הַמַּיִם מִן הַחֵמֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד תַּחַת אַחַד הַשִּׂיחִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְלוּ הַמַּיִם מִן הַחֵמֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד תַּחַת אַחַד הַשִּׂיחִם׃

english.text:
And the water was finished from the bottle, and she thrust
the boy under one of the shrubs,

translation.text: When the water in the skin was gone, she cast the child under one of the bushes.

verses.english:
and she went and sat opposite, going as far as a bow-shot,
because she said, “Let me not see the boy’s death.” And
she sat opposite and raised her voice and wept.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּשֶׁב לָהּ מִנֶּגֶד הַרְחֵק כִּמְטַחֲוֵי קֶשֶׁת כִּי אָמְרָה אַל אֶרְאֶה בְּמוֹת הַיָּלֶד וַתֵּשֶׁב מִנֶּגֶד וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלָהּ וַתֵּבְךְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּשֶׁב לָהּ מִנֶּגֶד הַרְחֵק כִּמְטַחֲוֵי קֶשֶׁת כִּי אָמְרָה אַל אֶרְאֶה בְּמוֹת הַיָּלֶד וַתֵּשֶׁב מִנֶּגֶד וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלָהּ וַתֵּבְךְּ׃

english.text:
and she went and sat opposite, going as far as a bow-shot,
because she said, “Let me not see the boy’s death.” And
she sat opposite and raised her voice and wept.

translation.text: Then she went and sat down opposite him a good look on the death of the child." And as she sat opposite him, she lifted up her voice and wept.

verses.english:
And God heard the boy’s voice. And an angel of God called
to Hagar from the heavens and said to her, “What trouble
do you have, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. Because God has heard
the boy’s voice where he is.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת קוֹל הַנַּעַר וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶל הָגָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה לָּךְ הָגָר אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל קוֹל הַנַּעַר בַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת קוֹל הַנַּעַר וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶל הָגָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה לָּךְ הָגָר אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל קוֹל הַנַּעַר בַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא שָׁם׃

english.text:
And God heard the boy’s voice. And an angel of God called
to Hagar from the heavens and said to her, “What trouble
do you have, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. Because God has heard
the boy’s voice where he is.

translation.text: And God heard the voice of the boy; and the the boy where he is.

verses.english:
Get up. Carry the boy and hold him up in your hand,
because I shall make him into a big nation.”
verses.hebrew: קוּמִי שְׂאִי אֶת הַנַּעַר וְהַחֲזִיקִי אֶת יָדֵךְ בּוֹ כִּי לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: קוּמִי שְׂאִי אֶת הַנַּעַר וְהַחֲזִיקִי אֶת יָדֵךְ בּוֹ כִּי לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
Get up. Carry the boy and hold him up in your hand,
because I shall make him into a big nation.”

translation.text: Come, lift up the boy and hold him fast with your hand, for I will make a great nation of him."

verses.english:
And God opened her eyes, and she saw a water well, and she
went and filled the bottle with water and had the boy
drink.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקַח אֱלֹהִים אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא בְּאֵר מָיִם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּא אֶת הַחֵמֶת מַיִם וַתַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַנָּעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקַח אֱלֹהִים אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא בְּאֵר מָיִם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּא אֶת הַחֵמֶת מַיִם וַתַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַנָּעַר׃

english.text:
And God opened her eyes, and she saw a water well, and she
went and filled the bottle with water and had the boy
drink.

translation.text: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. She went, and filled the skin with water, and gave the boy a drink.

verses.english:
And God was with the boy, and he grew, and he lived in the
wilderness and was a bowman.

him a wife from the land of Egypt.

english.text:
And he lived in the Paran wilderness, and his mother took
him a wife from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: He lived in the wilderness of Paran; and his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt.

And it was at that time, and Abimelek and Phichol, the

with you in everything that you do.

And it was at that time, and Abimelek and Phichol, the

with you in everything that you do.

verses.english:
And now, swear to me here by God that you won’t act
falsely to me and to my offspring and to my posterity Like
the kindness that I’ve done with you, you’ll do with me
and with the land in which you’ve resided.”

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים הֵנָּה אִם תִּשְׁקֹר לִי וּלְנִינִי וּלְנֶכְדִּי כַּחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עִמְּךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי וְעִם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר גַּרְתָּה בָּהּ׃

And now, swear to me here by God that you won’t act

and Abraham criticized Abimelek about a water well that

english.text:
and Abraham criticized Abimelek about a water well that
Abimelek’s servants had seized.

translation.text: When Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well of water that Abimelech's servants had seized,

verses.english:
And Abimelek said, “I don’t know who did this thing; and
also, you didn’t tell me; and also, I didn’t hear of it
except for today.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא יָדַעְתִּי מִי עָשָׂה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְגַם אַתָּה לֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי וְגַם אָנֹכִי לֹא שָׁמַעְתִּי בִּלְתִּי הַיּוֹם׃

And Abimelek said, “I don’t know who did this thing; and
also, you didn’t tell me; and also, I didn’t hear of it
except for today.”

translation.text: Abimelech said, "I do not know who has done this; you did not tell me, and I have not heard of it until today."

verses.english:
And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave to Abimelek, and
the two of them made a covenant.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם צֹאן וּבָקָר וַיִּתֵּן לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית׃

english.text:
And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave to Abimelek, and
the two of them made a covenant.

translation.text: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.

verses.english: And Abraham stood seven ewes of the sheep by themselves.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁבַע כִּבְשֹׂת הַצֹּאן לְבַדְּהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּב אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁבַע כִּבְשֹׂת הַצֹּאן לְבַדְּהֶן׃

english.text: And Abraham stood seven ewes of the sheep by themselves.

translation.text: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs of the flock.

verses.english:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What are these seven ewes
that you’ve stood by themselves?”

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה הֵנָּה שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִצַּבְתָּ לְבַדָּנָה׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What are these seven ewes
that you’ve stood by themselves?”

translation.text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, apart?"

verses.english:
And he said, “Because you’ll take these seven ewes from my
hand so that it will be evidence for me that I dug this
well.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶת שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת תִּקַּח מִיָּדִי בַּעֲבוּר תִּהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵדָה כִּי חָפַרְתִּי אֶת הַבְּאֵר הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶת שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת תִּקַּח מִיָּדִי בַּעֲבוּר תִּהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵדָה כִּי חָפַרְתִּי אֶת הַבְּאֵר הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And he said, “Because you’ll take these seven ewes from my
hand so that it will be evidence for me that I dug this
well.”

translation.text: He said, "These seven ewe lambs you shall accept from my hand, in order that you may be a witness for me that I dug this well."

verses.english:
On account of this he called that place Beer-sheba,
because the two of them swore there

On account of this he called that place Beer-sheba,
because the two of them swore there

translation.text: Therefore that place was called Beer-sheba; because there both of them swore an oath.

verses.english:
and made a covenant in Beer-sheba. And Abimelek and
Phichol, the commander of his army, got up and went to the
land of the Philistines.

and made a covenant in Beer-sheba. And Abimelek and

english.text:
And he planted a tamarisk in Beer-sheba and he called the
name of YHWH El Olam.

translation.text: Abraham planted a tamarisk Everlasting God.

verses.english:
And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines many
days.

english.text:
And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines many
days.

translation.text: And Abraham resided as an alien many days in the land of the Philistines.

verses.english:
And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

verses.english:
And He said, “Take your son,
your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah
and make him a burnt offering there
on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

and go to the land of Mo-riah

on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

And Abraham got up early in the morning
and harnessed his ass
and took his two boys with him
and Isaac, his son.
And he cut the wood for the burnt offering,
and he got up and went to the place
that God had said to him.

and Abraham raised his eyes

“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,

Milcah gave birth to these eight

verses.english:
And his concubine,
whose name was Reumah,
she too gave birth,
to Tebah and Gaham
and Tahash and Maacah.

english.text:
And his concubine,
whose name was Reumah,
she too gave birth,
to Tebah and Gaham
and Tahash and Maacah.

translation.text: Moreover, his concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

verses.english:
And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham. Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham. Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: After these things God tested Abraham. He said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."

verses.english:
And He said, “Take your son,
your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah
and make him a burnt offering there
on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning
and harnessed his ass
and took his two boys with him
and Isaac, his son.
And he cut the wood for the burnt offering,
and he got up and went to the place
that God had said to him.

On the third day:
and Abraham raised his eyes
and saw the place from a distance.

and Abraham raised his eyes

verses.english:
And Abraham said to his boys,
“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,
and we’ll come back to you.”

And Abraham said to his boys,
“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,
and we’ll come back to you.”

translation.text: Then Abraham said to his young men, worship, and then we will come back to you."

verses.english:
And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering
and put it on Isaac, his son,
and took the fire and the knife in his hand.
And the two of them went together.

english.text:
And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering
and put it on Isaac, his son,
and took the fire and the knife in his hand.
And the two of them went together.

translation.text: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. So the two of them walked on together.

verses.english:
And Isaac said to Abraham, his father;
and he said, “My father.”
And he said, “I’m here, my son.”
And he said, “Here are the fire and the wood,
but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?”

And Isaac said to Abraham, his father;
and he said, “My father.”
And he said, “I’m here, my son.”
And he said, “Here are the fire and the wood,
but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?”

translation.text: Isaac said to his father Abraham, "Father!" And he said, "Here I am, lamb for a burnt offering?"

verses.english:
And Abraham said,
“God will see to the sheep for the burnt offering,
my son.”
And the two of them went together.

And Abraham said,
“God will see to the sheep for the burnt offering,
my son.”
And the two of them went together.

translation.text: Abraham said, "God himself will provide together.

verses.english:
And they came to the place
that God had said to him.
And Abraham built the altar there
and arranged the wood,
and he bound Isaac, his son,
and put him on the altar
on top of the wood.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת הָעֵצִים וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִמַּעַל לָעֵצִים

english.text:
And they came to the place
that God had said to him.
And Abraham built the altar there
and arranged the wood,
and he bound Isaac, his son,
and put him on the altar
on top of the wood.

translation.text: When they came to the place that God had shown him, Abraham built an altar there and laid the wood in order. He bound his son Isaac, and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

verses.english:
And Abraham put out his hand
and took the knife
to slaughter his son.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יָדוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת לִשְׁחֹט אֶת בְּנוֹ

english.text:
And Abraham put out his hand
and took the knife
to slaughter his son.

translation.text: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to kill his son.

verses.english:
And an angel of YHWH called to him from the skies
and said, “Abraham! Abraham!”
And he said, “I’m here.”

english.text:
And an angel of YHWH called to him from the skies
and said, “Abraham! Abraham!”
And he said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: But the angel Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."

verses.english:
And he said,
“Don’t put your hand out toward the boy,
and don’t do anything to him,
because now I know that you fear L-0.22emꞀ,
and you didn’t withhold your son,
your only one, from me.”

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֶל הַנַּעַר וְאַל תַּעַשׂ לוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה וְלֹא חָשַׂכְתָּ אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ מִמֶּנִּי

english.text:
And he said,
“Don’t put your hand out toward the boy,
and don’t do anything to him,
because now I know that you fear L-0.22emꞀ,
and you didn’t withhold your son,
your only one, from me.”

translation.text: He said, "Do not lay your hand since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me."

verses.english:
And Abraham raised his eyes and saw,
and here was a ram behind,
caught in the thicket by its horns.
And Abraham went and took the ram
and made it a burnt offering
instead of his son.

And Abraham raised his eyes and saw,
and here was a ram behind,
caught in the thicket by its horns.
And Abraham went and took the ram
and made it a burnt offering
instead of his son.

translation.text: And Abraham looked up and saw a ram, caught in a thicket by its horns. instead of his son.

verses.english:
And Abraham called the name of that place
“YHWH Yir’eh,”
as is said today:
“In YHWH’s mountain it will be seen.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא יְהֹוָה יִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר יֵאָמֵר הַיּוֹם בְּהַר יְהֹוָה יֵרָאֶה

english.text:
And Abraham called the name of that place
“YHWH Yir’eh,”
as is said today:
“In YHWH’s mountain it will be seen.”

translation.text: So Abraham called that place "The LORD will provide"; as it is said to this day, "On the mount of the LORD it shall be provided."

verses.english:
And an angel of YHWH called to Abraham
a second time from the skies
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָהָם שֵׁנִית מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָהָם שֵׁנִית מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם

english.text:
And an angel of YHWH called to Abraham
a second time from the skies

translation.text: The angel of the LORD called to Abraham a second time from heaven,

verses.english:
and said, “I swear by me—

word of YHWH—

that because you did this thing
and didn’t withhold your son,
your only one,
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי
נְאֻם יְהֹוָה
כִּי יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא חָשַׂכְתָּ אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידֶךָ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי
נְאֻם יְהֹוָה
כִּי יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא חָשַׂכְתָּ אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידֶךָ

english.text: and said, “I swear by me—
word of YHWH—

that because you did this thing
and didn’t withhold your son,
your only one,

verses.translation: and said, "By myself I have sworn, says the LORD: Because you have done this, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

verses.english:
that I’ll bless you
and multiply your seed
like the stars of the skies
and like the sand that’s on the seashore,
and your seed will possess its enemies’ gate.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בָרֵךְ אֲבָרֶכְךָ וְהַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְכַחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם וְיִרַשׁ זַרְעֲךָ אֵת שַׁעַר אֹיְבָיו

hebrew.text: כִּי בָרֵךְ אֲבָרֶכְךָ וְהַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְכַחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם וְיִרַשׁ זַרְעֲךָ אֵת שַׁעַר אֹיְבָיו

english.text:
that I’ll bless you
and multiply your seed
like the stars of the skies
and like the sand that’s on the seashore,
and your seed will possess its enemies’ gate.

translation.text: I offspring shall possess the gate of their enemies,

verses.english:
And all the nations of the earth
will be blessed through your seed
because you listened to my voice
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְבָּרְכוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלִי

hebrew.text: וְהִתְבָּרְכוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלִי

english.text:
And all the nations of the earth
will be blessed through your seed
because you listened to my voice

translation.text: and by your offspring shall all the nations of the earth gain blessing for themselves, because you have obeyed my voice."

verses.english:
And Abraham went back to his boys
And they got up
And went together to Beer-sheba
And Abraham lived in Beer-sheba
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אַבְרָהָם אֶל נְעָרָיו וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל בְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְרָהָם בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אַבְרָהָם אֶל נְעָרָיו וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל בְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְרָהָם בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע

english.text:
And Abraham went back to his boys
And they got up
And went together to Beer-sheba
And Abraham lived in Beer-sheba

translation.text: So Abraham returned to his Abraham lived at Beer-sheba.

verses.english:
And it was after these things,
and it was told to Abraham, saying,
“Here Milcah has given birth, she also,
to sons for your brother Nahor:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֻּגַּד לְאַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָלְדָה מִלְכָּה גַם הִוא בָּנִים לְנָחוֹר אָחִיךָ

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֻּגַּד לְאַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָלְדָה מִלְכָּה גַם הִוא בָּנִים לְנָחוֹר אָחִיךָ

english.text:
And it was after these things,
and it was told to Abraham, saying,
“Here Milcah has given birth, she also,
to sons for your brother Nahor:

translation.text: Now after these things it was told Abraham, "Milcah also has borne children, to your brother Nahor:

verses.english:
Uz, his firstborn,
and Buz his brother,
and Kemuel, the father of Aram,
verses.hebrew: אֶת עוּץ בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת בּוּז אָחִיו וְאֶת קְמוּאֵל אֲבִי אֲרָם

hebrew.text: אֶת עוּץ בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת בּוּז אָחִיו וְאֶת קְמוּאֵל אֲבִי אֲרָם

english.text:
Uz, his firstborn,
and Buz his brother,
and Kemuel, the father of Aram,

translation.text: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

verses.english:
and Chesed and Hazo
and Pildash and Jidlaph
and Bethuel.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כֶּשֶׂד וְאֶת חֲזוֹ וְאֶת פִּלְדָּשׁ וְאֶת יִדְלָף וְאֵת בְּתוּאֵל

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כֶּשֶׂד וְאֶת חֲזוֹ וְאֶת פִּלְדָּשׁ וְאֶת יִדְלָף וְאֵת בְּתוּאֵל

english.text:
and Chesed and Hazo
and Pildash and Jidlaph
and Bethuel.

translation.text: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel."

verses.english:
And Bethuel fathered Rebekah.”
Milcah gave birth to these eight
for Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.hebrew: וּבְתוּאֵל יָלַד אֶת רִבְקָה שְׁמֹנָה אֵלֶּה יָלְדָה מִלְכָּה לְנָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם

hebrew.text: וּבְתוּאֵל יָלַד אֶת רִבְקָה שְׁמֹנָה אֵלֶּה יָלְדָה מִלְכָּה לְנָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם

english.text:
And Bethuel fathered Rebekah.”
Milcah gave birth to these eight
for Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

translation.text: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

verses.english:
And his concubine,
whose name was Reumah,
she too gave birth,
to Tebah and Gaham
and Tahash and Maacah.
verses.hebrew: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ רְאוּמָה וַתֵּלֶד גַּם הִוא אֶת טֶבַח וְאֶת גַּחַם וְאֶת תַּחַשׁ וְאֶת מַעֲכָה

hebrew.text: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ רְאוּמָה וַתֵּלֶד גַּם הִוא אֶת טֶבַח וְאֶת גַּחַם וְאֶת תַּחַשׁ וְאֶת מַעֲכָה

english.text:
And his concubine,
whose name was Reumah,
she too gave birth,
to Tebah and Gaham
and Tahash and Maacah.

translation.text: Moreover, his concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

verses.english:
And Sarah’s life was a hundred years and
twenty years and seven years: the years of Sarah’s life.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ חַיֵּי שָׂרָה מֵאָה שָׁנָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי שָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ חַיֵּי שָׂרָה מֵאָה שָׁנָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי שָׂרָה׃

english.text:
And Sarah’s life was a hundred years and
twenty years and seven years: the years of Sarah’s life.

translation.text: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years; this was the length of Sarah's life.

verses.english:
And Sarah died in Kiriath Arba—it is Hebron—in the land of
Canaan. And Abraham came to grieve for Sarah and to weep
for her.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּמת שָׂרָה בְּקִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיָּבֹא אַבְרָהָם לִסְפֹּד לְשָׂרָה וְלִבְכֹּתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּמת שָׂרָה בְּקִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיָּבֹא אַבְרָהָם לִסְפֹּד לְשָׂרָה וְלִבְכֹּתָהּ׃

english.text:
And Sarah died in Kiriath Arba—it is Hebron—in the land of
Canaan. And Abraham came to grieve for Sarah and to weep
for her.

translation.text: And Sarah died at Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the for her.

verses.english:
And Abraham got up from in front of his dead, and he spoke
to the children of Heth, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם אַבְרָהָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי מֵתוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי חֵת לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם אַבְרָהָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי מֵתוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי חֵת לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Abraham got up from in front of his dead, and he spoke
to the children of Heth, saying,

translation.text: Abraham rose up from beside his dead, and said to the Hittites,

verses.english:
“I’m an alien and a visitor with you. Give me a possession
for a tomb with you so I may bury my dead from in front of
me.”
verses.hebrew: גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב אָנֹכִי עִמָּכֶם תְּנוּ לִי אֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר עִמָּכֶם וְאֶקְבְּרָה מֵתִי מִלְּפָנָי׃

hebrew.text: גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב אָנֹכִי עִמָּכֶם תְּנוּ לִי אֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר עִמָּכֶם וְאֶקְבְּרָה מֵתִי מִלְּפָנָי׃

english.text:
“I’m an alien and a visitor with you. Give me a possession
for a tomb with you so I may bury my dead from in front of
me.”

translation.text: "I am a stranger and an alien residing among you; give me out of my sight."

verses.english: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי חֵת אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי חֵת אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לוֹ׃

english.text: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

translation.text: The Hittites answered Abraham,

verses.english:
“Listen to us, my lord. You’re a chieftain of God among
us. Bury your dead in the choice of our tombs. Not a man
of us will hold back his tomb from you, from burying your
dead.”
verses.hebrew: שְׁמָעֵנוּ אֲדֹנִי נְשִׂיא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה בְּתוֹכֵנוּ בְּמִבְחַר קְבָרֵינוּ קְבֹר אֶת מֵתֶךָ אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת קִבְרוֹ לֹא יִכְלֶה מִמְּךָ מִקְּבֹר מֵתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמָעֵנוּ אֲדֹנִי נְשִׂיא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה בְּתוֹכֵנוּ בְּמִבְחַר קְבָרֵינוּ קְבֹר אֶת מֵתֶךָ אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת קִבְרוֹ לֹא יִכְלֶה מִמְּךָ מִקְּבֹר מֵתֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Listen to us, my lord. You’re a chieftain of God among
us. Bury your dead in the choice of our tombs. Not a man
of us will hold back his tomb from you, from burying your
dead.”

translation.text: "Hear us, my ground for burying your dead."

verses.english:
And Abraham got up and bowed to the people of the land, to
the children of Heth,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם אַבְרָהָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְעַם הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי חֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם אַבְרָהָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְעַם הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי חֵת׃

english.text:
And Abraham got up and bowed to the people of the land, to
the children of Heth,

translation.text: Abraham rose and bowed to the Hittites, the people of the land.

verses.english:
and he spoke with them, saying, “If it’s acceptable to you
to bury my dead from in front of me, listen to me, and
intercede for me with Ephron, son of Zohar,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אִתָּם לֵאמֹר אִם יֵשׁ אֶת נַפְשְׁכֶם לִקְבֹּר אֶת מֵתִי מִלְּפָנַי שְׁמָעוּנִי וּפִגְעוּ לִי בְּעֶפְרוֹן בֶּן צֹחַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אִתָּם לֵאמֹר אִם יֵשׁ אֶת נַפְשְׁכֶם לִקְבֹּר אֶת מֵתִי מִלְּפָנַי שְׁמָעוּנִי וּפִגְעוּ לִי בְּעֶפְרוֹן בֶּן צֹחַר׃

english.text:
and he spoke with them, saying, “If it’s acceptable to you
to bury my dead from in front of me, listen to me, and
intercede for me with Ephron, son of Zohar,

translation.text: He said to them, "If you are willing me Ephron son of Zohar,

verses.english:
that he’ll give me the cave of Machpelah which he has,
that is at the edge of his field. For full price let him
give it to me among you as a possession for a tomb.”
verses.hebrew: וְיִתֶּן לִי אֶת מְעָרַת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה שָׂדֵהוּ בְּכֶסֶף מָלֵא יִתְּנֶנָּה לִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֶּן לִי אֶת מְעָרַת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה שָׂדֵהוּ בְּכֶסֶף מָלֵא יִתְּנֶנָּה לִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃

english.text:
that he’ll give me the cave of Machpelah which he has,
that is at the edge of his field. For full price let him
give it to me among you as a possession for a tomb.”

translation.text: so that he may give me the cave of burying place."

verses.english:
And Ephron was sitting among the children of Heth, and
Ephron, the Hittite, answered Abraham in the ears of the
children of Heth, for all who were coming to his city’s
gate, saying,
verses.hebrew: וְעֶפְרוֹן יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי חֵת וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי אֶת אַבְרָהָם בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת לְכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְעֶפְרוֹן יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי חֵת וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי אֶת אַבְרָהָם בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת לְכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Ephron was sitting among the children of Heth, and
Ephron, the Hittite, answered Abraham in the ears of the
children of Heth, for all who were coming to his city’s
gate, saying,

translation.text: Now Ephron was sitting among the Hittites; and all who went in at the gate of his city,

verses.english:
“No, sir. Listen to me: I’ve given the field to you, and
I’ve given the cave that’s in it to you. I’ve given it to

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם הָעֶבֶד אֶת יָדוֹ תַּחַת יֶרֶךְ אַבְרָהָם אֲדֹנָיו וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ עַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם הָעֶבֶד אֶת יָדוֹ תַּחַת יֶרֶךְ אַבְרָהָם אֲדֹנָיו וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ עַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And the servant placed his hand under his lord Abraham’s
thigh and swore to him about this thing.

translation.text: So the to him concerning this matter.

verses.english:
And the servant took ten camels of his lord’s camels and
went, and all of his lord’s best things were in his hand.
And he got up and went to Aram Naharaim, to the city of
Nahor,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח הָעֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָה גְמַלִּים מִגְּמַלֵּי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ וְכל טוּב אֲדֹנָיו בְּיָדוֹ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם אֶל עִיר נָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח הָעֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָה גְמַלִּים מִגְּמַלֵּי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ וְכל טוּב אֲדֹנָיו בְּיָדוֹ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם אֶל עִיר נָחוֹר׃

english.text:
And the servant took ten camels of his lord’s camels and
went, and all of his lord’s best things were in his hand.
And he got up and went to Aram Naharaim, to the city of
Nahor,

translation.text: Then the servant took ten of his master's camels and departed, went to Aram-naharaim, to the city of Nahor.

verses.english:
and he had the camels kneel outside the city at the water
well at evening time, the time that the women went out to
draw water.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּבְרֵךְ הַגְּמַלִּים מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל בְּאֵר הַמָּיִם לְעֵת עֶרֶב לְעֵת צֵאת הַשֹּׁאֲבֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבְרֵךְ הַגְּמַלִּים מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל בְּאֵר הַמָּיִם לְעֵת עֶרֶב לְעֵת צֵאת הַשֹּׁאֲבֹת׃

english.text:
and he had the camels kneel outside the city at the water
well at evening time, the time that the women went out to
draw water.

translation.text: He made the camels evening, the time when women go out to draw water.

verses.english:
And he said, “YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, make something
happen in front of me today and show kindness to my lord
Abraham:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם הַקְרֵה נָא לְפָנַי הַיּוֹם וַעֲשֵׂה חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם הַקְרֵה נָא לְפָנַי הַיּוֹם וַעֲשֵׂה חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם׃

english.text:
And he said, “YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, make something
happen in front of me today and show kindness to my lord
Abraham:

translation.text: And he said, and show steadfast love to my master Abraham.

verses.english:
Here I am, standing over the spring of water, and the
daughters of the people of the city are going out to draw
water.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וּבְנוֹת אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר יֹצְאֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וּבְנוֹת אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר יֹצְאֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם׃

english.text:
Here I am, standing over the spring of water, and the
daughters of the people of the city are going out to draw
water.

translation.text: I am standing here coming out to draw water.

verses.english:
And let it be that the girl to whom I’ll say, ‘Tip your
jar so I may drink,’ and she’ll say, ‘Drink, and I’ll
water your camels, too,’ she’ll be the one you’ve pointed
out for your servant, for Isaac, and I’ll know by this
that you’ve shown kindness to my lord.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנַּעֲרָ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַטִּי נָא כַדֵּךְ וְאֶשְׁתֶּה וְאָמְרָה שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה אֹתָהּ הֹכַחְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיִצְחָק וּבָהּ אֵדַע כִּי עָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַנַּעֲרָ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַטִּי נָא כַדֵּךְ וְאֶשְׁתֶּה וְאָמְרָה שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה אֹתָהּ הֹכַחְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיִצְחָק וּבָהּ אֵדַע כִּי עָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And let it be that the girl to whom I’ll say, ‘Tip your
jar so I may drink,’ and she’ll say, ‘Drink, and I’ll
water your camels, too,’ she’ll be the one you’ve pointed
out for your servant, for Isaac, and I’ll know by this
that you’ve shown kindness to my lord.”

translation.text: Let the girl to whom I shall say, 'Please offer your jar that I may drink,' and who shall say, 'Drink, and I will love to my master."

verses.english:
And he had not even finished speaking, and here was
Rebekah—who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, wife of
Nahor, Abraham’s brother—coming out, and her jar was on
her shoulder.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הוּא טֶרֶם כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדָה לִבְתוּאֵל בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הוּא טֶרֶם כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדָה לִבְתוּאֵל בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ׃

english.text:
And he had not even finished speaking, and here was
Rebekah—who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, wife of
Nahor, Abraham’s brother—coming out, and her jar was on
her shoulder.

translation.text: Before he had finished speaking, there was Rebekah, who was born coming out with her water jar on her shoulder.

verses.english:
And the girl was very good-looking, a virgin, and no man
had known her. And she went down to the spring and filled
her jar and went up.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעֲרָ טֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד בְּתוּלָה וְאִישׁ לֹא יְדָעָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּא כַדָּהּ וַתָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעֲרָ טֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד בְּתוּלָה וְאִישׁ לֹא יְדָעָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּא כַדָּהּ וַתָּעַל׃

english.text:
And the girl was very good-looking, a virgin, and no man
had known her. And she went down to the spring and filled
her jar and went up.

translation.text: The girl was very fair the spring, filled her jar, and came up.

verses.english:
And the servant ran toward her and said, “Give me a little
water from your jar.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרץ הָעֶבֶד לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַגְמִיאִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרץ הָעֶבֶד לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַגְמִיאִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּךְ׃

english.text:
And the servant ran toward her and said, “Give me a little
water from your jar.”

translation.text: Then the servant ran to meet her and said, "Please let me sip a little water from your jar."

verses.english:
And she said, “Drink, my lord,” and she hurried and
lowered her jar on her arm and let him drink.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה אֲדֹנִי וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֹּרֶד כַּדָּהּ עַל יָדָהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה אֲדֹנִי וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֹּרֶד כַּדָּהּ עַל יָדָהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And she said, “Drink, my lord,” and she hurried and
lowered her jar on her arm and let him drink.

translation.text: "Drink, gave him a drink.

verses.english:
And she finished letting him drink, and she said, “I’ll
draw water for your camels, too, until they finish
drinking.”
verses.hebrew: וַתְּכַל לְהַשְׁקֹתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר גַּם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב עַד אִם כִּלּוּ לִשְׁתֹּת׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּכַל לְהַשְׁקֹתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר גַּם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב עַד אִם כִּלּוּ לִשְׁתֹּת׃

english.text:
And she finished letting him drink, and she said, “I’ll
draw water for your camels, too, until they finish
drinking.”

translation.text: When she had finished giving him a drink, she drinking."

verses.english:
And she hurried and emptied her jar into the trough and
ran again to the well to draw water, and she drew water
for all his camels.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ אֶל הַשֹּׁקֶת וַתָּרץ עוֹד אֶל הַבְּאֵר לִשְׁאֹב וַתִּשְׁאַב לְכל גְּמַלָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ אֶל הַשֹּׁקֶת וַתָּרץ עוֹד אֶל הַבְּאֵר לִשְׁאֹב וַתִּשְׁאַב לְכל גְּמַלָּיו׃

english.text:
And she hurried and emptied her jar into the trough and
ran again to the well to draw water, and she drew water
for all his camels.

translation.text: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran again to the well to draw, and she drew for all his camels.

verses.english:
And the man, astonished at her, was keeping quiet so as to
know if YHWH had made his trip successful or not.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵה לָהּ מַחֲרִישׁ לָדַעַת הַהִצְלִיחַ יְהֹוָה דַּרְכּוֹ אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵה לָהּ מַחֲרִישׁ לָדַעַת הַהִצְלִיחַ יְהֹוָה דַּרְכּוֹ אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And the man, astonished at her, was keeping quiet so as to
know if YHWH had made his trip successful or not.

translation.text: The man journey successful.

verses.english:
And it was when the camels finished drinking: and the man
took a gold ring—its weight was a beqa—and two bracelets
for her arms—their weight was ten of gold.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלּוּ הַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁתּוֹת וַיִּקַּח הָאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב בֶּקַע מִשְׁקָלוֹ וּשְׁנֵי צְמִידִים עַל יָדֶיהָ עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מִשְׁקָלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלּוּ הַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁתּוֹת וַיִּקַּח הָאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב בֶּקַע מִשְׁקָלוֹ וּשְׁנֵי צְמִידִים עַל יָדֶיהָ עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מִשְׁקָלָם׃

english.text:
And it was when the camels finished drinking: and the man
took a gold ring—its weight was a beqa—and two bracelets
for her arms—their weight was ten of gold.

translation.text: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took a gold nosering weighing a half shekel, and two bracelets for her arms weighing ten gold shekels,

verses.english:
And he said, “Tell me, whose daughter are you? Is there a
place at your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּת מִי אַתְּ הַגִּידִי נָא לִי הֲיֵשׁ בֵּית אָבִיךְ מָקוֹם לָנוּ לָלִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּת מִי אַתְּ הַגִּידִי נָא לִי הֲיֵשׁ בֵּית אָבִיךְ מָקוֹם לָנוּ לָלִין׃

english.text:
And he said, “Tell me, whose daughter are you? Is there a
place at your father’s house for us to spend the night?”

translation.text: and said, "Tell me whose daughter you are. Is there room in your father's house for us to spend the night?"

verses.english:
And she said to him, “I’m a daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s
son whom she bore to Nahor.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בַּת בְּתוּאֵל אָנֹכִי בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְנָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בַּת בְּתוּאֵל אָנֹכִי בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְנָחוֹר׃

english.text:
And she said to him, “I’m a daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s
son whom she bore to Nahor.”

translation.text: She bore to Nahor."

verses.english:
And she said to him, “We also have plenty of both straw
and fodder, also a place to spend the night.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גַּם תֶּבֶן גַּם מִסְפּוֹא רַב עִמָּנוּ גַּם מָקוֹם לָלוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גַּם תֶּבֶן גַּם מִסְפּוֹא רַב עִמָּנוּ גַּם מָקוֹם לָלוּן׃

english.text:
And she said to him, “We also have plenty of both straw
and fodder, also a place to spend the night.”

translation.text: She added, "We have plenty of straw and fodder and a place to spend the night."

verses.english: And the man knelt and bowed to YHWH
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֹּד הָאִישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֹּד הָאִישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text: And the man knelt and bowed to YHWH

translation.text: The man bowed his head and worshiped the LORD

verses.english:
and said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, whose
kindness and faithfulness have not left my lord. I: YHWH
has led me to the house of my lord’s brother.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָזַב חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ מֵעִם אֲדֹנִי אָנֹכִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ נָחַנִי יְהֹוָה בֵּית אֲחֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָזַב חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ מֵעִם אֲדֹנִי אָנֹכִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ נָחַנִי יְהֹוָה בֵּית אֲחֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
and said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, whose
kindness and faithfulness have not left my lord. I: YHWH
has led me to the house of my lord’s brother.”

translation.text: and said, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of my way to the house of my master's kin."

verses.english:
And the girl ran and told her mother’s household about
these things.
