english.text:
And Rebekah said to Jacob, her son, saying, “Here I’ve
heard your father speaking to Esau, your brother, saying,

translation.text: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, "I heard your father say to your brother Esau,

verses.english:
‘Bring me game and make me delicacies so I may eat, and
I’ll bless you in the presence of YHWH before my death.’
verses.hebrew: הָבִיאָה לִּי צַיִד וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים וְאֹכֵלָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מוֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: הָבִיאָה לִּי צַיִד וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים וְאֹכֵלָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מוֹתִי׃

english.text:
‘Bring me game and make me delicacies so I may eat, and
I’ll bless you in the presence of YHWH before my death.’

translation.text: bless you before the LORD before I die.'

verses.english:
And now, my son, listen to my voice, to what I’m
commanding you.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי לַאֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְצַוָּה אֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי לַאֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְצַוָּה אֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
And now, my son, listen to my voice, to what I’m
commanding you.

translation.text: Now therefore, my son, obey my word as I command you.

verses.english:
Go to the flock and take two good goat kids for me from
there, and I’ll make them the kind of delicacies that your
father loves.
verses.hebrew: לֶךְ נָא אֶל הַצֹּאן וְקַח לִי מִשָּׁם שְׁנֵי גְּדָיֵי עִזִּים טֹבִים וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתָם מַטְעַמִּים לְאָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃

hebrew.text: לֶךְ נָא אֶל הַצֹּאן וְקַח לִי מִשָּׁם שְׁנֵי גְּדָיֵי עִזִּים טֹבִים וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתָם מַטְעַמִּים לְאָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃

english.text:
Go to the flock and take two good goat kids for me from
there, and I’ll make them the kind of delicacies that your
father loves.

translation.text: Go to the flock, and get me two choice kids, so that I may prepare from them savory food for your father, such as he likes;

verses.english:
And bring them to your father, and he’ll eat, so he’ll
bless you before his death.”
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ לְאָבִיךָ וְאָכָל בַּעֲבֻר אֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ לְאָבִיךָ וְאָכָל בַּעֲבֻר אֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And bring them to your father, and he’ll eat, so he’ll
bless you before his death.”

translation.text: and you shall take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies."

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, “Here, Esau, my
brother, is a hairy man and I’m a smooth man.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל רִבְקָה אִמּוֹ הֵן עֵשָׂו אָחִי אִישׁ שָׂעִר וְאָנֹכִי אִישׁ חָלָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל רִבְקָה אִמּוֹ הֵן עֵשָׂו אָחִי אִישׁ שָׂעִר וְאָנֹכִי אִישׁ חָלָק׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, “Here, Esau, my
brother, is a hairy man and I’m a smooth man.

translation.text: But Jacob said to his mother Rebekah, "Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, and I am a man of smooth skin.

verses.english:
Maybe my father will feel me, and I’ll be like a trickster
in his eyes, and I’ll bring a curse on me and not a
blessing.”
verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יְמֻשֵּׁנִי אָבִי וְהָיִיתִי בְעֵינָיו כִּמְתַעְתֵּעַ וְהֵבֵאתִי עָלַי קְלָלָה וְלֹא בְרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: אוּלַי יְמֻשֵּׁנִי אָבִי וְהָיִיתִי בְעֵינָיו כִּמְתַעְתֵּעַ וְהֵבֵאתִי עָלַי קְלָלָה וְלֹא בְרָכָה׃

english.text:
Maybe my father will feel me, and I’ll be like a trickster
in his eyes, and I’ll bring a curse on me and not a
blessing.”

translation.text: Perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall seem to be mocking him, and bring a curse on myself and not a blessing."

verses.english:
And his mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my
son; just listen to my voice and go take them for me.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִמּוֹ עָלַי קִלְלָתְךָ בְּנִי אַךְ שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְלֵךְ קַח לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִמּוֹ עָלַי קִלְלָתְךָ בְּנִי אַךְ שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְלֵךְ קַח לִי׃

english.text:
And his mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my
son; just listen to my voice and go take them for me.”

translation.text: His mother said to them for me."

verses.english:
And he went and took and brought them to his mother, and
his mother made the kind of delicacies that his father
loved.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח וַיָּבֵא לְאִמּוֹ וַתַּעַשׂ אִמּוֹ מַטְעַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח וַיָּבֵא לְאִמּוֹ וַתַּעַשׂ אִמּוֹ מַטְעַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And he went and took and brought them to his mother, and
his mother made the kind of delicacies that his father
loved.

translation.text: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother; and his mother prepared savory food, such as his father loved.

verses.english:
And Rebekah took the finest clothes of Esau, her older
son, that were with her in the house and put them on
Jacob, her younger son,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח רִבְקָה אֶת בִּגְדֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנָהּ הַגָּדֹל הַחֲמֻדֹת אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבָּיִת וַתַּלְבֵּשׁ אֶת יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ הַקָּטָן׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח רִבְקָה אֶת בִּגְדֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנָהּ הַגָּדֹל הַחֲמֻדֹת אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבָּיִת וַתַּלְבֵּשׁ אֶת יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ הַקָּטָן׃

english.text:
And Rebekah took the finest clothes of Esau, her older
son, that were with her in the house and put them on
Jacob, her younger son,

translation.text: Then Rebekah took the best garments of her elder son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob;

verses.english:
and put the skins of the goat kids on his hands and on the
smooth part of his neck.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת עֹרֹת גְּדָיֵי הָעִזִּים הִלְבִּישָׁה עַל יָדָיו וְעַל חֶלְקַת צַוָּארָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת עֹרֹת גְּדָיֵי הָעִזִּים הִלְבִּישָׁה עַל יָדָיו וְעַל חֶלְקַת צַוָּארָיו׃

english.text:
and put the skins of the goat kids on his hands and on the
smooth part of his neck.

translation.text: of his neck.

verses.english:
And she put the delicacies and the bread that she’d made
in the hand of Jacob, her son.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֵּן אֶת הַמַּטְעַמִּים וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה בְּיַד יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתֵּן אֶת הַמַּטְעַמִּים וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה בְּיַד יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ׃

english.text:
And she put the delicacies and the bread that she’d made
in the hand of Jacob, her son.

translation.text: Then she handed the savory food, and the bread that she had prepared, to her son Jacob.

verses.english:
And he came to his father. And he said, “My father.” And
he said, “I’m here. Who are you, my son?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי מִי אַתָּה בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי מִי אַתָּה בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And he came to his father. And he said, “My father.” And
he said, “I’m here. Who are you, my son?”

translation.text: So he went in to his father, and said, "My father"; and he said, "Here I am; who are you, my son?"

verses.english:
And Jacob said to his father, “I’m Esau, your firstborn. I
did as you spoke to me. Get up, sit, and eat some of my
game so your soul will bless me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל אָבִיו אָנֹכִי עֵשָׂו בְּכֹרֶךָ עָשִׂיתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי קוּם נָא שְׁבָה וְאכְלָה מִצֵּידִי בַּעֲבוּר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל אָבִיו אָנֹכִי עֵשָׂו בְּכֹרֶךָ עָשִׂיתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי קוּם נָא שְׁבָה וְאכְלָה מִצֵּידִי בַּעֲבוּר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to his father, “I’m Esau, your firstborn. I
did as you spoke to me. Get up, sit, and eat some of my
game so your soul will bless me.”

translation.text: Jacob said to his father, "I am my game, so that you may bless me."

verses.english:
And Isaac said to his son, “What’s this? You were quick to
find it, my son.” And he said, “Because YHWH your God made
it happen for me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל בְּנוֹ מַה זֶּה מִהַרְתָּ לִמְצֹא בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי הִקְרָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל בְּנוֹ מַה זֶּה מִהַרְתָּ לִמְצֹא בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי הִקְרָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנָי׃

english.text:
And Isaac said to his son, “What’s this? You were quick to
find it, my son.” And he said, “Because YHWH your God made
it happen for me.”

translation.text: But Isaac said to his son, "How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?" He answered, "Because the LORD your God granted me success."

verses.english:
And Isaac said to Jacob, “Come over, and I’ll feel you, my
son: is this you, my son Esau, or not?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב גְּשָׁה נָּא וַאֲמֻשְׁךָ בְּנִי הַאַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב גְּשָׁה נָּא וַאֲמֻשְׁךָ בְּנִי הַאַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And Isaac said to Jacob, “Come over, and I’ll feel you, my
son: is this you, my son Esau, or not?”

translation.text: Then Isaac said to Jacob, really my son Esau or not."

verses.english:
And Jacob came over to Isaac, his father, and he felt him.
And he said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, and the
hands are the hands of Esau.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיְמֻשֵּׁהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב וְהַיָּדַיִם יְדֵי עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיְמֻשֵּׁהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב וְהַיָּדַיִם יְדֵי עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Jacob came over to Isaac, his father, and he felt him.
And he said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, and the
hands are the hands of Esau.”

translation.text: So Jacob went up to his father Isaac, who hands of Esau."

verses.english:
And he did not recognize him because his hands were hairy
like the hands of Esau, his brother, and he blessed him.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הִכִּירוֹ כִּי הָיוּ יָדָיו כִּידֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיו שְׂעִרֹת וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הִכִּירוֹ כִּי הָיוּ יָדָיו כִּידֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיו שְׂעִרֹת וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And he did not recognize him because his hands were hairy
like the hands of Esau, his brother, and he blessed him.

translation.text: He did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau's hands; so he blessed him.

verses.english:
And he said, “Is this you, my son Esau?” And he said, “I
am.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

english.text:
And he said, “Is this you, my son Esau?” And he said, “I
am.”

translation.text: He said, "Are you really my son Esau?" He answered, "I am."

verses.english:
And he said, “Bring it over to me and let me eat some of
my son’s game so that my soul will bless you. And he
brought it over to him, and he ate; and he brought him
wine, and he drank.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּשָׁה לִּי וְאֹכְלָה מִצֵּיד בְּנִי לְמַעַן תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי וַיַּגֶּשׁ לוֹ וַיֹּאכַל וַיָּבֵא לוֹ יַיִן וַיֵּשְׁתְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּשָׁה לִּי וְאֹכְלָה מִצֵּיד בְּנִי לְמַעַן תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי וַיַּגֶּשׁ לוֹ וַיֹּאכַל וַיָּבֵא לוֹ יַיִן וַיֵּשְׁתְּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Bring it over to me and let me eat some of
my son’s game so that my soul will bless you. And he
brought it over to him, and he ate; and he brought him
wine, and he drank.

translation.text: Then he said, "Bring brought it to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.

verses.english:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Come over and kiss
me, my son.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק אָבִיו גְּשָׁה נָּא וּשְׁקָה לִּי בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק אָבִיו גְּשָׁה נָּא וּשְׁקָה לִּי בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Come over and kiss
me, my son.”

translation.text: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come near and kiss me, my son."

verses.english:
And he came over and kissed him, and he smelled the aroma
of his clothes and blessed him and said, “See, my son’s
aroma is like the aroma of a field that YHWH has blessed.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ וַיָּרַח אֶת רֵיחַ בְּגָדָיו וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר רְאֵה רֵיחַ בְּנִי כְּרֵיחַ שָׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ וַיָּרַח אֶת רֵיחַ בְּגָדָיו וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר רְאֵה רֵיחַ בְּנִי כְּרֵיחַ שָׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he came over and kissed him, and he smelled the aroma
of his clothes and blessed him and said, “See, my son’s
aroma is like the aroma of a field that YHWH has blessed.

translation.text: So he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.

verses.english:
And may God give you from the dew of the skies and from
the fat of the earth and much grain and wine.
verses.hebrew: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ הָאֱלֹהִים מִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְרֹב דָּגָן וְתִירֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ הָאֱלֹהִים מִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְרֹב דָּגָן וְתִירֹשׁ׃

english.text:
And may God give you from the dew of the skies and from
the fat of the earth and much grain and wine.

translation.text: May God give you of the dew of heaven, and plenty of grain and wine.

verses.english:
May peoples serve you and nations bow to you. Be your
brothers’ superior, and may your mother’s sons bow to you.
May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you
be blessed.”
verses.hebrew: יַעַבְדוּךָ עַמִּים (וישתחו) [וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לְךָ לְאֻמִּים הֱוֵה גְבִיר לְאַחֶיךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אִמֶּךָ אֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר וּמְבָרְכֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ׃

hebrew.text: יַעַבְדוּךָ עַמִּים (וישתחו) [וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לְךָ לְאֻמִּים הֱוֵה גְבִיר לְאַחֶיךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אִמֶּךָ אֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר וּמְבָרְכֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ׃

english.text:
May peoples serve you and nations bow to you. Be your
brothers’ superior, and may your mother’s sons bow to you.
May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you
be blessed.”

translation.text: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. and may your mother's sons bow down to you. and blessed be everyone who blesses you!"

verses.english:
And it was as Isaac finished blessing Jacob, and it was:
Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac, his
father!—and Esau, his brother, came from his hunting.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה יִצְחָק לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיְהִי אַךְ יָצֹא יָצָא יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו וְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו בָּא מִצֵּידוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה יִצְחָק לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיְהִי אַךְ יָצֹא יָצָא יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו וְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו בָּא מִצֵּידוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was as Isaac finished blessing Jacob, and it was:
Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac, his
father!—and Esau, his brother, came from his hunting.

translation.text: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, when Jacob had Esau came in from his hunting.

verses.english:
And he, too, had made delicacies and brought them to his
father. And he said to his father, “Let my father get up
and eat some of his son’s game so you yourself will bless
me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ גַּם הוּא מַטְעַמִּים וַיָּבֵא לְאָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו יָקֻם אָבִי וְיֹאכַל מִצֵּיד בְּנוֹ בַּעֲבֻר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ גַּם הוּא מַטְעַמִּים וַיָּבֵא לְאָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו יָקֻם אָבִי וְיֹאכַל מִצֵּיד בְּנוֹ בַּעֲבֻר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
And he, too, had made delicacies and brought them to his
father. And he said to his father, “Let my father get up
and eat some of his son’s game so you yourself will bless
me.”

translation.text: He also prepared savory food, and brought it to his father. And he said to his father, "Let my father sit up and eat of his son's game, so that you may bless me."

verses.english:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Who are you?” And he
said, “I’m your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יִצְחָק אָבִיו מִי אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי בִּנְךָ בְכֹרְךָ עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יִצְחָק אָבִיו מִי אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי בִּנְךָ בְכֹרְךָ עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Who are you?” And he
said, “I’m your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

translation.text: His father son, Esau."

verses.english:
And Isaac trembled—a very big trembling. And he said, “Who
then is the one who hunted game and brought it to me, and
I ate some of it all before you came, and I blessed him?
He will in fact be blessed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱרַד יִצְחָק חֲרָדָה גְּדֹלָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵפוֹא הוּא הַצָּד צַיִד וַיָּבֵא לִי וָאֹכַל מִכֹּל בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא וָאֲבָרְכֵהוּ גַּם בָּרוּךְ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱרַד יִצְחָק חֲרָדָה גְּדֹלָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵפוֹא הוּא הַצָּד צַיִד וַיָּבֵא לִי וָאֹכַל מִכֹּל בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא וָאֲבָרְכֵהוּ גַּם בָּרוּךְ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And Isaac trembled—a very big trembling. And he said, “Who
then is the one who hunted game and brought it to me, and
I ate some of it all before you came, and I blessed him?
He will in fact be blessed.”

translation.text: Then Isaac trembled violently, and said, "Who was it you came, and I have blessed him? — yes, and blessed he shall be!"

verses.english:
When Esau heard his father’s words he cried—a very big and
bitter cry. And he said to his father, “Bless me, also me,
my father.”
verses.hebrew: כִּשְׁמֹעַ עֵשָׂו אֶת דִּבְרֵי אָבִיו וַיִּצְעַק צְעָקָה גְּדֹלָה וּמָרָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו בָּרְכֵנִי גַם אָנִי אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּשְׁמֹעַ עֵשָׂו אֶת דִּבְרֵי אָבִיו וַיִּצְעַק צְעָקָה גְּדֹלָה וּמָרָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו בָּרְכֵנִי גַם אָנִי אָבִי׃

english.text:
When Esau heard his father’s words he cried—a very big and
bitter cry. And he said to his father, “Bless me, also me,
my father.”

translation.text: great and bitter cry, and said to his father, "Bless me, me also, father!"

verses.english:
And he said, “Your brother came with deception, and he
took your blessing.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּא אָחִיךָ בְּמִרְמָה וַיִּקַּח בִּרְכָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּא אָחִיךָ בְּמִרְמָה וַיִּקַּח בִּרְכָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Your brother came with deception, and he
took your blessing.”

translation.text: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully, and he has taken away your blessing."

verses.english:
And he said, “Was his name really called Jacob! And he’s
usurped me two times now. He’s taken my birthright, and,
here, now he’s taken my blessing.” And he said, “Haven’t
you saved a blessing for me?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הֲכִי קָרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם אֶת בְּכֹרָתִי לָקָח וְהִנֵּה עַתָּה לָקַח בִּרְכָתִי וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אָצַלְתָּ לִּי בְּרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הֲכִי קָרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם אֶת בְּכֹרָתִי לָקָח וְהִנֵּה עַתָּה לָקַח בִּרְכָתִי וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אָצַלְתָּ לִּי בְּרָכָה׃

english.text:
And he said, “Was his name really called Jacob! And he’s
usurped me two times now. He’s taken my birthright, and,
here, now he’s taken my blessing.” And he said, “Haven’t
you saved a blessing for me?”

translation.text: Esau said, "Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has reserved a blessing for me?"

verses.english:
And Isaac answered, and he said to Esau, “Here I’ve made
him your superior, and I’ve given all his brothers as
servants, and I’ve endowed him with grain and wine. And
for you: where, what, will I do, my son?”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵשָׂו הֵן גְּבִיר שַׂמְתִּיו לָךְ וְאֶת כּל אֶחָיו נָתַתִּי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים וְדָגָן וְתִירֹשׁ סְמַכְתִּיו וּלְכָה אֵפוֹא מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵשָׂו הֵן גְּבִיר שַׂמְתִּיו לָךְ וְאֶת כּל אֶחָיו נָתַתִּי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים וְדָגָן וְתִירֹשׁ סְמַכְתִּיו וּלְכָה אֵפוֹא מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And Isaac answered, and he said to Esau, “Here I’ve made
him your superior, and I’ve given all his brothers as
servants, and I’ve endowed him with grain and wine. And
for you: where, what, will I do, my son?”

translation.text: Isaac answered Esau, "I have already you, my son?"

verses.english:
And Esau said to his father, “Is it one blessing that you
have, my father? Bless me, also me, my father.” And Esau
raised his voice and wept.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אֶל אָבִיו הַבְרָכָה אַחַת הִוא לְךָ אָבִי בָּרְכֵנִי גַם אָנִי אָבִי וַיִּשָּׂא עֵשָׂו קֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אֶל אָבִיו הַבְרָכָה אַחַת הִוא לְךָ אָבִי בָּרְכֵנִי גַם אָנִי אָבִי וַיִּשָּׂא עֵשָׂו קֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃

english.text:
And Esau said to his father, “Is it one blessing that you
have, my father? Bless me, also me, my father.” And Esau
raised his voice and wept.

translation.text: Esau said to his father, "Have you only one blessing, wept.

verses.english:
And Isaac, his father, answered, and he said to him,
“Here, away from the fat of the earth will be your home,
and from the dew of the skies from above.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה מִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וּמִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה מִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וּמִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל׃

english.text:
And Isaac, his father, answered, and he said to him,
“Here, away from the fat of the earth will be your home,
and from the dew of the skies from above.

translation.text: Then his father Isaac answered him: and away from the dew of heaven on high.

verses.english:
And you’ll live by your sword. And you’ll serve your
brother. And it will be that when you get dominion you’ll
break his yoke from your neck.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַל חַרְבְּךָ תִחְיֶה וְאֶת אָחִיךָ תַּעֲבֹד וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּרִיד וּפָרַקְתָּ עֻלּוֹ מֵעַל צַוָּארֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל חַרְבְּךָ תִחְיֶה וְאֶת אָחִיךָ תַּעֲבֹד וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּרִיד וּפָרַקְתָּ עֻלּוֹ מֵעַל צַוָּארֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you’ll live by your sword. And you’ll serve your
brother. And it will be that when you get dominion you’ll
break his yoke from your neck.”

translation.text: By your sword you shall live, and you shall serve your brother; you shall break his yoke from your neck."

verses.english:
And Esau despised Jacob because of the blessing with which
his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, “The
days of mourning for my father will be soon, and then I’ll
kill Jacob, my brother.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂטֹם עֵשָׂו אֶת יַעֲקֹב עַל הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו בְּלִבּוֹ יִקְרְבוּ יְמֵי אֵבֶל אָבִי וְאַהַרְגָה אֶת יַעֲקֹב אָחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂטֹם עֵשָׂו אֶת יַעֲקֹב עַל הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו בְּלִבּוֹ יִקְרְבוּ יְמֵי אֵבֶל אָבִי וְאַהַרְגָה אֶת יַעֲקֹב אָחִי׃

english.text:
And Esau despised Jacob because of the blessing with which
his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, “The
days of mourning for my father will be soon, and then I’ll
kill Jacob, my brother.”

translation.text: Now Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father my father are approaching; then I will kill my brother Jacob."

verses.english:
And the words of Esau, her older son, were told to
Rebekah, and she sent and called to Jacob, her younger
son, and said to him, “Here, Esau, your brother, consoles
himself regarding you with the idea of killing you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְרִבְקָה אֶת דִּבְרֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנָהּ הַגָּדֹל וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְיַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ הַקָּטָן וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ מִתְנַחֵם לְךָ לְהרְגֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְרִבְקָה אֶת דִּבְרֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנָהּ הַגָּדֹל וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְיַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ הַקָּטָן וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ מִתְנַחֵם לְךָ לְהרְגֶךָ׃

english.text:
And the words of Esau, her older son, were told to
Rebekah, and she sent and called to Jacob, her younger
son, and said to him, “Here, Esau, your brother, consoles
himself regarding you with the idea of killing you.

translation.text: But consoling himself by planning to kill you.

verses.english:
And now, my son, listen to my voice and get up, flee to
Laban, my brother, at Haran
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְקוּם בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל לָבָן אָחִי חָרָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְקוּם בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל לָבָן אָחִי חָרָנָה׃

english.text:
And now, my son, listen to my voice and get up, flee to
Laban, my brother, at Haran

translation.text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran,

verses.english:
and live with him for a number of days until your
brother’s fury will turn back,
verses.hebrew: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ עִמּוֹ יָמִים אֲחָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁוּב חֲמַת אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ עִמּוֹ יָמִים אֲחָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁוּב חֲמַת אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
and live with him for a number of days until your
brother’s fury will turn back,

translation.text: and stay with him a while, until your brother's fury turns away —

verses.english:
until your brother’s anger turns back from you and he
forgets what you did to him. And I’ll send and take you
from there. Why should I be bereaved of the two of you as
well in one day?”
verses.hebrew: עַד שׁוּב אַף אָחִיךָ מִמְּךָ וְשָׁכַח אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ וְשָׁלַחְתִּי וּלְקַחְתִּיךָ מִשָּׁם לָמָה אֶשְׁכַּל גַּם שְׁנֵיכֶם יוֹם אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: עַד שׁוּב אַף אָחִיךָ מִמְּךָ וְשָׁכַח אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ וְשָׁלַחְתִּי וּלְקַחְתִּיךָ מִשָּׁם לָמָה אֶשְׁכַּל גַּם שְׁנֵיכֶם יוֹם אֶחָד׃

english.text:
until your brother’s anger turns back from you and he
forgets what you did to him. And I’ll send and take you
from there. Why should I be bereaved of the two of you as
well in one day?”

translation.text: until your should I lose both of you in one day?"

verses.english:
And Rebekah said to Isaac, “I’m disgusted with my life
because of the daughters of Heth! If Jacob takes a wife
from the daughters of Heth like these daughters of the
land, why do I have a life!”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רִבְקָה אֶל יִצְחָק קַצְתִּי בְחַיַּי מִפְּנֵי בְּנוֹת חֵת אִם לֹקֵחַ יַעֲקֹב אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת חֵת כָּאֵלֶּה מִבְּנוֹת הָאָרֶץ לָמָּה לִּי חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר רִבְקָה אֶל יִצְחָק קַצְתִּי בְחַיַּי מִפְּנֵי בְּנוֹת חֵת אִם לֹקֵחַ יַעֲקֹב אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת חֵת כָּאֵלֶּה מִבְּנוֹת הָאָרֶץ לָמָּה לִּי חַיִּים׃

english.text:
And Rebekah said to Isaac, “I’m disgusted with my life
because of the daughters of Heth! If Jacob takes a wife
from the daughters of Heth like these daughters of the
land, why do I have a life!”

translation.text: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the me?"

verses.english:
And Isaac called Jacob, and he blessed him and
commanded him, and he said to him, “You shall not take a
wife from the daughters of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And Isaac called Jacob, and he blessed him and
commanded him, and he said to him, “You shall not take a
wife from the daughters of Canaan.

translation.text: Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and charged him, "You shall not marry one of the Canaanite women.

verses.english:
Get up. Go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel, your
mother’s father, and take a wife from there, from the
daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
verses.hebrew: קוּם לֵךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם בֵּיתָה בְתוּאֵל אֲבִי אִמֶּךָ וְקַח לְךָ מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: קוּם לֵךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם בֵּיתָה בְתוּאֵל אֲבִי אִמֶּךָ וְקַח לְךָ מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Get up. Go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel, your
mother’s father, and take a wife from there, from the
daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

translation.text: Go at once to Paddan-aram there one of the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.

verses.english:
And may El Shadday bless you and make you fruitful and
multiply you, so you’ll become a community of peoples,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יְבָרֵךְ אֹתְךָ וְיַפְרְךָ וְיַרְבֶּךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִקְהַל עַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יְבָרֵךְ אֹתְךָ וְיַפְרְךָ וְיַרְבֶּךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִקְהַל עַמִּים׃

english.text:
And may El Shadday bless you and make you fruitful and
multiply you, so you’ll become a community of peoples,

translation.text: May may become a company of peoples.

verses.english:
and may He give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to
your seed with you, for you to possess the land of your
residences, which God gave to Abraham.”
verses.hebrew: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ אֶת בִּרְכַּת אַבְרָהָם לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אִתָּךְ לְרִשְׁתְּךָ אֶת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אֱלֹהִים לְאַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ אֶת בִּרְכַּת אַבְרָהָם לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אִתָּךְ לְרִשְׁתְּךָ אֶת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אֱלֹהִים לְאַבְרָהָם׃

english.text:
and may He give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to
your seed with you, for you to possess the land of your
residences, which God gave to Abraham.”

translation.text: May he give to you the blessing God gave to Abraham."

verses.english:
And Isaac sent Jacob, and he went to Paddan Aram, to
Laban, son of Bethuel, the Aramean, brother of Rebekah,
mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִצְחָק אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם אֶל לָבָן בֶּן בְּתוּאֵל הָאֲרַמִּי אֲחִי רִבְקָה אֵם יַעֲקֹב וְעֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִצְחָק אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם אֶל לָבָן בֶּן בְּתוּאֵל הָאֲרַמִּי אֲחִי רִבְקָה אֵם יַעֲקֹב וְעֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Isaac sent Jacob, and he went to Paddan Aram, to
Laban, son of Bethuel, the Aramean, brother of Rebekah,
mother of Jacob and Esau.

translation.text: Thus Isaac sent Jacob away; and he went to Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

verses.english:
And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to
Paddan Aram to take a wife for himself from there when he
blessed him, and he had commanded him, saying, “You shall
not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי בֵרַךְ יִצְחָק אֶת יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁלַּח אֹתוֹ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם לָקַחַת לוֹ מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה בְּבָרְכוֹ אֹתוֹ וַיְצַו עָלָיו לֵאמֹר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי בֵרַךְ יִצְחָק אֶת יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁלַּח אֹתוֹ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם לָקַחַת לוֹ מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה בְּבָרְכוֹ אֹתוֹ וַיְצַו עָלָיו לֵאמֹר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to
Paddan Aram to take a wife for himself from there when he
blessed him, and he had commanded him, saying, “You shall
not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,”

translation.text: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to charged him, "You shall not marry one of the Canaanite women,"

verses.english:
and Jacob had listened to his father and to his mother and
had gone to Paddan Aram.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יַעֲקֹב אֶל אָבִיו וְאֶל אִמּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יַעֲקֹב אֶל אָבִיו וְאֶל אִמּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם׃

english.text:
and Jacob had listened to his father and to his mother and
had gone to Paddan Aram.

translation.text: Paddan-aram.

verses.english:
And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were bad in his
father Isaac’s eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי רָעוֹת בְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן בְּעֵינֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי רָעוֹת בְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן בְּעֵינֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were bad in his
father Isaac’s eyes.

translation.text: So when Esau saw that the Canaanite women did not please his father Isaac,

verses.english:
And Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, daughter of
Ishmael, son of Abraham, sister of Nebaioth, in addition
to his wives as a wife for him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵאל וַיִּקַּח אֶת מָחֲלַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת עַל נָשָׁיו לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵאל וַיִּקַּח אֶת מָחֲלַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת עַל נָשָׁיו לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, daughter of
Ishmael, son of Abraham, sister of Nebaioth, in addition
to his wives as a wife for him.

translation.text: Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath wife in addition to the wives he had.

verses.english: And Jacob left Beer-sheba and went to Haran.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יַעֲקֹב מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיֵּלֶךְ חָרָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא יַעֲקֹב מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיֵּלֶךְ חָרָנָה׃

english.text: And Jacob left Beer-sheba and went to Haran.

translation.text: Jacob left Beer-sheba and went toward Haran.

verses.english:
And he happened upon a place and stayed the night there
because the sun was setting. And he took from the stones
of the place and set it as his headrest and lay down in
that place.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיִּקַּח מֵאַבְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיִּקַּח מֵאַבְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And he happened upon a place and stayed the night there
because the sun was setting. And he took from the stones
of the place and set it as his headrest and lay down in
that place.

translation.text: He came to a certain place and stayed there for the night, because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones of the place, he put it under his head and lay down in that place.

verses.english:
And he dreamed. And here was a ladder, set up on the
earth, and its top reaching to the skies. And here were
angels of God, going up and going down by it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he dreamed. And here was a ladder, set up on the
earth, and its top reaching to the skies. And here were
angels of God, going up and going down by it.

translation.text: And he dreamed that there was a ladder set up were ascending and descending on it.

verses.english:
And here was YHWH standing over him, and He said, “I am
YHWH, your father Abraham’s God and Isaac’s God. The land
on which you’re lying: I’ll give it to you and to your
seed.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה נִצָּב עָלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ וֵאלֹהֵי יִצְחָק הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שֹׁכֵב עָלֶיהָ לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה נִצָּב עָלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ וֵאלֹהֵי יִצְחָק הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שֹׁכֵב עָלֶיהָ לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And here was YHWH standing over him, and He said, “I am
YHWH, your father Abraham’s God and Isaac’s God. The land
on which you’re lying: I’ll give it to you and to your
seed.

translation.text: And the LORD stood beside offspring;

verses.english:
And your seed will be like the dust of the earth, and
you’ll expand to the west and east and north and south,
and all the families on the earth will be blessed through
you and through your seed.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְצָפֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה וּבְזַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְצָפֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה וּבְזַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And your seed will be like the dust of the earth, and
you’ll expand to the west and east and north and south,
and all the families on the earth will be blessed through
you and through your seed.

translation.text: and your offspring shall be like the dust of the earth, and and to the south; and all the families of the earth shall be blessed in you and in your offspring.

verses.english:
And here I am with you, and I’ll watch over you everywhere
that you’ll go, and I’ll bring you back to this land, for
I won’t leave you until I’ve done what I’ve spoken to
you.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה הַזֹּאת כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה הַזֹּאת כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׃

english.text:
And here I am with you, and I’ll watch over you everywhere
that you’ll go, and I’ll bring you back to this land, for
I won’t leave you until I’ve done what I’ve spoken to
you.”

translation.text: Know that I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."

verses.english:
And Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “YHWH is actually
in this place, and I didn’t know!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
And Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “YHWH is actually
in this place, and I didn’t know!”

translation.text: Then Jacob woke from his sleep and said, "Surely the LORD is in this place — and I did not know it!"

verses.english:
And he was afraid, and he said, “How awesome this place
is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the
gate of the skies!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְזֶה שַׁעַר הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְזֶה שַׁעַר הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And he was afraid, and he said, “How awesome this place
is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the
gate of the skies!”

translation.text: And he was afraid, and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven."

verses.english:
And Jacob got up early in the morning and took the stone
that he had set as his headrest and set it as a pillar and
poured oil on its top.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יַעֲקֹב בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָהּ מַצֵּבָה וַיִּצֹק שֶׁמֶן עַל רֹאשָׁהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יַעֲקֹב בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָהּ מַצֵּבָה וַיִּצֹק שֶׁמֶן עַל רֹאשָׁהּ׃

english.text:
And Jacob got up early in the morning and took the stone
that he had set as his headrest and set it as a pillar and
poured oil on its top.

translation.text: So Jacob rose early in the morning, and he took the stone that he had put under his head and set it up for a pillar and poured oil on the top of it.

verses.english:
And he called that place’s name Beth-El, though in fact
Luz was the name of the city at first.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֵּית אֵל וְאוּלָם לוּז שֵׁם הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֵּית אֵל וְאוּלָם לוּז שֵׁם הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
And he called that place’s name Beth-El, though in fact
Luz was the name of the city at first.

translation.text: He called that place Bethel; but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

verses.english:
And Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and
watch over me in this way that I’m going and give me bread
to eat and clothing to wear,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּר יַעֲקֹב נֶדֶר לֵאמֹר אִם יִהְיֶה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי וּשְׁמָרַנִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ וְנָתַן לִי לֶחֶם לֶאֱכֹל וּבֶגֶד לִלְבֹּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדַּר יַעֲקֹב נֶדֶר לֵאמֹר אִם יִהְיֶה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי וּשְׁמָרַנִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ וְנָתַן לִי לֶחֶם לֶאֱכֹל וּבֶגֶד לִלְבֹּשׁ׃

english.text:
And Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and
watch over me in this way that I’m going and give me bread
to eat and clothing to wear,

translation.text: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with eat and clothing to wear,

verses.english:
and I come back in peace to my father’s house, then YHWH
will become my God,
verses.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתִּי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶל בֵּית אָבִי וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׁבְתִּי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶל בֵּית אָבִי וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
and I come back in peace to my father’s house, then YHWH
will become my God,

translation.text: so that I come again to my father's house in peace, then the LORD shall be my God,

verses.english:
and this stone that I set as a pillar will be God’s house,
and everything that you’ll give me I’ll tithe to you.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי מַצֵּבָה יִהְיֶה בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּתֶּן לִי עַשֵּׂר אֲעַשְּׂרֶנּוּ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי מַצֵּבָה יִהְיֶה בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּתֶּן לִי עַשֵּׂר אֲעַשְּׂרֶנּוּ לָךְ׃

english.text:
and this stone that I set as a pillar will be God’s house,
and everything that you’ll give me I’ll tithe to you.”

translation.text: and this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God's house; and of all that you give me I will surely give one-tenth to you."

verses.english:
And Jacob lifted his feet and went to the land of the
people of the east.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב רַגְלָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַרְצָה בְנֵי קֶדֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב רַגְלָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַרְצָה בְנֵי קֶדֶם׃

english.text:
And Jacob lifted his feet and went to the land of the
people of the east.

translation.text: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the people of the east.

verses.english:
And he looked, and here was a well in the field, and here
were three flocks of sheep lying by it, because they
watered the flocks from that well, and the stone on the
mouth of the well was big,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶדְרֵי צֹאן רֹבְצִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי מִן הַבְּאֵר הַהִוא יַשְׁקוּ הָעֲדָרִים וְהָאֶבֶן גְּדֹלָה עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶדְרֵי צֹאן רֹבְצִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי מִן הַבְּאֵר הַהִוא יַשְׁקוּ הָעֲדָרִים וְהָאֶבֶן גְּדֹלָה עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר׃

english.text:
And he looked, and here was a well in the field, and here
were three flocks of sheep lying by it, because they
watered the flocks from that well, and the stone on the
mouth of the well was big,

translation.text: As he looked, he saw a well in the field and three flocks watered. The stone on the well's mouth was large,

verses.english:
and all the flocks would be gathered there, and they would
roll the stone from the mouth of the well and would water
the sheep and then would put the stone back in its place
on the mouth of the well.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶאֶסְפוּ שָׁמָּה כל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקוּ אֶת הַצֹּאן וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר לִמְקֹמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶאֶסְפוּ שָׁמָּה כל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקוּ אֶת הַצֹּאן וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר לִמְקֹמָהּ׃

english.text:
and all the flocks would be gathered there, and they would
roll the stone from the mouth of the well and would water
the sheep and then would put the stone back in its place
on the mouth of the well.

translation.text: and when all the its place on the mouth of the well.

verses.english:
4And Jacob said to them, “My brothers, where are you
from?” And they said, “We’re from Haran.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יַעֲקֹב אַחַי מֵאַיִן אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵחָרָן אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יַעֲקֹב אַחַי מֵאַיִן אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵחָרָן אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
4And Jacob said to them, “My brothers, where are you
from?” And they said, “We’re from Haran.”

translation.text: Jacob said to them, "My brothers, where do you come from?" They said, "We are from Haran."

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Do you know Laban, son of Nahor?”
And they said, “We know.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם אֶת לָבָן בֶּן נָחוֹר וַיֹּאמְרוּ יָדָעְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם אֶת לָבָן בֶּן נָחוֹר וַיֹּאמְרוּ יָדָעְנוּ׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Do you know Laban, son of Nahor?”
And they said, “We know.”

translation.text: He said to them, "Do you know Laban son of Nahor?" They said, "We do."

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Is he well?” And they said, “Well.
And here’s Rachel, his daughter, coming with the sheep.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הֲשָׁלוֹם לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם וְהִנֵּה רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הֲשָׁלוֹם לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם וְהִנֵּה רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Is he well?” And they said, “Well.
And here’s Rachel, his daughter, coming with the sheep.”

translation.text: He said to them, "Is it well with with the sheep."

verses.english:
And he said, “Here, it will still be daytime for a long
time, not the time for gathering the livestock. Water the
sheep and go, pasture them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הֵן עוֹד הַיּוֹם גָּדוֹל לֹא עֵת הֵאָסֵף הַמִּקְנֶה הַשְׁקוּ הַצֹּאן וּלְכוּ רְעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הֵן עוֹד הַיּוֹם גָּדוֹל לֹא עֵת הֵאָסֵף הַמִּקְנֶה הַשְׁקוּ הַצֹּאן וּלְכוּ רְעוּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Here, it will still be daytime for a long
time, not the time for gathering the livestock. Water the
sheep and go, pasture them.”

translation.text: He said, "Look, it is still broad daylight; it is not time pasture them."

verses.english:
And they said, “We can’t until all the flocks will be
gathered and they’ll roll the stone from the mouth of the
well, and then we’ll water the sheep.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יֵאָסְפוּ כּל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקִינוּ הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יֵאָסְפוּ כּל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקִינוּ הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And they said, “We can’t until all the flocks will be
gathered and they’ll roll the stone from the mouth of the
well, and then we’ll water the sheep.”

translation.text: But they said, "We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together, and the stone is rolled from the mouth of the well; then we water the sheep."

verses.english:
He was still speaking with them, and Rachel came with her
father’s sheep, because she was a shepherdess.
verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְרָחֵל בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיהָ כִּי רֹעָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְרָחֵל בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיהָ כִּי רֹעָה הִוא׃

english.text:
He was still speaking with them, and Rachel came with her
father’s sheep, because she was a shepherdess.

translation.text: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.

verses.english:
And it was when Jacob saw Rachel, daughter of Laban, his
mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s
brother: and he went over and rolled the stone from the
mouth of the well and watered the sheep of Laban, his
mother’s brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל בַּת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וְאֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב וַיָּגֶל אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל בַּת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וְאֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב וַיָּגֶל אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was when Jacob saw Rachel, daughter of Laban, his
mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s
brother: and he went over and rolled the stone from the
mouth of the well and watered the sheep of Laban, his
mother’s brother.

translation.text: Now when Jacob saw Rachel, the mouth, and watered the flock of his mother's brother Laban.

verses.english: And Jacob kissed Rachel and raised his voice and wept.

english.text: And Jacob kissed Rachel and raised his voice and wept.

translation.text: Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and wept aloud.

verses.english:
And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kin and
that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her
father.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל כִּי אֲחִי אָבִיהָ הוּא וְכִי בֶן רִבְקָה הוּא וַתָּרץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל כִּי אֲחִי אָבִיהָ הוּא וְכִי בֶן רִבְקָה הוּא וַתָּרץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kin and
that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her
father.

translation.text: And Jacob told Rachel that he and told her father.

verses.english:
And it was, when Laban heard the news of Jacob, his
sister’s son, that he ran to him and embraced him and
kissed him and brought him to his house. And he told Laban
all these things.

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ לָבָן אֶת שֵׁמַע יַעֲקֹב בֶּן אֲחֹתוֹ וַיָּרץ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְחַבֶּק לוֹ וַיְנַשֶּׁק לוֹ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיְסַפֵּר לְלָבָן אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

And it was, when Laban heard the news of Jacob, his

kissed him and brought him to his house. And he told Laban
all these things.

translation.text: When Laban heard the news about his sister's son Jacob, he ran to house. Jacob told Laban all these things,

And Laban said to him, “You are indeed my bone and my
flesh.” And he stayed with him a month.

And Laban said to him, “You are indeed my bone and my

your pay should be.”

brother that you should work for me for free? Tell me what
your pay should be.”

translation.text: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my kinsman, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what shall your wages be?"

verses.english:
And Laban had two daughters. The older one’s name was
Leah, and the younger one’s name was Rachel.

english.text:
And Laban had two daughters. The older one’s name was
Leah, and the younger one’s name was Rachel.

translation.text: the name of the younger was Rachel.

verses.english:
And Leah’s eyes were tender, and Rachel had an attractive
figure and was beautiful.

english.text:
And Leah’s eyes were tender, and Rachel had an attractive
figure and was beautiful.

translation.text: Leah's eyes were lovely, and Rachel was graceful and beautiful.

verses.english:
And Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, “I’ll work for you
seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶעֱבדְךָ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּרָחֵל בִּתְּךָ הַקְּטַנָּה׃

english.text:
And Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, “I’ll work for you
seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

translation.text: Jacob loved Rachel; so he said, "I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel."

verses.english:
And Laban said, “Better for me to give her to you than for
me to give her to another man. Live with me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן טוֹב תִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לָךְ מִתִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן טוֹב תִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לָךְ מִתִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
And Laban said, “Better for me to give her to you than for
me to give her to another man. Live with me.”

translation.text: Laban said, "It is better that I give her to you than that I should give her to any other man; stay with me."

verses.english:
And Jacob worked seven years for Rachel, and they were
like a few days in his eyes because of his loving her.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹד יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַיִּהְיוּ בְעֵינָיו כְּיָמִים אֲחָדִים בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And Jacob worked seven years for Rachel, and they were
like a few days in his eyes because of his loving her.

translation.text: So Jacob served seven years for had for her.

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, because my days
have been completed, and let me come to her.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל לָבָן הָבָה אֶת אִשְׁתִּי כִּי מָלְאוּ יָמָי וְאָבוֹאָה אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל לָבָן הָבָה אֶת אִשְׁתִּי כִּי מָלְאוּ יָמָי וְאָבוֹאָה אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, because my days
have been completed, and let me come to her.”

translation.text: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife that I may go in to her, for my time is completed."

verses.english:
And Laban gathered all the people of the place and made a
feast.

english.text:
And Laban gathered all the people of the place and made a
feast.

translation.text: So Laban gathered together all the people of the place, and made a feast.

verses.english:

and brought her to him. And he came to her.

english.text:
And it was in the evening, and he took Leah, his daughter,
and brought her to him. And he came to her.

translation.text: But in the evening he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob; and he went in to her.

verses.english:
And Laban gave her his maid Zilpah—to Leah, his daughter,

english.text:
And Laban gave her his maid Zilpah—to Leah, his daughter,
as a maid.

translation.text: (Laban gave his maid Zilpah to his daughter Leah to be her maid.)

And it was in the morning, and here she was: Leah! And he
said to Laban, “What is this you’ve done to me? Didn’t I
work with you for Rachel? And why have you deceived me?”

And Laban said, “It’s not done like that in our place, to

And Laban said, “It’s not done like that in our place, to

Complete this week, and this one will be given to you as
well—for the work that you’ll do with me: another seven

Complete this week, and this one will be given to you as

And Jacob did so; and he completed this week, and he gave

And Jacob did so; and he completed this week, and he gave
him Rachel, his daughter, for a wife.

translation.text: Jacob did so, and completed her week; then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as a wife.

verses.english:
And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to Rachel, his daughter—to
her as a maid.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לָהּ לְשִׁפְחָה׃

english.text:
And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to Rachel, his daughter—to
her as a maid.

translation.text: (Laban gave his maid Bilhah to his daughter Rachel to be her maid.)

verses.english:
And he also came to Rachel. And he also loved Rachel more
than Leah. And he worked with him another seven years.

english.text:
And he also came to Rachel. And he also loved Rachel more
than Leah. And he worked with him another seven years.

translation.text: So served Laban for another seven years.

And YHWH saw that Leah was hated, and He opened her womb,

And YHWH saw that Leah was hated, and He opened her womb,
and Rachel was infertile.

translation.text: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, he opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.

called his name Reuben because she said, “Because YHWH
looked at my suffering, so that now my man will love me.”

And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she said, “Now, this time my man will become bound to me
because I’ve given birth to three sons for him.” On
account of this his name was called Levi.

account of this his name was called Levi.

translation.text: husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons"; therefore he was named Levi.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and
said, “This time I’ll praise YHWH.” On account of this she
called his name Judah. And she stopped giving birth.

english.text:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and
said, “This time I’ll praise YHWH.” On account of this she
called his name Judah. And she stopped giving birth.

translation.text: She conceived again and bore a son, Judah; then she ceased bearing.

verses.english:
And Rachel saw that she had not given birth for Jacob,
and Rachel was jealous of her sister, and she said to
Jacob, “Give me children. And if not I’m dying!”
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא רָחֵל כִּי לֹא יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב וַתְּקַנֵּא רָחֵל בַּאֲחֹתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל יַעֲקֹב הָבָה לִּי בָנִים וְאִם אַיִן מֵתָה אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא רָחֵל כִּי לֹא יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב וַתְּקַנֵּא רָחֵל בַּאֲחֹתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל יַעֲקֹב הָבָה לִּי בָנִים וְאִם אַיִן מֵתָה אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
And Rachel saw that she had not given birth for Jacob,
and Rachel was jealous of her sister, and she said to
Jacob, “Give me children. And if not I’m dying!”

translation.text: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, she envied her sister; and she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I shall die!"

verses.english:
And Jacob’s anger flared at Rachel, and he said, “Am I in
place of God, who has held back the fruit of the womb from
you?!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר מָנַע מִמֵּךְ פְּרִי בָטֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר מָנַע מִמֵּךְ פְּרִי בָטֶן׃

english.text:
And Jacob’s anger flared at Rachel, and he said, “Am I in
place of God, who has held back the fruit of the womb from
you?!”

translation.text: Jacob who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?"

verses.english:
And she said, “Here’s my maid, Bilhah. Come to her, and
she’ll give birth on my knees, and I too will get a child
through her.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אֲמָתִי בִלְהָה בֹּא אֵלֶיהָ וְתֵלֵד עַל בִּרְכַּי וְאִבָּנֶה גַם אָנֹכִי מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אֲמָתִי בִלְהָה בֹּא אֵלֶיהָ וְתֵלֵד עַל בִּרְכַּי וְאִבָּנֶה גַם אָנֹכִי מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
And she said, “Here’s my maid, Bilhah. Come to her, and
she’ll give birth on my knees, and I too will get a child
through her.”

translation.text: Then she said, knees and that I too may have children through her."

verses.english:
And she gave him Bilhah, her maid, as a wife, and Jacob
came to her.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתָהּ לְאִשָּׁה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתָהּ לְאִשָּׁה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And she gave him Bilhah, her maid, as a wife, and Jacob
came to her.

translation.text: So she gave him her maid Bilhah as a wife; and Jacob went in to her.

verses.english:
And Bilhah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר בִּלְהָה וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר בִּלְהָה וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

english.text:
And Bilhah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Jacob.

translation.text: And Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.

verses.english:
And Rachel said, “God has judged me and heard my prayer as
well and has given me a son.” On account of this she
called his name Dan.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל דָּנַנִּי אֱלֹהִים וְגַם שָׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וַיִּתֶּן לִי בֵּן עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ דָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל דָּנַנִּי אֱלֹהִים וְגַם שָׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וַיִּתֶּן לִי בֵּן עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ דָּן׃

english.text:
And Rachel said, “God has judged me and heard my prayer as
well and has given me a son.” On account of this she
called his name Dan.

translation.text: Then Rachel said, "God has judged named him Dan.

verses.english:
And Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, became pregnant again and gave
birth to a second son for Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, became pregnant again and gave
birth to a second son for Jacob.

translation.text: Rachel's maid Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

verses.english:
And Rachel said, “I’ve had Godlike struggles with my
sister. I’ve also prevailed.” And she called his name
Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל נַפְתּוּלֵי אֱלֹהִים נִפְתַּלְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִי גַּם יָכֹלְתִּי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל נַפְתּוּלֵי אֱלֹהִים נִפְתַּלְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִי גַּם יָכֹלְתִּי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
And Rachel said, “I’ve had Godlike struggles with my
sister. I’ve also prevailed.” And she called his name
Naphtali.

translation.text: Then Rachel said, "With mighty wrestlings I have Naphtali.

verses.english:
And Leah saw that she had stopped giving birth, and she
took Zilpah, her maid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא לֵאָה כִּי עָמְדָה מִלֶּדֶת וַתִּקַּח אֶת זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחָתָהּ וַתִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ לְיַעֲקֹב לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Leah saw that she had stopped giving birth, and she
took Zilpah, her maid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

translation.text: When Leah saw that she had ceased bearing children, she took her maid Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

verses.english: And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a son for Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

english.text: And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a son for Jacob.

translation.text: Then Leah's maid Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

verses.english: And Leah said, “With fortune!” and called his name Gad.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה (בגד) [בָּא גָד] וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גָּד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה (בגד) [בָּא גָד] וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גָּד׃

english.text: And Leah said, “With fortune!” and called his name Gad.

translation.text: And Leah said, "Good fortune!" so she named him Gad.

verses.english:
And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a second son for
Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a second son for
Jacob.

translation.text: Leah's maid Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

verses.english:
And Leah said, “With my happiness!—because daughters will
wish me happiness,” and called his name Asher.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה בְּאשְׁרִי כִּי אִשְּׁרוּנִי בָּנוֹת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אָשֵׁר׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה בְּאשְׁרִי כִּי אִשְּׁרוּנִי בָּנוֹת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אָשֵׁר׃

english.text:
And Leah said, “With my happiness!—because daughters will
wish me happiness,” and called his name Asher.

translation.text: And named him Asher.

verses.english:
And in the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found
mandrakes in the field and brought them to Leah, his
mother. And Rachel said to Leah, “Give me some of your
son’s mandrakes.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן בִּימֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וַיִּמְצָא דוּדָאִים בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֶל לֵאָה אִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל אֶל לֵאָה תְּנִי נָא לִי מִדּוּדָאֵי בְּנֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן בִּימֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וַיִּמְצָא דוּדָאִים בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֶל לֵאָה אִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל אֶל לֵאָה תְּנִי נָא לִי מִדּוּדָאֵי בְּנֵךְ׃

english.text:
And in the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found
mandrakes in the field and brought them to Leah, his
mother. And Rachel said to Leah, “Give me some of your
son’s mandrakes.”

translation.text: In the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found mandrakes in Leah, "Please give me some of your son's mandrakes."

verses.english:
And she said to her, “Is your taking my man a small thing?
And you’re taking my son’s mandrakes, too?!” And Rachel
said, “Then let him lie with you tonight in return for
your son’s mandrakes.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְעַט קַחְתֵּךְ אֶת אִישִׁי וְלָקַחַת גַּם אֶת דּוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל לָכֵן יִשְׁכַּב עִמָּךְ הַלַּיְלָה תַּחַת דּוּדָאֵי בְנֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְעַט קַחְתֵּךְ אֶת אִישִׁי וְלָקַחַת גַּם אֶת דּוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל לָכֵן יִשְׁכַּב עִמָּךְ הַלַּיְלָה תַּחַת דּוּדָאֵי בְנֵךְ׃

english.text:
And she said to her, “Is your taking my man a small thing?
And you’re taking my son’s mandrakes, too?!” And Rachel
said, “Then let him lie with you tonight in return for
your son’s mandrakes.”

translation.text: But she said to her, "Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? may lie with you tonight for your son's mandrakes."

verses.english:
And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah
went out to him and said, “You are to come to me, because
I’ve hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” And he lay with
her that night.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב מִן הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וַתֵּצֵא לֵאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי תָּבוֹא כִּי שָׂכֹר שְׂכַרְתִּיךָ בְּדוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב מִן הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וַתֵּצֵא לֵאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי תָּבוֹא כִּי שָׂכֹר שְׂכַרְתִּיךָ בְּדוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

english.text:
And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah
went out to him and said, “You are to come to me, because
I’ve hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” And he lay with
her that night.

translation.text: When Jacob mandrakes." So he lay with her that night.

verses.english:
And God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and gave
birth to a fifth son for Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל לֵאָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן חֲמִישִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל לֵאָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן חֲמִישִׁי׃

english.text:
And God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and gave
birth to a fifth son for Jacob.

translation.text: And God heeded Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.

verses.english:
