verses.english:
And they gave all the foreign gods that were in their hand
and the rings that were in their ears to Jacob, and Jacob
stashed them under the oak that was by Shechem.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֵת כּל אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם וְאֶת הַנְּזָמִים אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּטְמֹן אֹתָם יַעֲקֹב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר עִם שְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֵת כּל אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם וְאֶת הַנְּזָמִים אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּטְמֹן אֹתָם יַעֲקֹב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר עִם שְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And they gave all the foreign gods that were in their hand
and the rings that were in their ears to Jacob, and Jacob
stashed them under the oak that was by Shechem.

translation.text: So they gave to Jacob all the foreign gods that they had, and the rings near Shechem.

verses.english:
And they traveled, and God’s terror was on the cities that
were around them, and they did not pursue the children of
Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּעוּ וַיְהִי חִתַּת אֱלֹהִים עַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וְלֹא רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסָּעוּ וַיְהִי חִתַּת אֱלֹהִים עַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וְלֹא רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And they traveled, and God’s terror was on the cities that
were around them, and they did not pursue the children of
Jacob.

translation.text: As they journeyed, a terror from God fell upon the cities all around them, so that no one pursued them.

verses.english:
And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—it
is Beth-El—he and all the people who were with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב לוּזָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן הִוא בֵּית אֵל הוּא וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב לוּזָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן הִוא בֵּית אֵל הוּא וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—it
is Beth-El—he and all the people who were with him.

translation.text: Jacob came to Luz (that is, were with him,

verses.english:
And he built an altar there and called the place El of
Beth-El because God was revealed to him there when he was
fleeing from his brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם אֵל בֵּית אֵל כִּי שָׁם נִגְלוּ אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בְּברְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם אֵל בֵּית אֵל כִּי שָׁם נִגְלוּ אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בְּברְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And he built an altar there and called the place El of
Beth-El because God was revealed to him there when he was
fleeing from his brother.

translation.text: and there he built an altar and called the place Elbethel, because it was there that God had revealed himself to him when he fled from his brother.

verses.english:
And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried beneath
Beth-El, beneath an oak, and he called its name Oak of
Weeping.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּמת דְּבֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וַתִּקָּבֵר מִתַּחַת לְבֵית אֵל תַּחַת הָאַלּוֹן וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּמת דְּבֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וַתִּקָּבֵר מִתַּחַת לְבֵית אֵל תַּחַת הָאַלּוֹן וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת׃

english.text:
And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried beneath
Beth-El, beneath an oak, and he called its name Oak of
Weeping.

translation.text: And Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried under an oak below Bethel. So it was called Allonbacuth.

verses.english:
And God appeared to Jacob again when he was coming from
Paddan Aram, and He blessed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב עוֹד בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב עוֹד בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And God appeared to Jacob again when he was coming from
Paddan Aram, and He blessed him.

translation.text: God appeared to Jacob again when he came from Paddan-aram, and he blessed him.

verses.english:
And God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name will
not be called Jacob anymore, but rather Israel will be
your name.” And He called his name Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹא יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹא יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name will
not be called Jacob anymore, but rather Israel will be
your name.” And He called his name Israel.

translation.text: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob; no longer called Israel.

verses.english:
And God said to him, “I am El Shadday Be fruitful and
multiply. A nation and a community of nations will be from
you, and kings will come out from your hips.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה מִמֶּךָּ וּמְלָכִים מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה מִמֶּךָּ וּמְלָכִים מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

english.text:
And God said to him, “I am El Shadday Be fruitful and
multiply. A nation and a community of nations will be from
you, and kings will come out from your hips.

translation.text: God said to him, "I am God Almighty: be fruitful and kings shall spring from you.

verses.english:
And the land that I gave to Abraham and to Isaac: I’ll
give it to you, and I’ll give the land to your seed after
you.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם וּלְיִצְחָק לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם וּלְיִצְחָק לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the land that I gave to Abraham and to Isaac: I’ll
give it to you, and I’ll give the land to your seed after
you.”

translation.text: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give the land to your offspring after you."

verses.english:
And God went up from on him in the place where He had
spoken with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And God went up from on him in the place where He had
spoken with him.

translation.text: Then God went up from him at the place where he had spoken with him.

verses.english:
And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken
with him, a stone pillar, and he poured a libation on it
and spilled oil on it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken
with him, a stone pillar, and he poured a libation on it
and spilled oil on it.

translation.text: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had on it, and poured oil on it.

verses.english:
And Jacob called the name of the place where God had
spoken to him there Beth-El.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם אֱלֹהִים בֵּית אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם אֱלֹהִים בֵּית אֵל׃

english.text:
And Jacob called the name of the place where God had
spoken to him there Beth-El.

translation.text: So Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Beth-El, and there was still the
span of the land to come to Ephrat, and Rachel gave birth,
and she had difficulty in her labor.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבֵּית אֵל וַיְהִי עוֹד כִּבְרַת הָאָרֶץ לָבוֹא אֶפְרָתָה וַתֵּלֶד רָחֵל וַתְּקַשׁ בְּלִדְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבֵּית אֵל וַיְהִי עוֹד כִּבְרַת הָאָרֶץ לָבוֹא אֶפְרָתָה וַתֵּלֶד רָחֵל וַתְּקַשׁ בְּלִדְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Beth-El, and there was still the
span of the land to come to Ephrat, and Rachel gave birth,
and she had difficulty in her labor.

translation.text: Then they journeyed from Bethel; and when they were still some labor.

verses.english:
And it was when she was having difficulty in her labor,
and the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, because
this, too, is a son for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְהַקְשֹׁתָהּ בְּלִדְתָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְיַלֶּדֶת אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי גַם זֶה לָךְ בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְהַקְשֹׁתָהּ בְּלִדְתָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְיַלֶּדֶת אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי גַם זֶה לָךְ בֵּן׃

english.text:
And it was when she was having difficulty in her labor,
and the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, because
this, too, is a son for you.”

translation.text: When she was in her hard labor, the midwife said to her, "Do not be afraid; for now you will have another son."

verses.english:
And it was as her soul was going out—because she died—and
she called his name Ben-oni. And his father called him
Benjamin.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן אוֹנִי וְאָבִיו קָרָא לוֹ בִנְיָמִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן אוֹנִי וְאָבִיו קָרָא לוֹ בִנְיָמִין׃

english.text:
And it was as her soul was going out—because she died—and
she called his name Ben-oni. And his father called him
Benjamin.

translation.text: As her soul was him Benjamin.

verses.english:
And Rachel died. And she was buried on the road to Ephrat.
It is Bethlehem.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּמת רָחֵל וַתִּקָּבֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָתָה הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּמת רָחֵל וַתִּקָּבֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָתָה הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And Rachel died. And she was buried on the road to Ephrat.
It is Bethlehem.

translation.text: So Rachel died, and she was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem),

verses.english:
And Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. It is the pillar
of Rachel’s grave to this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה עַל קְבֻרָתָהּ הִוא מַצֶּבֶת קְבֻרַת רָחֵל עַד הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה עַל קְבֻרָתָהּ הִוא מַצֶּבֶת קְבֻרַת רָחֵל עַד הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. It is the pillar
of Rachel’s grave to this day.

translation.text: and Jacob set up a pillar at her grave; it is the pillar of Rachel's tomb, which is there to this day.

verses.english: And Israel traveled and pitched his tent past Migdal-Eder.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּט אהֳלֹה מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּט אהֳלֹה מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵדֶר׃

english.text: And Israel traveled and pitched his tent past Migdal-Eder.

translation.text: Israel journeyed on, and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

verses.english:
And it was when Israel was tenting in that land: and
Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine.
And Israel heard. And Jacob’s sons were twelve.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֶת בִּלְהָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵ͏ל׃ פ וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֶת בִּלְהָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵ͏ל׃ פ וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

english.text:
And it was when Israel was tenting in that land: and
Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine.
And Israel heard. And Jacob’s sons were twelve.

translation.text: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine; and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

verses.english:
The sons of Leah were Jacob’s firstborn, Reuben, and
Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לֵאָה בְּכוֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וּזְבֻלוּן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי לֵאָה בְּכוֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וּזְבֻלוּן׃

english.text:
The sons of Leah were Jacob’s firstborn, Reuben, and
Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun.

translation.text: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob's firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

verses.english: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי רָחֵל יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי רָחֵל יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

translation.text: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.english:
And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, were Dan and
Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בִלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי בִלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, were Dan and
Naphtali.

translation.text: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel's maid: Dan and Naphtali.

verses.english:
And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maid, were Gad and Asher.
These were Jacob’s sons, who were born to him in Paddan
Aram.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה גָּד וְאָשֵׁר אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה גָּד וְאָשֵׁר אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם׃

english.text:
And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maid, were Gad and Asher.
These were Jacob’s sons, who were born to him in Paddan
Aram.

translation.text: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's maid: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Paddanaram.

verses.english:
And Jacob came to Isaac, his father, at Mamre, at Kiriath
Arba—it is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac had resided.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו מַמְרֵא קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּר שָׁם אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו מַמְרֵא קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּר שָׁם אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And Jacob came to Isaac, his father, at Mamre, at Kiriath
Arba—it is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac had resided.

translation.text: Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had resided as aliens.

verses.english: And Isaac’s days were a hundred years and eighty years,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text: And Isaac’s days were a hundred years and eighty years,

translation.text: Now the days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

verses.english:
and Isaac expired. And he died and was gathered to his
people, old and full of days. And Esau and Jacob, his
sons, buried him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְוַע יִצְחָק וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב בָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְוַע יִצְחָק וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב בָּנָיו׃

english.text:
and Isaac expired. And he died and was gathered to his
people, old and full of days. And Esau and Jacob, his
sons, buried him.

translation.text: And Isaac breathed his last; he died and was gathered to his people, old and full of days; and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

verses.english: And these are the records of Esau: He is Edom.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

english.text: And these are the records of Esau: He is Edom.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Esau (that is, Edom).

verses.english:
Esau had taken his wives from the daughters of Canaan:
Adah, daughter of Elon, the Hittite, and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite,
verses.hebrew: עֵשָׂו לָקַח אֶת נָשָׁיו מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן אֶת עָדָה בַּת אֵילוֹן הַחִתִּי וְאֶת אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן הַחִוִּי׃

hebrew.text: עֵשָׂו לָקַח אֶת נָשָׁיו מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן אֶת עָדָה בַּת אֵילוֹן הַחִתִּי וְאֶת אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן הַחִוִּי׃

english.text:
Esau had taken his wives from the daughters of Canaan:
Adah, daughter of Elon, the Hittite, and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite,

translation.text: Esau took his Oholibamah daughter of Anah son of Zibeon the Hivite,

verses.english: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת׃

english.text: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.

translation.text: and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

verses.english:
And Adah gave birth for Esau to Eliphaz, and Basemath gave
birth to Reuel,
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה לְעֵשָׂו אֶת אֱלִיפָז וּבָשְׂמַת יָלְדָה אֶת רְעוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה לְעֵשָׂו אֶת אֱלִיפָז וּבָשְׂמַת יָלְדָה אֶת רְעוּאֵל׃

english.text:
And Adah gave birth for Esau to Eliphaz, and Basemath gave
birth to Reuel,

translation.text: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau; Basemath bore Reuel;

verses.english:
and Aholibamah gave birth to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
These are Esau’s sons, who were born to him in the land of
Canaan.
verses.hebrew: וְאהֳלִיבָמָה יָלְדָה אֶת [יְעוּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת יַעְלָם וְאֶת קֹרַח אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדוּ לוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וְאהֳלִיבָמָה יָלְדָה אֶת [יְעוּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת יַעְלָם וְאֶת קֹרַח אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדוּ לוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
and Aholibamah gave birth to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
These are Esau’s sons, who were born to him in the land of
Canaan.

translation.text: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, land of Canaan.

verses.english:
And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and
all the persons of his household and his cattle and all of
his animals and all of his possessions that he had
acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land,
from the presence of Jacob, his brother,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח עֵשָׂו אֶת נָשָׁיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת כּל נַפְשׁוֹת בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְאֵת כּל קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֶרֶץ מִפְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח עֵשָׂו אֶת נָשָׁיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת כּל נַפְשׁוֹת בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְאֵת כּל קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֶרֶץ מִפְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and
all the persons of his household and his cattle and all of
his animals and all of his possessions that he had
acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land,
from the presence of Jacob, his brother,

translation.text: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the land some distance from his brother Jacob.

verses.english:
because their property was too great for them to live
together, and the land of their residences was not able to
suffice them because of their cattle.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
because their property was too great for them to live
together, and the land of their residences was not able to
suffice them because of their cattle.

translation.text: For their possessions were could not support them because of their livestock.

verses.english: And Esau lived in Mount Seir. Esau: he is Edom.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב עֵשָׂו בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב עֵשָׂו בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

english.text: And Esau lived in Mount Seir. Esau: he is Edom.

translation.text: So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.

verses.english:
And these are the records of Esau, father of Edom, in
Mount Seir.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר׃

english.text:
And these are the records of Esau, father of Edom, in
Mount Seir.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Esau, ancestor of the Edomites, in the hill country of Seir.

verses.english:
These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, son of Adah,
Esau’s wife; Reuel, son of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז בֶּן עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו רְעוּאֵל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז בֶּן עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו רְעוּאֵל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, son of Adah,
Esau’s wife; Reuel, son of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz son of Adah the wife of Esau; Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.english:
And Eliphaz’s sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam and
Kenaz.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן אוֹמָר צְפוֹ וְגַעְתָּם וּקְנַז׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן אוֹמָר צְפוֹ וְגַעְתָּם וּקְנַז׃

english.text:
And Eliphaz’s sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam and
Kenaz.

translation.text: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.english:
And Timna had been a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau,
and she gave birth to Amalek for Eliphaz. These are the
sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: וְתִמְנַע הָיְתָה פִילֶגֶשׁ לֶאֱלִיפַז בֶּן עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לֶאֱלִיפַז אֶת עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וְתִמְנַע הָיְתָה פִילֶגֶשׁ לֶאֱלִיפַז בֶּן עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לֶאֱלִיפַז אֶת עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Timna had been a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau,
and she gave birth to Amalek for Eliphaz. These are the
sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: Eliphaz.) These were the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

verses.english:
And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah
and Mizzeh. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל נַחַת וָזֶרַח שַׁמָּה וּמִזָּה אֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל נַחַת וָזֶרַח שַׁמָּה וּמִזָּה אֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah
and Mizzeh. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: These were the sons of Esau's wife, Basemath.

verses.english:
And these were the sons of Aholibamah, daughter of Anah,
daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she gave birth for
Esau to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה בַת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לְעֵשָׂו אֶת [יְעוּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת יַעְלָם וְאֶת קֹרַח׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה בַת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לְעֵשָׂו אֶת [יְעוּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת יַעְלָם וְאֶת קֹרַח׃

english.text:
And these were the sons of Aholibamah, daughter of Anah,
daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she gave birth for
Esau to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.

translation.text: These were the sons of Esau's wife Jalam, and Korah.

verses.english:
These are the chiefs of the children of Esau: the sons of
Eliphaz, Esau’s firstborn: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief
Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי בְנֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּכוֹר עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף אוֹמָר אַלּוּף צְפוֹ אַלּוּף קְנַז׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי בְנֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּכוֹר עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף אוֹמָר אַלּוּף צְפוֹ אַלּוּף קְנַז׃

english.text:
These are the chiefs of the children of Esau: the sons of
Eliphaz, Esau’s firstborn: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief
Zepho, chief Kenaz,

translation.text: These are the clans of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: the clans Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

verses.english:
chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the
chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons
of Adah.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף קֹרַח אַלּוּף גַּעְתָּם אַלּוּף עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף קֹרַח אַלּוּף גַּעְתָּם אַלּוּף עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה׃

english.text:
chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the
chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons
of Adah.

translation.text: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek; these are the clans of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Adah.

verses.english:
And these are the sons of Reuel, son of Esau: chief
Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These
are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the
sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל בֶּן עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף נַחַת אַלּוּף זֶרַח אַלּוּף שַׁמָּה אַלּוּף מִזָּה אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי רְעוּאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל בֶּן עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף נַחַת אַלּוּף זֶרַח אַלּוּף שַׁמָּה אַלּוּף מִזָּה אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי רְעוּאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And these are the sons of Reuel, son of Esau: chief
Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These
are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the
sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: These are the sons of Esau's son Reuel: Reuel in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.english:
And these are the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief
Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These were the chiefs of
Aholibamah, daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף יְעוּשׁ אַלּוּף יַעְלָם אַלּוּף קֹרַח אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף יְעוּשׁ אַלּוּף יַעְלָם אַלּוּף קֹרַח אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And these are the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief
Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These were the chiefs of
Aholibamah, daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: These are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: the clans Jeush, the daughter of Anah.

verses.english:
These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs.
That is Edom.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֵשָׂו וְאֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶם הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֵשָׂו וְאֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶם הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs.
That is Edom.

translation.text: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their clans.

verses.english:
These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who live in the
land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׂעִיר הַחֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַעֲנָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׂעִיר הַחֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַעֲנָה׃

english.text:
These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who live in the
land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah

translation.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.english:
and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs of
the Horites, the children of Seir, in the land of Edom.
verses.hebrew: וְדִשׁוֹן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי בְּנֵי שֵׂעִיר בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְדִשׁוֹן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי בְּנֵי שֵׂעִיר בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs of
the Horites, the children of Seir, in the land of Edom.

translation.text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the clans of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.

verses.english:
And the children of Lotan are Hori and Hemam, and Lotan’s
sister is Timna.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃

english.text:
And the children of Lotan are Hori and Hemam, and Lotan’s
sister is Timna.

translation.text: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Heman; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath
and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָם׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath
and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

translation.text: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah—that
is Anah who found the water in the wilderness when he
tended the asses of Zibeon, his father.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה הוּא עֲנָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא אֶת הַיֵּמִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בִּרְעֹתוֹ אֶת הַחֲמֹרִים לְצִבְעוֹן אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה הוּא עֲנָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא אֶת הַיֵּמִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בִּרְעֹתוֹ אֶת הַחֲמֹרִים לְצִבְעוֹן אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah—that
is Anah who found the water in the wilderness when he
tended the asses of Zibeon, his father.

translation.text: father Zibeon.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah.

translation.text: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban
and Ithran and Cheran.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי דִישָׁן חֶמְדָּן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי דִישָׁן חֶמְדָּן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban
and Ithran and Cheran.

translation.text: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.english:
These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and
Akan.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן וַעֲקָן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן וַעֲקָן׃

english.text:
These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and
Akan.

translation.text: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דִישָׁן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דִישָׁן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃

english.text: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

translation.text: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.english:
These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief
Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָה׃

english.text:
These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief
Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

translation.text: These are the clans of the Horites: the clans Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.english:
chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the
chiefs of the Horites by their chiefdoms in the land of
Seir.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף דִּשֹׁן אַלּוּף אֵצֶר אַלּוּף דִּישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ שֵׂעִיר׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף דִּשֹׁן אַלּוּף אֵצֶר אַלּוּף דִּישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ שֵׂעִיר׃

english.text:
chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the
chiefs of the Horites by their chiefdoms in the land of
Seir.

translation.text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the clans of the Horites, clan by clan in the land of Seir.

verses.english:
And these are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom
before a king ruled the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לִפְנֵי מְלךְ מֶלֶךְ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לִפְנֵי מְלךְ מֶלֶךְ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And these are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom
before a king ruled the children of Israel.

translation.text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the Israelites.

verses.english:
And Bela son of Beor ruled in Edom, and the name of his
city was Dinhabah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּאֱדוֹם בֶּלַע בֶּן בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּאֱדוֹם בֶּלַע בֶּן בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָבָה׃

english.text:
And Bela son of Beor ruled in Edom, and the name of his
city was Dinhabah.

translation.text: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom, the name of his city being Dinhabah.

verses.english:
And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah ruled in
his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבּצְרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבּצְרָה׃

english.text:
And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah ruled in
his place.

translation.text: Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah of Bozrah succeeded him as king.

verses.english:
And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani ruled in
his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חֻשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חֻשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִי׃

english.text:
And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani ruled in
his place.

translation.text: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

verses.english:
And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian
in the field of Moab, ruled in his place, and the name of
his city was Avith.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת חֻשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עֲוִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת חֻשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עֲוִית׃

english.text:
And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian
in the field of Moab, ruled in his place, and the name of
his city was Avith.

translation.text: Husham died, and succeeded him as king, the name of his city being Avith.

verses.english: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah ruled in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָה׃

english.text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah ruled in his place.

translation.text: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah succeeded him as king.

verses.english:
And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth on the river ruled
in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָר׃

english.text:
And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth on the river ruled
in his place.

translation.text: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates succeeded him as king.

verses.english:
And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor ruled in his
place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר׃

english.text:
And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor ruled in his
place.

translation.text: Shaul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor succeeded him as king.

verses.english:
And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar ruled in his
place, and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s
name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred daughter of Mezahab.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ פָּעוּ וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל בַּת מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ פָּעוּ וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל בַּת מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב׃

english.text:
And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar ruled in his
place, and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s
name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred daughter of Mezahab.

translation.text: Baalhanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar succeeded him as king, the name Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.

verses.english:
And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau by their
families, by their places, by their names: chief Timnah,
chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִמְקֹמֹתָם בִּשְׁמֹתָם אַלּוּף תִּמְנָע אַלּוּף עַלְוָה אַלּוּף יְתֵת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִמְקֹמֹתָם בִּשְׁמֹתָם אַלּוּף תִּמְנָע אַלּוּף עַלְוָה אַלּוּף יְתֵת׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau by their
families, by their places, by their names: chief Timnah,
chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

translation.text: These are the names of the clans of Esau, according to their families and their localities by their names: the clans Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

verses.english: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף אהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹן׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף אהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹן׃

english.text: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

translation.text: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

verses.english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק וּבְטֶרֶם יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְנַכְּלוּ אֹתוֹ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק וּבְטֶרֶם יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְנַכְּלוּ אֹתוֹ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And they saw him from a distance, and before he came close
to them they conspired against him: to kill him.

translation.text: They saw him from a distance, and before he came near to them, they conspired to kill him.

verses.english:
And the brothers said to one another, “Here comes the
dream-master, that one there!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת הַלָּזֶה בָּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת הַלָּזֶה בָּא׃

english.text:
And the brothers said to one another, “Here comes the
dream-master, that one there!

translation.text: They said to one another, "Here comes this dreamer.

verses.english:
And now, come on and let’s kill him and throw him in one
of the pits, and we’ll say a wild animal ate him, and
we’ll see what his dreams will be!”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנַהַרְגֵהוּ וְנַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד הַבֹּרוֹת וְאָמַרְנוּ חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ וְנִרְאֶה מַה יִּהְיוּ חֲלֹמֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנַהַרְגֵהוּ וְנַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד הַבֹּרוֹת וְאָמַרְנוּ חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ וְנִרְאֶה מַה יִּהְיוּ חֲלֹמֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And now, come on and let’s kill him and throw him in one
of the pits, and we’ll say a wild animal ate him, and
we’ll see what his dreams will be!”

translation.text: Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits; then we shall say that a wild animal has devoured him, and we shall see what will become of his dreams."

verses.english:
And Reuben heard, and he saved him from their hand. And he
said, “Let’s not take his life.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע רְאוּבֵן וַיַּצִּלֵהוּ מִיָּדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא נַכֶּנּוּ נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע רְאוּבֵן וַיַּצִּלֵהוּ מִיָּדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא נַכֶּנּוּ נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And Reuben heard, and he saved him from their hand. And he
said, “Let’s not take his life.”

translation.text: But when not take his life."

verses.english:
And Reuben said to them, “Don’t spill blood. Throw him
into this pit that’s in the wilderness, and don’t put out
a hand against him”—in order to save him from their hand,
to bring him back to his father.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רְאוּבֵן אַל תִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל הַבּוֹר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיָד אַל תִּשְׁלְחוּ בוֹ לְמַעַן הַצִּיל אֹתוֹ מִיָּדָם לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ אֶל אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רְאוּבֵן אַל תִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל הַבּוֹר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיָד אַל תִּשְׁלְחוּ בוֹ לְמַעַן הַצִּיל אֹתוֹ מִיָּדָם לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ אֶל אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And Reuben said to them, “Don’t spill blood. Throw him
into this pit that’s in the wilderness, and don’t put out
a hand against him”—in order to save him from their hand,
to bring him back to his father.

translation.text: Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood; throw him into this pit here in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him" — that he might rescue him out of their hand and restore him to his father.

verses.english:
And it was when Joseph came to his brothers: and they took
off Joseph’s coat, the coat of many colors, which he had
on.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּא יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף אֶת כֻּתּנְתּוֹ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּא יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף אֶת כֻּתּנְתּוֹ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And it was when Joseph came to his brothers: and they took
off Joseph’s coat, the coat of many colors, which he had
on.

translation.text: So long robe with sleeves that he wore;

verses.english:
And they took him and threw him into the pit. And the pit
was empty; there was no water in it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבֹּרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק אֵין בּוֹ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבֹּרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק אֵין בּוֹ מָיִם׃

english.text:
And they took him and threw him into the pit. And the pit
was empty; there was no water in it.

translation.text: and they took him and threw him into a pit. The pit was empty; there was no water in it.

verses.english:
And they sat down to eat bread. And they raised their eyes
and saw, and here was a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from
Gilead, and their camels were carrying spices and balsam
and myrrh, going to bring them down to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לֶאֱכל לֶחֶם וַיִּשְׂאוּ עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה אֹרְחַת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים בָּאָה מִגִּלְעָד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם נֹשְׂאִים נְכֹאת וּצְרִי וָלֹט הוֹלְכִים לְהוֹרִיד מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לֶאֱכל לֶחֶם וַיִּשְׂאוּ עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה אֹרְחַת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים בָּאָה מִגִּלְעָד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם נֹשְׂאִים נְכֹאת וּצְרִי וָלֹט הוֹלְכִים לְהוֹרִיד מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And they sat down to eat bread. And they raised their eyes
and saw, and here was a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from
Gilead, and their camels were carrying spices and balsam
and myrrh, going to bring them down to Egypt.

translation.text: Then they sat down to eat; and looking up they saw a caravan of and resin, on their way to carry it down to Egypt.

verses.english:
And Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is there if
we kill our brother and cover his blood?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכִסִּינוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכִסִּינוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is there if
we kill our brother and cover his blood?

translation.text: Then Judah said to his brothers, "What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

verses.english:
Come on and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let our
hand not be on him, because he’s our brother, our flesh.”
And his brothers listened.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְיָדֵנוּ אַל תְּהִי בוֹ כִּי אָחִינוּ בְשָׂרֵנוּ הוּא וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְיָדֵנוּ אַל תְּהִי בוֹ כִּי אָחִינוּ בְשָׂרֵנוּ הוּא וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
Come on and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let our
hand not be on him, because he’s our brother, our flesh.”
And his brothers listened.

translation.text: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not lay our agreed.

verses.english:
And Midianite people, merchants, passed, and they pulled
and lifted Joseph from the pit. And they sold Joseph to
the Ishmaelites for twenty weights of silver. And they
brought Joseph to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִדְיָנִים סֹחֲרִים וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִן הַבּוֹר וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִדְיָנִים סֹחֲרִים וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִן הַבּוֹר וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And Midianite people, merchants, passed, and they pulled
and lifted Joseph from the pit. And they sold Joseph to
the Ishmaelites for twenty weights of silver. And they
brought Joseph to Egypt.

translation.text: When some Midianite traders passed by, they drew Joseph twenty pieces of silver. And they took Joseph to Egypt.

verses.english:
And Reuben came back to the pit, and here: Joseph was not
in the pit. And he tore his clothes.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב רְאוּבֵן אֶל הַבּוֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹסֵף בַּבּוֹר וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב רְאוּבֵן אֶל הַבּוֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹסֵף בַּבּוֹר וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָיו׃

english.text:
And Reuben came back to the pit, and here: Joseph was not
in the pit. And he tore his clothes.

translation.text: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not in the pit, he tore his clothes.

verses.english:
And he went back to his brothers and said, “The boy’s
gone! And I, where can I go?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אֶל אֶחָיו וַיֹּאמַר הַיֶּלֶד אֵינֶנּוּ וַאֲנִי אָנָה אֲנִי בָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אֶל אֶחָיו וַיֹּאמַר הַיֶּלֶד אֵינֶנּוּ וַאֲנִי אָנָה אֲנִי בָא׃

english.text:
And he went back to his brothers and said, “The boy’s
gone! And I, where can I go?”

translation.text: He returned to his brothers, and said, "The boy is gone; and I, where can I turn?"

verses.english:
And they took Joseph’s coat and slaughtered a he-goat and
dipped the coat in the blood.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים וַיִּטְבְּלוּ אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת בַּדָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים וַיִּטְבְּלוּ אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת בַּדָּם׃

english.text:
And they took Joseph’s coat and slaughtered a he-goat and
dipped the coat in the blood.

translation.text: Then they took Joseph's robe, slaughtered a goat, and dipped the robe in the blood.

verses.english:
And they sent the coat of many colors and brought it to
their father and said, “We found this. Recognize: is it
your son’s coat or not?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֹאת מָצָאנוּ הַכֶּר נָא הַכְּתֹנֶת בִּנְךָ הִוא אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֹאת מָצָאנוּ הַכֶּר נָא הַכְּתֹנֶת בִּנְךָ הִוא אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And they sent the coat of many colors and brought it to
their father and said, “We found this. Recognize: is it
your son’s coat or not?”

translation.text: They "This we have found; see now whether it is your son's robe or not."

verses.english:
And he recognized it and said, “My son’s coat. A wild
animal ate him. Joseph is torn up!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכִּירָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתֹנֶת בְּנִי חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ טָרֹף טֹרַף יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכִּירָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתֹנֶת בְּנִי חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ טָרֹף טֹרַף יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
And he recognized it and said, “My son’s coat. A wild
animal ate him. Joseph is torn up!”

translation.text: devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn to pieces."

verses.english:
And Jacob ripped his clothes and wore sackcloth on his
hips and mourned over his son many days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַע יַעֲקֹב שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם שַׂק בְּמתְנָיו וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל בְּנוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַע יַעֲקֹב שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם שַׂק בְּמתְנָיו וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל בְּנוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
And Jacob ripped his clothes and wore sackcloth on his
hips and mourned over his son many days.

translation.text: Then Jacob son many days.

verses.english:
And all his sons and all his daughters got up to console
him, and he refused to be consoled, and he said, “Because
I’ll go down mourning to my son at Sheol,” and his father
wept for him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ כל בָּנָיו וְכל בְּנֹתָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ וַיְמָאֵן לְהִתְנַחֵם וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֵרֵד אֶל בְּנִי אָבֵל שְׁאֹלָה וַיֵּבְךְּ אֹתוֹ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ כל בָּנָיו וְכל בְּנֹתָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ וַיְמָאֵן לְהִתְנַחֵם וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֵרֵד אֶל בְּנִי אָבֵל שְׁאֹלָה וַיֵּבְךְּ אֹתוֹ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And all his sons and all his daughters got up to console
him, and he refused to be consoled, and he said, “Because
I’ll go down mourning to my son at Sheol,” and his father
wept for him.

translation.text: All his sons and all his daughters sought to comfort Sheol to my son, mourning." Thus his father bewailed him.

verses.english:
And the Medanites sold him to Egypt, to Potiphar, an
official of Pharaoh, chief of the guards.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמְּדָנִים מָכְרוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מִצְרָיִם לְפוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמְּדָנִים מָכְרוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מִצְרָיִם לְפוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים׃

english.text:
And the Medanites sold him to Egypt, to Potiphar, an
official of Pharaoh, chief of the guards.

translation.text: Pharaoh's officials, the captain of the guard.

verses.english:
And it was at that time, and Judah went down from
his brothers and turned to an Adullamite man, and his name
was Hirah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֵּרֶד יְהוּדָה מֵאֵת אֶחָיו וַיֵּט עַד אִישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִי וּשְׁמוֹ חִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֵּרֶד יְהוּדָה מֵאֵת אֶחָיו וַיֵּט עַד אִישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִי וּשְׁמוֹ חִירָה׃

english.text:
And it was at that time, and Judah went down from
his brothers and turned to an Adullamite man, and his name
was Hirah.

translation.text: It happened at that time that Judah went down from his brothers and settled near a certain Adullamite whose name was Hirah.

verses.english:
And Judah saw a daughter of a Canaanite man there, and his
name was Shua. And he took her and came to her.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁם יְהוּדָה בַּת אִישׁ כְּנַעֲנִי וּשְׁמוֹ שׁוּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁם יְהוּדָה בַּת אִישׁ כְּנַעֲנִי וּשְׁמוֹ שׁוּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Judah saw a daughter of a Canaanite man there, and his
name was Shua. And he took her and came to her.

translation.text: There Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; he married her and went in to her.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he
called his name Er.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ עֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ עֵר׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he
called his name Er.

translation.text: She conceived and bore a son; and he named him Er.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she called his name Onan.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אוֹנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אוֹנָן׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she called his name Onan.

translation.text: Again she conceived and bore a son whom she named Onan.

verses.english:
And she proceeded again to give birth to a son, and she
called his name Shelah. (And he was at Chezib when she
gave birth to him.)
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּסֶף עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁלָה וְהָיָה בִכְזִיב בְּלִדְתָּהּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּסֶף עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁלָה וְהָיָה בִכְזִיב בְּלִדְתָּהּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And she proceeded again to give birth to a son, and she
called his name Shelah. (And he was at Chezib when she
gave birth to him.)

translation.text: Yet again she bore a son, and she named him Shelah. She was in Chezib when she bore him.

verses.english:
And Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name
was Tamar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוּדָה אִשָּׁה לְעֵר בְּכוֹרוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יְהוּדָה אִשָּׁה לְעֵר בְּכוֹרוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר׃

english.text:
And Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name
was Tamar.

translation.text: Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn; her name was Tamar.

verses.english:
And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and
YHWH killed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְמִתֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְמִתֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and
YHWH killed him.

translation.text: But Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD put him to death.

verses.english:
And Judah said to Onan, “Come to your brother’s wife and
couple as a brother-in-law with her and raise seed for
your brother.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְאוֹנָן בֹּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ וְיַבֵּם אֹתָהּ וְהָקֵם זֶרַע לְאָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְאוֹנָן בֹּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ וְיַבֵּם אֹתָהּ וְהָקֵם זֶרַע לְאָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to Onan, “Come to your brother’s wife and
couple as a brother-in-law with her and raise seed for
your brother.”

translation.text: Then Judah brother-in-law to her; raise up offspring for your brother."

verses.english:
And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it was
when he came to his brother’s wife: and he spent on the
ground so as not to give seed for his brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע אוֹנָן כִּי לֹּא לוֹ יִהְיֶה הַזָּרַע וְהָיָה אִם בָּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו וְשִׁחֵת אַרְצָה לְבִלְתִּי נְתן זֶרַע לְאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע אוֹנָן כִּי לֹּא לוֹ יִהְיֶה הַזָּרַע וְהָיָה אִם בָּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו וְשִׁחֵת אַרְצָה לְבִלְתִּי נְתן זֶרַע לְאָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it was
when he came to his brother’s wife: and he spent on the
ground so as not to give seed for his brother.

translation.text: But since would not give offspring to his brother.

verses.english:
And what he did was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and He killed him,
too.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיָּמֶת גַּם אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיָּמֶת גַּם אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And what he did was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and He killed him,
too.

translation.text: What he did was displeasing in the sight of the LORD, and he put him to death also.

verses.english:
And Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Live as a
widow at your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up”
(because he said, “Or else he, too, will die like his
brothers”). And Tamar went and lived at her father’s
house.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ שְׁבִי אַלְמָנָה בֵית אָבִיךְ עַד יִגְדַּל שֵׁלָה בְנִי כִּי אָמַר פֶּן יָמוּת גַּם הוּא כְּאֶחָיו וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר וַתֵּשֶׁב בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ שְׁבִי אַלְמָנָה בֵית אָבִיךְ עַד יִגְדַּל שֵׁלָה בְנִי כִּי אָמַר פֶּן יָמוּת גַּם הוּא כְּאֶחָיו וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר וַתֵּשֶׁב בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Live as a
widow at your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up”
(because he said, “Or else he, too, will die like his
brothers”). And Tamar went and lived at her father’s
house.

translation.text: Then Judah house.

verses.english:
And the days were many, and Judah’s wife, the daughter of
Shua, died. And Judah was consoled. And he went up to his
sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite, to
Timnah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַתָּמת בַּת שׁוּעַ אֵשֶׁת יְהוּדָה וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל גֹּזְזֵי צֹאנוֹ הוּא וְחִירָה רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי תִּמְנָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַתָּמת בַּת שׁוּעַ אֵשֶׁת יְהוּדָה וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל גֹּזְזֵי צֹאנוֹ הוּא וְחִירָה רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי תִּמְנָתָה׃

english.text:
And the days were many, and Judah’s wife, the daughter of
Shua, died. And Judah was consoled. And he went up to his
sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite, to
Timnah.

translation.text: In course of time the wife of Judah, Shua's daughter, died; when sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

verses.english:
And it was told to Tamar, saying, “Here, your
father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְתָמָר לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָמִיךְ עֹלֶה תִמְנָתָה לָגֹז צֹאנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְתָמָר לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָמִיךְ עֹלֶה תִמְנָתָה לָגֹז צֹאנוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was told to Tamar, saying, “Here, your
father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

translation.text: When Tamar sheep,"

verses.english:
And she took off her widowhood clothes from on her and
covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself and sat in
a visible place that was on the road to Timnah, because
she saw that Shelah had grown up and she had not been
given to him as a wife.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּסַר בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתְּכַס בַּצָּעִיף וַתִּתְעַלָּף וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּפֶתַח עֵינַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל דֶּרֶךְ תִּמְנָתָה כִּי רָאֲתָה כִּי גָדַל שֵׁלָה וְהִוא לֹא נִתְּנָה לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּסַר בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתְּכַס בַּצָּעִיף וַתִּתְעַלָּף וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּפֶתַח עֵינַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל דֶּרֶךְ תִּמְנָתָה כִּי רָאֲתָה כִּי גָדַל שֵׁלָה וְהִוא לֹא נִתְּנָה לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And she took off her widowhood clothes from on her and
covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself and sat in
a visible place that was on the road to Timnah, because
she saw that Shelah had grown up and she had not been
given to him as a wife.

translation.text: she put off her widow's garments, put on a veil, wrapped been given to him in marriage.

verses.english:
And Judah saw her and thought her to be a prostitute
because she had covered her face.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאֶהָ יְהוּדָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לְזוֹנָה כִּי כִסְּתָה פָּנֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאֶהָ יְהוּדָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לְזוֹנָה כִּי כִסְּתָה פָּנֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Judah saw her and thought her to be a prostitute
because she had covered her face.

translation.text: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

verses.english:
And he turned to her by the road. And he said, “Come on.
Let me come to you,” because he did not know that she was
his daughter-in-law. And she said, “What will you give me
when you come to me?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט אֵלֶיהָ אֶל הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָבָה נָּא אָבוֹא אֵלַיִךְ כִּי לֹא יָדַע כִּי כַלָּתוֹ הִוא וַתֹּאמֶר מַה תִּתֶּן לִי כִּי תָבוֹא אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט אֵלֶיהָ אֶל הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָבָה נָּא אָבוֹא אֵלַיִךְ כִּי לֹא יָדַע כִּי כַלָּתוֹ הִוא וַתֹּאמֶר מַה תִּתֶּן לִי כִּי תָבוֹא אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And he turned to her by the road. And he said, “Come on.
Let me come to you,” because he did not know that she was
his daughter-in-law. And she said, “What will you give me
when you come to me?”

translation.text: He went over to her give me, that you may come in to me?"

verses.english:
And he said, “I’ll have a goat kid sent from the flock.”
And she said, “If you’ll give a pledge until you send it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח גְּדִי עִזִּים מִן הַצֹּאן וַתֹּאמֶר אִם תִּתֵּן עֵרָבוֹן עַד שׁלְחֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח גְּדִי עִזִּים מִן הַצֹּאן וַתֹּאמֶר אִם תִּתֵּן עֵרָבוֹן עַד שׁלְחֶךָ׃

english.text:
And he said, “I’ll have a goat kid sent from the flock.”
And she said, “If you’ll give a pledge until you send it.”

translation.text: He answered, "I will send you a kid from the flock." And she said, "Only if you give me a pledge, until you send it."

verses.english:
And he said, “What is the pledge that I’ll give you?” And
she said, “Your seal and your cord and your staff that’s
in your hand.” And he gave them to her, and he came to
her, and she became pregnant by him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הָעֵרָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶתֶּן לָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר חֹתָמְךָ וּפְתִילֶךָ וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לָהּ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַתַּהַר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הָעֵרָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶתֶּן לָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר חֹתָמְךָ וּפְתִילֶךָ וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לָהּ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַתַּהַר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he said, “What is the pledge that I’ll give you?” And
she said, “Your seal and your cord and your staff that’s
in your hand.” And he gave them to her, and he came to
her, and she became pregnant by him.

translation.text: He said, "What pledge shall I give you?" She replied, "Your signet and your cord, and the staff that is in your hand." So he gave them to her, and went in to her, and she conceived by him.

verses.english:
And she got up and went and took off her veil from on her
and put on her widowhood clothes.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּסַר צְעִיפָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּסַר צְעִיפָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ׃

english.text:
And she got up and went and took off her veil from on her
and put on her widowhood clothes.

translation.text: Then she got up and went away, and taking off her veil she put on the garments of her widowhood.

verses.english:
And Judah sent the goat kid by the hand of his friend the
Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman’s hand,
and he did not find her.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוּדָה אֶת גְּדִי הָעִזִּים בְּיַד רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי לָקַחַת הָעֵרָבוֹן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה וְלֹא מְצָאָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוּדָה אֶת גְּדִי הָעִזִּים בְּיַד רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי לָקַחַת הָעֵרָבוֹן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה וְלֹא מְצָאָהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah sent the goat kid by the hand of his friend the
Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman’s hand,
and he did not find her.

translation.text: When Judah sent the kid by his friend the Adullamite, to recover the pledge from the woman, he could not find her.

verses.english:
And he asked the people of her place, saying, “Where is
the sacred prostitute? She was visibly by the road.” And
they said, “There was no sacred prostitute here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמָהּ לֵאמֹר אַיֵּה הַקְּדֵשָׁה הִוא בָעֵינַיִם עַל הַדָּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמָהּ לֵאמֹר אַיֵּה הַקְּדֵשָׁה הִוא בָעֵינַיִם עַל הַדָּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

english.text:
And he asked the people of her place, saying, “Where is
the sacred prostitute? She was visibly by the road.” And
they said, “There was no sacred prostitute here.”

translation.text: He asked the the wayside?" But they said, "No prostitute has been here."

verses.english:
And he came back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her,
and also the people of the place said There was no sacred
prostitute here.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אֶל יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא מְצָאתִיהָ וְגַם אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם אָמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אֶל יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא מְצָאתִיהָ וְגַם אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם אָמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

english.text:
And he came back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her,
and also the people of the place said There was no sacred
prostitute here.’”

translation.text: So he townspeople said, 'No prostitute has been here.'"

verses.english:
And Judah said, “Let her take them or else we’ll be a
disgrace. Here, I’ve sent this goat kid, and you didn’t
find her.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה תִּקַּח לָהּ פֶּן נִהְיֶה לָבוּז הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי הַגְּדִי הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא מְצָאתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה תִּקַּח לָהּ פֶּן נִהְיֶה לָבוּז הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי הַגְּדִי הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא מְצָאתָהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah said, “Let her take them or else we’ll be a
disgrace. Here, I’ve sent this goat kid, and you didn’t
find her.”

translation.text: Judah replied, "Let her keep the things as her own, otherwise we will be laughed at; you see, I sent this kid, and you could not find her."

verses.english:
And it was about three months, and it was told to Judah,
saying, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has whored, and, here,
she’s pregnant by whoring as well.” And Judah said, “Bring
her out and let her be burned.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמִשְׁלֹשׁ חֳדָשִׁים וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר זָנְתָה תָּמָר כַּלָּתֶךָ וְגַם הִנֵּה הָרָה לִזְנוּנִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה הוֹצִיאוּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּמִשְׁלֹשׁ חֳדָשִׁים וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר זָנְתָה תָּמָר כַּלָּתֶךָ וְגַם הִנֵּה הָרָה לִזְנוּנִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה הוֹצִיאוּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And it was about three months, and it was told to Judah,
saying, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has whored, and, here,
she’s pregnant by whoring as well.” And Judah said, “Bring
her out and let her be burned.”

translation.text: About three months later Judah was told, "Your daughter-in-law whoredom." And Judah said, "Bring her out, and let her be burned."

verses.english:
She was brought out. And she sent to her father-in-law,
saying, “I’m pregnant by the man to whom these belong,”
and she said, “Recognize: to whom do these seal and cords
and staff belong?”
verses.hebrew: הִוא מוּצֵאת וְהִיא שָׁלְחָה אֶל חָמִיהָ לֵאמֹר לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵלֶּה לּוֹ אָנֹכִי הָרָה וַתֹּאמֶר הַכֶּר נָא לְמִי הַחֹתֶמֶת וְהַפְּתִילִים וְהַמַּטֶּה הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הִוא מוּצֵאת וְהִיא שָׁלְחָה אֶל חָמִיהָ לֵאמֹר לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵלֶּה לּוֹ אָנֹכִי הָרָה וַתֹּאמֶר הַכֶּר נָא לְמִי הַחֹתֶמֶת וְהַפְּתִילִים וְהַמַּטֶּה הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
She was brought out. And she sent to her father-in-law,
saying, “I’m pregnant by the man to whom these belong,”
and she said, “Recognize: to whom do these seal and cords
and staff belong?”

translation.text: As she was being brought out, she sent word to her father-in-law, staff."

verses.english:
And Judah recognized and said, “She’s more right than I
am, because of the fact that I didn’t give her to my son
Shelah.” And he did not go on to know her again.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּר יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיהָ לְשֵׁלָה בְנִי וְלֹא יָסַף עוֹד לְדַעְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּר יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיהָ לְשֵׁלָה בְנִי וְלֹא יָסַף עוֹד לְדַעְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah recognized and said, “She’s more right than I
am, because of the fact that I didn’t give her to my son
Shelah.” And he did not go on to know her again.

translation.text: Then Judah acknowledged them and said, "She is more in the right than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah." And he did not lie with her again.

verses.english:
And it was at the time that she was giving birth, and here
were twins in her womb.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת לִדְתָּהּ וְהִנֵּה תְאוֹמִים בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת לִדְתָּהּ וְהִנֵּה תְאוֹמִים בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

english.text:
And it was at the time that she was giving birth, and here
were twins in her womb.

translation.text: When the time of her delivery came, there were twins in her womb.

verses.english:
And it was as she was giving birth, and one put out his
hand, and the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on
his hand, saying, “This one came out first.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְלִדְתָּהּ וַיִּתֶּן יָד וַתִּקַּח הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁר עַל יָדוֹ שָׁנִי לֵאמֹר זֶה יָצָא רִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְלִדְתָּהּ וַיִּתֶּן יָד וַתִּקַּח הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁר עַל יָדוֹ שָׁנִי לֵאמֹר זֶה יָצָא רִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
And it was as she was giving birth, and one put out his
hand, and the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on
his hand, saying, “This one came out first.”

translation.text: While she was in labor, one put out a hand; and the midwife took first."

verses.english:
And it was as he pulled his hand back, and here his
brother came out. And she said, “What a breach you’ve made
for yourself!” And he called his name Perez.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ וְהִנֵּה יָצָא אָחִיו וַתֹּאמֶר מַה פָּרַצְתָּ עָלֶיךָ פָּרֶץ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פָּרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּמֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ וְהִנֵּה יָצָא אָחִיו וַתֹּאמֶר מַה פָּרַצְתָּ עָלֶיךָ פָּרֶץ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פָּרֶץ׃

english.text:
And it was as he pulled his hand back, and here his
brother came out. And she said, “What a breach you’ve made
for yourself!” And he called his name Perez.

translation.text: But just then he drew back his hand, and out came his brother; and she said, "What a breach you have made for yourself!" Therefore he was named Perez.

verses.english:
And his brother who had the scarlet thread on his hand
came out after. And he called his name Zerah.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָצָא אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר עַל יָדוֹ הַשָּׁנִי וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ זָרַח׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר יָצָא אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר עַל יָדוֹ הַשָּׁנִי וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ זָרַח׃

english.text:
And his brother who had the scarlet thread on his hand
came out after. And he called his name Zerah.

translation.text: Afterward his brother came out with the crimson thread on his hand; and he was named Zerah.

verses.english:
And Joseph had been brought down to Egypt. And an
Egyptian man, Potiphar, an official of Pharaoh, chief of
the guards, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites
who had brought him down there.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף הוּרַד מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּקְנֵהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אִישׁ מִצְרִי מִיַּד הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִדֻהוּ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹסֵף הוּרַד מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּקְנֵהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אִישׁ מִצְרִי מִיַּד הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִדֻהוּ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And Joseph had been brought down to Egypt. And an
Egyptian man, Potiphar, an official of Pharaoh, chief of
the guards, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites
who had brought him down there.

translation.text: Now Joseph was taken down to Egypt, and Potiphar, an officer of Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.

verses.english:
And YHWH was with Joseph, and he was a successful man, and
he was in his Egyptian lord’s house.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ וַיְהִי בְּבֵית אֲדֹנָיו הַמִּצְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ וַיְהִי בְּבֵית אֲדֹנָיו הַמִּצְרִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH was with Joseph, and he was a successful man, and
he was in his Egyptian lord’s house.

translation.text: The LORD was with Egyptian master.

verses.english:
And his lord saw that YHWH was with him, and YHWH made
everything he was doing successful in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֲדֹנָיו כִּי יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהֹוָה מַצְלִיחַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֲדֹנָיו כִּי יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהֹוָה מַצְלִיחַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And his lord saw that YHWH was with him, and YHWH made
everything he was doing successful in his hand.

translation.text: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD caused all that he did to prosper in his hands.

verses.english:
And Joseph found favor in his eyes, and he attended him,
and he appointed him over his house and put everything he
had in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא יוֹסֵף חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתוֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵהוּ עַל בֵּיתוֹ וְכל יֶשׁ לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא יוֹסֵף חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתוֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵהוּ עַל בֵּיתוֹ וְכל יֶשׁ לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Joseph found favor in his eyes, and he attended him,
and he appointed him over his house and put everything he
had in his hand.

translation.text: So Joseph house and put him in charge of all that he had.

verses.english:
And it was from the time that he appointed him in his
house and over all that he had that YHWH blessed the
Egyptian’s house because of Joseph, and YHWH’s blessing
was in everything that he had, in the house and in the
field.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵאָז הִפְקִיד אֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ וְעַל כּל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת בֵּית הַמִּצְרִי בִּגְלַל יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי בִּרְכַּת יְהֹוָה בְּכל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ בַּבַּיִת וּבַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֵאָז הִפְקִיד אֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ וְעַל כּל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת בֵּית הַמִּצְרִי בִּגְלַל יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי בִּרְכַּת יְהֹוָה בְּכל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ בַּבַּיִת וּבַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
And it was from the time that he appointed him in his
house and over all that he had that YHWH blessed the
Egyptian’s house because of Joseph, and YHWH’s blessing
was in everything that he had, in the house and in the
field.

translation.text: From the time that blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; the blessing of the LORD was on all that he had, in house and field.

verses.english:
And he left everything that he had in Joseph’s hand and
did not know a thing about what he had except the bread
that he was eating. And Joseph had an attractive figure
and was handsome.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בְּיַד יוֹסֵף וְלֹא יָדַע אִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הוּא אוֹכֵל וַיְהִי יוֹסֵף יְפֵה תֹאַר וִיפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲזֹב כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בְּיַד יוֹסֵף וְלֹא יָדַע אִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הוּא אוֹכֵל וַיְהִי יוֹסֵף יְפֵה תֹאַר וִיפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And he left everything that he had in Joseph’s hand and
did not know a thing about what he had except the bread
that he was eating. And Joseph had an attractive figure
and was handsome.

translation.text: So he left all that he had anything but the food that he ate. Now Joseph was handsome and good-looking.

verses.english:
And it was after these things, and his lord’s wife raised
her eyes to Joseph and said, “Lie with me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּשָּׂא אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו אֶת עֵינֶיהָ אֶל יוֹסֵף וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי׃

And the chief of the guards assigned Joseph with them, and
he attended them. And they were under watch for days.

translation.text: The captain of the guard charged Joseph in custody.

verses.english:
And the two of them had a dream, each his own dream, in
one night, each with his own dream’s meaning, the
drink-steward and the baker whom the king of Egypt had,
who were held in the prison.

hebrew.text: וַיַּחַלְמוּ חֲלוֹם שְׁנֵיהֶם אִישׁ חֲלֹמוֹ בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ הַמַּשְׁקֶה וְהָאֹפֶה אֲשֶׁר לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲסוּרִים בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

And the two of them had a dream, each his own dream, in
one night, each with his own dream’s meaning, the
drink-steward and the baker whom the king of Egypt had,
who were held in the prison.

translation.text: One night they both dreamed — the cupbearer and the own dream, and each dream with its own meaning.

verses.english:
And Joseph came to them in the morning and saw them, and
here they were upset.

english.text:
And Joseph came to them in the morning and saw them, and
here they were upset.

translation.text: When Joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were troubled.

verses.english:

watch at his lord’s house, saying, “Why are your faces bad
today?”

And they said to him, “We had a dream, and there’s no one
who can tell the meaning of it.” And Joseph said to them,
“Don’t meanings belong to God? Tell me.”

and in the vine were three branches, and it was like it

And Joseph said to him, “This is its meaning: The three
branches, they’re three days.

And Joseph said to him, “This is its meaning: The three

translation.text: Then Joseph said to him, "This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days;

verses.english:
In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up, and
he’ll put you back at your station, and you’ll set
Pharaoh’s cup in his hand—like the original manner when
you were his drink-steward.
verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת רֹאשֶׁךָ וַהֲשִׁיבְךָ עַל כַּנֶּךָ וְנָתַתָּ כוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתָ מַשְׁקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת רֹאשֶׁךָ וַהֲשִׁיבְךָ עַל כַּנֶּךָ וְנָתַתָּ כוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתָ מַשְׁקֵהוּ׃

In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up, and
he’ll put you back at your station, and you’ll set
Pharaoh’s cup in his hand—like the original manner when
you were his drink-steward.

verses.english:
So if you’ll remember me with you when it will be good for
you, and you’ll practice kindness with me, then you’ll
bring up the memory of me to Pharaoh, and you’ll bring me
out of this house.

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם זְכַרְתַּנִי אִתְּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לָךְ וְעָשִׂיתָ נָּא עִמָּדִי חָסֶד וְהִזְכַּרְתַּנִי אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵאתַנִי מִן הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

you, and you’ll practice kindness with me, then you’ll
bring up the memory of me to Pharaoh, and you’ll bring me

translation.text: But remember me when it is well with you; get me out of this place.
