verses.english:
And he put the chief of the drink-stewards back over his
stewardship, and he set the cup on Pharaoh’s hand;
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים עַל מַשְׁקֵהוּ וַיִּתֵּן הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים עַל מַשְׁקֵהוּ וַיִּתֵּן הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And he put the chief of the drink-stewards back over his
stewardship, and he set the cup on Pharaoh’s hand;

translation.text: He restored the chief cupbearer to his cupbearing, and he placed the cup in Pharaoh's hand;

verses.english:
and he hanged the chief of the bakers—as Joseph had told
the meaning for them.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים תָּלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים תָּלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
and he hanged the chief of the bakers—as Joseph had told
the meaning for them.

translation.text: but the chief baker he hanged, just as Joseph had interpreted to them.

verses.english:
And the chief of the drink-stewards did not remember
Joseph. And he forgot him.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא זָכַר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא זָכַר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And the chief of the drink-stewards did not remember
Joseph. And he forgot him.

translation.text: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.

verses.english:
And it was at the end of two years’time, and Pharaoh was
dreaming: and here he was standing by the Nile.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And it was at the end of two years’time, and Pharaoh was
dreaming: and here he was standing by the Nile.

translation.text: After two whole years, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing by the Nile,

verses.english:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
beautiful-looking and fat-fleshed, and they fed in the
reeds.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת יְפוֹת מַרְאֶה וּבְרִיאֹת בָּשָׂר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת יְפוֹת מַרְאֶה וּבְרִיאֹת בָּשָׂר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

english.text:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
beautiful-looking and fat-fleshed, and they fed in the
reeds.

translation.text: and there came up out of the Nile seven sleek and fat cows, and they grazed in the reed grass.

verses.english:
And here were seven other cows coming up after them from
the Nile, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood by
the cows that were by the bank of the Nile.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן מִן הַיְאֹר רָעוֹת מַרְאֶה וְדַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אֵצֶל הַפָּרוֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן מִן הַיְאֹר רָעוֹת מַרְאֶה וְדַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אֵצֶל הַפָּרוֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And here were seven other cows coming up after them from
the Nile, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood by
the cows that were by the bank of the Nile.

translation.text: Then seven other cows, ugly and thin, the bank of the Nile.

verses.english:
And the bad-looking and thin-fleshed cows ate the seven
beautiful-looking and fat cows—and Pharaoh woke up.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת רָעוֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְדַקֹּת הַבָּשָׂר אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת יְפֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְהַבְּרִיאֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת רָעוֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְדַקֹּת הַבָּשָׂר אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת יְפֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְהַבְּרִיאֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And the bad-looking and thin-fleshed cows ate the seven
beautiful-looking and fat cows—and Pharaoh woke up.

translation.text: The ugly and thin cows ate up the seven sleek and fat cows. And Pharaoh awoke.

verses.english:
And he slept and dreamed a second time, and here were
seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, fat and good.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּישָׁן וַיַּחֲלֹם שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלוֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד בְּרִיאוֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּישָׁן וַיַּחֲלֹם שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלוֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד בְּרִיאוֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

english.text:
And he slept and dreamed a second time, and here were
seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, fat and good.

translation.text: Then he fell asleep and dreamed one stalk.

verses.english:
And here were seven ears of grain, thin and scorched by
the east wind, growing after them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And here were seven ears of grain, thin and scorched by
the east wind, growing after them.

translation.text: Then seven ears, thin and blighted by the east wind, sprouted after them.

verses.english:
And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven fat and
full ears of grain—and Pharaoh woke up, and here it was a
dream.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְלַעְנָה הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקּוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַבְּרִיאוֹת וְהַמְּלֵאוֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּבְלַעְנָה הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקּוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַבְּרִיאוֹת וְהַמְּלֵאוֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם׃

english.text:
And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven fat and
full ears of grain—and Pharaoh woke up, and here it was a
dream.

translation.text: The thin ears swallowed up the seven plump and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and it was a dream.

verses.english:
And it was in the morning, and his spirit was moved, and
he sent and called all of Egypt’s magicians and all its
wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dream, and there was
no one who could tell the meaning of them to Pharaoh.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא אֶת כּל חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת כּל חֲכָמֶיהָ וַיְסַפֵּר פַּרְעֹה לָהֶם אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ וְאֵין פּוֹתֵר אוֹתָם לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא אֶת כּל חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת כּל חֲכָמֶיהָ וַיְסַפֵּר פַּרְעֹה לָהֶם אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ וְאֵין פּוֹתֵר אוֹתָם לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And it was in the morning, and his spirit was moved, and
he sent and called all of Egypt’s magicians and all its
wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dream, and there was
no one who could tell the meaning of them to Pharaoh.

translation.text: In the morning his spirit was troubled; so he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And the chief of the drink-stewards spoke to Pharaoh,
saying, “I’m recalling my sins today:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אֶת חֲטָאַי אֲנִי מַזְכִּיר הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אֶת חֲטָאַי אֲנִי מַזְכִּיר הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the chief of the drink-stewards spoke to Pharaoh,
saying, “I’m recalling my sins today:

translation.text: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "I remember my faults today.

verses.english:
Pharaoh had been angry at his servants, and he put me
under watch at the house of the chief of the guards, me
and the chief of the bakers.
verses.hebrew: פַּרְעֹה קָצַף עַל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּתֵּן אֹתִי בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֹתִי וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים׃

hebrew.text: פַּרְעֹה קָצַף עַל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּתֵּן אֹתִי בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֹתִי וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים׃

english.text:
Pharaoh had been angry at his servants, and he put me
under watch at the house of the chief of the guards, me
and the chief of the bakers.

translation.text: Once Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me and the chief baker in custody in the house of the captain of the guard.

verses.english:
And we had a dream in one night, I and he; we each dreamed
with his own dream’s meaning.
verses.hebrew: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ חָלָמְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ חָלָמְנוּ׃

english.text:
And we had a dream in one night, I and he; we each dreamed
with his own dream’s meaning.

translation.text: own meaning.

verses.english:
And there, with us, was a Hebrew boy, a slave of the chief
of the guards; and we told him, and he told us the meaning
of our dreams. He told the meaning according to each one’s
dream.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם אִתָּנוּ נַעַר עִבְרִי עֶבֶד לְשַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים וַנְּסַפֶּר לוֹ וַיִּפְתּר לָנוּ אֶת חֲלֹמֹתֵינוּ אִישׁ כַּחֲלֹמוֹ פָּתָר׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁם אִתָּנוּ נַעַר עִבְרִי עֶבֶד לְשַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים וַנְּסַפֶּר לוֹ וַיִּפְתּר לָנוּ אֶת חֲלֹמֹתֵינוּ אִישׁ כַּחֲלֹמוֹ פָּתָר׃

english.text:
And there, with us, was a Hebrew boy, a slave of the chief
of the guards; and we told him, and he told us the meaning
of our dreams. He told the meaning according to each one’s
dream.

translation.text: A young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the us, giving an interpretation to each according to his dream.

verses.english:
And it was—as he told the meaning for us, so it was: me he
put back at my station, and him he hanged.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָנוּ כֵּן הָיָה אֹתִי הֵשִׁיב עַל כַּנִּי וְאֹתוֹ תָלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָנוּ כֵּן הָיָה אֹתִי הֵשִׁיב עַל כַּנִּי וְאֹתוֹ תָלָה׃

english.text:
And it was—as he told the meaning for us, so it was: me he
put back at my station, and him he hanged.”

translation.text: As he interpreted to us, so it turned out; I was restored to my office, and the baker was hanged."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they rushed him
from the pit, and he shaved and changed his clothing and
came to Pharaoh.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְרִיצֻהוּ מִן הַבּוֹר וַיְגַלַּח וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְרִיצֻהוּ מִן הַבּוֹר וַיְגַלַּח וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they rushed him
from the pit, and he shaved and changed his clothing and
came to Pharaoh.

translation.text: Then Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was hurriedly brought out of came in before Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I’ve had a dream, and there’s
no one who can tell the meaning of it, and I’ve heard
about you, saying you hear a dream so as to tell the
meaning of it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר תִּשְׁמַע חֲלוֹם לִפְתֹּר אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר תִּשְׁמַע חֲלוֹם לִפְתֹּר אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I’ve had a dream, and there’s
no one who can tell the meaning of it, and I’ve heard
about you, saying you hear a dream so as to tell the
meaning of it.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have had a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."

verses.english:
And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “Not I. will
answer regarding Pharaoh’s well-being.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בִּלְעָדָי אֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶה אֶת שְׁלוֹם פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בִּלְעָדָי אֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶה אֶת שְׁלוֹם פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “Not I. will
answer regarding Pharaoh’s well-being.”

translation.text: Joseph answer."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, here I was
standing by the bank of the Nile.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף בַּחֲלֹמִי הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף בַּחֲלֹמִי הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, here I was
standing by the bank of the Nile.

translation.text: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream I was standing on the banks of the Nile;

verses.english:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
fat-fleshed and beautiful-figured, and they fed in the
reeds.

And Joseph said to Pharaoh, “Pharaoh’s dream: it is one.

The seven good cows: they’re seven years. And the seven
good ears of grain: they’re seven years. It’s one dream.

Here, seven years are coming: big bountifulness in all the

And Pharaoh said to his servants, “Will we find such a man
as this, that God’s spirit is in him?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל עֲבָדָיו הֲנִמְצָא כָזֶה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל עֲבָדָיו הֲנִמְצָא כָזֶה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to his servants, “Will we find such a man
as this, that God’s spirit is in him?”

translation.text: Pharaoh said the spirit of God?"

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made you know
all this, there’s no one as understanding and wise as you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֵי הוֹדִיעַ אֱלֹהִים אוֹתְךָ אֶת כּל זֹאת אֵין נָבוֹן וְחָכָם כָּמוֹךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֵי הוֹדִיעַ אֱלֹהִים אוֹתְךָ אֶת כּל זֹאת אֵין נָבוֹן וְחָכָם כָּמוֹךָ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made you know
all this, there’s no one as understanding and wise as you.

translation.text: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has shown you all this, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.

verses.english:
You shall be over my house, and at your mouth all my
people shall conform. I shall be greater than you only in
the throne.”
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תִּהְיֶה עַל בֵּיתִי וְעַל פִּיךָ יִשַּׁק כּל עַמִּי רַק הַכִּסֵּא אֶגְדַּל מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה תִּהְיֶה עַל בֵּיתִי וְעַל פִּיךָ יִשַּׁק כּל עַמִּי רַק הַכִּסֵּא אֶגְדַּל מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
You shall be over my house, and at your mouth all my
people shall conform. I shall be greater than you only in
the throne.”

translation.text: You shall command; only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “See, I’ve put you over all
the land of Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף רְאֵה נָתַתִּי אֹתְךָ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף רְאֵה נָתַתִּי אֹתְךָ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “See, I’ve put you over all
the land of Egypt.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on
Joseph’s hand, and he had him dressed in linen garments,
and he set a gold chain on his neck,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּסַר פַּרְעֹה אֶת טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ עַל יַד יוֹסֵף וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁשׁ וַיָּשֶׂם רְבִד הַזָּהָב עַל צַוָּארוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסַר פַּרְעֹה אֶת טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ עַל יַד יוֹסֵף וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁשׁ וַיָּשֶׂם רְבִד הַזָּהָב עַל צַוָּארוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on
Joseph’s hand, and he had him dressed in linen garments,
and he set a gold chain on his neck,

translation.text: Removing his signet ring from his hand, Pharaoh put it on Joseph's hand; he arrayed him in garments of fine linen, and put a gold chain around his neck.

verses.english:
and he had him driven in the chariot of the
second-in-command whom he had, and they called in front of
him, “Kneel,” so putting him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכֵּב אֹתוֹ בְּמִרְכֶּבֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְפָנָיו אַבְרֵךְ וְנָתוֹן אֹתוֹ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְכֵּב אֹתוֹ בְּמִרְכֶּבֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְפָנָיו אַבְרֵךְ וְנָתוֹן אֹתוֹ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and he had him driven in the chariot of the
second-in-command whom he had, and they called in front of
him, “Kneel,” so putting him over all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: He had him ride in the chariot of his secondin-command; and they cried out in front of him, "Bow the knee!" Thus he set him over all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you
a man won’t lift his hand and his foot in all the land of
Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲנִי פַרְעֹה וּבִלְעָדֶיךָ לֹא יָרִים אִישׁ אֶת יָדוֹ וְאֶת רַגְלוֹ בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲנִי פַרְעֹה וּבִלְעָדֶיךָ לֹא יָרִים אִישׁ אֶת יָדוֹ וְאֶת רַגְלוֹ בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you
a man won’t lift his hand and his foot in all the land of
Egypt.”

translation.text: Moreover Pharaoh said to hand or foot in all the land of Egypt."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphe-nath-paneah. And he
gave him Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, as
a wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה שֵׁם יוֹסֵף צָפְנַת פַּעְנֵחַ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן לְאִשָּׁה וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה שֵׁם יוֹסֵף צָפְנַת פַּעְנֵחַ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן לְאִשָּׁה וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphe-nath-paneah. And he
gave him Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, as
a wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

translation.text: Pharaoh gave Joseph the Potiphera, priest of On, as his wife. Thus Joseph gained authority over the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood in front of
Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from in front
of Pharaoh and passed through all the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּעמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּעמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood in front of
Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from in front
of Pharaoh and passed through all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh went through all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And the land produced in the seven years of bountifulness
by fistfuls.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַשׂ הָאָרֶץ בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע לִקְמָצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַשׂ הָאָרֶץ בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע לִקְמָצִים׃

english.text:
And the land produced in the seven years of bountifulness
by fistfuls.

translation.text: During the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

verses.english:
And he gathered all the food of the seven years, which
were in the land of Egypt, and he put food in cities; he
put the food of the city’s fields that were around it
inside of it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת כּל אֹכֶל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים אֹכֶל שְׂדֵה הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ נָתַן בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת כּל אֹכֶל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים אֹכֶל שְׂדֵה הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ נָתַן בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

english.text:
And he gathered all the food of the seven years, which
were in the land of Egypt, and he put food in cities; he
put the food of the city’s fields that were around it
inside of it.

translation.text: He gathered up all the food the fields around it.

verses.english:
And Joseph piled up grain like the sand of the sea, very
much, until he stopped counting, because it was without
number.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבֹּר יוֹסֵף בָּר כְּחוֹל הַיָּם הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד כִּי חָדַל לִסְפֹּר כִּי אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְבֹּר יוֹסֵף בָּר כְּחוֹל הַיָּם הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד כִּי חָדַל לִסְפֹּר כִּי אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

english.text:
And Joseph piled up grain like the sand of the sea, very
much, until he stopped counting, because it was without
number.

translation.text: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance — measure.

verses.english:
And two sons were born to Joseph before the year of famine
came—to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of
On, gave birth for him.
verses.hebrew: וּלְיוֹסֵף יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא שְׁנַת הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְיוֹסֵף יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא שְׁנַת הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אוֹן׃

english.text:
And two sons were born to Joseph before the year of famine
came—to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of
On, gave birth for him.

translation.text: Before the years of famine came, Joseph had two sons, whom Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

verses.english:
And Joseph called the firstborn’s name Manasseh, “because
God has made me forget all of my trouble and all of my
father’s house.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יוֹסֵף אֶת שֵׁם הַבְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי נַשַּׁנִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת כּל עֲמָלִי וְאֵת כּל בֵּית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יוֹסֵף אֶת שֵׁם הַבְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי נַשַּׁנִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת כּל עֲמָלִי וְאֵת כּל בֵּית אָבִי׃

english.text:
And Joseph called the firstborn’s name Manasseh, “because
God has made me forget all of my trouble and all of my
father’s house.”

translation.text: Joseph forget all my hardship and all my father's house."

verses.english:
And he called the second one’s name Ephraim, “because God
has made me fruitful in the land of my degradation.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי קָרָא אֶפְרָיִם כִּי הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶרֶץ ענְיִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי קָרָא אֶפְרָיִם כִּי הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶרֶץ ענְיִי׃

english.text:
And he called the second one’s name Ephraim, “because God
has made me fruitful in the land of my degradation.”

translation.text: The second he misfortunes."

verses.english:
And the seven years of the bountifulness that was in the
land of Egypt finished,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְלֶינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְלֶינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And the seven years of the bountifulness that was in the
land of Egypt finished,

translation.text: The seven years of plenty that prevailed in the land of Egypt came to an end;

verses.english:
and the seven years of famine started to come, as Joseph
had said. And there was famine in all the lands, and in
all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּחִלֶּינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב לָבוֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי רָעָב בְּכל הָאֲרָצוֹת וּבְכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הָיָה לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּחִלֶּינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב לָבוֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי רָעָב בְּכל הָאֲרָצוֹת וּבְכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הָיָה לָחֶם׃

english.text:
and the seven years of famine started to come, as Joseph
had said. And there was famine in all the lands, and in
all the land of Egypt there was bread.

translation.text: and the seven years of famine began to come, just as the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.english:
And all the land of Egypt hungered, and the people cried
to Pharaoh for the bread, and Pharaoh said to all Egypt,
“Go to Joseph. Do what he’ll tell you.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְעַב כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּצְעַק הָעָם אֶל פַּרְעֹה לַלָּחֶם וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה לְכל מִצְרַיִם לְכוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר לָכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּרְעַב כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּצְעַק הָעָם אֶל פַּרְעֹה לַלָּחֶם וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה לְכל מִצְרַיִם לְכוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר לָכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And all the land of Egypt hungered, and the people cried
to Pharaoh for the bread, and Pharaoh said to all Egypt,
“Go to Joseph. Do what he’ll tell you.”

translation.text: When all the land of Egypt was the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph; what he says to you, do."

verses.english:
And the famine was on all the face of the earth. And
Joseph opened everything that was in them and sold to
Egypt. And the famine was strong in the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וְהָרָעָב הָיָה עַל כּל פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיִּפְתַּח יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם וַיִּשְׁבֹּר לְמִצְרַיִם וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

I’ll bring him back to you.”

translation.text: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you. Put him in my hands, and I will bring him back to you."

verses.english:
And he said, “My son will not go down with you. Because
his brother’s dead, and he’s left by himself, and if some
harm would happen to him on the way in which you’re going
then you’ll bring down my gray hair in anguish to Sheol.”

And he said, “My son will not go down with you. Because

translation.text: But he said, "My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. If harm should come to him on with sorrow to Sheol."

verses.english: And the famine was heavy in the land.
verses.hebrew: וְהָרָעָב כָּבֵד בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text: And the famine was heavy in the land.

translation.text: Now the famine was severe in the land.

verses.english:
And it was when they had finished eating the grain that
they had brought from Egypt: and their father said to
them, “Go back. Buy us a little food.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלּוּ לֶאֱכֹל אֶת הַשֶּׁבֶר אֲשֶׁר הֵבִיאוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אֲבִיהֶם שֻׁבוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָנוּ מְעַט אֹכֶל׃

english.text:
And it was when they had finished eating the grain that
they had brought from Egypt: and their father said to
them, “Go back. Buy us a little food.”

translation.text: And when they had eaten them, "Go again, buy us a little more food."

verses.english:
And Judah said to him, saying, “The man certified to us,
saying, ‘You won’t see my face unless your brother is with
you.’

english.text:
And Judah said to him, saying, “The man certified to us,

you.’

translation.text: But Judah said to him, your brother is with you.'

verses.english:
If you’re sending our brother with us, we’ll go down and
buy food for you,
verses.hebrew: אִם יֶשְׁךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת אָחִינוּ אִתָּנוּ נֵרְדָה וְנִשְׁבְּרָה לְךָ אֹכֶל׃

hebrew.text: אִם יֶשְׁךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת אָחִינוּ אִתָּנוּ נֵרְדָה וְנִשְׁבְּרָה לְךָ אֹכֶל׃

english.text:
If you’re sending our brother with us, we’ll go down and
buy food for you,

translation.text: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food;

verses.english:
and if you’re not sending, we won’t go down, because the
man said to us, ‘You won’t see my face unless your brother
is with you.’”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֵינְךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ לֹא נֵרֵד כִּי הָאִישׁ אָמַר אֵלֵינוּ לֹא תִרְאוּ פָנַי בִּלְתִּי אֲחִיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אֵינְךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ לֹא נֵרֵד כִּי הָאִישׁ אָמַר אֵלֵינוּ לֹא תִרְאוּ פָנַי בִּלְתִּי אֲחִיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
and if you’re not sending, we won’t go down, because the

translation.text: but if you will not send him, we will not go down, for the man said to us, 'You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.'"

verses.english:
And Israel said, “Why have you done me wrong, to tell the
man that you have another brother?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתֶם לִי לְהַגִּיד לָאִישׁ הַעוֹד לָכֶם אָח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתֶם לִי לְהַגִּיד לָאִישׁ הַעוֹד לָכֶם אָח׃

english.text:
And Israel said, “Why have you done me wrong, to tell the
man that you have another brother?”

translation.text: Israel said, "Why did you treat me so badly as to tell the man that you had another brother?"

verses.english:
And they said, “The man asked about us and about our
birthplace, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you
have a brother?’ And we told him about these things. Could
we have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother
down’?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁאוֹל שָׁאַל הָאִישׁ לָנוּ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֵּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַעוֹד אֲבִיכֶם חַי הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָח וַנַּגֶּד לוֹ עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲיָדוֹעַ נֵדַע כִּי יֹאמַר הוֹרִידוּ אֶת אֲחִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁאוֹל שָׁאַל הָאִישׁ לָנוּ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֵּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַעוֹד אֲבִיכֶם חַי הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָח וַנַּגֶּד לוֹ עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲיָדוֹעַ נֵדַע כִּי יֹאמַר הוֹרִידוּ אֶת אֲחִיכֶם׃

english.text:
And they said, “The man asked about us and about our
birthplace, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you
have a brother?’ And we told him about these things. Could
we have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother
down’?”

translation.text: They replied, "The 'Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?' What we told him would say, 'Bring your brother down'?"

verses.english:
And Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with
me, so we may get up and go, and we’ll live and not die,
we and you and our infants as well.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִיו שִׁלְחָה הַנַּעַר אִתִּי וְנָקוּמָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַם אַתָּה גַּם טַפֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִיו שִׁלְחָה הַנַּעַר אִתִּי וְנָקוּמָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַם אַתָּה גַּם טַפֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with
me, so we may get up and go, and we’ll live and not die,
we and you and our infants as well.

translation.text: Then Judah said to his father may live and not die — you and we and also our little ones.

verses.english:
I’ll be security for him. You’ll seek him from my hand. If
I don’t bring him to you and set him before you, then I’ll
have sinned against you for all time.
verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי אֶעֶרְבֶנּוּ מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנּוּ אִם לֹא הֲבִיאֹתִיו אֵלֶיךָ וְהִצַּגְתִּיו לְפָנֶיךָ וְחָטָאתִי לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי אֶעֶרְבֶנּוּ מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנּוּ אִם לֹא הֲבִיאֹתִיו אֵלֶיךָ וְהִצַּגְתִּיו לְפָנֶיךָ וְחָטָאתִי לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
I’ll be security for him. You’ll seek him from my hand. If
I don’t bring him to you and set him before you, then I’ll
have sinned against you for all time.

translation.text: I myself will be surety for him; you can hold me accountable for him. If I do not blame forever.

verses.english:
For, if we hadn’t delayed, by now we would have come back
twice.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לוּלֵא הִתְמַהְמָהְנוּ כִּי עַתָּה שַׁבְנוּ זֶה פַעֲמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לוּלֵא הִתְמַהְמָהְנוּ כִּי עַתָּה שַׁבְנוּ זֶה פַעֲמָיִם׃

english.text:
For, if we hadn’t delayed, by now we would have come back
twice.”

translation.text: If we had not delayed, we would now have returned twice."

verses.english:
And Israel, their father, said to them, “If that’s how it
is, then do this: Take some of the best fruit of the land
in your containers and take a gift down to the man, a
little balm and a little honey, gum and myrrh, pistachios
and almonds.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיהֶם אִם כֵּן אֵפוֹא זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ מִזִּמְרַת הָאָרֶץ בִּכְלֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִידוּ לָאִישׁ מִנְחָה מְעַט צֳרִי וּמְעַט דְּבַשׁ נְכֹאת וָלֹט בּטְנִים וּשְׁקֵדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיהֶם אִם כֵּן אֵפוֹא זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ מִזִּמְרַת הָאָרֶץ בִּכְלֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִידוּ לָאִישׁ מִנְחָה מְעַט צֳרִי וּמְעַט דְּבַשׁ נְכֹאת וָלֹט בּטְנִים וּשְׁקֵדִים׃

english.text:
And Israel, their father, said to them, “If that’s how it
is, then do this: Take some of the best fruit of the land
in your containers and take a gift down to the man, a
little balm and a little honey, gum and myrrh, pistachios
and almonds.

translation.text: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be so, then do this: take some of the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry them resin, pistachio nuts, and almonds.

verses.english:
And take double the silver in your hand, and take back in
your hand the silver that was put back in the mouth of
your bags. Maybe it was a mistake.
verses.hebrew: וְכֶסֶף מִשְׁנֶה קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם וְאֶת הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּשָׁב בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם תָּשִׁיבוּ בְיֶדְכֶם אוּלַי מִשְׁגֶּה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְכֶסֶף מִשְׁנֶה קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם וְאֶת הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּשָׁב בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם תָּשִׁיבוּ בְיֶדְכֶם אוּלַי מִשְׁגֶּה הוּא׃

english.text:
And take double the silver in your hand, and take back in
your hand the silver that was put back in the mouth of
your bags. Maybe it was a mistake.

translation.text: Take double the money with you. sacks; perhaps it was an oversight.

verses.english: And take your brother. And get up, go back to the man.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם קָחוּ וְקוּמוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם קָחוּ וְקוּמוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ׃

english.text: And take your brother. And get up, go back to the man.

translation.text: Take your brother also, and be on your way again to the man;

verses.english:
And may El Shadday give you mercy before the man, so he’ll
send your other brother and Benjamin to you. And I: if I’m
bereaved I’m bereaved!”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ וְשִׁלַּח לָכֶם אֶת אֲחִיכֶם אַחֵר וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַאֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁכֹלְתִּי שָׁכָלְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ וְשִׁלַּח לָכֶם אֶת אֲחִיכֶם אַחֵר וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַאֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁכֹלְתִּי שָׁכָלְתִּי׃

english.text:
And may El Shadday give you mercy before the man, so he’ll
send your other brother and Benjamin to you. And I: if I’m
bereaved I’m bereaved!”

translation.text: may God Almighty grant you mercy Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved."

verses.english:
And the men took this gift and took double the silver in
their hand and Benjamin and got up and went down to Egypt
and stood before Joseph.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַזֹּאת וּמִשְׁנֶה כֶּסֶף לָקְחוּ בְיָדָם וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִן וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּרְדוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַזֹּאת וּמִשְׁנֶה כֶּסֶף לָקְחוּ בְיָדָם וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִן וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּרְדוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
And the men took this gift and took double the silver in
their hand and Benjamin and got up and went down to Egypt
and stood before Joseph.

translation.text: So the men took the present, and they took double the money with Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

verses.english:
And Joseph saw Benjamin with them and said to the one who
was over his house, “Bring the men to the house, and
slaughter and prepare an animal, because the men will eat
with me at noon.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף אִתָּם אֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ הָבֵא אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּיְתָה וּטְבֹחַ טֶבַח וְהָכֵן כִּי אִתִּי יֹאכְלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בַּצּהֳרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף אִתָּם אֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ הָבֵא אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּיְתָה וּטְבֹחַ טֶבַח וְהָכֵן כִּי אִתִּי יֹאכְלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בַּצּהֳרָיִם׃

english.text:

slaughter and prepare an animal, because the men will eat
with me at noon.”

translation.text: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his make ready, for the men are to dine with me at noon."

And the man did as Joseph said, and the man brought the

english.text:
And the man did as Joseph said, and the man brought the
men to Joseph’s house.

translation.text: The man did as Joseph said, and brought the men to Joseph's house.

verses.english:

account of the silver that came back in our bags the first

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי הוּבְאוּ בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַל דְּבַר הַכֶּסֶף הַשָּׁב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה אֲנַחְנוּ מוּבָאִים לְהִתְגֹּלֵל עָלֵינוּ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּל עָלֵינוּ וְלָקַחַת אֹתָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי הוּבְאוּ בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַל דְּבַר הַכֶּסֶף הַשָּׁב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה אֲנַחְנוּ מוּבָאִים לְהִתְגֹּלֵל עָלֵינוּ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּל עָלֵינוּ וְלָקַחַת אֹתָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵינוּ׃

And the men were afraid because they were brought to
Joseph’s house, and they said, “We’re being brought on

and spoke to him at the entrance of the house

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו פֶּתַח הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
And they went over to the man who was over Joseph’s house
and spoke to him at the entrance of the house

translation.text: So they went up to the steward of Joseph's house and spoke with him at the entrance to the house.

verses.english:
and said, “Please, my lord, we came down the first time to
buy food,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בִּי אֲדֹנִי יָרֹד יָרַדְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

and said, “Please, my lord, we came down the first time to
buy food,

and it was when we came to the lodging place, and we
opened our bags, and here was each man’s silver in the
mouth of his bag, our money in its full weight. And we’ve
brought it in our hand,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי בָאנוּ אֶל הַמָּלוֹן וַנִּפְתְּחָה אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה כֶסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּמִשְׁקָלוֹ וַנָּשֶׁב אֹתוֹ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי בָאנוּ אֶל הַמָּלוֹן וַנִּפְתְּחָה אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה כֶסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּמִשְׁקָלוֹ וַנָּשֶׁב אֹתוֹ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
and it was when we came to the lodging place, and we
opened our bags, and here was each man’s silver in the
mouth of his bag, our money in its full weight. And we’ve
brought it in our hand,

translation.text: and when we came brought it back with us.

verses.english:
and we’ve brought down additional silver in our hand to
buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our bags.”
verses.hebrew: וְכֶסֶף אַחֵר הוֹרַדְנוּ בְיָדֵנוּ לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מִי שָׂם כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֶסֶף אַחֵר הוֹרַדְנוּ בְיָדֵנוּ לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מִי שָׂם כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
and we’ve brought down additional silver in our hand to
buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our bags.”

translation.text: Moreover we have brought down with us our sacks."

verses.english:
And he said, “Peace to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God and
your father’s God put treasure in your bags for you. Your
silver came to me.” And he brought Simeon out to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם אַל תִּירָאוּ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם מַטְמוֹן בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם כַּסְפְּכֶם בָּא אֵלָי וַיּוֹצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶת שִׁמְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם אַל תִּירָאוּ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם מַטְמוֹן בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם כַּסְפְּכֶם בָּא אֵלָי וַיּוֹצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶת שִׁמְעוֹן׃

english.text:
And he said, “Peace to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God and
your father’s God put treasure in your bags for you. Your
silver came to me.” And he brought Simeon out to them.

translation.text: He replied, "Rest assured, do not be afraid; your God and received your money." Then he brought Simeon out to them.

verses.english:
And the man brought the men to Joseph’s house, and he gave
water, and they washed their feet, and he gave fodder for
their asses.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא הָאִישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וַיִּתֶּן מַיִם וַיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתֵּן מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא הָאִישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וַיִּתֶּן מַיִם וַיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתֵּן מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And the man brought the men to Joseph’s house, and he gave
water, and they washed their feet, and he gave fodder for
their asses.

translation.text: When donkeys fodder,

verses.english:
And they prepared the gift until Joseph’s arrival at noon
because they heard that they would eat bread there.

hebrew.text: וַיָּכִינוּ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה עַד בּוֹא יוֹסֵף בַּצּהֳרָיִם כִּי שָׁמְעוּ כִּי שָׁם יֹאכְלוּ לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And they prepared the gift until Joseph’s arrival at noon
because they heard that they would eat bread there.

translation.text: they made the present ready for Joseph's coming at noon, for they had heard that they would dine there.

verses.english:
And Joseph came to the house, and they brought the gift
for him that was in their hand to the house, and they
bowed to him to the ground.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹסֵף הַבַּיְתָה וַיָּבִיאּוּ לוֹ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם הַבָּיְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יוֹסֵף הַבַּיְתָה וַיָּבִיאּוּ לוֹ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם הַבָּיְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Joseph came to the house, and they brought the gift
for him that was in their hand to the house, and they
bowed to him to the ground.

translation.text: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present that they had carried into the house, and bowed to the ground before him.

verses.english:
And he asked if they were well, and he said, “Is your old
father whom you mentioned well? Is he still alive?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם אֲבִיכֶם הַזָּקֵן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם אֲבִיכֶם הַזָּקֵן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חָי׃

english.text:
And he asked if they were well, and he said, “Is your old
father whom you mentioned well? Is he still alive?”

translation.text: He inquired about their welfare, and said, "Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he still alive?"

verses.english:
And they said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He’s
still alive.” And they knelt and bowed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִינוּ עוֹדֶנּוּ חָי וַיִּקְּדוּ (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ]׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִינוּ עוֹדֶנּוּ חָי וַיִּקְּדוּ (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ]׃

english.text:
And they said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He’s
still alive.” And they knelt and bowed.

translation.text: They said, "Your servant our father is well; he is still alive." And they bowed their heads and did obeisance.

verses.english:
And he raised his eyes and saw Benjamin, his brother, his
mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother
whom you mentioned to me?” And he said, “May God be
gracious to you, my son.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת בִּנְיָמִין אָחִיו בֶּן אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמַר אֱלֹהִים יחְנְךָ בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת בִּנְיָמִין אָחִיו בֶּן אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמַר אֱלֹהִים יחְנְךָ בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And he raised his eyes and saw Benjamin, his brother, his
mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother
whom you mentioned to me?” And he said, “May God be
gracious to you, my son.”

translation.text: Then he looked up and saw his brother Benjamin, his spoke to me? God be gracious to you, my son!"

verses.english:
And Joseph hurried because his feelings for his brother
were boiling, and he looked for a place to weep and came
to his room and wept there.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר יוֹסֵף כִּי נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמָיו אֶל אָחִיו וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לִבְכּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַחַדְרָה וַיֵּבְךְּ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר יוֹסֵף כִּי נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמָיו אֶל אָחִיו וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לִבְכּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַחַדְרָה וַיֵּבְךְּ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And Joseph hurried because his feelings for his brother
were boiling, and he looked for a place to weep and came
to his room and wept there.

translation.text: With that, Joseph there.

verses.english:
And he washed his face and went out and restrained himself
and said, “Put out bread.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְחַץ פָּנָיו וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּתְאַפַּק וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְחַץ פָּנָיו וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּתְאַפַּק וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And he washed his face and went out and restrained himself
and said, “Put out bread.”

translation.text: Then he washed his face and came out; and controlling himself he said, "Serve the meal."

verses.english:
And they put it out for him by himself and for them by
themselves and for the Egyptians who were eating with him
by themselves, because the Egyptians could not eat bread
with the Hebrews because that is an offensive thing to
Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְלָהֶם לְבַדָּם וְלַמִּצְרִים הָאֹכְלִים אִתּוֹ לְבַדָּם כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּן הַמִּצְרִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת הָעִבְרִים לֶחֶם כִּי תוֹעֵבָה הִוא לְמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְלָהֶם לְבַדָּם וְלַמִּצְרִים הָאֹכְלִים אִתּוֹ לְבַדָּם כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּן הַמִּצְרִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת הָעִבְרִים לֶחֶם כִּי תוֹעֵבָה הִוא לְמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they put it out for him by himself and for them by
themselves and for the Egyptians who were eating with him
by themselves, because the Egyptians could not eat bread
with the Hebrews because that is an offensive thing to
Egypt.

translation.text: They served him by himself, and that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his
birthright and the youngest according to his youth. And
