onto Manasseh’s head,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף כִּי יָשִׁית אָבִיו יַד יְמִינוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו וַיִּתְמֹךְ יַד אָבִיו לְהָסִיר אֹתָהּ מֵעַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם עַל רֹאשׁ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף כִּי יָשִׁית אָבִיו יַד יְמִינוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו וַיִּתְמֹךְ יַד אָבִיו לְהָסִיר אֹתָהּ מֵעַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם עַל רֹאשׁ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand
on Ephraim’s head, and it was bad in his eyes, and he held
up his father’s hand to turn it from on Ephraim’s head
onto Manasseh’s head,

translation.text: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

verses.english:
and Joseph said to his father, “Not like that, my father,
because this is the firstborn. Set your right hand on his
head.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אָבִיו לֹא כֵן אָבִי כִּי זֶה הַבְּכֹר שִׂים יְמִינְךָ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אָבִיו לֹא כֵן אָבִי כִּי זֶה הַבְּכֹר שִׂים יְמִינְךָ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
and Joseph said to his father, “Not like that, my father,
because this is the firstborn. Set your right hand on his
head.”

translation.text: Joseph said to his father, "Not so, my father! Since this one is the firstborn, put your right hand on his head."

verses.english:
And his father refused and said, “I know, my son, I know.
He, too, will become a people; and he, too, will be great.
But in fact his little brother will be greater than he,
and his seed will be full-fledged of nations.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר יָדַעְתִּי בְנִי יָדַעְתִּי גַּם הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּעָם וְגַם הוּא יִגְדָּל וְאוּלָם אָחִיו הַקָּטֹן יִגְדַּל מִמֶּנּוּ וְזַרְעוֹ יִהְיֶה מְלֹא הַגּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֵן אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר יָדַעְתִּי בְנִי יָדַעְתִּי גַּם הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּעָם וְגַם הוּא יִגְדָּל וְאוּלָם אָחִיו הַקָּטֹן יִגְדַּל מִמֶּנּוּ וְזַרְעוֹ יִהְיֶה מְלֹא הַגּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
And his father refused and said, “I know, my son, I know.
He, too, will become a people; and he, too, will be great.
But in fact his little brother will be greater than he,
and his seed will be full-fledged of nations.”

translation.text: But his father refused, and said, "I know, my son, I know; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great. offspring shall become a multitude of nations."

verses.english:
And he blessed them in that day, saying, “Israel will
bless with you, saying: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and
like Manasseh.’” And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמוֹר בְּךָ יְבָרֵךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יְשִׂמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת אֶפְרַיִם לִפְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכֵם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמוֹר בְּךָ יְבָרֵךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יְשִׂמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת אֶפְרַיִם לִפְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And he blessed them in that day, saying, “Israel will
bless with you, saying: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and
like Manasseh.’” And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

translation.text: So he blessed them 'God make you like Ephraim and like Manasseh.'" So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.

verses.english:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Here, I’m dying. And God will
be with you and will bring you back to your fathers’ land.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵת וְהָיָה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּכֶם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶתְכֶם אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵת וְהָיָה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּכֶם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶתְכֶם אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Here, I’m dying. And God will
be with you and will bring you back to your fathers’ land.

translation.text: Then Israel said to Joseph, "I the land of your ancestors.

verses.english:
And I’ve given you one shoulder over your brothers, which
I took from the Amorite’s hand with my sword and my bow.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי נָתַתִּי לְךָ שְׁכֶם אַחַד עַל אַחֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתִּי מִיַּד הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחַרְבִּי וּבְקַשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי נָתַתִּי לְךָ שְׁכֶם אַחַד עַל אַחֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתִּי מִיַּד הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחַרְבִּי וּבְקַשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
And I’ve given you one shoulder over your brothers, which
I took from the Amorite’s hand with my sword and my bow.

translation.text: I now give to you one portion more than to your brothers, the portion that I took from the hand of the Amorites with my sword and with my bow."

verses.english:
And Jacob called to his sons and said: Gather, and I’ll
tell you what will happen to you in the future days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶל בָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶל בָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And Jacob called to his sons and said: Gather, and I’ll
tell you what will happen to you in the future days.

translation.text: Then Jacob called his sons, and said: "Gather around, that I may tell you what will happen to you in days to come.

verses.english:
Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel,
your father.
verses.hebrew: הִקָּבְצוּ וְשִׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁמְעוּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: הִקָּבְצוּ וְשִׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁמְעוּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיכֶם׃

english.text:
Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel,
your father.

translation.text: Assemble and hear, O sons of Jacob; listen to Israel your father.

verses.english:
Reuben, you’re my firstborn, my power, and the beginning
of my might, preeminent in bearing and preeminent in
strength.
verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹרִי אַתָּה כֹּחִי וְרֵאשִׁית אוֹנִי יֶתֶר שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹרִי אַתָּה כֹּחִי וְרֵאשִׁית אוֹנִי יֶתֶר שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז׃

english.text:
Reuben, you’re my firstborn, my power, and the beginning
of my might, preeminent in bearing and preeminent in
strength.

translation.text: Reuben, you are my firstborn, excelling in rank and excelling in power.

verses.english:
Unstable as water, you’ll not be preeminent, for you
ascended your father’s bed; then you defiled, going up to
my couch.
verses.hebrew: פַּחַז כַּמַּיִם אַל תּוֹתַר כִּי עָלִיתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵי אָבִיךָ אָז חִלַּלְתָּ יְצוּעִי עָלָה׃

hebrew.text: פַּחַז כַּמַּיִם אַל תּוֹתַר כִּי עָלִיתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵי אָבִיךָ אָז חִלַּלְתָּ יְצוּעִי עָלָה׃

english.text:
Unstable as water, you’ll not be preeminent, for you
ascended your father’s bed; then you defiled, going up to
my couch.

translation.text: Unstable as water, you shall no longer excel because you went up onto your father's bed; then you defiled it — you went up onto my couch!

verses.english:
Simeon and Levi are brothers: Implements of violence are
their tools of trade.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אַחִים כְּלֵי חָמָס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אַחִים כְּלֵי חָמָס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Simeon and Levi are brothers: Implements of violence are
their tools of trade.

translation.text: Simeon and Levi are brothers; weapons of violence are their swords.

verses.english:
Let my soul not come in their council; let my glory not be
united in their society. For in their anger they killed a
man, and by their will they crippled an ox.
verses.hebrew: בְּסֹדָם אַל תָּבֹא נַפְשִׁי בִּקְהָלָם אַל תֵּחַד כְּבֹדִי כִּי בְאַפָּם הָרְגוּ אִישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָם עִקְּרוּ שׁוֹר׃

hebrew.text: בְּסֹדָם אַל תָּבֹא נַפְשִׁי בִּקְהָלָם אַל תֵּחַד כְּבֹדִי כִּי בְאַפָּם הָרְגוּ אִישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָם עִקְּרוּ שׁוֹר׃

english.text:
Let my soul not come in their council; let my glory not be
united in their society. For in their anger they killed a
man, and by their will they crippled an ox.

translation.text: May I never come into their council; and at their whim they hamstrung oxen.

verses.english:
Cursed is their anger, for it’s strong, and their wrath,
for it’s hard. I’ll divide them in Jacob, and I’ll scatter
them in Israel.
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אַפָּם כִּי עָז וְעֶבְרָתָם כִּי קָשָׁתָה אֲחַלְּקֵם בְּיַעֲקֹב וַאֲפִיצֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אַפָּם כִּי עָז וְעֶבְרָתָם כִּי קָשָׁתָה אֲחַלְּקֵם בְּיַעֲקֹב וַאֲפִיצֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Cursed is their anger, for it’s strong, and their wrath,
for it’s hard. I’ll divide them in Jacob, and I’ll scatter
them in Israel.

translation.text: Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce, and their wrath, for it is cruel! and scatter them in Israel.

verses.english:
Judah: You, your brothers will praise you. Your hand on
your enemies’ neck, your father’s sons will bow to you.
verses.hebrew: יְהוּדָה אַתָּה יוֹדוּךָ אַחֶיךָ יָדְךָ בְּעֹרֶף אֹיְבֶיךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: יְהוּדָה אַתָּה יוֹדוּךָ אַחֶיךָ יָדְךָ בְּעֹרֶף אֹיְבֶיךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
Judah: You, your brothers will praise you. Your hand on
your enemies’ neck, your father’s sons will bow to you.

translation.text: Judah, your brothers shall praise you; your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons shall bow down before you.

verses.english:
A lion’s whelp is Judah; from prey, my son, you’ve risen.
He bent, crouched, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse him?
verses.hebrew: גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְהוּדָה מִטֶּרֶף בְּנִי עָלִיתָ כָּרַע רָבַץ כְּאַרְיֵה וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְהוּדָה מִטֶּרֶף בְּנִי עָלִיתָ כָּרַע רָבַץ כְּאַרְיֵה וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
A lion’s whelp is Judah; from prey, my son, you’ve risen.
He bent, crouched, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse him?

translation.text: Judah is a lion's whelp; from the prey, my son, you have gone up. like a lioness — who dares rouse him up?

verses.english:
The scepter won’t depart from Judah or a ruler from
between his legs until he comes to Shiloh, and peoples’
obedience is his.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יָסוּר שֵׁבֶט מִיהוּדָה וּמְחֹקֵק מִבֵּין רַגְלָיו עַד כִּי יָבֹא שִׁילֹה וְלוֹ יִקְּהַת עַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יָסוּר שֵׁבֶט מִיהוּדָה וּמְחֹקֵק מִבֵּין רַגְלָיו עַד כִּי יָבֹא שִׁילֹה וְלוֹ יִקְּהַת עַמִּים׃

english.text:
The scepter won’t depart from Judah or a ruler from
between his legs until he comes to Shiloh, and peoples’
obedience is his.

translation.text: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, until tribute comes to him; and the obedience of the peoples is his.

verses.english:
Tying his ass to the vine and his she-ass’s foal to the
choice vine, he washed in wine his clothing and in blood
of grapes his garment,
verses.hebrew: אֹסְרִי לַגֶּפֶן עִירֹה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָה בְּנִי אֲתֹנוֹ כִּבֵּס בַּיַּיִן לְבֻשׁוֹ וּבְדַם עֲנָבִים סוּתֹה׃

hebrew.text: אֹסְרִי לַגֶּפֶן עִירֹה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָה בְּנִי אֲתֹנוֹ כִּבֵּס בַּיַּיִן לְבֻשׁוֹ וּבְדַם עֲנָבִים סוּתֹה׃

english.text:
Tying his ass to the vine and his she-ass’s foal to the
choice vine, he washed in wine his clothing and in blood
of grapes his garment,

translation.text: Binding his foal to the vine and his robe in the blood of grapes;

verses.english: eyes darker than wine and teeth whiter than milk.
verses.hebrew: חַכְלִילִי עֵינַיִם מִיָּיִן וּלְבֶן שִׁנַּיִם מֵחָלָב׃

hebrew.text: חַכְלִילִי עֵינַיִם מִיָּיִן וּלְבֶן שִׁנַּיִם מֵחָלָב׃

english.text: eyes darker than wine and teeth whiter than milk.

translation.text: his eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.

verses.english:
Zebulun will dwell by seashores: and he’ll be a shore for
boats, and his border at Sidon.
verses.hebrew: זְבוּלֻן לְחוֹף יַמִּים יִשְׁכֹּן וְהוּא לְחוֹף אֳנִיֹּת וְיַרְכָתוֹ עַל צִידֹן׃

hebrew.text: זְבוּלֻן לְחוֹף יַמִּים יִשְׁכֹּן וְהוּא לְחוֹף אֳנִיֹּת וְיַרְכָתוֹ עַל צִידֹן׃

english.text:
Zebulun will dwell by seashores: and he’ll be a shore for
boats, and his border at Sidon.

translation.text: Zebulun shall settle at the shore of the sea; and his border shall be at Sidon.

verses.english:
Issachar is a strong ass crouching between the
saddle-packs:
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂשכָר חֲמֹר גָּרֶם רֹבֵץ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂשכָר חֲמֹר גָּרֶם רֹבֵץ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתָיִם׃

english.text:
Issachar is a strong ass crouching between the
saddle-packs:

translation.text: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds;

verses.english:
and he saw rest, that it was good, and the land, that it
was pleasant, and he leaned his shoulder to bear and
became a work-company servant.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מְנֻחָה כִּי טוֹב וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי נָעֵמָה וַיֵּט שִׁכְמוֹ לִסְבֹּל וַיְהִי לְמַס עֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא מְנֻחָה כִּי טוֹב וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי נָעֵמָה וַיֵּט שִׁכְמוֹ לִסְבֹּל וַיְהִי לְמַס עֹבֵד׃

english.text:
and he saw rest, that it was good, and the land, that it
was pleasant, and he leaned his shoulder to bear and
became a work-company servant.

translation.text: he saw that a resting place was good, and that the land was pleasant; and became a slave at forced labor.

verses.english: Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel:
verses.hebrew: דָּן יָדִין עַמּוֹ כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: דָּן יָדִין עַמּוֹ כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel:

translation.text: Dan shall judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.english:
Dan will be a snake on a road, a venomous snake on a path,
that bites a horse’s heels, and its rider falls backward.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי דָן נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי דֶרֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹן עֲלֵי אֹרַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ עִקְּבֵי סוּס וַיִּפֹּל רֹכְבוֹ אָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: יְהִי דָן נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי דֶרֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹן עֲלֵי אֹרַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ עִקְּבֵי סוּס וַיִּפֹּל רֹכְבוֹ אָחוֹר׃

english.text:
Dan will be a snake on a road, a venomous snake on a path,
that bites a horse’s heels, and its rider falls backward.

translation.text: Dan shall be a snake by the roadside, so that its rider falls backward.

verses.english: I wait for your salvation, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: I wait for your salvation, YHWH.

translation.text: I wait for your salvation, O LORD.

verses.english: Gad: a troop will trap him, and he’ll trap their heel.
verses.hebrew: גָּד גְּדוּד יְגוּדֶנּוּ וְהוּא יָגֻד עָקֵב׃

hebrew.text: גָּד גְּדוּד יְגוּדֶנּוּ וְהוּא יָגֻד עָקֵב׃

english.text: Gad: a troop will trap him, and he’ll trap their heel.

translation.text: Gad shall be raided by raiders, but he shall raid at their heels.

verses.english:
Asher: his bread will be rich, and he’ll provide a king’s
delights.
verses.hebrew: מֵאָשֵׁר שְׁמֵנָה לַחְמוֹ וְהוּא יִתֵּן מַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: מֵאָשֵׁר שְׁמֵנָה לַחְמוֹ וְהוּא יִתֵּן מַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Asher: his bread will be rich, and he’ll provide a king’s
delights.

translation.text: Asher's food shall be rich, and he shall provide royal delicacies.

verses.english: Naphtali: a hind let loose, who gives lovely words.
verses.hebrew: נַפְתָּלִי אַיָּלָה שְׁלֻחָה הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָׁפֶר׃

hebrew.text: נַפְתָּלִי אַיָּלָה שְׁלֻחָה הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָׁפֶר׃

english.text: Naphtali: a hind let loose, who gives lovely words.

translation.text: Naphtali is a doe let loose that bears lovely fawns.

verses.english:
A fruitful bough is Joseph, a fruitful bough over a
spring, branches running over a wall:
verses.hebrew: בֵּן פֹּרָת יוֹסֵף בֵּן פֹּרָת עֲלֵי עָיִן בָּנוֹת צָעֲדָה עֲלֵי שׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: בֵּן פֹּרָת יוֹסֵף בֵּן פֹּרָת עֲלֵי עָיִן בָּנוֹת צָעֲדָה עֲלֵי שׁוּר׃

english.text:
A fruitful bough is Joseph, a fruitful bough over a
spring, branches running over a wall:

translation.text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring; his branches run over the wall.

verses.english:
And archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and
despised him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָרְרֻהוּ וָרֹבּוּ וַיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ בַּעֲלֵי חִצִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָרְרֻהוּ וָרֹבּוּ וַיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ בַּעֲלֵי חִצִּים׃

english.text:
And archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and
despised him.

translation.text: The archers fiercely attacked him; they shot at him and pressed him hard.

verses.english:
And his bow stayed strong, and his forearms were nimble,
from the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from there, the
shepherd, the rock of Israel,
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן קַשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּפֹזּוּ זְרֹעֵי יָדָיו מִידֵי אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב מִשָּׁם רֹעֶה אֶבֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן קַשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּפֹזּוּ זְרֹעֵי יָדָיו מִידֵי אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב מִשָּׁם רֹעֶה אֶבֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And his bow stayed strong, and his forearms were nimble,
from the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from there, the
shepherd, the rock of Israel,

translation.text: Yet his bow remained taut,

verses.english:
from your father’s God, and He’ll strengthen you, and
Shadday, and He’ll bless you, blessings of skies from
above, blessings of deep, crouching below, blessings of
breast and womb.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֵל אָבִיךָ וְיַעְזְרֶךָּ וְאֵת שַׁדַּי וִיבָרְכֶךָּ בִּרְכֹת שָׁמַיִם מֵעָל בִּרְכֹת תְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת בִּרְכֹת שָׁדַיִם וָרָחַם׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֵל אָבִיךָ וְיַעְזְרֶךָּ וְאֵת שַׁדַּי וִיבָרְכֶךָּ בִּרְכֹת שָׁמַיִם מֵעָל בִּרְכֹת תְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת בִּרְכֹת שָׁדַיִם וָרָחַם׃

english.text:
from your father’s God, and He’ll strengthen you, and
Shadday, and He’ll bless you, blessings of skies from
above, blessings of deep, crouching below, blessings of
breast and womb.

translation.text: by the God of your father, who will help you, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.

verses.english:
blessings of your father, the mighty and most high,
blessings of the mountains of old desired object of the
hills of antiquity. They’ll be on Joseph’s head, on the
top of the head of the one separate from his brothers.
verses.hebrew: בִּרְכֹת אָבִיךָ גָּבְרוּ עַל בִּרְכֹת הוֹרַי עַד תַּאֲוַת גִּבְעֹת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶיןָ לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: בִּרְכֹת אָבִיךָ גָּבְרוּ עַל בִּרְכֹת הוֹרַי עַד תַּאֲוַת גִּבְעֹת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶיןָ לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
blessings of your father, the mighty and most high,
blessings of the mountains of old desired object of the
hills of antiquity. They’ll be on Joseph’s head, on the
top of the head of the one separate from his brothers.

translation.text: The blessings of your father the bounties of the everlasting hills; on the brow of him who was set apart from his brothers.

verses.english:
Benjamin is a tearing wolf: in the morning eating prey,
and at evening dividing booty.
verses.hebrew: בִּנְיָמִין זְאֵב יִטְרָף בַּבֹּקֶר יֹאכַל עַד וְלָעֶרֶב יְחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃

hebrew.text: בִּנְיָמִין זְאֵב יִטְרָף בַּבֹּקֶר יֹאכַל עַד וְלָעֶרֶב יְחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃

english.text:
Benjamin is a tearing wolf: in the morning eating prey,
and at evening dividing booty.

translation.text: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, and at evening dividing the spoil."

verses.english:
All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve, and this is
what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them. He
blessed them each according to his blessing.
verses.hebrew: כּל אֵלֶּה שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר וְזֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם וַיְבָרֶךְ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כְּבִרְכָתוֹ בֵּרַךְ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר וְזֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם וַיְבָרֶךְ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כְּבִרְכָתוֹ בֵּרַךְ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve, and this is
what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them. He
blessed them each according to his blessing.

translation.text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father suitable blessing.

verses.english:
And he commanded them and said to them, “I’m being
gathered to my people. Bury me: to my fathers, to the cave
that’s in the field of Ephron, the Hittite,
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אוֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי נֶאֱסָף אֶל עַמִּי קִבְרוּ אֹתִי אֶל אֲבֹתָי אֶל הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אוֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי נֶאֱסָף אֶל עַמִּי קִבְרוּ אֹתִי אֶל אֲבֹתָי אֶל הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי׃

english.text:
And he commanded them and said to them, “I’m being
gathered to my people. Bury me: to my fathers, to the cave
that’s in the field of Ephron, the Hittite,

translation.text: Then he charged them, saying to them, "I am about to be gathered Ephron the Hittite,

verses.english:
in the cave that’s in the field of Machpelah, which faces
Mamre in the land of Canaan, as Abraham bought the field
from Ephron, the Hittite, as a possession for a tomb.
verses.hebrew: בַּמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃

hebrew.text: בַּמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃

english.text:
in the cave that’s in the field of Machpelah, which faces
Mamre in the land of Canaan, as Abraham bought the field
from Ephron, the Hittite, as a possession for a tomb.

translation.text: in the cave in the field at Machpelah, near Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.

verses.english:
There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they
buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife. And there I buried
Leah.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת אַבְרָהָם וְאֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ וְשָׁמָּה קָבַרְתִּי אֶת לֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת אַבְרָהָם וְאֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ וְשָׁמָּה קָבַרְתִּי אֶת לֵאָה׃

english.text:
There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they
buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife. And there I buried
Leah.

translation.text: There Abraham and his wife Sarah buried Leah —

verses.english:
The field and the cave that’s in it were a purchase from
the children of Heth.”
verses.hebrew: מִקְנֵה הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃

hebrew.text: מִקְנֵה הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃

english.text:
The field and the cave that’s in it were a purchase from
the children of Heth.”

translation.text: the field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites."

verses.english:
And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered
his feet into the bed, and he expired, and he was gathered
to his people.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל יַעֲקֹב לְצַוֺּת אֶת בָּנָיו וַיֶּאֱסֹף רַגְלָיו אֶל הַמִּטָּה וַיִּגְוַע וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל יַעֲקֹב לְצַוֺּת אֶת בָּנָיו וַיֶּאֱסֹף רַגְלָיו אֶל הַמִּטָּה וַיִּגְוַע וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered
his feet into the bed, and he expired, and he was gathered
to his people.

translation.text: When Jacob ended his charge to his sons, he his people.

verses.english:
And Joseph fell upon his father’s face and wept over
him and kissed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Joseph fell upon his father’s face and wept over
him and kissed him.

translation.text: Then Joseph threw himself on his father's face and wept over him and kissed him.

verses.english:
And Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to
embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel,
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף אֶת עֲבָדָיו אֶת הָרֹפְאִים לַחֲנֹט אֶת אָבִיו וַיַּחַנְטוּ הָרֹפְאִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף אֶת עֲבָדָיו אֶת הָרֹפְאִים לַחֲנֹט אֶת אָבִיו וַיַּחַנְטוּ הָרֹפְאִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to
embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel,

translation.text: Joseph commanded the physicians in his service to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel;

verses.english:
and they spent forty days on him, because that is the
number of days they spent on the embalming, and Egypt
mourned him seventy days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלְאוּ לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם כִּי כֵּן יִמְלְאוּ יְמֵי הַחֲנֻטִים וַיִּבְכּוּ אֹתוֹ מִצְרַיִם שִׁבְעִים יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלְאוּ לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם כִּי כֵּן יִמְלְאוּ יְמֵי הַחֲנֻטִים וַיִּבְכּוּ אֹתוֹ מִצְרַיִם שִׁבְעִים יוֹם׃

english.text:
and they spent forty days on him, because that is the
number of days they spent on the embalming, and Egypt
mourned him seventy days.

translation.text: they spent forty days in doing this, for that is the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians wept for him seventy days.

verses.english:
And his mourning days passed, and Joseph spoke to

verses.english:
‘My father had me swear, saying, “Here I’m dying. In my
tomb, which I dug for me in the land of Canaan: you shall
bury me there.” And now, let me go up so I may bury my
father and come back.’”

‘My father had me swear, saying, “Here I’m dying. In my

translation.text: My father made me swear an oath; he said, 'I am about to die. In the tomb that I hewed out for myself in the so that I may bury my father; then I will return."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father as he had
you swear.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה עֲלֵה וּקְבֹר אֶת אָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבִּיעֶךָ׃

And Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father as he had
you swear.”

translation.text: Pharaoh answered, "Go up, and bury your father, as he made you swear to do."

verses.english:
And Joseph went up to bury his father, and all of
Pharaoh’s servants, the elders of his house, and all the
elders of the land of Egypt,

And Joseph went up to bury his father, and all of

elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.english:
and all of Joseph’s house and his brothers and his
father’s house. Only their infants and their flock and
their oxen they left in the land of Goshen.

english.text:
and all of Joseph’s house and his brothers and his
father’s house. Only their infants and their flock and
their oxen they left in the land of Goshen.

translation.text: as well as all the household of Joseph, his brothers, and his father's household. Only their children, their flocks, and their herds were left in the land of Goshen.

verses.english:
And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a
very heavy camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל עִמּוֹ גַּם רֶכֶב גַּם פָּרָשִׁים וַיְהִי הַמַּחֲנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a
very heavy camp.

translation.text: Both chariots and charioteers went up with him. It was a very great company.

verses.english:
And his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried
him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, as Abraham had
bought the field as a possession for a tomb from Ephron,
the Hittite, facing Mamre.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ בָנָיו אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃

And his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried
him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, as Abraham had
bought the field as a possession for a tomb from Ephron,
the Hittite, facing Mamre.

translation.text: as a burial site from Ephron the Hittite.

verses.english:
And, after his burial of his father, Joseph came back to
Egypt, he and his brothers and all those who went up with
him to bury his father.

english.text:
And, after his burial of his father, Joseph came back to
Egypt, he and his brothers and all those who went up with
him to bury his father.

translation.text: After he had buried his gone up with him to bury his father.

verses.english:
And Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, and
they said, “If Joseph will despise us he’ll pay us back
all the bad that we dealt to him.”

english.text:
And Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, and
they said, “If Joseph will despise us he’ll pay us back
all the bad that we dealt to him.”

translation.text: Realizing that their father was dead, Joseph's brothers said, "What if Joseph still bears a grudge against us and pays us back in full for all the wrong that we did to him?"

verses.english:
And they commanded to Joseph, saying, “Your father had
commanded before his death, saying,

english.text:
And they commanded to Joseph, saying, “Your father had
commanded before his death, saying,

translation.text: So they approached Joseph, saying, "Your father gave this instruction before he died,

‘You shall say this to Joseph: Please, bear your brothers’
offense and their sin, because they dealt you bad.’ And
now bear the offense of the servants of your father’s
God.” And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

‘You shall say this to Joseph: Please, bear your brothers’
offense and their sin, because they dealt you bad.’ And
now bear the offense of the servants of your father’s
God.” And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

translation.text: 'Say to Joseph: I of the God of your father." Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

said, “Here, we’re yours as slaves.”

And his brothers also went and fell in front of him and
said, “Here, we’re yours as slaves.”

And you thought bad against me. thought for good: in

And now, don’t be afraid. I’ll provide for you and your

And now, don’t be afraid. I’ll provide for you and your
