And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father’s house. And
Joseph lived a hundred ten years,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יוֹסֵף בְּמִצְרַיִם הוּא וּבֵית אָבִיו וַיְחִי יוֹסֵף מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יוֹסֵף בְּמִצְרַיִם הוּא וּבֵית אָבִיו וַיְחִי יוֹסֵף מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father’s house. And
Joseph lived a hundred ten years,

translation.text: So Joseph remained in Egypt, he and his father's household; and Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

verses.english:
and Joseph saw children of Ephraim’s of the third
generation. Also children of Machir, son of Manasseh, were
born on Joseph’s knees.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּנֵי שִׁלֵּשִׁים גַּם בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה יֻלְּדוּ עַל בִּרְכֵּי יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּנֵי שִׁלֵּשִׁים גַּם בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה יֻלְּדוּ עַל בִּרְכֵּי יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
and Joseph saw children of Ephraim’s of the third
generation. Also children of Machir, son of Manasseh, were
born on Joseph’s knees.

translation.text: Joseph saw Ephraim's children also born on Joseph's knees.

verses.english:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m dying. And God will
take account of you and will bring you up from this land
to the land that He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to
Jacob.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו אָנֹכִי מֵת וֵאלֹהִים פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֶתְכֶם וְהֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו אָנֹכִי מֵת וֵאלֹהִים פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֶתְכֶם וְהֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m dying. And God will
take account of you and will bring you up from this land
to the land that He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to
Jacob.”

translation.text: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die; but God will he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."

verses.english:
And Joseph had the children of Israel swear, saying, “God
will take account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones
from here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁבַּע יוֹסֵף אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶתְכֶם וְהַעֲלִתֶם אֶת עַצְמֹתַי מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁבַּע יוֹסֵף אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶתְכֶם וְהַעֲלִתֶם אֶת עַצְמֹתַי מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And Joseph had the children of Israel swear, saying, “God
will take account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones
from here.”

translation.text: So Joseph made the my bones from here."

verses.english:
And Joseph died, a hundred ten years old, and they
embalmed him and set him in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף בֶּן מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וַיַּחַנְטוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּישֶׂם בָּאָרוֹן בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף בֶּן מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וַיַּחַנְטוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּישֶׂם בָּאָרוֹן בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Joseph died, a hundred ten years old, and they
embalmed him and set him in a coffin in Egypt.

translation.text: And Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old; he was embalmed and placed in a coffin in Egypt.

verses.english:
And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar,
Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedor-laomer, king of Elam, and
Tidal, king of Goiim.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר אַרְיוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם וְתִדְעָל מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר אַרְיוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם וְתִדְעָל מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar,
Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedor-laomer, king of Elam, and
Tidal, king of Goiim.

verses.english:
They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and Birsha, king
of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of
Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)
verses.hebrew: עָשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה אֶת בֶּרַע מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וְאֶת בִּרְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ עֲמֹרָה שִׁנְאָב מֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה וְשֶׁמְאֵבֶר מֶלֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִם] וּמֶלֶךְ בֶּלַע הִיא צֹעַר׃

hebrew.text: עָשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה אֶת בֶּרַע מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וְאֶת בִּרְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ עֲמֹרָה שִׁנְאָב מֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה וְשֶׁמְאֵבֶר מֶלֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִם] וּמֶלֶךְ בֶּלַע הִיא צֹעַר׃

english.text:
They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and Birsha, king
of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of
Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

verses.english:
All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the
Dead Sea.)
verses.hebrew: כּל אֵלֶּה חָבְרוּ אֶל עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח׃

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה חָבְרוּ אֶל עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח׃

english.text:
All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the
Dead Sea.)

verses.english:
Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth
year they revolted,
verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה עָבְדוּ אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָרָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה עָבְדוּ אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָרָדוּ׃

english.text:
Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth
year they revolted,

verses.english:
and in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who
were with him came, and they struck the Rephaim in
Ashteroth Karnaim and the Zuzum in Ham and the Emim in
Shaveh Kiriataim
verses.hebrew: וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בָּא כְדרְלָעֹמֶר וְהַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת רְפָאִים בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם וְאֶת הַזּוּזִים בְּהָם וְאֵת הָאֵימִים בְּשָׁוֵה קִרְיָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בָּא כְדרְלָעֹמֶר וְהַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת רְפָאִים בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם וְאֶת הַזּוּזִים בְּהָם וְאֵת הָאֵימִים בְּשָׁוֵה קִרְיָתָיִם׃

english.text:
and in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who
were with him came, and they struck the Rephaim in
Ashteroth Karnaim and the Zuzum in Ham and the Emim in
Shaveh Kiriataim

verses.english:
and the Horites in their mountain Seir to El Paran, which
is by the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֹרִי בְּהַרְרָם שֵׂעִיר עַד אֵיל פָּארָן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֹרִי בְּהַרְרָם שֵׂעִיר עַד אֵיל פָּארָן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
and the Horites in their mountain Seir to El Paran, which
is by the wilderness.

verses.english:
And they came back and came to En Mishpat (that is Kadesh)
and struck the area of the Amalekites and also the
Amorites who live in Hazazon Tamar.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל עֵין מִשְׁפָּט הִוא קָדֵשׁ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת כּל שְׂדֵה הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְגַם אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּחַצְצֹן תָּמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל עֵין מִשְׁפָּט הִוא קָדֵשׁ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת כּל שְׂדֵה הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְגַם אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּחַצְצֹן תָּמָר׃

english.text:
And they came back and came to En Mishpat (that is Kadesh)
and struck the area of the Amalekites and also the
Amorites who live in Hazazon Tamar.

verses.english:
And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah and the
king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela
(that is Zoar) went out and aligned with them for war in
the Siddim Valley
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וּמֶלֶךְ עֲמֹרָה וּמֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה וּמֶלֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִם] וּמֶלֶךְ בֶּלַע הִוא צֹעַר וַיַּעַרְכוּ אִתָּם מִלְחָמָה בְּעֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וּמֶלֶךְ עֲמֹרָה וּמֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה וּמֶלֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִם] וּמֶלֶךְ בֶּלַע הִוא צֹעַר וַיַּעַרְכוּ אִתָּם מִלְחָמָה בְּעֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים׃

english.text:
And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah and the
king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela
(that is Zoar) went out and aligned with them for war in
the Siddim Valley

verses.english:
with Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of
Ellasar—four kings with five.
verses.hebrew: אֵת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם וְתִדְעָל מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם וְאַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר וְאַרְיוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר אַרְבָּעָה מְלָכִים אֶת הַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אֵת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם וְתִדְעָל מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם וְאַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר וְאַרְיוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר אַרְבָּעָה מְלָכִים אֶת הַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
with Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of
Ellasar—four kings with five.

verses.english:
And Siddim Valley was pits, pits of bitumen, and the kings
of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there; and those
who were left fled to the mountain.
verses.hebrew: וְעֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים בֶּאֱרֹת בֶּאֱרֹת חֵמָר וַיָּנֻסוּ מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וַיִּפְּלוּ שָׁמָּה וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים הֶרָה נָּסוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים בֶּאֱרֹת בֶּאֱרֹת חֵמָר וַיָּנֻסוּ מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וַיִּפְּלוּ שָׁמָּה וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים הֶרָה נָּסוּ׃

english.text:
And Siddim Valley was pits, pits of bitumen, and the kings
of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there; and those
who were left fled to the mountain.

verses.english:
And they took all the property of Sodom and Gomorrah and
all their food, and they went.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל רְכֻשׁ סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְאֶת כּל אכְלָם וַיֵּלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל רְכֻשׁ סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְאֶת כּל אכְלָם וַיֵּלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
And they took all the property of Sodom and Gomorrah and
all their food, and they went.

verses.english:
And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, and his property
when they went. And he had been living in Sodom.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת לוֹט וְאֶת רְכֻשׁוֹ בֶּן אֲחִי אַבְרָם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בִּסְדֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת לוֹט וְאֶת רְכֻשׁוֹ בֶּן אֲחִי אַבְרָם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בִּסְדֹם׃

english.text:
And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, and his property
when they went. And he had been living in Sodom.

verses.english:
And an escapee came and told Abram the Hebrew, and he was
tenting among the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of
Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were covenant
partners of Abram.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַפָּלִיט וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְרָם הָעִבְרִי וְהוּא שֹׁכֵן בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא הָאֱמֹרִי אֲחִי אֶשְׁכֹּל וַאֲחִי עָנֵר וְהֵם בַּעֲלֵי בְרִית אַבְרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַפָּלִיט וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְרָם הָעִבְרִי וְהוּא שֹׁכֵן בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא הָאֱמֹרִי אֲחִי אֶשְׁכֹּל וַאֲחִי עָנֵר וְהֵם בַּעֲלֵי בְרִית אַבְרָם׃

english.text:
And an escapee came and told Abram the Hebrew, and he was
tenting among the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of
Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were covenant
partners of Abram.

verses.english:
And Abram heard that his brother had been taken prisoner,
and he had his trained men, born in his house, unsheathe:
three hundred eighteen. And he pursued as far as Dan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אַבְרָם כִּי נִשְׁבָּה אָחִיו וַיָּרֶק אֶת חֲנִיכָיו יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיִּרְדֹּף עַד דָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אַבְרָם כִּי נִשְׁבָּה אָחִיו וַיָּרֶק אֶת חֲנִיכָיו יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיִּרְדֹּף עַד דָּן׃

english.text:
And Abram heard that his brother had been taken prisoner,
and he had his trained men, born in his house, unsheathe:
three hundred eighteen. And he pursued as far as Dan.

verses.english:
And he divided against them by night, he and his servants,
and he struck them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which
is at the left of Damascus.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּחָלֵק עֲלֵיהֶם לַיְלָה הוּא וַעֲבָדָיו וַיַּכֵּם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם עַד חוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר מִשְּׂמֹאל לְדַמָּשֶׂק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּחָלֵק עֲלֵיהֶם לַיְלָה הוּא וַעֲבָדָיו וַיַּכֵּם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם עַד חוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר מִשְּׂמֹאל לְדַמָּשֶׂק׃

english.text:
And he divided against them by night, he and his servants,
and he struck them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which
is at the left of Damascus.

verses.english:
And he brought back all the property, and he also brought
back Lot, his brother, and his property, and also the
women and the people.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֵת כּל הָרְכֻשׁ וְגַם אֶת לוֹט אָחִיו וּרְכֻשׁוֹ הֵשִׁיב וְגַם אֶת הַנָּשִׁים וְאֶת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֵת כּל הָרְכֻשׁ וְגַם אֶת לוֹט אָחִיו וּרְכֻשׁוֹ הֵשִׁיב וְגַם אֶת הַנָּשִׁים וְאֶת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And he brought back all the property, and he also brought
back Lot, his brother, and his property, and also the
women and the people.

verses.english:
And the king of Sodom came out to him after he came back
from striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him
at the Shaveh Valley. (That is the valley of the king.)
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ אַחֲרֵי שׁוּבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וְאֶת הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶל עֵמֶק שָׁוֵה הוּא עֵמֶק הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ אַחֲרֵי שׁוּבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וְאֶת הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶל עֵמֶק שָׁוֵה הוּא עֵמֶק הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And the king of Sodom came out to him after he came back
from striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him
at the Shaveh Valley. (That is the valley of the king.)

verses.english:
And Melchizedek, king of Salem, had brought out bread and
wine. And he was a priest of El the Highest.
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכִּי צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ שָׁלֵם הוֹצִיא לֶחֶם וָיָיִן וְהוּא כֹהֵן לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְכִּי צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ שָׁלֵם הוֹצִיא לֶחֶם וָיָיִן וְהוּא כֹהֵן לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן׃

english.text:
And Melchizedek, king of Salem, had brought out bread and
wine. And he was a priest of El the Highest.

verses.english:
And he blessed him and said, “Blessed is Abram to El the
Highest, creator of skies and earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמַר בָּרוּךְ אַבְרָם לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמַר בָּרוּךְ אַבְרָם לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And he blessed him and said, “Blessed is Abram to El the
Highest, creator of skies and earth.

verses.english:
And blessed is El the Highest, who delivered your foes
into your hand.” And he gave him a tithe from everything.
verses.hebrew: וּבָרוּךְ אֵל עֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר מִגֵּן צָרֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ מַעֲשֵׂר מִכֹּל׃

hebrew.text: וּבָרוּךְ אֵל עֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר מִגֵּן צָרֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ מַעֲשֵׂר מִכֹּל׃

english.text:
And blessed is El the Highest, who delivered your foes
into your hand.” And he gave him a tithe from everything.

verses.english:
And the king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give the persons to
me, and take the property for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם אֶל אַבְרָם תֶּן לִי הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהָרְכֻשׁ קַח לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם אֶל אַבְרָם תֶּן לִי הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהָרְכֻשׁ קַח לָךְ׃

english.text:
And the king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give the persons to
me, and take the property for you.”

verses.english:
And Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I’ve lifted my hand
to YHWH, El the Highest, creator of skies and earth,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֶל מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם הֲרִמֹתִי יָדִי אֶל יְהֹוָה אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֶל מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם הֲרִמֹתִי יָדִי אֶל יְהֹוָה אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I’ve lifted my hand
to YHWH, El the Highest, creator of skies and earth,

verses.english:
that, from a thread to a shoelace, I won’t take anything
that is yours, so you won’t say, ‘I made Abram rich.’
verses.hebrew: אִם מִחוּט וְעַד שְׂרוֹךְ נַעַל וְאִם אֶקַּח מִכּל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ וְלֹא תֹאמַר אֲנִי הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי אֶת אַבְרָם׃

hebrew.text: אִם מִחוּט וְעַד שְׂרוֹךְ נַעַל וְאִם אֶקַּח מִכּל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ וְלֹא תֹאמַר אֲנִי הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי אֶת אַבְרָם׃

english.text:
that, from a thread to a shoelace, I won’t take anything
that is yours, so you won’t say, ‘I made Abram rich.’

verses.english:
Except only what the boys have eaten and the share of the
people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They
shall take their share.”
verses.hebrew: בִּלְעָדַי רַק אֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ הַנְּעָרִים וְחֵלֶק הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אִתִּי עָנֵר אֶשְׁכֹּל וּמַמְרֵא הֵם יִקְחוּ חֶלְקָם׃

hebrew.text: בִּלְעָדַי רַק אֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ הַנְּעָרִים וְחֵלֶק הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אִתִּי עָנֵר אֶשְׁכֹּל וּמַמְרֵא הֵם יִקְחוּ חֶלְקָם׃

english.text:
Except only what the boys have eaten and the share of the
people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They
shall take their share.”

verses.english:
And these are the names of the children of Israel who came
to Egypt. With Jacob, each and his household had come:
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרָיְמָה אֵת יַעֲקֹב אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ בָּאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרָיְמָה אֵת יַעֲקֹב אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ בָּאוּ׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the children of Israel who came
to Egypt. With Jacob, each and his household had come:

translation.text: These are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob, each with his household:

verses.english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן שִׁמְעוֹן לֵוִי וִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּבֵן שִׁמְעוֹן לֵוִי וִיהוּדָה׃

english.text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

translation.text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

verses.english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂשכָר זְבוּלֻן וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂשכָר זְבוּלֻן וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

translation.text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

verses.english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.hebrew: דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי גָּד וְאָשֵׁר׃

hebrew.text: דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי גָּד וְאָשֵׁר׃

english.text: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

translation.text: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

verses.english:
And all the persons coming out from Jacob’s thigh were
seventy persons. And Joseph had been in Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל נֶפֶשׁ יֹצְאֵי יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב שִׁבְעִים נָפֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵף הָיָה בְמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל נֶפֶשׁ יֹצְאֵי יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב שִׁבְעִים נָפֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵף הָיָה בְמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And all the persons coming out from Jacob’s thigh were
seventy persons. And Joseph had been in Egypt.

translation.text: already in Egypt.

verses.english:
And Joseph and all of his brothers and all of that
generation died.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף וְכל אֶחָיו וְכֹל הַדּוֹר הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף וְכל אֶחָיו וְכֹל הַדּוֹר הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And Joseph and all of his brothers and all of that
generation died.

translation.text: Then Joseph died, and all his brothers, and that whole generation.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel were fruitful and teemed and
multiplied and became very, very powerful, and the land
was filled with them.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרוּ וַיִּשְׁרְצוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ וַיַּעַצְמוּ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרוּ וַיִּשְׁרְצוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ וַיַּעַצְמוּ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel were fruitful and teemed and
multiplied and became very, very powerful, and the land
was filled with them.

translation.text: But the Israelites were fruitful and prolific; they with them.

verses.english: And a new king rose over Egypt—who did not know Joseph.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם מֶלֶךְ חָדָשׁ עַל מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַע אֶת יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם מֶלֶךְ חָדָשׁ עַל מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַע אֶת יוֹסֵף׃

english.text: And a new king rose over Egypt—who did not know Joseph.

translation.text: Now a new king arose over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.

verses.english:
And he said to his people, “Here, the people of the
children of Israel is more numerous and powerful than we.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַמּוֹ הִנֵּה עַם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַמּוֹ הִנֵּה עַם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
And he said to his people, “Here, the people of the
children of Israel is more numerous and powerful than we.

translation.text: He more powerful than we.

verses.english:
Come on, let’s be wise toward it or else it will increase;
and it will be, when war will happen, that it, too, will
be added to our enemies and will war against us and go up
from the land.”
verses.hebrew: הָבָה נִתְחַכְּמָה לוֹ פֶּן יִרְבֶּה וְהָיָה כִּי תִקְרֶאנָה מִלְחָמָה וְנוֹסַף גַּם הוּא עַל שֹׂנְאֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם בָּנוּ וְעָלָה מִן הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: הָבָה נִתְחַכְּמָה לוֹ פֶּן יִרְבֶּה וְהָיָה כִּי תִקְרֶאנָה מִלְחָמָה וְנוֹסַף גַּם הוּא עַל שֹׂנְאֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם בָּנוּ וְעָלָה מִן הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Come on, let’s be wise toward it or else it will increase;
and it will be, when war will happen, that it, too, will
be added to our enemies and will war against us and go up
from the land.”

translation.text: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase and, in the event of war, join our enemies and fight against us and escape from the land."

verses.english:
And they set commanders of work-companies over it in order
to degrade it with their burdens. And they built storage
cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Rameses.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי מִסִּים לְמַעַן עַנֹּתוֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיִּבֶן עָרֵי מִסְכְּנוֹת לְפַרְעֹה אֶת פִּתֹם וְאֶת רַעַמְסֵס׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי מִסִּים לְמַעַן עַנֹּתוֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיִּבֶן עָרֵי מִסְכְּנוֹת לְפַרְעֹה אֶת פִּתֹם וְאֶת רַעַמְסֵס׃

english.text:
And they set commanders of work-companies over it in order
to degrade it with their burdens. And they built storage
cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Rameses.

translation.text: Therefore they set taskmasters Pithom and Rameses, for Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And the more they degraded it, the more it increased, and
the more it expanded; and they felt a disgust at the
children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְכַאֲשֶׁר יְעַנּוּ אֹתוֹ כֵּן יִרְבֶּה וְכֵן יִפְרֹץ וַיָּקֻצוּ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכַאֲשֶׁר יְעַנּוּ אֹתוֹ כֵּן יִרְבֶּה וְכֵן יִפְרֹץ וַיָּקֻצוּ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the more they degraded it, the more it increased, and
the more it expanded; and they felt a disgust at the
children of Israel.

translation.text: But the more they were came to dread the Israelites.

verses.english:
And Egypt made the children of Israel serve with
harshness;
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִדוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבִדוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And Egypt made the children of Israel serve with
harshness;

translation.text: The Egyptians became ruthless in imposing tasks on the Israelites,

verses.english:
and they made their lives bitter with hard work, with
mortar and with bricks and with all work in the field—all
their work that they did for them—with harshness.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת חַיֵּיהֶם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכל עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֵת כּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת חַיֵּיהֶם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכל עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֵת כּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָרֶךְ׃

english.text:
and they made their lives bitter with hard work, with
mortar and with bricks and with all work in the field—all
their work that they did for them—with harshness.

translation.text: and made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and brick and in every kind of field labor. They were ruthless in all the tasks that they imposed on them.

verses.english:
And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives—of whom
the name of one was Shiphrah and the name of the second
was Puah—
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת הָעִבְרִיֹּת אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָאַחַת שִׁפְרָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פּוּעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת הָעִבְרִיֹּת אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָאַחַת שִׁפְרָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פּוּעָה׃

english.text:
And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives—of whom
the name of one was Shiphrah and the name of the second
was Puah—

translation.text: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, one of whom was named Shiphrah and the other Puah,

verses.english:
and he said, “When you deliver the Hebrew women, and you
look at the two stones, if it’s a boy then kill him, and
if it’s a girl then she’ll live.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּיַלֶּדְכֶן אֶת הָעִבְרִיּוֹת וּרְאִיתֶן עַל הָאבְנָיִם אִם בֵּן הוּא וַהֲמִתֶּן אֹתוֹ וְאִם בַּת הִוא וָחָיָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּיַלֶּדְכֶן אֶת הָעִבְרִיּוֹת וּרְאִיתֶן עַל הָאבְנָיִם אִם בֵּן הוּא וַהֲמִתֶּן אֹתוֹ וְאִם בַּת הִוא וָחָיָה׃

english.text:
and he said, “When you deliver the Hebrew women, and you
look at the two stones, if it’s a boy then kill him, and
if it’s a girl then she’ll live.”

translation.text: "When you act as midwives to him; but if it is a girl, she shall live."

verses.english:
And the midwives feared God and did not do what the king
of Egypt had spoken to them, and they kept the boys alive.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּירֶאןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶן מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּירֶאןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶן מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

english.text:
And the midwives feared God and did not do what the king
of Egypt had spoken to them, and they kept the boys alive.

translation.text: But the midwives feared God; the boys live.

verses.english:
And the king of Egypt called the midwives and said to
them, “Why have you done this thing and kept the boys
alive?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן מַדּוּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן מַדּוּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

english.text:
And the king of Egypt called the midwives and said to
them, “Why have you done this thing and kept the boys
alive?”

translation.text: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and said to them, "Why have you done this, and allowed the boys to live?"

verses.english:
And the midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrews
aren’t like the Egyptian women, because they’re animals!
Before the midwife comes to them, they’ve given birth!”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי לֹא כַנָּשִׁים הַמִּצְרִיֹּת הָעִבְרִיֹּת כִּי חָיוֹת הֵנָּה בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא אֲלֵהֶן הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וְיָלָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי לֹא כַנָּשִׁים הַמִּצְרִיֹּת הָעִבְרִיֹּת כִּי חָיוֹת הֵנָּה בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא אֲלֵהֶן הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וְיָלָדוּ׃

english.text:
And the midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrews
aren’t like the Egyptian women, because they’re animals!
Before the midwife comes to them, they’ve given birth!”

translation.text: the midwife comes to them."

verses.english:
And God was good to the midwives. And the people
increased, and they became very powerful,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּיטֶב אֱלֹהִים לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיִּרֶב הָעָם וַיַּעַצְמוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּיטֶב אֱלֹהִים לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיִּרֶב הָעָם וַיַּעַצְמוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And God was good to the midwives. And the people
increased, and they became very powerful,

translation.text: So God dealt well with the midwives; and the people multiplied and became very strong.

verses.english:
and it was because the midwives feared God, and He made
them households.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי יָרְאוּ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם בָּתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי יָרְאוּ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם בָּתִּים׃

english.text:
and it was because the midwives feared God, and He made
them households.

translation.text: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh commanded all of his people, saying, “Every
son who is born: you shall throw him into the Nile. And
every daughter you shall keep alive.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה לְכל עַמּוֹ לֵאמֹר כּל הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד הַיְאֹרָה תַּשְׁלִיכֻהוּ וְכל הַבַּת תְּחַיּוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה לְכל עַמּוֹ לֵאמֹר כּל הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד הַיְאֹרָה תַּשְׁלִיכֻהוּ וְכל הַבַּת תְּחַיּוּן׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh commanded all of his people, saying, “Every
son who is born: you shall throw him into the Nile. And
every daughter you shall keep alive.”

translation.text: Then Pharaoh shall throw into the Nile, but you shall let every girl live."

verses.english:
And a man from the house of Levi went and took a
daughter of Levi.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִישׁ מִבֵּית לֵוִי וַיִּקַּח אֶת בַּת לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִישׁ מִבֵּית לֵוִי וַיִּקַּח אֶת בַּת לֵוִי׃

english.text:
And a man from the house of Levi went and took a
daughter of Levi.

translation.text: Now a man from the house of Levi went and married a Levite woman.

verses.english:
And the woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And
she saw him, that he was good, and she concealed him for
three months.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֵּרֶא אֹתוֹ כִּי טוֹב הוּא וַתִּצְפְּנֵהוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה יְרָחִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֵּרֶא אֹתוֹ כִּי טוֹב הוּא וַתִּצְפְּנֵהוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה יְרָחִים׃

english.text:
And the woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And
she saw him, that he was good, and she concealed him for
three months.

translation.text: The woman conceived and bore a son; and when she saw that he was a fine baby, she hid him three months.

verses.english:
And she was not able to conceal him anymore, and she took
an ark made of bulrushes for him and smeared it with
bitumen and with pitch and put the boy in it and put it in
the reeds by the bank of the Nile.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכְלָה עוֹד הַצְּפִינוֹ וַתִּקַּח לוֹ תֵּבַת גֹּמֶא וַתַּחְמְרָה בַחֵמָר וּבַזָּפֶת וַתָּשֶׂם בָּהּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַתָּשֶׂם בַּסּוּף עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכְלָה עוֹד הַצְּפִינוֹ וַתִּקַּח לוֹ תֵּבַת גֹּמֶא וַתַּחְמְרָה בַחֵמָר וּבַזָּפֶת וַתָּשֶׂם בָּהּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַתָּשֶׂם בַּסּוּף עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And she was not able to conceal him anymore, and she took
an ark made of bulrushes for him and smeared it with
bitumen and with pitch and put the boy in it and put it in
the reeds by the bank of the Nile.

translation.text: When she could with bitumen and pitch; she put the child in it and placed it among the reeds on the bank of the river.

verses.english:
And his sister stood still at a distance to know what
would be done to him.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּתַצַּב אֲחֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק לְדֵעָה מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּתַצַּב אֲחֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק לְדֵעָה מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And his sister stood still at a distance to know what
would be done to him.

translation.text: His sister stood at a distance, to see what would happen to him.

verses.english:
And the Pharaoh’s daughter went down to bathe at the Nile,
and her girls were going alongside the Nile, and she saw
the ark among the reeds and sent her maid, and she took
it.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶד בַּת פַּרְעֹה לִרְחֹץ עַל הַיְאֹר וְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ הֹלְכֹת עַל יַד הַיְאֹר וַתֵּרֶא אֶת הַתֵּבָה בְּתוֹךְ הַסּוּף וַתִּשְׁלַח אֶת אֲמָתָהּ וַתִּקָּחֶהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶד בַּת פַּרְעֹה לִרְחֹץ עַל הַיְאֹר וְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ הֹלְכֹת עַל יַד הַיְאֹר וַתֵּרֶא אֶת הַתֵּבָה בְּתוֹךְ הַסּוּף וַתִּשְׁלַח אֶת אֲמָתָהּ וַתִּקָּחֶהָ׃

english.text:
And the Pharaoh’s daughter went down to bathe at the Nile,
and her girls were going alongside the Nile, and she saw
the ark among the reeds and sent her maid, and she took
it.

translation.text: The daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river, while her reeds and sent her maid to bring it.

verses.english:
And she opened it and saw him, the child: and here was a
boy crying, and she had compassion on him, and she said,
“This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח וַתִּרְאֵהוּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וְהִנֵּה נַעַר בֹּכֶה וַתַּחְמֹל עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר מִיַּלְדֵי הָעִבְרִים זֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפְתַּח וַתִּרְאֵהוּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וְהִנֵּה נַעַר בֹּכֶה וַתַּחְמֹל עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר מִיַּלְדֵי הָעִבְרִים זֶה׃

english.text:
And she opened it and saw him, the child: and here was a
boy crying, and she had compassion on him, and she said,
“This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

translation.text: When she opened it, she saw the the Hebrews' children," she said.

verses.english:
And his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and
call a nursing woman from the Hebrews for you, and she’ll
nurse the child for you?”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲחֹתוֹ אֶל בַּת פַּרְעֹה הַאֵלֵךְ וְקָרָאתִי לָךְ אִשָּׁה מֵינֶקֶת מִן הָעִבְרִיֹּת וְתֵינִק לָךְ אֶת הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲחֹתוֹ אֶל בַּת פַּרְעֹה הַאֵלֵךְ וְקָרָאתִי לָךְ אִשָּׁה מֵינֶקֶת מִן הָעִבְרִיֹּת וְתֵינִק לָךְ אֶת הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
And his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and
call a nursing woman from the Hebrews for you, and she’ll
nurse the child for you?”

translation.text: Then his sister said to Pharaoh's nurse the child for you?"

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” And the girl
went and called the child’s mother.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה לֵכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ הָעַלְמָה וַתִּקְרָא אֶת אֵם הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה לֵכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ הָעַלְמָה וַתִּקְרָא אֶת אֵם הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” And the girl
went and called the child’s mother.

translation.text: Pharaoh's daughter said to her, "Yes." So the girl went and called the child's mother.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and
nurse him for me, and I’ll give your pay.” And the woman
took the boy and nursed him.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה הֵילִיכִי אֶת הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה וְהֵינִקִהוּ לִי וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת שְׂכָרֵךְ וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּנִיקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה הֵילִיכִי אֶת הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה וְהֵינִקִהוּ לִי וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת שְׂכָרֵךְ וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּנִיקֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and
nurse him for me, and I’ll give your pay.” And the woman
took the boy and nursed him.

translation.text: Pharaoh's daughter said wages." So the woman took the child and nursed it.

verses.english:
And the boy grew older, and she brought him to Pharaoh’
daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name
Moses, and she said, “Because I drew him from the water.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּבִאֵהוּ לְבַת פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי לָהּ לְבֵן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מֹשֶׁה וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי מִן הַמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּבִאֵהוּ לְבַת פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי לָהּ לְבֵן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מֹשֶׁה וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי מִן הַמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִהוּ׃

english.text:
And the boy grew older, and she brought him to Pharaoh’
daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name
Moses, and she said, “Because I drew him from the water.”

translation.text: When the child the water."

verses.english:
And it was in those days, and Moses grew older, and he
went out to his brothers and saw their burdens, and he saw
an Egyptian man striking a Hebrew man, one of his
brothers.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּגְדַּל מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּצֵא אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּרְא בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיַּרְא אִישׁ מִצְרִי מַכֶּה אִישׁ עִבְרִי מֵאֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּגְדַּל מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּצֵא אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּרְא בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיַּרְא אִישׁ מִצְרִי מַכֶּה אִישׁ עִבְרִי מֵאֶחָיו׃

english.text:
And it was in those days, and Moses grew older, and he
went out to his brothers and saw their burdens, and he saw
an Egyptian man striking a Hebrew man, one of his
brothers.

translation.text: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his people and his kinsfolk.

verses.english:
And he turned this way and that way and saw that there was
no man, and he struck the Egyptian and hid him in the
sand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן כֹּה וָכֹה וַיַּרְא כִּי אֵין אִישׁ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּטְמְנֵהוּ בַּחוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן כֹּה וָכֹה וַיַּרְא כִּי אֵין אִישׁ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּטְמְנֵהוּ בַּחוֹל׃

english.text:
And he turned this way and that way and saw that there was
no man, and he struck the Egyptian and hid him in the
sand.

translation.text: He looked this way and that, and seeing no one he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

verses.english:
And he went out on the second day, and here were two
Hebrew men fighting. And he said to the one who was in the
wrong, “Why do you strike your companion?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִבְרִים נִצִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָרָשָׁע לָמָּה תַכֶּה רֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִבְרִים נִצִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָרָשָׁע לָמָּה תַכֶּה רֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And he went out on the second day, and here were two
Hebrew men fighting. And he said to the one who was in the
wrong, “Why do you strike your companion?”

translation.text: When he went out the was in the wrong, "Why do you strike your fellow Hebrew?"

verses.english:
And he said, “Who made you a commander and judge over us?
Are you saying you’d kill me—the way you killed the
Egyptian?!” And Moses was afraid and said, “The thing is
known for sure.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי שָׂמְךָ לְאִישׁ שַׂר וְשֹׁפֵט עָלֵינוּ הַלְהרְגֵנִי אַתָּה אֹמֵר כַּאֲשֶׁר הָרַגְתָּ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּירָא מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אָכֵן נוֹדַע הַדָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי שָׂמְךָ לְאִישׁ שַׂר וְשֹׁפֵט עָלֵינוּ הַלְהרְגֵנִי אַתָּה אֹמֵר כַּאֲשֶׁר הָרַגְתָּ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּירָא מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אָכֵן נוֹדַע הַדָּבָר׃

english.text:
And he said, “Who made you a commander and judge over us?
Are you saying you’d kill me—the way you killed the
Egyptian?!” And Moses was afraid and said, “The thing is
known for sure.”

translation.text: He thought, "Surely the thing is known."

verses.english:
And Pharaoh heard this thing and sought to kill Moses, and
Moses fled from Pharaoh’s presence and lived in the land
of Midian. And he sat by a well.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע פַּרְעֹה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲרֹג אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיִּבְרַח מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְיָן וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַבְּאֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע פַּרְעֹה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲרֹג אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיִּבְרַח מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְיָן וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַבְּאֵר׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh heard this thing and sought to kill Moses, and
Moses fled from Pharaoh’s presence and lived in the land
of Midian. And he sat by a well.

translation.text: When Pharaoh heard of it, he sought to kill Moses. down by a well.

verses.english:
And a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came
and drew water and filled the troughs to water their
father’s flock,
verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹהֵן מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַתָּבֹאנָה וַתִּדְלֶנָה וַתְּמַלֶּאנָה אֶת הָרְהָטִים לְהַשְׁקוֹת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְכֹהֵן מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַתָּבֹאנָה וַתִּדְלֶנָה וַתְּמַלֶּאנָה אֶת הָרְהָטִים לְהַשְׁקוֹת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text:
And a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came
and drew water and filled the troughs to water their
father’s flock,

translation.text: The priest of Midian had seven daughters. They flock.

verses.english:
and the shepherds came and drove them away. And Moses got
up and saved them and watered their flock.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָרֹעִים וַיְגָרְשׁוּם וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאנָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָרֹעִים וַיְגָרְשׁוּם וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאנָם׃

english.text:
and the shepherds came and drove them away. And Moses got
up and saved them and watered their flock.

translation.text: But some shepherds came and drove them away. Moses got up and came to their defense and watered their flock.

verses.english:
And they came to Reuel, their father, and he said, “Why
were you so quick to come today?”
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל רְעוּאֵל אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל רְעוּאֵל אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And they came to Reuel, their father, and he said, “Why
were you so quick to come today?”

translation.text: When they back so soon today?"

verses.english:
And they said, “An Egyptian man rescued us from the
shepherds’ hand, and he drew water for us and watered the
flock, too.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ אִישׁ מִצְרִי הִצִּילָנוּ מִיַּד הָרֹעִים וְגַם דָּלֹה דָלָה לָנוּ וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ אִישׁ מִצְרִי הִצִּילָנוּ מִיַּד הָרֹעִים וְגַם דָּלֹה דָלָה לָנוּ וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And they said, “An Egyptian man rescued us from the
shepherds’ hand, and he drew water for us and watered the
flock, too.”

translation.text: They said, "An Egyptian helped us against the shepherds; he even drew water for us and watered the flock."

verses.english:
And he said to his daughters, “And where is he? Why is
this that you’ve left the man? Call him, and let him eat
bread.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בְּנֹתָיו וְאַיּוֹ לָמָּה זֶּה עֲזַבְתֶּן אֶת הָאִישׁ קִרְאֶן לוֹ וְיֹאכַל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בְּנֹתָיו וְאַיּוֹ לָמָּה זֶּה עֲזַבְתֶּן אֶת הָאִישׁ קִרְאֶן לוֹ וְיֹאכַל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And he said to his daughters, “And where is he? Why is
this that you’ve left the man? Call him, and let him eat
bread.”

translation.text: He him to break bread."

verses.english:
And Moses was content to live with the man. And he gave
Zipporah, his daughter, to Moses,
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל מֹשֶׁה לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת צִפֹּרָה בִתּוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹאֶל מֹשֶׁה לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת צִפֹּרָה בִתּוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses was content to live with the man. And he gave
Zipporah, his daughter, to Moses,

translation.text: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave Moses his daughter Zipporah in marriage.

verses.english:
and she gave birth to a son, and he called his name
Gershom, “because,” he said, “I was an alien in a foreign
land.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נכְרִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נכְרִיָּה׃

english.text:
and she gave birth to a son, and he called his name
Gershom, “because,” he said, “I was an alien in a foreign
land.”

translation.text: She bore a son, and foreign land."

verses.english:
And it was after those many days, and the king of Egypt
died. And the children of Israel groaned from the work,
and they cried out, and their wail went up to God from the
work.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַיָּמִים הָרַבִּים הָהֵם וַיָּמת מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּאָנְחוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הָעֲבֹדָה וַיִּזְעָקוּ וַתַּעַל שַׁוְעָתָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִן הָעֲבֹדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַיָּמִים הָרַבִּים הָהֵם וַיָּמת מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּאָנְחוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הָעֲבֹדָה וַיִּזְעָקוּ וַתַּעַל שַׁוְעָתָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִן הָעֲבֹדָה׃

english.text:
And it was after those many days, and the king of Egypt
died. And the children of Israel groaned from the work,
and they cried out, and their wail went up to God from the
work.

translation.text: After a long time the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned under their slavery, and cried out. Out of the slavery their cry for help rose up to God.

verses.english:
And God heard their moaning, and God remembered His
covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֶת יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֶת יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And God heard their moaning, and God remembered His
covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

translation.text: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.english: And God saw the children of Israel. And God knew!
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּדַע אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּדַע אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text: And God saw the children of Israel. And God knew!

translation.text: God looked upon the Israelites, and God took notice of them.

verses.english:
And Moses had been shepherding the flock of Jethro, his
father-in-law, priest of Midian. And he drove the flock at
the far side of the wilderness, and he came to the
Mountain of God, to Horeb.
verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת צֹאן יִתְרוֹ חֹתְנוֹ כֹּהֵן מִדְיָן וַיִּנְהַג אֶת הַצֹּאן אַחַר הַמִּדְבָּר וַיָּבֹא אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת צֹאן יִתְרוֹ חֹתְנוֹ כֹּהֵן מִדְיָן וַיִּנְהַג אֶת הַצֹּאן אַחַר הַמִּדְבָּר וַיָּבֹא אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵבָה׃

english.text:
And Moses had been shepherding the flock of Jethro, his
father-in-law, priest of Midian. And he drove the flock at
the far side of the wilderness, and he came to the
Mountain of God, to Horeb.

translation.text: Moses was keeping the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of mountain of God.

verses.english:
And an angel of YHWH appeared to him in a fire’s flame
from inside a bush. And he looked, and here: the bush was
burning in the fire, and the bush was not consumed!
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בְּלַבַּת אֵשׁ מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הַסְּנֶה בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וְהַסְּנֶה אֵינֶנּוּ אֻכָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בְּלַבַּת אֵשׁ מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הַסְּנֶה בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וְהַסְּנֶה אֵינֶנּוּ אֻכָּל׃

english.text:
And an angel of YHWH appeared to him in a fire’s flame
from inside a bush. And he looked, and here: the bush was
burning in the fire, and the bush was not consumed!

translation.text: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a flame of fire out of a bush; he looked, and the bush was blazing, yet it was not consumed.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Let me turn and see this great sight. Why
doesn’t the bush burn?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אָסֻרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הַמַּרְאֶה הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה מַדּוּעַ לֹא יִבְעַר הַסְּנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אָסֻרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הַמַּרְאֶה הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה מַדּוּעַ לֹא יִבְעַר הַסְּנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Let me turn and see this great sight. Why
doesn’t the bush burn?”

translation.text: Then Moses said, "I must turn aside and look at this great sight, and see why the bush is not burned up."

verses.english:
And YHWH saw that he turned to see. And God called to him
from inside the bush, and He said, “Moses, Moses.” And he
said, “I’m here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה כִּי סָר לִרְאוֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו אֱלֹהִים מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה כִּי סָר לִרְאוֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו אֱלֹהִים מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH saw that he turned to see. And God called to him
from inside the bush, and He said, “Moses, Moses.” And he
said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: When the bush, "Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here I am."

verses.english:
And He said, “Don’t come close here. Take off your shoes
from your feet, because the place on which you’re
standing: it’s holy ground.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם שַׁל נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם שַׁל נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃

english.text:
And He said, “Don’t come close here. Take off your shoes
from your feet, because the place on which you’re
standing: it’s holy ground.”

translation.text: Then he said, which you are standing is holy ground."

verses.english:
And He said, “I’m your father’s God, Abraham’s God,
Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God.” And Moses hid his face,
because he was afraid of looking at God.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וַיַּסְתֵּר מֹשֶׁה פָּנָיו כִּי יָרֵא מֵהַבִּיט אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וַיַּסְתֵּר מֹשֶׁה פָּנָיו כִּי יָרֵא מֵהַבִּיט אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And He said, “I’m your father’s God, Abraham’s God,
Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God.” And Moses hid his face,
because he was afraid of looking at God.

translation.text: He said further, "I am the God.

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “I’ve seen the degradation of my people who
are in Egypt, and I’ve heard their wail on account of
their taskmasters, because I know their pains.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת צַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפְּנֵי נֹגְשָׂיו כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת מַכְאֹבָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת צַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפְּנֵי נֹגְשָׂיו כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת מַכְאֹבָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “I’ve seen the degradation of my people who
are in Egypt, and I’ve heard their wail on account of
their taskmasters, because I know their pains.

translation.text: Then the LORD said, "I have observed the misery of my people who are in Egypt; I have heard their cry on account of their taskmasters. Indeed, I know their sufferings,

verses.english:
And I’ve come down to rescue them from Egypt’s hand and to
bring them up from that land to a good and widespread
land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place
of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the
Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֵד לְהַצִּילוֹ מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא אֶל אֶרֶץ טוֹבָה וּרְחָבָה אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֶל מְקוֹם הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵרֵד לְהַצִּילוֹ מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא אֶל אֶרֶץ טוֹבָה וּרְחָבָה אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֶל מְקוֹם הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
And I’ve come down to rescue them from Egypt’s hand and to
bring them up from that land to a good and widespread
land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place
of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the
Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

translation.text: and I have come down to deliver country of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.english:
“And now, here, the cry of the children of Israel has come
to me, and also I’ve seen the oppression that Egypt is
causing them.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה צַעֲקַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָה אֵלָי וְגַם רָאִיתִי אֶת הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה צַעֲקַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָה אֵלָי וְגַם רָאִיתִי אֶת הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“And now, here, the cry of the children of Israel has come
to me, and also I’ve seen the oppression that Egypt is
causing them.

translation.text: The cry of the Israelites has now come to me; I have also seen how the Egyptians oppress them.

verses.english:
And now go, and I’ll send you to Pharaoh, and bring out my
people, the children of Israel, from Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵא אֶת עַמִּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵא אֶת עַמִּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And now go, and I’ll send you to Pharaoh, and bring out my
people, the children of Israel, from Egypt.”

translation.text: So come, I will send you to Pharaoh to bring my people, the Israelites, out of Egypt."

verses.english:
And Moses said to God, “Who am I that I should go to
Pharaoh and that I should bring out the children of Israel
from Egypt?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִי אָנֹכִי כִּי אֵלֵךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְכִי אוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִי אָנֹכִי כִּי אֵלֵךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְכִי אוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to God, “Who am I that I should go to
Pharaoh and that I should bring out the children of Israel
from Egypt?”

translation.text: But Moses said to God, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh, and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?"

verses.english:
And He said, “Because I’ll be with you. And this is the
sign for you that I have sent you. When you bring out the
people from Egypt you shall serve God on this mountain.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְזֶה לְּךָ הָאוֹת כִּי אָנֹכִי שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת הָעָם מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּעַבְדוּן אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים עַל הָהָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְזֶה לְּךָ הָאוֹת כִּי אָנֹכִי שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת הָעָם מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּעַבְדוּן אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים עַל הָהָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And He said, “Because I’ll be with you. And this is the
sign for you that I have sent you. When you bring out the
people from Egypt you shall serve God on this mountain.”

translation.text: He said, "I will be with you; and this shall be the sign for you that it is I who sent you: when you have mountain."

verses.english:
And Moses said to God, “Here, I’m coming to the children
of Israel, and I’ll say to them, ‘Your fathers’ God sent
me to you.’ And they’ll say to me, ‘What is His name?’
What shall I say to them?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְאָמְרוּ לִי מַה שְּׁמוֹ מָה אֹמַר אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְאָמְרוּ לִי מַה שְּׁמוֹ מָה אֹמַר אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to God, “Here, I’m coming to the children
of Israel, and I’ll say to them, ‘Your fathers’ God sent
me to you.’ And they’ll say to me, ‘What is His name?’
What shall I say to them?”

translation.text: But Moses said to God, "If I come to the Israelites and say to them, is his name?' what shall I say to them?"

verses.english:
And God said to Moses, “I am who I am.” And He said, “You
shall say this to the children of Israel: ‘I Am’ has sent
me to you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And God said to Moses, “I am who I am.” And He said, “You
shall say this to the children of Israel: ‘I Am’ has sent
me to you.”

translation.text: God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM." He said further, "Thus you shall say to the Israelites, 'I AM has sent me to you.'"

verses.english:
And God said further to Moses, “You shall say this to the
children of Israel: YHWH, your fathers’ God, Abraham’s
God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God has sent me to you. This
is my name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered
for generation after generation.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֹּה תֹאמַר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם זֶה שְּׁמִי לְעֹלָם וְזֶה זִכְרִי לְדֹר דֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֹּה תֹאמַר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם זֶה שְּׁמִי לְעֹלָם וְזֶה זִכְרִי לְדֹר דֹּר׃

english.text:
And God said further to Moses, “You shall say this to the
children of Israel: YHWH, your fathers’ God, Abraham’s
God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God has sent me to you. This
is my name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered
for generation after generation.

translation.text: God also said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you': and this my title for all generations.

verses.english:
“Go and gather Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘YHWH,
your fathers’ God, has appeared to me—the God of Abraham,
Isaac, and Jacob—saying: I have taken account of you and
what has been done to you in Egypt,

hebrew.text: לֵךְ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נִרְאָה אֵלַי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד פָּקַדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת הֶעָשׂוּי לָכֶם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“Go and gather Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘YHWH,
your fathers’ God, has appeared to me—the God of Abraham,
Isaac, and Jacob—saying: I have taken account of you and
what has been done to you in Egypt,

and I say I shall bring you up from the degradation of
Egypt to the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מֵעֳנִי מִצְרַיִם אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
and I say I shall bring you up from the degradation of
Egypt to the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the
Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite,
to a land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: I declare that I will bring you up out of Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, a land flowing with milk and honey.'

verses.english:
And they’ll listen to your voice, and you’ll come, you and
Israel’s elders, to the king of Egypt, and you’ll say to
him, ‘YHWH, God of the Hebrews, has communicated with us.
And now, let us go on a trip of three days in the
wilderness so we may sacrifice to YHWH, our God.’
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְעוּ לְקֹלֶךָ וּבָאתָ אַתָּה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִיִּים נִקְרָה עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה נֵלְכָה נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְעוּ לְקֹלֶךָ וּבָאתָ אַתָּה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִיִּים נִקְרָה עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה נֵלְכָה נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And they’ll listen to your voice, and you’ll come, you and
Israel’s elders, to the king of Egypt, and you’ll say to
him, ‘YHWH, God of the Hebrews, has communicated with us.
And now, let us go on a trip of three days in the
wilderness so we may sacrifice to YHWH, our God.’

translation.text: They will listen to your voice; and you and the elders of Israel shall go to the king of Egypt and say to him, 'The LORD, God.'

verses.english:
And I know that the king of Egypt won’t allow you to go,
and not by a strong hand,
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִתֵּן אֶתְכֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַהֲלֹךְ וְלֹא בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִתֵּן אֶתְכֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַהֲלֹךְ וְלֹא בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
And I know that the king of Egypt won’t allow you to go,
and not by a strong hand,

translation.text: I know, however, that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless compelled by a mighty hand.

verses.english:
and I’ll put out my hand and strike Egypt with all my
wonders that I’ll do among them, and after that he’ll let
you go.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת יָדִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹל נִפְלְאֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת יָדִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹל נִפְלְאֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I’ll put out my hand and strike Egypt with all my
wonders that I’ll do among them, and after that he’ll let
you go.

translation.text: So I will stretch out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders that I will perform in it; after that he will let you go.

verses.english:
And I’ll put this people’s favor in Egypt’s eyes; and it
will be, when you go, you won’t go empty-handed.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת חֵן הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי תֵלֵכוּן לֹא תֵלְכוּ רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת חֵן הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי תֵלֵכוּן לֹא תֵלְכוּ רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
And I’ll put this people’s favor in Egypt’s eyes; and it
will be, when you go, you won’t go empty-handed.

translation.text: I will bring this people into such favor with the Egyptians that, when you go, you will not go empty-handed;

verses.english:
And each woman will ask for silver articles and gold
articles and clothes from her neighbor and from anyone
staying in her house, and you’ll put them on your sons and
on your daughters, and you’ll despoil Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאֲלָה אִשָּׁה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ וּמִגָּרַת בֵּיתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂמָלֹת וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל בְּנֵיכֶם וְעַל בְּנֹתֵיכֶם וְנִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאֲלָה אִשָּׁה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ וּמִגָּרַת בֵּיתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂמָלֹת וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל בְּנֵיכֶם וְעַל בְּנֹתֵיכֶם וְנִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And each woman will ask for silver articles and gold
articles and clothes from her neighbor and from anyone
staying in her house, and you’ll put them on your sons and
on your daughters, and you’ll despoil Egypt.”

translation.text: each house for jewelry of silver and of gold, and clothing, and you shall put Egyptians."

verses.english:
And Moses answered, and he said, “And here, they won’t
believe me and won’t listen to my voice, because they’ll
say, ‘YHWH hasn’t appeared to you!’”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר וְהֵן לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לִי וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי כִּי יֹאמְרוּ לֹא נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר וְהֵן לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לִי וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי כִּי יֹאמְרוּ לֹא נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses answered, and he said, “And here, they won’t
believe me and won’t listen to my voice, because they’ll
say, ‘YHWH hasn’t appeared to you!’”

translation.text: Then Moses answered, "But suppose they do not believe me or listen to me, but say, 'The LORD did not appear to you.'"

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him, “What’s this in your hand?” And he
said, “A staff.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה (מזה) [מַה זֶּה] בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה (מזה) [מַה זֶּה] בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him, “What’s this in your hand?” And he
said, “A staff.”

translation.text: The LORD said to him, "What is that in your hand?" He said, "A staff."

verses.english:
And He said, “Throw it to the ground.” And he threw it to
the ground. And it became a snake! And Moses fled from it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And He said, “Throw it to the ground.” And he threw it to
the ground. And it became a snake! And Moses fled from it.

translation.text: And he said, became a snake; and Moses drew back from it.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Put out your hand and take hold
of its tail.” And he put out his hand and held onto it,
and it became a staff in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה שְׁלַח יָדְךָ וֶאֱחֹז בִּזְנָבוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיַּחֲזֶק בּוֹ וַיְהִי לְמַטֶּה בְּכַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה שְׁלַח יָדְךָ וֶאֱחֹז בִּזְנָבוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיַּחֲזֶק בּוֹ וַיְהִי לְמַטֶּה בְּכַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Put out your hand and take hold
of its tail.” And he put out his hand and held onto it,
and it became a staff in his hand.

translation.text: Then the LORD said to out his hand and grasped it, and it became a staff in his hand —

verses.english:
“So that they will believe that YHWH, their fathers’ God,
Abraham’s God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God, has appeared
to you!”
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יַאֲמִינוּ כִּי נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן יַאֲמִינוּ כִּי נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
“So that they will believe that YHWH, their fathers’ God,
Abraham’s God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God, has appeared
to you!”

translation.text: "so to you."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him further, “Bring your hand into your
bosom.” And he brought his hand into his bosom. And he
brought it out; and, here, his hand was leprous like snow!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לוֹ עוֹד הָבֵא נָא יָדְךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וַיָּבֵא יָדוֹ בְּחֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ וְהִנֵּה יָדוֹ מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לוֹ עוֹד הָבֵא נָא יָדְךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וַיָּבֵא יָדוֹ בְּחֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ וְהִנֵּה יָדוֹ מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him further, “Bring your hand into your
bosom.” And he brought his hand into his bosom. And he
brought it out; and, here, his hand was leprous like snow!

translation.text: Again, the LORD said to him, "Put your hand inside your cloak." He leprous, as white as snow.

verses.english:
And He said, “Put your hand back to your bosom.” And he
put his hand back to his bosom. And he brought it out from
his bosom; and, here, it had gone back like its flesh.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָשֵׁב יָדְךָ אֶל חֵיקֶךָ וַיָּשֶׁב יָדוֹ אֶל חֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ מֵחֵיקוֹ וְהִנֵּה שָׁבָה כִּבְשָׂרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָשֵׁב יָדְךָ אֶל חֵיקֶךָ וַיָּשֶׁב יָדוֹ אֶל חֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ מֵחֵיקוֹ וְהִנֵּה שָׁבָה כִּבְשָׂרוֹ׃

english.text:
And He said, “Put your hand back to your bosom.” And he
put his hand back to his bosom. And he brought it out from
his bosom; and, here, it had gone back like its flesh.

translation.text: Then God said, "Put your hand back into took it out, it was restored like the rest of his body —

verses.english:
“And it will be, if they won’t believe you and won’t
listen to the voice of the first sign, then they’ll
believe the voice of the latter one.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לָךְ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהֶאֱמִינוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לָךְ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהֶאֱמִינוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if they won’t believe you and won’t
listen to the voice of the first sign, then they’ll
believe the voice of the latter one.

translation.text: "If they will sign.

verses.english:
And it will be, if they also won’t believe in these two
signs and won’t listen to your voice, then you’ll take
some of the water of the Nile and spill it on the dry
ground. And it will be water that you’ll take from the
Nile, and it will become blood on the dry ground.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ גַּם לִשְׁנֵי הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן לְקֹלֶךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר וְשָׁפַכְתָּ הַיַּבָּשָׁה וְהָיוּ הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר תִּקַּח מִן הַיְאֹר וְהָיוּ לְדָם בַּיַּבָּשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ גַּם לִשְׁנֵי הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן לְקֹלֶךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר וְשָׁפַכְתָּ הַיַּבָּשָׁה וְהָיוּ הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר תִּקַּח מִן הַיְאֹר וְהָיוּ לְדָם בַּיַּבָּשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And it will be, if they also won’t believe in these two
signs and won’t listen to your voice, then you’ll take
some of the water of the Nile and spill it on the dry
ground. And it will be water that you’ll take from the
Nile, and it will become blood on the dry ground.”

translation.text: If they will not believe even these two signs or heed you, you dry ground."

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “Please, my Lord, I’m not a man of
words. Neither yesterday nor the day before—nor since you
spoke to your servant! Because I’m heavy of mouth and
heavy of tongue.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה בִּי אֲדֹנָי לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי גַּם מִתְּמוֹל גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כְבַד פֶּה וּכְבַד לָשׁוֹן אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה בִּי אֲדֹנָי לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי גַּם מִתְּמוֹל גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כְבַד פֶּה וּכְבַד לָשׁוֹן אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “Please, my Lord, I’m not a man of
words. Neither yesterday nor the day before—nor since you
spoke to your servant! Because I’m heavy of mouth and
heavy of tongue.”

translation.text: But Moses said to the LORD, "O my Lord, I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor even now that you have spoken to your servant; but I am slow of speech and slow of tongue."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him, “Who set a mouth for humans? Or who
will set a mute or deaf or seeing or blind? Is it not I,
YHWH?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם אוֹ מִי יָשׂוּם אִלֵּם אוֹ חֵרֵשׁ אוֹ פִקֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר הֲלֹא אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם אוֹ מִי יָשׂוּם אִלֵּם אוֹ חֵרֵשׁ אוֹ פִקֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר הֲלֹא אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him, “Who set a mouth for humans? Or who
will set a mute or deaf or seeing or blind? Is it not I,
YHWH?

translation.text: Then the LORD said to seeing or blind? Is it not I, the LORD?

verses.english:
And now go, and I’ll be with your mouth, and I’ll instruct
you what you shall speak.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And now go, and I’ll be with your mouth, and I’ll instruct
you what you shall speak.”

translation.text: Now go, and I will be with your mouth and teach you what you are to speak."

verses.english:
And he said, “Please, my Lord, send by the hand you’ll
send.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנָי שְׁלַח נָא בְּיַד תִּשְׁלָח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנָי שְׁלַח נָא בְּיַד תִּשְׁלָח׃

english.text:
And he said, “Please, my Lord, send by the hand you’ll
send.”

translation.text: But he said, "O my Lord, please send someone else."

verses.english:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Moses, and He said, “Isn’t
Aaron your Levite brother? I knew that he will speak! And
also here he is, coming out toward you! And he’ll see you
and be happy in his heart.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלֹא אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ הַלֵּוִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי דַבֵּר יְדַבֵּר הוּא וְגַם הִנֵּה הוּא יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ וְרָאֲךָ וְשָׂמַח בְּלִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלֹא אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ הַלֵּוִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי דַבֵּר יְדַבֵּר הוּא וְגַם הִנֵּה הוּא יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ וְרָאֲךָ וְשָׂמַח בְּלִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Moses, and He said, “Isn’t
Aaron your Levite brother? I knew that he will speak! And
also here he is, coming out toward you! And he’ll see you
and be happy in his heart.

translation.text: Then the anger of the LORD was to meet you, and when he sees you his heart will be glad.

verses.english:
And you’ll speak to him and set the words in his mouth,
and I, I shall be with your mouth and with his mouth, and
I shall instruct you what you shall do.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיו וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְעִם פִּיהוּ וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיו וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְעִם פִּיהוּ וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
And you’ll speak to him and set the words in his mouth,
and I, I shall be with your mouth and with his mouth, and
I shall instruct you what you shall do.

translation.text: You shall mouth and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

verses.english:
And he will speak for you to the people. And it will be:
he will become a mouth for you, and you will become a god
for him!
verses.hebrew: וְדִבֶּר הוּא לְךָ אֶל הָעָם וְהָיָה הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לְפֶה וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבֶּר הוּא לְךָ אֶל הָעָם וְהָיָה הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לְפֶה וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And he will speak for you to the people. And it will be:
he will become a mouth for you, and you will become a god
for him!

translation.text: He indeed shall speak for you to the people; he shall serve as a mouth for you, and you shall serve as God for him.

verses.english:
And you shall take this staff in your hand, by which
you’ll do the signs.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַמַּטֶּה הַזֶּה תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ אֶת הָאֹתֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַמַּטֶּה הַזֶּה תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ אֶת הָאֹתֹת׃

english.text:
And you shall take this staff in your hand, by which
you’ll do the signs.”

translation.text: Take in your hand this staff, with which you shall perform the signs."

verses.english:
And Moses went. And he went back to Jether, his
father-in-law, and said to him, “Let me go so I may go
back to my brothers who are in Egypt and see if they’re
still living.” And Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשׁב אֶל יֶתֶר חֹתְנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלְכָה נָּא וְאָשׁוּבָה אֶל אַחַי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶרְאֶה הַעוֹדָם חַיִּים וַיֹּאמֶר יִתְרוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשׁב אֶל יֶתֶר חֹתְנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלְכָה נָּא וְאָשׁוּבָה אֶל אַחַי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶרְאֶה הַעוֹדָם חַיִּים וַיֹּאמֶר יִתְרוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
And Moses went. And he went back to Jether, his
father-in-law, and said to him, “Let me go so I may go
back to my brothers who are in Egypt and see if they’re
still living.” And Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

translation.text: Moses went back to his father-in-law Jethro and said to him, "Please living." And Jethro said to Moses, "Go in peace."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses in Midian, “Go. Go back to Egypt,
because all the people who sought your life have died.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְיָן לֵךְ שֻׁב מִצְרָיִם כִּי מֵתוּ כּל הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְבַקְשִׁים אֶת נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְיָן לֵךְ שֻׁב מִצְרָיִם כִּי מֵתוּ כּל הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְבַקְשִׁים אֶת נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses in Midian, “Go. Go back to Egypt,
because all the people who sought your life have died.”

translation.text: The LORD said to your life are dead."

verses.english:
And Moses took his wife and his sons and rode them on an
ass, and he went back to the land of Egypt. And Moses took
the staff of God in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיַּרְכִּבֵם עַל הַחֲמֹר וַיָּשׁב אַרְצָה מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּה הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיַּרְכִּבֵם עַל הַחֲמֹר וַיָּשׁב אַרְצָה מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּה הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses took his wife and his sons and rode them on an
ass, and he went back to the land of Egypt. And Moses took
the staff of God in his hand.

translation.text: So Moses took his wife and his sons, put them the staff of God in his hand.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “When you’re going to go back to
Egypt, see all the wonders that I’ve set in your hand, and
you shall do them in front of Pharaoh. And I: I’ll
strengthen his heart, and he won’t let the people go.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּלֶכְתְּךָ לָשׁוּב מִצְרַיְמָה רְאֵה כּל הַמֹּפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְיָדֶךָ וַעֲשִׂיתָם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַאֲנִי אֲחַזֵּק אֶת לִבּוֹ וְלֹא יְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּלֶכְתְּךָ לָשׁוּב מִצְרַיְמָה רְאֵה כּל הַמֹּפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְיָדֶךָ וַעֲשִׂיתָם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַאֲנִי אֲחַזֵּק אֶת לִבּוֹ וְלֹא יְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “When you’re going to go back to
Egypt, see all the wonders that I’ve set in your hand, and
you shall do them in front of Pharaoh. And I: I’ll
strengthen his heart, and he won’t let the people go.

translation.text: And the LORD said to Moses, "When you go back to Egypt, see that power; but I will harden his heart, so that he will not let the people go.

verses.english:
And you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘YHWH said this: My child,
my firstborn, is Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנִי בְכֹרִי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנִי בְכֹרִי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘YHWH said this: My child,
my firstborn, is Israel.

translation.text: Then you shall say to Pharaoh, 'Thus says the LORD: Israel is my firstborn son.

verses.english:
And I’ve said to you: Let my child go and serve me. And
should you refuse to let it go, here: I’m killing your
child, your firstborn!’”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ שַׁלַּח אֶת בְּנִי וְיַעַבְדֵנִי וַתְּמָאֵן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הֹרֵג אֶת בִּנְךָ בְּכֹרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ שַׁלַּח אֶת בְּנִי וְיַעַבְדֵנִי וַתְּמָאֵן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הֹרֵג אֶת בִּנְךָ בְּכֹרֶךָ׃

english.text:
And I’ve said to you: Let my child go and serve me. And
should you refuse to let it go, here: I’m killing your
child, your firstborn!’”

translation.text: I said to you, "Let my son go that he may worship me." But you refused to let him go; now I will kill your firstborn son.'"

verses.english:
And he was on the way, at a lodging place, and YHWH met
him, and he asked to kill him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַדֶּרֶךְ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַדֶּרֶךְ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And he was on the way, at a lodging place, and YHWH met
him, and he asked to kill him.

translation.text: On the way, at a place where they spent the night, the LORD met him and tried to kill him.

verses.english:
And Zipporah took a flint and cut her son’s foreskin and
touched his feet, and she said, “Because you’re a
bridegroom of blood to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח צִפֹּרָה צֹר וַתִּכְרֹת אֶת ערְלַת בְּנָהּ וַתַּגַּע לְרַגְלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי חֲתַן דָּמִים אַתָּה לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח צִפֹּרָה צֹר וַתִּכְרֹת אֶת ערְלַת בְּנָהּ וַתַּגַּע לְרַגְלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי חֲתַן דָּמִים אַתָּה לִי׃

english.text:
And Zipporah took a flint and cut her son’s foreskin and
touched his feet, and she said, “Because you’re a
bridegroom of blood to me.”

translation.text: But Zipporah took a flint and cut off her son's foreskin, and touched Moses' feet with it, and said, "Truly you are a bridegroom of blood to me!"

verses.english:
And he held back from Him. Then she said, “A bridegroom of
blood for circumcisions.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרֶף מִמֶּנּוּ אָז אָמְרָה חֲתַן דָּמִים לַמּוּלֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרֶף מִמֶּנּוּ אָז אָמְרָה חֲתַן דָּמִים לַמּוּלֹת׃

english.text:
And he held back from Him. Then she said, “A bridegroom of
blood for circumcisions.”

translation.text: So he let him alone. It was then she said, "A bridegroom of blood by circumcision."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “Go toward Moses, to the
wilderness.” And he went, and he met him in the Mountain
of God, and he kissed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵךְ לִקְרַאת מֹשֶׁה הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ בְּהַר הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵךְ לִקְרַאת מֹשֶׁה הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ בְּהַר הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “Go toward Moses, to the
wilderness.” And he went, and he met him in the Mountain
of God, and he kissed him.

translation.text: The LORD said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." So he went; and he met him at the mountain of God and kissed him.

verses.english:
