hebrew.text: וְהַחִטָּה וְהַכֻּסֶּמֶת לֹא נֻכּוּ כִּי אֲפִילֹת הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
And the wheat and the spelt were not struck, because they
were late crops.)

translation.text: But the wheat and the spelt were not ruined, for they are late in coming up.)

verses.english:
And Moses went out from Pharaoh, from the city, and spread
his hands to YHWH, and the thunders and the hail stopped,
and a shower did not pour to the earth.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעִיר וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחְדְּלוּ הַקֹּלוֹת וְהַבָּרָד וּמָטָר לֹא נִתַּךְ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעִיר וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחְדְּלוּ הַקֹּלוֹת וְהַבָּרָד וּמָטָר לֹא נִתַּךְ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Moses went out from Pharaoh, from the city, and spread
his hands to YHWH, and the thunders and the hail stopped,
and a shower did not pour to the earth.

translation.text: So Moses left Pharaoh, went out of the city, and stretched out his hands to the LORD; then the thunder and the hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured down on the earth.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh saw that the shower and the hail and the
thunder stopped, and he continued to sin, and he made his
heart heavy, he and his servants.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּי חָדַל הַמָּטָר וְהַבָּרָד וְהַקֹּלֹת וַיֹּסֶף לַחֲטֹא וַיַּכְבֵּד לִבּוֹ הוּא וַעֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּי חָדַל הַמָּטָר וְהַבָּרָד וְהַקֹּלֹת וַיֹּסֶף לַחֲטֹא וַיַּכְבֵּד לִבּוֹ הוּא וַעֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh saw that the shower and the hail and the
thunder stopped, and he continued to sin, and he made his
heart heavy, he and his servants.

translation.text: But officials.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not let the
children of Israel go—as YHWH had spoken by Moses’ hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not let the
children of Israel go—as YHWH had spoken by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: So the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh, because I have
made his heart and his servants’ heart heavy for the
purpose of my setting these signs of mine among them
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי אֲנִי הִכְבַּדְתִּי אֶת לִבּוֹ וְאֶת לֵב עֲבָדָיו לְמַעַן שִׁתִי אֹתֹתַי אֵלֶּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי אֲנִי הִכְבַּדְתִּי אֶת לִבּוֹ וְאֶת לֵב עֲבָדָיו לְמַעַן שִׁתִי אֹתֹתַי אֵלֶּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh, because I have
made his heart and his servants’ heart heavy for the
purpose of my setting these signs of mine among them

translation.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh; for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his officials, in order that I may show these signs of mine among them,

verses.english:
and for the purpose that you will tell in the ears of your
son and your son’s son about how I abused Egypt and about
my signs that I set among them, and you will know that I
am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַעַן תְּסַפֵּר בְּאזְנֵי בִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַלַּלְתִּי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶת אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בָם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַעַן תְּסַפֵּר בְּאזְנֵי בִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַלַּלְתִּי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶת אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בָם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and for the purpose that you will tell in the ears of your
son and your son’s son about how I abused Egypt and about
my signs that I set among them, and you will know that I
am YHWH.”

translation.text: and that you may tell your children and have done among them — so that you may know that I am the LORD."

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and said to him,
“YHWH, God of the Hebrews, said this: ‘How long do you
refuse to be humbled in front of me? Let my people go, so
they may serve me.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים עַד מָתַי מֵאַנְתָּ לֵעָנֹת מִפָּנָי שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים עַד מָתַי מֵאַנְתָּ לֵעָנֹת מִפָּנָי שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and said to him,
“YHWH, God of the Hebrews, said this: ‘How long do you
refuse to be humbled in front of me? Let my people go, so
they may serve me.

translation.text: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh, and said to him, "Thus says the yourself before me? Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

verses.english:
Because if you refuse to let my people go, here, I’m
bringing a locust swarm in your border tomorrow,
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מֵבִיא מָחָר אַרְבֶּה בִּגְבֻלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מֵבִיא מָחָר אַרְבֶּה בִּגְבֻלֶךָ׃

english.text:
Because if you refuse to let my people go, here, I’m
bringing a locust swarm in your border tomorrow,

translation.text: For if you refuse to let my people go, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country.

verses.english:
and it will cover the eye of the land, and one won’t be
able to see the land! And it will eat the remains of what
has survived that is left to you from the hail, and it
will eat every tree that is growing for you from the
field.
verses.hebrew: וְכִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְאָכַל אֶת יֶתֶר הַפְּלֵטָה הַנִּשְׁאֶרֶת לָכֶם מִן הַבָּרָד וְאָכַל אֶת כּל הָעֵץ הַצֹּמֵחַ לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְאָכַל אֶת יֶתֶר הַפְּלֵטָה הַנִּשְׁאֶרֶת לָכֶם מִן הַבָּרָד וְאָכַל אֶת כּל הָעֵץ הַצֹּמֵחַ לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
and it will cover the eye of the land, and one won’t be
able to see the land! And it will eat the remains of what
has survived that is left to you from the hail, and it
will eat every tree that is growing for you from the
field.

translation.text: They shall cover the surface of the land, so that no one will be able to see the land. They shall devour the last remnant left you after the hail, and they shall devour every tree of yours that grows in the field.

verses.english:
And they’ll fill your houses and the houses of all your
servants and the houses of all Egypt, which your fathers
and your fathers’ fathers did not see, from the day they
were on the land until this day’.” And he turned and went
out from Pharaoh.
verses.hebrew: וּמָלְאוּ בָתֶּיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל עֲבָדֶיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא רָאוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַאֲבוֹת אֲבֹתֶיךָ מִיּוֹם הֱיוֹתָם עַל הָאֲדָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וּמָלְאוּ בָתֶּיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל עֲבָדֶיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא רָאוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַאֲבוֹת אֲבֹתֶיךָ מִיּוֹם הֱיוֹתָם עַל הָאֲדָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And they’ll fill your houses and the houses of all your
servants and the houses of all Egypt, which your fathers
and your fathers’ fathers did not see, from the day they
were on the land until this day’.” And he turned and went
out from Pharaoh.

translation.text: They shall fill your houses, and the houses of all your earth to this day.'" Then he turned and went out from Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this be
a trap for us? Let the people go, so they may serve YHWH,
their God. Don’t you know yet that Egypt has perished?!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה אֵלָיו עַד מָתַי יִהְיֶה זֶה לָנוּ לְמוֹקֵשׁ שַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעַבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֲטֶרֶם תֵּדַע כִּי אָבְדָה מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה אֵלָיו עַד מָתַי יִהְיֶה זֶה לָנוּ לְמוֹקֵשׁ שַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעַבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֲטֶרֶם תֵּדַע כִּי אָבְדָה מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this be
a trap for us? Let the people go, so they may serve YHWH,
their God. Don’t you know yet that Egypt has perished?!”

translation.text: Pharaoh's officials said to him, "How long shall this fellow be a snare to us? Let the people go, so that they may worship the LORD their God; do you not yet understand that Egypt is ruined?"

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. And he
said to them, “Go. Serve YHWH, your God. Who are the ones
who are going?”
verses.hebrew: וַיּוּשַׁב אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִי וָמִי הַהֹלְכִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוּשַׁב אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִי וָמִי הַהֹלְכִים׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. And he
said to them, “Go. Serve YHWH, your God. Who are the ones
who are going?”

translation.text: So Moses and worship the LORD your God! But which ones are to go?"

verses.english:
And Moses said, “We’ll go with our young and with our old,
we’ll go with our sons and with our daughters, with our
sheep and with our oxen, because we have a festival of
YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בִּנְעָרֵינוּ וּבִזְקֵנֵינוּ נֵלֵךְ בְּבָנֵינוּ וּבִבְנוֹתֵנוּ בְּצֹאנֵנוּ וּבִבְקָרֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ כִּי חַג יְהֹוָה לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בִּנְעָרֵינוּ וּבִזְקֵנֵינוּ נֵלֵךְ בְּבָנֵינוּ וּבִבְנוֹתֵנוּ בְּצֹאנֵנוּ וּבִבְקָרֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ כִּי חַג יְהֹוָה לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “We’ll go with our young and with our old,
we’ll go with our sons and with our daughters, with our
sheep and with our oxen, because we have a festival of
YHWH.”

translation.text: Moses said, festival to celebrate."

verses.english:
And he said to them, “YHWH would be with you like that,
when I would let you and your infants go, see, because bad
is in front of your faces.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יְהִי כֵן יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת טַפְּכֶם רְאוּ כִּי רָעָה נֶגֶד פְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יְהִי כֵן יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת טַפְּכֶם רְאוּ כִּי רָעָה נֶגֶד פְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “YHWH would be with you like that,
when I would let you and your infants go, see, because bad
is in front of your faces.

translation.text: He said to them, "The LORD indeed will be with you, if ever I let your little ones go with you! Plainly, you have some evil purpose in mind.

verses.english:
It is not like that. Go—the men!—and serve YHWH, because
that is what you’re asking.” And he drove them out from
Pharaoh’s face.

was left, in the tree and in the field’s vegetation, in

And it covered the eye of all the land, and the land was
dark; and it ate all the land’s vegetation and the fruit

translation.text: They they ate all the plants in the land and all the fruit of the trees that the hail had left; nothing green was left, no tree, no plant in the field, in all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh hurried to call Moses and Aaron, and he said,

And now, bear my sin just this one time and pray to YHWH,

Each man did not see his brother, and each man did not get

And Moses said, “You shall put sacrifices and offerings in

Don’t continue to see my face. Because in the day you see
my face you’ll die!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה לֵךְ מֵעָלָי הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ אַל תֹּסֶף רְאוֹת פָּנַי כִּי בְּיוֹם רְאֹתְךָ פָנַי תָּמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה לֵךְ מֵעָלָי הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ אַל תֹּסֶף רְאוֹת פָּנַי כִּי בְּיוֹם רְאֹתְךָ פָנַי תָּמוּת׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to him, “Go away from me! Watch yourself!
Don’t continue to see my face. Because in the day you see
my face you’ll die!”

translation.text: Then Pharaoh said to him, "Get away from see my face you shall die."

verses.english:
And Moses said, “So you’ve spoken: I won’t continue to see
your face anymore.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן דִּבַּרְתָּ לֹא אֹסִף עוֹד רְאוֹת פָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן דִּבַּרְתָּ לֹא אֹסִף עוֹד רְאוֹת פָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “So you’ve spoken: I won’t continue to see
your face anymore.”

translation.text: Moses said, "Just as you say! I will never see your face again."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll bring one more plague on
Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that he’ll let you go from
here. When he lets go completely he’ll drive you out from
here!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עוֹד נֶגַע אֶחָד אָבִיא עַל פַּרְעֹה וְעַל מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה כְּשַׁלְּחוֹ כָּלָה גָּרֵשׁ יְגָרֵשׁ אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עוֹד נֶגַע אֶחָד אָבִיא עַל פַּרְעֹה וְעַל מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה כְּשַׁלְּחוֹ כָּלָה גָּרֵשׁ יְגָרֵשׁ אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll bring one more plague on
Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that he’ll let you go from
here. When he lets go completely he’ll drive you out from
here!

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "I will bring one more plague upon Pharaoh he lets you go, he will drive you away.

verses.english:
Speak in the people’s ears that each man will ask of his
neighbor and each woman of her neighbor items of silver
and items of gold.”
verses.hebrew: דַּבֶּר נָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וְיִשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִשָּׁה מֵאֵת רְעוּתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֶּר נָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וְיִשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִשָּׁה מֵאֵת רְעוּתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב׃

english.text:
Speak in the people’s ears that each man will ask of his
neighbor and each woman of her neighbor items of silver
and items of gold.”

translation.text: Tell the people that every man objects of silver and gold."

verses.english:
And YHWH put the people’s favor in the Egyptians’ eyes.
Also, the man Moses was very big in the land of Egypt in
the eyes of Pharaoh’s servants and in the people’s eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת חֵן הָעָם בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם גַּם הָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה גָּדוֹל מְאֹד בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת חֵן הָעָם בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם גַּם הָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה גָּדוֹל מְאֹד בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH put the people’s favor in the Egyptians’ eyes.
Also, the man Moses was very big in the land of Egypt in
the eyes of Pharaoh’s servants and in the people’s eyes.

translation.text: The LORD gave the people favor in the importance in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's officials and in the sight of the people.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “YHWH said this: In the middle of the
night I am going out through Egypt,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה כַּחֲצֹת הַלַּיְלָה אֲנִי יוֹצֵא בְּתוֹךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה כַּחֲצֹת הַלַּיְלָה אֲנִי יוֹצֵא בְּתוֹךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “YHWH said this: In the middle of the
night I am going out through Egypt,

translation.text: Moses said, "Thus says the LORD: About midnight I will go out through Egypt.

verses.english:
and every firstborn in the land of Egypt will die, from
the firstborn of Pharaoh who is sitting on his throne to
the firstborn of the maid who is behind the mill and every
firstborn of an animal.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵת כּל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכוֹר פַּרְעֹה הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל כִּסְאוֹ עַד בְּכוֹר הַשִּׁפְחָה אֲשֶׁר אַחַר הָרֵחָיִם וְכֹל בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵת כּל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכוֹר פַּרְעֹה הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל כִּסְאוֹ עַד בְּכוֹר הַשִּׁפְחָה אֲשֶׁר אַחַר הָרֵחָיִם וְכֹל בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
and every firstborn in the land of Egypt will die, from
the firstborn of Pharaoh who is sitting on his throne to
the firstborn of the maid who is behind the mill and every
firstborn of an animal.

translation.text: Every firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the livestock.

verses.english:
And there will be a big cry in all the land of Egypt, that
there has been none like it and there won’t continue to be
like it.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה צְעָקָה גְדֹלָה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר כָּמֹהוּ לֹא נִהְיָתָה וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא תֹסִף׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה צְעָקָה גְדֹלָה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר כָּמֹהוּ לֹא נִהְיָתָה וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא תֹסִף׃

english.text:
And there will be a big cry in all the land of Egypt, that
there has been none like it and there won’t continue to be
like it.

translation.text: Then there will be a loud cry throughout the whole land of Egypt, such as has never been or will ever be again.

verses.english:
But not a dog will move its tongue at any of the children
of Israel, from man to animal, so that you’ll know that
YHWH will distinguish between Egypt and Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֶחֱרַץ כֶּלֶב לְשֹׁנוֹ לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד בְּהֵמָה לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן אֲשֶׁר יַפְלֶה יְהֹוָה בֵּין מִצְרַיִם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֶחֱרַץ כֶּלֶב לְשֹׁנוֹ לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד בְּהֵמָה לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן אֲשֶׁר יַפְלֶה יְהֹוָה בֵּין מִצְרַיִם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But not a dog will move its tongue at any of the children
of Israel, from man to animal, so that you’ll know that
YHWH will distinguish between Egypt and Israel.

translation.text: But not a dog shall growl at any of the Israelites — not at people, not at animals — so and Israel.

verses.english:
And all these servants of yours will come down to me, and
they’ll bow to me, saying: ‘Go out, you and all the people
who are at your feet.’ And after that I’ll go out!” And he
went out from Pharaoh in a flaring of anger.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרְדוּ כל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה אֵלַי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לִי לֵאמֹר צֵא אַתָּה וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן אֵצֵא וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה בּחֳרִי אָף׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרְדוּ כל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה אֵלַי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לִי לֵאמֹר צֵא אַתָּה וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן אֵצֵא וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה בּחֳרִי אָף׃

english.text:
And all these servants of yours will come down to me, and
they’ll bow to me, saying: ‘Go out, you and all the people
who are at your feet.’ And after that I’ll go out!” And he
went out from Pharaoh in a flaring of anger.

translation.text: Then all these officials of yours shall come down to me, follow you.' After that I will leave." And in hot anger he left Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you—in
order to multiply my wonders in the land of Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיכֶם פַּרְעֹה לְמַעַן רְבוֹת מוֹפְתַי בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיכֶם פַּרְעֹה לְמַעַן רְבוֹת מוֹפְתַי בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you—in
order to multiply my wonders in the land of Egypt.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "Pharaoh will not listen to you, in order that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt."

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron had done all these wonders in front of
Pharaoh, and YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did
not let the children of Israel go from his land.
verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עָשׂוּ אֶת כּל הַמֹּפְתִים הָאֵלֶּה לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עָשׂוּ אֶת כּל הַמֹּפְתִים הָאֵלֶּה לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron had done all these wonders in front of
Pharaoh, and YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did
not let the children of Israel go from his land.

translation.text: Moses and out of his land.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron in the land of
Egypt, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron in the land of
Egypt, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt:

verses.english:
“This month is the beginning of months for you. It is
first of the months of the year for you.
verses.hebrew: הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לָכֶם רֹאשׁ חֳדָשִׁים רִאשׁוֹן הוּא לָכֶם לְחדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לָכֶם רֹאשׁ חֳדָשִׁים רִאשׁוֹן הוּא לָכֶם לְחדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
“This month is the beginning of months for you. It is
first of the months of the year for you.

translation.text: This month shall mark for you the beginning of months; it shall be the first month of the year for you.

verses.english:
Speak to all of the congregation of Israel, saying: On the
tenth of this month, let them each take a lamb for the
fathers’ houses, a lamb per house.
verses.hebrew: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בֶּעָשֹׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה וְיִקְחוּ לָהֶם אִישׁ שֶׂה לְבֵית אָבֹת שֶׂה לַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בֶּעָשֹׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה וְיִקְחוּ לָהֶם אִישׁ שֶׂה לְבֵית אָבֹת שֶׂה לַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
Speak to all of the congregation of Israel, saying: On the
tenth of this month, let them each take a lamb for the
fathers’ houses, a lamb per house.

translation.text: Tell the whole congregation of Israel that on the tenth of this month they are to take a lamb for each family, a lamb for each household.

verses.english:
And if the household will be too few for a lamb, then he
and his neighbor who is close to his house will take it
according to the count of persons; you shall count each
person according to what he eats for the lamb.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִמְעַט הַבַּיִת מִהְיוֹת מִשֶּׂה וְלָקַח הוּא וּשְׁכֵנוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֶל בֵּיתוֹ בְּמִכְסַת נְפָשֹׁת אִישׁ לְפִי אכְלוֹ תָּכֹסּוּ עַל הַשֶּׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִמְעַט הַבַּיִת מִהְיוֹת מִשֶּׂה וְלָקַח הוּא וּשְׁכֵנוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֶל בֵּיתוֹ בְּמִכְסַת נְפָשֹׁת אִישׁ לְפִי אכְלוֹ תָּכֹסּוּ עַל הַשֶּׂה׃

english.text:
And if the household will be too few for a lamb, then he
and his neighbor who is close to his house will take it
according to the count of persons; you shall count each
person according to what he eats for the lamb.

translation.text: If a household is too small for a whole lamb, it shall join its closest neighbor in obtaining one; the lamb shall be divided in proportion to the number of people who eat of it.

verses.english:
You shall have an unblemished, male, year-old lamb; you
shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.
verses.hebrew: שֶׂה תָמִים זָכָר בֶּן שָׁנָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַכְּבָשִׂים וּמִן הָעִזִּים תִּקָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: שֶׂה תָמִים זָכָר בֶּן שָׁנָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַכְּבָשִׂים וּמִן הָעִזִּים תִּקָּחוּ׃

english.text:
You shall have an unblemished, male, year-old lamb; you
shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.

translation.text: Your lamb shall be from the goats.

verses.english:
And it will be for you to watch over until the fourteenth
day of this month. And all the community of the
congregation of Israel will slaughter it ‘between the two
evenings.’
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת עַד אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה וְשָׁחֲטוּ אֹתוֹ כֹּל קְהַל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת עַד אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה וְשָׁחֲטוּ אֹתוֹ כֹּל קְהַל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

english.text:
And it will be for you to watch over until the fourteenth
day of this month. And all the community of the
congregation of Israel will slaughter it ‘between the two
evenings.’

translation.text: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of this slaughter it at twilight.

verses.english:
And they will take some of the blood and place it on the
two doorposts and on the lintel on the houses in which
they will eat it.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ מִן הַדָּם וְנָתְנוּ עַל שְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזֹת וְעַל הַמַּשְׁקוֹף עַל הַבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר יֹאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקְחוּ מִן הַדָּם וְנָתְנוּ עַל שְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזֹת וְעַל הַמַּשְׁקוֹף עַל הַבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר יֹאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
And they will take some of the blood and place it on the
two doorposts and on the lintel on the houses in which
they will eat it.

translation.text: They shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and the lintel of the houses in which they eat it.

verses.english:
And they will eat the meat in this night; they will eat it
fire-roasted and with unleavened bread on bitter herbs.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכְלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר בַּלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה צְלִי אֵשׁ וּמַצּוֹת עַל מְרֹרִים יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכְלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר בַּלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה צְלִי אֵשׁ וּמַצּוֹת עַל מְרֹרִים יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

english.text:
And they will eat the meat in this night; they will eat it
fire-roasted and with unleavened bread on bitter herbs.

translation.text: They shall eat the lamb that same night; they shall eat it roasted over the fire with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.english:
Do not eat any of it raw or cooked in water, but
fire-roasted: its head with its legs and with its innards.
verses.hebrew: אַל תֹּאכְלוּ מִמֶּנּוּ נָא וּבָשֵׁל מְבֻשָּׁל בַּמָּיִם כִּי אִם צְלִי אֵשׁ רֹאשׁוֹ עַל כְּרָעָיו וְעַל קִרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַל תֹּאכְלוּ מִמֶּנּוּ נָא וּבָשֵׁל מְבֻשָּׁל בַּמָּיִם כִּי אִם צְלִי אֵשׁ רֹאשׁוֹ עַל כְּרָעָיו וְעַל קִרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
Do not eat any of it raw or cooked in water, but
fire-roasted: its head with its legs and with its innards.

translation.text: Do not eat any of it raw or boiled in water, but roasted over the fire, with its head, legs, and inner organs.

verses.english:
And do not leave any of it until morning; and you shall
burn what is left of it until morning in fire.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וְהַנֹּתָר מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹפוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וְהַנֹּתָר מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹפוּ׃

english.text:
And do not leave any of it until morning; and you shall
burn what is left of it until morning in fire.

translation.text: You shall let none of it remain until the morning; anything that remains until the morning you shall burn.

verses.english:
And you shall eat it like this: your hips clothed, your
shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you
shall eat it in haste. It is YHWH’s Passover.
verses.hebrew: וְכָכָה תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ מתְנֵיכֶם חֲגֻרִים נַעֲלֵיכֶם בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם וּמַקֶּלְכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּחִפָּזוֹן פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכָכָה תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ מתְנֵיכֶם חֲגֻרִים נַעֲלֵיכֶם בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם וּמַקֶּלְכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּחִפָּזוֹן פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall eat it like this: your hips clothed, your
shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you
shall eat it in haste. It is YHWH’s Passover.

translation.text: This is how you shall eat it: your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it hurriedly. It is the passover of the LORD.

verses.english:
“And I shall pass through the land of Egypt in this night,
and I shall strike every firstborn in the land of Egypt,
from human to animal, and I shall make judgments on all
the gods of Egypt. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַרְתִּי בְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה וְהִכֵּיתִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מֵאָדָם וְעַד בְּהֵמָה וּבְכל אֱלֹהֵי מִצְרַיִם אֶעֱשֶׂה שְׁפָטִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַרְתִּי בְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה וְהִכֵּיתִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מֵאָדָם וְעַד בְּהֵמָה וּבְכל אֱלֹהֵי מִצְרַיִם אֶעֱשֶׂה שְׁפָטִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And I shall pass through the land of Egypt in this night,
and I shall strike every firstborn in the land of Egypt,
from human to animal, and I shall make judgments on all
the gods of Egypt. I am YHWH.

translation.text: For I will pass through the land of Egypt that night, and I beings and animals; on all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And the blood will be as a sign for you on the houses in
which you are, and I shall see the blood, and I shall halt
at you, and there won’t be a plague among you as a
destroyer when I strike in the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַדָּם לָכֶם לְאֹת עַל הַבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם שָׁם וְרָאִיתִי אֶת הַדָּם וּפָסַחְתִּי עֲלֵכֶם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָכֶם נֶגֶף לְמַשְׁחִית בְּהַכֹּתִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַדָּם לָכֶם לְאֹת עַל הַבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם שָׁם וְרָאִיתִי אֶת הַדָּם וּפָסַחְתִּי עֲלֵכֶם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָכֶם נֶגֶף לְמַשְׁחִית בְּהַכֹּתִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And the blood will be as a sign for you on the houses in
which you are, and I shall see the blood, and I shall halt
at you, and there won’t be a plague among you as a
destroyer when I strike in the land of Egypt.

translation.text: The blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you live: when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague shall destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
“And this day will become a commemoration for you, and you
shall celebrate it, a festival to YHWH; you shall
celebrate it through your generations, an eternal law:
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לָכֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַיהֹוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תְּחגֻּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לָכֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַיהֹוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תְּחגֻּהוּ׃

english.text:
“And this day will become a commemoration for you, and you
shall celebrate it, a festival to YHWH; you shall
celebrate it through your generations, an eternal law:

translation.text: This day shall be a day of remembrance for you. You shall celebrate observe it as a perpetual ordinance.

verses.english:
Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. Indeed, on the
first day you shall make leaven cease from your houses.
Because anyone who eats leavened bread: that person will
be cut off from Israel—from the first day to the seventh
day.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ אַךְ בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן תַּשְׁבִּיתוּ שְּׂאֹר מִבָּתֵּיכֶם כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חָמֵץ וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִיּוֹם הָרִאשֹׁן עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁבִעִי׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ אַךְ בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן תַּשְׁבִּיתוּ שְּׂאֹר מִבָּתֵּיכֶם כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חָמֵץ וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִיּוֹם הָרִאשֹׁן עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁבִעִי׃

english.text:
Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. Indeed, on the
first day you shall make leaven cease from your houses.
Because anyone who eats leavened bread: that person will
be cut off from Israel—from the first day to the seventh
day.

translation.text: Seven days you shall eat seventh day shall be cut off from Israel.

verses.english:
And you will have a holy assembly on the first day and a
holy assembly on the seventh day. Not any work will be
done on them. Just what will be eaten by each person: that
alone will be done for you.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בָהֶם אַךְ אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל לְכל נֶפֶשׁ הוּא לְבַדּוֹ יֵעָשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בָהֶם אַךְ אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל לְכל נֶפֶשׁ הוּא לְבַדּוֹ יֵעָשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And you will have a holy assembly on the first day and a
holy assembly on the seventh day. Not any work will be
done on them. Just what will be eaten by each person: that
alone will be done for you.

translation.text: On the first day you shall alone may be prepared by you.

verses.english:
And you shall observe the unleavened bread, because in
this very day I brought out your masses from the land of
Egypt, and you shall observe this day through your
generations, an eternal law.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַמַּצּוֹת כִּי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הוֹצֵאתִי אֶת צִבְאוֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַמַּצּוֹת כִּי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הוֹצֵאתִי אֶת צִבְאוֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And you shall observe the unleavened bread, because in
this very day I brought out your masses from the land of
Egypt, and you shall observe this day through your
generations, an eternal law.

translation.text: You shall observe the festival of generations as a perpetual ordinance.

verses.english:
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, in
the evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the
twenty-first day of the month, in the evening.
verses.hebrew: בָּרִאשֹׁן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב תֹּאכְלוּ מַצֹּת עַד יוֹם הָאֶחָד וְעֶשְׂרִים לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: בָּרִאשֹׁן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב תֹּאכְלוּ מַצֹּת עַד יוֹם הָאֶחָד וְעֶשְׂרִים לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעָרֶב׃

english.text:
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, in
the evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the
twenty-first day of the month, in the evening.

translation.text: In the first month, from the day, you shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.english:
Seven days leaven shall not be found in your houses,
because anyone who eats something leavened: that person
will be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether
the alien or the citizen of the land.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שְׂאֹר לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְּבָתֵּיכֶם כִּי כּל אֹכֵל מַחְמֶצֶת וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגֵּר וּבְאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שְׂאֹר לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְּבָתֵּיכֶם כִּי כּל אֹכֵל מַחְמֶצֶת וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגֵּר וּבְאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Seven days leaven shall not be found in your houses,
because anyone who eats something leavened: that person
will be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether
the alien or the citizen of the land.

translation.text: For seven days no leaven shall be found in your houses; for whoever eats what is leavened shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether an alien or a native of the land.

verses.english:
You shall not eat anything leavened; in all your homes you
shall eat unleavened bread.”
verses.hebrew: כּל מַחְמֶצֶת לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכְלוּ מַצּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: כּל מַחְמֶצֶת לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכְלוּ מַצּוֹת׃

english.text:
You shall not eat anything leavened; in all your homes you
shall eat unleavened bread.”

translation.text: You shall eat nothing leavened; in all your settlements you shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.english:
And Moses called all Israel’s elders, and he said to them,
“Pull out and take a sheep for your families and slaughter
the Passover.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לְכל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מִשְׁכוּ וּקְחוּ לָכֶם צֹאן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם וְשַׁחֲטוּ הַפָּסַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לְכל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מִשְׁכוּ וּקְחוּ לָכֶם צֹאן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם וְשַׁחֲטוּ הַפָּסַח׃

english.text:
And Moses called all Israel’s elders, and he said to them,
“Pull out and take a sheep for your families and slaughter
the Passover.

translation.text: Then Moses called all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go, select lambs for your families, and slaughter the passover lamb.

verses.english:
And you’ll take a bunch of hyssop and dip in the blood
that is in a basin and touch some of the blood that is in
the basin to the lintel and to the two doorposts. And you
shall not go out, each one, from his house’s entrance
until morning.
verses.hebrew: וּלְקַחְתֶּם אֲגֻדַּת אֵזוֹב וּטְבַלְתֶּם בַּדָּם אֲשֶׁר בַּסַּף וְהִגַּעְתֶּם אֶל הַמַּשְׁקוֹף וְאֶל שְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזֹת מִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר בַּסָּף וְאַתֶּם לֹא תֵצְאוּ אִישׁ מִפֶּתַח בֵּיתוֹ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וּלְקַחְתֶּם אֲגֻדַּת אֵזוֹב וּטְבַלְתֶּם בַּדָּם אֲשֶׁר בַּסַּף וְהִגַּעְתֶּם אֶל הַמַּשְׁקוֹף וְאֶל שְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזֹת מִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר בַּסָּף וְאַתֶּם לֹא תֵצְאוּ אִישׁ מִפֶּתַח בֵּיתוֹ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

And you’ll take a bunch of hyssop and dip in the blood
that is in a basin and touch some of the blood that is in
the basin to the lintel and to the two doorposts. And you

until morning.

translation.text: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and touch the shall go outside the door of your house until morning.

verses.english:
And YHWH will pass to strike Egypt, and He’ll see the
blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, and YHWH
will halt at the entrance and will not allow the destroyer
to come to your houses to strike.
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר יְהֹוָה לִנְגֹּף אֶת מִצְרַיִם וְרָאָה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמַּשְׁקוֹף וְעַל שְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזֹת וּפָסַח יְהֹוָה עַל הַפֶּתַח וְלֹא יִתֵּן הַמַּשְׁחִית לָבֹא אֶל בָּתֵּיכֶם לִנְגֹּף׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר יְהֹוָה לִנְגֹּף אֶת מִצְרַיִם וְרָאָה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמַּשְׁקוֹף וְעַל שְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזֹת וּפָסַח יְהֹוָה עַל הַפֶּתַח וְלֹא יִתֵּן הַמַּשְׁחִית לָבֹא אֶל בָּתֵּיכֶם לִנְגֹּף׃

And YHWH will pass to strike Egypt, and He’ll see the
blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, and YHWH
will halt at the entrance and will not allow the destroyer
to come to your houses to strike.

translation.text: For the LORD you down.

verses.english:
And you shall observe this thing as a law for you and your
children forever.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחק לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחק לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And you shall observe this thing as a law for you and your
children forever.

translation.text: You shall observe this rite as a perpetual ordinance for you and your children.

verses.english:
And it will be, when you will come to the land that YHWH
will give to you as He has spoken, that you shall observe
this service.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And it will be, when you will come to the land that YHWH
will give to you as He has spoken, that you shall observe
this service.

translation.text: When you come to the land that the LORD will give you, as he has promised, you shall keep this observance.

verses.english:
And it will be, when your children will say to you, ‘What
is this service to you?’
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ אֲלֵיכֶם בְּנֵיכֶם מָה הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ אֲלֵיכֶם בְּנֵיכֶם מָה הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And it will be, when your children will say to you, ‘What
is this service to you?’

translation.text: observance?'

verses.english:
that you shall say, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to YHWH,
because He halted at the houses of the children of Israel
in Egypt when He struck Egypt, and He saved our houses.’”
And the people knelt and bowed.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם זֶבַח פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר פָּסַח עַל בָּתֵּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּנגְפּוֹ אֶת מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת בָּתֵּינוּ הִצִּיל וַיִּקֹּד הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם זֶבַח פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר פָּסַח עַל בָּתֵּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּנגְפּוֹ אֶת מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת בָּתֵּינוּ הִצִּיל וַיִּקֹּד הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

english.text:
that you shall say, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to YHWH,
because He halted at the houses of the children of Israel
in Egypt when He struck Egypt, and He saved our houses.’”
And the people knelt and bowed.

translation.text: you shall say, 'It is the passover sacrifice to the LORD, for he passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt, when he struck down and worshiped.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel went and did as YHWH had
commanded Moses and Aaron. They did so.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel went and did as YHWH had
commanded Moses and Aaron. They did so.

translation.text: The Israelites went and did just as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
And it was in the middle of the night, and YHWH struck
every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn
of Pharaoh who was sitting on his throne to the firstborn
of the prisoner who was in the prison house and every
firstborn of an animal.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיהֹוָה הִכָּה כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכֹר פַּרְעֹה הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל כִּסְאוֹ עַד בְּכוֹר הַשְּׁבִי אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית הַבּוֹר וְכֹל בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיהֹוָה הִכָּה כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכֹר פַּרְעֹה הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל כִּסְאוֹ עַד בְּכוֹר הַשְּׁבִי אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית הַבּוֹר וְכֹל בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And it was in the middle of the night, and YHWH struck
every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn
of Pharaoh who was sitting on his throne to the firstborn
of the prisoner who was in the prison house and every
firstborn of an animal.

translation.text: At midnight the LORD struck down all the firstborn in the land of firstborn of the prisoner who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of the livestock.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh got up at night, he and all his servants and
all Egypt, and there was a big cry in Egypt, because there
was not a house in which there was not one dead.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם פַּרְעֹה לַיְלָה הוּא וְכל עֲבָדָיו וְכל מִצְרַיִם וַתְּהִי צְעָקָה גְדֹלָה בְּמִצְרָיִם כִּי אֵין בַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אֵין שָׁם מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם פַּרְעֹה לַיְלָה הוּא וְכל עֲבָדָיו וְכל מִצְרַיִם וַתְּהִי צְעָקָה גְדֹלָה בְּמִצְרָיִם כִּי אֵין בַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אֵין שָׁם מֵת׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh got up at night, he and all his servants and
all Egypt, and there was a big cry in Egypt, because there
was not a house in which there was not one dead.

translation.text: Pharaoh arose in the night, he and all his officials and all the Egyptians; and there was a loud cry in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.

verses.english:
And he called Moses and Aaron at night, and he said, “Get
up. Go out from among my people, both you and the children
of Israel, and go, serve YHWH as you spoke.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ צְּאוּ מִתּוֹךְ עַמִּי גַּם אַתֶּם גַּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה כְּדַבֶּרְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ צְּאוּ מִתּוֹךְ עַמִּי גַּם אַתֶּם גַּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה כְּדַבֶּרְכֶם׃

english.text:
And he called Moses and Aaron at night, and he said, “Get
up. Go out from among my people, both you and the children
of Israel, and go, serve YHWH as you spoke.

translation.text: Then he summoned Moses and you and the Israelites! Go, worship the LORD, as you said.

verses.english:
Take your sheep also, your oxen also, as you spoke, and
go. And you’ll bless me as well!”
verses.hebrew: גַּם צֹאנְכֶם גַּם בְּקַרְכֶם קְחוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתֶּם וָלֵכוּ וּבֵרַכְתֶּם גַּם אֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: גַּם צֹאנְכֶם גַּם בְּקַרְכֶם קְחוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתֶּם וָלֵכוּ וּבֵרַכְתֶּם גַּם אֹתִי׃

english.text:
Take your sheep also, your oxen also, as you spoke, and
go. And you’ll bless me as well!”

translation.text: Take your on me too!"

verses.english:
And Egypt was forceful on the people to hurry to let them
go from the land, because they said, “We’re all dead!”
verses.hebrew: וַתֶּחֱזַק מִצְרַיִם עַל הָעָם לְמַהֵר לְשַׁלְּחָם מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָמְרוּ כֻּלָּנוּ מֵתִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתֶּחֱזַק מִצְרַיִם עַל הָעָם לְמַהֵר לְשַׁלְּחָם מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָמְרוּ כֻּלָּנוּ מֵתִים׃

english.text:
And Egypt was forceful on the people to hurry to let them
go from the land, because they said, “We’re all dead!”

translation.text: The Egyptians urged the people to hasten their departure from the land, for they said, "We shall all be dead."

verses.english:
And the people carried off its dough before it leavened,
their bowls being wrapped in their garments on their
shoulder.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא הָעָם אֶת בְּצֵקוֹ טֶרֶם יֶחְמָץ מִשְׁאֲרֹתָם צְרֻרֹת בְּשִׂמְלֹתָם עַל שִׁכְמָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא הָעָם אֶת בְּצֵקוֹ טֶרֶם יֶחְמָץ מִשְׁאֲרֹתָם צְרֻרֹת בְּשִׂמְלֹתָם עַל שִׁכְמָם׃

english.text:
And the people carried off its dough before it leavened,
their bowls being wrapped in their garments on their
shoulder.

translation.text: So the people took their in their cloaks on their shoulders.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel had done according to Moses’
word, and they asked items of silver and items of gold and
garments from Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂמָלֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂמָלֹת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel had done according to Moses’
word, and they asked items of silver and items of gold and
garments from Egypt.

translation.text: The Israelites had done as Moses told them; they had asked the Egyptians for jewelry of silver and gold, and for clothing,

verses.english:
And YHWH had put the people’s favor in the Egyptians’
eyes, and they lent to them, and they despoiled Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה נָתַן אֶת חֵן הָעָם בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרַיִם וַיַּשְׁאִלוּם וַיְנַצְּלוּ אֶת מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה נָתַן אֶת חֵן הָעָם בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרַיִם וַיַּשְׁאִלוּם וַיְנַצְּלוּ אֶת מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH had put the people’s favor in the Egyptians’
eyes, and they lent to them, and they despoiled Egypt.

translation.text: and the LORD had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. And so they plundered the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel traveled from Rameses to
Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot—men, apart
from infants.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס סֻכֹּתָה כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף רַגְלִי הַגְּבָרִים לְבַד מִטָּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס סֻכֹּתָה כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף רַגְלִי הַגְּבָרִים לְבַד מִטָּף׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel traveled from Rameses to
Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot—men, apart
from infants.

translation.text: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.

verses.english:
And also a great mixture had gone up with them, and sheep
and oxen, a very heavy livestock.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם עֵרֶב רַב עָלָה אִתָּם וְצֹאן וּבָקָר מִקְנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם עֵרֶב רַב עָלָה אִתָּם וְצֹאן וּבָקָר מִקְנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And also a great mixture had gone up with them, and sheep
and oxen, a very heavy livestock.

translation.text: A mixed crowd also went up with them, and livestock in great numbers, both flocks and herds.

verses.english:
And they baked the dough that they brought out of Egypt:
cakes of unleavened bread, because it had not leavened,
because they were driven from Egypt and were not able to
delay, and they also had not made provisions for
themselves.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאפוּ אֶת הַבָּצֵק אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם עֻגֹת מַצּוֹת כִּי לֹא חָמֵץ כִּי גֹרְשׁוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִתְמַהְמֵהַּ וְגַם צֵדָה לֹא עָשׂוּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאפוּ אֶת הַבָּצֵק אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם עֻגֹת מַצּוֹת כִּי לֹא חָמֵץ כִּי גֹרְשׁוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִתְמַהְמֵהַּ וְגַם צֵדָה לֹא עָשׂוּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And they baked the dough that they brought out of Egypt:
cakes of unleavened bread, because it had not leavened,
because they were driven from Egypt and were not able to
delay, and they also had not made provisions for
themselves.

translation.text: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough that they had brought themselves.

verses.english:
And the duration of the children of Israel that they lived
in Egypt was thirty years and four hundred years.
verses.hebrew: וּמוֹשַׁב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָשְׁבוּ בְּמִצְרָיִם שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמוֹשַׁב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָשְׁבוּ בְּמִצְרָיִם שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And the duration of the children of Israel that they lived
in Egypt was thirty years and four hundred years.

translation.text: The time that the Israelites had lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

verses.english:
And it was at the end of thirty years and four hundred
years, and it was in that very day: all of YHWH’s masses
went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיְהִי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יָצְאוּ כּל צִבְאוֹת יְהֹוָה מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיְהִי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יָצְאוּ כּל צִבְאוֹת יְהֹוָה מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was at the end of thirty years and four hundred
years, and it was in that very day: all of YHWH’s masses
went out from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: At the end of four hundred thirty years, on that very day, all the companies of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
It is a night to be observed for YHWH for bringing them
out from the land of Egypt. It is this night, to be
observed for YHWH for all the children of Israel through
their generations.
verses.hebrew: לֵיל שִׁמֻּרִים הוּא לַיהֹוָה לְהוֹצִיאָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הוּא הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה לַיהֹוָה שִׁמֻּרִים לְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: לֵיל שִׁמֻּרִים הוּא לַיהֹוָה לְהוֹצִיאָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הוּא הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה לַיהֹוָה שִׁמֻּרִים לְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
It is a night to be observed for YHWH for bringing them
out from the land of Egypt. It is this night, to be
observed for YHWH for all the children of Israel through
their generations.

translation.text: That was for the LORD a night of vigil, to bring them out of the land of Israelites throughout their generations.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the law of the
Passover: any foreigner shall not eat from it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן זֹאת חֻקַּת הַפָּסַח כּל בֶּן נֵכָר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן זֹאת חֻקַּת הַפָּסַח כּל בֶּן נֵכָר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the law of the
Passover: any foreigner shall not eat from it.

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron: This is the ordinance for the passover: no foreigner shall eat of it,

verses.english:
And every slave of a man, purchased with money: you shall
circumcise him; then he shall eat from it.
verses.hebrew: וְכל עֶבֶד אִישׁ מִקְנַת כָּסֶף וּמַלְתָּה אֹתוֹ אָז יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל עֶבֶד אִישׁ מִקְנַת כָּסֶף וּמַלְתָּה אֹתוֹ אָז יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And every slave of a man, purchased with money: you shall
circumcise him; then he shall eat from it.

translation.text: but any slave who has been purchased may eat of it after he has been circumcised;

verses.english: A visitor and an employee shall not eat from it.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹשָׁב וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: תּוֹשָׁב וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

english.text: A visitor and an employee shall not eat from it.

translation.text: no bound or hired servant may eat of it.

verses.english:
It shall be eaten in one house; you shall not take any of
the meat from the house outside. And you shall not break a
bone from it.
verses.hebrew: בְּבַיִת אֶחָד יֵאָכֵל לֹא תוֹצִיא מִן הַבַּיִת מִן הַבָּשָׂר חוּצָה וְעֶצֶם לֹא תִשְׁבְּרוּ בוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בְּבַיִת אֶחָד יֵאָכֵל לֹא תוֹצִיא מִן הַבַּיִת מִן הַבָּשָׂר חוּצָה וְעֶצֶם לֹא תִשְׁבְּרוּ בוֹ׃

english.text:
It shall be eaten in one house; you shall not take any of
the meat from the house outside. And you shall not break a
bone from it.

translation.text: It shall be eaten in one house; you shall any of its bones.

verses.english: All of the congregation of Israel shall do it.
verses.hebrew: כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יַעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יַעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text: All of the congregation of Israel shall do it.

translation.text: The whole congregation of Israel shall celebrate it.

verses.english:
And if an alien will reside with you and will make a
Passover to YHWH, let him be circumcised, every male, and
then he may come forward to do it, and he will be like a
citizen of the land, but everyone who is uncircumcised
shall not eat from it.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר וְעָשָׂה פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה הִמּוֹל לוֹ כל זָכָר וְאָז יִקְרַב לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ וְהָיָה כְּאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ וְכל עָרֵל לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר וְעָשָׂה פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה הִמּוֹל לוֹ כל זָכָר וְאָז יִקְרַב לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ וְהָיָה כְּאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ וְכל עָרֵל לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And if an alien will reside with you and will make a
Passover to YHWH, let him be circumcised, every male, and
then he may come forward to do it, and he will be like a
citizen of the land, but everyone who is uncircumcised
shall not eat from it.

translation.text: If an alien who resides with you wants to celebrate the passover to uncircumcised person shall eat of it;

verses.english:
There shall be one instruction for the citizen and for the
alien who resides among you.”
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָאֶזְרָח וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָאֶזְרָח וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
There shall be one instruction for the citizen and for the
alien who resides among you.”

translation.text: there shall be one law for the native and for the alien who resides among you.

verses.english:
And all the children of Israel did as YHWH had commanded
Moses and Aaron. They did so.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And all the children of Israel did as YHWH had commanded
Moses and Aaron. They did so.

translation.text: All the Israelites did just as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
And it was in this very day: YHWH brought out the children
of Israel from the land of Egypt by their masses.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַל צִבְאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַל צִבְאֹתָם׃

english.text:
And it was in this very day: YHWH brought out the children
of Israel from the land of Egypt by their masses.

translation.text: That very day the LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt, company by company.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses:

verses.english:
“Consecrate every firstborn for me. The first birth of
every womb of the children of Israel, of a human and of an
animal: it is mine.”
verses.hebrew: קַדֶּשׁ לִי כל בְּכוֹר פֶּטֶר כּל רֶחֶם בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה לִי הוּא׃

hebrew.text: קַדֶּשׁ לִי כל בְּכוֹר פֶּטֶר כּל רֶחֶם בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה לִי הוּא׃

english.text:
“Consecrate every firstborn for me. The first birth of
every womb of the children of Israel, of a human and of an
animal: it is mine.”

translation.text: Consecrate to me all the firstborn; whatever and animals, is mine.

verses.english:
And Moses said to the people, “Remember this day in which
you went out from Egypt, from a house of slaves, because
YHWH brought you out of here by strength of hand: And no
leavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם זָכוֹר אֶת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְצָאתֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים כִּי בְּחֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה וְלֹא יֵאָכֵל חָמֵץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם זָכוֹר אֶת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְצָאתֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים כִּי בְּחֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה וְלֹא יֵאָכֵל חָמֵץ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the people, “Remember this day in which
you went out from Egypt, from a house of slaves, because
YHWH brought you out of here by strength of hand: And no
leavened bread shall be eaten.

translation.text: Moses said to the people, "Remember this day on which you came eaten.

verses.english: Today you are going out, in the month of Abib.
verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם אַתֶּם יֹצְאִים בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: הַיּוֹם אַתֶּם יֹצְאִים בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב׃

english.text: Today you are going out, in the month of Abib.

translation.text: Today, in the month of Abib, you are going out.

verses.english:
And it will be, when YHWH will bring you to the land of
the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the
Hivite and the Jebusite, which He swore to your fathers to
give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you
will perform this service in this month.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And it will be, when YHWH will bring you to the land of
the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the
Hivite and the Jebusite, which He swore to your fathers to
give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you
will perform this service in this month.

translation.text: When the keep this observance in this month.

verses.english:
You shall eat unleavened bread seven days, and on the
seventh day is a festival to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצֹּת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי חַג לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצֹּת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי חַג לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall eat unleavened bread seven days, and on the
seventh day is a festival to YHWH.

translation.text: Seven days you shall eat the LORD.

verses.english:
Unleavened bread will be eaten for the seven days, and
leavened bread shall not be seen for you, and leaven shall
not be seen for you within all your borders.
verses.hebrew: מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל אֵת שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה לְךָ חָמֵץ וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה לְךָ שְׂאֹר בְּכל גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל אֵת שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה לְךָ חָמֵץ וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה לְךָ שְׂאֹר בְּכל גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

english.text:
Unleavened bread will be eaten for the seven days, and
leavened bread shall not be seen for you, and leaven shall
not be seen for you within all your borders.

translation.text: Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days; no leavened bread shall be seen in your possession, and no leaven shall be seen among you in all your territory.

verses.english:
And you shall tell your child in that day, saying,
‘Because of that which YHWH did for me when I went out
from Egypt.’
verses.hebrew: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And you shall tell your child in that day, saying,
‘Because of that which YHWH did for me when I went out
from Egypt.’

translation.text: You shall tell your child on that Egypt.'

verses.english:
And it will become a sign on your hand and a reminder
between your eyes for you so that YHWH’s instruction will
be in your mouth, because YHWH brought you out from Egypt
with a strong hand.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְךָ לְאוֹת עַל יָדְךָ וּלְזִכָּרוֹן בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה תּוֹרַת יְהֹוָה בְּפִיךָ כִּי בְּיָד חֲזָקָה הוֹצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לְךָ לְאוֹת עַל יָדְךָ וּלְזִכָּרוֹן בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה תּוֹרַת יְהֹוָה בְּפִיךָ כִּי בְּיָד חֲזָקָה הוֹצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it will become a sign on your hand and a reminder
between your eyes for you so that YHWH’s instruction will
be in your mouth, because YHWH brought you out from Egypt
with a strong hand.

translation.text: It shall serve for you as a sign on your hand and as a reminder on your forehead, so that the teaching of the LORD may be on your lips; for with a strong hand the LORD brought you out of Egypt.

verses.english:
And you shall observe this law at its appointed time,
regularly.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת הַחֻקָּה הַזֹּאת לְמוֹעֲדָהּ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת הַחֻקָּה הַזֹּאת לְמוֹעֲדָהּ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה׃

english.text:
And you shall observe this law at its appointed time,
regularly.

translation.text: You shall keep this ordinance at its proper time from year to year.

verses.english:
And it will be, when YHWH will bring you to the land of
the Canaanite as He swore to you and to your fathers and
will give it to you,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְךָ וְלַאֲבֹתֶיךָ וּנְתָנָהּ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְךָ וְלַאֲבֹתֶיךָ וּנְתָנָהּ לָךְ׃

english.text:
And it will be, when YHWH will bring you to the land of
the Canaanite as He swore to you and to your fathers and
will give it to you,

translation.text: "When the LORD has brought you into the land of the Canaanites, as he swore to you and your ancestors, and has given it to you,

verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ כל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לַיהֹוָה וְכל פֶּטֶר שֶׁגֶר בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ הַזְּכָרִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ כל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לַיהֹוָה וְכל פֶּטֶר שֶׁגֶר בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ הַזְּכָרִים לַיהֹוָה׃

translation.text: you firstborn of your livestock that are males shall be the LORD's.

verses.english:
And you shall redeem every first birth of an ass with a
lamb, and if you will not redeem, then you shall break its
neck. And you shall redeem every human firstborn among
your sons.
verses.hebrew: וְכל פֶּטֶר חֲמֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ וְכֹל בְּכוֹר אָדָם בְּבָנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל פֶּטֶר חֲמֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ וְכֹל בְּכוֹר אָדָם בְּבָנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall redeem every first birth of an ass with a
lamb, and if you will not redeem, then you shall break its
neck. And you shall redeem every human firstborn among
your sons.

translation.text: But children you shall redeem.

verses.english:
And it will be, when your child will ask you tomorrow,
saying, ‘What is this?’ that you’ll say to him, ‘With
strength of hand YHWH brought us out from Egypt, from a
house of slaves.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יִשְׁאָלְךָ בִנְךָ מָחָר לֵאמֹר מַה זֹּאת וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו בְּחֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יִשְׁאָלְךָ בִנְךָ מָחָר לֵאמֹר מַה זֹּאת וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו בְּחֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
And it will be, when your child will ask you tomorrow,
saying, ‘What is this?’ that you’ll say to him, ‘With
strength of hand YHWH brought us out from Egypt, from a
house of slaves.

translation.text: When in the future your child asks you, brought us out of Egypt, from the house of slavery.

verses.english:
And it was when Pharaoh hardened against letting us go,
and YHWH killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from
firstborn of a human to firstborn of an animal. On account
of this I am sacrificing to YHWH every first birth of a
womb—the males—and I shall redeem every firstborn of my
sons.’
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי הִקְשָׁה פַרְעֹה לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ וַיַּהֲרֹג יְהֹוָה כּל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכֹר אָדָם וְעַד בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה עַל כֵּן אֲנִי זֹבֵחַ לַיהֹוָה כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם הַזְּכָרִים וְכל בְּכוֹר בָּנַי אֶפְדֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי הִקְשָׁה פַרְעֹה לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ וַיַּהֲרֹג יְהֹוָה כּל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכֹר אָדָם וְעַד בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה עַל כֵּן אֲנִי זֹבֵחַ לַיהֹוָה כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם הַזְּכָרִים וְכל בְּכוֹר בָּנַי אֶפְדֶּה׃

english.text:
And it was when Pharaoh hardened against letting us go,
and YHWH killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from
firstborn of a human to firstborn of an animal. On account
of this I am sacrificing to YHWH every first birth of a
womb—the males—and I shall redeem every firstborn of my
sons.’

translation.text: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from human firstborn to the firstborn of animals. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD every male that first opens the womb, but every firstborn of my sons I redeem.'

verses.english:
And it will become a sign on your hand and bands between
your eyes, because with strength of hand YHWH brought us
out from Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְאוֹת עַל יָדְכָה וּלְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ כִּי בְּחֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לְאוֹת עַל יָדְכָה וּלְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ כִּי בְּחֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it will become a sign on your hand and bands between
your eyes, because with strength of hand YHWH brought us
out from Egypt.”

translation.text: It shall serve as a sign on hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt." God rescues Israel at the sea (told first in prose)

verses.english:
And it was, when Pharaoh let the people go,
that God did not lead them by way of the Philistines’
land—because it was close—because God said, “In case the
people will be dissuaded when they see war, and they’ll go
back to Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁלַּח פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעָם וְלֹא נָחָם אֱלֹהִים דֶּרֶךְ אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי קָרוֹב הוּא כִּי אָמַר אֱלֹהִים פֶּן יִנָּחֵם הָעָם בִּרְאֹתָם מִלְחָמָה וְשָׁבוּ מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁלַּח פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעָם וְלֹא נָחָם אֱלֹהִים דֶּרֶךְ אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי קָרוֹב הוּא כִּי אָמַר אֱלֹהִים פֶּן יִנָּחֵם הָעָם בִּרְאֹתָם מִלְחָמָה וְשָׁבוּ מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And it was, when Pharaoh let the people go,
that God did not lead them by way of the Philistines’
land—because it was close—because God said, “In case the
people will be dissuaded when they see war, and they’ll go
back to Egypt.”

translation.text: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, although that was nearer; for God thought, Egypt."

verses.english:
And God turned the people by way of the wilderness of the
Red Sea. And the children of Israel went up armed from the
land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָעָם דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר יַם סוּף וַחֲמֻשִׁים עָלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסֵּב אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָעָם דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר יַם סוּף וַחֲמֻשִׁים עָלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And God turned the people by way of the wilderness of the
Red Sea. And the children of Israel went up armed from the
land of Egypt.

translation.text: So God led the people by the roundabout way of the of Egypt prepared for battle.

verses.english:
And Moses took Joseph’s bones with him, because he had had
the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will take
account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones from here
with you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף עִמּוֹ כִּי הַשְׁבֵּעַ הִשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶתְכֶם וְהַעֲלִיתֶם אֶת עַצְמֹתַי מִזֶּה אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף עִמּוֹ כִּי הַשְׁבֵּעַ הִשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶתְכֶם וְהַעֲלִיתֶם אֶת עַצְמֹתַי מִזֶּה אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses took Joseph’s bones with him, because he had had
the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will take
account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones from here
with you.”

translation.text: And Moses took with him the bones of you from here."

verses.english:
And they traveled from Succoth and camped in Etham at the
edge of the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Succoth and camped in Etham at the
edge of the wilderness.

translation.text: They set out from Succoth, and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.

verses.english:
And YHWH was going in front of them by day in a column of
cloud to show them the way, and by night in a column of
fire to shed light for them, so as to go by day and by
night.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם יוֹמָם בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן לַנְחֹתָם הַדֶּרֶךְ וְלַיְלָה בְּעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָהֶם לָלֶכֶת יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם יוֹמָם בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן לַנְחֹתָם הַדֶּרֶךְ וְלַיְלָה בְּעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָהֶם לָלֶכֶת יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH was going in front of them by day in a column of
cloud to show them the way, and by night in a column of
fire to shed light for them, so as to go by day and by
night.

translation.text: The LORD went in front of them in a fire by night, to give them light, so that they might travel by day and by night.

verses.english:
The column of cloud by day and the column of fire by night
did not depart in front of the people.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יָמִישׁ עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן יוֹמָם וְעַמּוּד הָאֵשׁ לָיְלָה לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יָמִישׁ עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן יוֹמָם וְעַמּוּד הָאֵשׁ לָיְלָה לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
The column of cloud by day and the column of fire by night
did not depart in front of the people.

translation.text: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD said to Moses:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel that they should go back
and camp in front of Pi-Hahiroth, between Migdol and the
sea, in front of Baal-Zephon. You shall camp facing it, by
the sea.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיָשֻׁבוּ וְיַחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי פִּי הַחִירֹת בֵּין מִגְדֹּל וּבֵין הַיָּם לִפְנֵי בַּעַל צְפֹן נִכְחוֹ תַחֲנוּ עַל הַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיָשֻׁבוּ וְיַחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי פִּי הַחִירֹת בֵּין מִגְדֹּל וּבֵין הַיָּם לִפְנֵי בַּעַל צְפֹן נִכְחוֹ תַחֲנוּ עַל הַיָּם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel that they should go back
and camp in front of Pi-Hahiroth, between Migdol and the
sea, in front of Baal-Zephon. You shall camp facing it, by
the sea.

translation.text: Tell the Israelites to turn back and Baal-zephon; you shall camp opposite it, by the sea.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh will say about the children of Israel:
‘They’re muddled in the land! The wilderness has closed
them in.’
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר פַּרְעֹה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְבֻכִים הֵם בָּאָרֶץ סָגַר עֲלֵיהֶם הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַר פַּרְעֹה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְבֻכִים הֵם בָּאָרֶץ סָגַר עֲלֵיהֶם הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh will say about the children of Israel:
‘They’re muddled in the land! The wilderness has closed
them in.’

translation.text: Pharaoh will say wilderness has closed in on them."

verses.english:
And I’ll strengthen Pharaoh’s heart, and he’ll pursue
them, and I’ll be glorified against Pharaoh and against
all of his army, and Egypt will know that I am YHWH.” And
they did so.
verses.hebrew: וְחִזַּקְתִּי אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְרָדַף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְאִכָּבְדָה בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכל חֵילוֹ וְיָדְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְחִזַּקְתִּי אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְרָדַף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְאִכָּבְדָה בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכל חֵילוֹ וְיָדְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן׃

english.text:
And I’ll strengthen Pharaoh’s heart, and he’ll pursue
them, and I’ll be glorified against Pharaoh and against
all of his army, and Egypt will know that I am YHWH.” And
they did so.

translation.text: I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and they did so.

verses.english:
And it was told to the king of Egypt that the people had
fled, and the heart of Pharaoh and his servants was
changed toward the people. And they said, “What is this
that we’ve done, that we let Israel go from serving us?!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם כִּי בָרַח הָעָם וַיֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַב פַּרְעֹה וַעֲבָדָיו אֶל הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂינוּ כִּי שִׁלַּחְנוּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעבְדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם כִּי בָרַח הָעָם וַיֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַב פַּרְעֹה וַעֲבָדָיו אֶל הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂינוּ כִּי שִׁלַּחְנוּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעבְדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And it was told to the king of Egypt that the people had
fled, and the heart of Pharaoh and his servants was
changed toward the people. And they said, “What is this
that we’ve done, that we let Israel go from serving us?!”

translation.text: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, the minds said, "What have we done, letting Israel leave our service?"

verses.english: And he hitched his chariot and took his people with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאְסֹר אֶת רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת עַמּוֹ לָקַח עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאְסֹר אֶת רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת עַמּוֹ לָקַח עִמּוֹ׃

english.text: And he hitched his chariot and took his people with him.

translation.text: So he had his chariot made ready, and took his army with him;

verses.english:
And he took six hundred chosen chariots—and all the
chariotry of Egypt—and officers over all of it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בָּחוּר וְכֹל רֶכֶב מִצְרָיִם וְשָׁלִשִׁם עַל כֻּלּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בָּחוּר וְכֹל רֶכֶב מִצְרָיִם וְשָׁלִשִׁם עַל כֻּלּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he took six hundred chosen chariots—and all the
chariotry of Egypt—and officers over all of it.

translation.text: he took six officers over all of them.

verses.english:
And YHWH strengthened the heart of Pharaoh, king of Egypt,
and he pursued the children of Israel. And the children of
Israel were going out with a high hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹצְאִים בְּיָד רָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹצְאִים בְּיָד רָמָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH strengthened the heart of Pharaoh, king of Egypt,
and he pursued the children of Israel. And the children of
Israel were going out with a high hand.

translation.text: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh boldly.

verses.english:
And Egypt pursued them, and they caught up to them,
camping by the sea—every chariot horse of Pharaoh and his
horsemen and his army—at Pi-Hahiroth, in front of
Baal-Zephon.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיַּשִּׂיגוּ אוֹתָם חֹנִים עַל הַיָּם כּל סוּס רֶכֶב פַּרְעֹה וּפָרָשָׁיו וְחֵילוֹ עַל פִּי הַחִירֹת לִפְנֵי בַּעַל צְפֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיַּשִּׂיגוּ אוֹתָם חֹנִים עַל הַיָּם כּל סוּס רֶכֶב פַּרְעֹה וּפָרָשָׁיו וְחֵילוֹ עַל פִּי הַחִירֹת לִפְנֵי בַּעַל צְפֹן׃

english.text:
And Egypt pursued them, and they caught up to them,
camping by the sea—every chariot horse of Pharaoh and his
horsemen and his army—at Pi-Hahiroth, in front of
Baal-Zephon.

translation.text: The Egyptians pursued them, all Pharaoh's horses and by the sea, by Pi-hahiroth, in front of Baal-zephon.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh came close! And the children of Israel raised
their eyes, and here was Egypt coming after them, and they
were very afraid. And the children of Israel cried out to
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּפַרְעֹה הִקְרִיב וַיִּשְׂאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם וְהִנֵּה מִצְרַיִם נֹסֵעַ אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּפַרְעֹה הִקְרִיב וַיִּשְׂאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם וְהִנֵּה מִצְרַיִם נֹסֵעַ אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh came close! And the children of Israel raised
their eyes, and here was Egypt coming after them, and they
were very afraid. And the children of Israel cried out to
YHWH.

translation.text: As Pharaoh drew near, the Israelites looked back, and there were the Egyptians advancing on them. In great fear the Israelites cried out to the LORD.

verses.english:
And they said to Moses, “Was it because of an
absence—none!—of graves in Egypt that you took us to die
in the wilderness?! What is this that you’ve done to us to
bring us out of Egypt?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין קְבָרִים בְּמִצְרַיִם לְקַחְתָּנוּ לָמוּת בַּמִּדְבָּר מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ לְהוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין קְבָרִים בְּמִצְרַיִם לְקַחְתָּנוּ לָמוּת בַּמִּדְבָּר מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ לְהוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they said to Moses, “Was it because of an
absence—none!—of graves in Egypt that you took us to die
in the wilderness?! What is this that you’ve done to us to
bring us out of Egypt?

translation.text: They said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you have taken us away to die in the wilderness? What have you done to us, bringing us out of Egypt?

verses.english:
Isn’t this the thing that we spoke to you in Egypt,
saying: Stop from us! And let’s serve Egypt. Because
serving Egypt is better for us than our dying in the
wilderness!”
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְמִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר חֲדַל מִמֶּנּוּ וְנַעַבְדָה אֶת מִצְרָיִם כִּי טוֹב לָנוּ עֲבֹד אֶת מִצְרַיִם מִמֻּתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְמִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר חֲדַל מִמֶּנּוּ וְנַעַבְדָה אֶת מִצְרָיִם כִּי טוֹב לָנוּ עֲבֹד אֶת מִצְרַיִם מִמֻּתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
Isn’t this the thing that we spoke to you in Egypt,
saying: Stop from us! And let’s serve Egypt. Because
serving Egypt is better for us than our dying in the
wilderness!”

translation.text: Is this not the Egyptians'? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness."

verses.english:
And Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand
still and see YHWH’s salvation that He’ll do for you
today. For, as you’ve seen Egypt today, you’ll never see
them again, ever.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם אַל תִּירָאוּ הִתְיַצְּבוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת יְשׁוּעַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה לָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם אֶת מִצְרַיִם הַיּוֹם לֹא תֹסִפוּ לִרְאֹתָם עוֹד עַד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם אַל תִּירָאוּ הִתְיַצְּבוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת יְשׁוּעַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה לָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם אֶת מִצְרַיִם הַיּוֹם לֹא תֹסִפוּ לִרְאֹתָם עוֹד עַד עוֹלָם׃
