I won’t drive them out from in front of you in one year,
or else the land will be a devastation, and the animal of
the field will be many at you.

translation.text: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, or against you.

verses.english:
Little by little I shall drive them out from in front of
you, until you will be fruitful, and you will have a
legacy of the land.
verses.hebrew: מְעַט מְעַט אֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר תִּפְרֶה וְנָחַלְתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: מְעַט מְעַט אֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר תִּפְרֶה וְנָחַלְתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Little by little I shall drive them out from in front of
you, until you will be fruitful, and you will have a
legacy of the land.

translation.text: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and possess the land.

verses.english:
And I shall set your border from the Red Sea to the sea of
the Philistines and from the wilderness to the river,
because I shall put the residents of the land in your
hand, and you’ll drive them out from in front of you.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׁתִּי אֶת גְּבֻלְךָ מִיַּם סוּף וְעַד יָם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמִמִּדְבָּר עַד הַנָּהָר כִּי אֶתֵּן בְּיֶדְכֶם אֵת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְגֵרַשְׁתָּמוֹ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׁתִּי אֶת גְּבֻלְךָ מִיַּם סוּף וְעַד יָם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמִמִּדְבָּר עַד הַנָּהָר כִּי אֶתֵּן בְּיֶדְכֶם אֵת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְגֵרַשְׁתָּמוֹ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And I shall set your border from the Red Sea to the sea of
the Philistines and from the wilderness to the river,
because I shall put the residents of the land in your
hand, and you’ll drive them out from in front of you.

translation.text: I will set your borders from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness land, and you shall drive them out before you.

verses.english:
You shall not make a covenant with them and with their
gods.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִכְרֹת לָהֶם וְלֵאלֹהֵיהֶם בְּרִית׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִכְרֹת לָהֶם וְלֵאלֹהֵיהֶם בְּרִית׃

english.text:
You shall not make a covenant with them and with their
gods.

translation.text: You shall make no covenant with them and their gods.

verses.english:
They shall not live in your land, in case they will make
you sin against me when you’ll serve their gods, because
it will be a trap for you.”
verses.hebrew: לֹא יֵשְׁבוּ בְּאַרְצְךָ פֶּן יַחֲטִיאוּ אֹתְךָ לִי כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי יִהְיֶה לְךָ לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יֵשְׁבוּ בְּאַרְצְךָ פֶּן יַחֲטִיאוּ אֹתְךָ לִי כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי יִהְיֶה לְךָ לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

english.text:
They shall not live in your land, in case they will make
you sin against me when you’ll serve their gods, because
it will be a trap for you.”

translation.text: They shall not live in your land, or they will make you sin against me; for if you worship their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.

verses.english:
And He said to Moses, “Come up to YHWH: you and Aaron,
Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders, and bow
from a distance.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל מֹשֶׁה אָמַר עֲלֵה אֶל יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא וְשִׁבְעִים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם מֵרָחֹק׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל מֹשֶׁה אָמַר עֲלֵה אֶל יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא וְשִׁבְעִים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם מֵרָחֹק׃

english.text:
And He said to Moses, “Come up to YHWH: you and Aaron,
Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders, and bow
from a distance.

translation.text: Then he said to Moses, "Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab, distance.

verses.english:
And Moses will come over alone to YHWH, and they shall not
come over, and the people shall not come up with him.”
verses.hebrew: וְנִגַּשׁ מֹשֶׁה לְבַדּוֹ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְהֵם לֹא יִגָּשׁוּ וְהָעָם לֹא יַעֲלוּ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִגַּשׁ מֹשֶׁה לְבַדּוֹ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְהֵם לֹא יִגָּשׁוּ וְהָעָם לֹא יַעֲלוּ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses will come over alone to YHWH, and they shall not
come over, and the people shall not come up with him.”

translation.text: Moses alone shall come near the LORD; but the others shall not come near, and the people shall not come up with him."

verses.english:
And Moses came and told the people all of YHWH’s words and
all the judgments. And all the people answered, one voice,
and they said, “We’ll do all the things that YHWH has
spoken.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיְסַפֵּר לָעָם אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה וְאֵת כּל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וַיַּעַן כּל הָעָם קוֹל אֶחָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיְסַפֵּר לָעָם אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה וְאֵת כּל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וַיַּעַן כּל הָעָם קוֹל אֶחָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And Moses came and told the people all of YHWH’s words and
all the judgments. And all the people answered, one voice,
and they said, “We’ll do all the things that YHWH has
spoken.”

translation.text: Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD and all the the words that the LORD has spoken we will do."

verses.english:
And Moses wrote all of YHWH’s words. And he got up early
in the morning and built an altar below the mountain and
twelve pillars for twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּבֶן מִזְבֵּחַ תַּחַת הָהָר וּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה מַצֵּבָה לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּבֶן מִזְבֵּחַ תַּחַת הָהָר וּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה מַצֵּבָה לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses wrote all of YHWH’s words. And he got up early
in the morning and built an altar below the mountain and
twelve pillars for twelve tribes of Israel.

translation.text: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. He rose early in the morning, and built corresponding to the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.english:
And he sent young men of the children of Israel, and they
made burnt offerings, and they made peace-offering
sacrifices to YHWH: bulls.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת נַעֲרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלֹת וַיִּזְבְּחוּ זְבָחִים שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת נַעֲרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלֹת וַיִּזְבְּחוּ זְבָחִים שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים׃

english.text:
And he sent young men of the children of Israel, and they
made burnt offerings, and they made peace-offering
sacrifices to YHWH: bulls.

translation.text: He sent young men of the people of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed oxen as offerings of well-being to the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses took half of the blood and set it in basins and
threw half of the blood on the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה חֲצִי הַדָּם וַיָּשֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹת וַחֲצִי הַדָּם זָרַק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה חֲצִי הַדָּם וַיָּשֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹת וַחֲצִי הַדָּם זָרַק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Moses took half of the blood and set it in basins and
threw half of the blood on the altar.

translation.text: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he dashed against the altar.

verses.english:
And he took the scroll of the covenant and read in the
people’s ears. And they said, “We’ll do everything that
YHWH has spoken, and we’ll listen.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית וַיִּקְרָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה נַעֲשֶׂה וְנִשְׁמָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית וַיִּקְרָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה נַעֲשֶׂה וְנִשְׁמָע׃

english.text:
And he took the scroll of the covenant and read in the
people’s ears. And they said, “We’ll do everything that
YHWH has spoken, and we’ll listen.”

translation.text: and we will be obedient."

verses.english:
And Moses took the blood and threw it on the people, and
he said, “Here is the blood of the covenant that YHWH has
made with you regarding all these things.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרֹק עַל הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה דַם הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם עַל כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרֹק עַל הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה דַם הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם עַל כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And Moses took the blood and threw it on the people, and
he said, “Here is the blood of the covenant that YHWH has
made with you regarding all these things.”

translation.text: Moses took the blood and dashed it on made with you in accordance with all these words."

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of
Israel’s elders went up.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא וְשִׁבְעִים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא וְשִׁבְעִים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of
Israel’s elders went up.

translation.text: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up,

verses.english:
And they saw the God of Israel. And below His feet it was like a
structure of sapphire brick and like the essence of the skies for
clarity.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֵת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתַחַת רַגְלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה לִבְנַת הַסַּפִּיר וּכְעֶצֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם לָטֹהַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֵת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתַחַת רַגְלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה לִבְנַת הַסַּפִּיר וּכְעֶצֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם לָטֹהַר׃

english.text:
And they saw the God of Israel. And below His feet it was like a
structure of sapphire brick and like the essence of the skies for
clarity.

translation.text: and they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet heaven for clearness.

verses.english:
And He did not put out His hand to the chiefs of the
children of Israel. And they envisioned God. And they ate
and drank.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל אֲצִילֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא שָׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיֶּחֱזוּ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל אֲצִילֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא שָׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיֶּחֱזוּ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ׃

english.text:
And He did not put out His hand to the chiefs of the
children of Israel. And they envisioned God. And they ate
and drank.

translation.text: God did not lay his hand on the chief men of the people of Israel; also they beheld God, and they ate and drank.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come up to me, to the mountain,
and be there, and I’ll give you stone tablets and the
instruction and the commandment that I’ve written to
instruct them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲלֵה אֵלַי הָהָרָה וֶהְיֵה שָׁם וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת לֻחֹת הָאֶבֶן וְהַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתִּי לְהוֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲלֵה אֵלַי הָהָרָה וֶהְיֵה שָׁם וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת לֻחֹת הָאֶבֶן וְהַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתִּי לְהוֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come up to me, to the mountain,
and be there, and I’ll give you stone tablets and the
instruction and the commandment that I’ve written to
instruct them.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain, and wait commandment, which I have written for their instruction."

verses.english:
And Moses and Joshua, his attendant, got up, and Moses
went up to the Mountain of God.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Moses and Joshua, his attendant, got up, and Moses
went up to the Mountain of God.

translation.text: So Moses of God.

verses.english:
And he said to the elders, “Sit for us here until we’ll
come back to you. And here, Aaron and Hur are with you.
Let whoever has any matters go over to them.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל הַזְּקֵנִים אָמַר שְׁבוּ לָנוּ בָזֶה עַד אֲשֶׁר נָשׁוּב אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִנֵּה אַהֲרֹן וְחוּר עִמָּכֶם מִי בַעַל דְּבָרִים יִגַּשׁ אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל הַזְּקֵנִים אָמַר שְׁבוּ לָנוּ בָזֶה עַד אֲשֶׁר נָשׁוּב אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִנֵּה אַהֲרֹן וְחוּר עִמָּכֶם מִי בַעַל דְּבָרִים יִגַּשׁ אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And he said to the elders, “Sit for us here until we’ll
come back to you. And here, Aaron and Hur are with you.
Let whoever has any matters go over to them.”

translation.text: To the elders he had said, "Wait here for us, until we come may go to them."

verses.english:
And Moses went up to the mountain. And the cloud covered
the mountain.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָהָר וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָהָר וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת הָהָר׃

english.text:
And Moses went up to the mountain. And the cloud covered
the mountain.

translation.text: Then Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

verses.english:
And YHWH’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud
covered it six days. And He called to Moses on the seventh
day from inside the cloud.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה עַל הַר סִינַי וַיְכַסֵּהוּ הֶעָנָן שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִתּוֹךְ הֶעָנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה עַל הַר סִינַי וַיְכַסֵּהוּ הֶעָנָן שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִתּוֹךְ הֶעָנָן׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud
covered it six days. And He called to Moses on the seventh
day from inside the cloud.

translation.text: The glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days; on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the cloud.

verses.english:
And the appearance of YHWH’s glory was like a consuming
fire in the mountaintop before the eyes of the children of
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּמַרְאֵה כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה כְּאֵשׁ אֹכֶלֶת בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּמַרְאֵה כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה כְּאֵשׁ אֹכֶלֶת בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the appearance of YHWH’s glory was like a consuming
fire in the mountaintop before the eyes of the children of
Israel.

translation.text: Now the appearance of the glory of the LORD was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the sight of the people of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses came inside the cloud and went up into the
mountain. And Moses was in the mountain forty days and
forty nights.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה בְּתוֹךְ הֶעָנָן וַיַּעַל אֶל הָהָר וַיְהִי מֹשֶׁה בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה בְּתוֹךְ הֶעָנָן וַיַּעַל אֶל הָהָר וַיְהִי מֹשֶׁה בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
And Moses came inside the cloud and went up into the
mountain. And Moses was in the mountain forty days and
forty nights.

translation.text: Moses entered the cloud, and went up on the mountain. Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel that they shall take a
donation for me. You shall take my donation from every man
whose heart will move him.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ לִי תְּרוּמָה מֵאֵת כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִדְּבֶנּוּ לִבּוֹ תִּקְחוּ אֶת תְּרוּמָתִי׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ לִי תְּרוּמָה מֵאֵת כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִדְּבֶנּוּ לִבּוֹ תִּקְחוּ אֶת תְּרוּמָתִי׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel that they shall take a
donation for me. You shall take my donation from every man
whose heart will move him.

translation.text: Tell the Israelites to take for me an offering; offering for me.

verses.english:
And this is the donation that you shall take from them:
gold and silver and bronze
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְחוּ מֵאִתָּם זָהָב וָכֶסֶף וּנְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְחוּ מֵאִתָּם זָהָב וָכֶסֶף וּנְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And this is the donation that you shall take from them:
gold and silver and bronze

translation.text: This is the offering that you shall receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,

verses.english: and blue and purple and scarlet and linen and goats’ hair
verses.hebrew: וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּים׃

english.text: and blue and purple and scarlet and linen and goats’ hair

translation.text: blue, purple, and crimson yarns and fine linen, goats' hair,

verses.english:
and rams’ skins dyed red and leather skins and acacia
wood,
verses.hebrew: וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים וַעֲצֵי שִׁטִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים וַעֲצֵי שִׁטִּים׃

english.text:
and rams’ skins dyed red and leather skins and acacia
wood,

translation.text: tanned rams' skins, fine leather, acacia wood,

verses.english:
oil for lighting, spices for the anointing oil and for the
incense fragrances,
verses.hebrew: שֶׁמֶן לַמָּאֹר בְּשָׂמִים לְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים׃

hebrew.text: שֶׁמֶן לַמָּאֹר בְּשָׂמִים לְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים׃

english.text:
oil for lighting, spices for the anointing oil and for the
incense fragrances,

translation.text: oil for the lamps, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,

verses.english:
onyx stones and stones to be set for the ephod and for the
breastplate.
verses.hebrew: אַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וְאַבְנֵי מִלֻּאִים לָאֵפֹד וְלַחֹשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: אַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וְאַבְנֵי מִלֻּאִים לָאֵפֹד וְלַחֹשֶׁן׃

english.text:
onyx stones and stones to be set for the ephod and for the
breastplate.

translation.text: onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and for the breastpiece.

verses.english:
And they shall make me a holy place, and I shall tent
among them.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשׂוּ לִי מִקְדָּשׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשׂוּ לִי מִקְדָּשׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
And they shall make me a holy place, and I shall tent
among them.

translation.text: And have them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them.

verses.english:
According to everything that I show you: the design of the
Tabernacle and the design of all its equipment. And you
shall do so.
verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מַרְאֶה אוֹתְךָ אֵת תַּבְנִית הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֵת תַּבְנִית כּל כֵּלָיו וְכֵן תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מַרְאֶה אוֹתְךָ אֵת תַּבְנִית הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֵת תַּבְנִית כּל כֵּלָיו וְכֵן תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
According to everything that I show you: the design of the
Tabernacle and the design of all its equipment. And you
shall do so.

translation.text: In accordance with all that I show you concerning the pattern of the tabernacle and of all its furniture, so you shall make it.

verses.english:
“And they shall make an ark of acacia wood, its length two
and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a half and its
height a cubit and a half.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשׂוּ אֲרוֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשׂוּ אֲרוֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And they shall make an ark of acacia wood, its length two
and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a half and its
height a cubit and a half.

translation.text: They shall make an ark of acacia wood; it shall be two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.english:
And you shall plate it with pure gold. You shall plate it
inside and outside. And you shall make a border of gold
all around on it.
verses.hebrew: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ תְּצַפֶּנּוּ וְעָשִׂיתָ עָלָיו זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ תְּצַפֶּנּוּ וְעָשִׂיתָ עָלָיו זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And you shall plate it with pure gold. You shall plate it
inside and outside. And you shall make a border of gold
all around on it.

translation.text: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it, and you shall make a molding of gold upon it all around.

verses.english:
And you shall cast four rings of gold for it and place
them on its four bases: and two rings on its one side and
two rings on its second side.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצַקְתָּ לּוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּה עַל אַרְבַּע פַּעֲמֹתָיו וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הָאֶחָת וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצַקְתָּ לּוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּה עַל אַרְבַּע פַּעֲמֹתָיו וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הָאֶחָת וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
And you shall cast four rings of gold for it and place
them on its four bases: and two rings on its one side and
two rings on its second side.

translation.text: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side.

verses.english:
And you shall make poles of acacia wood and plate them
with gold,
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב׃

english.text:
And you shall make poles of acacia wood and plate them
with gold,

translation.text: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.english:
and bring the poles through the rings on the ark’s sides,
in order to carry the ark with them.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת הָאָרֹן בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת הָאָרֹן בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
and bring the poles through the rings on the ark’s sides,
in order to carry the ark with them.

translation.text: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, by which to carry the ark.

verses.english:
The poles shall be in the ark’s rings; they shall not
depart from it.
verses.hebrew: בְּטַבְּעֹת הָאָרֹן יִהְיוּ הַבַּדִּים לֹא יָסֻרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּטַבְּעֹת הָאָרֹן יִהְיוּ הַבַּדִּים לֹא יָסֻרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
The poles shall be in the ark’s rings; they shall not
depart from it.

translation.text: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.

verses.english:
And you shall place in the ark the Testimony that I shall
give you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אֶל הָאָרֹן אֵת הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶל הָאָרֹן אֵת הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall place in the ark the Testimony that I shall
give you.

translation.text: You shall put into the ark the covenant that I shall give you.

verses.english:
And you shall make an atonement dais of pure gold, its
length two and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a
half.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ כַפֹּרֶת זָהָב טָהוֹר אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכָּהּ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ כַפֹּרֶת זָהָב טָהוֹר אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכָּהּ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבָּהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall make an atonement dais of pure gold, its
length two and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a
half.

translation.text: Then you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

verses.english:
And you shall make two cherubs of gold—you shall make them
of hammered work—at the two ends of the atonement dais.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁנַיִם כְּרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁנַיִם כְּרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
And you shall make two cherubs of gold—you shall make them
of hammered work—at the two ends of the atonement dais.

translation.text: You shall make two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.english:
And make one cherub at this end and one cherub at that
end. You shall make the cherubs from the atonement dais on
its two sides.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשֵׂה כְּרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה וּכְרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה מִן הַכַּפֹּרֶת תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשֵׂה כְּרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה וּכְרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה מִן הַכַּפֹּרֶת תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And make one cherub at this end and one cherub at that
end. You shall make the cherubs from the atonement dais on
its two sides.

translation.text: Make one cherub at the one end, and make the cherubim at its two ends.

verses.english:
And the two cherubs will be spreading wings above,
covering over the atonement dais with their wings, and
their faces each toward its brother: the cherubs’ faces
shall be toward the atonement dais.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הַכְּרֻבִים פֹּרְשֵׂי כְנָפַיִם לְמַעְלָה סֹכְכִים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וּפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו אֶל הַכַּפֹּרֶת יִהְיוּ פְּנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ הַכְּרֻבִים פֹּרְשֵׂי כְנָפַיִם לְמַעְלָה סֹכְכִים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וּפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו אֶל הַכַּפֹּרֶת יִהְיוּ פְּנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

english.text:
And the two cherubs will be spreading wings above,
covering over the atonement dais with their wings, and
their faces each toward its brother: the cherubs’ faces
shall be toward the atonement dais.

translation.text: The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings. turned toward the mercy seat.

verses.english:
And you shall place the atonement dais on the ark, from
above, and you shall place in the ark the Testimony that I
shall give you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה וְאֶל הָאָרֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה וְאֶל הָאָרֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall place the atonement dais on the ark, from
above, and you shall place in the ark the Testimony that I
shall give you.

translation.text: You shall put the mercy seat on the give you.

verses.english:
And I shall meet with you there and speak with you from
above the atonement dais, from between the two cherubs
that are on the Ark of the Testimony, everything that I
shall command you to the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְנוֹעַדְתִּי לְךָ שָׁם וְדִבַּרְתִּי אִתְּךָ מֵעַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת מִבֵּין שְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּה אוֹתְךָ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנוֹעַדְתִּי לְךָ שָׁם וְדִבַּרְתִּי אִתְּךָ מֵעַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת מִבֵּין שְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּה אוֹתְךָ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And I shall meet with you there and speak with you from
above the atonement dais, from between the two cherubs
that are on the Ark of the Testimony, everything that I
shall command you to the children of Israel.

translation.text: There I will meet with you, and from above the mercy seat, will deliver to you all my commands for the Israelites.

verses.english:
“And you shall make a table of acacia wood, its length two
cubits and its width a cubit and its height a cubit and a
half.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ שֻׁלְחָן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שֻׁלְחָן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a table of acacia wood, its length two
cubits and its width a cubit and its height a cubit and a
half.

translation.text: You shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.english:
And you shall plate it with pure gold and make a border of
gold all around for it
verses.hebrew: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And you shall plate it with pure gold and make a border of
gold all around for it

translation.text: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a molding of gold around it.

verses.english:
and make a rim of a handbreadth for it all around and make
a border of gold for its rim all around.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת טֹפַח סָבִיב וְעָשִׂיתָ זֵר זָהָב לְמִסְגַּרְתּוֹ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת טֹפַח סָבִיב וְעָשִׂיתָ זֵר זָהָב לְמִסְגַּרְתּוֹ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
and make a rim of a handbreadth for it all around and make
a border of gold for its rim all around.

translation.text: You shall make around it a rim a handbreadth wide, and a molding of gold around the rim.

verses.english:
And you shall make four rings of gold for it and put the
rings on the four corners that its four legs have.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall make four rings of gold for it and put the
rings on the four corners that its four legs have.

translation.text: four corners at its four legs.

verses.english:
The rings shall be in juxtaposition to the rim as housings
for the poles in order to carry the table.
verses.hebrew: לְעֻמַּת הַמִּסְגֶּרֶת תִּהְיֶיןָ הַטַּבָּעֹת לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

hebrew.text: לְעֻמַּת הַמִּסְגֶּרֶת תִּהְיֶיןָ הַטַּבָּעֹת לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

english.text:
The rings shall be in juxtaposition to the rim as housings
for the poles in order to carry the table.

translation.text: The rings that hold the poles used for carrying the table shall be close to the rim.

verses.english:
And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and plate them
with gold, and the table will be carried with them.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב וְנִשָּׂא בָם אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב וְנִשָּׂא בָם אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

english.text:
And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and plate them
with gold, and the table will be carried with them.

translation.text: You shall make the poles carried with these.

verses.english:
And you shall make its dishes and its pans and its jars
and its bowls with which libations will be poured. You
shall make them of pure gold.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ קְּעָרֹתָיו וְכַפֹּתָיו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן זָהָב טָהוֹר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קְּעָרֹתָיו וְכַפֹּתָיו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן זָהָב טָהוֹר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And you shall make its dishes and its pans and its jars
and its bowls with which libations will be poured. You
shall make them of pure gold.

translation.text: You shall make its plates and dishes for incense, and its flagons and bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.

verses.english:
And you shall place show bread on the table in front of me
always.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן לֶחֶם פָּנִים לְפָנַי תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן לֶחֶם פָּנִים לְפָנַי תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
And you shall place show bread on the table in front of me
always.

translation.text: And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me always.

verses.english:
“And you shall make a menorah of pure gold. The menorah
shall be made of hammered work—its shaft and its branch,
its cups, its ornaments, and its flowers shall be part of
it—
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ מְנֹרַת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה תֵּעָשֶׂה הַמְּנוֹרָה יְרֵכָהּ וְקָנָהּ גְּבִיעֶיהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מְנֹרַת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה תֵּעָשֶׂה הַמְּנוֹרָה יְרֵכָהּ וְקָנָהּ גְּבִיעֶיהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a menorah of pure gold. The menorah
shall be made of hammered work—its shaft and its branch,
its cups, its ornaments, and its flowers shall be part of
it—

translation.text: You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The base and the shaft of and its petals shall be of one piece with it;

verses.english:
and six branches coming out from its sides, three of the
menorah’s branches from its one side and three of the
menorah’s branches from its second side,
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁשָּׁה קָנִים יֹצְאִים מִצִּדֶּיהָ שְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁשָּׁה קָנִים יֹצְאִים מִצִּדֶּיהָ שְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
and six branches coming out from its sides, three of the
menorah’s branches from its one side and three of the
menorah’s branches from its second side,

translation.text: and there shall be six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of side of it;

verses.english:
three almond-shaped cups in the one branch, with ornament
and flower, and three almond-shaped cups in the other
branch, with ornament and flower. So it is for the six
branches that come out from the menorah,
verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפֶרַח וּשְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפָרַח כֵּן לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: שְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפֶרַח וּשְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפָרַח כֵּן לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָה׃

english.text:
three almond-shaped cups in the one branch, with ornament
and flower, and three almond-shaped cups in the other
branch, with ornament and flower. So it is for the six
branches that come out from the menorah,

translation.text: three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx six branches going out of the lampstand.

verses.english:
and four almond-shaped cups within the menorah, with its
ornaments and its flowers,
verses.hebrew: וּבַמְּנֹרָה אַרְבָּעָה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַמְּנֹרָה אַרְבָּעָה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ׃

english.text:
and four almond-shaped cups within the menorah, with its
ornaments and its flowers,

translation.text: On the lampstand itself calyxes and petals.

verses.english:
and an ornament under the two branches from it, and an
ornament under the two branches from it, and an ornament
under the two branches from it, for the six branches that
come out from the menorah.
verses.hebrew: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָה׃

english.text:
and an ornament under the two branches from it, and an
ornament under the two branches from it, and an ornament
under the two branches from it, for the six branches that
come out from the menorah.

translation.text: There shall be a calyx of one piece with it under the first pair of branches, a calyx of one piece with it under the next pair of branches, and a calyx of one piece with it under the last pair of branches — so for the six branches that go out of the lampstand.

verses.english:
Their ornaments and their branches shall be part of it,
all of it one hammered work of pure gold.
verses.hebrew: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם וּקְנֹתָם מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ כֻּלָּהּ מִקְשָׁה אַחַת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם וּקְנֹתָם מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ כֻּלָּהּ מִקְשָׁה אַחַת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
Their ornaments and their branches shall be part of it,
all of it one hammered work of pure gold.

translation.text: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it, the whole of it one hammered piece of pure gold.

verses.english:
And you shall make its lamps seven, and it will hold up
its lamps and light the area in front of it.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה וְהֶעֱלָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְהֵאִיר עַל עֵבֶר פָּנֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה וְהֶעֱלָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְהֵאִיר עַל עֵבֶר פָּנֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And you shall make its lamps seven, and it will hold up
its lamps and light the area in front of it.

translation.text: You shall make the seven space in front of it.

verses.english: And its tongs and its fire-holders of pure gold.
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְקָחֶיהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶיהָ זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְקָחֶיהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶיהָ זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text: And its tongs and its fire-holders of pure gold.

translation.text: Its snuffers and trays shall be of pure gold.

verses.english:
He shall make it—all of these items—of a talent of pure
gold.
verses.hebrew: כִּכָּר זָהָב טָהוֹר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ אֵת כּל הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּכָּר זָהָב טָהוֹר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ אֵת כּל הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
He shall make it—all of these items—of a talent of pure
gold.

translation.text: It, and all these utensils, shall be made from a talent of pure gold.

verses.english:
And see and make them by their design that you are shown
in the mountain.
verses.hebrew: וּרְאֵה וַעֲשֵׂה בְּתַבְנִיתָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה מרְאֶה בָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וּרְאֵה וַעֲשֵׂה בְּתַבְנִיתָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה מרְאֶה בָּהָר׃

english.text:
And see and make them by their design that you are shown
in the mountain.

translation.text: And being shown you on the mountain.

verses.english:
“And you shall make the Tabernacle with ten curtains of
woven linen and blue and purple and scarlet, with
cherubs—you shall make them designer’s work.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן תַּעֲשֶׂה עֶשֶׂר יְרִיעֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתֹלַעַת שָׁנִי כְּרֻבִים מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן תַּעֲשֶׂה עֶשֶׂר יְרִיעֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתֹלַעַת שָׁנִי כְּרֻבִים מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“And you shall make the Tabernacle with ten curtains of
woven linen and blue and purple and scarlet, with
cherubs—you shall make them designer’s work.

translation.text: Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine them with cherubim skillfully worked into them.

verses.english:
The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight in cubits,
and the width of one curtain four in cubits: one size to
all the curtains.
verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁמֹנֶה וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּאַמָּה וְרֹחַב אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְכל הַיְרִיעֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁמֹנֶה וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּאַמָּה וְרֹחַב אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְכל הַיְרִיעֹת׃

english.text:
The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight in cubits,
and the width of one curtain four in cubits: one size to
all the curtains.

translation.text: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall be of the same size.

verses.english:
Five curtains will be connected, each to its sister-piece,
and five curtains connected, each to its sister-piece.
verses.hebrew: חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת תִּהְיֶיןָ חֹבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ וְחָמֵשׁ יְרִיעֹת חֹבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת תִּהְיֶיןָ חֹבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ וְחָמֵשׁ יְרִיעֹת חֹבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
Five curtains will be connected, each to its sister-piece,
and five curtains connected, each to its sister-piece.

translation.text: Five curtains shall be one another.

verses.english:
And you shall make loops of blue on the side of the one
curtain at the end of the connected group, and you shall
do so in the side of the end curtain in the second
connected group.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לֻלְאֹת תְּכֵלֶת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִקָּצָה בַּחֹבָרֶת וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּשְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לֻלְאֹת תְּכֵלֶת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִקָּצָה בַּחֹבָרֶת וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּשְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
And you shall make loops of blue on the side of the one
curtain at the end of the connected group, and you shall
do so in the side of the end curtain in the second
connected group.

translation.text: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set; and likewise you shall make loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.

verses.english:
You shall make fifty loops in the end of the curtain that
is in the second connected group, with the loops parallel:
each to its sister-piece.
verses.hebrew: חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה בַּיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּקְצֵה הַיְרִיעָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית מַקְבִּילֹת הַלֻּלָאֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה בַּיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּקְצֵה הַיְרִיעָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית מַקְבִּילֹת הַלֻּלָאֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
You shall make fifty loops in the end of the curtain that
is in the second connected group, with the loops parallel:
each to its sister-piece.

translation.text: You shall make edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another.

verses.english:
And you shall make fifty clasps of gold and connect the
curtains, each to its sister-piece, with the clasps. And
the Tabernacle will be one.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֲמִשִּׁים קַרְסֵי זָהָב וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת הַיְרִיעֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ בַּקְּרָסִים וְהָיָה הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֲמִשִּׁים קַרְסֵי זָהָב וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת הַיְרִיעֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ בַּקְּרָסִים וְהָיָה הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And you shall make fifty clasps of gold and connect the
curtains, each to its sister-piece, with the clasps. And
the Tabernacle will be one.

translation.text: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and join the curtains whole.

verses.english:
“And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent
over the Tabernacle. You shall make them eleven curtains.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ יְרִיעֹת עִזִּים לְאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ יְרִיעֹת עִזִּים לְאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent
over the Tabernacle. You shall make them eleven curtains.

translation.text: You shall also make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; you shall make eleven curtains.

verses.english:
The length of one curtain shall be thirty in cubits, and
the width of one curtain four in cubits: one size for
eleven curtains.
verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה וְרֹחַב אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְעַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה וְרֹחַב אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְעַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת׃

english.text:
The length of one curtain shall be thirty in cubits, and
the width of one curtain four in cubits: one size for
eleven curtains.

translation.text: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains shall be of the same size.

verses.english:
And you shall connect five of the curtains by themselves
and six of the curtains by themselves. And you shall
double-fold the sixth curtain opposite the front of the
tent.
verses.hebrew: וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְאֶת שֵׁשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְכָפַלְתָּ אֶת הַיְרִיעָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְאֶת שֵׁשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְכָפַלְתָּ אֶת הַיְרִיעָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
And you shall connect five of the curtains by themselves
and six of the curtains by themselves. And you shall
double-fold the sixth curtain opposite the front of the
tent.

translation.text: You shall join five curtain you shall double over at the front of the tent.

verses.english:
And you shall make fifty loops on the side of the one end
curtain in the connected group and fifty loops on the side
of the curtain of the second connected group.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת הַקִּיצֹנָה בַּחֹבָרֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַחֹבֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת הַקִּיצֹנָה בַּחֹבָרֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַחֹבֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
And you shall make fifty loops on the side of the one end
curtain in the connected group and fifty loops on the side
of the curtain of the second connected group.

translation.text: You shall set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.

verses.english:
And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze and bring the
clasps into the loops and connect the tent. And it will be
one.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְסֵי נְחֹשֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁים וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַקְּרָסִים בַּלֻּלָאֹת וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְסֵי נְחֹשֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁים וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַקְּרָסִים בַּלֻּלָאֹת וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze and bring the
clasps into the loops and connect the tent. And it will be
one.

translation.text: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and join the tent together, so that it may be one whole.

verses.english:
And the hanging one that is left over among the tent’s
curtains: you shall hang half of the leftover curtain on
the back parts of the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וְסֶרַח הָעֹדֵף בִּירִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל חֲצִי הַיְרִיעָה הָעֹדֶפֶת תִּסְרַח עַל אֲחֹרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְסֶרַח הָעֹדֵף בִּירִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל חֲצִי הַיְרִיעָה הָעֹדֶפֶת תִּסְרַח עַל אֲחֹרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And the hanging one that is left over among the tent’s
curtains: you shall hang half of the leftover curtain on
the back parts of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: The remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And the cubit on this side and the cubit on that side in
the leftover in the length of the tent’s curtains shall be
hung on the sides of the Tabernacle, on this side and on
that side, to cover it.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאַמָּה מִזֶּה וְהָאַמָּה מִזֶּה בָּעֹדֵף בְּאֹרֶךְ יְרִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל יִהְיֶה סָרוּחַ עַל צִדֵּי הַמִּשְׁכָּן מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לְכַסֹּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאַמָּה מִזֶּה וְהָאַמָּה מִזֶּה בָּעֹדֵף בְּאֹרֶךְ יְרִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל יִהְיֶה סָרוּחַ עַל צִדֵּי הַמִּשְׁכָּן מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לְכַסֹּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And the cubit on this side and the cubit on that side in
the leftover in the length of the tent’s curtains shall be
hung on the sides of the Tabernacle, on this side and on
that side, to cover it.

translation.text: The cubit on the tabernacle, on this side and that side, to cover it.

verses.english:
And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins
dyed red and a covering of leather skins above.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִכְסֶה לָאֹהֶל עֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וּמִכְסֵה עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים מִלְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִכְסֶה לָאֹהֶל עֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וּמִכְסֵה עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים מִלְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins
dyed red and a covering of leather skins above.

translation.text: You shall make for the tent a covering of tanned rams' skins and an outer covering of fine leather.

verses.english:
“And you shall make the frames for the Tabernacle of
acacia wood, standing.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים עֹמְדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים עֹמְדִים׃

english.text:
“And you shall make the frames for the Tabernacle of
acacia wood, standing.

translation.text: You shall make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

verses.english:
The frame’s length shall be ten cubits, and the width of
one frame a cubit and a half cubit.
verses.hebrew: עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ הַקָּרֶשׁ וְאַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה רֹחַב הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ הַקָּרֶשׁ וְאַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה רֹחַב הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
The frame’s length shall be ten cubits, and the width of
one frame a cubit and a half cubit.

translation.text: width of each frame.

verses.english:
One frame has two projections, each aligned with its
sister-piece: so you shall make for all the Tabernacle’s
frames.
verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵּי יָדוֹת לַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד מְשֻׁלָּבֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: שְׁתֵּי יָדוֹת לַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד מְשֻׁלָּבֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
One frame has two projections, each aligned with its
sister-piece: so you shall make for all the Tabernacle’s
frames.

translation.text: There shall be two pegs in each frame to fit the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And you shall make the frames for the Tabernacle: twenty
frames for the south side—to the south.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשְׂרִים קֶרֶשׁ לִפְאַת נֶגְבָּה תֵימָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשְׂרִים קֶרֶשׁ לִפְאַת נֶגְבָּה תֵימָנָה׃

english.text:
And you shall make the frames for the Tabernacle: twenty
frames for the south side—to the south.

translation.text: You shall make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side;

verses.english:
And you shall make forty bases of silver under the twenty
frames: two bases under one frame for its two projections
and two bases under each other frame for its two
projections.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵי כֶסֶף תַּעֲשֶׂה תַּחַת עֶשְׂרִים הַקָּרֶשׁ שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵי כֶסֶף תַּעֲשֶׂה תַּחַת עֶשְׂרִים הַקָּרֶשׁ שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall make forty bases of silver under the twenty
frames: two bases under one frame for its two projections
and two bases under each other frame for its two
projections.

translation.text: and you shall make forty bases of silver pegs, and two bases under the next frame for its two pegs;

verses.english:
And for the Tabernacle’s second side, for the north side:
twenty frames
verses.hebrew: וּלְצֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית לִפְאַת צָפוֹן עֶשְׂרִים קָרֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְצֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית לִפְאַת צָפוֹן עֶשְׂרִים קָרֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And for the Tabernacle’s second side, for the north side:
twenty frames

translation.text: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side twenty frames,

verses.english:
and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame
and two bases under each other frame.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵיהֶם כָּסֶף שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵיהֶם כָּסֶף שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame
and two bases under each other frame.

translation.text: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under the first frame, and two bases under the next frame;

verses.english:
And for the rear of the Tabernacle, to the west, you shall
make six frames.
verses.hebrew: וּלְיַרְכְּתֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה שִׁשָּׁה קְרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּלְיַרְכְּתֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה שִׁשָּׁה קְרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And for the rear of the Tabernacle, to the west, you shall
make six frames.

translation.text: and for the rear of the tabernacle westward you shall make six frames.

verses.english:
And you shall make two frames for the Tabernacle’s corners
in the rear,
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵי קְרָשִׁים תַּעֲשֶׂה לִמְקֻצְעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן בַּיַּרְכָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁנֵי קְרָשִׁים תַּעֲשֶׂה לִמְקֻצְעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן בַּיַּרְכָתָיִם׃

english.text:
And you shall make two frames for the Tabernacle’s corners
in the rear,

translation.text: You shall make two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear;

verses.english:
and they shall be doubles from below, and together they
shall be integrated on its top to one ring. It shall be so
for the two of them; they will be for the two corners.
verses.hebrew: וְיִהְיוּ תֹאֲמִם מִלְּמַטָּה וְיַחְדָּו יִהְיוּ תַמִּים עַל רֹאשׁוֹ אֶל הַטַּבַּעַת הָאֶחָת כֵּן יִהְיֶה לִשְׁנֵיהֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמִּקְצֹעֹת יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִהְיוּ תֹאֲמִם מִלְּמַטָּה וְיַחְדָּו יִהְיוּ תַמִּים עַל רֹאשׁוֹ אֶל הַטַּבַּעַת הָאֶחָת כֵּן יִהְיֶה לִשְׁנֵיהֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמִּקְצֹעֹת יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
and they shall be doubles from below, and together they
shall be integrated on its top to one ring. It shall be so
for the two of them; they will be for the two corners.

translation.text: they shall be separate beneath, but joined at the top, at the first ring; it shall be the same with both of them; they shall form the two corners.

verses.english:
And they shall be eight frames and their bases of silver,
sixteen bases, two bases under one frame and two bases
under each other frame.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ שְׁמֹנָה קְרָשִׁים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֲדָנִים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ שְׁמֹנָה קְרָשִׁים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֲדָנִים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And they shall be eight frames and their bases of silver,
sixteen bases, two bases under one frame and two bases
under each other frame.

translation.text: And so there shall be eight first frame, and two bases under the next frame.

verses.english:
And you shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the
frames of one side of the Tabernacle
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ בְרִיחִם עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חֲמִשָּׁה לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בְרִיחִם עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חֲמִשָּׁה לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And you shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the
frames of one side of the Tabernacle

translation.text: You shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.english:
and five bars for the frames of the second side of the
Tabernacle and five bars for the frames of the side of the
Tabernacle at the rear, to the west,
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן לַיַּרְכָתַיִם יָמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן לַיַּרְכָתַיִם יָמָּה׃

english.text:
and five bars for the frames of the second side of the
Tabernacle and five bars for the frames of the side of the
Tabernacle at the rear, to the west,

translation.text: and five bars for the frames of the other side tabernacle at the rear westward.

verses.english:
and the middle bar through the frames extending from end
to end.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים מַבְרִחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים מַבְרִחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה׃

english.text:
and the middle bar through the frames extending from end
to end.

translation.text: The middle bar, halfway up the frames, shall pass through from end to end.

verses.english:
And you shall plate the frames with gold, and you shall
make their rings gold, housings for the bars, and you
shall plate the bars with gold.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים תְּצַפֶּה זָהָב וְאֶת טַבְּעֹתֵיהֶם תַּעֲשֶׂה זָהָב בָּתִּים לַבְּרִיחִם וְצִפִּיתָ אֶת הַבְּרִיחִם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים תְּצַפֶּה זָהָב וְאֶת טַבְּעֹתֵיהֶם תַּעֲשֶׂה זָהָב בָּתִּים לַבְּרִיחִם וְצִפִּיתָ אֶת הַבְּרִיחִם זָהָב׃

english.text:
And you shall plate the frames with gold, and you shall
make their rings gold, housings for the bars, and you
shall plate the bars with gold.

translation.text: You shall overlay the frames with gold, and shall make their rings of gold to hold the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.

verses.english:
And you shall set up the Tabernacle according to the model
of it that you were shown in the mountain.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ אֲשֶׁר הרְאֵיתָ בָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ אֲשֶׁר הרְאֵיתָ בָּהָר׃

english.text:
And you shall set up the Tabernacle according to the model
of it that you were shown in the mountain.

translation.text: Then you shall erect the mountain.

verses.english:
“And you shall make a pavilion of blue and purple and
scarlet and woven linen; he shall make them designer’s
work with cherubs.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ פָרֹכֶת תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ כְּרֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ פָרֹכֶת תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ כְּרֻבִים׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a pavilion of blue and purple and
scarlet and woven linen; he shall make them designer’s
work with cherubs.

translation.text: You shall make a curtain of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen; it shall be made with cherubim skillfully worked into it.

verses.english:
And you shall place it on four acacia columns plated with
gold, their hooks of gold, on four bases of silver.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ עַל אַרְבָּעָה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים מְצֻפִּים זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב עַל אַרְבָּעָה אַדְנֵי כָסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ עַל אַרְבָּעָה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים מְצֻפִּים זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב עַל אַרְבָּעָה אַדְנֵי כָסֶף׃

english.text:
And you shall place it on four acacia columns plated with
gold, their hooks of gold, on four bases of silver.

translation.text: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, which have hooks of gold and rest on four bases of silver.

verses.english:
And you shall place the pavilion under the clasps. And you
shall bring the Ark of the Testimony there, inside the
pavilion, and the pavilion will distinguish for you
between the Holy and the Holy of Holies.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת תַּחַת הַקְּרָסִים וְהֵבֵאתָ שָׁמָּה מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְהִבְדִּילָה הַפָּרֹכֶת לָכֶם בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת תַּחַת הַקְּרָסִים וְהֵבֵאתָ שָׁמָּה מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְהִבְדִּילָה הַפָּרֹכֶת לָכֶם בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And you shall place the pavilion under the clasps. And you
shall bring the Ark of the Testimony there, inside the
pavilion, and the pavilion will distinguish for you
between the Holy and the Holy of Holies.

translation.text: You shall hang the curtain under the clasps, and bring the ark of the covenant in holy place from the most holy.

verses.english:
And you shall place the atonement dais on the Ark of the
Testimony in the Holy of Holies.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת בְּקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת בְּקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And you shall place the atonement dais on the Ark of the
Testimony in the Holy of Holies.

translation.text: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

verses.english:
And you shall place the table outside the pavilion, and
the menorah opposite the table on the south side of the
Tabernacle, and you shall place the table on the north
side.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן תֵּימָנָה וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן תִּתֵּן עַל צֶלַע צָפוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן תֵּימָנָה וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן תִּתֵּן עַל צֶלַע צָפוֹן׃

english.text:
And you shall place the table outside the pavilion, and
the menorah opposite the table on the south side of the
Tabernacle, and you shall place the table on the north
side.

translation.text: You shall set the table tabernacle opposite the table; and you shall put the table on the north side.

verses.english:
“And you shall make a cover for the entrance of the tent:
blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen—embroiderer’s
work.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ מָסָךְ לְפֶתַח הָאֹהֶל תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מָסָךְ לְפֶתַח הָאֹהֶל תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a cover for the entrance of the tent:
blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen—embroiderer’s
work.

translation.text: You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue, needlework.

verses.english:
And you shall make five acacia columns for the cover and
plate them with gold, their hooks of gold, and cast five
bases of bronze for them.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לַמָּסָךְ חֲמִשָּׁה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב וְיָצַקְתָּ לָהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה אַדְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לַמָּסָךְ חֲמִשָּׁה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב וְיָצַקְתָּ לָהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה אַדְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make five acacia columns for the cover and
plate them with gold, their hooks of gold, and cast five
bases of bronze for them.

translation.text: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.

verses.english:
“And you shall make the altar of acacia wood. Five
cubits long and five cubits wide, the altar shall be
square—and its height three cubits.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת רֹחַב רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת רֹחַב רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall make the altar of acacia wood. Five
cubits long and five cubits wide, the altar shall be
square—and its height three cubits.

translation.text: You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and it shall be three cubits high.

verses.english:
And you shall make its horns on its four corners. Its
horns shall be part of it. And you shall plate it with
bronze.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ תִּהְיֶיןָ קַרְנֹתָיו וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ תִּהְיֶיןָ קַרְנֹתָיו וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make its horns on its four corners. Its
horns shall be part of it. And you shall plate it with
bronze.

translation.text: You shall make horns for it on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with bronze.

verses.english:
And you shall make its pots to remove ashes from it, and
its shovels and its basins and its forks and its
fire-holders. You shall make all of its equipment bronze.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ סִּירֹתָיו לְדַשְּׁנוֹ וְיָעָיו וּמִזְרְקֹתָיו וּמִזְלְגֹתָיו וּמַחְתֹּתָיו לְכל כֵּלָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ סִּירֹתָיו לְדַשְּׁנוֹ וְיָעָיו וּמִזְרְקֹתָיו וּמִזְלְגֹתָיו וּמַחְתֹּתָיו לְכל כֵּלָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make its pots to remove ashes from it, and
its shovels and its basins and its forks and its
fire-holders. You shall make all of its equipment bronze.

translation.text: You shall make firepans; you shall make all its utensils of bronze.

verses.english:
And you shall make a grate for it, a network of bronze,
and on the net you shall make four rings of bronze on its
four ends.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הָרֶשֶׁת אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל אַרְבַּע קְצוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הָרֶשֶׁת אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל אַרְבַּע קְצוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall make a grate for it, a network of bronze,
and on the net you shall make four rings of bronze on its
four ends.

translation.text: You shall also make four bronze rings at its four corners.

verses.english:
And you shall place it under the altar’s ledge below so
that the net will be up to the middle of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ תַּחַת כַּרְכֹּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּמָטָּה וְהָיְתָה הָרֶשֶׁת עַד חֲצִי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ תַּחַת כַּרְכֹּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּמָטָּה וְהָיְתָה הָרֶשֶׁת עַד חֲצִי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And you shall place it under the altar’s ledge below so
that the net will be up to the middle of the altar.

translation.text: You shall set it under the ledge of the altar so that the net shall extend halfway down the altar.

verses.english:
And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia
wood, and plate them with bronze.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדִּים לַמִּזְבֵּחַ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדִּים לַמִּזְבֵּחַ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia
wood, and plate them with bronze.

translation.text: You with bronze;

verses.english:
And its poles shall be brought through rings so that the
poles shall be on the altar’s two sides when carrying it.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּבָא אֶת בַּדָּיו בַּטַּבָּעֹת וְהָיוּ הַבַּדִּים עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּשְׂאֵת אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּבָא אֶת בַּדָּיו בַּטַּבָּעֹת וְהָיוּ הַבַּדִּים עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּשְׂאֵת אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And its poles shall be brought through rings so that the
poles shall be on the altar’s two sides when carrying it.

translation.text: the poles shall be put through the rings, so that the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

verses.english:
You shall make it hollow of boards, as it was shown to you
in the mountain. They shall do it so.
verses.hebrew: נְבוּב לֻחֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה אֹתְךָ בָּהָר כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: נְבוּב לֻחֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה אֹתְךָ בָּהָר כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
You shall make it hollow of boards, as it was shown to you
in the mountain. They shall do it so.

translation.text: You shown on the mountain.

verses.english:
“And you shall make the Tabernacle’s courtyard: for the
south side—to the south, hangings for the courtyard of
woven linen, one side having a hundred in cubits,
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֵת חֲצַר הַמִּשְׁכָּן לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קְלָעִים לֶחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ לַפֵּאָה הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֵת חֲצַר הַמִּשְׁכָּן לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קְלָעִים לֶחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ לַפֵּאָה הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
“And you shall make the Tabernacle’s courtyard: for the
south side—to the south, hangings for the courtyard of
woven linen, one side having a hundred in cubits,

translation.text: You shall make the court of the tabernacle. On the south side the court shall have hangings of fine twisted linen one hundred cubits long for that side;

verses.english:
and its columns twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze,
and the columns’ hooks and their rods of silver.
verses.hebrew: וְעַמֻּדָיו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְעַמֻּדָיו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
and its columns twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze,
and the columns’ hooks and their rods of silver.

translation.text: its twenty pillars and their twenty bases shall be of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.

verses.english:
And so for the north side: in length, hangings of a
hundred long, and its columns twenty, and their bases
twenty of bronze, and the columns’ hooks and their bands
of silver.
verses.hebrew: וְכֵן לִפְאַת צָפוֹן בָּאֹרֶךְ קְלָעִים מֵאָה אֹרֶךְ וְעַמֻּדָו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן לִפְאַת צָפוֹן בָּאֹרֶךְ קְלָעִים מֵאָה אֹרֶךְ וְעַמֻּדָו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And so for the north side: in length, hangings of a
hundred long, and its columns twenty, and their bases
twenty of bronze, and the columns’ hooks and their bands
of silver.

translation.text: bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s width for the west side: hangings of
fifty cubits, their columns ten and their bases ten.
verses.hebrew: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s width for the west side: hangings of
fifty cubits, their columns ten and their bases ten.

translation.text: For the width of the court on the west side there shall be fifty cubits of hangings, with ten pillars and ten bases.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s width for the east side—to the
east—fifty cubits.
verses.hebrew: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s width for the east side—to the
east—fifty cubits.

translation.text: The width of the court on the front to the east shall be fifty cubits.

verses.english:
And the panel shall have fifteen cubits of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three;
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קְלָעִים לַכָּתֵף עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קְלָעִים לַכָּתֵף עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
And the panel shall have fifteen cubits of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three;

translation.text: There shall be fifteen cubits of hangings on the one side, with three pillars and three bases.

verses.english:
and the second panel shall have fifteen of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three.
verses.hebrew: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה קְלָעִים עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה קְלָעִים עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
and the second panel shall have fifteen of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three.

translation.text: There shall be fifteen cubits of hangings on the other side, with three pillars and three bases.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s gate shall have a cover of twenty
cubits: blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen,
embroiderer’s work, their columns four and their bases
four.
verses.hebrew: וּלְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר מָסָךְ עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם עַמֻּדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר מָסָךְ עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם עַמֻּדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s gate shall have a cover of twenty
cubits: blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen,
embroiderer’s work, their columns four and their bases
four.

translation.text: For the gate of the court there shall be a pillars and with them four bases.

verses.english:
All of the courtyard’s columns all around shall be banded
with silver, their hooks of silver and their bases bronze.
verses.hebrew: כּל עַמּוּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף וָוֵיהֶם כָּסֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: כּל עַמּוּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף וָוֵיהֶם כָּסֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
All of the courtyard’s columns all around shall be banded
with silver, their hooks of silver and their bases bronze.

translation.text: All the pillars around the court bases of bronze.

verses.english:
The courtyard’s length a hundred in cubits, and width
consistently fifty, and height five cubits of woven linen,
and their bases of bronze.
verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ הֶחָצֵר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה וְרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וְקֹמָה חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: אֹרֶךְ הֶחָצֵר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה וְרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וְקֹמָה חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
The courtyard’s length a hundred in cubits, and width
consistently fifty, and height five cubits of woven linen,
and their bases of bronze.

translation.text: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, the width fifty, and the height five cubits, with hangings of fine twisted linen and bases of bronze.

verses.english:
For all of the Tabernacle’s equipment in all of the
service of it, and all of its pegs and all of the
courtyard’s pegs: bronze.
verses.hebrew: לְכֹל כְּלֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן בְּכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְכל יְתֵדֹתָיו וְכל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: לְכֹל כְּלֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן בְּכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְכל יְתֵדֹתָיו וְכל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
For all of the Tabernacle’s equipment in all of the
service of it, and all of its pegs and all of the
courtyard’s pegs: bronze.

translation.text: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court, shall be of bronze.

verses.english:
COMMAND “And you: you shall command the children of Israel
that they shall bring clear pressed olive oil to you for
the light, to keep up a lamp always.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
COMMAND “And you: you shall command the children of Israel
that they shall bring clear pressed olive oil to you for
the light, to keep up a lamp always.

translation.text: You shall further command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of regularly.

verses.english:
In the Tent of Meeting, outside the pavilion that is over
the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from
evening until morning in front of YHWH, an eternal law
through their generations from the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
In the Tent of Meeting, outside the pavilion that is over
the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from
evening until morning in front of YHWH, an eternal law
through their generations from the children of Israel.

translation.text: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that is before throughout their generations by the Israelites.

verses.english:
“And you, bring Aaron, your brother, forward to you,
and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel,
for him to function as a priest for me: Aaron, Nadab and
Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה הַקְרֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה הַקְרֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
“And you, bring Aaron, your brother, forward to you,
and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel,
for him to function as a priest for me: Aaron, Nadab and
Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

translation.text: Then bring near to you your brother Aaron, and his sons with him, sons, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.english:
And you shall make holy clothes for Aaron, your brother, for glory
and for beauty.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת׃

english.text:
And you shall make holy clothes for Aaron, your brother, for glory
and for beauty.

translation.text: You shall make sacred vestments for the glorious adornment of your brother Aaron.

verses.english:
And you shall speak to all the wise of heart whom I have
filled with a spirit of wisdom, that they shall make
Aaron’s clothes, to sanctify him for him to function as a
priest for me.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תְּדַבֵּר אֶל כּל חַכְמֵי לֵב אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאתִיו רוּחַ חכְמָה וְעָשׂוּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי אַהֲרֹן לְקַדְּשׁוֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תְּדַבֵּר אֶל כּל חַכְמֵי לֵב אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאתִיו רוּחַ חכְמָה וְעָשׂוּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי אַהֲרֹן לְקַדְּשׁוֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall speak to all the wise of heart whom I have
filled with a spirit of wisdom, that they shall make
Aaron’s clothes, to sanctify him for him to function as a
priest for me.

translation.text: And priesthood.

verses.english:
And these are the clothes that they shall make:
breastplate and ephod and robe and patterned coat, a
headdress and a sash. And they shall make holy clothes for
Aaron, your brother, and for his sons, for him to function
as a priest for me.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַבְּגָדִים אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ חֹשֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד וּמְעִיל וּכְתֹנֶת תַּשְׁבֵּץ מִצְנֶפֶת וְאַבְנֵט וְעָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וּלְבָנָיו לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַבְּגָדִים אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ חֹשֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד וּמְעִיל וּכְתֹנֶת תַּשְׁבֵּץ מִצְנֶפֶת וְאַבְנֵט וְעָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וּלְבָנָיו לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

english.text:
And these are the clothes that they shall make:
breastplate and ephod and robe and patterned coat, a
headdress and a sash. And they shall make holy clothes for
Aaron, your brother, and for his sons, for him to function
as a priest for me.

translation.text: These are the vestments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a checkered tunic, a turban, and a sash. his sons to serve me as priests,

verses.english:
And they shall take the gold and the blue and the purple
and the scarlet and the linen.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵם יִקְחוּ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָאַרְגָּמָן וְאֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּׁשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵם יִקְחוּ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָאַרְגָּמָן וְאֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּׁשׁ׃

english.text:
And they shall take the gold and the blue and the purple
and the scarlet and the linen.

translation.text: they shall use gold, blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and fine linen.

verses.english:
“And they shall make the ephod: gold, blue, and purple,
scarlet, and woven linen, designer’s work.
