verses.hebrew: וְעָשׂוּ אֶת הָאֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשׂוּ אֶת הָאֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב׃

english.text:
“And they shall make the ephod: gold, blue, and purple,
scarlet, and woven linen, designer’s work.

translation.text: They shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen, skillfully worked.

verses.english:
It shall have two connected shoulder-pieces at its two
ends, and it will be connected.
verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵּי כְתֵפֹת חֹבְרֹת יִהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹתָיו וְחֻבָּר׃

hebrew.text: שְׁתֵּי כְתֵפֹת חֹבְרֹת יִהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹתָיו וְחֻבָּר׃

english.text:
It shall have two connected shoulder-pieces at its two
ends, and it will be connected.

translation.text: It shall have two together.

verses.english:
And the ephod’s designed belt that is on it shall be like
its work and be a part of it: gold, blue, and purple, and
scarlet and woven linen.
verses.hebrew: וְחֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יִהְיֶה זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

hebrew.text: וְחֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יִהְיֶה זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

english.text:
And the ephod’s designed belt that is on it shall be like
its work and be a part of it: gold, blue, and purple, and
scarlet and woven linen.

translation.text: The decorated band on it shall be of the same yarns, and of fine twisted linen.

verses.english:
And you shall take two onyx stones and inscribe the names
of the children of Israel on them:
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי אַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וּפִתַּחְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶם שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי אַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וּפִתַּחְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶם שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall take two onyx stones and inscribe the names
of the children of Israel on them:

translation.text: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,

verses.english:
six of their names on one stone and the names of the
remaining six on the second stone, according to their
birth orders.
verses.hebrew: שִׁשָּׁה מִשְּׁמֹתָם עַל הָאֶבֶן הָאֶחָת וְאֶת שְׁמוֹת הַשִּׁשָּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים עַל הָאֶבֶן הַשֵּׁנִית כְּתוֹלְדֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: שִׁשָּׁה מִשְּׁמֹתָם עַל הָאֶבֶן הָאֶחָת וְאֶת שְׁמוֹת הַשִּׁשָּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים עַל הָאֶבֶן הַשֵּׁנִית כְּתוֹלְדֹתָם׃

english.text:
six of their names on one stone and the names of the
remaining six on the second stone, according to their
birth orders.

translation.text: six of their names stone, in the order of their birth.

verses.english:
By a stone engraver’s work you shall inscribe the two
stones with signet inscriptions according to the names of
the children of Israel. You shall make them surrounded by
settings of gold.
verses.hebrew: מַעֲשֵׂה חָרַשׁ אֶבֶן פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם תְּפַתַּח אֶת שְׁתֵּי הָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֻסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: מַעֲשֵׂה חָרַשׁ אֶבֶן פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם תְּפַתַּח אֶת שְׁתֵּי הָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֻסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
By a stone engraver’s work you shall inscribe the two
stones with signet inscriptions according to the names of
the children of Israel. You shall make them surrounded by
settings of gold.

translation.text: As a gem-cutter engraves signets, Israel; you shall mount them in settings of gold filigree.

verses.english:
And you shall set the two stones on the ephod’s
shoulder-pieces, commemorative stones for the children of
Israel, and Aaron shall carry their names in front of YHWH
on his two shoulders as a commemoration.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הָאֲבָנִים עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אַבְנֵי זִכָּרֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמוֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁתֵּי כְתֵפָיו לְזִכָּרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הָאֲבָנִים עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אַבְנֵי זִכָּרֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמוֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁתֵּי כְתֵפָיו לְזִכָּרֹן׃

english.text:
And you shall set the two stones on the ephod’s
shoulder-pieces, commemorative stones for the children of
Israel, and Aaron shall carry their names in front of YHWH
on his two shoulders as a commemoration.

translation.text: You shall set before the LORD on his two shoulders for remembrance.

verses.english: “And you shall make settings of gold
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב׃

english.text: “And you shall make settings of gold

translation.text: You shall make settings of gold filigree,

verses.english:
and two chains of pure gold. You shall make them twisted,
rope work, and put the rope chains on the settings.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי שַׁרְשְׁרֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִגְבָּלֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת וְנָתַתָּה אֶת שַׁרְשְׁרֹת הָעֲבֹתֹת עַל הַמִּשְׁבְּצֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי שַׁרְשְׁרֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִגְבָּלֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת וְנָתַתָּה אֶת שַׁרְשְׁרֹת הָעֲבֹתֹת עַל הַמִּשְׁבְּצֹת׃

english.text:
and two chains of pure gold. You shall make them twisted,
rope work, and put the rope chains on the settings.

translation.text: and two chains of pure gold, twisted like cords; and you shall attach the corded chains to the settings.

verses.english:
“And you shall make a breastplate of judgment, designer’s
work. You shall make it like the work of the ephod. You
shall make it gold, blue, and purple and scarlet and woven
linen.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֹשֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֵפֹד תַּעֲשֶׂנּוּ זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֹשֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֵפֹד תַּעֲשֶׂנּוּ זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a breastplate of judgment, designer’s
work. You shall make it like the work of the ephod. You
shall make it gold, blue, and purple and scarlet and woven
linen.

translation.text: You shall make a breastpiece of judgment, in skilled work; you shall crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen you shall make it.

verses.english:
It shall be square when doubled, its length a span and its
width a span.
verses.hebrew: רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה כָּפוּל זֶרֶת ארְכּוֹ וְזֶרֶת רחְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה כָּפוּל זֶרֶת ארְכּוֹ וְזֶרֶת רחְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
It shall be square when doubled, its length a span and its
width a span.

translation.text: It shall be square and doubled, a span in length and a span in width.

verses.english:
And you shall put a mounting of stones in it: four rows of stone. A
row of a carnelian, a topaz, and an emerald: the one row.
verses.hebrew: וּמִלֵּאתָ בוֹ מִלֻּאַת אֶבֶן אַרְבָּעָה טוּרִים אָבֶן טוּר אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וּבָרֶקֶת הַטּוּר הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלֵּאתָ בוֹ מִלֻּאַת אֶבֶן אַרְבָּעָה טוּרִים אָבֶן טוּר אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וּבָרֶקֶת הַטּוּר הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And you shall put a mounting of stones in it: four rows of stone. A
row of a carnelian, a topaz, and an emerald: the one row.

translation.text: You shall set in it four rows of stones. A row of carnelian, chrysolite, and emerald shall be the first row;

verses.english: And the second row: a ruby, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.hebrew: וְהַטּוּר הַשֵּׁנִי נֹפֶךְ סַפִּיר וְיָהֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַטּוּר הַשֵּׁנִי נֹפֶךְ סַפִּיר וְיָהֲלֹם׃

english.text: And the second row: a ruby, a sapphire, and a diamond.

translation.text: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire and a moonstone;

verses.english: And the third row: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.hebrew: וְהַטּוּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַטּוּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָמָה׃

english.text: And the third row: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

translation.text: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.english:
And the fourth row: a beryl and an onyx and a jasper. They
shall be set in gold in their mountings.
verses.hebrew: וְהַטּוּר הָרְבִיעִי תַּרְשִׁישׁ וְשֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה מְשֻׁבָּצִים זָהָב יִהְיוּ בְּמִלּוּאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַטּוּר הָרְבִיעִי תַּרְשִׁישׁ וְשֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה מְשֻׁבָּצִים זָהָב יִהְיוּ בְּמִלּוּאֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the fourth row: a beryl and an onyx and a jasper. They
shall be set in gold in their mountings.

translation.text: and the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be set in gold filigree.

verses.english:
And the stones shall be with the names of the children of
Israel, twelve with their names; they shall be signet
engravings, each with its name, for twelve tribes.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲבָנִים תִּהְיֶיןָ עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עַל שְׁמֹתָם פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם אִישׁ עַל שְׁמוֹ תִּהְיֶיןָ לִשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר שָׁבֶט׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲבָנִים תִּהְיֶיןָ עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עַל שְׁמֹתָם פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם אִישׁ עַל שְׁמוֹ תִּהְיֶיןָ לִשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר שָׁבֶט׃

english.text:
And the stones shall be with the names of the children of
Israel, twelve with their names; they shall be signet
engravings, each with its name, for twelve tribes.

translation.text: There shall be twelve stones with names signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.

verses.english:
And you shall make twisted chains, rope work, of pure
gold, on the breastplate.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שַׁרְשֹׁת גַּבְלֻת מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שַׁרְשֹׁת גַּבְלֻת מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
And you shall make twisted chains, rope work, of pure
gold, on the breastplate.

translation.text: You shall make for the breastpiece chains of pure gold, twisted like cords;

verses.english:
And you shall make two rings of gold on the breastplate
and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעוֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעוֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And you shall make two rings of gold on the breastplate
and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate

translation.text: and rings on the two edges of the breastpiece.

verses.english:
and put the two ropes of gold on the two rings at the ends
of the breastplate.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת שְׁתֵּי עֲבֹתֹת הַזָּהָב עַל שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת אֶל קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת שְׁתֵּי עֲבֹתֹת הַזָּהָב עַל שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת אֶל קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

english.text:
and put the two ropes of gold on the two rings at the ends
of the breastplate.

translation.text: You shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece;

verses.english:
And you shall put the two ends of the two ropes on the two
settings, and you shall put them on the ephod’s
shoulder-pieces opposite the front of it.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי קְצוֹת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת תִּתֵּן עַל שְׁתֵּי הַמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת וְנָתַתָּה עַל כִּתְפוֹת הָאֵפֹד אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי קְצוֹת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת תִּתֵּן עַל שְׁתֵּי הַמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת וְנָתַתָּה עַל כִּתְפוֹת הָאֵפֹד אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall put the two ends of the two ropes on the two
settings, and you shall put them on the ephod’s
shoulder-pieces opposite the front of it.

translation.text: the attach it in front to the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.

verses.english:
And you shall make two rings of gold and set them on the
breastplate’s two ends on its side that is adjacent to the
ephod, inward.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְשַׂמְתָּ אֹתָם עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן עַל שְׂפָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר אֶל עֵבֶר הָאֵפֹד בָּיְתָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְשַׂמְתָּ אֹתָם עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן עַל שְׂפָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר אֶל עֵבֶר הָאֵפֹד בָּיְתָה׃

english.text:
And you shall make two rings of gold and set them on the
breastplate’s two ends on its side that is adjacent to the
ephod, inward.

translation.text: You shall breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.

verses.english:
And you shall make two rings of gold and put them on the
ephod’s two shoulder-pieces below, opposite the front of
it, by its connection, above the ephod’s designed belt.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָם עַל שְׁתֵּי כִתְפוֹת הָאֵפוֹד מִלְּמַטָּה מִמּוּל פָּנָיו לְעֻמַּת מַחְבַּרְתּוֹ מִמַּעַל לְחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָם עַל שְׁתֵּי כִתְפוֹת הָאֵפוֹד מִלְּמַטָּה מִמּוּל פָּנָיו לְעֻמַּת מַחְבַּרְתּוֹ מִמַּעַל לְחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפוֹד׃

english.text:
And you shall make two rings of gold and put them on the
ephod’s two shoulder-pieces below, opposite the front of
it, by its connection, above the ephod’s designed belt.

translation.text: You shall make band of the ephod.

verses.english:
And they shall attach the breastplate from its rings to
the ephod’s rings with a blue string so it will be on the
ephod’s designed belt and the breastplate will not be
detached from the ephod.
verses.hebrew: וְיִרְכְּסוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָו אֶל טַבְּעֹת הָאֵפוֹד בִּפְתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לִהְיוֹת עַל חֵשֶׁב הָאֵפוֹד וְלֹא יִזַּח הַחֹשֶׁן מֵעַל הָאֵפוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְיִרְכְּסוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָו אֶל טַבְּעֹת הָאֵפוֹד בִּפְתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לִהְיוֹת עַל חֵשֶׁב הָאֵפוֹד וְלֹא יִזַּח הַחֹשֶׁן מֵעַל הָאֵפוֹד׃

english.text:
And they shall attach the breastplate from its rings to
the ephod’s rings with a blue string so it will be on the
ephod’s designed belt and the breastplate will not be
detached from the ephod.

translation.text: The breastpiece shall be bound by its rings to come loose from the ephod.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall carry the names of the children of Israel
in the breastplate of judgment on his heart when he comes
into the Holy, as a commemorative in front of YHWH always.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט עַל לִבּוֹ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְזִכָּרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט עַל לִבּוֹ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְזִכָּרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall carry the names of the children of Israel
in the breastplate of judgment on his heart when he comes
into the Holy, as a commemorative in front of YHWH always.

translation.text: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment on his heart when he goes into the holy place, for a continual remembrance before the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall put the Urim and Tummim in the breastplate
of judgment, and they shall be on Aaron’s heart when he
comes in front of YHWH, and Aaron shall carry the judgment
of the children of Israel on his heart in front of YHWH
always.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אֶל חֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים וְהָיוּ עַל לֵב אַהֲרֹן בְּבֹאוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת מִשְׁפַּט בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל לִבּוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶל חֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים וְהָיוּ עַל לֵב אַהֲרֹן בְּבֹאוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת מִשְׁפַּט בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל לִבּוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
And you shall put the Urim and Tummim in the breastplate
of judgment, and they shall be on Aaron’s heart when he
comes in front of YHWH, and Aaron shall carry the judgment
of the children of Israel on his heart in front of YHWH
always.

translation.text: In and they shall be on Aaron's heart when he goes in before the LORD; thus Aaron shall bear the judgment of the Israelites on his heart before the LORD continually.

verses.english: “And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מְעִיל הָאֵפוֹד כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מְעִיל הָאֵפוֹד כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

english.text: “And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

translation.text: You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

verses.english:
And its head-opening shall be within it. It shall have a
binding for its opening all around, weaver’s work. It
shall be like the opening of a coat of mail for him; it
will not be torn.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה פִי רֹאשׁוֹ בְּתוֹכוֹ שָׂפָה יִהְיֶה לְפִיו סָבִיב מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג כְּפִי תַחְרָא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ לֹא יִקָּרֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה פִי רֹאשׁוֹ בְּתוֹכוֹ שָׂפָה יִהְיֶה לְפִיו סָבִיב מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג כְּפִי תַחְרָא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ לֹא יִקָּרֵעַ׃

english.text:
And its head-opening shall be within it. It shall have a
binding for its opening all around, weaver’s work. It
shall be like the opening of a coat of mail for him; it
will not be torn.

translation.text: It shall have an torn.

verses.english:
And you shall make on its skirts pomegranates of blue and
purple and scarlet, on its skirts all around, and bells of
gold within them all around:
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל שׁוּלָיו רִמֹּנֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי עַל שׁוּלָיו סָבִיב וּפַעֲמֹנֵי זָהָב בְּתוֹכָם סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל שׁוּלָיו רִמֹּנֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי עַל שׁוּלָיו סָבִיב וּפַעֲמֹנֵי זָהָב בְּתוֹכָם סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And you shall make on its skirts pomegranates of blue and
purple and scarlet, on its skirts all around, and bells of
gold within them all around:

translation.text: On its lower hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, all around the lower hem, with bells of gold between them all around —

verses.english:
a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a
pomegranate, on the robe’s skirts all around.
verses.hebrew: פַּעֲמֹן זָהָב וְרִמּוֹן פַּעֲמֹן זָהָב וְרִמּוֹן עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: פַּעֲמֹן זָהָב וְרִמּוֹן פַּעֲמֹן זָהָב וְרִמּוֹן עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב׃

english.text:
a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a
pomegranate, on the robe’s skirts all around.

translation.text: a golden bell and a pomegranate alternating all around the lower hem of the robe.

verses.english:
And it shall be on Aaron for ministering: and the sound of
it will be heard when he comes to the Holy in front of
YHWH and when he goes out, so he will not die.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה עַל אַהֲרֹן לְשָׁרֵת וְנִשְׁמַע קוֹלוֹ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּבְצֵאתוֹ וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה עַל אַהֲרֹן לְשָׁרֵת וְנִשְׁמַע קוֹלוֹ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּבְצֵאתוֹ וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

english.text:
And it shall be on Aaron for ministering: and the sound of
it will be heard when he comes to the Holy in front of
YHWH and when he goes out, so he will not die.

translation.text: Aaron shall wear not die.

verses.english:
“And you shall make a plate of pure gold and make signet
inscriptions on it: ‘Holiness to YHWH.’
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ צִּיץ זָהָב טָהוֹר וּפִתַּחְתָּ עָלָיו פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ צִּיץ זָהָב טָהוֹר וּפִתַּחְתָּ עָלָיו פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a plate of pure gold and make signet
inscriptions on it: ‘Holiness to YHWH.’

translation.text: You shall make a rosette of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet, "Holy to the LORD."

verses.english:
And you shall set it on a blue string, and it shall be on
the headdress. It shall be opposite the front of the
headdress.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֹתוֹ עַל פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת וְהָיָה עַל הַמִּצְנָפֶת אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הַמִּצְנֶפֶת יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֹתוֹ עַל פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת וְהָיָה עַל הַמִּצְנָפֶת אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הַמִּצְנֶפֶת יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And you shall set it on a blue string, and it shall be on
the headdress. It shall be opposite the front of the
headdress.

translation.text: You shall fasten it on the turban with a blue cord; it shall be on the front of the turban.

verses.english:
And it shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the crime
of the holy things that the children of Israel will sanctify, for
all their holy gifts. And it shall be on his forehead always for
acceptance for them in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה עַל מֵצַח אַהֲרֹן וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת עֲוֺן הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכל מַתְּנֹת קדְשֵׁיהֶם וְהָיָה עַל מִצְחוֹ תָּמִיד לְרָצוֹן לָהֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה עַל מֵצַח אַהֲרֹן וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת עֲוֺן הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכל מַתְּנֹת קדְשֵׁיהֶם וְהָיָה עַל מִצְחוֹ תָּמִיד לְרָצוֹן לָהֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And it shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the crime
of the holy things that the children of Israel will sanctify, for
all their holy gifts. And it shall be on his forehead always for
acceptance for them in front of YHWH.

translation.text: It shall be on Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall take on himself any guilt sacred donations; it shall always be on his forehead, in order that they may find favor before the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall weave the coat in a pattern of linen and
make a headdress of linen. And you shall make a sash,
embroiderer’s work,
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ הַכְּתֹנֶת שֵׁשׁ וְעָשִׂיתָ מִצְנֶפֶת שֵׁשׁ וְאַבְנֵט תַּעֲשֶׂה מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ הַכְּתֹנֶת שֵׁשׁ וְעָשִׂיתָ מִצְנֶפֶת שֵׁשׁ וְאַבְנֵט תַּעֲשֶׂה מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם׃

english.text:
And you shall weave the coat in a pattern of linen and
make a headdress of linen. And you shall make a sash,
embroiderer’s work,

translation.text: You shall make the checkered tunic of fine linen, and you shall with needlework.

verses.english:
and you shall make coats for Aaron’s sons, and you shall
make sashes for them, and you shall make hats for them—for
glory and for beauty.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה כֻתֳּנֹת וְעָשִׂיתָ לָהֶם אַבְנֵטִים וּמִגְבָּעוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה כֻתֳּנֹת וְעָשִׂיתָ לָהֶם אַבְנֵטִים וּמִגְבָּעוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת׃

english.text:
and you shall make coats for Aaron’s sons, and you shall
make sashes for them, and you shall make hats for them—for
glory and for beauty.

translation.text: For Aaron's sons you shall make tunics and sashes and headdresses; you shall make them for their glorious adornment.

verses.english:
And you shall dress them—Aaron, your brother, and his sons
with him—and you shall anoint them and fill their hand and
sanctify them, and they shall function as priests for me.
verses.hebrew: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם אֶת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם וּמִלֵּאתָ אֶת יָדָם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם אֶת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם וּמִלֵּאתָ אֶת יָדָם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall dress them—Aaron, your brother, and his sons
with him—and you shall anoint them and fill their hand and
sanctify them, and they shall function as priests for me.

translation.text: You shall put serve me as priests.

verses.english:
And make shorts of linen for them, to cover naked flesh;
they shall be from hips to thighs.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשֵׂה לָהֶם מִכְנְסֵי בָד לְכַסּוֹת בְּשַׂר עֶרְוָה מִמּתְנַיִם וְעַד יְרֵכַיִם יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשֵׂה לָהֶם מִכְנְסֵי בָד לְכַסּוֹת בְּשַׂר עֶרְוָה מִמּתְנַיִם וְעַד יְרֵכַיִם יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
And make shorts of linen for them, to cover naked flesh;
they shall be from hips to thighs.

translation.text: You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their naked flesh; they shall reach from the hips to the thighs;

verses.english:
And they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they come
to the Tent of Meeting or when they come close to the
altar to minister in the Holy, so they will not bear a
crime and die. It is an eternal law for him and for his
seed after him.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ עַל אַהֲרֹן וְעַל בָּנָיו בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אוֹ בְגִשְׁתָּם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וְלֹא יִשְׂאוּ עָוֺן וָמֵתוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ עַל אַהֲרֹן וְעַל בָּנָיו בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אוֹ בְגִשְׁתָּם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וְלֹא יִשְׂאוּ עָוֺן וָמֵתוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they come
to the Tent of Meeting or when they come close to the
altar to minister in the Holy, so they will not bear a
crime and die. It is an eternal law for him and for his
seed after him.

translation.text: perpetual ordinance for him and for his descendants after him.

verses.english:
“And this is the thing that you shall do to them to
sanctify them to function as priests for me: Take one bull
of the cattle and two unblemished rams
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לִי לְקַח פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר וְאֵילִם שְׁנַיִם תְּמִימִם׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לִי לְקַח פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר וְאֵילִם שְׁנַיִם תְּמִימִם׃

english.text:
“And this is the thing that you shall do to them to
sanctify them to function as priests for me: Take one bull
of the cattle and two unblemished rams

translation.text: Now this is what you shall do to them to consecrate them, so that without blemish,

verses.english:
and unleavened bread and unleavened cakes mixed with oil
and unleavened wafers with oil poured on them—you shall
make them of fine flour of wheat.
verses.hebrew: וְלֶחֶם מַצּוֹת וְחַלֹּת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן סֹלֶת חִטִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֶחֶם מַצּוֹת וְחַלֹּת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן סֹלֶת חִטִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
and unleavened bread and unleavened cakes mixed with oil
and unleavened wafers with oil poured on them—you shall
make them of fine flour of wheat.

translation.text: and unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed of choice wheat flour.

verses.english:
And you shall put them on one basket and bring them
forward in the basket—and the bull and the two rams.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אוֹתָם עַל סַל אֶחָד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֹתָם בַּסָּל וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אוֹתָם עַל סַל אֶחָד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֹתָם בַּסָּל וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִם׃

english.text:
And you shall put them on one basket and bring them
forward in the basket—and the bull and the two rams.

translation.text: You shall put them in one basket and bring them in the basket, and bring the bull and the two rams.

verses.english:
And you shall bring Aaron and his sons forward to the Tent
of Meeting and wash them with water.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְרָחַצְתָּ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְרָחַצְתָּ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And you shall bring Aaron and his sons forward to the Tent
of Meeting and wash them with water.

translation.text: You shall wash them with water.

verses.english:
And you shall take the clothes and dress Aaron with the
coat and with the ephod’s robe and with the ephod and with
the breastplate, and you shall put on the ephod for him
with the ephod’s designed belt.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַבְּגָדִים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וְאֵת מְעִיל הָאֵפֹד וְאֶת הָאֵפֹד וְאֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ לוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַבְּגָדִים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וְאֵת מְעִיל הָאֵפֹד וְאֶת הָאֵפֹד וְאֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ לוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד׃

english.text:
And you shall take the clothes and dress Aaron with the
coat and with the ephod’s robe and with the ephod and with
the breastplate, and you shall put on the ephod for him
with the ephod’s designed belt.

translation.text: Then you shall take the vestments, and put breastpiece, and gird him with the decorated band of the ephod;

verses.english:
And you shall set the headdress on his head and put the
crown of Holiness on the headdress.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְנָתַתָּ אֶת נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל הַמִּצְנָפֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְנָתַתָּ אֶת נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל הַמִּצְנָפֶת׃

english.text:
And you shall set the headdress on his head and put the
crown of Holiness on the headdress.

translation.text: and turban.

verses.english:
And you shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his
head and anoint him.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְיָצַקְתָּ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְיָצַקְתָּ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his
head and anoint him.

translation.text: You shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head and anoint him.

verses.english:
And you shall bring his sons forward, and you shall dress
them in coats
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם כֻּתֳּנֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם כֻּתֳּנֹת׃

english.text:
And you shall bring his sons forward, and you shall dress
them in coats

translation.text: Then you shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them,

verses.english:
and you shall belt them with a sash, Aaron and his sons,
and put hats on for them. And they shall have priesthood
as an eternal law. And you shall fill Aaron’s hand and his
sons’ hand.
verses.hebrew: וְחָגַרְתָּ אֹתָם אַבְנֵט אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעֹת וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם כְּהֻנָּה לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמִלֵּאתָ יַד אַהֲרֹן וְיַד בָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְחָגַרְתָּ אֹתָם אַבְנֵט אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעֹת וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם כְּהֻנָּה לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמִלֵּאתָ יַד אַהֲרֹן וְיַד בָּנָיו׃

english.text:
and you shall belt them with a sash, Aaron and his sons,
and put hats on for them. And they shall have priesthood
as an eternal law. And you shall fill Aaron’s hand and his
sons’ hand.

translation.text: the priesthood shall be theirs by a perpetual ordinance. You shall then ordain Aaron and his sons.

verses.english:
And you shall bring the bull forward in front of the Tent
of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands
on the bull’s head.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר׃

english.text:
And you shall bring the bull forward in front of the Tent
of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands
on the bull’s head.

translation.text: You shall bring the bull in front of the tent of meeting. Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull,

verses.english:
And you shall slaughter the bull in front of YHWH at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And you shall slaughter the bull in front of YHWH at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: and you shall meeting,

verses.english:
And you shall take some of the bull’s blood and put it on
the horns of the altar with your finger, and you shall
spill all of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִדַּם הַפָּר וְנָתַתָּה עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶךָ וְאֶת כּל הַדָּם תִּשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִדַּם הַפָּר וְנָתַתָּה עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶךָ וְאֶת כּל הַדָּם תִּשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And you shall take some of the bull’s blood and put it on
the horns of the altar with your finger, and you shall
spill all of the blood at the base of the altar.

translation.text: and shall take some of the blood of the bull and put it on you shall pour out at the base of the altar.

verses.english:
And you shall take all of the fat that covers the inside
and the appendage on the liver and the two kidneys and the
fat that is on them, and you shall burn them into smoke at
the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And you shall take all of the fat that covers the inside
and the appendage on the liver and the two kidneys and the
fat that is on them, and you shall burn them into smoke at
the altar.

translation.text: You shall take all the fat altar.

verses.english:
And you shall burn the meat of the bull and its skin and
its dung in fire outside the camp. It is a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בְּשַׂר הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה חַטָּאת הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בְּשַׂר הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה חַטָּאת הוּא׃

english.text:
And you shall burn the meat of the bull and its skin and
its dung in fire outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

translation.text: But the flesh of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And you shall take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons
shall lay their hands on the ram’s head.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַיִל הָאֶחָד תִּקָּח וְסָמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל הָאֶחָד תִּקָּח וְסָמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

english.text:
And you shall take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons
shall lay their hands on the ram’s head.

translation.text: Then you shall take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,

verses.english:
And you shall slaughter the ram and take its blood and
fling it on the altar all around.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הָאָיִל וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הָאָיִל וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And you shall slaughter the ram and take its blood and
fling it on the altar all around.

translation.text: and you shall slaughter the ram, and shall take its blood and dash it against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And you shall cut up the ram into its parts, and you shall
wash its inside and its legs and put them on its parts and
on its head.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַיִל תְּנַתֵּחַ לִנְתָחָיו וְרָחַצְתָּ קִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו וְנָתַתָּ עַל נְתָחָיו וְעַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל תְּנַתֵּחַ לִנְתָחָיו וְרָחַצְתָּ קִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו וְנָתַתָּ עַל נְתָחָיו וְעַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall cut up the ram into its parts, and you shall
wash its inside and its legs and put them on its parts and
on its head.

translation.text: Then you shall cut the ram into its parts, and wash its entrails and its legs, and put them with its parts and its head,

verses.english:
And you shall burn all of the ram to smoke at the altar.
It is a burnt offering to YHWH. It is a pleasant smell, an
offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לַיהֹוָה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לַיהֹוָה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה הוּא׃

english.text:
And you shall burn all of the ram to smoke at the altar.
It is a burnt offering to YHWH. It is a pleasant smell, an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: and turn the whole ram into smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons
shall lay their hands on the ram’s head.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֵת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֵת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

english.text:
And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons
shall lay their hands on the ram’s head.

translation.text: You shall take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,

verses.english:
And you shall slaughter the ram and take some of its blood
and put it on Aaron’s earlobe and on his sons’ earlobe,
the right one, and on the thumb of their right hand and on
the big toe of their right foot. And you shall fling the
blood on the altar all around.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הָאַיִל וְלָקַחְתָּ מִדָּמוֹ וְנָתַתָּה עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן וְעַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן בָּנָיו הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וְזָרַקְתָּ אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הָאַיִל וְלָקַחְתָּ מִדָּמוֹ וְנָתַתָּה עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן וְעַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן בָּנָיו הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וְזָרַקְתָּ אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And you shall slaughter the ram and take some of its blood
and put it on Aaron’s earlobe and on his sons’ earlobe,
the right one, and on the thumb of their right hand and on
the big toe of their right foot. And you shall fling the
blood on the altar all around.

translation.text: and you shall slaughter the ram, and right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet, and dash the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar
and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and
on his clothes and on his sons and on his sons’ clothes
with him. And he and his clothes and his sons and his
sons’ clothes with him will be holy.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְהִזֵּיתָ עַל אַהֲרֹן וְעַל בְּגָדָיו וְעַל בָּנָיו וְעַל בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ וְקָדַשׁ הוּא וּבְגָדָיו וּבָנָיו וּבִגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְהִזֵּיתָ עַל אַהֲרֹן וְעַל בְּגָדָיו וְעַל בָּנָיו וְעַל בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ וְקָדַשׁ הוּא וּבְגָדָיו וּבָנָיו וּבִגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar
and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and
on his clothes and on his sons and on his sons’ clothes
with him. And he and his clothes and his sons and his
sons’ clothes with him will be holy.

translation.text: Then you shall take some of vestments with him; then he and his vestments shall be holy, as well as his sons and his sons' vestments.

verses.english:
And you shall take the fat from the ram and the fat tail
and the fat that covers the inside and the appendage of
the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them
and the right thigh—because it is a ram of ordination—
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִן הָאַיִל הַחֵלֶב וְהָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין כִּי אֵיל מִלֻּאִים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִן הָאַיִל הַחֵלֶב וְהָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין כִּי אֵיל מִלֻּאִים הוּא׃

english.text:
And you shall take the fat from the ram and the fat tail
and the fat that covers the inside and the appendage of
the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them
and the right thigh—because it is a ram of ordination—

translation.text: You shall also take the fat of the ram, the fat tail, the fat that covers that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of ordination),

verses.english:
and one loaf of bread and one cake of bread with oil and
one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is in
front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְכִכַּר לֶחֶם אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד מִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִכַּר לֶחֶם אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד מִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and one loaf of bread and one cake of bread with oil and
one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is in
front of YHWH.

translation.text: wafer, out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD;

verses.english:
And you shall put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’
hands and elevate them as an elevation offering in front
of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’
hands and elevate them as an elevation offering in front
of YHWH.

translation.text: and you shall place all these on the palms of Aaron and on the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall take them from their hand and burn them to
smoke at the altar in addition to the burnt offering as a
pleasant smell in front of YHWH. It is an offering by fire
to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֹתָם מִיָּדָם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֹתָם מִיָּדָם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall take them from their hand and burn them to
smoke at the altar in addition to the burnt offering as a
pleasant smell in front of YHWH. It is an offering by fire
to YHWH.

translation.text: Then you shall take them from their hands, and turn them into before the LORD; it is an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall take the breast from the ram of ordination
that is Aaron’s and elevate it as an elevation offering in
front of YHWH, and it shall be a portion for you.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הֶחָזֶה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה לְךָ לְמָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הֶחָזֶה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה לְךָ לְמָנָה׃

english.text:
And you shall take the breast from the ram of ordination
that is Aaron’s and elevate it as an elevation offering in
front of YHWH, and it shall be a portion for you.

translation.text: You shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron's ordination and raise it as an elevation offering before the LORD; and it shall be your portion.

verses.english:
And you shall sanctify the breast that is an elevation
offering and the thigh that is a donation, that is
elevated and that is donated, from the ram of ordination,
from Aaron’s and from his sons’.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֵת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הוּנַף וַאֲשֶׁר הוּרָם מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים מֵאֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן וּמֵאֲשֶׁר לְבָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֵת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הוּנַף וַאֲשֶׁר הוּרָם מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים מֵאֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן וּמֵאֲשֶׁר לְבָנָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall sanctify the breast that is an elevation
offering and the thigh that is a donation, that is
elevated and that is donated, from the ram of ordination,
from Aaron’s and from his sons’.

translation.text: You shall consecrate the breast that was raised as an elevation sons.

verses.english:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ as an eternal law
from the children of Israel, because it is a donation, and
it will be a donation from the children of Israel from the
sacrifices of their peace offerings, their donation to
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תְרוּמָה הוּא וּתְרוּמָה יִהְיֶה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם תְּרוּמָתָם לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תְרוּמָה הוּא וּתְרוּמָה יִהְיֶה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם תְּרוּמָתָם לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ as an eternal law
from the children of Israel, because it is a donation, and
it will be a donation from the children of Israel from the
sacrifices of their peace offerings, their donation to
YHWH.

translation.text: These things shall be a perpetual ordinance for Aaron and his offering by the Israelites from their sacrifice of offerings of well-being, their offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
And the holy clothes that are Aaron’s shall be his sons’
after him, to be anointed in them and to fill their hand
in them.
verses.hebrew: וּבִגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן יִהְיוּ לְבָנָיו אַחֲרָיו לְמשְׁחָה בָהֶם וּלְמַלֵּא בָם אֶת יָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבִגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן יִהְיוּ לְבָנָיו אַחֲרָיו לְמשְׁחָה בָהֶם וּלְמַלֵּא בָם אֶת יָדָם׃

english.text:
And the holy clothes that are Aaron’s shall be his sons’
after him, to be anointed in them and to fill their hand
in them.

translation.text: The sacred vestments of Aaron shall be passed on to his sons after him; they shall be anointed in them and ordained in them.

verses.english:
The priest in his place from among his sons, who will come
to the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy, shall wear
them for seven days.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִלְבָּשָׁם הַכֹּהֵן תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִלְבָּשָׁם הַכֹּהֵן תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
The priest in his place from among his sons, who will come
to the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy, shall wear
them for seven days.

translation.text: The son into the tent of meeting to minister in the holy place.

verses.english:
And you shall take the ram of ordination and cook its meat
in a holy place,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים תִּקָּח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בְּמָקֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים תִּקָּח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בְּמָקֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall take the ram of ordination and cook its meat
in a holy place,

translation.text: You shall take the ram of ordination, and boil its flesh in a holy place;

verses.english:
and Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram and
the bread that is in the basket at the entrance of the
Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכַל אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת בְּשַׂר הָאַיִל וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּסָּל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַל אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת בְּשַׂר הָאַיִל וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּסָּל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
and Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram and
the bread that is in the basket at the entrance of the
Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: and Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And those who have acquired atonement by them shall eat
them, to fill their hand, to make them holy; and an
outsider shall not eat, because they are holy.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכְלוּ אֹתָם אֲשֶׁר כֻּפַּר בָּהֶם לְמַלֵּא אֶת יָדָם לְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם וְזָר לֹא יֹאכַל כִּי קֹדֶשׁ הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכְלוּ אֹתָם אֲשֶׁר כֻּפַּר בָּהֶם לְמַלֵּא אֶת יָדָם לְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם וְזָר לֹא יֹאכַל כִּי קֹדֶשׁ הֵם׃

english.text:
And those who have acquired atonement by them shall eat
them, to fill their hand, to make them holy; and an
outsider shall not eat, because they are holy.

translation.text: they are holy.

verses.english:
And if some of the meat of the ordination or some of the
bread will be left until the morning, then you shall burn
what is left in fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is
holy.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִוָּתֵר מִבְּשַׂר הַמִּלֻּאִים וּמִן הַלֶּחֶם עַד הַבֹּקֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ אֶת הַנּוֹתָר בָּאֵשׁ לֹא יֵאָכֵל כִּי קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִוָּתֵר מִבְּשַׂר הַמִּלֻּאִים וּמִן הַלֶּחֶם עַד הַבֹּקֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ אֶת הַנּוֹתָר בָּאֵשׁ לֹא יֵאָכֵל כִּי קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃

english.text:
And if some of the meat of the ordination or some of the
bread will be left until the morning, then you shall burn
what is left in fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is
holy.

translation.text: If any of the flesh for the ordination, or of the bread, remains until the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

verses.english:
“And you shall do thus to Aaron and to his sons, according
to all that I have commanded you. You shall fill their
hand for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו כָּכָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֹתָכָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תְּמַלֵּא יָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו כָּכָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֹתָכָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תְּמַלֵּא יָדָם׃

english.text:
“And you shall do thus to Aaron and to his sons, according
to all that I have commanded you. You shall fill their
hand for seven days.

translation.text: Thus you shall do to Aaron and to his sons, just as I have commanded you; through seven days you shall ordain them.

verses.english:
And you shall do a bull sin offering per day for
atonement, and you shall make a sin offering on the altar
when you make atonement for it, and you shall anoint it to
make it holy.
verses.hebrew: וּפַר חַטָּאת תַּעֲשֶׂה לַיּוֹם עַל הַכִּפֻּרִים וְחִטֵּאתָ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ עָלָיו וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּפַר חַטָּאת תַּעֲשֶׂה לַיּוֹם עַל הַכִּפֻּרִים וְחִטֵּאתָ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ עָלָיו וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall do a bull sin offering per day for
atonement, and you shall make a sin offering on the altar
when you make atonement for it, and you shall anoint it to
make it holy.

translation.text: Also for it, and shall anoint it, to consecrate it.

verses.english:
Seven days you shall make atonement on the altar and make
it holy, and the altar shall be holy of holies. Anyone who
touches the altar will be holy.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תְּכַפֵּר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְהָיָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ יִקְדָּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תְּכַפֵּר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְהָיָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ יִקְדָּשׁ׃

english.text:
Seven days you shall make atonement on the altar and make
it holy, and the altar shall be holy of holies. Anyone who
touches the altar will be holy.

translation.text: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and consecrate it, and the altar shall be most holy; whatever touches the altar shall become holy.

verses.english:
“And this is what you shall do on the altar: year-old
lambs, two per day, always.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
“And this is what you shall do on the altar: year-old
lambs, two per day, always.

translation.text: Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old regularly each day.

verses.english:
You shall do the one sheep in the morning and do the
second sheep between the two evenings.
verses.hebrew: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

english.text:
You shall do the one sheep in the morning and do the
second sheep between the two evenings.

translation.text: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer in the evening;

verses.english:
And a tenth of a measure of fine flour mixed with a fourth
of a hin of pressed oil and a libation of a fourth of a
hin of wine for the first lamb.
verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרֹן סֹלֶת בָּלוּל בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רֶבַע הַהִין וְנֵסֶךְ רְבִיעִת הַהִין יָיִן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְעִשָּׂרֹן סֹלֶת בָּלוּל בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רֶבַע הַהִין וְנֵסֶךְ רְבִיעִת הַהִין יָיִן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And a tenth of a measure of fine flour mixed with a fourth
of a hin of pressed oil and a libation of a fourth of a
hin of wine for the first lamb.

translation.text: and with the first offering.

verses.english:
And you shall do the second lamb between the two evenings.
You shall do it like the morning grain offering and like
its libation for a pleasant smell, an offering by fire to
YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּהּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּהּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall do the second lamb between the two evenings.
You shall do it like the morning grain offering and like
its libation for a pleasant smell, an offering by fire to
YHWH,

translation.text: And the other lamb you shall offer in the evening, and morning, for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
a continual burnt offering through your generations at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting in front of YHWH, where I
shall meet with you to speak to you there.
verses.hebrew: עֹלַת תָּמִיד לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: עֹלַת תָּמִיד לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ שָׁם׃

english.text:
a continual burnt offering through your generations at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting in front of YHWH, where I
shall meet with you to speak to you there.

translation.text: It shall with you, to speak to you there.

verses.english:
And I shall meet there with the children of Israel, and it
will be made holy through my glory.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹעַדְתִּי שָׁמָּה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִקְדַּשׁ בִּכְבֹדִי׃

hebrew.text: וְנֹעַדְתִּי שָׁמָּה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִקְדַּשׁ בִּכְבֹדִי׃

english.text:
And I shall meet there with the children of Israel, and it
will be made holy through my glory.

translation.text: I will meet with the Israelites there, and it shall be sanctified by my glory;

verses.english:
And I shall make the Tent of Meeting and the altar holy,
and I shall make Aaron and his sons holy to function as
priests for me.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אֲקַדֵּשׁ לְכַהֵן לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אֲקַדֵּשׁ לְכַהֵן לִי׃

english.text:
And I shall make the Tent of Meeting and the altar holy,
and I shall make Aaron and his sons holy to function as
priests for me.

translation.text: I will consecrate the tent of serve me as priests.

verses.english:
And I shall tent among the children of Israel, and I shall
be God to them.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And I shall tent among the children of Israel, and I shall
be God to them.

translation.text: I will dwell among the Israelites, and I will be their God.

verses.english:
And they will know that I am YHWH, their God, who brought them
out from the land of Egypt for me to tent among them. I am YHWH,
their God.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְשׁכְנִי בְתוֹכָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְשׁכְנִי בְתוֹכָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And they will know that I am YHWH, their God, who brought them
out from the land of Egypt for me to tent among them. I am YHWH,
their God.

translation.text: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt that I might dwell among them; I am the LORD their God.

verses.english:
“And you shall make an altar for burning incense. You
shall make it of acacia wood.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ מִקְטַר קְטֹרֶת עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ מִקְטַר קְטֹרֶת עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall make an altar for burning incense. You
shall make it of acacia wood.

translation.text: You shall make an altar on which to offer incense; you shall make it of acacia wood.

verses.english:
Its length a cubit and its width a cubit, it shall be
square, and its height two cubits, its horns a part of it.
verses.hebrew: אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה וְאַמָּתַיִם קֹמָתוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ קַרְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה וְאַמָּתַיִם קֹמָתוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ קַרְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
Its length a cubit and its width a cubit, it shall be
square, and its height two cubits, its horns a part of it.

translation.text: It shall be one cubit long, and one cubit wide; it shall be square, and shall be two cubits high; its horns shall be of one piece with it.

verses.english:
And you shall plate it with pure gold, its roof and its
walls all around and its horns. And you shall make a
border of gold for it all around.
verses.hebrew: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר אֶת גַּגּוֹ וְאֶת קִירֹתָיו סָבִיב וְאֶת קַרְנֹתָיו וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר אֶת גַּגּוֹ וְאֶת קִירֹתָיו סָבִיב וְאֶת קַרְנֹתָיו וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And you shall plate it with pure gold, its roof and its
walls all around and its horns. And you shall make a
border of gold for it all around.

translation.text: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, and its sides all around.

verses.english:
And you shall make two rings of gold for it below its rim
on its two sides; you shall make it on its two sidewalls,
and it will be for housings for poles with which to carry
it.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב תַּעֲשֶׂה לּוֹ מִתַּחַת לְזֵרוֹ עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹתָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל שְׁנֵי צִדָּיו וְהָיָה לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב תַּעֲשֶׂה לּוֹ מִתַּחַת לְזֵרוֹ עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹתָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל שְׁנֵי צִדָּיו וְהָיָה לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֵמָּה׃

english.text:
And you shall make two rings of gold for it below its rim
on its two sides; you shall make it on its two sidewalls,
and it will be for housings for poles with which to carry
it.

translation.text: And you shall make two golden rings for it; under its shall hold the poles with which to carry it.

verses.english:
And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and plate them
with gold.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב׃

english.text:
And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and plate them
with gold.

translation.text: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.english:
And you shall put it in front of the pavilion that is over
the Ark of the Testimony, in front of the atonement dais
that is over the Testimony, where I shall meet with you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת לִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת לִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And you shall put it in front of the pavilion that is over
the Ark of the Testimony, in front of the atonement dais
that is over the Testimony, where I shall meet with you.

translation.text: You shall place it in front of the curtain that is above the ark of the covenant, in front of the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall burn incense of fragrances on it. Morning
by morning, when he attends to the lamps, he shall burn
it,
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו אַהֲרֹן קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר בְּהֵיטִיבוֹ אֶת הַנֵּרֹת יַקְטִירֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו אַהֲרֹן קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר בְּהֵיטִיבוֹ אֶת הַנֵּרֹת יַקְטִירֶנָּה׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall burn incense of fragrances on it. Morning
by morning, when he attends to the lamps, he shall burn
it,

translation.text: dresses the lamps he shall offer it,

verses.english:
and when Aaron puts up the lamps between the two evenings
he shall burn it: a continual incense in front of YHWH
through your generations.
verses.hebrew: וּבְהַעֲלֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַנֵּרֹת בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם יַקְטִירֶנָּה קְטֹרֶת תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהַעֲלֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַנֵּרֹת בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם יַקְטִירֶנָּה קְטֹרֶת תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and when Aaron puts up the lamps between the two evenings
he shall burn it: a continual incense in front of YHWH
through your generations.

translation.text: and when Aaron sets up the lamps in the evening, he shall offer it, a regular incense offering before the LORD throughout your generations.

verses.english:
You shall not offer unfitting incense or a burnt offering
or a grain offering on it, and you shall not pour a
libation on it.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲלוּ עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת זָרָה וְעֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְנֵסֶךְ לֹא תִסְּכוּ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲלוּ עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת זָרָה וְעֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְנֵסֶךְ לֹא תִסְּכוּ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
You shall not offer unfitting incense or a burnt offering
or a grain offering on it, and you shall not pour a
libation on it.

translation.text: You shall not offer unholy incense on it, or a burnt offering, or a grain offering; and you shall not pour a drink offering on it.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once per year;
he shall make atonement on it with the blood of the sin
offering of atonement once per year through your
generations. It is holy of holies to YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר אַהֲרֹן עַל קַרְנֹתָיו אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה מִדַּם חַטַּאת הַכִּפֻּרִים אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר אַהֲרֹן עַל קַרְנֹתָיו אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה מִדַּם חַטַּאת הַכִּפֻּרִים אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once per year;
he shall make atonement on it with the blood of the sin
offering of atonement once per year through your
generations. It is holy of holies to YHWH.”

translation.text: Once a year Aaron shall perform the rite atoning sin offering. It is most holy to the LORD.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:

verses.english:
“When you add up the heads of the children of Israel by
their counts, each of them shall give a ransom for his
life to YHWH when counting them, so there will not be a
plague among them when counting them.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִשָּׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ אִישׁ כֹּפֶר נַפְשׁוֹ לַיהֹוָה בִּפְקֹד אֹתָם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָהֶם נֶגֶף בִּפְקֹד אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִשָּׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ אִישׁ כֹּפֶר נַפְשׁוֹ לַיהֹוָה בִּפְקֹד אֹתָם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָהֶם נֶגֶף בִּפְקֹד אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“When you add up the heads of the children of Israel by
their counts, each of them shall give a ransom for his
life to YHWH when counting them, so there will not be a
plague among them when counting them.

translation.text: When you take a census of the Israelites being registered.

verses.english:
Everyone who passes through the counts shall give this:
half of a shekel, by the shekel of the Holy (the shekel is
twenty gerah); half of a shekel as a donation to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: זֶה יִתְּנוּ כּל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשֶּׁקֶל מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: זֶה יִתְּנוּ כּל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשֶּׁקֶל מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Everyone who passes through the counts shall give this:
half of a shekel, by the shekel of the Holy (the shekel is
twenty gerah); half of a shekel as a donation to YHWH.

translation.text: This is what each one who is registered shall give: twenty gerahs), half a shekel as an offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
Everyone who passes through the counts, from twenty years
old and up, shall give YHWH’s donation.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה יִתֵּן תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה יִתֵּן תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Everyone who passes through the counts, from twenty years
old and up, shall give YHWH’s donation.

translation.text: Each one LORD's offering.

verses.english:
The rich one shall not multiply, and the poor one shall
not diminish from the half of a shekel, to give YHWH’s
donation, to make atonement for your lives.
verses.hebrew: הֶעָשִׁיר לֹא יַרְבֶּה וְהַדַּל לֹא יַמְעִיט מִמַּחֲצִית הַשָּׁקֶל לָתֵת אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: הֶעָשִׁיר לֹא יַרְבֶּה וְהַדַּל לֹא יַמְעִיט מִמַּחֲצִית הַשָּׁקֶל לָתֵת אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
The rich one shall not multiply, and the poor one shall
not diminish from the half of a shekel, to give YHWH’s
donation, to make atonement for your lives.

translation.text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when you bring this offering to the LORD to make atonement for your lives.

verses.english:
And you shall take the atonement money from the children
of Israel and give it for the service of the Tent of
Meeting, and it shall become a commemorative for the
children of Israel in front of YHWH, to make atonement for
your lives.”
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת כֶּסֶף הַכִּפֻּרִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתַתָּ אֹתוֹ עַל עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָיָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת כֶּסֶף הַכִּפֻּרִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתַתָּ אֹתוֹ עַל עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָיָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall take the atonement money from the children
of Israel and give it for the service of the Tent of
Meeting, and it shall become a commemorative for the
children of Israel in front of YHWH, to make atonement for
your lives.”

translation.text: You shall take the atonement money from the Israelites and shall designate it for the service of the tent of meeting; before the LORD it will be a reminder to the Israelites of the ransom given for your lives.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:

verses.english:
“And you shall make a basin of bronze and its stand of
bronze for washing, and you shall put it between the Tent
of Meeting and the altar and put water there.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ כִּיּוֹר נְחֹשֶׁת וְכַנּוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת לְרחְצָה וְנָתַתָּ אֹתוֹ בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁמָּה מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ כִּיּוֹר נְחֹשֶׁת וְכַנּוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת לְרחְצָה וְנָתַתָּ אֹתוֹ בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁמָּה מָיִם׃

english.text:
“And you shall make a basin of bronze and its stand of
bronze for washing, and you shall put it between the Tent
of Meeting and the altar and put water there.

translation.text: You shall make a bronze basin with a meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it;

verses.english:
And Aaron and his sons will wash their hands and their
feet from it.
verses.hebrew: וְרָחֲצוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחֲצוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Aaron and his sons will wash their hands and their
feet from it.

translation.text: with the water Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet.

verses.english:
When they come to the Tent of Meeting they shall wash with
water, and they will not die—or when they come near to the
altar to minister, to burn an offering by fire to YHWH to
smoke.
verses.hebrew: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יִרְחֲצוּ מַיִם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ אוֹ בְגִשְׁתָּם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְשָׁרֵת לְהַקְטִיר אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יִרְחֲצוּ מַיִם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ אוֹ בְגִשְׁתָּם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְשָׁרֵת לְהַקְטִיר אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When they come to the Tent of Meeting they shall wash with
water, and they will not die—or when they come near to the
altar to minister, to burn an offering by fire to YHWH to
smoke.

translation.text: When they minister, to make an offering by fire to the LORD, they shall wash with water, so that they may not die.

verses.english:
And they shall wash their hands and their feet, and they
will not die. And it will be an eternal law for them—for
him and for his seed through their generations.”
verses.hebrew: וְרָחֲצוּ יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם חק עוֹלָם לוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחֲצוּ יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם חק עוֹלָם לוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
And they shall wash their hands and their feet, and they
will not die. And it will be an eternal law for them—for
him and for his seed through their generations.”

translation.text: They shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they may not die: it shall be a perpetual ordinance generations.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קַח לְךָ בְּשָׂמִים רֹאשׁ מר דְּרוֹר חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְקִנְּמן בֶּשֶׂם מַחֲצִיתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם וּקְנֵה בֹשֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה קַח לְךָ בְּשָׂמִים רֹאשׁ מר דְּרוֹר חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְקִנְּמן בֶּשֶׂם מַחֲצִיתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם וּקְנֵה בֹשֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם׃

translation.text: Take the finest spices: of liquid myrrh that is, two hundred fifty, and two hundred fifty of aromatic cane,

verses.english:
and cassia, five hundred—by the shekel of the Holy—and
olive oil, a hin.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדָּה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְשֶׁמֶן זַיִת הִין׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדָּה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְשֶׁמֶן זַיִת הִין׃

english.text:
and cassia, five hundred—by the shekel of the Holy—and
olive oil, a hin.

translation.text: a hin of olive oil;

verses.english:
And you shall make it oil of holy anointing, an ointment
mixture, the work of an ointment-maker. It shall be oil of
holy anointing.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתוֹ שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ רֹקַח מִרְקַחַת מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵחַ שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתוֹ שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ רֹקַח מִרְקַחַת מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵחַ שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And you shall make it oil of holy anointing, an ointment
mixture, the work of an ointment-maker. It shall be oil of
holy anointing.

translation.text: and you shall make of these a sacred anointing oil blended as by the perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.

verses.english:
And you shall anoint the Tent of Meeting and the Ark of
the Testimony with it,
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ בוֹ אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ בוֹ אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת׃

english.text:
And you shall anoint the Tent of Meeting and the Ark of
the Testimony with it,

translation.text: With it you shall anoint the tent of meeting and the ark of the covenant,

verses.english:
and the table and all its equipment and the menorah and
its equipment and the incense altar
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְאֶת כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְאֶת כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

english.text:
and the table and all its equipment and the menorah and
its equipment and the incense altar

translation.text: and the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,

verses.english:
and the altar of burnt offering and all its equipment and
the basin and its stand.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

english.text:
and the altar of burnt offering and all its equipment and
the basin and its stand.

translation.text: and the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand;

verses.english:
And you shall make them holy, and they shall be holy of
holies. Anyone who touches them will be holy.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall make them holy, and they shall be holy of
holies. Anyone who touches them will be holy.

translation.text: you shall consecrate them, so that they may be most holy; whatever touches them will become holy.

verses.english:
And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and make them holy
to function as priests for me.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תִּמְשָׁח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תִּמְשָׁח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and make them holy
to function as priests for me.

translation.text: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, in order that they may serve me as priests.

verses.english:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying,
‘This shall be oil of holy anointing for me through your
generations.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה זֶה לִי לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה זֶה לִי לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying,
‘This shall be oil of holy anointing for me through your
generations.

translation.text: You shall say to the Israelites, "This shall be my holy anointing oil throughout your generations.

verses.english:
It shall not be poured on human flesh, and you shall not
make anything else like it in its quantities. It is a holy
thing. It shall be a holy thing to you.
verses.hebrew: עַל בְּשַׂר אָדָם לֹא יִיסָךְ וּבְמַתְכֻּנְתּוֹ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ כָּמֹהוּ קֹדֶשׁ הוּא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: עַל בְּשַׂר אָדָם לֹא יִיסָךְ וּבְמַתְכֻּנְתּוֹ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ כָּמֹהוּ קֹדֶשׁ הוּא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
It shall not be poured on human flesh, and you shall not
make anything else like it in its quantities. It is a holy
thing. It shall be a holy thing to you.

translation.text: It make no other like it in composition; it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.

verses.english:
Anyone who will make a compound like it and who will give
some of it to an outsider: he will be cut off from his
people.’”
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִרְקַח כָּמֹהוּ וַאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ עַל זָר וְנִכְרַת מֵעַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִרְקַח כָּמֹהוּ וַאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ עַל זָר וְנִכְרַת מֵעַמָּיו׃

english.text:
Anyone who will make a compound like it and who will give
some of it to an outsider: he will be cut off from his
people.’”

translation.text: Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it on an unqualified person shall be cut off from the people."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take fragrances—stacte and onycha
and galbanum—fragrances and clear frankincense; it shall
be part for part.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח לְךָ סַמִּים נָטָף וּשְׁחֵלֶת וְחֶלְבְּנָה סַמִּים וּלְבֹנָה זַכָּה בַּד בְּבַד יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח לְךָ סַמִּים נָטָף וּשְׁחֵלֶת וְחֶלְבְּנָה סַמִּים וּלְבֹנָה זַכָּה בַּד בְּבַד יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take fragrances—stacte and onycha
and galbanum—fragrances and clear frankincense; it shall
be part for part.

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses: Take sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and

verses.english:
And you shall make it ointment incense, the work of an
ointment-maker: salted, pure, holy.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתָהּ קְטֹרֶת רֹקַח מַעֲשֵׂה רוֹקֵחַ מְמֻלָּח טָהוֹר קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתָהּ קְטֹרֶת רֹקַח מַעֲשֵׂה רוֹקֵחַ מְמֻלָּח טָהוֹר קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall make it ointment incense, the work of an
ointment-maker: salted, pure, holy.

translation.text: and make an incense blended as by the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy;

verses.english:
And you shall pound some of it, making it thin, and put
some of it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of
Meeting where I shall meet with you. It shall be holy of
holies to you.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנָּה הָדֵק וְנָתַתָּה מִמֶּנָּה לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָׁמָּה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנָּה הָדֵק וְנָתַתָּה מִמֶּנָּה לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָׁמָּה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall pound some of it, making it thin, and put
some of it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of
Meeting where I shall meet with you. It shall be holy of
holies to you.

translation.text: and you shall beat some of it into powder, and put part of it before the covenant in the tent of meeting where I shall meet with you; it shall be for you most holy.

verses.english:
And the incense that you will make: you shall not make for
yourselves in its quantities. It shall be a holy thing to
you for YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַקְּטֹרֶת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּמַתְכֻּנְתָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לְךָ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַקְּטֹרֶת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּמַתְכֻּנְתָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לְךָ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the incense that you will make: you shall not make for
yourselves in its quantities. It shall be a holy thing to
you for YHWH.

translation.text: When you make yourselves; it shall be regarded by you as holy to the LORD.

verses.english:
Anyone who will make anything like it to make a fragrance
with it will be cut off from his people.”
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כָמוֹהָ לְהָרִיחַ בָּהּ וְנִכְרַת מֵעַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כָמוֹהָ לְהָרִיחַ בָּהּ וְנִכְרַת מֵעַמָּיו׃

english.text:
Anyone who will make anything like it to make a fragrance
with it will be cut off from his people.”

translation.text: Whoever makes any like it to use as perfume shall be cut off from the people.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:
