verses.english:
“See, I’ve called by name Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur,
of the tribe of Judah.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה קָרָאתִי בְשֵׁם בְּצַלְאֵל בֶּן אוּרִי בֶן חוּר לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה קָרָאתִי בְשֵׁם בְּצַלְאֵל בֶּן אוּרִי בֶן חוּר לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
“See, I’ve called by name Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur,
of the tribe of Judah.

translation.text: See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

verses.english:
And I’ve filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom and
in understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of
work,
verses.hebrew: וָאֲמַלֵּא אֹתוֹ רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בְּחכְמָה וּבִתְבוּנָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכל מְלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲמַלֵּא אֹתוֹ רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בְּחכְמָה וּבִתְבוּנָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכל מְלָאכָה׃

english.text:
And I’ve filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom and
in understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of
work,

translation.text: and I have filled him with divine spirit, with ability, intelligence, and knowledge in every kind of craft,

verses.english:
to form conceptions to make in gold and in silver and in
bronze
verses.hebrew: לַחְשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבֹת לַעֲשׂוֹת בַּזָּהָב וּבַכֶּסֶף וּבַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: לַחְשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבֹת לַעֲשׂוֹת בַּזָּהָב וּבַכֶּסֶף וּבַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
to form conceptions to make in gold and in silver and in
bronze

translation.text: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,

verses.english:
and in cutting stone for setting and in cutting wood—for
making things in every kind of work.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן לְמַלֹּאת וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּכל מְלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן לְמַלֹּאת וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּכל מְלָאכָה׃

english.text:
and in cutting stone for setting and in cutting wood—for
making things in every kind of work.

translation.text: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, in every kind of craft.

verses.english:
And I: here, I’ve put Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the
tribe of Dan, with him. And in the heart of every
wise-hearted person I’ve put wisdom. And they’ll make
everything that I’ve commanded you:
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אִתּוֹ אֵת אהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן וּבְלֵב כּל חֲכַם לֵב נָתַתִּי חכְמָה וְעָשׂוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אִתּוֹ אֵת אהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן וּבְלֵב כּל חֲכַם לֵב נָתַתִּי חכְמָה וְעָשׂוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ׃

english.text:
And I: here, I’ve put Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the
tribe of Dan, with him. And in the heart of every
wise-hearted person I’ve put wisdom. And they’ll make
everything that I’ve commanded you:

translation.text: tribe of Dan; and I have given skill to all the skillful, so that they may make all that I have commanded you:

verses.english:
the Tent of Meeting and the Ark of the Testimony and the
atonement dais that is on it and all the equipment of the
tent
verses.hebrew: אֵת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הָאָרֹן לָעֵדֻת וְאֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: אֵת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הָאָרֹן לָעֵדֻת וְאֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
the Tent of Meeting and the Ark of the Testimony and the
atonement dais that is on it and all the equipment of the
tent

translation.text: the tent of meeting, and the furnishings of the tent,

verses.english:
and the table and its equipment and the pure menorah and
all its equipment and the incense altar
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

english.text:
and the table and its equipment and the pure menorah and
all its equipment and the incense altar

translation.text: the table and its utensils, and the pure lampstand with all its utensils, and the altar of incense,

verses.english:
and the burnt offering altar and all its equipment and the
basin and its stand
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיּוֹר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיּוֹר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

english.text:
and the burnt offering altar and all its equipment and the
basin and its stand

translation.text: and the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand,

verses.english:
and the fabric clothes and the holy clothes for Aaron, the
priest, and his sons’ clothes for functioning as priests
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵן׃

english.text:
and the fabric clothes and the holy clothes for Aaron, the
priest, and his sons’ clothes for functioning as priests

translation.text: Aaron and the vestments of his sons, for their service as priests,

verses.english:
and the anointing oil and the incense of fragrances for
the Holy. According to everything that I’ve commanded you,
they shall do.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים לַקֹּדֶשׁ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ יַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים לַקֹּדֶשׁ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ יַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
and the anointing oil and the incense of fragrances for
the Holy. According to everything that I’ve commanded you,
they shall do.”

translation.text: and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense for the holy place. They shall do just as I have commanded you.

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses:

verses.english:
“And you, speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Just:
you shall observe my Sabbaths, because it is a sign
between me and you through your generations: to know that
I, YHWH, make you holy.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אַךְ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ כִּי אוֹת הִוא בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם לָדַעַת כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אַךְ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ כִּי אוֹת הִוא בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם לָדַעַת כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
“And you, speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Just:
you shall observe my Sabbaths, because it is a sign
between me and you through your generations: to know that
I, YHWH, make you holy.

translation.text: You yourself are to speak to the Israelites: the LORD, sanctify you.

verses.english:
And you shall observe the Sabbath, because it is a holy thing to
you. One who desecrates it shall be put to death. Because anyone who
does work in it: that person will be cut off from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת כִּי קֹדֶשׁ הִוא לָכֶם מְחַלְלֶיהָ מוֹת יוּמָת כִּי כּל הָעֹשֶׂה בָהּ מְלָאכָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת כִּי קֹדֶשׁ הִוא לָכֶם מְחַלְלֶיהָ מוֹת יוּמָת כִּי כּל הָעֹשֶׂה בָהּ מְלָאכָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And you shall observe the Sabbath, because it is a holy thing to
you. One who desecrates it shall be put to death. Because anyone who
does work in it: that person will be cut off from among his people.

translation.text: You shall keep the sabbath, because it is holy any work on it shall be cut off from among the people.

verses.english:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day is a
Sabbath, a ceasing, a holy thing to YHWH. Anyone who does
work in the Sabbath day shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים יֵעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה כּל הָעֹשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים יֵעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה כּל הָעֹשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day is a
Sabbath, a ceasing, a holy thing to YHWH. Anyone who does
work in the Sabbath day shall be put to death.

translation.text: Six days shall death.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel shall observe the Sabbath, to
make the Sabbath through their generations, an eternal
covenant.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת לְדֹרֹתָם בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת לְדֹרֹתָם בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel shall observe the Sabbath, to
make the Sabbath through their generations, an eternal
covenant.

translation.text: Therefore the Israelites shall keep the sabbath, observing the sabbath throughout their generations, as a perpetual covenant.

verses.english:
Between me and the children of Israel it is a sign
forever, because for six days YHWH made the skies and the
earth, and in the seventh day He ceased and was
refreshed.’”
verses.hebrew: בֵּינִי וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹת הִוא לְעֹלָם כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שָׁבַת וַיִּנָּפַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: בֵּינִי וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹת הִוא לְעֹלָם כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שָׁבַת וַיִּנָּפַשׁ׃

english.text:
Between me and the children of Israel it is a sign
forever, because for six days YHWH made the skies and the
earth, and in the seventh day He ceased and was
refreshed.’”

translation.text: It is a sign forever between me and the people of Israel that in six days the was refreshed."

verses.english:
And when He finished speaking with him in Mount Sinai, He
gave the two tablets of the Testimony to Moses, tablets of
stone, written by the finger of God.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינַי שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת לֻחֹת אֶבֶן כְּתֻבִים בְּאֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינַי שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת לֻחֹת אֶבֶן כְּתֻבִים בְּאֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And when He finished speaking with him in Mount Sinai, He
gave the two tablets of the Testimony to Moses, tablets of
stone, written by the finger of God.

translation.text: When God finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.

verses.english:
And the people saw that Moses was delaying to come down
from the mountain, and the people assembled at Aaron and
said to him, “Get up. Make gods for us who will go in
front of us, because this Moses, the man who brought us up
from the land of Egypt: we don’t know what has become of
him!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא הָעָם כִּי בֹשֵׁשׁ מֹשֶׁה לָרֶדֶת מִן הָהָר וַיִּקָּהֵל הָעָם עַל אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו קוּם עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ לְפָנֵינוּ כִּי זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מֶה הָיָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא הָעָם כִּי בֹשֵׁשׁ מֹשֶׁה לָרֶדֶת מִן הָהָר וַיִּקָּהֵל הָעָם עַל אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו קוּם עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ לְפָנֵינוּ כִּי זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מֶה הָיָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And the people saw that Moses was delaying to come down
from the mountain, and the people assembled at Aaron and
said to him, “Get up. Make gods for us who will go in
front of us, because this Moses, the man who brought us up
from the land of Egypt: we don’t know what has become of
him!”

translation.text: When the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the become of him."

verses.english:
And Aaron said to them, “Take off the gold rings that are
in your wives’, your sons’, and your daughters’ ears, and
bring them to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַהֲרֹן פָּרְקוּ נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵי נְשֵׁיכֶם בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶם וְהָבִיאוּ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַהֲרֹן פָּרְקוּ נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵי נְשֵׁיכֶם בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶם וְהָבִיאוּ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And Aaron said to them, “Take off the gold rings that are
in your wives’, your sons’, and your daughters’ ears, and
bring them to me.”

translation.text: Aaron said to them, "Take off the gold rings that are on the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me."

verses.english:
And all the people took off the gold rings that were in
their ears and brought them to Aaron.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפָּרְקוּ כּל הָעָם אֶת נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפָּרְקוּ כּל הָעָם אֶת נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And all the people took off the gold rings that were in
their ears and brought them to Aaron.

translation.text: So all the people took off the gold rings from their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

verses.english:
And he took them from their hand and fashioned it with a
stylus and made it a molten calf. And they said, “These
are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of
Egypt!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מִיָּדָם וַיָּצַר אֹתוֹ בַּחֶרֶט וַיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מִיָּדָם וַיָּצַר אֹתוֹ בַּחֶרֶט וַיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And he took them from their hand and fashioned it with a
stylus and made it a molten calf. And they said, “These
are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of
Egypt!”

translation.text: He took the gold from them, formed it in a mold, and cast an image of a calf; and they said, "These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!"

verses.english:
And Aaron saw, and he built an altar in front of it, and
Aaron called, and he said, “A festival to YHWH tomorrow!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וַיִּבֶן מִזְבֵּחַ לְפָנָיו וַיִּקְרָא אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמַר חַג לַיהֹוָה מָחָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וַיִּבֶן מִזְבֵּחַ לְפָנָיו וַיִּקְרָא אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמַר חַג לַיהֹוָה מָחָר׃

english.text:
And Aaron saw, and he built an altar in front of it, and
Aaron called, and he said, “A festival to YHWH tomorrow!”

translation.text: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation and said, "Tomorrow shall be a festival to the LORD."

verses.english:
And they got up early the next day, and they made burnt
offerings and brought over peace offerings, and the people
sat down to eat and drink, and they got up to fool around.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ מִמּחֳרָת וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלֹת וַיַּגִּשׁוּ שְׁלָמִים וַיֵּשֶׁב הָעָם לֶאֱכֹל וְשָׁתוֹ וַיָּקֻמוּ לְצַחֵק׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ מִמּחֳרָת וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלֹת וַיַּגִּשׁוּ שְׁלָמִים וַיֵּשֶׁב הָעָם לֶאֱכֹל וְשָׁתוֹ וַיָּקֻמוּ לְצַחֵק׃

english.text:
And they got up early the next day, and they made burnt
offerings and brought over peace offerings, and the people
sat down to eat and drink, and they got up to fool around.

translation.text: sacrifices of well-being; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to revel.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses: “Go. Go down. Because your
people, whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, has
corrupted.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֶךְ רֵד כִּי שִׁחֵת עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלֵיתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֶךְ רֵד כִּי שִׁחֵת עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלֵיתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses: “Go. Go down. Because your
people, whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, has
corrupted.

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "Go down at once! Your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have acted perversely;

verses.english:
They’ve turned quickly from the way that I commanded them.
They’ve made themselves a molten calf, and they’ve bowed
to it and sacrificed to it and said, ‘These are your gods,
Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!’”
verses.hebrew: סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם עָשׂוּ לָהֶם עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם עָשׂוּ לָהֶם עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
They’ve turned quickly from the way that I commanded them.
They’ve made themselves a molten calf, and they’ve bowed
to it and sacrificed to it and said, ‘These are your gods,
Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!’”

translation.text: they have been quick to turn aside from the way that I commanded them; they have cast for themselves an image of a calf, and have worshiped it brought you up out of the land of Egypt!'"

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ve seen this people; and, here,
it’s a hard-necked people.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ve seen this people; and, here,
it’s a hard-necked people.

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "I have seen this people, how stiff-necked they are.

verses.english:
And now, leave off from me, and my anger will flare at
them, and I’ll finish them, and I’ll make you into a big
nation!”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי וְיִחַר אַפִּי בָהֶם וַאֲכַלֵּם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי וְיִחַר אַפִּי בָהֶם וַאֲכַלֵּם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
And now, leave off from me, and my anger will flare at
them, and I’ll finish them, and I’ll make you into a big
nation!”

translation.text: Now let me alone, so that my wrath may burn hot against them and I may consume them; and of you I will make a great nation."

verses.english:
And Moses conciliated in front of YHWH, his God, and said,
“Why, YHWH, should your anger flare at your people whom
you brought out from the land of Egypt with big power and
with a strong hand?
verses.hebrew: וַיְחַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָה יְהֹוָה יֶחֱרֶה אַפְּךָ בְּעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָה יְהֹוָה יֶחֱרֶה אַפְּךָ בְּעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
And Moses conciliated in front of YHWH, his God, and said,
“Why, YHWH, should your anger flare at your people whom
you brought out from the land of Egypt with big power and
with a strong hand?

translation.text: But Moses implored the LORD his God, and said, "O LORD, why does the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

verses.english:
Why should Egypt say, saying, ‘He brought them out for
bad, to kill them in the mountains, and to finish them
from on the face of the earth’? Turn back from your
flaring anger, and relent about the bad to your people.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר בְּרָעָה הוֹצִיאָם לַהֲרֹג אֹתָם בֶּהָרִים וּלְכַלֹּתָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר בְּרָעָה הוֹצִיאָם לַהֲרֹג אֹתָם בֶּהָרִים וּלְכַלֹּתָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Why should Egypt say, saying, ‘He brought them out for
bad, to kill them in the mountains, and to finish them
from on the face of the earth’? Turn back from your
flaring anger, and relent about the bad to your people.

translation.text: Why should the Egyptians say, 'It was with evil intent that he brought them not bring disaster on your people.

verses.english:
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, that
you swore to them by yourself, and you spoke to them:
‘I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies, and
I’ll give to your seed all this land that I’ve said, and
they’ll possess it forever.’”
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם וְנָחֲלוּ לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: זְכֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם וְנָחֲלוּ לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, that
you swore to them by yourself, and you spoke to them:
‘I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies, and
I’ll give to your seed all this land that I’ve said, and
they’ll possess it forever.’”

translation.text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and to them, 'I will multiply your descendants like the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have promised I will give to your descendants, and they shall inherit it forever.'"

verses.english:
And YHWH relented about the bad that He had spoken, to do
to His people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה עַל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַעֲשׂוֹת לְעַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה עַל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַעֲשׂוֹת לְעַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH relented about the bad that He had spoken, to do
to His people.

translation.text: And the LORD changed his mind about the disaster that he planned to bring on his people.

verses.english:
And Moses turned and went down from the mountain. And the
two tablets of witness were in his hand, tablets written
from their two sides: from this side and from this side
they were written.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיָדוֹ לֻחֹת כְּתֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵיהֶם מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה הֵם כְּתֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיָדוֹ לֻחֹת כְּתֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵיהֶם מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה הֵם כְּתֻבִים׃

english.text:
And Moses turned and went down from the mountain. And the
two tablets of witness were in his hand, tablets written
from their two sides: from this side and from this side
they were written.

translation.text: Then Moses turned and went down from the mountain, carrying the both sides, written on the front and on the back.

verses.english:
And the tablets: they were God’s doing. And the writing:
it was God’s writing, inscribed on the tablets.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלֻּחֹת מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּב מִכְתַּב אֱלֹהִים הוּא חָרוּת עַל הַלֻּחֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַלֻּחֹת מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּב מִכְתַּב אֱלֹהִים הוּא חָרוּת עַל הַלֻּחֹת׃

english.text:
And the tablets: they were God’s doing. And the writing:
it was God’s writing, inscribed on the tablets.

translation.text: The tablets were upon the tablets.

verses.english:
And Joshua heard the sound of the people in its shouting,
and he said to Moses, “A sound of war is in the camp.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת קוֹל הָעָם בְּרֵעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל מֹשֶׁה קוֹל מִלְחָמָה בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת קוֹל הָעָם בְּרֵעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל מֹשֶׁה קוֹל מִלְחָמָה בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Joshua heard the sound of the people in its shouting,
and he said to Moses, “A sound of war is in the camp.”

translation.text: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, "There is a noise of war in the camp."

verses.english:
And he said, “It’s not a sound of singing of victory, and
it’s not a sound of singing of defeat. It’s just the sound
of singing I hear!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת גְּבוּרָה וְאֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת חֲלוּשָׁה קוֹל עַנּוֹת אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת גְּבוּרָה וְאֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת חֲלוּשָׁה קוֹל עַנּוֹת אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

english.text:
And he said, “It’s not a sound of singing of victory, and
it’s not a sound of singing of defeat. It’s just the sound
of singing I hear!”

translation.text: or the sound made by losers; it is the sound of revelers that I hear."

verses.english:
And it was when he came close to the camp, and he saw the
calf and dancing: and Moses’ anger flared, and he threw
the tablets from his hands and shattered them below the
mountain.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר קָרַב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֵגֶל וּמְחֹלֹת וַיִּחַר אַף מֹשֶׁה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ מִיָּדָו אֶת הַלֻּחֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר אֹתָם תַּחַת הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר קָרַב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֵגֶל וּמְחֹלֹת וַיִּחַר אַף מֹשֶׁה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ מִיָּדָו אֶת הַלֻּחֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר אֹתָם תַּחַת הָהָר׃

english.text:
And it was when he came close to the camp, and he saw the
calf and dancing: and Moses’ anger flared, and he threw
the tablets from his hands and shattered them below the
mountain.

translation.text: As soon as he came near the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, broke them at the foot of the mountain.

verses.english:
And he took the calf that they had made, and he burned it
in fire and ground it until it was thin, and he scattered
it on the face of the water, and he made the children of
Israel drink!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּטְחַן עַד אֲשֶׁר דָּק וַיִּזֶר עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּטְחַן עַד אֲשֶׁר דָּק וַיִּזֶר עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he took the calf that they had made, and he burned it
in fire and ground it until it was thin, and he scattered
it on the face of the water, and he made the children of
Israel drink!

translation.text: He took the calf that they had made, burned it with fire, ground it to powder, scattered it on the water, and made the Israelites drink it.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “What did this people do to you,
that you’ve brought a big sin on it?!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן מֶה עָשָׂה לְךָ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלָיו חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה׃

is for YHWH: to me!” And all the children of Levi were
gathered to him.

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד מֹשֶׁה בְּשַׁעַר הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לַיהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּאָסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

english.text:
And Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, “Whoever
is for YHWH: to me!” And all the children of Levi were
gathered to him.

translation.text: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, "Who is on the LORD's side? Come to me!" And all the sons of Levi gathered around him.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “YHWH, God of Israel, said this:
‘Set, each man, his sword on his thigh; cross over and
come back from gate to gate in the camp; and kill, each
man, his brother and, each man, his neighbor and, each
man, his relative.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׂימוּ אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל יְרֵכוֹ עִבְרוּ וָשׁוּבוּ מִשַּׁעַר לָשַׁעַר בַּמַּחֲנֶה וְהִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו וְאִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִישׁ אֶת קְרֹבוֹ׃

And the children of Levi did according to Moses’ word, and

verses.english:

man was at his son and at his brother—and to put a
blessing on you today.”

And Moses said, “Fill your hand to YHWH today—because each

“You’ve committed a big sin. And now I’ll go up to YHWH.
Perhaps I may make atonement for your sin.”

“You’ve committed a big sin. And now I’ll go up to YHWH.
Perhaps I may make atonement for your sin.”

themselves.

english.text:
And now, if you will bear their sin—and if not, wipe me
out from your scroll that you’ve written.”

translation.text: But now, if you will only forgive their sin — but if not, blot me out of the book that you have written."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The one who has sinned against
me, I’ll wipe him out from my scroll.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מִי אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לִי אֶמְחֶנּוּ מִסִּפְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מִי אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לִי אֶמְחֶנּוּ מִסִּפְרִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The one who has sinned against
me, I’ll wipe him out from my scroll.

translation.text: But the LORD said to Moses, "Whoever has sinned against me I will blot out of my book.

verses.english:
And now, go. Lead the people to where I spoke to you.
Here, my angel will go ahead of you. And, in the day that
I take account, I’ll account their sin on them.”

And now, go. Lead the people to where I spoke to you.
Here, my angel will go ahead of you. And, in the day that
I take account, I’ll account their sin on them.”

verses.english:
And YHWH struck the people because they had made the calf,
which Aaron had made.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת הָעָם עַל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH struck the people because they had made the calf,
which Aaron had made.

translation.text: Then the LORD sent a plague on the people, because they made the calf — the one that Aaron made.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses: “Go. Go up from here, you and
the people whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, to
the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob,
saying, ‘I’ll give it to your seed.’

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵךְ עֲלֵה מִזֶּה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלִיתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה׃

And YHWH spoke to Moses: “Go. Go up from here, you and
the people whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, to
the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob,
saying, ‘I’ll give it to your seed.’

Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite and the Perizzite
and the Hivite and the Jebusite—

english.text:
And I’ll send an angel ahead of you—and I’ll drive out the
Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite and the Perizzite
and the Hivite and the Jebusite—

translation.text: I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.english:
to a land flowing with milk and honey, because I won’t go
up among you, because you’re a hard-necked people, or else
I’ll finish you on the way.”

hebrew.text: אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ כִּי לֹא אֶעֱלֶה בְּקִרְבְּךָ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף אַתָּה פֶּן אֲכֶלְךָ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
to a land flowing with milk and honey, because I won’t go
up among you, because you’re a hard-necked people, or else
I’ll finish you on the way.”

translation.text: Go up to a land flowing with milk and way, for you are a stiff-necked people."

verses.english:
And the people heard this bad thing, and they mourned, and
not a man put his jewelry on him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה וַיִּתְאַבָּלוּ וְלֹא שָׁתוּ אִישׁ עֶדְיוֹ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה וַיִּתְאַבָּלוּ וְלֹא שָׁתוּ אִישׁ עֶדְיוֹ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And the people heard this bad thing, and they mourned, and
not a man put his jewelry on him.

translation.text: When the people heard these harsh words, they mourned, and no one put on ornaments.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the children of Israel:
‘You’re a hard-necked people. If I would go up among you
for one moment, I would finish you! And now, put your
jewelry down from on you, so I may know what I’ll do with
you.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף רֶגַע אֶחָד אֶעֱלֶה בְקִרְבְּךָ וְכִלִּיתִיךָ וְעַתָּה הוֹרֵד עֶדְיְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְאֵדְעָה מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף רֶגַע אֶחָד אֶעֱלֶה בְקִרְבְּךָ וְכִלִּיתִיךָ וְעַתָּה הוֹרֵד עֶדְיְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְאֵדְעָה מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the children of Israel:
‘You’re a hard-necked people. If I would go up among you
for one moment, I would finish you! And now, put your
jewelry down from on you, so I may know what I’ll do with
you.’”

translation.text: For the LORD had said to Moses, "Say to the ornaments, and I will decide what to do to you.'"

verses.english:
And the children of Israel divested their jewelry from
Mount Horeb.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְנַצְּלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶדְיָם מֵהַר חוֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְנַצְּלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶדְיָם מֵהַר חוֹרֵב׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel divested their jewelry from
Mount Horeb.

translation.text: Therefore the onward.

verses.english:
And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside of the
camp, going far from the camp, and he called it the Tent
of Meeting. And it would be: everyone seeking YHWH would
go out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside of the
camp.
verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה יִקַּח אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְנָטָה לוֹ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה הַרְחֵק מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה וְקָרָא לוֹ אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָיָה כּל מְבַקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה יֵצֵא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה יִקַּח אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְנָטָה לוֹ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה הַרְחֵק מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה וְקָרָא לוֹ אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָיָה כּל מְבַקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה יֵצֵא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside of the
camp, going far from the camp, and he called it the Tent
of Meeting. And it would be: everyone seeking YHWH would
go out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside of the
camp.

translation.text: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far outside the camp.

verses.english:
And it would be, when Moses would go out to the Tent, all
the people would get up, and they would stand up, each one
at the entrance of his tent, and they would look after
Moses until he came to the Tent.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּצֵאת מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֹהֶל יָקוּמוּ כּל הָעָם וְנִצְּבוּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ וְהִבִּיטוּ אַחֲרֵי מֹשֶׁה עַד בֹּאוֹ הָאֹהֱלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּצֵאת מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֹהֶל יָקוּמוּ כּל הָעָם וְנִצְּבוּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ וְהִבִּיטוּ אַחֲרֵי מֹשֶׁה עַד בֹּאוֹ הָאֹהֱלָה׃

english.text:
And it would be, when Moses would go out to the Tent, all
the people would get up, and they would stand up, each one
at the entrance of his tent, and they would look after
Moses until he came to the Tent.

translation.text: Whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the tents and watch Moses until he had gone into the tent.

verses.english:
And it would be, when Moses came to the Tent, the column
of cloud would come down, and it would stand at the
entrance of the Tent, and He would speak with Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּבֹא מֹשֶׁה הָאֹהֱלָה יֵרֵד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן וְעָמַד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְדִבֶּר עִם מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּבֹא מֹשֶׁה הָאֹהֱלָה יֵרֵד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן וְעָמַד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְדִבֶּר עִם מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And it would be, when Moses came to the Tent, the column
of cloud would come down, and it would stand at the
entrance of the Tent, and He would speak with Moses.

translation.text: When Moses entrance of the tent, and the LORD would speak with Moses.

verses.english:
And all the people would see the column of cloud standing
at the entrance of the Tent, and all the people would get
up and bow, each at the entrance of his tent.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֶת עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עֹמֵד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְקָם כּל הָעָם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֶת עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עֹמֵד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְקָם כּל הָעָם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ׃

english.text:
And all the people would see the column of cloud standing
at the entrance of the Tent, and all the people would get
up and bow, each at the entrance of his tent.

translation.text: When entrance of their tent.

verses.english:
And YHWH would speak to Moses face-to-face, the way a man
speaks to his fellow man. And he would come back to the
camp. And his attendant, Joshua, son of Nun, a young man,
would not depart from inside the Tent.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ וְשָׁב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וּמְשָׁרְתוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן נַעַר לֹא יָמִישׁ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ וְשָׁב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וּמְשָׁרְתוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן נַעַר לֹא יָמִישׁ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
And YHWH would speak to Moses face-to-face, the way a man
speaks to his fellow man. And he would come back to the
camp. And his attendant, Joshua, son of Nun, a young man,
would not depart from inside the Tent.

translation.text: Thus the LORD used to speak to Moses face to his young assistant, Joshua son of Nun, would not leave the tent.

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “See, you say to me, ‘Bring this
people up,’ and you haven’t made known to me whom you will
send with me. And you’ve said, ‘I’ve known you by name,’
and also ‘You’ve found favor in my eyes.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה רְאֵה אַתָּה אֹמֵר אֵלַי הַעַל אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא הוֹדַעְתַּנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ יְדַעְתִּיךָ בְשֵׁם וְגַם מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה רְאֵה אַתָּה אֹמֵר אֵלַי הַעַל אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא הוֹדַעְתַּנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ יְדַעְתִּיךָ בְשֵׁם וְגַם מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “See, you say to me, ‘Bring this
people up,’ and you haven’t made known to me whom you will
send with me. And you’ve said, ‘I’ve known you by name,’
and also ‘You’ve found favor in my eyes.’

translation.text: Moses said to the LORD, "See, you have said to me, 'Bring up this people'; but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. in my sight.'

verses.english:
And now, if I’ve found favor in your eyes, make your way
known to me, so I may know you, so that I’ll find favor in
your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ הוֹדִעֵנִי נָא אֶת דְּרָכֶךָ וְאֵדָעֲךָ לְמַעַן אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כִּי עַמְּךָ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ הוֹדִעֵנִי נָא אֶת דְּרָכֶךָ וְאֵדָעֲךָ לְמַעַן אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כִּי עַמְּךָ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And now, if I’ve found favor in your eyes, make your way
known to me, so I may know you, so that I’ll find favor in
your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.”

translation.text: Now if I have found favor in your sight, show me your ways, so that I may know you and find favor in your sight. Consider too that this nation is your people."

verses.english: And He said, “My face will go, and I’ll let you rest.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר פָּנַי יֵלֵכוּ וַהֲנִחֹתִי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר פָּנַי יֵלֵכוּ וַהֲנִחֹתִי לָךְ׃

english.text: And He said, “My face will go, and I’ll let you rest.”

translation.text: He said, "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."

verses.english:
And he said to Him, “If your face isn’t going, don’t take
us up from here.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם אֵין פָּנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים אַל תַּעֲלֵנוּ מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם אֵין פָּנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים אַל תַּעֲלֵנוּ מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he said to Him, “If your face isn’t going, don’t take
us up from here.

translation.text: And he said to him, "If your presence will not go, do not carry us up from here.

verses.english:
And by what then will it be known that I’ve found favor in
your eyes, I and your people? Is it not by your going with
us? And we’ll be distinguished, I and your people, from
every people that is on the face of the earth.”
verses.hebrew: וּבַמֶּה יִוָּדַע אֵפוֹא כִּי מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲנִי וְעַמֶּךָ הֲלוֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ עִמָּנוּ וְנִפְלִינוּ אֲנִי וְעַמְּךָ מִכּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַמֶּה יִוָּדַע אֵפוֹא כִּי מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲנִי וְעַמֶּךָ הֲלוֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ עִמָּנוּ וְנִפְלִינוּ אֲנִי וְעַמְּךָ מִכּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And by what then will it be known that I’ve found favor in
your eyes, I and your people? Is it not by your going with
us? And we’ll be distinguished, I and your people, from
every people that is on the face of the earth.”

translation.text: For how shall it be known that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people, unless you go with us? In this way, we shall be distinct, I and your people, from every people on the face of the earth."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll do this thing that you’ve
spoken as well, because you’ve found favor in my eyes, and
I’ve known you by name.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה גַּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינַי וָאֵדָעֲךָ בְּשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה גַּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינַי וָאֵדָעֲךָ בְּשֵׁם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll do this thing that you’ve
spoken as well, because you’ve found favor in my eyes, and
I’ve known you by name.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "I will do the very thing that you have asked; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name."

verses.english: And he said, “Show me your glory!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר הַרְאֵנִי נָא אֶת כְּבֹדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר הַרְאֵנִי נָא אֶת כְּבֹדֶךָ׃

english.text: And he said, “Show me your glory!”

translation.text: Moses said, "Show me your glory, I pray."

verses.english:
And He said, “I shall have all my good pass in front of
you, and I shall invoke the name YHWH in front of you. And
I shall show grace to whomever I shall show grace, and I
shall show mercy to whomever I shall show mercy.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אַעֲבִיר כּל טוּבִי עַל פָּנֶיךָ וְקָרָאתִי בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אֲרַחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אַעֲבִיר כּל טוּבִי עַל פָּנֶיךָ וְקָרָאתִי בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אֲרַחֵם׃

english.text:
And He said, “I shall have all my good pass in front of
you, and I shall invoke the name YHWH in front of you. And
I shall show grace to whomever I shall show grace, and I
shall show mercy to whomever I shall show mercy.”

translation.text: And he said, "I will the name, 'The LORD'; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.

verses.english:
And He said, “You won’t be able to see my face, because a
human will not see me and live.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת פָּנָי כִּי לֹא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת פָּנָי כִּי לֹא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

english.text:
And He said, “You won’t be able to see my face, because a
human will not see me and live.”

translation.text: But," he said, "you cannot see my face; for no one shall see me and live."

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “Here is a place with me, and you’ll stand
up on a rock;
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה מָקוֹם אִתִּי וְנִצַּבְתָּ עַל הַצּוּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה מָקוֹם אִתִּי וְנִצַּבְתָּ עַל הַצּוּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “Here is a place with me, and you’ll stand
up on a rock;

translation.text: And the LORD rock;

verses.english:
and it will be, when my glory passes, that I’ll set you in
a cleft of the rock, and I’ll cover my hand over you until
I’ve passed,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּעֲבֹר כְּבֹדִי וְשַׂמְתִּיךָ בְּנִקְרַת הַצּוּר וְשַׂכֹּתִי כַפִּי עָלֶיךָ עַד עבְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּעֲבֹר כְּבֹדִי וְשַׂמְתִּיךָ בְּנִקְרַת הַצּוּר וְשַׂכֹּתִי כַפִּי עָלֶיךָ עַד עבְרִי׃

english.text:
and it will be, when my glory passes, that I’ll set you in
a cleft of the rock, and I’ll cover my hand over you until
I’ve passed,

translation.text: and while my glory passes by I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and I will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

verses.english:
and I’ll turn my hand away, and you’ll see my back, but my
face won’t be seen.”
verses.hebrew: וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת כַּפִּי וְרָאִיתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָי וּפָנַי לֹא יֵרָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת כַּפִּי וְרָאִיתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָי וּפָנַי לֹא יֵרָאוּ׃

english.text:
and I’ll turn my hand away, and you’ll see my back, but my
face won’t be seen.”

translation.text: then I not be seen."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Carve two tablets of stones
like the first ones, and I’ll write on the tablets the
words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פְּסל לְךָ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וְכָתַבְתִּי עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל הַלֻּחֹת הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פְּסל לְךָ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וְכָתַבְתִּי עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל הַלֻּחֹת הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Carve two tablets of stones
like the first ones, and I’ll write on the tablets the
words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "Cut two tablets of stone like the former ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former tablets, which you broke.

verses.english:
And be ready for the morning, and you shall go up in the
morning to Mount Sinai and present yourself to me there on
the top of the mountain.
verses.hebrew: וֶהְיֵה נָכוֹן לַבֹּקֶר וְעָלִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר אֶל הַר סִינַי וְנִצַּבְתָּ לִי שָׁם עַל רֹאשׁ הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וֶהְיֵה נָכוֹן לַבֹּקֶר וְעָלִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר אֶל הַר סִינַי וְנִצַּבְתָּ לִי שָׁם עַל רֹאשׁ הָהָר׃

english.text:
And be ready for the morning, and you shall go up in the
morning to Mount Sinai and present yourself to me there on
the top of the mountain.

translation.text: Be ready in the morning, and come up in top of the mountain.

verses.english:
And no man shall go up with you, and also let no man be
seen in all of the mountain. Also let the flock and the
oxen not feed opposite that mountain.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ לֹא יַעֲלֶה עִמָּךְ וְגַם אִישׁ אַל יֵרָא בְּכל הָהָר גַּם הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר אַל יִרְעוּ אֶל מוּל הָהָר הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ לֹא יַעֲלֶה עִמָּךְ וְגַם אִישׁ אַל יֵרָא בְּכל הָהָר גַּם הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר אַל יִרְעוּ אֶל מוּל הָהָר הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And no man shall go up with you, and also let no man be
seen in all of the mountain. Also let the flock and the
oxen not feed opposite that mountain.”

translation.text: No one shall come up with you, and do not let herds graze in front of that mountain."

verses.english:
And he carved two tablets of stones like the first ones,
and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount
Sinai as YHWH had commanded him, and he took in his hand
two tablets of stones.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מֹשֶׁה בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעַל אֶל הַר סִינַי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מֹשֶׁה בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעַל אֶל הַר סִינַי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
And he carved two tablets of stones like the first ones,
and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount
Sinai as YHWH had commanded him, and he took in his hand
two tablets of stones.

translation.text: So Moses cut two tablets of hand the two tablets of stone.

verses.english:
And YHWH came down in a cloud and stood with him there,
and he invoked the name YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH came down in a cloud and stood with him there,
and he invoked the name YHWH.

translation.text: The LORD descended in the cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name, "The LORD."

verses.english:
And YHWH passed in front of him and called, YHWH, YHWH,
merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in
kindness and faithfulness,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

english.text:
And YHWH passed in front of him and called, YHWH, YHWH,
merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in
kindness and faithfulness,

translation.text: The to the third and the fourth generation."

verses.english:
keeping kindness for thousands, bearing crime and offense and sin;
though not making one innocent: reckoning fathers’ crime on children
and on children’s children, on third generations and on fourth
generations.
verses.hebrew: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל בְּנֵי בָנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים׃

hebrew.text: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל בְּנֵי בָנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים׃

english.text:
keeping kindness for thousands, bearing crime and offense and sin;
though not making one innocent: reckoning fathers’ crime on children
and on children’s children, on third generations and on fourth
generations.

verses.english: And Moses hurried and knelt to the ground and bowed,
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקֹּד אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקֹּד אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

english.text: And Moses hurried and knelt to the ground and bowed,

translation.text: And Moses quickly bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

verses.english:
and he said, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, my Lord,
may my Lord go among us, because it is a stiff-necked
people, and forgive our crime and our sin, and make us
your legacy.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֵלֶךְ נָא אֲדֹנָי בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֵלֶךְ נָא אֲדֹנָי בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ׃

english.text:
and he said, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, my Lord,
may my Lord go among us, because it is a stiff-necked
people, and forgive our crime and our sin, and make us
your legacy.”

translation.text: He said, "If now I have found favor in your sight, O Lord, I pray, let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance."

verses.english:
And He said, “Here, I’m making a covenant. Before all your
people I’ll do wonders that haven’t been created in all
the earth and among all the nations; and all the people
whom you’re among will see YHWH’s deeds, because that
which I’m doing with you is awesome.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי כֹּרֵת בְּרִית נֶגֶד כּל עַמְּךָ אֶעֱשֶׂה נִפְלָאֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִבְרְאוּ בְכל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכל הַגּוֹיִם וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בְקִרְבּוֹ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה כִּי נוֹרָא הוּא אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי כֹּרֵת בְּרִית נֶגֶד כּל עַמְּךָ אֶעֱשֶׂה נִפְלָאֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִבְרְאוּ בְכל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכל הַגּוֹיִם וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בְקִרְבּוֹ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה כִּי נוֹרָא הוּא אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And He said, “Here, I’m making a covenant. Before all your
people I’ll do wonders that haven’t been created in all
the earth and among all the nations; and all the people
whom you’re among will see YHWH’s deeds, because that
which I’m doing with you is awesome.

translation.text: He said: I hereby make a covenant. Before all your people I will perform marvels, such as have not been performed in all the earth or in of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I will do with you.

verses.english:
Watch yourself regarding what I command you today. Here,
I’m driving out from before you the Amorite and the
Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite
and the Jebusite.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמר לְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם הִנְנִי גֹרֵשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמר לְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם הִנְנִי גֹרֵשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
Watch yourself regarding what I command you today. Here,
I’m driving out from before you the Amorite and the
Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite
and the Jebusite.

translation.text: Observe what I command you today. See, I will drive out before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.english:
Be watchful of yourself that you don’t make a covenant
with the resident of the land onto which you’re coming,
that he doesn’t become a trap among you.
verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָּא עָלֶיהָ פֶּן יִהְיֶה לְמוֹקֵשׁ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָּא עָלֶיהָ פֶּן יִהְיֶה לְמוֹקֵשׁ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Be watchful of yourself that you don’t make a covenant
with the resident of the land onto which you’re coming,
that he doesn’t become a trap among you.

translation.text: Take care not to make a covenant with the snare among you.

verses.english:
But you shall demolish their altars and shatter their
pillars and cut down their Asherahs.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם תִּתֹּצוּן וְאֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּן וְאֶת אֲשֵׁרָיו תִּכְרֹתוּן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם תִּתֹּצוּן וְאֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּן וְאֶת אֲשֵׁרָיו תִּכְרֹתוּן׃

english.text:
But you shall demolish their altars and shatter their
pillars and cut down their Asherahs.

translation.text: You shall tear down their altars, break their pillars, and cut down their sacred poles

verses.english:
For you shall not bow to another god—because YHWH: His
name is Jealous, He is a jealous God—
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל אַחֵר כִּי יְהֹוָה קַנָּא שְׁמוֹ אֵל קַנָּא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל אַחֵר כִּי יְהֹוָה קַנָּא שְׁמוֹ אֵל קַנָּא הוּא׃

english.text:
For you shall not bow to another god—because YHWH: His
name is Jealous, He is a jealous God—

translation.text: (for you shall worship no other god, because the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God).

verses.english:
that you not make a covenant with the resident of the
land, and they will prostitute themselves after their gods
and sacrifice to their gods, and he will call to you, and
you will eat from his sacrifice.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וְזָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְזָבְחוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְקָרָא לְךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ מִזִּבְחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וְזָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְזָבְחוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְקָרָא לְךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ מִזִּבְחוֹ׃

english.text:
that you not make a covenant with the resident of the
land, and they will prostitute themselves after their gods
and sacrifice to their gods, and he will call to you, and
you will eat from his sacrifice.

translation.text: You shall not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for sacrifice.

verses.english:
And you will take some of his daughters for your sons, and
his daughters will prostitute themselves after their gods
and cause your sons to prostitute themselves after their
gods.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִבְּנֹתָיו לְבָנֶיךָ וְזָנוּ בְנֹתָיו אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וְהִזְנוּ אֶת בָּנֶיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִבְּנֹתָיו לְבָנֶיךָ וְזָנוּ בְנֹתָיו אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וְהִזְנוּ אֶת בָּנֶיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And you will take some of his daughters for your sons, and
his daughters will prostitute themselves after their gods
and cause your sons to prostitute themselves after their
gods.

translation.text: And you will take wives from among their daughters for will make your sons also prostitute themselves to their gods.

verses.english: You shall not make molten gods for yourself.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: אֱלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

english.text: You shall not make molten gods for yourself.

translation.text: You shall not make cast idols.

verses.english:
You shall observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread. Seven
days you shall eat unleavened bread, which I commanded
you, at the appointed time, the month of Abib; because in
the month of Abib you went out of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ לְמוֹעֵד חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב יָצָאתָ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ לְמוֹעֵד חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב יָצָאתָ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
You shall observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread. Seven
days you shall eat unleavened bread, which I commanded
you, at the appointed time, the month of Abib; because in
the month of Abib you went out of Egypt.

translation.text: You shall keep the festival of unleavened bread. Seven days you out from Egypt.

verses.english:
Every first birth of a womb is mine, and all your animals
that have a male first birth, ox or sheep.
verses.hebrew: כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לִי וְכל מִקְנְךָ תִּזָּכָר פֶּטֶר שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לִי וְכל מִקְנְךָ תִּזָּכָר פֶּטֶר שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה׃

english.text:
Every first birth of a womb is mine, and all your animals
that have a male first birth, ox or sheep.

translation.text: All that first opens the womb is mine, all your male livestock, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

verses.english:
And you shall redeem an ass’s first birth with a sheep,
and if you do not redeem it then you shall break its neck.
You shall redeem every firstborn of your sons. And none
shall appear before me empty-handed.
verses.hebrew: וּפֶטֶר חֲמוֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ כֹּל בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּה וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ פָנַי רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: וּפֶטֶר חֲמוֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ כֹּל בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּה וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ פָנַי רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
And you shall redeem an ass’s first birth with a sheep,
and if you do not redeem it then you shall break its neck.
You shall redeem every firstborn of your sons. And none
shall appear before me empty-handed.

translation.text: The firstborn of a donkey you shall neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem.

verses.english:
Six days you shall work, and in the seventh day you shall
cease. In plowing time and in harvest, you shall cease.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תִּשְׁבֹּת בֶּחָרִישׁ וּבַקָּצִיר תִּשְׁבֹּת׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תִּשְׁבֹּת בֶּחָרִישׁ וּבַקָּצִיר תִּשְׁבֹּת׃

english.text:
Six days you shall work, and in the seventh day you shall
cease. In plowing time and in harvest, you shall cease.

translation.text: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in plowing time and in harvest time you shall rest.

verses.english:
And you shall make a Festival of Weeks, of the firstfruits
of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Gathering at the
end of the year.
verses.hebrew: וְחַג שָׁבֻעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ בִּכּוּרֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וְחַג הָאָסִיף תְּקוּפַת הַשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְחַג שָׁבֻעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ בִּכּוּרֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וְחַג הָאָסִיף תְּקוּפַת הַשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
And you shall make a Festival of Weeks, of the firstfruits
of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Gathering at the
end of the year.

translation.text: You shall observe the festival of weeks, the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the festival of ingathering at the turn of the year.

verses.english:
Three times in the year every one of your males shall
appear before the Lord YHWH, God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כּל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת פְּנֵי הָאָדֹן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כּל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת פְּנֵי הָאָדֹן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Three times in the year every one of your males shall
appear before the Lord YHWH, God of Israel.

translation.text: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the LORD God, the God of Israel.

verses.english:
For I shall dispossess nations before you and widen your
border, and no man will covet your land while you are
going up to appear before YHWH, your God, three times in
the year.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם מִפָּנֶיךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּי אֶת גְּבֻלֶךָ וְלֹא יַחְמֹד אִישׁ אֶת אַרְצְךָ בַּעֲלֹתְךָ לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם מִפָּנֶיךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּי אֶת גְּבֻלֶךָ וְלֹא יַחְמֹד אִישׁ אֶת אַרְצְךָ בַּעֲלֹתְךָ לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
For I shall dispossess nations before you and widen your
border, and no man will covet your land while you are
going up to appear before YHWH, your God, three times in
the year.

translation.text: For I will cast out nations before you, and enlarge your borders; no one shall three times in the year.

verses.english:
You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice on leavened
bread. And the sacrifice of the Festival of Passover shall
not remain until the morning.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׁחַט עַל חָמֵץ דַּם זִבְחִי וְלֹא יָלִין לַבֹּקֶר זֶבַח חַג הַפָּסַח׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׁחַט עַל חָמֵץ דַּם זִבְחִי וְלֹא יָלִין לַבֹּקֶר זֶבַח חַג הַפָּסַח׃

english.text:
You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice on leavened
bread. And the sacrifice of the Festival of Passover shall
not remain until the morning.

translation.text: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven, and the morning.

verses.english:
You shall bring the first of the firstfruits of your land
to the house of YHWH, your God. You shall not cook a kid
in its mother’s milk.
verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ תָּבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ תָּבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall bring the first of the firstfruits of your land
to the house of YHWH, your God. You shall not cook a kid
in its mother’s milk.

translation.text: The best of the first fruits of your ground you shall bring to the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Write these words for yourself,
because I’ve made a covenant with you and with Israel
based on these words.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּתב לְךָ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כָּרַתִּי אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וְאֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּתב לְךָ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כָּרַתִּי אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וְאֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Write these words for yourself,
because I’ve made a covenant with you and with Israel
based on these words.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses: Write these words; in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.

verses.english:
And he was there with YHWH forty days and forty nights. He
did not eat bread, and he did not drink water. And he
wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten
Commandments.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שָׁם עִם יְהֹוָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתָה וַיִּכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֵת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי שָׁם עִם יְהֹוָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתָה וַיִּכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֵת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים׃

english.text:
And he was there with YHWH forty days and forty nights. He
did not eat bread, and he did not drink water. And he
wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten
Commandments.

translation.text: He was covenant, the ten commandments.

verses.english:
And it was when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai,
and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses’ hand
when he was coming down from the mountain. And Moses had
not known that the skin of his face was transformed when
He was speaking with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּרֶדֶת מֹשֶׁה מֵהַר סִינַי וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה בְּרִדְתּוֹ מִן הָהָר וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא יָדַע כִּי קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּרֶדֶת מֹשֶׁה מֵהַר סִינַי וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה בְּרִדְתּוֹ מִן הָהָר וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא יָדַע כִּי קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai,
and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses’ hand
when he was coming down from the mountain. And Moses had
not known that the skin of his face was transformed when
He was speaking with him.

translation.text: Moses came down from Mount Sinai. As he came down from the with God.

verses.english:
And Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses; and,
here, the skin of his face was transformed, and they were
afraid of going over to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְהִנֵּה קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מִגֶּשֶׁת אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְהִנֵּה קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מִגֶּשֶׁת אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses; and,
here, the skin of his face was transformed, and they were
afraid of going over to him.

translation.text: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, the skin of his face was shining, and they were afraid to come near him.

verses.english:
And Moses called to them. And Aaron and all the chiefs in
the congregation came back to him, and he spoke to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו אַהֲרֹן וְכל הַנְּשִׂאִים בָּעֵדָה וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו אַהֲרֹן וְכל הַנְּשִׂאִים בָּעֵדָה וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses called to them. And Aaron and all the chiefs in
the congregation came back to him, and he spoke to them.

translation.text: But congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke with them.

verses.english:
And after that all the children of Israel went over. And
he commanded them everything that YHWH had spoken with him
in Mount Sinai.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן נִגְּשׁוּ כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְצַוֵּם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן נִגְּשׁוּ כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְצַוֵּם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינָי׃

english.text:
And after that all the children of Israel went over. And
he commanded them everything that YHWH had spoken with him
in Mount Sinai.

translation.text: commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

verses.english:
And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil
on his face.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה מִדַּבֵּר אִתָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל פָּנָיו מַסְוֶה׃

And Moses assembled all of the congregation of the

Anyone who does work in shall be put to death.

out from in front of Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלִּפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלִּפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And all of the congregation of the children of Israel went
out from in front of Moses.

translation.text: Then all the congregation of the Israelites withdrew from the presence of Moses.

verses.english:
And everyone whose heart inspired him came, and everyone
whose spirit moved him brought a contribution for YHWH for
the work of the Tent of Meeting and for all of its
construction and for the holy clothes.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂאוֹ לִבּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר נָדְבָה רוּחוֹ אֹתוֹ הֵבִיאוּ אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לִמְלֶאכֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּלְכל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וּלְבִגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂאוֹ לִבּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר נָדְבָה רוּחוֹ אֹתוֹ הֵבִיאוּ אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לִמְלֶאכֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּלְכל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וּלְבִגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And everyone whose heart inspired him came, and everyone
whose spirit moved him brought a contribution for YHWH for
the work of the Tent of Meeting and for all of its
construction and for the holy clothes.

translation.text: And they came, everyone whose heart was offering to be used for the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the sacred vestments.

verses.english:
And the men came together with the women. All whose hearts
moved them had brought brooches and earrings and rings and
ornaments, every kind of gold item. And every man who
brought an elevation offering of gold to YHWH
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים עַל הַנָּשִׁים כֹּל נְדִיב לֵב הֵבִיאוּ חָח וָנֶזֶם וְטַבַּעַת וְכוּמָז כּל כְּלִי זָהָב וְכל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֵנִיף תְּנוּפַת זָהָב לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים עַל הַנָּשִׁים כֹּל נְדִיב לֵב הֵבִיאוּ חָח וָנֶזֶם וְטַבַּעַת וְכוּמָז כּל כְּלִי זָהָב וְכל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֵנִיף תְּנוּפַת זָהָב לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the men came together with the women. All whose hearts
moved them had brought brooches and earrings and rings and
ornaments, every kind of gold item. And every man who
brought an elevation offering of gold to YHWH

translation.text: So they came, both men and women; all offering of gold to the LORD.

verses.english:
and every man with whom was found blue and purple and
scarlet and linen and goats’ hair and rams’ skins dyed red
and leather skins had brought them.
verses.hebrew: וְכל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא אִתּוֹ תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּים וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים הֵבִיאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא אִתּוֹ תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּים וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים הֵבִיאוּ׃

english.text:
and every man with whom was found blue and purple and
scarlet and linen and goats’ hair and rams’ skins dyed red
and leather skins had brought them.

translation.text: And everyone who possessed blue or purple or crimson yarn or fine linen or goats' hair or tanned rams' skins or fine leather, brought them.

verses.english:
Everyone making a donation of silver and bronze had
brought YHWH’s donation. And everyone with whom was found
acacia wood for all the work of the construction had
brought it.
verses.hebrew: כּל מֵרִים תְּרוּמַת כֶּסֶף וּנְחֹשֶׁת הֵבִיאוּ אֵת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא אִתּוֹ עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים לְכל מְלֶאכֶת הָעֲבֹדָה הֵבִיאוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל מֵרִים תְּרוּמַת כֶּסֶף וּנְחֹשֶׁת הֵבִיאוּ אֵת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא אִתּוֹ עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים לְכל מְלֶאכֶת הָעֲבֹדָה הֵבִיאוּ׃

english.text:
Everyone making a donation of silver and bronze had
brought YHWH’s donation. And everyone with whom was found
acacia wood for all the work of the construction had
brought it.

translation.text: Everyone who could make an it.

verses.english:
And every woman who was wise of heart with her hands had
spun, and they brought yarn, the blue and the purple, the
scarlet and the linen.
verses.hebrew: וְכל אִשָּׁה חַכְמַת לֵב בְּיָדֶיהָ טָווּ וַיָּבִיאוּ מַטְוֶה אֶת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָאַרְגָּמָן אֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּׁשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל אִשָּׁה חַכְמַת לֵב בְּיָדֶיהָ טָווּ וַיָּבִיאוּ מַטְוֶה אֶת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָאַרְגָּמָן אֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּׁשׁ׃

english.text:
And every woman who was wise of heart with her hands had
spun, and they brought yarn, the blue and the purple, the
scarlet and the linen.

translation.text: All the skillful women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun in blue and purple and crimson yarns and fine linen;

verses.english:
And all the women whose hearts inspired them with wisdom
had spun the goats’ hair.
verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂא לִבָּן אֹתָנָה בְּחכְמָה טָווּ אֶת הָעִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂא לִבָּן אֹתָנָה בְּחכְמָה טָווּ אֶת הָעִזִּים׃

english.text:
And all the women whose hearts inspired them with wisdom
had spun the goats’ hair.

translation.text: goats' hair.

verses.english:
And the chieftains had brought onyx stones and stones to
be set for the ephod and for the breastplate
verses.hebrew: וְהַנְּשִׂאִם הֵבִיאוּ אֵת אַבְנֵי הַשֹּׁהַם וְאֵת אַבְנֵי הַמִּלֻּאִים לָאֵפוֹד וְלַחֹשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנְּשִׂאִם הֵבִיאוּ אֵת אַבְנֵי הַשֹּׁהַם וְאֵת אַבְנֵי הַמִּלֻּאִים לָאֵפוֹד וְלַחֹשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And the chieftains had brought onyx stones and stones to
be set for the ephod and for the breastplate

translation.text: And the leaders brought onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece,

verses.english:
and the spice and the oil for lighting and for the
anointing oil and for the incense fragrances.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַבֹּשֶׂם וְאֶת הַשָּׁמֶן לְמָאוֹר וּלְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַבֹּשֶׂם וְאֶת הַשָּׁמֶן לְמָאוֹר וּלְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים׃

english.text:
and the spice and the oil for lighting and for the
anointing oil and for the incense fragrances.

translation.text: and spices and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

verses.english:
Every man and woman whose heart moved them to bring for
all the work that YHWH had commanded to do by the hand of
Moses: the children of Israel brought a contribution for
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כּל אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר נָדַב לִבָּם אֹתָם לְהָבִיא לְכל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה הֵבִיאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר נָדַב לִבָּם אֹתָם לְהָבִיא לְכל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה הֵבִיאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Every man and woman whose heart moved them to bring for
all the work that YHWH had commanded to do by the hand of
Moses: the children of Israel brought a contribution for
YHWH.

translation.text: All the done, brought it as a freewill offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses said to the children of Israel, “See, YHWH has
called Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of
Judah by name,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רְאוּ קָרָא יְהֹוָה בְּשֵׁם בְּצַלְאֵל בֶּן אוּרִי בֶן חוּר לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רְאוּ קָרָא יְהֹוָה בְּשֵׁם בְּצַלְאֵל בֶּן אוּרִי בֶן חוּר לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the children of Israel, “See, YHWH has
called Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of
Judah by name,

translation.text: Then Moses said to the Israelites: See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

verses.english:
and He has filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom, in
understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of work
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַלֵּא אֹתוֹ רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בְּחכְמָה בִּתְבוּנָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכל מְלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַלֵּא אֹתוֹ רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בְּחכְמָה בִּתְבוּנָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכל מְלָאכָה׃

english.text:
and He has filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom, in
understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of work

translation.text: he has filled him with divine spirit, with skill, intelligence, and knowledge in every kind of craft,

verses.english:
and to form conceptions to make in gold and in silver and
in bronze
verses.hebrew: וְלַחְשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבֹת לַעֲשֹׂת בַּזָּהָב וּבַכֶּסֶף וּבַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְלַחְשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבֹת לַעֲשֹׂת בַּזָּהָב וּבַכֶּסֶף וּבַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
and to form conceptions to make in gold and in silver and
in bronze

translation.text: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,

verses.english:
and in cutting stone for setting and in cutting wood, for
making every kind of conceived work.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן לְמַלֹּאת וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּכל מְלֶאכֶת מַחֲשָׁבֶת׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן לְמַלֹּאת וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּכל מְלֶאכֶת מַחֲשָׁבֶת׃

english.text:
and in cutting stone for setting and in cutting wood, for
making every kind of conceived work.

translation.text: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, in every kind of craft.

verses.english:
And He has put it in his heart to instruct: he and
Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.hebrew: וּלְהוֹרֹת נָתַן בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא וְאהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְהוֹרֹת נָתַן בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא וְאהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן׃

english.text:
And He has put it in his heart to instruct: he and
Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

translation.text: And he has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.english:
He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do all the work
of the cutter and the designer and the embroiderer in the
blue and in the purple, in the scarlet and in the linen
and the weaver: those who do every kind of work and form
conceptions.
verses.hebrew: מִלֵּא אֹתָם חכְמַת לֵב לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל מְלֶאכֶת חָרָשׁ וְחֹשֵׁב וְרֹקֵם בַּתְּכֵלֶת וּבָאַרְגָּמָן בְּתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבַשֵּׁשׁ וְאֹרֵג עֹשֵׂי כּל מְלָאכָה וְחֹשְׁבֵי מַחֲשָׁבֹת׃

hebrew.text: מִלֵּא אֹתָם חכְמַת לֵב לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל מְלֶאכֶת חָרָשׁ וְחֹשֵׁב וְרֹקֵם בַּתְּכֵלֶת וּבָאַרְגָּמָן בְּתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבַשֵּׁשׁ וְאֹרֵג עֹשֵׂי כּל מְלָאכָה וְחֹשְׁבֵי מַחֲשָׁבֹת׃

english.text:
He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do all the work
of the cutter and the designer and the embroiderer in the
blue and in the purple, in the scarlet and in the linen
and the weaver: those who do every kind of work and form
conceptions.

translation.text: He has filled them with skill to do every kind of work done by an artisan or by a designer linen, or by a weaver — by any sort of artisan or skilled designer.

verses.english:
And Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who is wise of
heart, in whom YHWH has put wisdom and understanding to
know how to do all the work of the service of the Holy
shall do it, for everything that YHWH has commanded.”
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה בְצַלְאֵל וְאהֳלִיאָב וְכֹל אִישׁ חֲכַם לֵב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה חכְמָה וּתְבוּנָה בָּהֵמָּה לָדַעַת לַעֲשֹׂת אֶת כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה בְצַלְאֵל וְאהֳלִיאָב וְכֹל אִישׁ חֲכַם לֵב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה חכְמָה וּתְבוּנָה בָּהֵמָּה לָדַעַת לַעֲשֹׂת אֶת כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who is wise of
heart, in whom YHWH has put wisdom and understanding to
know how to do all the work of the service of the Holy
shall do it, for everything that YHWH has commanded.”

translation.text: Bezalel and Oholiab and every skillful one to whom the LORD has construction of the sanctuary shall work in accordance with all that the LORD has commanded.

verses.english:
And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who was
wise of heart, in whose heart YHWH had put wisdom,
everyone whose heart inspired him to come forward for the
work, to do it.
