gold, and they wrote on it a text of signet inscriptions:
“Holiness to YHWH.”

translation.text: They made the rosette of the holy diadem of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engraving of a signet, "Holy to the LORD."

verses.english:
And they put a blue string on it for putting it on the
headdress above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלָיו פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לָתֵת עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלָיו פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לָתֵת עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And they put a blue string on it for putting it on the
headdress above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: They tied to it a blue cord, to fasten it on the turban above; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And all of the construction of the Tabernacle of the Tent
of Meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did
according to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.
They did so.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּכֶל כּל עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּכֶל כּל עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And all of the construction of the Tabernacle of the Tent
of Meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did
according to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.
They did so.

translation.text: In this way all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And they brought the Tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all
of its equipment, its clasps, its frames, its bars, and
its columns and its bases,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו קְרָסָיו קְרָשָׁיו בְּרִיחָו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו קְרָסָיו קְרָשָׁיו בְּרִיחָו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו׃

english.text:
And they brought the Tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all
of its equipment, its clasps, its frames, its bars, and
its columns and its bases,

translation.text: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its utensils, its hooks, its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;

verses.english:
and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red and the covering
of leather skins, and the covering pavilion,
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עוֹרֹת הָאֵילִם הַמְאדָּמִים וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עֹרֹת הַתְּחָשִׁים וְאֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עוֹרֹת הָאֵילִם הַמְאדָּמִים וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עֹרֹת הַתְּחָשִׁים וְאֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ׃

english.text:
and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red and the covering
of leather skins, and the covering pavilion,

translation.text: the covering of tanned rams' skins and the covering of fine leather, and the curtain for the screen;

verses.english:
the Ark of the Testimony and its poles and the atonement
dais,
verses.hebrew: אֶת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְאֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֵת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: אֶת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְאֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֵת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
the Ark of the Testimony and its poles and the atonement
dais,

translation.text: the ark of the covenant with its poles and the mercy seat;

verses.english: the table and all of its equipment and the show bread,
verses.hebrew: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֵת לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֵת לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים׃

english.text: the table and all of its equipment and the show bread,

translation.text: the table with all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

verses.english:
the pure menorah, its lamps, lamps for the row, and all of
its equipment, and the oil for lighting,
verses.hebrew: אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ נֵרֹת הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ נֵרֹת הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר׃

english.text:
the pure menorah, its lamps, lamps for the row, and all of
its equipment, and the oil for lighting,

translation.text: the pure lampstand with its lamps set on it and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;

verses.english:
and the golden altar and the anointing oil and the incense
of fragrances and the cover of the entrance of the Tent,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וְאֵת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וְאֵת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
and the golden altar and the anointing oil and the incense
of fragrances and the cover of the entrance of the Tent,

translation.text: the golden altar, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance of the tent;

verses.english:
the bronze altar and the bronze grate that it had, its
poles and all of its equipment, the basin and its stand,
verses.hebrew: אֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

english.text:
the bronze altar and the bronze grate that it had, its
poles and all of its equipment, the basin and its stand,

translation.text: the bronze altar, and its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

verses.english:
the courtyard’s hangings, its columns and its bases and
the cover for the courtyard’s gate, its cords and its
pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.hebrew: אֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר אֶת עַמֻּדֶיהָ וְאֶת אֲדָנֶיהָ וְאֶת הַמָּסָךְ לְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֶת מֵיתָרָיו וִיתֵדֹתֶיהָ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: אֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר אֶת עַמֻּדֶיהָ וְאֶת אֲדָנֶיהָ וְאֶת הַמָּסָךְ לְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֶת מֵיתָרָיו וִיתֵדֹתֶיהָ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
the courtyard’s hangings, its columns and its bases and
the cover for the courtyard’s gate, its cords and its
pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting,

translation.text: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

verses.english:
the fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, the holy
clothes for Aaron, the priest, and his sons’ clothes for
functioning as priests.
verses.hebrew: אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵן׃

hebrew.text: אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵן׃

english.text:
the fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, the holy
clothes for Aaron, the priest, and his sons’ clothes for
functioning as priests.

translation.text: the finely worked vestments for ministering in vestments of his sons to serve as priests.

verses.english:
According to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses: so
the children of Israel did all of the construction.
verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הָעֲבֹדָה׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הָעֲבֹדָה׃

english.text:
According to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses: so
the children of Israel did all of the construction.

translation.text: The Israelites had done all of the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses saw all of the work; and, here, they had done it
as YHWH had commanded. They did so. And Moses blessed
them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הַמְּלָאכָה וְהִנֵּה עָשׂוּ אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה כֵּן עָשׂוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הַמְּלָאכָה וְהִנֵּה עָשׂוּ אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה כֵּן עָשׂוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses saw all of the work; and, here, they had done it
as YHWH had commanded. They did so. And Moses blessed
them.

translation.text: When Moses he blessed them.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:

verses.english:
“On the day of the first month, on the first of the month,
you shall set up the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ תָּקִים אֶת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ תָּקִים אֶת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
“On the day of the first month, on the first of the month,
you shall set up the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And you shall set the Ark of the Testimony there and have
the pavilion cover over the ark.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ שָׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְסַכֹּתָ עַל הָאָרֹן אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ שָׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְסַכֹּתָ עַל הָאָרֹן אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And you shall set the Ark of the Testimony there and have
the pavilion cover over the ark.

translation.text: You shall put in it the ark of the covenant, and you shall screen the ark with the curtain.

verses.english:
And you shall bring the table and make its arrangement,
and bring the menorah and put up its lamps.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְעָרַכְתָּ אֶת עֶרְכּוֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְעָרַכְתָּ אֶת עֶרְכּוֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And you shall bring the table and make its arrangement,
and bring the menorah and put up its lamps.

translation.text: You shall bring in the table, and arrange its setting; and you shall bring in the lampstand, and set up its lamps.

verses.english:
And you shall put the golden altar for incense in front of
the Ark of the Testimony, and you shall set the cover of
the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב לִקְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב לִקְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And you shall put the golden altar for incense in front of
the Ark of the Testimony, and you shall set the cover of
the entrance of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: You shall put the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and set up the screen for the entrance of the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And you shall put the altar of burnt offering in front of
the entrance of the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And you shall put the altar of burnt offering in front of
the entrance of the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: You shall set the altar of burnt

verses.english:
And you shall put the basin between the Tent of Meeting
and the altar and put water there.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁם מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁם מָיִם׃

english.text:
And you shall put the basin between the Tent of Meeting
and the altar and put water there.

translation.text: and place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

verses.english:
And you shall set the courtyard all around and put on the
cover of the courtyard’s gate.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר׃

english.text:
And you shall set the courtyard all around and put on the
cover of the courtyard’s gate.

translation.text: You shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen for the gate of the court.

verses.english:
And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the
Tabernacle and everything that is in it, and you shall
make it and all of its equipment holy, and it will be
holiness.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְהָיָה קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְהָיָה קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the
Tabernacle and everything that is in it, and you shall
make it and all of its equipment holy, and it will be
holiness.

translation.text: Then you shall take the consecrate it and all its furniture, so that it shall become holy.

verses.english:
And you shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all
of its equipment, and you shall make the altar holy: and
the altar will be holy of holies.
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהָיָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהָיָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And you shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all
of its equipment, and you shall make the altar holy: and
the altar will be holy of holies.

translation.text: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, so that the altar shall be most holy.

verses.english:
And you shall anoint the basin and its stand and make it
holy.
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall anoint the basin and its stand and make it
holy.

translation.text: You shall also anoint the basin with its stand, and consecrate it.

verses.english:
“And you shall bring Aaron and his sons forward to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְרָחַצְתָּ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְרָחַצְתָּ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
“And you shall bring Aaron and his sons forward to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

translation.text: Then you shall shall wash them with water,

verses.english:
And you shall dress Aaron with the holy clothes and anoint
him and make him holy, and he shall function as a priest
for me.
verses.hebrew: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֵת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְכִהֵן לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֵת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְכִהֵן לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall dress Aaron with the holy clothes and anoint
him and make him holy, and he shall function as a priest
for me.

translation.text: and put on Aaron the sacred vestments, as priest.

verses.english:
And you shall bring his sons forward and dress them with
coats
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם כֻּתֳּנֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם כֻּתֳּנֹת׃

english.text:
And you shall bring his sons forward and dress them with
coats

translation.text: You shall bring his sons also and put tunics on them,

verses.english:
and anoint them as you anointed their father, and they
shall function as priests for me. And it will be for their
anointing to be theirs as an eternal priesthood through
their generations.”
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת אֲבִיהֶם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי וְהָיְתָה לִהְיֹת לָהֶם משְׁחָתָם לִכְהֻנַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת אֲבִיהֶם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי וְהָיְתָה לִהְיֹת לָהֶם משְׁחָתָם לִכְהֻנַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
and anoint them as you anointed their father, and they
shall function as priests for me. And it will be for their
anointing to be theirs as an eternal priesthood through
their generations.”

translation.text: and priests: and their anointing shall admit them to a perpetual priesthood throughout all generations to come.

verses.english:
And Moses did it. According to everything that YHWH
commanded him, he did so.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
And Moses did it. According to everything that YHWH
commanded him, he did so.

translation.text: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.english:
And it was: in the first month, in the second year, on the
first of the month, the Tabernacle was set up.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הוּקַם הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הוּקַם הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And it was: in the first month, in the second year, on the
first of the month, the Tabernacle was set up.

translation.text: In the tabernacle was set up.

verses.english:
And Moses set up the Tabernacle and put on its bases and
set its frames and put on its bars and set up its columns.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת אֲדָנָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת קְרָשָׁיו וַיִּתֵּן אֶת בְּרִיחָיו וַיָּקֶם אֶת עַמּוּדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת אֲדָנָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת קְרָשָׁיו וַיִּתֵּן אֶת בְּרִיחָיו וַיָּקֶם אֶת עַמּוּדָיו׃

english.text:
And Moses set up the Tabernacle and put on its bases and
set its frames and put on its bars and set up its columns.

translation.text: Moses set up the tabernacle; he laid its bases, and set up its frames, and put in its poles, and raised up its pillars;

verses.english:
And he spread the Tent over the Tabernacle and set the
Tent’s covering on it above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת הָאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵה הָאֹהֶל עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת הָאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵה הָאֹהֶל עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he spread the Tent over the Tabernacle and set the
Tent’s covering on it above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: the tent over it; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he took the Testimony and put it into the ark, and he
set the poles on the ark, and he put the atonement dais on
the ark above.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֶל הָאָרֹן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַבַּדִּים עַל הָאָרֹן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֶל הָאָרֹן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַבַּדִּים עַל הָאָרֹן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
And he took the Testimony and put it into the ark, and he
set the poles on the ark, and he put the atonement dais on
the ark above.

translation.text: He took the covenant and put it into the ark, and put the poles on the ark, and set the mercy seat above the ark;

verses.english:
And he brought the ark into the Tabernacle and set the
covering pavilion and covered over the Ark of the
Testimony, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הָאָרֹן אֶל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וַיָּסֶךְ עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הָאָרֹן אֶל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וַיָּסֶךְ עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he brought the ark into the Tabernacle and set the
covering pavilion and covered over the Ark of the
Testimony, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: and he brought the ark into the of the covenant; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he put the table in the Tent of Meeting on the
northward side of the Tabernacle, outside of the pavilion.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן צָפֹנָה מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן צָפֹנָה מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And he put the table in the Tent of Meeting on the
northward side of the Tabernacle, outside of the pavilion.

translation.text: He put the outside the curtain,

verses.english:
And he made the arrangement of bread on it in front of
YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ עָלָיו עֵרֶךְ לֶחֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ עָלָיו עֵרֶךְ לֶחֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he made the arrangement of bread on it in front of
YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: and set the bread in order on it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he set the menorah in the Tent of Meeting opposite the
table, on the southward side of the Tabernacle,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן נֶגְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן נֶגְבָּה׃

english.text:
And he set the menorah in the Tent of Meeting opposite the
table, on the southward side of the Tabernacle,

translation.text: He put the lampstand in the tabernacle,

verses.english:
and he put up the lamps in front of YHWH, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַנֵּרֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל הַנֵּרֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
and he put up the lamps in front of YHWH, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: and set up the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he set the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting in
front of the pavilion,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And he set the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting in
front of the pavilion,

translation.text: He put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the curtain,

verses.english:
and he burned the incense of fragrances on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
and he burned the incense of fragrances on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: and offered fragrant incense on it; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english: And he set the cover of the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text: And he set the cover of the entrance of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: He also put in place the screen for the entrance of the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and he offered up the
burnt offering and the grain offering on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה שָׂם פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעַל עָלָיו אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה שָׂם פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעַל עָלָיו אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and he offered up the
burnt offering and the grain offering on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: He set the altar of burnt offering at the Moses.

verses.english:
And he set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the
altar, and he put water for washing there.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרחְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרחְצָה׃

english.text:
And he set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the
altar, and he put water for washing there.

translation.text: He set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing,

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and
their feet from it.
verses.hebrew: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and
their feet from it.

translation.text: with which Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.

verses.english:
When they came to the Tent of Meeting and when they came
forward to the altar they would wash, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבְקרְבָתָם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יִרְחָצוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבְקרְבָתָם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יִרְחָצוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
When they came to the Tent of Meeting and when they came
forward to the altar they would wash, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: When they went into the the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he set up the courtyard all around the Tabernacle and
the altar, and he put on the cover of the courtyard’s
gate. And Moses finished the work.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה׃

english.text:
And he set up the courtyard all around the Tabernacle and
the altar, and he put on the cover of the courtyard’s
gate. And Moses finished the work.

translation.text: He set up the court around the court. So Moses finished the work.

verses.english:
And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and YHWH’s
glory filled the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and YHWH’s
glory filled the Tabernacle.

translation.text: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And Moses was not able to come into the Tent of Meeting,
because the cloud had settled on it and YHWH’s glory
filled the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכֹל מֹשֶׁה לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּי שָׁכַן עָלָיו הֶעָנָן וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכֹל מֹשֶׁה לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּי שָׁכַן עָלָיו הֶעָנָן וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And Moses was not able to come into the Tent of Meeting,
because the cloud had settled on it and YHWH’s glory
filled the Tabernacle.

translation.text: Moses was not able to enter the tent of filled the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And when the cloud was lifted from on the Tabernacle, the
children of Israel would travel—in all their travels—
verses.hebrew: וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And when the cloud was lifted from on the Tabernacle, the
children of Israel would travel—in all their travels—

translation.text: Whenever the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out on each stage of their journey;

verses.english:
and if the cloud would not be lifted, then they would not
travel until the day that it would be lifted.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
and if the cloud would not be lifted, then they would not
travel until the day that it would be lifted.

translation.text: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day that it was taken up.

verses.english:
Because YHWH’s cloud was on the Tabernacle by day, and
fire would be in it at night, before the eyes of all the
house of Israel in all their travels.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עֲנַן יְהֹוָה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עֲנַן יְהֹוָה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Because YHWH’s cloud was on the Tabernacle by day, and
fire would be in it at night, before the eyes of all the
house of Israel in all their travels.

translation.text: For the cloud of the LORD was on the of all the house of Israel at each stage of their journey.

verses.english:
And He called to Moses, and YHWH spoke to him from the
Tent of Meeting, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מֵאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מֵאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And He called to Moses, and YHWH spoke to him from the
Tent of Meeting, saying,

translation.text: The LORD summoned Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: A human from you who will make an offering to
YHWH—you shall make your offering from the domestic
animals: from the herd and from the flock.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אָדָם כִּי יַקְרִיב מִכֶּם קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבְּהֵמָה מִן הַבָּקָר וּמִן הַצֹּאן תַּקְרִיבוּ אֶת קרְבַּנְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אָדָם כִּי יַקְרִיב מִכֶּם קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבְּהֵמָה מִן הַבָּקָר וּמִן הַצֹּאן תַּקְרִיבוּ אֶת קרְבַּנְכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: A human from you who will make an offering to
YHWH—you shall make your offering from the domestic
animals: from the herd and from the flock.

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: When your offering from the herd or from the flock.

verses.english:
“If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he
shall make it an unblemished male. He shall bring it
forward to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting for his
acceptance in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אִם עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַבָּקָר זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִרְצֹנוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אִם עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַבָּקָר זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִרְצֹנוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he
shall make it an unblemished male. He shall bring it
forward to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting for his
acceptance in front of YHWH.

translation.text: If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you shall offer a male without blemish; you shall bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting, for acceptance in your behalf before the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt
offering, and it will be accepted for him, to atone for
him.
verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הָעֹלָה וְנִרְצָה לוֹ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הָעֹלָה וְנִרְצָה לוֹ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt
offering, and it will be accepted for him, to atone for
him.

translation.text: You shall lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be acceptable in your behalf as atonement for you.

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter the herd animal in front of YHWH,
and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood
forward and fling the blood on the altar, all around,
which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת בֶּן הַבָּקָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הַדָּם וְזָרְקוּ אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת בֶּן הַבָּקָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הַדָּם וְזָרְקוּ אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter the herd animal in front of YHWH,
and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood
forward and fling the blood on the altar, all around,
which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: The bull shall be slaughtered dashing the blood against all sides of the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And he shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into its
parts.
verses.hebrew: וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת הָעֹלָה וְנִתַּח אֹתָהּ לִנְתָחֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת הָעֹלָה וְנִתַּח אֹתָהּ לִנְתָחֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And he shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into its
parts.

translation.text: The burnt offering shall be flayed and cut up into its parts.

verses.english:
And the sons of Aaron, the priest, shall put fire on the
altar and arrange wood on the fire.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְעָרְכוּ עֵצִים עַל הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְעָרְכוּ עֵצִים עַל הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And the sons of Aaron, the priest, shall put fire on the
altar and arrange wood on the fire.

translation.text: The sons of the priest Aaron shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

verses.english:
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange the
parts, the head, and the suet on the wood that is on the
fire that is on the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְעָרְכוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֵת הַנְּתָחִים אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָרְכוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֵת הַנְּתָחִים אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange the
parts, the head, and the suet on the wood that is on the
fire that is on the altar.

translation.text: Aaron's sons the priests shall arrange on the altar;

verses.english:
And he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. And
the priest shall burn it all to smoke at the altar, a
burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְקִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְקִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. And
the priest shall burn it all to smoke at the altar, a
burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to
YHWH.

translation.text: but its entrails and its legs shall be washed with water. Then the priest shall turn the whole into smoke on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
“And if his offering is from the flock—from the sheep or
from the goats—for a burnt offering, he shall make it an
unblemished male.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַכְּשָׂבִים אוֹ מִן הָעִזִּים לְעֹלָה זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַכְּשָׂבִים אוֹ מִן הָעִזִּים לְעֹלָה זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
“And if his offering is from the flock—from the sheep or
from the goats—for a burnt offering, he shall make it an
unblemished male.

translation.text: If your gift for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the sheep or goats, your offering shall be a male without blemish.

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter it on the northward side of the
altar in front of YHWH. And the sons of Aaron, the
priests, shall fling its blood on the altar, all around.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפֹנָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת דָּמוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפֹנָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת דָּמוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter it on the northward side of the
altar in front of YHWH. And the sons of Aaron, the
priests, shall fling its blood on the altar, all around.

translation.text: It shall be slaughtered on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron's sons the priests shall dash its blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And he shall cut it into its parts and its head and its
suet. And the priest shall arrange them on the wood that
is on the fire that is on the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְנִתַּח אֹתוֹ לִנְתָחָיו וְאֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת פִּדְרוֹ וְעָרַךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִתַּח אֹתוֹ לִנְתָחָיו וְאֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת פִּדְרוֹ וְעָרַךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And he shall cut it into its parts and its head and its
suet. And the priest shall arrange them on the wood that
is on the fire that is on the altar.

translation.text: It shall be cut up into its parts, with its head and its suet, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that is on the fire on the altar;

verses.english:
And he shall wash the innards and the legs with water. And
the priest shall bring it all forward and burn it to smoke
at the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַקֶּרֶב וְהַכְּרָעַיִם יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַקֶּרֶב וְהַכְּרָעַיִם יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall wash the innards and the legs with water. And
the priest shall bring it all forward and burn it to smoke
at the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: but shall offer the whole and turn it into smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
“And if his offering to YHWH is a burnt offering from
birds, then he shall make his offering from turtledoves or
from pigeons.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִן הָעוֹף עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיב מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִן הָעוֹף עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיב מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ׃

english.text:
“And if his offering to YHWH is a burnt offering from
birds, then he shall make his offering from turtledoves or
from pigeons.

translation.text: If your offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, you shall choose your offering from turtledoves or pigeons.

verses.english:
And the priest shall bring it forward to the altar and
wring its head and burn it to smoke at the altar, and its
blood shall be drained on the wall of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְנִמְצָה דָמוֹ עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְנִמְצָה דָמוֹ עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall bring it forward to the altar and
wring its head and burn it to smoke at the altar, and its
blood shall be drained on the wall of the altar.

translation.text: The priest shall bring it to the altar and wring off its head, and turn it into smoke on altar.

verses.english:
And he shall take away its crop with its feathers and
throw it beside the altar eastward to the place of the
ashes.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵסִיר אֶת מֻרְאָתוֹ בְּנֹצָתָהּ וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֹתָהּ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֵדְמָה אֶל מְקוֹם הַדָּשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵסִיר אֶת מֻרְאָתוֹ בְּנֹצָתָהּ וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֹתָהּ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֵדְמָה אֶל מְקוֹם הַדָּשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And he shall take away its crop with its feathers and
throw it beside the altar eastward to the place of the
ashes.

translation.text: He shall remove its crop with its contents and throw it at the east side of the altar, in the place for ashes.

verses.english:
And he shall tear it open by its wings—he shall not divide
it—and the priest shall burn it to smoke at the altar on
the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁסַּע אֹתוֹ בִכְנָפָיו לֹא יַבְדִּיל וְהִקְטִיר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁסַּע אֹתוֹ בִכְנָפָיו לֹא יַבְדִּיל וְהִקְטִיר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall tear it open by its wings—he shall not divide
it—and the priest shall burn it to smoke at the altar on
the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: He shall tear it open by its wings without severing it. Then the priest shall turn it into smoke on offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
“And a person who will make an offering of a grain
offering to YHWH, his offering shall be of fine flour, and
he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תַקְרִיב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה סֹלֶת יִהְיֶה קרְבָּנוֹ וְיָצַק עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְנָתַן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תַקְרִיב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה סֹלֶת יִהְיֶה קרְבָּנוֹ וְיָצַק עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְנָתַן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה׃

english.text:
“And a person who will make an offering of a grain
offering to YHWH, his offering shall be of fine flour, and
he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

translation.text: When anyone presents a grain offering to the LORD, the offering shall frankincense on it,

verses.english:
And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests.
And he shall take the fill of his fist from there: from
its fine flour and from its oil in addition to all of its
frankincense. And the priest shall burn a representative
portion of it to smoke at the altar, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים וְקָמַץ מִשָּׁם מְלֹא קֻמְצוֹ מִסּלְתָּהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים וְקָמַץ מִשָּׁם מְלֹא קֻמְצוֹ מִסּלְתָּהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests.
And he shall take the fill of his fist from there: from
its fine flour and from its oil in addition to all of its
frankincense. And the priest shall burn a representative
portion of it to smoke at the altar, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: and bring it to Aaron's sons the priests. After frankincense, the priest shall turn this token portion into smoke on the altar, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.

translation.text: And what is left of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons, a most holy part of the offerings by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
“And if he will make an offering of an oven-baked grain
offering: fine flour, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and
unleavened wafers with oil poured on them.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַקְרִב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה מַאֲפֵה תַנּוּר סֹלֶת חַלּוֹת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תַקְרִב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה מַאֲפֵה תַנּוּר סֹלֶת חַלּוֹת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
“And if he will make an offering of an oven-baked grain
offering: fine flour, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and
unleavened wafers with oil poured on them.

translation.text: When you present a grain offering baked in the oven, it shall be of spread with oil.

verses.english:
“And if your offering is a grain offering on a griddle, it
shall be fine flour, mixed with oil, unleavened.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִנְחָה עַל הַמַּחֲבַת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן מַצָּה תִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִנְחָה עַל הַמַּחֲבַת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן מַצָּה תִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
“And if your offering is a grain offering on a griddle, it
shall be fine flour, mixed with oil, unleavened.

translation.text: If your offering is grain prepared on a griddle, it shall be of choice flour mixed with oil, unleavened;

verses.english:
Break it into pieces and pour oil on it. It is a grain
offering.
verses.hebrew: פָּתוֹת אֹתָהּ פִּתִּים וְיָצַקְתָּ עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן מִנְחָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: פָּתוֹת אֹתָהּ פִּתִּים וְיָצַקְתָּ עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן מִנְחָה הִוא׃

english.text:
Break it into pieces and pour oil on it. It is a grain
offering.

translation.text: break it in pieces, and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.english:
“And if your offering is a grain offering from a pan, it
shall be made of fine flour in oil.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִנְחַת מַרְחֶשֶׁת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִנְחַת מַרְחֶשֶׁת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה׃

english.text:
“And if your offering is a grain offering from a pan, it
shall be made of fine flour in oil.

translation.text: If your offering is grain prepared in a pan, it shall be made of choice flour in oil.

verses.english:
“And you shall bring the grain offering that one will make
from these things to YHWH, and one shall bring it forward
to the priest, and he shall bring it over to the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מֵאֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִגִּישָׁהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מֵאֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִגִּישָׁהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
“And you shall bring the grain offering that one will make
from these things to YHWH, and one shall bring it forward
to the priest, and he shall bring it over to the altar.

translation.text: You shall bring to the when it is presented to the priest, he shall take it to the altar.

verses.english:
And the priest shall lift from the grain offering a
representative portion of it and burn it to smoke at the
altar, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall lift from the grain offering a
representative portion of it and burn it to smoke at the
altar, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: The this into smoke on the altar, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.

translation.text: And what is left of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
Every grain offering that you will bring forward to YHWH
shall not be made with leavening, because all leaven and
all honey: you shall not burn any of it to smoke as an
offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לֹא תֵעָשֶׂה חָמֵץ כִּי כל שְׂאֹר וְכל דְּבַשׁ לֹא תַקְטִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לֹא תֵעָשֶׂה חָמֵץ כִּי כל שְׂאֹר וְכל דְּבַשׁ לֹא תַקְטִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Every grain offering that you will bring forward to YHWH
shall not be made with leavening, because all leaven and
all honey: you shall not burn any of it to smoke as an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: No grain offering that you bring to the LORD shall be made with offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall bring them forward to YHWH as an offering of a
first thing, but they shall not go up to the altar as a
pleasant smell.
verses.hebrew: קרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: קרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ׃

english.text:
You shall bring them forward to YHWH as an offering of a
first thing, but they shall not go up to the altar as a
pleasant smell.

translation.text: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of choice products, but they shall not be offered on the altar for a pleasing odor.

verses.english:
And you shall sprinkle every offering of a grain offering
with salt. And you shall not let the salt of your God’s
covenant cease from on your grain offering; you shall
bring salt on all your offerings.
verses.hebrew: וְכל קרְבַּן מִנְחָתְךָ בַּמֶּלַח תִּמְלָח וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּית מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעַל מִנְחָתֶךָ עַל כּל קרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח׃

hebrew.text: וְכל קרְבַּן מִנְחָתְךָ בַּמֶּלַח תִּמְלָח וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּית מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעַל מִנְחָתֶךָ עַל כּל קרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח׃

english.text:
And you shall sprinkle every offering of a grain offering
with salt. And you shall not let the salt of your God’s
covenant cease from on your grain offering; you shall
bring salt on all your offerings.

translation.text: You shall not omit from your grain offerings the offer salt.

verses.english:
“And if you will bring a grain offering of firstfruits to
YHWH, you shall bring the grain offering of your
firstfruits ripe, parched with fire, groats of fresh
grain.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם תַּקְרִיב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל תַּקְרִיב אֵת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תַּקְרִיב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל תַּקְרִיב אֵת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“And if you will bring a grain offering of firstfruits to
YHWH, you shall bring the grain offering of your
firstfruits ripe, parched with fire, groats of fresh
grain.

translation.text: If you bring a grain offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall fresh ears, parched with fire.

verses.english:
And you shall put oil on it and set frankincense on it. It
is a grain offering.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה מִנְחָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה מִנְחָה הִוא׃

english.text:
And you shall put oil on it and set frankincense on it. It
is a grain offering.

translation.text: You shall add oil to it and lay frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn a representative portion of it

sins by mistake—of any of YHWH’s commandments that are not
to be done—and does any one of them:
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה מִכֹּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְעָשָׂה מֵאַחַת מֵהֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה מִכֹּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְעָשָׂה מֵאַחַת מֵהֵנָּה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: A person who
sins by mistake—of any of YHWH’s commandments that are not
to be done—and does any one of them:

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel, them:

verses.english:
“If the anointed priest will sin, causing the people’s
guilt, then he shall bring forward for his sin that he
committed: a bull of the cattle, unblemished, for YHWH as
a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: אִם הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ יֶחֱטָא לְאַשְׁמַת הָעָם וְהִקְרִיב עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר תָּמִים לַיהֹוָה לְחַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: אִם הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ יֶחֱטָא לְאַשְׁמַת הָעָם וְהִקְרִיב עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר תָּמִים לַיהֹוָה לְחַטָּאת׃

english.text:
“If the anointed priest will sin, causing the people’s
guilt, then he shall bring forward for his sin that he
committed: a bull of the cattle, unblemished, for YHWH as
a sin offering.

translation.text: If it is the anointed priest who sins, thus bringing guilt on the people, without blemish as a sin offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall bring the bull to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting in front of YHWH. And he shall lay his hand on the
bull’s head and slaughter the bull in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֶת הַפָּר אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֶת הַפָּר אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring the bull to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting in front of YHWH. And he shall lay his hand on the
bull’s head and slaughter the bull in front of YHWH.

translation.text: He shall bring the bull LORD.

verses.english:
And the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s
blood and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהֵבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהֵבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s
blood and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and
sprinkle some of the blood seven times in front of YHWH
before the pavilion of the Holy.
verses.hebrew: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וְהִזָּה מִן הַדָּם שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶת פְּנֵי פָּרֹכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וְהִזָּה מִן הַדָּם שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶת פְּנֵי פָּרֹכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and
sprinkle some of the blood seven times in front of YHWH
before the pavilion of the Holy.

translation.text: The priest shall dip his finger in the front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

verses.english:
And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of
the altar of the incense of fragrances, in front of YHWH,
which is in the Tent of Meeting. And he shall spill all of
the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt
offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַדָּם עַל קַרְנוֹת מִזְבַּח קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת כּל דַּם הַפָּר יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַדָּם עַל קַרְנוֹת מִזְבַּח קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת כּל דַּם הַפָּר יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of
the altar of the incense of fragrances, in front of YHWH,
which is in the Tent of Meeting. And he shall spill all of
the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt
offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is in the tent of meeting before the LORD; and the rest of the blood of the bull he shall entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And he shall take off all the fat of the bull of the sin
offering from it: the fat that covers the innards and all
the fat that is on the innards
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כּל חֵלֶב פַּר הַחַטָּאת יָרִים מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל חֵלֶב פַּר הַחַטָּאת יָרִים מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב׃

english.text:
And he shall take off all the fat of the bull of the sin
offering from it: the fat that covers the innards and all
the fat that is on the innards

translation.text: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of sin offering: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is around the entrails;

verses.english:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיוֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיוֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

english.text:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys

translation.text: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the kidneys,

verses.english:
when it will be taken off from the ox of the
peace-offering sacrifice. And the priest shall burn them
to smoke on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּרַם מִשּׁוֹר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִירָם הַכֹּהֵן עַל מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּרַם מִשּׁוֹר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִירָם הַכֹּהֵן עַל מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
when it will be taken off from the ox of the
peace-offering sacrifice. And the priest shall burn them
to smoke on the altar of burnt offering.

translation.text: just as these are removed from the ox of the sacrifice of burnt offering.

verses.english:
And the bull’s skin and all of its meat with its head and
with its legs and its innards and its dung:
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת עוֹר הַפָּר וְאֶת כּל בְּשָׂרוֹ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל כְּרָעָיו וְקִרְבּוֹ וּפִרְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת עוֹר הַפָּר וְאֶת כּל בְּשָׂרוֹ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל כְּרָעָיו וְקִרְבּוֹ וּפִרְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And the bull’s skin and all of its meat with its head and
with its legs and its innards and its dung:

translation.text: But the skin of the bull and all its flesh, as well as its head, its legs, its entrails, and its dung —

verses.english:
and he shall bring all of the bull outside the camp, to a
pure place, to the place where ash is spilled, and burn it
on wood in fire. It shall be burned at the place where ash
is spilled.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצִיא אֶת כּל הַפָּר אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל מָקוֹם טָהוֹר אֶל שֶׁפֶךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן וְשָׂרַף אֹתוֹ עַל עֵצִים בָּאֵשׁ עַל שֶׁפֶךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹצִיא אֶת כּל הַפָּר אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל מָקוֹם טָהוֹר אֶל שֶׁפֶךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן וְשָׂרַף אֹתוֹ עַל עֵצִים בָּאֵשׁ עַל שֶׁפֶךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
and he shall bring all of the bull outside the camp, to a
pure place, to the place where ash is spilled, and burn it
on wood in fire. It shall be burned at the place where ash
is spilled.

translation.text: all the rest of the bull — he shall carry out to a clean place outside the camp, to the ash heap, and shall burn it on a wood fire; at the ash heap it shall be burned.

verses.english:
“And if all the congregation of Israel will make a
mistake, and something will be hidden from the community’s
eyes, and they do one of any of YHWH’s commandments that
are not to be done, and they are guilty,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁגּוּ וְנֶעְלַם דָּבָר מֵעֵינֵי הַקָּהָל וְעָשׂוּ אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְאָשֵׁמוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁגּוּ וְנֶעְלַם דָּבָר מֵעֵינֵי הַקָּהָל וְעָשׂוּ אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְאָשֵׁמוּ׃

english.text:
“And if all the congregation of Israel will make a
mistake, and something will be hidden from the community’s
eyes, and they do one of any of YHWH’s commandments that
are not to be done, and they are guilty,

translation.text: If the whole congregation of Israel errs unintentionally and the incur guilt;

verses.english:
and the sin over which they have sinned will become known,
then the community shall bring forward a bull of the
cattle as a sin offering, and they shall bring it in front
of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְנוֹדְעָה הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ עָלֶיהָ וְהִקְרִיבוּ הַקָּהָל פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְנוֹדְעָה הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ עָלֶיהָ וְהִקְרִיבוּ הַקָּהָל פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
and the sin over which they have sinned will become known,
then the community shall bring forward a bull of the
cattle as a sin offering, and they shall bring it in front
of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: when the sin that they have committed becomes known, the assembly shall offer a bull of the herd for a sin offering and bring it before the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And the community’s elders shall lay their hands on the
bull’s head in front of YHWH, and he shall slaughter the
bull in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְסָמְכוּ זִקְנֵי הָעֵדָה אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמְכוּ זִקְנֵי הָעֵדָה אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the community’s elders shall lay their hands on the
bull’s head in front of YHWH, and he shall slaughter the
bull in front of YHWH.

translation.text: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the LORD.

verses.english:
And the anointed priest shall bring some of the bull’s
blood to the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And the anointed priest shall bring some of the bull’s
blood to the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull into the tent of meeting,

verses.english:
And the priest shall dip his finger from the blood and
sprinkle seven times in front of YHWH before the pavilion.
verses.hebrew: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶצְבָּעוֹ מִן הַדָּם וְהִזָּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת פְּנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶצְבָּעוֹ מִן הַדָּם וְהִזָּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת פְּנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And the priest shall dip his finger from the blood and
sprinkle seven times in front of YHWH before the pavilion.

translation.text: and the before the LORD, in front of the curtain.

verses.english:
And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the
altar that is in front of YHWH, that is in the Tent of
Meeting, and he shall spill all of the blood at the base
of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן הַדָּם יִתֵּן עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת כּל הַדָּם יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִן הַדָּם יִתֵּן עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת כּל הַדָּם יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the
altar that is in front of YHWH, that is in the Tent of
Meeting, and he shall spill all of the blood at the base
of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance

forgiven for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבָּהּ יָסִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּסַר חֵלֶב הַכֶּשֶׂב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבָּהּ יָסִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּסַר חֵלֶב הַכֶּשֶׂב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall take away all of its fat as the sheep’s fat
was taken away from the peace-offering sacrifice, and the
priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar with YHWH’s
offerings by fire, and the priest shall make atonement
over him, over his sin that he committed, and it will be
forgiven for him.

translation.text: You shall remove all its fat, as the fat of the sheep is removed from the sacrifice of well-being, and the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar, with the offerings by fire to the LORD. Thus the committed, and you shall be forgiven.

verses.english:
“And a person who will sin in that he has heard a
pronouncement of an oath, and he was a witness—whether he
saw or he knew: if he will not tell, then he shall bear
his crime.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְשָׁמְעָה קוֹל אָלָה וְהוּא עֵד אוֹ רָאָה אוֹ יָדָע אִם לוֹא יַגִּיד וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְשָׁמְעָה קוֹל אָלָה וְהוּא עֵד אוֹ רָאָה אוֹ יָדָע אִם לוֹא יַגִּיד וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
“And a person who will sin in that he has heard a
pronouncement of an oath, and he was a witness—whether he
saw or he knew: if he will not tell, then he shall bear
his crime.

translation.text: When any of you sin in that you have heard a public adjuration to the matter — do not speak up, you are subject to punishment.

verses.english:
“Or a person who will touch any impure thing or the
carcass of an impure wild animal or the carcass of an
impure domestic animal or the carcass of an impure
swarming creature, and it was hidden from him, so he had
become impure and had become guilty;
verses.hebrew: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בְּכל דָּבָר טָמֵא אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיָּה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת שֶׁרֶץ טָמֵא וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא טָמֵא וְאָשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בְּכל דָּבָר טָמֵא אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיָּה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת שֶׁרֶץ טָמֵא וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא טָמֵא וְאָשֵׁם׃

english.text:
“Or a person who will touch any impure thing or the
carcass of an impure wild animal or the carcass of an
impure domestic animal or the carcass of an impure
swarming creature, and it was hidden from him, so he had
become impure and had become guilty;

translation.text: Or unclean, and are guilty.

verses.english:
or when he will touch a human’s impurity—for any impurity
of his through which he will become impure—and it was
hidden from him, and then he had come to know and had
become guilty;
verses.hebrew: אוֹ כִי יִגַּע בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא בָּהּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ כִי יִגַּע בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא בָּהּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם׃

english.text:
or when he will touch a human’s impurity—for any impurity
of his through which he will become impure—and it was
hidden from him, and then he had come to know and had
become guilty;

translation.text: Or when you touch human uncleanness — of it, when you come to know it, you shall be guilty.

verses.english:
or a person who will swear so as to let out of his lips to
do bad or to do good—for anything that a human would let
out in an oath—and it was hidden from him, and then he had
come to know and had become guilty by one of these:
verses.hebrew: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִשָּׁבַע לְבַטֵּא בִשְׂפָתַיִם לְהָרַע אוֹ לְהֵיטִיב לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְבַטֵּא הָאָדָם בִּשְׁבֻעָה וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִשָּׁבַע לְבַטֵּא בִשְׂפָתַיִם לְהָרַע אוֹ לְהֵיטִיב לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְבַטֵּא הָאָדָם בִּשְׁבֻעָה וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
or a person who will swear so as to let out of his lips to
do bad or to do good—for anything that a human would let
out in an oath—and it was hidden from him, and then he had
come to know and had become guilty by one of these:

translation.text: Or when any of know it, you shall in any of these be guilty.

verses.english:
And it will be that when he becomes guilty by one of these
he shall confess that he has sinned over it,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And it will be that when he becomes guilty by one of these
he shall confess that he has sinned over it,

translation.text: When you realize your guilt in any of these, you shall confess the sin that you have committed.

verses.english:
and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH over his sin
that he has committed: a female from the flock, a sheep or
a goat, as a sin offering, and the priest shall make
atonement over him from his sin.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא נְקֵבָה מִן הַצֹּאן כִּשְׂבָּה אוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא נְקֵבָה מִן הַצֹּאן כִּשְׂבָּה אוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ׃

english.text:
and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH over his sin
that he has committed: a female from the flock, a sheep or
a goat, as a sin offering, and the priest shall make
atonement over him from his sin.

translation.text: And you shall bring to the LORD, as your penalty for the sin that you sin.

verses.english:
“And if his hand will not attain enough for a sheep, then
he shall bring as his guilt offering for having sinned two
turtledoves or two pigeons to YHWH: one for a sin offering
and one for a burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַגִּיעַ יָדוֹ דֵּי שֶׂה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַגִּיעַ יָדוֹ דֵּי שֶׂה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
“And if his hand will not attain enough for a sheep, then
he shall bring as his guilt offering for having sinned two
turtledoves or two pigeons to YHWH: one for a sin offering
and one for a burnt offering.

translation.text: But if you cannot afford a sheep, you shall bring to the LORD, as your pigeons, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
And he shall bring them to the priest, and he shall bring
forward the one that is for the sin offering first and
will wring but not separate its head at the point opposite
its neck.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִקְרִיב אֶת אֲשֶׁר לַחַטָּאת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ מִמּוּל ערְפּוֹ וְלֹא יַבְדִּיל׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִקְרִיב אֶת אֲשֶׁר לַחַטָּאת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ מִמּוּל ערְפּוֹ וְלֹא יַבְדִּיל׃

english.text:
And he shall bring them to the priest, and he shall bring
forward the one that is for the sin offering first and
will wring but not separate its head at the point opposite
its neck.

translation.text: You shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer first the one for the sin offering, wringing its head at the nape without severing it.

verses.english:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin
offering on the wall of the altar, and what remains of the
blood shall be drained at the base of the altar. It is a
sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הוּא׃

english.text:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin
offering on the wall of the altar, and what remains of the
blood shall be drained at the base of the altar. It is a
sin offering.

translation.text: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And he shall make the second one a burnt offering
according to the required manner. And the priest shall
make atonement over him from his sin that he committed,
and it shall be forgiven for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall make the second one a burnt offering
according to the required manner. And the priest shall
make atonement over him from his sin that he committed,
and it shall be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And the second he shall offer for a burnt you shall be forgiven.

verses.english:
“And if his hand cannot attain enough for two turtledoves
or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for
having sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin
offering. He shall not set oil on it, and he shall not put
frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ לִשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ לִשְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת לְחַטָּאת לֹא יָשִׂים עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה כִּי חַטָּאת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ לִשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ לִשְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת לְחַטָּאת לֹא יָשִׂים עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה כִּי חַטָּאת הִוא׃

english.text:
“And if his hand cannot attain enough for two turtledoves
or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for
having sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin
offering. He shall not set oil on it, and he shall not put
frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

translation.text: But if you cannot afford two turtledoves or two pigeons, you shall of an ephah of choice flour for a sin offering; you shall not put oil on it or lay frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall
take the fill of his fist from it, a representative
portion of it, and he shall burn it to smoke at the altar
with YHWH’s offerings by fire. It is a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

english.text:
And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall
take the fill of his fist from it, a representative
portion of it, and he shall burn it to smoke at the altar
with YHWH’s offerings by fire. It is a sin offering.

translation.text: You shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall scoop up a handful of it as its memorial fire to the LORD; it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make atonement over him, over his sin
that he committed, from one of these, and it shall be
forgiven for him. And it shall be the priest’s, like the
grain offering.”
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מֵאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ וְהָיְתָה לַכֹּהֵן כַּמִּנְחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מֵאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ וְהָיְתָה לַכֹּהֵן כַּמִּנְחָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make atonement over him, over his sin
that he committed, from one of these, and it shall be
forgiven for him. And it shall be the priest’s, like the
grain offering.”

translation.text: Thus the priest shall make committed, and you shall be forgiven. Like the grain offering, the rest shall be for the priest.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“A person who will make a breach and sin by mistake among
YHWH’s holy things: he shall bring his guilt offering to
YHWH, an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation
of silver by shekels, by the shekel of the Holy, as a
guilt offering.

hebrew.text: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִמְעֹל מַעַל וְחָטְאָה בִּשְׁגָגָה מִקּדְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאָשָׁם׃

english.text:
“A person who will make a breach and sin by mistake among
YHWH’s holy things: he shall bring his guilt offering to
YHWH, an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation
of silver by shekels, by the shekel of the Holy, as a
guilt offering.

translation.text: When any of you commit a trespass and sin unintentionally in any of the holy things of the LORD, blemish from the flock, convertible into silver by the sanctuary shekel; it is a guilt offering.

verses.english:
And for what he sinned from the Holy he shall pay and add
to it a fifth of it and give it to the priest, and the
priest shall make atonement over him with the ram of the
guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם וְאֶת חֲמִישִׁתוֹ יוֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן אֹתוֹ לַכֹּהֵן וְהַכֹּהֵן יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם וְאֶת חֲמִישִׁתוֹ יוֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן אֹתוֹ לַכֹּהֵן וְהַכֹּהֵן יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

priest shall make atonement over him with the ram of the
guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And you shall make restitution for the holy thing in which you were remiss, and shall add one-fifth to it and give it ram of the guilt offering, and you shall be forgiven.

verses.english:
“And if a person who will sin and commit one of any of

“And if a person who will sin and commit one of any of
YHWH’s commandments that are not to be done and did not
know and became guilty, then he shall bear his crime.

that he made and had not known, and it shall be forgiven
for him.

And he shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock by
