that he made and had not known, and it shall be forgiven

something set in hand or by robbery, or has exploited his
fellow

english.text:
“A person who will sin and make a breach against YHWH and
tell a lie against his fellow in a matter of a deposit or
something set in hand or by robbery, or has exploited his
fellow

verses.english:
or has found something that was lost and has lied about it
or sworn to a falsehood—for one of any of these that a

or has found something that was lost and has lied about it
or sworn to a falsehood—for one of any of these that a
human will do to sin:

it will be, when he sins and is guilty, that he shall
bring back the thing that he robbed or the thing that he
coerced or the thing that was deposited with him or the
lost thing that he found

or anything about which he swore as a falsehood, and he
shall pay it in its worth and add to it a fifth of it. He
shall give it to the one whose it is on the day of his

or anything about which he swore as a falsehood, and he

and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH: an

Fire always shall be kept burning on the altar. It shall
not go out.

translation.text: And you shall bring to the priest, flock, or its equivalent, for a guilt offering.

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction for the grain offering. The
sons of Aaron shall bring it forward in front of YHWH to
the front of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פְּנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פְּנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction for the grain offering. The
sons of Aaron shall bring it forward in front of YHWH to
the front of the altar.

translation.text: The priest shall make for any of the things that one may do and incur guilt thereby.

verses.english:
And he shall lift some of it in his fist, some of the fine
flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all of
the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he
shall burn a representative portion of it to smoke at the
altar as a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall lift some of it in his fist, some of the fine
flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all of
the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he
shall burn a representative portion of it to smoke at the
altar as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the remainder of it. It
shall be eaten as unleavened bread, in a holy place. They
shall eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלוּהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלוּהָ׃

english.text:
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the remainder of it. It
shall be eaten as unleavened bread, in a holy place. They
shall eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the ritual of the burnt offering. The burnt offering itself while the fire on the altar shall be kept burning.

verses.english:
It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as
their portion from my offerings by fire. It is the holy of
holies, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָׁם׃

english.text:
It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as
their portion from my offerings by fire. It is the holy of
holies, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

translation.text: The priest shall put on his linen vestments after putting on his linen undergarments next to the burnt offering on the altar, and place them beside the altar.

verses.english:
Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it—an eternal
law through your generations—from YHWH’s offerings by
fire. Anything that will touch them will become holy.”
verses.hebrew: כּל זָכָר בִּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן יֹאכְלֶנָּה חק עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כּל זָכָר בִּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן יֹאכְלֶנָּה חק עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃

english.text:
Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it—an eternal
law through your generations—from YHWH’s offerings by
fire. Anything that will touch them will become holy.”

translation.text: carry the ashes out to a clean place outside the camp.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning; it shall not go out. Every morning the priest smoke the fat pieces of the offerings of well-being.

verses.english:
“This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they
shall bring to YHWH in the day of his being anointed: a
tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain
offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the
evening.
verses.hebrew: זֶה קרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת מִנְחָה תָּמִיד מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: זֶה קרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת מִנְחָה תָּמִיד מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב׃

english.text:
“This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they
shall bring to YHWH in the day of his being anointed: a
tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain
offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the
evening.

translation.text: A perpetual fire shall be kept burning on the altar; it shall not go out.

verses.english:
It shall be made on a griddle in oil. You shall bring it
well mixed. You shall offer it as cakes of a grain
offering of pieces, a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עַל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עַל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
It shall be made on a griddle in oil. You shall bring it
well mixed. You shall offer it as cakes of a grain
offering of pieces, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: This is the ritual of the grain offering: The sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, in front of the altar.

verses.english:
And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons
shall do it, an eternal law, for YHWH: it shall be burned
to smoke entirely.
verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חק עוֹלָם לַיהֹוָה כָּלִיל תּקְטָר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חק עוֹלָם לַיהֹוָה כָּלִיל תּקְטָר׃

english.text:
And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons
shall do it, an eternal law, for YHWH: it shall be burned
to smoke entirely.

translation.text: They shall take from it a handful of the choice flour and oil of the grain offering, with all the portion into smoke on the altar as a pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
And every grain offering of a priest shall be done
entirely. It shall not be eaten.”
verses.hebrew: וְכל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
And every grain offering of a priest shall be done
entirely. It shall not be eaten.”

translation.text: they shall eat it.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as offering and the guilt offering.

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the
instruction for the sin offering. In the place where the
burnt offering will be slaughtered, the sin offering shall
be slaughtered, in front of YHWH. It is the holy of
holies.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשָּׁחֵט הָעֹלָה תִּשָּׁחֵט הַחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשָּׁחֵט הָעֹלָה תִּשָּׁחֵט הַחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the
instruction for the sin offering. In the place where the
burnt offering will be slaughtered, the sin offering shall
be slaughtered, in front of YHWH. It is the holy of
holies.

translation.text: Every male among the descendants them shall become holy.

verses.english:
The priest who makes it a sin offering shall eat it. It
shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the
Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: הַכֹּהֵן הַמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכְלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: הַכֹּהֵן הַמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכְלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
The priest who makes it a sin offering shall eat it. It
shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the
Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
Anything that will touch the meat of it will become holy.
And if some of its blood will spatter on clothing, you
shall wash the thing on which it will spatter in a holy
place.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

english.text:
Anything that will touch the meat of it will become holy.
And if some of its blood will spatter on clothing, you
shall wash the thing on which it will spatter in a holy
place.

translation.text: This is the offering that Aaron and his sons shall offer to the LORD on the day when he is anointed: one-tenth of an ephah of choice flour as a regular offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

verses.english:
And a clay container in which it will be boiled shall be
broken. And if it was boiled in a brass container then it
shall be scoured and rinsed with water.
verses.hebrew: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And a clay container in which it will be boiled shall be
broken. And if it was boiled in a brass container then it
shall be scoured and rinsed with water.

translation.text: It shall be made with oil on a pieces, and you shall present it as a pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is the holy
of holies.
verses.hebrew: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

hebrew.text: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

english.text:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is the holy
of holies.

translation.text: And entirely into smoke.

verses.english:
And every sin offering some of whose blood will be brought
to the Tent of Meeting for atoning in the Holy shall not
be eaten. It shall be burned in fire.
verses.hebrew: וְכל חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יוּבָא מִדָּמָהּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ לֹא תֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְכל חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יוּבָא מִדָּמָהּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ לֹא תֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And every sin offering some of whose blood will be brought
to the Tent of Meeting for atoning in the Holy shall not
be eaten. It shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: Every grain offering of a priest shall be wholly burned; it shall not be eaten.

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction for the guilt offering. It
is the holy of holies.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction for the guilt offering. It
is the holy of holies.

translation.text: This is the ritual of the guilt offering. It is most holy;

verses.english:
They shall slaughter the guilt offering in the place where
they slaughter the burnt offering. And he shall fling its
blood on the altar all around.
verses.hebrew: בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָעֹלָה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָעֹלָה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
They shall slaughter the guilt offering in the place where
they slaughter the burnt offering. And he shall fling its
blood on the altar all around.

translation.text: at the spot where the burnt offering is slaughtered, they shall slaughter the guilt offering, and its blood shall be dashed against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And he shall bring forward from it all its fat, the fat
tail and the fat that covers the innards,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב׃

english.text:
And he shall bring forward from it all its fat, the fat
tail and the fat that covers the innards,

translation.text: entrails,

verses.english:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

english.text:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

translation.text: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which shall be removed with the kidneys.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar, an
offering by fire to YHWH. It is a guilt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אָשָׁם הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אָשָׁם הוּא׃

english.text:
And the priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar, an
offering by fire to YHWH. It is a guilt offering.

translation.text: The priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar as an offering by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.

verses.english:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It shall be
eaten in a holy place. It is the holy of holies.
verses.hebrew: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

english.text:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It shall be
eaten in a holy place. It is the holy of holies.

translation.text: Every male among the priests shall eat of it; it shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

verses.english:
As with the sin offering, so with the guilt offering: they
have one instruction. The priest who will make atonement
with it: it shall be his.
verses.hebrew: כַּחַטָּאת כָּאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: כַּחַטָּאת כָּאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
As with the sin offering, so with the guilt offering: they
have one instruction. The priest who will make atonement
with it: it shall be his.

translation.text: The guilt offering is like the sin offering, there is the same ritual for them; the priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.

verses.english:
And the priest who brings forward a man’s burnt offering:
the skin of the burnt offering that he brought forward is
for the priest; it shall be his.
verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת עֹלַת אִישׁ עוֹר הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת עֹלַת אִישׁ עוֹר הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And the priest who brings forward a man’s burnt offering:
the skin of the burnt offering that he brought forward is
for the priest; it shall be his.

translation.text: So, too, the priest who offers anyone's burnt offering shall keep the skin of the burnt offering that he has offered.

verses.english:
And every grain offering that will be baked in an oven and
every one made in a pan and on a griddle shall be for the
priest who brings it; it shall be his.
verses.hebrew: וְכל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And every grain offering that will be baked in an oven and
every one made in a pan and on a griddle shall be for the
priest who brings it; it shall be his.

translation.text: And every grain offering baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in a pan or on a griddle, shall belong to the priest who offers it.

verses.english:
And every grain offering mixed with oil or dry shall be
for all the sons of Aaron, each like his brother.
verses.hebrew: וְכל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו׃

english.text:
And every grain offering mixed with oil or dry shall be
for all the sons of Aaron, each like his brother.

translation.text: But every other grain offering, mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron equally.

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction of the peace-offering
sacrifice that one shall bring forward to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction of the peace-offering
sacrifice that one shall bring forward to YHWH.

translation.text: This is the ritual of the sacrifice of the offering of well-being that one may offer to the LORD.

verses.english:
If he will bring it forward out of thanks then he shall
bring forward with the sacrifice of thanks unleavened
cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured
on them and fine flour well mixed, cakes, mixed with oil.
verses.hebrew: אִם עַל תּוֹדָה יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ וְהִקְרִיב עַל זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה חַלּוֹת מַצּוֹת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וְסֹלֶת מֻרְבֶּכֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: אִם עַל תּוֹדָה יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ וְהִקְרִיב עַל זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה חַלּוֹת מַצּוֹת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וְסֹלֶת מֻרְבֶּכֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
If he will bring it forward out of thanks then he shall
bring forward with the sacrifice of thanks unleavened
cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured
on them and fine flour well mixed, cakes, mixed with oil.

translation.text: If you offer it for thanksgiving, you shall soaked in oil.

verses.english:
He shall make his offering with cakes of leavened bread,
with his peace-offering sacrifice of thanks.
verses.hebrew: עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו׃

english.text:
He shall make his offering with cakes of leavened bread,
with his peace-offering sacrifice of thanks.

translation.text: With your thanksgiving sacrifice of well-being you shall bring your offering with cakes of leavened bread.

verses.english:
And he shall bring forward from it one of each offering as
a donation for YHWH. For the priest who flings the blood
of the peace offerings: it shall be his.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכּל קרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכּל קרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring forward from it one of each offering as
a donation for YHWH. For the priest who flings the blood
of the peace offerings: it shall be his.

translation.text: From this shall belong to the priest who dashes the blood of the offering of wellbeing.

verses.english:
And the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice shall be
eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any
of it until morning.
verses.hebrew: וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice shall be
eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any
of it until morning.

translation.text: And the flesh of your thanksgiving sacrifice of well-being shall be eaten on the day it is offered; you shall not leave any of it until morning.

verses.english:
And if his sacrificial offering is a vow or a
contribution, it shall be eaten on the day that he brings
forward his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of
it may be eaten.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם נֶדֶר אוֹ נְדָבָה זֶבַח קרְבָּנוֹ בְּיוֹם הַקְרִיבוֹ אֶת זִבְחוֹ יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר מִמֶּנּוּ יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נֶדֶר אוֹ נְדָבָה זֶבַח קרְבָּנוֹ בְּיוֹם הַקְרִיבוֹ אֶת זִבְחוֹ יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר מִמֶּנּוּ יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
And if his sacrificial offering is a vow or a
contribution, it shall be eaten on the day that he brings
forward his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of
it may be eaten.

translation.text: But if the sacrifice you offer is a votive offering or a sacrifice, and what is left of it shall be eaten the next day;

verses.english:
And what is left of the meat of the sacrifice on the third
day shall be burned in fire.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And what is left of the meat of the sacrifice on the third
day shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: but what is left of the flesh of the sacrifice shall be burned up on the third day.

verses.english:
And if any of the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice
will be eaten on the third day, it shall not be
acceptable. The one who brings it forward: it shall not be
counted for him. It shall be a repugnant thing. And the
person who eats any of it shall bear his crime.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֹא יֵרָצֶה הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁב לוֹ פִּגּוּל יִהְיֶה וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מִמֶּנּוּ עֲוֺנָהּ תִּשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֹא יֵרָצֶה הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁב לוֹ פִּגּוּל יִהְיֶה וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מִמֶּנּוּ עֲוֺנָהּ תִּשָּׂא׃

english.text:
And if any of the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice
will be eaten on the third day, it shall not be
acceptable. The one who brings it forward: it shall not be
counted for him. It shall be a repugnant thing. And the
person who eats any of it shall bear his crime.

translation.text: If any of the flesh of your sacrifice of well-being is eaten on the third day, it shall not be acceptable, nor shall it be credited to the one shall incur guilt.

verses.english:
And meat that will touch any impure thing shall not be
eaten. It shall be burned in fire. And meat: everyone who
is pure may eat meat,
verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף וְהַבָּשָׂר כּל טָהוֹר יֹאכַל בָּשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף וְהַבָּשָׂר כּל טָהוֹר יֹאכַל בָּשָׂר׃

english.text:
And meat that will touch any impure thing shall not be
eaten. It shall be burned in fire. And meat: everyone who
is pure may eat meat,

translation.text: Flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burned up. As for other flesh, all who are clean may eat such flesh.

verses.english:
but the person who will eat meat from the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s while his impurity is on him,
that person will be cut off from his people.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
but the person who will eat meat from the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s while his impurity is on him,
that person will be cut off from his people.

translation.text: But those who eat flesh from the LORD's sacrifice of well-being while in a state of uncleanness shall be cut off from their kin.

verses.english:
And a person who will touch any impure thing, human
impurity or an impure animal or any impure detestable
thing, and will eat some of the meat of the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s: that person will be cut off from
his people.”
verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם אוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּכל שֶׁקֶץ טָמֵא וְאָכַל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם אוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּכל שֶׁקֶץ טָמֵא וְאָכַל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And a person who will touch any impure thing, human
impurity or an impure animal or any impure detestable
thing, and will eat some of the meat of the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s: that person will be cut off from
his people.”

translation.text: When any one sacrifice of well-being, you shall be cut off from your kin.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: You shall not
eat any fat of an ox or sheep or goat.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: You shall not
eat any fat of an ox or sheep or goat.

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: You shall eat no fat of ox or sheep or goat.

verses.english:
And fat of a carcass and fat of a torn animal may be used
for any work, but you shall not eat it.
verses.hebrew: וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

english.text:
And fat of a carcass and fat of a torn animal may be used
for any work, but you shall not eat it.

translation.text: The fat of an use, but you must not eat it.

verses.english:
Because anyone who eats fat from an animal from which one
would bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH, the
person who eats it will be cut off from his people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חֵלֶב מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנָּה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חֵלֶב מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנָּה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
Because anyone who eats fat from an animal from which one
would bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH, the
person who eats it will be cut off from his people.

translation.text: If any one of you eats the fat from an eat it shall be cut off from your kin.

verses.english:
And you shall not eat any blood in all of your homes, a
bird’s or an animal’s.
verses.hebrew: וְכל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And you shall not eat any blood in all of your homes, a
bird’s or an animal’s.

translation.text: You must not eat any blood whatever, either of bird or of animal, in any of your settlements.

verses.english:
Any person who will eat any blood, that person will be cut
off from his people.”
verses.hebrew: כּל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל כּל דָּם וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כּל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל כּל דָּם וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
Any person who will eat any blood, that person will be cut
off from his people.”

translation.text: Any one of you who eats any blood shall be cut off from your kin.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: The one who
brings forward his peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH shall
bring his offering to YHWH from his peace-offering
sacrifice:
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו לַיהֹוָה יָבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִזֶּבַח שְׁלָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו לַיהֹוָה יָבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִזֶּבַח שְׁלָמָיו׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: The one who
brings forward his peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH shall
bring his offering to YHWH from his peace-offering
sacrifice:

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel, sacrifice of well-being.

verses.english:
his hands shall bring YHWH’s offerings by fire. He shall
bring it, the fat with the breast: the breast so as to
elevate it, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: יָדָיו תְּבִיאֶינָה אֵת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב עַל הֶחָזֶה יְבִיאֶנּוּ אֵת הֶחָזֶה לְהָנִיף אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: יָדָיו תְּבִיאֶינָה אֵת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב עַל הֶחָזֶה יְבִיאֶנּוּ אֵת הֶחָזֶה לְהָנִיף אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
his hands shall bring YHWH’s offerings by fire. He shall
bring it, the fat with the breast: the breast so as to
elevate it, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

translation.text: Your own hands shall bring the LORD's breast may be raised as an elevation offering before the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn the fat to smoke at the altar,
and the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃

english.text:
And the priest shall burn the fat to smoke at the altar,
and the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

translation.text: The priest shall turn the fat into smoke on the altar, but the breast shall belong to Aaron and his sons.

verses.english:
And you shall give the right thigh as a donation to the
priest from your peace-offering sacrifices.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall give the right thigh as a donation to the
priest from your peace-offering sacrifices.

translation.text: And the right thigh from your sacrifices of well-being you shall give to the priest as an offering;

verses.english:
The one from the sons of Aaron who brings forward the
blood of the peace offerings and the fat: the right thigh
shall be his as a portion.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָה׃

hebrew.text: הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָה׃

english.text:
The one from the sons of Aaron who brings forward the
blood of the peace offerings and the fat: the right thigh
shall be his as a portion.

translation.text: the offering of well-being shall have the right thigh for a portion.

verses.english:
Because I have taken the breast of the elevation offering
and the thigh of the donation from the children of Israel,
from their peace-offering sacrifices, and I have given
them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal law
from the children of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה לָקַחְתִּי מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן אֹתָם לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה לָקַחְתִּי מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן אֹתָם לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Because I have taken the breast of the elevation offering
and the thigh of the donation from the children of Israel,
from their peace-offering sacrifices, and I have given
them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal law
from the children of Israel.”

translation.text: For I offered, from the people of Israel, from their sacrifices of well-being, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons, as a perpetual due from the people of Israel.

verses.english:
This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his
sons from YHWH’s offerings by fire in the day He brought
them forward to function as priests for YHWH,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his
sons from YHWH’s offerings by fire in the day He brought
them forward to function as priests for YHWH,

translation.text: This is the portion allotted to Aaron have been brought forward to serve the LORD as priests;

verses.english:
which YHWH commanded to give to them in the day of His
anointing them from among the children of Israel, an
eternal law through their generations.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לָהֶם בְּיוֹם משְׁחוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לָהֶם בְּיוֹם משְׁחוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
which YHWH commanded to give to them in the day of His
anointing them from among the children of Israel, an
eternal law through their generations.

translation.text: these the perpetual due from the people of Israel throughout their generations.

verses.english:
This is the instruction of the burnt offering, of the
grain offering, and of the sin offering and of the guilt
offering and of the ordination and of the peace-offering
sacrifice,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
This is the instruction of the burnt offering, of the
grain offering, and of the sin offering and of the guilt
offering and of the ordination and of the peace-offering
sacrifice,

translation.text: This is the ritual of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the offering of ordination, and the sacrifice of well-being,

verses.english:
which YHWH commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that
He commanded the children of Israel to make their
offerings to YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי בְּיוֹם צַוֺּתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבְּנֵיהֶם לַיהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי בְּיוֹם צַוֺּתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבְּנֵיהֶם לַיהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

english.text:
which YHWH commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that
He commanded the children of Israel to make their
offerings to YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai.

translation.text: which the LORD commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Take Aaron and his sons with him and the clothes and the
anointing oil and the bull for the sin offering and the
two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,
verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּוֹת׃

english.text:
“Take Aaron and his sons with him and the clothes and the
anointing oil and the bull for the sin offering and the
two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,

translation.text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, the vestments, the anointing oil, the bull of sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

verses.english:
and assemble all of the congregation to the entrance of
the Tent of Meeting.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
and assemble all of the congregation to the entrance of
the Tent of Meeting.”

translation.text: and assemble the whole congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And the congregation
was gathered to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And the congregation
was gathered to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And Moses did at the entrance of the tent of meeting,

verses.english:
And Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing
that YHWH has commanded to do.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing
that YHWH has commanded to do.”

translation.text: Moses said to the congregation, "This is what the LORD has commanded to be done."

verses.english:
And Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and he
washed them with water.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and he
washed them with water.

translation.text: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and washed them with water.

verses.english:
And he put the coat on him and belted him with the sash
and dressed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and
belted him with the ephod’s designed belt and put on the
ephod for him with it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בָּאַבְנֵט וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ אֶת הַמְּעִיל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הָאֵפֹד וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וַיֶּאְפֹּד לוֹ בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בָּאַבְנֵט וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ אֶת הַמְּעִיל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הָאֵפֹד וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וַיֶּאְפֹּד לוֹ בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he put the coat on him and belted him with the sash
and dressed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and
belted him with the ephod’s designed belt and put on the
ephod for him with it.

translation.text: He put the tunic on him, fastened the sash around him, it.

verses.english:
And he set the breastplate on him and put the Urim and
Tummim into the breastplate.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים׃

english.text:
And he set the breastplate on him and put the Urim and
Tummim into the breastplate.

translation.text: He placed the breastpiece on him, and in the breastpiece he put the Urim and the Thummim.

verses.english:
And he set the headdress on his head and set the gold
plate, the crown of Holiness, on the headdress opposite
the front of it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו אֵת צִיץ הַזָּהָב נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו אֵת צִיץ הַזָּהָב נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he set the headdress on his head and set the gold
plate, the crown of Holiness, on the headdress opposite
the front of it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he set the turban on his head, and on the turban, in front, he set the golden ornament, the holy crown, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses took the anointing oil, and he anointed the
Tabernacle and everything that was in it, so he
consecrated them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses took the anointing oil, and he anointed the
Tabernacle and everything that was in it, so he
consecrated them.

translation.text: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.

verses.english:
And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and
anointed the altar and all of its equipment and the basin
and its stand to consecrate them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּז מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ לְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּז מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ לְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and
anointed the altar and all of its equipment and the basin
and its stand to consecrate them.

translation.text: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the basin and its base, to consecrate them.

verses.english:
And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head
and anointed him to consecrate him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head
and anointed him to consecrate him.

translation.text: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to consecrate him.

verses.english:
And Moses brought forward Aaron’s sons and dressed them in
coats and belted them with a sash and put on hats for
them, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses brought forward Aaron’s sons and dressed them in
coats and belted them with a sash and put on hats for
them, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he brought up the bull for the sin offering. And Aaron
and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for
the sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וַיִּסְמֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ פַּר הַחַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וַיִּסְמֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ פַּר הַחַטָּאת׃

english.text:
And he brought up the bull for the sin offering. And Aaron
and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for
the sin offering.

translation.text: He led forward the bull of sin offering; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bull of sin offering,

verses.english:
And Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around with his finger and purified
the altar from sin, and he poured the blood at the base of
the altar, and he consecrated it to make atonement on it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וַיְחַטֵּא אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וַיְחַטֵּא אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around with his finger and purified
the altar from sin, and he poured the blood at the base of
the altar, and he consecrated it to make atonement on it.

translation.text: and it was each of the horns of the altar, purifying the altar; then he poured out atonement for it.

verses.english:
And he took all the fat that was on the innards and the
lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and
Moses burned them to smoke at the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he took all the fat that was on the innards and the
lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and
Moses burned them to smoke at the altar.

translation.text: Moses took all the fat that was around the their fat, and turned them into smoke on the altar.

verses.english:
And he burned the bull and its skin and its meat and its
dung in fire outside the camp, as YHWH had commanded
Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he burned the bull and its skin and its meat and its
dung in fire outside the camp, as YHWH had commanded
Moses.

translation.text: But the bull itself, its skin and flesh and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering. And
Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת אֵיל הָעֹלָה וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת אֵיל הָעֹלָה וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering. And
Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.

translation.text: Then he brought forward the ram of burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,

verses.english:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses flung the blood on the
altar all around.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses flung the blood on the
altar all around.

translation.text: and it was slaughtered. Moses dashed the blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And he cut the ram into its parts, and Moses burned the
head and the parts and the suet to smoke.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר׃

english.text:
And he cut the ram into its parts, and Moses burned the
head and the parts and the suet to smoke.

translation.text: The ram was and the suet.

verses.english:
And he washed the innards and the legs with water. And
Moses burned all of the ram to smoke at the altar. It was
a burnt offering as a pleasant smell. It was an offering
by fire to YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַיִם רָחַץ בַּמָּיִם וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַיִם רָחַץ בַּמָּיִם וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he washed the innards and the legs with water. And
Moses burned all of the ram to smoke at the altar. It was
a burnt offering as a pleasant smell. It was an offering
by fire to YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And after the entrails and the legs were washed with burnt offering for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the second ram, the ram of
ordination. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the
ram’s head.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the second ram, the ram of
ordination. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the
ram’s head.

translation.text: Then he brought forward the second ram, the ram of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,

verses.english:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood
and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe and on the thumb of
his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood
and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe and on the thumb of
his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

translation.text: and it toe of his right foot.

verses.english:
And he brought Aaron’s sons forward, and Moses put some of
the blood on their right earlobe and on the thumb of their
right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. And
Moses flung the blood on the altar all around.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה מִן הַדָּם עַל תְּנוּךְ אזְנָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה מִן הַדָּם עַל תְּנוּךְ אזְנָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he brought Aaron’s sons forward, and Moses put some of
the blood on their right earlobe and on the thumb of their
right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. And
Moses flung the blood on the altar all around.

translation.text: After Aaron's sons were brought forward, the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet; and Moses dashed the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that
was on the innards and the lobe of the liver and the two
kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

english.text:
And he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that
was on the innards and the lobe of the liver and the two
kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

translation.text: entrails, the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat — and the right thigh.

verses.english:
And from the basket of unleavened bread that was in front
of YHWH he took one cake of unleavened bread and one cake
of bread with oil and one wafer, and he set them on the
fats and on the right thigh.
verses.hebrew: וּמִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָקַח חַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַחֲלָבִים וְעַל שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

hebrew.text: וּמִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָקַח חַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַחֲלָבִים וְעַל שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

english.text:
And from the basket of unleavened bread that was in front
of YHWH he took one cake of unleavened bread and one cake
of bread with oil and one wafer, and he set them on the
fats and on the right thigh.

translation.text: From the basket of unleavened bread that the right thigh.

verses.english:
And he put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’ hands
and elevated them, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’ hands
and elevated them, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

translation.text: He placed all these on the palms of Aaron and on the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses took them from on their hands and burned them to
smoke at the altar with the burnt offering. They were an
ordination offering as a pleasant smell. It was an
offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֹתָם מֵעַל כַּפֵּיהֶם וַיַּקְטֵר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה מִלֻּאִים הֵם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֹתָם מֵעַל כַּפֵּיהֶם וַיַּקְטֵר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה מִלֻּאִים הֵם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses took them from on their hands and burned them to
smoke at the altar with the burnt offering. They were an
ordination offering as a pleasant smell. It was an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: Then Moses took them from their hands and turned them into smoke on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses took the breast and elevated it, an elevation
offering in front of YHWH from the ram of ordination. It
was Moses’ for a portion, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הֶחָזֶה וַיְנִיפֵהוּ תְנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים לְמֹשֶׁה הָיָה לְמָנָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הֶחָזֶה וַיְנִיפֵהוּ תְנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים לְמֹשֶׁה הָיָה לְמָנָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses took the breast and elevated it, an elevation
offering in front of YHWH from the ram of ordination. It
was Moses’ for a portion, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: Moses took the breast and raised it as an elevation offering before the LORD; commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the
blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron,
on his clothes, and on his sons and on his sons’ clothes
with him, and he consecrated Aaron, his clothes, and his
sons and his sons’ clothes with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּז עַל אַהֲרֹן עַל בְּגָדָיו וְעַל בָּנָיו וְעַל בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּז עַל אַהֲרֹן עַל בְּגָדָיו וְעַל בָּנָיו וְעַל בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the
blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron,
on his clothes, and on his sons and on his sons’ clothes
with him, and he consecrated Aaron, his clothes, and his
sons and his sons’ clothes with him.

translation.text: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood and his vestments, and also his sons and their vestments.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Cook the meat at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and eat it and the
bread that’s in the basket of ordination there, as I
commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו בַּשְּׁלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְשָׁם תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּסַל הַמִּלֻּאִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּיתִי לֵאמֹר אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו בַּשְּׁלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְשָׁם תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּסַל הַמִּלֻּאִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּיתִי לֵאמֹר אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Cook the meat at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and eat it and the
bread that’s in the basket of ordination there, as I
commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

translation.text: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the flesh at the entrance sons shall eat it';

verses.english:
And you shall burn what is left of the meat and of the
bread in fire.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַלָּחֶם בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹפוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַלָּחֶם בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹפוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall burn what is left of the meat and of the
bread in fire.

translation.text: and what remains of the flesh and the bread you shall burn with fire.

verses.english:
And you shall not go out from the Tent of Meeting for
seven days, until the day of completion of the days of
your ordination, because He will fill your hand for seven
days.
verses.hebrew: וּמִפֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא תֵצְאוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים עַד יוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי מִלֻּאֵיכֶם כִּי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יְמַלֵּא אֶת יֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִפֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא תֵצְאוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים עַד יוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי מִלֻּאֵיכֶם כִּי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יְמַלֵּא אֶת יֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not go out from the Tent of Meeting for
seven days, until the day of completion of the days of
your ordination, because He will fill your hand for seven
days.

translation.text: You shall not go outside the entrance of the ordination is completed. For it will take seven days to ordain you;

verses.english:
What has been done on this day YHWH commanded to do, to
make atonement over you.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
What has been done on this day YHWH commanded to do, to
make atonement over you.

translation.text: as atonement for you.

verses.english:
And you shall sit at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
day and night, seven days, and you shall keep YHWH’s
charge, and you will not die, because that is what I was
commanded.”
verses.hebrew: וּפֶתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד תֵּשְׁבוּ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ כִּי כֵן צֻוֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וּפֶתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד תֵּשְׁבוּ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ כִּי כֵן צֻוֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
And you shall sit at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
day and night, seven days, and you shall keep YHWH’s
charge, and you will not die, because that is what I was
commanded.”

translation.text: You shall remain at the entrance of the tent of that you do not die; for so I am commanded."

verses.english:
And Aaron and his sons did all the things that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Aaron and his sons did all the things that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: Aaron and his sons did all the things that the LORD commanded through Moses.

verses.english:
And it was, on the eighth day, Moses called to Aaron and
to his sons and to Israel’s elders.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי קָרָא מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וּלְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי קָרָא מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וּלְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And it was, on the eighth day, Moses called to Aaron and
to his sons and to Israel’s elders.

translation.text: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

verses.english:
And he said to Aaron, “Take a calf of the cattle for a sin
offering and a ram for a burnt offering—unblemished—and
bring them forward in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח לְךָ עֵגֶל בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה תְּמִימִם וְהַקְרֵב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח לְךָ עֵגֶל בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה תְּמִימִם וְהַקְרֵב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he said to Aaron, “Take a calf of the cattle for a sin
offering and a ram for a burnt offering—unblemished—and
bring them forward in front of YHWH.

translation.text: He said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf for a sin offering before the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying,
‘Take a goat for a sin offering and a calf and a lamb,
unblemished one-year-olds, for a burnt offering
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר קְחוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְעֵגֶל וָכֶבֶשׂ בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר קְחוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְעֵגֶל וָכֶבֶשׂ בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying,
‘Take a goat for a sin offering and a calf and a lamb,
unblemished one-year-olds, for a burnt offering

translation.text: And say to the people of Israel, 'Take a male goat for a sin offering; a calf and a lamb, yearlings without blemish, for a burnt offering;

verses.english:
and an ox and a ram for peace offerings to sacrifice in
front of YHWH, and a grain offering mixed with oil,
because today YHWH is appearing to you.’”
verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר וָאַיִל לִשְׁלָמִים לִזְבֹּחַ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשׁוֹר וָאַיִל לִשְׁלָמִים לִזְבֹּחַ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and an ox and a ram for peace offerings to sacrifice in
front of YHWH, and a grain offering mixed with oil,
because today YHWH is appearing to you.’”

translation.text: and an ox and a ram for an offering of well-being to sacrifice before the LORD; and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.'"

verses.english:
And they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the
Tent of Meeting, and they brought forward all of the
congregation, and they stood in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּקְרְבוּ כּל הָעֵדָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּקְרְבוּ כּל הָעֵדָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the
Tent of Meeting, and they brought forward all of the
congregation, and they stood in front of YHWH.

translation.text: They brought what Moses commanded near and stood before the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “This is the thing that YHWH has commanded
that you shall do, and YHWH’s glory will appear to you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ וְיֵרָא אֲלֵיכֶם כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ וְיֵרָא אֲלֵיכֶם כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “This is the thing that YHWH has commanded
that you shall do, and YHWH’s glory will appear to you.”

translation.text: And Moses said, "This is the thing appear to you."

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Come forward to the altar and
make your sin offering and your burnt offering and make
atonement for yourself and for the people, and make the
people’s offering and make atonement for them as YHWH
commanded.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קְרַב אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת חַטָּאתְךָ וְאֶת עֹלָתֶךָ וְכַפֵּר בַּעַדְךָ וּבְעַד הָעָם וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת קרְבַּן הָעָם וְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קְרַב אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת חַטָּאתְךָ וְאֶת עֹלָתֶךָ וְכַפֵּר בַּעַדְךָ וּבְעַד הָעָם וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת קרְבַּן הָעָם וְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Come forward to the altar and
make your sin offering and your burnt offering and make
atonement for yourself and for the people, and make the
people’s offering and make atonement for them as YHWH
commanded.”

translation.text: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Draw near to the altar commanded."

verses.english:
And Aaron came forward to the altar and slaughtered the
calf for the sin offering that he had.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַב אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת עֵגֶל הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַב אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת עֵגֶל הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Aaron came forward to the altar and slaughtered the
calf for the sin offering that he had.

translation.text: Aaron drew near to the altar, and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

verses.english:
And Aaron’s sons brought forward the blood to him, and he
dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the altar’s
horns, and he poured the blood to the base of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּטְבֹּל אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּטְבֹּל אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Aaron’s sons brought forward the blood to him, and he
dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the altar’s
horns, and he poured the blood to the base of the altar.

translation.text: The sons of Aaron presented the horns of the altar; and the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.

verses.english:
And he burned the fat and the kidneys and the lobe from
the liver from the sin offering to smoke at the altar, as
YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת מִן הַכָּבֵד מִן הַחַטָּאת הִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת מִן הַכָּבֵד מִן הַחַטָּאת הִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he burned the fat and the kidneys and the lobe from
the liver from the sin offering to smoke at the altar, as
YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: But the fat, the kidneys, and the appendage of the liver commanded Moses;

verses.english:
And he burned the meat and the skin in fire outside the
camp.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת הָעוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת הָעוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And he burned the meat and the skin in fire outside the
camp.

translation.text: and the flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

verses.english:
And he slaughtered the burnt offering. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֵלָיו אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֵלָיו אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered the burnt offering. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around.

translation.text: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he dashed it against all sides of the altar.

verses.english:
And they presented the burnt offering to him in its parts
and the head, and he burned it to smoke on the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָעֹלָה הִמְצִיאוּ אֵלָיו לִנְתָחֶיהָ וְאֶת הָרֹאשׁ וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָעֹלָה הִמְצִיאוּ אֵלָיו לִנְתָחֶיהָ וְאֶת הָרֹאשׁ וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And they presented the burnt offering to him in its parts
and the head, and he burned it to smoke on the altar.

translation.text: And they turned into smoke on the altar.

verses.english:
And he washed the innards and the legs and burned them to
smoke with the burnt offering at the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְחַץ אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעָיִם וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הָעֹלָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְחַץ אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעָיִם וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הָעֹלָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he washed the innards and the legs and burned them to
smoke with the burnt offering at the altar.

translation.text: He washed the entrails and the legs and, with the burnt offering, turned them into smoke on the altar.

verses.english:
And he made the people’s offering: and he took the goat
for the sin offering that was the people’s, and he
slaughtered it and made a sin offering with it like the
first one.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת קרְבַּן הָעָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵהוּ וַיְחַטְּאֵהוּ כָּרִאשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת קרְבַּן הָעָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵהוּ וַיְחַטְּאֵהוּ כָּרִאשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
And he made the people’s offering: and he took the goat
for the sin offering that was the people’s, and he
slaughtered it and made a sin offering with it like the
first one.

translation.text: Next he presented the people's offering. He took the goat of the sin as a sin offering like the first one.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the burnt offering and made it
according to the required manner.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the burnt offering and made it
according to the required manner.

translation.text: He presented the burnt offering, and sacrificed it according to regulation.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the grain offering and filled his
hand from it and burned it to smoke on the altar—apart
from the morning’s burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הַמִּנְחָה וַיְמַלֵּא כַפּוֹ מִמֶּנָּה וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הַמִּנְחָה וַיְמַלֵּא כַפּוֹ מִמֶּנָּה וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the grain offering and filled his
hand from it and burned it to smoke on the altar—apart
from the morning’s burnt offering.

translation.text: He presented the grain altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

verses.english:
And he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the peace-offering
sacrifice that was the people’s. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הַשּׁוֹר וְאֶת הָאַיִל זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הַשּׁוֹר וְאֶת הָאַיִל זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the peace-offering
sacrifice that was the people’s. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around,

translation.text: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as a sacrifice of well-being for against all sides of the altar,

verses.english:
and the fats from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail
and the covering and the kidneys and the lobe of the
liver.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים מִן הַשּׁוֹר וּמִן הָאַיִל הָאַלְיָה וְהַמְכַסֶּה וְהַכְּלָיֹת וְיֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים מִן הַשּׁוֹר וּמִן הָאַיִל הָאַלְיָה וְהַמְכַסֶּה וְהַכְּלָיֹת וְיֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד׃

english.text:
and the fats from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail
and the covering and the kidneys and the lobe of the
liver.

translation.text: and the fat of the ox and of the ram — the broad tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the two kidneys and the fat on them, and the appendage of the liver.

verses.english:
And they set the fats on the breasts, and he burned the
fats to smoke at the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת הַחֲלָבִים עַל הֶחָזוֹת וַיַּקְטֵר הַחֲלָבִים הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת הַחֲלָבִים עַל הֶחָזוֹת וַיַּקְטֵר הַחֲלָבִים הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And they set the fats on the breasts, and he burned the
fats to smoke at the altar.

translation.text: They first laid the fat on the breasts, and the fat was turned into smoke on the altar;

verses.english:
And Aaron elevated the breasts and the right thigh, an
elevation offering in front of YHWH, as Moses had
commanded.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הֶחָזוֹת וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין הֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הֶחָזוֹת וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין הֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Aaron elevated the breasts and the right thigh, an
elevation offering in front of YHWH, as Moses had
commanded.

translation.text: and before the LORD, as Moses had commanded.

verses.english:
And Aaron raised his hands to the people and blessed them.
And he went down from making the sin offering and the
burnt offering and the peace offering.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדָו אֶל הָעָם וַיְבָרְכֵם וַיֵּרֶד מֵעֲשֹׂת הַחַטָּאת וְהָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדָו אֶל הָעָם וַיְבָרְכֵם וַיֵּרֶד מֵעֲשֹׂת הַחַטָּאת וְהָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And Aaron raised his hands to the people and blessed them.
And he went down from making the sin offering and the
burnt offering and the peace offering.

translation.text: Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them; and he the offering of well-being.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came to the Tent of Meeting, and they
went out and blessed the people. And YHWH’s glory appeared
to all the people.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּצְאוּ וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּצְאוּ וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came to the Tent of Meeting, and they
went out and blessed the people. And YHWH’s glory appeared
to all the people.

translation.text: Moses and Aaron entered the tent of the LORD appeared to all the people.

verses.english:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed the
burnt offering and the fats on the altar! And all the
people saw, and they shouted, and they fell on their
faces!
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים וַיַּרְא כּל הָעָם וַיָּרֹנּוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים וַיַּרְא כּל הָעָם וַיָּרֹנּוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed the
burnt offering and the fats on the altar! And all the
people saw, and they shouted, and they fell on their
faces!

translation.text: Fire came out from the LORD all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.

verses.english:
And Aaron’s sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his
fire-holder, and they put fire in them and set incense on
it. And they brought forward unfitting fire, which He had
not commanded them, in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ בְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלֶיהָ קְטֹרֶת וַיַּקְרִיבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵשׁ זָרָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוָּה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ בְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלֶיהָ קְטֹרֶת וַיַּקְרִיבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵשׁ זָרָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוָּה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Aaron’s sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his
fire-holder, and they put fire in them and set incense on
it. And they brought forward unfitting fire, which He had
not commanded them, in front of YHWH.

translation.text: Now Aaron's sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his censer, put fire in it, and laid incense on it; and they offered unholy fire before the LORD, such as he had not commanded them.

verses.english:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed them!
And they died in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אוֹתָם וַיָּמֻתוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃
