days of her impure emission she shall be like the days of
her impurity. She is impure.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי יָזוּב זוֹב דָּמָהּ יָמִים רַבִּים בְּלֹא עֶת נִדָּתָהּ אוֹ כִי תָזוּב עַל נִדָּתָהּ כּל יְמֵי זוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ כִּימֵי נִדָּתָהּ תִּהְיֶה טְמֵאָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי יָזוּב זוֹב דָּמָהּ יָמִים רַבִּים בְּלֹא עֶת נִדָּתָהּ אוֹ כִי תָזוּב עַל נִדָּתָהּ כּל יְמֵי זוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ כִּימֵי נִדָּתָהּ תִּהְיֶה טְמֵאָה הִוא׃

english.text:
“And when a woman will have an emission of her blood many
days when it is not the time of her impurity, or when she
will have an emission beyond her impurity, for all the
days of her impure emission she shall be like the days of
her impurity. She is impure.

translation.text: If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time uncleanness; as in the days of her impurity, she shall be unclean.

verses.english:
Any bed on which she will lie all the days of her emission
will be like a bed of her impurity for her, and any item
on which she will sit will be impure like the impurity of
her menstruation.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו כּל יְמֵי זוֹבָהּ כְּמִשְׁכַּב נִדָּתָהּ יִהְיֶה לָּהּ וְכל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה כְּטֻמְאַת נִדָּתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו כּל יְמֵי זוֹבָהּ כְּמִשְׁכַּב נִדָּתָהּ יִהְיֶה לָּהּ וְכל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה כְּטֻמְאַת נִדָּתָהּ׃

english.text:
Any bed on which she will lie all the days of her emission
will be like a bed of her impurity for her, and any item
on which she will sit will be impure like the impurity of
her menstruation.

translation.text: Every bed on which she lies during all the days of her discharge shall be shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her impurity.

verses.english:
And anyone who touches them will be impure. And he shall
wash his clothes and shall wash with water and will be
impure until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּם יִטְמָא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּם יִטְמָא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And anyone who touches them will be impure. And he shall
wash his clothes and shall wash with water and will be
impure until evening.

translation.text: Whoever bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.english:
“And if she has become purified from her emission, then
she shall count seven days, and after that she will be
pure.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם טָהֲרָה מִזּוֹבָהּ וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְאַחַר תִּטְהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם טָהֲרָה מִזּוֹבָהּ וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְאַחַר תִּטְהָר׃

english.text:
“And if she has become purified from her emission, then
she shall count seven days, and after that she will be
pure.

translation.text: If she is cleansed of her discharge, she shall count seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.english:
And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or
two pigeons, and she shall bring them to the priest at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּקַּח לָהּ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיאָה אוֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּקַּח לָהּ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיאָה אוֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or
two pigeons, and she shall bring them to the priest at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two meeting.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make one a sin offering and one a
burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement over
her in front of YHWH from her impure emission.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מִזּוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מִזּוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make one a sin offering and one a
burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement over
her in front of YHWH from her impure emission.

translation.text: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering and the other behalf before the LORD for her unclean discharge.

verses.english:
“And you shall alert the children of Israel regarding
their impurity so they will not die through their impurity
when they defile my Tabernacle that is among them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזַּרְתֶּם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִטֻּמְאָתָם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּטֻמְאָתָם בְּטַמְּאָם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִי אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזַּרְתֶּם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִטֻּמְאָתָם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּטֻמְאָתָם בְּטַמְּאָם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִי אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
“And you shall alert the children of Israel regarding
their impurity so they will not die through their impurity
when they defile my Tabernacle that is among them.

translation.text: Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst.

verses.english:
This is the instruction for one who has an emission and
for one from whom seed of intercourse will come out, so as
to become impure by it,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַזָּב וַאֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַזָּב וַאֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
This is the instruction for one who has an emission and
for one from whom seed of intercourse will come out, so as
to become impure by it,

translation.text: This is the ritual for those who have a discharge: for him who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean thereby,

verses.english:
and one who is in her menstrual impurity and one who has
an emission—for a male and for a female—and for a man who
will lie with a woman who is impure.”
verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּוָה בְּנִדָּתָהּ וְהַזָּב אֶת זוֹבוֹ לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עִם טְמֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַדָּוָה בְּנִדָּתָהּ וְהַזָּב אֶת זוֹבוֹ לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עִם טְמֵאָה׃

english.text:
and one who is in her menstrual impurity and one who has
an emission—for a male and for a female—and for a man who
will lie with a woman who is impure.”

translation.text: for her who is in the discharge, and for the man who lies with a woman who is unclean.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two
sons—when they came forward in front of YHWH and died.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן בְּקרְבָתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן בְּקרְבָתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two
sons—when they came forward in front of YHWH and died.

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before the LORD and died.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron, your brother, and
let him not come at all times to the Holy, inside the
pavilion, in front of the atonement dais that is over the
ark, so he will not die, because I shall appear in a cloud
over the atonement dais.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאַל יָבֹא בְכל עֵת אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֶל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאָרֹן וְלֹא יָמוּת כִּי בֶּעָנָן אֵרָאֶה עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאַל יָבֹא בְכל עֵת אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֶל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאָרֹן וְלֹא יָמוּת כִּי בֶּעָנָן אֵרָאֶה עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron, your brother, and
let him not come at all times to the Holy, inside the
pavilion, in front of the atonement dais that is over the
ark, so he will not die, because I shall appear in a cloud
over the atonement dais.

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses: Tell your brother Aaron not to come just at any time into the sanctuary inside the curtain before the mercy seat that is upon the ark, or he will die; for I appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

verses.english:
Aaron shall come to the Holy with this: with a bull of the
cattle for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
Aaron shall come to the Holy with this: with a bull of the
cattle for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

translation.text: Thus shall Aaron ram for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
He shall wear a holy linen coat, and linen drawers shall
be on his flesh, and he shall be belted with a linen sash,
and he shall wear a linen headdress. They are holy
clothes: and he shall wash his flesh with water and put
them on.
verses.hebrew: כְּתֹנֶת בַּד קֹדֶשׁ יִלְבָּשׁ וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִהְיוּ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבְאַבְנֵט בַּד יַחְגֹּר וּבְמִצְנֶפֶת בַּד יִצְנֹף בִּגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ הֵם וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וּלְבֵשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: כְּתֹנֶת בַּד קֹדֶשׁ יִלְבָּשׁ וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִהְיוּ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבְאַבְנֵט בַּד יַחְגֹּר וּבְמִצְנֶפֶת בַּד יִצְנֹף בִּגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ הֵם וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וּלְבֵשָׁם׃

english.text:
He shall wear a holy linen coat, and linen drawers shall
be on his flesh, and he shall be belted with a linen sash,
and he shall wear a linen headdress. They are holy
clothes: and he shall wash his flesh with water and put
them on.

translation.text: He shall put on the holy linen tunic, and sash, and wear the linen turban; these are the holy vestments. He shall bathe his body in water, and then put them on.

verses.english:
And he shall take from the congregation of the children of
Israel two goats for a sin offering and one ram for a
burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵאֵת עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקַּח שְׁנֵי שְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵאֵת עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקַּח שְׁנֵי שְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And he shall take from the congregation of the children of
Israel two goats for a sin offering and one ram for a
burnt offering.

translation.text: He shall take from offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for himself and for
his house.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for himself and for
his house.

translation.text: Aaron shall offer the bull as a sin offering for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house.

verses.english:
And he shall take the two goats and stand them in front of
YHWH, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם וְהֶעֱמִיד אֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֶת שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם וְהֶעֱמִיד אֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he shall take the two goats and stand them in front of
YHWH, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: He shall take the two goats and set them before the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting;

verses.english:
And Aaron shall cast lots on the two goats, one lot for
YHWH and one lot for Azazel.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַהֲרֹן עַל שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם גֹּרָלוֹת גּוֹרָל אֶחָד לַיהֹוָה וְגוֹרָל אֶחָד לַעֲזָאזֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן אַהֲרֹן עַל שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם גֹּרָלוֹת גּוֹרָל אֶחָד לַיהֹוָה וְגוֹרָל אֶחָד לַעֲזָאזֵל׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall cast lots on the two goats, one lot for
YHWH and one lot for Azazel.

translation.text: and Aaron shall cast lots on the two goats, one lot for the LORD and the other lot for Azazel.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot
for YHWH arose, and he shall make it a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַיהֹוָה וְעָשָׂהוּ חַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַיהֹוָה וְעָשָׂהוּ חַטָּאת׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot
for YHWH arose, and he shall make it a sin offering.

translation.text: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer it as a sin offering;

verses.english:
And the goat on which the lot for Azazel arose shall be
stood alive in front of YHWH to make atonement over it, to
let it go to Azazel, into the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יעֳמַד חַי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְשַׁלַּח אֹתוֹ לַעֲזָאזֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יעֳמַד חַי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְשַׁלַּח אֹתוֹ לַעֲזָאזֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

english.text:
And the goat on which the lot for Azazel arose shall be
stood alive in front of YHWH to make atonement over it, to
let it go to Azazel, into the wilderness.

translation.text: but the goat on which the lot fell for Azazel shall be presented alive before the LORD to make Azazel.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for him and for his
house, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering
that he has.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for him and for his
house, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering
that he has.

translation.text: Aaron shall present the bull as a sin offering for himself, and shall bull as a sin offering for himself.

verses.english:
And he shall take a fire-holder-full of coals of fire from
on the altar, from in front of YHWH, and handfuls of fine
incense of fragrances, and he shall bring it inside the
pavilion
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח מְלֹא הַמַּחְתָּה גַּחֲלֵי אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמְלֹא חפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה וְהֵבִיא מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח מְלֹא הַמַּחְתָּה גַּחֲלֵי אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמְלֹא חפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה וְהֵבִיא מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And he shall take a fire-holder-full of coals of fire from
on the altar, from in front of YHWH, and handfuls of fine
incense of fragrances, and he shall bring it inside the
pavilion

translation.text: He shall take a censer full of coals sweet incense, and he shall bring it inside the curtain

verses.english:
and put the incense on the fire in front of YHWH so that
the cloud of the incense will cover the atonement dais
that is over the Testimony, and he will not die.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת עַל הָאֵשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִסָּה עֲנַן הַקְּטֹרֶת אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדוּת וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת עַל הָאֵשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִסָּה עֲנַן הַקְּטֹרֶת אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדוּת וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

english.text:
and put the incense on the fire in front of YHWH so that
the cloud of the incense will cover the atonement dais
that is over the Testimony, and he will not die.

translation.text: and put the cover the mercy seat that is upon the covenant, or he will die.

verses.english:
And he shall take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle
with his finger on the front of the atonement dais
eastward, and he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his
finger in front of the atonement dais seven times.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה בְאֶצְבָּעוֹ עַל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת קֵדְמָה וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת יַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה בְאֶצְבָּעוֹ עַל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת קֵדְמָה וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת יַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle
with his finger on the front of the atonement dais
eastward, and he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his
finger in front of the atonement dais seven times.

translation.text: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger sprinkle the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that
is the people’s and shall bring its blood inside the
pavilion and shall do its blood as he did to the bull’s
blood: and he shall sprinkle it on the atonement dais and
in front of the atonement dais.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וְהֵבִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ אֶל מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וְעָשָׂה אֶת דָּמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדַם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה אֹתוֹ עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וְהֵבִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ אֶל מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וְעָשָׂה אֶת דָּמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדַם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה אֹתוֹ עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that
is the people’s and shall bring its blood inside the
pavilion and shall do its blood as he did to the bull’s
blood: and he shall sprinkle it on the atonement dais and
in front of the atonement dais.

translation.text: He shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that is for the people and bring its blood inside the curtain, and do with its blood as he did before the mercy seat.

verses.english:
And he shall make atonement over the Holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel and from their
offenses, for all their sins, and he shall do so for the
Tent of Meeting that tents with them among their
impurities.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם׃

english.text:
And he shall make atonement over the Holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel and from their
offenses, for all their sins, and he shall do so for the
Tent of Meeting that tents with them among their
impurities.

translation.text: Thus he shall make atonement for the because of their transgressions, all their sins; and so he shall do for the uncleannesses.

verses.english:
And no human shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he comes
to make atonement in the Holy until he comes out. And he
shall make atonement for him and for his house and for all
the community of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְכל אָדָם לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּבֹאוֹ לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַד צֵאתוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל אָדָם לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּבֹאוֹ לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַד צֵאתוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And no human shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he comes
to make atonement in the Holy until he comes out. And he
shall make atonement for him and for his house and for all
the community of Israel.

translation.text: No one shall be in the tent of meeting from the time assembly of Israel.

verses.english:
“And he shall go out to the altar that is in front of YHWH
and make atonement over it, and he shall take some of the
bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וּמִדַּם הַשָּׂעִיר וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וּמִדַּם הַשָּׂעִיר וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
“And he shall go out to the altar that is in front of YHWH
and make atonement over it, and he shall take some of the
bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around.

translation.text: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the horns of the altar.

verses.english:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his
finger seven times and purify it and make it holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה עָלָיו מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְקִדְּשׁוֹ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה עָלָיו מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְקִדְּשׁוֹ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his
finger seven times and purify it and make it holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel.

translation.text: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with uncleannesses of the people of Israel.

verses.english:
“And when he will finish making atonement for the Holy and
the Tent of Meeting and the altar, then he shall bring
forward the live goat.
verses.hebrew: וְכִלָּה מִכַּפֵּר אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהִקְרִיב אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר הֶחָי׃

hebrew.text: וְכִלָּה מִכַּפֵּר אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהִקְרִיב אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר הֶחָי׃

english.text:
“And when he will finish making atonement for the Holy and
the Tent of Meeting and the altar, then he shall bring
forward the live goat.

translation.text: When he has finished atoning for the holy place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall lay his two hands on the live goat’s head
and confess over it all the crimes of the children of
Israel and all their offenses, for all their sins, and he
shall put them on the goat’s head and let it go by the
hand of an appointed man to the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁתֵּי יָדָו עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר הַחַי וְהִתְוַדָּה עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת כּל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְנָתַן אֹתָם עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשִׁלַּח בְּיַד אִישׁ עִתִּי הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁתֵּי יָדָו עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר הַחַי וְהִתְוַדָּה עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת כּל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְנָתַן אֹתָם עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשִׁלַּח בְּיַד אִישׁ עִתִּי הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall lay his two hands on the live goat’s head
and confess over it all the crimes of the children of
Israel and all their offenses, for all their sins, and he
shall put them on the goat’s head and let it go by the
hand of an appointed man to the wilderness.

translation.text: Then Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over it all the iniquities of the people of Israel, and all their transgressions, task.

verses.english:
And the goat will carry all their crimes on it to an
inaccessible land. And he shall let the goat go in the
wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹתָם אֶל אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹתָם אֶל אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And the goat will carry all their crimes on it to an
inaccessible land. And he shall let the goat go in the
wilderness.

translation.text: The goat shall bear on itself all their iniquities to a barren region; and the goat shall be set free in the wilderness.

verses.english:
“And Aaron shall come to the Tent of Meeting and take off
the linen clothes that he wore when he came to the Holy,
and he shall leave them there.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּפָשַׁט אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד אֲשֶׁר לָבַשׁ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּפָשַׁט אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד אֲשֶׁר לָבַשׁ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם׃

english.text:
“And Aaron shall come to the Tent of Meeting and take off
the linen clothes that he wore when he came to the Holy,
and he shall leave them there.

translation.text: Then Aaron shall enter the tent of meeting, and shall take off the shall leave them there.

verses.english:
And he shall wash his flesh with water in a holy place and
put on his clothes, and he shall go out and make his burnt
offering and the people’s burnt offering and make
atonement for him and for the people.
verses.hebrew: וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַמַּיִם בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְיָצָא וְעָשָׂה אֶת עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלַת הָעָם וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַמַּיִם בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְיָצָא וְעָשָׂה אֶת עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלַת הָעָם וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד הָעָם׃

english.text:
And he shall wash his flesh with water in a holy place and
put on his clothes, and he shall go out and make his burnt
offering and the people’s burnt offering and make
atonement for him and for the people.

translation.text: He shall bathe his body in water in a holy atonement for himself and for the people.

verses.english:
And he shall burn the fat of the sin offering into smoke
at the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת חֵלֶב הַחַטָּאת יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת חֵלֶב הַחַטָּאת יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he shall burn the fat of the sin offering into smoke
at the altar.

translation.text: The fat of the sin offering he shall turn into smoke on the altar.

verses.english:
And the one who let the goat go to Azazel shall wash his
clothes and wash his flesh with water, and after that he
shall come to the camp.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר לַעֲזָאזֵל יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר לַעֲזָאזֵל יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the one who let the goat go to Azazel shall wash his
clothes and wash his flesh with water, and after that he
shall come to the camp.

translation.text: The one who sets the goat free for Azazel shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward may come into the camp.

verses.english:
And he shall take the bull of the sin offering and the
goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought to make
atonement in the Holy, outside the camp; and they shall
burn their skin and their meat and their dung in fire.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָם לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ יוֹצִיא אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת עֹרֹתָם וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָם וְאֶת פִּרְשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָם לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ יוֹצִיא אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת עֹרֹתָם וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָם וְאֶת פִּרְשָׁם׃

english.text:
And he shall take the bull of the sin offering and the
goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought to make
atonement in the Holy, outside the camp; and they shall
burn their skin and their meat and their dung in fire.

translation.text: The bull of the sin offering skin and their flesh and their dung shall be consumed in fire.

verses.english:
And the one who burns them shall wash his clothes and wash
his flesh with water, and after that he shall come to the
camp.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the one who burns them shall wash his clothes and wash
his flesh with water, and after that he shall come to the
camp.

translation.text: The water, and afterward may come into the camp.

verses.english:
“And it shall be an eternal law for you: in the seventh
month, on the tenth of the month, you shall degrade
yourselves, and you shall not do any work: the citizen and
the alien who resides among you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ תְּעַנּוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְכל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ תְּעַנּוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְכל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
“And it shall be an eternal law for you: in the seventh
month, on the tenth of the month, you shall degrade
yourselves, and you shall not do any work: the citizen and
the alien who resides among you.

translation.text: This shall be a statute to you forever: In the seventh month, on the work, neither the citizen nor the alien who resides among you.

verses.english:
Because on this day he shall make atonement over you, to
purify you. You will be pure from all your sins in front
of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תִּטְהָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תִּטְהָרוּ׃

english.text:
Because on this day he shall make atonement over you, to
purify you. You will be pure from all your sins in front
of YHWH.

translation.text: For your sins you shall be clean before the LORD.

verses.english:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, to you. And you shall degrade
yourselves—an eternal law.
verses.hebrew: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הִיא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הִיא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, to you. And you shall degrade
yourselves—an eternal law.

translation.text: It is a sabbath of forever.

verses.english:
And the priest whom one will anoint and who will fill his
hand to function as a priest in his father’s place shall
make atonement. And he shall wear the linen clothes, the
holy clothes.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר יְמַלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לְכַהֵן תַּחַת אָבִיו וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר יְמַלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לְכַהֵן תַּחַת אָבִיו וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the priest whom one will anoint and who will fill his
hand to function as a priest in his father’s place shall
make atonement. And he shall wear the linen clothes, the
holy clothes.

translation.text: The priest who is anointed and consecrated as priest in his holy vestments.

verses.english:
And he shall make atonement for the holy place of the
Holy, and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting
and for the altar, and he shall make atonement over the
priests and over all the people of the community.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יְכַפֵּר וְעַל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְעַל כּל עַם הַקָּהָל יְכַפֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יְכַפֵּר וְעַל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְעַל כּל עַם הַקָּהָל יְכַפֵּר׃

english.text:
And he shall make atonement for the holy place of the
Holy, and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting
and for the altar, and he shall make atonement over the
priests and over all the people of the community.

translation.text: He shall make atonement for the sanctuary, and he assembly.

verses.english:
And this shall become an eternal law for you, to make
atonement over the children of Israel from all their sins,
once in the year.” And he did as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה זֹּאת לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה זֹּאת לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And this shall become an eternal law for you, to make
atonement over the children of Israel from all their sins,
once in the year.” And he did as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the people of Israel once in the year for all their sins. And Moses did as the LORD had commanded him.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel and say to them: This is the thing that YHWH has
commanded, saying:
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel and say to them: This is the thing that YHWH has
commanded, saying:

translation.text: Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the people of Israel and say to them: This is what the LORD has commanded.

verses.english:
Any man from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a
sheep or a goat in the camp or who slaughters outside the
camp
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז בַּמַּחֲנֶה אוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז בַּמַּחֲנֶה אוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
Any man from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a
sheep or a goat in the camp or who slaughters outside the
camp

translation.text: If anyone of the house of Israel slaughters an ox or a lamb or a goat in the camp, or slaughters it outside the camp,

verses.english:
and has not brought it to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting to bring forward an offering to YHWH in front of
YHWH’s Tabernacle: blood will be counted to that man. He
has spilled blood. And that man will be cut off from among
his people.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא הֱבִיאוֹ לְהַקְרִיב קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה דָּם יֵחָשֵׁב לָאִישׁ הַהוּא דָּם שָׁפָךְ וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא הֱבִיאוֹ לְהַקְרִיב קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה דָּם יֵחָשֵׁב לָאִישׁ הַהוּא דָּם שָׁפָךְ וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
and has not brought it to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting to bring forward an offering to YHWH in front of
YHWH’s Tabernacle: blood will be counted to that man. He
has spilled blood. And that man will be cut off from among
his people.

translation.text: and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent shed blood, and he shall be cut off from the people.

verses.english:
So that the children of Israel will bring their
sacrifices—which they are making at the open field—and
will bring them to YHWH, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, to the priest, and make them sacrifices of peace
offerings to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹבְחִים עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וֶהֱבִיאֻם לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְזָבְחוּ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹבְחִים עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וֶהֱבִיאֻם לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְזָבְחוּ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
So that the children of Israel will bring their
sacrifices—which they are making at the open field—and
will bring them to YHWH, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, to the priest, and make them sacrifices of peace
offerings to YHWH.

translation.text: This is in order that the people of Israel may bring their sacrifices that they offer in the entrance of the tent of meeting, and offer them as sacrifices of wellbeing to the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest shall fling the blood on YHWH’s altar at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat to
smoke as a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְזָרַק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַדָּם עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְטִיר הַחֵלֶב לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָרַק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַדָּם עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְטִיר הַחֵלֶב לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall fling the blood on YHWH’s altar at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat to
smoke as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: The priest shall dash the blood against the altar of smoke as a pleasing odor to the LORD,

verses.english:
And they shall not make their sacrifices anymore to the
satyrs, after whom they are whoring. This shall be an
eternal law to them through their generations.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִזְבְּחוּ עוֹד אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם לַשְּׂעִירִם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה זֹּאת לָהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִזְבְּחוּ עוֹד אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם לַשְּׂעִירִם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה זֹּאת לָהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
And they shall not make their sacrifices anymore to the
satyrs, after whom they are whoring. This shall be an
eternal law to them through their generations.

“And any man from the house of Israel and from the aliens

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יֹאכַל כּל דָּם וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת אֶת הַדָּם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתָהּ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יֹאכַל כּל דָּם וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת אֶת הַדָּם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתָהּ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And any man from the house of Israel and from the aliens
who will reside among them who will eat any blood: then I
shall set my face against the person who eats the blood,
and I shall cut him off from among his people.

translation.text: If anyone of the house of Israel or of the aliens who reside among blood, and will cut that person off from the people.

verses.english:
Because the flesh’s life is in the blood, and I have given
it to you on the altar to make atonement over your lives,
because it is the blood that makes atonement for life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר בַּדָּם הִוא וַאֲנִי נְתַתִּיו לָכֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי הַדָּם הוּא בַּנֶּפֶשׁ יְכַפֵּר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר בַּדָּם הִוא וַאֲנִי נְתַתִּיו לָכֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי הַדָּם הוּא בַּנֶּפֶשׁ יְכַפֵּר׃

english.text:
Because the flesh’s life is in the blood, and I have given
it to you on the altar to make atonement over your lives,
because it is the blood that makes atonement for life.

translation.text: For the life of atonement for your lives on the altar; for, as life, it is the blood that makes atonement.

verses.english:
On account of this I have said to the children of Israel:
every person among you shall not eat blood, and the alien
who resides among you shall not eat blood.
verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל נֶפֶשׁ מִכֶּם לֹא תֹאכַל דָּם וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לֹא יֹאכַל דָּם׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל נֶפֶשׁ מִכֶּם לֹא תֹאכַל דָּם וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לֹא יֹאכַל דָּם׃

english.text:
On account of this I have said to the children of Israel:
every person among you shall not eat blood, and the alien
who resides among you shall not eat blood.

translation.text: Therefore I have said to the people of Israel: No among you eat blood.

verses.english:
“And any man from the children of Israel and from the
aliens who reside among them who will hunt game, animal or
bird, that may be eaten: he shall spill out its blood and
cover it with dust.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יָצוּד צֵיד חַיָּה אוֹ עוֹף אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְשָׁפַךְ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְכִסָּהוּ בֶּעָפָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יָצוּד צֵיד חַיָּה אוֹ עוֹף אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְשָׁפַךְ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְכִסָּהוּ בֶּעָפָר׃

english.text:
“And any man from the children of Israel and from the
aliens who reside among them who will hunt game, animal or
bird, that may be eaten: he shall spill out its blood and
cover it with dust.

translation.text: And anyone of the people of Israel, or of the may be eaten shall pour out its blood and cover it with earth.

verses.english:
Because all flesh’s life: its blood is one with its life.
So I say to the children of Israel: you shall not eat the
blood of all flesh—because all flesh’s life: it is its
blood. Everyone of those who eat it will be cut off.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וָאֹמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּם כּל בָּשָׂר לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ הִוא כּל אֹכְלָיו יִכָּרֵת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וָאֹמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּם כּל בָּשָׂר לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ הִוא כּל אֹכְלָיו יִכָּרֵת׃

english.text:
Because all flesh’s life: its blood is one with its life.
So I say to the children of Israel: you shall not eat the
blood of all flesh—because all flesh’s life: it is its
blood. Everyone of those who eat it will be cut off.

translation.text: For the life of every creature — its blood is its life; therefore I have creature, for the life of every creature is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.

verses.english:
And any living being, whether a citizen or an alien, who
will eat carcass or a torn animal shall wash his clothes
and shall wash with water and will be impure until evening
and then will be pure.

hebrew.text: וְכל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה בָּאֶזְרָח וּבַגֵּר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעֶרֶב וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And any living being, whether a citizen or an alien, who
will eat carcass or a torn animal shall wash his clothes
and shall wash with water and will be impure until evening
and then will be pure.

translation.text: All persons, citizens or aliens, who eat what dies of itself shall be clean.

verses.english:
And if he will not wash them and will not wash his flesh,
then he shall bear his crime.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יְכַבֵּס וּבְשָׂרוֹ לֹא יִרְחָץ וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יְכַבֵּס וּבְשָׂרוֹ לֹא יִרְחָץ וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
And if he will not wash them and will not wash his flesh,
then he shall bear his crime.”

translation.text: But if they do not wash themselves or bathe their body, they shall bear their guilt.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
You shall shall not do like what is done in the land of
Egypt, in which you lived; and you shall not do like what
is done in the land of Canaan, to which I’m bringing you;
and you shall not go by their laws.
verses.hebrew: כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶם לֹא תֵלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶם לֹא תֵלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
You shall shall not do like what is done in the land of
Egypt, in which you lived; and you shall not do like what
is done in the land of Canaan, to which I’m bringing you;
and you shall not go by their laws.

translation.text: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived, and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

verses.english:
You shall do my judgments, and you shall observe my laws,
to go by them. I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשׂוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשׂוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall do my judgments, and you shall observe my laws,
to go by them. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: My ordinances the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall observe my laws and my judgments, which,
when a human will do them, he’ll live through them! I am
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall observe my laws and my judgments, which,
when a human will do them, he’ll live through them! I am
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall keep my statutes and my ordinances; by doing so one shall live: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“Any man, to any close relative of his: you shall not come
close to expose nudity. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ אֶל כּל שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא תִקְרְבוּ לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָה אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִישׁ אֶל כּל שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא תִקְרְבוּ לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָה אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Any man, to any close relative of his: you shall not come
close to expose nudity. I am YHWH.

translation.text: None of you shall approach anyone near of kin to uncover nakedness: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s nudity and your
mother’s nudity. She is your mother. You shall not expose
her nudity.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ וְעֶרְוַת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אִמְּךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ וְעֶרְוַת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אִמְּךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s nudity and your
mother’s nudity. She is your mother. You shall not expose
her nudity.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, which is the nakedness of your mother; she is your mother, you shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s wife’s nudity. It is
your father’s nudity.

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s wife’s nudity. It is
your father’s nudity.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife; it is the nakedness of your father.

Your sister’s nudity—your father’s daughter or your
mother’s daughter, born home or born outside—you shall not
expose their nudity.

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹתְךָ בַת אָבִיךָ אוֹ בַת אִמֶּךָ מוֹלֶדֶת בַּיִת אוֹ מוֹלֶדֶת חוּץ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן׃

english.text:
Your sister’s nudity—your father’s daughter or your
mother’s daughter, born home or born outside—you shall not
expose their nudity.

translation.text: abroad.

verses.english:
The nudity of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s
daughter—you shall not expose their nudity, because they
are your nudity.

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת בַּת בִּנְךָ אוֹ בַת בִּתְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן כִּי עֶרְוָתְךָ הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
The nudity of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s
daughter—you shall not expose their nudity, because they
are your nudity.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son's daughter nakedness.

verses.english:
The nudity of your father’s wife’s daughter, born of your
father: she is your sister; you shall not expose her
nudity.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת בַּת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ מוֹלֶדֶת אָבִיךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת בַּת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ מוֹלֶדֶת אָבִיךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
The nudity of your father’s wife’s daughter, born of your
father: she is your sister; you shall not expose her
nudity.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife's daughter, begotten by your father, since she is your sister.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s sister’s nudity. She is
your father’s close relative.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה שְׁאֵר אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה שְׁאֵר אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s sister’s nudity. She is
your father’s close relative.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister; she is your father's flesh.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your mother’s sister’s nudity. She is
your mother’s close relative.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי שְׁאֵר אִמְּךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי שְׁאֵר אִמְּךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your mother’s sister’s nudity. She is
your mother’s close relative.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is your mother's flesh.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s brother’s nudity: you
shall not come close to his wife. She is your aunt.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחִי אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֹא תִקְרָב דֹּדָתְךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחִי אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֹא תִקְרָב דֹּדָתְךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s brother’s nudity: you
shall not come close to his wife. She is your aunt.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother, that is, you shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your daughter-in-law’s nudity. She is
your son’s wife. You shall not expose her nudity.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת כַּלָּתְךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֵשֶׁת בִּנְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת כַּלָּתְךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֵשֶׁת בִּנְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your daughter-in-law’s nudity. She is
your son’s wife. You shall not expose her nudity.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your brother’s wife’s nudity. It is
your brother’s nudity.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָחִיךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָחִיךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your brother’s wife’s nudity. It is
your brother’s nudity.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife; it is your brother's nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose the nudity of a woman and her
daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter or her
daughter’s daughter to expose her nudity. They are close
relatives. It is perversion.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אִשָּׁה וּבִתָּהּ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶת בַּת בְּנָהּ וְאֶת בַּת בִּתָּהּ לֹא תִקַּח לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ שַׁאֲרָה הֵנָּה זִמָּה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אִשָּׁה וּבִתָּהּ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶת בַּת בְּנָהּ וְאֶת בַּת בִּתָּהּ לֹא תִקַּח לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ שַׁאֲרָה הֵנָּה זִמָּה הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose the nudity of a woman and her
daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter or her
daughter’s daughter to expose her nudity. They are close
relatives. It is perversion.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the son's daughter or her daughter's daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are your flesh; it is depravity.

verses.english:
And you shall not take a woman to her sister to rival, to
expose her nudity along with her in her lifetime.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרֹר לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ עָלֶיהָ בְּחַיֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרֹר לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ עָלֶיהָ בְּחַיֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And you shall not take a woman to her sister to rival, to
expose her nudity along with her in her lifetime.

translation.text: And you shall not take a woman as a rival to her sister, uncovering her nakedness while her sister is still alive.

verses.english:
And you shall not come close to a woman during her
menstrual impurity to expose her nudity.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל אִשָּׁה בְּנִדַּת טֻמְאָתָהּ לֹא תִקְרַב לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל אִשָּׁה בְּנִדַּת טֻמְאָתָהּ לֹא תִקְרַב לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not come close to a woman during her
menstrual impurity to expose her nudity.

translation.text: You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness.

verses.english:
And you shall not give your intercourse of seed to your
fellow’s wife, to become impure by it.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל אֵשֶׁת עֲמִיתְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְזָרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל אֵשֶׁת עֲמִיתְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְזָרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not give your intercourse of seed to your
fellow’s wife, to become impure by it.

translation.text: You shall not have sexual relations with your kinsman's wife, and defile yourself with her.

verses.english:
And you shall not give any of your seed for passing to the
Molech, and you shall not desecrate your God’s name. I am
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּמִזַּרְעֲךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לְהַעֲבִיר לַמֹּלֶךְ וְלֹא תְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִזַּרְעֲךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לְהַעֲבִיר לַמֹּלֶךְ וְלֹא תְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall not give any of your seed for passing to the
Molech, and you shall not desecrate your God’s name. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall not give any of your offspring to sacrifice them to Molech, and so profane the name of your God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall not lie with a male like lying with a woman.
It is an offensive thing.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת זָכָר לֹא תִשְׁכַּב מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת זָכָר לֹא תִשְׁכַּב מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה הִוא׃

english.text:
And you shall not lie with a male like lying with a woman.
It is an offensive thing.

translation.text: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination.

verses.english:
And you shall not give your intercourse with any animal,
to become impure by it. And a woman shall not stand in
front of an animal to mate with it. It is an aberration.
verses.hebrew: וּבְכל בְּהֵמָה לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְטמְאָה בָהּ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא תַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי בְהֵמָה לְרִבְעָהּ תֶּבֶל הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבְכל בְּהֵמָה לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְטמְאָה בָהּ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא תַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי בְהֵמָה לְרִבְעָהּ תֶּבֶל הוּא׃

english.text:
And you shall not give your intercourse with any animal,
to become impure by it. And a woman shall not stand in
front of an animal to mate with it. It is an aberration.

translation.text: You shall not have sexual relations with any animal and defile yourself with it, nor shall any woman give herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it: it is perversion.

verses.english:
“You shall not become impure by all of these, because the
nations that I am putting out from in front of you became
impure by all of these,
verses.hebrew: אַל תִּטַּמְּאוּ בְּכל אֵלֶּה כִּי בְכל אֵלֶּה נִטְמְאוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּטַּמְּאוּ בְּכל אֵלֶּה כִּי בְכל אֵלֶּה נִטְמְאוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall not become impure by all of these, because the
nations that I am putting out from in front of you became
impure by all of these,

translation.text: Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, for by all these themselves.

verses.english:
and the land became impure, and I reckoned its sin on it,
and the land vomited out its residents.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ וָאֶפְקֹד עֲוֺנָהּ עָלֶיהָ וַתָּקִא הָאָרֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ וָאֶפְקֹד עֲוֺנָהּ עָלֶיהָ וַתָּקִא הָאָרֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶיהָ׃

english.text:
and the land became impure, and I reckoned its sin on it,
and the land vomited out its residents.

translation.text: Thus the land became defiled; and I punished it for its iniquity, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

verses.english:
But you: you shall observe my laws and my judgments and
not do any of all these offensive things, the citizen and
the alien who resides among you—
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
But you: you shall observe my laws and my judgments and
not do any of all these offensive things, the citizen and
the alien who resides among you—

translation.text: But you shall keep abominations, either the citizen or the alien who resides among you

verses.english:
because the people of the land who were before you did all
of these offensive things, and the land became impure—
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת כּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵל עָשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת כּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵל עָשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
because the people of the land who were before you did all
of these offensive things, and the land became impure—

translation.text: of these abominations, and the land became defiled);

verses.english:
so the land will not vomit you out for your making it
impure as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶתְכֶם בְּטַמַּאֲכֶם אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קָאָה אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶתְכֶם בְּטַמַּאֲכֶם אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קָאָה אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
so the land will not vomit you out for your making it
impure as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

translation.text: otherwise the land will vomit you out for defiling it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

verses.english:
Because anyone who will do any of these offensive things:
the persons who do will be cut off from among their
people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְנִכְרְתוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָעֹשֹׂת מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְנִכְרְתוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָעֹשֹׂת מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

english.text:
Because anyone who will do any of these offensive things:
the persons who do will be cut off from among their
people.

translation.text: For whoever commits any of these abominations shall be cut off from their people.

verses.english:
And you shall keep my charge: not to do any of the
abominable customs that were done before you; and you will
not become impure by them. I am YHWH, your God.”
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת מֵחֻקּוֹת הַתּוֹעֵבֹת אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשׂוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת מֵחֻקּוֹת הַתּוֹעֵבֹת אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשׂוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall keep my charge: not to do any of the
abominable customs that were done before you; and you will
not become impure by them. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: So keep my charge not to commit defile yourselves by them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel,
and you shall say to them: You shall be holy, because I,
YHWH, your God, am holy.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם קְדֹשִׁים תִּהְיוּ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם קְדֹשִׁים תִּהְיוּ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel,
and you shall say to them: You shall be holy, because I,
YHWH, your God, am holy.

translation.text: Speak to all the congregation of the people of Israel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God am holy.

verses.english:
“You shall each fear his mother and his father, and you
shall observe my Sabbaths. I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall each fear his mother and his father, and you
shall observe my Sabbaths. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: You shall each the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“Do not turn to idols, and you shall not make molten gods
for yourselves. I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֱלִילִם וֵאלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֱלִילִם וֵאלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Do not turn to idols, and you shall not make molten gods
for yourselves. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Do not turn to idols or make cast images for yourselves: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“And when you will make a peace-offering sacrifice to
YHWH, you shall sacrifice it so that it will be accepted
for you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחֻהוּ׃

english.text:
“And when you will make a peace-offering sacrifice to
YHWH, you shall sacrifice it so that it will be accepted
for you.

translation.text: When you offer a sacrifice of well-being to the LORD, offer it in such a way that it is acceptable in your behalf.

verses.english:
It shall be eaten on the day of your sacrifice and on the
next day; and what is left until the third day shall be
burned in fire.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם זִבְחֲכֶם יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹם זִבְחֲכֶם יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
It shall be eaten on the day of your sacrifice and on the
next day; and what is left until the third day shall be
burned in fire.

translation.text: It shall be eaten on the same third day shall be consumed in fire.

verses.english:
And if it will be eaten on the third day it is a repugnant
thing. It shall not be acceptable.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פִּגּוּל הוּא לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פִּגּוּל הוּא לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

english.text:
And if it will be eaten on the third day it is a repugnant
thing. It shall not be acceptable.

translation.text: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it will not be acceptable.

verses.english:
And anyone who eats it shall bear his crime, because he
desecrated YHWH’s holy thing, and that person will be cut
off from his people.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹכְלָיו עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא כִּי אֶת קֹדֶשׁ יְהֹוָה חִלֵּל וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֹכְלָיו עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא כִּי אֶת קֹדֶשׁ יְהֹוָה חִלֵּל וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And anyone who eats it shall bear his crime, because he
desecrated YHWH’s holy thing, and that person will be cut
off from his people.

translation.text: All who eat it holy to the LORD; and any such person shall be cut off from the people.

verses.english:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish harvesting your field’s corner, and you shall not
gather your harvest’s gleaning.
verses.hebrew: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט׃

hebrew.text: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט׃

english.text:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish harvesting your field’s corner, and you shall not
gather your harvest’s gleaning.

translation.text: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field, or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

verses.english:
And you shall not strip your vineyard, and you shall not
collect the vineyard’s fallen fruit. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not strip your vineyard, and you shall not
collect the vineyard’s fallen fruit. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the alien: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall not steal, and you shall not lie, and you shall
not act false, each against his fellow.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּגְנֹבוּ וְלֹא תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּרוּ אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּגְנֹבוּ וְלֹא תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּרוּ אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
“You shall not steal, and you shall not lie, and you shall
not act false, each against his fellow.

translation.text: You shall not steal; you shall not deal falsely; and you shall not lie to one another.

verses.english:
And you shall not swear by my name falsely, so that you
would desecrate your God’s name. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall not swear by my name falsely, so that you
would desecrate your God’s name. I am YHWH.

translation.text: And you shall not swear falsely by my name, profaning the name of your God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“You shall not exploit your neighbor, and you shall not
rob. An employee’s wages shall not stay through the night
with you until morning.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק אֶת רֵעֲךָ וְלֹא תִגְזֹל לֹא תָלִין פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר אִתְּךָ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק אֶת רֵעֲךָ וְלֹא תִגְזֹל לֹא תָלִין פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר אִתְּךָ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
“You shall not exploit your neighbor, and you shall not
rob. An employee’s wages shall not stay through the night
with you until morning.

translation.text: You shall not defraud your neighbor; you shall not steal; and you shall not keep for yourself the wages of a laborer until morning.

verses.english:
You shall not curse a deaf person, and you shall not place
a stumbling block in front of a blind person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not curse a deaf person, and you shall not place
a stumbling block in front of a blind person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.

translation.text: You shall not revile the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind; you shall fear your God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment. You shall not
be partial to a weak person, and you shall not favor a big
person. You shall judge your fellow with justice.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט לֹא תִשָּׂא פְנֵי דָל וְלֹא תֶהְדַּר פְּנֵי גָדוֹל בְּצֶדֶק תִּשְׁפֹּט עֲמִיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט לֹא תִשָּׂא פְנֵי דָל וְלֹא תֶהְדַּר פְּנֵי גָדוֹל בְּצֶדֶק תִּשְׁפֹּט עֲמִיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment. You shall not
be partial to a weak person, and you shall not favor a big
person. You shall judge your fellow with justice.

translation.text: You shall not render an unjust judgment; you shall not be partial to neighbor.

verses.english:
You shall not go with slander among your people. You shall
not stand by at your neighbor’s blood. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not go with slander among your people. You shall
not stand by at your neighbor’s blood. I am YHWH.

translation.text: You shall not go around as a slanderer among your the LORD.

verses.english:
“You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall
criticize your fellow, so you shall not bear sin over him.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׂנָא אֶת אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ הוֹכֵחַ תּוֹכִיחַ אֶת עֲמִיתֶךָ וְלֹא תִשָּׂא עָלָיו חֵטְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׂנָא אֶת אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ הוֹכֵחַ תּוֹכִיחַ אֶת עֲמִיתֶךָ וְלֹא תִשָּׂא עָלָיו חֵטְא׃

english.text:
“You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall
criticize your fellow, so you shall not bear sin over him.

translation.text: You shall not hate in your heart anyone of your kin; you shall reprove your neighbor, or you will incur guilt yourself.

verses.english:
You shall not take revenge, and you shall not keep on at
the children of your people. And you shall love your
neighbor as yourself. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִקֹּם וְלֹא תִטֹּר אֶת בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִקֹּם וְלֹא תִטֹּר אֶת בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not take revenge, and you shall not keep on at
the children of your people. And you shall love your
neighbor as yourself. I am YHWH.

translation.text: You shall not shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“You shall observe my laws. Your animal: you shall not
mate two kinds. Your field: you shall not seed two kinds.
And a garment of two kinds, sha‘atnez: it shall not go on
you.
verses.hebrew: אֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ לֹא תַרְבִּיעַ כִּלְאַיִם שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרַע כִּלְאָיִם וּבֶגֶד כִּלְאַיִם שַׁעַטְנֵז לֹא יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ לֹא תַרְבִּיעַ כִּלְאַיִם שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרַע כִּלְאָיִם וּבֶגֶד כִּלְאַיִם שַׁעַטְנֵז לֹא יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall observe my laws. Your animal: you shall not
mate two kinds. Your field: you shall not seed two kinds.
And a garment of two kinds, sha‘atnez: it shall not go on
you.

translation.text: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your animals breed seed; nor shall you put on a garment made of two different materials.

verses.english:
“And when a man will lie with a woman—an intercourse of
seed—and she is a maid designated to a man, and she has
not been redeemed, or freedom has not been given to her,
there will be a reparation. They shall not be put to
death, because she was not freed.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְהִוא שִׁפְחָה נֶחֱרֶפֶת לְאִישׁ וְהפְדֵּה לֹא נִפְדָּתָה אוֹ חֻפְשָׁה לֹא נִתַּן לָהּ בִּקֹּרֶת תִּהְיֶה לֹא יוּמְתוּ כִּי לֹא חֻפָּשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְהִוא שִׁפְחָה נֶחֱרֶפֶת לְאִישׁ וְהפְדֵּה לֹא נִפְדָּתָה אוֹ חֻפְשָׁה לֹא נִתַּן לָהּ בִּקֹּרֶת תִּהְיֶה לֹא יוּמְתוּ כִּי לֹא חֻפָּשָׁה׃

english.text:
“And when a man will lie with a woman—an intercourse of
seed—and she is a maid designated to a man, and she has
not been redeemed, or freedom has not been given to her,
there will be a reparation. They shall not be put to
death, because she was not freed.

translation.text: If a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave, an inquiry shall be held. They shall not be put to death, since she has not been freed;

verses.english:
And he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH, to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a ram for a guilt
offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֵיל אָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֵיל אָשָׁם׃

english.text:
And he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH, to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a ram for a guilt
offering.

translation.text: but he shall bring a guilt offering for himself to the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram as guilt offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall atone over him with the ram for the
guilt offering in front of YHWH over his sin that he
committed, and it will be forgiven for him from his sin
that he committed.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

english.text:
And the priest shall atone over him with the ram for the
guilt offering in front of YHWH over his sin that he
committed, and it will be forgiven for him from his sin
that he committed.

translation.text: committed shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
“And when you will come to the land, and you will plant
any tree for eating, you shall leave its top with its
fruit uncircumcised. It shall be uncircumcised for three
years for you. It shall not be eaten.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם כּל עֵץ מַאֲכָל וַעֲרַלְתֶּם ערְלָתוֹ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים יִהְיֶה לָכֶם עֲרֵלִים לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם כּל עֵץ מַאֲכָל וַעֲרַלְתֶּם ערְלָתוֹ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים יִהְיֶה לָכֶם עֲרֵלִים לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
“And when you will come to the land, and you will plant
any tree for eating, you shall leave its top with its
fruit uncircumcised. It shall be uncircumcised for three
years for you. It shall not be eaten.

translation.text: When you come into the land and plant all kinds of trees for food, then you shall regard their fruit as forbidden; three years it shall be forbidden to you, it must not be eaten.

verses.english:
And in the fourth year all of its fruit shall be holy,
tributes for YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִת יִהְיֶה כּל פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִת יִהְיֶה כּל פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And in the fourth year all of its fruit shall be holy,
tributes for YHWH.

translation.text: In the fourth year all their fruit shall be set apart for rejoicing in the LORD.

verses.english:
And in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, to increase
its produce for you. I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁת תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ לְהוֹסִיף לָכֶם תְּבוּאָתוֹ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁת תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ לְהוֹסִיף לָכֶם תְּבוּאָתוֹ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, to increase
its produce for you. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: But in the fifth year you may eat of their fruit, that their yield may be increased for you: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall not eat with the blood. You shall not practice
divination, and you shall not practice soothsaying.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַל הַדָּם לֹא תְנַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְעוֹנֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַל הַדָּם לֹא תְנַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְעוֹנֵנוּ׃

english.text:
“You shall not eat with the blood. You shall not practice
divination, and you shall not practice soothsaying.

translation.text: You shall not eat anything with its blood. You shall not practice augury or witchcraft.

verses.english:
You shall not trim your head’s edge, and you shall not
destroy your beard’s edge.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַקִּפוּ פְּאַת רֹאשְׁכֶם וְלֹא תַשְׁחִית אֵת פְּאַת זְקָנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַקִּפוּ פְּאַת רֹאשְׁכֶם וְלֹא תַשְׁחִית אֵת פְּאַת זְקָנֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not trim your head’s edge, and you shall not
destroy your beard’s edge.

translation.text: You shall not round off the hair on your temples or mar the edges of your beard.

verses.english:
You shall not put a cut in your flesh for a person, and
you shall not put an inscription of a tattoo in you. I am
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשֶׂרֶט לָנֶפֶשׁ לֹא תִתְּנוּ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם וּכְתֹבֶת קַעֲקַע לֹא תִתְּנוּ בָּכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשֶׂרֶט לָנֶפֶשׁ לֹא תִתְּנוּ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם וּכְתֹבֶת קַעֲקַע לֹא תִתְּנוּ בָּכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not put a cut in your flesh for a person, and
you shall not put an inscription of a tattoo in you. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall not make any the LORD.

verses.english:
“Do not desecrate your daughter to make her a prostitute,
so the land will not go to prostitution, and the land will
fill with perversion.
verses.hebrew: אַל תְּחַלֵּל אֶת בִּתְּךָ לְהַזְנוֹתָהּ וְלֹא תִזְנֶה הָאָרֶץ וּמָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ זִמָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַל תְּחַלֵּל אֶת בִּתְּךָ לְהַזְנוֹתָהּ וְלֹא תִזְנֶה הָאָרֶץ וּמָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ זִמָּה׃

english.text:
“Do not desecrate your daughter to make her a prostitute,
so the land will not go to prostitution, and the land will
fill with perversion.

translation.text: Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, that the land not become prostituted and full of depravity.

verses.english:
You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my holy place. I am
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my holy place. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall keep my sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“Do not turn to ghosts, and do not seek spirits of
acquaintances, to become impure by them. I am YHWH, your
God.
verses.hebrew: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים אַל תְּבַקְשׁוּ לְטמְאָה בָהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים אַל תְּבַקְשׁוּ לְטמְאָה בָהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Do not turn to ghosts, and do not seek spirits of
acquaintances, to become impure by them. I am YHWH, your
God.

translation.text: Do not turn to mediums or wizards; do not seek them out, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall get up in front of an aged person, and you
shall show respect in front of an elderly person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“You shall get up in front of an aged person, and you
shall show respect in front of an elderly person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.
