translation.text: You shall rise before the aged, and defer to the old; and you shall fear your God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“And if an alien will reside with you in your land, you
shall not persecute him.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר בְּאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תוֹנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר בְּאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תוֹנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And if an alien will reside with you in your land, you
shall not persecute him.

translation.text: When an alien resides with you in your land, you shall not oppress the alien.

verses.english:
The alien who resides with you shall be to you like a
citizen of yours, and you shall love him as yourself,
because you were aliens in the land of Egypt. I am YHWH,
your God.
verses.hebrew: כְּאֶזְרָח מִכֶּם יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם וְאָהַבְתָּ לוֹ כָּמוֹךָ כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כְּאֶזְרָח מִכֶּם יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם וְאָהַבְתָּ לוֹ כָּמוֹךָ כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
The alien who resides with you shall be to you like a
citizen of yours, and you shall love him as yourself,
because you were aliens in the land of Egypt. I am YHWH,
your God.

translation.text: The alien who resides with you shall be to you as the aliens in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment, in
measurement, in weight, and in quantity.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בַּמִּדָּה בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בַּמִּדָּה בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָה׃

english.text:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment, in
measurement, in weight, and in quantity.

translation.text: You shall not cheat in measuring length, weight, or quantity.

verses.english:
You shall have just scales, just weights, a just ephah,
and a just hin. I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out
from the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: מֹאזְנֵי צֶדֶק אַבְנֵי צֶדֶק אֵיפַת צֶדֶק וְהִין צֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: מֹאזְנֵי צֶדֶק אַבְנֵי צֶדֶק אֵיפַת צֶדֶק וְהִין צֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
You shall have just scales, just weights, a just ephah,
and a just hin. I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out
from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: You of Egypt.

verses.english:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them. I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them. I am YHWH.”

translation.text: You shall keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and observe them: I am the LORD.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“And to the children of Israel you shall say: Any man from
the children of Israel and from the alien who resides in
Israel who will give any of his seed to the Molech shall
be put to death. The people of the land shall batter him
with stone.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ מוֹת יוּמָת עַם הָאָרֶץ יִרְגְּמֻהוּ בָאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ מוֹת יוּמָת עַם הָאָרֶץ יִרְגְּמֻהוּ בָאָבֶן׃

english.text:
“And to the children of Israel you shall say: Any man from
the children of Israel and from the alien who resides in
Israel who will give any of his seed to the Molech shall
be put to death. The people of the land shall batter him
with stone.

translation.text: Say further to the people of Israel: Any of the people of Israel, or of the aliens who reside in Israel, who give any of their offspring to Molech shall be put to death; the people of the land shall stone them to death.

verses.english:
And I shall set my face against that man, and I shall cut
him off from among his people because he gave any of his
seed for the Molech so as to make my holy place impure and
to desecrate my holy name.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ כִּי מִזַּרְעוֹ נָתַן לַמֹּלֶךְ לְמַעַן טַמֵּא אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי וּלְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ כִּי מִזַּרְעוֹ נָתַן לַמֹּלֶךְ לְמַעַן טַמֵּא אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי וּלְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי׃

english.text:
And I shall set my face against that man, and I shall cut
him off from among his people because he gave any of his
seed for the Molech so as to make my holy place impure and
to desecrate my holy name.

translation.text: I myself will set my face against holy name.

verses.english:
And if the people of the land will hide their eyes from
that man when he gives any of his seed for the Molech, not
to put him to death,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הַעְלֵם יַעְלִימוּ עַם הָאָרֶץ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם מִן הָאִישׁ הַהוּא בְּתִתּוֹ מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי הָמִית אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הַעְלֵם יַעְלִימוּ עַם הָאָרֶץ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם מִן הָאִישׁ הַהוּא בְּתִתּוֹ מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי הָמִית אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And if the people of the land will hide their eyes from
that man when he gives any of his seed for the Molech, not
to put him to death,

translation.text: And if the people of the land should ever close their eyes them to death,

verses.english:
then I shall set my face at that man and at his family,
and I shall cut off him and all who whore after him, to
whore after the Molech, from among their people.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֵת כּל הַזֹּנִים אַחֲרָיו לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵי הַמֹּלֶךְ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֵת כּל הַזֹּנִים אַחֲרָיו לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵי הַמֹּלֶךְ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

english.text:
then I shall set my face at that man and at his family,
and I shall cut off him and all who whore after him, to
whore after the Molech, from among their people.

translation.text: I myself will set my face against them and against all who follow them in prostituting themselves to Molech.

verses.english:
And the person who will turn to ghosts and to spirits of
acquaintances to whore after them: I shall set my face
against that person and cut him off from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים לִזְנֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פָּנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים לִזְנֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פָּנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the person who will turn to ghosts and to spirits of
acquaintances to whore after them: I shall set my face
against that person and cut him off from among his people.

translation.text: If any turn to mediums and wizards, prostituting themselves to them, I will set my face against them, and will cut them off from the people.

verses.english:
“And you shall make yourselves holy, and you shall be
holy, because I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And you shall make yourselves holy, and you shall be
holy, because I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall observe my laws and do them. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall observe my laws and do them. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy.

translation.text: Keep my statutes, and observe them; I am the LORD; I sanctify you.

verses.english:
“Because any man who will curse his father and his mother
shall be put to death. He has cursed his father and his
mother: his blood is on him!
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִישׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְקַלֵּל אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ קִלֵּל דָּמָיו בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִישׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְקַלֵּל אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ קִלֵּל דָּמָיו בּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Because any man who will curse his father and his mother
shall be put to death. He has cursed his father and his
mother: his blood is on him!

translation.text: All who curse father or mother shall be put to death; having cursed father or mother, their blood is upon them.

verses.english:
“And a man who will commit adultery with a man’s wife—who
will commit adultery with his neighbor’s wife!—shall be
put to death: the adulterer and the adulteress.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ מוֹת יוּמַת הַנֹּאֵף וְהַנֹּאָפֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ מוֹת יוּמַת הַנֹּאֵף וְהַנֹּאָפֶת׃

english.text:
“And a man who will commit adultery with a man’s wife—who
will commit adultery with his neighbor’s wife!—shall be
put to death: the adulterer and the adulteress.

translation.text: If a man commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with his father’s wife, he has
exposed his father’s nudity: the two of them shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו עֶרְוַת אָבִיו גִּלָּה מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו עֶרְוַת אָבִיו גִּלָּה מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with his father’s wife, he has
exposed his father’s nudity: the two of them shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: The man who lies them shall be put to death; their blood is upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with his daughter-in-law: the two
of them shall be put to death. They have done an
aberration. Their blood is on them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת כַּלָּתוֹ מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם תֶּבֶל עָשׂוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת כַּלָּתוֹ מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם תֶּבֶל עָשׂוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with his daughter-in-law: the two
of them shall be put to death. They have done an
aberration. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall be put to death; they have committed perversion, their blood is upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with a male like lying with a
woman: the two of them have done an offensive thing. They
shall be put to death. Their blood is on them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת זָכָר מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה עָשׂוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת זָכָר מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה עָשׂוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with a male like lying with a
woman: the two of them have done an offensive thing. They
shall be put to death. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: If a man lies with a male as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination; they shall be put to death; their blood is upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will take a woman and her mother: it is a
perversion. You shall burn him and them in fire, so there
will not be perversion among you.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אִשָּׁה וְאֶת אִמָּהּ זִמָּה הִוא בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרְפוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶתְהֶן וְלֹא תִהְיֶה זִמָּה בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אִשָּׁה וְאֶת אִמָּהּ זִמָּה הִוא בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרְפוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶתְהֶן וְלֹא תִהְיֶה זִמָּה בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
And a man who will take a woman and her mother: it is a
perversion. You shall burn him and them in fire, so there
will not be perversion among you.

translation.text: If a man takes a wife and her mother also, it is depravity; they shall be burned to death, both he and they, that there may be no depravity among you.

verses.english:
And a man who will have his intercourse with an animal
shall be put to death. And you shall kill the animal.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן שְׁכבְתּוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה תַּהֲרֹגוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן שְׁכבְתּוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה תַּהֲרֹגוּ׃

english.text:
And a man who will have his intercourse with an animal
shall be put to death. And you shall kill the animal.

translation.text: If a you shall kill the animal.

verses.english:
And a woman who will go up to any animal to mate with it:
you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרַב אֶל כּל בְּהֵמָה לְרִבְעָה אֹתָהּ וְהָרַגְתָּ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרַב אֶל כּל בְּהֵמָה לְרִבְעָה אֹתָהּ וְהָרַגְתָּ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a woman who will go up to any animal to mate with it:
you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: If a woman approaches any animal and has sexual relations with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; they shall be put to death, their blood is upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will take his sister, his father’s daughter
or his mother’s daughter, and see her nudity, and she will
see his nudity, it is shame; and they will be cut off in
the eyes of the children of their people. He has exposed
his sister’s nudity. He shall bear his crime.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְרָאָה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ וְהִיא תִרְאֶה אֶת עֶרְוָתוֹ חֶסֶד הוּא וְנִכְרְתוּ לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמָּם עֶרְוַת אֲחֹתוֹ גִּלָּה עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְרָאָה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ וְהִיא תִרְאֶה אֶת עֶרְוָתוֹ חֶסֶד הוּא וְנִכְרְתוּ לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמָּם עֶרְוַת אֲחֹתוֹ גִּלָּה עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא׃

english.text:
And a man who will take his sister, his father’s daughter
or his mother’s daughter, and see her nudity, and she will
see his nudity, it is shame; and they will be cut off in
the eyes of the children of their people. He has exposed
his sister’s nudity. He shall bear his crime.

translation.text: If a man takes his sister, a daughter of his father or a daughter of his disgrace, and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people; he has uncovered his sister's nakedness, he shall be subject to punishment.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with a menstruating woman and will
expose her nudity: he has uncovered her source, and she
has exposed the source of her blood. And the two of them
will be cut off from among their people.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה דָּוָה וְגִלָּה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ אֶת מְקֹרָהּ הֶעֱרָה וְהִוא גִּלְּתָה אֶת מְקוֹר דָּמֶיהָ וְנִכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה דָּוָה וְגִלָּה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ אֶת מְקֹרָהּ הֶעֱרָה וְהִוא גִּלְּתָה אֶת מְקוֹר דָּמֶיהָ וְנִכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with a menstruating woman and will
expose her nudity: he has uncovered her source, and she
has exposed the source of her blood. And the two of them
will be cut off from among their people.

translation.text: blood; both of them shall be cut off from their people.

verses.english:
And you shall not expose the nudity of your mother’s
sister or your father’s sister, because one has thus
uncovered his close relative. They shall bear their crime.
verses.hebrew: וְעֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ וַאֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי אֶת שְׁאֵרוֹ הֶעֱרָה עֲוֺנָם יִשָּׂאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ וַאֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי אֶת שְׁאֵרוֹ הֶעֱרָה עֲוֺנָם יִשָּׂאוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not expose the nudity of your mother’s
sister or your father’s sister, because one has thus
uncovered his close relative. They shall bear their crime.

translation.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister or of your father's sister, punishment.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with his aunt: he has exposed his
uncle’s nudity. They shall bear their sin. They shall die
childless.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת דֹּדָתוֹ עֶרְוַת דֹּדוֹ גִּלָּה חֶטְאָם יִשָּׂאוּ עֲרִירִים יָמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת דֹּדָתוֹ עֶרְוַת דֹּדוֹ גִּלָּה חֶטְאָם יִשָּׂאוּ עֲרִירִים יָמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with his aunt: he has exposed his
uncle’s nudity. They shall bear their sin. They shall die
childless.

translation.text: If a man lies with his uncle's wife, he has uncovered his childless.

verses.english:
And a man who will take his brother’s wife: it is an
impurity. He has exposed his brother’s nudity. They will
be childless.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו נִדָּה הִוא עֶרְוַת אָחִיו גִּלָּה עֲרִירִים יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו נִדָּה הִוא עֶרְוַת אָחִיו גִּלָּה עֲרִירִים יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
And a man who will take his brother’s wife: it is an
impurity. He has exposed his brother’s nudity. They will
be childless.

translation.text: If a man takes his brother's wife, it is impurity; he has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.english:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them, and the land to which I am bringing you to
live in it will not vomit you out.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָקִיא אֶתְכֶם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לָשֶׁבֶת בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָקִיא אֶתְכֶם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לָשֶׁבֶת בָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them, and the land to which I am bringing you to
live in it will not vomit you out.

translation.text: You shall keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and observe you out.

verses.english:
And you shall not go by the laws of the nation that I am
ejecting from in front of you, because they have done all
of these, and I am disgusted with them.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תֵלְכוּ בְּחֻקֹּת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי אֶת כּל אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ וָאָקֻץ בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תֵלְכוּ בְּחֻקֹּת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי אֶת כּל אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ וָאָקֻץ בָּם׃

english.text:
And you shall not go by the laws of the nation that I am
ejecting from in front of you, because they have done all
of these, and I am disgusted with them.

translation.text: You shall not follow the practices of the nation that I am them.

verses.english:
And I have said to you: You shall possess their land, and
I shall give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with
milk and honey. I am YHWH, your God, who has distinguished
you from the peoples,
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לָכֶם אַתֶּם תִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם וַאֲנִי אֶתְּנֶנָּה לָכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר לָכֶם אַתֶּם תִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם וַאֲנִי אֶתְּנֶנָּה לָכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים׃

english.text:
And I have said to you: You shall possess their land, and
I shall give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with
milk and honey. I am YHWH, your God, who has distinguished
you from the peoples,

translation.text: But I have said to you: You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God; I have separated you from the peoples.

verses.english:
and you shall distinguish between the pure animal and the
impure, and between the impure bird and the pure, and you
shall not make yourselves detestable by an animal or by a
bird or by anything that creeps on the ground that I have
distinguished as impure for you.
verses.hebrew: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּם בֵּין הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה לַטְּמֵאָה וּבֵין הָעוֹף הַטָּמֵא לַטָּהֹר וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בַּבְּהֵמָה וּבָעוֹף וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּרְמֹשׂ הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי לָכֶם לְטַמֵּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּם בֵּין הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה לַטְּמֵאָה וּבֵין הָעוֹף הַטָּמֵא לַטָּהֹר וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בַּבְּהֵמָה וּבָעוֹף וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּרְמֹשׂ הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי לָכֶם לְטַמֵּא׃

english.text:
and you shall distinguish between the pure animal and the
impure, and between the impure bird and the pure, and you
shall not make yourselves detestable by an animal or by a
bird or by anything that creeps on the ground that I have
distinguished as impure for you.

translation.text: You shall unclean.

verses.english:
And you shall be holy to me because I, YHWH, am holy, and
I have distinguished you from the peoples to be mine.
verses.hebrew: וִהְיִיתֶם לִי קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וָאַבְדִּל אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת לִי׃

hebrew.text: וִהְיִיתֶם לִי קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וָאַבְדִּל אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall be holy to me because I, YHWH, am holy, and
I have distinguished you from the peoples to be mine.

translation.text: You shall be holy to me; for I the LORD am holy, and I have separated you from the other peoples to be mine.

verses.english:
“And a man or woman: if there will be among them a ghost
or a spirit of an acquaintance, they shall be put to
death. They shall batter them with stone. Their blood is
on them.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בָהֶם אוֹב אוֹ יִדְּעֹנִי מוֹת יוּמָתוּ בָּאֶבֶן יִרְגְּמוּ אֹתָם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בָהֶם אוֹב אוֹ יִדְּעֹנִי מוֹת יוּמָתוּ בָּאֶבֶן יִרְגְּמוּ אֹתָם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
“And a man or woman: if there will be among them a ghost
or a spirit of an acquaintance, they shall be put to
death. They shall batter them with stone. Their blood is
on them.”

translation.text: A man or a woman who is a medium or a wizard shall be put to death; they shall be stoned to death, their blood is upon them.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the priests, the sons of
Aaron, and say to them: One shall not become impure for a
person among his people
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לְנֶפֶשׁ לֹא יִטַּמָּא בְּעַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לְנֶפֶשׁ לֹא יִטַּמָּא בְּעַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the priests, the sons of
Aaron, and say to them: One shall not become impure for a
person among his people

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses: Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: No one shall defile himself for a dead person among his relatives,

verses.english:
except for his relative who is close to him: for his
mother and for his father and for his son and for his
daughter and for his brother
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו לְאִמּוֹ וּלְאָבִיו וְלִבְנוֹ וּלְבִתּוֹ וּלְאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו לְאִמּוֹ וּלְאָבִיו וְלִבְנוֹ וּלְבִתּוֹ וּלְאָחִיו׃

english.text:
except for his relative who is close to him: for his
mother and for his father and for his son and for his
daughter and for his brother

translation.text: except for his nearest kin: his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, his brother;

verses.english:
and for his virgin sister who is close to him, who has not
been a husband’s; he may become impure for her.
verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲחֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ לָהּ יִטַּמָּא׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲחֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ לָהּ יִטַּמָּא׃

english.text:
and for his virgin sister who is close to him, who has not
been a husband’s; he may become impure for her.

translation.text: likewise, for a virgin sister, close to him because she has had no husband, he may defile himself for her.

verses.english:
He shall not become impure as a husband among his people,
for him to be desecrated.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִטַּמָּא בַּעַל בְּעַמָּיו לְהֵחַלּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִטַּמָּא בַּעַל בְּעַמָּיו לְהֵחַלּוֹ׃

english.text:
He shall not become impure as a husband among his people,
for him to be desecrated.

translation.text: But he shall not defile himself as a husband among his people and so profane himself.

verses.english:
They shall not make a bald place on their head and shall
not shave the corner of their beard and not make a cut in
their flesh.
verses.hebrew: לֹא [יִקְרְחוּ] (יקרחה) קרְחָה בְּרֹאשָׁם וּפְאַת זְקָנָם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּבִבְשָׂרָם לֹא יִשְׂרְטוּ שָׂרָטֶת׃

hebrew.text: לֹא [יִקְרְחוּ] (יקרחה) קרְחָה בְּרֹאשָׁם וּפְאַת זְקָנָם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּבִבְשָׂרָם לֹא יִשְׂרְטוּ שָׂרָטֶת׃

english.text:
They shall not make a bald place on their head and shall
not shave the corner of their beard and not make a cut in
their flesh.

translation.text: They their beards, or make any gashes in their flesh.

verses.english:
They shall be holy to their God and shall not desecrate
their God’s name, because they are bringing forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire, their God’s bread, so they shall be a
holy thing.
verses.hebrew: קְדֹשִׁים יִהְיוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֵם מַקְרִיבִם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: קְדֹשִׁים יִהְיוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֵם מַקְרִיבִם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
They shall be holy to their God and shall not desecrate
their God’s name, because they are bringing forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire, their God’s bread, so they shall be a
holy thing.

translation.text: They shall be holy to LORD's offerings by fire, the food of their God; therefore they shall be holy.

verses.english:
They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and
desecrated, and they shall not take a woman who is
divorced from her husband, because he is holy to his God.
verses.hebrew: אִשָּׁה זֹנָה וַחֲלָלָה לֹא יִקָּחוּ וְאִשָּׁה גְּרוּשָׁה מֵאִישָׁהּ לֹא יִקָּחוּ כִּי קָדֹשׁ הוּא לֵאלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: אִשָּׁה זֹנָה וַחֲלָלָה לֹא יִקָּחוּ וְאִשָּׁה גְּרוּשָׁה מֵאִישָׁהּ לֹא יִקָּחוּ כִּי קָדֹשׁ הוּא לֵאלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and
desecrated, and they shall not take a woman who is
divorced from her husband, because he is holy to his God.

translation.text: They shall not marry a prostitute or a woman who has been defiled; neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband. For they are holy to their God,

verses.english:
And you shall regard him as holy because he is bringing
forward your God’s bread. He shall be holy to you because
I, YHWH, who makes you holy, am holy.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ כִּי אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא מַקְרִיב קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ כִּי אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא מַקְרִיב קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall regard him as holy because he is bringing
forward your God’s bread. He shall be holy to you because
I, YHWH, who makes you holy, am holy.

translation.text: and you shall treat them as holy, since LORD, I who sanctify you, am holy.

verses.english:
And the daughter of a man who is a priest who will become
desecrated, to whore: she is desecrating her father. She
shall be burned in fire.
verses.hebrew: וּבַת אִישׁ כֹּהֵן כִּי תֵחֵל לִזְנוֹת אֶת אָבִיהָ הִיא מְחַלֶּלֶת בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וּבַת אִישׁ כֹּהֵן כִּי תֵחֵל לִזְנוֹת אֶת אָבִיהָ הִיא מְחַלֶּלֶת בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And the daughter of a man who is a priest who will become
desecrated, to whore: she is desecrating her father. She
shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: When the daughter of a priest shall be burned to death.

verses.english:
“And the priest who is the most senior of his brothers, on
whose head the anointing oil will be poured and who has
filled his hand to wear the clothes, he shall not let
loose the hair of his head and not tear his clothes
verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל מֵאֶחָיו אֲשֶׁר יוּצַק עַל רֹאשׁוֹ שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לִלְבֹּשׁ אֶת הַבְּגָדִים אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ לֹא יִפְרָע וּבְגָדָיו לֹא יִפְרֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל מֵאֶחָיו אֲשֶׁר יוּצַק עַל רֹאשׁוֹ שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לִלְבֹּשׁ אֶת הַבְּגָדִים אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ לֹא יִפְרָע וּבְגָדָיו לֹא יִפְרֹם׃

english.text:
“And the priest who is the most senior of his brothers, on
whose head the anointing oil will be poured and who has
filled his hand to wear the clothes, he shall not let
loose the hair of his head and not tear his clothes

translation.text: The priest who is exalted above his fellows, on whose head the the vestments, shall not dishevel his hair, nor tear his vestments.

verses.english:
and he shall not come to any dead persons; he shall not
become impure for his father and for his mother.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל כּל נַפְשֹׁת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל כּל נַפְשֹׁת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא׃

english.text:
and he shall not come to any dead persons; he shall not
become impure for his father and for his mother.

translation.text: He even for his father or mother.

verses.english:
And he shall not go out from the holy place, so he will
not desecrate his God’s holy place, because the crown with
his God’s anointing oil is on him. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא יֵצֵא וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֵת מִקְדַּשׁ אֱלֹהָיו כִּי נֵזֶר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת אֱלֹהָיו עָלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא יֵצֵא וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֵת מִקְדַּשׁ אֱלֹהָיו כִּי נֵזֶר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת אֱלֹהָיו עָלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall not go out from the holy place, so he will
not desecrate his God’s holy place, because the crown with
his God’s anointing oil is on him. I am YHWH.

translation.text: He shall not go outside the sanctuary anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.

verses.english: “And he shall take a woman in her virginity.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּח׃

english.text: “And he shall take a woman in her virginity.

translation.text: He shall marry only a woman who is a virgin.

verses.english:
A widow and a divorcée and a desecrated woman, a
prostitute: he shall not take these; he shall take none
except a virgin from his people.
verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וַחֲלָלָה זֹנָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לֹא יִקָּח כִּי אִם בְּתוּלָה מֵעַמָּיו יִקַּח אִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וַחֲלָלָה זֹנָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לֹא יִקָּח כִּי אִם בְּתוּלָה מֵעַמָּיו יִקַּח אִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
A widow and a divorcée and a desecrated woman, a
prostitute: he shall not take these; he shall take none
except a virgin from his people.

translation.text: A widow, or a divorced woman, or a woman who has been defiled, a prostitute, these he shall not marry. He shall marry a virgin of his own kin,

verses.english:
And he shall not desecrate his seed among his people,
because I, YHWH, make him holy.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ בְּעַמָּיו כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ בְּעַמָּיו כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall not desecrate his seed among his people,
because I, YHWH, make him holy.”

translation.text: that he may not profane his offspring among his kin; for I am the LORD; I sanctify him.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron, saying: A man from your seed, through
their generations, in whom will be an injury shall not
come forward to bring forward his God’s bread.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִזַּרְעֲךָ לְדֹרֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרַב לְהַקְרִיב לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִזַּרְעֲךָ לְדֹרֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרַב לְהַקְרִיב לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron, saying: A man from your seed, through
their generations, in whom will be an injury shall not
come forward to bring forward his God’s bread.

translation.text: Speak to Aaron and say: No one approach to offer the food of his God.

verses.english:
Because any man in whom is an injury shall not come
forward: a blind man or a cripple or mutilated or who has
an elongated limb
verses.hebrew: כִּי כל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרָב אִישׁ עִוֵּר אוֹ פִסֵּחַ אוֹ חָרֻם אוֹ שָׂרוּעַ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרָב אִישׁ עִוֵּר אוֹ פִסֵּחַ אוֹ חָרֻם אוֹ שָׂרוּעַ׃

english.text:
Because any man in whom is an injury shall not come
forward: a blind man or a cripple or mutilated or who has
an elongated limb

translation.text: For no one who has a mutilated face or a limb too long,

verses.english:
or a man who has a break of the leg or a break of the arm
in him
verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ שֶׁבֶר רָגֶל אוֹ שֶׁבֶר יָד׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ שֶׁבֶר רָגֶל אוֹ שֶׁבֶר יָד׃

english.text:
or a man who has a break of the leg or a break of the arm
in him

translation.text: or one who has a broken foot or a broken hand,

verses.english:
or a hunchback or a dwarf or who has a spotting in his eye
or is scabbed or scurvied or has crushed testicles.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ גִבֵּן אוֹ דַק אוֹ תְּבַלֻּל בְּעֵינוֹ אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת אוֹ מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ גִבֵּן אוֹ דַק אוֹ תְּבַלֻּל בְּעֵינוֹ אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת אוֹ מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ׃

english.text:
or a hunchback or a dwarf or who has a spotting in his eye
or is scabbed or scurvied or has crushed testicles.

translation.text: or a hunchback, or a dwarf, or a man with a blemish in his eyes or an itching disease or scabs or crushed testicles.

verses.english:
Any man from the seed of Aaron the priest in whom is an
injury shall not come near to bring forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire. He has an injury in him. He shall not
come near to bring forward his God’s bread.
verses.hebrew: כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה מוּם בּוֹ אֵת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב׃

hebrew.text: כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה מוּם בּוֹ אֵת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב׃

english.text:
Any man from the seed of Aaron the priest in whom is an
injury shall not come near to bring forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire. He has an injury in him. He shall not
come near to bring forward his God’s bread.

translation.text: No offer the LORD's offerings by fire; since he has a blemish, he shall not come near to offer the food of his God.

verses.english:
He shall eat his God’s bread, from the holies of holies
and from the holies.
verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו מִקּדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּמִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים יֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו מִקּדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּמִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים יֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
He shall eat his God’s bread, from the holies of holies
and from the holies.

translation.text: He may eat the food of his God, of the most holy as well as of the holy.

verses.english:
Just: he shall not come to the pavilion, and he shall not
come near to the altar, because he has an injury in him.
And he shall not desecrate my holy places, because I,
YHWH, make them holy.”
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶל הַפָּרֹכֶת לֹא יָבֹא וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִגַּשׁ כִּי מוּם בּוֹ וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֶת מִקְדָּשַׁי כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶל הַפָּרֹכֶת לֹא יָבֹא וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִגַּשׁ כִּי מוּם בּוֹ וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֶת מִקְדָּשַׁי כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
Just: he shall not come to the pavilion, and he shall not
come near to the altar, because he has an injury in him.
And he shall not desecrate my holy places, because I,
YHWH, make them holy.”

translation.text: But he shall not come he may not profane my sanctuaries; for I am the LORD; I sanctify them.

verses.english:
So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the
children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the
children of Israel.

translation.text: Thus Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the people of Israel.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons that they be alerted
regarding the holy things of the children of Israel that
they consecrate to me, so they will not desecrate my holy
name. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְיִנָּזְרוּ מִקּדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְיִנָּזְרוּ מִקּדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons that they be alerted
regarding the holy things of the children of Israel that
they consecrate to me, so they will not desecrate my holy
name. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Direct Aaron and his sons to deal carefully with the sacred donations of the people of Israel, which they LORD.

verses.english:
Say to them: Through your generations, any man who will
come close, from all of your seed, to the holy things that
the children of Israel will consecrate to YHWH, while his
impurity is on him: that person will be cut off from in
front of me. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַב מִכּל זַרְעֲכֶם אֶל הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִלְּפָנַי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַב מִכּל זַרְעֲכֶם אֶל הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִלְּפָנַי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Say to them: Through your generations, any man who will
come close, from all of your seed, to the holy things that
the children of Israel will consecrate to YHWH, while his
impurity is on him: that person will be cut off from in
front of me. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Say to them: If anyone among all your offspring throughout of Israel dedicate to the LORD, while he is in a state of uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“Any man from Aaron’s seed and who is a leper or has an
emission shall not eat any of the holy things until he
becomes pure. And one who touches anything that is impure
by a person, or a man from whom intercourse seed will come
out,
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן וְהוּא צָרוּעַ אוֹ זָב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא יֹאכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יִטְהָר וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכל טְמֵא נֶפֶשׁ אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן וְהוּא צָרוּעַ אוֹ זָב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא יֹאכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יִטְהָר וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכל טְמֵא נֶפֶשׁ אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע׃

english.text:
“Any man from Aaron’s seed and who is a leper or has an
emission shall not eat any of the holy things until he
becomes pure. And one who touches anything that is impure
by a person, or a man from whom intercourse seed will come
out,

translation.text: No one of of semen,

verses.english:
or a man who will touch any swarming creature by which he
will become impure or a human by whom he will become
impure, whatever his impurity:
verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל שֶׁרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ אוֹ בְאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל שֶׁרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ אוֹ בְאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ׃

english.text:
or a man who will touch any swarming creature by which he
will become impure or a human by whom he will become
impure, whatever his impurity:

translation.text: and whoever touches any swarming thing by which he may unclean — whatever his uncleanness may be —

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בּוֹ וְטָמְאָה עַד הָעָרֶב וְלֹא יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי אִם רָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בּוֹ וְטָמְאָה עַד הָעָרֶב וְלֹא יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי אִם רָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם׃

translation.text: the person who touches any such shall be unclean until evening and shall not eat of the sacred donations unless he has washed his body in water.

verses.english:
And when the sun has set, he shall be pure, and after that
he shall eat from the holy things, because it is his food.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי לַחְמוֹ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי לַחְמוֹ הוּא׃

english.text:
And when the sun has set, he shall be pure, and after that
he shall eat from the holy things, because it is his food.

translation.text: When the donations, for they are his food.

verses.english:
He shall not eat a carcass or a torn animal, to become
impure by it. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא יֹאכַל לְטמְאָה בָהּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא יֹאכַל לְטמְאָה בָהּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He shall not eat a carcass or a torn animal, to become
impure by it. I am YHWH.

translation.text: That which died or was torn by wild animals he shall not eat, becoming unclean by it: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“And they shall keep my charge so they will not bear sin
over it and die through it when they desecrate it. I,
YHWH, make them holy.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא יִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא וּמֵתוּ בוֹ כִּי יְחַלְּלֻהוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא יִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא וּמֵתוּ בוֹ כִּי יְחַלְּלֻהוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
“And they shall keep my charge so they will not bear sin
over it and die through it when they desecrate it. I,
YHWH, make them holy.

translation.text: They sanctuary for having profaned it: I am the LORD; I sanctify them.

verses.english:
“And any outsider shall not eat what is holy: a priest’s
visitor and an employee shall not eat what is holy.
verses.hebrew: וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁב כֹּהֵן וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁב כֹּהֵן וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
“And any outsider shall not eat what is holy: a priest’s
visitor and an employee shall not eat what is holy.

translation.text: No lay person shall eat of the sacred donations. No bound or hired servant of the priest shall eat of the sacred donations;

verses.english:
But when a priest buys a person as a possession by his
money, he may eat it; and one who is born in his
household: they may eat his bread.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹהֵן כִּי יִקְנֶה נֶפֶשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפּוֹ הוּא יֹאכַל בּוֹ וִילִיד בֵּיתוֹ הֵם יֹאכְלוּ בְלַחְמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹהֵן כִּי יִקְנֶה נֶפֶשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפּוֹ הוּא יֹאכַל בּוֹ וִילִיד בֵּיתוֹ הֵם יֹאכְלוּ בְלַחְמוֹ׃

english.text:
But when a priest buys a person as a possession by his
money, he may eat it; and one who is born in his
household: they may eat his bread.

translation.text: but if a priest that are born in his house may eat of his food.

verses.english:
And a priest’s daughter who will become an outsider’s: she
shall not eat the donated holy things;
verses.hebrew: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ זָר הִוא בִּתְרוּמַת הַקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ זָר הִוא בִּתְרוּמַת הַקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
And a priest’s daughter who will become an outsider’s: she
shall not eat the donated holy things;

translation.text: If a priest's daughter donations;

verses.english:
but a priest’s daughter who will be a widow or a divorcée
and has no seed and returns to her father’s house as in
her youth, she may eat from her father’s bread. But any
outsider shall not eat it.
verses.hebrew: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וְזֶרַע אֵין לָהּ וְשָׁבָה אֶל בֵּית אָבִיהָ כִּנְעוּרֶיהָ מִלֶּחֶם אָבִיהָ תֹּאכֵל וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וְזֶרַע אֵין לָהּ וְשָׁבָה אֶל בֵּית אָבִיהָ כִּנְעוּרֶיהָ מִלֶּחֶם אָבִיהָ תֹּאכֵל וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

english.text:
but a priest’s daughter who will be a widow or a divorcée
and has no seed and returns to her father’s house as in
her youth, she may eat from her father’s bread. But any
outsider shall not eat it.

translation.text: but if a priest's daughter is widowed or divorced, without eat of her father's food. No lay person shall eat of it.

verses.english:
And a man who eats what is holy by mistake shall add to it
a fifth of it and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And a man who eats what is holy by mistake shall add to it
a fifth of it and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

translation.text: If a man eats of the sacred donation unintentionally, he shall add one-fifth of its value to it, and give the sacred donation to the priest.

verses.english:
And they shall not desecrate the holy things of the
children of Israel that they will donate to YHWH
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת קדְשֵׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת קדְשֵׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they shall not desecrate the holy things of the
children of Israel that they will donate to YHWH

translation.text: No one shall to the LORD,

verses.english:
so that they would make them bear a crime requiring a
guilt offering by their eating their holy things, because
I, YHWH, make them holy.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיאוּ אוֹתָם עֲוֺן אַשְׁמָה בְּאכְלָם אֶת קדְשֵׁיהֶם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשִּׂיאוּ אוֹתָם עֲוֺן אַשְׁמָה בְּאכְלָם אֶת קדְשֵׁיהֶם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
so that they would make them bear a crime requiring a
guilt offering by their eating their holy things, because
I, YHWH, make them holy.”

translation.text: causing them to bear guilt requiring a guilt offering, by eating their sacred donations: for I am the LORD; I sanctify them.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man from the house
of Israel or from the aliens in Israel who will make his
offering—for all their vows and all their contributions
that they bring forward to YHWH as a burnt offering—
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לְכל נִדְרֵיהֶם וּלְכל נִדְבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לְכל נִדְרֵיהֶם וּלְכל נִדְבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man from the house
of Israel or from the aliens in Israel who will make his
offering—for all their vows and all their contributions
that they bring forward to YHWH as a burnt offering—

translation.text: Speak to Aaron and his sons and Israel or of the aliens residing in Israel presents an offering, whether in as a burnt offering,

verses.english:
for acceptance for you it is to be unblemished, male of
the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.hebrew: לִרְצֹנְכֶם תָּמִים זָכָר בַּבָּקָר בַּכְּשָׂבִים וּבָעִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: לִרְצֹנְכֶם תָּמִים זָכָר בַּבָּקָר בַּכְּשָׂבִים וּבָעִזִּים׃

english.text:
for acceptance for you it is to be unblemished, male of
the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.

translation.text: to be acceptable in your behalf it shall be a male without blemish, of the cattle or the sheep or the goats.

verses.english:
You shall not bring forward any that has an injury in it,
because it will not be acceptable for you.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ כִּי לֹא לְרָצוֹן יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ כִּי לֹא לְרָצוֹן יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not bring forward any that has an injury in it,
because it will not be acceptable for you.

translation.text: You shall not offer anything that has a blemish, for it will not be acceptable in your behalf.

verses.english:
And a man who will bring forward a peace-offering
sacrifice to YHWH to express a vow or as a contribution of
the cattle or of the flock: it shall be unblemished for
acceptance; there shall not be any injury in it.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְרִיב זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ לִנְדָבָה בַּבָּקָר אוֹ בַצֹּאן תָּמִים יִהְיֶה לְרָצוֹן כּל מוּם לֹא יִהְיֶה בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְרִיב זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ לִנְדָבָה בַּבָּקָר אוֹ בַצֹּאן תָּמִים יִהְיֶה לְרָצוֹן כּל מוּם לֹא יִהְיֶה בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And a man who will bring forward a peace-offering
sacrifice to YHWH to express a vow or as a contribution of
the cattle or of the flock: it shall be unblemished for
acceptance; there shall not be any injury in it.

translation.text: When anyone offers a sacrifice of well-being to the LORD, in fulfillment of a vow or as a freewill offering, from the herd or from the flock, to be acceptable it must be perfect; there shall be no blemish in it.

verses.english:
Blind or broken or slashed or sore or scabbed or scurvied:
you shall not bring these forward to YHWH, and you shall
not give an offering by fire of them on the altar to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עַוֶּרֶת אוֹ שָׁבוּר אוֹ חָרוּץ אוֹ יַבֶּלֶת אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְאִשֶּׁה לֹא תִתְּנוּ מֵהֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עַוֶּרֶת אוֹ שָׁבוּר אוֹ חָרוּץ אוֹ יַבֶּלֶת אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְאִשֶּׁה לֹא תִתְּנוּ מֵהֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Blind or broken or slashed or sore or scabbed or scurvied:
you shall not bring these forward to YHWH, and you shall
not give an offering by fire of them on the altar to YHWH.

translation.text: Anything blind, or injured, or maimed, or having a discharge or them on the altar as offerings by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
An ox or a sheep that has an elongated limb or a short
limb: you may make it a contribution, but it shall not be
accepted for a vow.
verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה שָׂרוּעַ וְקָלוּט נְדָבָה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ וּלְנֵדֶר לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה שָׂרוּעַ וְקָלוּט נְדָבָה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ וּלְנֵדֶר לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

english.text:
An ox or a sheep that has an elongated limb or a short
limb: you may make it a contribution, but it shall not be
accepted for a vow.

translation.text: An ox or a lamb offering; but it will not be accepted for a vow.

verses.english:
And you shall not bring forward to YHWH one that is
bruised, crushed, torn, or cut. And you shall not do it in
your land,
verses.hebrew: וּמָעוּךְ וְכָתוּת וְנָתוּק וְכָרוּת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה וּבְאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָעוּךְ וְכָתוּת וְנָתוּק וְכָרוּת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה וּבְאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not bring forward to YHWH one that is
bruised, crushed, torn, or cut. And you shall not do it in
your land,

translation.text: Any animal that has its testicles bruised or crushed or torn or cut, you shall not offer to the LORD; such you shall not do within your land,

verses.english:
and you shall not bring forward your God’s bread from any
of these from a foreigner’s hand, because their flaw is in
them, an injury is in them; they shall not be accepted for
you.”
verses.hebrew: וּמִיַּד בֶּן נֵכָר לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכּל אֵלֶּה כִּי משְׁחָתָם בָּהֶם מוּם בָּם לֹא יֵרָצוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִיַּד בֶּן נֵכָר לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכּל אֵלֶּה כִּי משְׁחָתָם בָּהֶם מוּם בָּם לֹא יֵרָצוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
and you shall not bring forward your God’s bread from any
of these from a foreigner’s hand, because their flaw is in
them, an injury is in them; they shall not be accepted for
you.”

translation.text: nor shall you accept in your behalf.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“When an ox or a sheep or a goat will be born, it will be
under its mother seven days, and from the eighth day on it
will be accepted as an offering, an offering by fire to
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז כִּי יִוָּלֵד וְהָיָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּחַת אִמּוֹ וּמִיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה יֵרָצֶה לְקרְבַּן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז כִּי יִוָּלֵד וְהָיָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּחַת אִמּוֹ וּמִיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה יֵרָצֶה לְקרְבַּן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“When an ox or a sheep or a goat will be born, it will be
under its mother seven days, and from the eighth day on it
will be accepted as an offering, an offering by fire to
YHWH.

translation.text: When an ox or a sheep or a eighth day on it shall be acceptable as the LORD's offering by fire.

verses.english:
And an ox or a sheep: you shall not slaughter it and its
child on one day.
verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ לֹא תִשְׁחֲטוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְשׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ לֹא תִשְׁחֲטוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And an ox or a sheep: you shall not slaughter it and its
child on one day.

translation.text: But you shall not slaughter, from the herd or the flock, an animal with its young on the same day.

verses.english:
And if you will make a sacrifice of thanks to YHWH, you
shall sacrifice it so it will be acceptable for you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח תּוֹדָה לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח תּוֹדָה לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחוּ׃

english.text:
And if you will make a sacrifice of thanks to YHWH, you
shall sacrifice it so it will be acceptable for you.

translation.text: When you sacrifice a thanksgiving offering to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that it may be acceptable in your behalf.

verses.english:
It shall be eaten on that day. Do not leave any of it
until morning. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵאָכֵל לֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵאָכֵל לֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
It shall be eaten on that day. Do not leave any of it
until morning. I am YHWH.

translation.text: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall not leave any of it until morning: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“And you shall observe my commandments and do them. I am
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall observe my commandments and do them. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: Thus you shall keep my commandments and observe them: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“And you shall not desecrate my holy name, so I shall be
sanctified among the children of Israel. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy,
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
“And you shall not desecrate my holy name, so I shall be
sanctified among the children of Israel. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy,

translation.text: You shall not profane my holy name, that I may be sanctified among the people of Israel: I am the LORD; I sanctify you,

verses.english:
who brought brought you out from the land of Egypt to be
God to you. I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
who brought brought you out from the land of Egypt to be
God to you. I am YHWH.”

translation.text: I who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am the LORD.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call holy
assemblies—these are my appointed times:
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶּה הֵם מוֹעֲדָי׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶּה הֵם מוֹעֲדָי׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call holy
assemblies—these are my appointed times:

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel and shall proclaim as holy convocations, my appointed festivals.

verses.english:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day is a
Sabbath, a ceasing, a holy assembly. You shall not do any
work. It is a Sabbath to YHWH in all your homes.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ שַׁבָּת הִוא לַיהֹוָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ שַׁבָּת הִוא לַיהֹוָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day is a
Sabbath, a ceasing, a holy assembly. You shall not do any
work. It is a Sabbath to YHWH in all your homes.

translation.text: Six days shall work be done; but the seventh day is a sabbath of complete rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no work: it is a sabbath to the LORD throughout your settlements.

verses.english:
“These are YHWH’s appointed times, holy assemblies that
you shall proclaim at their appointed time:
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָם׃

english.text:
“These are YHWH’s appointed times, holy assemblies that
you shall proclaim at their appointed time:

translation.text: These are the appointed festivals of the LORD, the holy convocations, which you shall celebrate at the time appointed for them.

verses.english:
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month,
‘between the two evenings,’ is YHWH’s Passover.
verses.hebrew: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month,
‘between the two evenings,’ is YHWH’s Passover.

translation.text: In the first a passover offering to the LORD,

verses.english:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is YHWH’s Festival
of Unleavened Bread. You shall eat unleavened bread seven
days.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חַג הַמַּצּוֹת לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חַג הַמַּצּוֹת לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is YHWH’s Festival
of Unleavened Bread. You shall eat unleavened bread seven
days.

translation.text: and on the fifteenth day of the same shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.english:
On the first day you shall have a holy assembly. You shall
not do any act of work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
On the first day you shall have a holy assembly. You shall
not do any act of work.

translation.text: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH
for seven days. On the seventh day you shall have a holy
assembly. You shall not do any act of work.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH
for seven days. On the seventh day you shall have a holy
assembly. You shall not do any act of work.”

translation.text: For seven days you shall present the LORD's offerings by fire; on the seventh day there shall be a holy convocation: you shall not work at your occupations.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you and you reap its harvest, you shall bring the first
sheaf of your harvest to the priest,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וּקְצַרְתֶּם אֶת קְצִירָהּ וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֶת עֹמֶר רֵאשִׁית קְצִירְכֶם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וּקְצַרְתֶּם אֶת קְצִירָהּ וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֶת עֹמֶר רֵאשִׁית קְצִירְכֶם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you and you reap its harvest, you shall bring the first
sheaf of your harvest to the priest,

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel and say to harvest, you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

verses.english:
and he shall elevate the sheaf in front of YHWH for
acceptance for you. The priest shall elevate it on the day
after the Sabbath.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אֶת הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנִיף אֶת הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
and he shall elevate the sheaf in front of YHWH for
acceptance for you. The priest shall elevate it on the day
after the Sabbath.

translation.text: He shall raise the sheaf before the LORD, that you may find acceptance; on the day after the sabbath the priest shall raise it.

verses.english:
And on the day of your elevating the sheaf, you shall do
an unblemished lamb in its first year as a burnt offering
to YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם בְּיוֹם הֲנִיפְכֶם אֶת הָעֹמֶר כֶּבֶשׂ תָּמִים בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם בְּיוֹם הֲנִיפְכֶם אֶת הָעֹמֶר כֶּבֶשׂ תָּמִים בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And on the day of your elevating the sheaf, you shall do
an unblemished lamb in its first year as a burnt offering
to YHWH,

translation.text: On without blemish, as a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
and its grain offering shall be two-tenths of a measure of
fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to YHWH, a
pleasant smell, and its libation shall be wine, a fourth
of a hin.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתוֹ שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ וְנִסְכֹּה יַיִן רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: וּמִנְחָתוֹ שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ וְנִסְכֹּה יַיִן רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

english.text:
and its grain offering shall be two-tenths of a measure of
fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to YHWH, a
pleasant smell, and its libation shall be wine, a fourth
of a hin.

translation.text: And the grain with oil, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, one-fourth of a hin.

verses.english:
And you shall not eat bread or parched or fresh grain
until that very day, until you have brought your God’s
offering. It is an eternal law through your generations in
all your homes.
verses.hebrew: וְלֶחֶם וְקָלִי וְכַרְמֶל לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַד עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַד הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת קרְבַּן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֶחֶם וְקָלִי וְכַרְמֶל לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַד עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַד הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת קרְבַּן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not eat bread or parched or fresh grain
until that very day, until you have brought your God’s
offering. It is an eternal law through your generations in
all your homes.

translation.text: You shall eat throughout your generations in all your settlements.

verses.english:
And you shall count from the day after the Sabbath, from
the day of your bringing the sheaf for an elevation
offering, seven Sabbaths. They shall be complete.
verses.hebrew: וּסְפַרְתֶּם לָכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת מִיּוֹם הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת עֹמֶר הַתְּנוּפָה שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימֹת תִּהְיֶינָה׃

hebrew.text: וּסְפַרְתֶּם לָכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת מִיּוֹם הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת עֹמֶר הַתְּנוּפָה שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימֹת תִּהְיֶינָה׃

english.text:
And you shall count from the day after the Sabbath, from
the day of your bringing the sheaf for an elevation
offering, seven Sabbaths. They shall be complete.

translation.text: And from the day after the sabbath, from the day on which you weeks; they shall be complete.

verses.english:
You shall count until the day after the seventh Sabbath:
fifty days. And you shall bring forward a new grain
offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עַד מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת הַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּסְפְּרוּ חֲמִשִּׁים יוֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עַד מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת הַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּסְפְּרוּ חֲמִשִּׁים יוֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall count until the day after the seventh Sabbath:
fifty days. And you shall bring forward a new grain
offering to YHWH.

translation.text: You shall count until the day after new grain to the LORD.

verses.english:
From your homes you shall bring bread for an elevation
offering: two of them. They shall be two-tenths of a
measure of fine flour, baked with leaven, firstfruits to
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאּוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה שְׁתַּיִם שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת תִּהְיֶינָה חָמֵץ תֵּאָפֶינָה בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאּוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה שְׁתַּיִם שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת תִּהְיֶינָה חָמֵץ תֵּאָפֶינָה בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
From your homes you shall bring bread for an elevation
offering: two of them. They shall be two-tenths of a
measure of fine flour, baked with leaven, firstfruits to
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall bring from your settlements two an ephah; they shall be of choice flour, baked with leaven, as first fruits to the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward with the bread seven lambs,
unblemished one-year-olds, and one bull of the cattle and
two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to YHWH, with
their grain offering and their libations, an offering by
fire, a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עַל הַלֶּחֶם שִׁבְעַת כְּבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם בְּנֵי שָׁנָה וּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד וְאֵילִם שְׁנָיִם יִהְיוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עַל הַלֶּחֶם שִׁבְעַת כְּבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם בְּנֵי שָׁנָה וּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד וְאֵילִם שְׁנָיִם יִהְיוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward with the bread seven lambs,
unblemished one-year-olds, and one bull of the cattle and
two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to YHWH, with
their grain offering and their libations, an offering by
fire, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: You shall present with the bread seven lambs a year old offerings, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall do one goat as a sin offering and two
one-year-old lambs as a peace-offering sacrifice.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And you shall do one goat as a sin offering and two
one-year-old lambs as a peace-offering sacrifice.

translation.text: You shall old as a sacrifice of well-being.

verses.english:
And the priest shall elevate them with the bread of
firstfruits, an elevation offering in front of YHWH with
the two sheep. They shall be a holy thing to YHWH: for the
priest.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל לֶחֶם הַבִּכֻּרִים תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁנֵי כְּבָשִׂים קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנִיף הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל לֶחֶם הַבִּכֻּרִים תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁנֵי כְּבָשִׂים קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And the priest shall elevate them with the bread of
firstfruits, an elevation offering in front of YHWH with
the two sheep. They shall be a holy thing to YHWH: for the
priest.

translation.text: The priest shall raise them with the priest.

verses.english:
And you shall proclaim on that very day: you shall have a
holy assembly. You shall not do any act of work: an
eternal law in all your homes through your generations.
verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם בְּכל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם בְּכל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall proclaim on that very day: you shall have a
holy assembly. You shall not do any act of work: an
eternal law in all your homes through your generations.

translation.text: On that same day you shall make proclamation; you shall hold statute forever in all your settlements throughout your generations.

verses.english:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish your field’s corner when you harvest, and you shall
not gather your harvest’s gleaning. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.”
verses.hebrew: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ בְּקֻצְרֶךָ וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ בְּקֻצְרֶךָ וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish your field’s corner when you harvest, and you shall
not gather your harvest’s gleaning. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the shall leave them for the poor and for the alien: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: In the seventh
month, on the first of the month you shall have a ceasing,
a commemoration with horn-blasting, a holy assembly.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם שַׁבָּתוֹן זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם שַׁבָּתוֹן זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: In the seventh
month, on the first of the month you shall have a ceasing,
a commemoration with horn-blasting, a holy assembly.

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel, with trumpet blasts.

verses.english:
You shall not do any act of work. And you shall bring
forward an offering by fire to YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not do any act of work. And you shall bring
forward an offering by fire to YHWH.”

translation.text: You shall not work at your occupations; and you shall present the LORD's offering by fire.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Just: On the tenth of this seventh month, it is the Day
of Atonement. You shall have a holy assembly, and you
shall degrade yourselves. And you shall bring forward an
offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה יוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הוּא מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה יוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הוּא מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Just: On the tenth of this seventh month, it is the Day
of Atonement. You shall have a holy assembly, and you
shall degrade yourselves. And you shall bring forward an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: Now, the tenth day of this fire;

verses.english:
And you shall not do any work on this very day, because it
is a day of atonement, to atone for you in front of YHWH,
your God.
verses.hebrew: וְכל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפֻּרִים הוּא לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפֻּרִים הוּא לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not do any work on this very day, because it
is a day of atonement, to atone for you in front of YHWH,
your God.

translation.text: and you shall do no work during that entire day; for it is a day your God.

verses.english:
Because any person who will not be degraded on this very
day will be cut off from his people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כל הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא תְעֻנֶּה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְנִכְרְתָה מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא תְעֻנֶּה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְנִכְרְתָה מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
Because any person who will not be degraded on this very
day will be cut off from his people.

translation.text: For anyone who does not practice self-denial during that entire day shall be cut off from the people.

verses.english:
And any person who will do any work in this very day: I
shall destroy that person from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה כּל מְלָאכָה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה כּל מְלָאכָה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
And any person who will do any work in this very day: I
shall destroy that person from among his people.

translation.text: And anyone who does midst of the people.

verses.english:
You shall not do any work: an eternal law through your
generations in all your homes.
verses.hebrew: כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not do any work: an eternal law through your
generations in all your homes.

translation.text: You shall do no work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your settlements.

verses.english:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, for you, and you shall degrade
yourselves: on the ninth of the month in the evening, from
evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
verses.hebrew: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הוּא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב מֵעֶרֶב עַד עֶרֶב תִּשְׁבְּתוּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הוּא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב מֵעֶרֶב עַד עֶרֶב תִּשְׁבְּתוּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, for you, and you shall degrade
yourselves: on the ninth of the month in the evening, from
evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

translation.text: It shall be to keep your sabbath.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth
day of this seventh month is the Festival of Booths, seven
days, for YHWH.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃
