hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth
day of this seventh month is the Festival of Booths, seven
days, for YHWH.

translation.text: Speak to the people of Israel, days, there shall be the festival of booths to the LORD.

verses.english:
On the first day is a holy assembly. You shall not do any
act of work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
On the first day is a holy assembly. You shall not do any
act of work.

translation.text: The first day shall be a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.

verses.english:
For seven days you shall bring forward an offering by fire
to YHWH. On the eighth day you shall have a holy assembly,
and you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH.
It is a convocation. You shall not do any act of work.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּקְרִיבוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֲצֶרֶת הִוא כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּקְרִיבוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֲצֶרֶת הִוא כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
For seven days you shall bring forward an offering by fire
to YHWH. On the eighth day you shall have a holy assembly,
and you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH.
It is a convocation. You shall not do any act of work.

translation.text: Seven days you shall present the LORD's offerings by fire; on the eighth occupations.

verses.english:
“These are YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call
holy assemblies, to bring forward an offering by fire to
YHWH: burnt offering and grain offering, sacrifice and
libations, each day’s thing on its day,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה זֶבַח וּנְסָכִים דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה זֶבַח וּנְסָכִים דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
“These are YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call
holy assemblies, to bring forward an offering by fire to
YHWH: burnt offering and grain offering, sacrifice and
libations, each day’s thing on its day,

translation.text: These are the appointed festivals of the LORD, which you shall offerings by fire — burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its proper day —

verses.english:
aside from YHWH’s Sabbaths and aside from your gifts and
aside from all of your vows and aside from all of your
contributions that you will give to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד שַׁבְּתֹת יְהֹוָה וּמִלְּבַד מַתְּנוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כּל נִדְרֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כּל נִדְבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִלְּבַד שַׁבְּתֹת יְהֹוָה וּמִלְּבַד מַתְּנוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כּל נִדְרֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כּל נִדְבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
aside from YHWH’s Sabbaths and aside from your gifts and
aside from all of your vows and aside from all of your
contributions that you will give to YHWH.

translation.text: apart from the sabbaths of offerings, and apart from all your freewill offerings, which you give to the LORD.

verses.english:
“Just: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month when you
gather the land’s produce, you shall celebrate YHWH’s
holiday seven days. On the first day is a ceasing, and on
the eighth day is a ceasing.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאסְפְּכֶם אֶת תְּבוּאַת הָאָרֶץ תָּחֹגּוּ אֶת חַג יְהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן שַׁבָּתוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שַׁבָּתוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאסְפְּכֶם אֶת תְּבוּאַת הָאָרֶץ תָּחֹגּוּ אֶת חַג יְהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן שַׁבָּתוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שַׁבָּתוֹן׃

english.text:
“Just: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month when you
gather the land’s produce, you shall celebrate YHWH’s
holiday seven days. On the first day is a ceasing, and on
the eighth day is a ceasing.

translation.text: Now, the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the produce of the land, you shall keep the festival of the complete rest on the eighth day.

verses.english:
And on the first day you shall take fruit of appealing
trees, branches of palms, boughs of thick trees, and
willows of a wadi, and you shall be happy in front of
YHWH, your God, seven days.
verses.hebrew: וּלְקַחְתֶּם לָכֶם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן פְּרִי עֵץ הָדָר כַּפֹּת תְּמָרִים וַעֲנַף עֵץ עָבֹת וְעַרְבֵי נָחַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וּלְקַחְתֶּם לָכֶם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן פְּרִי עֵץ הָדָר כַּפֹּת תְּמָרִים וַעֲנַף עֵץ עָבֹת וְעַרְבֵי נָחַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And on the first day you shall take fruit of appealing
trees, branches of palms, boughs of thick trees, and
willows of a wadi, and you shall be happy in front of
YHWH, your God, seven days.

translation.text: On the first day you shall take the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, boughs of leafy trees, God for seven days.

verses.english:
And you shall celebrate it, a holiday to YHWH, seven days
in the year, an eternal law through your generations; you
shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.hebrew: וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּחֹגּוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּחֹגּוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall celebrate it, a holiday to YHWH, seven days
in the year, an eternal law through your generations; you
shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

translation.text: You shall keep it as a festival to the LORD seven forever throughout your generations.

verses.english:
You shall live in booths seven days. Every citizen in
Israel shall live in booths,
verses.hebrew: בַּסֻּכֹּת תֵּשְׁבוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כּל הָאֶזְרָח בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יֵשְׁבוּ בַּסֻּכֹּת׃

hebrew.text: בַּסֻּכֹּת תֵּשְׁבוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כּל הָאֶזְרָח בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יֵשְׁבוּ בַּסֻּכֹּת׃

english.text:
You shall live in booths seven days. Every citizen in
Israel shall live in booths,

translation.text: You shall live in booths for seven days; all that are citizens in Israel shall live in booths,

verses.english:
so your generations will know that I had the children of
Israel live in booths when I brought them out from the
land of Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.”
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דֹרֹתֵיכֶם כִּי בַסֻּכּוֹת הוֹשַׁבְתִּי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהוֹצִיאִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דֹרֹתֵיכֶם כִּי בַסֻּכּוֹת הוֹשַׁבְתִּי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהוֹצִיאִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
so your generations will know that I had the children of
Israel live in booths when I brought them out from the
land of Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: so that your God.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke YHWH’s appointed times to the children of
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke YHWH’s appointed times to the children of
Israel.

translation.text: Thus Moses declared to the people of Israel the appointed festivals of the LORD.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel that they shall take clear
pressed olive oil to you for the light, to keep up a lamp
always.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel that they shall take clear
pressed olive oil to you for the light, to keep up a lamp
always.

translation.text: Command the people of Israel to kept burning regularly.

verses.english:
Outside of the pavilion of the Testimony, in the Tent of
Meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening until morning
in front of YHWH always, an eternal law through your
generations.
verses.hebrew: מִחוּץ לְפָרֹכֶת הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מִחוּץ לְפָרֹכֶת הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Outside of the pavilion of the Testimony, in the Tent of
Meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening until morning
in front of YHWH always, an eternal law through your
generations.

translation.text: Aaron shall set it up in the tent of meeting, before the LORD regularly; it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

verses.english:
He shall arrange the lamps on the pure menorah in front of
YHWH always.
verses.hebrew: עַל הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה יַעֲרֹךְ אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: עַל הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה יַעֲרֹךְ אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
He shall arrange the lamps on the pure menorah in front of
YHWH always.

translation.text: He shall set up the lamps on the lampstand of pure gold before the LORD regularly.

verses.english:
“And you shall take fine flour and bake it into twelve
loaves: each loaf shall be two-tenths of a measure.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ סֹלֶת וְאָפִיתָ אֹתָהּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה חַלּוֹת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים יִהְיֶה הַחַלָּה הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ סֹלֶת וְאָפִיתָ אֹתָהּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה חַלּוֹת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים יִהְיֶה הַחַלָּה הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
“And you shall take fine flour and bake it into twelve
loaves: each loaf shall be two-tenths of a measure.

translation.text: You shall take choice flour, and bake twelve loaves of it; two-tenths of an ephah shall be in each loaf.

verses.english:
And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the
pure table in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אוֹתָם שְׁתַּיִם מַעֲרָכוֹת שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲרָכֶת עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן הַטָּהֹר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אוֹתָם שְׁתַּיִם מַעֲרָכוֹת שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲרָכֶת עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן הַטָּהֹר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the
pure table in front of YHWH.

translation.text: You shall place them in two rows, six in a row, on the table of pure gold.

verses.english:
And you shall put clear frankincense on each row, and it
will be a representative portion for the bread, an
offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְבֹנָה זַכָּה וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְבֹנָה זַכָּה וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall put clear frankincense on each row, and it
will be a representative portion for the bread, an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: You shall put pure frankincense with each row, to be a token offering for the bread, as an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
On the Sabbath day, on the Sabbath day, he shall arrange
it in front of YHWH always from the children of Israel, an
eternal covenant.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת יַעַרְכֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת יַעַרְכֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
On the Sabbath day, on the Sabbath day, he shall arrange
it in front of YHWH always from the children of Israel, an
eternal covenant.

translation.text: Every sabbath day Aaron shall set them Israel, as a covenant forever.

verses.english:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’, and they shall eat
it in a holy place, because it is the holy of holies to
him from YHWH’s offerings by fire, an eternal law.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וַאֲכָלֻהוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לוֹ מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חק עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וַאֲכָלֻהוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לוֹ מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חק עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’, and they shall eat
it in a holy place, because it is the holy of holies to
him from YHWH’s offerings by fire, an eternal law.”

translation.text: They shall be for Aaron and his descendants, who shall eat them in a holy place, for they are most holy due.

verses.english:
And a son of an Israelite woman—and he was a son of an Egyptian
man—went out among the children of Israel, and the son of the
Israelite woman fought with an Israelite man in the camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא בֶּן אִשָּׁה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְהוּא בֶּן אִישׁ מִצְרִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּנָּצוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה בֶּן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית וְאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא בֶּן אִשָּׁה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְהוּא בֶּן אִישׁ מִצְרִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּנָּצוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה בֶּן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית וְאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי׃

english.text:
And a son of an Israelite woman—and he was a son of an Egyptian
man—went out among the children of Israel, and the son of the
Israelite woman fought with an Israelite man in the camp.

translation.text: A man whose mother was an Israelite and whose father was an woman's son and a certain Israelite began fighting in the camp.

verses.english:
And the son of the Israelite woman profaned the name and
cursed. And they brought him to Moses. And his mother’s
name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of
Dan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֹּב בֶּן הָאִשָּׁה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית אֶת הַשֵּׁם וַיְקַלֵּל וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ שְׁלֹמִית בַּת דִּבְרִי לְמַטֵּה דָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֹּב בֶּן הָאִשָּׁה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית אֶת הַשֵּׁם וַיְקַלֵּל וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ שְׁלֹמִית בַּת דִּבְרִי לְמַטֵּה דָן׃

english.text:
And the son of the Israelite woman profaned the name and
cursed. And they brought him to Moses. And his mother’s
name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of
Dan.

translation.text: The daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan —

verses.english:
And they left him under watch, to determine it for them by
YHWH’s word.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָר לִפְרֹשׁ לָהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָר לִפְרֹשׁ לָהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they left him under watch, to determine it for them by
YHWH’s word.

translation.text: and they put him in custody, until the decision of the LORD should be made clear to them.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Take out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and let all who heard lay their hands on his head, and all
the congregation shall batter him.
verses.hebrew: הוֹצֵא אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְסָמְכוּ כל הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְרָגְמוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: הוֹצֵא אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְסָמְכוּ כל הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְרָגְמוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
“Take out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and let all who heard lay their hands on his head, and all
the congregation shall batter him.

translation.text: Take the blasphemer outside the and let the whole congregation stone him.

verses.english:
“And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying:
Any man who curses his God: he shall bear his sin.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יְקַלֵּל אֱלֹהָיו וְנָשָׂא חֶטְאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יְקַלֵּל אֱלֹהָיו וְנָשָׂא חֶטְאוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying:
Any man who curses his God: he shall bear his sin.

translation.text: And speak to the people of Israel, saying: Anyone who curses God shall bear the sin.

verses.english:
And one who profanes YHWH’s name shall be put to death.
All the congregation shall batter him. The same for the
alien and the citizen: when he profanes the name he shall
be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹקֵב שֵׁם יְהֹוָה מוֹת יוּמָת רָגוֹם יִרְגְּמוּ בוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח בְּנקְבוֹ שֵׁם יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְנֹקֵב שֵׁם יְהֹוָה מוֹת יוּמָת רָגוֹם יִרְגְּמוּ בוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח בְּנקְבוֹ שֵׁם יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And one who profanes YHWH’s name shall be put to death.
All the congregation shall batter him. The same for the
alien and the citizen: when he profanes the name he shall
be put to death.

translation.text: One who when they blaspheme the Name, shall be put to death.

verses.english:
“And a man who will strike any human’s life shall be put
to death,
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַכֶּה כּל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַכֶּה כּל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
“And a man who will strike any human’s life shall be put
to death,

translation.text: Anyone who kills a human being shall be put to death.

verses.english:
and one who strikes an animal’s life shall pay for it: a
life for a life.
verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
and one who strikes an animal’s life shall pay for it: a
life for a life.

translation.text: Anyone who kills an animal shall make restitution for it, life for life.

verses.english:
And a man who will make an injury in his fellow: as he has
done, so it shall be done to him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִתֵּן מוּם בַּעֲמִיתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִתֵּן מוּם בַּעֲמִיתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
And a man who will make an injury in his fellow: as he has
done, so it shall be done to him.

translation.text: Anyone who maims another shall suffer the same injury in return:

verses.english:
A break for a break, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a
tooth: as he will make an injury in a human, so it shall
be made in him.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁבֶר תַּחַת שֶׁבֶר עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מוּם בָּאָדָם כֵּן יִנָּתֶן בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: שֶׁבֶר תַּחַת שֶׁבֶר עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מוּם בָּאָדָם כֵּן יִנָּתֶן בּוֹ׃

english.text:
A break for a break, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a
tooth: as he will make an injury in a human, so it shall
be made in him.

translation.text: fracture for fracture, suffered.

verses.english:
And one who strikes an animal shall pay for it, and one
who strikes a human shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה בְהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה וּמַכֵּה אָדָם יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וּמַכֵּה בְהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה וּמַכֵּה אָדָם יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And one who strikes an animal shall pay for it, and one
who strikes a human shall be put to death.

translation.text: One who kills an animal shall make restitution for it; but one who kills a human being shall be put to death.

verses.english:
You shall have one judgment: it will be the same for the
alien and the citizen; because I am YHWH, your God.”
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפַּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח יִהְיֶה כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מִשְׁפַּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח יִהְיֶה כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall have one judgment: it will be the same for the
alien and the citizen; because I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: You shall have one law for the alien and for the citizen: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke to the children of Israel. And they
brought out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and they battered him with stone. And the children of
Israel had done as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ אָבֶן וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ אָבֶן וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke to the children of Israel. And they
brought out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and they battered him with stone. And the children of
Israel had done as YHWH commanded Moses.

translation.text: Israel did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you, then the land shall have a Sabbath for YHWH.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וְשָׁבְתָה הָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וְשָׁבְתָה הָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you, then the land shall have a Sabbath for YHWH.

translation.text: Speak to the giving you, the land shall observe a sabbath for the LORD.

verses.english:
Six years you shall seed your field, and six years you
shall prune your vineyard, and you shall gather its
produce.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע שָׂדֶךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְמֹר כַּרְמֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע שָׂדֶךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְמֹר כַּרְמֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
Six years you shall seed your field, and six years you
shall prune your vineyard, and you shall gather its
produce.

translation.text: Six years and gather in their yield;

verses.english:
And in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath, a
ceasing, a Sabbath for YHWH: you shall not seed your
field, and you shall not prune your vineyard,
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרָע וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תִזְמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרָע וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תִזְמֹר׃

english.text:
And in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath, a
ceasing, a Sabbath for YHWH: you shall not seed your
field, and you shall not prune your vineyard,

translation.text: but in the seventh year there shall be a sabbath of complete rest for the land, a sabbath for the LORD: you shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

verses.english:
you shall not reap your harvest’s free growth, and you
shall not cut off your untrimmed grapes. The land shall
have a year of ceasing.
verses.hebrew: אֵת סְפִיחַ קְצִירְךָ לֹא תִקְצוֹר וְאֶת עִנְּבֵי נְזִירֶךָ לֹא תִבְצֹר שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: אֵת סְפִיחַ קְצִירְךָ לֹא תִקְצוֹר וְאֶת עִנְּבֵי נְזִירֶךָ לֹא תִבְצֹר שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
you shall not reap your harvest’s free growth, and you
shall not cut off your untrimmed grapes. The land shall
have a year of ceasing.

translation.text: You shall not reap the vine: it shall be a year of complete rest for the land.

verses.english:
And the land’s Sabbath shall be yours for food: for you
and for your servant and for your maid and for your
employee and for your visitor who are residing with you
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ לָכֶם לְאכְלָה לְךָ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלִשְׂכִירְךָ וּלְתוֹשָׁבְךָ הַגָּרִים עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ לָכֶם לְאכְלָה לְךָ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלִשְׂכִירְךָ וּלְתוֹשָׁבְךָ הַגָּרִים עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And the land’s Sabbath shall be yours for food: for you
and for your servant and for your maid and for your
employee and for your visitor who are residing with you

translation.text: You may eat slaves, your hired and your bound laborers who live with you;

verses.english:
and for your domestic animal and for the wild animal that
are in your land shall be all of its produce to eat.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְהֶמְתְּךָ וְלַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצֶךָ תִּהְיֶה כל תְּבוּאָתָהּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְהֶמְתְּךָ וְלַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצֶךָ תִּהְיֶה כל תְּבוּאָתָהּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

english.text:
and for your domestic animal and for the wild animal that
are in your land shall be all of its produce to eat.

translation.text: for your livestock also, and for the wild animals in your land all its yield shall be for food.

verses.english:
“And you shall count seven Sabbaths of years: seven years,
seven times. And the days of the seven Sabbaths of years
shall be for you forty-nine years.
verses.hebrew: וְסָפַרְתָּ לְךָ שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ יְמֵי שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת הַשָּׁנִים תֵּשַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָפַרְתָּ לְךָ שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ יְמֵי שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת הַשָּׁנִים תֵּשַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall count seven Sabbaths of years: seven years,
seven times. And the days of the seven Sabbaths of years
shall be for you forty-nine years.

translation.text: You shall count off seven weeks of years, seven times seven years, so that the period of seven weeks of years gives forty-nine years.

verses.english:
And you shall pass a blasting horn in the seventh month on
the tenth of the month: on the Day of Atonement you shall
have the horn pass through all your land.
verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים תַּעֲבִירוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּכל אַרְצְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים תַּעֲבִירוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּכל אַרְצְכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall pass a blasting horn in the seventh month on
the tenth of the month: on the Day of Atonement you shall
have the horn pass through all your land.

translation.text: Then trumpet sounded throughout all your land.

verses.english:
And you shall consecrate the year that makes fifty years
and proclaim liberty in the land, to all its inhabitants.
It shall be a jubilee for you. And you shall go back, each
to his possession; and you shall go back, each to his
family.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם אֵת שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר בָּאָרֶץ לְכל יֹשְׁבֶיהָ יוֹבֵל הִוא תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תָּשֻׁבוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם אֵת שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר בָּאָרֶץ לְכל יֹשְׁבֶיהָ יוֹבֵל הִוא תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תָּשֻׁבוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall consecrate the year that makes fifty years
and proclaim liberty in the land, to all its inhabitants.
It shall be a jubilee for you. And you shall go back, each
to his possession; and you shall go back, each to his
family.

translation.text: And you shall hallow the fiftieth year and you shall proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you: you shall return, every one of you, to your property and every one of you to your family.

verses.english:
It, the year that makes fifty years, shall be a jubilee
for you. You shall not seed, and you shall not harvest its
free growths, and you shall not cut off its untrimmed
fruits,
verses.hebrew: יוֹבֵל הִוא שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם לֹא תִזְרָעוּ וְלֹא תִקְצְרוּ אֶת סְפִיחֶיהָ וְלֹא תִבְצְרוּ אֶת נְזִרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: יוֹבֵל הִוא שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם לֹא תִזְרָעוּ וְלֹא תִקְצְרוּ אֶת סְפִיחֶיהָ וְלֹא תִבְצְרוּ אֶת נְזִרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
It, the year that makes fifty years, shall be a jubilee
for you. You shall not seed, and you shall not harvest its
free growths, and you shall not cut off its untrimmed
fruits,

translation.text: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you: you shall not sow, or reap the aftergrowth, or harvest the unpruned vines.

verses.english:
because it is a jubilee; it shall be a holy thing to you.
You shall eat its produce from the field.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יוֹבֵל הִוא קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יוֹבֵל הִוא קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
because it is a jubilee; it shall be a holy thing to you.
You shall eat its produce from the field.

translation.text: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you: you shall eat only what the field itself produces.

verses.english:
In this jubilee year you shall go back, each to his
possession.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת תָּשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת תָּשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
In this jubilee year you shall go back, each to his
possession.

translation.text: In this year of jubilee you shall return, every one of you, to your property.

verses.english:
And when you will make a sale to your fellow or buy from
your fellow’s hand: each of you, do not persecute his
brother.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִמְכְּרוּ מִמְכָּר לַעֲמִיתֶךָ אוֹ קָנֹה מִיַּד עֲמִיתֶךָ אַל תּוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִמְכְּרוּ מִמְכָּר לַעֲמִיתֶךָ אוֹ קָנֹה מִיַּד עֲמִיתֶךָ אַל תּוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And when you will make a sale to your fellow or buy from
your fellow’s hand: each of you, do not persecute his
brother.

translation.text: When you make a sale to your neighbor or buy from your neighbor, you shall not cheat one another.

verses.english:
You shall buy from your fellow by the number of years
after the jubilee. He shall sell to you by the number of
years of yields—
verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים אַחַר הַיּוֹבֵל תִּקְנֶה מֵאֵת עֲמִיתֶךָ בְּמִסְפַּר שְׁנֵי תְבוּאֹת יִמְכּר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים אַחַר הַיּוֹבֵל תִּקְנֶה מֵאֵת עֲמִיתֶךָ בְּמִסְפַּר שְׁנֵי תְבוּאֹת יִמְכּר לָךְ׃

english.text:
You shall buy from your fellow by the number of years
after the jubilee. He shall sell to you by the number of
years of yields—

translation.text: When you buy from your neighbor, you shall pay only for the number of years since the jubilee; the seller shall charge you only for the remaining crop years.

verses.english:
corresponding to a greater amount of the years, you shall
make its price greater; and corresponding to a smaller
amount of the years, you shall make its price
smaller—because it is a number of yields that he is
selling to you.
verses.hebrew: לְפִי רֹב הַשָּׁנִים תַּרְבֶּה מִקְנָתוֹ וּלְפִי מְעֹט הַשָּׁנִים תַּמְעִיט מִקְנָתוֹ כִּי מִסְפַּר תְּבוּאֹת הוּא מֹכֵר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: לְפִי רֹב הַשָּׁנִים תַּרְבֶּה מִקְנָתוֹ וּלְפִי מְעֹט הַשָּׁנִים תַּמְעִיט מִקְנָתוֹ כִּי מִסְפַּר תְּבוּאֹת הוּא מֹכֵר לָךְ׃

english.text:
corresponding to a greater amount of the years, you shall
make its price greater; and corresponding to a smaller
amount of the years, you shall make its price
smaller—because it is a number of yields that he is
selling to you.

translation.text: If the years are more, you shall increase the price, and if the years are fewer, you shall diminish the price; for it is a certain number of harvests that are being sold to you.

verses.english:
And you shall not persecute—each of you—his brother, but
you shall fear your God, because I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not persecute—each of you—his brother, but
you shall fear your God, because I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: You shall not cheat one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“And you shall do my laws and observe my judgments and do
them, so you will live on the land in security.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וִישַׁבְתֶּם עַל הָאָרֶץ לָבֶטַח׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וִישַׁבְתֶּם עַל הָאָרֶץ לָבֶטַח׃

english.text:
“And you shall do my laws and observe my judgments and do
them, so you will live on the land in security.

translation.text: You shall observe my statutes and faithfully keep my ordinances, so that you may live on the land securely.

verses.english:
And the land will give its fruit, and you will eat to the
full, and you will live in security on it.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And the land will give its fruit, and you will eat to the
full, and you will live in security on it.

translation.text: The land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live on it securely.

verses.english:
And if you will say, ‘What shall we eat in the seventh
year? Here, we won’t seed and won’t gather our produce,’
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תֹאמְרוּ מַה נֹּאכַל בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת הֵן לֹא נִזְרָע וְלֹא נֶאֱסֹף אֶת תְּבוּאָתֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תֹאמְרוּ מַה נֹּאכַל בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת הֵן לֹא נִזְרָע וְלֹא נֶאֱסֹף אֶת תְּבוּאָתֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And if you will say, ‘What shall we eat in the seventh
year? Here, we won’t seed and won’t gather our produce,’

translation.text: Should you ask, our crop?"

verses.english:
I shall command my blessing for you in the sixth year, and
it will make the produce for the three years.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוִּיתִי אֶת בִּרְכָתִי לָכֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית וְעָשָׂת אֶת הַתְּבוּאָה לִשְׁלֹשׁ הַשָּׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוִּיתִי אֶת בִּרְכָתִי לָכֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית וְעָשָׂת אֶת הַתְּבוּאָה לִשְׁלֹשׁ הַשָּׁנִים׃

english.text:
I shall command my blessing for you in the sixth year, and
it will make the produce for the three years.

translation.text: I will order my blessing for you in the sixth year, so that it will yield a crop for three years.

verses.english:
And you will seed the eighth year and eat from the old
produce until the ninth year; you will eat the old until
its produce comes.
verses.hebrew: וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֵת הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמִינִת וַאֲכַלְתֶּם מִן הַתְּבוּאָה יָשָׁן עַד הַשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִת עַד בּוֹא תְּבוּאָתָהּ תֹּאכְלוּ יָשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֵת הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמִינִת וַאֲכַלְתֶּם מִן הַתְּבוּאָה יָשָׁן עַד הַשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִת עַד בּוֹא תְּבוּאָתָהּ תֹּאכְלוּ יָשָׁן׃

english.text:
And you will seed the eighth year and eat from the old
produce until the ninth year; you will eat the old until
its produce comes.

translation.text: When you sow in the eighth year, produce comes in, you shall eat the old.

verses.english:
But the land shall not be sold permanently, because the
land is mine, because you are aliens and visitors with me!
verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ לֹא תִמָּכֵר לִצְמִתֻת כִּי לִי הָאָרֶץ כִּי גֵרִים וְתוֹשָׁבִים אַתֶּם עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאָרֶץ לֹא תִמָּכֵר לִצְמִתֻת כִּי לִי הָאָרֶץ כִּי גֵרִים וְתוֹשָׁבִים אַתֶּם עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
But the land shall not be sold permanently, because the
land is mine, because you are aliens and visitors with me!

translation.text: The land shall not be sold in tenants.

verses.english:
So in all the land in your possession you shall give a
redemption for the land.
verses.hebrew: וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם גְּאֻלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם גְּאֻלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
So in all the land in your possession you shall give a
redemption for the land.

translation.text: Throughout the land that you hold, you shall provide for the redemption of the land.

verses.english:
When your brother will be low so that he will sell any of his
possession, then his redeemer who is the closest relative to him
shall come and redeem his brother’s sale.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָכַר מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ וּבָא גֹאֲלוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו וְגָאַל אֵת מִמְכַּר אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָכַר מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ וּבָא גֹאֲלוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו וְגָאַל אֵת מִמְכַּר אָחִיו׃

english.text:
When your brother will be low so that he will sell any of his
possession, then his redeemer who is the closest relative to him
shall come and redeem his brother’s sale.

translation.text: If anyone of your kin falls into difficulty and sells a piece of has sold.

verses.english:
And when a man will not have a redeemer, but his hand has
come to attain it and he has found enough for his
redemption,
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ גֹּאֵל וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וּמָצָא כְּדֵי גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ גֹּאֵל וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וּמָצָא כְּדֵי גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And when a man will not have a redeemer, but his hand has
come to attain it and he has found enough for his
redemption,

translation.text: If the person has no one to redeem it, but then prospers and finds sufficient means to do so,

verses.english:
then he shall figure the years of his sale and pay back
what is left over to the man to whom he sold it, and he
shall go back to his possession.
verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב אֶת שְׁנֵי מִמְכָּרוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הָעֹדֵף לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָכַר לוֹ וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְחִשַּׁב אֶת שְׁנֵי מִמְכָּרוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הָעֹדֵף לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָכַר לוֹ וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
then he shall figure the years of his sale and pay back
what is left over to the man to whom he sold it, and he
shall go back to his possession.

translation.text: the years since its sale shall be it was sold, and the property shall be returned.

verses.english:
And if his hand has not found enough to pay it back to
him, then his sale shall be in the hand of the one who
bought it until the jubilee year, and it shall come out in
the jubilee, and he shall go back to his possession.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא מָצְאָה יָדוֹ דֵּי הָשִׁיב לוֹ וְהָיָה מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּיַד הַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל וְיָצָא בַּיֹּבֵל וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא מָצְאָה יָדוֹ דֵּי הָשִׁיב לוֹ וְהָיָה מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּיַד הַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל וְיָצָא בַּיֹּבֵל וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And if his hand has not found enough to pay it back to
him, then his sale shall be in the hand of the one who
bought it until the jubilee year, and it shall come out in
the jubilee, and he shall go back to his possession.

translation.text: But if there are not purchaser until the year of jubilee; in the jubilee it shall be released, and the property shall be returned.

verses.english:
“And when a man will sell a home in a walled city, then
its redemption shall be until the end of the year of its
sale. Its redemption shall be for days.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמְכֹּר בֵּית מוֹשַׁב עִיר חוֹמָה וְהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתוֹ עַד תֹּם שְׁנַת מִמְכָּרוֹ יָמִים תִּהְיֶה גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמְכֹּר בֵּית מוֹשַׁב עִיר חוֹמָה וְהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתוֹ עַד תֹּם שְׁנַת מִמְכָּרוֹ יָמִים תִּהְיֶה גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And when a man will sell a home in a walled city, then
its redemption shall be until the end of the year of its
sale. Its redemption shall be for days.

translation.text: If anyone sells a dwelling house in a walled city, it may be redeemed until a year has elapsed since its sale; the right of redemption shall be one year.

verses.english:
And if it will not be redeemed by the completion of a full
year for it, then the house that is in a city that has a
wall shall be established permanently for the one who
bought it, through his generations. It shall not come out
in the jubilee.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל עַד מְלֹאת לוֹ שָׁנָה תְמִימָה וְקָם הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) חֹמָה לַצְּמִיתֻת לַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ לְדֹרֹתָיו לֹא יֵצֵא בַּיֹּבֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל עַד מְלֹאת לוֹ שָׁנָה תְמִימָה וְקָם הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) חֹמָה לַצְּמִיתֻת לַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ לְדֹרֹתָיו לֹא יֵצֵא בַּיֹּבֵל׃

english.text:
And if it will not be redeemed by the completion of a full
year for it, then the house that is in a city that has a
wall shall be established permanently for the one who
bought it, through his generations. It shall not come out
in the jubilee.

translation.text: If it is not redeemed before a full year has elapsed, a house that is in a walled city shall pass in perpetuity to the purchaser, throughout the generations; it shall not be released in the jubilee.

verses.english:
“As for houses of the villages that do not have a wall
around them: it shall be figured along with the land’s
field. It shall have redemption, and it shall come out in
the jubilee.
verses.hebrew: וּבָתֵּי הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם חֹמָה סָבִיב עַל שְׂדֵה הָאָרֶץ יֵחָשֵׁב גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ וּבַיֹּבֵל יֵצֵא׃

hebrew.text: וּבָתֵּי הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם חֹמָה סָבִיב עַל שְׂדֵה הָאָרֶץ יֵחָשֵׁב גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ וּבַיֹּבֵל יֵצֵא׃

english.text:
“As for houses of the villages that do not have a wall
around them: it shall be figured along with the land’s
field. It shall have redemption, and it shall come out in
the jubilee.

translation.text: the jubilee.

verses.english:
“As for the Levites’ cities, the houses in the cities of
their possession: the Levites shall have eternal
redemption.
verses.hebrew: וְעָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בָּתֵּי עָרֵי אֲחֻזָּתָם גְּאֻלַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בָּתֵּי עָרֵי אֲחֻזָּתָם גְּאֻלַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
“As for the Levites’ cities, the houses in the cities of
their possession: the Levites shall have eternal
redemption.

translation.text: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites shall forever them.

verses.english:
And that which one from the Levites will redeem: it shall
come out, a sale of a house and of a city of his
possession, in the jubilee, because that—the houses of the
Levites’ cities—is their possession among the children of
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר יִגְאַל מִן הַלְוִיִּם וְיָצָא מִמְכַּר בַּיִת וְעִיר אֲחֻזָּתוֹ בַּיֹּבֵל כִּי בָתֵּי עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם הִוא אֲחֻזָּתָם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר יִגְאַל מִן הַלְוִיִּם וְיָצָא מִמְכַּר בַּיִת וְעִיר אֲחֻזָּתוֹ בַּיֹּבֵל כִּי בָתֵּי עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם הִוא אֲחֻזָּתָם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And that which one from the Levites will redeem: it shall
come out, a sale of a house and of a city of his
possession, in the jubilee, because that—the houses of the
Levites’ cities—is their possession among the children of
Israel.

translation.text: Such property as may be redeemed from the Levites — houses sold in a city belonging to them — shall be released in the jubilee; among the people of Israel.

verses.english:
But a field of their cities’ surrounding land shall not be
sold, because it is an eternal possession for them.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂדֵה מִגְרַשׁ עָרֵיהֶם לֹא יִמָּכֵר כִּי אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם הוּא לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂדֵה מִגְרַשׁ עָרֵיהֶם לֹא יִמָּכֵר כִּי אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם הוּא לָהֶם׃

english.text:
But a field of their cities’ surrounding land shall not be
sold, because it is an eternal possession for them.

translation.text: But the open land around their cities may not be sold; for that is their possession for all time.

verses.english:
“And when your brother will be low so that his hand is
slipping with you, then you shall take hold of him—an
alien and a visitor—and he shall live with you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָטָה יָדוֹ עִמָּךְ וְהֶחֱזַקְתָּ בּוֹ גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וָחַי עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָטָה יָדוֹ עִמָּךְ וְהֶחֱזַקְתָּ בּוֹ גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וָחַי עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And when your brother will be low so that his hand is
slipping with you, then you shall take hold of him—an
alien and a visitor—and he shall live with you.

translation.text: If any of your kin fall into difficulty and become dependent on you, aliens.

verses.english:
Do not take interest or a charge from him; but you shall
fear your God, and your brother will live with you.
verses.hebrew: אַל תִּקַּח מֵאִתּוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ וְחֵי אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּקַּח מֵאִתּוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ וְחֵי אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Do not take interest or a charge from him; but you shall
fear your God, and your brother will live with you.

translation.text: Do not take interest in advance or otherwise make a profit from them, but fear your God; let them live with you.

verses.english:
You shall not give him your money for interest, and you
shall not give him your food for a charge.
verses.hebrew: אֶת כַּסְפְּךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית לֹא תִתֵּן אכְלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת כַּסְפְּךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית לֹא תִתֵּן אכְלֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not give him your money for interest, and you
shall not give him your food for a charge.

translation.text: You shall not food at a profit.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be God to you.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be God to you.

translation.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, to be your God.

verses.english:
“And when your brother will be low with you so that he is
sold to you, you shall not have him work a slave’s work.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ וְנִמְכַּר לָךְ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבֹדַת עָבֶד׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ וְנִמְכַּר לָךְ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבֹדַת עָבֶד׃

english.text:
“And when your brother will be low with you so that he is
sold to you, you shall not have him work a slave’s work.

translation.text: If any who are dependent on you become so impoverished that they sell themselves to you, you shall not make them serve as slaves.

verses.english:
He shall be like an employee, like a visitor, with you. He
shall work with you until the jubilee year.
verses.hebrew: כְּשָׂכִיר כְּתוֹשָׁב יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַעֲבֹד עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: כְּשָׂכִיר כְּתוֹשָׁב יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַעֲבֹד עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
He shall be like an employee, like a visitor, with you. He
shall work with you until the jubilee year.

translation.text: They shall remain with you as hired or bound laborers. They shall serve with you until the year of the jubilee.

verses.english:
And he shall go out from you, he and his children with
him, and go back to his family, and he shall go back to
his fathers’ possession.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא מֵעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ וְשָׁב אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְאֶל אֲחֻזַּת אֲבֹתָיו יָשׁוּב׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא מֵעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ וְשָׁב אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְאֶל אֲחֻזַּת אֲבֹתָיו יָשׁוּב׃

english.text:
And he shall go out from you, he and his children with
him, and go back to his family, and he shall go back to
his fathers’ possession.

translation.text: Then they and their children with them shall be free from your authority; they shall go back to their own family and return to their ancestral property.

verses.english:
Because they are my servants, whom I brought out from the
land of Egypt; they shall not be sold like the sale of a
slave.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָבֶד׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָבֶד׃

english.text:
Because they are my servants, whom I brought out from the
land of Egypt; they shall not be sold like the sale of a
slave.

translation.text: For they are my sold as slaves are sold.

verses.english:
You shall not dominate him with harshness, but you shall
fear your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not dominate him with harshness, but you shall
fear your God.

translation.text: You shall not rule over them with harshness, but shall fear your God.

verses.english:
“And your slave and your maid that you will have: from the
nations that are around you, you shall buy a slave or a
maid from them.
verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ לָךְ מֵאֵת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ עֶבֶד וְאָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ לָךְ מֵאֵת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ עֶבֶד וְאָמָה׃

english.text:
“And your slave and your maid that you will have: from the
nations that are around you, you shall buy a slave or a
maid from them.

translation.text: As for the male and female slaves whom male and female slaves.

verses.english:
And also from the children of the visitors who reside with
you—you shall buy from them and from their families that
are with you—to whom they gave birth in your land. And
they shall become a possession for you.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם מִבְּנֵי הַתּוֹשָׁבִים הַגָּרִים עִמָּכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם אֲשֶׁר עִמָּכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם מִבְּנֵי הַתּוֹשָׁבִים הַגָּרִים עִמָּכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם אֲשֶׁר עִמָּכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

english.text:
And also from the children of the visitors who reside with
you—you shall buy from them and from their families that
are with you—to whom they gave birth in your land. And
they shall become a possession for you.

translation.text: You may also acquire them from among the aliens residing with you, and from their families that are with you, who have been born in your land; and they may be your property.

verses.english:
And you shall make them a legacy for your children after
you to inherit as a possession. You may have them work
forever, but as for your brothers, the children of
Israel—a man toward his brother—you shall not dominate him
with harshness.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֹתָם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֲחֻזָּה לְעֹלָם בָּהֶם תַּעֲבֹדוּ וּבְאַחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֹתָם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֲחֻזָּה לְעֹלָם בָּהֶם תַּעֲבֹדוּ וּבְאַחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And you shall make them a legacy for your children after
you to inherit as a possession. You may have them work
forever, but as for your brothers, the children of
Israel—a man toward his brother—you shall not dominate him
with harshness.

translation.text: You fellow Israelites, no one shall rule over the other with harshness.

verses.english:
“And if the hand of an alien and visitor with you will
attain it, and your brother is low with him and is sold to
the alien and visitor with you or to an offshoot of an
alien’s family,
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַשִּׂיג יַד גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ וּמָךְ אָחִיךָ עִמּוֹ וְנִמְכַּר לְגֵר תּוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ אוֹ לְעֵקֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת גֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תַשִּׂיג יַד גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ וּמָךְ אָחִיךָ עִמּוֹ וְנִמְכַּר לְגֵר תּוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ אוֹ לְעֵקֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת גֵּר׃

english.text:
“And if the hand of an alien and visitor with you will
attain it, and your brother is low with him and is sold to
the alien and visitor with you or to an offshoot of an
alien’s family,

translation.text: If resident aliens among you prosper, and if any of your kin fall into branch of the alien's family,

verses.english:
after he is sold he shall have redemption. One of his
brothers shall redeem him,
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי נִמְכַּר גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶחָד מֵאֶחָיו יִגְאָלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרֵי נִמְכַּר גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶחָד מֵאֶחָיו יִגְאָלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
after he is sold he shall have redemption. One of his
brothers shall redeem him,

translation.text: after they have sold themselves they them,

verses.english:
or his uncle or his uncle’s son shall redeem him, or some
close relative of his from his family shall redeem him; or
if his hand can attain it then he can redeem himself.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ דֹדוֹ אוֹ בֶן דֹּדוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ מִשְּׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וְנִגְאָל׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ דֹדוֹ אוֹ בֶן דֹּדוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ מִשְּׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וְנִגְאָל׃

english.text:
or his uncle or his uncle’s son shall redeem him, or some
close relative of his from his family shall redeem him; or
if his hand can attain it then he can redeem himself.

translation.text: or their uncle or their uncle's son may redeem them, or if they prosper they may redeem themselves.

verses.english:
And he shall figure with the one who buys him: from the
year he was sold to him to the jubilee year; and the price
of his sale shall be by the number of years. It shall be
with him like the days of an employee:
verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב עִם קֹנֵהוּ מִשְּׁנַת הִמָּכְרוֹ לוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְהָיָה כֶּסֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים כִּימֵי שָׂכִיר יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְחִשַּׁב עִם קֹנֵהוּ מִשְּׁנַת הִמָּכְרוֹ לוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְהָיָה כֶּסֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים כִּימֵי שָׂכִיר יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall figure with the one who buys him: from the
year he was sold to him to the jubilee year; and the price
of his sale shall be by the number of years. It shall be
with him like the days of an employee:

translation.text: They shall compute to the alien until the jubilee year; the price of the sale shall be applied rated as the time of a hired laborer.

verses.english:
If there are still a great number of years, he shall pay
back his redemption according to them from his purchase
price.
verses.hebrew: אִם עוֹד רַבּוֹת בַּשָּׁנִים לְפִיהֶן יָשִׁיב גְּאֻלָּתוֹ מִכֶּסֶף מִקְנָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם עוֹד רַבּוֹת בַּשָּׁנִים לְפִיהֶן יָשִׁיב גְּאֻלָּתוֹ מִכֶּסֶף מִקְנָתוֹ׃

english.text:
If there are still a great number of years, he shall pay
back his redemption according to them from his purchase
price.

translation.text: If many years remain, they shall pay for their redemption in proportion to the purchase price;

verses.english:
And if a small amount of years remain until the jubilee
year, then he shall figure it for him. He shall pay back
his redemption according to his years.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מְעַט נִשְׁאַר בַּשָּׁנִים עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ כְּפִי שָׁנָיו יָשִׁיב אֶת גְּאֻלָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מְעַט נִשְׁאַר בַּשָּׁנִים עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ כְּפִי שָׁנָיו יָשִׁיב אֶת גְּאֻלָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And if a small amount of years remain until the jubilee
year, then he shall figure it for him. He shall pay back
his redemption according to his years.

translation.text: and if few years remain until the jubilee year, they shall compute thus: redemption.

verses.english:
He shall be with him like a year-by-year employee. He
shall not dominate him with harshness before your eyes.
verses.hebrew: כִּשְׂכִיר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ לֹא יִרְדֶּנּוּ בְּפֶרֶךְ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּשְׂכִיר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ לֹא יִרְדֶּנּוּ בְּפֶרֶךְ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
He shall be with him like a year-by-year employee. He
shall not dominate him with harshness before your eyes.

translation.text: As a laborer hired by the year they shall be under the them in your sight.

verses.english:
And if he will not be redeemed by these, then he shall go
out in the jubilee year, he and his children with him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל בְּאֵלֶּה וְיָצָא בִּשְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל בְּאֵלֶּה וְיָצָא בִּשְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And if he will not be redeemed by these, then he shall go
out in the jubilee year, he and his children with him.

translation.text: And if they have not been redeemed in any of jubilee year.

verses.english:
Because the children of Israel are servants to me. They
are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of
Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Because the children of Israel are servants to me. They
are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of
Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: For to me the people of Israel are servants; they are my your God.

verses.english:
“You shall not make idols, and you shall not set up an
image or a pillar, and you shall not put a carved stone in
your land to bow at it, because I am YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֱלִילִם וּפֶסֶל וּמַצֵּבָה לֹא תָקִימוּ לָכֶם וְאֶבֶן מַשְׂכִּית לֹא תִתְּנוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת עָלֶיהָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֱלִילִם וּפֶסֶל וּמַצֵּבָה לֹא תָקִימוּ לָכֶם וְאֶבֶן מַשְׂכִּית לֹא תִתְּנוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת עָלֶיהָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall not make idols, and you shall not set up an
image or a pillar, and you shall not put a carved stone in
your land to bow at it, because I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: You shall make for yourselves no idols and erect no carved images or pillars, and you shall not place figured stones in your land, to worship at them; for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my sanctuary. I am
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my sanctuary. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall keep my sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
BY MY LAWS “If you will go by my laws, and if you will
observe my commandments, and you will do them:
verses.hebrew: אִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם׃

english.text:
BY MY LAWS “If you will go by my laws, and if you will
observe my commandments, and you will do them:

translation.text: If you follow my statutes and keep my commandments and observe them faithfully,

verses.english:
then I shall give your rains in their time, and the earth
will give its crop, and the tree of the field will give
its fruit,
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי גִשְׁמֵיכֶם בְּעִתָּם וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי גִשְׁמֵיכֶם בְּעִתָּם וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

english.text:
then I shall give your rains in their time, and the earth
will give its crop, and the tree of the field will give
its fruit,

translation.text: I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its produce, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

verses.english:
and threshing will extend to vintage for you, and vintage
will extend to seeding, and you will eat your bread to the
full, and you will live in security in your land,
verses.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיג לָכֶם דַּיִשׁ אֶת בָּצִיר וּבָצִיר יַשִּׂיג אֶת זָרַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לַחְמְכֶם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשִּׂיג לָכֶם דַּיִשׁ אֶת בָּצִיר וּבָצִיר יַשִּׂיג אֶת זָרַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לַחְמְכֶם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

english.text:
and threshing will extend to vintage for you, and vintage
will extend to seeding, and you will eat your bread to the
full, and you will live in security in your land,

translation.text: securely in your land.

verses.english:
and I shall give peace in the land, and you will lie down
with no one making you afraid, and I shall make wild
animals cease from the land, and a sword will not pass
through your land,
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי שָׁלוֹם בָּאָרֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּם וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי חַיָּה רָעָה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְחֶרֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹר בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי שָׁלוֹם בָּאָרֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּם וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי חַיָּה רָעָה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְחֶרֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹר בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall give peace in the land, and you will lie down
with no one making you afraid, and I shall make wild
animals cease from the land, and a sword will not pass
through your land,

translation.text: And I will grant peace in the land, and you shall animals from the land, and no sword shall go through your land.

verses.english:
and you will chase your enemies, and they will fall in
front of you by the sword,
verses.hebrew: וּרְדַפְתֶּם אֶת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְנָפְלוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וּרְדַפְתֶּם אֶת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְנָפְלוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

english.text:
and you will chase your enemies, and they will fall in
front of you by the sword,

translation.text: You shall give chase to your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.english:
and five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you
will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall in
front of you by the sword,
verses.hebrew: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ וְנָפְלוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ וְנָפְלוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

english.text:
and five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you
will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall in
front of you by the sword,

translation.text: Five of you shall give chase to a hundred, and a hundred of you shall give chase to ten thousand; your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.english:
and I shall turn to you, and I shall make you fruitful and
make you multiply, and I shall establish my covenant with
you,
verses.hebrew: וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall turn to you, and I shall make you fruitful and
make you multiply, and I shall establish my covenant with
you,

translation.text: I will look with favor upon you and make you fruitful and multiply you; and I will maintain my covenant with you.

verses.english:
and you will eat the oldest of the old, and you will take
out the old because of the new,
verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם יָשָׁן נוֹשָׁן וְיָשָׁן מִפְּנֵי חָדָשׁ תּוֹצִיאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם יָשָׁן נוֹשָׁן וְיָשָׁן מִפְּנֵי חָדָשׁ תּוֹצִיאוּ׃

english.text:
and you will eat the oldest of the old, and you will take
out the old because of the new,

translation.text: You shall eat old grain long stored, and you shall have to clear out the old to make way for the new.

verses.english:
and I shall put my Tabernacle among you, and my soul will
not scorn you,
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי מִשְׁכָּנִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי מִשְׁכָּנִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall put my Tabernacle among you, and my soul will
not scorn you,

translation.text: I will place my dwelling in your midst, and I shall not abhor you.

verses.english:
and I shall walk among you, and I shall be God to you, and
you will be a people to me.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי לְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי לְעָם׃

english.text:
and I shall walk among you, and I shall be God to you, and
you will be a people to me.

translation.text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you shall be my people.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from being slaves to them, and I broke the beams of
your yoke and had you go standing tall.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִהְיֹת לָהֶם עֲבָדִים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֹת עֻלְּכֶם וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם קוֹמְמִיּוּת׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִהְיֹת לָהֶם עֲבָדִים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֹת עֻלְּכֶם וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם קוֹמְמִיּוּת׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from being slaves to them, and I broke the beams of
your yoke and had you go standing tall.

translation.text: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be their slaves no more; I have broken the bars of your yoke and made you walk erect.

verses.english:
“But if you will not listen to me and not do all these
commandments,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
“But if you will not listen to me and not do all these
commandments,

translation.text: But if you will not obey me, and do not observe all these commandments,

verses.english:
and if you will reject my laws, and if your souls will
scorn my judgments so as not to do all my commandments, so
that you break my covenant,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תִּמְאָסוּ וְאִם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּגְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי לְהַפְרְכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תִּמְאָסוּ וְאִם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּגְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי לְהַפְרְכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

english.text:
and if you will reject my laws, and if your souls will
scorn my judgments so as not to do all my commandments, so
that you break my covenant,

translation.text: if you spurn my statutes, and abhor my ordinances, covenant,

verses.english:
I, too, I shall do this to you: Then I shall appoint
terror over you with consumption and with fever,
exhausting eyes and grieving the soul, and you will sow
your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it,
verses.hebrew: אַף אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה זֹּאת לָכֶם וְהִפְקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם בֶּהָלָה אֶת הַשַּׁחֶפֶת וְאֶת הַקַּדַּחַת מְכַלּוֹת עֵינַיִם וּמְדִיבֹת נָפֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּם לָרִיק זַרְעֲכֶם וַאֲכָלֻהוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַף אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה זֹּאת לָכֶם וְהִפְקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם בֶּהָלָה אֶת הַשַּׁחֶפֶת וְאֶת הַקַּדַּחַת מְכַלּוֹת עֵינַיִם וּמְדִיבֹת נָפֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּם לָרִיק זַרְעֲכֶם וַאֲכָלֻהוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I, too, I shall do this to you: Then I shall appoint
terror over you with consumption and with fever,
exhausting eyes and grieving the soul, and you will sow
your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it,

translation.text: I in turn will do this to you: I will bring terror on you; consumption and fever that waste the eyes and cause life to pine away. You shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

verses.english:
and I shall set my face against you, and you will be
struck before your enemies, and ones who hate you will
dominate you, and you will flee though no one is pursuing
you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בָּכֶם וְנִגַּפְתֶּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְרָדוּ בָכֶם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶם וְנַסְתֶּם וְאֵין רֹדֵף אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בָּכֶם וְנִגַּפְתֶּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְרָדוּ בָכֶם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶם וְנַסְתֶּם וְאֵין רֹדֵף אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall set my face against you, and you will be
struck before your enemies, and ones who hate you will
dominate you, and you will flee though no one is pursuing
you.

translation.text: I will set my face against you, and you shall be struck down by your enemies; your foes shall rule over you, and you shall flee though no one pursues you.

verses.english:
And if, even after these, you will not listen to me, then
I shall add seven times more to discipline you for your
sins:
verses.hebrew: וְאִם עַד אֵלֶּה לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי לְיַסְּרָה אֶתְכֶם שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם עַד אֵלֶּה לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי לְיַסְּרָה אֶתְכֶם שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And if, even after these, you will not listen to me, then
I shall add seven times more to discipline you for your
sins:

translation.text: And if in spite of this you will not obey me, I will continue to punish you sevenfold for your sins.

verses.english:
and I shall break your strong pride, and I shall make your
skies like iron and your land like bronze,
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת שְׁמֵיכֶם כַּבַּרְזֶל וְאֶת אַרְצְכֶם כַּנְּחֻשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת שְׁמֵיכֶם כַּבַּרְזֶל וְאֶת אַרְצְכֶם כַּנְּחֻשָׁה׃

english.text:
and I shall break your strong pride, and I shall make your
skies like iron and your land like bronze,

translation.text: I will break your proud glory, and I will make your sky like iron and your earth like copper.

verses.english:
and your power will be used up in vain, and your land will
not give its crop, and the tree of the land will not give
its fruit.
verses.hebrew: וְתַם לָרִיק כֹּחֲכֶם וְלֹא תִתֵּן אַרְצְכֶם אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הָאָרֶץ לֹא יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְתַם לָרִיק כֹּחֲכֶם וְלֹא תִתֵּן אַרְצְכֶם אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הָאָרֶץ לֹא יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

english.text:
and your power will be used up in vain, and your land will
not give its crop, and the tree of the land will not give
its fruit.

translation.text: Your produce, and the trees of the land shall not yield their fruit.

verses.english:
And if you will go on with me in defiance and will not be
willing to listen to me, then I shall add seven times more
striking on you, corresponding to your sins:
verses.hebrew: וְאִם תֵּלְכוּ עִמִּי קֶרִי וְלֹא תֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַכָּה שֶׁבַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תֵּלְכוּ עִמִּי קֶרִי וְלֹא תֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַכָּה שֶׁבַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And if you will go on with me in defiance and will not be
willing to listen to me, then I shall add seven times more
striking on you, corresponding to your sins:

translation.text: If you continue hostile to me, and will not obey me, I will continue to plague you sevenfold for your sins.

verses.english:
and I shall let loose the wild animal among you, and it
will bereave you, and it will cut off your cattle, and it
will diminish you, and your roads will be desolated.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי בָכֶם אֶת חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וְשִׁכְּלָה אֶתְכֶם וְהִכְרִיתָה אֶת בְּהֶמְתְּכֶם וְהִמְעִיטָה אֶתְכֶם וְנָשַׁמּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי בָכֶם אֶת חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וְשִׁכְּלָה אֶתְכֶם וְהִכְרִיתָה אֶת בְּהֶמְתְּכֶם וְהִמְעִיטָה אֶתְכֶם וְנָשַׁמּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall let loose the wild animal among you, and it
will bereave you, and it will cut off your cattle, and it
will diminish you, and your roads will be desolated.

translation.text: I will let loose wild animals your livestock; they shall make you few in number, and your roads shall be deserted.

verses.english:
And if you will not be disciplined for me by these, and
you will go on with me in defiance,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּאֵלֶּה לֹא תִוָּסְרוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי קֶרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּאֵלֶּה לֹא תִוָּסְרוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי קֶרִי׃

english.text:
And if you will not be disciplined for me by these, and
you will go on with me in defiance,

translation.text: If in spite of these punishments you have not turned back to me, but continue hostile to me,

verses.english:
then I shall go on with you, I also, in defiance. And I
shall strike you, I too, seven times more for your sins:
verses.hebrew: וְהָלַכְתִּי אַף אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּקֶרִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם גַּם אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָלַכְתִּי אַף אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּקֶרִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם גַּם אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
then I shall go on with you, I also, in defiance. And I
shall strike you, I too, seven times more for your sins:

translation.text: then I too will continue hostile to you: I myself will strike you sevenfold for your sins.

verses.english:
and I shall bring a sword over you, requiting covenant
retribution, and you will be gathered to your cities, and
I shall let an epidemic go among you, and you will be put
in your enemy’s hand.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתִי עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרֶב נֹקֶמֶת נְקַם בְּרִית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּם אֶל עָרֵיכֶם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי דֶבֶר בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְנִתַּתֶּם בְּיַד אוֹיֵב׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתִי עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרֶב נֹקֶמֶת נְקַם בְּרִית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּם אֶל עָרֵיכֶם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי דֶבֶר בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְנִתַּתֶּם בְּיַד אוֹיֵב׃

english.text:
and I shall bring a sword over you, requiting covenant
retribution, and you will be gathered to your cities, and
I shall let an epidemic go among you, and you will be put
in your enemy’s hand.

translation.text: I will bring the sword shall be delivered into enemy hands.

verses.english:
When I break the staff of bread for you, then ten women
will bake your bread in one oven, and they will give back
your bread by weight, and you will eat and not be full.
verses.hebrew: בְּשִׁבְרִי לָכֶם מַטֵּה לֶחֶם וְאָפוּ עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים לַחְמְכֶם בְּתַנּוּר אֶחָד וְהֵשִׁיבוּ לַחְמְכֶם בַּמִּשְׁקָל וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּשִׁבְרִי לָכֶם מַטֵּה לֶחֶם וְאָפוּ עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים לַחְמְכֶם בְּתַנּוּר אֶחָד וְהֵשִׁיבוּ לַחְמְכֶם בַּמִּשְׁקָל וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

english.text:
When I break the staff of bread for you, then ten women
will bake your bread in one oven, and they will give back
your bread by weight, and you will eat and not be full.

translation.text: When I break your staff of be satisfied.

verses.english:
And if, through this, you will not listen to me, and you
will go on with me in defiance,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּזֹאת לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּזֹאת לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

english.text:
And if, through this, you will not listen to me, and you
will go on with me in defiance,

translation.text: But if, despite this, you disobey me, and continue hostile to me,

verses.english:
then I shall go on with you in a fury of defiance, and I
shall discipline you, I also, seven times more for your
sins:
verses.hebrew: וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת קֶרִי וְיִסַּרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַף אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת קֶרִי וְיִסַּרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַף אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
then I shall go on with you in a fury of defiance, and I
shall discipline you, I also, seven times more for your
sins:

translation.text: I sevenfold for your sins.

verses.english:
and you will eat your sons’ flesh, and your daughters’
flesh you will eat,
verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בְּשַׂר בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְשַׂר בְּנֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בְּשַׂר בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְשַׂר בְּנֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
and you will eat your sons’ flesh, and your daughters’
flesh you will eat,

translation.text: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.

verses.english:
and I shall destroy your high places, and I shall cut off
your incense altars, and I shall put your carcasses on
your idols’ carcasses, and my soul will scorn you,
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת בָּמֹתֵיכֶם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פִּגְרֵיכֶם עַל פִּגְרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְגָעֲלָה נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת בָּמֹתֵיכֶם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פִּגְרֵיכֶם עַל פִּגְרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְגָעֲלָה נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall destroy your high places, and I shall cut off
your incense altars, and I shall put your carcasses on
your idols’ carcasses, and my soul will scorn you,

translation.text: I will destroy your high places carcasses of your idols. I will abhor you.

verses.english:
and I shall make your cities a ruin, and I shall devastate
your holy places, and I shall not smell your pleasant
smell,
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת עָרֵיכֶם חרְבָּה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּרֵיחַ נִיחֹחֲכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת עָרֵיכֶם חרְבָּה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּרֵיחַ נִיחֹחֲכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall make your cities a ruin, and I shall devastate
your holy places, and I shall not smell your pleasant
smell,

translation.text: I will lay your cities waste, will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your pleasing odors.

verses.english:
and I, I, shall devastate the land, so your enemies who
live in it will be astonished,
verses.hebrew: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֲנִי אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹיְבֵיכֶם הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֲנִי אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹיְבֵיכֶם הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

english.text:
and I, I, shall devastate the land, so your enemies who
live in it will be astonished,

translation.text: I will devastate the land, so that your enemies who come to settle in it shall be appalled at it.

verses.english:
and you: I shall scatter among the nations, and I shall
unsheathe my sword after you, and your land will be a
devastation, and your cities will be a ruin.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְכֶם אֱזָרֶה בַגּוֹיִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם חָרֶב וְהָיְתָה אַרְצְכֶם שְׁמָמָה וְעָרֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ חרְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶתְכֶם אֱזָרֶה בַגּוֹיִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם חָרֶב וְהָיְתָה אַרְצְכֶם שְׁמָמָה וְעָרֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ חרְבָּה׃

english.text:
and you: I shall scatter among the nations, and I shall
unsheathe my sword after you, and your land will be a
devastation, and your cities will be a ruin.

translation.text: And you I will scatter among the nations, and I will unsheathe the sword against you; your land shall be a desolation, and your cities a waste.

verses.english:
Then the land will accept its Sabbaths: all the days of
devastation, while you are in your enemies’ land. Then the
land will cease and accept its Sabbaths.
verses.hebrew: אָז תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ כֹּל יְמֵי השַּׁמָּה וְאַתֶּם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם אָז תִּשְׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ וְהִרְצָת אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: אָז תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ כֹּל יְמֵי השַּׁמָּה וְאַתֶּם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם אָז תִּשְׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ וְהִרְצָת אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Then the land will accept its Sabbaths: all the days of
devastation, while you are in your enemies’ land. Then the
land will cease and accept its Sabbaths.
