verses.english: for YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: for YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD had said to Moses:

verses.english:
“Except: you shall not count the tribe of Levi, and you
shall not add up their heads among the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת מַטֵּה לֵוִי לֹא תִפְקֹד וְאֶת רֹאשָׁם לֹא תִשָּׂא בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶת מַטֵּה לֵוִי לֹא תִפְקֹד וְאֶת רֹאשָׁם לֹא תִשָּׂא בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Except: you shall not count the tribe of Levi, and you
shall not add up their heads among the children of Israel.

translation.text: Only the tribe of Levi you shall not Israelites.

verses.english:
And you: appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the
Testimony and over all its equipment and over everything
it has. They shall carry the Tabernacle and all its
equipment, and they shall attend to it, and they shall
camp around the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה הַפְקֵד אֶת הַלְוִיִּם עַל מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת וְעַל כּל כֵּלָיו וְעַל כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הֵמָּה יִשְׂאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְהֵם יְשָׁרְתֻהוּ וְסָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה הַפְקֵד אֶת הַלְוִיִּם עַל מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת וְעַל כּל כֵּלָיו וְעַל כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הֵמָּה יִשְׂאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְהֵם יְשָׁרְתֻהוּ וְסָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ׃

english.text:
And you: appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the
Testimony and over all its equipment and over everything
it has. They shall carry the Tabernacle and all its
equipment, and they shall attend to it, and they shall
camp around the Tabernacle.

translation.text: Rather you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of it; they are to carry the tabernacle and all its equipment, and they shall tend it, and shall camp around the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And when the Tabernacle travels, the Levites shall take it
down; and when the Tabernacle camps, the Levites shall set
it up. And an outsider who comes close shall be put to
death.
verses.hebrew: וּבִנְסֹעַ הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹרִידוּ אֹתוֹ הַלְוִיִּם וּבַחֲנֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָקִימוּ אֹתוֹ הַלְוִיִּם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וּבִנְסֹעַ הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹרִידוּ אֹתוֹ הַלְוִיִּם וּבַחֲנֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָקִימוּ אֹתוֹ הַלְוִיִּם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And when the Tabernacle travels, the Levites shall take it
down; and when the Tabernacle camps, the Levites shall set
it up. And an outsider who comes close shall be put to
death.

translation.text: When the tabernacle is to set out, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is near shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel shall camp, each at his camp,
each at his flag, by their army units,
verses.hebrew: וְחָנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ עַל מַחֲנֵהוּ וְאִישׁ עַל דִּגְלוֹ לְצִבְאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְחָנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ עַל מַחֲנֵהוּ וְאִישׁ עַל דִּגְלוֹ לְצִבְאֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel shall camp, each at his camp,
each at his flag, by their army units,

translation.text: The other Israelites shall camp in their respective regimental camps, by companies;

verses.english:
and the Levites shall camp all around the Tabernacle of
the Testimony, so there will not be a rage on the
congregation of the children of Israel, and the Levites
shall keep the charge of the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם יַחֲנוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת וְלֹא יִהְיֶה קֶצֶף עַל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַלְוִיִּם יַחֲנוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת וְלֹא יִהְיֶה קֶצֶף עַל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדוּת׃

english.text:
and the Levites shall camp all around the Tabernacle of
the Testimony, so there will not be a rage on the
congregation of the children of Israel, and the Levites
shall keep the charge of the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

translation.text: but the Levites shall perform the guard duty of the tabernacle of the covenant.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel did according to everything
that YHWH had commanded Moses. They did so.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel did according to everything
that YHWH had commanded Moses. They did so.

translation.text: The Israelites did so; they did just as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

verses.english:
“The children of Israel shall camp, each by his flag with
the signs of their fathers’ house; they shall camp
opposite, all around the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ עַל דִּגְלוֹ בְאֹתֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם יַחֲנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנֶּגֶד סָבִיב לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַחֲנוּ׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ עַל דִּגְלוֹ בְאֹתֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם יַחֲנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנֶּגֶד סָבִיב לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַחֲנוּ׃

english.text:
“The children of Israel shall camp, each by his flag with
the signs of their fathers’ house; they shall camp
opposite, all around the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: The Israelites shall side.

verses.english:
And the ones camping on the east: to the east is the flag
of Judah’s camp by their armies. And the chieftain of the
children of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab,
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה יְהוּדָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יְהוּדָה נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחֹנִים קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה יְהוּדָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יְהוּדָה נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב׃

english.text:
And the ones camping on the east: to the east is the flag
of Judah’s camp by their armies. And the chieftain of the
children of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab,

translation.text: Those to camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of people of Judah shall be Nahshon son of Amminadab,

verses.english:
and his army and its counts are seventy-four thousand six
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and its counts are seventy-four thousand six
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of seventy-four thousand six hundred.

verses.english:
And the ones camping next to it are: the tribe of
Issachar. And the chieftain of the children of Issachar is
Nethanel son of Zuar,
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָר׃

english.text:
And the ones camping next to it are: the tribe of
Issachar. And the chieftain of the children of Issachar is
Nethanel son of Zuar,

translation.text: Those to Issacharites shall be Nethanel son of Zuar,

verses.english:
and his army and its counts are fifty-four thousand four
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אַרְבָּעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אַרְבָּעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and its counts are fifty-four thousand four
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of fifty-four thousand four hundred.

verses.english:
The tribe of Zebulun. And the chieftain of the children of
Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon,
verses.hebrew: מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֹן׃

hebrew.text: מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֹן׃

english.text:
The tribe of Zebulun. And the chieftain of the children of
Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon,

translation.text: Then the tribe of Zebulun: The leader of the Zebulunites shall be Eliab son of Helon,

verses.english:
and his army and its counts are fifty-seven thousand four
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and its counts are fifty-seven thousand four
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

verses.english:
All the counts of Judah’s camp are one hundred eighty-six
thousand four hundred by their army units. They shall
travel first.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה יְהוּדָה מְאַת אֶלֶף וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם רִאשֹׁנָה יִסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה יְהוּדָה מְאַת אֶלֶף וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם רִאשֹׁנָה יִסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
All the counts of Judah’s camp are one hundred eighty-six
thousand four hundred by their army units. They shall
travel first.

translation.text: The total enrollment of the camp of Judah, by companies, is one hundred eightysix thousand four hundred. They shall set out first on the march.

verses.english:
“The flag of Reuben’s camp on the south by their armies.
And the chieftain of the children of Reuben is Elizur son
of Shedeur,
verses.hebrew: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן תֵּימָנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

hebrew.text: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן תֵּימָנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

english.text:
“The flag of Reuben’s camp on the south by their armies.
And the chieftain of the children of Reuben is Elizur son
of Shedeur,

translation.text: On the south side shall be the regimental encampment of Reuben Shedeur,

verses.english:
and his army and its counts are forty-six thousand five
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and its counts are forty-six thousand five
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
And the ones camping next to it are: the tribe of Simeon.
And the chieftain of the children of Simeon is Shelumiel
son of Zurishadday,
verses.hebrew: וְהַחוֹנִם עָלָיו מַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחוֹנִם עָלָיו מַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

english.text:
And the ones camping next to it are: the tribe of Simeon.
And the chieftain of the children of Simeon is Shelumiel
son of Zurishadday,

translation.text: And those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Zurishaddai,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are fifty-nine thousand
three hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם תִּשְׁעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם תִּשְׁעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are fifty-nine thousand
three hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

verses.english:
And the tribe of Gad. And the chieftain of the children of
Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel,
verses.hebrew: וּמַטֵּה גָּד וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן רְעוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּמַטֵּה גָּד וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן רְעוּאֵל׃

english.text:
And the tribe of Gad. And the chieftain of the children of
Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel,

translation.text: Then the tribe of Gad: The leader of the Gadites shall be Eliasaph son of Reuel,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are forty-five thousand six
hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are forty-five thousand six
hundred fifty.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

verses.english:
All the counts of Reuben’s camp are one hundred fifty-one
thousand four hundred fifty by their army units. And they
shall travel second.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן מְאַת אֶלֶף וְאֶחָד וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לְצִבְאֹתָם וּשְׁנִיִּם יִסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן מְאַת אֶלֶף וְאֶחָד וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לְצִבְאֹתָם וּשְׁנִיִּם יִסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
All the counts of Reuben’s camp are one hundred fifty-one
thousand four hundred fifty by their army units. And they
shall travel second.

translation.text: The total enrollment of the camp of hundred fifty. They shall set out second.

verses.english:
“And the Tent of Meeting, the Levites’ camp, shall travel
inside the camps. As they camp, so they shall travel: each
at his position by their flags.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַע אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מַחֲנֵה הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר יַחֲנוּ כֵּן יִסָּעוּ אִישׁ עַל יָדוֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַע אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מַחֲנֵה הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר יַחֲנוּ כֵּן יִסָּעוּ אִישׁ עַל יָדוֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“And the Tent of Meeting, the Levites’ camp, shall travel
inside the camps. As they camp, so they shall travel: each
at his position by their flags.

translation.text: The tent of meeting, with the camp of the Levites, shall set out in position, by their regiments.

verses.english:
“The flag of Ephraim’s camp by their armies on the west.
And the chieftain of the children of Ephraim is Elishama
son of Ammihud,
verses.hebrew: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם יָמָּה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

hebrew.text: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם יָמָּה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

english.text:
“The flag of Ephraim’s camp by their armies on the west.
And the chieftain of the children of Ephraim is Elishama
son of Ammihud,

translation.text: On the west side shall be the regimental encampment of Ephraim by of Ammihud,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are forty thousand five
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are forty thousand five
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of forty thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
And next to it: the camp of Manasseh. And the chieftain of
the children of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
verses.hebrew: וְעָלָיו מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן פְּדָהצוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְעָלָיו מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן פְּדָהצוּר׃

english.text:
And next to it: the camp of Manasseh. And the chieftain of
the children of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,

translation.text: Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The leader of the people of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are thirty-two thousand two
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are thirty-two thousand two
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of thirty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.english:
And the tribe of Benjamin. And the chieftain of the
children of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni,
verses.hebrew: וּמַטֵּה בִּנְיָמִן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וּמַטֵּה בִּנְיָמִן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעֹנִי׃

english.text:
And the tribe of Benjamin. And the chieftain of the
children of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni,

translation.text: Then the of Gideoni,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are thirty-five thousand
four hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are thirty-five thousand
four hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of thirty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.english:
All the counts of Ephraim’s camp are one hundred eight
thousand one hundred by their army units. And they shall
travel third.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם מְאַת אֶלֶף וּשְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וּמֵאָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וּשְׁלִשִׁים יִסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם מְאַת אֶלֶף וּשְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וּמֵאָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וּשְׁלִשִׁים יִסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
All the counts of Ephraim’s camp are one hundred eight
thousand one hundred by their army units. And they shall
travel third.

translation.text: The total enrollment of the camp of Ephraim, by out third on the march.

verses.english:
“The flag of Dan’s camp on the north by their armies. And
the chieftain of the children of Dan is Ahiezer son of
Ammishadday,
verses.hebrew: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה דָן צָפֹנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי דָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

hebrew.text: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה דָן צָפֹנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי דָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

english.text:
“The flag of Dan’s camp on the north by their armies. And
the chieftain of the children of Dan is Ahiezer son of
Ammishadday,

translation.text: On the north side shall be the regimental encampment of Dan by Ammishaddai,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are sixty-two thousand seven
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are sixty-two thousand seven
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.english:
And the ones camping next to it are: the tribe of Asher.
And the chieftain of the children of Asher is Pagiel son
of Ochran,
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה אָשֵׁר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עכְרָן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה אָשֵׁר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עכְרָן׃

english.text:
And the ones camping next to it are: the tribe of Asher.
And the chieftain of the children of Asher is Pagiel son
of Ochran,

translation.text: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The leader of the Asherites shall be Pagiel son of Ochran,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are forty-one thousand five
hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אֶחָד וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אֶחָד וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are forty-one thousand five
hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
And the tribe of Naphtali. And the chieftain of the
children of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan,
verses.hebrew: וּמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן עֵינָן׃

hebrew.text: וּמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן עֵינָן׃

english.text:
And the tribe of Naphtali. And the chieftain of the
children of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan,

translation.text: Then the tribe of Naphtali: The leader of the Naphtalites shall be Ahira son of Enan,

verses.english:
and his army and their counts are fifty-three thousand
four hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and his army and their counts are fifty-three thousand
four hundred.

translation.text: with a company as enrolled of fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.english:
All the counts of Dan’s camp are one hundred fifty-seven
thousand six hundred. They shall travel last, by their
flags.”
verses.hebrew: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה דָן מְאַת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָה יִסְעוּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה דָן מְאַת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָה יִסְעוּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
All the counts of Dan’s camp are one hundred fifty-seven
thousand six hundred. They shall travel last, by their
flags.”

translation.text: The total enrollment of the camp of Dan is one companies.

verses.english:
These are the counts of the children of Israel by their
fathers’ house, all the counts of the camps by their
armies: six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כּל פְּקוּדֵי הַמַּחֲנֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כּל פְּקוּדֵי הַמַּחֲנֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

english.text:
These are the counts of the children of Israel by their
fathers’ house, all the counts of the camps by their
armies: six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

translation.text: This was the enrollment of the Israelites by their ancestral houses; three thousand five hundred fifty.

verses.english:
And the Levites were not counted among the children of
Israel, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם לֹא התְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַלְוִיִּם לֹא התְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And the Levites were not counted among the children of
Israel, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: Just as the LORD had commanded Moses, the Levites were not enrolled among the other Israelites.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel did according to all that YHWH
commanded Moses. So they camped by their flags, and so
they traveled, each by his families, by his fathers’
house.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן חָנוּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם וְכֵן נָסָעוּ אִישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו עַל בֵּית אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן חָנוּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם וְכֵן נָסָעוּ אִישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו עַל בֵּית אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel did according to all that YHWH
commanded Moses. So they camped by their flags, and so
they traveled, each by his families, by his fathers’
house.

translation.text: The Israelites did just as the LORD had commanded Moses: They clans, according to ancestral houses.

verses.english:
These are the records of Aaron and Moses in the day YHWH
spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי׃

english.text:
These are the records of Aaron and Moses in the day YHWH
spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai.

translation.text: This is the lineage of Aaron and Moses at the time when the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

verses.english:
And these are the names of Aaron’s sons: the firstborn
Nadab, and Abihu and Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַבְּכֹר נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַבְּכֹר נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר׃

english.text:
And these are the names of Aaron’s sons: the firstborn
Nadab, and Abihu and Eleazar and Ithamar.

translation.text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar;

verses.english:
These are the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests,
who filled their hand to function as priests.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְּשֻׁחִים אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא יָדָם לְכַהֵן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְּשֻׁחִים אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא יָדָם לְכַהֵן׃

english.text:
These are the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests,
who filled their hand to function as priests.

translation.text: these ordained to minister as priests.

verses.english:
And Nadab and Abihu died in front of YHWH when they
brought forward unfitting fire in front of YHWH in the
wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Eleazar and
Ithamar functioned as priests in front of Aaron, their
father.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּהַקְרִבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי וּבָנִים לֹא הָיוּ לָהֶם וַיְכַהֵן אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר עַל פְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּהַקְרִבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי וּבָנִים לֹא הָיוּ לָהֶם וַיְכַהֵן אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר עַל פְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Nadab and Abihu died in front of YHWH when they
brought forward unfitting fire in front of YHWH in the
wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Eleazar and
Ithamar functioned as priests in front of Aaron, their
father.

translation.text: Nadab and Abihu died before the priests in the lifetime of their father Aaron.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Bring forward the tribe of Levi and stand it in front of
Aaron, the priest, so they will attend to him.
verses.hebrew: הַקְרֵב אֶת מַטֵּה לֵוִי וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְשֵׁרְתוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הַקְרֵב אֶת מַטֵּה לֵוִי וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְשֵׁרְתוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“Bring forward the tribe of Levi and stand it in front of
Aaron, the priest, so they will attend to him.

translation.text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, so that they may assist him.

verses.english:
And they shall keep his charge and the charge of all the
congregation in front of the Tent of Meeting, to do the
work of the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתּוֹ וְאֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת כּל הָעֵדָה לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתּוֹ וְאֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת כּל הָעֵדָה לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And they shall keep his charge and the charge of all the
congregation in front of the Tent of Meeting, to do the
work of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: front of the tent of meeting, doing service at the tabernacle;

verses.english:
And they shall keep all the equipment of the Tent of
Meeting and the charge of the children of Israel, to do
the work of the Tabernacle.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת כּל כְּלֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת כּל כְּלֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And they shall keep all the equipment of the Tent of
Meeting and the charge of the children of Israel, to do
the work of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: they tabernacle.

verses.english:
And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons.
They are given—given—to him from the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו נְתוּנִם נְתוּנִם הֵמָּה לוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו נְתוּנִם נְתוּנִם הֵמָּה לוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons.
They are given—given—to him from the children of Israel.

translation.text: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and his descendants; they are unreservedly given to him from among the Israelites.

verses.english:
And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, that they shall
keep their priesthood, and an outsider who comes close
shall be put to death.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תִּפְקֹד וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנָּתָם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תִּפְקֹד וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנָּתָם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, that they shall
keep their priesthood, and an outsider who comes close
shall be put to death.”

translation.text: But be put to death.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“And I, here, I have taken the Levites from among the
children of Israel in place of every firstborn, the first
birth of the womb, from the children of Israel. And the
Levites shall be mine.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
“And I, here, I have taken the Levites from among the
children of Israel in place of every firstborn, the first
birth of the womb, from the children of Israel. And the
Levites shall be mine.

translation.text: I hereby accept the Levites from among the Israelites as substitutes for all the firstborn that open the womb among the Israelites. The Levites shall be mine,

verses.english:
Because every firstborn is mine. In the day that I struck
every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated every
firstborn in Israel to me, from human to animal. They
shall be mine. I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לִי כּל בְּכוֹר בְּיוֹם הַכֹּתִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָה לִי יִהְיוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לִי כּל בְּכוֹר בְּיוֹם הַכֹּתִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָה לִי יִהְיוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Because every firstborn is mine. In the day that I struck
every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated every
firstborn in Israel to me, from human to animal. They
shall be mine. I am YHWH.”

translation.text: for all the firstborn are mine; when I killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I animal; they shall be mine. I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai,
saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai,
saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:

verses.english:
“Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ house, by
their families. You shall count them: every male from a
month old and up.”
verses.hebrew: פְּקֹד אֶת בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה תִּפְקְדֵם׃

hebrew.text: פְּקֹד אֶת בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה תִּפְקְדֵם׃

english.text:
“Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ house, by
their families. You shall count them: every male from a
month old and up.”

translation.text: every male from a month old and upward.

verses.english: And Moses counted them by YHWH’s word as he was commanded.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צֻוָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צֻוָּה׃

english.text: And Moses counted them by YHWH’s word as he was commanded.

translation.text: So Moses enrolled them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.

verses.english:
And these were Levi’s sons by their names: Gershon and
Kohath and Merari.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ אֵלֶּה בְנֵי לֵוִי בִּשְׁמֹתָם גֵּרְשׁוֹן וּקְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ אֵלֶּה בְנֵי לֵוִי בִּשְׁמֹתָם גֵּרְשׁוֹן וּקְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃

english.text:
And these were Levi’s sons by their names: Gershon and
Kohath and Merari.

translation.text: The Merari.

verses.english:
And these are the names of Gershon’s sons by their
families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי׃

english.text:
And these are the names of Gershon’s sons by their
families: Libni and Shimei.

translation.text: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.

verses.english:
And Kohath’s sons by their families: Amram and Izhar,
Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְהָת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר חֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קְהָת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר חֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל׃

english.text:
And Kohath’s sons by their families: Amram and Izhar,
Hebron and Uzziel.

translation.text: The sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.english:
And Merari’s sons by their families: Mahli and Mushi.
These are the Levite families by their fathers’ house.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַלֵּוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַלֵּוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Merari’s sons by their families: Mahli and Mushi.
These are the Levite families by their fathers’ house.

translation.text: The sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites, by their ancestral houses.

verses.english:
Gershon had the Libnite family and the Shimeite family.
These are the Gershonite families.
verses.hebrew: לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְעִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי׃

hebrew.text: לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְעִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי׃

english.text:
Gershon had the Libnite family and the Shimeite family.
These are the Gershonite families.

translation.text: To Gershon belonged the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites; these were the clans of the Gershonites.

verses.english:
Their counts by the number of every male from a month old
and up: their counts were seven thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
Their counts by the number of every male from a month old
and up: their counts were seven thousand five hundred.

translation.text: Their enrollment, thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
The Gershonite families were to camp behind the
Tabernacle, to the west.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אַחֲרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ יָמָּה׃

hebrew.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אַחֲרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ יָמָּה׃

english.text:
The Gershonite families were to camp behind the
Tabernacle, to the west.

translation.text: The clans of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle on the west,

verses.english:
And the chieftain of the Gershonite father’s house was
Eliasaph son of Lael.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן לָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן לָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the chieftain of the Gershonite father’s house was
Eliasaph son of Lael.

translation.text: with Eliasaph son of Lael as head of the ancestral house of the Gershonites.

verses.english:
And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of
Meeting was the Tabernacle and the tent, its covering and
the cover of the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְהָאֹהֶל מִכְסֵהוּ וּמָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְהָאֹהֶל מִכְסֵהוּ וּמָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of
Meeting was the Tabernacle and the tent, its covering and
the cover of the entrance of the Tent of Meeting

translation.text: The responsibility of the meeting,

verses.english:
and the courtyard’s hangings and the cover for the
entrance of the courtyard that is all around the
Tabernacle and the altar, and its cords, for all of its
service.
verses.hebrew: וְקַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵיתָרָיו לְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְקַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵיתָרָיו לְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

english.text:
and the courtyard’s hangings and the cover for the
entrance of the courtyard that is all around the
Tabernacle and the altar, and its cords, for all of its
service.

translation.text: the hangings of the court, the screen for the entrance of all the service pertaining to these.

verses.english:
And Kohath had the Amramite family and the Izharite family
and the Hebronite family and the Uzzielite family. These
are the Kohathite families.
verses.hebrew: וְלִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַעַמְרָמִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְהָרִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הָעזִּיאֵלִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְלִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַעַמְרָמִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְהָרִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הָעזִּיאֵלִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי׃

english.text:
And Kohath had the Amramite family and the Izharite family
and the Hebronite family and the Uzzielite family. These
are the Kohathite families.

translation.text: To Kohath belonged the clan of the Amramites, the clan of the Izharites, the clan of the Hebronites, and the clan of the Uzzielites; these are the clans of the Kohathites.

verses.english:
By the number of every male from a month old and up: eight
thousand six hundred keeping the charge of the Holy.
verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: בְּמִסְפַּר כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
By the number of every male from a month old and up: eight
thousand six hundred keeping the charge of the Holy.

translation.text: Counting all the males, from a attending to the duties of the sanctuary.

verses.english:
The families of the children of Kohath were to camp to the
south.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי קְהָת יַחֲנוּ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן תֵּימָנָה׃

hebrew.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי קְהָת יַחֲנוּ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן תֵּימָנָה׃

english.text:
The families of the children of Kohath were to camp to the
south.

translation.text: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,

verses.english:
And the chieftain of the father’s house for the Kohathite
families was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן עֻזִּיאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן עֻזִּיאֵל׃

english.text:
And the chieftain of the father’s house for the Kohathite
families was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

translation.text: with Elizaphan Kohathites.

verses.english:
And their charge was the ark and the table and the menorah
and the altars and the equipment of the Holy with which
they minister and the cover and all of its service.
verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּם הָאָרֹן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן וְהַמְּנֹרָה וְהַמִּזְבְּחֹת וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ בָּהֶם וְהַמָּסָךְ וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּם הָאָרֹן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן וְהַמְּנֹרָה וְהַמִּזְבְּחֹת וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ בָּהֶם וְהַמָּסָךְ וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And their charge was the ark and the table and the menorah
and the altars and the equipment of the Holy with which
they minister and the cover and all of its service.

translation.text: Their responsibility was to be the ark, the table, the priests minister, and the screen — all the service pertaining to these.

verses.english:
And the chieftain of chieftains of the Levites was Eleazar
son of Aaron, the priest, with responsibility for those
who keep the charge of the Holy.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא נְשִׂיאֵי הַלֵּוִי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדַּת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּנְשִׂיא נְשִׂיאֵי הַלֵּוִי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדַּת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the chieftain of chieftains of the Levites was Eleazar
son of Aaron, the priest, with responsibility for those
who keep the charge of the Holy.

translation.text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest was to be chief over the leaders of the sanctuary.

verses.english:
And Merari had the Mahlite family and the Mushite family.
These are the Merarite families.
verses.hebrew: לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִי׃

hebrew.text: לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִי׃

english.text:
And Merari had the Mahlite family and the Mushite family.
These are the Merarite families.

translation.text: To Merari belonged the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites: these are the clans of Merari.

verses.english:
And their counts by the number of every male from a month
old and up: six thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

english.text:
And their counts by the number of every male from a month
old and up: six thousand two hundred.

translation.text: Their enrollment, counting hundred.

verses.english:
And the chieftain of the father’s house for the Merarite
families was Zuriel son of Abihail. They were to camp on
the side of the Tabernacle to the north.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִי צוּרִיאֵל בֶּן אֲבִיחָיִל עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ צָפֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִי צוּרִיאֵל בֶּן אֲבִיחָיִל עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ צָפֹנָה׃

english.text:
And the chieftain of the father’s house for the Merarite
families was Zuriel son of Abihail. They were to camp on
the side of the Tabernacle to the north.

translation.text: The head of the ancestral house of the clans of Merari was tabernacle.

verses.english:
And the responsibility of the charge of the children of
Merari was the Tabernacle’s frames and its bars and its
columns and its bases and all of its equipment and all of
its service
verses.hebrew: וּפְקֻדַּת מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּבְרִיחָיו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו וְכל כֵּלָיו וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְקֻדַּת מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּבְרִיחָיו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו וְכל כֵּלָיו וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And the responsibility of the charge of the children of
Merari was the Tabernacle’s frames and its bars and its
columns and its bases and all of its equipment and all of
its service

translation.text: The responsibility assigned to the sons of Merari was to be the frames of the tabernacle, the bars, the pillars, the bases, and all their accessories — all the service pertaining to these;

verses.english:
and the courtyard’s columns all around and their bases and
their pegs and their cords.
verses.hebrew: וְעַמֻּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם וִיתֵדֹתָם וּמֵיתְרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַמֻּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם וִיתֵדֹתָם וּמֵיתְרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
and the courtyard’s columns all around and their bases and
their pegs and their cords.

translation.text: also the pillars of the court all around, with their bases and pegs and cords.

verses.english:
And those who camped in front of the Tabernacle, on the
east, in front of the Tent of Meeting, to the east, were
Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the
holy place, for the charge of the children of Israel. And
the outsider who will come close shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים לִפְנֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן קֵדְמָה לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִזְרָחָה מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו שֹׁמְרִים מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחֹנִים לִפְנֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן קֵדְמָה לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִזְרָחָה מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו שֹׁמְרִים מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And those who camped in front of the Tabernacle, on the
east, in front of the Tent of Meeting, to the east, were
Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the
holy place, for the charge of the children of Israel. And
the outsider who will come close shall be put to death.

translation.text: Those who were to camp in front of the tabernacle on the east — in near was to be put to death.

verses.english:
All the counts of the Levites that Moses and Aaron made by
YHWH’s word, by their families, every male from a month
old and up were twenty-two thousand.
verses.hebrew: כּל פְּקוּדֵי הַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: כּל פְּקוּדֵי הַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
All the counts of the Levites that Moses and Aaron made by
YHWH’s word, by their families, every male from a month
old and up were twenty-two thousand.

translation.text: The total enrollment of the Levites their clans, all the males from a month old and upward, was twentytwo thousand.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Count every male firstborn of the
children of Israel from a month old and up, and add up the
number of their names.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פְּקֹד כּל בְּכֹר זָכָר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה וְשָׂא אֵת מִסְפַּר שְׁמֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פְּקֹד כּל בְּכֹר זָכָר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה וְשָׂא אֵת מִסְפַּר שְׁמֹתָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Count every male firstborn of the
children of Israel from a month old and up, and add up the
number of their names.

translation.text: Then the LORD said to Moses: Enroll all the firstborn males of the Israelites, from a month old and upward, and count their names.

verses.english:
And you shall take the Levites for me—I am YHWH—in place
of every firstborn in the children of Israel, and the
Levites’ animals in place of every firstborn in the
animals of the children of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה תַּחַת כּל בְּכֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת בֶּהֱמַת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר בְּבֶהֱמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה תַּחַת כּל בְּכֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת בֶּהֱמַת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר בְּבֶהֱמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall take the Levites for me—I am YHWH—in place
of every firstborn in the children of Israel, and the
Levites’ animals in place of every firstborn in the
animals of the children of Israel.”

translation.text: But you shall accept the Levites for me — I am the LORD — as substitutes for all the firstborn among the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites as substitutes for all the firstborn among the livestock of the Israelites.

verses.english:
And Moses counted, as YHWH commanded him, every firstborn
in the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶת כּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶת כּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses counted, as YHWH commanded him, every firstborn
in the children of Israel.

translation.text: commanded him.

verses.english:
And every male firstborn, by the number of names, from a
month old and up, by their counts were twenty-two thousand
two hundred seventy-three.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כל בְּכוֹר זָכָר בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף שְׁלֹשָׁה וְשִׁבְעִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כל בְּכוֹר זָכָר בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף שְׁלֹשָׁה וְשִׁבְעִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

english.text:
And every male firstborn, by the number of names, from a
month old and up, by their counts were twenty-two thousand
two hundred seventy-three.

translation.text: The total enrollment, all the firstborn males from a month old and upward, counting the number of names, was twentytwo thousand two hundred seventy-three.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Take the Levites in place of every firstborn in the
children of Israel, and the Levites’ animals in place of
their animals, and the Levites shall be mine. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת בֶּהֱמַת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת בְּהֶמְתָּם וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: קַח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת בֶּהֱמַת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת בְּהֶמְתָּם וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Take the Levites in place of every firstborn in the
children of Israel, and the Levites’ animals in place of
their animals, and the Levites shall be mine. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Accept the Levites as substitutes for all the firstborn among the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites as substitutes for their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And for the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three
who are left over above the Levites from the firstborn of
the children of Israel,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פְּדוּיֵי הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה וְהַשִּׁבְעִים וְהַמָּאתָיִם הָעֹדְפִים עַל הַלְוִיִּם מִבְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת פְּדוּיֵי הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה וְהַשִּׁבְעִים וְהַמָּאתָיִם הָעֹדְפִים עַל הַלְוִיִּם מִבְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And for the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three
who are left over above the Levites from the firstborn of
the children of Israel,

translation.text: As the price of redemption of the two hundred number of the Levites,

verses.english:
you shall take five shekels each per head; you shall take
it by the shekel of the Holy. (The shekel is twenty
gerah.)
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ חֲמֵשֶׁת חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ תִּקָּח עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשָּׁקֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ חֲמֵשֶׁת חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ תִּקָּח עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשָּׁקֶל׃

english.text:
you shall take five shekels each per head; you shall take
it by the shekel of the Holy. (The shekel is twenty
gerah.)

translation.text: you shall accept five shekels apiece, reckoning by the shekel of the sanctuary, a shekel of twenty gerahs.

verses.english:
And you shall give the money to Aaron and to his sons for
the redemption of those left over among them.”
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה הַכֶּסֶף לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו פְּדוּיֵי הָעֹדְפִים בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה הַכֶּסֶף לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו פְּדוּיֵי הָעֹדְפִים בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall give the money to Aaron and to his sons for
the redemption of those left over among them.”

translation.text: them is redeemed.

verses.english:
And Moses took the money of the redemption from those left
over above those who were redeemed by the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֵת כֶּסֶף הַפִּדְיוֹם מֵאֵת הָעֹדְפִים עַל פְּדוּיֵי הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֵת כֶּסֶף הַפִּדְיוֹם מֵאֵת הָעֹדְפִים עַל פְּדוּיֵי הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And Moses took the money of the redemption from those left
over above those who were redeemed by the Levites.

translation.text: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were over and above those redeemed by the Levites;

verses.english:
He took the money from the firstborn of the children of
Israel: one thousand three hundred sixty-five by the
shekel of the Holy.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֵת בְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַח אֶת הַכָּסֶף חֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וָאֶלֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֵת בְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַח אֶת הַכָּסֶף חֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וָאֶלֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
He took the money from the firstborn of the children of
Israel: one thousand three hundred sixty-five by the
shekel of the Holy.

translation.text: sanctuary;

verses.english:
And Moses gave the money for those who were redeemed to
Aaron and to his sons by YHWH’s word, as YHWH commanded
Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת כֶּסֶף הַפְּדֻיִם לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת כֶּסֶף הַפְּדֻיִם לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses gave the money for those who were redeemed to
Aaron and to his sons by YHWH’s word, as YHWH commanded
Moses.

translation.text: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his Moses.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

verses.english:
“Add up the heads of the children of Kohath from among the
children of Levi by their families, by their fathers’
house,
verses.hebrew: נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי קְהָת מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי קְהָת מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

english.text:
“Add up the heads of the children of Kohath from among the
children of Levi by their families, by their fathers’
house,

translation.text: Take a census of the ancestral houses,

verses.english:
from thirty years old and up to fifty years old, everyone
who would come to the army to do work in the Tent of
Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כּל בָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלָאכָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כּל בָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלָאכָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
from thirty years old and up to fifty years old, everyone
who would come to the army to do work in the Tent of
Meeting.

translation.text: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, all who qualify to do work relating to the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
This is the work of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of
Meeting: the Holy of Holies.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
This is the work of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of
Meeting: the Holy of Holies.

translation.text: The service of the things.

verses.english:
“And Aaron and his sons shall come when the camp is to
travel, and they shall take down the covering pavilion and
cover the ark of the testimony with it.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו בִּנְסֹעַ הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהוֹרִדוּ אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וְכִסּוּ בָהּ אֵת אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו בִּנְסֹעַ הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהוֹרִדוּ אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וְכִסּוּ בָהּ אֵת אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת׃

english.text:
“And Aaron and his sons shall come when the camp is to
travel, and they shall take down the covering pavilion and
cover the ark of the testimony with it.

translation.text: When the camp is to set out, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the screening curtain, and cover the ark of the covenant with it;

verses.english:
And they shall put a cover of leather and shall spread a
fabric all of blue above it and put in its poles.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וּפָרְשׂוּ בֶגֶד כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת מִלְמָעְלָה וְשָׂמוּ בַּדָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וּפָרְשׂוּ בֶגֶד כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת מִלְמָעְלָה וְשָׂמוּ בַּדָּיו׃

english.text:
And they shall put a cover of leather and shall spread a
fabric all of blue above it and put in its poles.

translation.text: then they shall put on it a covering of fine leather, and spread over that a cloth all of blue, and shall put its poles in place.

verses.english:
And on the table of show bread they shall spread a blue
fabric, and they shall put on it the dishes and the pans
and the bowls and the libation jars; and the continual
bread shall be on it.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל שֻׁלְחַן הַפָּנִים יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו אֶת הַקְּעָרֹת וְאֶת הַכַּפֹּת וְאֶת הַמְּנַקִּיֹּת וְאֵת קְשׂוֹת הַנָּסֶךְ וְלֶחֶם הַתָּמִיד עָלָיו יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל שֻׁלְחַן הַפָּנִים יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו אֶת הַקְּעָרֹת וְאֶת הַכַּפֹּת וְאֶת הַמְּנַקִּיֹּת וְאֵת קְשׂוֹת הַנָּסֶךְ וְלֶחֶם הַתָּמִיד עָלָיו יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And on the table of show bread they shall spread a blue
fabric, and they shall put on it the dishes and the pans
and the bowls and the libation jars; and the continual
bread shall be on it.

translation.text: Over the table of the bread of the Presence they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the plates, the dishes for incense, the bowls, and the flagons for the drink offering; the regular bread also shall be on it;

verses.english:
And they shall spread a scarlet fabric over them and cover
it with a leather covering and set its poles.
verses.hebrew: וּפָרְשׂוּ עֲלֵיהֶם בֶּגֶד תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת בַּדָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וּפָרְשׂוּ עֲלֵיהֶם בֶּגֶד תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת בַּדָּיו׃

english.text:
And they shall spread a scarlet fabric over them and cover
it with a leather covering and set its poles.

translation.text: then they shall leather, and shall put its poles in place.

verses.english:
And they shall take a blue fabric and cover the menorah
for lighting and its lamps and its tongs and its
fire-holders and all its equipment for oil with which they
will minister for it.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֶת מְנֹרַת הַמָּאוֹר וְאֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת מַלְקָחֶיהָ וְאֶת מַחְתֹּתֶיהָ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי שַׁמְנָהּ אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ לָהּ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקְחוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֶת מְנֹרַת הַמָּאוֹר וְאֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת מַלְקָחֶיהָ וְאֶת מַחְתֹּתֶיהָ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי שַׁמְנָהּ אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ לָהּ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
And they shall take a blue fabric and cover the menorah
for lighting and its lamps and its tongs and its
fire-holders and all its equipment for oil with which they
will minister for it.

translation.text: They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lampstand for the light, with its lamps, its snuffers, its trays, and all the vessels for oil with which it is supplied;

verses.english:
And they shall put it and all its equipment into a leather
covering and put it on a beam.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֹתָהּ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ אֶל מִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל הַמּוֹט׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ אֹתָהּ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ אֶל מִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל הַמּוֹט׃

english.text:
And they shall put it and all its equipment into a leather
covering and put it on a beam.

translation.text: and they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on the carrying frame.

verses.english:
And on the gold altar they shall spread a blue fabric, and
they shall cover it with a leather covering and set its
poles.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת בַּדָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת בַּדָּיו׃

english.text:
And on the gold altar they shall spread a blue fabric, and
they shall cover it with a leather covering and set its
poles.

translation.text: Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue poles in place;

verses.english:
And they shall take all the equipment for ministering with
which they minister in the Holy and put them into a blue
fabric and cover them with a leather covering and put them
on a beam.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ אֶת כּל כְּלֵי הַשָּׁרֵת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ בָם בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וְנָתְנוּ אֶל בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אוֹתָם בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל הַמּוֹט׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקְחוּ אֶת כּל כְּלֵי הַשָּׁרֵת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ בָם בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וְנָתְנוּ אֶל בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אוֹתָם בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל הַמּוֹט׃

english.text:
And they shall take all the equipment for ministering with
which they minister in the Holy and put them into a blue
fabric and cover them with a leather covering and put them
on a beam.

translation.text: and they shall take all the utensils of the service that are used in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.

verses.english:
And they shall clear the ashes from the altar and spread a
purple fabric over it.
verses.hebrew: וְדִשְּׁנוּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד אַרְגָּמָן׃

hebrew.text: וְדִשְּׁנוּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד אַרְגָּמָן׃

english.text:
And they shall clear the ashes from the altar and spread a
purple fabric over it.

translation.text: cloth over it;

verses.english:
And they shall put on it all its equipment with which they
minister at it—the fire-holders, the forks and the shovels
and the basins—all the altar’s equipment, and they shall
spread a leather covering on it and set its poles.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו אֶת כּל כֵּלָיו אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ עָלָיו בָּהֶם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת אֶת הַמִּזְלָגֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹת כֹּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ בַדָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו אֶת כּל כֵּלָיו אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ עָלָיו בָּהֶם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת אֶת הַמִּזְלָגֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹת כֹּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ בַדָּיו׃

english.text:
And they shall put on it all its equipment with which they
minister at it—the fire-holders, the forks and the shovels
and the basins—all the altar’s equipment, and they shall
spread a leather covering on it and set its poles.

translation.text: and they shall put on it all the utensils of the altar, spread on it a covering of fine leather, and shall put its poles in place.

verses.english:
And Aaron and his sons will finish covering the Holy and
all the equipment of the Holy when the camp is to travel,
and after that the children of Kohath shall come to carry,
so they shall not touch the holy and die. These are what
the children of Kohath are to carry in the Tent of
Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְכִלָּה אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו לְכַסֹּת אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת כּל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ בִּנְסֹעַ הַמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבֹאוּ בְנֵי קְהָת לָשֵׂאת וְלֹא יִגְּעוּ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵתוּ אֵלֶּה מַשָּׂא בְנֵי קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְכִלָּה אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו לְכַסֹּת אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת כּל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ בִּנְסֹעַ הַמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבֹאוּ בְנֵי קְהָת לָשֵׂאת וְלֹא יִגְּעוּ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵתוּ אֵלֶּה מַשָּׂא בְנֵי קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And Aaron and his sons will finish covering the Holy and
all the equipment of the Holy when the camp is to travel,
and after that the children of Kohath shall come to carry,
so they shall not touch the holy and die. These are what
the children of Kohath are to carry in the Tent of
Meeting.

translation.text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, as the camp sets out, after that the that the Kohathites are to carry.

verses.english:
“And the responsibility of Eleazar son of Aaron, the
priest, is the oil for lighting and the incense of
fragrances and the continual grain offering and the
anointing oil—the responsibility for all of the Tabernacle
and everything that is in it, in the Holy and in its
equipment.”
verses.hebrew: וּפְקֻדַּת אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר וּקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וּמִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד וְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה פְּקֻדַּת כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְכל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ בְּקֹדֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּפְקֻדַּת אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר וּקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וּמִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד וְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה פְּקֻדַּת כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְכל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ בְּקֹדֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָיו׃

english.text:
“And the responsibility of Eleazar son of Aaron, the
priest, is the oil for lighting and the incense of
fragrances and the continual grain offering and the
anointing oil—the responsibility for all of the Tabernacle
and everything that is in it, in the Holy and in its
equipment.”

translation.text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall have charge of the oil for the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle and all that is in it, in the sanctuary and in its utensils.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

verses.english:
“You shall not cut off the tribe of the Kohathite families
from among the Levites,
verses.hebrew: אַל תַּכְרִיתוּ אֶת שֵׁבֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִתּוֹךְ הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תַּכְרִיתוּ אֶת שֵׁבֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִתּוֹךְ הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
“You shall not cut off the tribe of the Kohathite families
from among the Levites,

translation.text: You must not the Levites.

verses.english:
but do this to them so they will live and not die when
they come close to the Holy of Holies: Aaron and his sons
shall come, and they shall set them each at his work and
to what he is to carry,
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת עֲשׂוּ לָהֶם וְחָיוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּם אֶת קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יָבֹאוּ וְשָׂמוּ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְאֶל מַשָּׂאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת עֲשׂוּ לָהֶם וְחָיוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּם אֶת קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יָבֹאוּ וְשָׂמוּ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְאֶל מַשָּׂאוֹ׃

english.text:
but do this to them so they will live and not die when
they come close to the Holy of Holies: Aaron and his sons
shall come, and they shall set them each at his work and
to what he is to carry,

translation.text: This is how you must deal with them in order that they may live and not die when they come near to the most holy things: burden.

verses.english:
and they shall not come to see as the Holy is covered up
and die.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָבֹאוּ לִרְאוֹת כְּבַלַּע אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָבֹאוּ לִרְאוֹת כְּבַלַּע אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵתוּ׃

english.text:
and they shall not come to see as the Holy is covered up
and die.”

translation.text: But the Kohathites must not go in to look on the holy things even for a moment; otherwise they will die.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Add up the heads of the children of Gershon, them as
well, by their fathers’ house, by their families.
verses.hebrew: נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן גַּם הֵם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן גַּם הֵם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
“Add up the heads of the children of Gershon, them as
well, by their fathers’ house, by their families.

translation.text: Take a census of the Gershonites also, by their ancestral houses and by their clans;

verses.english:
You shall count them from thirty years old and up to fifty
years old, everyone who would come to do army service, to
do work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה עַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּפְקֹד אוֹתָם כּל הַבָּא לִצְבֹא צָבָא לַעֲבֹד עֲבֹדָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה עַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּפְקֹד אוֹתָם כּל הַבָּא לִצְבֹא צָבָא לַעֲבֹד עֲבֹדָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
You shall count them from thirty years old and up to fifty
years old, everyone who would come to do army service, to
do work in the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: from qualify to do work in the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
This is the work of the Gershonite families, for work and
for carrying:
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לַעֲבֹד וּלְמַשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לַעֲבֹד וּלְמַשָּׂא׃

english.text:
This is the work of the Gershonite families, for work and
for carrying:

translation.text: This is the service of the clans of the Gershonites, in serving and bearing burdens:

verses.english:
And they shall carry the curtains of the Tabernacle, and
the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the leather
covering that is on it above, and the cover of the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting
verses.hebrew: וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת יְרִיעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִכְסֵהוּ וּמִכְסֵה הַתַּחַשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת יְרִיעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִכְסֵהוּ וּמִכְסֵה הַתַּחַשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And they shall carry the curtains of the Tabernacle, and
the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the leather
covering that is on it above, and the cover of the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting

translation.text: They shall covering, and the outer covering of fine leather that is on top of it, and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,

verses.english:
and the courtyard’s hangings and the cover for the
entrance of the gate of the courtyard that is all around
the Tabernacle and the altar, and their cords and all the
equipment for their service. And everything that will be
done for them: they shall do the work.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵיתְרֵיהֶם וְאֶת כּל כְּלֵי עֲבֹדָתָם וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם וְעָבָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵיתְרֵיהֶם וְאֶת כּל כְּלֵי עֲבֹדָתָם וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם וְעָבָדוּ׃

english.text:
and the courtyard’s hangings and the cover for the
entrance of the gate of the courtyard that is all around
the Tabernacle and the altar, and their cords and all the
equipment for their service. And everything that will be
done for them: they shall do the work.

translation.text: and the the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, and all the equipment for their service; and they shall do all that needs to be done with regard to them.

verses.english:
All the work of the children of the Gershonites shall be
by the word of Aaron and his sons, for all their carrying
and all their work. And you shall supervise them in the
task: all their carrying.
verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו תִּהְיֶה כּל עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְכל מַשָּׂאָם וּלְכֹל עֲבֹדָתָם וּפְקַדְתֶּם עֲלֵהֶם בְּמִשְׁמֶרֶת אֵת כּל מַשָּׂאָם׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו תִּהְיֶה כּל עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְכל מַשָּׂאָם וּלְכֹל עֲבֹדָתָם וּפְקַדְתֶּם עֲלֵהֶם בְּמִשְׁמֶרֶת אֵת כּל מַשָּׂאָם׃

english.text:
All the work of the children of the Gershonites shall be
by the word of Aaron and his sons, for all their carrying
and all their work. And you shall supervise them in the
task: all their carrying.

translation.text: All the service of the Gershonites charge all that they are to carry.

verses.english:
This is the work of the families of the children of the
Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. And their charge is in
the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
This is the work of the families of the children of the
Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. And their charge is in
the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

translation.text: This is the service of the clans of the priest.

verses.english:
“The children of Merari by their families, by their
fathers’ house: you shall count them.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם תִּפְקֹד אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם תִּפְקֹד אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“The children of Merari by their families, by their
fathers’ house: you shall count them.

translation.text: As for the Merarites, you shall enroll them by their clans and their ancestral houses;

verses.english:
You shall count them from thirty years old and up to fifty
years old, everyone who would come to the army, to do the
work of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּפְקְדֵם כּל הַבָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּפְקְדֵם כּל הַבָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃
