verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ רֹעִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת זְנוּתֵיכֶם עַד תֹּם פִּגְרֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ רֹעִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת זְנוּתֵיכֶם עַד תֹּם פִּגְרֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And your children will be roving in the wilderness forty
years, and they’ll bear your whoring until the end of your
carcasses in the wilderness.

translation.text: And your children shall be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and shall suffer for your faithlessness, until the last of your dead bodies lies in the wilderness.

verses.english:
For the number of days that you scouted the land, forty
days, you shall bear your crimes a day for each year,
forty years, and you shall know my frustration!
verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר תַּרְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וִידַעְתֶּם אֶת תְּנוּאָתִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּמִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר תַּרְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וִידַעְתֶּם אֶת תְּנוּאָתִי׃

english.text:
For the number of days that you scouted the land, forty
days, you shall bear your crimes a day for each year,
forty years, and you shall know my frustration!

translation.text: According to the number of displeasure."

verses.english:
I, YHWH, have spoken: If I shall not do this to all this
bad congregation who are gathered against me: in this
wilderness they shall end, and they shall die there!”
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי אִם לֹא זֹאת אֶעֱשֶׂה לְכל הָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָי בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִתַּמּוּ וְשָׁם יָמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי אִם לֹא זֹאת אֶעֱשֶׂה לְכל הָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָי בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִתַּמּוּ וְשָׁם יָמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
I, YHWH, have spoken: If I shall not do this to all this
bad congregation who are gathered against me: in this
wilderness they shall end, and they shall die there!”

translation.text: I the LORD have spoken; surely I will do thus to all this they shall come to a full end, and there they shall die.

verses.english:
And the men whom Moses sent to scout the land and came
back and caused all the congregation to complain against
him, bringing out a report about the land:
verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ (וילונו) [וַיַּלִּינוּ] עָלָיו אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה לְהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ (וילונו) [וַיַּלִּינוּ] עָלָיו אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה לְהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the men whom Moses sent to scout the land and came
back and caused all the congregation to complain against
him, bringing out a report about the land:

translation.text: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned report about the land —

verses.english:
the men who brought out the bad report of the land died in
a plague in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמֻתוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת הָאָרֶץ רָעָה בַּמַּגֵּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמֻתוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת הָאָרֶץ רָעָה בַּמַּגֵּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
the men who brought out the bad report of the land died in
a plague in front of YHWH.

translation.text: the men who brought an unfavorable report about the land died by a plague before the LORD.

verses.english:
But, out of those men who went to scout the land, Joshua
son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived. And
Moses spoke these things to all the children of Israel,
and the people mourned very much.
verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה חָיוּ מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם הַהֹלְכִים לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה חָיוּ מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם הַהֹלְכִים לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
But, out of those men who went to scout the land, Joshua
son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived. And
Moses spoke these things to all the children of Israel,
and the people mourned very much.

translation.text: But Joshua men who went to spy out the land.

verses.english: When Moses told these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned greatly.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם מְאֹד׃

english.text: When Moses told these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned greatly.

translation.text: When Moses told these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned greatly.

verses.english:
And they got up in the morning and went up to the top of
the mountain, saying, “Here we are, and we’ll go up to the
place that YHWH said, because we’ve sinned.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר לֵאמֹר הִנֶּנּוּ וְעָלִינוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר לֵאמֹר הִנֶּנּוּ וְעָלִינוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ׃

english.text:
And they got up in the morning and went up to the top of
the mountain, saying, “Here we are, and we’ll go up to the
place that YHWH said, because we’ve sinned.”

translation.text: They rose early in the morning and went up to the heights of the hill country, saying, "Here we are. We will go up to the place that the LORD has promised, for we have sinned."

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Why are you violating YHWH’s word? And it
won’t succeed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לָמָּה זֶּה אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִוא לֹא תִצְלָח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לָמָּה זֶּה אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִוא לֹא תִצְלָח׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Why are you violating YHWH’s word? And it
won’t succeed.

translation.text: But LORD? That will not succeed.

verses.english:
Don’t go up, so you won’t be stricken in front of your
enemies, because YHWH isn’t among you.
verses.hebrew: אַל תַּעֲלוּ כִּי אֵין יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תַּעֲלוּ כִּי אֵין יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Don’t go up, so you won’t be stricken in front of your
enemies, because YHWH isn’t among you.

translation.text: Do not go up, for the LORD is not with you; do not let yourselves be struck down before your enemies.

verses.english:
Because the Amalekite and the Canaanite are there in front
of you, and you’ll fall by the sword because of the fact
that you’ve gone back from following YHWH, and YHWH won’t
be with you.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי שָׁם לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם בֶּחָרֶב כִּי עַל כֵּן שַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי שָׁם לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם בֶּחָרֶב כִּי עַל כֵּן שַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
Because the Amalekite and the Canaanite are there in front
of you, and you’ll fall by the sword because of the fact
that you’ve gone back from following YHWH, and YHWH won’t
be with you.”

translation.text: For the LORD, the LORD will not be with you."

verses.english:
And they acted heedlessly, going up to the top of the
mountain. And the ark of the covenant of YHWH and Moses
did not draw away from the camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֹת אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא מָשׁוּ מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֹת אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא מָשׁוּ מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And they acted heedlessly, going up to the top of the
mountain. And the ark of the covenant of YHWH and Moses
did not draw away from the camp.

translation.text: But they presumed to go covenant of the LORD, and Moses, had not left the camp.

verses.english:
And the Amalekite and the Canaanite who lived in that
mountain came down, and they struck them and crushed them
as far as Hormah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּם וַיַּכְּתוּם עַד הַחרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּם וַיַּכְּתוּם עַד הַחרְמָה׃

english.text:
And the Amalekite and the Canaanite who lived in that
mountain came down, and they struck them and crushed them
as far as Hormah.

translation.text: Then the down and defeated them, pursuing them as far as Hormah.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land of your homes that I
am giving to you,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land of your homes that I
am giving to you,

translation.text: Speak to the Israelites and say to giving you,

verses.english:
and you will make a fire offering to YHWH, a burnt
offering or a sacrifice, to express a vow or as a
contribution or at your appointed times, to make a
pleasant smell to YHWH from the cattle or from the flock,
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֹלָה אוֹ זֶבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ בִנְדָבָה אוֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבָּקָר אוֹ מִן הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֹלָה אוֹ זֶבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ בִנְדָבָה אוֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבָּקָר אוֹ מִן הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
and you will make a fire offering to YHWH, a burnt
offering or a sacrifice, to express a vow or as a
contribution or at your appointed times, to make a
pleasant smell to YHWH from the cattle or from the flock,

translation.text: and you make an offering by fire to the LORD from the fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or at your appointed festivals — to make a pleasing odor for the LORD,

verses.english:
then the one bringing his offering to YHWH shall bring
forward a grain offering, fine flour, one-tenth of a
measure, mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב הַמַּקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת עִשָּׂרוֹן בָּלוּל בִּרְבִעִית הַהִין שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב הַמַּקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת עִשָּׂרוֹן בָּלוּל בִּרְבִעִית הַהִין שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
then the one bringing his offering to YHWH shall bring
forward a grain offering, fine flour, one-tenth of a
measure, mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil.

translation.text: then whoever presents such an offering to the LORD shall present also a grain offering, one-tenth of an ephah of choice flour, mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil.

verses.english:
And you shall make wine for a libation with the burnt
offering or the sacrifice, a fourth of a hin for one lamb.
verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ רְבִיעִית הַהִין תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הָעֹלָה אוֹ לַזָּבַח לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ רְבִיעִית הַהִין תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הָעֹלָה אוֹ לַזָּבַח לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And you shall make wine for a libation with the burnt
offering or the sacrifice, a fourth of a hin for one lamb.

translation.text: offering with the burnt offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.

verses.english:
Or for a ram, you shall make a grain offering, fine flour,
two tenths, mixed with oil, a third of a hin,
verses.hebrew: אוֹ לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין׃

english.text:
Or for a ram, you shall make a grain offering, fine flour,
two tenths, mixed with oil, a third of a hin,

translation.text: For a ram, you shall offer a grain offering, two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil;

verses.english:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, a third
of a hin, a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, a third
of a hin, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: and as a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine, a pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
And if you will make a bull a burnt offering or a
sacrifice, to express a vow, or a peace offering to YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַעֲשֶׂה בֶן בָּקָר עֹלָה אוֹ זָבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תַעֲשֶׂה בֶן בָּקָר עֹלָה אוֹ זָבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And if you will make a bull a burnt offering or a
sacrifice, to express a vow, or a peace offering to YHWH,

translation.text: When you offer a bull as a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as an offering of well-being to the LORD,

verses.english:
then he shall bring forward with the bull a grain
offering, fine flour, three tenths, mixed with oil, half
of a hin,
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב עַל בֶּן הַבָּקָר מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן חֲצִי הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב עַל בֶּן הַבָּקָר מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן חֲצִי הַהִין׃

english.text:
then he shall bring forward with the bull a grain
offering, fine flour, three tenths, mixed with oil, half
of a hin,

translation.text: then you shall present with the bull a grain offering, three-tenths of an ephah of choice flour, mixed with half a hin of oil,

verses.english:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, half of a
hin, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן תַּקְרִיב לַנֶּסֶךְ חֲצִי הַהִין אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַיִן תַּקְרִיב לַנֶּסֶךְ חֲצִי הַהִין אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, half of a
hin, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: and you shall present as a drink offering half a hin of wine, as an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
It shall be done this way for one ox or for one ram or for
a lamb of the sheep or of the goats.
verses.hebrew: כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לַשּׁוֹר הָאֶחָד אוֹ לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד אוֹ לַשֶּׂה בַכְּבָשִׂים אוֹ בָעִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לַשּׁוֹר הָאֶחָד אוֹ לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד אוֹ לַשֶּׂה בַכְּבָשִׂים אוֹ בָעִזִּים׃

english.text:
It shall be done this way for one ox or for one ram or for
a lamb of the sheep or of the goats.

translation.text: Thus it shall be done for each ox or ram, or for each of the male lambs or the kids.

verses.english:
By the number that you will do, you shall do each one of
their number this way.
verses.hebrew: כַּמִּסְפָּר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כָּכָה תַּעֲשׂוּ לָאֶחָד כְּמִסְפָּרָם׃

hebrew.text: כַּמִּסְפָּר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כָּכָה תַּעֲשׂוּ לָאֶחָד כְּמִסְפָּרָם׃

english.text:
By the number that you will do, you shall do each one of
their number this way.

translation.text: According to the number that you offer, so you shall do with each and every one.

verses.english:
Every citizen shall do these this way when bringing
forward an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כּל הָאֶזְרָח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּכָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לְהַקְרִיב אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל הָאֶזְרָח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּכָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לְהַקְרִיב אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Every citizen shall do these this way when bringing
forward an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: Every native Israelite shall do these things in this way, in presenting an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
And when an alien will reside with you—or someone who is
among you—through your generations and will make an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH, as you will
do so he shall do.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר אוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וְעָשָׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר אוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וְעָשָׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And when an alien will reside with you—or someone who is
among you—through your generations and will make an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH, as you will
do so he shall do.

translation.text: An alien who lives with you, or who takes up permanent pleasing odor to the LORD, shall do as you do.

verses.english:
You, congregation, and the resident alien have one law, an
eternal law through your generations: it will be the same
for you and for the alien in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הַקָּהָל חֻקָּה אַחַת לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּכֶם כַּגֵּר יִהְיֶה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הַקָּהָל חֻקָּה אַחַת לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּכֶם כַּגֵּר יִהְיֶה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You, congregation, and the resident alien have one law, an
eternal law through your generations: it will be the same
for you and for the alien in front of YHWH.

translation.text: As for the assembly, be alike before the LORD.

verses.english:
You and the alien who resides with you shall have one
instruction and one judgment.”
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרָה אַחַת וּמִשְׁפָּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: תּוֹרָה אַחַת וּמִשְׁפָּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
You and the alien who resides with you shall have one
instruction and one judgment.”

translation.text: You and the alien who resides with you shall have the same law and the same ordinance.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land where I’m bringing you,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land where I’m bringing you,

translation.text: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: After you come into the land to which I am bringing you,

verses.english:
then it will be that when you eat some of the land’s bread
you shall make a donation to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּאֲכלְכֶם מִלֶּחֶם הָאָרֶץ תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּאֲכלְכֶם מִלֶּחֶם הָאָרֶץ תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
then it will be that when you eat some of the land’s bread
you shall make a donation to YHWH.

translation.text: donation to the LORD.

verses.english:
The first of your dough: you shall make a loaf as a
donation. Like a donation from the threshing floor, so you
shall donate it.
verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵכֶם חַלָּה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן כֵּן תָּרִימוּ אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: רֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵכֶם חַלָּה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן כֵּן תָּרִימוּ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
The first of your dough: you shall make a loaf as a
donation. Like a donation from the threshing floor, so you
shall donate it.

translation.text: From your first batch of dough you shall present a loaf as a donation; you shall present it just as you present a donation from the threshing floor.

verses.english:
From the first of your dough you shall give a donation to
YHWH through your generations.
verses.hebrew: מֵרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה תְּרוּמָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מֵרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה תְּרוּמָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
From the first of your dough you shall give a donation to
YHWH through your generations.

translation.text: Throughout your generations dough.

verses.english:
“And when you will make a mistake and not do all of these
commandments that YHWH has spoken to Moses,
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִשְׁגּוּ וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִשְׁגּוּ וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
“And when you will make a mistake and not do all of these
commandments that YHWH has spoken to Moses,

translation.text: But if you unintentionally fail to observe all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses —

verses.english:
everything that YHWH has commanded you by Moses’ hand,
from the day that YHWH commanded and on through your
generations,
verses.hebrew: אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה מִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וָהָלְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה מִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וָהָלְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
everything that YHWH has commanded you by Moses’ hand,
from the day that YHWH commanded and on through your
generations,

translation.text: everything that the LORD has and thereafter, throughout your generations —

verses.english:
then it will be that, if it was done by mistake, out of
the congregation’s sight, then all the congregation shall
do one bull of the cattle as a burnt offering for a
pleasant smell to YHWH and its grain offering and its
libation according to the required manner and one goat for
a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם מֵעֵינֵי הָעֵדָה נֶעֶשְׂתָה לִשְׁגָגָה וְעָשׂוּ כל הָעֵדָה פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד לְעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתוֹ וְנִסְכּוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם מֵעֵינֵי הָעֵדָה נֶעֶשְׂתָה לִשְׁגָגָה וְעָשׂוּ כל הָעֵדָה פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד לְעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתוֹ וְנִסְכּוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּת׃

english.text:
then it will be that, if it was done by mistake, out of
the congregation’s sight, then all the congregation shall
do one bull of the cattle as a burnt offering for a
pleasant smell to YHWH and its grain offering and its
libation according to the required manner and one goat for
a sin offering.

translation.text: then if it was done pleasing odor to the LORD, together with its grain offering and its drink offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make atonement for all the
congregation of the children of Israel, and it will be
forgiven for them, because it was a mistake, and they
brought their offering, an offering by fire to YHWH, and
their sin offering in front of YHWH for their mistake.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם כִּי שְׁגָגָה הִוא וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֶת קרְבָּנָם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְחַטָּאתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שִׁגְגָתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם כִּי שְׁגָגָה הִוא וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֶת קרְבָּנָם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְחַטָּאתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שִׁגְגָתָם׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make atonement for all the
congregation of the children of Israel, and it will be
forgiven for them, because it was a mistake, and they
brought their offering, an offering by fire to YHWH, and
their sin offering in front of YHWH for their mistake.

translation.text: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the Israelites, and they shall be forgiven; it was unintentional, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.

verses.english:
And it will be forgiven for all the congregation of the
children of Israel and the alien who resides among them,
because it was by mistake for all the people.
verses.hebrew: וְנִסְלַח לְכל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם כִּי לְכל הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִסְלַח לְכל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם כִּי לְכל הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
And it will be forgiven for all the congregation of the
children of Israel and the alien who resides among them,
because it was by mistake for all the people.

translation.text: All the congregation of the Israelites shall be forgiven, as well as the aliens error.

verses.english:
“And if one person will sin by mistake, then he shall
bring a she-goat in its first year for a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה וְהִקְרִיבָה עֵז בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ לְחַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה וְהִקְרִיבָה עֵז בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ לְחַטָּאת׃

english.text:
“And if one person will sin by mistake, then he shall
bring a she-goat in its first year for a sin offering.

translation.text: An individual who sins unintentionally shall present a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make atonement for the person who
made the mistake, sinning by mistake, in front of YHWH to
make atonement for him, and it will be forgiven for him.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶגֶת בְּחֶטְאָה בִשְׁגָגָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶגֶת בְּחֶטְאָה בִשְׁגָגָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make atonement for the person who
made the mistake, sinning by mistake, in front of YHWH to
make atonement for him, and it will be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And the priest shall make atonement forgiven.

verses.english:
The citizen among the children of Israel and for the alien
who resides among them: you shall have one instruction for
one who acts by mistake.
verses.hebrew: הָאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לָעֹשֶׂה בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: הָאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לָעֹשֶׂה בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
The citizen among the children of Israel and for the alien
who resides among them: you shall have one instruction for
one who acts by mistake.

translation.text: For both the native among the Israelites and the alien acts in error.

verses.english:
“But the person who will act with a high hand, a citizen
or an alien, he is blaspheming YHWH, and that person will
be cut off from among his people,
verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָד רָמָה מִן הָאֶזְרָח וּמִן הַגֵּר אֶת יְהֹוָה הוּא מְגַדֵּף וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָד רָמָה מִן הָאֶזְרָח וּמִן הַגֵּר אֶת יְהֹוָה הוּא מְגַדֵּף וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
“But the person who will act with a high hand, a citizen
or an alien, he is blaspheming YHWH, and that person will
be cut off from among his people,

translation.text: But whoever acts high-handedly, whether a native or people.

verses.english:
because he disdained YHWH’s word and broke His
commandment. That person will be cut off. His crime is in
him.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי דְבַר יְהֹוָה בָּזָה וְאֶת מִצְוָתוֹ הֵפַר הִכָּרֵת תִּכָּרֵת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא עֲוֺנָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי דְבַר יְהֹוָה בָּזָה וְאֶת מִצְוָתוֹ הֵפַר הִכָּרֵת תִּכָּרֵת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא עֲוֺנָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
because he disdained YHWH’s word and broke His
commandment. That person will be cut off. His crime is in
him.”

translation.text: Because of having despised the word of the LORD and bear the guilt.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel were in the wilderness, and
they found a man collecting wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel were in the wilderness, and
they found a man collecting wood on the Sabbath day.

translation.text: When the Israelites were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the sabbath day.

verses.english:
And those who found him collecting wood brought him
forward to Moses and to Aaron and to all the congregation.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתוֹ הַמֹּצְאִים אֹתוֹ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתוֹ הַמֹּצְאִים אֹתוֹ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And those who found him collecting wood brought him
forward to Moses and to Aaron and to all the congregation.

translation.text: Those who found him congregation.

verses.english:
And they left him under watch because it had not been
determined what should be done to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָר כִּי לֹא פֹרַשׁ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָר כִּי לֹא פֹרַשׁ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And they left him under watch because it had not been
determined what should be done to him.

translation.text: They put him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The man shall be put to death!
All the congregation is to batter him with stones outside
the camp.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מוֹת יוּמַת הָאִישׁ רָגוֹם אֹתוֹ בָאֲבָנִים כּל הָעֵדָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מוֹת יוּמַת הָאִישׁ רָגוֹם אֹתוֹ בָאֲבָנִים כּל הָעֵדָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The man shall be put to death!
All the congregation is to batter him with stones outside
the camp.”

translation.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man shall be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him outside the camp."

verses.english:
And all the congregation brought him outside the camp and
battered him with stones, and he died, as YHWH commanded
Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ בָּאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ בָּאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And all the congregation brought him outside the camp and
battered him with stones, and he died, as YHWH commanded
Moses.

translation.text: The whole congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him to death, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them that they shall make fringe on the corners of their
clothes through their generations. And they shall put a
blue string on the fringe of the corner.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them that they shall make fringe on the corners of their
clothes through their generations. And they shall put a
blue string on the fringe of the corner.

translation.text: Speak to the Israelites, and tell them to generations and to put a blue cord on the fringe at each corner.

verses.english:
And you shall have the fringe so you will see it and bring
to mind all of YHWH’s commandments and will do them, and
you will not go around after your heart and after your
eyes, because you whore after them.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall have the fringe so you will see it and bring
to mind all of YHWH’s commandments and will do them, and
you will not go around after your heart and after your
eyes, because you whore after them.

translation.text: You have the fringe so that, when you see it, you will remember all the your own heart and your own eyes.

verses.english:
So you will bring to mind and do all my commandments, and
you will be holy to your God.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
So you will bring to mind and do all my commandments, and
you will be holy to your God.

translation.text: So you shall remember and do all my commandments, and you shall be holy to your God.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to be God to you. I am YHWH, your God.”
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to be God to you. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: I am the God: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And Korah son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi, and
Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On, son of Peleth,
sons of Reuben, took
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח קֹרַח בֶּן יִצְהָר בֶּן קְהָת בֶּן לֵוִי וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וְאוֹן בֶּן פֶּלֶת בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח קֹרַח בֶּן יִצְהָר בֶּן קְהָת בֶּן לֵוִי וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וְאוֹן בֶּן פֶּלֶת בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
And Korah son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi, and
Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On, son of Peleth,
sons of Reuben, took

translation.text: Now Korah son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi, along with Dathan Reuben — took

verses.english:
and got up in front of Moses—and two hundred fifty people
from the children of Israel, chieftains of the
congregation, prominent ones of the assembly, people of
repute.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וַאֲנָשִׁים מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם נְשִׂיאֵי עֵדָה קְרִאֵי מוֹעֵד אַנְשֵׁי שֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וַאֲנָשִׁים מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם נְשִׂיאֵי עֵדָה קְרִאֵי מוֹעֵד אַנְשֵׁי שֵׁם׃

english.text:
and got up in front of Moses—and two hundred fifty people
from the children of Israel, chieftains of the
congregation, prominent ones of the assembly, people of
repute.

translation.text: two hundred fifty Israelite men, leaders of the confronted Moses.

verses.english:
And they assembled against Moses and against Aaron and
said to them, “You have much! Because all of the
congregation, all of them, are holy, and YHWH is among
them. And why do you raise yourselves up over YHWH’s
community?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם רַב לָכֶם כִּי כל הָעֵדָה כֻּלָּם קְדֹשִׁים וּבְתוֹכָם יְהֹוָה וּמַדּוּעַ תִּתְנַשְּׂאוּ עַל קְהַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם רַב לָכֶם כִּי כל הָעֵדָה כֻּלָּם קְדֹשִׁים וּבְתוֹכָם יְהֹוָה וּמַדּוּעַ תִּתְנַשְּׂאוּ עַל קְהַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they assembled against Moses and against Aaron and
said to them, “You have much! Because all of the
congregation, all of them, are holy, and YHWH is among
them. And why do you raise yourselves up over YHWH’s
community?”

translation.text: They assembled against Moses and against Aaron, you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?"

verses.english: And Moses listened, and he fell on his face.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל עַל פָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל עַל פָּנָיו׃

english.text: And Moses listened, and he fell on his face.

translation.text: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

verses.english:
And he spoke to Korah and to all of his congregation,
saying, “In the morning YHWH will make known who is His
and who is holy, and He will bring him close to Him. And
He will bring the one He chooses close to Him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל קֹרַח וְאֶל כּל עֲדָתוֹ לֵאמֹר בֹּקֶר וְיֹדַע יְהֹוָה אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְאֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ וְהִקְרִיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בּוֹ יַקְרִיב אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל קֹרַח וְאֶל כּל עֲדָתוֹ לֵאמֹר בֹּקֶר וְיֹדַע יְהֹוָה אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְאֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ וְהִקְרִיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בּוֹ יַקְרִיב אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And he spoke to Korah and to all of his congregation,
saying, “In the morning YHWH will make known who is His
and who is holy, and He will bring him close to Him. And
He will bring the one He chooses close to Him.

translation.text: Then he said to Korah and all his he will choose he will allow to approach him.

verses.english:
Do this: Take incense burners, Korah and all his
congregation,

Do this: Take incense burners, Korah and all his
congregation,

and put fire in them and set incense on them in front of

and put fire in them and set incense on them in front of

english.text: And Moses said to Korah, “Listen, sons of Levi,

translation.text: Then Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you Levites!

verses.english:
is it too small a thing for you that Israel’s God has
distinguished you from the congregation of Israel to bring
you close to him, to do the work of YHWH’s Tabernacle and
to stand in front of the congregation to minister for
them,

hebrew.text: הַמְעַט מִכֶּם כִּי הִבְדִּיל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶתְכֶם אֵלָיו לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְלַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לְשָׁרְתָם׃

english.text:
is it too small a thing for you that Israel’s God has
distinguished you from the congregation of Israel to bring
you close to him, to do the work of YHWH’s Tabernacle and
to stand in front of the congregation to minister for
them,

translation.text: Is it too little for you that the tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation and serve them?

verses.english:
and that He has brought you and all your brothers, the
sons of Levi, with you close to Him? And you seek
priesthood as well?!
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֹתְךָ וְאֶת כּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי אִתָּךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם גַּם כְּהֻנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֹתְךָ וְאֶת כּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי אִתָּךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם גַּם כְּהֻנָּה׃

english.text:
and that He has brought you and all your brothers, the
sons of Levi, with you close to Him? And you seek
priesthood as well?!

translation.text: you; yet you seek the priesthood as well!

verses.english:
Therefore you and all your congregation who are gathering
are against YHWH! And Aaron, what is he that you complain
against him?”
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הַנֹּעָדִים עַל יְהֹוָה וְאַהֲרֹן מַה הוּא כִּי (תלונו) [תַלִּינוּ] עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הַנֹּעָדִים עַל יְהֹוָה וְאַהֲרֹן מַה הוּא כִּי (תלונו) [תַלִּינוּ] עָלָיו׃

english.text:
Therefore you and all your congregation who are gathering
are against YHWH! And Aaron, what is he that you complain
against him?”

translation.text: Therefore you and all your you rail against him?"

verses.english:
And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab,
and they said, “We won’t come up.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לִקְרֹא לְדָתָן וְלַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לִקְרֹא לְדָתָן וְלַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab,
and they said, “We won’t come up.

translation.text: Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram sons of Eliab; but they said, "We will not come!

verses.english:
Is it a small thing that you brought us up from a land
flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness,
that you lord it over us as well?
verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט כִּי הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי תִשְׂתָּרֵר עָלֵינוּ גַּם הִשְׂתָּרֵר׃

hebrew.text: הַמְעַט כִּי הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי תִשְׂתָּרֵר עָלֵינוּ גַּם הִשְׂתָּרֵר׃

english.text:
Is it a small thing that you brought us up from a land
flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness,
that you lord it over us as well?

translation.text: Is it too little that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness, that you must also lord it over us?

verses.english:
Besides, you haven’t brought us to a land flowing with
milk and honey or given us possession of field or
vineyard. Will you put out those people’s eyes? We won’t
come up.”
verses.hebrew: אַף לֹא אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הֲבִיאֹתָנוּ וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ נַחֲלַת שָׂדֶה וָכָרֶם הַעֵינֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם תְּנַקֵּר לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

hebrew.text: אַף לֹא אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הֲבִיאֹתָנוּ וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ נַחֲלַת שָׂדֶה וָכָרֶם הַעֵינֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם תְּנַקֵּר לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

english.text:
Besides, you haven’t brought us to a land flowing with
milk and honey or given us possession of field or
vineyard. Will you put out those people’s eyes? We won’t
come up.”

translation.text: It is clear you have not brought us into a come!"

verses.english:
And Moses was very angry, and he said to YHWH, “Don’t turn
to their offering. Not one ass of theirs have I taken
away, and I haven’t wronged one of them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְמֹשֶׁה מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יְהֹוָה אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל מִנְחָתָם לֹא חֲמוֹר אֶחָד מֵהֶם נָשָׂאתִי וְלֹא הֲרֵעֹתִי אֶת אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְמֹשֶׁה מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יְהֹוָה אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל מִנְחָתָם לֹא חֲמוֹר אֶחָד מֵהֶם נָשָׂאתִי וְלֹא הֲרֵעֹתִי אֶת אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses was very angry, and he said to YHWH, “Don’t turn
to their offering. Not one ass of theirs have I taken
away, and I haven’t wronged one of them.”

translation.text: Moses was very angry and said to the LORD, "Pay no attention to harmed any one of them."

verses.english:
And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your congregation,
be in front of YHWH—you and they and Aaron—tomorrow.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הֱיוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וָהֵם וְאַהֲרֹן מָחָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הֱיוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וָהֵם וְאַהֲרֹן מָחָר׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your congregation,
be in front of YHWH—you and they and Aaron—tomorrow.

translation.text: And Moses said to Korah, "As for you they and Aaron;

verses.english:
And each man take his fire-holder, and put incense on
them, and each man bring his fire-holder forward in front
of YHWH, two hundred fifty fire-holders, and you and
Aaron, each man his fire-holder.”
verses.hebrew: וּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וּנְתַתֶּם עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם מַחְתֹּת וְאַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וּנְתַתֶּם עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם מַחְתֹּת וְאַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And each man take his fire-holder, and put incense on
them, and each man bring his fire-holder forward in front
of YHWH, two hundred fifty fire-holders, and you and
Aaron, each man his fire-holder.”

translation.text: and let each one of you take his censer, and put two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer."

verses.english:
And each man took his fire-holder, and they put fire on
them and set incense on them, and they stood at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and Moses and Aaron.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And each man took his fire-holder, and they put fire on
them and set incense on them, and they stood at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and Moses and Aaron.

translation.text: So meeting with Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
And Korah assembled all the congregation against them, to
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And YHWH’s glory
appeared to all the congregation.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְהֵל עֲלֵיהֶם קֹרַח אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְהֵל עֲלֵיהֶם קֹרַח אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And Korah assembled all the congregation against them, to
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And YHWH’s glory
appeared to all the congregation.

translation.text: Then Korah assembled the whole the glory of the LORD appeared to the whole congregation.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:

verses.english:
“Separate from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!”
verses.hebrew: הִבָּדְלוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע׃

hebrew.text: הִבָּדְלוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע׃

english.text:
“Separate from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!”

translation.text: Separate moment.

verses.english:
And they fell on their faces and said, “God, the God of
the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin and you be
angry at all the congregation?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכל בָּשָׂר הָאִישׁ אֶחָד יֶחֱטָא וְעַל כּל הָעֵדָה תִּקְצֹף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכל בָּשָׂר הָאִישׁ אֶחָד יֶחֱטָא וְעַל כּל הָעֵדָה תִּקְצֹף׃

english.text:
And they fell on their faces and said, “God, the God of
the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin and you be
angry at all the congregation?”

translation.text: They fell on their faces, and said, "O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one person sin and you become angry with the whole congregation?"

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get up from around
the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’”
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר הֵעָלוּ מִסָּבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר הֵעָלוּ מִסָּבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get up from around
the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’”

translation.text: Say to the congregation: Get away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

verses.english:
And Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and
Israel’s elders went after him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and
Israel’s elders went after him.

translation.text: So followed him.

verses.english:
And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Turn away from
the tents of these wicked men and don’t touch anything
that is theirs, or else you’ll be annihilated through all
their sins.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר סוּרוּ נָא מֵעַל אהֳלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרְשָׁעִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאַל תִּגְּעוּ בְּכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם פֶּן תִּסָּפוּ בְּכל חַטֹּאתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר סוּרוּ נָא מֵעַל אהֳלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרְשָׁעִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאַל תִּגְּעוּ בְּכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם פֶּן תִּסָּפוּ בְּכל חַטֹּאתָם׃

english.text:
And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Turn away from
the tents of these wicked men and don’t touch anything
that is theirs, or else you’ll be annihilated through all
their sins.”

translation.text: He said to the congregation, "Turn away from the swept away for all their sins."

verses.english:
And they got up from around the tabernacle of Korah,
Dathan and Abiram. And Dathan and Abiram came out,
standing at the entrance of their tents, and their wives
and their children and their infants.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּעָלוּ מֵעַל מִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם מִסָּבִיב וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם יָצְאוּ נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח אהֳלֵיהֶם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וְטַפָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּעָלוּ מֵעַל מִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם מִסָּבִיב וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם יָצְאוּ נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח אהֳלֵיהֶם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וְטַפָּם׃

english.text:
And they got up from around the tabernacle of Korah,
Dathan and Abiram. And Dathan and Abiram came out,
standing at the entrance of their tents, and their wives
and their children and their infants.

translation.text: So they got away from the dwellings children, and their little ones.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “By this you’ll know that YHWH sent me to
do all these things, because it’s not from my own heart.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּזֹאת תֵּדְעוּן כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי לֹא מִלִּבִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּזֹאת תֵּדְעוּן כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי לֹא מִלִּבִּי׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “By this you’ll know that YHWH sent me to
do all these things, because it’s not from my own heart.

translation.text: And Moses said, "This is how you shall of my own accord:

verses.english:
If these die like the death of every human, and the event
of every human happens to them, then YHWH hasn’t sent me.
verses.hebrew: אִם כְּמוֹת כּל הָאָדָם יְמֻתוּן אֵלֶּה וּפְקֻדַּת כּל הָאָדָם יִפָּקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחָנִי׃

hebrew.text: אִם כְּמוֹת כּל הָאָדָם יְמֻתוּן אֵלֶּה וּפְקֻדַּת כּל הָאָדָם יִפָּקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחָנִי׃

english.text:
If these die like the death of every human, and the event
of every human happens to them, then YHWH hasn’t sent me.

translation.text: If these people die a natural death, or if a natural fate comes on them, then the LORD has not sent me.

verses.english:
But if YHWH will create something, and the ground will
open its mouth and swallow them and all that they have,
and they’ll go down alive to Sheol, then you’ll know that
these people have rejected YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּרִיאָה יִבְרָא יְהֹוָה וּפָצְתָה הָאֲדָמָה אֶת פִּיהָ וּבָלְעָה אֹתָם וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְיָרְדוּ חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּרִיאָה יִבְרָא יְהֹוָה וּפָצְתָה הָאֲדָמָה אֶת פִּיהָ וּבָלְעָה אֹתָם וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְיָרְדוּ חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But if YHWH will create something, and the ground will
open its mouth and swallow them and all that they have,
and they’ll go down alive to Sheol, then you’ll know that
these people have rejected YHWH.”

translation.text: But if the LORD Sheol, then you shall know that these men have despised the LORD."

verses.english:
And it was as he was finishing speaking all these things,
and the ground that was under them was broken up,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
And it was as he was finishing speaking all these things,
and the ground that was under them was broken up,

translation.text: As soon as he finished speaking all these words, the ground under them was split apart.

verses.english:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
their households and all the people who were with Korah
and all the property,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם וְאֵת כּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר לְקֹרַח וְאֵת כּל הָרְכוּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם וְאֵת כּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר לְקֹרַח וְאֵת כּל הָרְכוּשׁ׃

english.text:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
their households and all the people who were with Korah
and all the property,

translation.text: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed Korah and all their goods.

verses.english:
and they went down, they and all that they had, alive to
Sheol. And the earth covered them over, and they perished
from among the community.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ הֵם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וַתְּכַס עֲלֵיהֶם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאבְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ הֵם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וַתְּכַס עֲלֵיהֶם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאבְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל׃

english.text:
and they went down, they and all that they had, alive to
Sheol. And the earth covered them over, and they perished
from among the community.

translation.text: So they with all that belonged to them perished from the midst of the assembly.

verses.english:
And all Israel that was around them fled at the sound of
them, for they said, “Or else the earth will swallow us.”
verses.hebrew: וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם נָסוּ לְקֹלָם כִּי אָמְרוּ פֶּן תִּבְלָעֵנוּ הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם נָסוּ לְקֹלָם כִּי אָמְרוּ פֶּן תִּבְלָעֵנוּ הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And all Israel that was around them fled at the sound of
them, for they said, “Or else the earth will swallow us.”

translation.text: All Israel around them fled at their outcry, for they said, "The earth will swallow us too!"

verses.english:
And fire had gone out from YHWH and consumed the two
hundred fifty people offering the incense.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֵת הַחֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ מַקְרִיבֵי הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֵת הַחֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ מַקְרִיבֵי הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

english.text:
And fire had gone out from YHWH and consumed the two
hundred fifty people offering the incense.

translation.text: And offering the incense.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Say to Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, that he should
pick up the fire-holders from the burning and disperse the
fire, because they have become holy.
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְיָרֵם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת מִבֵּין הַשְּׂרֵפָה וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ זְרֵה הָלְאָה כִּי קָדֵשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֱמֹר אֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְיָרֵם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת מִבֵּין הַשְּׂרֵפָה וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ זְרֵה הָלְאָה כִּי קָדֵשׁוּ׃

english.text:
“Say to Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, that he should
pick up the fire-holders from the burning and disperse the
fire, because they have become holy.

translation.text: Speak to the Israelites, and get leaders of their ancestral houses. Write each man's name on his staff,

verses.english:
And the fire-holders of these who sinned at the cost of
their lives: let them make them into hammered plates as
plating for the altar, because they brought them forward
in front of YHWH, and they became holy, and let them
become a sign to the children of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַחַטָּאִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַפְשֹׁתָם וְעָשׂוּ אֹתָם רִקֻּעֵי פַחִים צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי הִקְרִיבֻם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּקְדָּשׁוּ וְיִהְיוּ לְאוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַחַטָּאִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַפְשֹׁתָם וְעָשׂוּ אֹתָם רִקֻּעֵי פַחִים צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי הִקְרִיבֻם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּקְדָּשׁוּ וְיִהְיוּ לְאוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the fire-holders of these who sinned at the cost of
their lives: let them make them into hammered plates as
plating for the altar, because they brought them forward
in front of YHWH, and they became holy, and let them
become a sign to the children of Israel.”

translation.text: staff for the head of each ancestral house.

verses.english:
And Eleazar, the priest, took the fire-holders of bronze
that those who were burned had brought forward, and they
hammered them into a plating for the altar,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִים וַיְרַקְּעוּם צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִים וַיְרַקְּעוּם צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Eleazar, the priest, took the fire-holders of bronze
that those who were burned had brought forward, and they
hammered them into a plating for the altar,

translation.text: Place them in the tent of meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

verses.english:
a commemoration for the children of Israel so that no
outsider, one who is not from Aaron’s seed, will come
forward to burn incense in front of YHWH, so he will not
be like Korah and like his congregation, as YHWH spoke to
him by Moses’ hand.
verses.hebrew: זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִקְרַב אִישׁ זָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הוּא לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה כְקֹרַח וְכַעֲדָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִקְרַב אִישׁ זָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הוּא לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה כְקֹרַח וְכַעֲדָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה לוֹ׃

english.text:
a commemoration for the children of Israel so that no
outsider, one who is not from Aaron’s seed, will come
forward to burn incense in front of YHWH, so he will not
be like Korah and like his congregation, as YHWH spoke to
him by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: And the staff complaints of the Israelites that they continually make against you.

verses.english:
And all the congregation of the children of Israel
complained the next day against Moses and against Aaron,
saying, “You killed YHWH’s people!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלֹּנוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמּחֳרָת עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם הֲמִתֶּם אֶת עַם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלֹּנוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמּחֳרָת עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם הֲמִתֶּם אֶת עַם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And all the congregation of the children of Israel
complained the next day against Moses and against Aaron,
saying, “You killed YHWH’s people!”

translation.text: Moses spoke to the Israelites; and all their leaders gave him staffs, one for each leader, according to their ancestral houses, twelve staffs; and the staff of Aaron was among theirs.

verses.english:
And it was when the congregation was assembled against
Moses and against Aaron, and they turned to the Tent of
Meeting; and, here, the cloud had covered it, and YHWH’s
glory appeared.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּהִקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיִּפְנוּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִנֵּה כִסָּהוּ הֶעָנָן וַיֵּרָא כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּהִקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיִּפְנוּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִנֵּה כִסָּהוּ הֶעָנָן וַיֵּרָא כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And it was when the congregation was assembled against
Moses and against Aaron, and they turned to the Tent of
Meeting; and, here, the cloud had covered it, and YHWH’s
glory appeared.

translation.text: So Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the tent of the covenant.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of
Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of
Meeting.

translation.text: When Moses went into the tent of the covenant on the next day, the produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from before the LORD to all the Israelites; and they looked, and each man took his staff.

verses.english:
“Move away from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!” And they fell on their faces.
verses.hebrew: הֵרֹמּוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: הֵרֹמּוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“Move away from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!” And they fell on their faces.

translation.text: And the LORD said to Moses, "Put back else they will die."

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Take a fire-holder and put fire
from the altar on it and set incense and carry it quickly
to the congregation and make atonement for them, because a
rage has come out from in front of YHWH! The plague has
begun!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח אֶת הַמַּחְתָּה וְתֶן עָלֶיהָ אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשִׂים קְטֹרֶת וְהוֹלֵךְ מְהֵרָה אֶל הָעֵדָה וְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם כִּי יָצָא הַקֶּצֶף מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה הֵחֵל הַנָּגֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח אֶת הַמַּחְתָּה וְתֶן עָלֶיהָ אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשִׂים קְטֹרֶת וְהוֹלֵךְ מְהֵרָה אֶל הָעֵדָה וְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם כִּי יָצָא הַקֶּצֶף מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה הֵחֵל הַנָּגֶף׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Take a fire-holder and put fire
from the altar on it and set incense and carry it quickly
to the congregation and make atonement for them, because a
rage has come out from in front of YHWH! The plague has
begun!”

translation.text: Moses did so; just as the LORD commanded him, so he did.

verses.english:
And Aaron took it as Moses had spoken, and he ran among
the community. And, here, the plague had begun among the
people. And he put in incense and made atonement for the
people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּרץ אֶל תּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל וְהִנֵּה הֵחֵל הַנֶּגֶף בָּעָם וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת וַיְכַפֵּר עַל הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּרץ אֶל תּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל וְהִנֵּה הֵחֵל הַנֶּגֶף בָּעָם וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת וַיְכַפֵּר עַל הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Aaron took it as Moses had spoken, and he ran among
the community. And, here, the plague had begun among the
people. And he put in incense and made atonement for the
people.

translation.text: The Israelites said to Moses, "We are perishing; we are lost, all of us are lost!

verses.english:
And he stood between the dead and the living. And the
plague was halted.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד בֵּין הַמֵּתִים וּבֵין הַחַיִּים וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד בֵּין הַמֵּתִים וּבֵין הַחַיִּים וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה׃

english.text:
And he stood between the dead and the living. And the
plague was halted.

translation.text: Everyone who approaches the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all to perish?"

verses.english:
And the dead in the plague were fourteen thousand seven
hundred, apart from the dead over the matter of Korah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת מִלְּבַד הַמֵּתִים עַל דְּבַר קֹרַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת מִלְּבַד הַמֵּתִים עַל דְּבַר קֹרַח׃

english.text:
And the dead in the plague were fourteen thousand seven
hundred, apart from the dead over the matter of Korah.

verses.english:
And Aaron went back to Moses, to the entrance of the Tent
of Meeting, when the plague had been halted.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אַהֲרֹן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהַמַּגֵּפָה נֶעֱצָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אַהֲרֹן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהַמַּגֵּפָה נֶעֱצָרָה׃

english.text:
And Aaron went back to Moses, to the entrance of the Tent
of Meeting, when the plague had been halted.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel and take from them a
staff for each father’s house, from all their chieftains
by their fathers’ house, twelve staffs. You shall write
each man’s name on his staff,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְקַח מֵאִתָּם מַטֶּה מַטֶּה לְבֵית אָב מֵאֵת כּל נְשִׂיאֵהֶם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מַטּוֹת אִישׁ אֶת שְׁמוֹ תִּכְתֹּב עַל מַטֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְקַח מֵאִתָּם מַטֶּה מַטֶּה לְבֵית אָב מֵאֵת כּל נְשִׂיאֵהֶם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מַטּוֹת אִישׁ אֶת שְׁמוֹ תִּכְתֹּב עַל מַטֵּהוּ׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel and take from them a
staff for each father’s house, from all their chieftains
by their fathers’ house, twelve staffs. You shall write
each man’s name on his staff,

verses.english:
and you shall write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi,
because there shall be one staff for the head of their
fathers’ house.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שֵׁם אַהֲרֹן תִּכְתֹּב עַל מַטֵּה לֵוִי כִּי מַטֶּה אֶחָד לְרֹאשׁ בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שֵׁם אַהֲרֹן תִּכְתֹּב עַל מַטֵּה לֵוִי כִּי מַטֶּה אֶחָד לְרֹאשׁ בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם׃

english.text:
and you shall write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi,
because there shall be one staff for the head of their
fathers’ house.

verses.english:
And you shall leave them in the Tent of Meeting in front
of the Testimony where I shall meet with you.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנַּחְתָּם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הָעֵדוּת אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנַּחְתָּם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הָעֵדוּת אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And you shall leave them in the Tent of Meeting in front
of the Testimony where I shall meet with you.

verses.english:
And it will be that the man I shall choose: his staff will
bloom. And I’ll decrease from me the complaints of the
children of Israel that they’re making against you.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֶבְחַר בּוֹ מַטֵּהוּ יִפְרָח וַהֲשִׁכֹּתִי מֵעָלַי אֶת תְּלֻנּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַלִּינִם עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֶבְחַר בּוֹ מַטֵּהוּ יִפְרָח וַהֲשִׁכֹּתִי מֵעָלַי אֶת תְּלֻנּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַלִּינִם עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And it will be that the man I shall choose: his staff will
bloom. And I’ll decrease from me the complaints of the
children of Israel that they’re making against you.”

verses.english:
And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and all their
chieftains gave him a staff for each chieftain by their
fathers’ house, twelve staffs, and Aaron’s staff was among
their staffs.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֵלָיו כּל נְשִׂיאֵיהֶם מַטֶּה לְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד מַטֶּה לְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מַטּוֹת וּמַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן בְּתוֹךְ מַטּוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֵלָיו כּל נְשִׂיאֵיהֶם מַטֶּה לְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד מַטֶּה לְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מַטּוֹת וּמַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן בְּתוֹךְ מַטּוֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and all their
chieftains gave him a staff for each chieftain by their
fathers’ house, twelve staffs, and Aaron’s staff was among
their staffs.

verses.english:
And Moses left the staffs in front of YHWH in the Tent of
the Testimony.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּטֹּת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּאֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּטֹּת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּאֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת׃

english.text:
And Moses left the staffs in front of YHWH in the Tent of
the Testimony.

verses.english:
And it was the next day, and Moses came to the Tent of the
Testimony; and, here, Aaron’s staff, of the house of Levi,
had bloomed; and it brought out a bloom, and it made a
blossom, and it produced almonds!
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה אֶל אֹהֶל הָעֵדוּת וְהִנֵּה פָּרַח מַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן לְבֵית לֵוִי וַיֹּצֵא פֶרַח וַיָּצֵץ צִיץ וַיִּגְמֹל שְׁקֵדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה אֶל אֹהֶל הָעֵדוּת וְהִנֵּה פָּרַח מַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן לְבֵית לֵוִי וַיֹּצֵא פֶרַח וַיָּצֵץ צִיץ וַיִּגְמֹל שְׁקֵדִים׃

english.text:
And it was the next day, and Moses came to the Tent of the
Testimony; and, here, Aaron’s staff, of the house of Levi,
had bloomed; and it brought out a bloom, and it made a
blossom, and it produced almonds!

verses.english:
And Moses brought out all the staffs from in front of YHWH
to the children of Israel. And they saw, and each took his
staff.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵא מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הַמַּטֹּת מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְאוּ וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַטֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצֵא מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הַמַּטֹּת מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְאוּ וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַטֵּהוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses brought out all the staffs from in front of YHWH
to the children of Israel. And they saw, and each took his
staff.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Put back Aaron’s staff in front
of the Testimony for watching over, for a sign to rebels,
and you’ll end their complaints against me so they won’t
die!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הָשֵׁב אֶת מַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי הָעֵדוּת לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְאוֹת לִבְנֵי מֶרִי וּתְכַל תְּלוּנֹּתָם מֵעָלַי וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הָשֵׁב אֶת מַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי הָעֵדוּת לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְאוֹת לִבְנֵי מֶרִי וּתְכַל תְּלוּנֹּתָם מֵעָלַי וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Put back Aaron’s staff in front
of the Testimony for watching over, for a sign to rebels,
and you’ll end their complaints against me so they won’t
die!”

verses.english: And Moses did it. As YHWH had commanded him, he did so.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָׂה׃

english.text: And Moses did it. As YHWH had commanded him, he did so.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel said to Moses, saying, “Here,
we’re expiring, we’re perishing, we’re all perishing!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר הֵן גָּוַעְנוּ אָבַדְנוּ כֻּלָּנוּ אָבָדְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר הֵן גָּוַעְנוּ אָבַדְנוּ כֻּלָּנוּ אָבָדְנוּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel said to Moses, saying, “Here,
we’re expiring, we’re perishing, we’re all perishing!

verses.english:
Everyone who comes close—who comes close to YHWH’s
Tabernacle—will die. Have we come to the end of
expiring?!”
verses.hebrew: כֹּל הַקָּרֵב הַקָּרֵב אֶל מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה יָמוּת הַאִם תַּמְנוּ לִגְוֺעַ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל הַקָּרֵב הַקָּרֵב אֶל מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה יָמוּת הַאִם תַּמְנוּ לִגְוֺעַ׃

english.text:
Everyone who comes close—who comes close to YHWH’s
Tabernacle—will die. Have we come to the end of
expiring?!”

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your
father’s house with you shall bear any crime of the holy
place, and you and your sons with you shall bear any crime
of your priesthood.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your
father’s house with you shall bear any crime of the holy
place, and you and your sons with you shall bear any crime
of your priesthood.

translation.text: The LORD said to Aaron: You and your sons and your ancestral house offenses connected with the priesthood.

verses.english:
And bring forward your brothers, the tribe of Levi, your
father’s tribe, with you as well, and they shall be
connected to you and shall minister to you, and you and
your sons with you shall be in front of the Tent of the
Testimony.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת אַחֶיךָ מַטֵּה לֵוִי שֵׁבֶט אָבִיךָ הַקְרֵב אִתָּךְ וְיִלָּווּ עָלֶיךָ וִישָׁרְתוּךָ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶת אַחֶיךָ מַטֵּה לֵוִי שֵׁבֶט אָבִיךָ הַקְרֵב אִתָּךְ וְיִלָּווּ עָלֶיךָ וִישָׁרְתוּךָ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת׃

english.text:
And bring forward your brothers, the tribe of Levi, your
father’s tribe, with you as well, and they shall be
connected to you and shall minister to you, and you and
your sons with you shall be in front of the Tent of the
Testimony.

translation.text: So bring with you also your brothers of the tribe of Levi, your ancestral tribe, in order that they are in front of the tent of the covenant.

verses.english:
And they shall keep your charge, the charge of all of the
tent, but they shall not come close to the equipment of
the holy and to the altar, so they will not die, both they
and you.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמַרְתְּךָ וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת כּל הָאֹהֶל אַךְ אֶל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִקְרָבוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ גַם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמַרְתְּךָ וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת כּל הָאֹהֶל אַךְ אֶל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִקְרָבוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ גַם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
And they shall keep your charge, the charge of all of the
tent, but they shall not come close to the equipment of
the holy and to the altar, so they will not die, both they
and you.

translation.text: They shall perform duties for utensils of the sanctuary or the altar, otherwise both they and you will die.

verses.english:
And they shall be connected to you and shall keep the
charge of the Tent of Meeting, for all the work of the
tent, but an outsider shall not come close to you.
verses.hebrew: וְנִלְווּ עָלֶיךָ וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכֹל עֲבֹדַת הָאֹהֶל וְזָר לֹא יִקְרַב אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנִלְווּ עָלֶיךָ וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכֹל עֲבֹדַת הָאֹהֶל וְזָר לֹא יִקְרַב אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And they shall be connected to you and shall keep the
charge of the Tent of Meeting, for all the work of the
tent, but an outsider shall not come close to you.

translation.text: They are attached to you in order to perform the duties of the approach you.

verses.english:
And you shall keep the charge of the holy and the charge
of the altar, so there will not be any more rage at the
children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד קֶצֶף עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד קֶצֶף עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall keep the charge of the holy and the charge
of the altar, so there will not be any more rage at the
children of Israel.

translation.text: You yourselves shall perform the duties of the come upon the Israelites.

verses.english:
And I, here, I have taken your brothers, the Levites from
among the children of Israel as a gift to you, given for
YHWH, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֶם מַתָּנָה נְתֻנִים לַיהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֶם מַתָּנָה נְתֻנִים לַיהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And I, here, I have taken your brothers, the Levites from
among the children of Israel as a gift to you, given for
YHWH, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: It is I who now take your brother Levites the LORD, to perform the service of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And you and your sons with you shall watch over your
priesthood for everything of the altar’s and for inside
the pavilion, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood
as a gift of service. And the outsider who comes close
shall be put to death.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתְּךָ תִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם לְכל דְּבַר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּלְמִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּם עֲבֹדַת מַתָּנָה אֶתֵּן אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתְּךָ תִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם לְכל דְּבַר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּלְמִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּם עֲבֹדַת מַתָּנָה אֶתֵּן אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And you and your sons with you shall watch over your
priesthood for everything of the altar’s and for inside
the pavilion, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood
as a gift of service. And the outsider who comes close
shall be put to death.”

translation.text: But you and your sons with you shall diligently perform your priestly duties in all death.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “And I, here, I have given charge
of my donations to you for all the holy things of the
children of Israel. I have given them to you as an
anointing and to your sons as an eternal law.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת תְּרוּמֹתָי לְכל קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים לְמשְׁחָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ לְחק עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת תְּרוּמֹתָי לְכל קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים לְמשְׁחָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ לְחק עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “And I, here, I have given charge
of my donations to you for all the holy things of the
children of Israel. I have given them to you as an
anointing and to your sons as an eternal law.

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Aaron: I have given you charge of the offerings made to me, all the holy gifts of the Israelites; I have given them to you and your sons as a priestly portion due you in perpetuity.

verses.english:
This shall be yours from the holy of holies, from the
fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of
theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt
offering of theirs that they will pay back to me. It is
holy of holies for you and for your sons.
verses.hebrew: זֶה יִהְיֶה לְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים מִן הָאֵשׁ כּל קרְבָּנָם לְכל מִנְחָתָם וּלְכל חַטָּאתָם וּלְכל אֲשָׁמָם אֲשֶׁר יָשִׁיבוּ לִי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים לְךָ הוּא וּלְבָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: זֶה יִהְיֶה לְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים מִן הָאֵשׁ כּל קרְבָּנָם לְכל מִנְחָתָם וּלְכל חַטָּאתָם וּלְכל אֲשָׁמָם אֲשֶׁר יָשִׁיבוּ לִי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים לְךָ הוּא וּלְבָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
This shall be yours from the holy of holies, from the
fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of
theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt
offering of theirs that they will pay back to me. It is
holy of holies for you and for your sons.
