field and at a vineyard and won’t drink well waters. We’ll
go by the king’s road until we pass your border.”
verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נִטֶּה בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם לֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נִטֶּה בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם לֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Let me pass through your land. We won’t turn in at a
field and at a vineyard and won’t drink well waters. We’ll
go by the king’s road until we pass your border.”

translation.text: King's Highway until we have passed through your territory."

verses.english:
And Sihon did not allow Israel to pass within his border.
And Sihon gathered all his people and went out to Israel
at the wilderness and came to Jahaz and fought against
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נָתַן סִיחֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹף סִיחֹן אֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיָּבֹא יָהְצָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נָתַן סִיחֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹף סִיחֹן אֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיָּבֹא יָהְצָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Sihon did not allow Israel to pass within his border.
And Sihon gathered all his people and went out to Israel
at the wilderness and came to Jahaz and fought against
Israel.

translation.text: But wilderness; he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.english:
And Israel struck him by the sword and took possession of
his land from Arnon to Jabbok, to the children of Ammon,
because the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּהוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפִי חָרֶב וַיִּירַשׁ אֶת אַרְצוֹ מֵאַרְנֹן עַד יַבֹּק עַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי עַז גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּהוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפִי חָרֶב וַיִּירַשׁ אֶת אַרְצוֹ מֵאַרְנֹן עַד יַבֹּק עַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי עַז גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And Israel struck him by the sword and took possession of
his land from Arnon to Jabbok, to the children of Ammon,
because the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

translation.text: Israel put Ammonites was strong.

verses.english:
And Israel took all of these cities, and Israel lived in
all the Amorite cities in Heshbon and all of its environs,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל עָרֵי הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבְכל בְּנֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל עָרֵי הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבְכל בְּנֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Israel took all of these cities, and Israel lived in
all the Amorite cities in Heshbon and all of its environs,

translation.text: Israel took all these towns, and Israel settled in all the towns of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

verses.english:
because Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the
Amorite, and he fought against the former king of Moab and
took all of his land from his hand as far as Arnon.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֶשְׁבּוֹן עִיר סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הִוא וְהוּא נִלְחַם בְּמֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל אַרְצוֹ מִיָּדוֹ עַד אַרְנֹן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי חֶשְׁבּוֹן עִיר סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הִוא וְהוּא נִלְחַם בְּמֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל אַרְצוֹ מִיָּדוֹ עַד אַרְנֹן׃

english.text:
because Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the
Amorite, and he fought against the former king of Moab and
took all of his land from his hand as far as Arnon.

translation.text: far as the Arnon.

verses.english:
On account of this they say proverbially: Come to Heshbon.
Built and founded is Sihon’s city.
verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הַמֹּשְׁלִים בֹּאוּ חֶשְׁבּוֹן תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן עִיר סִיחוֹן׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הַמֹּשְׁלִים בֹּאוּ חֶשְׁבּוֹן תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן עִיר סִיחוֹן׃

english.text:
On account of this they say proverbially: Come to Heshbon.
Built and founded is Sihon’s city.

translation.text: Therefore the ballad singers say, "Come to Heshbon, let it be built; let the city of Sihon be established.

verses.english:
For fire went out of Heshbon, flame from Sihon’s town; it
consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of
Arnon.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן לֶהָבָה מִקִּרְיַת סִיחֹן אָכְלָה עָר מוֹאָב בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת אַרְנֹן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן לֶהָבָה מִקִּרְיַת סִיחֹן אָכְלָה עָר מוֹאָב בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת אַרְנֹן׃

english.text:
For fire went out of Heshbon, flame from Sihon’s town; it
consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of
Arnon.

translation.text: For fire came out from Heshbon, flame from the city of Sihon. and swallowed up the heights of the Arnon.

verses.english:
Woe unto you, Moab: you’ve perished, Chemosh’s people.
He’s made his sons refugees and his daughters captive to
the king of the Amorite, Sihon.
verses.hebrew: אוֹי לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַדְתָּ עַם כְּמוֹשׁ נָתַן בָּנָיו פְּלֵיטִם וּבְנֹתָיו בַּשְּׁבִית לְמֶלֶךְ אֱמֹרִי סִיחוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אוֹי לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַדְתָּ עַם כְּמוֹשׁ נָתַן בָּנָיו פְּלֵיטִם וּבְנֹתָיו בַּשְּׁבִית לְמֶלֶךְ אֱמֹרִי סִיחוֹן׃

english.text:
Woe unto you, Moab: you’ve perished, Chemosh’s people.
He’s made his sons refugees and his daughters captive to
the king of the Amorite, Sihon.

translation.text: Woe to you, O Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh! to an Amorite king, Sihon.

verses.english:
And their fiefdom perished, Heshbon to Dibon, and we
devastated up to Nophah which reaches to Medeba.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּירָם אָבַד חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד דִּיבֹן וַנַּשִּׁים עַד נֹפַח אֲשֶׁר עַד מֵידְבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּירָם אָבַד חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד דִּיבֹן וַנַּשִּׁים עַד נֹפַח אֲשֶׁר עַד מֵידְבָא׃

english.text:
And their fiefdom perished, Heshbon to Dibon, and we
devastated up to Nophah which reaches to Medeba.

translation.text: So their posterity perished and we laid waste until fire spread to Medeba."

verses.english: And Israel lived in the Amorite’s land.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי׃

english.text: And Israel lived in the Amorite’s land.

translation.text: Thus Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.

verses.english:
And Moses sent to spy on Jazer, and they captured its
environs and dispossessed the Amorite who was there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לְרַגֵּל אֶת יַעְזֵר וַיִּלְכְּדוּ בְּנֹתֶיהָ (ויירש) [וַיּוֹרֶשׁ] אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לְרַגֵּל אֶת יַעְזֵר וַיִּלְכְּדוּ בְּנֹתֶיהָ (ויירש) [וַיּוֹרֶשׁ] אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Moses sent to spy on Jazer, and they captured its
environs and dispossessed the Amorite who was there.

translation.text: Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they captured its villages, and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.

verses.english:
And they turned and went up the road of Bashan, and Og,
the king of Bashan, went out to them, he and all his
people, to war at Edrei.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתָם הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתָם הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
And they turned and went up the road of Bashan, and Og,
the king of Bashan, went out to them, he and all his
people, to war at Edrei.

translation.text: Then they turned and went up the road to Bashan; and King Og of Bashan came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, because I’ve
delivered him and all his people and his land into your
hand, and you’ll do to him as you did to Sihon, king of
the Amorite, who lived in Heshbon.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, because I’ve
delivered him and all his people and his land into your
hand, and you’ll do to him as you did to Sihon, king of
the Amorite, who lived in Heshbon.”

translation.text: But the LORD said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him; for I have given him into your hand, with all his people, and all his land. You shall Heshbon."

verses.english:
And they struck him and his sons and all his people until
he did not have a remnant left, and they took possession
of his land.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And they struck him and his sons and all his people until
he did not have a remnant left, and they took possession
of his land.

translation.text: So they killed him, his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left; and they took possession of his land.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel traveled, and they camped in
the plains of Moab, across the Jordan from Jericho.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel traveled, and they camped in
the plains of Moab, across the Jordan from Jericho.

translation.text: The Israelites set out, and camped in the plains of Moab across the Jordan from Jericho.

verses.english:
And Balak, son of Zippor, saw everything that Israel had
done to the Amorite.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לָאֱמֹרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לָאֱמֹרִי׃

english.text:
And Balak, son of Zippor, saw everything that Israel had
done to the Amorite.

translation.text: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.english:
And Moab was very fearful because of the people because it
was numerous, and Moab felt a disgust at the children of
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּגר מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי הָעָם מְאֹד כִּי רַב הוּא וַיָּקץ מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּגר מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי הָעָם מְאֹד כִּי רַב הוּא וַיָּקץ מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moab was very fearful because of the people because it
was numerous, and Moab felt a disgust at the children of
Israel.

translation.text: Moab was in great dread of the people, people of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now the community
will lick up all of our surroundings the way an ox licks
up the plants of a field!” And Balak, son of Zippor, was
king of Moab at that time.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מוֹאָב אֶל זִקְנֵי מִדְיָן עַתָּה יְלַחֲכוּ הַקָּהָל אֶת כּל סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ כִּלְחֹךְ הַשּׁוֹר אֵת יֶרֶק הַשָּׂדֶה וּבָלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ לְמוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מוֹאָב אֶל זִקְנֵי מִדְיָן עַתָּה יְלַחֲכוּ הַקָּהָל אֶת כּל סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ כִּלְחֹךְ הַשּׁוֹר אֵת יֶרֶק הַשָּׂדֶה וּבָלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ לְמוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

english.text:
And Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now the community
will lick up all of our surroundings the way an ox licks
up the plants of a field!” And Balak, son of Zippor, was
king of Moab at that time.

translation.text: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, "This horde will now lick up all that is around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field." Now Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

verses.english:
And he sent messengers to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pethor,
which is on the river—the land of the children of his
people—to call him, saying, “Here, a people has come out
from Egypt. Here, it has covered the eye of the land. And
it’s sitting across from me!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעֹר פְּתוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹ לִקְרֹא לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַם יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם הִנֵּה כִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב מִמֻּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעֹר פְּתוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹ לִקְרֹא לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַם יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם הִנֵּה כִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב מִמֻּלִי׃

english.text:
And he sent messengers to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pethor,
which is on the river—the land of the children of his
people—to call him, saying, “Here, a people has come out
from Egypt. Here, it has covered the eye of the land. And
it’s sitting across from me!

translation.text: He they have settled next to me.

verses.english:
And now, go, curse this people for me, because it’s more
powerful than I—maybe I’ll be able: we’ll strike it, and
I’ll drive it out from the land—because I know that
whoever you’ll bless will be blessed, and whoever you’ll
curse will be cursed.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נָּא אָרָה לִּי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי עָצוּם הוּא מִמֶּנִּי אוּלַי אוּכַל נַכֶּה בּוֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבָרֵךְ מְבֹרָךְ וַאֲשֶׁר תָּאֹר יוּאָר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נָּא אָרָה לִּי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי עָצוּם הוּא מִמֶּנִּי אוּלַי אוּכַל נַכֶּה בּוֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבָרֵךְ מְבֹרָךְ וַאֲשֶׁר תָּאֹר יוּאָר׃

english.text:
And now, go, curse this people for me, because it’s more
powerful than I—maybe I’ll be able: we’ll strike it, and
I’ll drive it out from the land—because I know that
whoever you’ll bless will be blessed, and whoever you’ll
curse will be cursed.”

translation.text: Come now, curse this people for me, blessed, and whomever you curse is cursed."

verses.english:
And Moab’s elders and Midian’s elders went, and divination
implements were in their hand, and they came to Balaam and
spoke Balak’s words to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי מוֹאָב וְזִקְנֵי מִדְיָן וּקְסָמִים בְּיָדָם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו דִּבְרֵי בָלָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי מוֹאָב וְזִקְנֵי מִדְיָן וּקְסָמִים בְּיָדָם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו דִּבְרֵי בָלָק׃

english.text:
And Moab’s elders and Midian’s elders went, and divination
implements were in their hand, and they came to Balaam and
spoke Balak’s words to him.

translation.text: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the him Balak's message.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Spend the night here tonight, and
I’ll bring back word to you as YHWH will speak to me.” And
the chiefs of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לִינוּ פֹה הַלַּיְלָה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי אֶתְכֶם דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב עִם בִּלְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לִינוּ פֹה הַלַּיְלָה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי אֶתְכֶם דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב עִם בִּלְעָם׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Spend the night here tonight, and
I’ll bring back word to you as YHWH will speak to me.” And
the chiefs of Moab stayed with Balaam.

translation.text: He said to them, "Stay here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, just as the LORD speaks to me"; so the officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.

verses.english:
And God came to Balaam and said, “Who are these people
with you?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And God came to Balaam and said, “Who are these people
with you?”

translation.text: God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"

verses.english:
And Balaam said to God, “Balak, son of Zippor, king of
Moab, sent to me:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים בָּלָק בֶּן צִפֹּר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים בָּלָק בֶּן צִפֹּר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to God, “Balak, son of Zippor, king of
Moab, sent to me:

translation.text: Balaam said to God, "King Balak son of Zippor of Moab, has sent me this message:

verses.english:
‘Here is a people who came out from Egypt and has covered
the eye of the land. Now go, execrate it for me. Maybe
I’ll be able to fight against it, and I’ll drive it out.’”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיְכַס אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ עַתָּה לְכָה קָבָה לִּי אֹתוֹ אוּלַי אוּכַל לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיְכַס אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ עַתָּה לְכָה קָבָה לִּי אֹתוֹ אוּלַי אוּכַל לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּיו׃

english.text:
‘Here is a people who came out from Egypt and has covered
the eye of the land. Now go, execrate it for me. Maybe
I’ll be able to fight against it, and I’ll drive it out.’”

translation.text: 'A people has come out them out.'"

verses.english:
And God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You
shall not curse the people, because it is blessed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לֹא תֵלֵךְ עִמָּהֶם לֹא תָאֹר אֶת הָעָם כִּי בָרוּךְ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לֹא תֵלֵךְ עִמָּהֶם לֹא תָאֹר אֶת הָעָם כִּי בָרוּךְ הוּא׃

english.text:
And God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You
shall not curse the people, because it is blessed.”

translation.text: God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."

verses.english:
And Balaam got up in the morning and said to Balak’s
chiefs, “Go to your land, because YHWH refused to allow me
to go with you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל שָׂרֵי בָלָק לְכוּ אֶל אַרְצְכֶם כִּי מֵאֵן יְהֹוָה לְתִתִּי לַהֲלֹךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל שָׂרֵי בָלָק לְכוּ אֶל אַרְצְכֶם כִּי מֵאֵן יְהֹוָה לְתִתִּי לַהֲלֹךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
And Balaam got up in the morning and said to Balak’s
chiefs, “Go to your land, because YHWH refused to allow me
to go with you.”

translation.text: So Balaam rose in for the LORD has refused to let me go with you."

verses.english:
And the chiefs of Moab got up and came to Balak and said,
“Balaam refused to go with us.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בָּלָק וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֵן בִּלְעָם הֲלֹךְ עִמָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בָּלָק וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֵן בִּלְעָם הֲלֹךְ עִמָּנוּ׃

english.text:
And the chiefs of Moab got up and came to Balak and said,
“Balaam refused to go with us.”

translation.text: So the officials of us."

verses.english:
And Balak went on again to send more numerous and
prestigious chiefs than these.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד בָּלָק שְׁלֹחַ שָׂרִים רַבִּים וְנִכְבָּדִים מֵאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד בָּלָק שְׁלֹחַ שָׂרִים רַבִּים וְנִכְבָּדִים מֵאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And Balak went on again to send more numerous and
prestigious chiefs than these.

translation.text: Once again Balak sent officials, more numerous and more distinguished than these.

verses.english:
And they came to Balaam and said to him, “Balak, son of
Zippor, said this: ‘Don’t be held back from coming to me,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אַל נָא תִמָּנַע מֵהֲלֹךְ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אַל נָא תִמָּנַע מֵהֲלֹךְ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And they came to Balaam and said to him, “Balak, son of
Zippor, said this: ‘Don’t be held back from coming to me,

translation.text: They came to Balaam and said to him, coming to me;

verses.english:
because I’ll honor you very much, and I’ll do everything
that you’ll say to me. And go, execrate this people for
me.’”
verses.hebrew: כִּי כַבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ מְאֹד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה וּלְכָה נָּא קָבָה לִּי אֵת הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כַבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ מְאֹד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה וּלְכָה נָּא קָבָה לִּי אֵת הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
because I’ll honor you very much, and I’ll do everything
that you’ll say to me. And go, execrate this people for
me.’”

translation.text: for I will surely do you great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do; come, curse this people for me.'"

verses.english:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak’s servants, “If
Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of his I
wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, my God,
to do something small or big.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַבְדֵי בָלָק אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת קְטַנָּה אוֹ גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַבְדֵי בָלָק אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת קְטַנָּה אוֹ גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak’s servants, “If
Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of his I
wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, my God,
to do something small or big.

translation.text: But Balaam the LORD my God, to do less or more.

verses.english:
And now, stay here, you as well, tonight, so I may know
what YHWH will add to speak with me.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁבוּ נָא בָזֶה גַּם אַתֶּם הַלָּיְלָה וְאֵדְעָה מַה יֹּסֵף יְהֹוָה דַּבֵּר עִמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁבוּ נָא בָזֶה גַּם אַתֶּם הַלָּיְלָה וְאֵדְעָה מַה יֹּסֵף יְהֹוָה דַּבֵּר עִמִּי׃

english.text:
And now, stay here, you as well, tonight, so I may know
what YHWH will add to speak with me.”

translation.text: You remain here, as the others did, so that I may learn what more the LORD may say to me."

verses.english:
And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, “If these
people have come to call you, get up, go with them. And
just the thing that I shall speak to you—you shall do
that.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם לִקְרֹא לְךָ בָּאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים קוּם לֵךְ אִתָּם וְאַךְ אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם לִקְרֹא לְךָ בָּאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים קוּם לֵךְ אִתָּם וְאַךְ אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, “If these
people have come to call you, get up, go with them. And
just the thing that I shall speak to you—you shall do
that.”

translation.text: That do."

verses.english:
And Balaam got up in the morning and harnessed his ass and
went with the chiefs of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת אֲתֹנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת אֲתֹנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And Balaam got up in the morning and harnessed his ass and
went with the chiefs of Moab.

translation.text: So Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the officials of Moab.

verses.english:
And God’s anger flared because he was going. And an angel
of YHWH stood up in the road as an adversary to him. And
he was riding on his ass, and his two boys were with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף אֱלֹהִים כִּי הוֹלֵךְ הוּא וַיִּתְיַצֵּב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ לְשָׂטָן לוֹ וְהוּא רֹכֵב עַל אֲתֹנוֹ וּשְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו עִמּוֹ׃

honor you?!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם הֲלֹא שָׁלֹחַ שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לִקְרֹא לָךְ לָמָּה לֹא הָלַכְתָּ אֵלָי הַאֻמְנָם לֹא אוּכַל כַּבְּדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם הֲלֹא שָׁלֹחַ שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לִקְרֹא לָךְ לָמָּה לֹא הָלַכְתָּ אֵלָי הַאֻמְנָם לֹא אוּכַל כַּבְּדֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I send to you, to call
you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I indeed not able to
honor you?!”

translation.text: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send to you?"

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Here, I’ve come to you. Now:
will I be able to speak anything? The thing that God will
set in my mouth: that is what I’ll speak.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הִנֵּה בָאתִי אֵלֶיךָ עַתָּה הֲיָכֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאוּמָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הִנֵּה בָאתִי אֵלֶיךָ עַתָּה הֲיָכֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאוּמָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Here, I’ve come to you. Now:
will I be able to speak anything? The thing that God will
set in my mouth: that is what I’ll speak.”

translation.text: Balaam said to Balak, "I have come to you now, but do I have what I must say."

verses.english:
And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath
Huzoth.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם בָּלָק וַיָּבֹאוּ קִרְיַת חֻצוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם בָּלָק וַיָּבֹאוּ קִרְיַת חֻצוֹת׃

english.text:
And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath
Huzoth.

translation.text: Then Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.

verses.english:
And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and he let them go to
Balaam and to the chiefs who were with them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח בָּלָק בָּקָר וָצֹאן וַיְשַׁלַּח לְבִלְעָם וְלַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְבַּח בָּלָק בָּקָר וָצֹאן וַיְשַׁלַּח לְבִלְעָם וְלַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and he let them go to
Balaam and to the chiefs who were with them.

translation.text: Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent them to Balaam and to the officials who were with him.

verses.english:
And it was in the morning, and Balak took Balaam and
brought him up to the High Places of Baal, and he saw the
outer edge of the people from there.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ בָּמוֹת בָּעַל וַיַּרְא מִשָּׁם קְצֵה הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ בָּמוֹת בָּעַל וַיַּרְא מִשָּׁם קְצֵה הָעָם׃

english.text:
And it was in the morning, and Balak took Balaam and
brought him up to the High Places of Baal, and he saw the
outer edge of the people from there.

translation.text: On the next day Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamothbaal; and from there he could see part of the people of Israel.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me
here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me
here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

translation.text: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

verses.english:
And Balak did as Balaam spoke, and Balak and Balaam
offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל בָּלָק וּבִלְעָם פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל בָּלָק וּבִלְעָם פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Balak did as Balaam spoke, and Balak and Balaam
offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

translation.text: Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand up by your burnt
offering, and let me go. Maybe YHWH will communicate to
me. And whatever He’ll show me, I’ll tell you.” And he
went to a viewpoint.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לְבָלָק הִתְיַצֵּב עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאֵלְכָה אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהֹוָה לִקְרָאתִי וּדְבַר מַה יַּרְאֵנִי וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ שֶׁפִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לְבָלָק הִתְיַצֵּב עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאֵלְכָה אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהֹוָה לִקְרָאתִי וּדְבַר מַה יַּרְאֵנִי וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ שֶׁפִי׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand up by your burnt
offering, and let me go. Maybe YHWH will communicate to
me. And whatever He’ll show me, I’ll tell you.” And he
went to a viewpoint.

translation.text: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your burnt offerings shows me I will tell you." And he went to a bare height.

verses.english:
And God communicated to Balaam. And he said to Him, “I’ve
arranged the seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on
each altar.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֶת שִׁבְעַת הַמִּזְבְּחֹת עָרַכְתִּי וָאַעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֶת שִׁבְעַת הַמִּזְבְּחֹת עָרַכְתִּי וָאַעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And God communicated to Balaam. And he said to Him, “I’ve
arranged the seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on
each altar.”

translation.text: Then God met Balaam; and Balaam said to him, "I have arranged the seven altars, and have offered a bull and a ram on each altar."

verses.english:
And YHWH put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and He said, “Go
back to Balak, and speak like this.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and He said, “Go
back to Balak, and speak like this.”

translation.text: The this is what you must say."

verses.english:
And he went back to him, and here he was, standing up by
his burnt offering, he and all the chiefs of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ הוּא וְכל שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ הוּא וְכל שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And he went back to him, and here he was, standing up by
his burnt offering, he and all the chiefs of Moab.

translation.text: So he returned to Balak, who was standing beside his burnt offerings with all the officials of Moab.

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Balak led
me from Aram, Moab’s king from mountains of the East.
“Come, curse Jacob for me! Come, denounce Israel!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר מִן אֲרָם יַנְחֵנִי בָלָק מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב מֵהַרְרֵי קֶדֶם לְכָה אָרָה לִּי יַעֲקֹב וּלְכָה זֹעֲמָה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר מִן אֲרָם יַנְחֵנִי בָלָק מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב מֵהַרְרֵי קֶדֶם לְכָה אָרָה לִּי יַעֲקֹב וּלְכָה זֹעֲמָה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Balak led
me from Aram, Moab’s king from mountains of the East.
“Come, curse Jacob for me! Come, denounce Israel!”

translation.text: Then Balaam uttered his oracle, saying: the king of Moab from the eastern mountains: 'Come, curse Jacob for me;

verses.english:
How shall I execrate whom God hasn’t execrated? And how
shall I denounce whom YHWH hasn’t denounced?
verses.hebrew: מָה אֶקֹּב לֹא קַבֹּה אֵל וּמָה אֶזְעֹם לֹא זָעַם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מָה אֶקֹּב לֹא קַבֹּה אֵל וּמָה אֶזְעֹם לֹא זָעַם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
How shall I execrate whom God hasn’t execrated? And how
shall I denounce whom YHWH hasn’t denounced?

translation.text: How can I curse whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced?

verses.english:
For from the top of rocks I see it, and from hills I view
it. Here: a people dwelling separate and not reckoned
among the nations.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מֵרֹאשׁ צֻרִים אֶרְאֶנּוּ וּמִגְּבָעוֹת אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מֵרֹאשׁ צֻרִים אֶרְאֶנּוּ וּמִגְּבָעוֹת אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב׃

english.text:
For from the top of rocks I see it, and from hills I view
it. Here: a people dwelling separate and not reckoned
among the nations.

translation.text: For from the top of the crags I see him, from the hills I behold him; and not reckoning itself among the nations!

verses.english:
Who has counted the dust of Jacob and the number of a
fourth of Israel? May my soul die the death of the
righteous, and may my future be like his!
verses.hebrew: מִי מָנָה עֲפַר יַעֲקֹב וּמִסְפָּר אֶת רֹבַע יִשְׂרָאֵל תָּמֹת נַפְשִׁי מוֹת יְשָׁרִים וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמֹהוּ׃

hebrew.text: מִי מָנָה עֲפַר יַעֲקֹב וּמִסְפָּר אֶת רֹבַע יִשְׂרָאֵל תָּמֹת נַפְשִׁי מוֹת יְשָׁרִים וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמֹהוּ׃

english.text:
Who has counted the dust of Jacob and the number of a
fourth of Israel? May my soul die the death of the
righteous, and may my future be like his!

translation.text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number the dust-cloud of Israel? and let my end be like his!"

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me?! I
took you to execrate my enemies. And, here, you’ve blessed
them!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לִי לָקֹב אֹיְבַי לְקַחְתִּיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לִי לָקֹב אֹיְבַי לְקַחְתִּיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me?! I
took you to execrate my enemies. And, here, you’ve blessed
them!”

translation.text: Then Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought them."

verses.english:
And he answered and said, “Isn’t it that what ever YHWH
sets in my mouth, that is what I’ll watch out to say?!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים יְהֹוָה בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֶשְׁמֹר לְדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים יְהֹוָה בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֶשְׁמֹר לְדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And he answered and said, “Isn’t it that what ever YHWH
sets in my mouth, that is what I’ll watch out to say?!”

translation.text: He answered, "Must I not take care to say what the LORD puts into my mouth?"

verses.english:
And Balak said to him, “Come on with me to another place
from which you’ll see it. You’ll see nothing but its edge,
and you won’t see all of it. And execrate it for me from
there.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בָּלָק (לך) [לְכָה] נָּא אִתִּי אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶנּוּ מִשָּׁם אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה וְקבְנוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בָּלָק (לך) [לְכָה] נָּא אִתִּי אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶנּוּ מִשָּׁם אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה וְקבְנוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
And Balak said to him, “Come on with me to another place
from which you’ll see it. You’ll see nothing but its edge,
and you won’t see all of it. And execrate it for me from
there.”

translation.text: So Balak said to him, "Come with me to another place from which them all; then curse them for me from there."

verses.english:
And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of
Pisgah, and he built seven altars and offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שְׂדֵה צֹפִים אֶל רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וַיִּבֶן שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שְׂדֵה צֹפִים אֶל רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וַיִּבֶן שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of
Pisgah, and he built seven altars and offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.

translation.text: So he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah. He built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.english:
And he said to Balak, “Stand up here by your burnt
offering, and I’ll be communicated with here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי אִקָּרֶה כֹּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי אִקָּרֶה כֹּה׃

english.text:
And he said to Balak, “Stand up here by your burnt
offering, and I’ll be communicated with here.”

translation.text: Balaam said to Balak, "Stand here beside your burnt offerings, while I meet the LORD over there."

verses.english:
And YHWH was communicated to Balaam, and He set a word in
his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak, and you shall speak
this.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּר יְהֹוָה אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיָּשֶׂם דָּבָר בְּפִיו וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּר יְהֹוָה אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיָּשֶׂם דָּבָר בְּפִיו וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH was communicated to Balaam, and He set a word in
his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak, and you shall speak
this.”

translation.text: The Balak, and this is what you shall say."

verses.english:
And he came to him, and here he was, standing up by his
burnt offering, and the chiefs of Moab were with him. And
Balak said to him, “What did YHWH speak?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וְהִנּוֹ נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ וְשָׂרֵי מוֹאָב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּלָק מַה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וְהִנּוֹ נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ וְשָׂרֵי מוֹאָב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּלָק מַה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he came to him, and here he was, standing up by his
burnt offering, and the chiefs of Moab were with him. And
Balak said to him, “What did YHWH speak?”

translation.text: When he came to him, he was said to him, "What has the LORD said?"

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Get up,
Balak, and listen. Hear me, son of Zippor.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר קוּם בָּלָק וּשְׁמָע הַאֲזִינָה עָדַי בְּנוֹ צִפֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר קוּם בָּלָק וּשְׁמָע הַאֲזִינָה עָדַי בְּנוֹ צִפֹּר׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Get up,
Balak, and listen. Hear me, son of Zippor.

translation.text: Then Balaam uttered his oracle, saying: "Rise, Balak, and hear; listen to me, O son of Zippor:

verses.english:
is not a man, that He would lie, or a human being,
that He would regret. Has He said and will not do or
spoken and will not bring it about?
verses.hebrew: לֹא אִישׁ אֵל וִיכַזֵּב וּבֶן אָדָם וְיִתְנֶחָם הַהוּא אָמַר וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה וְדִבֶּר וְלֹא יְקִימֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אִישׁ אֵל וִיכַזֵּב וּבֶן אָדָם וְיִתְנֶחָם הַהוּא אָמַר וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה וְדִבֶּר וְלֹא יְקִימֶנָּה׃

english.text:
is not a man, that He would lie, or a human being,
that He would regret. Has He said and will not do or
spoken and will not bring it about?

translation.text: God is not a human being, that he should lie, or a mortal, that he should change his mind. Has he promised, and will he not do it? Has he spoken, and will he not fulfill it?

verses.english:
Here, I was taken to bless, and He blessed, and I won’t
take it back.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה בָרֵךְ לָקָחְתִּי וּבֵרֵךְ וְלֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה בָרֵךְ לָקָחְתִּי וּבֵרֵךְ וְלֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנָּה׃

english.text:
Here, I was taken to bless, and He blessed, and I won’t
take it back.

translation.text: See, I received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot revoke it.

verses.english:
He didn’t find harm in Jacob, and He didn’t see trouble in
Israel. YHWH, its God, is with it, and a shout for a king
is in it.
verses.hebrew: לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ׃

english.text:
He didn’t find harm in Jacob, and He didn’t see trouble in
Israel. YHWH, its God, is with it, and a shout for a king
is in it.

translation.text: He has not beheld misfortune in Jacob; nor has he seen trouble in Israel. acclaimed as a king among them.

verses.english:
who brought them out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it.
verses.hebrew: אֵל מוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרָיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵל מוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרָיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ׃

english.text:
who brought them out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it.

translation.text: God, who brings them out of Egypt, is like the horns of a wild ox for them.

verses.english:
For there’s no divination against Jacob and no enchantment
against Israel. At this time it will be said to Jacob and
to Israel: “What has God done?”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נַחַשׁ בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא קֶסֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כָּעֵת יֵאָמֵר לְיַעֲקֹב וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל מַה פָּעַל אֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא נַחַשׁ בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא קֶסֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כָּעֵת יֵאָמֵר לְיַעֲקֹב וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל מַה פָּעַל אֵל׃

english.text:
For there’s no divination against Jacob and no enchantment
against Israel. At this time it will be said to Jacob and
to Israel: “What has God done?”

translation.text: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, no divination against Israel;

verses.english:
Here, a people will get up like a feline and like a lion
will raise itself. It won’t lie down until it has eaten
prey and until it has drunk blood of carcasses.
verses.hebrew: הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא לֹא יִשְׁכַּב עַד יֹאכַל טֶרֶף וְדַם חֲלָלִים יִשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא לֹא יִשְׁכַּב עַד יֹאכַל טֶרֶף וְדַם חֲלָלִים יִשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
Here, a people will get up like a feline and like a lion
will raise itself. It won’t lie down until it has eaten
prey and until it has drunk blood of carcasses.

translation.text: Look, a people rising up like a lioness, and rousing itself like a lion! and drunk the blood of the slain."

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Don’t do either: execrate them
or bless them!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם גַּם קֹב לֹא תִקֳּבֶנּוּ גַּם בָּרֵךְ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם גַּם קֹב לֹא תִקֳּבֶנּוּ גַּם בָּרֵךְ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Don’t do either: execrate them
or bless them!”

translation.text: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Do not curse them at all, and do not bless them at all."

verses.english:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak
to you, saying, ‘Everything that YHWH will speak, that is
what I’ll do’?”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא דִּבַּרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא דִּבַּרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak
to you, saying, ‘Everything that YHWH will speak, that is
what I’ll do’?”

translation.text: But Balaam answered Balak, "Did I not tell you, 'Whatever the LORD says, that is what I must do'?"

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Come on. I’ll take you to
another place. Maybe it will be right in God’s eyes, and
you’ll execrate it for me from there.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לְכָה נָּא אֶקָּחֲךָ אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אוּלַי יִישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וְקַבֹּתוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לְכָה נָּא אֶקָּחֲךָ אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אוּלַי יִישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וְקַבֹּתוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Come on. I’ll take you to
another place. Maybe it will be right in God’s eyes, and
you’ll execrate it for me from there.”

translation.text: So Balak said to Balaam, "Come now, I will take you to another there."

verses.english:
And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks out
over Jeshimon.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם רֹאשׁ הַפְּעוֹר הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם רֹאשׁ הַפְּעוֹר הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

english.text:
And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks out
over Jeshimon.

translation.text: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the wasteland.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here
and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִם׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here
and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

translation.text: Balaam said to Balak, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

verses.english:
And Balak did as Balaam said, and he offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Balak did as Balaam said, and he offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.

translation.text: So Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.english:
And Balaam saw that it was good in YHWH’s eyes to bless
Israel, and he did not go as in previous times to
divinations. And he turned his face to the wilderness,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בִּלְעָם כִּי טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הָלַךְ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם לִקְרַאת נְחָשִׁים וַיָּשֶׁת אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר פָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא בִּלְעָם כִּי טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הָלַךְ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם לִקְרַאת נְחָשִׁים וַיָּשֶׁת אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר פָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And Balaam saw that it was good in YHWH’s eyes to bless
Israel, and he did not go as in previous times to
divinations. And he turned his face to the wilderness,

translation.text: Now Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, so he did not wilderness.

verses.english:
and Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel, tenting
according to its tribes, and God’s spirit came on him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא בִלְעָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֹׁכֵן לִשְׁבָטָיו וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא בִלְעָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֹׁכֵן לִשְׁבָטָיו וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
and Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel, tenting
according to its tribes, and God’s spirit came on him.

translation.text: Balaam looked up and saw Israel camping tribe by tribe. Then the spirit of God came upon him,

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Word of
Balaam, son of Beor, and word of the man, opened of eye;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Word of
Balaam, son of Beor, and word of the man, opened of eye;

translation.text: and he uttered his oracle, saying:

verses.english:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings, who sees
Shadday’s vision, falling, but with eyes uncovered.
verses.hebrew: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל אֲשֶׁר מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

hebrew.text: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל אֲשֶׁר מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

english.text:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings, who sees
Shadday’s vision, falling, but with eyes uncovered.

translation.text: the oracle of one who hears the words of God, who falls down, but with eyes uncovered:

verses.english: How good your tents are, Jacob, your tabernacles, Israel.
verses.hebrew: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: How good your tents are, Jacob, your tabernacles, Israel.

translation.text: how fair are your tents, O Jacob, your encampments, O Israel!

verses.english:
They spread like palms, like gardens by a river, like
aloes YHWH planted, like cedars by water.
verses.hebrew: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר כַּאֲהָלִים נָטַע יְהֹוָה כַּאֲרָזִים עֲלֵי מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר כַּאֲהָלִים נָטַע יְהֹוָה כַּאֲרָזִים עֲלֵי מָיִם׃

english.text:
They spread like palms, like gardens by a river, like
aloes YHWH planted, like cedars by water.

translation.text: Like palm groves that stretch far away, like cedar trees beside the waters.

verses.english:
It drips water from its branches and its seed in plentiful
water. And its king will be higher than Agag, and its
kingdom will be elevated.
verses.hebrew: יִזַּל מַיִם מִדָּלְיָו וְזַרְעוֹ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְיָרֹם מֵאֲגַג מַלְכּוֹ וְתִנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכֻתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יִזַּל מַיִם מִדָּלְיָו וְזַרְעוֹ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְיָרֹם מֵאֲגַג מַלְכּוֹ וְתִנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכֻתוֹ׃

english.text:
It drips water from its branches and its seed in plentiful
water. And its king will be higher than Agag, and its
kingdom will be elevated.

translation.text: Water shall flow from his buckets, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

verses.english:
who brought it out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it. He shall eat up nations, its foes, and break
their bones and pierce with His arrows.
verses.hebrew: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ יֹאכַל גּוֹיִם צָרָיו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶם יְגָרֵם וְחִצָּיו יִמְחָץ׃

hebrew.text: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ יֹאכַל גּוֹיִם צָרָיו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶם יְגָרֵם וְחִצָּיו יִמְחָץ׃

english.text:
who brought it out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it. He shall eat up nations, its foes, and break
their bones and pierce with His arrows.

translation.text: God who brings him out of Egypt, is like the horns of a wild ox for him; and break their bones. He shall strike with his arrows.

verses.english:
It bent, lay down, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse it? Those who bless you: he’s blessed. And
those who curse you: he’s cursed.
verses.hebrew: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ מְבָרְכֶיךָ בָרוּךְ וְאֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר׃

hebrew.text: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ מְבָרְכֶיךָ בָרוּךְ וְאֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר׃

english.text:
It bent, lay down, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse it? Those who bless you: he’s blessed. And
those who curse you: he’s cursed.

translation.text: He crouched, he lay down like a lion, and like a lioness; who will rouse him up? and cursed is everyone who curses you."

verses.english:
And Balak’s anger flared at Balaam, and he wrung his
hands, and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to execrate
my enemies; and, here, you’ve blessed these three times!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיִּסְפֹּק אֶת כַּפָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לָקֹב אֹיְבַי קְרָאתִיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיִּסְפֹּק אֶת כַּפָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לָקֹב אֹיְבַי קְרָאתִיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And Balak’s anger flared at Balaam, and he wrung his
hands, and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to execrate
my enemies; and, here, you’ve blessed these three times!

translation.text: Then Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he struck his enemies, but instead you have blessed them these three times.

verses.english:
And now, flee to your place! I said I would honor you;
and, here, YHWH has held you back from honor!”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל מְקוֹמֶךָ אָמַרְתִּי כַּבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ וְהִנֵּה מְנָעֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִכָּבוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל מְקוֹמֶךָ אָמַרְתִּי כַּבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ וְהִנֵּה מְנָעֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִכָּבוֹד׃

english.text:
And now, flee to your place! I said I would honor you;
and, here, YHWH has held you back from honor!”

translation.text: Now be off with you! Go home! I said, 'I will reward you richly,' but the LORD has denied you any reward."

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak to your
messengers whom you sent to me as well, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא גַּם אֶל מַלְאָכֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלַי דִּבַּרְתִּי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא גַּם אֶל מַלְאָכֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלַי דִּבַּרְתִּי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak to your
messengers whom you sent to me as well, saying,

translation.text: And Balaam said to Balak, "Did I not tell your messengers whom you sent to me,

verses.english:
‘If Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of
his I wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, to
do good or bad from my own heart. Whatever YHWH speaks,
that is what I’ll speak.’
verses.hebrew: אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹבָה אוֹ רָעָה מִלִּבִּי אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹבָה אוֹ רָעָה מִלִּבִּי אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
‘If Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of
his I wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, to
do good or bad from my own heart. Whatever YHWH speaks,
that is what I’ll speak.’

translation.text: 'If Balak should give me his house full of silver and gold, I would not be able to go beyond the LORD says, that is what I will say'?

verses.english:
And now, here, I’m going to my people. Come. I’ll advise
you of what this people will do to your people in the
future days.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנְנִי הוֹלֵךְ לְעַמִּי לְכָה אִיעָצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָעָם הַזֶּה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנְנִי הוֹלֵךְ לְעַמִּי לְכָה אִיעָצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָעָם הַזֶּה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And now, here, I’m going to my people. Come. I’ll advise
you of what this people will do to your people in the
future days.”

translation.text: So now, I am going to my people; come."

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

translation.text: So he uttered his oracle, saying:

verses.english:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings and who knows the
Highest’s knowledge, who sees Shadday’s vision, falling,
but with eyes uncovered.
verses.hebrew: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל וְיֹדֵעַ דַּעַת עֶלְיוֹן מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

hebrew.text: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל וְיֹדֵעַ דַּעַת עֶלְיוֹן מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

english.text:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings and who knows the
Highest’s knowledge, who sees Shadday’s vision, falling,
but with eyes uncovered.

translation.text: the oracle of one who hears the words of God, who falls down, but with his eyes uncovered:

verses.english:
I see it—and not now; I view it—and not close: a star has
stepped from Jacob, and a scepter has come up from Israel
and pierced the temples of Moab and the crown of all the
children of Seth.
verses.hebrew: אֶרְאֶנּוּ וְלֹא עַתָּה אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחַץ פַּאֲתֵי מוֹאָב וְקַרְקַר כּל בְּנֵי שֵׁת׃

hebrew.text: אֶרְאֶנּוּ וְלֹא עַתָּה אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחַץ פַּאֲתֵי מוֹאָב וְקַרְקַר כּל בְּנֵי שֵׁת׃

english.text:
I see it—and not now; I view it—and not close: a star has
stepped from Jacob, and a scepter has come up from Israel
and pierced the temples of Moab and the crown of all the
children of Seth.

translation.text: I see him, but not now; and a scepter shall rise out of Israel; and the territory of all the Shethites.

verses.english:
And Edom was a possession, and Seir was a possession of
its enemies, and Israel was making triumph.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אֱדוֹם יְרֵשָׁה וְהָיָה יְרֵשָׁה שֵׂעִיר אֹיְבָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֶׂה חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אֱדוֹם יְרֵשָׁה וְהָיָה יְרֵשָׁה שֵׂעִיר אֹיְבָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֶׂה חָיִל׃

english.text:
And Edom was a possession, and Seir was a possession of
its enemies, and Israel was making triumph.

translation.text: Edom will become a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

verses.english:
And one from Jacob dominated and destroyed a remnant from
a city.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיַּעֲקֹב וְהֶאֱבִיד שָׂרִיד מֵעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיַּעֲקֹב וְהֶאֱבִיד שָׂרִיד מֵעִיר׃

english.text:
And one from Jacob dominated and destroyed a remnant from
a city.

translation.text: One out of Jacob shall rule, and destroy the survivors of Ir."

verses.english:
And he saw Amalek, and he took up his pronouncement, and
he said: Amalek was foremost of nations, and its future
arrives at destruction.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶת עֲמָלֵק וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֶת עֲמָלֵק וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

english.text:
And he saw Amalek, and he took up his pronouncement, and
he said: Amalek was foremost of nations, and its future
arrives at destruction.

translation.text: Then he looked on Amalek, and uttered his oracle, saying: but its end is to perish forever."

verses.english:
And he saw the Kenites, and he took up his pronouncement
and said: Your residence is strong, and set your nest in a
cliff.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶת הַקֵּינִי וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אֵיתָן מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וְשִׂים בַּסֶּלַע קִנֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֶת הַקֵּינִי וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אֵיתָן מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וְשִׂים בַּסֶּלַע קִנֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And he saw the Kenites, and he took up his pronouncement
and said: Your residence is strong, and set your nest in a
cliff.

translation.text: Then he looked on the Kenite, and uttered his oracle, saying: and your nest is set in the rock;

verses.english:
But Cain will be for burning How long will Asshur hold you
prisoner?
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה לְבָעֵר קָיִן עַד מָה אַשּׁוּר תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה לְבָעֵר קָיִן עַד מָה אַשּׁוּר תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
But Cain will be for burning How long will Asshur hold you
prisoner?

translation.text: yet Kain is destined for burning. How long shall Asshur take you away captive?"

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Woe. Who
will live more than what God set him?
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אוֹי מִי יִחְיֶה מִשֻּׂמוֹ אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אוֹי מִי יִחְיֶה מִשֻּׂמוֹ אֵל׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Woe. Who
will live more than what God set him?

translation.text: Again he uttered his oracle, saying: "Alas, who shall live when God does this?

verses.english:
And ships from the hand of Kittim: And they degraded
Asshur, and they degraded Eber. And it, too, arrives at
destruction.
verses.hebrew: וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים וְעִנּוּ אַשּׁוּר וְעִנּוּ עֵבֶר וְגַם הוּא עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים וְעִנּוּ אַשּׁוּר וְעִנּוּ עֵבֶר וְגַם הוּא עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

english.text:
And ships from the hand of Kittim: And they degraded
Asshur, and they degraded Eber. And it, too, arrives at
destruction.

translation.text: But ships shall come from Kittim and shall afflict Asshur and Eber; and he also shall perish forever."

verses.english:
And Balaam got up and went, and he went back to his place.
And Balak, too, went his way.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְגַם בָּלָק הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְגַם בָּלָק הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Balaam got up and went, and he went back to his place.
And Balak, too, went his way.

translation.text: Then Balaam got up and went back to his place, and Balak also went his way.

verses.english:
And Israel lived in Shittim, and the people began to
prostitute themselves to the daughters of Moab:
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשִּׁטִּים וַיָּחֶל הָעָם לִזְנוֹת אֶל בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשִּׁטִּים וַיָּחֶל הָעָם לִזְנוֹת אֶל בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And Israel lived in Shittim, and the people began to
prostitute themselves to the daughters of Moab:

translation.text: While Israel was staying at Shittim, the people began to have sexual relations with the women of Moab.

verses.english:
And they attracted the people to the sacrifices of their
gods, and the people ate and bowed to their gods,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרֶאןָ לָעָם לְזִבְחֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרֶאןָ לָעָם לְזִבְחֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And they attracted the people to the sacrifices of their
gods, and the people ate and bowed to their gods,

translation.text: These invited the people to the gods.

verses.english:
and Israel was associated with Baal Peor. And YHWH’s anger
flared at Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּמֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצָּמֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and Israel was associated with Baal Peor. And YHWH’s anger
flared at Israel.

translation.text: Thus Israel yoked itself to the Baal of Peor, and the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take all of the leaders of the
people and hang them in front of the sun, and YHWH’s
flaring anger will go back from Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח אֶת כּל רָאשֵׁי הָעָם וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם לַיהֹוָה נֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁב חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח אֶת כּל רָאשֵׁי הָעָם וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם לַיהֹוָה נֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁב חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take all of the leaders of the
people and hang them in front of the sun, and YHWH’s
flaring anger will go back from Israel.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses, "Take all in order that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel."

verses.english:
And Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you, kill
those of his people who are associated with Baal Peor.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל שֹׁפְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל שֹׁפְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you, kill
those of his people who are associated with Baal Peor.”

translation.text: your people who have yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor."

verses.english:
And, here, a man from the children of Israel came and
brought forward a Midianite woman to his brothers before
the eyes of Moses and before the eyes of all the
congregation of the children of Israel while they were
mourning at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא וַיַּקְרֵב אֶל אֶחָיו אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית לְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה וּלְעֵינֵי כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֵמָּה בֹכִים פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא וַיַּקְרֵב אֶל אֶחָיו אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית לְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה וּלְעֵינֵי כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֵמָּה בֹכִים פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And, here, a man from the children of Israel came and
brought forward a Midianite woman to his brothers before
the eyes of Moses and before the eyes of all the
congregation of the children of Israel while they were
mourning at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: Just then one of the Israelites came and brought a Midianite woman entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.english:
And Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, saw,
and he got up from among the congregation and took a spear
in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וַיָּקם מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה וַיִּקַּח רֹמַח בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וַיָּקם מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה וַיִּקַּח רֹמַח בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, saw,
and he got up from among the congregation and took a spear
in his hand.

translation.text: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he got up and left the congregation. Taking a spear in his hand,

verses.english:
And he came after the Israelite man to the enclosure and
ran the two of them through, the Israelite man and the
woman, to her stomach, and the plague was halted from the
children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַחַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הַקֻּבָּה וַיִּדְקֹר אֶת שְׁנֵיהֶם אֵת אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶל קֳבָתָהּ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אַחַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הַקֻּבָּה וַיִּדְקֹר אֶת שְׁנֵיהֶם אֵת אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶל קֳבָתָהּ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he came after the Israelite man to the enclosure and
ran the two of them through, the Israelite man and the
woman, to her stomach, and the plague was halted from the
children of Israel.

translation.text: he went after the Israelite man into the tent, and belly. So the plague was stopped among the people of Israel.

verses.english: And the dead in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

english.text: And the dead in the plague were twenty-four thousand.

translation.text: thousand.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, has
turned back my fury from the children of Israel by his
carrying out my jealousy among them, so I didn’t finish
the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.hebrew: פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן הֵשִׁיב אֶת חֲמָתִי מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקַנְאוֹ אֶת קִנְאָתִי בְּתוֹכָם וְלֹא כִלִּיתִי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִנְאָתִי׃

hebrew.text: פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן הֵשִׁיב אֶת חֲמָתִי מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקַנְאוֹ אֶת קִנְאָתִי בְּתוֹכָם וְלֹא כִלִּיתִי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִנְאָתִי׃

english.text:
“Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, has
turned back my fury from the children of Israel by his
carrying out my jealousy among them, so I didn’t finish
the children of Israel in my jealousy.

translation.text: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of did not consume the Israelites.

verses.english: Therefore, say: Here, I’m giving him my covenant of peace,
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִי שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן אֱמֹר הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִי שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text: Therefore, say: Here, I’m giving him my covenant of peace,

translation.text: Therefore say, 'I hereby grant him my covenant of peace.

verses.english:
and it shall be his, and his seed’s after him, a covenant
of eternal priesthood, because he was jealous for his God,
and he made atonement for the children of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו בְּרִית כְּהֻנַּת עוֹלָם תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר קִנֵּא לֵאלֹהָיו וַיְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו בְּרִית כְּהֻנַּת עוֹלָם תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר קִנֵּא לֵאלֹהָיו וַיְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and it shall be his, and his seed’s after him, a covenant
of eternal priesthood, because he was jealous for his God,
and he made atonement for the children of Israel.”

translation.text: It shall be for him and for his descendants after God, and made atonement for the Israelites.'"

verses.english:
And the name of the stricken Israelite man, who was struck
with the Midianite woman, was Zimri son of Salu, chieftain
of a father’s house of the Simeonites.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֻּכֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֻכָּה אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית זִמְרִי בֶּן סָלוּא נְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֻּכֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֻכָּה אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית זִמְרִי בֶּן סָלוּא נְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִי׃

english.text:
And the name of the stricken Israelite man, who was struck
with the Midianite woman, was Zimri son of Salu, chieftain
of a father’s house of the Simeonites.

translation.text: The name of the slain Israelite man, who was killed with the belonging to the Simeonites.

verses.english:
And the name of the stricken Midianite woman was Cozbi
daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a father’s
house in Midian.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם הָאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית כּזְבִּי בַת צוּר רֹאשׁ אֻמּוֹת בֵּית אָב בְּמִדְיָן הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם הָאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית כּזְבִּי בַת צוּר רֹאשׁ אֻמּוֹת בֵּית אָב בְּמִדְיָן הוּא׃

english.text:
And the name of the stricken Midianite woman was Cozbi
daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a father’s
house in Midian.

translation.text: The name of the Midianite woman an ancestral house in Midian.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.english: “Afflict the Midianites—and you shall strike them—
verses.hebrew: צָרוֹר אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִים וְהִכִּיתֶם אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: צָרוֹר אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִים וְהִכִּיתֶם אוֹתָם׃

english.text: “Afflict the Midianites—and you shall strike them—

translation.text: "Harass the Midianites, and defeat them;

verses.english:
because they have been afflicting you with their
conspiracies that they made against you over the matter of
Peor and over the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a
chieftain of Midian, their sister who was struck on the
day of the plague over the matter of Peor.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי צֹרְרִים הֵם לָכֶם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְּלוּ לָכֶם עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וְעַל דְּבַר כּזְבִּי בַת נְשִׂיא מִדְיָן אֲחֹתָם הַמֻּכָּה בְיוֹם הַמַּגֵּפָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי צֹרְרִים הֵם לָכֶם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְּלוּ לָכֶם עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וְעַל דְּבַר כּזְבִּי בַת נְשִׂיא מִדְיָן אֲחֹתָם הַמֻּכָּה בְיוֹם הַמַּגֵּפָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר׃

english.text:
because they have been afflicting you with their
conspiracies that they made against you over the matter of
Peor and over the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a
chieftain of Midian, their sister who was struck on the
day of the plague over the matter of Peor.”

translation.text: for they have harassed you by the trickery with which they deceived you in the affair of Peor, and in the affair of Cozbi, the daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister; she was killed on the day of the plague that resulted from Peor."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron, the
priest, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַמַּגֵּפָה פ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַמַּגֵּפָה פ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron, the
priest, saying,

translation.text: After the plague the LORD said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כּל יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כּל יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

translation.text: "Take a census of the whole congregation of the Israelites, in Israel able to go to war."

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, spoke with them in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, spoke with them in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

translation.text: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,

verses.english:
“From twenty years old and up,” as YHWH commanded Moses
and the children of Israel who had gone out from the land
of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּצְאִים מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּצְאִים מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“From twenty years old and up,” as YHWH commanded Moses
and the children of Israel who had gone out from the land
of Egypt.

translation.text: the LORD commanded Moses. The Israelites, who came out of the land of Egypt, were:

verses.english:
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn; the children of Reuben:
Hanoch: the family of the Hanochites. Of Pallu: the family
of the Palluites.
verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֲנֹכִי לְפַלּוּא מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּלֻּאִי׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֲנֹכִי לְפַלּוּא מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּלֻּאִי׃

english.text:
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn; the children of Reuben:
Hanoch: the family of the Hanochites. Of Pallu: the family
of the Palluites.

translation.text: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel. The descendants of Reuben: of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;

verses.english:
Of Hezron: the family of the Hezronites. Of Carmi: the
family of the Carmites.
verses.hebrew: לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרוֹנִי לְכַרְמִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַכַּרְמִי׃

hebrew.text: לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרוֹנִי לְכַרְמִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַכַּרְמִי׃

english.text:
Of Hezron: the family of the Hezronites. Of Carmi: the
family of the Carmites.

translation.text: Carmites.

verses.english:
These are the families of the Reubenites, and their counts
were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָראוּבֵנִי וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָראוּבֵנִי וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
These are the families of the Reubenites, and their counts
were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

translation.text: These are the clans of the Reubenites; the number of those enrolled was forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

verses.english: And Pallu’s sons: Eliab.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי פַלּוּא אֱלִיאָב׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי פַלּוּא אֱלִיאָב׃

english.text: And Pallu’s sons: Eliab.

translation.text: And the descendants of Pallu: Eliab.

verses.english:
And Eliab’s sons: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. That is
the Dathan and Abiram, prominent ones of the congregation,
who fought against Moses and against Aaron in Korah’s
congregation when they fought against YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֱלִיאָב נְמוּאֵל וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם הוּא דָתָן וַאֲבִירָם (קרואי) [קְרִיאֵי] הָעֵדָה אֲשֶׁר הִצּוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בַּעֲדַת קֹרַח בְּהַצֹּתָם עַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי אֱלִיאָב נְמוּאֵל וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם הוּא דָתָן וַאֲבִירָם (קרואי) [קְרִיאֵי] הָעֵדָה אֲשֶׁר הִצּוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בַּעֲדַת קֹרַח בְּהַצֹּתָם עַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Eliab’s sons: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. That is
the Dathan and Abiram, prominent ones of the congregation,
who fought against Moses and against Aaron in Korah’s
congregation when they fought against YHWH,

translation.text: The descendants of Eliab: Nemuel, company of Korah, when they rebelled against the LORD,

verses.english:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
Korah when the congregation died, when the fire consumed
the two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת קֹרַח בְּמוֹת הָעֵדָה בַּאֲכֹל הָאֵשׁ אֵת חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיִּהְיוּ לְנֵס׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת קֹרַח בְּמוֹת הָעֵדָה בַּאֲכֹל הָאֵשׁ אֵת חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיִּהְיוּ לְנֵס׃

english.text:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
Korah when the congregation died, when the fire consumed
the two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

translation.text: and the men; and they became a warning.

verses.english: But Korah’s sons did not die.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח לֹא מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח לֹא מֵתוּ׃

english.text: But Korah’s sons did not die.

translation.text: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah did not die.

verses.english:
The children of Simeon by their families: Of Nemuel: the
family of the Nemuelites. Of Jamin: the family of the
Jaminites. Of Jachin: the family of the Jachinites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִנְמוּאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנְּמוּאֵלִי לְיָמִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּמִינִי לְיָכִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּכִינִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִנְמוּאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנְּמוּאֵלִי לְיָמִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּמִינִי לְיָכִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּכִינִי׃

english.text:
The children of Simeon by their families: Of Nemuel: the
family of the Nemuelites. Of Jamin: the family of the
Jaminites. Of Jachin: the family of the Jachinites.

translation.text: The descendants of Simeon by their clans: of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinites;

verses.english:
Of Zerah: the family of the Zerahites. Of Saul: the family
of the Saulites.
verses.hebrew: לְזֶרַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי לְשָׁאוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשָּׁאוּלִי׃

hebrew.text: לְזֶרַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי לְשָׁאוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשָּׁאוּלִי׃

english.text:
Of Zerah: the family of the Zerahites. Of Saul: the family
of the Saulites.

translation.text: of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulites.

verses.english:
These are the families of the Simeonites: twenty-two
thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

english.text:
These are the families of the Simeonites: twenty-two
thousand two hundred.

translation.text: These are the clans of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.english:
The children of Gad by their families: Of Zephon: the
family of the Zephonites. Of Haggi: the family of the
Haggites. Of Shuni: the family of the Shunites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִצְפוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַצְּפוֹנִי לְחַגִּי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחַגִּי לְשׁוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּנִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִצְפוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַצְּפוֹנִי לְחַגִּי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחַגִּי לְשׁוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּנִי׃

english.text:
The children of Gad by their families: Of Zephon: the
family of the Zephonites. Of Haggi: the family of the
Haggites. Of Shuni: the family of the Shunites.

translation.text: The children of Gad by their clans: of Zephon, the clan of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the clan of the Haggites; of Shuni, the clan of the Shunites;

verses.english:
Of Ozni: the family of the Oznites. Of Eri: the family of
the Erites.
verses.hebrew: לְאזְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאזְנִי לְעֵרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָעֵרִי׃

hebrew.text: לְאזְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאזְנִי לְעֵרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָעֵרִי׃

english.text:
Of Ozni: the family of the Oznites. Of Eri: the family of
the Erites.

translation.text: of Ozni, the clan of the Oznites; of Eri, the clan of the Erites;
