verses.english:
Of Arod: the family of the Arodites. Of Areli: the family
of the Arelites.
verses.hebrew: לַאֲרוֹד מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֲרוֹדִי לְאַרְאֵלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַרְאֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: לַאֲרוֹד מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֲרוֹדִי לְאַרְאֵלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַרְאֵלִי׃

english.text:
Of Arod: the family of the Arodites. Of Areli: the family
of the Arelites.

translation.text: of Arod, the clan of the Arodites; of Areli, the clan of the Arelites.

verses.english:
These are the families of the children of Gad by their
counts: forty thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי גָד לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי גָד לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of the children of Gad by their
counts: forty thousand five hundred.

translation.text: These are the clans of the Gadites: the number of those enrolled was forty thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
Judah’s sons were Er and Onan, but Er and Onan died in the
land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וַיָּמת עֵר וְאוֹנָן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וַיָּמת עֵר וְאוֹנָן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
Judah’s sons were Er and Onan, but Er and Onan died in the
land of Canaan.

translation.text: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
Then the children of Judah by their families were: Of
Shelah: the family of the Shelanites. Of Perez: the family
of the Perezites. Of Zerah: the family of the Zerahites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשֵׁלָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשֵּׁלָנִי לְפֶרֶץ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּרְצִי לְזֶרַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשֵׁלָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשֵּׁלָנִי לְפֶרֶץ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּרְצִי לְזֶרַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי׃

english.text:
Then the children of Judah by their families were: Of
Shelah: the family of the Shelanites. Of Perez: the family
of the Perezites. Of Zerah: the family of the Zerahites.

translation.text: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanites; of Perez, the clan of the Perezites; of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites.

verses.english:
And the children of Perez were: Of Hezron: the family of
the Hezronites. Of Hamul: the family of the Hamulites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי פֶרֶץ לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרֹנִי לְחָמוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הֶחָמוּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי פֶרֶץ לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרֹנִי לְחָמוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הֶחָמוּלִי׃

english.text:
And the children of Perez were: Of Hezron: the family of
the Hezronites. Of Hamul: the family of the Hamulites.

translation.text: The descendants of Perez were: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the clan of the Hamulites.

verses.english:
These are the families of Judah by their counts:
seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יְהוּדָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יְהוּדָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of Judah by their counts:
seventy-six thousand five hundred.

translation.text: seventy-six thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
The children of Issachar by their families: Tola: the
family of the Tolaites. Of Puwah, the family of the
Punites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם תּוֹלָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתּוֹלָעִי לְפֻוָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפּוּנִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם תּוֹלָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתּוֹלָעִי לְפֻוָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפּוּנִי׃

english.text:
The children of Issachar by their families: Tola: the
family of the Tolaites. Of Puwah, the family of the
Punites.

translation.text: The descendants of Issachar by their clans: of Tola, the clan of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the clan of the Punites;

verses.english:
Of Jashub: the family of the Jashubites. Of Shimron: the
family of the Shimronites.
verses.hebrew: לְיָשׁוּב מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּשֻׁבִי לְשִׁמְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְרֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: לְיָשׁוּב מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּשֻׁבִי לְשִׁמְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְרֹנִי׃

english.text:
Of Jashub: the family of the Jashubites. Of Shimron: the
family of the Shimronites.

translation.text: of Jashub, the clan of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronites.

verses.english:
These are the families of Issachar by their counts:
sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יִשָּׂשכָר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יִשָּׂשכָר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of Issachar by their counts:
sixty-four thousand three hundred.

translation.text: These are the clans of Issachar: sixty-four thousand three hundred enrolled.

verses.english:
The children of Zebulun by their families: Of Sered: the
family of the Seredites. Of Elon: the family of the
Elonites. Of Jahleel: the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְסֶרֶד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַסַּרְדִּי לְאֵלוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֵלֹנִי לְיַחְלְאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיַּחְלְאֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְסֶרֶד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַסַּרְדִּי לְאֵלוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֵלֹנִי לְיַחְלְאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיַּחְלְאֵלִי׃

english.text:
The children of Zebulun by their families: Of Sered: the
family of the Seredites. Of Elon: the family of the
Elonites. Of Jahleel: the family of the Jahleelites.

translation.text: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans: of Sered, the clan of the Seredites; of Elon, the clan of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the clan of the Jahleelites.

verses.english:
These are the families of the Zebulunites by their counts:
sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַזְּבוּלֹנִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַזְּבוּלֹנִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of the Zebulunites by their counts:
sixty thousand five hundred.

translation.text: These are the clans of the Zebulunites; the number of those enrolled was sixty thousand five hundred.

verses.english:
The children of Joseph by their families were Manasseh and
Ephraim.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
The children of Joseph by their families were Manasseh and
Ephraim.

translation.text: The sons of Joseph by their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.english:
Of the children of Manasseh: Of Machir: the family of the
Machirites. And Machir fathered Gilead. Of Gilead: the
family of the Gileadites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְמָכִיר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמָּכִירִי וּמָכִיר הוֹלִיד אֶת גִּלְעָד לְגִלְעָד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגִּלְעָדִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְמָכִיר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמָּכִירִי וּמָכִיר הוֹלִיד אֶת גִּלְעָד לְגִלְעָד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגִּלְעָדִי׃

english.text:
Of the children of Manasseh: Of Machir: the family of the
Machirites. And Machir fathered Gilead. Of Gilead: the
family of the Gileadites.

translation.text: The Machir was the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadites.

verses.english:
These are the children of Gilead: Of Iezer: the family of
the Iezerites. Of Helek: the family of the Helekites.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי גִלְעָד אִיעֶזֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאִיעֶזְרִי לְחֵלֶק מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶלְקִי׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי גִלְעָד אִיעֶזֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאִיעֶזְרִי לְחֵלֶק מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶלְקִי׃

english.text:
These are the children of Gilead: Of Iezer: the family of
the Iezerites. Of Helek: the family of the Helekites.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Gilead: of Iezer, the clan of the Iezerites; of Helek, the clan of the Helekites;

verses.english:
And Asriel: the family of the Asrielites. And Shechem: the
family of the Shechemites.
verses.hebrew: וְאַשְׂרִיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַשְׂרִאֵלִי וְשֶׁכֶם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁכְמִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַשְׂרִיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַשְׂרִאֵלִי וְשֶׁכֶם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁכְמִי׃

english.text:
And Asriel: the family of the Asrielites. And Shechem: the
family of the Shechemites.

translation.text: and of Asriel, the clan of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the clan of the Shechemites;

verses.english:
And Shemida: the family of the Shemidaites. And Hepher:
the family of the Hepherites.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמִידָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִי וְחֵפֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶפְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמִידָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִי וְחֵפֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶפְרִי׃

english.text:
And Shemida: the family of the Shemidaites. And Hepher:
the family of the Hepherites.

translation.text: and of Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the clan of the Hepherites.

verses.english:
And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, just daughters,
and the names of Zelophehad’s daughters were Mahlah and
Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.hebrew: וּצְלפְחָד בֶּן חֵפֶר לֹא הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם בָּנוֹת וְשֵׁם בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וּצְלפְחָד בֶּן חֵפֶר לֹא הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם בָּנוֹת וְשֵׁם בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, just daughters,
and the names of Zelophehad’s daughters were Mahlah and
Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

translation.text: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.english:
These are the families of Manasseh; and their counts:
fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of Manasseh; and their counts:
fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

translation.text: These are the clans of hundred.

verses.english:
These are the children of Ephraim by their families: Of
Shuthelah: the family of the Shuthelahites. Of Becher: the
family of the Becherites. Of Tahan: the family of the
Tahanites.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשׁוּתֶלַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשֻּׁתַלְחִי לְבֶכֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבַּכְרִי לְתַחַן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתַּחֲנִי׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשׁוּתֶלַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשֻּׁתַלְחִי לְבֶכֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבַּכְרִי לְתַחַן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתַּחֲנִי׃

english.text:
These are the children of Ephraim by their families: Of
Shuthelah: the family of the Shuthelahites. Of Becher: the
family of the Becherites. Of Tahan: the family of the
Tahanites.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Ephraim according to their clans: of Becherites; of Tahan, the clan of the Tahanites.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Shuthelah: Of Eran: the
family of the Eranites.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוּתָלַח לְעֵרָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָעֵרָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוּתָלַח לְעֵרָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָעֵרָנִי׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Shuthelah: Of Eran: the
family of the Eranites.

translation.text: And these are the descendants of Shuthelah: of Eran, the clan of the Eranites.

verses.english:
These are the families of the children of Ephraim by their
counts: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the
sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי אֶפְרַיִם לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אֵלֶּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי אֶפְרַיִם לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אֵלֶּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
These are the families of the children of Ephraim by their
counts: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the
sons of Joseph after their families.

translation.text: These by their clans.

verses.english:
The children of Benjamin by their families: Of Bela: the
family of the Belaites. Of Ashbel: the family of the
Ashbelites. Of Ahiram: the family of the Ahiramites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֶלַע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבַּלְעִי לְאַשְׁבֵּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַשְׁבֵּלִי לַאֲחִירָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֲחִירָמִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֶלַע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבַּלְעִי לְאַשְׁבֵּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַשְׁבֵּלִי לַאֲחִירָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֲחִירָמִי׃

english.text:
The children of Benjamin by their families: Of Bela: the
family of the Belaites. Of Ashbel: the family of the
Ashbelites. Of Ahiram: the family of the Ahiramites.

translation.text: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramites;

verses.english:
Of Shephupham: the family of the Shuphamites. Of Hupham:
the family of the Huphamites.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁפוּפָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּפָמִי לְחוּפָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחוּפָמִי׃

hebrew.text: לִשְׁפוּפָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּפָמִי לְחוּפָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחוּפָמִי׃

english.text:
Of Shephupham: the family of the Shuphamites. Of Hupham:
the family of the Huphamites.

translation.text: of Shephupham, the clan of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the clan of the Huphamites.

verses.english:
And the children of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family
of the Ardites. Of Naaman: the family of the Naamites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי בֶלַע אַרְדְּ וְנַעֲמָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַרְדִּי לְנַעֲמָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנַּעֲמִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי בֶלַע אַרְדְּ וְנַעֲמָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַרְדִּי לְנַעֲמָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנַּעֲמִי׃

english.text:
And the children of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family
of the Ardites. Of Naaman: the family of the Naamites.

translation.text: And the sons of Bela were of the Naamites.

verses.english:
These are the children of Benjamin by their families; and
their counts: forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the children of Benjamin by their families; and
their counts: forty-five thousand six hundred.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Benjamin by their hundred.

verses.english:
These are the children of Dan by their families: Of
Shuham: the family of the Shuhamites. These are the
families of Dan after their families.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשׁוּחָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּחָמִי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת דָּן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשׁוּחָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּחָמִי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת דָּן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
These are the children of Dan by their families: Of
Shuham: the family of the Shuhamites. These are the
families of Dan after their families.

translation.text: These are the descendants of Dan by their clans: of Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamites. These are the clans of Dan by their clans.

verses.english:
All the families of the Shuhamites by their counts:
sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: כּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשּׁוּחָמִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: כּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשּׁוּחָמִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
All the families of the Shuhamites by their counts:
sixty-four thousand four hundred.

translation.text: All the clans of the Shuhamites: sixty-four thousand four hundred enrolled.

verses.english:
The children of Asher by their families: Of Imnah: the
family of Imnah. Of Ishvi: the family of the Ishvites. Of
Beriah: the family of the Beriites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְיִמְנָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּמְנָה לְיִשְׁוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּשְׁוִי לִבְרִיעָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבְּרִיעִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְיִמְנָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּמְנָה לְיִשְׁוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּשְׁוִי לִבְרִיעָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבְּרִיעִי׃

english.text:
The children of Asher by their families: Of Imnah: the
family of Imnah. Of Ishvi: the family of the Ishvites. Of
Beriah: the family of the Beriites.

translation.text: The descendants of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the clan of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the clan of the Beriites.

verses.english:
Of the children of Beriah: Of Heber: the family of the
Heberites. Of Malchiel: the family of the Malchielites.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי בְרִיעָה לְחֶבֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרִי לְמַלְכִּיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי בְרִיעָה לְחֶבֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרִי לְמַלְכִּיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִי׃

english.text:
Of the children of Beriah: Of Heber: the family of the
Heberites. Of Malchiel: the family of the Malchielites.

translation.text: Of the descendants of Beriah: of Heber, the clan of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the clan of the Malchielites.

verses.english: And Asher’s daughter’s name was Serah.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם בַּת אָשֵׁר שָׂרַח׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם בַּת אָשֵׁר שָׂרַח׃

english.text: And Asher’s daughter’s name was Serah.

translation.text: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

verses.english:
These are the families of the children of Asher by their
counts: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of the children of Asher by their
counts: fifty-three thousand four hundred.

translation.text: These are the clans of the hundred.

verses.english:
The children of Naphtali by their families: Of Jahzeel:
the family of the Jahzeelites. Of Guni: the family of the
Gunites.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְיַחְצְאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיַּחְצְאֵלִי לְגוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגּוּנִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְיַחְצְאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיַּחְצְאֵלִי לְגוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגּוּנִי׃

english.text:
The children of Naphtali by their families: Of Jahzeel:
the family of the Jahzeelites. Of Guni: the family of the
Gunites.

translation.text: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans: of Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the clan of the Gunites;

verses.english:
Of Jezer: the family of the Jezerites. Of Shillem: the
family of the Shillemites.
verses.hebrew: לְיֵצֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְרִי לְשִׁלֵּם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִי׃

hebrew.text: לְיֵצֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְרִי לְשִׁלֵּם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִי׃

english.text:
Of Jezer: the family of the Jezerites. Of Shillem: the
family of the Shillemites.

translation.text: of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.

verses.english:
These are the families of Naphtali by their families, and
their counts: forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
These are the families of Naphtali by their families, and
their counts: forty-five thousand four hundred.

translation.text: These are the Naphtalites by their clans: the number of those enrolled was forty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.english:
These are the counts of the children of Israel: six
hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וָאָלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וָאָלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
These are the counts of the children of Israel: six
hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

translation.text: This was the number of the Israelites enrolled: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred thirty.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“The land shall be distributed to these as a legacy with
the number of names.
verses.hebrew: לָאֵלֶּה תֵּחָלֵק הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: לָאֵלֶּה תֵּחָלֵק הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת׃

english.text:
“The land shall be distributed to these as a legacy with
the number of names.

translation.text: To these the land shall be apportioned for inheritance according to the number of names.

verses.english:
For the large you shall make its legacy larger, and for
the small you shall make its legacy smaller. Each man will
be given his legacy according to his counts.
verses.hebrew: לָרַב תַּרְבֶּה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט נַחֲלָתוֹ אִישׁ לְפִי פְקֻדָיו יֻתַּן נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לָרַב תַּרְבֶּה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט נַחֲלָתוֹ אִישׁ לְפִי פְקֻדָיו יֻתַּן נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
For the large you shall make its legacy larger, and for
the small you shall make its legacy smaller. Each man will
be given his legacy according to his counts.

translation.text: To a large tribe you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a small inheritance; every tribe shall be given its inheritance according to its enrollment.

verses.english:
Just: the land shall be distributed by lot. They shall
have a legacy by the names of their fathers’ tribes.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בְּגוֹרָל יֵחָלֵק אֶת הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמוֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָם יִנְחָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בְּגוֹרָל יֵחָלֵק אֶת הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמוֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָם יִנְחָלוּ׃

english.text:
Just: the land shall be distributed by lot. They shall
have a legacy by the names of their fathers’ tribes.

translation.text: But the land shall be apportioned by lot; according to the names of their ancestral tribes they shall inherit.

verses.english:
Its legacy shall be distributed according to the lot,
whether large or small.”
verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי הַגּוֹרָל תֵּחָלֵק נַחֲלָתוֹ בֵּין רַב לִמְעָט׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי הַגּוֹרָל תֵּחָלֵק נַחֲלָתוֹ בֵּין רַב לִמְעָט׃

english.text:
Its legacy shall be distributed according to the lot,
whether large or small.”

translation.text: Their inheritance shall be apportioned according to lot between the larger and the smaller.

verses.english:
And these are the counts of the Levites by their families:
Of Gershon: the family of the Gershonites. Of Kohath: the
family of the Kohathites. Of Merari: the family of the
Merarites.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַלֵּוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמְּרָרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַלֵּוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמְּרָרִי׃

english.text:
And these are the counts of the Levites by their families:
Of Gershon: the family of the Gershonites. Of Kohath: the
family of the Kohathites. Of Merari: the family of the
Merarites.

translation.text: This is the enrollment of the Levites by their clans: of Gershon, the Merari, the clan of the Merarites.

verses.english:
These are the families of the Levites: the family of the
Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the
Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the
Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת לֵוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקּרְחִי וּקְהָת הוֹלִד אֶת עַמְרָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת לֵוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקּרְחִי וּקְהָת הוֹלִד אֶת עַמְרָם׃

english.text:
These are the families of the Levites: the family of the
Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the
Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the
Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.

translation.text: These are the clans of Levi: the Kohath was the father of Amram.

verses.english:
And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a daughter of
Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. And she gave birth
for Amram to Aaron and Moses and Miriam, their sister.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת עַמְרָם יוֹכֶבֶד בַּת לֵוִי אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֹתָהּ לְלֵוִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וַתֵּלֶד לְעַמְרָם אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֵת מִרְיָם אֲחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת עַמְרָם יוֹכֶבֶד בַּת לֵוִי אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֹתָהּ לְלֵוִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וַתֵּלֶד לְעַמְרָם אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֵת מִרְיָם אֲחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a daughter of
Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. And she gave birth
for Amram to Aaron and Moses and Miriam, their sister.

translation.text: The name of Amram's wife was bore to Amram: Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.

verses.english:
And Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar were born to
Aaron.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְאַהֲרֹן אֶת נָדָב וְאֶת אֲבִיהוּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת אִיתָמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְאַהֲרֹן אֶת נָדָב וְאֶת אֲבִיהוּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת אִיתָמָר׃

english.text:
And Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar were born to
Aaron.

translation.text: To Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.english:
And Nadab and Abihu died when they brought forward
unfitting fire in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Nadab and Abihu died when they brought forward
unfitting fire in front of YHWH.

translation.text: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unholy fire before the LORD.

verses.english:
And their counts were twenty-three thousand, every male
from a month old and up, because they were not counted
among the children of Israel because a legacy was not
given to them among the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה כִּי לֹא התְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא נִתַּן לָהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה כִּי לֹא התְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא נִתַּן לָהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And their counts were twenty-three thousand, every male
from a month old and up, because they were not counted
among the children of Israel because a legacy was not
given to them among the children of Israel.

translation.text: The Israelites.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

translation.text: These were those enrolled by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who Jericho.

verses.english:
and there was not a man among these from the counts of
Moses and Aaron, the priest, who counted the children of
Israel in the wilderness of Sinai,
verses.hebrew: וּבְאֵלֶּה לֹא הָיָה אִישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְאֵלֶּה לֹא הָיָה אִישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

english.text:
and there was not a man among these from the counts of
Moses and Aaron, the priest, who counted the children of
Israel in the wilderness of Sinai,

translation.text: Among these there was not one of those enrolled by Moses and Aaron the priest, who had enrolled the Israelites in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.english:

And he had no sons.

Why should our father’s name be subtracted from among his
family because he didn’t have a son? Give us a possession
among our father’s brothers.”

“Zelophehad’s daughters speak right. You shall give them a
possession for a legacy among their father’s brothers, and
you shall pass their father’s legacy to them.

legacy to his daughter.

And you’ll see it, and then you’ll be gathered to your

and in front of all the congregation, and you shall
command him before their eyes.
verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה וְצִוִּיתָה אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה וְצִוִּיתָה אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall stand him in front of Eleazar, the priest,
and in front of all the congregation, and you shall
command him before their eyes.

translation.text: have him commission him in their sight.

verses.english:
And you shall put some of your eminence on him so that all
the congregation of the children of Israel will hear.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה מֵהוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה מֵהוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall put some of your eminence on him so that all
the congregation of the children of Israel will hear.

translation.text: You shall give him some of your authority, so that all the congregation of the Israelites may obey.

verses.english:
And he shall stand in front of Eleazar, the priest; and he
shall ask him in judgment of the Urim in front of YHWH. By
his word they shall go out, and by his word they shall
come in, he and all the children of Israel with him and
all the congregation.”
verses.hebrew: וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמֹד וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל פִּיו יֵצְאוּ וְעַל פִּיו יָבֹאוּ הוּא וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתּוֹ וְכל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמֹד וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל פִּיו יֵצְאוּ וְעַל פִּיו יָבֹאוּ הוּא וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתּוֹ וְכל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And he shall stand in front of Eleazar, the priest; and he
shall ask him in judgment of the Urim in front of YHWH. By
his word they shall go out, and by his word they shall
come in, he and all the children of Israel with him and
all the congregation.”

translation.text: But he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the Israelites with him, the whole congregation."

verses.english:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him, and he took Joshua
and stood him in front of Eleazar, the priest, and in
front of all the congregation.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him, and he took Joshua
and stood him in front of Eleazar, the priest, and in
front of all the congregation.

translation.text: So Moses did as the LORD the priest and the whole congregation;

verses.english:
And he laid his hands on him and commanded him, as YHWH
had spoken by Moses’ hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְמֹךְ אֶת יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיְצַוֵּהוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְמֹךְ אֶת יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיְצַוֵּהוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he laid his hands on him and commanded him, as YHWH
had spoken by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: he laid his hands on him and commissioned him — as the LORD had directed through Moses.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: You shall observe to bring forward my sacrifice to
me, my bread, for my offering by fire, my pleasant smell,
at its appointed time.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת קרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי רֵיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת קרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי רֵיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: You shall observe to bring forward my sacrifice to
me, my bread, for my offering by fire, my pleasant smell,
at its appointed time.

translation.text: Command the Israelites, and say to them: My offering, the food for my offerings by fire, my pleasing odor, you shall take care to offer to me at its appointed time.

verses.english:
“And you shall say to them: This is the offering by fire
that you shall bring forward to YHWH: two unblemished
one-year-old lambs per day as a continual burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְמִימִם שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם עֹלָה תָמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְמִימִם שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם עֹלָה תָמִיד׃

english.text:
“And you shall say to them: This is the offering by fire
that you shall bring forward to YHWH: two unblemished
one-year-old lambs per day as a continual burnt offering.

translation.text: And you shall say to them, This is the offering by fire that you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs a year old without blemish, daily, as a regular offering.

verses.english:
You shall do one lamb in the morning, and you shall do the
second lamb ‘between the two evenings.’
verses.hebrew: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

english.text:
You shall do one lamb in the morning, and you shall do the
second lamb ‘between the two evenings.’

translation.text: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;

verses.english:
And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain
offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of pressed oil,
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

english.text:
And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain
offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of pressed oil,

translation.text: also one-tenth of an ephah of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with one-fourth of a hin of beaten oil.

verses.english:
the continual burnt offering that was done at Mount Sinai
for a pleasant smell, an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
the continual burnt offering that was done at Mount Sinai
for a pleasant smell, an offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: It is a regular burnt offering, ordained at Mount Sinai for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
And its libation shall be a fourth of a hin for one lamb.
Pour a libation of beer in the holy place for YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And its libation shall be a fourth of a hin for one lamb.
Pour a libation of beer in the holy place for YHWH.

translation.text: Its drink offering shall be one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the sanctuary you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall do the second lamb ‘between the two
evenings,’ and you shall do it like the morning grain
offering and like its libation, an offering by fire of a
pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall do the second lamb ‘between the two
evenings,’ and you shall do it like the morning grain
offering and like its libation, an offering by fire of a
pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight with a grain offering and a drink offering like the one in the morning; you shall offer it as an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the LORD.

verses.english:
“And on the Sabbath day two unblemished one-year-old lambs
and two tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil, and its libation:
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
“And on the Sabbath day two unblemished one-year-old lambs
and two tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil, and its libation:

translation.text: On the sabbath day: two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering —

verses.english:
the burnt offering of each Sabbath in its week, beside the
continual burnt offering and its libation.
verses.hebrew: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

english.text:
the burnt offering of each Sabbath in its week, beside the
continual burnt offering and its libation.

translation.text: this is the burnt offering for every offering.

verses.english:
“And at the beginning of your months you shall bring
forward a burnt offering to YHWH: two bulls of the cattle
and one ram, seven unblemished one-year-old lambs,
verses.hebrew: וּבְרָאשֵׁי חדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרָאשֵׁי חדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

english.text:
“And at the beginning of your months you shall bring
forward a burnt offering to YHWH: two bulls of the cattle
and one ram, seven unblemished one-year-old lambs,

translation.text: At the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to without blemish;

verses.english:
with three tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed
with oil for one bull and two tenths of fine flour mixed
with oil for the one ram,
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַפָּר הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַפָּר הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
with three tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed
with oil for one bull and two tenths of fine flour mixed
with oil for the one ram,

translation.text: also three-tenths of an ephah of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two-tenths of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

verses.english:
and one tenth of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil for each lamb, a burnt offering as a pleasant smell,
an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and one tenth of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil for each lamb, a burnt offering as a pleasant smell,
an offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: and onetenth of choice flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for every lamb — a burnt offering of pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the LORD.

verses.english:
And their libations: half a hin will be for a bull and a
third of a hin for a ram and a fourth of a hin for a
lamb—wine. This is the burnt offering of each new month in
its month for the months of the year.
verses.hebrew: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם חֲצִי הַהִין יִהְיֶה לַפָּר וּשְׁלִישִׁת הַהִין לָאַיִל וּרְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ יָיִן זֹאת עֹלַת חֹדֶשׁ בְּחדְשׁוֹ לְחדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם חֲצִי הַהִין יִהְיֶה לַפָּר וּשְׁלִישִׁת הַהִין לָאַיִל וּרְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ יָיִן זֹאת עֹלַת חֹדֶשׁ בְּחדְשׁוֹ לְחדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
And their libations: half a hin will be for a bull and a
third of a hin for a ram and a fourth of a hin for a
lamb—wine. This is the burnt offering of each new month in
its month for the months of the year.

translation.text: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

verses.english:
And one goat for a sin offering to YHWH shall be done,
beside the continual burnt offering and its libation.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהֹוָה עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהֹוָה עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
And one goat for a sin offering to YHWH shall be done,
beside the continual burnt offering and its libation.

translation.text: And there shall be one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD; it shall be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.english:
“And in the first month on the fourteenth day of the month
is a Passover to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And in the first month on the fourteenth day of the month
is a Passover to YHWH.

translation.text: On the fourteenth day of the first month there shall be a passover offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is a holiday. For
seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is a holiday. For
seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.

translation.text: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a festival; seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

verses.english:
On the first day is a holy assembly. You shall not do any
act of work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
On the first day is a holy assembly. You shall not do any
act of work.

translation.text: On the first occupations.

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire, a burnt
offering to YHWH. You shall have two bulls of the cattle
and one ram and seven unblemished one-year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד וְשִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד וְשִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire, a burnt
offering to YHWH. You shall have two bulls of the cattle
and one ram and seven unblemished one-year-old lambs.

translation.text: You shall offer an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; see that they are without blemish.

verses.english:
And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with
oil. You shall do three tenths for a bull and two tenths
for a ram.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with
oil. You shall do three tenths for a bull and two tenths
for a ram.

translation.text: Their grain offering shall be of choice flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah shall you offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;

verses.english:
And you shall do one tenth for each lamb, for the seven
lambs.
verses.hebrew: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

english.text:
And you shall do one tenth for each lamb, for the seven
lambs.

translation.text: one-tenth shall you offer for each of the seven lambs;

verses.english:
And one goat for a sin offering to make atonement over
you.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And one goat for a sin offering to make atonement over
you.

translation.text: also one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

verses.english:
You shall do these aside from the morning burnt offering
that is for the continual burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר אֲשֶׁר לְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת אֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר אֲשֶׁר לְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת אֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
You shall do these aside from the morning burnt offering
that is for the continual burnt offering.

translation.text: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which belongs to the regular burnt offering.

verses.english:
You shall do food as a fire offering, a pleasant smell to
YHWH, like these daily for seven days. It shall be done
beside the continual burnt offering and its libation.
verses.hebrew: כָּאֵלֶּה תַּעֲשׂוּ לַיּוֹם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לֶחֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה עַל עוֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כָּאֵלֶּה תַּעֲשׂוּ לַיּוֹם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לֶחֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה עַל עוֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall do food as a fire offering, a pleasant smell to
YHWH, like these daily for seven days. It shall be done
beside the continual burnt offering and its libation.

translation.text: In the same way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of an addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.english:
And on the seventh day you shall have a holy assembly. You
shall not do any act of work.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And on the seventh day you shall have a holy assembly. You
shall not do any act of work.

translation.text: And on at your occupations.

verses.english:
“And on the Day of Firstfruits, when you bring a new grain
offering to YHWH on your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a
holy assembly. You shall not do any act of work.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהֹוָה בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהֹוָה בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
“And on the Day of Firstfruits, when you bring a new grain
offering to YHWH on your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a
holy assembly. You shall not do any act of work.

translation.text: On the day of the first fruits, when you offer a grain offering of convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward a burnt offering for a
plea-sant smell to YHWH: two bulls of the cattle, one ram,
seven one-year-old lambs
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עוֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם אַיִל אֶחָד שִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עוֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם אַיִל אֶחָד שִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward a burnt offering for a
plea-sant smell to YHWH: two bulls of the cattle, one ram,
seven one-year-old lambs

translation.text: You shall offer ram, seven male lambs a year old.

verses.english:
and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three
tenths for one bull, two tenths for one ram,
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר הָאֶחָד שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר הָאֶחָד שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three
tenths for one bull, two tenths for one ram,

translation.text: Their grain offering shall be of two-tenths for one ram,

verses.english: one tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs,
verses.hebrew: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

english.text: one tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs,

translation.text: one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;

verses.english: one goat to make atonement over you.
verses.hebrew: שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text: one goat to make atonement over you.

translation.text: with one male goat, to make atonement for you.

verses.english:
You shall do it aside from the continual burnt offering
and its grain offering—they shall be unblemished for
you—and their libations.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתוֹ תַּעֲשׂוּ תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתוֹ תַּעֲשׂוּ תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
You shall do it aside from the continual burnt offering
and its grain offering—they shall be unblemished for
you—and their libations.

translation.text: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, you shall offer them and their drink offering. They shall be without blemish.

verses.english:
“And in the seventh month on the first of the month you
shall have a holy assembly. You shall not do any act of
work. You shall have a day of horn-blasting.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
“And in the seventh month on the first of the month you
shall have a holy assembly. You shall not do any act of
work. You shall have a day of horn-blasting.

translation.text: On the first day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations. It is a day for you to blow the trumpets,

verses.english:
And you shall do a burnt offering for a pleasant smell for
YHWH: one bull of the cattle, one ram, seven unblemished
one-year-old lambs,
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם עֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד אַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

english.text:
And you shall do a burnt offering for a pleasant smell for
YHWH: one bull of the cattle, one ram, seven unblemished
one-year-old lambs,

translation.text: and you shall offer a burnt offering, a pleasing old without blemish.

and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three
tenths for a bull, two tenths for a ram,

english.text:
and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three
tenths for a bull, two tenths for a ram,

translation.text: Their grain offering shall be of choice flour the ram,

verses.english: and one tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs,
verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרוֹן אֶחָד לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

and one goat for a sin offering to make atonement over

make a restriction on himself shall not desecrate his
word. He shall do it according to everything that comes
out of his mouth.

restriction in her father’s house in her youth,

restriction in her father’s house in her youth,

made on herself, and her father keeps quiet to her, then
all her vows shall stand, and every restriction that she
made on herself shall stand.

all her vows shall stand, and every restriction that she
made on herself shall stand.

her vows and her restrictions that she made on herself, it
will not stand. And YHWH will forgive her because her
father held her back.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הֵנִיא אָבִיהָ אֹתָהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ כּל נְדָרֶיהָ וֶאֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ כִּי הֵנִיא אָבִיהָ אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הֵנִיא אָבִיהָ אֹתָהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ כּל נְדָרֶיהָ וֶאֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ כִּי הֵנִיא אָבִיהָ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
But if her father held her back on the day he heard all
her vows and her restrictions that she made on herself, it
will not stand. And YHWH will forgive her because her
father held her back.

translation.text: If she marries, while obligated by her vows or any thoughtless utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself,

verses.english:
“And if she will have a husband while her vows or the
thing she let out of her lips with which she restricted
herself are on her,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הָיוֹ תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ וּנְדָרֶיהָ עָלֶיהָ אוֹ מִבְטָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הָיוֹ תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ וּנְדָרֶיהָ עָלֶיהָ אוֹ מִבְטָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ׃

english.text:
“And if she will have a husband while her vows or the
thing she let out of her lips with which she restricted
herself are on her,

translation.text: and her herself shall stand.

verses.english:
and her husband hears and keeps quiet on the day he heard
it, then her vows will stand, and her restrictions that
she made on herself will stand.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ וְהֶחֱרִישׁ לָהּ וְקָמוּ נְדָרֶיהָ וֶאֱסָרֶהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקֻמוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ וְהֶחֱרִישׁ לָהּ וְקָמוּ נְדָרֶיהָ וֶאֱסָרֶהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקֻמוּ׃

english.text:
and her husband hears and keeps quiet on the day he heard
it, then her vows will stand, and her restrictions that
she made on herself will stand.

translation.text: But if, at the time that her husband hears of it, he expresses disapproval to her, then he shall nullify the vow by which she bound herself; and the LORD will forgive her.

verses.english:
But if, on the day her husband hears it, he will hold her
back and will break her vow that is on her and what was
let out of her lips by which she restricted herself, then
YHWH will forgive her.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּיוֹם שְׁמֹעַ אִישָׁהּ יָנִיא אוֹתָהּ וְהֵפֵר אֶת נִדְרָהּ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִבְטָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּיוֹם שְׁמֹעַ אִישָׁהּ יָנִיא אוֹתָהּ וְהֵפֵר אֶת נִדְרָהּ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִבְטָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ׃

english.text:
But if, on the day her husband hears it, he will hold her
back and will break her vow that is on her and what was
let out of her lips by which she restricted herself, then
YHWH will forgive her.

translation.text: (But every vow of a be binding upon her.)

verses.english:
“And a widow’s or divorced woman’s vow, everything by
which she has restricted herself, shall stand regarding
her.
verses.hebrew: וְנֵדֶר אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֵדֶר אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
“And a widow’s or divorced woman’s vow, everything by
which she has restricted herself, shall stand regarding
her.

translation.text: And if she made a vow in her husband's house, or bound herself by a pledge with an oath,

verses.english:
“And if she vowed or made a restriction on herself by an
oath at her husband’s house,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בֵּית אִישָׁהּ נָדָרָה אוֹ אָסְרָה אִסָּר עַל נַפְשָׁהּ בִּשְׁבֻעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בֵּית אִישָׁהּ נָדָרָה אוֹ אָסְרָה אִסָּר עַל נַפְשָׁהּ בִּשְׁבֻעָה׃

english.text:
“And if she vowed or made a restriction on herself by an
oath at her husband’s house,

translation.text: and her husband herself shall stand.

verses.english:
and her husband heard it and kept quiet to her—he did not
hold her back—then all her vows shall stand, and every
restriction that she made on herself shall stand.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ לֹא הֵנִיא אֹתָהּ וְקָמוּ כּל נְדָרֶיהָ וְכל אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ לֹא הֵנִיא אֹתָהּ וְקָמוּ כּל נְדָרֶיהָ וְכל אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם׃

english.text:
and her husband heard it and kept quiet to her—he did not
hold her back—then all her vows shall stand, and every
restriction that she made on herself shall stand.

translation.text: But if her husband nullifies them at the time that vows, or concerning her pledge of herself, shall not stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will forgive her.

verses.english:
But if her husband broke them on the day he heard all that
came out of her lips for her vows and for restricting
herself, it shall not stand. Her husband had broken them,
and YHWH will forgive her.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ כּל מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ לִנְדָרֶיהָ וּלְאִסַּר נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם אִישָׁהּ הֲפֵרָם וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ כּל מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ לִנְדָרֶיהָ וּלְאִסַּר נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם אִישָׁהּ הֲפֵרָם וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ׃

english.text:
But if her husband broke them on the day he heard all that
came out of her lips for her vows and for restricting
herself, it shall not stand. Her husband had broken them,
and YHWH will forgive her.

translation.text: Any vow or any husband may nullify.

verses.english:
Every vow and every oath of restriction to degrade
oneself: her husband shall make it stand, and her husband
shall break it.
verses.hebrew: כּל נֵדֶר וְכל שְׁבֻעַת אִסָּר לְעַנֹּת נָפֶשׁ אִישָׁהּ יְקִימֶנּוּ וְאִישָׁהּ יְפֵרֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל נֵדֶר וְכל שְׁבֻעַת אִסָּר לְעַנֹּת נָפֶשׁ אִישָׁהּ יְקִימֶנּוּ וְאִישָׁהּ יְפֵרֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
Every vow and every oath of restriction to degrade
oneself: her husband shall make it stand, and her husband
shall break it.

translation.text: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he validates all her vows, or all her pledges, by which she is obligated; he has validated them, because he said nothing to her at the time that he heard of them.

verses.english:
And if her husband will keep quiet in regard to her from
that day to the next, then he has made all her vows and
all her restrictions that are on her stand. He has made
them stand because he kept quiet to her on the day he
heard it.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הַחֲרֵשׁ יַחֲרִישׁ לָהּ אִישָׁהּ מִיּוֹם אֶל יוֹם וְהֵקִים אֶת כּל נְדָרֶיהָ אוֹ אֶת כּל אֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ הֵקִים אֹתָם כִּי הֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הַחֲרֵשׁ יַחֲרִישׁ לָהּ אִישָׁהּ מִיּוֹם אֶל יוֹם וְהֵקִים אֶת כּל נְדָרֶיהָ אוֹ אֶת כּל אֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ הֵקִים אֹתָם כִּי הֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ׃

english.text:
And if her husband will keep quiet in regard to her from
that day to the next, then he has made all her vows and
all her restrictions that are on her stand. He has made
them stand because he kept quiet to her on the day he
heard it.

translation.text: But if he nullifies them some time after he has heard of them, then he shall bear her guilt.

verses.english:
And if he will break them after he has heard them, then he
shall bear her crime.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אַחֲרֵי שׁמְעוֹ וְנָשָׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אַחֲרֵי שׁמְעוֹ וְנָשָׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָהּ׃

english.text:
And if he will break them after he has heard them, then he
shall bear her crime.”

translation.text: These are the statutes that the LORD commanded Moses concerning a husband and his wife, and a father and his daughter while she is still young and in her father's house.

verses.english:
These are the laws that YHWH commanded Moses between a man
and his wife, between a father and his daughter in her
youth at her father’s house.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ בֵּין אָב לְבִתּוֹ בִּנְעֻרֶיהָ בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ בֵּין אָב לְבִתּוֹ בִּנְעֻרֶיהָ בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
These are the laws that YHWH commanded Moses between a man
and his wife, between a father and his daughter in her
youth at her father’s house.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.english:
“Get revenge for the children of Israel from the
Midianites. After that you’ll be gathered to your people.”
verses.hebrew: נְקֹם נִקְמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַמִּדְיָנִים אַחַר תֵּאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: נְקֹם נִקְמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַמִּדְיָנִים אַחַר תֵּאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
“Get revenge for the children of Israel from the
Midianites. After that you’ll be gathered to your people.”

translation.text: "Avenge the Israelites on the Midianites; afterward you shall be gathered to your people."

verses.english:
And Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Let people from
you be equipped for the army, so they’ll be against Midian
to put YHWH’s revenge in Midian.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הֵחָלְצוּ מֵאִתְּכֶם אֲנָשִׁים לַצָּבָא וְיִהְיוּ עַל מִדְיָן לָתֵת נִקְמַת יְהֹוָה בְּמִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הֵחָלְצוּ מֵאִתְּכֶם אֲנָשִׁים לַצָּבָא וְיִהְיוּ עַל מִדְיָן לָתֵת נִקְמַת יְהֹוָה בְּמִדְיָן׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Let people from
you be equipped for the army, so they’ll be against Midian
to put YHWH’s revenge in Midian.

translation.text: So Midian.

verses.english:
You shall send a thousand per tribe, a thousand per tribe,
for all Israel’s tribes, to the army.”
verses.hebrew: אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּשְׁלְחוּ לַצָּבָא׃

hebrew.text: אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּשְׁלְחוּ לַצָּבָא׃

english.text:
You shall send a thousand per tribe, a thousand per tribe,
for all Israel’s tribes, to the army.”

translation.text: You shall send a thousand from each of the tribes of Israel to the war."

verses.english:
And, from Israel’s thousands, a thousand per tribe were
delivered, twelve thousand equipped for the army.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּסְרוּ מֵאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי צָבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמָּסְרוּ מֵאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי צָבָא׃

english.text:
And, from Israel’s thousands, a thousand per tribe were
delivered, twelve thousand equipped for the army.

translation.text: So out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe were conscripted, twelve thousand armed for battle.

verses.english:
And Moses sent them, a thousand per tribe, to the army;
them and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the army,
with the equipment of the Holy and the trumpets for
blasting in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לַצָּבָא אֹתָם וְאֶת פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן לַצָּבָא וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְרוֹת הַתְּרוּעָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לַצָּבָא אֹתָם וְאֶת פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן לַצָּבָא וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְרוֹת הַתְּרוּעָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses sent them, a thousand per tribe, to the army;
them and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the army,
with the equipment of the Holy and the trumpets for
blasting in his hand.

translation.text: Moses sent trumpets for sounding the alarm in his hand.

verses.english:
And they made war on Midian as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they killed every male.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבְּאוּ עַל מִדְיָן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיַּהַרְגוּ כּל זָכָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְבְּאוּ עַל מִדְיָן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיַּהַרְגוּ כּל זָכָר׃

english.text:
And they made war on Midian as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they killed every male.

translation.text: They did battle against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and killed every male.

verses.english:
And they killed the kings of Midian—Evi and Rekem and Zur
and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian—over their
corpses. And they killed Balaam son of Beor by the sword.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן הָרְגוּ עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם אֶת אֱוִי וְאֶת רֶקֶם וְאֶת צוּר וְאֶת חוּר וְאֶת רֶבַע חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וְאֵת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר הָרְגוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן הָרְגוּ עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם אֶת אֱוִי וְאֶת רֶקֶם וְאֶת צוּר וְאֶת חוּר וְאֶת רֶבַע חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וְאֵת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר הָרְגוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
And they killed the kings of Midian—Evi and Rekem and Zur
and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian—over their
corpses. And they killed Balaam son of Beor by the sword.

translation.text: five kings of Midian, in addition to others who were slain by them; and they also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel took the women of Midian and
their infants prisoner, and they despoiled all their
animals and all their livestock and all their wealth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת נְשֵׁי מִדְיָן וְאֶת טַפָּם וְאֵת כּל בְּהֶמְתָּם וְאֶת כּל מִקְנֵהֶם וְאֶת כּל חֵילָם בָּזָזוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת נְשֵׁי מִדְיָן וְאֶת טַפָּם וְאֵת כּל בְּהֶמְתָּם וְאֶת כּל מִקְנֵהֶם וְאֶת כּל חֵילָם בָּזָזוּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel took the women of Midian and
their infants prisoner, and they despoiled all their
animals and all their livestock and all their wealth.

translation.text: The Israelites all their cattle, their flocks, and all their goods as booty.

verses.english:
And they burned all their cities with their homes and all
their encampments in fire.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל עָרֵיהֶם בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְאֵת כּל טִירֹתָם שָׂרְפוּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל עָרֵיהֶם בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְאֵת כּל טִירֹתָם שָׂרְפוּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And they burned all their cities with their homes and all
their encampments in fire.

translation.text: All their burned,

verses.english:
And they took all the spoil and all the prey, human and
animal.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל הַשָּׁלָל וְאֵת כּל הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל הַשָּׁלָל וְאֵת כּל הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And they took all the spoil and all the prey, human and
animal.

translation.text: but they took all the spoil and all the booty, both people and animals.

verses.english:
And they brought the prisoners and the prey and the spoil
to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp, to
the plains of Moab, which is by the Jordan toward Jericho.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשְּׁבִי וְאֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָל אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל עַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשְּׁבִי וְאֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָל אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל עַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
And they brought the prisoners and the prey and the spoil
to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp, to
the plains of Moab, which is by the Jordan toward Jericho.

translation.text: Then they brought the captives and the booty and the Israelites, at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, and all the
congregation’s chieftains went out to them, outside the
camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְכל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לִקְרָאתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְכל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לִקְרָאתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, and all the
congregation’s chieftains went out to them, outside the
camp.

translation.text: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.

verses.english:
And Moses was angry at the officers of the army, the
chiefs of thousands and the chiefs of hundreds who were
coming from the army of the war.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף מֹשֶׁה עַל פְּקוּדֵי הֶחָיִל שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת הַבָּאִים מִצְּבָא הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְצֹף מֹשֶׁה עַל פְּקוּדֵי הֶחָיִל שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת הַבָּאִים מִצְּבָא הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
And Moses was angry at the officers of the army, the
chiefs of thousands and the chiefs of hundreds who were
coming from the army of the war.

translation.text: Moses became angry with the commanders of hundreds, who had come from service in the war.

verses.english: And Moses said to them, “Did you keep every female alive?!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה הַחִיִּיתֶם כּל נְקֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה הַחִיִּיתֶם כּל נְקֵבָה׃

english.text: And Moses said to them, “Did you keep every female alive?!

translation.text: Moses said to them, "Have you allowed all the women to live?

verses.english:
Here, they came to bring about a breach against YHWH by
the children of Israel, at Balaam’s word, over the matter
of Peor, so there was the plague in YHWH’s congregation!
verses.hebrew: הֵן הֵנָּה הָיוּ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְבַר בִּלְעָם לִמְסר מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וַתְּהִי הַמַּגֵּפָה בַּעֲדַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הֵן הֵנָּה הָיוּ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְבַר בִּלְעָם לִמְסר מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וַתְּהִי הַמַּגֵּפָה בַּעֲדַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Here, they came to bring about a breach against YHWH by
the children of Israel, at Balaam’s word, over the matter
of Peor, so there was the plague in YHWH’s congregation!

translation.text: These the congregation of the LORD.

verses.english:
So now, kill every male among the infants, and kill every
woman who has known a man for male intercourse.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִרְגוּ כל זָכָר בַּטָּף וְכל אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הֲרֹגוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִרְגוּ כל זָכָר בַּטָּף וְכל אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הֲרֹגוּ׃

english.text:
So now, kill every male among the infants, and kill every
woman who has known a man for male intercourse.

translation.text: Now therefore, kill every male among with him.

verses.english:
But all infants among the women who have not known a
male’s inter-course: keep alive.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל הַטַּף בַּנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הַחֲיוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל הַטַּף בַּנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הַחֲיוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
But all infants among the women who have not known a
male’s inter-course: keep alive.

translation.text: But all the young girls who have not known a man by sleeping with him, keep alive for yourselves.

verses.english:
And you, camp outside the camp for seven days: everyone
who killed a life and everyone who touched a corpse, do
sin expiation on the third day and on the seventh day, you
and your prisoners.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם חֲנוּ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כֹּל הֹרֵג נֶפֶשׁ וְכֹל נֹגֵעַ בֶּחָלָל תִּתְחַטְּאוּ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אַתֶּם וּשְׁבִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם חֲנוּ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כֹּל הֹרֵג נֶפֶשׁ וְכֹל נֹגֵעַ בֶּחָלָל תִּתְחַטְּאוּ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אַתֶּם וּשְׁבִיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you, camp outside the camp for seven days: everyone
who killed a life and everyone who touched a corpse, do
sin expiation on the third day and on the seventh day, you
and your prisoners.

translation.text: Camp outside the camp day.

verses.english:
And for every piece of clothing and every leather item and
everything made from goats and every wood item you shall
do expiation.”
verses.hebrew: וְכל בֶּגֶד וְכל כְּלִי עוֹר וְכל מַעֲשֵׂה עִזִּים וְכל כְּלִי עֵץ תִּתְחַטָּאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל בֶּגֶד וְכל כְּלִי עוֹר וְכל מַעֲשֵׂה עִזִּים וְכל כְּלִי עֵץ תִּתְחַטָּאוּ׃

english.text:
And for every piece of clothing and every leather item and
everything made from goats and every wood item you shall
do expiation.”

translation.text: You shall purify every garment, every article of skin, everything made of goats' hair, and every article of wood."

verses.english:
And Eleazar, the priest, said to the men of the army who
had come to the war, “This is the law of the instruction
that YHWH commanded Moses:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא הַבָּאִים לַמִּלְחָמָה זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא הַבָּאִים לַמִּלְחָמָה זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Eleazar, the priest, said to the men of the army who
had come to the war, “This is the law of the instruction
that YHWH commanded Moses:

translation.text: Eleazar the priest said to the troops who had gone to battle: "This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded Moses:

verses.english:
Just the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the
tin, and the lead,
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַכָּסֶף אֶת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֶת הַבַּרְזֶל אֶת הַבְּדִיל וְאֶת הָעֹפָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַכָּסֶף אֶת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֶת הַבַּרְזֶל אֶת הַבְּדִיל וְאֶת הָעֹפָרֶת׃

english.text:
Just the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the
tin, and the lead,

translation.text: gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead —

verses.english:
every thing that will go in fire, you shall pass through
fire and purify. It shall be expiated from sin just in
water of impurity. And everything that will not go in
fire, you shall pass through water.
verses.hebrew: כּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא בָאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בָאֵשׁ וְטָהֵר אַךְ בְּמֵי נִדָּה יִתְחַטָּא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָבֹא בָּאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: כּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא בָאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בָאֵשׁ וְטָהֵר אַךְ בְּמֵי נִדָּה יִתְחַטָּא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָבֹא בָּאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
every thing that will go in fire, you shall pass through
fire and purify. It shall be expiated from sin just in
water of impurity. And everything that will not go in
fire, you shall pass through water.

translation.text: everything that can withstand fire, shall be passed through fire, and it shall be clean. Nevertheless it cannot withstand fire, shall be passed through the water.

verses.english:
And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and
you will be pure, and after that you shall come to the
camp.”
verses.hebrew: וְכִבַּסְתֶּם בִּגְדֵיכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּטְהַרְתֶּם וְאַחַר תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִבַּסְתֶּם בִּגְדֵיכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּטְהַרְתֶּם וְאַחַר תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and
you will be pure, and after that you shall come to the
camp.”

translation.text: You must wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean; afterward you may come into the camp."

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.english:
“Add up the heads of the prey, the prisoners, human and
animal, you and Eleazar, the priest, and the heads of the
fathers of the congregation.
verses.hebrew: שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ מַלְקוֹחַ הַשְּׁבִי בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה אַתָּה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ מַלְקוֹחַ הַשְּׁבִי בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה אַתָּה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
“Add up the heads of the prey, the prisoners, human and
animal, you and Eleazar, the priest, and the heads of the
fathers of the congregation.

translation.text: "You and Eleazar the priest and inventory of the booty captured, both human and animal.

verses.english:
And you shall split the prey between the warriors who went
out to the army and all the congregation.
verses.hebrew: וְחָצִיתָ אֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בֵּין תֹּפְשֵׂי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא וּבֵין כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְחָצִיתָ אֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בֵּין תֹּפְשֵׂי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא וּבֵין כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And you shall split the prey between the warriors who went
out to the army and all the congregation.

translation.text: Divide and all the congregation.

verses.english:
And you shall levy a tax for YHWH from the men of war who
went out to the army, one individual out of five hundred,
from humans and from cattle and from asses and from sheep.

And you shall levy a tax for YHWH from the men of war who
went out to the army, one individual out of five hundred,
from humans and from cattle and from asses and from sheep.

translation.text: From the share of the warriors who went out to battle, set aside as tribute for the LORD, one item out of every five hundred, whether persons, oxen, donkeys, sheep, or goats.

verses.english:
You shall take from their half and you shall give to
Eleazar, the priest, YHWH’s donation.
verses.hebrew: מִמַּחֲצִיתָם תִּקָּחוּ וְנָתַתָּה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall take from their half and you shall give to
Eleazar, the priest, YHWH’s donation.

translation.text: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.

verses.english:
From the half of the children of Israel you shall take one
share out of fifty, from humans, from cattle, from asses,
and from sheep, from all the animals, and you shall give
them to the Levites, who keep the watch of YHWH’s
Tabernacle.”

From the half of the children of Israel you shall take one
share out of fifty, from humans, from cattle, from asses,
and from sheep, from all the animals, and you shall give
them to the Levites, who keep the watch of YHWH’s
Tabernacle.”

translation.text: But from the Israelites' half you shall take one out of every tabernacle of the LORD."

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, did as YHWH commanded

So the half, the portion of those who went out in the army

man of them is lacking.
