verses.english:
And we have made an offering for YHWH—whatever each man
found: an item of gold, an armlet or bracelet, a ring, an
earring, or an ornament—to make atonement for ourselves in
front of YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וַנַּקְרֵב אֶת קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כְלִי זָהָב אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד טַבַּעַת עָגִיל וְכוּמָז לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּקְרֵב אֶת קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כְלִי זָהָב אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד טַבַּעַת עָגִיל וְכוּמָז לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And we have made an offering for YHWH—whatever each man
found: an item of gold, an armlet or bracelet, a ring, an
earring, or an ornament—to make atonement for ourselves in
front of YHWH.”

translation.text: And we have brought the LORD's offering, what each of us found, pendants, to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD."

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from
them, every item of handiwork.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאִתָּם כֹּל כְּלִי מַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאִתָּם כֹּל כְּלִי מַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from
them, every item of handiwork.

translation.text: Moses crafted articles.

verses.english:
And all the gold of the donation that they donated to YHWH
was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the
chiefs of the thousands and from the chiefs of the
hundreds.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל זְהַב הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁקֶל מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וּמֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל זְהַב הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁקֶל מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וּמֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

english.text:
And all the gold of the donation that they donated to YHWH
was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the
chiefs of the thousands and from the chiefs of the
hundreds.

translation.text: And all the gold of the offering that they offered to hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

verses.english: The men of the army each had kept as spoil what was his.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא בָּזְזוּ אִישׁ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא בָּזְזוּ אִישׁ לוֹ׃

english.text: The men of the army each had kept as spoil what was his.

translation.text: (The troops had all taken plunder for themselves.)

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from the
chiefs of the thousands and the hundreds and brought it to
the Tent of Meeting, a commemoration for the children of
Israel in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from the
chiefs of the thousands and the hundreds and brought it to
the Tent of Meeting, a commemoration for the children of
Israel in front of YHWH.

translation.text: So Moses and Eleazar the Israelites before the LORD.

verses.english:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had
a great amount of livestock, very substantial. And they
saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and here:
the place was a place for livestock.
verses.hebrew: וּמִקְנֶה רַב הָיָה לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלִבְנֵי גָד עָצוּם מְאֹד וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת אֶרֶץ יַעְזֵר וְאֶת אֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד וְהִנֵּה הַמָּקוֹם מְקוֹם מִקְנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִקְנֶה רַב הָיָה לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלִבְנֵי גָד עָצוּם מְאֹד וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת אֶרֶץ יַעְזֵר וְאֶת אֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד וְהִנֵּה הַמָּקוֹם מְקוֹם מִקְנֶה׃

english.text:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had
a great amount of livestock, very substantial. And they
saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and here:
the place was a place for livestock.

translation.text: Now the Reubenites and the Gadites owned a very great number of was a good place for cattle,

verses.english:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came
and said to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
chieftains of the congregation, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came
and said to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
chieftains of the congregation, saying,

translation.text: the Gadites and the Reubenites came and congregation, saying,

verses.english:
“Ataroth and Dibon and Jazer and Nimrah and Heshbon and
Elealeh and Sebam and Nebo and Beon,
verses.hebrew: עֲטָרוֹת וְדִיבֹן וְיַעְזֵר וְנִמְרָה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵה וּשְׂבָם וּנְבוֹ וּבְעֹן׃

hebrew.text: עֲטָרוֹת וְדִיבֹן וְיַעְזֵר וְנִמְרָה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵה וּשְׂבָם וּנְבוֹ וּבְעֹן׃

english.text:
“Ataroth and Dibon and Jazer and Nimrah and Heshbon and
Elealeh and Sebam and Nebo and Beon,

translation.text: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon —

verses.english:
the land that YHWH struck in front of the congregation of
Israel: it’s livestock land, and your servants have
livestock.”
verses.hebrew: הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶרֶץ מִקְנֶה הִוא וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ מִקְנֶה׃

hebrew.text: הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶרֶץ מִקְנֶה הִוא וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ מִקְנֶה׃

english.text:
the land that YHWH struck in front of the congregation of
Israel: it’s livestock land, and your servants have
livestock.”

translation.text: the land that the LORD subdued servants have cattle."

verses.english:
And they said, “If we’ve found favor in your eyes, let
this land be given to your servants for a possession.
Don’t have us cross the Jordan.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִם מָצָאנוּ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יֻתַּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לַאֲחֻזָּה אַל תַּעֲבִרֵנוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִם מָצָאנוּ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יֻתַּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לַאֲחֻזָּה אַל תַּעֲבִרֵנוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
And they said, “If we’ve found favor in your eyes, let
this land be given to your servants for a possession.
Don’t have us cross the Jordan.”

translation.text: They continued, "If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; do not make us cross the Jordan."

verses.english:
And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children
of Reuben, “Will your brothers go to war while you sit
here?!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַאַחֵיכֶם יָבֹאוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתֶּם תֵּשְׁבוּ פֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַאַחֵיכֶם יָבֹאוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתֶּם תֵּשְׁבוּ פֹה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children
of Reuben, “Will your brothers go to war while you sit
here?!

translation.text: But Moses said to the Gadites and to the Reubenites, "Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

verses.english:
And why do you hold back the heart of the children of
Israel from crossing to the land that YHWH has given them?
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה (תנואון) [תְנִיאוּן] אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֲבֹר אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָמָּה (תנואון) [תְנִיאוּן] אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֲבֹר אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And why do you hold back the heart of the children of
Israel from crossing to the land that YHWH has given them?

translation.text: Why will you discourage the hearts of the Israelites from going over into the land that the LORD has given them?

verses.english:
That’s what your fathers did when I sent them from
Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם בְּשׁלְחִי אֹתָם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לִרְאוֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם בְּשׁלְחִי אֹתָם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לִרְאוֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
That’s what your fathers did when I sent them from
Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

translation.text: Your fathers did this, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.

verses.english:
And they went up to the Wadi Eshcol and saw the land, but
they held back the heart of the children of Israel so as
not to go to the land that YHWH had given them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּנִיאוּ אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּנִיאוּ אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they went up to the Wadi Eshcol and saw the land, but
they held back the heart of the children of Israel so as
not to go to the land that YHWH had given them.

translation.text: When they went up to the Wadi Eshcol and into the land that the LORD had given them.

verses.english: And YHWH’s anger flared on that day, and he swore saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH’s anger flared on that day, and he swore saying,

translation.text: The LORD's anger was kindled on that day and he swore, saying,

verses.english:
‘The people who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old
and up, won’t see the land that I swore to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, because they didn’t go after me
completely,
verses.hebrew: אִם יִרְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹלִים מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב כִּי לֹא מִלְאוּ אַחֲרָי׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִרְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹלִים מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב כִּי לֹא מִלְאוּ אַחֲרָי׃

english.text:
‘The people who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old
and up, won’t see the land that I swore to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, because they didn’t go after me
completely,

translation.text: 'Surely none of the people because they have not unreservedly followed me —

verses.english:
except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the Kenizzite, and Joshua
son of Nun because they went after YHWH completely.’
verses.hebrew: בִּלְתִּי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן כִּי מִלְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּלְתִּי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן כִּי מִלְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the Kenizzite, and Joshua
son of Nun because they went after YHWH completely.’

translation.text: none except have unreservedly followed the LORD.'

verses.english:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Israel, and he made them roam
in the wilderness forty years, until the end of all the
generation who were doing bad in YHWH’s eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְנִעֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר הָעֹשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְנִעֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר הָעֹשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Israel, and he made them roam
in the wilderness forty years, until the end of all the
generation who were doing bad in YHWH’s eyes.

translation.text: And the LORD's anger was forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the sight of the LORD had disappeared.

verses.english:
And, here, you’ve gotten up in your fathers’ place, a
group of sinning people, to add more onto YHWH’s flaring
anger at Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה קַמְתֶּם תַּחַת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים לִסְפּוֹת עוֹד עַל חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה קַמְתֶּם תַּחַת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים לִסְפּוֹת עוֹד עַל חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And, here, you’ve gotten up in your fathers’ place, a
group of sinning people, to add more onto YHWH’s flaring
anger at Israel.

translation.text: And now you, a brood of sinners, have against Israel!

verses.english:
If you go back from behind Him, then He’ll add more to
leave them in the wilderness, and you’ll have destroyed
all of this people!”
verses.hebrew: כִּי תְשׁוּבֻן מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָסַף עוֹד לְהַנִּיחוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְשִׁחַתֶּם לְכל הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תְשׁוּבֻן מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָסַף עוֹד לְהַנִּיחוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְשִׁחַתֶּם לְכל הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
If you go back from behind Him, then He’ll add more to
leave them in the wilderness, and you’ll have destroyed
all of this people!”

translation.text: If you turn away from following him, he will again abandon them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all this people."

verses.english:
And they came over to him and said, “We’ll build walls for
our livestock here, and cities for our infants.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְרֹת צֹאן נִבְנֶה לְמִקְנֵנוּ פֹּה וְעָרִים לְטַפֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְרֹת צֹאן נִבְנֶה לְמִקְנֵנוּ פֹּה וְעָרִים לְטַפֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
And they came over to him and said, “We’ll build walls for
our livestock here, and cities for our infants.

translation.text: Then they came up to him and said, "We will build sheepfolds here for our flocks, and towns for our little ones,

verses.english:
And we shall be equipped, ready in front of the children
of Israel until we’ve brought them to their place, and our
infants will live in fortified cities because of the
residents of the land.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נֵחָלֵץ חֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם הֲבִיאֹנֻם אֶל מְקוֹמָם וְיָשַׁב טַפֵּנוּ בְּעָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר מִפְּנֵי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נֵחָלֵץ חֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם הֲבִיאֹנֻם אֶל מְקוֹמָם וְיָשַׁב טַפֵּנוּ בְּעָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר מִפְּנֵי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And we shall be equipped, ready in front of the children
of Israel until we’ve brought them to their place, and our
infants will live in fortified cities because of the
residents of the land.

translation.text: but we will take up arms their place. Meanwhile our little ones will stay in the fortified towns because of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.english:
We won’t go back to our houses until the children of
Israel take possession, each of his legacy.
verses.hebrew: לֹא נָשׁוּב אֶל בָּתֵּינוּ עַד הִתְנַחֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא נָשׁוּב אֶל בָּתֵּינוּ עַד הִתְנַחֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
We won’t go back to our houses until the children of
Israel take possession, each of his legacy.

translation.text: We will not return to our homes until all the Israelites have obtained their inheritance.

verses.english:
Because we won’t have a possession with them from the
farther side of the Jordan, because our possession has
come to us from the eastward side of the Jordan.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נִנְחַל אִתָּם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וָהָלְאָה כִּי בָאָה נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֵלֵינוּ מֵעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא נִנְחַל אִתָּם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וָהָלְאָה כִּי בָאָה נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֵלֵינוּ מֵעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
Because we won’t have a possession with them from the
farther side of the Jordan, because our possession has
come to us from the eastward side of the Jordan.”

translation.text: We will the east."

verses.english:
And Moses said to them, “If you’ll do this thing: if
you’ll get equipped for war in front of YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה אִם תַּעֲשׂוּן אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אִם תֵּחָלְצוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה אִם תַּעֲשׂוּן אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אִם תֵּחָלְצוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to them, “If you’ll do this thing: if
you’ll get equipped for war in front of YHWH,

translation.text: So Moses said to them, "If you do this — if you take up arms to go before the LORD for the war,

verses.english:
and every one of you will cross the Jordan equipped in
front of YHWH until He dispossesses his enemies in front
of him,
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר לָכֶם כּל חָלוּץ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד הוֹרִישׁוֹ אֶת אֹיְבָיו מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר לָכֶם כּל חָלוּץ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד הוֹרִישׁוֹ אֶת אֹיְבָיו מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
and every one of you will cross the Jordan equipped in
front of YHWH until He dispossesses his enemies in front
of him,

translation.text: and all those of you who bear arms from before him

verses.english:
and the land will be subdued in front of YHWH, then, after
that, you’ll go back, and, from YHWH and from Israel,
you’ll be free, and this land will become yours for a
possession in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר תָּשֻׁבוּ וִהְיִיתֶם נְקִיִּם מֵיְהֹוָה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר תָּשֻׁבוּ וִהְיִיתֶם נְקִיִּם מֵיְהֹוָה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and the land will be subdued in front of YHWH, then, after
that, you’ll go back, and, from YHWH and from Israel,
you’ll be free, and this land will become yours for a
possession in front of YHWH.

translation.text: and the land is subdued before the LORD — then Israel, and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

verses.english:
But if you won’t do this, here, you’ve sinned to YHWH, and
know that your sin will find you.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן הִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה וּדְעוּ חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן הִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה וּדְעוּ חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
But if you won’t do this, here, you’ve sinned to YHWH, and
know that your sin will find you.

translation.text: But if sin will find you out.

verses.english:
Build cities for your infants and fences for your flocks,
and do what has come out of your mouths.”
verses.hebrew: בְּנוּ לָכֶם עָרִים לְטַפְּכֶם וּגְדֵרֹת לְצֹנַאֲכֶם וְהַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּנוּ לָכֶם עָרִים לְטַפְּכֶם וּגְדֵרֹת לְצֹנַאֲכֶם וְהַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
Build cities for your infants and fences for your flocks,
and do what has come out of your mouths.”

translation.text: Build towns for your little ones, and folds for your flocks; but do what you have promised."

verses.english:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to
Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי מְצַוֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי מְצַוֶּה׃

english.text:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to
Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

translation.text: Then the Gadites and the Reubenites said to Moses, "Your servants will do as my lord commands.

verses.english:
Our infants, our women, our livestock, and all our animals
will be there in the cities of Gilead.
verses.hebrew: טַפֵּנוּ נָשֵׁינוּ מִקְנֵנוּ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ שָׁם בְּעָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: טַפֵּנוּ נָשֵׁינוּ מִקְנֵנוּ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ שָׁם בְּעָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
Our infants, our women, our livestock, and all our animals
will be there in the cities of Gilead.

translation.text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall remain there in the towns of Gilead;

verses.english:
And your servants will cross, everyone equipped for the
army, in front of YHWH for war as my lord speaks.”
verses.hebrew: וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יַעַבְרוּ כּל חֲלוּץ צָבָא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי דֹּבֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יַעַבְרוּ כּל חֲלוּץ צָבָא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי דֹּבֵר׃

english.text:
And your servants will cross, everyone equipped for the
army, in front of YHWH for war as my lord speaks.”

translation.text: but your servants will cross over, everyone armed for war, to do battle for the LORD, just as my lord orders."

verses.english:
And Moses commanded Eleazar, the priest, and Joshua son of
Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the
children of Israel for them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה אֵת אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְאֶת רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה אֵת אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְאֶת רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded Eleazar, the priest, and Joshua son of
Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the
children of Israel for them.

translation.text: So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest, to Israelite tribes.

verses.english:
And Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the
children of Reuben will cross the Jordan with you,
everyone equipped for war, in front of YHWH, and the land
will be subdued in front of you, then you shall give them
the land of Gilead for a possession.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִם יַעַבְרוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אִתְּכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן כּל חָלוּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְתַתֶּם לָהֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִם יַעַבְרוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אִתְּכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן כּל חָלוּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְתַתֶּם לָהֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the
children of Reuben will cross the Jordan with you,
everyone equipped for war, in front of YHWH, and the land
will be subdued in front of you, then you shall give them
the land of Gilead for a possession.

translation.text: And Moses said to them, "If the Gadites and the you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

But if they will not cross equipped with you, then they
will have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ חֲלוּצִים אִתְּכֶם וְנֹאחֲזוּ בְתֹכְכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
But if they will not cross equipped with you, then they
will have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben
answered, saying, “What YHWH has spoken to your servants:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן לֵאמֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן לֵאמֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben
answered, saying, “What YHWH has spoken to your servants:
we shall do so.

translation.text: The Gadites and the Reubenites answered, "As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.

verses.english:
We’ll cross equipped in front of YHWH to the land of
Canaan while we’ll have our legacy possession across the
Jordan.”
verses.hebrew: נַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹר חֲלוּצִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאִתָּנוּ אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָתֵנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: נַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹר חֲלוּצִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאִתָּנוּ אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָתֵנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
We’ll cross equipped in front of YHWH to the land of
Canaan while we’ll have our legacy possession across the
Jordan.”

translation.text: the Jordan."

verses.english:
And Moses gave them, the children of Gad and the children
of Reuben and half of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph,
the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the
kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, the land with its cities,
with the borders of the land’s cities all around.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף אֶת מַמְלֶכֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן הָאָרֶץ לְעָרֶיהָ בִּגְבֻלֹת עָרֵי הָאָרֶץ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף אֶת מַמְלֶכֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן הָאָרֶץ לְעָרֶיהָ בִּגְבֻלֹת עָרֵי הָאָרֶץ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And Moses gave them, the children of Gad and the children
of Reuben and half of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph,
the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the
kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, the land with its cities,
with the borders of the land’s cities all around.

translation.text: Moses gave to them — to the Gadites and to the Reubenites and to its towns, with the territories of the surrounding towns.

verses.english: And the children of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי גָד אֶת דִּיבֹן וְאֶת עֲטָרֹת וְאֵת עֲרֹעֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי גָד אֶת דִּיבֹן וְאֶת עֲטָרֹת וְאֵת עֲרֹעֵר׃

english.text: And the children of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer

translation.text: And the Gadites rebuilt Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

verses.english: and Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת עַטְרֹת שׁוֹפָן וְאֶת יַעְזֵר וְיגְבְּהָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת עַטְרֹת שׁוֹפָן וְאֶת יַעְזֵר וְיגְבְּהָה׃

english.text: and Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah

translation.text: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

verses.english:
and Beth-Nimrah and Beth-Haran, fortified cities and
fences for flocks.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בֵּית נִמְרָה וְאֶת בֵּית הָרָן עָרֵי מִבְצָר וְגִדְרֹת צֹאן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בֵּית נִמְרָה וְאֶת בֵּית הָרָן עָרֵי מִבְצָר וְגִדְרֹת צֹאן׃

english.text:
and Beth-Nimrah and Beth-Haran, fortified cities and
fences for flocks.

translation.text: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.

verses.english:
And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and
Kiriathaim
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בָּנוּ אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָלֵא וְאֵת קִרְיָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בָּנוּ אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָלֵא וְאֵת קִרְיָתָיִם׃

english.text:
And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and
Kiriathaim

translation.text: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

verses.english:
and Nebo and Baal-meon—with changes of name—and Sibmah,
and they called the names of the cities that they built by
new names.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת נְבוֹ וְאֶת בַּעַל מְעוֹן מוּסַבֹּת שֵׁם וְאֶת שִׂבְמָה וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁמֹת אֶת שְׁמוֹת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת נְבוֹ וְאֶת בַּעַל מְעוֹן מוּסַבֹּת שֵׁם וְאֶת שִׂבְמָה וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁמֹת אֶת שְׁמוֹת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ׃

english.text:
and Nebo and Baal-meon—with changes of name—and Sibmah,
and they called the names of the cities that they built by
new names.

translation.text: Nebo, and Baal-meon (some names being changed), and Sibmah; and they gave names to the towns that they rebuilt.

verses.english:
And the children of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead
and captured it and dispossessed the Amorite who was in
it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ וַיּוֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ וַיּוֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead
and captured it and dispossessed the Amorite who was in
it.

translation.text: The and dispossessed the Amorites who were there;

verses.english:
And Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and they
lived in it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַגִּלְעָד לְמָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַגִּלְעָד לְמָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and they
lived in it.

translation.text: so Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he settled there.

verses.english:
And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages,
and he called them Havvoth-Jair.
verses.hebrew: וְיָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת חַוֺּתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא אֶתְהֶן חַוֺּת יָאִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְיָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת חַוֺּתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא אֶתְהֶן חַוֺּת יָאִיר׃

english.text:
And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages,
and he called them Havvoth-Jair.

translation.text: Jair son of Havvoth-jair.

verses.english:
And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its towns, and he
called it Nobah after his own name.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹבַח הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת קְנָת וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא לָה נֹבַח בִּשְׁמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֹבַח הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת קְנָת וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא לָה נֹבַח בִּשְׁמוֹ׃

english.text:
And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its towns, and he
called it Nobah after his own name.

translation.text: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages, and renamed it Nobah after himself.

verses.english:
These are the travels of the children of Israel who went
out from the land of Egypt by their armies by the hand of
Moses and Aaron.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
These are the travels of the children of Israel who went
out from the land of Egypt by their armies by the hand of
Moses and Aaron.

translation.text: These are the stages by which the Israelites went out of the land of Egypt in military formation under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
And Moses wrote their stops for their travels by YHWH’s
word, and these are their travels and their stops.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses wrote their stops for their travels by YHWH’s
word, and these are their travels and their stops.

translation.text: places.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Rameses in the first month on the
fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the
Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand
before the eyes of all Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרַעְמְסֵס בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן מִמּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח יָצְאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָד רָמָה לְעֵינֵי כּל מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרַעְמְסֵס בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן מִמּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח יָצְאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָד רָמָה לְעֵינֵי כּל מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Rameses in the first month on the
fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the
Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand
before the eyes of all Egypt.

translation.text: They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the passover the Israelites went out boldly in the sight of all the Egyptians,

verses.english:
And the Egyptians were burying those whom YHWH had struck
among them: every firstborn. And YHWH had made judgments
on their gods.
verses.hebrew: וּמִצְרַיִם מְקַבְּרִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם כּל בְּכוֹר וּבֵאלֹהֵיהֶם עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה שְׁפָטִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִצְרַיִם מְקַבְּרִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם כּל בְּכוֹר וּבֵאלֹהֵיהֶם עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה שְׁפָטִים׃

english.text:
And the Egyptians were burying those whom YHWH had struck
among them: every firstborn. And YHWH had made judgments
on their gods.

translation.text: while the Egyptians were them. The LORD executed judgments even against their gods.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel traveled from Rameses and
camped in Succoth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּסֻכֹּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּסֻכֹּת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel traveled from Rameses and
camped in Succoth.

translation.text: So the Israelites set out from Rameses, and camped at Succoth.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Succoth and camped in Etham, which
is at the edge of the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Succoth and camped in Etham, which
is at the edge of the wilderness.

translation.text: They the wilderness.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Etham and turned back toward
Pi-hahiroth, which is in front of Baal-Zephon: and they
camped in front of Migdol.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵתָם וַיָּשׁב עַל פִּי הַחִירֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי בַּעַל צְפוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי מִגְדֹּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵתָם וַיָּשׁב עַל פִּי הַחִירֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי בַּעַל צְפוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי מִגְדֹּל׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Etham and turned back toward
Pi-hahiroth, which is in front of Baal-Zephon: and they
camped in front of Migdol.

translation.text: They set out from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which faces Baal-zephon; and they camped before Migdol.

verses.english:
And they traveled from before Pi-hahiroth and passed
through the sea to the wilderness. And they went three
days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped in
Marah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפְּנֵי הַחִירֹת וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ הַיָּם הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בְּמִדְבַּר אֵתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפְּנֵי הַחִירֹת וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ הַיָּם הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בְּמִדְבַּר אֵתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמָרָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from before Pi-hahiroth and passed
through the sea to the wilderness. And they went three
days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped in
Marah.

translation.text: camped at Marah.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Marah and came to Elim. And in Elim
were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. And
they camped there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמָּרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וּבְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמָּרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וּבְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Marah and came to Elim. And in Elim
were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. And
they camped there.

translation.text: They set out from Marah and came to Elim; at Elim camped there.

verses.english: And they traveled from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל יַם סוּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל יַם סוּף׃

english.text: And they traveled from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

translation.text: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the Red Sea and camped in the
wilderness of Sin.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיַּם סוּף וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיַּם סוּף וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִין׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the Red Sea and camped in the
wilderness of Sin.

translation.text: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the wilderness of Sin and camped in
Dophkah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִין וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדפְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִין וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדפְקָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the wilderness of Sin and camped in
Dophkah.

translation.text: They set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Dophkah and camped in Alush.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדּפְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאָלוּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדּפְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאָלוּשׁ׃

english.text: And they traveled from Dophkah and camped in Alush.

translation.text: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Alush and camped at Rephidim. And
there was no water there for the people to drink.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאָלוּשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִם וְלֹא הָיָה שָׁם מַיִם לָעָם לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאָלוּשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִם וְלֹא הָיָה שָׁם מַיִם לָעָם לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Alush and camped at Rephidim. And
there was no water there for the people to drink.

translation.text: They set out from people to drink.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Rephidim and camped in the
wilderness of Sinai.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרְפִידִם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרְפִידִם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Rephidim and camped in the
wilderness of Sinai.

translation.text: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the wilderness of Sinai and camped
at Kibroth Hattaavah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the wilderness of Sinai and camped
at Kibroth Hattaavah.

translation.text: They set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at
Hazeroth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקִּבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲצֵרֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקִּבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲצֵרֹת׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at
Hazeroth.

translation.text: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

verses.english: And they traveled from Hazeroth and camped in Rithmah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲצֵרֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִתְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲצֵרֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִתְמָה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Hazeroth and camped in Rithmah.

translation.text: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-parez.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִתְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִמֹּן פָּרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִתְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִמֹּן פָּרֶץ׃

english.text: And they traveled from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-parez.

translation.text: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmonperez.

verses.english: And they traveled from Rimmon-parez and camped in Libnah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִמֹּן פָּרֶץ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּלִבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִמֹּן פָּרֶץ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּלִבְנָה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Rimmon-parez and camped in Libnah.

translation.text: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִלִּבְנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִסָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִלִּבְנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִסָּה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

translation.text: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Rissah and camped in Kehelathah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִסָּה וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּקְהֵלָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִסָּה וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּקְהֵלָתָה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Rissah and camped in Kehelathah.

translation.text: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Kehelathah and camped at Mount
Shapher.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקְּהֵלָתָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהַר שָׁפֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקְּהֵלָתָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהַר שָׁפֶר׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Kehelathah and camped at Mount
Shapher.

translation.text: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Mount Shapher and camped in
Haradah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַר שָׁפֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲרָדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַר שָׁפֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲרָדָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Mount Shapher and camped in
Haradah.

translation.text: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Haradah and camped in Makheloth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲרָדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲרָדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹת׃

english.text: And they traveled from Haradah and camped in Makheloth.

translation.text: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

verses.english: And they traveled from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּתָחַת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּתָחַת׃

english.text: And they traveled from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

translation.text: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

verses.english: And they traveled from Tahath and camped at Tarah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִתָּחַת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּתָרַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִתָּחַת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּתָרַח׃

english.text: And they traveled from Tahath and camped at Tarah.

translation.text: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Tarah and camped in Mithkah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִתָּרַח וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִתְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִתָּרַח וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִתְקָה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Tarah and camped in Mithkah.

translation.text: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.

verses.english: And they went from Mithkah and camped in Hashmonah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּתְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּתְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָה׃

english.text: And they went from Mithkah and camped in Hashmonah.

translation.text: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחַשְׁמֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמֹסֵרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחַשְׁמֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמֹסֵרוֹת׃

english.text: And they traveled from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

translation.text: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

verses.english: And they traveled from Moseroth and camped in Bene-jaakan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמֹּסֵרוֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּבְנֵי יַעֲקָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמֹּסֵרוֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּבְנֵי יַעֲקָן׃

english.text: And they traveled from Moseroth and camped in Bene-jaakan.

translation.text: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Benejaakan.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Bene-jaakan and camped at
Hor-haggidgad.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבְּנֵי יַעֲקָן וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּחֹר הַגִּדְגָּד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבְּנֵי יַעֲקָן וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּחֹר הַגִּדְגָּד׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Bene-jaakan and camped at
Hor-haggidgad.

translation.text: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Horhaggidgad.

verses.english: And they went from Hor-haggidgad and camped in Jotbathah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֹר הַגִּדְגָּד וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּיטְבָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֹר הַגִּדְגָּד וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּיטְבָתָה׃

english.text: And they went from Hor-haggidgad and camped in Jotbathah.

translation.text: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Jotbathah and camped at Ebronah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיּטְבָתָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַבְרֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיּטְבָתָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַבְרֹנָה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Jotbathah and camped at Ebronah.

translation.text: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Ebronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַבְרֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַבְרֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר׃

english.text: And they traveled from Ebronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

translation.text: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Ezion-geber and camped in the
wilderness of Zin. That is Kadesh.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְמִדְבַּר צִן הִוא קָדֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְמִדְבַּר צִן הִוא קָדֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Ezion-geber and camped in the
wilderness of Zin. That is Kadesh.

translation.text: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin (that is, Kadesh).

verses.english:
And they traveled from Kadesh and camped in Mount Hor, at
the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהֹר הָהָר בִּקְצֵה אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהֹר הָהָר בִּקְצֵה אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Kadesh and camped in Mount Hor, at
the edge of the land of Edom.

translation.text: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.

verses.english:
And Aaron, the priest, went up into Mount Hor at the word
of YHWH and died there in the fortieth year after the
children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the
fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הֹר הָהָר עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וַיָּמת שָׁם בִּשְׁנַת הָאַרְבָּעִים לְצֵאת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הֹר הָהָר עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וַיָּמת שָׁם בִּשְׁנַת הָאַרְבָּעִים לְצֵאת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And Aaron, the priest, went up into Mount Hor at the word
of YHWH and died there in the fortieth year after the
children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the
fifth month, on the first day of the month.

translation.text: Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at the command of the LORD and died there in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.

verses.english:
And Aaron was a hundred twenty-three years old when he
died in Mount Hor.
verses.hebrew: וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן שָׁלֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ בְּהֹר הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן שָׁלֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ בְּהֹר הָהָר׃

english.text:
And Aaron was a hundred twenty-three years old when he
died in Mount Hor.

translation.text: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.

verses.english:
And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the
Negeb in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the
children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בַּנֶּגֶב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן בְּבֹא בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בַּנֶּגֶב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן בְּבֹא בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the
Negeb in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the
children of Israel.

translation.text: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the Negeb in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the Israelites.

verses.english: And they traveled from Mount Hor and camped in Zalmonah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהֹר הָהָר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּצַלְמֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהֹר הָהָר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּצַלְמֹנָה׃

english.text: And they traveled from Mount Hor and camped in Zalmonah.

translation.text: They set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

verses.english: And they traveled from Zalmonah and camped in Punon.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִצַּלְמֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּפוּנֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִצַּלְמֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּפוּנֹן׃

english.text: And they traveled from Zalmonah and camped in Punon.

translation.text: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

verses.english: And they traveled from Punon and camped in Oboth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפּוּנֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפּוּנֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹת׃

english.text: And they traveled from Punon and camped in Oboth.

translation.text: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Oboth and camped in Iyye-abarim, in
the border of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בִּגְבוּל מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בִּגְבוּל מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Oboth and camped in Iyye-abarim, in
the border of Moab.

translation.text: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iyeabarim, in the territory of Moab.

verses.english: And they traveled from Iyyim and camped in Dibon-gad.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעִיִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדִיבֹן גָּד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעִיִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדִיבֹן גָּד׃

english.text: And they traveled from Iyyim and camped in Dibon-gad.

translation.text: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Dibon-gad and camped in
Almon-diblathaim.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדִּיבֹן גָּד וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדִּיבֹן גָּד וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Dibon-gad and camped in
Almon-diblathaim.

translation.text: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the
mountains of Abarim in front of Nebo.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים לִפְנֵי נְבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים לִפְנֵי נְבוֹ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the
mountains of Abarim in front of Nebo.

translation.text: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the mountains of Abarim and camped
in the plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the mountains of Abarim and camped
in the plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.

translation.text: They set out the Jordan at Jericho;

verses.english:
And they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to
Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִבֵּית הַיְשִׁמֹת עַד אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִבֵּית הַיְשִׁמֹת עַד אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to
Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

translation.text: they camped by the Jordan from Bethjeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

translation.text: In the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

translation.text: Speak to the Israelites, and say to them: When you cross over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.english:
you shall dispossess all the residents of the land in
front of you, and destroy all their carved figures, and
you shall destroy all their molten images and demolish all
their high places.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֵת כּל מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם וְאֵת כּל צַלְמֵי מַסֵּכֹתָם תְּאַבֵּדוּ וְאֵת כּל בָּמוֹתָם תַּשְׁמִידוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֵת כּל מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם וְאֵת כּל צַלְמֵי מַסֵּכֹתָם תְּאַבֵּדוּ וְאֵת כּל בָּמוֹתָם תַּשְׁמִידוּ׃

english.text:
you shall dispossess all the residents of the land in
front of you, and destroy all their carved figures, and
you shall destroy all their molten images and demolish all
their high places.

translation.text: you shall drive out all stones, destroy all their cast images, and demolish all their high places.

verses.english:
And you shall take possession of the land and live in it,
because I’ve given the land to you to possess it.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי לָכֶם נָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי לָכֶם נָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall take possession of the land and live in it,
because I’ve given the land to you to possess it.

translation.text: You shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

verses.english:
And you shall give legacies of the land by lot, by your
families: for the large you shall make its legacy larger,
and for the small you shall make its legacy smaller.
Wherever the lot indicates for it shall belong to it. You
shall give legacies to the tribes of your fathers.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּגוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם לָרַב תַּרְבּוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ אֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא לוֹ שָׁמָּה הַגּוֹרָל לוֹ יִהְיֶה לְמַטּוֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְנֶחָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּגוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם לָרַב תַּרְבּוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ אֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא לוֹ שָׁמָּה הַגּוֹרָל לוֹ יִהְיֶה לְמַטּוֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְנֶחָלוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall give legacies of the land by lot, by your
families: for the large you shall make its legacy larger,
and for the small you shall make its legacy smaller.
Wherever the lot indicates for it shall belong to it. You
shall give legacies to the tribes of your fathers.

translation.text: You shall apportion the land by lot inheritance, and to a small one you shall give a small inheritance; the inheritance shall belong to the person on whom the lot falls; according to your ancestral tribes you shall inherit.

verses.english:
And if you don’t dispossess the residents of the land in
front of you, then those whom you leave of them will
become sticks in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and
they’ll afflict you on the land in which you’re living.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר תּוֹתִירוּ מֵהֶם לְשִׂכִּים בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלִצְנִינִם בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְצָרְרוּ אֶתְכֶם עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר תּוֹתִירוּ מֵהֶם לְשִׂכִּים בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלִצְנִינִם בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְצָרְרוּ אֶתְכֶם עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And if you don’t dispossess the residents of the land in
front of you, then those whom you leave of them will
become sticks in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and
they’ll afflict you on the land in which you’re living.

translation.text: But if you do not drive out remain shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they shall trouble you in the land where you are settling.

verses.english:
And it will be that, as I meant to do to them, I’ll do to
you!”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּמִּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּמִּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And it will be that, as I meant to do to them, I’ll do to
you!”

translation.text: And I will do to you as I thought to do to them.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land of Canaan, this is the
land that will fall to you as a legacy, the land of Canaan
by its borders:
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם בָּאִים אֶל הָאָרֶץ כְּנָעַן זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּפֹּל לָכֶם בְּנַחֲלָה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם בָּאִים אֶל הָאָרֶץ כְּנָעַן זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּפֹּל לָכֶם בְּנַחֲלָה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land of Canaan, this is the
land that will fall to you as a legacy, the land of Canaan
by its borders:

translation.text: Command the Israelites, and say to boundaries),

verses.english:
And the southern side for you shall be from the wilderness
of Zin next to Edom, and the southern border for you shall
be from the edge of the Dead Sea to the east.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָכֶם פְּאַת נֶגֶב מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַל יְדֵי אֱדוֹם וְהָיָה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח קֵדְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לָכֶם פְּאַת נֶגֶב מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַל יְדֵי אֱדוֹם וְהָיָה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח קֵדְמָה׃

english.text:
And the southern side for you shall be from the wilderness
of Zin next to Edom, and the southern border for you shall
be from the edge of the Dead Sea to the east.

translation.text: your south sector shall extend from the wilderness of Zin end of the Dead Sea on the east;

verses.english:
And the border for you shall turn from the south to the
ascent of Akrabim and will pass to Zin, and its extent
shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and it shall go
out to Hazar-addar and pass to Azmon.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב לָכֶם הַגְּבוּל מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תּוֹצְאֹתָיו מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְיָצָא חֲצַר אַדָּר וְעָבַר עַצְמֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַב לָכֶם הַגְּבוּל מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תּוֹצְאֹתָיו מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְיָצָא חֲצַר אַדָּר וְעָבַר עַצְמֹנָה׃

english.text:
And the border for you shall turn from the south to the
ascent of Akrabim and will pass to Zin, and its extent
shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and it shall go
out to Hazar-addar and pass to Azmon.

translation.text: your boundary shall turn south of to Azmon;

verses.english:
And the border shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt,
and its extent shall be to the sea.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מֵעַצְמוֹן נַחְלָה מִצְרָיִם וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מֵעַצְמוֹן נַחְלָה מִצְרָיִם וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

english.text:
And the border shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt,
and its extent shall be to the sea.

translation.text: the boundary shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt, and its termination shall be at the Sea.

verses.english:
And the western border: and the big sea shall be a border
for you. This shall be the western border for you.
verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל יָם וְהָיָה לָכֶם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל יָם׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל יָם וְהָיָה לָכֶם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל יָם׃

english.text:
And the western border: and the big sea shall be a border
for you. This shall be the western border for you.

translation.text: For the western boundary, you shall have the Great Sea and its coast; this shall be your western boundary.

verses.english:
And this shall be the northern border for you: you shall
mark from the big sea to Mount Hor,
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן מִן הַיָּם הַגָּדֹל תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם הֹר הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן מִן הַיָּם הַגָּדֹל תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם הֹר הָהָר׃

english.text:
And this shall be the northern border for you: you shall
mark from the big sea to Mount Hor,

translation.text: This shall be your northern boundary: from the Great Sea you shall mark out your line to Mount Hor;

verses.english:
from Mount Hor you shall mark to the entrance of Hamath,
and the border’s extent shall be to Zedad,
verses.hebrew: מֵהֹר הָהָר תְּתָאוּ לְבֹא חֲמָת וְהָיוּ תּוֹצְאֹת הַגְּבֻל צְדָדָה׃

hebrew.text: מֵהֹר הָהָר תְּתָאוּ לְבֹא חֲמָת וְהָיוּ תּוֹצְאֹת הַגְּבֻל צְדָדָה׃

english.text:
from Mount Hor you shall mark to the entrance of Hamath,
and the border’s extent shall be to Zedad,

translation.text: from Mount Hor you shall mark it Zedad;

verses.english:
and the border shall go out to Ziphron, and its extent
shall be to Hazar-enan. This shall be the northern border
for you.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבֻל זִפְרֹנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו חֲצַר עֵינָן זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַגְּבֻל זִפְרֹנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו חֲצַר עֵינָן זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן׃

english.text:
and the border shall go out to Ziphron, and its extent
shall be to Hazar-enan. This shall be the northern border
for you.

translation.text: then the boundary shall extend to Ziphron, and its end shall be at Hazar-enan; this shall be your northern boundary.

verses.english:
And you shall mark for the border to the east from
Hazar-enan to Shepham,
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם לִגְבוּל קֵדְמָה מֵחֲצַר עֵינָן שְׁפָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם לִגְבוּל קֵדְמָה מֵחֲצַר עֵינָן שְׁפָמָה׃

english.text:
And you shall mark for the border to the east from
Hazar-enan to Shepham,

translation.text: You shall mark out your eastern boundary from Hazar-enan to Shepham;

verses.english:
and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah at the
east of Ain, and the border shall go down and rub on the
shoulder of the Sea of Kinneret on the east,
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל מִשְּׁפָם הָרִבְלָה מִקֶּדֶם לָעָיִן וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל וּמָחָה עַל כֶּתֶף יָם כִּנֶּרֶת קֵדְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל מִשְּׁפָם הָרִבְלָה מִקֶּדֶם לָעָיִן וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל וּמָחָה עַל כֶּתֶף יָם כִּנֶּרֶת קֵדְמָה׃

english.text:
and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah at the
east of Ain, and the border shall go down and rub on the
shoulder of the Sea of Kinneret on the east,

translation.text: and the boundary shall continue down from Shepham to reach the eastern slope of the sea of Chinnereth;

verses.english:
and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its extent
will be to the Dead Sea. This shall be the land for you by
its borders all around.”
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו יָם הַמֶּלַח זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו יָם הַמֶּלַח זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its extent
will be to the Dead Sea. This shall be the land for you by
its borders all around.”

translation.text: and the boundary shall go down to the Jordan, and its end shall be at the Dead Sea. This shall be your land with its boundaries all around.

verses.english:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This
is the land that you shall give as legacies by lot, which
YHWH commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of
a tribe.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּתְנַחֲלוּ אֹתָהּ בְּגוֹרָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּתְנַחֲלוּ אֹתָהּ בְּגוֹרָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This
is the land that you shall give as legacies by lot, which
YHWH commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of
a tribe.”

translation.text: Moses commanded the Israelites, saying: This is the land that you tribes and to the half-tribe;

verses.english:
Because the tribe of the children of the Reubenites by
their fathers’ house and the tribe of the children of the
Gadites by their fathers’ house had taken and half of the
tribe of Manasseh had taken their legacy.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לָקְחוּ מַטֵּה בְנֵי הָראוּבֵנִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וּמַטֵּה בְנֵי הַגָּדִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לָקְחוּ מַטֵּה בְנֵי הָראוּבֵנִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וּמַטֵּה בְנֵי הַגָּדִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם׃

english.text:
Because the tribe of the children of the Reubenites by
their fathers’ house and the tribe of the children of the
Gadites by their fathers’ house had taken and half of the
tribe of Manasseh had taken their legacy.

translation.text: for the tribe of the Reubenites by their ancestral houses and the tribe of the Gadites by their ancestral houses have taken their inheritance, and also the half-tribe of Manasseh;

verses.english:
The two tribes and the half of a tribe had taken their
legacy from across the Jordan toward Jericho on the east
side—to the east.
verses.hebrew: שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
The two tribes and the half of a tribe had taken their
legacy from across the Jordan toward Jericho on the east
side—to the east.

translation.text: the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִנְחֲלוּ לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִנְחֲלוּ לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

translation.text: These are the names of the men who shall apportion the land to you for inheritance: the priest Eleazar and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.english:
and you shall take one chieftain for each tribe to give
the land as legacies.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד מִמַּטֶּה תִּקְחוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד מִמַּטֶּה תִּקְחוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
and you shall take one chieftain for each tribe to give
the land as legacies.

translation.text: You shall take one leader of every tribe to apportion the land for inheritance.

verses.english:
And these are the people’s names: For the tribe of Judah,
Caleb son of Jephunneh.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה׃

english.text:
And these are the people’s names: For the tribe of Judah,
Caleb son of Jephunneh.

translation.text: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Simeon, Samuel son of
Ammihud.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁמוּאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁמוּאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Simeon, Samuel son of
Ammihud.

translation.text: Of the tribe of the Simeonites, Shemuel son of Ammihud.

verses.english: For the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.
verses.hebrew: לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֱלִידָד בֶּן כִּסְלוֹן׃

hebrew.text: לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֱלִידָד בֶּן כִּסְלוֹן׃

english.text: For the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.

translation.text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Dan, a chieftain,
Bukki son of Jogli.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן נָשִׂיא בֻּקִּי בֶּן יגְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן נָשִׂיא בֻּקִּי בֶּן יגְלִי׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Dan, a chieftain,
Bukki son of Jogli.

translation.text: Of the tribe of the Danites a leader, Bukki son of Jogli.

verses.english:
For the children of Joseph: for the tribe of the children
of Manasseh, a chieftain, Hanniel son of Ephod;
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה נָשִׂיא חַנִּיאֵל בֶּן אֵפֹד׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה נָשִׂיא חַנִּיאֵל בֶּן אֵפֹד׃

english.text:
For the children of Joseph: for the tribe of the children
of Manasseh, a chieftain, Hanniel son of Ephod;

translation.text: Of the Josephites: of the tribe of the Manassites a leader, Hanniel son of Ephod,

verses.english:
and for the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chieftain,
Kemuel son of Shiphtan.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם נָשִׂיא קְמוּאֵל בֶּן שִׁפְטָן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם נָשִׂיא קְמוּאֵל בֶּן שִׁפְטָן׃

english.text:
and for the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chieftain,
Kemuel son of Shiphtan.

translation.text: and of the tribe of the Ephraimites a leader, Kemuel son of Shiphtan.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chieftain,
Elizaphan son of Parnach.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי זְבוּלֻן נָשִׂיא אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן פַּרְנָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי זְבוּלֻן נָשִׂיא אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן פַּרְנָךְ׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chieftain,
Elizaphan son of Parnach.

translation.text: Of the tribe of the Zebulunites a leader, Eli-zaphan son of Parnach.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Issachar, a
chieftain, Paltiel son of Azzan.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נָשִׂיא פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן עַזָּן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נָשִׂיא פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן עַזָּן׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Issachar, a
chieftain, Paltiel son of Azzan.

translation.text: Of the tribe of the Issacharites a leader, Paltiel son of Azzan.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Asher, a chieftain,
Ahihud son of Shelomi.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אָשֵׁר נָשִׂיא אֲחִיהוּד בֶּן שְׁלֹמִי׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אָשֵׁר נָשִׂיא אֲחִיהוּד בֶּן שְׁלֹמִי׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Asher, a chieftain,
Ahihud son of Shelomi.

translation.text: And of the tribe of the Asherites a leader, Ahihud son of Shelomi.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a
chieftain, Pedahel son of Ammihud.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי נָשִׂיא פְּדַהְאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי נָשִׂיא פְּדַהְאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a
chieftain, Pedahel son of Ammihud.”

translation.text: Of the tribe of the Naphtalites a leader, Pedahel son of Ammihud.

verses.english:
These are the ones whom YHWH commanded to give the
children of Israel legacies in the land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לְנַחֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לְנַחֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
These are the ones whom YHWH commanded to give the
children of Israel legacies in the land of Canaan.

translation.text: These were the ones whom the LORD of Canaan.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

translation.text: In the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel that, from the legacy of
their possession, they shall give the Levites cities in
which to live, and you shall give the Levites surrounding
land for the cities all around them.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתְנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלַת אֲחֻזָּתָם עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרָשׁ לֶעָרִים סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתְנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלַת אֲחֻזָּתָם עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרָשׁ לֶעָרִים סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel that, from the legacy of
their possession, they shall give the Levites cities in
which to live, and you shall give the Levites surrounding
land for the cities all around them.

translation.text: Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance that they possess, towns for the Levites to live in; you shall also give to the Levites pasture lands surrounding the towns.

verses.english:
And the cities shall be theirs to live in, and their
surrounding lands shall be for their cattle and for their
property and for their animals.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לָהֶם לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם יִהְיוּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם וְלִרְכֻשָׁם וּלְכֹל חַיָּתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לָהֶם לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם יִהְיוּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם וְלִרְכֻשָׁם וּלְכֹל חַיָּתָם׃

english.text:
And the cities shall be theirs to live in, and their
surrounding lands shall be for their cattle and for their
property and for their animals.

translation.text: The towns shall be theirs to live in, and their pasture lands shall be for their cattle, for their livestock, and for all their animals.

verses.english:
And the surrounding lands of the cities that you shall
give to the Levites: from the city wall outward, a
thousand cubits all around.
verses.hebrew: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִקִּיר הָעִיר וָחוּצָה אֶלֶף אַמָּה סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִקִּיר הָעִיר וָחוּצָה אֶלֶף אַמָּה סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And the surrounding lands of the cities that you shall
give to the Levites: from the city wall outward, a
thousand cubits all around.

translation.text: The pasture lands of the towns, which you shall give to the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the town outward a thousand cubits all around.

verses.english:
And you shall measure outside the city: on the eastern
side two thousand in cubits, and on the southern side two
thousand in cubits, and on the western side two thousand
in cubits, and on the northern side two thousand in
cubits, and the city in the middle. This shall be the
surrounding lands of the cities for them.
verses.hebrew: וּמַדֹּתֶם מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶת פְּאַת קֵדְמָה אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת נֶגֶב אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת יָם אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֵת פְּאַת צָפוֹן אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְהָעִיר בַּתָּוֶךְ זֶה יִהְיֶה לָהֶם מִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמַדֹּתֶם מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶת פְּאַת קֵדְמָה אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת נֶגֶב אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת יָם אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֵת פְּאַת צָפוֹן אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְהָעִיר בַּתָּוֶךְ זֶה יִהְיֶה לָהֶם מִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים׃

english.text:
And you shall measure outside the city: on the eastern
side two thousand in cubits, and on the southern side two
thousand in cubits, and on the western side two thousand
in cubits, and on the northern side two thousand in
cubits, and the city in the middle. This shall be the
surrounding lands of the cities for them.

translation.text: You shall measure, for the north side two thousand cubits, with the town in the middle; this shall belong to them as pasture land for their towns.

verses.english:
And the cities that you shall give to the Levites: six
cities of refuge that you shall give for the manslayer to
flee there, and you shall give in addition to them
forty-two cities.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אֵת שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לָנֻס שָׁמָּה הָרֹצֵחַ וַעֲלֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם עִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אֵת שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לָנֻס שָׁמָּה הָרֹצֵחַ וַעֲלֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם עִיר׃

english.text:
And the cities that you shall give to the Levites: six
cities of refuge that you shall give for the manslayer to
flee there, and you shall give in addition to them
forty-two cities.

translation.text: The towns that you give to the Levites shall include the six cities of refuge, where you shall permit a slayer to flee, and in addition to them you shall give forty-two towns.

verses.english:
All the cities that you shall give to the Levites:
forty-eight cities, them and their surrounding lands.
verses.hebrew: כּל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה עִיר אֶתְהֶן וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: כּל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה עִיר אֶתְהֶן וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
All the cities that you shall give to the Levites:
forty-eight cities, them and their surrounding lands.

translation.text: The towns that you give to the Levites shall total forty-eight, with their pasture lands.

verses.english:
And the cities that you shall give from the possession of
the children of Israel: from the larger you shall give
more, and from the smaller you shall give fewer. Each
shall give some of his cities to the Levites according to
his legacy that they will give.”
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ מֵאֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הָרַב תַּרְבּוּ וּמֵאֵת הַמְעַט תַּמְעִיטוּ אִישׁ כְּפִי נַחֲלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִנְחָלוּ יִתֵּן מֵעָרָיו לַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ מֵאֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הָרַב תַּרְבּוּ וּמֵאֵת הַמְעַט תַּמְעִיטוּ אִישׁ כְּפִי נַחֲלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִנְחָלוּ יִתֵּן מֵעָרָיו לַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And the cities that you shall give from the possession of
the children of Israel: from the larger you shall give
more, and from the smaller you shall give fewer. Each
shall give some of his cities to the Levites according to
his legacy that they will give.”

translation.text: And as for the towns that you shall give from the possession of the Israelites, from the larger few; each, in proportion to the inheritance that it obtains, shall give of its towns to the Levites.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

translation.text: Speak to the Israelites, and say to them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.english:
you shall establish cities; they shall be cities of refuge
for you, and a manslayer who strikes a life by mistake
shall flee there.
