verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם עָרִים עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם וְנָס שָׁמָּה רֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם עָרִים עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם וְנָס שָׁמָּה רֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
you shall establish cities; they shall be cities of refuge
for you, and a manslayer who strikes a life by mistake
shall flee there.

translation.text: then you shall select cities to be cities of refuge for you, so that a slayer who kills a person without intent may flee there.

verses.english:
And you shall have the cities for refuge from an avenger
so the manslayer will not die until he stands in front of
the congregation for judgment.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לָכֶם הֶעָרִים לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרֹצֵחַ עַד עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ לָכֶם הֶעָרִים לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרֹצֵחַ עַד עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And you shall have the cities for refuge from an avenger
so the manslayer will not die until he stands in front of
the congregation for judgment.

translation.text: The cities shall be for you a refuge from the avenger, so that the slayer may not die until there is a trial before the congregation.

verses.english:
And the cities that you shall give: You shall have six
cities of refuge.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּנוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּנוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And the cities that you shall give: You shall have six
cities of refuge.

translation.text: The cities that you designate shall be six cities of refuge for you:

verses.english:
You shall put three of the cities across the Jordan, and
you shall put three of the cities in the land of Canaan.
They shall be cities of refuge.
verses.hebrew: אֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְאֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְאֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה׃

english.text:
You shall put three of the cities across the Jordan, and
you shall put three of the cities in the land of Canaan.
They shall be cities of refuge.

translation.text: you shall designate three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities in the land of Canaan, to be cities of refuge.

verses.english:
“These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of
Israel and for the alien and for the visitor among them,
for anyone who strikes a life by mistake to flee there.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב בְּתוֹכָם תִּהְיֶינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְמִקְלָט לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב בְּתוֹכָם תִּהְיֶינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְמִקְלָט לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
“These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of
Israel and for the alien and for the visitor among them,
for anyone who strikes a life by mistake to flee there.

translation.text: These six cities shall serve as refuge for the Israelites, for the resident or transient alien among them, so that anyone who kills a person without intent may flee there.

verses.english:
But if he struck him with an iron item so that he died, he
is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בִּכְלִי בַרְזֶל הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בִּכְלִי בַרְזֶל הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

english.text:
But if he struck him with an iron item so that he died, he
is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.

translation.text: But anyone who strikes another with an iron object, and death ensues, is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And if he struck him with a stone in the hand by which one
could die, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer
shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּאֶבֶן יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּאֶבֶן יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

english.text:
And if he struck him with a stone in the hand by which one
could die, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer
shall be put to death.

translation.text: Or anyone death ensues, is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

verses.english:
Or if he struck him with a wooden object in the hand by
which one could die, so that he died, he is a murderer.
The murderer shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בִּכְלִי עֵץ יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בִּכְלִי עֵץ יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

english.text:
Or if he struck him with a wooden object in the hand by
which one could die, so that he died, he is a murderer.
The murderer shall be put to death.

translation.text: Or put to death.

verses.english:
The blood avenger, he shall kill the murderer. When he
comes upon him, he shall kill him.
verses.hebrew: גֹּאֵל הַדָּם הוּא יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ הוּא יְמִתֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: גֹּאֵל הַדָּם הוּא יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ הוּא יְמִתֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
The blood avenger, he shall kill the murderer. When he
comes upon him, he shall kill him.

translation.text: The avenger of blood is the one who shall put the execute the sentence.

verses.english:
And if he pushed him in hatred or threw something on him
through scheming so that he died,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּשִׂנְאָה יֶהְדֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו בִּצְדִיָּה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּשִׂנְאָה יֶהְדֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו בִּצְדִיָּה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And if he pushed him in hatred or threw something on him
through scheming so that he died,

translation.text: Likewise, if someone pushes another from hatred, or hurls something at another, lying in wait, and death ensues,

verses.english:
or if he struck him with his hand in enmity so that he
died, the one who struck shall be put to death. He is a
murderer. The blood avenger shall kill the murderer when
he comes upon him.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בְאֵיבָה הִכָּהוּ בְיָדוֹ וַיָּמֹת מוֹת יוּמַת הַמַּכֶּה רֹצֵחַ הוּא גֹּאֵל הַדָּם יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בְאֵיבָה הִכָּהוּ בְיָדוֹ וַיָּמֹת מוֹת יוּמַת הַמַּכֶּה רֹצֵחַ הוּא גֹּאֵל הַדָּם יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ׃

english.text:
or if he struck him with his hand in enmity so that he
died, the one who struck shall be put to death. He is a
murderer. The blood avenger shall kill the murderer when
he comes upon him.

translation.text: or in enmity strikes another with the hand, and death ensues, then they meet.

verses.english:
But if by chance, not in enmity, he pushed him or threw
any object on him not through scheming,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּפֶתַע בְּלֹא אֵיבָה הֲדָפוֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו כּל כְּלִי בְּלֹא צְדִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּפֶתַע בְּלֹא אֵיבָה הֲדָפוֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו כּל כְּלִי בְּלֹא צְדִיָּה׃

english.text:
But if by chance, not in enmity, he pushed him or threw
any object on him not through scheming,

translation.text: But if someone pushes another suddenly without enmity, or hurls any object without lying in wait,

verses.english:
or with any stone by which one could die, without seeing,
so that he dropped it on him so that he died, and he was
not an enemy to him and was not seeking to harm him,
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בְכל אֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ בְּלֹא רְאוֹת וַיַּפֵּל עָלָיו וַיָּמֹת וְהוּא לֹא אוֹיֵב לוֹ וְלֹא מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בְכל אֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ בְּלֹא רְאוֹת וַיַּפֵּל עָלָיו וַיָּמֹת וְהוּא לֹא אוֹיֵב לוֹ וְלֹא מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתוֹ׃

english.text:
or with any stone by which one could die, without seeing,
so that he dropped it on him so that he died, and he was
not an enemy to him and was not seeking to harm him,

translation.text: or, while handling any stone that ensues, though they were not enemies, and no harm was intended,

verses.english:
then the congregation shall judge between the one who
struck and the blood avenger on the basis of these
judgments.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפְטוּ הָעֵדָה בֵּין הַמַּכֶּה וּבֵין גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁפְטוּ הָעֵדָה בֵּין הַמַּכֶּה וּבֵין גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
then the congregation shall judge between the one who
struck and the blood avenger on the basis of these
judgments.

translation.text: of blood, in accordance with these ordinances;

verses.english:
And the congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the
blood avenger’s hand, and the congregation shall bring him
back to his city of refuge to which he fled, and he shall
live in it until the death of the high priest whom one
anointed with the holy oil.
verses.hebrew: וְהִצִּילוּ הָעֵדָה אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ מִיַּד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֹתוֹ הָעֵדָה אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָס שָׁמָּה וְיָשַׁב בָּהּ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּשֶׁמֶן הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִצִּילוּ הָעֵדָה אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ מִיַּד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֹתוֹ הָעֵדָה אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָס שָׁמָּה וְיָשַׁב בָּהּ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּשֶׁמֶן הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the
blood avenger’s hand, and the congregation shall bring him
back to his city of refuge to which he fled, and he shall
live in it until the death of the high priest whom one
anointed with the holy oil.

translation.text: and the refuge. The slayer shall live in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.english:
But if the murderer will go out of the border of his city
of refuge to which he will flee,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יָצֹא יֵצֵא הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת גְּבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יָצֹא יֵצֵא הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת גְּבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
But if the murderer will go out of the border of his city
of refuge to which he will flee,

translation.text: But if the slayer shall at any time go outside the bounds of the original city of refuge,

verses.english:
and the blood avenger will find him outside of the border
of his city of refuge, and the blood avenger will murder
the murderer, he does not have blood,
verses.hebrew: וּמָצָא אֹתוֹ גֹּאֵל הַדָּם מִחוּץ לִגְבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ וְרָצַח גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ אֵין לוֹ דָּם׃

hebrew.text: וּמָצָא אֹתוֹ גֹּאֵל הַדָּם מִחוּץ לִגְבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ וְרָצַח גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ אֵין לוֹ דָּם׃

english.text:
and the blood avenger will find him outside of the border
of his city of refuge, and the blood avenger will murder
the murderer, he does not have blood,

translation.text: and is found by killed by the avenger, no bloodguilt shall be incurred.

verses.english:
because he shall live in his city of refuge until the high
priest’s death, and after the high priest’s death the
murderer shall go back to the land of his possession.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְעִיר מִקְלָטוֹ יֵשֵׁב עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל וְאַחֲרֵי מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל יָשׁוּב הָרֹצֵחַ אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בְעִיר מִקְלָטוֹ יֵשֵׁב עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל וְאַחֲרֵי מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל יָשׁוּב הָרֹצֵחַ אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
because he shall live in his city of refuge until the high
priest’s death, and after the high priest’s death the
murderer shall go back to the land of his possession.

translation.text: For the slayer must remain in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest; but after the death of the high priest the slayer may return home.

verses.english:
“And these shall become a law of judgment for you through
your generations in all your homes.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ אֵלֶּה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ אֵלֶּה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And these shall become a law of judgment for you through
your generations in all your homes.

translation.text: These things shall be a statute and ordinance for you throughout your generations wherever you live.

verses.english:
Anyone who strikes a life, the murderer shall be murdered
by the mouth of witnesses. And one witness shall not
testify against a person so as to die.
verses.hebrew: כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ לְפִי עֵדִים יִרְצַח אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ וְעֵד אֶחָד לֹא יַעֲנֶה בְנֶפֶשׁ לָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ לְפִי עֵדִים יִרְצַח אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ וְעֵד אֶחָד לֹא יַעֲנֶה בְנֶפֶשׁ לָמוּת׃

english.text:
Anyone who strikes a life, the murderer shall be murdered
by the mouth of witnesses. And one witness shall not
testify against a person so as to die.

translation.text: If anyone kills another, the murderer shall be put to death on the testimony of a single witness.

verses.english:
And you shall not take a ransom for a murderer’s life,
because he did wrong so as to die, but he shall be put to
death.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לְנֶפֶשׁ רֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר הוּא רָשָׁע לָמוּת כִּי מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לְנֶפֶשׁ רֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר הוּא רָשָׁע לָמוּת כִּי מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And you shall not take a ransom for a murderer’s life,
because he did wrong so as to die, but he shall be put to
death.

translation.text: Moreover you shall accept no ransom murderer must be put to death.

verses.english:
And you shall not take a ransom to flee to his city of
refuge, to go back to live in the land until the priest’s
death.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לָנוּס אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ לָשׁוּב לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לָנוּס אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ לָשׁוּב לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And you shall not take a ransom to flee to his city of
refuge, to go back to live in the land until the priest’s
death.

translation.text: Nor shall you accept ransom for one who has fled to a city of refuge, enabling the fugitive to return to live in the land before the death of the high priest.

verses.english:
So you shall not pollute the land in which you are.
Because blood: it will pollute the land, and the land will
not have expiation for blood that is spilled in it except
by the blood of the one who spilled it!
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תַחֲנִיפוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי הַדָּם הוּא יַחֲנִיף אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּהּ כִּי אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תַחֲנִיפוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי הַדָּם הוּא יַחֲנִיף אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּהּ כִּי אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ׃

english.text:
So you shall not pollute the land in which you are.
Because blood: it will pollute the land, and the land will
not have expiation for blood that is spilled in it except
by the blood of the one who spilled it!

translation.text: You shall not pollute except by the blood of the one who shed it.

verses.english:
And you shall not make the land impure in which you are
living, in which I tent, because I, YHWH, tent among the
children of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָהּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָהּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall not make the land impure in which you are
living, in which I tent, because I, YHWH, tent among the
children of Israel.”

translation.text: You shall not defile the land in which you live, in which I also dwell; for I the LORD dwell among the Israelites.

verses.english:
And the heads of the fathers of the family of the
children of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the
families of the children of Joseph, came forward and spoke
in front of Moses and in front of the chieftains, heads of
fathers of the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמִשְׁפַּחַת בְּנֵי גִלְעָד בֶּן מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמִשְׁפַּחַת בְּנֵי גִלְעָד בֶּן מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the heads of the fathers of the family of the
children of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the
families of the children of Joseph, came forward and spoke
in front of Moses and in front of the chieftains, heads of
fathers of the children of Israel.

translation.text: The heads of the ancestral houses of the clans of the descendants of of the ancestral houses of the Israelites;

verses.english:
And they said, “YHWH commanded my lord to give the land as
legacy by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was
commanded by YHWH to give the legacy of Zelophehad, our
brother, to his daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶת אֲדֹנִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּגוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאדֹנִי צֻוָּה בַיהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת נַחֲלַת צְלפְחָד אָחִינוּ לִבְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶת אֲדֹנִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּגוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאדֹנִי צֻוָּה בַיהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת נַחֲלַת צְלפְחָד אָחִינוּ לִבְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And they said, “YHWH commanded my lord to give the land as
legacy by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was
commanded by YHWH to give the legacy of Zelophehad, our
brother, to his daughters.

translation.text: they said, "The LORD inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

verses.english:
If they will become wives to one of the sons of the tribes
of the children of Israel, then their legacy will be
subtracted from our fathers’ legacy and added onto the
legacy of the tribe to whom they will belong, and it will
be subtracted from our legacy by the lot.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לְאֶחָד מִבְּנֵי שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָשִׁים וְנִגְרְעָה נַחֲלָתָן מִנַּחֲלַת אֲבֹתֵינוּ וְנוֹסַף עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִגֹּרַל נַחֲלָתֵנוּ יִגָּרֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ לְאֶחָד מִבְּנֵי שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָשִׁים וְנִגְרְעָה נַחֲלָתָן מִנַּחֲלַת אֲבֹתֵינוּ וְנוֹסַף עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִגֹּרַל נַחֲלָתֵנוּ יִגָּרֵעַ׃

english.text:
If they will become wives to one of the sons of the tribes
of the children of Israel, then their legacy will be
subtracted from our fathers’ legacy and added onto the
legacy of the tribe to whom they will belong, and it will
be subtracted from our legacy by the lot.

translation.text: But if they are married into another Israelite tribe, then their inheritance will be inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so it will be taken away from the allotted portion of our inheritance.

verses.english:
And if the children of Israel will have the jubilee, then
their legacy will be added onto the legacy of the tribe to
whom they will belong, and their legacy will be subtracted
from the legacy of our fathers’ tribe.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִהְיֶה הַיֹּבֵל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנוֹסְפָה נַחֲלָתָן עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִנַּחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתֵינוּ יִגָּרַע נַחֲלָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִהְיֶה הַיֹּבֵל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנוֹסְפָה נַחֲלָתָן עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִנַּחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתֵינוּ יִגָּרַע נַחֲלָתָן׃

english.text:
And if the children of Israel will have the jubilee, then
their legacy will be added onto the legacy of the tribe to
whom they will belong, and their legacy will be subtracted
from the legacy of our fathers’ tribe.”

translation.text: And when the jubilee of inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our ancestral tribe."

verses.english:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel by YHWH’s word,
saying, “The children of Joseph speak right.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֵּן מַטֵּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵף דֹּבְרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֵּן מַטֵּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵף דֹּבְרִים׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel by YHWH’s word,
saying, “The children of Joseph speak right.

translation.text: Then Moses commanded the Israelites according to the word of the LORD, saying, "The descendants of the tribe of Joseph are right in what they are saying.

verses.english:
This is the thing that YHWH has commanded Zelophehad’s
daughters, saying: They shall become wives for any in
whose eyes it is good, except: they shall become wives to
the family of their father’s tribe.
verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת צְלפְחָד לֵאמֹר לַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים אַךְ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אֲבִיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת צְלפְחָד לֵאמֹר לַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים אַךְ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אֲבִיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
This is the thing that YHWH has commanded Zelophehad’s
daughters, saying: They shall become wives for any in
whose eyes it is good, except: they shall become wives to
the family of their father’s tribe.

translation.text: This is what the LORD commands concerning the it must be into a clan of their father's tribe that they are married,

verses.english:
So a legacy of the children of Israel will not turn from
tribe to tribe, but the children of Israel shall each
cling to the legacy of his fathers’ tribe.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמַּטֶּה אֶל מַטֶּה כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו יִדְבְּקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמַּטֶּה אֶל מַטֶּה כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו יִדְבְּקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So a legacy of the children of Israel will not turn from
tribe to tribe, but the children of Israel shall each
cling to the legacy of his fathers’ tribe.

translation.text: so that no inheritance of the Israelites shall be transferred from one tribe ancestral tribes.

verses.english:
And any daughter who inherits a legacy from the tribes of
the children of Israel shall become a wife to someone from
a family of her father’s tribe, so that the children of
Israel will each inherit his fathers’ legacy,
verses.hebrew: וְכל בַּת יֹרֶשֶׁת נַחֲלָה מִמַּטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶחָד מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אָבִיהָ תִּהְיֶה לְאִשָּׁה לְמַעַן יִירְשׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְכל בַּת יֹרֶשֶׁת נַחֲלָה מִמַּטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶחָד מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אָבִיהָ תִּהְיֶה לְאִשָּׁה לְמַעַן יִירְשׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And any daughter who inherits a legacy from the tribes of
the children of Israel shall become a wife to someone from
a family of her father’s tribe, so that the children of
Israel will each inherit his fathers’ legacy,

translation.text: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the Israelites shall marry one from the clan of her father's tribe, so that all Israelites may continue to possess their ancestral inheritance.

verses.english:
and a legacy will not turn from a tribe to another tribe,
but the tribes of the children of Israel shall each cling
to its legacy.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה מִמַּטֶּה לְמַטֶּה אַחֵר כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ יִדְבְּקוּ מַטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה מִמַּטֶּה לְמַטֶּה אַחֵר כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ יִדְבְּקוּ מַטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and a legacy will not turn from a tribe to another tribe,
but the tribes of the children of Israel shall each cling
to its legacy.”

translation.text: No inheritance shall be transferred from one tribe to another; for each of the tribes of the Israelites shall retain its own inheritance.'"

verses.english: As YHWH commanded Moses, so Zelophehad’s daughters did.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד׃

english.text: As YHWH commanded Moses, so Zelophehad’s daughters did.

translation.text: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah and Milcah and Noah,
Zelophehad’s daughters, became wives to their uncles’
sons.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּהְיֶינָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד לִבְנֵי דֹדֵיהֶן לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּהְיֶינָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד לִבְנֵי דֹדֵיהֶן לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah and Milcah and Noah,
Zelophehad’s daughters, became wives to their uncles’
sons.

translation.text: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, married sons of their father's brothers.

verses.english:
They became wives within the families of the children of
Manasseh son of Joseph, and their legacy was on the tribe
of their father’s family.
verses.hebrew: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text:
They became wives within the families of the children of
Manasseh son of Joseph, and their legacy was on the tribe
of their father’s family.

translation.text: They were and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's clan.

verses.english:
These are the commandments and the judgments that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand to the children of Israel in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
These are the commandments and the judgments that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand to the children of Israel in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.

translation.text: These are the commandments and the ordinances that the LORD the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.english:
These are the words that Moses spoke to all of Israel
across the Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite
Suph between Paran and Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth and
Di-zahab,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּעֲרָבָה מוֹל סוּף בֵּין פָּארָן וּבֵין תֹּפֶל וְלָבָן וַחֲצֵרֹת וְדִי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּעֲרָבָה מוֹל סוּף בֵּין פָּארָן וּבֵין תֹּפֶל וְלָבָן וַחֲצֵרֹת וְדִי זָהָב׃

english.text:
These are the words that Moses spoke to all of Israel
across the Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite
Suph between Paran and Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth and
Di-zahab,

translation.text: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab.

verses.english:
eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir up to
Kadesh-barnea.
verses.hebrew: אַחַד עָשָׂר יוֹם מֵחֹרֵב דֶּרֶךְ הַר שֵׂעִיר עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: אַחַד עָשָׂר יוֹם מֵחֹרֵב דֶּרֶךְ הַר שֵׂעִיר עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

english.text:
eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir up to
Kadesh-barnea.

translation.text: (By the way of Mount Seir it takes eleven days to reach Kadesh-barnea from Horeb.)

verses.english:
And it was in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on
the first of the month, Moses spoke to the children of
Israel of everything that YHWH commanded him to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּעַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּעַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And it was in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on
the first of the month, Moses spoke to the children of
Israel of everything that YHWH commanded him to them.

translation.text: In the the Israelites just as the LORD had commanded him to speak to them.

verses.english:
After he struck Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in
Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth at
Edrei,
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי הַכֹּתוֹ אֵת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֵת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹת בְּאֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרֵי הַכֹּתוֹ אֵת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֵת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹת בְּאֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
After he struck Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in
Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth at
Edrei,

translation.text: and in Edrei.

verses.english:
across the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to
make this instruction clear, saying,
verses.hebrew: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב הוֹאִיל מֹשֶׁה בֵּאֵר אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב הוֹאִיל מֹשֶׁה בֵּאֵר אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
across the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to
make this instruction clear, saying,

translation.text: Beyond the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to expound this law as follows:

verses.english:
“YHWH our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You’ve had
enough of staying at this mountain.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלֵינוּ בְּחֹרֵב לֵאמֹר רַב לָכֶם שֶׁבֶת בָּהָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלֵינוּ בְּחֹרֵב לֵאמֹר רַב לָכֶם שֶׁבֶת בָּהָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“YHWH our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You’ve had
enough of staying at this mountain.

translation.text: The LORD our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

verses.english:
Turn and travel and come to the Amorite hill country and
to all its neighboring places, in the plain, in the hill
country, and in the lowland and in the Negeb and by the
seashore, the land of the Canaanite and Lebanon as far as
the big river, the Euphrates River.
verses.hebrew: פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם וּבֹאוּ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶל כּל שְׁכֵנָיו בָּעֲרָבָה בָהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבַנֶּגֶב וּבְחוֹף הַיָּם אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַלְּבָנוֹן עַד הַנָּהָר הַגָּדֹל נְהַר פְּרָת׃

hebrew.text: פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם וּבֹאוּ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶל כּל שְׁכֵנָיו בָּעֲרָבָה בָהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבַנֶּגֶב וּבְחוֹף הַיָּם אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַלְּבָנוֹן עַד הַנָּהָר הַגָּדֹל נְהַר פְּרָת׃

english.text:
Turn and travel and come to the Amorite hill country and
to all its neighboring places, in the plain, in the hill
country, and in the lowland and in the Negeb and by the
seashore, the land of the Canaanite and Lebanon as far as
the big river, the Euphrates River.

translation.text: Resume your journey, and go into the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.english:
See: I’ve put the land in front of you. Come and possess
the land that YHWH swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their seed
after them.’
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בֹּאוּ וּרְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם וּלְזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בֹּאוּ וּרְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם וּלְזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
See: I’ve put the land in front of you. Come and possess
the land that YHWH swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their seed
after them.’

translation.text: See, I have set the land before you; go in and take possession of the land that I swore to your ancestors, to descendants after them."

verses.english:
“And I said to you at that time, saying, ‘I’m not able to
carry you by myself.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר לֹא אוּכַל לְבַדִּי שְׂאֵת אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר לֹא אוּכַל לְבַדִּי שְׂאֵת אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“And I said to you at that time, saying, ‘I’m not able to
carry you by myself.

translation.text: At that time I said to you, "I am unable by myself to bear you.

verses.english:
YHWH, your God, has made you multiply, and here today
you’re like the stars of the skies for multitude.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הִרְבָּה אֶתְכֶם וְהִנְּכֶם הַיּוֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הִרְבָּה אֶתְכֶם וְהִנְּכֶם הַיּוֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב׃

english.text:
YHWH, your God, has made you multiply, and here today
you’re like the stars of the skies for multitude.

translation.text: The as the stars of heaven.

verses.english:
(May YHWH, your fathers’ God, add on to you a thousand
times more like you! And may He bless you as He spoke to
you.)
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵכֶם יֹסֵף עֲלֵיכֶם כָּכֶם אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים וִיבָרֵךְ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵכֶם יֹסֵף עֲלֵיכֶם כָּכֶם אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים וִיבָרֵךְ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

english.text:
(May YHWH, your fathers’ God, add on to you a thousand
times more like you! And may He bless you as He spoke to
you.)

translation.text: May the LORD, the God of your ancestors, you!

verses.english:
How shall I carry your stress and your burden and your
quarrels by myself?
verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה אֶשָּׂא לְבַדִּי טרְחֲכֶם וּמַשַּׂאֲכֶם וְרִיבְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵיכָה אֶשָּׂא לְבַדִּי טרְחֲכֶם וּמַשַּׂאֲכֶם וְרִיבְכֶם׃

english.text:
How shall I carry your stress and your burden and your
quarrels by myself?

translation.text: But how can I bear the heavy burden of your disputes all by myself?

verses.english:
Get wise and understanding and knowledgeable people for
your tribes, and I’ll set them among your heads.’
verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וּנְבֹנִים וִידֻעִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וַאֲשִׂימֵם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: הָבוּ לָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וּנְבֹנִים וִידֻעִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וַאֲשִׂימֵם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶם׃

english.text:
Get wise and understanding and knowledgeable people for
your tribes, and I’ll set them among your heads.’

translation.text: Choose for each of your tribes individuals who are wise, discerning, and reputable to be your leaders."

verses.english:
“And you answered me, and you said, ‘The thing that you’ve
spoken is good to do.’
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנוּ אֹתִי וַתֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲנוּ אֹתִי וַתֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
“And you answered me, and you said, ‘The thing that you’ve
spoken is good to do.’

translation.text: You answered me, "The plan you have proposed is a good one."

verses.english:
“And I took heads of your tribes, wise and knowledgeable
people, and I set them as heads over you, chiefs of
thousands and chiefs of hundreds and chiefs of fifties and
chiefs of tens and officers for your tribes.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וִידֻעִים וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם רָאשִׁים עֲלֵיכֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת וְשֹׁטְרִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וִידֻעִים וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם רָאשִׁים עֲלֵיכֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת וְשֹׁטְרִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And I took heads of your tribes, wise and knowledgeable
people, and I set them as heads over you, chiefs of
thousands and chiefs of hundreds and chiefs of fifties and
chiefs of tens and officers for your tribes.

translation.text: So I took the leaders your tribes.

verses.english:
And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear
between your brothers, and you shall judge with justice
between a man and his brother or between him and his
alien.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶת שֹׁפְטֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹעַ בֵּין אֲחֵיכֶם וּשְׁפַטְתֶּם צֶדֶק בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין אָחִיו וּבֵין גֵּרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶת שֹׁפְטֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹעַ בֵּין אֲחֵיכֶם וּשְׁפַטְתֶּם צֶדֶק בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין אָחִיו וּבֵין גֵּרוֹ׃

english.text:
And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear
between your brothers, and you shall judge with justice
between a man and his brother or between him and his
alien.

translation.text: I charged your judges at that time: "Give the members person and another, whether citizen or resident alien.

verses.english:
You shall not recognize a face in judgment: you shall hear
the same for small and for big. Don’t be fearful in front
of a man—because justice is God’s. And a matter that will
be too hard for you, you shall bring forward to me, and
I’ll hear it.’
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַכִּירוּ פָנִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדֹל תִּשְׁמָעוּן לֹא תָגוּרוּ מִפְּנֵי אִישׁ כִּי הַמִּשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהִים הוּא וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִקְשֶׁה מִכֶּם תַּקְרִבוּן אֵלַי וּשְׁמַעְתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַכִּירוּ פָנִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדֹל תִּשְׁמָעוּן לֹא תָגוּרוּ מִפְּנֵי אִישׁ כִּי הַמִּשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהִים הוּא וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִקְשֶׁה מִכֶּם תַּקְרִבוּן אֵלַי וּשְׁמַעְתִּיו׃

english.text:
You shall not recognize a face in judgment: you shall hear
the same for small and for big. Don’t be fearful in front
of a man—because justice is God’s. And a matter that will
be too hard for you, you shall bring forward to me, and
I’ll hear it.’

translation.text: You must not be partial in judging: hear out the small and the great alike; you shall is too hard for you, bring to me, and I will hear it."

verses.english:
And I commanded you at that time all the things that you
should do.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
And I commanded you at that time all the things that you
should do.

translation.text: So I charged you at that time with all the things that you should do.

verses.english:
“And we traveled from Horeb and went through all that big
and fearful wilderness that you’ve seen by way of the
Amorite hill country as YHWH, our God, commanded us, and
we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּסַּע מֵחֹרֵב וַנֵּלֶךְ אֵת כּל הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֹתָנוּ וַנָּבֹא עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּסַּע מֵחֹרֵב וַנֵּלֶךְ אֵת כּל הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֹתָנוּ וַנָּבֹא עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

english.text:
“And we traveled from Horeb and went through all that big
and fearful wilderness that you’ve seen by way of the
Amorite hill country as YHWH, our God, commanded us, and
we came to Kadesh-barnea.

translation.text: Then, just as the LORD our God had ordered us, we set out from Kadesh-barnea.

verses.english:
And I said to you, ‘You’ve come to the Amorite hill
country that YHWH, our God, is giving us.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּאתֶם עַד הַר הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּאתֶם עַד הַר הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And I said to you, ‘You’ve come to the Amorite hill
country that YHWH, our God, is giving us.

translation.text: I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.

verses.english:
See: YHWH, our God, has put the land in front of you. Go
up, possess it as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.
Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.’
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ עֲלֵה רֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אַל תִּירָא וְאַל תֵּחָת׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ עֲלֵה רֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אַל תִּירָא וְאַל תֵּחָת׃

english.text:
See: YHWH, our God, has put the land in front of you. Go
up, possess it as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.
Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.’

translation.text: See, the LORD dismayed."

verses.english:
“And you came forward to me, all of you, and said, ‘Let’s
send men ahead of us, and let them explore the land for us
and bring us back word of the way by which we’ll go up and
of the cities to which we’ll come.’
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כֻּלְּכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ נִשְׁלְחָה אֲנָשִׁים לְפָנֵינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְיָשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָּבָר אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נַעֲלֶה בָּהּ וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָבֹא אֲלֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כֻּלְּכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ נִשְׁלְחָה אֲנָשִׁים לְפָנֵינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְיָשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָּבָר אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נַעֲלֶה בָּהּ וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָבֹא אֲלֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
“And you came forward to me, all of you, and said, ‘Let’s
send men ahead of us, and let them explore the land for us
and bring us back word of the way by which we’ll go up and
of the cities to which we’ll come.’

translation.text: All of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead of us to route by which we should go up and the cities we will come to."

verses.english:
And the thing was good in my eyes, and I took twelve men
from you, one man per tribe.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינַי הַדָּבָר וָאֶקַּח מִכֶּם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶחָד לַשָּׁבֶט׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינַי הַדָּבָר וָאֶקַּח מִכֶּם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶחָד לַשָּׁבֶט׃

english.text:
And the thing was good in my eyes, and I took twelve men
from you, one man per tribe.

translation.text: The tribe.

verses.english:
And they turned and went up to the hill country and came
to the Wadi Eshcol and spied it out.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And they turned and went up to the hill country and came
to the Wadi Eshcol and spied it out.

translation.text: They set out and went up into the hill country, and when they reached the Valley of Eshcol they spied it out

verses.english:
And they took some of the land’s fruit in their hand and
brought it down to us, and they brought us back word and
said, the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us is good.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ בְיָדָם מִפְּרִי הָאָרֶץ וַיּוֹרִדוּ אֵלֵינוּ וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָבָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹבָה הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

rebelled against YHWH’s word and acted presumptuously and
went up to the hill country.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וַתָּזִדוּ וַתַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וַתָּזִדוּ וַתַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה׃

english.text:
And I spoke to you, but you didn’t listen, and you
rebelled against YHWH’s word and acted presumptuously and
went up to the hill country.

translation.text: Although I told you, you would not presumptuously went up into the hill country.

verses.english:
And the Amorite who lives in that hill country came out at
you and pursued you the way bees do, and they crushed you
in Seir as far as Hormah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂינָה הַדְּבֹרִים וַיַּכְּתוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׂעִיר עַד חרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂינָה הַדְּבֹרִים וַיַּכְּתוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׂעִיר עַד חרְמָה׃

english.text:
And the Amorite who lives in that hill country came out at
you and pursued you the way bees do, and they crushed you
in Seir as far as Hormah.

translation.text: The Amorites who bees do. They beat you down in Seir as far as Hormah.

verses.english:
And you came back and wept in front of YHWH, but YHWH
didn’t listen to your voices and didn’t hear you!
verses.hebrew: וַתָּשֻׁבוּ וַתִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקֹלְכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱזִין אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּשֻׁבוּ וַתִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקֹלְכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱזִין אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you came back and wept in front of YHWH, but YHWH
didn’t listen to your voices and didn’t hear you!

translation.text: When you voice nor pay you any attention.

verses.english:
“So you lived in Kadesh many days—as many days as you
lived there—
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בְקָדֵשׁ יָמִים רַבִּים כַּיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בְקָדֵשׁ יָמִים רַבִּים כַּיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם׃

english.text:
“So you lived in Kadesh many days—as many days as you
lived there—

translation.text: After you had stayed at Kadesh as many days as you did,

verses.english:
and we turned and traveled to the wilderness by way of
the Red Sea as YHWH spoke to me, and we stayed around
Mount Seir many days.
verses.hebrew: וַנֵּפֶן וַנִּסַּע הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַנָּסב אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַנֵּפֶן וַנִּסַּע הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַנָּסב אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
and we turned and traveled to the wilderness by way of
the Red Sea as YHWH spoke to me, and we stayed around
Mount Seir many days.

translation.text: we journeyed back into the wilderness, in the Seir for many days.

verses.english: “And YHWH said to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: “And YHWH said to me, saying,

translation.text: Then the LORD said to me:

verses.english:
‘You’ve had enough of staying around this mountain. Turn
north.
verses.hebrew: רַב לָכֶם סֹב אֶת הָהָר הַזֶּה פְּנוּ לָכֶם צָפֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: רַב לָכֶם סֹב אֶת הָהָר הַזֶּה פְּנוּ לָכֶם צָפֹנָה׃

english.text:
‘You’ve had enough of staying around this mountain. Turn
north.

translation.text: "You have been skirting this hill country long enough. Head north,

verses.english:
And command the people, saying: You’re crossing the border
of your brothers, the children of Esau, who live in Seir.
And they’ll be afraid of you, so be very watchful.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָעָם צַו לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים בִּגְבוּל אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְיִירְאוּ מִכֶּם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָעָם צַו לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים בִּגְבוּל אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְיִירְאוּ מִכֶּם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And command the people, saying: You’re crossing the border
of your brothers, the children of Esau, who live in Seir.
And they’ll be afraid of you, so be very watchful.

translation.text: and charge the kindred, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so, be very careful

verses.english:
Don’t get agitated at them, because I won’t give you any
of their land, even as much as a footstep, because I’ve
given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.
verses.hebrew: אַל תִּתְגָּרוּ בָם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לָכֶם מֵאַרְצָם עַד מִדְרַךְ כַּף רָגֶל כִּי יְרֻשָּׁה לְעֵשָׂו נָתַתִּי אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּתְגָּרוּ בָם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לָכֶם מֵאַרְצָם עַד מִדְרַךְ כַּף רָגֶל כִּי יְרֻשָּׁה לְעֵשָׂו נָתַתִּי אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר׃

english.text:
Don’t get agitated at them, because I won’t give you any
of their land, even as much as a footstep, because I’ve
given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.

translation.text: not to engage in battle with them, for I will not give you even so much as a foot's length of their land, since I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.

verses.english:
Food: you shall buy from them with money, and then you’ll
eat. And water, too: you shall purchase from them with
money, and then you’ll drink.
verses.hebrew: אֹכֶל תִּשְׁבְּרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְגַם מַיִם תִּכְרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֹכֶל תִּשְׁבְּרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְגַם מַיִם תִּכְרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶם׃

english.text:
Food: you shall buy from them with money, and then you’ll
eat. And water, too: you shall purchase from them with
money, and then you’ll drink.

translation.text: You shall purchase water from them for money, so that you may drink.

verses.english:
Because YHWH, your God, has blessed you in all your hand’s
work. He has known your walking in this big wilderness.
These forty years, YHWH, your God, has been with you. You
haven’t lacked a thing.’
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בֵּרַכְךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ יָדַע לֶכְתְּךָ אֶת הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ לֹא חָסַרְתָּ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בֵּרַכְךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ יָדַע לֶכְתְּךָ אֶת הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ לֹא חָסַרְתָּ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Because YHWH, your God, has blessed you in all your hand’s
work. He has known your walking in this big wilderness.
These forty years, YHWH, your God, has been with you. You
haven’t lacked a thing.’

translation.text: Surely the LORD God has been with you; you have lacked nothing."

verses.english:
So we passed by our brothers, the children of Esau, who
live in Seir, from the way of the plain, from Eilat, and
from Ezion-geber, and we turned and passed by way of the
wilderness of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַנַּעֲבֹר מֵאֵת אַחֵינוּ בְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר מִדֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה מֵאֵילַת וּמֵעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר ס וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעֲבֹר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּעֲבֹר מֵאֵת אַחֵינוּ בְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר מִדֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה מֵאֵילַת וּמֵעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר ס וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעֲבֹר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
So we passed by our brothers, the children of Esau, who
live in Seir, from the way of the plain, from Eilat, and
from Ezion-geber, and we turned and passed by way of the
wilderness of Moab.

translation.text: So we passed by route of the Arabah, and leaving behind Elath and Ezion-geber.

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t oppose Moab and don’t agitate
them with war, because I won’t give you a possession from
its land, because I’ve given Ar as a possession to the
children of Lot.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תָּצַר אֶת מוֹאָב וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם מִלְחָמָה כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לְךָ מֵאַרְצוֹ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נָתַתִּי אֶת עָר יְרֻשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תָּצַר אֶת מוֹאָב וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם מִלְחָמָה כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לְךָ מֵאַרְצוֹ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נָתַתִּי אֶת עָר יְרֻשָּׁה׃

english.text:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t oppose Moab and don’t agitate
them with war, because I won’t give you a possession from
its land, because I’ve given Ar as a possession to the
children of Lot.

translation.text: the LORD said to me: "Do not harass Moab or engage them in battle, for I will not give you any of its land as a possession, since I have given Ar as a possession to the descendants of Lot."

verses.english:
The Emim had lived there before, a people that was big and
numerous and tall as giants.
verses.hebrew: הָאֵמִים לְפָנִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים׃

hebrew.text: הָאֵמִים לְפָנִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים׃

english.text:
The Emim had lived there before, a people that was big and
numerous and tall as giants.

translation.text: (The Emim — a large it.

verses.english:
They were also thought to be Rephaim, like the giants, but
the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.hebrew: רְפָאִים יֵחָשְׁבוּ אַף הֵם כָּעֲנָקִים וְהַמֹּאָבִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם אֵמִים׃

hebrew.text: רְפָאִים יֵחָשְׁבוּ אַף הֵם כָּעֲנָקִים וְהַמֹּאָבִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם אֵמִים׃

english.text:
They were also thought to be Rephaim, like the giants, but
the Moabites call them Emim.

translation.text: Like the Anakim, they are usually reckoned as Rephaim, though the Moabites call them Emim.

verses.english:
And the Horites lived in Seir before, but the children of
Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them in front of them
and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of its
possession that YHWH gave them.
verses.hebrew: וּבְשֵׂעִיר יָשְׁבוּ הַחֹרִים לְפָנִים וּבְנֵי עֵשָׂו יִירָשׁוּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַּחְתָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשֵׂעִיר יָשְׁבוּ הַחֹרִים לְפָנִים וּבְנֵי עֵשָׂו יִירָשׁוּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַּחְתָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And the Horites lived in Seir before, but the children of
Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them in front of them
and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of its
possession that YHWH gave them.

translation.text: Moreover, the Horim had formerly land that the LORD gave them as a possession.)

verses.english:
Now get up and cross the Wadi Zered.’ And we crossed the
Wadi Zered.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה קֻמוּ וְעִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד וַנַּעֲבֹר אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה קֻמוּ וְעִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד וַנַּעֲבֹר אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד׃

english.text:
Now get up and cross the Wadi Zered.’ And we crossed the
Wadi Zered.

translation.text: "Now then, proceed to cross over the Wadi Zered." So we crossed over the Wadi Zered.

verses.english:
And the days that we went from Kadesh-barnea until we
crossed the Wadi Zered were thirty-eight years, until the
end of all the generation, the men of war, from among the
camp, as YHWH swore to them.
verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ עַד אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ אֶת נַחַל זֶרֶד שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ עַד אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ אֶת נַחַל זֶרֶד שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And the days that we went from Kadesh-barnea until we
crossed the Wadi Zered were thirty-eight years, until the
end of all the generation, the men of war, from among the
camp, as YHWH swore to them.

translation.text: And the length of time we had thirty-eight years, until the entire generation of warriors had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn concerning them.

verses.english:
And YHWH’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from
among the camp until their end.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם יַד יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בָּם לְהֻמָּם מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד תֻּמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם יַד יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בָּם לְהֻמָּם מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד תֻּמָּם׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from
among the camp until their end.

translation.text: Indeed, the until all had perished.

verses.english:
“And it was when all the men of war had ended, dying from
among the people,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר תַּמּוּ כּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה לָמוּת מִקֶּרֶב הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר תַּמּוּ כּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה לָמוּת מִקֶּרֶב הָעָם׃

english.text:
“And it was when all the men of war had ended, dying from
among the people,

translation.text: Just as soon as all the warriors had died off from among the people,

verses.english: and YHWH spoke to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: and YHWH spoke to me, saying,

translation.text: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.english: ‘You’re crossing the border of Moab, Ar, today.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת גְּבוּל מוֹאָב אֶת עָר׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת גְּבוּל מוֹאָב אֶת עָר׃

english.text: ‘You’re crossing the border of Moab, Ar, today.

translation.text: "Today you are going to cross the boundary of Moab at Ar.

verses.english:
And when you come close opposite the children of Ammon,
don’t oppose them and don’t get agitated at them, because
I won’t give you a possession from the land of the
children of Ammon, because I’ve given it as a possession
to the children of Lot.’
verses.hebrew: וְקָרַבְתָּ מוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אַל תְּצֻרֵם וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן מֵאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְךָ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נְתַתִּיהָ יְרֻשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְקָרַבְתָּ מוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אַל תְּצֻרֵם וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן מֵאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְךָ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נְתַתִּיהָ יְרֻשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And when you come close opposite the children of Ammon,
don’t oppose them and don’t get agitated at them, because
I won’t give you a possession from the land of the
children of Ammon, because I’ve given it as a possession
to the children of Lot.’

translation.text: When you approach the frontier of the given it to the descendants of Lot."

verses.english:
(It, too, was thought to be a land of Rephaim: Rephaim had
lived there before, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים תֵּחָשֵׁב אַף הִוא רְפָאִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ לְפָנִים וְהָעַמֹּנִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם זַמְזֻמִּים׃

hebrew.text: אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים תֵּחָשֵׁב אַף הִוא רְפָאִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ לְפָנִים וְהָעַמֹּנִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם זַמְזֻמִּים׃

english.text:
(It, too, was thought to be a land of Rephaim: Rephaim had
lived there before, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

translation.text: (It also is usually reckoned as a Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

verses.english:
a people that was big and numerous and tall as giants, but
YHWH destroyed them in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and lived in their place,
verses.hebrew: עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵם יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

hebrew.text: עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵם יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

english.text:
a people that was big and numerous and tall as giants, but
YHWH destroyed them in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and lived in their place,

translation.text: a strong and numerous people, Ammonites so that they could dispossess them and settle in their place.

verses.english:
as He did for the children of Esau, who live in Seir, in
that He destroyed the Horite in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and have lived in their place to this
day.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִבְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֶת הַחֹרִי מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִבְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֶת הַחֹרִי מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
as He did for the children of Esau, who live in Seir, in
that He destroyed the Horite in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and have lived in their place to this
day.

translation.text: He did the same for the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, by and settle in their place even to this day.

verses.english:
So the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the
Caphtorites who left Caphtor destroyed them, and they
dwelled in their place.)
verses.hebrew: וְהָעַוִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּחֲצֵרִים עַד עַזָּה כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתֹּר הִשְׁמִידֻם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעַוִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּחֲצֵרִים עַד עַזָּה כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתֹּר הִשְׁמִידֻם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

english.text:
So the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the
Caphtorites who left Caphtor destroyed them, and they
dwelled in their place.)

translation.text: As for the Avvim, who had from Caphtor, destroyed them and settled in their place.)

verses.english:
‘Get up, travel, and cross the Wadi Arnon. See: I’ve put
Sihon, king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land in your
hand. Begin. Dispossess! And you shall agitate him with
war.
verses.hebrew: קוּמוּ סְּעוּ וְעִבְרוּ אֶת נַחַל אַרְנֹן רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ וְהִתְגָּר בּוֹ מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: קוּמוּ סְּעוּ וְעִבְרוּ אֶת נַחַל אַרְנֹן רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ וְהִתְגָּר בּוֹ מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
‘Get up, travel, and cross the Wadi Arnon. See: I’ve put
Sihon, king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land in your
hand. Begin. Dispossess! And you shall agitate him with
war.

translation.text: "Proceed possession by engaging him in battle.

verses.english:
This day I’ll begin to put an awe of you and a fear of you
on the faces of the peoples under all the skies so that
when they’ll hear the news of you they’ll tremble and
writhe in front of you.’
verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָחֵל תֵּת פַּחְדְּךָ וְיִרְאָתְךָ עַל פְּנֵי הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן שִׁמְעֲךָ וְרָגְזוּ וְחָלוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָחֵל תֵּת פַּחְדְּךָ וְיִרְאָתְךָ עַל פְּנֵי הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן שִׁמְעֲךָ וְרָגְזוּ וְחָלוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
This day I’ll begin to put an awe of you and a fear of you
on the faces of the peoples under all the skies so that
when they’ll hear the news of you they’ll tremble and
writhe in front of you.’

translation.text: This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon the peoples everywhere under heaven; because of you."

verses.english:
“And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to
Sihon, king of Heshbon, words of peace, saying,
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים מִמִּדְבַּר קְדֵמוֹת אֶל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן דִּבְרֵי שָׁלוֹם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים מִמִּדְבַּר קְדֵמוֹת אֶל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן דִּבְרֵי שָׁלוֹם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to
Sihon, king of Heshbon, words of peace, saying,

translation.text: So I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to King Sihon of Heshbon with the following terms of peace:

verses.english:
‘Let me pass through your land. I’ll go on the road, on
the road! I won’t turn right or left.
verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֵלֵךְ לֹא אָסוּר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

hebrew.text: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֵלֵךְ לֹא אָסוּר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

english.text:
‘Let me pass through your land. I’ll go on the road, on
the road! I won’t turn right or left.

translation.text: "If you let me aside neither to the right nor to the left.

verses.english:
Food: you’ll sell me for money, and I’ll eat. And water:
you’ll give me for money, and I’ll drink. Only let me pass
on my feet
verses.hebrew: אֹכֶל בַּכֶּסֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵנִי וְאָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם בַּכֶּסֶף תִּתֶּן לִי וְשָׁתִיתִי רַק אֶעְבְּרָה בְרַגְלָי׃

hebrew.text: אֹכֶל בַּכֶּסֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵנִי וְאָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם בַּכֶּסֶף תִּתֶּן לִי וְשָׁתִיתִי רַק אֶעְבְּרָה בְרַגְלָי׃

english.text:
Food: you’ll sell me for money, and I’ll eat. And water:
you’ll give me for money, and I’ll drink. Only let me pass
on my feet

translation.text: You shall sell me food for may drink. Only allow me to pass through on foot —

verses.english:
as the children of Esau, who live in Seir, and the
Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I’ll cross the
Jordan to the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us.’
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְהַמּוֹאָבִים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָר עַד אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְהַמּוֹאָבִים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָר עַד אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

english.text:
as the children of Esau, who live in Seir, and the
Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I’ll cross the
Jordan to the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us.’

translation.text: just as the the LORD our God is giving us."

verses.english:
But Sihon, king of Heshbon, was not willing to let us pass
through it, because YHWH, your God, had hardened his
spirit and made his heart bold in order to put him in your
hand—as it is this day.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבָה סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַעֲבִרֵנוּ בּוֹ כִּי הִקְשָׁה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת רוּחוֹ וְאִמֵּץ אֶת לְבָבוֹ לְמַעַן תִּתּוֹ בְיָדְךָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אָבָה סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַעֲבִרֵנוּ בּוֹ כִּי הִקְשָׁה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת רוּחוֹ וְאִמֵּץ אֶת לְבָבוֹ לְמַעַן תִּתּוֹ בְיָדְךָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But Sihon, king of Heshbon, was not willing to let us pass
through it, because YHWH, your God, had hardened his
spirit and made his heart bold in order to put him in your
hand—as it is this day.

translation.text: But King Sihon of Heshbon was not he has now done.

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘See: I’ve begun to put Sihon and
his land before you. Begin. Dispossess, so as to possess
his land.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רְאֵה הַחִלֹּתִי תֵּת לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת סִיחֹן וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רְאֵה הַחִלֹּתִי תֵּת לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת סִיחֹן וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘See: I’ve begun to put Sihon and
his land before you. Begin. Dispossess, so as to possess
his land.’

translation.text: The LORD said to me, "See, I have begun to give Sihon and his land over to you. Begin now to take possession of his land."

verses.english:
“And Sihon came out at us, he and all his people, for war
at Jahaz.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה יָהְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה יָהְצָה׃

english.text:
“And Sihon came out at us, he and all his people, for war
at Jahaz.

translation.text: So when Sihon came out against us, he and all his people for battle at Jahaz,

verses.english:
And YHWH, our God, put him before us, and we struck him
and his sons and all his people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַנַּךְ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַנַּךְ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, our God, put him before us, and we struck him
and his sons and all his people.

translation.text: with his offspring and all his people.

verses.english:
And we captured all his cities at that time, and we put
every city to complete destruction: men and women and
infants. We didn’t leave a remnant.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַנַּחֲרֵם אֶת כּל עִיר מְתִם וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף לֹא הִשְׁאַרְנוּ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַנַּחֲרֵם אֶת כּל עִיר מְתִם וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף לֹא הִשְׁאַרְנוּ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
And we captured all his cities at that time, and we put
every city to complete destruction: men and women and
infants. We didn’t leave a remnant.

translation.text: At that time we captured all his children. We left not a single survivor.

verses.english:
Only the animals we despoiled for ourselves, and the spoil
of the cities that we captured.
verses.hebrew: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה בָּזַזְנוּ לָנוּ וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָכָדְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה בָּזַזְנוּ לָנוּ וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָכָדְנוּ׃

english.text:
Only the animals we despoiled for ourselves, and the spoil
of the cities that we captured.

translation.text: Only the livestock we kept as captured.

verses.english:
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon and the
city that is in the wadi, to Gilead, there wasn’t a town
that was too high for us. YHWH, our God, put it all before
us.
verses.hebrew: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּנַּחַל וְעַד הַגִּלְעָד לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂגְבָה מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַכֹּל נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּנַּחַל וְעַד הַגִּלְעָד לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂגְבָה מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַכֹּל נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ׃

english.text:
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon and the
city that is in the wadi, to Gilead, there wasn’t a town
that was too high for us. YHWH, our God, put it all before
us.

translation.text: From Aroer on the edge of the Wadi Arnon (including the town that is in the wadi itself) as far as Gilead, there was no citadel too high for us. The LORD our God gave everything to us.

verses.english:
Only to the land of the children of Ammon did you not come
close, all along the Wadi Jabbok, and the cities of the
hill country, and whatever YHWH, our God, commanded.
verses.hebrew: רַק אֶל אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לֹא קָרָבְתָּ כּל יַד נַחַל יַבֹּק וְעָרֵי הָהָר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: רַק אֶל אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לֹא קָרָבְתָּ כּל יַד נַחַל יַבֹּק וְעָרֵי הָהָר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
Only to the land of the children of Ammon did you not come
close, all along the Wadi Jabbok, and the cities of the
hill country, and whatever YHWH, our God, commanded.

translation.text: You did not country, just as the LORD our God had charged.

verses.english:
“And we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og,
king of Bashan, came out at us, he and all his people, for
war at Edrei.
verses.hebrew: וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעַל דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעַל דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
“And we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og,
king of Bashan, came out at us, he and all his people, for
war at Edrei.

translation.text: When we headed up the road to Bashan, King Og of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, for battle at Edrei.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t be afraid of him, because I’ve
put him and all his people and his land in your hand, and
you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the
Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t be afraid of him, because I’ve
put him and all his people and his land in your hand, and
you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the
Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.’

translation.text: The LORD said Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

verses.english:
And YHWH, our God, put Og, king of Bashan, and all his
people in our hand as well, and we struck him until he did
not have a remnant left.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ גַּם אֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַנַּכֵּהוּ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ גַּם אֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַנַּכֵּהוּ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
And YHWH, our God, put Og, king of Bashan, and all his
people in our hand as well, and we struck him until he did
not have a remnant left.

translation.text: So the LORD our God also down until not a single survivor was left.

verses.english:
And we captured all his cities at that time. There wasn’t
a town that we didn’t take from them: sixty cities—all the
region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא לָקַחְנוּ מֵאִתָּם שִׁשִּׁים עִיר כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא לָקַחְנוּ מֵאִתָּם שִׁשִּׁים עִיר כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
And we captured all his cities at that time. There wasn’t
a town that we didn’t take from them: sixty cities—all the
region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

translation.text: At that time we captured all towns, the whole region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.english:
All of these were ortified cities—a high wall, double
gates, and a bar—aside from a great many unwalled cities.
verses.hebrew: כּל אֵלֶּה עָרִים בְּצֻרֹת חוֹמָה גְבֹהָה דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ לְבַד מֵעָרֵי הַפְּרָזִי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה עָרִים בְּצֻרֹת חוֹמָה גְבֹהָה דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ לְבַד מֵעָרֵי הַפְּרָזִי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
All of these were ortified cities—a high wall, double
gates, and a bar—aside from a great many unwalled cities.

translation.text: All besides a great many villages.

verses.english:
And we completely destroyed them as we did to Sihon, king
of Heshbon, completely destroying every city: men, women,
and infants.
verses.hebrew: וַנַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂינוּ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַחֲרֵם כּל עִיר מְתִם הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂינוּ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַחֲרֵם כּל עִיר מְתִם הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

english.text:
And we completely destroyed them as we did to Sihon, king
of Heshbon, completely destroying every city: men, women,
and infants.

translation.text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we men, women, and children.

verses.english:
And we despoiled all the animals and the spoil of the
cities for ourselves.
verses.hebrew: וְכל הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים בַּזּוֹנוּ לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים בַּזּוֹנוּ לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And we despoiled all the animals and the spoil of the
cities for ourselves.

translation.text: But all the livestock and the plunder of the towns we kept as spoil for ourselves.

verses.english:
And at that time we took the land from the hand of the two
kings of the Amorites that was across the Jordan, from the
Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon
verses.hebrew: וַנִּקַּח בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִיַּד שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִנַּחַל אַרְנֹן עַד הַר חֶרְמוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּקַּח בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִיַּד שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִנַּחַל אַרְנֹן עַד הַר חֶרְמוֹן׃

english.text:
And at that time we took the land from the hand of the two
kings of the Amorites that was across the Jordan, from the
Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon

translation.text: So at that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land beyond the Jordan, from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon

verses.english:
(Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it
Senir),
verses.hebrew: צִידֹנִים יִקְרְאוּ לְחֶרְמוֹן שִׂרְיֹן וְהָאֱמֹרִי יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ שְׂנִיר׃

hebrew.text: צִידֹנִים יִקְרְאוּ לְחֶרְמוֹן שִׂרְיֹן וְהָאֱמֹרִי יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ שְׂנִיר׃

english.text:
(Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it
Senir),

translation.text: (the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, while the Amorites call it Senir),

verses.english:
all the cities of the plain and all of Gilead and all of
Bashan as far as Salcah and Edrei, cities of Og’s kingdom
in Bashan.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן עַד סַלְכָה וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן עַד סַלְכָה וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
all the cities of the plain and all of Gilead and all of
Bashan as far as Salcah and Edrei, cities of Og’s kingdom
in Bashan.

translation.text: all the as Salecah and Edrei, towns of Og's kingdom in Bashan.

verses.english:
Because only Og, king of Bashan, was left from the rest of
the Rephaim. Here, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron.
Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Its length is
nine cubits and its width is four cubits by a man’s cubit.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רַק עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הִנֵּה עַרְשׂוֹ עֶרֶשׂ בַּרְזֶל הֲלֹה הִוא בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן תֵּשַׁע אַמּוֹת ארְכָּהּ וְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת רחְבָּהּ בְּאַמַּת אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי רַק עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הִנֵּה עַרְשׂוֹ עֶרֶשׂ בַּרְזֶל הֲלֹה הִוא בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן תֵּשַׁע אַמּוֹת ארְכָּהּ וְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת רחְבָּהּ בְּאַמַּת אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Because only Og, king of Bashan, was left from the rest of
the Rephaim. Here, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron.
Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Its length is
nine cubits and its width is four cubits by a man’s cubit.

translation.text: (Now only common cubit it is nine cubits long and four cubits wide.)

verses.english:
And we took possession of this land at that time. I gave
the Reubenites and the Gadites from Aroer, which is on the
Wadi Arnon, and half of the hill country of Gilead and its
cities.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת יָרַשְׁנוּ בָּעֵת הַהִוא מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל נַחַל אַרְנֹן וַחֲצִי הַר הַגִּלְעָד וְעָרָיו נָתַתִּי לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת יָרַשְׁנוּ בָּעֵת הַהִוא מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל נַחַל אַרְנֹן וַחֲצִי הַר הַגִּלְעָד וְעָרָיו נָתַתִּי לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי׃

english.text:
And we took possession of this land at that time. I gave
the Reubenites and the Gadites from Aroer, which is on the
Wadi Arnon, and half of the hill country of Gilead and its
cities.

translation.text: As for the Wadi Arnon, as well as half the hill country of Gilead with its towns,

verses.english:
And I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, Og’s
kingdom, to half of the tribe of Manasseh. All the region
of Argob: all of that Bashan is called ‘the land of the
Rephaim.’
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג נָתַתִּי לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה כֹּל חֶבֶל הָאַרְגֹּב לְכל הַבָּשָׁן הַהוּא יִקָּרֵא אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג נָתַתִּי לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה כֹּל חֶבֶל הָאַרְגֹּב לְכל הַבָּשָׁן הַהוּא יִקָּרֵא אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים׃

english.text:
And I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, Og’s
kingdom, to half of the tribe of Manasseh. All the region
of Argob: all of that Bashan is called ‘the land of the
Rephaim.’

translation.text: Bashan used to be called a land of Rephaim;

verses.english:
Jair son of Manasseh had taken all the region of Argob as
far as the border of the Geshurites nd the Maachathites,
and he called them, the Bashan, by his name, Havvoth-Jair,
to this day.
verses.hebrew: יָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לָקַח אֶת כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב עַד גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹ אֶת הַבָּשָׁן חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: יָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לָקַח אֶת כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב עַד גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹ אֶת הַבָּשָׁן חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Jair son of Manasseh had taken all the region of Argob as
far as the border of the Geshurites nd the Maachathites,
and he called them, the Bashan, by his name, Havvoth-Jair,
to this day.

translation.text: Jair the Manassite — after himself, Havvoth-jair, as it is to this day.)

verses.english: And I gave Gilead to Machir.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמָכִיר נָתַתִּי אֶת הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמָכִיר נָתַתִּי אֶת הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

translation.text: To Machir I gave Gilead.

verses.english:
And I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites from Gilead to
the Wadi Arnon, the middle of the wadi being the border,
and to the Wadi Jabbok, the border of the children of
Ammon,
