verses.hebrew: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי נָתַתִּי מִן הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד נַחַל אַרְנֹן תּוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וּגְבֻל וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי נָתַתִּי מִן הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד נַחַל אַרְנֹן תּוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וּגְבֻל וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites from Gilead to
the Wadi Arnon, the middle of the wadi being the border,
and to the Wadi Jabbok, the border of the children of
Ammon,

translation.text: And to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory Ammonites;

verses.english:
and the plain, with the Jordan being the border, from the
Kinneret to the sea of the plain, the Dead Sea, below the
slopes of Pisgah eastward.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲרָבָה וְהַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל מִכִּנֶּרֶת וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם הַמֶּלַח תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֲרָבָה וְהַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל מִכִּנֶּרֶת וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם הַמֶּלַח תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
and the plain, with the Jordan being the border, from the
Kinneret to the sea of the plain, the Dead Sea, below the
slopes of Pisgah eastward.

translation.text: the Arabah also, with the Jordan and its banks, from lower slopes of Pisgah on the east.

verses.english:
“And I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘YHWH, your
God, has given you this land to take possession of it. You
shall pass equipped, all the warriors, in front of your
brothers, the children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲצַו אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ חֲלוּצִים תַּעַבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל בְּנֵי חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲצַו אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ חֲלוּצִים תַּעַבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל בְּנֵי חָיִל׃

english.text:
“And I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘YHWH, your
God, has given you this land to take possession of it. You
shall pass equipped, all the warriors, in front of your
brothers, the children of Israel.

translation.text: At that time, I charged you as follows: "Although the LORD your God has given you this land to occupy, all your troops shall cross over armed as the vanguard of your Israelite kin.

verses.english:
Only your wives and your infants and your livestock (I
knew that you have a great amount of livestock) shall stay
in your cities that I’ve given you
verses.hebrew: רַק נְשֵׁיכֶם וְטַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵכֶם יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מִקְנֶה רַב לָכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: רַק נְשֵׁיכֶם וְטַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵכֶם יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מִקְנֶה רַב לָכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Only your wives and your infants and your livestock (I
knew that you have a great amount of livestock) shall stay
in your cities that I’ve given you

translation.text: Only your wives, your children, behind in the towns that I have given to you.

verses.english:
until YHWH will give your brothers rest like you, and
they, too, will get possession of the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving them across the Jordan. Then you shall go
back, each to his possession that I’ve given you.’
verses.hebrew: עַד אֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם הֵם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ לִירֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: עַד אֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם הֵם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ לִירֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

english.text:
until YHWH will give your brothers rest like you, and
they, too, will get possession of the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving them across the Jordan. Then you shall go
back, each to his possession that I’ve given you.’

translation.text: When the LORD gives you may return to the property that I have given to you."

verses.english:
And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes,
that have seen everything that YHWH, your God, has done to
these two kings: so may YHWH do to all the kingdoms to
which you’re crossing.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת יְהוֹשׁוּעַ צִוֵּיתִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר עֵינֶיךָ הָרֹאֹת אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לְכל הַמַּמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת יְהוֹשׁוּעַ צִוֵּיתִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר עֵינֶיךָ הָרֹאֹת אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לְכל הַמַּמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes,
that have seen everything that YHWH, your God, has done to
these two kings: so may YHWH do to all the kingdoms to
which you’re crossing.

translation.text: And I LORD will do to all the kingdoms into which you are about to cross.

verses.english:
You shall not fear them, because YHWH, your God: He is the
one fighting for you.’
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּירָאוּם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּירָאוּם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not fear them, because YHWH, your God: He is the
one fighting for you.’

translation.text: Do not fear them, for it is the LORD your God who fights for you."

verses.english: AND I IMPLORED “And I implored YHWH at that time, saying,
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְחַנַּן אֶל יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְחַנַּן אֶל יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: AND I IMPLORED “And I implored YHWH at that time, saying,

translation.text: At that time, too, I entreated the LORD, saying:

verses.english:
‘My Lord, YHWH, you’ve begun to show your servant your
greatness and your strong hand, for who is a god in the
skies and in the earth who can do anything like your acts
and like your victories?!
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה הַחִלּוֹתָ לְהַרְאוֹת אֶת עַבְדְּךָ אֶת גּדְלְךָ וְאֶת יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה אֲשֶׁר מִי אֵל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה הַחִלּוֹתָ לְהַרְאוֹת אֶת עַבְדְּךָ אֶת גּדְלְךָ וְאֶת יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה אֲשֶׁר מִי אֵל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶךָ׃

english.text:
‘My Lord, YHWH, you’ve begun to show your servant your
greatness and your strong hand, for who is a god in the
skies and in the earth who can do anything like your acts
and like your victories?!

translation.text: "O Lord GOD, you have only begun to show your servant your greatness and your might; like yours!

verses.english:
Let me cross and see the good land that’s across the
Jordan, this good hill country and the Lebanon.’
verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן הָהָר הַטּוֹב הַזֶּה וְהַלְּבָנֹן׃

hebrew.text: אֶעְבְּרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן הָהָר הַטּוֹב הַזֶּה וְהַלְּבָנֹן׃

english.text:
Let me cross and see the good land that’s across the
Jordan, this good hill country and the Lebanon.’

translation.text: Let me cross over to see the good land beyond the Jordan, that good hill country and the Lebanon."

verses.english:
“But YHWH was cross at me for your sakes, and He would not
listen to me. And YHWH said to me, ‘You have much. Don’t
go on speaking to me anymore of this thing.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְעַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בִּי לְמַעַנְכֶם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רַב לָךְ אַל תּוֹסֶף דַּבֵּר אֵלַי עוֹד בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְעַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בִּי לְמַעַנְכֶם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רַב לָךְ אַל תּוֹסֶף דַּבֵּר אֵלַי עוֹד בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“But YHWH was cross at me for your sakes, and He would not
listen to me. And YHWH said to me, ‘You have much. Don’t
go on speaking to me anymore of this thing.

translation.text: But the LORD was to me, "Enough from you! Never speak to me of this matter again!

verses.english:
Go up to the top of Pisgah and raise your eyes west and
north and south and east and see it with your eyes,
because you won’t cross this Jordan.
verses.hebrew: עֲלֵה רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְשָׂא עֵינֶיךָ יָמָּה וְצָפֹנָה וְתֵימָנָה וּמִזְרָחָה וּרְאֵה בְעֵינֶיךָ כִּי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: עֲלֵה רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְשָׂא עֵינֶיךָ יָמָּה וְצָפֹנָה וְתֵימָנָה וּמִזְרָחָה וּרְאֵה בְעֵינֶיךָ כִּי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Go up to the top of Pisgah and raise your eyes west and
north and south and east and see it with your eyes,
because you won’t cross this Jordan.

translation.text: north, to the south, and to the east. Look well, for you shall not cross over this Jordan.

verses.english:
And command Joshua and strengthen him and make him bold,
because he will cross in front of this people, and he will
get them the land that you’ll see as a legacy.’
verses.hebrew: וְצַו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְחַזְּקֵהוּ וְאַמְּצֵהוּ כִּי הוּא יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהוּא יַנְחִיל אוֹתָם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְצַו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְחַזְּקֵהוּ וְאַמְּצֵהוּ כִּי הוּא יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהוּא יַנְחִיל אוֹתָם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And command Joshua and strengthen him and make him bold,
because he will cross in front of this people, and he will
get them the land that you’ll see as a legacy.’

translation.text: But charge Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, because it is he who shall cross over at the head of this people and who shall secure their possession of the land that you will see."

verses.english: “And we stayed in the valley opposite Bethpeor.
verses.hebrew: וַנֵּשֶׁב בַּגָּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַנֵּשֶׁב בַּגָּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר׃

english.text: “And we stayed in the valley opposite Bethpeor.

translation.text: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor.

verses.english:
“And now, Israel, listen to the laws and to the
judgments that I’m teaching you to do, so that you’ll
live, and you’ll come and take possession of the land that
YHWH, your fathers’ God, is giving you
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמַע אֶל הַחֻקִּים וְאֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּ וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמַע אֶל הַחֻקִּים וְאֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּ וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
“And now, Israel, listen to the laws and to the
judgments that I’m teaching you to do, so that you’ll
live, and you’ll come and take possession of the land that
YHWH, your fathers’ God, is giving you

translation.text: So now, Israel, give heed to the statutes and ordinances that I am land that the LORD, the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

verses.english:
You shall not add onto the thing that I command you, and
you shall not subtract from it: observing the commandments
of YHWH, your God, that I command you.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹסִפוּ עַל הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹסִפוּ עַל הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not add onto the thing that I command you, and
you shall not subtract from it: observing the commandments
of YHWH, your God, that I command you.

translation.text: You must I am charging you.

verses.english:
It’s your eyes that saw what YHWH did at Baal Peor, that
every man who went after Baal Peor: YHWH, your God,
destroyed him from among you.
verses.hebrew: עֵינֵיכֶם הָרֹאוֹת אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה בְּבַעַל פְּעוֹר כִּי כל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי בַעַל פְּעוֹר הִשְׁמִידוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: עֵינֵיכֶם הָרֹאוֹת אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה בְּבַעַל פְּעוֹר כִּי כל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי בַעַל פְּעוֹר הִשְׁמִידוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
It’s your eyes that saw what YHWH did at Baal Peor, that
every man who went after Baal Peor: YHWH, your God,
destroyed him from among you.

translation.text: You have seen for yourselves what the LORD did from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,

verses.english:
But you who were clinging to YHWH, your God: you’re all
alive today!
verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
But you who were clinging to YHWH, your God: you’re all
alive today!

translation.text: while those of you who held fast to the LORD your God are all alive today.

verses.english:
See: I’ve taught you laws and judgments as YHWH, my God,
commanded me, to do so within the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה לִמַּדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּן בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה לִמַּדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּן בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
See: I’ve taught you laws and judgments as YHWH, my God,
commanded me, to do so within the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.

translation.text: See, just as the LORD my God has charged me, I now teach you about to enter and occupy.

verses.english:
And you shall observe and do them because it’s your wisdom
and your understanding before the eyes of the peoples, in
that they will hear all these laws and will say, ‘Only a
wise and understanding people is this great nation.’
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כִּי הִוא חכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָמְרוּ רַק עַם חָכָם וְנָבוֹן הַגּוֹי הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כִּי הִוא חכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָמְרוּ רַק עַם חָכָם וְנָבוֹן הַגּוֹי הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall observe and do them because it’s your wisdom
and your understanding before the eyes of the peoples, in
that they will hear all these laws and will say, ‘Only a
wise and understanding people is this great nation.’

translation.text: You must observe them diligently, for this they hear all these statutes, will say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and discerning people!"

verses.english:
Because who is a great nation that has gods close to it
like YHWH, our God, in all our calling to him?
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי גוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים קְרֹבִים אֵלָיו כַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכל קרְאֵנוּ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִי גוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים קְרֹבִים אֵלָיו כַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכל קרְאֵנוּ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
Because who is a great nation that has gods close to it
like YHWH, our God, in all our calling to him?

translation.text: For what other great nation has a god so near to it as the LORD our God is whenever we call to him?

verses.english:
And who is a great nation that has just laws and judgments
like all this instruction that I’m putting in front of you
today?
verses.hebrew: וּמִי גּוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים צַדִּיקִם כְּכֹל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי גּוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים צַדִּיקִם כְּכֹל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And who is a great nation that has just laws and judgments
like all this instruction that I’m putting in front of you
today?

translation.text: And what other great nation has statutes and ordinances as just as this entire law that I am setting before you today?

verses.english:
“Only be watchful, and watch yourself very much, in case
you’ll forget the things that your eyes have seen and in
case they’ll turn away from your heart, all the days of
your life. But you shall make them known to your children
and to your children’s children:
verses.hebrew: רַק הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ וּשְׁמֹר נַפְשְׁךָ מְאֹד פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וּפֶן יָסוּרוּ מִלְּבָבְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: רַק הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ וּשְׁמֹר נַפְשְׁךָ מְאֹד פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וּפֶן יָסוּרוּ מִלְּבָבְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“Only be watchful, and watch yourself very much, in case
you’ll forget the things that your eyes have seen and in
case they’ll turn away from your heart, all the days of
your life. But you shall make them known to your children
and to your children’s children:

translation.text: But take care and watch yourselves closely, so as neither to forget the things that your eyes have seen nor to let them slip from your mind all children's children —

verses.english:
the day that you stood in front of YHWH, your God, at
Horeb, when YHWH said to me, ‘Assemble the people to me,
and I’ll make them hear my words so that they’ll learn to
fear me all the days that they’re living on the land, and
they’ll teach their children.’
verses.hebrew: יוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּחֹרֵב בֶּאֱמֹר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַקְהֶל לִי אֶת הָעָם וְאַשְׁמִעֵם אֶת דְּבָרָי אֲשֶׁר יִלְמְדוּן לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הֵם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה וְאֶת בְּנֵיהֶם יְלַמֵּדוּן׃

hebrew.text: יוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּחֹרֵב בֶּאֱמֹר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַקְהֶל לִי אֶת הָעָם וְאַשְׁמִעֵם אֶת דְּבָרָי אֲשֶׁר יִלְמְדוּן לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הֵם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה וְאֶת בְּנֵיהֶם יְלַמֵּדוּן׃

english.text:
the day that you stood in front of YHWH, your God, at
Horeb, when YHWH said to me, ‘Assemble the people to me,
and I’ll make them hear my words so that they’ll learn to
fear me all the days that they’re living on the land, and
they’ll teach their children.’

translation.text: how you once stood before the LORD your God I will let them hear my words, so that they may learn to fear me as long as they live on the earth, and may teach their children so";

verses.english:
And you came forward and stood below the mountain, and the
mountain was burning in fire to the heart of the skies:
darkness, cloud, and nimbus.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרְבוּן וַתַּעַמְדוּן תַּחַת הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ עַד לֵב הַשָּׁמַיִם חֹשֶׁךְ עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרְבוּן וַתַּעַמְדוּן תַּחַת הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ עַד לֵב הַשָּׁמַיִם חֹשֶׁךְ עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל׃

english.text:
And you came forward and stood below the mountain, and the
mountain was burning in fire to the heart of the skies:
darkness, cloud, and nimbus.

translation.text: you was blazing up to the very heavens, shrouded in dark clouds.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to you from inside the fire. You were
hearing the sound of words, but you weren’t seeing a form,
just sound.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּבָרִים אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים וּתְמוּנָה אֵינְכֶם רֹאִים זוּלָתִי קוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּבָרִים אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים וּתְמוּנָה אֵינְכֶם רֹאִים זוּלָתִי קוֹל׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to you from inside the fire. You were
hearing the sound of words, but you weren’t seeing a form,
just sound.

translation.text: Then but saw no form; there was only a voice.

verses.english:
And He told you His covenant that He commanded you to do,
the Ten commandments, and He wrote them on two tablets of
stones.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד לָכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת אֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד לָכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת אֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
And He told you His covenant that He commanded you to do,
the Ten commandments, and He wrote them on two tablets of
stones.

translation.text: He declared to you his commandments; and he wrote them on two stone tablets.

verses.english:
And YHWH commanded me at that time to teach you laws and
judgments, for you to do them in the land to which you’re
crossing to take possession of it.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹתִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶם אֹתָם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֹתִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶם אֹתָם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH commanded me at that time to teach you laws and
judgments, for you to do them in the land to which you’re
crossing to take possession of it.

translation.text: And the you to observe in the land that you are about to cross into and occupy.

verses.english:
And you shall be very watchful of yourselves—because you
didn’t see any form in the day that YHWH spoke to you at
Horeb from inside the fire—
verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי לֹא רְאִיתֶם כּל תְּמוּנָה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּחֹרֵב מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי לֹא רְאִיתֶם כּל תְּמוּנָה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּחֹרֵב מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall be very watchful of yourselves—because you
didn’t see any form in the day that YHWH spoke to you at
Horeb from inside the fire—

translation.text: Since you saw no form when the LORD spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire, take care and watch yourselves closely,

verses.english:
in case you’ll be corrupted, and you’ll make a statue, a
form of any figure, a design of a male or a female,
verses.hebrew: פֶּן תַּשְׁחִתוּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כּל סָמֶל תַּבְנִית זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן תַּשְׁחִתוּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כּל סָמֶל תַּבְנִית זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה׃

english.text:
in case you’ll be corrupted, and you’ll make a statue, a
form of any figure, a design of a male or a female,

translation.text: so that you do not figure — the likeness of male or female,

verses.english:
a design of any animal that’s in the earth, a design of
any winged bird that flies in the skies,
verses.hebrew: תַּבְנִית כּל בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ תַּבְנִית כּל צִפּוֹר כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר תָּעוּף בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: תַּבְנִית כּל בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ תַּבְנִית כּל צִפּוֹר כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר תָּעוּף בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
a design of any animal that’s in the earth, a design of
any winged bird that flies in the skies,

translation.text: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the air,

verses.english:
a design of anything that creeps on the ground, a design
of any fish that’s in the water under the earth,
verses.hebrew: תַּבְנִית כּל רֹמֵשׂ בָּאֲדָמָה תַּבְנִית כּל דָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: תַּבְנִית כּל רֹמֵשׂ בָּאֲדָמָה תַּבְנִית כּל דָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
a design of anything that creeps on the ground, a design
of any fish that’s in the water under the earth,

translation.text: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth.

verses.english:
and in case you’ll raise your eyes to the skies, and
you’ll see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the
array of the skies, and you’ll be moved so that you’ll bow
to them and serve them, when YHWH, your God, has allocated
them to all the peoples under all the skies.
verses.hebrew: וּפֶן תִּשָּׂא עֵינֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְרָאִיתָ אֶת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת הַיָּרֵחַ וְאֶת הַכּוֹכָבִים כֹּל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לָהֶם וַעֲבַדְתָּם אֲשֶׁר חָלַק יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֹתָם לְכֹל הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּפֶן תִּשָּׂא עֵינֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְרָאִיתָ אֶת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת הַיָּרֵחַ וְאֶת הַכּוֹכָבִים כֹּל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לָהֶם וַעֲבַדְתָּם אֲשֶׁר חָלַק יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֹתָם לְכֹל הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
and in case you’ll raise your eyes to the skies, and
you’ll see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the
array of the skies, and you’ll be moved so that you’ll bow
to them and serve them, when YHWH, your God, has allocated
them to all the peoples under all the skies.

translation.text: And when you look up to the heavens and see the sun, the moon, and the stars, all the host of everywhere under heaven.

verses.english:
But YHWH has taken you, and He has brought you out from
the iron furnace, from Egypt, to become a legacy people
for him, as it is this day.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְכֶם לָקַח יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִא אֶתְכֶם מִכּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל מִמִּצְרָיִם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶתְכֶם לָקַח יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִא אֶתְכֶם מִכּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל מִמִּצְרָיִם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But YHWH has taken you, and He has brought you out from
the iron furnace, from Egypt, to become a legacy people
for him, as it is this day.

translation.text: But the LORD has taken you and brought very own possession, as you are now.

verses.english:
“And YHWH had been incensed at me over your matters, and
He swore that I would not cross the Jordan and not come to
the good land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a
legacy.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הִתְאַנַּף בִּי עַל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לְבִלְתִּי עבְרִי אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וּלְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הִתְאַנַּף בִּי עַל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לְבִלְתִּי עבְרִי אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וּלְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
“And YHWH had been incensed at me over your matters, and
He swore that I would not cross the Jordan and not come to
the good land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a
legacy.

translation.text: The LORD was angry with me because of you, and he vowed that I that the LORD your God is giving for your possession.

verses.english:
So I am dying in this land. I’m not crossing the Jordan.
But you are crossing, and you shall possess this good
land.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אָנֹכִי מֵת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֵינֶנִּי עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם עֹבְרִים וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אָנֹכִי מֵת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֵינֶנִּי עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם עֹבְרִים וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
So I am dying in this land. I’m not crossing the Jordan.
But you are crossing, and you shall possess this good
land.

translation.text: For I am going to die in this land without crossing over the Jordan, but you are going to cross over to take possession of that good land.

verses.english:
Watch yourselves, in case you’ll forget the covenant of
YHWH, your God, that He made with you, and you’ll make a
statue of any form about which YHWH, your God, has
commanded you,
verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן תִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִמָּכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן תִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִמָּכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Watch yourselves, in case you’ll forget the covenant of
YHWH, your God, that He made with you, and you’ll make a
statue of any form about which YHWH, your God, has
commanded you,

translation.text: So be careful not your God has forbidden you.

verses.english:
because YHWH, your God: He is a consuming fire, a jealous
God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא אֵל קַנָּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא אֵל קַנָּא׃

english.text:
because YHWH, your God: He is a consuming fire, a jealous
God.

translation.text: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

verses.english:
“When you’ll produce children and grand-children and will
have been in the land long, and you’ll be corrupt and make
a statue of any form and do what is bad in the eyes of
YHWH, your God, to provoke Him,
verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹלִיד בָּנִים וּבְנֵי בָנִים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּם בָּאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל וַעֲשִׂיתֶם הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תוֹלִיד בָּנִים וּבְנֵי בָנִים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּם בָּאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל וַעֲשִׂיתֶם הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll produce children and grand-children and will
have been in the land long, and you’ll be corrupt and make
a statue of any form and do what is bad in the eyes of
YHWH, your God, to provoke Him,

translation.text: When you have had children and children's children, and become form of anything, thus doing what is evil in the sight of the LORD your God, and provoking him to anger,

verses.english:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today that you’ll perish quickly from the land to which
you’re crossing the Jordan to take possession of it. You
won’t extend days on it, but you’ll be destroyed!
verses.hebrew: הַעִידֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן מַהֵר מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי הִשָּׁמֵד תִּשָּׁמֵדוּן׃

hebrew.text: הַעִידֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן מַהֵר מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי הִשָּׁמֵד תִּשָּׁמֵדוּן׃

english.text:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today that you’ll perish quickly from the land to which
you’re crossing the Jordan to take possession of it. You
won’t extend days on it, but you’ll be destroyed!

translation.text: I call heaven and earth to witness you are crossing the Jordan to occupy; you will not live long on it, but will be utterly destroyed.

verses.english:
And YHWH will scatter you among the peoples, and you’ll be
left few in number among the nations where YHWH will drive
you.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵפִיץ יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בָּעַמִּים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֵג יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵפִיץ יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בָּעַמִּים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֵג יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH will scatter you among the peoples, and you’ll be
left few in number among the nations where YHWH will drive
you.

translation.text: The LORD will scatter you among the LORD will lead you.

verses.english:
And you’ll serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and
stone, there, that don’t see and don’t hear and don’t eat
and don’t smell.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁם אֱלֹהִים מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִרְאוּן וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן וְלֹא יֹאכְלוּן וְלֹא יְרִיחֻן׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁם אֱלֹהִים מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִרְאוּן וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן וְלֹא יֹאכְלוּן וְלֹא יְרִיחֻן׃

english.text:
And you’ll serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and
stone, there, that don’t see and don’t hear and don’t eat
and don’t smell.

translation.text: There you will serve other gods made by human nor smell.

verses.english:
“But if you’ll seek YHWH, your God, from there, then
you’ll find Him, when you’ll inquire of Him with all your
heart and all your soul.
verses.hebrew: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם מִשָּׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמָצָאתָ כִּי תִדְרְשֶׁנּוּ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם מִשָּׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמָצָאתָ כִּי תִדְרְשֶׁנּוּ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
“But if you’ll seek YHWH, your God, from there, then
you’ll find Him, when you’ll inquire of Him with all your
heart and all your soul.

translation.text: From there you will seek the LORD your God, and you will find him if you search after him with all your heart and soul.

verses.english:
When you have trouble, and all these things have found
you, in the future days, if you’ll go back to YHWH, your
God, and listen to His voice,
verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר לְךָ וּמְצָאוּךָ כֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בַּצַּר לְךָ וּמְצָאוּךָ כֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
When you have trouble, and all these things have found
you, in the future days, if you’ll go back to YHWH, your
God, and listen to His voice,

translation.text: In your you will return to the LORD your God and heed him.

verses.english:
He won’t let you down, and he won’t destroy you, because
YHWH, your God, is a merciful God, and He won’t forget
your fathers’ covenant that He swore to them.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶךָ וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת בְּרִית אֲבֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶךָ וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת בְּרִית אֲבֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם׃

english.text:
He won’t let you down, and he won’t destroy you, because
YHWH, your God, is a merciful God, and He won’t forget
your fathers’ covenant that He swore to them.

translation.text: Because the he swore to them.

verses.english:
Because ask of the earliest days that were before you,
from the day that God created a human on the earth, and
from one end of the skies to the other end of the skies:
has there been anything like this great thing? or has
any-thing like it been heard of?
verses.hebrew: כִּי שְׁאַל נָא לְיָמִים רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ לְמִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם עַל הָאָרֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעַד קְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם הֲנִהְיָה כַּדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אוֹ הֲנִשְׁמַע כָּמֹהוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שְׁאַל נָא לְיָמִים רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ לְמִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם עַל הָאָרֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעַד קְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם הֲנִהְיָה כַּדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אוֹ הֲנִשְׁמַע כָּמֹהוּ׃

english.text:
Because ask of the earliest days that were before you,
from the day that God created a human on the earth, and
from one end of the skies to the other end of the skies:
has there been anything like this great thing? or has
any-thing like it been heard of?

translation.text: For ask now about former ages, long before your own, ever since happened or has its like ever been heard of?

verses.english:
Has a people heard God’s voice speaking from inside a fire
the way you heard—and lived?
verses.hebrew: הֲשָׁמַע עָם קוֹל אֱלֹהִים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: הֲשָׁמַע עָם קוֹל אֱלֹהִים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
Has a people heard God’s voice speaking from inside a fire
the way you heard—and lived?

translation.text: Has any people ever heard the voice of a god speaking out of a fire, as you have heard, and lived?

verses.english:
Or has God put it to the test, to come to take for Himself
a people from among another people with tests, with signs,
and with wonders and with war and with a strong hand and
with an outstretched arm and with great fears like
everything that YHWH, your God, has done for you in Egypt
before your eyes?
verses.hebrew: אוֹ הֲנִסָּה אֱלֹהִים לָבוֹא לָקַחַת לוֹ גוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי בְּמַסֹּת בְּאֹתֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִים וּבְמִלְחָמָה וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמוֹרָאִים גְּדֹלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ הֲנִסָּה אֱלֹהִים לָבוֹא לָקַחַת לוֹ גוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי בְּמַסֹּת בְּאֹתֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִים וּבְמִלְחָמָה וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמוֹרָאִים גְּדֹלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Or has God put it to the test, to come to take for Himself
a people from among another people with tests, with signs,
and with wonders and with war and with a strong hand and
with an outstretched arm and with great fears like
everything that YHWH, your God, has done for you in Egypt
before your eyes?

translation.text: Or has any god ever attempted to go and take a nation for terrifying displays of power, as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

verses.english:
You have been shown in order to know that YHWH: He is God.
There is no other outside of Him.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה הרְאֵתָ לָדַעַת כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה הרְאֵתָ לָדַעַת כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
You have been shown in order to know that YHWH: He is God.
There is no other outside of Him.

translation.text: To you it was shown so that you would acknowledge that the LORD is God; there is no other besides him.

verses.english:
From the skies He had you hear His voice in order to
discipline you, and on the earth He showed you His great
fire, and you heard His words from inside the fire.
verses.hebrew: מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת קֹלוֹ לְיַסְּרֶךָּ וְעַל הָאָרֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ אֶת אִשּׁוֹ הַגְּדוֹלָה וּדְבָרָיו שָׁמַעְתָּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת קֹלוֹ לְיַסְּרֶךָּ וְעַל הָאָרֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ אֶת אִשּׁוֹ הַגְּדוֹלָה וּדְבָרָיו שָׁמַעְתָּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
From the skies He had you hear His voice in order to
discipline you, and on the earth He showed you His great
fire, and you heard His words from inside the fire.

translation.text: fire.

verses.english:
And because He loved your fathers He chose their seed
after them, so He brought you out in front of Him from
Egypt by His great power,
verses.hebrew: וְתַחַת כִּי אָהַב אֶת אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו וַיּוֹצִאֲךָ בְּפָנָיו בְּכֹחוֹ הַגָּדֹל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְתַחַת כִּי אָהַב אֶת אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו וַיּוֹצִאֲךָ בְּפָנָיו בְּכֹחוֹ הַגָּדֹל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And because He loved your fathers He chose their seed
after them, so He brought you out in front of Him from
Egypt by His great power,

translation.text: And because he loved your ancestors, he chose their presence, by his great power,

verses.english:
to dispossess bigger and more powerful nations than you in
front of you, to bring you, to give you their land as a
legacy as it is today.
verses.hebrew: לְהוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִמְּךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ לַהֲבִיאֲךָ לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: לְהוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִמְּךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ לַהֲבִיאֲךָ לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
to dispossess bigger and more powerful nations than you in
front of you, to bring you, to give you their land as a
legacy as it is today.

translation.text: driving out before you nations greater and mightier than yourselves, to bring you in, giving you their land for a possession, as it is still today.

verses.english:
And you shall know today and store it in your heart that
YHWH: He is God in the skies above and on the earth below.
There isn’t another.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד׃

english.text:
And you shall know today and store it in your heart that
YHWH: He is God in the skies above and on the earth below.
There isn’t another.

translation.text: So acknowledge today and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.

verses.english:
And you shall observe His laws and His commandments that I
command you today so it will be good for you and for your
children after you, and so that you’ll extend days on the
land that YHWH, your God, is giving you forever.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת חֻקָּיו וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן תַּאֲרִיךְ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת חֻקָּיו וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן תַּאֲרִיךְ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And you shall observe His laws and His commandments that I
command you today so it will be good for you and for your
children after you, and so that you’ll extend days on the
land that YHWH, your God, is giving you forever.”

translation.text: Keep his statutes and his commandments, which I the LORD your God is giving you for all time.

verses.english:
Then Moses distinguished three cities across the Jordan
toward the sun’s rising,
verses.hebrew: אָז יַבְדִּיל מֹשֶׁה שָׁלֹשׁ עָרִים בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה שָׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַבְדִּיל מֹשֶׁה שָׁלֹשׁ עָרִים בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה שָׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
Then Moses distinguished three cities across the Jordan
toward the sun’s rising,

translation.text: Then Moses set apart on the east side of the Jordan three cities

verses.english:
for the manslayer who would slay his neighbor without
knowing—and he had not hated him from the day before
yesterday—to flee there, so he would flee to one of these
the cities and would live:
verses.hebrew: לָנֻס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר יִרְצַח אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בִּבְלִי דַעַת וְהוּא לֹא שֹׂנֵא לוֹ מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְנָס אֶל אַחַת מִן הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: לָנֻס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר יִרְצַח אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בִּבְלִי דַעַת וְהוּא לֹא שֹׂנֵא לוֹ מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְנָס אֶל אַחַת מִן הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וָחָי׃

english.text:
for the manslayer who would slay his neighbor without
knowing—and he had not hated him from the day before
yesterday—to flee there, so he would flee to one of these
the cities and would live:

translation.text: to homicide could flee to one of these cities and live:

verses.english:
Bezer in the wilderness of the plain for the Reubenites,
and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan
for the Manassites.
verses.hebrew: אֶת בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּישֹׁר לָראוּבֵנִי וְאֶת רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד לַגָּדִי וְאֶת גּוֹלָן בַּבָּשָׁן לַמְנַשִּׁי׃

hebrew.text: אֶת בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּישֹׁר לָראוּבֵנִי וְאֶת רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד לַגָּדִי וְאֶת גּוֹלָן בַּבָּשָׁן לַמְנַשִּׁי׃

english.text:
Bezer in the wilderness of the plain for the Reubenites,
and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan
for the Manassites.

translation.text: Bezer in the Manassites.

verses.english:
And this is the instruction that Moses set before the
children of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And this is the instruction that Moses set before the
children of Israel.

translation.text: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.

verses.english:
These are the testimonies and the laws and the judgments
that Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they went
out from Egypt,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הָעֵדֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הָעֵדֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
These are the testimonies and the laws and the judgments
that Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they went
out from Egypt,

translation.text: These are the Israelites when they had come out of Egypt,

verses.english:
across the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the
land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon,
whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they
came out from the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּגַּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּגַּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
across the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the
land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon,
whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they
came out from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: beyond the Jordan in defeated when they came out of Egypt.

verses.english:
And they took possession of his land, and of the land of
Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who were
across the Jordan at the sun’s rising,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ וְאֶת אֶרֶץ עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח שָׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ וְאֶת אֶרֶץ עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח שָׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And they took possession of his land, and of the land of
Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who were
across the Jordan at the sun’s rising,

translation.text: They occupied his land and eastern side of the Jordan:

verses.english:
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, to
Mount Sion—that is Hermon—
verses.hebrew: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְעַד הַר שִׂיאֹן הוּא חֶרְמוֹן׃

hebrew.text: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְעַד הַר שִׂיאֹן הוּא חֶרְמוֹן׃

english.text:
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, to
Mount Sion—that is Hermon—

translation.text: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, as far as Mount Sirion (that is, Hermon),

verses.english:
and all the plain across the Jordan eastward to the sea of
the plain below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.hebrew: וְכל הָעֲרָבָה עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הָעֲרָבָה עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

english.text:
and all the plain across the Jordan eastward to the sea of
the plain below the slopes of Pisgah.

translation.text: together with Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.english:
And Moses called all of Israel and said to them,
“Listen, Israel, to the laws and the judgments that I’m
speaking in your ears today. And you shall learn them and
be watchful to do them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי דֹּבֵר בְּאזְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּם אֹתָם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשֹׂתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי דֹּבֵר בְּאזְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּם אֹתָם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשֹׂתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses called all of Israel and said to them,
“Listen, Israel, to the laws and the judgments that I’m
speaking in your ears today. And you shall learn them and
be watchful to do them.

translation.text: Moses convened all Israel, and said to them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I am addressing to you today; you shall learn them and observe them diligently.

verses.english: YHWH, our God, had made a covenant with us at Horeb.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כָּרַת עִמָּנוּ בְּרִית בְּחֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כָּרַת עִמָּנוּ בְּרִית בְּחֹרֵב׃

english.text: YHWH, our God, had made a covenant with us at Horeb.

translation.text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

verses.english:
YHWH did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with
us! We! These! Here! Today! All of us! Living!
verses.hebrew: לֹא אֶת אֲבֹתֵינוּ כָּרַת יְהֹוָה אֶת הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת כִּי אִתָּנוּ אֲנַחְנוּ אֵלֶּה פֹה הַיּוֹם כֻּלָּנוּ חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אֶת אֲבֹתֵינוּ כָּרַת יְהֹוָה אֶת הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת כִּי אִתָּנוּ אֲנַחְנוּ אֵלֶּה פֹה הַיּוֹם כֻּלָּנוּ חַיִּים׃

english.text:
YHWH did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with
us! We! These! Here! Today! All of us! Living!

translation.text: Not with our ancestors alive today.

verses.english:
Face-to-face, YHWH spoke with you at the mountain from
inside the fire
verses.hebrew: פָּנִים בְּפָנִים דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: פָּנִים בְּפָנִים דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Face-to-face, YHWH spoke with you at the mountain from
inside the fire

translation.text: The LORD spoke with you face to face at the mountain, out of the fire.

verses.english:
(I was standing between YHWH and you at that time to tell
you YHWH’s word because you were afraid on account of the
fire, and you didn’t go up in the mountain), saying:
verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי עֹמֵד בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵינֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְהַגִּיד לָכֶם אֶת דְּבַר יְהֹוָה כִּי יְרֵאתֶם מִפְּנֵי הָאֵשׁ וְלֹא עֲלִיתֶם בָּהָר לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי עֹמֵד בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵינֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְהַגִּיד לָכֶם אֶת דְּבַר יְהֹוָה כִּי יְרֵאתֶם מִפְּנֵי הָאֵשׁ וְלֹא עֲלִיתֶם בָּהָר לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
(I was standing between YHWH and you at that time to tell
you YHWH’s word because you were afraid on account of the
fire, and you didn’t go up in the mountain), saying:

translation.text: (At that time I was standing between the LORD and because of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from a house of slaves.
verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִ͏ים׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִ͏ים׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from a house of slaves.

translation.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery;

verses.english: You shall not have other gods before my face.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶ͏ה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עַל פָּנָ͏ַי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶ͏ה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עַל פָּנָ͏ַי׃

english.text: You shall not have other gods before my face.

translation.text: you shall have no other gods before me.

verses.english:
You shall not make a statue, any form that is in the skies
above or that is in the earth below or that is in the
water below the earth.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל כּל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּ͏ַחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל כּל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּ͏ַחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
You shall not make a statue, any form that is in the skies
above or that is in the earth below or that is in the
water below the earth.

translation.text: You shall not make for yourself an idol, whether in the form of that is in the water under the earth.

verses.english:
You shall not bow to them, and you shall not serve them.
Because I, YHWH, your God, am a jealous God, counting
parents’ crime on children and on the third generation and
on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לָהֶם וְלֹא תעבְדֵם כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים לְשֹׂנְאָי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לָהֶם וְלֹא תעבְדֵם כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים לְשֹׂנְאָי׃

english.text:
You shall not bow to them, and you shall not serve them.
Because I, YHWH, your God, am a jealous God, counting
parents’ crime on children and on the third generation and
on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

translation.text: You shall not bow down to them children for the iniquity of parents, to the third and fourth generation of those who reject me,

verses.english:
but practicing kindness to thousands for those who love me
and for those who observe my commandments.
verses.hebrew: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי (מצותו) [מִצְוֺתָי]׃

hebrew.text: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי (מצותו) [מִצְוֺתָי]׃

english.text:
but practicing kindness to thousands for those who love me
and for those who observe my commandments.

translation.text: but showing steadfast love to the commandments.

verses.english:
You shall not bring up the name of YHWH, your God, for a
falsehood, because YHWH will not make one innocent who
will bring up His name for a falsehood.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהֹוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהֹוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא׃

english.text:
You shall not bring up the name of YHWH, your God, for a
falsehood, because YHWH will not make one innocent who
will bring up His name for a falsehood.

translation.text: You shall not make wrongful use of the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not acquit anyone who misuses his name.

verses.english:
Observe the Sabbath day, to make it holy, as YHWH, your
God, commanded you.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Observe the Sabbath day, to make it holy, as YHWH, your
God, commanded you.

translation.text: Observe the sabbath day and keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

verses.english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כּל מְלַאכְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כּל מְלַאכְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

translation.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.

verses.english:
and the seventh day is a Sabbath to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do any work: you and your son and your daughter
and your servant and your maid and your ox and your ass or
any animal and your alien who is in your gates—in order
that your servant and your maid will rest like you,
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כל מְלָאכָה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ וַחֲמֹרְךָ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֶּךָ וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יָנוּחַ עַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ כָּמוֹךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כל מְלָאכָה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ וַחֲמֹרְךָ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֶּךָ וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יָנוּחַ עַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ כָּמוֹךָ׃

english.text:
and the seventh day is a Sabbath to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do any work: you and your son and your daughter
and your servant and your maid and your ox and your ass or
any animal and your alien who is in your gates—in order
that your servant and your maid will rest like you,

translation.text: But the seventh day is a sabbath to the LORD your God; you shall not do rest as well as you.

verses.english:
and you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt and YHWH, your God, brought you out from there
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. On account of
this, YHWH, your God, has commanded you to do the Sabbath
day.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֹּצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה עַל כֵּן צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֹּצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה עַל כֵּן צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

english.text:
and you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt and YHWH, your God, brought you out from there
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. On account of
this, YHWH, your God, has commanded you to do the Sabbath
day.

translation.text: Remember that you were a slave in the land of commanded you to keep the sabbath day.

verses.english:
Honor your father and your mother, as YHWH, your God,
commanded you, so that your days will be extended and so
that it will be good for you on the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you.
verses.hebrew: כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכֻן יָמֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכֻן יָמֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
Honor your father and your mother, as YHWH, your God,
commanded you, so that your days will be extended and so
that it will be good for you on the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you.

translation.text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

verses.english:
You shall not murder. And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not steal. And you shall not testify against
your neighbor as a false witness.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּרְצָ͏ח׃ ס וְלֹא תִּנְאָ͏ף׃ ס וְלֹא תִּגְנֹב׃ ס וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה בְרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁוְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּרְצָ͏ח׃ ס וְלֹא תִּנְאָ͏ף׃ ס וְלֹא תִּגְנֹב׃ ס וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה בְרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁוְא׃

english.text:
You shall not murder. And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not steal. And you shall not testify against
your neighbor as a false witness.

translation.text: You shall not murder.

verses.english:
And you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, and you
shall not long for your neighbor’s house, his field, or
his servant or his maid, his ox or his ass or anything
that your neighbor has.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ ס וְלֹא תִתְאַוֶּה בֵּית רֵעֶךָ שָׂדֵהוּ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ שׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ ס וְלֹא תִתְאַוֶּה בֵּית רֵעֶךָ שָׂדֵהוּ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ שׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, and you
shall not long for your neighbor’s house, his field, or
his servant or his maid, his ox or his ass or anything
that your neighbor has.

translation.text: Neither shall you commit adultery.

verses.english:
“YHWH spoke these words to your entire community at the
mountain from inside the fire, the cloud, and the nimbus,
a powerful voice. And He did not add. And He wrote them on
two tablets of stones and gave them to me.
verses.hebrew: אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל קְהַלְכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הֶעָנָן וְהָעֲרָפֶל קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא יָסָף וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים וַיִּתְּנֵם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל קְהַלְכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הֶעָנָן וְהָעֲרָפֶל קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא יָסָף וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים וַיִּתְּנֵם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
“YHWH spoke these words to your entire community at the
mountain from inside the fire, the cloud, and the nimbus,
a powerful voice. And He did not add. And He wrote them on
two tablets of stones and gave them to me.

translation.text: Neither shall you steal.

verses.english:
“And it was when you heard the voice from inside the
darkness, as the mountain was burning in fire, that you
came forward to me, all the heads of your tribes and your
elders,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת הַקּוֹל מִתּוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כּל רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְזִקְנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת הַקּוֹל מִתּוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כּל רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְזִקְנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And it was when you heard the voice from inside the
darkness, as the mountain was burning in fire, that you
came forward to me, all the heads of your tribes and your
elders,

translation.text: Neither shall you bear false witness against your neighbor.

verses.english:
and you said, ‘Here, YHWH, our God, has shown us His glory
and His greatness, and we’ve heard His voice from inside
the fire. This day we’ve seen that God may speak to a
human and he lives.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמְרוּ הֵן הֶרְאָנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת כְּבֹדוֹ וְאֶת גּדְלוֹ וְאֶת קֹלוֹ שָׁמַעְנוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה רָאִינוּ כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמְרוּ הֵן הֶרְאָנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת כְּבֹדוֹ וְאֶת גּדְלוֹ וְאֶת קֹלוֹ שָׁמַעְנוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה רָאִינוּ כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

english.text:
and you said, ‘Here, YHWH, our God, has shown us His glory
and His greatness, and we’ve heard His voice from inside
the fire. This day we’ve seen that God may speak to a
human and he lives.

translation.text: Neither shall you covet your neighbor's wife. neighbor.

verses.english:
So now why should we die? Because this big fire will
consume us. If we go on hearing the voice of YHWH, our
God, anymore, then we’ll die.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לָמָּה נָמוּת כִּי תֹאכְלֵנוּ הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת אִם יֹסְפִים אֲנַחְנוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת קוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹד וָמָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לָמָּה נָמוּת כִּי תֹאכְלֵנוּ הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת אִם יֹסְפִים אֲנַחְנוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת קוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹד וָמָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
So now why should we die? Because this big fire will
consume us. If we go on hearing the voice of YHWH, our
God, anymore, then we’ll die.

translation.text: These words the LORD spoke with a loud voice to your whole and gave them to me.

verses.english:
Because who, of all flesh, is there who has heard the
voice of the living God speaking from inside fire as we
have and lived?
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי כל בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע קוֹל אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כָּמֹנוּ וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִי כל בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע קוֹל אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כָּמֹנוּ וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
Because who, of all flesh, is there who has heard the
voice of the living God speaking from inside fire as we
have and lived?

translation.text: When you heard the voice out of the me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders;

verses.english:
You go forward and listen to everything that YHWH, our
God, will say, and you’ll speak to us everything that
YHWH, our God, will speak to you, and we’ll listen, and
we’ll do it.’
verses.hebrew: קְרַב אַתָּה וּשְׁמָע אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַתְּ תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֵינוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְנוּ וְעָשִׂינוּ׃

hebrew.text: קְרַב אַתָּה וּשְׁמָע אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַתְּ תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֵינוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְנוּ וְעָשִׂינוּ׃

english.text:
You go forward and listen to everything that YHWH, our
God, will say, and you’ll speak to us everything that
YHWH, our God, will speak to you, and we’ll listen, and
we’ll do it.’

translation.text: and you said, speak to someone and the person may still live.

verses.english:
“And YHWH listened to your words’ voice when you were
speaking to me, and YHWH said to me, ‘I’ve listened to the
voice of this people’s words that they spoke to you.
They’ve been good in everything that they’ve spoken.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ הֵיטִיבוּ כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ הֵיטִיבוּ כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּרוּ׃

english.text:
“And YHWH listened to your words’ voice when you were
speaking to me, and YHWH said to me, ‘I’ve listened to the
voice of this people’s words that they spoke to you.
They’ve been good in everything that they’ve spoken.

translation.text: So now why should we die? For this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer, we shall die.

verses.english:
Who would make it so, that they would have such a heart,
to fear me and observe all my commandments every day, so
it would be good for them and for their children forever!
verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן וְהָיָה לְבָבָם זֶה לָהֶם לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי וְלִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי כּל הַיָּמִים לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: מִי יִתֵּן וְהָיָה לְבָבָם זֶה לָהֶם לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי וְלִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי כּל הַיָּמִים לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
Who would make it so, that they would have such a heart,
to fear me and observe all my commandments every day, so
it would be good for them and for their children forever!

translation.text: For who is there of all flesh have, and remained alive?

verses.english: Go say to them, “Go back to your tents.”
verses.hebrew: לֵךְ אֱמֹר לָהֶם שׁוּבוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ אֱמֹר לָהֶם שׁוּבוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם׃

english.text: Go say to them, “Go back to your tents.”

translation.text: Go near, you yourself, and hear all that God tells you, and we will listen and do it."

verses.english:
And you, stand here with me so I may speak to you all the
commandment and the laws and the judgments that you shall
teach them so they’ll do them in the land that I’m giving
them to take possession of it.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד עִמָּדִי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוָה וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תְּלַמְּדֵם וְעָשׂוּ בָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד עִמָּדִי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוָה וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תְּלַמְּדֵם וְעָשׂוּ בָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And you, stand here with me so I may speak to you all the
commandment and the laws and the judgments that you shall
teach them so they’ll do them in the land that I’m giving
them to take possession of it.

translation.text: The LORD heard your words when you spoke to me, and the LORD spoken to you; they are right in all that they have spoken.

verses.english:
And you shall be watchful to do as YHWH, your God, has
commanded you. You shall not turn right or left.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לֹא תָסֻרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לֹא תָסֻרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל׃

english.text:
And you shall be watchful to do as YHWH, your God, has
commanded you. You shall not turn right or left.

translation.text: If only their children forever!

verses.english:
You shall go in all the way that YHWH, your God, has
commanded you, so that you’ll live, and it will be good
for you, and you’ll extend days in the land that you’ll
possess.’
verses.hebrew: בְּכל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם תֵּלֵכוּ לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּן וְטוֹב לָכֶם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּם יָמִים בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּירָשׁוּן׃

hebrew.text: בְּכל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם תֵּלֵכוּ לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּן וְטוֹב לָכֶם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּם יָמִים בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּירָשׁוּן׃

english.text:
You shall go in all the way that YHWH, your God, has
commanded you, so that you’ll live, and it will be good
for you, and you’ll extend days in the land that you’ll
possess.’

translation.text: Go say to them, 'Return to your tents.'

verses.english:
“And this is the commandment, the laws, and the
judgments that YHWH, your God, commanded to teach you to
do in the land to which you’re crossing to take possession
of it,
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַמִּצְוָה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת הַמִּצְוָה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And this is the commandment, the laws, and the
judgments that YHWH, your God, commanded to teach you to
do in the land to which you’re crossing to take possession
of it,

translation.text: Now this is the commandment — the statutes and the ordinances — that you are about to cross into and occupy,

verses.english:
so that you’ll fear YHWH, your God, to observe all His
laws and His commandments that I’m commanding you: you and
your child and your child’s child, all the days of your
life, and so that your days will be extended.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּירָא אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וּלְמַעַן יַאֲרִכֻן יָמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן תִּירָא אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וּלְמַעַן יַאֲרִכֻן יָמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
so that you’ll fear YHWH, your God, to observe all His
laws and His commandments that I’m commanding you: you and
your child and your child’s child, all the days of your
life, and so that your days will be extended.

translation.text: so that you and your that I am commanding you, so that your days may be long.

verses.english:
And you shall listen, Israel, and be watchful to do it,
that it will be good for you and that you’ll multiply very
much, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you: a land
flowing with milk and honey.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וַאֲשֶׁר תִּרְבּוּן מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וַאֲשֶׁר תִּרְבּוּן מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall listen, Israel, and be watchful to do it,
that it will be good for you and that you’ll multiply very
much, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you: a land
flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe them diligently, so that it may go well you.

verses.english: “Listen, Israel: YHWH is our God. YHWH is one.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד׃

english.text: “Listen, Israel: YHWH is our God. YHWH is one.

translation.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD is our God, the LORD alone.

verses.english:
And you shall love YHWH, your God, with all your heart and
with all your soul and with all your might.
verses.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכל מְאֹדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכל מְאֹדֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall love YHWH, your God, with all your heart and
with all your soul and with all your might.

translation.text: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.

verses.english:
And these words that I command you today shall be on your
heart.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל לְבָבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל לְבָבֶךָ׃

english.text:
And these words that I command you today shall be on your
heart.

translation.text: Keep these words that I am commanding you today in your heart.

verses.english:
And you shall impart them to your children, and you shall
speak about them when you sit in your house and when you
go in the road and when you lie down and when you get up.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall impart them to your children, and you shall
speak about them when you sit in your house and when you
go in the road and when you lie down and when you get up.

translation.text: Recite them to your children and talk about them when when you rise.

verses.english:
And you shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they
shall become bands between your eyes.
verses.hebrew: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they
shall become bands between your eyes.

translation.text: Bind them as a sign on your hand, fix them as an emblem on your forehead,

verses.english:
And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house
and in your gates.
verses.hebrew: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house
and in your gates.

translation.text: and write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

verses.english:
“And it will be when YHWH, your God, will bring you to the
land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac,
and to Jacob, to give you big and good cities that you
didn’t build,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֶת לָךְ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וְטֹבֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא בָנִיתָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֶת לָךְ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וְטֹבֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא בָנִיתָ׃

english.text:
“And it will be when YHWH, your God, will bring you to the
land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac,
and to Jacob, to give you big and good cities that you
didn’t build,

translation.text: When the LORD your God has brought you into the land that he you — a land with fine, large cities that you did not build,

verses.english:
and houses filled with everything good that you didn’t
fill, and cisterns hewed that you didn’t hew, vineyards
and olives that you did’t plant, and you’ll eat and be
satisfied,
verses.hebrew: וּבָתִּים מְלֵאִים כּל טוּב אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִלֵּאתָ וּבֹרֹת חֲצוּבִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא חָצַבְתָּ כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא נָטָעְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָתִּים מְלֵאִים כּל טוּב אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִלֵּאתָ וּבֹרֹת חֲצוּבִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא חָצַבְתָּ כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא נָטָעְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

english.text:
and houses filled with everything good that you didn’t
fill, and cisterns hewed that you didn’t hew, vineyards
and olives that you did’t plant, and you’ll eat and be
satisfied,

translation.text: houses filled with all sorts of goods that you did not fill, hewn cisterns that and when you have eaten your fill,

verses.english:
watch yourself in case you’ll forget YHWH, who brought you
out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.
verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
watch yourself in case you’ll forget YHWH, who brought you
out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.

translation.text: take care that you do not forget of slavery.

verses.english:
It’s YHWH, your God, whom you’ll fear, and it’s He whom
you’ll serve, and it’s in His name that you’ll swear.
verses.hebrew: אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵעַ׃

english.text:
It’s YHWH, your God, whom you’ll fear, and it’s He whom
you’ll serve, and it’s in His name that you’ll swear.

translation.text: The LORD your God you shall fear; him you shall serve, and by his name alone you shall swear.

verses.english:
You shall not go after other gods, from the gods of the
peoples who are around you,
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֵלְכוּן אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֵלְכוּן אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not go after other gods, from the gods of the
peoples who are around you,

translation.text: Do not follow other gods, any of the gods of the peoples who are all around you,

verses.english:
because YHWH, your God, is a jealous God among you, in
case the anger of YHWH, your God, will flare at you, and
He’ll destroy you from the face of the earth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵל קַנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ פֶּן יֶחֱרֶה אַף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּךְ וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵל קַנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ פֶּן יֶחֱרֶה אַף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּךְ וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
because YHWH, your God, is a jealous God among you, in
case the anger of YHWH, your God, will flare at you, and
He’ll destroy you from the face of the earth.

translation.text: because the LORD from the face of the earth.

verses.english:
You shall not test YHWH, your God, as you tested at
Massah.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תְנַסּוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתֶם בַּמַּסָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תְנַסּוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתֶם בַּמַּסָּה׃

english.text:
You shall not test YHWH, your God, as you tested at
Massah.

translation.text: Do not put the LORD your God to the test, as you tested him at Massah.

verses.english:
You shall observe the commandments of YHWH, your God, and
His testimonies and His laws that He commanded you.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמוֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְעֵדֹתָיו וְחֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמוֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְעֵדֹתָיו וְחֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

english.text:
You shall observe the commandments of YHWH, your God, and
His testimonies and His laws that He commanded you.

translation.text: You must diligently keep the commandments of the LORD you.

verses.english:
And you shall do what is right and good in YHWH’s eyes so
it will be good for you, and you’ll come and take
possession of the good land that YHWH swore to your
fathers,
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וּבָאתָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וּבָאתָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall do what is right and good in YHWH’s eyes so
it will be good for you, and you’ll come and take
possession of the good land that YHWH swore to your
fathers,

translation.text: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it land that the LORD swore to your ancestors to give you,

verses.english:
to push all your enemies from in front of you, as YHWH has
spoken.
verses.hebrew: לַהֲדֹף אֶת כּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לַהֲדֹף אֶת כּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
to push all your enemies from in front of you, as YHWH has
spoken.

translation.text: thrusting out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has promised.

verses.english:
“When your child will ask you tomorrow, saying, ‘What are
the testimonies and the laws and the judgments that YHWH,
our God, commanded you?’
