translation.text: Remember that you were this reason I lay this command upon you today.

verses.english:
“And it will be, if he’ll say to you, ‘I won’t go out from
you’ because he loves you and your house, because it is
good for him with you,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמַר אֵלֶיךָ לֹא אֵצֵא מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ וְאֶת בֵּיתֶךָ כִּי טוֹב לוֹ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמַר אֵלֶיךָ לֹא אֵצֵא מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ וְאֶת בֵּיתֶךָ כִּי טוֹב לוֹ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if he’ll say to you, ‘I won’t go out from
you’ because he loves you and your house, because it is
good for him with you,

translation.text: But if he says to you, since he is well off with you,

verses.english:
then you shall take an awl and put it in his ear and in
the door, and he shall be a slave forever to you. And you
shall also do this to your maid.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַמַּרְצֵעַ וְנָתַתָּה בְאזְנוֹ וּבַדֶּלֶת וְהָיָה לְךָ עֶבֶד עוֹלָם וְאַף לַאֲמָתְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַמַּרְצֵעַ וְנָתַתָּה בְאזְנוֹ וּבַדֶּלֶת וְהָיָה לְךָ עֶבֶד עוֹלָם וְאַף לַאֲמָתְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה כֵּן׃

english.text:
then you shall take an awl and put it in his ear and in
the door, and he shall be a slave forever to you. And you
shall also do this to your maid.

translation.text: then you shall take an awl and thrust it through his earlobe into the door, and he shall be your slave forever. You shall do the same with regard to your female slave.

verses.english:
It shall not be hard in your eyes when you let him go
liberated from you, because he served you six years at
twice the value of an employee, and YHWH, your God, will
bless you in everything that you’ll do.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִקְשֶׁה בְעֵינֶךָ בְּשַׁלֵּחֲךָ אֹתוֹ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי מִשְׁנֶה שְׂכַר שָׂכִיר עֲבָדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִקְשֶׁה בְעֵינֶךָ בְּשַׁלֵּחֲךָ אֹתוֹ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי מִשְׁנֶה שְׂכַר שָׂכִיר עֲבָדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
It shall not be hard in your eyes when you let him go
liberated from you, because he served you six years at
twice the value of an employee, and YHWH, your God, will
bless you in everything that you’ll do.

translation.text: Do not consider it a hardship when you send them out from you the wages of hired laborers; and the LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.

verses.english:
“Every male firstborn that will be born in your herd and
in your flock you shall consecrate to YHWH, your God. You
shall not work with your ox’s firstborn, and you shall not
shear your sheep’s firstborn.
verses.hebrew: כּל הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלֵד בִּבְקָרְךָ וּבְצֹאנְךָ הַזָּכָר תַּקְדִּישׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בִּבְכֹר שׁוֹרֶךָ וְלֹא תָגֹז בְּכוֹר צֹאנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלֵד בִּבְקָרְךָ וּבְצֹאנְךָ הַזָּכָר תַּקְדִּישׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בִּבְכֹר שׁוֹרֶךָ וְלֹא תָגֹז בְּכוֹר צֹאנֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Every male firstborn that will be born in your herd and
in your flock you shall consecrate to YHWH, your God. You
shall not work with your ox’s firstborn, and you shall not
shear your sheep’s firstborn.

translation.text: Every firstling male born of your herd and flock you shall consecrate shear the firstling of your flock.

verses.english:
You shall eat it in front of YHWH, your God, year by year
in the place that YHWH will choose—you and your household.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹאכְלֶנּוּ שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹאכְלֶנּוּ שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall eat it in front of YHWH, your God, year by year
in the place that YHWH will choose—you and your household.

translation.text: You shall eat it, you together with the place that the LORD will choose.

verses.english:
And if there will be an injury in it—crippled or blind,
any bad injury—you shall not sacrifice it to YHWH, your
God.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם פִּסֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר כֹּל מוּם רָע לֹא תִזְבָּחֶנּוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם פִּסֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר כֹּל מוּם רָע לֹא תִזְבָּחֶנּוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And if there will be an injury in it—crippled or blind,
any bad injury—you shall not sacrifice it to YHWH, your
God.

translation.text: But if it has any defect — any serious defect, such as lameness or blindness — you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God;

verses.english:
You shall eat it within your gates—the impure and the pure
together, like a gazelle and like a deer.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יַחְדָּו כַּצְּבִי וְכָאַיָּל׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יַחְדָּו כַּצְּבִי וְכָאַיָּל׃

english.text:
You shall eat it within your gates—the impure and the pure
together, like a gazelle and like a deer.

translation.text: within your towns you may eat it, the unclean and the clean alike, as you would a gazelle or deer.

verses.english:
Only: you shall not eat its blood. You shall spill it like
water on the ground.
verses.hebrew: רַק אֶת דָּמוֹ לֹא תֹאכֵל עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: רַק אֶת דָּמוֹ לֹא תֹאכֵל עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
Only: you shall not eat its blood. You shall spill it like
water on the ground.

translation.text: Its blood, water.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמוֹר אֶת חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב וְעָשִׂיתָ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב הוֹצִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמוֹר אֶת חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב וְעָשִׂיתָ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב הוֹצִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם לָיְלָה׃

translation.text: Observe the month of Abib by keeping the passover to the LORD your Egypt by night.

verses.english:
And you shall make a Passover sacrifice to YHWH, your God,
of the flock and herd, in the place that YHWH will choose
to tent His name there.
verses.hebrew: וְזָבַחְתָּ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ צֹאן וּבָקָר בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְזָבַחְתָּ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ צֹאן וּבָקָר בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And you shall make a Passover sacrifice to YHWH, your God,
of the flock and herd, in the place that YHWH will choose
to tent His name there.

translation.text: You shall offer the passover sacrifice to the LORD your choose as a dwelling for his name.

verses.english:
You shall not eat leavened bread with it. Seven days you
shall eat unleavened bread, the bread of degradation, with
it, because you went out from the land of Egypt in
haste—so that you will remember the day you went out from
the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאכַל עָלָיו חָמֵץ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל עָלָיו מַצּוֹת לֶחֶם עֹנִי כִּי בְחִפָּזוֹן יָצָאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְמַעַן תִּזְכֹּר אֶת יוֹם צֵאתְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאכַל עָלָיו חָמֵץ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל עָלָיו מַצּוֹת לֶחֶם עֹנִי כִּי בְחִפָּזוֹן יָצָאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְמַעַן תִּזְכֹּר אֶת יוֹם צֵאתְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not eat leavened bread with it. Seven days you
shall eat unleavened bread, the bread of degradation, with
it, because you went out from the land of Egypt in
haste—so that you will remember the day you went out from
the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

translation.text: You must not eat with it anything great haste, so that all the days of your life you may remember the day of your departure from the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And you shall not have leaven appear within all your
borders for seven days, and none of the meat that you will
sacrifice in the evening on the first day shall remain
until the morning.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה לְךָ שְׂאֹר בְּכל גְּבֻלְךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְלֹא יָלִין מִן הַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר תִּזְבַּח בָּעֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן לַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה לְךָ שְׂאֹר בְּכל גְּבֻלְךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְלֹא יָלִין מִן הַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר תִּזְבַּח בָּעֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן לַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And you shall not have leaven appear within all your
borders for seven days, and none of the meat that you will
sacrifice in the evening on the first day shall remain
until the morning.

translation.text: No leaven shall be seen morning.

verses.english:
You may not make the Passover sacrifice within one of your
gates that YHWH, your God, is giving you.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תוּכַל לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תוּכַל לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
You may not make the Passover sacrifice within one of your
gates that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

translation.text: You are not permitted to offer the passover sacrifice within any of your towns that the LORD your God is giving you.

verses.english:
But, rather, to the place that YHWH, your God, will choose
to tent His name: there you shall make the Passover
sacrifice in the evening at sunset, the time when you went
out from Egypt.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם תִּזְבַּח אֶת הַפֶּסַח בָּעָרֶב כְּבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מוֹעֵד צֵאתְךָ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם תִּזְבַּח אֶת הַפֶּסַח בָּעָרֶב כְּבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מוֹעֵד צֵאתְךָ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
But, rather, to the place that YHWH, your God, will choose
to tent His name: there you shall make the Passover
sacrifice in the evening at sunset, the time when you went
out from Egypt.

translation.text: But at the sunset, the time of day when you departed from Egypt.

verses.english:
And you shall cook and eat it in the place that YHWH, your
God, will choose; and you shall turn in the morning and go
to your tents.
verses.hebrew: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ וּפָנִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ לְאֹהָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ וּפָנִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ לְאֹהָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall cook and eat it in the place that YHWH, your
God, will choose; and you shall turn in the morning and go
to your tents.

translation.text: You shall cook it and eat it at the place that the LORD your God will choose; the next morning you may go back to your tents.

verses.english:
Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the
seventh day shall be a convocation to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do work.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי עֲצֶרֶת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה מְלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי עֲצֶרֶת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה מְלָאכָה׃

english.text:
Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the
seventh day shall be a convocation to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do work.

translation.text: For six days you shall work.

verses.english:
“You shall count seven weeks. From when the sickle begins
to be in the standing grain you shall begin to count seven
weeks.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעָה שָׁבֻעֹת תִּסְפּר לָךְ מֵהָחֵל חֶרְמֵשׁ בַּקָּמָה תָּחֵל לִסְפֹּר שִׁבְעָה שָׁבֻעוֹת׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעָה שָׁבֻעֹת תִּסְפּר לָךְ מֵהָחֵל חֶרְמֵשׁ בַּקָּמָה תָּחֵל לִסְפֹּר שִׁבְעָה שָׁבֻעוֹת׃

english.text:
“You shall count seven weeks. From when the sickle begins
to be in the standing grain you shall begin to count seven
weeks.

translation.text: You shall count seven weeks; begin to count the seven weeks from the time the sickle is first put to the standing grain.

verses.english:
And you shall make a Festival of Weeks for YHWH, your God,
the full amount of your hand’s contribution that you can
give insofar as YHWH, your God, will bless you.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ חַג שָׁבֻעוֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִסַּת נִדְבַת יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חַג שָׁבֻעוֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִסַּת נִדְבַת יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall make a Festival of Weeks for YHWH, your God,
the full amount of your hand’s contribution that you can
give insofar as YHWH, your God, will bless you.

translation.text: Then you shall keep the festival of weeks to the LORD your God, contributing a freewill LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall rejoice in front of YHWH, your God—you and
your son and your daughter and your servant and your maid
and the Levite who is within your gates and the alien and
the orphan and the widow who are among you—in the place
that YHWH, your God, will choose to tent His name there.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבֶּךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבֶּךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And you shall rejoice in front of YHWH, your God—you and
your son and your daughter and your servant and your maid
and the Levite who is within your gates and the alien and
the orphan and the widow who are among you—in the place
that YHWH, your God, will choose to tent His name there.

translation.text: Rejoice before the LORD your God — you and your choose as a dwelling for his name.

verses.english:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and
you shall be watchful and do these laws.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and
you shall be watchful and do these laws.

translation.text: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and diligently observe these statutes.

verses.english:
“You shall make a Festival of Booths seven days, when you
gather from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
verses.hebrew: חַג הַסֻּכֹּת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּאסְפְּךָ מִגּרְנְךָ וּמִיִּקְבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: חַג הַסֻּכֹּת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּאסְפְּךָ מִגּרְנְךָ וּמִיִּקְבֶךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall make a Festival of Booths seven days, when you
gather from your threshing floor and from your winepress.

translation.text: You shall keep the festival of booths for seven days, when you have press.

verses.english:
And you shall rejoice on your festival—you and your son
and your daughter and your servant and your maid and the
Levite and the alien and the orphan and the widow who are
within your gates.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְּחַגֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְּחַגֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall rejoice on your festival—you and your son
and your daughter and your servant and your maid and the
Levite and the alien and the orphan and the widow who are
within your gates.

translation.text: Rejoice during your festival, you and your sons and your strangers, the orphans, and the widows resident in your towns.

verses.english:
Seven days you shall celebrate for YHWH, your God, in the
place that YHWH will choose, because YHWH, your God, will
bless you in all your produce and all your hands’ work,
and you shall just be happy.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תָּחֹג לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה כִּי יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל תְּבוּאָתְךָ וּבְכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ שָׂמֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תָּחֹג לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה כִּי יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל תְּבוּאָתְךָ וּבְכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ שָׂמֵחַ׃

english.text:
Seven days you shall celebrate for YHWH, your God, in the
place that YHWH will choose, because YHWH, your God, will
bless you in all your produce and all your hands’ work,
and you shall just be happy.

translation.text: Seven days you shall keep the festival to the LORD your God at the place celebrate.

verses.english:
“Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear
in front of YHWH, your God, in the place that He will
choose: on the Festival of Unleavened Bread and on the
Festival of Weeks and on the Festival of Booths. And he
shall not appear in front of YHWH empty-handed:
verses.hebrew: שָׁלוֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר בְּחַג הַמַּצּוֹת וּבְחַג הַשָּׁבֻעוֹת וּבְחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: שָׁלוֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר בְּחַג הַמַּצּוֹת וּבְחַג הַשָּׁבֻעוֹת וּבְחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
“Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear
in front of YHWH, your God, in the place that He will
choose: on the Festival of Unleavened Bread and on the
Festival of Weeks and on the Festival of Booths. And he
shall not appear in front of YHWH empty-handed:

translation.text: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the LORD your bread, at the festival of weeks, and at the festival of booths. They shall not appear before the LORD empty-handed;

verses.english:
each according to what his hand can give, according to the
blessing of YHWH, your God, that He has given you.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ כְּמַתְּנַת יָדוֹ כְּבִרְכַּת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ כְּמַתְּנַת יָדוֹ כְּבִרְכַּת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָךְ׃

english.text:
each according to what his hand can give, according to the
blessing of YHWH, your God, that He has given you.

translation.text: all shall give as they are you.

verses.english:
JUDGES “You shall put judges and officers in all your
gates that YHWH, your God, is giving you, for your tribes,
and they shall judge the people: judgment with justice.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁפְטִים וְשֹׁטְרִים תִּתֶּן לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לִשְׁבָטֶיךָ וְשָׁפְטוּ אֶת הָעָם מִשְׁפַּט צֶדֶק׃

hebrew.text: שֹׁפְטִים וְשֹׁטְרִים תִּתֶּן לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לִשְׁבָטֶיךָ וְשָׁפְטוּ אֶת הָעָם מִשְׁפַּט צֶדֶק׃

english.text:
JUDGES “You shall put judges and officers in all your
gates that YHWH, your God, is giving you, for your tribes,
and they shall judge the people: judgment with justice.

translation.text: You shall appoint judges and officials throughout your tribes, in all just decisions for the people.

verses.english:
You shall not bend judgment, you shall not recognize a
face, and you shall not take a bribe, because bribery will
blind the eyes of the wise and undermine the words of the
virtuous.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפָּט לֹא תַכִּיר פָּנִים וְלֹא תִקַּח שֹׁחַד כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר עֵינֵי חֲכָמִים וִיסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפָּט לֹא תַכִּיר פָּנִים וְלֹא תִקַּח שֹׁחַד כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר עֵינֵי חֲכָמִים וִיסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִם׃

english.text:
You shall not bend judgment, you shall not recognize a
face, and you shall not take a bribe, because bribery will
blind the eyes of the wise and undermine the words of the
virtuous.

translation.text: You must not distort justice; you must not show partiality; and you must not accept bribes, for a bribe blinds right.

verses.english:
Justice, justice you shall pursue, so that you’ll live,
and you’ll take possession of the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you.
verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק צֶדֶק תִּרְדֹּף לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: צֶדֶק צֶדֶק תִּרְדֹּף לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
Justice, justice you shall pursue, so that you’ll live,
and you’ll take possession of the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you.

translation.text: Justice, and only justice, you shall pursue, so that you may live and occupy the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

verses.english:
“You shall not plant an Asherah of any wood near the altar
of YHWH, your God, that you will make.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִטַּע לְךָ אֲשֵׁרָה כּל עֵץ אֵצֶל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִטַּע לְךָ אֲשֵׁרָה כּל עֵץ אֵצֶל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

english.text:
“You shall not plant an Asherah of any wood near the altar
of YHWH, your God, that you will make.

translation.text: You shall not plant any tree as a sacred pole beside the altar that you make for the LORD your God;

verses.english:
And you shall not set up a pillar, which YHWH, your God,
hates.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָקִים לְךָ מַצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָקִים לְךָ מַצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall not set up a pillar, which YHWH, your God,
hates.

translation.text: nor shall you set up a stone pillar — things that the LORD your God hates.

verses.english:
“You shall not sacrifice to YHWH, your God, a bull or a
sheep in which will be any injury, any bad thing, because
that is an offensive thing of YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִזְבַּח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם כֹּל דָּבָר רָע כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִזְבַּח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם כֹּל דָּבָר רָע כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא׃

english.text:
“You shall not sacrifice to YHWH, your God, a bull or a
sheep in which will be any injury, any bad thing, because
that is an offensive thing of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: You must not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep that has your God.

verses.english:
“If there will be found among you, in one of your gates
that YHWH, your God, is giving you, a man or woman who
will do what is bad in the eyes of YHWH, your God, to
violate His covenant,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמָּצֵא בְקִרְבְּךָ בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲבֹר בְּרִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִמָּצֵא בְקִרְבְּךָ בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲבֹר בְּרִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
“If there will be found among you, in one of your gates
that YHWH, your God, is giving you, a man or woman who
will do what is bad in the eyes of YHWH, your God, to
violate His covenant,

translation.text: If there is found among you, in one of your towns that the LORD your of the LORD your God, and transgresses his covenant

verses.english:
and will go and serve other gods and bow to them and to
the sun or to the moon or to any of the array of the
skies, which I did not command,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהֶם וְלַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אוֹ לַיָּרֵחַ אוֹ לְכל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוִּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהֶם וְלַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אוֹ לַיָּרֵחַ אוֹ לְכל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוִּיתִי׃

english.text:
and will go and serve other gods and bow to them and to
the sun or to the moon or to any of the array of the
skies, which I did not command,

translation.text: by going to serve any of the host of heaven, which I have forbidden —

verses.english:
and it will be told to you and you will hear it, and you
will inquire well, and, here, it is true, the thing is
right, this offensive thing has been done in Israel,
verses.hebrew: וְהֻגַּד לְךָ וְשָׁמָעְתָּ וְדָרַשְׁתָּ הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה אֱמֶת נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר נֶעֶשְׂתָה הַתּוֹעֵבָה הַזֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהֻגַּד לְךָ וְשָׁמָעְתָּ וְדָרַשְׁתָּ הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה אֱמֶת נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר נֶעֶשְׂתָה הַתּוֹעֵבָה הַזֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and it will be told to you and you will hear it, and you
will inquire well, and, here, it is true, the thing is
right, this offensive thing has been done in Israel,

translation.text: and if it is occurred in Israel,

verses.english:
then you shall bring that man or that woman who did this
bad thing out to your gates, the man or the woman, and you
shall stone them with stones so they die.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצֵאתָ אֶת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא אוֹ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה הַהִוא אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה אֶל שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֶת הָאִישׁ אוֹ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וּסְקַלְתָּם בָּאֲבָנִים וָמֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹצֵאתָ אֶת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא אוֹ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה הַהִוא אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה אֶל שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֶת הָאִישׁ אוֹ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וּסְקַלְתָּם בָּאֲבָנִים וָמֵתוּ׃

english.text:
then you shall bring that man or that woman who did this
bad thing out to your gates, the man or the woman, and you
shall stone them with stones so they die.

translation.text: then you shall bring out to your gates that man or man or woman to death.

verses.english:
“On the word of two witnesses or three witnesses shall the
one who is to die be put to death. One shall not be put to
death on the word of one witness.
verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי שְׁנַיִם עֵדִים אוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה עֵדִים יוּמַת הַמֵּת לֹא יוּמַת עַל פִּי עֵד אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי שְׁנַיִם עֵדִים אוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה עֵדִים יוּמַת הַמֵּת לֹא יוּמַת עַל פִּי עֵד אֶחָד׃

english.text:
“On the word of two witnesses or three witnesses shall the
one who is to die be put to death. One shall not be put to
death on the word of one witness.

translation.text: On the evidence of two or three witnesses death on the evidence of only one witness.

verses.english:
The witnesses’ hand shall be on him first to put him to
death, and all the people’s hand after that. So you shall
burn away what is bad from among you.
verses.hebrew: יַד הָעֵדִים תִּהְיֶה בּוֹ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לַהֲמִיתוֹ וְיַד כּל הָעָם בָּאַחֲרֹנָה וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: יַד הָעֵדִים תִּהְיֶה בּוֹ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לַהֲמִיתוֹ וְיַד כּל הָעָם בָּאַחֲרֹנָה וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
The witnesses’ hand shall be on him first to put him to
death, and all the people’s hand after that. So you shall
burn away what is bad from among you.

translation.text: The hands of the purge the evil from your midst.

verses.english:
“If a matter for judgment will be too daunting for you,
between blood and blood, between law and law, and between
injury and injury, matters of disputes in your gates, then
you shall get up and go up to the place that YHWH, your
God, will choose.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִפָּלֵא מִמְּךָ דָבָר לַמִּשְׁפָּט בֵּין דָּם לְדָם בֵּין דִּין לְדִין וּבֵין נֶגַע לָנֶגַע דִּבְרֵי רִיבֹת בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְקַמְתָּ וְעָלִיתָ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִפָּלֵא מִמְּךָ דָבָר לַמִּשְׁפָּט בֵּין דָּם לְדָם בֵּין דִּין לְדִין וּבֵין נֶגַע לָנֶגַע דִּבְרֵי רִיבֹת בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְקַמְתָּ וְעָלִיתָ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ׃

english.text:
“If a matter for judgment will be too daunting for you,
between blood and blood, between law and law, and between
injury and injury, matters of disputes in your gates, then
you shall get up and go up to the place that YHWH, your
God, will choose.

translation.text: If a judicial decision is too difficult for you to make between one kind your God will choose,

verses.english:
And you shall come to the Levite priests and to the judge
who will be in those days, and you shall inquire, and they
will tell you the matter of judgment.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְאֶל הַשֹּׁפֵט אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וְדָרַשְׁתָּ וְהִגִּידוּ לְךָ אֵת דְּבַר הַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְאֶל הַשֹּׁפֵט אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וְדָרַשְׁתָּ וְהִגִּידוּ לְךָ אֵת דְּבַר הַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And you shall come to the Levite priests and to the judge
who will be in those days, and you shall inquire, and they
will tell you the matter of judgment.

translation.text: where you shall consult with the levitical announce to you the decision in the case.

verses.english:
And you shall do according to the word on the matter that
they will tell you from that place that YHWH will choose,
and you shall be watchful to do according to everything
that they will instruct you.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל פִּי הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידוּ לְךָ מִן הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל פִּי הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידוּ לְךָ מִן הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall do according to the word on the matter that
they will tell you from that place that YHWH will choose,
and you shall be watchful to do according to everything
that they will instruct you.

translation.text: Carry out exactly the choose, diligently observing everything they instruct you.

verses.english:
You shall do it according to the word of the instruction
that they will give you and according to the judgment that
they will say to you. You shall not turn from the thing
that they will tell you, right or left.
verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּךָ וְעַל הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרוּ לְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה לֹא תָסוּר מִן הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידוּ לְךָ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּךָ וְעַל הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרוּ לְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה לֹא תָסוּר מִן הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידוּ לְךָ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל׃

english.text:
You shall do it according to the word of the instruction
that they will give you and according to the judgment that
they will say to you. You shall not turn from the thing
that they will tell you, right or left.

translation.text: You must announce to you, either to the right or to the left.

verses.english:
And the man who will act presumptuously, not listening to
the priest who is standing to serve YHWH, your God, there,
or to the judge: that man shall die. So you shall burn
away what is bad from Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה בְזָדוֹן לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹעַ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן הָעֹמֵד לְשָׁרֶת שָׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אוֹ אֶל הַשֹּׁפֵט וּמֵת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה בְזָדוֹן לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹעַ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן הָעֹמֵד לְשָׁרֶת שָׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אוֹ אֶל הַשֹּׁפֵט וּמֵת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the man who will act presumptuously, not listening to
the priest who is standing to serve YHWH, your God, there,
or to the judge: that man shall die. So you shall burn
away what is bad from Israel.

translation.text: As for anyone the evil from Israel.

verses.english:
And all the people will listen and fear and won’t act
presumptuously anymore.
verses.hebrew: וְכל הָעָם יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ וְלֹא יְזִידוּן עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הָעָם יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ וְלֹא יְזִידוּן עוֹד׃

english.text:
And all the people will listen and fear and won’t act
presumptuously anymore.

translation.text: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not act presumptuously again.

verses.english:
“When you’ll come to the land that YHWH, your God, is
giving you, and you’ll take possession of it and live in
it, and you’ll say, ‘Let me set a king over me like all
the nations that are around me,’
verses.hebrew: כִּי תָבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְיָשַׁבְתָּה בָּהּ וְאָמַרְתָּ אָשִׂימָה עָלַי מֶלֶךְ כְּכל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תָבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְיָשַׁבְתָּה בָּהּ וְאָמַרְתָּ אָשִׂימָה עָלַי מֶלֶךְ כְּכל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתָי׃

english.text:
“When you’ll come to the land that YHWH, your God, is
giving you, and you’ll take possession of it and live in
it, and you’ll say, ‘Let me set a king over me like all
the nations that are around me,’

translation.text: When you have come into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, "I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,"

verses.english:
you shall set a king over you whom YHWH, your God, will
choose! You shall set a king from among your brothers over
you. You may not put a foreign man, who is not your
brother, over you.
verses.hebrew: שׂוֹם תָּשִׂים עָלֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ מִקֶּרֶב אַחֶיךָ תָּשִׂים עָלֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ לֹא תוּכַל לָתֵת עָלֶיךָ אִישׁ נכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא אָחִיךָ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: שׂוֹם תָּשִׂים עָלֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ מִקֶּרֶב אַחֶיךָ תָּשִׂים עָלֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ לֹא תוּכַל לָתֵת עָלֶיךָ אִישׁ נכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא אָחִיךָ הוּא׃

english.text:
you shall set a king over you whom YHWH, your God, will
choose! You shall set a king from among your brothers over
you. You may not put a foreign man, who is not your
brother, over you.

translation.text: you may indeed set over you a king whom the LORD your God will choose. community.

verses.english:
Only, he shall not get himself many horses, and he shall
not bring the people back to Egypt in order to get many
horses, when YHWH has said to you, ‘You shall not go back
this way ever again.’
verses.hebrew: רַק לֹא יַרְבֶּה לּוֹ סוּסִים וְלֹא יָשִׁיב אֶת הָעָם מִצְרַיְמָה לְמַעַן הַרְבּוֹת סוּס וַיהֹוָה אָמַר לָכֶם לֹא תֹסִפוּן לָשׁוּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: רַק לֹא יַרְבֶּה לּוֹ סוּסִים וְלֹא יָשִׁיב אֶת הָעָם מִצְרַיְמָה לְמַעַן הַרְבּוֹת סוּס וַיהֹוָה אָמַר לָכֶם לֹא תֹסִפוּן לָשׁוּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה עוֹד׃

english.text:
Only, he shall not get himself many horses, and he shall
not bring the people back to Egypt in order to get many
horses, when YHWH has said to you, ‘You shall not go back
this way ever again.’

translation.text: Even so, he must not acquire many horses for himself, or LORD has said to you, "You must never return that way again."

verses.english:
And he shall not get himself many wives, so his heart will
not turn away. And he shall not get himself very much
silver and gold.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יַרְבֶּה לּוֹ נָשִׁים וְלֹא יָסוּר לְבָבוֹ וְכֶסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא יַרְבֶּה לּוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יַרְבֶּה לּוֹ נָשִׁים וְלֹא יָסוּר לְבָבוֹ וְכֶסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא יַרְבֶּה לּוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And he shall not get himself many wives, so his heart will
not turn away. And he shall not get himself very much
silver and gold.

translation.text: And he must not acquire many wives for himself, or else his heart will turn himself.

verses.english:
And it will be, when he sits on his kingdom’s throne, that
he shall write himself a copy of this instruction on a
scroll from in front of the Levite priests.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ וְכָתַב לוֹ אֶת מִשְׁנֵה הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת עַל סֵפֶר מִלִּפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ וְכָתַב לוֹ אֶת מִשְׁנֵה הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת עַל סֵפֶר מִלִּפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And it will be, when he sits on his kingdom’s throne, that
he shall write himself a copy of this instruction on a
scroll from in front of the Levite priests.

translation.text: When he has taken the throne of his kingdom, he shall have priests.

verses.english:
And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the
days of his life, so that he will learn to fear YHWH, his
God, to observe all the words of this instruction and
these laws, to do them,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה עִמּוֹ וְקָרָא בוֹ כּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן יִלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה לַעֲשֹׂתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה עִמּוֹ וְקָרָא בוֹ כּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן יִלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה לַעֲשֹׂתָם׃

english.text:
And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the
days of his life, so that he will learn to fear YHWH, his
God, to observe all the words of this instruction and
these laws, to do them,

translation.text: It shall remain with him and he shall read in it all the days of observing all the words of this law and these statutes,

verses.english:
so his heart will not be elevated above his brothers, and
so he will not turn from the commandment, right or left,
and so he will extend days over his kingdom, he and his
sons, within Israel.
verses.hebrew: לְבִלְתִּי רוּם לְבָבוֹ מֵאֶחָיו וּלְבִלְתִּי סוּר מִן הַמִּצְוָה יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיךְ יָמִים עַל מַמְלַכְתּוֹ הוּא וּבָנָיו בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: לְבִלְתִּי רוּם לְבָבוֹ מֵאֶחָיו וּלְבִלְתִּי סוּר מִן הַמִּצְוָה יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיךְ יָמִים עַל מַמְלַכְתּוֹ הוּא וּבָנָיו בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
so his heart will not be elevated above his brothers, and
so he will not turn from the commandment, right or left,
and so he will extend days over his kingdom, he and his
sons, within Israel.

translation.text: neither aside from the commandment, either to the right or to the left, so that he and his descendants may reign long over his kingdom in Israel.

verses.english:
“The Levite priests, all the tribe of Levi, shall not
have a portion and legacy with Israel. They shall eat
YHWH’s offerings by fire and His legacy.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶה לַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם כּל שֵׁבֶט לֵוִי חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְנַחֲלָתוֹ יֹאכֵלוּן׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶה לַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם כּל שֵׁבֶט לֵוִי חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְנַחֲלָתוֹ יֹאכֵלוּן׃

english.text:
“The Levite priests, all the tribe of Levi, shall not
have a portion and legacy with Israel. They shall eat
YHWH’s offerings by fire and His legacy.

translation.text: The levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no allotment LORD's portion

verses.english:
But he shall not have a legacy among his brothers. YHWH:
He is his legacy, as He spoke to him.
verses.hebrew: וְנַחֲלָה לֹא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנַחֲלָה לֹא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לוֹ׃

english.text:
But he shall not have a legacy among his brothers. YHWH:
He is his legacy, as He spoke to him.

translation.text: but they shall have no inheritance among the other promised them.

verses.english:
And this shall be the rule for the priests from the
people, from those who make a sacrifice, whether an ox or
a sheep: he shall give the shoulder, the cheeks, and the
stomach.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה יִהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט הַכֹּהֲנִים מֵאֵת הָעָם מֵאֵת זֹבְחֵי הַזֶּבַח אִם שׁוֹר אִם שֶׂה וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן הַזְּרֹעַ וְהַלְּחָיַיִם וְהַקֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה יִהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט הַכֹּהֲנִים מֵאֵת הָעָם מֵאֵת זֹבְחֵי הַזֶּבַח אִם שׁוֹר אִם שֶׂה וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן הַזְּרֹעַ וְהַלְּחָיַיִם וְהַקֵּבָה׃

english.text:
And this shall be the rule for the priests from the
people, from those who make a sacrifice, whether an ox or
a sheep: he shall give the shoulder, the cheeks, and the
stomach.

translation.text: This shall be the priests' due from the people, from those offering a shoulder, the two jowls, and the stomach.

verses.english:
You shall give him the first of your grain, your wine, and
your oil, and the first shearing of your sheep.
verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית דְּגָנְךָ תִּירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וְרֵאשִׁית גֵּז צֹאנְךָ תִּתֶּן לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רֵאשִׁית דְּגָנְךָ תִּירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וְרֵאשִׁית גֵּז צֹאנְךָ תִּתֶּן לוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall give him the first of your grain, your wine, and
your oil, and the first shearing of your sheep.

translation.text: The first fruits of your grain, your wine, and your oil, as well as the first of the fleece of your sheep, you shall give him.

verses.english:
Because YHWH, your God, has chosen him from all your
tribes to stand to serve in YHWH’s name, he and his sons,
for all time.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בוֹ בָּחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִכּל שְׁבָטֶיךָ לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה הוּא וּבָנָיו כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בוֹ בָּחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִכּל שְׁבָטֶיךָ לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה הוּא וּבָנָיו כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Because YHWH, your God, has chosen him from all your
tribes to stand to serve in YHWH’s name, he and his sons,
for all time.

translation.text: For the LORD your God has chosen Levi out and his sons for all time.

verses.english:
“And when a Levite will come from one of your gates, from
all of Israel, where he lives, then he shall come as much
as his soul desires to the place that YHWH will choose
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָבֹא הַלֵּוִי מֵאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ מִכּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הוּא גָּר שָׁם וּבָא בְּכל אַוַּת נַפְשׁוֹ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָבֹא הַלֵּוִי מֵאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ מִכּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הוּא גָּר שָׁם וּבָא בְּכל אַוַּת נַפְשׁוֹ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And when a Levite will come from one of your gates, from
all of Israel, where he lives, then he shall come as much
as his soul desires to the place that YHWH will choose

translation.text: If a Levite leaves any of your towns, from wherever he has been residing in Israel, and comes to the place that the LORD will choose (and he may come whenever he wishes),

verses.english:
and serve in the name of YHWH, his God, like all of his
Levite brothers who are standing there in front of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁרֵת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּכל אֶחָיו הַלְוִיִּם הָעֹמְדִים שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁרֵת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּכל אֶחָיו הַלְוִיִּם הָעֹמְדִים שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and serve in the name of YHWH, his God, like all of his
Levite brothers who are standing there in front of YHWH.

translation.text: then he may minister in the name there before the LORD.

verses.english:
They shall eat, portion for portion, aside from his sales
of patrimony.
verses.hebrew: חֵלֶק כְּחֵלֶק יֹאכֵלוּ לְבַד מִמְכָּרָיו עַל הָאָבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: חֵלֶק כְּחֵלֶק יֹאכֵלוּ לְבַד מִמְכָּרָיו עַל הָאָבוֹת׃

english.text:
They shall eat, portion for portion, aside from his sales
of patrimony.

translation.text: They shall have equal portions to eat, even though they have income from the sale of family possessions.

verses.english:
“When you come to the land that YHWH, your God, is giving
you, you shall not learn to do like the offensive things
of those nations.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה בָּא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ לֹא תִלְמַד לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אַתָּה בָּא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ לֹא תִלְמַד לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם׃

english.text:
“When you come to the land that YHWH, your God, is giving
you, you shall not learn to do like the offensive things
of those nations.

translation.text: When you come into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, you must not learn to imitate the abhorrent practices of those nations.

verses.english:
There shall not be found among you someone who passes his
son or his daughter through fire, one who practices
enchantment, a soothsayer or a diviner or a sorcerer
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְךָ מַעֲבִיר בְּנוֹ וּבִתּוֹ בָּאֵשׁ קֹסֵם קְסָמִים מְעוֹנֵן וּמְנַחֵשׁ וּמְכַשֵּׁף׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְךָ מַעֲבִיר בְּנוֹ וּבִתּוֹ בָּאֵשׁ קֹסֵם קְסָמִים מְעוֹנֵן וּמְנַחֵשׁ וּמְכַשֵּׁף׃

english.text:
There shall not be found among you someone who passes his
son or his daughter through fire, one who practices
enchantment, a soothsayer or a diviner or a sorcerer

translation.text: No one shall be found among you who makes a son or daughter pass through fire, or who practices divination, or is a soothsayer, or an augur, or a sorcerer,

verses.english:
or one who casts spells or who asks of a ghost or of a
spirit of an acquaintance or inquires of the dead,
verses.hebrew: וְחֹבֵר חָבֶר וְשֹׁאֵל אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִי וְדֹרֵשׁ אֶל הַמֵּתִים׃

hebrew.text: וְחֹבֵר חָבֶר וְשֹׁאֵל אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִי וְדֹרֵשׁ אֶל הַמֵּתִים׃

english.text:
or one who casts spells or who asks of a ghost or of a
spirit of an acquaintance or inquires of the dead,

translation.text: or one who casts spells, or who consults ghosts or spirits, or who seeks oracles from the dead.

verses.english:
because everyone who does these is an offensive thing of
YHWH, and because of these offensive things YHWH, your
God, is dispossessing them from in front of you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה וּבִגְלַל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מוֹרִישׁ אוֹתָם מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה וּבִגְלַל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מוֹרִישׁ אוֹתָם מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
because everyone who does these is an offensive thing of
YHWH, and because of these offensive things YHWH, your
God, is dispossessing them from in front of you.

translation.text: For whoever does practices that the LORD your God is driving them out before you.

verses.english: You shall be unblemished with YHWH, your God,
verses.hebrew: תָּמִים תִּהְיֶה עִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: תָּמִים תִּהְיֶה עִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text: You shall be unblemished with YHWH, your God,

translation.text: You must remain completely loyal to the LORD your God.

verses.english:
because these nations whom you are dispossessing listen to
soothsayers and enchanters, but you: YHWH, your God, has
not permitted such for you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יוֹרֵשׁ אוֹתָם אֶל מְעֹנְנִים וְאֶל קֹסְמִים יִשְׁמָעוּ וְאַתָּה לֹא כֵן נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יוֹרֵשׁ אוֹתָם אֶל מְעֹנְנִים וְאֶל קֹסְמִים יִשְׁמָעוּ וְאַתָּה לֹא כֵן נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
because these nations whom you are dispossessing listen to
soothsayers and enchanters, but you: YHWH, your God, has
not permitted such for you.

translation.text: Although these so.

verses.english:
YHWH, your God, will raise up for you a prophet from among
you, from your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him—
verses.hebrew: נָבִיא מִקִּרְבְּךָ מֵאַחֶיךָ כָּמֹנִי יָקִים לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵלָיו תִּשְׁמָעוּן׃

hebrew.text: נָבִיא מִקִּרְבְּךָ מֵאַחֶיךָ כָּמֹנִי יָקִים לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵלָיו תִּשְׁמָעוּן׃

english.text:
YHWH, your God, will raise up for you a prophet from among
you, from your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him—

translation.text: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you shall heed such a prophet.

verses.english:
in accordance with everything that you asked from YHWH,
your God, at Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying,
‘Let me not continue to hear the voice of YHWH, my God,
and let me not see this big fire anymore, so I won’t die!’
verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּחֹרֵב בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל לֵאמֹר לֹא אֹסֵף לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת קוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת לֹא אֶרְאֶה עוֹד וְלֹא אָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּחֹרֵב בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל לֵאמֹר לֹא אֹסֵף לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת קוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת לֹא אֶרְאֶה עוֹד וְלֹא אָמוּת׃

english.text:
in accordance with everything that you asked from YHWH,
your God, at Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying,
‘Let me not continue to hear the voice of YHWH, my God,
and let me not see this big fire anymore, so I won’t die!’

translation.text: This is what more, or ever again see this great fire, I will die."

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘They’ve been good in what they’ve
spoken.

“And YHWH said to me, ‘They’ve been good in what they’ve
spoken.

verses.english:
I’ll raise up a prophet for them from among their
brothers, like you, and I’ll put my words in his mouth,
and he’ll speak to them everything that I’ll command him.

I’ll raise up a prophet for them from among their
brothers, like you, and I’ll put my words in his mouth,
and he’ll speak to them everything that I’ll command him.

translation.text: I will raise up everything that I command.

verses.english:
And it will be: the man who won’t listen to my words that
he’ll speak in my name, I shall require it from him!
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֶל דְּבָרַי אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר בִּשְׁמִי אָנֹכִי אֶדְרֹשׁ מֵעִמּוֹ׃

And it will be: the man who won’t listen to my words that

Just: the prophet who will presume to speak a thing in my

Just: the prophet who will presume to speak a thing in my

“And if you’ll say in your heart, ‘How shall we know the

translation.text: If a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD but the thing does not take place or prove true, it is a word that the LORD has frightened by it.

verses.english:
“When YHWH, your God, will cut off the nations whose
land YHWH, your God, is giving you, and you’ll dispossess
them and live in their cities and in their houses,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יַכְרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶת אַרְצָם וִירִשְׁתָּם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בְעָרֵיהֶם וּבְבָתֵּיהֶם׃

“When YHWH, your God, will cut off the nations whose

YHWH, your God, is giving you to take possession of it.

land that YHWH, your God, will give you as a legacy into

there.

will lie in wait for him and get up against him and strike
him mortally, and he dies, and he will flee to one of
these cities,
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִהְיֶה אִישׁ שֹׂנֵא לְרֵעֵהוּ וְאָרַב לוֹ וְקָם עָלָיו וְהִכָּהוּ נֶפֶשׁ וָמֵת וְנָס אֶל אַחַת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִהְיֶה אִישׁ שֹׂנֵא לְרֵעֵהוּ וְאָרַב לוֹ וְקָם עָלָיו וְהִכָּהוּ נֶפֶשׁ וָמֵת וְנָס אֶל אַחַת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל׃

english.text:
“But if there will be a man who hates his neighbor and
will lie in wait for him and get up against him and strike
him mortally, and he dies, and he will flee to one of
these cities,

translation.text: But if someone at enmity with another lies in wait and attacks and takes the life of that person, and flees into one of these cities,

verses.english:
then his city’s elders shall send and take him from there
and put him in the hand of the avenger of blood, so he
will die.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁלְחוּ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְלָקְחוּ אֹתוֹ מִשָּׁם וְנָתְנוּ אֹתוֹ בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וָמֵת׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁלְחוּ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְלָקְחוּ אֹתוֹ מִשָּׁם וְנָתְנוּ אֹתוֹ בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וָמֵת׃

english.text:
then his city’s elders shall send and take him from there
and put him in the hand of the avenger of blood, so he
will die.

translation.text: then the elders of the killer's city shall send to have the culprit taken from there and handed over to the avenger of blood to be put to death.

verses.english:
Your eye shall not pity him. And you shall burn away the
innocent blood from Israel, and it will be well with you.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ עָלָיו וּבִעַרְתָּ דַם הַנָּקִי מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ עָלָיו וּבִעַרְתָּ דַם הַנָּקִי מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

english.text:
Your eye shall not pity him. And you shall burn away the
innocent blood from Israel, and it will be well with you.

translation.text: so that it may go well with you.

verses.english:
“You shall not move your neighbor’s landmark that the
first ones set, in your legacy that you will have in the
land that YHWH, your God, is giving you to take possession
of it.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר גָּבְלוּ רִאשֹׁנִים בְּנַחֲלָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּנְחַל בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר גָּבְלוּ רִאשֹׁנִים בְּנַחֲלָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּנְחַל בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
“You shall not move your neighbor’s landmark that the
first ones set, in your legacy that you will have in the
land that YHWH, your God, is giving you to take possession
of it.

translation.text: You must not move your neighbor's boundary marker, set up by former generations, on the property that will be allotted to you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

verses.english:
“One witness shall not get up against a man for any crime
or for any sin, in any sin that one will commit. On the
word of two witnesses or on the word of three witnesses a
case shall stand up.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יָקוּם עֵד אֶחָד בְּאִישׁ לְכל עָוֺן וּלְכל חַטָּאת בְּכל חֵטְא אֲשֶׁר יֶחֱטָא עַל פִּי שְׁנֵי עֵדִים אוֹ עַל פִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה עֵדִים יָקוּם דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יָקוּם עֵד אֶחָד בְּאִישׁ לְכל עָוֺן וּלְכל חַטָּאת בְּכל חֵטְא אֲשֶׁר יֶחֱטָא עַל פִּי שְׁנֵי עֵדִים אוֹ עַל פִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה עֵדִים יָקוּם דָּבָר׃

english.text:
“One witness shall not get up against a man for any crime
or for any sin, in any sin that one will commit. On the
word of two witnesses or on the word of three witnesses a
case shall stand up.

translation.text: A single witness shall not suffice to convict a person of any crime or wrongdoing in connection with any offense that may be committed. sustained.

verses.english:
If a malicious witness will get up against a man to
testify a misrepresentation against him,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יָקוּם עֵד חָמָס בְּאִישׁ לַעֲנוֹת בּוֹ סָרָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָקוּם עֵד חָמָס בְּאִישׁ לַעֲנוֹת בּוֹ סָרָה׃

english.text:
If a malicious witness will get up against a man to
testify a misrepresentation against him,

translation.text: If a malicious witness comes forward to accuse someone of wrongdoing,

verses.english:
and the two people who have the dispute shall stand in
front of YHWH, in front of the priests and the judges who
will be in those days,
verses.hebrew: וְעָמְדוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם הָרִיב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַשֹּׁפְטִים אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָמְדוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם הָרִיב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַשֹּׁפְטִים אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

english.text:
and the two people who have the dispute shall stand in
front of YHWH, in front of the priests and the judges who
will be in those days,

translation.text: then both parties to the dispute shall appear before days,

verses.english:
and the judges will inquire well, and, here, the witness
is a lying witness, he testified a lie against his
brother,
verses.hebrew: וְדָרְשׁוּ הַשֹּׁפְטִים הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה עֵד שֶׁקֶר הָעֵד שֶׁקֶר עָנָה בְאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְדָרְשׁוּ הַשֹּׁפְטִים הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה עֵד שֶׁקֶר הָעֵד שֶׁקֶר עָנָה בְאָחִיו׃

english.text:
and the judges will inquire well, and, here, the witness
is a lying witness, he testified a lie against his
brother,

translation.text: and the judges shall make a thorough inquiry. If the witness is a false witness, having testified falsely against another,

verses.english:
then you shall do to him as he schemed to do to his
brother. So you shall burn away what is bad from among
you.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר זָמַם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְאָחִיו וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר זָמַם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְאָחִיו וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
then you shall do to him as he schemed to do to his
brother. So you shall burn away what is bad from among
you.

translation.text: then you shall do to the false witness just as the false witness had meant to do to the other. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.

verses.english:
And those who remain will listen and fear and won’t
continue to do anything like this bad thing anymore among
you.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ וְלֹא יֹסִפוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת עוֹד כַּדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ וְלֹא יֹסִפוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת עוֹד כַּדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And those who remain will listen and fear and won’t
continue to do anything like this bad thing anymore among
you.

translation.text: The rest shall hear and be afraid, and a crime such as this shall never again be committed among you.

verses.english:
And your eye shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye,
tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶךָ נֶפֶשׁ בְּנֶפֶשׁ עַיִן בְּעַיִן שֵׁן בְּשֵׁן יָד בְּיָד רֶגֶל בְּרָגֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶךָ נֶפֶשׁ בְּנֶפֶשׁ עַיִן בְּעַיִן שֵׁן בְּשֵׁן יָד בְּיָד רֶגֶל בְּרָגֶל׃

english.text:
And your eye shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye,
tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

translation.text: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

verses.english:
“When you’ll go out to war against your enemies, and
you’ll see horses and chariots, a people more numerous
than you, you shall not fear them, because YHWH, your God,
is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תֵצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֶךָ וְרָאִיתָ סוּס וָרֶכֶב עַם רַב מִמְּךָ לֹא תִירָא מֵהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תֵצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֶךָ וְרָאִיתָ סוּס וָרֶכֶב עַם רַב מִמְּךָ לֹא תִירָא מֵהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“When you’ll go out to war against your enemies, and
you’ll see horses and chariots, a people more numerous
than you, you shall not fear them, because YHWH, your God,
is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: When you go out to war against your enemies, and see horses and land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And it will be, when you approach the war, that the priest
shall go over and speak to the people.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּקָרבְכֶם אֶל הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִגַּשׁ הַכֹּהֵן וְדִבֶּר אֶל הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּקָרבְכֶם אֶל הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִגַּשׁ הַכֹּהֵן וְדִבֶּר אֶל הָעָם׃

english.text:
And it will be, when you approach the war, that the priest
shall go over and speak to the people.

translation.text: Before you engage in battle, the priest shall come forward and speak to the troops,

verses.english:
And he shall say to them, ‘Listen, Israel, you’re
approaching war against your enemies today. Let your heart
not be weak. Don’t be afraid and don’t panic and don’t be
scared in front of them,
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם קְרֵבִים הַיּוֹם לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֵיכֶם אַל יֵרַךְ לְבַבְכֶם אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תַּחְפְּזוּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם קְרֵבִים הַיּוֹם לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֵיכֶם אַל יֵרַךְ לְבַבְכֶם אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תַּחְפְּזוּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And he shall say to them, ‘Listen, Israel, you’re
approaching war against your enemies today. Let your heart
not be weak. Don’t be afraid and don’t panic and don’t be
scared in front of them,

translation.text: and shall say to them: "Hear, O Israel! Today you are drawing near to do battle against your enemies. Do not lose heart, or be afraid, or panic, or be in dread of them;

verses.english:
because YHWH, your God, is the one going with you to fight
for you with your enemies, to save you.’
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּכֶם לְהִלָּחֵם לָכֶם עִם אֹיְבֵיכֶם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּכֶם לְהִלָּחֵם לָכֶם עִם אֹיְבֵיכֶם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
because YHWH, your God, is the one going with you to fight
for you with your enemies, to save you.’

translation.text: for it enemies, to give you victory."

verses.english:
“And the officers shall speak to the people, saying, ‘Who
is a man who has built a new house and has not dedicated
it? Let him go, and let him go back to his house, in case
he would die in the war and another man would dedicate it.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבְּרוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר מִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בַיִת חָדָשׁ וְלֹא חֲנָכוֹ יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ פֶּן יָמוּת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְאִישׁ אַחֵר יַחְנְכֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבְּרוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר מִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בַיִת חָדָשׁ וְלֹא חֲנָכוֹ יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ פֶּן יָמוּת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְאִישׁ אַחֵר יַחְנְכֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
“And the officers shall speak to the people, saying, ‘Who
is a man who has built a new house and has not dedicated
it? Let him go, and let him go back to his house, in case
he would die in the war and another man would dedicate it.

translation.text: Then the officials shall address the dedicate it.

verses.english:
And who is a man who has planted a vineyard and has not
desanctified it? Let him go, and let him go back to his
house, in case he would die in the war and another man
would desanctify it.
verses.hebrew: וּמִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נָטַע כֶּרֶם וְלֹא חִלְּלוֹ יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ פֶּן יָמוּת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְאִישׁ אַחֵר יְחַלְּלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נָטַע כֶּרֶם וְלֹא חִלְּלוֹ יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ פֶּן יָמוּת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְאִישׁ אַחֵר יְחַלְּלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
And who is a man who has planted a vineyard and has not
desanctified it? Let him go, and let him go back to his
house, in case he would die in the war and another man
would desanctify it.

translation.text: Has anyone planted a vineyard but not yet enjoyed its fruit? He should go back to his house, or he might die in the battle and another be first to enjoy its fruit.

verses.english:
And who is a man who has betrothed a woman and has not
taken her? Let him go, and let him go back to his house,
in case he would die in the war and another man would take
her.’
verses.hebrew: וּמִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵרַשׂ אִשָּׁה וְלֹא לְקָחָהּ יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ פֶּן יָמוּת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְאִישׁ אַחֵר יִקָּחֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵרַשׂ אִשָּׁה וְלֹא לְקָחָהּ יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ פֶּן יָמוּת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְאִישׁ אַחֵר יִקָּחֶנָּה׃

english.text:
And who is a man who has betrothed a woman and has not
taken her? Let him go, and let him go back to his house,
in case he would die in the war and another man would take
her.’

translation.text: Has anyone become engaged to a might die in the battle and another marry her."

verses.english:
And the officers shall continue to speak to the people and
shall say, ‘Who is a man who is afraid and weakhearted?
Let him go, and go back to his house, so he won’t melt his
brothers’ heart like his heart.’
verses.hebrew: וְיָסְפוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם וְאָמְרוּ מִי הָאִישׁ הַיָּרֵא וְרַךְ הַלֵּבָב יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ וְלֹא יִמַּס אֶת לְבַב אֶחָיו כִּלְבָבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָסְפוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם וְאָמְרוּ מִי הָאִישׁ הַיָּרֵא וְרַךְ הַלֵּבָב יֵלֵךְ וְיָשֹׁב לְבֵיתוֹ וְלֹא יִמַּס אֶת לְבַב אֶחָיו כִּלְבָבוֹ׃

english.text:
And the officers shall continue to speak to the people and
shall say, ‘Who is a man who is afraid and weakhearted?
Let him go, and go back to his house, so he won’t melt his
brothers’ heart like his heart.’

translation.text: The officials shall heart of his comrades to melt like his own."

verses.english:
And it will be, when the officers finish speaking to the
people, that they shall appoint officers of the armies at
the head of the people.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּכַלֹּת הַשֹּׁטְרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם וּפָקְדוּ שָׂרֵי צְבָאוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּכַלֹּת הַשֹּׁטְרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם וּפָקְדוּ שָׂרֵי צְבָאוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

english.text:
And it will be, when the officers finish speaking to the
people, that they shall appoint officers of the armies at
the head of the people.

translation.text: When the officials have of them.

verses.english:
“When you’ll approach a city to fight against it, then you
shall call to it for peace.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִקְרַב אֶל עִיר לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ וְקָרָאתָ אֵלֶיהָ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִקְרַב אֶל עִיר לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ וְקָרָאתָ אֵלֶיהָ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
“When you’ll approach a city to fight against it, then you
shall call to it for peace.

translation.text: When you draw near to a town to fight against it, offer it terms of peace.

verses.english:
And it will be, if it will answer you with peace and open
up to you, then it will be that all the people who are
found in it shall become yours for a work-company and
shall serve you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁלוֹם תַּעַנְךָ וּפָתְחָה לָךְ וְהָיָה כּל הָעָם הַנִּמְצָא בָהּ יִהְיוּ לְךָ לָמַס וַעֲבָדוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁלוֹם תַּעַנְךָ וּפָתְחָה לָךְ וְהָיָה כּל הָעָם הַנִּמְצָא בָהּ יִהְיוּ לְךָ לָמַס וַעֲבָדוּךָ׃

english.text:
And it will be, if it will answer you with peace and open
up to you, then it will be that all the people who are
found in it shall become yours for a work-company and
shall serve you.

translation.text: If it accepts your terms of peace and surrenders to you, then all the people in it shall serve you at forced labor.

verses.english:
And if it will not make peace with you, but it will make
war with you, then you shall besiege it.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַשְׁלִים עִמָּךְ וְעָשְׂתָה עִמְּךָ מִלְחָמָה וְצַרְתָּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַשְׁלִים עִמָּךְ וְעָשְׂתָה עִמְּךָ מִלְחָמָה וְצַרְתָּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And if it will not make peace with you, but it will make
war with you, then you shall besiege it.

translation.text: If it does not besiege it;

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will put it in your hand, and you
shall strike all its males by the sword.
verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנָהּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת כּל זְכוּרָהּ לְפִי חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנָהּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת כּל זְכוּרָהּ לְפִי חָרֶב׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will put it in your hand, and you
shall strike all its males by the sword.

translation.text: and when the LORD your God gives it into your hand, you shall put all its males to the sword.

verses.english:
Only, you shall take as spoil the women and the infants
and the animals and everything that will be in the city,
all its spoil, and you shall eat your enemies’ spoil that
YHWH, your God, has given you.
verses.hebrew: רַק הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְהַבְּהֵמָה וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בָעִיר כּל שְׁלָלָהּ תָּבֹז לָךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת שְׁלַל אֹיְבֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְהַבְּהֵמָה וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בָעִיר כּל שְׁלָלָהּ תָּבֹז לָךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת שְׁלַל אֹיְבֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ׃

english.text:
Only, you shall take as spoil the women and the infants
and the animals and everything that will be in the city,
all its spoil, and you shall eat your enemies’ spoil that
YHWH, your God, has given you.

translation.text: You may, however, take as your town, all its spoil. You may enjoy the spoil of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.

verses.english:
That is what you shall do to all the cities that are very
distant from you, those that are not from these nations’
cities.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכל הֶעָרִים הָרְחֹקֹת מִמְּךָ מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא מֵעָרֵי הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכל הֶעָרִים הָרְחֹקֹת מִמְּךָ מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא מֵעָרֵי הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
That is what you shall do to all the cities that are very
distant from you, those that are not from these nations’
cities.

translation.text: Thus you shall treat all the towns that are very far from you, which are not towns of the nations here.

verses.english:
Only from these peoples’ cities that YHWH, your God, is
giving you as a legacy shall you not let any soul live.
verses.hebrew: רַק מֵעָרֵי הָעַמִּים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לֹא תְחַיֶּה כּל נְשָׁמָה׃

hebrew.text: רַק מֵעָרֵי הָעַמִּים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לֹא תְחַיֶּה כּל נְשָׁמָה׃

english.text:
Only from these peoples’ cities that YHWH, your God, is
giving you as a legacy shall you not let any soul live.

translation.text: But alive.

verses.english:
But you shall completely destroy them—the Hittite and the
Amorite, the Canaanite and the Perizzite, the Hivite and
the Jebusite—as YHWH, your God, has commanded you,
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַחֲרֵם תַּחֲרִימֵם הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַחֲרֵם תַּחֲרִימֵם הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
But you shall completely destroy them—the Hittite and the
Amorite, the Canaanite and the Perizzite, the Hivite and
the Jebusite—as YHWH, your God, has commanded you,

translation.text: You shall annihilate them — the Hittites and the Amorites, the the LORD your God has commanded,

verses.english:
so they won’t teach you to do things like all their
offensive things that they did for their gods, and you’ll
sin to YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְלַמְּדוּ אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל תּוֹעֲבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וַחֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְלַמְּדוּ אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל תּוֹעֲבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וַחֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
so they won’t teach you to do things like all their
offensive things that they did for their gods, and you’ll
sin to YHWH, your God.

translation.text: so that they may not teach you to do all the abhorrent things that they do for their gods, and you thus sin against the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“When you’ll besiege a city many days, fighting against it
to capture it, you shall not destroy a tree of it, moving
an axe at it, because you’ll eat from it, so you shall not
cut it down; because is a tree of the field a human, to go
from in front of you in a siege?!
verses.hebrew: כִּי תָצוּר אֶל עִיר יָמִים רַבִּים לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ לְתפְשָׂהּ לֹא תַשְׁחִית אֶת עֵצָהּ לִנְדֹּחַ עָלָיו גַּרְזֶן כִּי מִמֶּנּוּ תֹאכֵל וְאֹתוֹ לֹא תִכְרֹת כִּי הָאָדָם עֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה לָבֹא מִפָּנֶיךָ בַּמָּצוֹר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תָצוּר אֶל עִיר יָמִים רַבִּים לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ לְתפְשָׂהּ לֹא תַשְׁחִית אֶת עֵצָהּ לִנְדֹּחַ עָלָיו גַּרְזֶן כִּי מִמֶּנּוּ תֹאכֵל וְאֹתוֹ לֹא תִכְרֹת כִּי הָאָדָם עֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה לָבֹא מִפָּנֶיךָ בַּמָּצוֹר׃

english.text:
“When you’ll besiege a city many days, fighting against it
to capture it, you shall not destroy a tree of it, moving
an axe at it, because you’ll eat from it, so you shall not
cut it down; because is a tree of the field a human, to go
from in front of you in a siege?!

translation.text: If you besiege a town for a long time, making war against it in order under siege from you?

verses.english:
Only a tree that you’ll know that it isn’t a tree for
eating: that one you may destroy and cut down so you may
build a siege-work against the city that is making war
with you until its fall.
verses.hebrew: רַק עֵץ אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע כִּי לֹא עֵץ מַאֲכָל הוּא אֹתוֹ תַשְׁחִית וְכָרָתָּ וּבָנִיתָ מָצוֹר עַל הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר הִוא עֹשָׂה עִמְּךָ מִלְחָמָה עַד רִדְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: רַק עֵץ אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע כִּי לֹא עֵץ מַאֲכָל הוּא אֹתוֹ תַשְׁחִית וְכָרָתָּ וּבָנִיתָ מָצוֹר עַל הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר הִוא עֹשָׂה עִמְּךָ מִלְחָמָה עַד רִדְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
Only a tree that you’ll know that it isn’t a tree for
eating: that one you may destroy and cut down so you may
build a siege-work against the city that is making war
with you until its fall.

translation.text: You may destroy only the trees that you siegeworks against the town that makes war with you, until it falls.

verses.english:
“If a corpse will be found in the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you to take possession of it, fallen in the
field, unknown who struck him,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמָּצֵא חָלָל בָּאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּהּ נֹפֵל בַּשָּׂדֶה לֹא נוֹדַע מִי הִכָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִמָּצֵא חָלָל בָּאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּהּ נֹפֵל בַּשָּׂדֶה לֹא נוֹדַע מִי הִכָּהוּ׃

english.text:
“If a corpse will be found in the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you to take possession of it, fallen in the
field, unknown who struck him,

translation.text: If, in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess, a body person down,

verses.english:
then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure
to the cities that are around the corpse.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצְאוּ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶיךָ וּמָדְדוּ אֶל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹת הֶחָלָל׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצְאוּ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶיךָ וּמָדְדוּ אֶל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹת הֶחָלָל׃

english.text:
then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure
to the cities that are around the corpse.

translation.text: then your elders and your judges shall come out to measure the distances to the towns that are near the body.

verses.english:
And it will be, the closest city to the corpse: that
city’s elders shall take a heifer that has not been worked
with, that has not pulled in a yoke.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הָעִיר הַקְּרֹבָה אֶל הֶחָלָל וְלָקְחוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא עֶגְלַת בָּקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא עֻבַּד בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא מָשְׁכָה בְּעֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הָעִיר הַקְּרֹבָה אֶל הֶחָלָל וְלָקְחוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא עֶגְלַת בָּקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא עֻבַּד בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא מָשְׁכָה בְּעֹל׃

english.text:
And it will be, the closest city to the corpse: that
city’s elders shall take a heifer that has not been worked
with, that has not pulled in a yoke.

translation.text: The been worked, one that has not pulled in the yoke;

verses.english:
And that city’s elders shall take the heifer down to a
strongly flowing wadi that would not be worked with and
would not be seeded, and they shall break the heifer’s
neck there in the wadi.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרִדוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא אֶת הָעֶגְלָה אֶל נַחַל אֵיתָן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵעָבֵד בּוֹ וְלֹא יִזָּרֵעַ וְעָרְפוּ שָׁם אֶת הָעֶגְלָה בַּנָּחַל׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹרִדוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא אֶת הָעֶגְלָה אֶל נַחַל אֵיתָן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵעָבֵד בּוֹ וְלֹא יִזָּרֵעַ וְעָרְפוּ שָׁם אֶת הָעֶגְלָה בַּנָּחַל׃

english.text:
And that city’s elders shall take the heifer down to a
strongly flowing wadi that would not be worked with and
would not be seeded, and they shall break the heifer’s
neck there in the wadi.

translation.text: the elders of that the wadi.

verses.english:
And the priests, sons of Levi, shall go over, because
YHWH, your God, chose them to serve Him and to bless in
YHWH’s name, and every dispute and every injury shall be
by their word.
verses.hebrew: וְנִגְּשׁוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי בָם בָּחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשָׁרְתוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וְעַל פִּיהֶם יִהְיֶה כּל רִיב וְכל נָגַע׃

hebrew.text: וְנִגְּשׁוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי בָם בָּחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשָׁרְתוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וְעַל פִּיהֶם יִהְיֶה כּל רִיב וְכל נָגַע׃

english.text:
And the priests, sons of Levi, shall go over, because
YHWH, your God, chose them to serve Him and to bless in
YHWH’s name, and every dispute and every injury shall be
by their word.

translation.text: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, for cases of dispute and assault shall be settled.

verses.english:
And all of that city’s elders, who are close to the
corpse, shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck
was broken in the wadi.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא הַקְּרֹבִים אֶל הֶחָלָל יִרְחֲצוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל הָעֶגְלָה הָעֲרוּפָה בַנָּחַל׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא הַקְּרֹבִים אֶל הֶחָלָל יִרְחֲצוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל הָעֶגְלָה הָעֲרוּפָה בַנָּחַל׃

english.text:
And all of that city’s elders, who are close to the
