was broken in the wadi.

translation.text: All the elders of that neck was broken in the wadi,

verses.english:
And they shall testify, and they shall say, ‘Our hands did
not spill this blood, and our eyes did not see it.
verses.hebrew: וְעָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ יָדֵינוּ לֹא (שפכה) [שָׁפְכוּ] אֶת הַדָּם הַזֶּה וְעֵינֵינוּ לֹא רָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ יָדֵינוּ לֹא (שפכה) [שָׁפְכוּ] אֶת הַדָּם הַזֶּה וְעֵינֵינוּ לֹא רָאוּ׃

english.text:
And they shall testify, and they shall say, ‘Our hands did
not spill this blood, and our eyes did not see it.

translation.text: and they shall declare: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor were we witnesses to it.

verses.english:
Grant atonement for your people Israel, whom you redeemed,
YHWH, and don’t impute innocent blood among your people
Israel.’ And for them the blood will be atoned for.
verses.hebrew: כַּפֵּר לְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ יְהֹוָה וְאַל תִּתֵּן דָּם נָקִי בְּקֶרֶב עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִכַּפֵּר לָהֶם הַדָּם׃

hebrew.text: כַּפֵּר לְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ יְהֹוָה וְאַל תִּתֵּן דָּם נָקִי בְּקֶרֶב עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִכַּפֵּר לָהֶם הַדָּם׃

english.text:
Grant atonement for your people Israel, whom you redeemed,
YHWH, and don’t impute innocent blood among your people
Israel.’ And for them the blood will be atoned for.

translation.text: Absolve, O LORD, will be absolved of bloodguilt.

verses.english:
So you shall burn away the innocent blood from among you
when you will do what is right in YHWH’s eyes.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תְּבַעֵר הַדָּם הַנָּקִי מִקִּרְבֶּךָ כִּי תַעֲשֶׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תְּבַעֵר הַדָּם הַנָּקִי מִקִּרְבֶּךָ כִּי תַעֲשֶׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So you shall burn away the innocent blood from among you
when you will do what is right in YHWH’s eyes.

translation.text: So you shall purge the guilt of the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
“When you’ll go out to war against your
enemies, and YHWH, your God, will put him in your hand,
and you’ll take prisoners from him,
verses.hebrew: כִּי תֵצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וּנְתָנוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְשָׁבִיתָ שִׁבְיוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תֵצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וּנְתָנוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְשָׁבִיתָ שִׁבְיוֹ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll go out to war against your
enemies, and YHWH, your God, will put him in your hand,
and you’ll take prisoners from him,

translation.text: When you go out to war against your enemies, and the LORD your God hands them over to you and you take them captive,

verses.english:
and you’ll see among the prisoners a woman with a
beautiful figure, and you’ll be attracted to her and take
her for yourself as a wife,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאִיתָ בַּשִּׁבְיָה אֵשֶׁת יְפַת תֹּאַר וְחָשַׁקְתָּ בָהּ וְלָקַחְתָּ לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאִיתָ בַּשִּׁבְיָה אֵשֶׁת יְפַת תֹּאַר וְחָשַׁקְתָּ בָהּ וְלָקַחְתָּ לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
and you’ll see among the prisoners a woman with a
beautiful figure, and you’ll be attracted to her and take
her for yourself as a wife,

translation.text: suppose want to marry,

verses.english:
then you shall bring her into your house, and she shall
shave her head and do her nails
verses.hebrew: וַהֲבֵאתָהּ אֶל תּוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ וְגִלְּחָה אֶת רֹאשָׁהּ וְעָשְׂתָה אֶת צִפּרְנֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲבֵאתָהּ אֶל תּוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ וְגִלְּחָה אֶת רֹאשָׁהּ וְעָשְׂתָה אֶת צִפּרְנֶיהָ׃

english.text:
then you shall bring her into your house, and she shall
shave her head and do her nails

translation.text: and so you bring her home to your house: she shall shave her head, pare her nails,

verses.english:
and take away her prisoner’s garment from on her. And she
shall live in your house and shall mourn her father and
her mother a month of days. And after that you may come to
her and marry her, and she shall become your wife.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵסִירָה אֶת שִׂמְלַת שִׁבְיָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וְיָשְׁבָה בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבָכְתָה אֶת אָבִיהָ וְאֶת אִמָּהּ יֶרַח יָמִים וְאַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא אֵלֶיהָ וּבְעַלְתָּהּ וְהָיְתָה לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵסִירָה אֶת שִׂמְלַת שִׁבְיָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וְיָשְׁבָה בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבָכְתָה אֶת אָבִיהָ וְאֶת אִמָּהּ יֶרַח יָמִים וְאַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא אֵלֶיהָ וּבְעַלְתָּהּ וְהָיְתָה לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
and take away her prisoner’s garment from on her. And she
shall live in your house and shall mourn her father and
her mother a month of days. And after that you may come to
her and marry her, and she shall become your wife.

translation.text: discard her captive's garb, and shall shall be your wife.

verses.english:
And it will be, if you don’t desire her then you shall let
her go on her own, and you shall not sell her for money.
You shall not get profit through her, because you degraded
her.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא חָפַצְתָּ בָּהּ וְשִׁלַּחְתָּהּ לְנַפְשָׁהּ וּמָכֹר לֹא תִמְכְּרֶנָּה בַּכָּסֶף לֹא תִתְעַמֵּר בָּהּ תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עִנִּיתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא חָפַצְתָּ בָּהּ וְשִׁלַּחְתָּהּ לְנַפְשָׁהּ וּמָכֹר לֹא תִמְכְּרֶנָּה בַּכָּסֶף לֹא תִתְעַמֵּר בָּהּ תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עִנִּיתָהּ׃

And it will be, if you don’t desire her then you shall let
her go on her own, and you shall not sell her for money.
You shall not get profit through her, because you degraded
her.

translation.text: But if you are not satisfied with her, you shall let slave, since you have dishonored her.

verses.english:
“When a man will have two wives, one loved and one hated,
and they’ll give birth to children for him, the loved and
the hated, and the hated will have the firstborn son,
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִהְיֶיןָ לְאִישׁ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים הָאַחַת אֲהוּבָה וְהָאַחַת שְׂנוּאָה וְיָלְדוּ לוֹ בָנִים הָאֲהוּבָה וְהַשְּׂנוּאָה וְהָיָה הַבֵּן הַבְּכֹר לַשְּׂנִיאָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִהְיֶיןָ לְאִישׁ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים הָאַחַת אֲהוּבָה וְהָאַחַת שְׂנוּאָה וְיָלְדוּ לוֹ בָנִים הָאֲהוּבָה וְהַשְּׂנוּאָה וְהָיָה הַבֵּן הַבְּכֹר לַשְּׂנִיאָה׃

english.text:
“When a man will have two wives, one loved and one hated,
and they’ll give birth to children for him, the loved and
the hated, and the hated will have the firstborn son,

translation.text: If a man has two wives, one of them loved and the other disliked, firstborn being the son of the one who is disliked,

verses.english:
then it will be, on the day that he gives what he has as a
legacy to his children, he shall not be able to give a son
of the loved one the birthright before the firstborn son
of the hated one.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם הַנְחִילוֹ אֶת בָּנָיו אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לוֹ לֹא יוּכַל לְבַכֵּר אֶת בֶּן הָאֲהוּבָה עַל פְּנֵי בֶן הַשְּׂנוּאָה הַבְּכֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם הַנְחִילוֹ אֶת בָּנָיו אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לוֹ לֹא יוּכַל לְבַכֵּר אֶת בֶּן הָאֲהוּבָה עַל פְּנֵי בֶן הַשְּׂנוּאָה הַבְּכֹר׃

english.text:
then it will be, on the day that he gives what he has as a
legacy to his children, he shall not be able to give a son
of the loved one the birthright before the firstborn son
of the hated one.

translation.text: then on the day when he wills his possessions to his sons, he is not permitted to treat disliked, who is the firstborn.

verses.english:
But he shall recognize the firstborn son of the hated one,
to give him a double portion of all that he has, because
he is the beginning of his might. The legal due of the
firstborn is his.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת הַבְּכֹר בֶּן הַשְּׂנוּאָה יַכִּיר לָתֶת לוֹ פִּי שְׁנַיִם בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא לוֹ כִּי הוּא רֵאשִׁית אֹנוֹ לוֹ מִשְׁפַּט הַבְּכֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת הַבְּכֹר בֶּן הַשְּׂנוּאָה יַכִּיר לָתֶת לוֹ פִּי שְׁנַיִם בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא לוֹ כִּי הוּא רֵאשִׁית אֹנוֹ לוֹ מִשְׁפַּט הַבְּכֹרָה׃

english.text:
But he shall recognize the firstborn son of the hated one,
to give him a double portion of all that he has, because
he is the beginning of his might. The legal due of the
firstborn is his.

translation.text: He must acknowledge as firstborn the son of the one who is disliked, giving him a double portion of all that he has; since he is the first issue of his virility, the right of the firstborn is his.

verses.english:
“When a man will have a stubborn and rebellious son, not
listening to his father’s voice and his mother’s voice,
and they will discipline him, but he will not listen to
them,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ בֵּן סוֹרֵר וּמוֹרֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁמֵעַ בְּקוֹל אָבִיו וּבְקוֹל אִמּוֹ וְיִסְּרוּ אֹתוֹ וְלֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ בֵּן סוֹרֵר וּמוֹרֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁמֵעַ בְּקוֹל אָבִיו וּבְקוֹל אִמּוֹ וְיִסְּרוּ אֹתוֹ וְלֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“When a man will have a stubborn and rebellious son, not
listening to his father’s voice and his mother’s voice,
and they will discipline him, but he will not listen to
them,

translation.text: If someone has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey his

verses.english:
then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and
bring him out to his city’s elders and to the gate of his
place.
verses.hebrew: וְתָפְשׂוּ בוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְאֶל שַׁעַר מְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְתָפְשׂוּ בוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְאֶל שַׁעַר מְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and
bring him out to his city’s elders and to the gate of his
place.

translation.text: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his town at the gate of that place.

verses.english:
And they shall say to his city’s elders, ‘This son of ours
is stubborn and rebellious, he doesn’t listen to our
voice, a glutton, and a drunk.’
verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ אֶל זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ בְּנֵנוּ זֶה סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁמֵעַ בְּקֹלֵנוּ זוֹלֵל וְסֹבֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמְרוּ אֶל זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ בְּנֵנוּ זֶה סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁמֵעַ בְּקֹלֵנוּ זוֹלֵל וְסֹבֵא׃

english.text:
And they shall say to his city’s elders, ‘This son of ours
is stubborn and rebellious, he doesn’t listen to our
voice, a glutton, and a drunk.’

translation.text: They shall say to the elders of his town, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard."

verses.english:
And all his city’s people shall batter him with stones so
he dies. So you shall burn away what is bad from among
you. And all Israel will listen and fear.
verses.hebrew: וּרְגָמֻהוּ כּל אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ בָאֲבָנִים וָמֵת וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּרְגָמֻהוּ כּל אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ בָאֲבָנִים וָמֵת וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ׃

english.text:
And all his city’s people shall batter him with stones so
he dies. So you shall burn away what is bad from among
you. And all Israel will listen and fear.

translation.text: Then all the from your midst; and all Israel will hear, and be afraid.

verses.english:
“And if there will be a sin bringing a sentence of death
on a man, and he will be put to death, and you will hang
him on a tree,
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בְאִישׁ חֵטְא מִשְׁפַּט מָוֶת וְהוּמָת וְתָלִיתָ אֹתוֹ עַל עֵץ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בְאִישׁ חֵטְא מִשְׁפַּט מָוֶת וְהוּמָת וְתָלִיתָ אֹתוֹ עַל עֵץ׃

english.text:
“And if there will be a sin bringing a sentence of death
on a man, and he will be put to death, and you will hang
him on a tree,

translation.text: When someone is convicted of a crime punishable by death and is executed, and you hang him on a tree,

verses.english:
you shall not leave his corpse on the tree, but you shall
bury him on that day, because a hanged person is an
offense to God, and you shall not make impure your land
that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תָלִין נִבְלָתוֹ עַל הָעֵץ כִּי קָבוֹר תִּקְבְּרֶנּוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי קִלְלַת אֱלֹהִים תָּלוּי וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת אַדְמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תָלִין נִבְלָתוֹ עַל הָעֵץ כִּי קָבוֹר תִּקְבְּרֶנּוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי קִלְלַת אֱלֹהִים תָּלוּי וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת אַדְמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
you shall not leave his corpse on the tree, but you shall
bury him on that day, because a hanged person is an
offense to God, and you shall not make impure your land
that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy.

translation.text: his corpse must not remain the LORD your God is giving you for possession.

verses.english:
“You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep
driven off, and you hide yourself from them. You shall
bring them back to your brother.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִרְאֶה אֶת שׁוֹר אָחִיךָ אוֹ אֶת שֵׂיוֹ נִדָּחִים וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ מֵהֶם הָשֵׁב תְּשִׁיבֵם לְאָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִרְאֶה אֶת שׁוֹר אָחִיךָ אוֹ אֶת שֵׂיוֹ נִדָּחִים וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ מֵהֶם הָשֵׁב תְּשִׁיבֵם לְאָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep
driven off, and you hide yourself from them. You shall
bring them back to your brother.

translation.text: You shall not watch your neighbor's ox or sheep straying away and ignore them; you shall take them back to their owner.

verses.english:
And if your brother is not close to you, and you don’t
know him, then you shall gather it into your house, and it
shall be with you until your brother inquires about it,
and you shall give it back to him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא קָרוֹב אָחִיךָ אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא יְדַעְתּוֹ וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ אֶל תּוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ וְהָיָה עִמְּךָ עַד דְּרֹשׁ אָחִיךָ אֹתוֹ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתוֹ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא קָרוֹב אָחִיךָ אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא יְדַעְתּוֹ וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ אֶל תּוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ וְהָיָה עִמְּךָ עַד דְּרֹשׁ אָחִיךָ אֹתוֹ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתוֹ לוֹ׃

english.text:
And if your brother is not close to you, and you don’t
know him, then you shall gather it into your house, and it
shall be with you until your brother inquires about it,
and you shall give it back to him.

translation.text: If the owner shall bring it to your own house, and it shall remain with you until the owner claims it; then you shall return it.

verses.english:
And you shall do that with his ass, and you shall do that
with his garment, and you shall do that with any lost
thing of your brother’s that will be lost by him and you
find it. You may not hide yourself.
verses.hebrew: וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשִׂמְלָתוֹ וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכל אֲבֵדַת אָחִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאבַד מִמֶּנּוּ וּמְצָאתָהּ לֹא תוּכַל לְהִתְעַלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשִׂמְלָתוֹ וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכל אֲבֵדַת אָחִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאבַד מִמֶּנּוּ וּמְצָאתָהּ לֹא תוּכַל לְהִתְעַלֵּם׃

english.text:
And you shall do that with his ass, and you shall do that
with his garment, and you shall do that with any lost
thing of your brother’s that will be lost by him and you
find it. You may not hide yourself.

translation.text: You shall do the same with a neighbor's donkey; you shall do the same with a neighbor's garment; and you find. You may not withhold your help.

verses.english:
You shall not see your brother’s ass or his ox falling in
the road, and you hide yourself from them. You shall lift
it up with him.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִרְאֶה אֶת חֲמוֹר אָחִיךָ אוֹ שׁוֹרוֹ נֹפְלִים בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ מֵהֶם הָקֵם תָּקִים עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִרְאֶה אֶת חֲמוֹר אָחִיךָ אוֹ שׁוֹרוֹ נֹפְלִים בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ מֵהֶם הָקֵם תָּקִים עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall not see your brother’s ass or his ox falling in
the road, and you hide yourself from them. You shall lift
it up with him.

translation.text: You shall not see your neighbor's donkey or ox fallen on the road and ignore it; you shall help to lift it up.

verses.english:
“There shall not be a man’s item on a woman, and a man
shall not wear a woman’s garment, because everyone who
does these is an offensive thing of YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶה כְלִי גֶבֶר עַל אִשָּׁה וְלֹא יִלְבַּשׁ גֶּבֶר שִׂמְלַת אִשָּׁה כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶה כְלִי גֶבֶר עַל אִשָּׁה וְלֹא יִלְבַּשׁ גֶּבֶר שִׂמְלַת אִשָּׁה כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
“There shall not be a man’s item on a woman, and a man
shall not wear a woman’s garment, because everyone who
does these is an offensive thing of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: A woman shall not wear a man's apparel, nor shall a man put on a LORD your God.

verses.english:
“When a bird’s nest will happen to be in front of you on
the road in any tree or on the ground—chicks or eggs—and
the mother is sitting over the chicks or over the eggs,
you shall not take the mother along with the children.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִקָּרֵא קַן צִפּוֹר לְפָנֶיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּכל עֵץ אוֹ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֶפְרֹחִים אוֹ בֵיצִים וְהָאֵם רֹבֶצֶת עַל הָאֶפְרֹחִים אוֹ עַל הַבֵּיצִים לֹא תִקַּח הָאֵם עַל הַבָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִקָּרֵא קַן צִפּוֹר לְפָנֶיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּכל עֵץ אוֹ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֶפְרֹחִים אוֹ בֵיצִים וְהָאֵם רֹבֶצֶת עַל הָאֶפְרֹחִים אוֹ עַל הַבֵּיצִים לֹא תִקַּח הָאֵם עַל הַבָּנִים׃

english.text:
“When a bird’s nest will happen to be in front of you on
the road in any tree or on the ground—chicks or eggs—and
the mother is sitting over the chicks or over the eggs,
you shall not take the mother along with the children.

translation.text: If you come on a bird's nest, in any tree or on the ground, with fledglings or eggs, with the mother sitting on the fledglings or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.

verses.english:
You shall let the mother go, and you may take the children
for you, so that it will be good for you, and you will
extend days.
verses.hebrew: שַׁלֵּחַ תְּשַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֵם וְאֶת הַבָּנִים תִּקַּח לָךְ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וְהַאֲרַכְתָּ יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: שַׁלֵּחַ תְּשַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֵם וְאֶת הַבָּנִים תִּקַּח לָךְ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וְהַאֲרַכְתָּ יָמִים׃

english.text:
You shall let the mother go, and you may take the children
for you, so that it will be good for you, and you will
extend days.

translation.text: Let the mother with you and you may live long.

verses.english:
“When you’ll build a new house, you shall make a railing
for your roof, so you won’t set blood in your house when
someone will fall from it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִבְנֶה בַּיִת חָדָשׁ וְעָשִׂיתָ מַעֲקֶה לְגַגֶּךָ וְלֹא תָשִׂים דָּמִים בְּבֵיתֶךָ כִּי יִפֹּל הַנֹּפֵל מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִבְנֶה בַּיִת חָדָשׁ וְעָשִׂיתָ מַעֲקֶה לְגַגֶּךָ וְלֹא תָשִׂים דָּמִים בְּבֵיתֶךָ כִּי יִפֹּל הַנֹּפֵל מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll build a new house, you shall make a railing
for your roof, so you won’t set blood in your house when
someone will fall from it.

translation.text: When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof; fall from it.

verses.english:
“You shall not seed your vineyard with two kinds, or else
the whole of the seed that you’ll sow and the vineyard’s
produce will become holy.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִזְרַע כַּרְמְךָ כִּלְאָיִם פֶּן תִּקְדַּשׁ הַמְלֵאָה הַזֶּרַע אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרָע וּתְבוּאַת הַכָּרֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִזְרַע כַּרְמְךָ כִּלְאָיִם פֶּן תִּקְדַּשׁ הַמְלֵאָה הַזֶּרַע אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרָע וּתְבוּאַת הַכָּרֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall not seed your vineyard with two kinds, or else
the whole of the seed that you’ll sow and the vineyard’s
produce will become holy.

translation.text: You shall not sow your vineyard with a second kind of seed, or the whole yield will have to be forfeited, both the crop that you have sown and the yield of the vineyard itself.

verses.english: You shall not plow with an ox and an ass together.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַחֲרֹשׁ בְּשׁוֹר וּבַחֲמֹר יַחְדָּו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַחֲרֹשׁ בְּשׁוֹר וּבַחֲמֹר יַחְדָּו׃

english.text: You shall not plow with an ox and an ass together.

translation.text: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.

verses.english: You shall not wear sha‘atnez: wool and linen together.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִלְבַּשׁ שַׁעַטְנֵז צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים יַחְדָּו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִלְבַּשׁ שַׁעַטְנֵז צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים יַחְדָּו׃

english.text: You shall not wear sha‘atnez: wool and linen together.

translation.text: You shall not wear clothes made of wool and linen woven together.

verses.english:
“You shall make braided threads on the four corners of
your apparel with which you cover yourself.
verses.hebrew: גְּדִלִים תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ עַל אַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת כְּסוּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּכַסֶּה בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: גְּדִלִים תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ עַל אַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת כְּסוּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּכַסֶּה בָּהּ׃

english.text:
“You shall make braided threads on the four corners of
your apparel with which you cover yourself.

translation.text: You shall make tassels on the four corners of the cloak with which you cover yourself.

verses.english:
“When a man will take a wife and come to her and then hate
her,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה וּבָא אֵלֶיהָ וּשְׂנֵאָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה וּבָא אֵלֶיהָ וּשְׂנֵאָהּ׃

english.text:
“When a man will take a wife and come to her and then hate
her,

translation.text: Suppose a man marries a woman, but after going in to her, he dislikes her

verses.english:
and he’ll assert words of abuse toward her and bring out a
bad name on her and say, ‘I took this woman, and I came
close to her, and I didn’t find signs of virginity for
her,’
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂם לָהּ עֲלִילֹת דְּבָרִים וְהוֹצִא עָלֶיהָ שֵׁם רָע וְאָמַר אֶת הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָקַחְתִּי וָאֶקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וְלֹא מָצָאתִי לָהּ בְּתוּלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂם לָהּ עֲלִילֹת דְּבָרִים וְהוֹצִא עָלֶיהָ שֵׁם רָע וְאָמַר אֶת הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָקַחְתִּי וָאֶקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וְלֹא מָצָאתִי לָהּ בְּתוּלִים׃

english.text:
and he’ll assert words of abuse toward her and bring out a
bad name on her and say, ‘I took this woman, and I came
close to her, and I didn’t find signs of virginity for
her,’

translation.text: and makes up charges against her, slandering her by evidence of her virginity."

verses.english:
then the young woman’s father and her mother shall take
and bring out the signs of the young woman’s virginity to
the city’s elders at the gate.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָ וְאִמָּהּ וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֶת בְּתוּלֵי הַנַּעֲרָ אֶל זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַשָּׁעְרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָ וְאִמָּהּ וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֶת בְּתוּלֵי הַנַּעֲרָ אֶל זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַשָּׁעְרָה׃

english.text:
then the young woman’s father and her mother shall take
and bring out the signs of the young woman’s virginity to
the city’s elders at the gate.

translation.text: The father of the young woman and her to the elders of the city at the gate.

verses.english:
“And the young woman’s father shall say to the elders, ‘I
gave my daughter to this man for a wife, and he hated her.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָ אֶל הַזְּקֵנִים אֶת בִּתִּי נָתַתִּי לָאִישׁ הַזֶּה לְאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָ אֶל הַזְּקֵנִים אֶת בִּתִּי נָתַתִּי לָאִישׁ הַזֶּה לְאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ׃

english.text:
“And the young woman’s father shall say to the elders, ‘I
gave my daughter to this man for a wife, and he hated her.

translation.text: The father of the young woman shall say to the elders: "I gave my daughter in marriage to this man but he dislikes her;

verses.english:
And, here, he has asserted words of abuse, saying: “I
didn’t find signs of virginity for your daughter.” But
these are the signs of my daughter’s virginity!’ And they
shall spread out the garment in front of the city’s
elders.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה הוּא שָׂם עֲלִילֹת דְּבָרִים לֵאמֹר לֹא מָצָאתִי לְבִתְּךָ בְּתוּלִים וְאֵלֶּה בְּתוּלֵי בִתִּי וּפָרְשׂוּ הַשִּׂמְלָה לִפְנֵי זִקְנֵי הָעִיר׃

Egypt, and the fact that it hired Balaam son of Beor from
Pethor of Aram Naharaim against you to curse you.
verses.hebrew: עַל דְּבַר אֲשֶׁר לֹא קִדְּמוּ אֶתְכֶם בַּלֶּחֶם וּבַמַּיִם בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׂכַר עָלֶיךָ אֶת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר מִפְּתוֹר אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם לְקַלְלֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל דְּבַר אֲשֶׁר לֹא קִדְּמוּ אֶתְכֶם בַּלֶּחֶם וּבַמַּיִם בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׂכַר עָלֶיךָ אֶת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר מִפְּתוֹר אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם לְקַלְלֶךָּ׃

english.text:
on account of the fact that they did not meet you with
bread and with water on the way when you came out from
Egypt, and the fact that it hired Balaam son of Beor from
Pethor of Aram Naharaim against you to curse you.

translation.text: (Yet the LORD your God refused to heed Balaam; the LORD your God loved you.)

verses.english:
But YHWH, your God, was not willing to listen to Balaam,
and YHWH, your God, turned the curse into a blessing for
you because YHWH, your God, loved you.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְּךָ אֶת הַקְּלָלָה לִבְרָכָה כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אָבָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְּךָ אֶת הַקְּלָלָה לִבְרָכָה כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
But YHWH, your God, was not willing to listen to Balaam,
and YHWH, your God, turned the curse into a blessing for
you because YHWH, your God, loved you.

translation.text: You shall never promote their welfare or their prosperity as long as you live.

verses.english:
You shall not seek their well-being or their good, all
your days, forever.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִדְרֹשׁ שְׁלֹמָם וְטֹבָתָם כּל יָמֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִדְרֹשׁ שְׁלֹמָם וְטֹבָתָם כּל יָמֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
You shall not seek their well-being or their good, all
your days, forever.

translation.text: You shall not abhor any of the Edomites, for they are your kin. You residing in their land.

verses.english:
“You shall not abhor an Edomite, because he is your
brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were
an alien in his land.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תְתַעֵב אֲדֹמִי כִּי אָחִיךָ הוּא לֹא תְתַעֵב מִצְרִי כִּי גֵר הָיִיתָ בְאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תְתַעֵב אֲדֹמִי כִּי אָחִיךָ הוּא לֹא תְתַעֵב מִצְרִי כִּי גֵר הָיִיתָ בְאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
“You shall not abhor an Edomite, because he is your
brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were
an alien in his land.

translation.text: The children of the third generation that are born to them may be admitted to the assembly of the LORD.

verses.english:
Third-generation children who will be born to them may
come into YHWH’s community.
verses.hebrew: בָּנִים אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלְדוּ לָהֶם דּוֹר שְׁלִישִׁי יָבֹא לָהֶם בִּקְהַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בָּנִים אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלְדוּ לָהֶם דּוֹר שְׁלִישִׁי יָבֹא לָהֶם בִּקְהַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Third-generation children who will be born to them may
come into YHWH’s community.

translation.text: When you are encamped against your enemies you shall guard against any impropriety.

verses.english:
“When you’ll go out encamped against your enemies, you
shall be watchful against any bad thing.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תֵצֵא מַחֲנֶה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְנִשְׁמַרְתָּ מִכֹּל דָּבָר רָע׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תֵצֵא מַחֲנֶה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְנִשְׁמַרְתָּ מִכֹּל דָּבָר רָע׃

english.text:
“When you’ll go out encamped against your enemies, you
shall be watchful against any bad thing.

translation.text: If one of you becomes unclean because of a nocturnal emission, then he shall go outside the camp; he must not come within the camp.

verses.english:
If there will be among you a man who will not be pure by a
night occurrence, then he shall go outside the camp. He
shall not come inside the camp.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִהְיֶה בְךָ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִהְיֶה טָהוֹר מִקְּרֵה לָיְלָה וְיָצָא אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה לֹא יָבֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִהְיֶה בְךָ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִהְיֶה טָהוֹר מִקְּרֵה לָיְלָה וְיָצָא אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה לֹא יָבֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
If there will be among you a man who will not be pure by a
night occurrence, then he shall go outside the camp. He
shall not come inside the camp.

translation.text: sun has set, he may come back into the camp.

verses.english:
And it shall be: toward evening he shall wash in water,
and when the sun sets he shall come inside the camp.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לִפְנוֹת עֶרֶב יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וּכְבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָבֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לִפְנוֹת עֶרֶב יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וּכְבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָבֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And it shall be: toward evening he shall wash in water,
and when the sun sets he shall come inside the camp.

translation.text: You shall have a designated area outside the camp to which you shall go.

verses.english:
And you shall have a location outside the camp, and you
shall go out there, outside;
verses.hebrew: וְיָד תִּהְיֶה לְךָ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְיָצָאתָ שָּׁמָּה חוּץ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָד תִּהְיֶה לְךָ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְיָצָאתָ שָּׁמָּה חוּץ׃

english.text:
And you shall have a location outside the camp, and you
shall go out there, outside;

translation.text: With your utensils you shall have a trowel; when you relieve excrement.

verses.english:
and you shall have a spade among your equipment, and it
shall be, when you sit outside, that you shall dig with
it, and you shall go back and cover what comes out of you.
verses.hebrew: וְיָתֵד תִּהְיֶה לְךָ עַל אֲזֵנֶךָ וְהָיָה בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ חוּץ וְחָפַרְתָּה בָהּ וְשַׁבְתָּ וְכִסִּיתָ אֶת צֵאָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָתֵד תִּהְיֶה לְךָ עַל אֲזֵנֶךָ וְהָיָה בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ חוּץ וְחָפַרְתָּה בָהּ וְשַׁבְתָּ וְכִסִּיתָ אֶת צֵאָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
and you shall have a spade among your equipment, and it
shall be, when you sit outside, that you shall dig with
it, and you shall go back and cover what comes out of you.

translation.text: Because the LORD your God travels along with your camp, you and turn away from you. The heightened moral responsibilities of the covenant community;

verses.english:
Because YHWH, your God, is going within your camp, to
rescue you and to put your enemies in front of you, so
your camp shall be holy, so He won’t see an exposure of
something in you and turn back from you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֶךָ לְהַצִּילְךָ וְלָתֵת אֹיְבֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהָיָה מַחֲנֶיךָ קָדוֹשׁ וְלֹא יִרְאֶה בְךָ עֶרְוַת דָּבָר וְשָׁב מֵאַחֲרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֶךָ לְהַצִּילְךָ וְלָתֵת אֹיְבֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהָיָה מַחֲנֶיךָ קָדוֹשׁ וְלֹא יִרְאֶה בְךָ עֶרְוַת דָּבָר וְשָׁב מֵאַחֲרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Because YHWH, your God, is going within your camp, to
rescue you and to put your enemies in front of you, so
your camp shall be holy, so He won’t see an exposure of
something in you and turn back from you.

translation.text: Slaves who have escaped to you from their owners shall not be given back to them.

verses.english:
“You shall not turn over to his master a slave who will
seek deliverance with you from his master.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַסְגִּיר עֶבֶד אֶל אֲדֹנָיו אֲשֶׁר יִנָּצֵל אֵלֶיךָ מֵעִם אֲדֹנָיו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַסְגִּיר עֶבֶד אֶל אֲדֹנָיו אֲשֶׁר יִנָּצֵל אֵלֶיךָ מֵעִם אֲדֹנָיו׃

english.text:
“You shall not turn over to his master a slave who will
seek deliverance with you from his master.

translation.text: They shall reside with you, in your midst, in any place not oppress them.

verses.english:
He shall live with you, among you, in the place that he
will choose in one of your gates, where it is good for
him. You shall not persecute him.
verses.hebrew: עִמְּךָ יֵשֵׁב בְּקִרְבְּךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב לוֹ לֹא תּוֹנֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: עִמְּךָ יֵשֵׁב בְּקִרְבְּךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב לוֹ לֹא תּוֹנֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
He shall live with you, among you, in the place that he
will choose in one of your gates, where it is good for
him. You shall not persecute him.

translation.text: None of the daughters of Israel shall be a temple prostitute; none of the sons of Israel shall be a temple prostitute.

verses.english:
“There shall not be a sacred prostitute from the daughters
of Israel, and there shall not be a sacred prostitute from
the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִהְיֶה קְדֵשָׁה מִבְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִהְיֶה קָדֵשׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִהְיֶה קְדֵשָׁה מִבְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִהְיֶה קָדֵשׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“There shall not be a sacred prostitute from the daughters
of Israel, and there shall not be a sacred prostitute from
the sons of Israel.

translation.text: You shall not bring the fee of a prostitute or the wages of a male prostitute into the house abhorrent to the LORD your God.

verses.english:
You shall not bring the price of a prostitute or the cost
of a dog to the house of YHWH, your God, for any vow,
because the two of them are both an offensive thing of
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תָבִיא אֶתְנַן זוֹנָה וּמְחִיר כֶּלֶב בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְכל נֶדֶר כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תָבִיא אֶתְנַן זוֹנָה וּמְחִיר כֶּלֶב בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְכל נֶדֶר כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not bring the price of a prostitute or the cost
of a dog to the house of YHWH, your God, for any vow,
because the two of them are both an offensive thing of
YHWH.

translation.text: You shall not charge interest on loans to another Israelite, interest on money, interest on provisions, interest on anything that is lent.

verses.english:
“You shall not require interest for your brother: interest
of money, interest of food, interest of anything that one
might charge.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַשִּׁיךְ לְאָחִיךָ נֶשֶׁךְ כֶּסֶף נֶשֶׁךְ אֹכֶל נֶשֶׁךְ כּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁךְ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַשִּׁיךְ לְאָחִיךָ נֶשֶׁךְ כֶּסֶף נֶשֶׁךְ אֹכֶל נֶשֶׁךְ כּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁךְ׃

english.text:
“You shall not require interest for your brother: interest
of money, interest of food, interest of anything that one
might charge.

translation.text: about to enter and possess.

verses.english:
For a foreigner you may require it, but for your brother
you shall not require it, so that YHWH, your God, will
bless you in everything your hand has taken on, on the
land to which you’re coming to take possession of it.
verses.hebrew: לַנּכְרִי תַשִּׁיךְ וּלְאָחִיךָ לֹא תַשִּׁיךְ לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: לַנּכְרִי תַשִּׁיךְ וּלְאָחִיךָ לֹא תַשִּׁיךְ לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
For a foreigner you may require it, but for your brother
you shall not require it, so that YHWH, your God, will
bless you in everything your hand has taken on, on the
land to which you’re coming to take possession of it.

translation.text: If you make a vow to the LORD your God, do not postpone fulfilling incur guilt.

verses.english:
“When you’ll make a vow to YHWH, your God, you shall not
delay to fulfill it, because YHWH, your God, will require
it from you, and it will be a sin in you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִדֹּר נֶדֶר לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְאַחֵר לְשַׁלְּמוֹ כִּי דָרֹשׁ יִדְרְשֶׁנּוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעִמָּךְ וְהָיָה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִדֹּר נֶדֶר לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְאַחֵר לְשַׁלְּמוֹ כִּי דָרֹשׁ יִדְרְשֶׁנּוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעִמָּךְ וְהָיָה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

english.text:
“When you’ll make a vow to YHWH, your God, you shall not
delay to fulfill it, because YHWH, your God, will require
it from you, and it will be a sin in you.

translation.text: But if you refrain from vowing, you will not incur guilt.

verses.english:
But if you desist from vowing, that will not be a sin in
you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תֶחְדַּל לִנְדֹּר לֹא יִהְיֶה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תֶחְדַּל לִנְדֹּר לֹא יִהְיֶה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

english.text:
But if you desist from vowing, that will not be a sin in
you.

translation.text: Whatever your lips utter you must diligently perform, just as you have freely vowed to the LORD your God with your own mouth.

verses.english:
You shall watch what comes out of your lips and do as you
vowed to YHWH, your God, the contribution that you spoke
with your mouth.
verses.hebrew: מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיךָ תִּשְׁמֹר וְעָשִׂיתָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נָדַרְתָּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נְדָבָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּפִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיךָ תִּשְׁמֹר וְעָשִׂיתָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נָדַרְתָּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נְדָבָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּפִיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall watch what comes out of your lips and do as you
vowed to YHWH, your God, the contribution that you spoke
with your mouth.

translation.text: If you go into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, as many as you wish, but you shall not put any in a container.

verses.english:
“When you’ll come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you
may eat grapes as you wish, your fill; but you shall not
put any into your container.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תָבֹא בְּכֶרֶם רֵעֶךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ עֲנָבִים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ שׂבְעֶךָ וְאֶל כֶּלְיְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תָבֹא בְּכֶרֶם רֵעֶךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ עֲנָבִים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ שׂבְעֶךָ וְאֶל כֶּלְיְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן׃

english.text:
“When you’ll come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you
may eat grapes as you wish, your fill; but you shall not
put any into your container.

translation.text: If you go into your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck the standing grain.

verses.english:
When you’ll come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then
you may pluck ears with your hand; but you shall not lift
a sickle at your neighbor’s grain.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תָבֹא בְּקָמַת רֵעֶךָ וְקָטַפְתָּ מְלִילֹת בְּיָדֶךָ וְחֶרְמֵשׁ לֹא תָנִיף עַל קָמַת רֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תָבֹא בְּקָמַת רֵעֶךָ וְקָטַפְתָּ מְלִילֹת בְּיָדֶךָ וְחֶרְמֵשׁ לֹא תָנִיף עַל קָמַת רֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
When you’ll come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then
you may pluck ears with your hand; but you shall not lift
a sickle at your neighbor’s grain.

verses.english:
“When a man will take a woman and marry her, and it
will be that, if she does not find favor in his eyes
because he has found an exposure of something in her, and
he will write a document of cutting-off for her and put it
in her hand and let her go from his house,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה וּבְעָלָהּ וְהָיָה אִם לֹא תִמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָיו כִּי מָצָא בָהּ עֶרְוַת דָּבָר וְכָתַב לָהּ סֵפֶר כְּרִיתֻת וְנָתַן בְּיָדָהּ וְשִׁלְּחָהּ מִבֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה וּבְעָלָהּ וְהָיָה אִם לֹא תִמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָיו כִּי מָצָא בָהּ עֶרְוַת דָּבָר וְכָתַב לָהּ סֵפֶר כְּרִיתֻת וְנָתַן בְּיָדָהּ וְשִׁלְּחָהּ מִבֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
“When a man will take a woman and marry her, and it
will be that, if she does not find favor in his eyes
because he has found an exposure of something in her, and
he will write a document of cutting-off for her and put it
in her hand and let her go from his house,

translation.text: Suppose a man enters into marriage with a woman, but she does not he writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; she then leaves his house

verses.english:
and she will go out from his house and go and become
another man’s,
verses.hebrew: וְיָצְאָה מִבֵּיתוֹ וְהָלְכָה וְהָיְתָה לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצְאָה מִבֵּיתוֹ וְהָלְכָה וְהָיְתָה לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃

english.text:
and she will go out from his house and go and become
another man’s,

translation.text: and goes off to become another man's wife.

verses.english:
and the latter man will hate her and write a document of
cutting-off for her and put it in her hand and let her go
from his house, or if the latter man who took her to him
for a wife will die:
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂנֵאָהּ הָאִישׁ הָאַחֲרוֹן וְכָתַב לָהּ סֵפֶר כְּרִיתֻת וְנָתַן בְּיָדָהּ וְשִׁלְּחָהּ מִבֵּיתוֹ אוֹ כִי יָמוּת הָאִישׁ הָאַחֲרוֹן אֲשֶׁר לְקָחָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂנֵאָהּ הָאִישׁ הָאַחֲרוֹן וְכָתַב לָהּ סֵפֶר כְּרִיתֻת וְנָתַן בְּיָדָהּ וְשִׁלְּחָהּ מִבֵּיתוֹ אוֹ כִי יָמוּת הָאִישׁ הָאַחֲרוֹן אֲשֶׁר לְקָחָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
and the latter man will hate her and write a document of
cutting-off for her and put it in her hand and let her go
from his house, or if the latter man who took her to him
for a wife will die:

translation.text: Then suppose the second man dislikes her, writes her a bill of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house (or the second man who married her dies);

verses.english:
her first husband who let her go shall not be able to come
back to take her to be his for a wife since she has been
made impure, because that is an offensive thing in front
of YHWH, and you shall not bring sin on the land that
YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יוּכַל בַּעְלָהּ הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר שִׁלְּחָהּ לָשׁוּב לְקַחְתָּהּ לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הֻטַּמָּאָה כִּי תוֹעֵבָה הִוא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תַחֲטִיא אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יוּכַל בַּעְלָהּ הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר שִׁלְּחָהּ לָשׁוּב לְקַחְתָּהּ לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הֻטַּמָּאָה כִּי תוֹעֵבָה הִוא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תַחֲטִיא אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
her first husband who let her go shall not be able to come
back to take her to be his for a wife since she has been
made impure, because that is an offensive thing in front
of YHWH, and you shall not bring sin on the land that
YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy.

translation.text: her first husband, who shall not bring guilt on the land that the LORD your God is giving you as a possession.

verses.english:
“When a man will take a new wife, he shall not go out in
the army and not go along with it for any matter. He shall
be free at his house for one year and shall make his wife
whom he has taken happy.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה חֲדָשָׁה לֹא יֵצֵא בַּצָּבָא וְלֹא יַעֲבֹר עָלָיו לְכל דָּבָר נָקִי יִהְיֶה לְבֵיתוֹ שָׁנָה אֶחָת וְשִׂמַּח אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לָקָח׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה חֲדָשָׁה לֹא יֵצֵא בַּצָּבָא וְלֹא יַעֲבֹר עָלָיו לְכל דָּבָר נָקִי יִהְיֶה לְבֵיתוֹ שָׁנָה אֶחָת וְשִׂמַּח אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לָקָח׃

english.text:
“When a man will take a new wife, he shall not go out in
the army and not go along with it for any matter. He shall
be free at his house for one year and shall make his wife
whom he has taken happy.

translation.text: When a man is newly married, he shall not go out with the army or to be happy with the wife whom he has married.

verses.english:
One shall not take a mill or an upper millstone as
security, because he is taking one’s life as security.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יַחֲבֹל רֵחַיִם וָרָכֶב כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הוּא חֹבֵל׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יַחֲבֹל רֵחַיִם וָרָכֶב כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הוּא חֹבֵל׃

english.text:
One shall not take a mill or an upper millstone as
security, because he is taking one’s life as security.

translation.text: No one shall take a mill or an upper millstone in pledge, for that would be taking a life in pledge.

verses.english:
“When a man will be found stealing a person from among his
brothers, from the children of Israel, so he will get
profit through him and sell him, then that thief shall
die. So you shall burn away what is bad from among you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמָּצֵא אִישׁ גֹּנֵב נֶפֶשׁ מֵאֶחָיו מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִתְעַמֶּר בּוֹ וּמְכָרוֹ וּמֵת הַגַּנָּב הַהוּא וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִמָּצֵא אִישׁ גֹּנֵב נֶפֶשׁ מֵאֶחָיו מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִתְעַמֶּר בּוֹ וּמְכָרוֹ וּמֵת הַגַּנָּב הַהוּא וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
“When a man will be found stealing a person from among his
brothers, from the children of Israel, so he will get
profit through him and sell him, then that thief shall
die. So you shall burn away what is bad from among you.

translation.text: If someone is caught kidnapping another Israelite, enslaving or selling the Israelite, then that kidnaper shall die. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.

verses.english:
“Be watchful with the plague of leprosy, to be very
watchful and to do according to everything that the Levite
priests will instruct you. You shall be watchful to do
according to what I commanded them.
verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר בְּנֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת לִשְׁמֹר מְאֹד וְלַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּ אֶתְכֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם תִּשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר בְּנֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת לִשְׁמֹר מְאֹד וְלַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּ אֶתְכֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם תִּשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
“Be watchful with the plague of leprosy, to be very
watchful and to do according to everything that the Levite
priests will instruct you. You shall be watchful to do
according to what I commanded them.

translation.text: Guard against an outbreak of a leprous skin disease by being very instruct you, just as I have commanded them.

verses.english:
Remember what YHWH, your God, did to Miriam on the way
when you were coming out from Egypt.
verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְמִרְיָם בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְמִרְיָם בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Remember what YHWH, your God, did to Miriam on the way
when you were coming out from Egypt.

translation.text: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on your journey out of Egypt.

verses.english:
“When you’ll make a loan of anything to your neighbor, you
shall not come into his house to get his pledge.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תַשֶּׁה בְרֵעֲךָ מַשַּׁאת מְאוּמָה לֹא תָבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ לַעֲבֹט עֲבֹטוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תַשֶּׁה בְרֵעֲךָ מַשַּׁאת מְאוּמָה לֹא תָבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ לַעֲבֹט עֲבֹטוֹ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll make a loan of anything to your neighbor, you
shall not come into his house to get his pledge.

translation.text: When you make your neighbor a loan of any kind, you shall not go into the house to take the pledge.

verses.english:
You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you’re
lending shall bring the pledge outside to you.
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּץ תַּעֲמֹד וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה נֹשֶׁה בוֹ יוֹצִיא אֵלֶיךָ אֶת הַעֲבוֹט הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּחוּץ תַּעֲמֹד וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה נֹשֶׁה בוֹ יוֹצִיא אֵלֶיךָ אֶת הַעֲבוֹט הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you’re
lending shall bring the pledge outside to you.

translation.text: You shall wait outside, while the person to whom you are making the loan brings the pledge out to you.

verses.english:
And if he is a poor man, you shall not lie down with his
pledge.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם אִישׁ עָנִי הוּא לֹא תִשְׁכַּב בַּעֲבֹטוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אִישׁ עָנִי הוּא לֹא תִשְׁכַּב בַּעֲבֹטוֹ׃

english.text:
And if he is a poor man, you shall not lie down with his
pledge.

translation.text: If the person is poor, you shall not sleep in the garment given you as the pledge.

verses.english:
You shall give back the pledge to him as the sun sets, and
he’ll lie down with his clothing, and he’ll bless you, and
you’ll have virtue in front of YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: הָשֵׁב תָּשִׁיב לוֹ אֶת הַעֲבוֹט כְּבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְשָׁכַב בְּשַׂלְמָתוֹ וּבֵרְכֶךָּ וּלְךָ תִּהְיֶה צְדָקָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הָשֵׁב תָּשִׁיב לוֹ אֶת הַעֲבוֹט כְּבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְשָׁכַב בְּשַׂלְמָתוֹ וּבֵרְכֶךָּ וּלְךָ תִּהְיֶה צְדָקָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall give back the pledge to him as the sun sets, and
he’ll lie down with his clothing, and he’ll bless you, and
you’ll have virtue in front of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: You shall give the pledge back by sunset, so that your credit before the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall not exploit a poor or an indigent employee,
from your brothers or from your aliens who are in your
land, in your gates.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק שָׂכִיר עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מֵאַחֶיךָ אוֹ מִגֵּרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק שָׂכִיר עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מֵאַחֶיךָ אוֹ מִגֵּרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall not exploit a poor or an indigent employee,
from your brothers or from your aliens who are in your
land, in your gates.

translation.text: You shall not withhold the wages of poor and needy laborers, your towns.

verses.english:
You shall give his pay in his day, and the sun shall not
set on it—because he is poor, and he maintains his life by
it—so he won’t call against you to YHWH, and it will be a
sin in you.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹמוֹ תִתֵּן שְׂכָרוֹ וְלֹא תָבוֹא עָלָיו הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כִּי עָנִי הוּא וְאֵלָיו הוּא נֹשֵׂא אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ וְלֹא יִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹמוֹ תִתֵּן שְׂכָרוֹ וְלֹא תָבוֹא עָלָיו הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כִּי עָנִי הוּא וְאֵלָיו הוּא נֹשֵׂא אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ וְלֹא יִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

english.text:
You shall give his pay in his day, and the sun shall not
set on it—because he is poor, and he maintains his life by
it—so he won’t call against you to YHWH, and it will be a
sin in you.

translation.text: You shall pay them their wages daily before sunset, they might cry to the LORD against you, and you would incur guilt.

verses.english:
“Fathers shall not be put to death for sons, and sons
shall not be put to death for fathers. They shall each be
put to death through his own sin.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא יוּמְתוּ עַל אָבוֹת אִישׁ בְּחֶטְאוֹ יוּמָתוּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא יוּמְתוּ עַל אָבוֹת אִישׁ בְּחֶטְאוֹ יוּמָתוּ׃

english.text:
“Fathers shall not be put to death for sons, and sons
shall not be put to death for fathers. They shall each be
put to death through his own sin.

translation.text: Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall children persons be put to death.

verses.english:
“You shall not bend judgment of an alien or an orphan, and
you shall not take a widow’s clothing as security.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְלֹא תַחֲבֹל בֶּגֶד אַלְמָנָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְלֹא תַחֲבֹל בֶּגֶד אַלְמָנָה׃

english.text:
“You shall not bend judgment of an alien or an orphan, and
you shall not take a widow’s clothing as security.

translation.text: You shall not deprive a resident alien or an orphan of justice; you shall not take a widow's garment in pledge.

verses.english:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and
YHWH, your God, redeemed you from there. On account of
this I command you to do this thing.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרַיִם וַיִּפְדְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרַיִם וַיִּפְדְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and
YHWH, your God, redeemed you from there. On account of
this I command you to do this thing.

translation.text: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this.

verses.english:
When you’ll reap your harvest in your field, and you’ll
forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to take
it. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s and the
widow’s, so that YHWH, your God, will bless you in all
your hands’ work.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִקְצֹר קְצִירְךָ בְשָׂדֶךָ וְשָׁכַחְתָּ עֹמֶר בַּשָּׂדֶה לֹא תָשׁוּב לְקַחְתּוֹ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִקְצֹר קְצִירְךָ בְשָׂדֶךָ וְשָׁכַחְתָּ עֹמֶר בַּשָּׂדֶה לֹא תָשׁוּב לְקַחְתּוֹ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ׃

english.text:
When you’ll reap your harvest in your field, and you’ll
forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to take
it. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s and the
widow’s, so that YHWH, your God, will bless you in all
your hands’ work.

translation.text: When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it; it shall be left for the alien, the your undertakings.

verses.english:
When you’ll beat your olive trees, you shall not do a
bough afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תַחְבֹּט זֵיתְךָ לֹא תְפַאֵר אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תַחְבֹּט זֵיתְךָ לֹא תְפַאֵר אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
When you’ll beat your olive trees, you shall not do a
bough afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.

translation.text: When you beat your olive trees, do not strip what is left; it shall be for the alien, the orphan, and the widow.

verses.english:
When you’ll cut off grapes of your vineyard, you shall not
glean afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִבְצֹר כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִבְצֹר כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
When you’ll cut off grapes of your vineyard, you shall not
glean afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.

translation.text: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, do not glean what is left; it shall be for the alien, the orphan, and the widow.

verses.english:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt. On account of this I command you to do this
thing.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt. On account of this I command you to do this
thing.

translation.text: Remember you to do this.

verses.english:
“When there will be a dispute between people, and they
will go over to judgment, and they will judge them, then
they shall find in favor of the one who is in the right
and find against the one who is in the wrong.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִהְיֶה רִיב בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְּשׁוּ אֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׁפָטוּם וְהִצְדִּיקוּ אֶת הַצַּדִּיק וְהִרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת הָרָשָׁע׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִהְיֶה רִיב בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְּשׁוּ אֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׁפָטוּם וְהִצְדִּיקוּ אֶת הַצַּדִּיק וְהִרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת הָרָשָׁע׃

english.text:
“When there will be a dispute between people, and they
will go over to judgment, and they will judge them, then
they shall find in favor of the one who is in the right
and find against the one who is in the wrong.

translation.text: Suppose two persons have a dispute and enter into litigation, and the other to be in the wrong.

verses.english:
And it will be, if the one who is in the wrong is to be
struck, that the judge shall have him laid down and have
him struck in front of him, according to his wrongdoing in
number.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם בִּן הַכּוֹת הָרָשָׁע וְהִפִּילוֹ הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהִכָּהוּ לְפָנָיו כְּדֵי רִשְׁעָתוֹ בְּמִסְפָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם בִּן הַכּוֹת הָרָשָׁע וְהִפִּילוֹ הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהִכָּהוּ לְפָנָיו כְּדֵי רִשְׁעָתוֹ בְּמִסְפָּר׃

english.text:
And it will be, if the one who is in the wrong is to be
struck, that the judge shall have him laid down and have
him struck in front of him, according to his wrongdoing in
number.

translation.text: If the one in the wrong deserves to be his presence with the number of lashes proportionate to the offense.

verses.english:
They shall strike him forty times. He shall not add, in
case he would add onto these to strike him a great amount,
and your brother would be treated as inconsequential
before your eyes.
verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעִים יַכֶּנּוּ לֹא יֹסִיף פֶּן יֹסִיף לְהַכֹּתוֹ עַל אֵלֶּה מַכָּה רַבָּה וְנִקְלָה אָחִיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַרְבָּעִים יַכֶּנּוּ לֹא יֹסִיף פֶּן יֹסִיף לְהַכֹּתוֹ עַל אֵלֶּה מַכָּה רַבָּה וְנִקְלָה אָחִיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
They shall strike him forty times. He shall not add, in
case he would add onto these to strike him a great amount,
and your brother would be treated as inconsequential
before your eyes.

translation.text: given, your neighbor will be degraded in your sight.

verses.english: “You shall not muzzle an ox when it is threshing.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַחְסֹם שׁוֹר בְּדִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַחְסֹם שׁוֹר בְּדִישׁוֹ׃

english.text: “You shall not muzzle an ox when it is threshing.

translation.text: You shall not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.

verses.english:
“When brothers will live together, and one of them will
die, and he had no son, the dead man’s wife shall not be
an unrelated man’s, outside. Her brother-in-law shall come
to her and take her to him for a wife and shall do the
brother-in-law’s duty for her.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יֵשְׁבוּ אַחִים יַחְדָּו וּמֵת אַחַד מֵהֶם וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ לֹא תִהְיֶה אֵשֶׁת הַמֵּת הַחוּצָה לְאִישׁ זָר יְבָמָהּ יָבֹא עָלֶיהָ וּלְקָחָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וְיִבְּמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יֵשְׁבוּ אַחִים יַחְדָּו וּמֵת אַחַד מֵהֶם וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ לֹא תִהְיֶה אֵשֶׁת הַמֵּת הַחוּצָה לְאִישׁ זָר יְבָמָהּ יָבֹא עָלֶיהָ וּלְקָחָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וְיִבְּמָהּ׃

english.text:
“When brothers will live together, and one of them will
die, and he had no son, the dead man’s wife shall not be
an unrelated man’s, outside. Her brother-in-law shall come
to her and take her to him for a wife and shall do the
brother-in-law’s duty for her.

translation.text: When brothers reside together, and one of them dies and has no son, marriage, and performing the duty of a husband's brother to her,

verses.english:
And the firstborn to whom she will give birth shall be
signified by the name of his brother who died, so his name
will not be wiped out from Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד יָקוּם עַל שֵׁם אָחִיו הַמֵּת וְלֹא יִמָּחֶה שְׁמוֹ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד יָקוּם עַל שֵׁם אָחִיו הַמֵּת וְלֹא יִמָּחֶה שְׁמוֹ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the firstborn to whom she will give birth shall be
signified by the name of his brother who died, so his name
will not be wiped out from Israel.

translation.text: deceased brother, so that his name may not be blotted out of Israel.

verses.english:
And if the man won’t desire to take his sister-in-law,
then his sister-in-law shall go up at the gate to the
elders and say, ‘My brother-in-law refuses to preserve a
name for his brother in Israel. He was not willing to do
the brother-in-law’s duty for me.’
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יַחְפֹּץ הָאִישׁ לָקַחַת אֶת יְבִמְתּוֹ וְעָלְתָה יְבִמְתּוֹ הַשַּׁעְרָה אֶל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאָמְרָה מֵאֵן יְבָמִי לְהָקִים לְאָחִיו שֵׁם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אָבָה יַבְּמִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יַחְפֹּץ הָאִישׁ לָקַחַת אֶת יְבִמְתּוֹ וְעָלְתָה יְבִמְתּוֹ הַשַּׁעְרָה אֶל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאָמְרָה מֵאֵן יְבָמִי לְהָקִים לְאָחִיו שֵׁם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אָבָה יַבְּמִי׃

english.text:
And if the man won’t desire to take his sister-in-law,
then his sister-in-law shall go up at the gate to the
elders and say, ‘My brother-in-law refuses to preserve a
name for his brother in Israel. He was not willing to do
the brother-in-law’s duty for me.’

translation.text: husband's brother refuses to perpetuate his brother's name in Israel; he will not perform the duty of a husband's brother to me."

verses.english:
And his city’s elders shall call him and speak to him, and
if he’ll stand and say, ‘I don’t desire to take her,’
verses.hebrew: וְקָרְאוּ לוֹ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְדִבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וְעָמַד וְאָמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְקָרְאוּ לוֹ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְדִבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וְעָמַד וְאָמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And his city’s elders shall call him and speak to him, and
if he’ll stand and say, ‘I don’t desire to take her,’

translation.text: Then the saying, "I have no desire to marry her,"

verses.english:
then his sister-in-law shall go over to him before the
elders’ eyes and take off his shoe from his foot and spit
in front of him. And she shall answer and say, ‘Thus shall
be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s
house.’
verses.hebrew: וְנִגְּשָׁה יְבִמְתּוֹ אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי הַזְּקֵנִים וְחָלְצָה נַעֲלוֹ מֵעַל רַגְלוֹ וְיָרְקָה בְּפָנָיו וְעָנְתָה וְאָמְרָה כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִבְנֶה אֶת בֵּית אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְנִגְּשָׁה יְבִמְתּוֹ אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי הַזְּקֵנִים וְחָלְצָה נַעֲלוֹ מֵעַל רַגְלוֹ וְיָרְקָה בְּפָנָיו וְעָנְתָה וְאָמְרָה כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִבְנֶה אֶת בֵּית אָחִיו׃

english.text:
then his sister-in-law shall go over to him before the
elders’ eyes and take off his shoe from his foot and spit
in front of him. And she shall answer and say, ‘Thus shall
be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s
house.’

translation.text: then his brother's wife shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, pull his sandal off his foot, spit in his face, and declare, "This is what is done to the man who does not build up his brother's house."

verses.english:
And his name shall be called in Israel ‘the house of the
one whose shoe was taken off.’
verses.hebrew: וְנִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית חֲלוּץ הַנָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְנִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית חֲלוּץ הַנָּעַל׃

english.text:
And his name shall be called in Israel ‘the house of the
one whose shoe was taken off.’

translation.text: Throughout Israel his family shall be known as "the house of him whose sandal was pulled off."

verses.english:
“If people will fight together, a man and his brother, and
the wife of one will come close to rescue her husband from
the hand of the one striking him, and she’ll put out her
hand and take hold of his private parts,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים יַחְדָּו אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְקָרְבָה אֵשֶׁת הָאֶחָד לְהַצִּיל אֶת אִישָׁהּ מִיַּד מַכֵּהוּ וְשָׁלְחָה יָדָהּ וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בִּמְבֻשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים יַחְדָּו אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְקָרְבָה אֵשֶׁת הָאֶחָד לְהַצִּיל אֶת אִישָׁהּ מִיַּד מַכֵּהוּ וְשָׁלְחָה יָדָהּ וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בִּמְבֻשָׁיו׃

english.text:
“If people will fight together, a man and his brother, and
the wife of one will come close to rescue her husband from
the hand of the one striking him, and she’ll put out her
hand and take hold of his private parts,

translation.text: If men get into a fight with one another, and the wife of one reaching out and seizing his genitals,

verses.english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not pity.
verses.hebrew: וְקַצֹּתָה אֶת כַּפָּהּ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְקַצֹּתָה אֶת כַּפָּהּ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶךָ׃

english.text: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not pity.

translation.text: you shall cut off her hand; show no pity.

verses.english:
“You shall not have in your bag multiple stones, a big and
a small.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּכִיסְךָ אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּכִיסְךָ אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

english.text:
“You shall not have in your bag multiple stones, a big and
a small.

translation.text: You shall not have in your bag two kinds of weights, large and small.

verses.english:
You shall not have in your house multiple ephah measures,
a big and a small.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּבֵיתְךָ אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּבֵיתְךָ אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

english.text:
You shall not have in your house multiple ephah measures,
a big and a small.

translation.text: You shall not have in your house two kinds of measures, large and small.

verses.english:
You shall have a whole and honest stone; you shall have a
whole and honest ephah measure, so your days will be
extended on the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.
verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ אֵיפָה שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכוּ יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: אֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ אֵיפָה שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכוּ יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
You shall have a whole and honest stone; you shall have a
whole and honest ephah measure, so your days will be
extended on the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

translation.text: You shall have only a full and honest weight; you shall the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

verses.english:
Because everyone who does these is an offensive thing of
YHWH, everyone who does injustice.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה כֹּל עֹשֵׂה עָוֶל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה כֹּל עֹשֵׂה עָוֶל׃

english.text:
Because everyone who does these is an offensive thing of
YHWH, everyone who does injustice.

translation.text: For all who do such things, all who act dishonestly, are abhorrent to the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came
out from Egypt,
verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ עֲמָלֵק בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ עֲמָלֵק בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came
out from Egypt,

translation.text: Remember what Amalek did to you on your journey out of Egypt,

verses.english:
how he fell upon you on the way and cut off all the weak
ones at your rear, when you were exhausted and tired, and
he didn’t fear God.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר קָרְךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְזַנֵּב בְּךָ כּל הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִים אַחֲרֶיךָ וְאַתָּה עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ וְלֹא יָרֵא אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר קָרְךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְזַנֵּב בְּךָ כּל הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִים אַחֲרֶיךָ וְאַתָּה עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ וְלֹא יָרֵא אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
how he fell upon you on the way and cut off all the weak
ones at your rear, when you were exhausted and tired, and
he didn’t fear God.

translation.text: struck down all who lagged behind you; he did not fear God.

verses.english:
So it shall be, when YHWH, your God, will give you rest
from all your enemies all around in the land that YHWH,
your God, is giving you as a legacy to take possession of
it, you shall wipe out the memory of Amalek from under the
skies. You shall not forget.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּהָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ מִכּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִסָּבִיב בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ תִּמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם לֹא תִּשְׁכָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּהָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ מִכּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִסָּבִיב בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ תִּמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם לֹא תִּשְׁכָּח׃

english.text:
So it shall be, when YHWH, your God, will give you rest
from all your enemies all around in the land that YHWH,
your God, is giving you as a legacy to take possession of
it, you shall wipe out the memory of Amalek from under the
skies. You shall not forget.

translation.text: you as an inheritance to possess, you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; do not forget.

verses.english:
“And it shall be, when you’ll come to
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy,
and you’ll take possession of it and live in it,
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תָבוֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי תָבוֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And it shall be, when you’ll come to
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy,
and you’ll take possession of it and live in it,

translation.text: When you have come into the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, and you possess it, and settle in it,

verses.english:
that you shall take from the first of all the land’s fruit
that you’ll bring in from your land that YHWH, your God,
is giving you, and set it in a basket and go to the place
that YHWH, your God, will choose to tent His name there.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מֵרֵאשִׁית כּל פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּבִיא מֵאַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וְשַׂמְתָּ בַטֶּנֶא וְהָלַכְתָּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מֵרֵאשִׁית כּל פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּבִיא מֵאַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וְשַׂמְתָּ בַטֶּנֶא וְהָלַכְתָּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
that you shall take from the first of all the land’s fruit
that you’ll bring in from your land that YHWH, your God,
is giving you, and set it in a basket and go to the place
that YHWH, your God, will choose to tent His name there.

translation.text: you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall put it in a basket and go to the place that the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his name.

verses.english:
And you shall come to the priest who will be in those days
and say to him: I declare today to YHWH, your God, that
I’ve come to the land that YHWH swore to our fathers to
give to us.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו הִגַּדְתִּי הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בָאתִי אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ לָתֶת לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו הִגַּדְתִּי הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בָאתִי אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ לָתֶת לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall come to the priest who will be in those days
and say to him: I declare today to YHWH, your God, that
I’ve come to the land that YHWH swore to our fathers to
give to us.

translation.text: You shall go to the priest who is in ancestors to give us."

verses.english:
And the priest shall take the basket from your hand and
set it down in front of the altar of YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַטֶּנֶא מִיָּדֶךָ וְהִנִּיחוֹ לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַטֶּנֶא מִיָּדֶךָ וְהִנִּיחוֹ לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take the basket from your hand and
set it down in front of the altar of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: When the priest takes the basket from your hand and sets it down before the altar of the LORD your God,

verses.english:
And you shall answer and say in front of YHWH, your God:
My father was a perishing Aramean, so he went down to
Egypt and resided there with few persons and became a big,
powerful, and numerous nation there.
verses.hebrew: וְעָנִיתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲרַמִּי אֹבֵד אָבִי וַיֵּרֶד מִצְרַיְמָה וַיָּגר שָׁם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט וַיְהִי שָׁם לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל עָצוּם וָרָב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָנִיתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲרַמִּי אֹבֵד אָבִי וַיֵּרֶד מִצְרַיְמָה וַיָּגר שָׁם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט וַיְהִי שָׁם לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל עָצוּם וָרָב׃

english.text:
And you shall answer and say in front of YHWH, your God:
My father was a perishing Aramean, so he went down to
Egypt and resided there with few persons and became a big,
powerful, and numerous nation there.

translation.text: you and populous.

verses.english:
And the Egyptians were bad to us and degraded us and
imposed hard work on us.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֵעוּ אֹתָנוּ הַמִּצְרִים וַיְעַנּוּנוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלֵינוּ עֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֵעוּ אֹתָנוּ הַמִּצְרִים וַיְעַנּוּנוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלֵינוּ עֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה׃

english.text:
And the Egyptians were bad to us and degraded us and
imposed hard work on us.

translation.text: When the Egyptians treated us harshly and afflicted us, by imposing hard labor on us,

verses.english:
And we cried out to YHWH, our fathers’ God, and YHWH
listened to our voice and saw our degradation and our
trouble and our oppression.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קֹלֵנוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת ענְיֵנוּ וְאֶת עֲמָלֵנוּ וְאֶת לַחֲצֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קֹלֵנוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת ענְיֵנוּ וְאֶת עֲמָלֵנוּ וְאֶת לַחֲצֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And we cried out to YHWH, our fathers’ God, and YHWH
listened to our voice and saw our degradation and our
trouble and our oppression.

translation.text: we cried to the LORD, the God of our ancestors; the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

verses.english:
And YHWH brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand and
an outstretched arm and with great fear and with signs and
with wonders.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמֹרָא גָּדֹל וּבְאֹתוֹת וּבְמֹפְתִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצִאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמֹרָא גָּדֹל וּבְאֹתוֹת וּבְמֹפְתִים׃

english.text:
And YHWH brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand and
an outstretched arm and with great fear and with signs and
with wonders.

translation.text: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty with signs and wonders;

verses.english:
And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a
land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבִאֵנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּתֶּן לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבִאֵנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּתֶּן לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a
land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: and he brought us into this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.english:
And now, here, I’ve brought the first of the fruit of the
land that you’ve given me, YHWH. And you shall set it down
in front of YHWH, your God, and bow in front of YHWH, your
God.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֵבֵאתִי אֶת רֵאשִׁית פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִנַּחְתּוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֵבֵאתִי אֶת רֵאשִׁית פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִנַּחְתּוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And now, here, I’ve brought the first of the fruit of the
land that you’ve given me, YHWH. And you shall set it down
in front of YHWH, your God, and bow in front of YHWH, your
God.

translation.text: So now I bring the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall rejoice in all the good that YHWH, your God,
has given to you and to your house, you and the Levite and
the alien who is among you.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְכל הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּלְבֵיתֶךָ אַתָּה וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְכל הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּלְבֵיתֶךָ אַתָּה וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall rejoice in all the good that YHWH, your God,
has given to you and to your house, you and the Levite and
the alien who is among you.

translation.text: Then you, together with the Levites and the aliens LORD your God has given to you and to your house.

verses.english:
“When you’ll finish doing all the tithe of your produce in
the third year, the year of the tithe, and you’ll give it
to the Levite, to the alien, to the orphan, and to the
widow, and they’ll eat in your gates and be full,
verses.hebrew: כִּי תְכַלֶּה לַעְשֵׂר אֶת כּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁת שְׁנַת הַמַּעֲשֵׂר וְנָתַתָּה לַלֵּוִי לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה וְאָכְלוּ בִשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְשָׂבֵעוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תְכַלֶּה לַעְשֵׂר אֶת כּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁת שְׁנַת הַמַּעֲשֵׂר וְנָתַתָּה לַלֵּוִי לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה וְאָכְלוּ בִשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְשָׂבֵעוּ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll finish doing all the tithe of your produce in
the third year, the year of the tithe, and you’ll give it
to the Levite, to the alien, to the orphan, and to the
widow, and they’ll eat in your gates and be full,

translation.text: When you have finished paying all the tithe of your produce in the third year (which is the year of the tithe), giving it to the Levites, the within your towns,

verses.english:
then you shall say in front of YHWH, your God: I have
taken away what was holy from the house, and I have also
given it to the Levite and to the alien, to the orphan,
and to the widow according to all your commandment that
you’ve commanded me. I have not violated and have not
forgotten any of your commandments.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בִּעַרְתִּי הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִן הַבַּיִת וְגַם נְתַתִּיו לַלֵּוִי וְלַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה כְּכל מִצְוָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי לֹא עָבַרְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ וְלֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בִּעַרְתִּי הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִן הַבַּיִת וְגַם נְתַתִּיו לַלֵּוִי וְלַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה כְּכל מִצְוָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי לֹא עָבַרְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ וְלֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

english.text:
then you shall say in front of YHWH, your God: I have
taken away what was holy from the house, and I have also
given it to the Levite and to the alien, to the orphan,
and to the widow according to all your commandment that
you’ve commanded me. I have not violated and have not
forgotten any of your commandments.

translation.text: then you shall say before the LORD your God: "I have neither transgressed nor forgotten any of your commandments:

verses.english:
I have not eaten any of it while I was mourning, and I
have not taken any of it away while impure, and I have not
given any of it to the dead. I have listened to the voice
of YHWH, my God. I have done according to everything that
you commanded me.
verses.hebrew: לֹא אָכַלְתִּי בְאֹנִי מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא בִעַרְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ בְּטָמֵא וְלֹא נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ לְמֵת שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי עָשִׂיתִי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אָכַלְתִּי בְאֹנִי מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא בִעַרְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ בְּטָמֵא וְלֹא נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ לְמֵת שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי עָשִׂיתִי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי׃

english.text:
I have not eaten any of it while I was mourning, and I
have not taken any of it away while impure, and I have not
given any of it to the dead. I have listened to the voice
of YHWH, my God. I have done according to everything that
you commanded me.

translation.text: I have not eaten of it while in mourning; I have not removed any of it while I was unclean; and I have not offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God, doing just as you commanded me.

verses.english:
Gaze from your holy abode, from the skies, and bless your
people, Israel, and the land that you’ve given us as you
swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.hebrew: הַשְׁקִיפָה מִמְּעוֹן קדְשְׁךָ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לָנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: הַשְׁקִיפָה מִמְּעוֹן קדְשְׁךָ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לָנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
Gaze from your holy abode, from the skies, and bless your
people, Israel, and the land that you’ve given us as you
swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: our ancestors — a land flowing with milk and honey."

verses.english:
“This day YHWH, your God, commands you to do these laws
and judgments. And you shall be watchful and do them with
all your heart and all your soul.
verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אוֹתָם בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃
