hebrew.text: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אוֹתָם בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
“This day YHWH, your God, commands you to do these laws
and judgments. And you shall be watchful and do them with
all your heart and all your soul.

translation.text: This very day the LORD your God is commanding you to observe these statutes and ordinances; so observe them diligently with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.english:
You have proclaimed YHWH today to be God to you, and to go
in His ways and to observe His laws and His commandments
and His judgments and to listen to His voice.
verses.hebrew: אֶת יְהֹוָה הֶאֱמַרְתָּ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וְלָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר חֻקָּיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְלִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת יְהֹוָה הֶאֱמַרְתָּ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וְלָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר חֻקָּיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְלִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
You have proclaimed YHWH today to be God to you, and to go
in His ways and to observe His laws and His commandments
and His judgments and to listen to His voice.

translation.text: Today you have obtained the LORD's his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and to obey him.

verses.english:
And YHWH proclaimed you today to be a treasured people to
Him as He spoke to you—and to observe all His
commandments—
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הֶאֱמִירְךָ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְלִשְׁמֹר כּל מִצְוֺתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הֶאֱמִירְךָ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְלִשְׁמֹר כּל מִצְוֺתָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH proclaimed you today to be a treasured people to
Him as He spoke to you—and to observe all His
commandments—

translation.text: Today the LORD has obtained your agreement: to be his treasured people, as he promised you, and to keep his commandments;

verses.english:
and to set you high above all the nations that He has made
in praise and name and beauty, and for you to be a holy
people to YHWH, your God, as He spoke.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְתִתְּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִתְהִלָּה וּלְשֵׁם וּלְתִפְאָרֶת וְלִהְיֹתְךָ עַם קָדֹשׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וּלְתִתְּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִתְהִלָּה וּלְשֵׁם וּלְתִפְאָרֶת וְלִהְיֹתְךָ עַם קָדֹשׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
and to set you high above all the nations that He has made
in praise and name and beauty, and for you to be a holy
people to YHWH, your God, as He spoke.”

translation.text: for him to set you high above all nations that he has made, in praise and in God, as he promised.

verses.english:
And Moses and Israel’s elders commanded the people,
saying, “Observe all the commandment that I command you
today.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הָעָם לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹר אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הָעָם לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹר אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Israel’s elders commanded the people,
saying, “Observe all the commandment that I command you
today.

translation.text: Then Moses and the elders of Israel charged all the people as follows: Keep the entire commandment that I am commanding you today.

verses.english:
And it shall be, in the day that you’ll cross the Jordan
to the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you, that you
shall set up big stones and cover them with plaster.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תַּעַבְרוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ לְךָ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ אֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תַּעַבְרוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ לְךָ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ אֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

english.text:
And it shall be, in the day that you’ll cross the Jordan
to the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you, that you
shall set up big stones and cover them with plaster.

translation.text: On the day that you cross over the Jordan into the land that the LORD your plaster.

verses.english:
And you shall write on them all the words of this
instruction when you cross so that you’ll come to the land
that YHWH, your God, is giving you, a land flowing with
milk and honey, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.
verses.hebrew: וְכָתַבְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶן אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בְּעבְרֶךָ לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכָתַבְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶן אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בְּעבְרֶךָ לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ׃

english.text:
And you shall write on them all the words of this
instruction when you cross so that you’ll come to the land
that YHWH, your God, is giving you, a land flowing with
milk and honey, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.

translation.text: You shall write on them all the words of this law when you ancestors, promised you.

verses.english:
And it shall be, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall
set up these stones that I command you today in Mount Ebal
and cover them with plaster.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן תָּקִימוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּהַר עֵיבָל וְשַׂדְתָּ אוֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן תָּקִימוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּהַר עֵיבָל וְשַׂדְתָּ אוֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

english.text:
And it shall be, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall
set up these stones that I command you today in Mount Ebal
and cover them with plaster.

translation.text: So when you have crossed over the Jordan, today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall cover them with plaster.

verses.english:
And you shall build an altar to YHWH, your God, there, an
altar of stones. You shall not lift iron over them.
verses.hebrew: וּבָנִיתָ שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים לֹא תָנִיף עֲלֵיהֶם בַּרְזֶל׃

hebrew.text: וּבָנִיתָ שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים לֹא תָנִיף עֲלֵיהֶם בַּרְזֶל׃

english.text:
And you shall build an altar to YHWH, your God, there, an
altar of stones. You shall not lift iron over them.

translation.text: And you shall build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar of stones on which you have not used an iron tool.

verses.english:
You shall build the altar of YHWH, your God, of whole
stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to YHWH,
your God.
verses.hebrew: אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה אֶת מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתָ עָלָיו עוֹלֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה אֶת מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתָ עָלָיו עוֹלֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall build the altar of YHWH, your God, of whole
stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to YHWH,
your God.

translation.text: You must build the altar of it to the LORD your God,

verses.english:
And you shall sacrifice peace offerings and eat there and
rejoice in front of YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וְזָבַחְתָּ שְׁלָמִים וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְזָבַחְתָּ שְׁלָמִים וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall sacrifice peace offerings and eat there and
rejoice in front of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: make sacrifices of well-being, and eat them there, rejoicing before the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall write on the stones all the words of this
instruction very clearly.”
verses.hebrew: וְכָתַבְתָּ עַל הָאֲבָנִים אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בַּאֵר הֵיטֵב׃

hebrew.text: וְכָתַבְתָּ עַל הָאֲבָנִים אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בַּאֵר הֵיטֵב׃

english.text:
And you shall write on the stones all the words of this
instruction very clearly.”

translation.text: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very clearly.

verses.english:
And Moses and the Levite priests spoke to all Israel,
saying, “Be silent, and listen, Israel: this day you have
become a people to YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַסְכֵּת וּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִהְיֵיתָ לְעָם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַסְכֵּת וּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִהְיֵיתָ לְעָם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And Moses and the Levite priests spoke to all Israel,
saying, “Be silent, and listen, Israel: this day you have
become a people to YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Then Moses and the levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying: Keep silence and hear, O Israel! This very day you have become the people of the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, and
do His commandments and His laws that I command you
today.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מִצְוֺתָו וְאֶת חֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מִצְוֺתָו וְאֶת חֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And you shall listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, and
do His commandments and His laws that I command you
today.”

translation.text: Therefore obey the LORD your God, observing his commandments and his statutes that I am commanding you today.

verses.english: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,

translation.text: The same day Moses charged the people as follows:

verses.english:
“These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim
when you cross the Jordan: Simeon and Levi and Judah and
Issachar and Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת הָעָם עַל הַר גְּרִזִים בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וְיוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת הָעָם עַל הַר גְּרִזִים בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וְיוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
“These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim
when you cross the Jordan: Simeon and Levi and Judah and
Issachar and Joseph and Benjamin.

translation.text: When you Benjamin.

verses.english:
And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben,
Gad, and Asher and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ עַל הַקְּלָלָה בְּהַר עֵיבָל רְאוּבֵן גָּד וְאָשֵׁר וּזְבוּלֻן דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ עַל הַקְּלָלָה בְּהַר עֵיבָל רְאוּבֵן גָּד וְאָשֵׁר וּזְבוּלֻן דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben,
Gad, and Asher and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

translation.text: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

verses.english:
And the Levites shall answer, and they shall say in a loud
voice to every man of Israel:
verses.hebrew: וְעָנוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְאָמְרוּ אֶל כּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל רָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָנוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְאָמְרוּ אֶל כּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל רָם׃

english.text:
And the Levites shall answer, and they shall say in a loud
voice to every man of Israel:

translation.text: Then the Levites shall declare in a loud voice to all the Israelites:

verses.english:
‘Cursed be the man who will make a statue or molten thing,
an offensive thing of YHWH, a stone engraver’s work, and
set it up in secret.’ And all the people shall answer, and
they shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה פֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי חָרָשׁ וְשָׂם בַּסָּתֶר וְעָנוּ כל הָעָם וְאָמְרוּ אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה פֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי חָרָשׁ וְשָׂם בַּסָּתֶר וְעָנוּ כל הָעָם וְאָמְרוּ אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be the man who will make a statue or molten thing,
an offensive thing of YHWH, a stone engraver’s work, and
set it up in secret.’ And all the people shall answer, and
they shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who makes an idol or casts an image, anything abhorrent to the LORD, the work of an artisan, and sets it up in secret." All the people shall respond, saying, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who disrespects one’s father and his
mother.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַקְלֶה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַקְלֶה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who disrespects one’s father and his
mother.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who dishonors father or mother." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who moves a neighbor's boundary marker." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who misleads a blind person on the way.’
And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַשְׁגֶּה עִוֵּר בַּדָּרֶךְ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַשְׁגֶּה עִוֵּר בַּדָּרֶךְ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who misleads a blind person on the way.’
And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who misleads a blind person on the road." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who bends the judgment of an alien, an
orphan, or a widow.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who bends the judgment of an alien, an
orphan, or a widow.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who deprives the alien, the orphan, and the widow of justice." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his father’s wife, because he
has exposed his father’s hem.’ And all the people shall
say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו כִּי גִלָּה כְּנַף אָבִיו וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו כִּי גִלָּה כְּנַף אָבִיו וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his father’s wife, because he
has exposed his father’s hem.’ And all the people shall
say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who lies with his father's wife, because he has violated his father's rights." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with any animal.’ And all the
people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם כּל בְּהֵמָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם כּל בְּהֵמָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with any animal.’ And all the
people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who lies with any animal." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his sister —his father’s
daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ And all the people
shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his sister —his father’s
daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ And all the people
shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who lies with his sister, whether the daughter of "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם חֹתַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם חֹתַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who lies with his mother-in-law." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who strikes his neighbor in secret.’ And
all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַכֵּה רֵעֵהוּ בַּסָּתֶר וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַכֵּה רֵעֵהוּ בַּסָּתֶר וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who strikes his neighbor in secret.’ And
all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who strikes down a neighbor in secret." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who takes a bribe to strike a
person—innocent blood.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר לֹקֵחַ שֹׁחַד לְהַכּוֹת נֶפֶשׁ דָּם נָקִי וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר לֹקֵחַ שֹׁחַד לְהַכּוֹת נֶפֶשׁ דָּם נָקִי וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who takes a bribe to strike a
person—innocent blood.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who takes a bribe to shed innocent blood." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who will not uphold the words of this
instruction, to do them.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָקִים אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָם וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָקִים אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָם וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who will not uphold the words of this
instruction, to do them.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’

translation.text: "Cursed be anyone who does not uphold the words of this law by observing them." All the people shall say, "Amen!"

verses.english:
“And it will be, if you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments that I
command you today, that YHWH, your God, will set you high
above all the nations of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments that I
command you today, that YHWH, your God, will set you high
above all the nations of the earth.

translation.text: If you will only obey the LORD your God, by diligently observing all his will set you high above all the nations of the earth;

verses.english:
And all these blessings will come on you and catch up with
you when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God:
verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַבְּרָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻךָ כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַבְּרָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻךָ כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And all these blessings will come on you and catch up with
you when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God:

translation.text: all these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you, if you obey the LORD your God:

verses.english:
You’ll be blessed in the city, and you’ll be blessed in
the field.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בָּעִיר וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בָּעִיר וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
You’ll be blessed in the city, and you’ll be blessed in
the field.

translation.text: Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field.

verses.english:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land and the
fruit of your animals, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young, will be blessed.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וּפְרִי בְהֶמְתֶּךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרוֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וּפְרִי בְהֶמְתֶּךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרוֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

english.text:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land and the
fruit of your animals, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young, will be blessed.

translation.text: Blessed shall be the fruit of your womb, the fruit of your ground, and issue of your flock.

verses.english: Your basket and your bowl will be blessed.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Your basket and your bowl will be blessed.

translation.text: Blessed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.

verses.english:
You’ll be blessed when you come in, and you’ll be blessed
when you go out.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll be blessed when you come in, and you’ll be blessed
when you go out.

translation.text: Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.

verses.english:
YHWH will make your enemies who come up against you
stricken in front of you. By one road they’ll come out at
you, and by seven roads they’ll flee in front of you.
verses.hebrew: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ נִגָּפִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד יֵצְאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים יָנוּסוּ לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ נִגָּפִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד יֵצְאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים יָנוּסוּ לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make your enemies who come up against you
stricken in front of you. By one road they’ll come out at
you, and by seven roads they’ll flee in front of you.

translation.text: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise against you to be defeated you seven ways.

verses.english:
YHWH will command the blessing for you in your storehouses
and in everything your hand takes on and will bless you in
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.
verses.hebrew: יְצַו יְהֹוָה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה בַּאֲסָמֶיךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: יְצַו יְהֹוָה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה בַּאֲסָמֶיךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
YHWH will command the blessing for you in your storehouses
and in everything your hand takes on and will bless you in
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

translation.text: The LORD will command the blessing upon you in your barns, and in all that you undertake; he will bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

verses.english:
YHWH will establish you for him as a holy people as He
swore to you if you’ll keep the commandments of YHWH, your
God, and go in His ways.
verses.hebrew: יְקִימְךָ יְהֹוָה לוֹ לְעַם קָדוֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָךְ כִּי תִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִּדְרָכָיו׃

hebrew.text: יְקִימְךָ יְהֹוָה לוֹ לְעַם קָדוֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָךְ כִּי תִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִּדְרָכָיו׃

english.text:
YHWH will establish you for him as a holy people as He
swore to you if you’ll keep the commandments of YHWH, your
God, and go in His ways.

translation.text: The LORD will establish you as commandments of the LORD your God and walk in his ways.

verses.english:
And all the peoples of the earth will see that YHWH’s name
is called on you, and they’ll be afraid of you.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאוּ כּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי שֵׁם יְהֹוָה נִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ וְיָרְאוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאוּ כּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי שֵׁם יְהֹוָה נִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ וְיָרְאוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
And all the peoples of the earth will see that YHWH’s name
is called on you, and they’ll be afraid of you.

translation.text: All the LORD, and they shall be afraid of you.

verses.english:
And YHWH will give you a surplus of good in the fruit of
your womb and in the fruit of your animals and in the
fruit of your land, on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers to give you.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹתִרְךָ יְהֹוָה לְטוֹבָה בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹתִרְךָ יְהֹוָה לְטוֹבָה בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH will give you a surplus of good in the fruit of
your womb and in the fruit of your animals and in the
fruit of your land, on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers to give you.

translation.text: The LORD will make you swore to your ancestors to give you.

verses.english:
YHWH will open His good treasure, the skies, to you, to
give your lands showers at their time and to bless all
your hand’s work. And you’ll lend to many nations, and you
won’t borrow;
verses.hebrew: יִפְתַּח יְהֹוָה לְךָ אֶת אוֹצָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם לָתֵת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ בְּעִתּוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֵת כּל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ וְהִלְוִיתָ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאַתָּה לֹא תִלְוֶה׃

hebrew.text: יִפְתַּח יְהֹוָה לְךָ אֶת אוֹצָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם לָתֵת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ בְּעִתּוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֵת כּל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ וְהִלְוִיתָ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאַתָּה לֹא תִלְוֶה׃

english.text:
YHWH will open His good treasure, the skies, to you, to
give your lands showers at their time and to bless all
your hand’s work. And you’ll lend to many nations, and you
won’t borrow;

translation.text: The LORD will open for you his rich storehouse, the heavens, to give the rain of your land in its season you will not borrow.

verses.english:
and YHWH will put you at the head and not at the tail; and
you’ll only be above, and you won’t be below—if you’ll
listen to the commandments of YHWH, your God, that I
command you today, to observe and to do,
verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה לְרֹאשׁ וְלֹא לְזָנָב וְהָיִיתָ רַק לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא תִהְיֶה לְמָטָּה כִּי תִשְׁמַע אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה לְרֹאשׁ וְלֹא לְזָנָב וְהָיִיתָ רַק לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא תִהְיֶה לְמָטָּה כִּי תִשְׁמַע אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
and YHWH will put you at the head and not at the tail; and
you’ll only be above, and you won’t be below—if you’ll
listen to the commandments of YHWH, your God, that I
command you today, to observe and to do,

translation.text: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail; you shall be only at the top, and not at the bottom — if you obey you today, by diligently observing them,

verses.english:
and you won’t turn from all the things that I command you
today, right or left, to go after other gods, to serve
them.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָסוּר מִכּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָסוּר מִכּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם׃

english.text:
and you won’t turn from all the things that I command you
today, right or left, to go after other gods, to serve
them.

translation.text: and if you do not turn aside right or to the left, following other gods to serve them.

verses.english:
“And it will be, if you won’t listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments and
His laws that I command you today, that all these curses
will come on you and catch up with you:
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if you won’t listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments and
His laws that I command you today, that all these curses
will come on you and catch up with you:

translation.text: But if you will not obey the LORD your God by diligently observing all then all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you:

verses.english:
You’ll be cursed in the city, and you’ll be cursed in the
field.
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אַתָּה בָּעִיר וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אַתָּה בָּעִיר וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
You’ll be cursed in the city, and you’ll be cursed in the
field.

translation.text: Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.

verses.english: Your basket and your bowl will be cursed.
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Your basket and your bowl will be cursed.

translation.text: Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.

verses.english:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, your
cattle’s offspring and your flock’s young, will be cursed.
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

english.text:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, your
cattle’s offspring and your flock’s young, will be cursed.

translation.text: Cursed shall be the fruit of your womb, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your cattle and the issue of your flock.

verses.english:
You’ll be cursed when you come in, and you’ll be cursed
when you go out.
verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll be cursed when you come in, and you’ll be cursed
when you go out.

translation.text: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.

verses.english:
YHWH will send curse and tumult and annoyance at you in
everything your hand takes on that you’ll do, until you’re
destroyed and until you perish quickly because of your bad
practices, in that you left me.
verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַמְּאֵרָה אֶת הַמְּהוּמָה וְאֶת הַמִּגְעֶרֶת בְּכל מִשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַד הִשָּׁמֶדְךָ וְעַד אֲבדְךָ מַהֵר מִפְּנֵי רֹעַ מַעֲלָלֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עֲזַבְתָּנִי׃

hebrew.text: יְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַמְּאֵרָה אֶת הַמְּהוּמָה וְאֶת הַמִּגְעֶרֶת בְּכל מִשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַד הִשָּׁמֶדְךָ וְעַד אֲבדְךָ מַהֵר מִפְּנֵי רֹעַ מַעֲלָלֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עֲזַבְתָּנִי׃

english.text:
YHWH will send curse and tumult and annoyance at you in
everything your hand takes on that you’ll do, until you’re
destroyed and until you perish quickly because of your bad
practices, in that you left me.

translation.text: The LORD will send upon you disaster, panic, and frustration in forsaken me.

verses.english:
YHWH will make an epidemic cling to you until He finishes
you from the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.
verses.hebrew: יַדְבֵּק יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַדָּבֶר עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ אֹתְךָ מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: יַדְבֵּק יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַדָּבֶר עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ אֹתְךָ מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make an epidemic cling to you until He finishes
you from the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.

translation.text: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you until it has consumed you off the land that you are entering to possess.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with consumption and with fever and
with inflammation and with burning and with the sword and
with blight and with mildew. And they’ll pursue you until
you perish.
verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בַּשַּׁחֶפֶת וּבַקַּדַּחַת וּבַדַּלֶּקֶת וּבַחַרְחֻר וּבַחֶרֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפוֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן וּרְדָפוּךָ עַד אבְדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בַּשַּׁחֶפֶת וּבַקַּדַּחַת וּבַדַּלֶּקֶת וּבַחַרְחֻר וּבַחֶרֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפוֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן וּרְדָפוּךָ עַד אבְדֶךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with consumption and with fever and
with inflammation and with burning and with the sword and
with blight and with mildew. And they’ll pursue you until
you perish.

translation.text: The LORD will afflict you with consumption, fever, inflammation, with fiery until you perish.

verses.english:
And your skies that are over your head will be bronze, and
the land that is under you iron.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ שָׁמֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשְׁךָ נְחֹשֶׁת וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיךָ בַּרְזֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ שָׁמֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשְׁךָ נְחֹשֶׁת וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיךָ בַּרְזֶל׃

english.text:
And your skies that are over your head will be bronze, and
the land that is under you iron.

translation.text: The sky over your head shall be bronze, and the earth under you iron.

verses.english:
YHWH will make your land’s showers powder and dust; it
will fall on you from the skies until you’re destroyed.
verses.hebrew: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ אָבָק וְעָפָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יֵרֵד עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

hebrew.text: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ אָבָק וְעָפָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יֵרֵד עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make your land’s showers powder and dust; it
will fall on you from the skies until you’re destroyed.

translation.text: The LORD will change the rain of your land until you are destroyed.

verses.english:
YHWH will make you stricken in front of your enemies. By
one road you’ll go out at him, and by seven roads you’ll
flee in front of him. And you’ll be a horrifying thing to
all the earth’s kingdoms.
verses.hebrew: יִתֶּנְךָ יְהֹוָה נִגָּף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד תֵּצֵא אֵלָיו וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים תָּנוּס לְפָנָיו וְהָיִיתָ לְזַעֲוָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: יִתֶּנְךָ יְהֹוָה נִגָּף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד תֵּצֵא אֵלָיו וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים תָּנוּס לְפָנָיו וְהָיִיתָ לְזַעֲוָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make you stricken in front of your enemies. By
one road you’ll go out at him, and by seven roads you’ll
flee in front of him. And you’ll be a horrifying thing to
all the earth’s kingdoms.

translation.text: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies; you shall go out against them one way and flee before them seven ways. You shall become an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.english:
And your carcass will become food for every bird of the
skies and for the animals of the earth, with no one making
them afraid.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה נִבְלָתְךָ לְמַאֲכָל לְכל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה נִבְלָתְךָ לְמַאֲכָל לְכל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד׃

english.text:
And your carcass will become food for every bird of the
skies and for the animals of the earth, with no one making
them afraid.

translation.text: Your corpses shall be food for every bird of the air and animal of the earth, and there shall be no one to frighten them away.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with
hemorrhoids and with scabs and with itches, from which you
won’t be able to be healed.
verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין מִצְרַיִם (ובעפלים) [וּבַטְּחֹרִים] וּבַגָּרָב וּבֶחָרֶס אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין מִצְרַיִם (ובעפלים) [וּבַטְּחֹרִים] וּבַגָּרָב וּבֶחָרֶס אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with
hemorrhoids and with scabs and with itches, from which you
won’t be able to be healed.

translation.text: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with ulcers, scurvy, and itch, of which you cannot be healed.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with madness and with blindness and
with amazement of heart.
verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁגָּעוֹן וּבְעִוָּרוֹן וּבְתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁגָּעוֹן וּבְעִוָּרוֹן וּבְתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with madness and with blindness and
with amazement of heart.

translation.text: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind;

verses.english:
And you’ll be feeling around at noon the way the blind
would feel around, in the dark. And you won’t make your
ways successful, but you’ll just be exploited and robbed
every day, and there will be no one to save you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ מְמַשֵּׁשׁ בַּצּהֳרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְמַשֵּׁשׁ הַעִוֵּר בָּאֲפֵלָה וְלֹא תַצְלִיחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ עָשׁוּק וְגָזוּל כּל הַיָּמִים וְאֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִיתָ מְמַשֵּׁשׁ בַּצּהֳרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְמַשֵּׁשׁ הַעִוֵּר בָּאֲפֵלָה וְלֹא תַצְלִיחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ עָשׁוּק וְגָזוּל כּל הַיָּמִים וְאֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

english.text:
And you’ll be feeling around at noon the way the blind
would feel around, in the dark. And you won’t make your
ways successful, but you’ll just be exploited and robbed
every day, and there will be no one to save you.

translation.text: you shall grope about at noon as blind people grope in darkness, but you shall be unable to find anyone to help.

verses.english:
You’ll betroth a woman, and another man will ravish her.
You’ll build a house, and you won’t live in it. You’ll
plant a vineyard, and you won’t desanctify it.
verses.hebrew: אִשָּׁה תְאָרֵשׂ וְאִישׁ אַחֵר (ישגלנה) [יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה] בַּיִת תִּבְנֶה וְלֹא תֵשֵׁב בּוֹ כֶּרֶם תִּטַּע וְלֹא תְחַלְּלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אִשָּׁה תְאָרֵשׂ וְאִישׁ אַחֵר (ישגלנה) [יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה] בַּיִת תִּבְנֶה וְלֹא תֵשֵׁב בּוֹ כֶּרֶם תִּטַּע וְלֹא תְחַלְּלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
You’ll betroth a woman, and another man will ravish her.
You’ll build a house, and you won’t live in it. You’ll
plant a vineyard, and you won’t desanctify it.

translation.text: You shall become engaged to a woman, but another man shall lie with her. You shall build a house, but not live in it. You shall plant a vineyard, but not enjoy its fruit.

verses.english:
Your ox slaughtered before your eyes—and you won’t eat any
of it. Your ass stolen from in front of you—and it won’t
come back to you. Your sheep given to your enemies—and
you’ll have no one to save you.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹרְךָ טָבוּחַ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְלֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ חֲמֹרְךָ גָּזוּל מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב לָךְ צֹאנְךָ נְתֻנוֹת לְאֹיְבֶיךָ וְאֵין לְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

hebrew.text: שׁוֹרְךָ טָבוּחַ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְלֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ חֲמֹרְךָ גָּזוּל מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב לָךְ צֹאנְךָ נְתֻנוֹת לְאֹיְבֶיךָ וְאֵין לְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

english.text:
Your ox slaughtered before your eyes—and you won’t eat any
of it. Your ass stolen from in front of you—and it won’t
come back to you. Your sheep given to your enemies—and
you’ll have no one to save you.

translation.text: Your ox shall be shall be stolen in front of you, and shall not be restored to you. Your sheep shall be given to your enemies, without anyone to help you.

verses.english:
Your sons and your daughters given to another people—while
your eyes are looking for them all day and giving out, and
there’s no God at your hand.
verses.hebrew: בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ נְתֻנִים לְעַם אַחֵר וְעֵינֶיךָ רֹאוֹת וְכָלוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם כּל הַיּוֹם וְאֵין לְאֵל יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ נְתֻנִים לְעַם אַחֵר וְעֵינֶיךָ רֹאוֹת וְכָלוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם כּל הַיּוֹם וְאֵין לְאֵל יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
Your sons and your daughters given to another people—while
your eyes are looking for them all day and giving out, and
there’s no God at your hand.

translation.text: powerless to do anything.

verses.english:
A people whom you haven’t known will eat your land’s fruit
and all the product of your exhaustion, and you’ll only be
exploited and crushed every day.
verses.hebrew: פְּרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וְכל יְגִיעֲךָ יֹאכַל עַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדָעְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ רַק עָשׁוּק וְרָצוּץ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: פְּרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וְכל יְגִיעֲךָ יֹאכַל עַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדָעְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ רַק עָשׁוּק וְרָצוּץ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
A people whom you haven’t known will eat your land’s fruit
and all the product of your exhaustion, and you’ll only be
exploited and crushed every day.

translation.text: A people whom you do not know shall continually abused and crushed,

verses.english:
And you’ll be driven mad from the sight before your eyes
that you’ll see.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ מְשֻׁגָּע מִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִיתָ מְשֻׁגָּע מִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And you’ll be driven mad from the sight before your eyes
that you’ll see.

translation.text: and driven mad by the sight that your eyes shall see.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with bad boils on the knees and on
the thighs from which you won’t be able to be healed, from
your foot to the top of your head.
verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין רָע עַל הַבִּרְכַּיִם וְעַל הַשֹּׁקַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא מִכַּף רַגְלְךָ וְעַד קדְקֳדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין רָע עַל הַבִּרְכַּיִם וְעַל הַשֹּׁקַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא מִכַּף רַגְלְךָ וְעַד קדְקֳדֶךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with bad boils on the knees and on
the thighs from which you won’t be able to be healed, from
your foot to the top of your head.

translation.text: The LORD will strike you on the knees and on the of your foot to the crown of your head.

verses.english:
YHWH will drive you and your king whom you’ll set up over
you to a nation whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, and you’ll serve other gods, wood and stone,
there.
verses.hebrew: יוֹלֵךְ יְהֹוָה אֹתְךָ וְאֶת מַלְכְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תָּקִים עָלֶיךָ אֶל גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: יוֹלֵךְ יְהֹוָה אֹתְךָ וְאֶת מַלְכְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תָּקִים עָלֶיךָ אֶל גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

english.text:
YHWH will drive you and your king whom you’ll set up over
you to a nation whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, and you’ll serve other gods, wood and stone,
there.

translation.text: The LORD will bring you, and stone.

verses.english:
And you’ll become an astonishment, a proverb, and an
expression among all the peoples to which YHWH will drive
you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ לְשַׁמָּה לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְךָ יְהֹוָה שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִיתָ לְשַׁמָּה לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְךָ יְהֹוָה שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And you’ll become an astonishment, a proverb, and an
expression among all the peoples to which YHWH will drive
you.

translation.text: You shall become an object of horror, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you.

verses.english:
You’ll take out much seed to the field, but you’ll gather
little, because locusts will finish it off.
verses.hebrew: זֶרַע רַב תּוֹצִיא הַשָּׂדֶה וּמְעַט תֶּאֱסֹף כִּי יַחְסְלֶנּוּ הָאַרְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: זֶרַע רַב תּוֹצִיא הַשָּׂדֶה וּמְעַט תֶּאֱסֹף כִּי יַחְסְלֶנּוּ הָאַרְבֶּה׃

english.text:
You’ll take out much seed to the field, but you’ll gather
little, because locusts will finish it off.

translation.text: You shall carry much seed into the field but shall gather little in, for the locust shall consume it.

verses.english:
You’ll plant vineyards and work them, but you won’t drink
wine or gather grapes, because worms will eat it.
verses.hebrew: כְּרָמִים תִּטַּע וְעָבָדְתָּ וְיַיִן לֹא תִשְׁתֶּה וְלֹא תֶאֱגֹר כִּי תֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַתֹּלָעַת׃

hebrew.text: כְּרָמִים תִּטַּע וְעָבָדְתָּ וְיַיִן לֹא תִשְׁתֶּה וְלֹא תֶאֱגֹר כִּי תֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַתֹּלָעַת׃

english.text:
You’ll plant vineyards and work them, but you won’t drink
wine or gather grapes, because worms will eat it.

translation.text: You shall plant vineyards and dress the worm shall eat them.

verses.english:
You’ll have olives within all your border, but you won’t
anoint with oil, because your olive will drop off.
verses.hebrew: זֵיתִים יִהְיוּ לְךָ בְּכל גְּבוּלֶךָ וְשֶׁמֶן לֹא תָסוּךְ כִּי יִשַּׁל זֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: זֵיתִים יִהְיוּ לְךָ בְּכל גְּבוּלֶךָ וְשֶׁמֶן לֹא תָסוּךְ כִּי יִשַּׁל זֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll have olives within all your border, but you won’t
anoint with oil, because your olive will drop off.

translation.text: You shall have olive trees throughout all your territory, but you shall not anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives shall drop off.

verses.english:
You’ll give birth to sons and daughters, but you won’t
have them, because they’ll go into captivity.
verses.hebrew: בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת תּוֹלִיד וְלֹא יִהְיוּ לָךְ כִּי יֵלְכוּ בַּשֶּׁבִי׃

hebrew.text: בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת תּוֹלִיד וְלֹא יִהְיוּ לָךְ כִּי יֵלְכוּ בַּשֶּׁבִי׃

english.text:
You’ll give birth to sons and daughters, but you won’t
have them, because they’ll go into captivity.

translation.text: You shall have sons and daughters, but they shall not remain yours, for they shall go into captivity.

verses.english:
Crickets will take possession of all your trees and your
land’s fruit.
verses.hebrew: כּל עֵצְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ יְיָרֵשׁ הַצְּלָצַל׃

hebrew.text: כּל עֵצְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ יְיָרֵשׁ הַצְּלָצַל׃

english.text:
Crickets will take possession of all your trees and your
land’s fruit.

translation.text: All your trees and the fruit of your ground the cicada shall take over.

verses.english:
The alien who is among you will go up above you higher and
higher, and you will go down lower and lower.
verses.hebrew: הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּךָ יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ מַעְלָה מָּעְלָה וְאַתָּה תֵרֵד מַטָּה מָּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּךָ יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ מַעְלָה מָּעְלָה וְאַתָּה תֵרֵד מַטָּה מָּטָּה׃

english.text:
The alien who is among you will go up above you higher and
higher, and you will go down lower and lower.

translation.text: Aliens you shall descend lower and lower.

verses.english:
He will lend to you, but you won’t lend to him. He will
become a head, and you will become a tail.
verses.hebrew: הוּא יַלְוְךָ וְאַתָּה לֹא תַלְוֶנּוּ הוּא יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְזָנָב׃

hebrew.text: הוּא יַלְוְךָ וְאַתָּה לֹא תַלְוֶנּוּ הוּא יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְזָנָב׃

english.text:
He will lend to you, but you won’t lend to him. He will
become a head, and you will become a tail.

translation.text: They shall lend to you but you shall not lend to them; they shall be the head and you shall be the tail.

verses.english:
“And all these curses will come over you and pursue you
and catch up with you until you’re destroyed because you
didn’t listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to observe
His commandments and His laws that He commanded you.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וּרְדָפוּךָ וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וּרְדָפוּךָ וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And all these curses will come over you and pursue you
and catch up with you until you’re destroyed because you
didn’t listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to observe
His commandments and His laws that He commanded you.

translation.text: All these curses shall come upon you, pursuing and overtaking you you.

verses.english:
And they’ll be a sign and a wonder in you and in your seed
forever.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ בְךָ לְאוֹת וּלְמוֹפֵת וּבְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ בְךָ לְאוֹת וּלְמוֹפֵת וּבְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And they’ll be a sign and a wonder in you and in your seed
forever.

translation.text: They shall be among you and your descendants as a sign and a portent forever.

verses.english:
Because you didn’t serve YHWH, your God, with joy and with
good feeling from the abundance of everything,
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָבַדְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְטוּב לֵבָב מֵרֹב כֹּל׃

hebrew.text: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָבַדְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְטוּב לֵבָב מֵרֹב כֹּל׃

english.text:
Because you didn’t serve YHWH, your God, with joy and with
good feeling from the abundance of everything,

translation.text: Because you did not serve the LORD your God joyfully and with gladness of heart for the abundance of everything,

verses.english:
so you’ll serve your enemies whom YHWH will send at you in
hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of
everything. And He’ll put an iron yoke on your neck until
He has destroyed you.
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה בָּךְ בְּרָעָב וּבְצָמָא וּבְעֵירֹם וּבְחֹסֶר כֹּל וְנָתַן עֹל בַּרְזֶל עַל צַוָּארֶךָ עַד הִשְׁמִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה בָּךְ בְּרָעָב וּבְצָמָא וּבְעֵירֹם וּבְחֹסֶר כֹּל וְנָתַן עֹל בַּרְזֶל עַל צַוָּארֶךָ עַד הִשְׁמִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
so you’ll serve your enemies whom YHWH will send at you in
hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of
everything. And He’ll put an iron yoke on your neck until
He has destroyed you.

translation.text: therefore you iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

verses.english:
YHWH will fetch a nation from far, from the end of the
earth, over you the way an eagle soars, a nation whose
language you won’t understand,
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ גּוֹי מֵרָחֹק מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִדְאֶה הַנָּשֶׁר גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשְׁמַע לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ גּוֹי מֵרָחֹק מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִדְאֶה הַנָּשֶׁר גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשְׁמַע לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH will fetch a nation from far, from the end of the
earth, over you the way an eagle soars, a nation whose
language you won’t understand,

translation.text: The LORD will understand,

verses.english:
a fierce-faced nation who won’t be partial to the old and
won’t show grace to the young—
verses.hebrew: גּוֹי עַז פָּנִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים לְזָקֵן וְנַעַר לֹא יָחֹן׃

hebrew.text: גּוֹי עַז פָּנִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים לְזָקֵן וְנַעַר לֹא יָחֹן׃

english.text:
a fierce-faced nation who won’t be partial to the old and
won’t show grace to the young—

translation.text: a grim-faced nation showing no respect to the old or favor to the young.

verses.english:
and it will eat the fruit of your animals and the fruit of
your land until you are destroyed—who won’t leave you
grain, wine, and oil, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young until it has made you perish.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכַל פְּרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַשְׁאִיר לְךָ דָּגָן תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ עַד הַאֲבִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַל פְּרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַשְׁאִיר לְךָ דָּגָן תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ עַד הַאֲבִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
and it will eat the fruit of your animals and the fruit of
your land until you are destroyed—who won’t leave you
grain, wine, and oil, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young until it has made you perish.

translation.text: It shall consume the fruit of your livestock and your flock, until it has made you perish.

verses.english:
And it will close you in, in all your gates, until your
high and fortified walls in which you trust come down in
all your land; and it will close you in, in all your
gates, in all your land that YHWH, your God, has given
you.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ עַד רֶדֶת חֹמֹתֶיךָ הַגְּבֹהֹת וְהַבְּצֻרוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֵן בְּכל אַרְצֶךָ וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּכל אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ עַד רֶדֶת חֹמֹתֶיךָ הַגְּבֹהֹת וְהַבְּצֻרוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֵן בְּכל אַרְצֶךָ וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּכל אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ׃

english.text:
And it will close you in, in all your gates, until your
high and fortified walls in which you trust come down in
all your land; and it will close you in, in all your
gates, in all your land that YHWH, your God, has given
you.

translation.text: It shall besiege you in all throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.

verses.english:
And you’ll eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your
sons and your daughters whom YHWH, your God, has given
you, in the siege and in the constraint that your enemy
will put on you.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכַלְתָּ פְרִי בִטְנְךָ בְּשַׂר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיְבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ פְרִי בִטְנְךָ בְּשַׂר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיְבֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you’ll eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your
sons and your daughters whom YHWH, your God, has given
you, in the siege and in the constraint that your enemy
will put on you.

verses.english:
The tenderest and the most delicate woman among you, who
wouldn’t risk setting her foot on the ground out of
delicacy and tenderness: her eye will look with evil
intent at the man of her bosom and her son and her
daughter
verses.hebrew: הָרַכָּה בְךָ וְהָעֲנֻגָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִסְּתָה כַף רַגְלָהּ הַצֵּג עַל הָאָרֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּג וּמֵרֹךְ תֵּרַע עֵינָהּ בְּאִישׁ חֵיקָהּ וּבִבְנָהּ וּבְבִתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: הָרַכָּה בְךָ וְהָעֲנֻגָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִסְּתָה כַף רַגְלָהּ הַצֵּג עַל הָאָרֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּג וּמֵרֹךְ תֵּרַע עֵינָהּ בְּאִישׁ חֵיקָהּ וּבִבְנָהּ וּבְבִתָּהּ׃

english.text:
The tenderest and the most delicate woman among you, who
wouldn’t risk setting her foot on the ground out of
delicacy and tenderness: her eye will look with evil
intent at the man of her bosom and her son and her
daughter

translation.text: She who is and to her own daughter,

verses.english:
and her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs
and her children to whom she’ll give birth, because she’ll
eat them in secret due to the lack of everything in the
siege and in the constraint that your enemy will put on
you in your gates.
verses.hebrew: וּבְשִׁלְיָתָהּ הַיּוֹצֵת מִבֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ וּבְבָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד כִּי תֹאכְלֵם בְּחֹסֶר כֹּל בַּסָּתֶר בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשִׁלְיָתָהּ הַיּוֹצֵת מִבֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ וּבְבָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד כִּי תֹאכְלֵם בְּחֹסֶר כֹּל בַּסָּתֶר בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs
and her children to whom she’ll give birth, because she’ll
eat them in secret due to the lack of everything in the
siege and in the constraint that your enemy will put on
you in your gates.

translation.text: begrudging even the afterbirth that towns.

verses.english:
If you won’t be watchful to do the words of this
instruction that are written in this scroll, to fear this
honored and awesome name: YHWH, your God,
verses.hebrew: אִם לֹא תִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לְיִרְאָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם הַנִּכְבָּד וְהַנּוֹרָא הַזֶּה אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אִם לֹא תִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לְיִרְאָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם הַנִּכְבָּד וְהַנּוֹרָא הַזֶּה אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
If you won’t be watchful to do the words of this
instruction that are written in this scroll, to fear this
honored and awesome name: YHWH, your God,

translation.text: If you do not diligently observe all the words of this law that are your God,

verses.english:
then YHWH will make your plagues and your seed’s plagues
astonishing, great and enduring plagues, and great and
enduring illnesses.
verses.hebrew: וְהִפְלָא יְהֹוָה אֶת מַכֹּתְךָ וְאֵת מַכּוֹת זַרְעֶךָ מַכּוֹת גְּדֹלֹת וְנֶאֱמָנוֹת וחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְלָא יְהֹוָה אֶת מַכֹּתְךָ וְאֵת מַכּוֹת זַרְעֶךָ מַכּוֹת גְּדֹלֹת וְנֶאֱמָנוֹת וחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים׃

english.text:
then YHWH will make your plagues and your seed’s plagues
astonishing, great and enduring plagues, and great and
enduring illnesses.

translation.text: then the LORD will overwhelm both you and your maladies.

verses.english:
And He’ll bring back among you every disease of Egypt,
which you were dreading, and they’ll cling to you.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁיב בְּךָ אֵת כּל מַדְוֵה מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְדָבְקוּ בָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵשִׁיב בְּךָ אֵת כּל מַדְוֵה מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְדָבְקוּ בָּךְ׃

english.text:
And He’ll bring back among you every disease of Egypt,
which you were dreading, and they’ll cling to you.

translation.text: He will bring back upon you all the diseases of Egypt, of which you were in dread, and they shall cling to you.

verses.english:
YHWH will bring over you every illness and every plague
that is not written in this scroll of instruction, as
well, until you are destroyed.
verses.hebrew: גַּם כּל חֳלִי וְכל מַכָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא כָתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת יַעְלֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם כּל חֳלִי וְכל מַכָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא כָתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת יַעְלֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

english.text:
YHWH will bring over you every illness and every plague
that is not written in this scroll of instruction, as
well, until you are destroyed.

translation.text: Every other law, the LORD will inflict on you until you are destroyed.

verses.english:
And you’ll be left with few persons when you had been like
the stars of the skies for multitude, because you didn’t
listen to the voice of YHWH, your God.
verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר הֱיִיתֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר הֱיִיתֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you’ll be left with few persons when you had been like
the stars of the skies for multitude, because you didn’t
listen to the voice of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Although once you were as numerous as the stars in heaven, you shall be left few in number, because you did not obey the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And it will be: as YHWH had satisfaction over you to do
good to you and to multiply you, so YHWH will have
satisfaction over you to make you perish and to destroy
you, and you’ll be torn away from the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהֵיטִיב אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַרְבּוֹת אֶתְכֶם כֵּן יָשִׂישׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַאֲבִיד אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהֵיטִיב אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַרְבּוֹת אֶתְכֶם כֵּן יָשִׂישׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַאֲבִיד אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And it will be: as YHWH had satisfaction over you to do
good to you and to multiply you, so YHWH will have
satisfaction over you to make you perish and to destroy
you, and you’ll be torn away from the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.

translation.text: And just as LORD will take delight in bringing you to ruin and destruction; you shall be plucked off the land that you are entering to possess.

verses.english:
And YHWH will scatter you among all the peoples from one
end of the earth to the other end of the earth. And you’ll
serve other gods, whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, there, wood and stone.
verses.hebrew: וֶהֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּכל הָעַמִּים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּכל הָעַמִּים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

english.text:
And YHWH will scatter you among all the peoples from one
end of the earth to the other end of the earth. And you’ll
serve other gods, whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, there, wood and stone.

translation.text: The LORD neither you nor your ancestors have known.

verses.english:
And among those nations you won’t have a respite, and
there won’t be a resting place for your foot, and YHWH
will give you there a trembling heart and a failing of
eyes and a fainting of soul.
verses.hebrew: וּבַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם לֹא תַרְגִּיעַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלֶךָ וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה לְךָ שָׁם לֵב רַגָּז וְכִלְיוֹן עֵינַיִם וְדַאֲבוֹן נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם לֹא תַרְגִּיעַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלֶךָ וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה לְךָ שָׁם לֵב רַגָּז וְכִלְיוֹן עֵינַיִם וְדַאֲבוֹן נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And among those nations you won’t have a respite, and
there won’t be a resting place for your foot, and YHWH
will give you there a trembling heart and a failing of
eyes and a fainting of soul.

translation.text: Among those nations you shall find no ease, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a languishing spirit.

verses.english:
And your life will be hanging opposite you, and you’ll
fear night and day, and you won’t trust in your life.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ חַיֶּיךָ תְּלֻאִים לְךָ מִנֶּגֶד וּפָחַדְתָּ לַיְלָה וְיוֹמָם וְלֹא תַאֲמִין בְּחַיֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ חַיֶּיךָ תְּלֻאִים לְךָ מִנֶּגֶד וּפָחַדְתָּ לַיְלָה וְיוֹמָם וְלֹא תַאֲמִין בְּחַיֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
And your life will be hanging opposite you, and you’ll
fear night and day, and you won’t trust in your life.

translation.text: Your life shall hang in doubt before you; night and day you shall be in dread, with no assurance of your life.

verses.english:
In the morning you’ll say, ‘Who would make it evening,’
and in the evening you’ll say, ‘Who would make it
morning,’ because of your heart’s fear that you’ll have
and because of the sight before your eyes that you’ll see.
verses.hebrew: בַּבֹּקֶר תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן עֶרֶב וּבָעֶרֶב תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן בֹּקֶר מִפַּחַד לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְחָד וּמִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: בַּבֹּקֶר תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן עֶרֶב וּבָעֶרֶב תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן בֹּקֶר מִפַּחַד לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְחָד וּמִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
In the morning you’ll say, ‘Who would make it evening,’
and in the evening you’ll say, ‘Who would make it
morning,’ because of your heart’s fear that you’ll have
and because of the sight before your eyes that you’ll see.

translation.text: In the morning you shall say, "If only it were evening!" and at evening you shall say, "If feel and the sights that your eyes shall see.

verses.english:
And YHWH will bring you back to Egypt in boats, by the way
that I said to you: ‘You won’t go on to see it anymore.’
And you’ll sell yourselves there to your enemies as slaves
and as maids, and none will buy!”
