you.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְךָ וְרִחֲמֶךָ וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְךָ וְרִחֲמֶךָ וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
that YHWH, your God, will bring back your captivity and be
merciful to you. And He’ll come back and gather you from
all the peoples to which YHWH, your God, has scattered
you.

translation.text: LORD your God has scattered you.

verses.english:
If you’ll be driven to the end of the skies, YHWH, your
God, will gather you from there, and He’ll take you from
there.
verses.hebrew: אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶךָ׃

english.text:
If you’ll be driven to the end of the skies, YHWH, your
God, will gather you from there, and He’ll take you from
there.

translation.text: Even if you are exiled to the ends of there he will bring you back.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will bring you to the land that your
fathers possessed, and you’ll take possession of it, and
He’ll be good to you and multiply you more than your
fathers.
verses.hebrew: וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְהֵיטִבְךָ וְהִרְבְּךָ מֵאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְהֵיטִבְךָ וְהִרְבְּךָ מֵאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will bring you to the land that your
fathers possessed, and you’ll take possession of it, and
He’ll be good to you and multiply you more than your
fathers.

translation.text: The LORD your God will bring you into the land that your ancestors possessed, and you will possess it; he will make you more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will circumcise your heart and your
seed’s heart so as to love YHWH, your God, with all your
heart and with all your soul so that you’ll live.
verses.hebrew: וּמָל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת לְבַב זַרְעֶךָ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ לְמַעַן חַיֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת לְבַב זַרְעֶךָ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ לְמַעַן חַיֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will circumcise your heart and your
seed’s heart so as to love YHWH, your God, with all your
heart and with all your soul so that you’ll live.

translation.text: Moreover, the LORD your God will circumcise your heart and the heart your heart and with all your soul, in order that you may live.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will put all these curses on your
enemies and on those who hate you who have pursued you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל הָאָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְעַל שֹׂנְאֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל הָאָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְעַל שֹׂנְאֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will put all these curses on your
enemies and on those who hate you who have pursued you.

translation.text: The LORD adversaries who took advantage of you.

verses.english:
And you’ll come back and listen to YHWH’s voice and do all
His commandments that I command you today.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תָשׁוּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תָשׁוּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And you’ll come back and listen to YHWH’s voice and do all
His commandments that I command you today.

translation.text: Then you shall again obey today,

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will give you extra of all your hand’s
work, of the fruit of your womb and of the fruit of your
animals and the fruit of your land for good. Because YHWH
will come back to have satisfaction over you for good as
He had satisfaction over your fathers,
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹתִירְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ לְטֹבָה כִּי יָשׁוּב יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּשׂ עָלֶיךָ לְטוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ עַל אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹתִירְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ לְטֹבָה כִּי יָשׁוּב יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּשׂ עָלֶיךָ לְטוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ עַל אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will give you extra of all your hand’s
work, of the fruit of your womb and of the fruit of your
animals and the fruit of your land for good. Because YHWH
will come back to have satisfaction over you for good as
He had satisfaction over your fathers,

translation.text: and the LORD your God will make you abundantly prosperous in all your undertakings, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your ancestors,

verses.english:
when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
observe His commandments and His laws, written in this
scroll of instruction, when you’ll come back to YHWH, your
God, with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו הַכְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה כִּי תָשׁוּב אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו הַכְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה כִּי תָשׁוּב אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
observe His commandments and His laws, written in this
scroll of instruction, when you’ll come back to YHWH, your
God, with all your heart and with all your soul.

translation.text: when you obey the LORD your God by observing his your soul. The original continuation of chapter

verses.english:
“Because this commandment that I command you today: it’s
not too wondrous for you, and it’s not too far.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לֹא נִפְלֵאת הִוא מִמְּךָ וְלֹא רְחֹקָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לֹא נִפְלֵאת הִוא מִמְּךָ וְלֹא רְחֹקָה הִוא׃

english.text:
“Because this commandment that I command you today: it’s
not too wondrous for you, and it’s not too far.

translation.text: Surely, this commandment that I am commanding you today is not too hard for you, nor is it too far away.

verses.english:
It’s not in the skies, that one would say, ‘Who will go up
for us to the skies and get it for us and enable us to
hear it so we’ll do it?’
verses.hebrew: לֹא בַשָּׁמַיִם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה לָּנוּ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא בַשָּׁמַיִם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה לָּנוּ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

english.text:
It’s not in the skies, that one would say, ‘Who will go up
for us to the skies and get it for us and enable us to
hear it so we’ll do it?’

translation.text: It is not in heaven, that you should say, "Who will go up to heaven for us, and get it for us so that we may hear it and observe it?"

verses.english:
And it’s not across the sea, that one would say, ‘Who will
cross for us, across the sea, and get it for us and enable
us to hear it so we’ll do it?’
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא מֵעֵבֶר לַיָּם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲבר לָנוּ אֶל עֵבֶר הַיָּם וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא מֵעֵבֶר לַיָּם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲבר לָנוּ אֶל עֵבֶר הַיָּם וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

english.text:
And it’s not across the sea, that one would say, ‘Who will
cross for us, across the sea, and get it for us and enable
us to hear it so we’ll do it?’

translation.text: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, "Who will cross to the other side of the sea for us, and get it for us so that we may hear it and observe it?"

verses.english:
But the thing is very close to you, in your mouth, and in
your heart, to do it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּפִיךָ וּבִלְבָבְךָ לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּפִיךָ וּבִלְבָבְךָ לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

english.text:
But the thing is very close to you, in your mouth, and in
your heart, to do it.

translation.text: No, the word is observe.

verses.english:
“See: I’ve put in front of you today life and good, and
death and bad,
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם אֶת הַחַיִּים וְאֶת הַטּוֹב וְאֶת הַמָּוֶת וְאֶת הָרָע׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם אֶת הַחַיִּים וְאֶת הַטּוֹב וְאֶת הַמָּוֶת וְאֶת הָרָע׃

english.text:
“See: I’ve put in front of you today life and good, and
death and bad,

translation.text: See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, death and adversity.

verses.english:
in that I command you today to love YHWH, your God, to go
in His ways and to observe His commandments and His laws
and His judgments so you’ll live and multiply and bless
YHWH, your God, in the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחָיִיתָ וְרָבִיתָ וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחָיִיתָ וְרָבִיתָ וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
in that I command you today to love YHWH, your God, to go
in His ways and to observe His commandments and His laws
and His judgments so you’ll live and multiply and bless
YHWH, your God, in the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.

translation.text: If you obey the commandments of the LORD your God that bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.

verses.english:
But if your heart will turn away, and you won’t listen,
and you’ll be driven so that you’ll bow to other gods and
serve them,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִפְנֶה לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִפְנֶה לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּם׃

english.text:
But if your heart will turn away, and you won’t listen,
and you’ll be driven so that you’ll bow to other gods and
serve them,

translation.text: But if your to other gods and serve them,

verses.english:
I’ve told you today that you’ll perish. You won’t extend
days on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
come to take possession of it.
verses.hebrew: הִגַּדְתִּי לָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבוֹא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: הִגַּדְתִּי לָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבוֹא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
I’ve told you today that you’ll perish. You won’t extend
days on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
come to take possession of it.

translation.text: I declare to you today that you shall Jordan to enter and possess.

verses.english:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today: I’ve put life and death in front of you, blessing
and curse. And you shall choose life, so you’ll live, you
and your seed,
verses.hebrew: הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּוֶת נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה וּבָחַרְתָּ בַּחַיִּים לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה אַתָּה וְזַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּוֶת נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה וּבָחַרְתָּ בַּחַיִּים לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה אַתָּה וְזַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today: I’ve put life and death in front of you, blessing
and curse. And you shall choose life, so you’ll live, you
and your seed,

translation.text: I call heaven and earth to witness and curses. Choose life so that you and your descendants may live,

verses.english:
to love YHWH, your God, to listen to His voice and to
cling to Him, because He is your life and the extension of
your days to reside on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to
them.”
verses.hebrew: לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ וּלְדבְקָה בוֹ כִּי הוּא חַיֶּיךָ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֶיךָ לָשֶׁבֶת עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ וּלְדבְקָה בוֹ כִּי הוּא חַיֶּיךָ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֶיךָ לָשֶׁבֶת עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

english.text:
to love YHWH, your God, to listen to His voice and to
cling to Him, because He is your life and the extension of
your days to reside on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to
them.”

translation.text: Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.english:
And Moses went and spoke these things to
all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses went and spoke these things to
all Israel.

translation.text: When Moses had finished speaking all these words to all Israel,

verses.english:
And he said to them, “I’m a hundred twenty years old
today. I’m not able to go out and come in anymore. And
YHWH said to me, ‘You shall not cross this Jordan.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם לֹא אוּכַל עוֹד לָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם לֹא אוּכַל עוֹד לָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “I’m a hundred twenty years old
today. I’m not able to go out and come in anymore. And
YHWH said to me, ‘You shall not cross this Jordan.’

translation.text: he this Jordan.'

verses.english:
YHWH, your God: He is crossing in front of you. He’ll
destroy these nations in front of you, and you’ll
dispossess them. Joshua: he is crossing in front of you,
as YHWH has spoken.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יַשְׁמִיד אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יַשְׁמִיד אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
YHWH, your God: He is crossing in front of you. He’ll
destroy these nations in front of you, and you’ll
dispossess them. Joshua: he is crossing in front of you,
as YHWH has spoken.

translation.text: The LORD your God himself will cross over before you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua also will cross over before you, as the LORD promised.

verses.english:
And YHWH will do to them as He did to Sihon and to Og, the
kings of the Amorites, and to their land, that He
destroyed them.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְסִיחוֹן וּלְעוֹג מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְאַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְסִיחוֹן וּלְעוֹג מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְאַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH will do to them as He did to Sihon and to Og, the
kings of the Amorites, and to their land, that He
destroyed them.

translation.text: The LORD and to their land, when he destroyed them.

verses.english:
And YHWH will put them in front of you, and you shall do
to them according to all of the commandment that I’ve
commanded you.
verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָהֶם כְּכל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָהֶם כְּכל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH will put them in front of you, and you shall do
to them according to all of the commandment that I’ve
commanded you.

translation.text: The LORD will give them command that I have given to you.

verses.english:
Be strong and be bold. Don’t be afraid and don’t be scared
in front of them, because YHWH, your God: He is the one
going with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you.”
verses.hebrew: חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ׃

english.text:
Be strong and be bold. Don’t be afraid and don’t be scared
in front of them, because YHWH, your God: He is the one
going with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you.”

translation.text: Be strong and bold; have no fear or dread of them, because it is the LORD your God who goes with you; he will not fail you or forsake you."

verses.english:
And Moses called Joshua and said to him before the eyes of
all Israel, “Be strong and be bold, because you will come
with this people to the land that YHWH swore to their
fathers to give to them, and you will get it for them as a
legacy.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי כל יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם וְאַתָּה תַּנְחִילֶנָּה אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי כל יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם וְאַתָּה תַּנְחִילֶנָּה אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses called Joshua and said to him before the eyes of
all Israel, “Be strong and be bold, because you will come
with this people to the land that YHWH swore to their
fathers to give to them, and you will get it for them as a
legacy.

translation.text: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the sight of all people into the land that the LORD has sworn to their ancestors to give them; and you will put them in possession of it.

verses.english:
And YHWH: He is the one who is going in front of you. He
will be with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you. You shall not fear, and you shall not be dismayed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ לֹא תִירָא וְלֹא תֵחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ לֹא תִירָא וְלֹא תֵחָת׃

english.text:
And YHWH: He is the one who is going in front of you. He
will be with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you. You shall not fear, and you shall not be dismayed.”

translation.text: It is the LORD who you. Do not fear or be dismayed."

verses.english:
And Moses wrote this instruction and gave it to the
priests, sons of Levi, who were carrying the ark of YHWH’s
covenant and to all of Israel’s elders.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וַיִּתְּנָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי הַנֹּשְׂאִים אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְאֶל כּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וַיִּתְּנָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי הַנֹּשְׂאִים אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְאֶל כּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses wrote this instruction and gave it to the
priests, sons of Levi, who were carrying the ark of YHWH’s
covenant and to all of Israel’s elders.

translation.text: Then Moses wrote down this law, and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of seven
years, at the appointed time of the year of the remission,
on the Festival of Booths,
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּמֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּמֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of seven
years, at the appointed time of the year of the remission,
on the Festival of Booths,

translation.text: Moses commanded them: "Every seventh year, in the scheduled year of remission, during the festival of booths,

verses.english:
when all Israel comes to appear before YHWH, your God, in
the place that He will choose, you shall read this
instruction in front of all Israel in their ears.
verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא כל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר תִּקְרָא אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת נֶגֶד כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאזְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: בְּבוֹא כל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר תִּקְרָא אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת נֶגֶד כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאזְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
when all Israel comes to appear before YHWH, your God, in
the place that He will choose, you shall read this
instruction in front of all Israel in their ears.

translation.text: when all will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

verses.english:
Assemble the people—the men and the women and the infants
and your alien who is in your gates—so they will listen
and so they will learn and will fear YHWH, your God, and
they will be watchful to do all the words of this
instruction.
verses.hebrew: הַקְהֵל אֶת הָעָם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ וּלְמַעַן יִלְמְדוּ וְיָרְאוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְשָׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: הַקְהֵל אֶת הָעָם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ וּלְמַעַן יִלְמְדוּ וְיָרְאוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְשָׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Assemble the people—the men and the women and the infants
and your alien who is in your gates—so they will listen
and so they will learn and will fear YHWH, your God, and
they will be watchful to do all the words of this
instruction.

translation.text: aliens residing in your towns — so that they may hear and learn to fear

verses.english:
And their children who have not known will listen and
learn to fear YHWH, your God, all the days that you’re
living on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
take possession of it.”
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ יִשְׁמְעוּ וְלָמְדוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ יִשְׁמְעוּ וְלָמְדוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And their children who have not known will listen and
learn to fear YHWH, your God, all the days that you’re
living on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
take possession of it.”

translation.text: and so that their children, who have not known it, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing over the Jordan to possess."

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, your days to die have come
close. Call Joshua, and stand up in the Tent of Meeting,
and I’ll command him.” And Moses and Joshua went and stood
up in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֵן קָרְבוּ יָמֶיךָ לָמוּת קְרָא אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַאֲצַוֶּנּוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃
