treated the king of Jericho.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־מַקֵּדָה לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הֶחֱרִם אוֹתָם וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמֶלֶךְ
מַקֵּדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־מַקֵּדָה לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הֶחֱרִם אוֹתָם וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמֶלֶךְ
מַקֵּדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
At that time Joshua captured Makkedah and put it and its king to
the sword, proscribing it and every person in it and leaving none
that escaped. And he treated the king of Makkedah as he had
treated the king of Jericho.

translation.text: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword; he utterly destroyed every person in it; he left to the king of Jericho.

verses.english:
From Makkedah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Libnah, and he
attacked it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִמַּקֵּדָה לִבְנָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם־לִבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִמַּקֵּדָה לִבְנָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם־לִבְנָה׃

english.text:
From Makkedah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Libnah, and he
attacked it.

translation.text: Then Joshua passed on from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

verses.english:
YHWH delivered it and its king into the hands of Israel; they put
it and all the people in it to the sword, letting none escape. And
he treated its king as he had treated the king of Jericho.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם־אוֹתָהּ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר בָּהּ שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם־אוֹתָהּ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר בָּהּ שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH delivered it and its king into the hands of Israel; they put
it and all the people in it to the sword, letting none escape. And
he treated its king as he had treated the king of Jericho.

translation.text: The LORD gave it also and its sword, and every person in it; he left no one remaining in it; and he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

verses.english:
From Libnah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Lachish; he
encamped against it and attacked it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלִּבְנָה לָכִישָׁה וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלִּבְנָה לָכִישָׁה וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

english.text:
From Libnah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Lachish; he
encamped against it and attacked it.

translation.text: Next Joshua passed on from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and laid siege to it, and assaulted it.

verses.english:
YHWH delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel. They captured it
on the second day and put it and all the people in it to the
sword, just as they had done to Libnah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־לָכִישׁ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־לָכִישׁ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה׃

english.text:
YHWH delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel. They captured it
on the second day and put it and all the people in it to the
sword, just as they had done to Libnah.

translation.text: The LORD gave Lachish into the hand of Israel, and he took it on the second day, and struck it Libnah.

verses.english:
At that time King Horam of Gezer marched to the help of Lachish;
but Joshua defeated him and his army, letting none of them escape.
verses.hebrew: אָז עָלָה הֹרָם מֶלֶךְ גֶּזֶר לַעְזֹר אֶת־לָכִישׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: אָז עָלָה הֹרָם מֶלֶךְ גֶּזֶר לַעְזֹר אֶת־לָכִישׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
At that time King Horam of Gezer marched to the help of Lachish;
but Joshua defeated him and his army, letting none of them escape.

translation.text: Then King Horam of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, leaving him no survivors.

verses.english:
From Lachish, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Eglon; they
encamped against it and attacked it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלָּכִישׁ עֶגְלֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלָּכִישׁ עֶגְלֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
From Lachish, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Eglon; they
encamped against it and attacked it.

translation.text: From Lachish Joshua passed on with all Israel to Eglon; and they laid siege to it, and assaulted it;

verses.english:
They captured it on the same day and put it to the sword,
proscribing all the people that were in it, as they had done to
Lachish.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֵת כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֶחֱרִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלָכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֵת כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֶחֱרִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלָכִישׁ׃

english.text:
They captured it on the same day and put it to the sword,
proscribing all the people that were in it, as they had done to
Lachish.

translation.text: and they took it that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword; and every person in it he utterly destroyed that day, as he had done to Lachish.

verses.english:
From Eglon, Joshua marched with all Israel to Hebron and attacked
it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מֵעֶגְלוֹנָה חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מֵעֶגְלוֹנָה חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
From Eglon, Joshua marched with all Israel to Hebron and attacked
it.

translation.text: Then Joshua went up with all Israel from Eglon to Hebron; they assaulted it,

verses.english:
They captured it and put it, its king, and all its towns, and all
the people that were in it, to the sword. He let none escape,
proscribing it and all the people in it, just as he had done in
the case of Eglon.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיַּכּוּהָ־לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְעֶגְלוֹן וַיַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיַּכּוּהָ־לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְעֶגְלוֹן וַיַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ׃

english.text:
They captured it and put it, its king, and all its towns, and all
the people that were in it, to the sword. He let none escape,
proscribing it and all the people in it, just as he had done in
the case of Eglon.

translation.text: and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, every person in it.

verses.english:
Joshua and all Israel with him then turned back to Debir and
attacked it.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ דְּבִרָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ דְּבִרָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Joshua and all Israel with him then turned back to Debir and
attacked it.

translation.text: Then Joshua, with all Israel, turned back to Debir and assaulted it,

verses.english:
He captured it and its king and all its towns. They put them to
the sword and proscribed all the people in it. They let none
escape; just as they had done to Hebron, and as they had done to
Libnah and its king, so they did to Debir and its king.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כּל־נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֶבְרוֹן כֵּן־עָשָׂה
לִדְבִרָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כּל־נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֶבְרוֹן כֵּן־עָשָׂה
לִדְבִרָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ׃

english.text:
He captured it and its king and all its towns. They put them to
the sword and proscribed all the people in it. They let none
escape; just as they had done to Hebron, and as they had done to
Libnah and its king, so they did to Debir and its king.

translation.text: and he took it with its king and all its towns; they struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed every person in it; he left to Libnah and its king, so he did to Debir and its king.

verses.english:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country: the hill country, the
Negeb, the Shephelah, and the slopes, with all their kings; he let
none escape, but proscribed everything that breathed—as YHWH, the
God of Israel, had commanded.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּכֶּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה וְהָאֲשֵׁדוֹת וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וְאֵת כּל־הַנְּשָׁמָה הֶחֱרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּכֶּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה וְהָאֲשֵׁדוֹת וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וְאֵת כּל־הַנְּשָׁמָה הֶחֱרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country: the hill country, the
Negeb, the Shephelah, and the slopes, with all their kings; he let
none escape, but proscribed everything that breathed—as YHWH, the
God of Israel, had commanded.

translation.text: So Joshua defeated the whole land, the hill country and the Negeb Israel commanded.

verses.english:
Joshua conquered them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, all the land of
Goshen, and up to Gibeon.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעַד־עַזָּה וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְעַד־גִּבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעַד־עַזָּה וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְעַד־גִּבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Joshua conquered them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, all the land of
Goshen, and up to Gibeon.

translation.text: And Joshua defeated them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, as far as Gibeon.

verses.english:
All those kings and their lands were conquered by Joshua at a
single stroke, for YHWH, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־אַרְצָם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פַּעַם אֶחָת כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־אַרְצָם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פַּעַם אֶחָת כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
All those kings and their lands were conquered by Joshua at a
single stroke, for YHWH, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

translation.text: Joshua of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.english: Then Joshua, with all Israel, returned to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃

english.text: Then Joshua, with all Israel, returned to the camp at Gilgal.

translation.text: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.english:
When the news reached King Jabin of Hazor, he sent messages to
King Jobab of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of
Achshaph,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יוֹבָב מֶלֶךְ מָדוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ שִׁמְרוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַכְשָׁף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יוֹבָב מֶלֶךְ מָדוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ שִׁמְרוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַכְשָׁף׃

english.text:
When the news reached King Jabin of Hazor, he sent messages to
King Jobab of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of
Achshaph,

translation.text: When King Jabin of Hazor heard of this, he sent to King Jobab of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן בָּהָר וּבָעֲרָבָה נֶגֶב כִּנְרוֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְנָפוֹת דּוֹר מִיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן בָּהָר וּבָעֲרָבָה נֶגֶב כִּנְרוֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְנָפוֹת דּוֹר מִיָּם׃

translation.text: and to the of Chinneroth, and in the lowland, and in Naphoth-dor on the west,

verses.english:
to the Canaanites in the east and in the west; to the Amorites,
Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to
the Hivites at the foot of Hermon, in the land of Mizpah.
verses.hebrew: הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִמִּזְרָח וּמִיָּם וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי בָּהָר וְהַחִוִּי תַּחַת חֶרְמוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִמִּזְרָח וּמִיָּם וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי בָּהָר וְהַחִוִּי תַּחַת חֶרְמוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
to the Canaanites in the east and in the west; to the Amorites,
Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to
the Hivites at the foot of Hermon, in the land of Mizpah.

translation.text: to the Canaanites in the east and the west, the Amorites, the Hittites, under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

verses.english:
They took the field with all their armies—an enormous host, as
numerous as the sands on the seashore—and a vast multitude of
horses and chariots.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ הֵם וְכל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם עַם־רָב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וְסוּס וָרֶכֶב רַב־מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ הֵם וְכל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם עַם־רָב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וְסוּס וָרֶכֶב רַב־מְאֹד׃

english.text:
They took the field with all their armies—an enormous host, as
numerous as the sands on the seashore—and a vast multitude of
horses and chariots.

translation.text: They came out, with all their very many horses and chariots.

verses.english:
All these kings joined forces; they came and encamped together at
the Waters of Merom to give battle to Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ כֹּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־מֵי מֵרוֹם לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ כֹּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־מֵי מֵרוֹם לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
All these kings joined forces; they came and encamped together at
the Waters of Merom to give battle to Israel.

translation.text: All these kings joined their forces, and Israel.

verses.english:
But YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them; tomorrow at
this time I will have them all lying slain before Israel. You
shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי־מָחָר כָּעֵת הַזֹּאת אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם תְּעַקֵּר
וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי־מָחָר כָּעֵת הַזֹּאת אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם תְּעַקֵּר
וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them; tomorrow at
this time I will have them all lying slain before Israel. You
shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.”

translation.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, for tomorrow at this time I will hand over all of them, slain, to Israel; you shall hamstring their horses, and burn their chariots with fire."

verses.english:
So Joshua, with all his fighting men, came upon them suddenly at
the Waters of Merom, and pounced upon them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־מֵי מֵרוֹם פִּתְאֹם וַיִּפְּלוּ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־מֵי מֵרוֹם פִּתְאֹם וַיִּפְּלוּ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
So Joshua, with all his fighting men, came upon them suddenly at
the Waters of Merom, and pounced upon them.

translation.text: So waters of Merom, and fell upon them.

verses.english:
YHWH delivered them into the hands of Israel, and they defeated
them and pursued them all the way to Great Sidon and
Misrephothmaim, and all the way to the Valley of Mizpeh on the
east; they crushed them, letting none escape.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּם וַיִּרְדְּפוּם עַד־צִידוֹן רַבָּה וְעַד מִשְׂרְפוֹת מַיִם וְעַד־בִּקְעַת מִצְפֶּה מִזְרָחָה וַיַּכֻּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לָהֶם
שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּם וַיִּרְדְּפוּם עַד־צִידוֹן רַבָּה וְעַד מִשְׂרְפוֹת מַיִם וְעַד־בִּקְעַת מִצְפֶּה מִזְרָחָה וַיַּכֻּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לָהֶם
שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
YHWH delivered them into the hands of Israel, and they defeated
them and pursued them all the way to Great Sidon and
Misrephothmaim, and all the way to the Valley of Mizpeh on the
east; they crushed them, letting none escape.

translation.text: And the LORD handed them Mizpeh. They struck them down, until they had left no one remaining.

verses.english:
And Joshua dealt with them as YHWH had ordered him; he hamstrung
their horses and burned their chariots.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ יְהֹוָה אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ יְהֹוָה אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And Joshua dealt with them as YHWH had ordered him; he hamstrung
their horses and burned their chariots.

translation.text: And Joshua did to them as the LORD commanded him; he hamstrung their horses, and burned their chariots with fire.

verses.english:
Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor and put her king to the
sword.—Hazor was formerly the head of all those kingdoms.—
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הִכָּה בֶחָרֶב כִּי־חָצוֹר לְפָנִים הִיא רֹאשׁ כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הִכָּה בֶחָרֶב כִּי־חָצוֹר לְפָנִים הִיא רֹאשׁ כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor and put her king to the
sword.—Hazor was formerly the head of all those kingdoms.—

translation.text: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king kingdoms.

verses.english:
They proscribed and put to the sword every person in it. Not a
soul survived, and Hazor itself was burned down.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב הַחֲרֵם לֹא נוֹתַר כּל־נְשָׁמָה וְאֶת־חָצוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב הַחֲרֵם לֹא נוֹתַר כּל־נְשָׁמָה וְאֶת־חָצוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
They proscribed and put to the sword every person in it. Not a
soul survived, and Hazor itself was burned down.

translation.text: And they put to the sword all who were in it, utterly Hazor with fire.

verses.english:
Joshua captured all those royal cities and their kings. He put
them to the sword; he proscribed them in accordance with the
charge of Moses, the servant of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֵי הַמְּלָכִים־הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּכֵּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב הֶחֱרִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֵי הַמְּלָכִים־הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּכֵּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב הֶחֱרִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Joshua captured all those royal cities and their kings. He put
them to the sword; he proscribed them in accordance with the
charge of Moses, the servant of YHWH.

translation.text: And all the towns of those kings, and all their kings, destroying them, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded.

verses.english:
However, all those towns that are still standing on their mounds
were not burned down by Israel; it was Hazor alone that Joshua
burned down.
verses.hebrew: רַק כּל־הֶעָרִים הָעֹמְדוֹת עַל־תִּלָּם לֹא שְׂרָפָם יִשְׂרָאֵל זוּלָתִי אֶת־חָצוֹר לְבַדָּהּ שָׂרַף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: רַק כּל־הֶעָרִים הָעֹמְדוֹת עַל־תִּלָּם לֹא שְׂרָפָם יִשְׂרָאֵל זוּלָתִי אֶת־חָצוֹר לְבַדָּהּ שָׂרַף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
However, all those towns that are still standing on their mounds
were not burned down by Israel; it was Hazor alone that Joshua
burned down.

translation.text: Hazor, which Joshua did burn.

verses.english:
The Israelites kept all the spoil and cattle of the rest of those
cities as booty. But they cut down their populations with the
sword until they exterminated them; they did not spare a soul.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל שְׁלַל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַבְּהֵמָה בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק אֶת־כּל־הָאָדָם הִכּוּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־הִשְׁמִדָם אוֹתָם לֹא הִשְׁאִירוּ כּל־נְשָׁמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל שְׁלַל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַבְּהֵמָה בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק אֶת־כּל־הָאָדָם הִכּוּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־הִשְׁמִדָם אוֹתָם לֹא הִשְׁאִירוּ כּל־נְשָׁמָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites kept all the spoil and cattle of the rest of those
cities as booty. But they cut down their populations with the
sword until they exterminated them; they did not spare a soul.

translation.text: All the spoil of these towns, and the livestock, the Israelites took for their booty; but all the people they them, and they did not leave any who breathed.

verses.english:
Just as YHWH had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses had charged
Joshua, and so Joshua did; he left nothing undone of all that YHWH
had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֵן עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵסִיר דָּבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֵן עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵסִיר דָּבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
Just as YHWH had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses had charged
Joshua, and so Joshua did; he left nothing undone of all that YHWH
had commanded Moses.

translation.text: As the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
Joshua conquered the whole of this region: the hill country [of
Judah], the Negeb, the whole land of Goshen, the Shephelah, the
Arabah, and the hill country and coastal plain of Israel—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הָהָר וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגֹּשֶׁן וְאֶת־הַשְּׁפֵלָה וְאֶת־הָעֲרָבָה וְאֶת־הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הָהָר וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגֹּשֶׁן וְאֶת־הַשְּׁפֵלָה וְאֶת־הָעֲרָבָה וְאֶת־הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹה׃

english.text:
Joshua conquered the whole of this region: the hill country [of
Judah], the Negeb, the whole land of Goshen, the Shephelah, the
Arabah, and the hill country and coastal plain of Israel—

translation.text: So Joshua took all that land: the hill country and all the Negeb and country of Israel and its lowland,

verses.english:
[everything] from Mount Halak, which ascends to Seir, all the way
to Baal-gad in the Valley of the Lebanon at the foot of Mount
Hermon; and he captured all the kings there and executed them.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעוֹלֶה שֵׂעִיר וְעַד־בַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן תַּחַת הַר־חֶרְמוֹן וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד וַיַּכֵּם וַיְמִיתֵם׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעוֹלֶה שֵׂעִיר וְעַד־בַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן תַּחַת הַר־חֶרְמוֹן וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד וַיַּכֵּם וַיְמִיתֵם׃

english.text:
[everything] from Mount Halak, which ascends to Seir, all the way
to Baal-gad in the Valley of the Lebanon at the foot of Mount
Hermon; and he captured all the kings there and executed them.

translation.text: from Mount Halak, which rises death.

verses.english: Joshua waged war with all those kings over a long period.
verses.hebrew: יָמִים רַבִּים עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: יָמִים רַבִּים עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text: Joshua waged war with all those kings over a long period.

translation.text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

verses.english:
Apart from the Hivites who dwelt in Gibeon, not a single city made
terms with the Israelites; all were taken in battle.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־הָיְתָה עִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִימָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלְתִּי הַחִוִּי יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־הַכֹּל לָקְחוּ בַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־הָיְתָה עִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִימָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלְתִּי הַחִוִּי יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־הַכֹּל לָקְחוּ בַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Apart from the Hivites who dwelt in Gibeon, not a single city made
terms with the Israelites; all were taken in battle.

translation.text: There was not a town that made peace with the Israelites, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon; all were taken in battle.

verses.english:
For it was YHWH’s doing to stiffen their hearts to give battle to
Israel, in order that they might be proscribed without quarter and
wiped out, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew:
כִּי מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבָּם לִקְרַאת הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן הַחֲרִימָם לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת־לָהֶם תְּחִנָּה כִּי לְמַעַן הַשְׁמִידָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה
יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבָּם לִקְרַאת הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן הַחֲרִימָם לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת־לָהֶם תְּחִנָּה כִּי לְמַעַן הַשְׁמִידָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה
יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
For it was YHWH’s doing to stiffen their hearts to give battle to
Israel, in order that they might be proscribed without quarter and
wiped out, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: For it was the commanded Moses.

verses.english:
At that time, Joshua went and wiped out the Anakites from the hill
country, from Hebron, Debir, and Anab, from the entire hill
country of Judah, and from the entire hill country of Israel;
Joshua proscribed them and their towns.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיַּכְרֵת אֶת־הָעֲנָקִים מִן־הָהָר מִן־חֶבְרוֹן מִן־דְּבִר מִן־עֲנָב וּמִכֹּל הַר יְהוּדָה וּמִכֹּל הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־עָרֵיהֶם הֶחֱרִימָם
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיַּכְרֵת אֶת־הָעֲנָקִים מִן־הָהָר מִן־חֶבְרוֹן מִן־דְּבִר מִן־עֲנָב וּמִכֹּל הַר יְהוּדָה וּמִכֹּל הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־עָרֵיהֶם הֶחֱרִימָם
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
At that time, Joshua went and wiped out the Anakites from the hill
country, from Hebron, Debir, and Anab, from the entire hill
country of Judah, and from the entire hill country of Israel;
Joshua proscribed them and their towns.

translation.text: At that time Joshua came and wiped out the Anakim from the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel; Joshua utterly destroyed them with their towns.

verses.english:
No Anakites remained in the land of the Israelites; but some
remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־נוֹתַר עֲנָקִים בְּאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק בְּעַזָּה בְּגַת וּבְאַשְׁדּוֹד נִשְׁאָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־נוֹתַר עֲנָקִים בְּאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק בְּעַזָּה בְּגַת וּבְאַשְׁדּוֹד נִשְׁאָרוּ׃

english.text:
No Anakites remained in the land of the Israelites; but some
remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

translation.text: None of the Anakim was left in the land of the Israelites; some remained only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod.

verses.english:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country, just as YHWH had promised
Moses; and Joshua assigned it to Israel to share according to
their tribal divisions. And the land had rest from war.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְּנָהּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְנַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה
מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְּנָהּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְנַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה
מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country, just as YHWH had promised
Moses; and Joshua assigned it to Israel to share according to
their tribal divisions. And the land had rest from war.

translation.text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Israel according to their tribal allotments. And the land had rest from war.

verses.english:
The following are the local kings whom the Israelites defeated and
whose territories they took possession of: East of the Jordan,
from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, including the eastern half of
the Arabah:
verses.hebrew:
וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה הַשָּׁמֶשׁ מִנַּחַל אַרְנוֹן עַד־הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכל־הָעֲרָבָה
מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה הַשָּׁמֶשׁ מִנַּחַל אַרְנוֹן עַד־הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכל־הָעֲרָבָה
מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
The following are the local kings whom the Israelites defeated and
whose territories they took possession of: East of the Jordan,
from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, including the eastern half of
the Arabah:

translation.text: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the Israelites defeated, the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, with all the Arabah eastward:

verses.english:
King Sihon of the Amorites, who resided in Heshbon and ruled over
part of Gilead—from Aroer on the bank of the Wadi Arnon and the
wadi proper up to the Wadi Jabbok [and] the border of the
Ammonites—
verses.hebrew:
סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן מֹשֵׁל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְתוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי
עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן מֹשֵׁל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְתוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי
עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
King Sihon of the Amorites, who resided in Heshbon and ruled over
part of Gilead—from Aroer on the bank of the Wadi Arnon and the
wadi proper up to the Wadi Jabbok [and] the border of the
Ammonites—

translation.text: Ammonites, that is, half of Gilead,

verses.english:
and over the eastern Arabah up to the Sea of Chinnereth and,
southward by way of Beth-jeshimoth at the foot of the slopes of
Pisgah on the east, down to the Sea of the Arabah, that is, the
Dead Sea.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲרָבָה עַד־יָם כִּנְרוֹת מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם־הַמֶּלַח מִזְרָחָה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַיְשִׁמוֹת וּמִתֵּימָן תַּחַת אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֲרָבָה עַד־יָם כִּנְרוֹת מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם־הַמֶּלַח מִזְרָחָה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַיְשִׁמוֹת וּמִתֵּימָן תַּחַת אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

english.text:
and over the eastern Arabah up to the Sea of Chinnereth and,
southward by way of Beth-jeshimoth at the foot of the slopes of
Pisgah on the east, down to the Sea of the Arabah, that is, the
Dead Sea.

translation.text: and the Arabah to the Sea of of Pisgah;

verses.english:
Also the territory of King Og of Bashan—one of the last of the
Rephaim—who resided in Ashtaroth and in Edrei
verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
Also the territory of King Og of Bashan—one of the last of the
Rephaim—who resided in Ashtaroth and in Edrei

translation.text: and King Og of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei

verses.english:
and ruled over Mount Hermon, Salcah, and all of Bashan up to the
border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, as also over part of
Gilead [down to] the border of King Sihon of Heshbon.
verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֵׁל בְּהַר חֶרְמוֹן וּבְסַלְכָה וּבְכל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד גְּבוּל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֵׁל בְּהַר חֶרְמוֹן וּבְסַלְכָה וּבְכל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד גְּבוּל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

english.text:
and ruled over Mount Hermon, Salcah, and all of Bashan up to the
border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, as also over part of
Gilead [down to] the border of King Sihon of Heshbon.

translation.text: and ruled over Mount Hermon Heshbon.

verses.english:
These were vanquished by Moses, the servant of YHWH, and the
Israelites; and Moses, the servant of YHWH, assigned that
territory as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.

commanded you.
verses.hebrew: כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָהָר מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן עַד־מִשְׂרְפֹת מַיִם כּל־צִידֹנִים אָנֹכִי אוֹרִישֵׁם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק הַפִּלֶהָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנַחֲלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָהָר מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן עַד־מִשְׂרְפֹת מַיִם כּל־צִידֹנִים אָנֹכִי אוֹרִישֵׁם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק הַפִּלֶהָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנַחֲלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ׃

english.text:
with all the inhabitants of the hill country from the [Valley of
the] Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, namely, all the Sidonians. I
Myself will dispossess those nations for the Israelites; you have
only to apportion their lands by lot among Israel, as I have
commanded you.

translation.text: all the inhabitants of the hill will myself drive them out from before the Israelites; only allot the land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

verses.english:
Therefore, divide this territory into hereditary portions for the
nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה חַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת בְּנַחֲלָה לְתִשְׁעַת הַשְּׁבָטִים וַחֲצִי הַשֵּׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה חַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת בְּנַחֲלָה לְתִשְׁעַת הַשְּׁבָטִים וַחֲצִי הַשֵּׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
Therefore, divide this territory into hereditary portions for the
nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

translation.text: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh."

verses.english:
Now the Reubenites and the Gadites, along with the other
half-tribe, had already received the shares which Moses assigned
to them on the east side of the Jordan—as assigned to them by
Moses the servant of YHWH:
verses.hebrew: עִמּוֹ הָראוּבֵנִי וְהַגָּדִי לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עִמּוֹ הָראוּבֵנִי וְהַגָּדִי לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Now the Reubenites and the Gadites, along with the other
half-tribe, had already received the shares which Moses assigned
to them on the east side of the Jordan—as assigned to them by
Moses the servant of YHWH:

translation.text: With the other half-tribe of Manasseh the Reubenites and the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:

verses.english:
from Aroer on the edge of the Wadi Arnon and the town in the
middle of the wadi, the entire Tableland [from] Medeba to Dibon,
verses.hebrew: מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכל־הַמִּישֹׁר מֵידְבָא עַד־דִּיבוֹן׃

hebrew.text: מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכל־הַמִּישֹׁר מֵידְבָא עַד־דִּיבוֹן׃

english.text:
from Aroer on the edge of the Wadi Arnon and the town in the
middle of the wadi, the entire Tableland [from] Medeba to Dibon,

translation.text: from Dibon;

verses.english:
embracing all the towns of King Sihon of the Amorites, who had
reigned in Heshbon, up to the border of the Ammonites;
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל עָרֵי סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל עָרֵי סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
embracing all the towns of King Sihon of the Amorites, who had
reigned in Heshbon, up to the border of the Ammonites;

translation.text: and all the cities of King Sihon of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the boundary of the Ammonites;

verses.english:
further, Gilead, the territories of the Geshurites and the
Maacathites, and all of Mount Hermon, and the whole of Bashan up
to Salcah—
verses.hebrew: וְהַגִּלְעָד וּגְבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וְכֹל הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־סַלְכָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַגִּלְעָד וּגְבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וְכֹל הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־סַלְכָה׃

english.text:
further, Gilead, the territories of the Geshurites and the
Maacathites, and all of Mount Hermon, and the whole of Bashan up
to Salcah—

translation.text: and Gilead, Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

verses.hebrew: כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר־מָלַךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי הוּא נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים וַיַּכֵּם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּרִשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר־מָלַךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי הוּא נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים וַיַּכֵּם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּרִשֵׁם׃

translation.text: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, survivors of the Rephaim); these Moses had defeated and driven out.

verses.english:
but the Israelites failed to dispossess the Geshurites and the
Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath remain among Israel to this
day.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיֵּשֶׁב גְּשׁוּר וּמַעֲכָת בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיֵּשֶׁב גְּשׁוּר וּמַעֲכָת בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
but the Israelites failed to dispossess the Geshurites and the
Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath remain among Israel to this
day.

translation.text: Yet the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites; but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

verses.english:
No hereditary portion, however, was assigned to the tribe of Levi,
their portion being the fire offerings of YHWH, the God of Israel,
as He spoke concerning them.
verses.hebrew: רַק לְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא נָתַן נַחֲלָה אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רַק לְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא נָתַן נַחֲלָה אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃

english.text:
No hereditary portion, however, was assigned to the tribe of Levi,
their portion being the fire offerings of YHWH, the God of Israel,
as He spoke concerning them.

translation.text: To the tribe of Levi alone Moses gave no inheritance; the offerings them.

verses.english:
And so Moses assigned [the following] to the tribe of the
Reubenites, for their various clans,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And so Moses assigned [the following] to the tribe of the
Reubenites, for their various clans,

translation.text: Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of the Reubenites according to their clans.

verses.english:
and it became theirs: The territory from Aroer, on the edge of the
Wadi Arnon and the town in the middle of the wadi, up to Medeba—
the entire Tableland—
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכל־הַמִּישֹׁר עַל־מֵידְבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכל־הַמִּישֹׁר עַל־מֵידְבָא׃

english.text:
and it became theirs: The territory from Aroer, on the edge of the
Wadi Arnon and the town in the middle of the wadi, up to Medeba—
the entire Tableland—

translation.text: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the edge and all the tableland by Medeba;

verses.english:
Heshbon and all its towns in the Tableland: Dibon, Bamoth-baal,
Beth-baal-meon,
verses.hebrew: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְכל־עָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּישֹׁר דִּיבֹן וּבָמוֹת בַּעַל וּבֵית בַּעַל מְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְכל־עָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּישֹׁר דִּיבֹן וּבָמוֹת בַּעַל וּבֵית בַּעַל מְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Heshbon and all its towns in the Tableland: Dibon, Bamoth-baal,
Beth-baal-meon,

translation.text: with Heshbon, and all its towns that are in the tableland; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baalmeon,

verses.english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.hebrew: וְיַהְצָה וּקְדֵמֹת וּמֵפָעַת׃

hebrew.text: וְיַהְצָה וּקְדֵמֹת וּמֵפָעַת׃

english.text: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

translation.text: and Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the hill of the valley,
verses.hebrew: וְקִרְיָתַיִם וְשִׂבְמָה וְצֶרֶת הַשַּׁחַר בְּהַר הָעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text: וְקִרְיָתַיִם וְשִׂבְמָה וְצֶרֶת הַשַּׁחַר בְּהַר הָעֵמֶק׃

english.text: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the hill of the valley,

translation.text: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,

verses.english: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—
verses.hebrew: וּבֵית פְּעוֹר וְאַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה וּבֵית הַיְשִׁמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵית פְּעוֹר וְאַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה וּבֵית הַיְשִׁמוֹת׃

english.text: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—

translation.text: and Bethpeor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

verses.english:
all the towns of the Tableland and the entire kingdom of Sihon,
the king of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon. (For Moses
defeated him and the Midianite chiefs Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and
Reba, who had dwelt in the land as princes of Sihon.
verses.hebrew:
וְכֹל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל־מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־אֱוִי וְאֶת־רֶקֶם וְאֶת־צוּר
וְאֶת־חוּר וְאֶת־רֶבַע נְסִיכֵי סִיחוֹן יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וְכֹל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל־מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־אֱוִי וְאֶת־רֶקֶם וְאֶת־צוּר
וְאֶת־חוּר וְאֶת־רֶבַע נְסִיכֵי סִיחוֹן יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
all the towns of the Tableland and the entire kingdom of Sihon,
the king of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon. (For Moses
defeated him and the Midianite chiefs Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and
Reba, who had dwelt in the land as princes of Sihon.

translation.text: that is, all the of Sihon, who lived in the land.

verses.english:
Together with the others that they slew, the Israelites put Balaam
son of Beor, the augur, to the sword.)
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר הַקּוֹסֵם הָרְגוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּחֶרֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר הַקּוֹסֵם הָרְגוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּחֶרֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Together with the others that they slew, the Israelites put Balaam
son of Beor, the augur, to the sword.)

translation.text: Along with the rest of those they who practiced divination.

verses.english:
The boundary of the Reubenites was the edge of the Jordan. That
was the portion of the Reubenites for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
The boundary of the Reubenites was the edge of the Jordan. That
was the portion of the Reubenites for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.

translation.text: And the border of the Reubenites was the according to their families, with their towns and villages.

verses.english:
To the tribe of Gad, for the various Gadite clans, Moses assigned
[the following],
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה־גָד לִבְנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה־גָד לִבְנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
To the tribe of Gad, for the various Gadite clans, Moses assigned
[the following],

translation.text: Moses gave an inheritance also to the tribe of the Gadites, according to their families.

verses.english:
and it became their territory: Jazer, all the towns of Gilead,
part of the country of the Ammonites up to Aroer, which is close
to Rabbah,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל יַעְזֵר וְכל־עָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד וַחֲצִי אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי רַבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל יַעְזֵר וְכל־עָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד וַחֲצִי אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי רַבָּה׃

english.text:
and it became their territory: Jazer, all the towns of Gilead,
part of the country of the Ammonites up to Aroer, which is close
to Rabbah,

translation.text: Their territory was Jazer, and all the is east of Rabbah,

verses.english:
and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim
to the border of Lidbir;
verses.hebrew: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־רָמַת הַמִּצְפֶּה וּבְטֹנִים וּמִמַּחֲנַיִם עַד־גְּבוּל לִדְבִר׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־רָמַת הַמִּצְפֶּה וּבְטֹנִים וּמִמַּחֲנַיִם עַד־גְּבוּל לִדְבִר׃

english.text:
and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim
to the border of Lidbir;

translation.text: and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir,

verses.english:
and in the Valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and
Zaphon—the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, the king of Heshbon—down
to the edge of the Jordan and up to the tip of the Sea of
Chinnereth on the east side of the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וּבָעֵמֶק בֵּית הָרָם וּבֵית נִמְרָה וְסֻכּוֹת וְצָפוֹן יֶתֶר מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל עַד־קְצֵה יָם־כִּנֶּרֶת עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבָעֵמֶק בֵּית הָרָם וּבֵית נִמְרָה וְסֻכּוֹת וְצָפוֹן יֶתֶר מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל עַד־קְצֵה יָם־כִּנֶּרֶת עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
and in the Valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and
Zaphon—the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, the king of Heshbon—down
to the edge of the Jordan and up to the tip of the Sea of
Chinnereth on the east side of the Jordan.

translation.text: and in the the lower end of the Sea of Chinnereth, eastward beyond the Jordan.

verses.english:
That was the portion of the Gadites, for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
That was the portion of the Gadites, for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the Gadites according to their clans, with their towns and villages.

verses.english:
And to the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses assigned [the following],
so that it went to the half-tribe of Manasseh, for its various
clans,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי לַחֲצִי מַטֵּה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי לַחֲצִי מַטֵּה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

english.text:
And to the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses assigned [the following],
so that it went to the half-tribe of Manasseh, for its various
clans,

translation.text: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh; it was allotted to the half-tribe of the Manassites according to their families.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מִמַּחֲנַיִם כּל־הַבָּשָׁן כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן וְכל־חַוֺּת יָאִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מִמַּחֲנַיִם כּל־הַבָּשָׁן כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן וְכל־חַוֺּת יָאִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עִיר׃

translation.text: Their territory extended from Mahanaim, through all Bashan, the which are in Bashan, sixty towns,

verses.english:
and part of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of
Og in Bashan, were assigned to the descendants of Machir son of
Manasseh—to a part of the descendants of Machir—for their various
clans.
verses.hebrew: וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן לִבְנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לַחֲצִי בְנֵי־מָכִיר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן לִבְנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לַחֲצִי בְנֵי־מָכִיר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

english.text:
and part of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of
Og in Bashan, were assigned to the descendants of Machir son of
Manasseh—to a part of the descendants of Machir—for their various
clans.

translation.text: and half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth, clans — for half the Machirites.

verses.english:
Those, then, were the portions that Moses assigned in the steppes
of Moab, on the east side of the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
Those, then, were the portions that Moses assigned in the steppes
of Moab, on the east side of the Jordan.

translation.text: These are the inheritances that Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan east of Jericho.

verses.english:
But no portion was assigned by Moses to the tribe of Levi; YHWH,
the God of Israel, is their portion, as He spoke concerning them.
verses.hebrew: וּלְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם׃

english.text:
But no portion was assigned by Moses to the tribe of Levi; YHWH,
the God of Israel, is their portion, as He spoke concerning them.

translation.text: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance; the LORD God of Israel is their inheritance, as he said to them.

verses.english:
And these are the allotments of the Israelites in the land of
Canaan, that were apportioned to them by the priest Eleazar, by
Joshua son of Nun, and by the heads of the ancestral houses of the
Israelite tribes,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אוֹתָם אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אוֹתָם אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And these are the allotments of the Israelites in the land of
Canaan, that were apportioned to them by the priest Eleazar, by
Joshua son of Nun, and by the heads of the ancestral houses of the
Israelite tribes,

translation.text: These are the inheritances that the Israelites received in the land of heads of the families of the tribes of the Israelites distributed to them.

verses.english:
the portions that fell to them by lot, as YHWH had commanded
through Moses for the nine and a half tribes.
verses.hebrew: בְּגוֹרַל נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּגוֹרַל נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

english.text:
the portions that fell to them by lot, as YHWH had commanded
through Moses for the nine and a half tribes.

translation.text: Their inheritance was by lot, as the LORD had commanded Moses for the nine and one-half tribes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלַת שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְלַלְוִיִּם לֹא־נָתַן נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלַת שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְלַלְוִיִּם לֹא־נָתַן נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹכָם׃

translation.text: For Moses had given an inheritance to gave no inheritance among them.

verses.english:
for whereas the descendants of Joseph constituted two tribes,
Manasseh and Ephraim, the Levites were assigned no share in the
land, but only some towns to live in, with the pastures for their
livestock and cattle.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף שְׁנֵי מַטּוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בָּאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־עָרִים לָשֶׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם לְמִקְנֵיהֶם וּלְקִנְיָנָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־הָיוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף שְׁנֵי מַטּוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בָּאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־עָרִים לָשֶׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם לְמִקְנֵיהֶם וּלְקִנְיָנָם׃

english.text:
for whereas the descendants of Joseph constituted two tribes,
Manasseh and Ephraim, the Levites were assigned no share in the
land, but only some towns to live in, with the pastures for their
livestock and cattle.

translation.text: For the people of Joseph were two in the land, but only towns to live in, with their pasture lands for their flocks and herds.

verses.english:
Just as YHWH had commanded Moses, so the Israelites did when they
apportioned the land.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Just as YHWH had commanded Moses, so the Israelites did when they
apportioned the land.

translation.text: The Israelites did as the LORD commanded Moses; they allotted the land.

verses.english:
The Judites approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of
Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him: “You know what instructions
YHWH gave at Kadesh-barnea to Moses, the man of God, concerning
you and me.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה
אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים עַל אֹדוֹתַי וְעַל אֹדוֹתֶיךָ בְּקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה
אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים עַל אֹדוֹתַי וְעַל אֹדוֹתֶיךָ בְּקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

english.text:
The Judites approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of
Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him: “You know what instructions
YHWH gave at Kadesh-barnea to Moses, the man of God, concerning
you and me.

translation.text: Then the people of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal; and Caleb son of Moses the man of God in Kadesh-barnea concerning you and me.

verses.english:
I was forty years old when Moses the servant of YHWH sent me from
Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I gave him a forthright
report.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי בִּשְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה אֹתִי מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וָאָשֵׁב אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר עִם־לְבָבִי׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי בִּשְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה אֹתִי מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וָאָשֵׁב אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר עִם־לְבָבִי׃

english.text:
I was forty years old when Moses the servant of YHWH sent me from
Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I gave him a forthright
report.

translation.text: I report.

verses.english:
While my companions who went up with me took the heart out of the
people, I was loyal to YHWH my God.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַי אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמִּי הִמְסִיו אֶת־לֵב הָעָם וְאָנֹכִי מִלֵּאתִי אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַי אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמִּי הִמְסִיו אֶת־לֵב הָעָם וְאָנֹכִי מִלֵּאתִי אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
While my companions who went up with me took the heart out of the
people, I was loyal to YHWH my God.

translation.text: But my companions who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; yet I wholeheartedly followed the LORD my God.

verses.english:
On that day, Moses promised on oath, ‘The land on which your foot
trod shall be a portion for you and your descendants forever,
because you were loyal to YHWH my God.’
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר אִם־לֹא הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכָה רַגְלְךָ בָּהּ לְךָ תִהְיֶה לְנַחֲלָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד־עוֹלָם כִּי מִלֵּאתָ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר אִם־לֹא הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכָה רַגְלְךָ בָּהּ לְךָ תִהְיֶה לְנַחֲלָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד־עוֹלָם כִּי מִלֵּאתָ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
On that day, Moses promised on oath, ‘The land on which your foot
trod shall be a portion for you and your descendants forever,
because you were loyal to YHWH my God.’

verses.english:
Now YHWH has preserved me, as He promised. It is forty-five years
since YHWH made this promise to Moses, when Israel was journeying
through the wilderness; and here I am today, eighty-five years
old.
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֶחֱיָה יְהֹוָה אוֹתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר זֶה אַרְבָּעִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מֵאָז דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֶחֱיָה יְהֹוָה אוֹתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר זֶה אַרְבָּעִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מֵאָז דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Now YHWH has preserved me, as He promised. It is forty-five years
since YHWH made this promise to Moses, when Israel was journeying
through the wilderness; and here I am today, eighty-five years
old.

translation.text: And now, as you see, the LORD has kept me alive, as he said, these forty-five years since the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, today, eighty-five years old.

verses.english:
I am still as strong today as on the day that Moses sent me; my
strength is the same now as it was then, for battle and for
activity.
verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנִּי הַיּוֹם חָזָק כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּיוֹם שְׁלֹחַ אוֹתִי מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹחִי אָז וּכְכֹחִי עָתָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדֶנִּי הַיּוֹם חָזָק כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּיוֹם שְׁלֹחַ אוֹתִי מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹחִי אָז וּכְכֹחִי עָתָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא׃

english.text:
I am still as strong today as on the day that Moses sent me; my
strength is the same now as it was then, for battle and for
activity.

translation.text: I am still as strong today as I was on the for war, and for going and coming.

verses.english:
So assign to me this hill country as YHWH promised on that day.
Though you too heard on that day that Anakites are there and great
fortified cities, if only YHWH is with me, I will dispossess them,
as YHWH promised.”
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־הָהָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אַתָּה־שָׁמַעְתָּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־עֲנָקִים שָׁם וְעָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת בְּצֻרוֹת אוּלַי יְהֹוָה
אוֹתִי וְהוֹרַשְׁתִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־הָהָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אַתָּה־שָׁמַעְתָּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־עֲנָקִים שָׁם וְעָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת בְּצֻרוֹת אוּלַי יְהֹוָה
אוֹתִי וְהוֹרַשְׁתִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So assign to me this hill country as YHWH promised on that day.
Though you too heard on that day that Anakites are there and great
fortified cities, if only YHWH is with me, I will dispossess them,
as YHWH promised.”

translation.text: So now give me this hill country LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said."

verses.english:
So Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and assigned Hebron to
him as his portion.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה לְנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה לְנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
So Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and assigned Hebron to
him as his portion.

translation.text: Then Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

verses.english:
Thus Hebron became the portion of Caleb son of Jephunneh the
Kenizzite, as it still is, because he was loyal to YHWH, the God
of Israel.—
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי לְנַחֲלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי לְנַחֲלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thus Hebron became the portion of Caleb son of Jephunneh the
Kenizzite, as it still is, because he was loyal to YHWH, the God
of Israel.—

translation.text: So Hebron became the inheritance of wholeheartedly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.english:
The name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath-arba: [Arba] was the great
man among the Anakites. And the land had rest from war.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים הוּא וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים הוּא וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
The name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath-arba: [Arba] was the great
man among the Anakites. And the land had rest from war.

translation.text: Now the name among the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.

verses.english:
The portion that fell by lot to the various clans of the tribe of
Judah lay farthest south, down to the border of Edom, which is the
Wilderness of Zin.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אֶל־גְּבוּל אֱדוֹם מִדְבַּר־צִן נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה תֵימָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אֶל־גְּבוּל אֱדוֹם מִדְבַּר־צִן נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה תֵימָן׃

english.text:
The portion that fell by lot to the various clans of the tribe of
Judah lay farthest south, down to the border of Edom, which is the
Wilderness of Zin.

translation.text: The lot for the tribe of the people of Judah according to their families at the farthest south.

verses.english:
Their southern boundary began from the tip of the Dead Sea, from
the tongue that projects southward.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁן הַפֹּנֶה נֶגְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁן הַפֹּנֶה נֶגְבָּה׃

english.text:
Their southern boundary began from the tip of the Dead Sea, from
the tongue that projects southward.

translation.text: And their south boundary ran from the end of the Dead Sea, from the bay that faces southward;

verses.english:
It proceeded to the south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed on to
Zin, ascended to the south of Kadesh-barnea, passed on to Hezron,
ascended to Addar, and made a turn to Karka.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה וְעָלָה מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעָבַר חֶצְרוֹן וְעָלָה אַדָּרָה וְנָסַב הַקַּרְקָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה וְעָלָה מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעָבַר חֶצְרוֹן וְעָלָה אַדָּרָה וְנָסַב הַקַּרְקָעָה׃

english.text:
It proceeded to the south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed on to
Zin, ascended to the south of Kadesh-barnea, passed on to Hezron,
ascended to Addar, and made a turn to Karka.

translation.text: it goes out to Karka,

verses.english:
From there it passed on to Azmon and proceeded to the Wadi of
Egypt; and the boundary ran on to the Sea. That shall be your
southern boundary.
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר עַצְמוֹנָה וְיָצָא נַחַל מִצְרַיִם (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר עַצְמוֹנָה וְיָצָא נַחַל מִצְרַיִם (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב׃

english.text:
From there it passed on to Azmon and proceeded to the Wadi of
Egypt; and the boundary ran on to the Sea. That shall be your
southern boundary.

translation.text: passes along to Azmon, goes out by the Wadi of Egypt, and comes to its end at the sea. This shall be your south boundary.

verses.english:
The boundary on the east was the Dead Sea up to the mouth of the
Jordan. On the northern side, the boundary began at the tongue of
the Sea at the mouth of the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל קֵדְמָה יָם הַמֶּלַח עַד־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִלְּשׁוֹן הַיָּם מִקְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל קֵדְמָה יָם הַמֶּלַח עַד־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִלְּשׁוֹן הַיָּם מִקְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
The boundary on the east was the Dead Sea up to the mouth of the
Jordan. On the northern side, the boundary began at the tongue of
the Sea at the mouth of the Jordan.

translation.text: And mouth of the Jordan;

verses.english:
The boundary ascended to Beth-hoglah and passed north of
Beth-arabah; then the boundary ascended to the Stone of Bohan son
of Reuben.
verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל בֵּית חגְלָה וְעָבַר מִצְּפוֹן לְבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל בֵּית חגְלָה וְעָבַר מִצְּפוֹן לְבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
The boundary ascended to Beth-hoglah and passed north of
Beth-arabah; then the boundary ascended to the Stone of Bohan son
of Reuben.

translation.text: and the boundary goes up to Beth-hoglah, and Stone of Bohan, Reuben's son;

verses.english:
The boundary ascended from the Valley of Achor to Debir and turned
north to Gilgal, facing the Ascent of Adummim which is south of
the wadi; from there the boundary continued to the waters of
En-shemesh and ran on to En-rogel.
verses.hebrew:
וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל דְּבִרָה מֵעֵמֶק עָכוֹר וְצָפוֹנָה פֹּנֶה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּל אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח לְמַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לַנָּחַל וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־מֵי־עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ
תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־עֵין רֹגֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל דְּבִרָה מֵעֵמֶק עָכוֹר וְצָפוֹנָה פֹּנֶה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּל אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח לְמַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לַנָּחַל וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־מֵי־עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ
תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־עֵין רֹגֵל׃

english.text:
The boundary ascended from the Valley of Achor to Debir and turned
north to Gilgal, facing the Ascent of Adummim which is south of
the wadi; from there the boundary continued to the waters of
En-shemesh and ran on to En-rogel.

translation.text: and the boundary goes up to Debir of the valley; and the boundary passes along to the waters of Enshemesh, and ends at En-rogel;

verses.english:
Then the boundary ascended into the Valley of Ben-hinnom, along
the southern flank of the Jebusites—that is, Jerusalem. The
boundary then ran up to the top of the hill which flanks the
Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of
Rephaim.
verses.hebrew:

north of the slope of Mount Jearim—that is, Chesalon—descended to

verses.english:
The boundary then proceeded to the northern flank of Ekron; the
boundary curved to Shikkeron, passed on to Mount Baalah, and
proceeded to Jabneel; and the boundary ran on to the Sea.

And the western boundary was the edge of the Mediterranean Sea.
Those were the boundaries of the various clans of the Judites on
all sides.

verses.english:
In accordance with YHWH’s command to Joshua, Caleb son of
Jephunneh was given a portion among the Judites, namely,
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron. ([Arba] was the father of Anak.)

verses.english:
Caleb dislodged from there the three Anakites: Sheshai, Ahiman,
and Talmai, descendants of Anak.

hebrew.text: וַיֹּרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם כָּלֵב אֶת־שְׁלוֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמַי יְלִידֵי הָעֲנָק׃

Caleb dislodged from there the three Anakites: Sheshai, Ahiman,
and Talmai, descendants of Anak.

From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir—the name of
Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher—

From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir—the name of
Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher—

and Caleb announced, “I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage

his daughter Achsah in marriage.

When she came [to him], she induced him to ask her father for some
property. She dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb asked her,
“What is the matter?”

and Lower Gulloth.

inhabitants of Jerusalem; so the Judites dwell with the Jebusites
in Jerusalem to this day.
