verses.english:
The portion that fell by lot to the Josephites ran from the Jordan
at Jericho—from the waters of Jericho east of the wilderness. From
Jericho it ascended through the hill country to Bethel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף מִיַּרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ לְמֵי יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה הַמִּדְבָּר עֹלֶה מִירִיחוֹ בָּהָר בֵּית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף מִיַּרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ לְמֵי יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה הַמִּדְבָּר עֹלֶה מִירִיחוֹ בָּהָר בֵּית־אֵל׃

english.text:
The portion that fell by lot to the Josephites ran from the Jordan
at Jericho—from the waters of Jericho east of the wilderness. From
Jericho it ascended through the hill country to Bethel.

translation.text: The allotment of the Josephites went from the Jordan by Jericho, east into the hill country to Bethel;

verses.english:
From Bethel it ran to Luz and passed on to the territory of the
Archites at Ataroth,
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא מִבֵּית־אֵל לוּזָה וְעָבַר אֶל־גְּבוּל הָאַרְכִּי עֲטָרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא מִבֵּית־אֵל לוּזָה וְעָבַר אֶל־גְּבוּל הָאַרְכִּי עֲטָרוֹת׃

english.text:
From Bethel it ran to Luz and passed on to the territory of the
Archites at Ataroth,

translation.text: then going from Bethel to Luz, it passes along to Ataroth, the territory of the Archites;

verses.english:
descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as
the border of Lower Beth-horon and Gezer, and ran on to the Sea.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד־יָמָּה אֶל־גְּבוּל הַיַּפְלֵטִי עַד גְּבוּל בֵּית־חוֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן וְעַד־גָּזֶר וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָו יָמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד־יָמָּה אֶל־גְּבוּל הַיַּפְלֵטִי עַד גְּבוּל בֵּית־חוֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן וְעַד־גָּזֶר וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָו יָמָּה׃

english.text:
descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as
the border of Lower Beth-horon and Gezer, and ran on to the Sea.

translation.text: then it goes territory of Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer, and it ends at the sea.

verses.english:
Thus the Josephites—that is, Manasseh and Ephraim—received their
portion.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּנְחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנְחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Thus the Josephites—that is, Manasseh and Ephraim—received their
portion.

translation.text: The Josephites, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.

verses.english:
The territory of the Ephraimites, by their clans, was as follows:
The boundary of their portion ran from Atroth-addar on the east to
Upper Beth-horon,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם מִזְרָחָה עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַד־בֵּית חוֹרֹן עֶלְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם מִזְרָחָה עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַד־בֵּית חוֹרֹן עֶלְיוֹן׃

english.text:
The territory of the Ephraimites, by their clans, was as follows:
The boundary of their portion ran from Atroth-addar on the east to
Upper Beth-horon,

translation.text: The territory of the Ephraimites by their families was as follows: the Upper Beth-horon,

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל הַיָּמָּה הַמִּכְמְתָת מִצָּפוֹן וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִזְרָחָה תַּאֲנַת שִׁלֹה וְעָבַר אוֹתוֹ מִמִּזְרַח יָנוֹחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל הַיָּמָּה הַמִּכְמְתָת מִצָּפוֹן וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִזְרָחָה תַּאֲנַת שִׁלֹה וְעָבַר אוֹתוֹ מִמִּזְרַח יָנוֹחָה׃

translation.text: and the boundary goes from there to the sea; on Janoah,

verses.english:
from Janoah it descended to Ataroth and Naarath, touched on
Jericho, and ran on to the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד מִיָּנוֹחָה עֲטָרוֹת וְנַעֲרָתָה וּפָגַע בִּירִיחוֹ וְיָצָא הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד מִיָּנוֹחָה עֲטָרוֹת וְנַעֲרָתָה וּפָגַע בִּירִיחוֹ וְיָצָא הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
from Janoah it descended to Ataroth and Naarath, touched on
Jericho, and ran on to the Jordan.

translation.text: then it goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, and touches Jericho, ending at the Jordan.

verses.english:
Westward, the boundary proceeded from Tappuah to the Wadi Kanah
and ran on to the Sea. This was the portion of the tribe of the
Ephraimites, by their clans,
verses.hebrew: מִתַּפּוּחַ יֵלֵךְ הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה נַחַל קָנָה וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: מִתַּפּוּחַ יֵלֵךְ הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה נַחַל קָנָה וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
Westward, the boundary proceeded from Tappuah to the Wadi Kanah
and ran on to the Sea. This was the portion of the tribe of the
Ephraimites, by their clans,

translation.text: From Tappuah the is the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites by their families,

verses.english:
together with the towns marked off for the Ephraimites within the
territory of the Manassites—all those towns with their villages.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה כּל־הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָרִים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה כּל־הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
together with the towns marked off for the Ephraimites within the
territory of the Manassites—all those towns with their villages.

translation.text: the inheritance of the Manassites, all those towns with their villages.

verses.english:
However, they failed to dispossess the Canaanites who dwelt in
Gezer; so the Canaanites remained in the midst of Ephraim, as is
still the case. But they had to perform forced labor.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקֶרֶב אֶפְרַיִם עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי לְמַס־עֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקֶרֶב אֶפְרַיִם עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי לְמַס־עֹבֵד׃

english.text:
However, they failed to dispossess the Canaanites who dwelt in
Gezer; so the Canaanites remained in the midst of Ephraim, as is
still the case. But they had to perform forced labor.

translation.text: made to do forced labor.

verses.english:
And this is the portion that fell by lot to the tribe of
Manasseh—for he was Joseph’s first-born. Since Machir, the
first-born of Manasseh and the father of Gilead, was a valiant
warrior, Gilead and Bashan were assigned to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי־הוּא בְּכוֹר יוֹסֵף לְמָכִיר בְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה אֲבִי הַגִּלְעָד כִּי הוּא הָיָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי־הוּא בְּכוֹר יוֹסֵף לְמָכִיר בְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה אֲבִי הַגִּלְעָד כִּי הוּא הָיָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
And this is the portion that fell by lot to the tribe of
Manasseh—for he was Joseph’s first-born. Since Machir, the
first-born of Manasseh and the father of Gilead, was a valiant
warrior, Gilead and Bashan were assigned to him.

translation.text: Then allotment was made to the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. To Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, were allotted Gilead and Bashan, because he was a warrior.

verses.english:
And now assignments were made to the remaining Manassites, by
their clans: the descendants of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem,
Hepher, and Shemida. Those were the male descendants of Manasseh
son of Joseph, by their clans.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנֵי אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵלֶק וְלִבְנֵי אַשְׂרִיאֵל וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁכֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵפֶר וְלִבְנֵי שְׁמִידָע אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי
מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הַזְּכָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנֵי אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵלֶק וְלִבְנֵי אַשְׂרִיאֵל וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁכֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵפֶר וְלִבְנֵי שְׁמִידָע אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי
מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הַזְּכָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And now assignments were made to the remaining Manassites, by
their clans: the descendants of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem,
Hepher, and Shemida. Those were the male descendants of Manasseh
son of Joseph, by their clans.

translation.text: their families, Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida; families.

verses.english:
Now Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of
Manasseh had no sons, but only daughters. The names of his
daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.hebrew: וְלִצְלפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִצְלפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
Now Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of
Manasseh had no sons, but only daughters. The names of his
daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

translation.text: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.english:
They appeared before the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and
the chieftains, saying: “YHWH commanded Moses to grant us a
portion among our male kinsmen.” So, in accordance with YHWH’s
instructions, they were granted a portion among their father’s
kinsmen.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקְרַבְנָה לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִים לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אַחֵינוּ וַיִּתֵּן
לָהֶם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקְרַבְנָה לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִים לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אַחֵינוּ וַיִּתֵּן
לָהֶם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text:
They appeared before the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and
the chieftains, saying: “YHWH commanded Moses to grant us a
portion among our male kinsmen.” So, in accordance with YHWH’s
instructions, they were granted a portion among their father’s
kinsmen.

translation.text: They came gave them an inheritance among the kinsmen of their father.

verses.english:
Ten districts fell to Manasseh, apart from the lands of Gilead and
Bashan, which are across the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְּלוּ חַבְלֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה עֲשָׂרָה לְבַד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְּלוּ חַבְלֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה עֲשָׂרָה לְבַד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Ten districts fell to Manasseh, apart from the lands of Gilead and
Bashan, which are across the Jordan.

translation.text: Thus Bashan, which is on the other side of the Jordan,

verses.english:
Manasseh’s daughters inherited a portion in these together with
his sons, while the land of Gilead was assigned to the rest of
Manasseh’s descendants.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְּנוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה נָחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בָּנָיו וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הָיְתָה לִבְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בְּנוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה נָחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בָּנָיו וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הָיְתָה לִבְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים׃

english.text:
Manasseh’s daughters inherited a portion in these together with
his sons, while the land of Gilead was assigned to the rest of
Manasseh’s descendants.

translation.text: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance along with his sons. The land of Gilead was allotted to the rest of the Manassites.

verses.english:
The boundary of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath, which lies
near Shechem. The boundary continued to the right, toward the
inhabitants of En-tappuah.—
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה מֵאָשֵׁר הַמִּכְמְתָת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי שְׁכֶם וְהָלַךְ הַגְּבוּל אֶל־הַיָּמִין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי עֵין תַּפּוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה מֵאָשֵׁר הַמִּכְמְתָת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי שְׁכֶם וְהָלַךְ הַגְּבוּל אֶל־הַיָּמִין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי עֵין תַּפּוּחַ׃

english.text:
The boundary of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath, which lies
near Shechem. The boundary continued to the right, toward the
inhabitants of En-tappuah.—

translation.text: The territory of Manasseh reached from Asher to Michmethath, the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

verses.english:
The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah, on the
border of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.—
verses.hebrew: לִמְנַשֶּׁה הָיְתָה אֶרֶץ תַּפּוּחַ וְתַפּוּחַ אֶל־גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה לִבְנֵי אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: לִמְנַשֶּׁה הָיְתָה אֶרֶץ תַּפּוּחַ וְתַפּוּחַ אֶל־גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה לִבְנֵי אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah, on the
border of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.—

translation.text: The land of Tappuah belonged to belonged to the Ephraimites.

verses.english:
Then the boundary descended to the Wadi Kanah. Those towns to the
south of the wadi belonged to Ephraim as an enclave among the
towns of Manasseh. The boundary of Manasseh lay north of the wadi
and ran on to the Sea.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל נַחַל קָנָה נֶגְבָּה לַנַּחַל עָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ עָרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וּגְבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִצְּפוֹן לַנַּחַל וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל נַחַל קָנָה נֶגְבָּה לַנַּחַל עָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ עָרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וּגְבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִצְּפוֹן לַנַּחַל וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

english.text:
Then the boundary descended to the Wadi Kanah. Those towns to the
south of the wadi belonged to Ephraim as an enclave among the
towns of Manasseh. The boundary of Manasseh lay north of the wadi
and ran on to the Sea.

translation.text: Then the boundary went down to the Manasseh goes along the north side of the wadi and ends at the sea.

verses.english:
What lay to the south belonged to Ephraim, and what lay to the
north belonged to Manasseh, with the Sea as its boundary. [This
territory] was contiguous with Asher on the north and with
Issachar on the east.
verses.hebrew: נֶגְבָּה לְאֶפְרַיִם וְצָפוֹנָה לִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי הַיָּם גְּבוּלוֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר יִפְגְּעוּן מִצָּפוֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָר מִמִּזְרָח׃

hebrew.text: נֶגְבָּה לְאֶפְרַיִם וְצָפוֹנָה לִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי הַיָּם גְּבוּלוֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר יִפְגְּעוּן מִצָּפוֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָר מִמִּזְרָח׃

english.text:
What lay to the south belonged to Ephraim, and what lay to the
north belonged to Manasseh, with the Sea as its boundary. [This
territory] was contiguous with Asher on the north and with
Issachar on the east.

translation.text: The land to the south is Ephraim's and that to the north is Manasseh's, on the east Issachar.

verses.english:
Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh possessed Beth-shean and its
dependencies, Ibleam and its dependencies, the inhabitants of Dor
and its dependencies, the inhabitants of En-dor and its
dependencies, the inhabitants of Taanach and its dependencies, and
the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependencies: these constituted
three regions.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לִמְנַשֶּׁה בְּיִשָּׂשכָר וּבְאָשֵׁר בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָם וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי דֹאר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי עֵין־דֹּר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי
תַעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַנָּפֶת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לִמְנַשֶּׁה בְּיִשָּׂשכָר וּבְאָשֵׁר בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָם וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי דֹאר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי עֵין־דֹּר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי
תַעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַנָּפֶת׃

english.text:
Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh possessed Beth-shean and its
dependencies, Ibleam and its dependencies, the inhabitants of Dor
and its dependencies, the inhabitants of En-dor and its
dependencies, the inhabitants of Taanach and its dependencies, and
the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependencies: these constituted
three regions.

translation.text: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh had Bethshean and its villages, Ibleam and its villages, the inhabitants of Dor inhabitants of Taanach and its villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages (the third is Naphath).

verses.english:
The Manassites could not dispossess [the inhabitants of] these
towns, and the Canaanites stubbornly remained in this region.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
The Manassites could not dispossess [the inhabitants of] these
towns, and the Canaanites stubbornly remained in this region.

translation.text: Yet the Manassites could not take possession of those towns; but the Canaanites continued to live in that land.

verses.english:
When the Israelites became stronger, they imposed tribute on the
Canaanites; but they did not dispossess them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי חָזְקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵשׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי חָזְקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵשׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

english.text:
When the Israelites became stronger, they imposed tribute on the
Canaanites; but they did not dispossess them.

translation.text: But when the Israelites grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out.

verses.english:
The Josephites complained to Joshua, saying, “Why have you
assigned as our portion a single allotment and a single district,
seeing that we are a numerous people whom YHWH has blessed so
greatly?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ נָתַתָּה לִּי נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל אֶחָד וְחֶבֶל אֶחָד וַאֲנִי עַם־רָב עַד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּה בֵּרְכַנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ נָתַתָּה לִּי נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל אֶחָד וְחֶבֶל אֶחָד וַאֲנִי עַם־רָב עַד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּה בֵּרְכַנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The Josephites complained to Joshua, saying, “Why have you
assigned as our portion a single allotment and a single district,
seeing that we are a numerous people whom YHWH has blessed so
greatly?”

translation.text: The tribe of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given numerous people, whom all along the LORD has blessed?"

verses.english:
“If you are a numerous people,” Joshua answered them, “go up to
the forest country and clear an area for yourselves there, in the
territory of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, seeing that you are
cramped in the hill country of Ephraim.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אִם־עַם־רַב אַתָּה עֲלֵה לְךָ הַיַּעְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ לְךָ שָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ הַפְּרִזִּי וְהָרְפָאִים כִּי־אָץ לְךָ הַר־אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אִם־עַם־רַב אַתָּה עֲלֵה לְךָ הַיַּעְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ לְךָ שָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ הַפְּרִזִּי וְהָרְפָאִים כִּי־אָץ לְךָ הַר־אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“If you are a numerous people,” Joshua answered them, “go up to
the forest country and clear an area for yourselves there, in the
territory of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, seeing that you are
cramped in the hill country of Ephraim.”

translation.text: And narrow for you."

verses.english:
“The hill country is not enough for us,” the Josephites replied,
“and all the Canaanites who live in the valley area have iron
chariots, both those in Beth-shean and its dependencies and those
in the Valley of Jezreel.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לֹא־יִמָּצֵא לָנוּ הָהָר וְרֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל בְּכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ־הָעֵמֶק לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק
יִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לֹא־יִמָּצֵא לָנוּ הָהָר וְרֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל בְּכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ־הָעֵמֶק לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק
יִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
“The hill country is not enough for us,” the Josephites replied,
“and all the Canaanites who live in the valley area have iron
chariots, both those in Beth-shean and its dependencies and those
in the Valley of Jezreel.”

translation.text: The tribe of Joseph said, "The hill country is not chariots of iron, both those in Beth-shean and its villages and those in the Valley of Jezreel."

verses.english:
But Joshua declared to the House of Joseph, to Ephraim and
Manasseh, “You are indeed a numerous people, possessed of great
strength; you shall not have one allotment only.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁה לֵאמֹר עַם־רַב אַתָּה וְכֹחַ גָּדוֹל לָךְ לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ גּוֹרָל אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁה לֵאמֹר עַם־רַב אַתָּה וְכֹחַ גָּדוֹל לָךְ לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ גּוֹרָל אֶחָד׃

english.text:
But Joshua declared to the House of Joseph, to Ephraim and
Manasseh, “You are indeed a numerous people, possessed of great
strength; you shall not have one allotment only.

translation.text: Then Joshua said to the house of Joseph, to great power; you shall not have one lot only,

verses.english:
The hill country shall be yours as well; true, it is forest land,
but you will clear it and possess it to its farthest limits. And
you shall also dispossess the Canaanites, even though they have
iron chariots and even though they are strong.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַר יִהְיֶה־לָּךְ כִּי־יַעַר הוּא וּבֵרֵאתוֹ וְהָיָה לְךָ תֹּצְאֹתָיו כִּי־תוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי כִּי רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לוֹ כִּי חָזָק הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַר יִהְיֶה־לָּךְ כִּי־יַעַר הוּא וּבֵרֵאתוֹ וְהָיָה לְךָ תֹּצְאֹתָיו כִּי־תוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי כִּי רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לוֹ כִּי חָזָק הוּא׃

english.text:
The hill country shall be yours as well; true, it is forest land,
but you will clear it and possess it to its farthest limits. And
you shall also dispossess the Canaanites, even though they have
iron chariots and even though they are strong.”

translation.text: but the hill country shall be yours, for though it is a forest, you shall clear it and possess it to its farthest borders; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong."

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה וַיַּשְׁכִּינוּ שָׁם אֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָאָרֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה וַיַּשְׁכִּינוּ שָׁם אֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָאָרֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

translation.text: Then the whole congregation of the Israelites assembled at Shiloh, them.

verses.english:
but there remained seven tribes of the Israelites which had not
yet received their portions.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּתְרוּ בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָלְקוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתָם שִׁבְעָה שְׁבָטִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּתְרוּ בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָלְקוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתָם שִׁבְעָה שְׁבָטִים׃

english.text:
but there remained seven tribes of the Israelites which had not
yet received their portions.

translation.text: There remained among the Israelites seven tribes whose inheritance had not yet been apportioned.

verses.english:
So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you be slack
about going and taking possession of the land which YHWH, the God
of your fathers, has assigned to you?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־אָנָה אַתֶּם מִתְרַפִּים לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־אָנָה אַתֶּם מִתְרַפִּים לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you be slack
about going and taking possession of the land which YHWH, the God
of your fathers, has assigned to you?

translation.text: So Joshua said to the Israelites, "How long will you be slack about going in and taking possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your ancestors, has given you?

verses.english:
Appoint three men of each tribe; I will send them out to go
through the country and write down a description of it for
purposes of apportionment, and then come back to me.
verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לָכֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים לַשָּׁבֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵם וְיָקֻמוּ וְיִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִכְתְּבוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי נַחֲלָתָם וְיָבֹאוּ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: הָבוּ לָכֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים לַשָּׁבֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵם וְיָקֻמוּ וְיִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִכְתְּבוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי נַחֲלָתָם וְיָבֹאוּ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
Appoint three men of each tribe; I will send them out to go
through the country and write down a description of it for
purposes of apportionment, and then come back to me.

translation.text: Provide view to their inheritances. Then come back to me.

verses.english:
They shall divide it into seven parts—Judah shall remain by its
territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain by
its territory in the north.—
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְחַלְּקוּ אֹתָהּ לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים יְהוּדָה יַעֲמֹד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ מִנֶּגֶב וּבֵית יוֹסֵף יַעַמְדוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָם מִצָּפוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְחַלְּקוּ אֹתָהּ לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים יְהוּדָה יַעֲמֹד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ מִנֶּגֶב וּבֵית יוֹסֵף יַעַמְדוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָם מִצָּפוֹן׃

english.text:
They shall divide it into seven parts—Judah shall remain by its
territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain by
its territory in the north.—

translation.text: They shall divide it into seven portions, Judah continuing in its territory on the south, and the house of Joseph in their territory on the north.

verses.english:
When you have written down the description of the land in seven
parts, bring it here to me. Then I will cast lots for you here
before YHWH our God.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תִּכְתְּבוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֵלַי הֵנָּה וְיָרִיתִי לָכֶם גּוֹרָל פֹּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם תִּכְתְּבוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֵלַי הֵנָּה וְיָרִיתִי לָכֶם גּוֹרָל פֹּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
When you have written down the description of the land in seven
parts, bring it here to me. Then I will cast lots for you here
before YHWH our God.

translation.text: You shall describe the land in seven divisions and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

verses.english:
For the Levites have no share among you, since the priesthood of
YHWH is their portion; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of
Manasseh have received the portions which were assigned to them by
Moses the servant of YHWH, on the eastern side of the Jordan.”
verses.hebrew:
כִּי אֵין־חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־כְהֻנַּת יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְגָד וּרְאוּבֵן וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן
לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי אֵין־חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־כְהֻנַּת יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְגָד וּרְאוּבֵן וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן
לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
For the Levites have no share among you, since the priesthood of
YHWH is their portion; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of
Manasseh have received the portions which were assigned to them by
Moses the servant of YHWH, on the eastern side of the Jordan.”

translation.text: The Levites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of the LORD is their heritage; of the LORD gave them."

verses.english:
The men set out on their journeys. Joshua ordered the men who were
leaving to write down a description of the land—“Go, traverse the
country and write down a description of it. Then return to me, and
I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh before YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים לִכְתֹּב אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְכִתְבוּ אוֹתָהּ וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וּפֹה אַשְׁלִיךְ
לָכֶם גּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים לִכְתֹּב אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְכִתְבוּ אוֹתָהּ וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וּפֹה אַשְׁלִיךְ
לָכֶם גּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
The men set out on their journeys. Joshua ordered the men who were
leaving to write down a description of the land—“Go, traverse the
country and write down a description of it. Then return to me, and
I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh before YHWH.”

translation.text: So the men started on their way; and Joshua charged those who land and write a description of it, and come back to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh."

verses.english:
So the men went and traversed the land; they described it in a
document, town by town, in seven parts, and they returned to
Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַבְרוּ בָאָרֶץ וַיִּכְתְּבוּהָ לֶעָרִים לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים עַל־סֵפֶר וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַבְרוּ בָאָרֶץ וַיִּכְתְּבוּהָ לֶעָרִים לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים עַל־סֵפֶר וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
So the men went and traversed the land; they described it in a
document, town by town, in seven parts, and they returned to
Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

translation.text: So the men went and in seven divisions; then they came back to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh,

verses.english:
Joshua cast lots for them at Shiloh before YHWH, and there Joshua
apportioned the land among the Israelites according to their
divisions.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גּוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גּוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם׃

english.text:
Joshua cast lots for them at Shiloh before YHWH, and there Joshua
apportioned the land among the Israelites according to their
divisions.

translation.text: and Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD; and there Joshua apportioned the land to the Israelites, to each a portion.

verses.english:
The lot of the tribe of the Benjaminites, by their clans, came out
first. The territory which fell to their lot lay between the
Judites and the Josephites.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל גּוֹרַל מַטֵּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיֵּצֵא גְּבוּל גּוֹרָלָם בֵּין בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבֵין בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל גּוֹרַל מַטֵּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיֵּצֵא גְּבוּל גּוֹרָלָם בֵּין בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבֵין בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
The lot of the tribe of the Benjaminites, by their clans, came out
first. The territory which fell to their lot lay between the
Judites and the Josephites.

translation.text: The lot of the tribe of Benjamin according to its families came up, and the territory allotted to it fell between the tribe of Judah and the tribe of Joseph.

verses.english:
The boundary on their northern rim began at the Jordan; the
boundary ascended to the northern flank of Jericho, ascended
westward into the hill country and ran on to the Wilderness of
Beth-aven.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף יְרִיחוֹ מִצָּפוֹן וְעָלָה בָהָר יָמָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאֹתָיו מִדְבַּרָה בֵּית אָוֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף יְרִיחוֹ מִצָּפוֹן וְעָלָה בָהָר יָמָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאֹתָיו מִדְבַּרָה בֵּית אָוֶן׃

english.text:
The boundary on their northern rim began at the Jordan; the
boundary ascended to the northern flank of Jericho, ascended
westward into the hill country and ran on to the Wilderness of
Beth-aven.

translation.text: On the north side their boundary began at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.english:
From there the boundary passed on southward to Luz, to the flank
of Luz—that is, Bethel; then the boundary descended to
Atroth-addar [and] to the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר מִשָּׁם הַגְּבוּל לוּזָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף לוּזָה נֶגְבָּה הִיא בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַל־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לְבֵית־חֹרוֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר מִשָּׁם הַגְּבוּל לוּזָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף לוּזָה נֶגְבָּה הִיא בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַל־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לְבֵית־חֹרוֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

english.text:
From there the boundary passed on southward to Luz, to the flank
of Luz—that is, Bethel; then the boundary descended to
Atroth-addar [and] to the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.

translation.text: From there the boundary passes along southward in the direction of Luz, to the slope of Luz (that is, Bethel), lies south of Lower Beth-horon.

verses.english:
The boundary now turned and curved onto the western rim; and the
boundary ran southward from the hill on the south side of
Beth-horon till it ended at Kiriath-baal—that is, Kiriath-jearim—a
town of the Judites. That was the western rim.
verses.hebrew:
וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל וְנָסַב לִפְאַת־יָם נֶגְבָּה מִן־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי בֵית־חֹרוֹן נֶגְבָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים עִיר בְּנֵי
יְהוּדָה זֹאת פְּאַת־יָם׃

hebrew.text:
וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל וְנָסַב לִפְאַת־יָם נֶגְבָּה מִן־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי בֵית־חֹרוֹן נֶגְבָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים עִיר בְּנֵי
יְהוּדָה זֹאת פְּאַת־יָם׃

english.text:
The boundary now turned and curved onto the western rim; and the
boundary ran southward from the hill on the south side of
Beth-horon till it ended at Kiriath-baal—that is, Kiriath-jearim—a
town of the Judites. That was the western rim.

translation.text: Then the boundary goes in another that lies to the south, opposite Beth-horon, and it ends at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a town belonging to the tribe of Judah. This forms the western side.

verses.english:
The southern rim: From the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim, the
boundary passed westward and ran on to the fountain of the Waters
of Nephtoah.
verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת־נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה וְיָצָא אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְאַת־נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה וְיָצָא אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ׃

english.text:
The southern rim: From the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim, the
boundary passed westward and ran on to the fountain of the Waters
of Nephtoah.

translation.text: The southern side begins at the outskirts of spring of the Waters of Nephtoah;

verses.english:
Then the boundary descended to the foot of the hill by the Valley
of Ben-hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim; then
it ran down the Valley of Hinnom along the southern flank of the
Jebusites to En-rogel.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל אֶל־קְצֵה הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד גֵּי הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי נֶגְבָּה וְיָרַד עֵין רֹגֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל אֶל־קְצֵה הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד גֵּי הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי נֶגְבָּה וְיָרַד עֵין רֹגֵל׃

english.text:
Then the boundary descended to the foot of the hill by the Valley
of Ben-hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim; then
it ran down the Valley of Hinnom along the southern flank of the
Jebusites to En-rogel.

translation.text: then the boundary goes down to Jebusites, and downward to En-rogel;

verses.english:
Curving northward, it ran on to En-shemesh and ran on to Geliloth,
facing the Ascent of Adummim, and descended to the Stone of Bohan
son of Reuben.
verses.hebrew: וְתָאַר מִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָצָא אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח מַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים וְיָרַד אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

ascended to Japhia.

verses.english:
But the territory of the Danites slipped from their grasp. So the
Danites migrated and made war on Leshem. They captured it and put
it to the sword; they took possession of it and settled in it. And
they changed the name of Leshem to Dan, after their ancestor Dan.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצֵא גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָן מֵהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־דָן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִם־לֶשֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיִּרְשׁוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ
לְלֶשֶׁם דָּן כְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצֵא גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָן מֵהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־דָן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִם־לֶשֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיִּרְשׁוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ
לְלֶשֶׁם דָּן כְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
But the territory of the Danites slipped from their grasp. So the
Danites migrated and made war on Leshem. They captured it and put
it to the sword; they took possession of it and settled in it. And
they changed the name of Leshem to Dan, after their ancestor Dan.

translation.text: When the sword, they took possession of it and settled in it, calling Leshem, Dan, after their ancestor Dan.

That was the portion of the tribe of the Danites, by their
clans—those towns, with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, according to their families — these towns with their villages.

verses.english:
When they had finished allotting the land by its boundaries, the
Israelites gave a portion in their midst to Joshua son of Nun.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַלּוּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַלּוּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
When they had finished allotting the land by its boundaries, the
Israelites gave a portion in their midst to Joshua son of Nun.

translation.text: When they had finished distributing the several territories of the Joshua son of Nun.

verses.english:
At the command of YHWH they gave him the town that he asked for,
Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; he fortified the
town and settled in it.
verses.hebrew: עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נָתְנוּ לוֹ אֶת־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶרַח בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נָתְנוּ לוֹ אֶת־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶרַח בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

english.text:
At the command of YHWH they gave him the town that he asked for,
Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; he fortified the
town and settled in it.

translation.text: By command of the LORD they gave him the town that he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; he rebuilt the town, and settled in it.

verses.english:
These are the portions assigned by lot to the tribes of Israel by
the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the
ancestral houses, before YHWH at Shiloh, at the entrance of the
Tent of Meeting. When they had finished dividing the land,
verses.hebrew:
אֵלֶּה הַנְּחָלֹת אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמַטּוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּגוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד
וַיְכַלּוּ מֵחַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
אֵלֶּה הַנְּחָלֹת אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמַטּוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּגוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד
וַיְכַלּוּ מֵחַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
These are the portions assigned by lot to the tribes of Israel by
the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the
ancestral houses, before YHWH at Shiloh, at the entrance of the
Tent of Meeting. When they had finished dividing the land,

translation.text: These are the inheritances that the priest Eleazar and Joshua son of distributed by lot at Shiloh before the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

verses.english: YHWH said to Joshua:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: YHWH said to Joshua:

translation.text: Then the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.english:
“Speak to the Israelites: Designate the cities of refuge—about
which I commanded you through Moses—
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the Israelites: Designate the cities of refuge—about
which I commanded you through Moses—

translation.text: "Say to the Israelites, 'Appoint the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Moses,

verses.english:
to which a manslayer who kills a person by mistake,
unintentionally, may flee. They shall serve you as a refuge from
the blood avenger.
verses.hebrew: לָנוּס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה בִּבְלִי־דָעַת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל הַדָּם׃

hebrew.text: לָנוּס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה בִּבְלִי־דָעַת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל הַדָּם׃

english.text:
to which a manslayer who kills a person by mistake,
unintentionally, may flee. They shall serve you as a refuge from
the blood avenger.

translation.text: flee there; they shall be for you a refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.english:
He shall flee to one of those cities, present himself at the
entrance to the city gate, and plead his case before the elders of
that city; and they shall admit him into the city and give him a
place in which to live among them.
verses.hebrew:
וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם
וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃

hebrew.text:
וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם
וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃

english.text:
He shall flee to one of those cities, present himself at the
entrance to the city gate, and plead his case before the elders of
that city; and they shall admit him into the city and give him a
place in which to live among them.

translation.text: entrance of the gate of the city, and explain the case to the elders of place, and shall remain with them.

verses.english:
Should the blood avenger pursue him, they shall not hand the
manslayer over to him, since he killed the other person without
intent and had not been his enemy in the past.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
Should the blood avenger pursue him, they shall not hand the
manslayer over to him, since he killed the other person without
intent and had not been his enemy in the past.

translation.text: And if the avenger of blood is in killed by mistake, there having been no enmity between them before.

verses.english:
He shall live in that city until he can stand trial before the
assembly, [and remain there] until the death of the high priest
who is in office at that time. Thereafter, the manslayer may go
back to his home in his own town, to the town from which he fled.”
verses.hebrew:
וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ
אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ
אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
He shall live in that city until he can stand trial before the
assembly, [and remain there] until the death of the high priest
who is in office at that time. Thereafter, the manslayer may go
back to his home in his own town, to the town from which he fled.”

translation.text: The slayer shall remain in that city until there is a trial before the congregation, until the death of the one who is high priest at the time: done.'"

verses.english:
So they set aside Kedesh in the hill country of Naphtali in
Galilee, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—in the hill country of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְדִּשׁוּ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל בְּהַר נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְדִּשׁוּ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל בְּהַר נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
So they set aside Kedesh in the hill country of Naphtali in
Galilee, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—in the hill country of Judah.

translation.text: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

verses.english:
And across the Jordan, east of Jericho, they assigned Bezer in the
wilderness, in the Tableland, from the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in
Gilead from the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan from the tribe
of Manasseh.
verses.hebrew:
וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה נָתְנוּ אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמִּישֹׁר מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וְאֶת־רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד מִמַּטֵּה־גָד וְאֶת־[גּוֹלָן] (גלון) בַּבָּשָׁן
מִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה נָתְנוּ אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמִּישֹׁר מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וְאֶת־רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד מִמַּטֵּה־גָד וְאֶת־[גּוֹלָן] (גלון) בַּבָּשָׁן
מִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And across the Jordan, east of Jericho, they assigned Bezer in the
wilderness, in the Tableland, from the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in
Gilead from the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan from the tribe
of Manasseh.

translation.text: And beyond the Jordan east of Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.english:
Those were the towns designated for all the Israelites and for
aliens residing among them, to which anyone who killed a person
unintentionally might flee, and not die by the hand of the blood
avenger before standing trial by the assembly.
verses.hebrew:
אֵלֶּה הָיוּ עָרֵי הַמּוּעָדָה לְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְלֹא יָמוּת בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי
הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text:
אֵלֶּה הָיוּ עָרֵי הַמּוּעָדָה לְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְלֹא יָמוּת בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי
הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
Those were the towns designated for all the Israelites and for
aliens residing among them, to which anyone who killed a person
unintentionally might flee, and not die by the hand of the blood
avenger before standing trial by the assembly.

translation.text: These were the cities so as not to die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until there was a trial before the congregation.

verses.english:
The heads of the ancestral houses of the Levites approached the
priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the ancestral
houses of the Israelite tribes,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The heads of the ancestral houses of the Levites approached the
priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the ancestral
houses of the Israelite tribes,

translation.text: Then the heads of the families of the Levites came to the priest the tribes of the Israelites;

verses.english:
and spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, as follows:
“YHWH commanded through Moses that we be given towns to live in,
along with their pastures for our livestock.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּשִׁלֹה בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּשִׁלֹה בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
and spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, as follows:
“YHWH commanded through Moses that we be given towns to live in,
along with their pastures for our livestock.”

translation.text: they said to them at Shiloh in the land of to live in, along with their pasture lands for our livestock."

verses.english:
So the Israelites, in accordance with YHWH’s command, assigned to
the Levites, out of their own portions, the following towns with
their pastures:
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלָתָם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלָתָם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
So the Israelites, in accordance with YHWH’s command, assigned to
the Levites, out of their own portions, the following towns with
their pastures:

translation.text: So by towns and pasture lands out of their inheritance.

verses.english:
The [first] lot among the Levites fell to the Kohathite clans. To
the descendants of the priest Aaron, there fell by lot 13 towns
from the tribe of Judah, the tribe of Simeon, and the tribe of
Benjamin;
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַלְוִיִּם מִמַּטֵּה יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים
שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַלְוִיִּם מִמַּטֵּה יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים
שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
The [first] lot among the Levites fell to the Kohathite clans. To
the descendants of the priest Aaron, there fell by lot 13 towns
from the tribe of Judah, the tribe of Simeon, and the tribe of
Benjamin;

translation.text: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. So those Levites towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

verses.english:
and to the remaining Kohathites [there fell] by lot 10 towns from
the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, the tribe of Dan, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת מַטֵּה־אֶפְרַיִם וּמִמַּטֵּה־דָן וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת מַטֵּה־אֶפְרַיִם וּמִמַּטֵּה־דָן וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר׃

english.text:
and to the remaining Kohathites [there fell] by lot 10 towns from
the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, the tribe of Dan, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.

translation.text: The rest of the Kohathites received by lot ten towns from the families Manasseh.

verses.english:
To the Gershonites [there fell] by lot 13 towns from the clans of
the tribe of Issachar, the tribe of Asher, the tribe of Naphtali,
and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת מַטֵּה־יִשָּׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה־אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַבָּשָׁן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת מַטֵּה־יִשָּׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה־אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַבָּשָׁן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
To the Gershonites [there fell] by lot 13 towns from the clans of
the tribe of Issachar, the tribe of Asher, the tribe of Naphtali,
and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

translation.text: The Gershonites received by lot thirteen towns from the families of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.english:
[And] to the Merarites, by their clans—12 towns from the tribe of
Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
[And] to the Merarites, by their clans—12 towns from the tribe of
Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.

translation.text: The Merarites according to their families received twelve towns from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.english:
The Israelites assigned those towns with their pastures by lot to
the Levites—as YHWH had commanded through Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה בַּגּוֹרָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה בַּגּוֹרָל׃

english.text:
The Israelites assigned those towns with their pastures by lot to
the Levites—as YHWH had commanded through Moses.

translation.text: These towns and their pasture lands the Israelites gave by lot to the Levites, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

verses.english:
From the tribe of the Judites and the tribe of the Simeonites were
assigned the following towns, which will be listed by name;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ מִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְהֶן בְּשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ מִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְהֶן בְּשֵׁם׃

english.text:
From the tribe of the Judites and the tribe of the Simeonites were
assigned the following towns, which will be listed by name;

translation.text: Out of the tribe of Judah and the tribe of Simeon they gave the following towns mentioned by name,

verses.english:
they went to the descendants of Aaron among the Kohathite clans of
the Levites, for the first lot had fallen to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל רִאישֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל רִאישֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
they went to the descendants of Aaron among the Kohathite clans of
the Levites, for the first lot had fallen to them.

translation.text: which went to the belonged to the Levites, since the lot fell to them first.

verses.english:
To them were assigned in the hill country of Judah
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—together with the pastures around it.
[Arba was] the father of the Anokites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע אֲבִי הָעֲנוֹק הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע אֲבִי הָעֲנוֹק הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
To them were assigned in the hill country of Judah
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—together with the pastures around it.
[Arba was] the father of the Anokites.

translation.text: They gave the hill country of Judah, along with the pasture lands around it.

verses.english:

Jephunneh as his holding.

of Ephraim

To the remaining Levites, the clans of the Merarites: From the

Kedemoth with her pasture lands, and Mephaath with her pasture

From the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead—the city of refuge for
manslayers—with its pastures, Mahanaim with its pastures,

From the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead—the city of refuge for

Heshbon with its pastures, and Jazer with its pastures—4 towns in

All the towns which went by lot to the Merarites, by their
clans—the rest of the levitical clans—came to 12 towns.

hebrew.text: כּל־הֶעָרִים לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלְוִיִּם וַיְהִי גּוֹרָלָם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

verses.english:
All the towns of the Levites within the holdings of the Israelites
came to 48 towns, with their pastures.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָרִים אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָרִים אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
All the towns of the Levites within the holdings of the Israelites
came to 48 towns, with their pastures.

translation.text: The towns of the Levites within the holdings of the Israelites were in all forty-eight towns with their pasture lands.

verses.english:
Thus those towns were assigned, every town with its surrounding
pasture; and so it was with all those towns.
verses.hebrew: תִּהְיֶינָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עִיר עִיר וּמִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ כֵּן לְכל־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: תִּהְיֶינָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עִיר עִיר וּמִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ כֵּן לְכל־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Thus those towns were assigned, every town with its surrounding
pasture; and so it was with all those towns.

translation.text: Each of these towns had its pasture lands around it; so it was with all these towns.

verses.english:
YHWH gave to Israel the whole country which He had sworn to their
fathers that He would assign to them; they took possession of it
and settled in it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָתֵת לַאֲבוֹתָם וַיִּרָשׁוּהָ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָתֵת לַאֲבוֹתָם וַיִּרָשׁוּהָ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

english.text:
YHWH gave to Israel the whole country which He had sworn to their
fathers that He would assign to them; they took possession of it
and settled in it.

translation.text: Thus the LORD gave to Israel all the land that he swore to their they settled there.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנַח יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מִסָּבִיב כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנַח יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מִסָּבִיב כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדָם׃

translation.text: And the LORD gave them rest on every side just as hands.

verses.english:
Not one of the good things which YHWH had promised to the House of
Israel was lacking. Everything was fulfilled.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר מִכֹּל הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּל בָּא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר מִכֹּל הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּל בָּא׃

english.text:
Not one of the good things which YHWH had promised to the House of
Israel was lacking. Everything was fulfilled.

translation.text: Not one of all the good promises that the LORD had made to the house of Israel had failed; all came to pass.

verses.english:
Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh,
verses.hebrew: אָז יִקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אָז יִקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh,

translation.text: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the halftribe of Manasseh,

verses.english:
and said to them, “You have observed all that Moses the servant of
YHWH commanded you, and have obeyed me in everything that I
commanded you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם שְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וַתִּשְׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם שְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וַתִּשְׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and said to them, “You have observed all that Moses the servant of
YHWH commanded you, and have obeyed me in everything that I
commanded you.

translation.text: and said to them, "You have observed all that in all that I have commanded you;

verses.english:
You have not forsaken your kinsmen through the long years down to
this day, but have faithfully observed the Instruction of YHWH
your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־עֲזַבְתֶּם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־עֲזַבְתֶּם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You have not forsaken your kinsmen through the long years down to
this day, but have faithfully observed the Instruction of YHWH
your God.

translation.text: you have not forsaken your keep the charge of the LORD your God.

verses.english:
Now YHWH your God has given your kinsmen rest, as He promised
them. Therefore turn and go to your homes, to the land of your
holdings beyond the Jordan that Moses the servant of YHWH assigned
to you.
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לַאֲחֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וְעַתָּה פְּנוּ וּלְכוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה
בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לַאֲחֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וְעַתָּה פְּנוּ וּלְכוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה
בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Now YHWH your God has given your kinsmen rest, as He promised
them. Therefore turn and go to your homes, to the land of your
holdings beyond the Jordan that Moses the servant of YHWH assigned
to you.

translation.text: And now the LORD your God Jordan.

verses.english:
But be very careful to fulfill the Instruction and the Teaching
that Moses the servant of YHWH enjoined upon you, to love YHWH
your God and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments
and hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and
soul.”
verses.hebrew:
רַק שִׁמְרוּ מְאֹד לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר
מִצְוֺתָיו וּלְדבְקָה־בוֹ וּלְעבְדוֹ בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
רַק שִׁמְרוּ מְאֹד לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר
מִצְוֺתָיו וּלְדבְקָה־בוֹ וּלְעבְדוֹ בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
But be very careful to fulfill the Instruction and the Teaching
that Moses the servant of YHWH enjoined upon you, to love YHWH
your God and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments
and hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and
soul.”

left the Israelites at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, and made
their way back to the land of Gilead, the land of their own
holding, which they had acquired by the command of YHWH through
Moses.

holding, which they had acquired by the command of YHWH through

translation.text: So the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned home, parting from the Israelites at Shiloh, which is Moses.

verses.english:
When they came to the region of the Jordan in the land of Canaan,
the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
built an altar there by the Jordan, a great conspicuous altar.

וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְבֵּחַ גָּדוֹל

When they came to the region of the Jordan in the land of Canaan,
the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
built an altar there by the Jordan, a great conspicuous altar.

the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar opposite the land
of Canaan, in the region of the Jordan, across from the
Israelites.”

the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar opposite the land
of Canaan, in the region of the Jordan, across from the
Israelites.”

translation.text: The Israelites heard that the Reubenites and the Gadites and the halftribe of Manasseh had built an altar at the frontier of the land of Israelites.

verses.english:
When the Israelites heard this, the whole community of the
Israelites assembled at Shiloh to make war on them.

the land of Gilead,

of Manasseh in the land of Gilead, they spoke to them as follows:

english.text:
When they came to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe
of Manasseh in the land of Gilead, they spoke to them as follows:

translation.text: They came to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, in the land of Gilead, and they said to them,

verses.english:
“Thus said the whole community of YHWH: What is this treachery
that you have committed this day against the God of Israel,
turning away from YHWH, building yourselves an altar and rebelling
this day against YHWH!
verses.hebrew:
כֹּה אָמְרוּ כֹּל עֲדַת יְהֹוָה מָה־הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה בִּבְנוֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לִמְרדְכֶם הַיּוֹם
בַּיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כֹּה אָמְרוּ כֹּל עֲדַת יְהֹוָה מָה־הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה בִּבְנוֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לִמְרדְכֶם הַיּוֹם
בַּיהֹוָה׃

“Thus said the whole community of YHWH: What is this treachery
that you have committed this day against the God of Israel,
turning away from YHWH, building yourselves an altar and rebelling
this day against YHWH!

translation.text: today from following the LORD, by building yourselves an altar today in rebellion against the LORD?

and now you would turn away from YHWH! If you rebel against YHWH

Israel.

and now you would turn away from YHWH! If you rebel against YHWH

verses.english:
If it is because the land of your holding is unclean, cross over
into the land of YHWH’s own holding, where the Tabernacle of YHWH
abides, and acquire holdings among us. But do not rebel against
YHWH, and do not rebel against us by building for yourselves an
altar other than the altar of YHWH our God.
verses.hebrew:
וְאַךְ אִם־טְמֵאָה אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם עִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן־שָׁם מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְהֵאָחֲזוּ בְּתוֹכֵנוּ וּבַיהֹוָה אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאֹתָנוּ
אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ בִּבְנֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַךְ אִם־טְמֵאָה אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם עִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן־שָׁם מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְהֵאָחֲזוּ בְּתוֹכֵנוּ וּבַיהֹוָה אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאֹתָנוּ
אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ בִּבְנֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
If it is because the land of your holding is unclean, cross over
into the land of YHWH’s own holding, where the Tabernacle of YHWH
abides, and acquire holdings among us. But do not rebel against
YHWH, and do not rebel against us by building for yourselves an
altar other than the altar of YHWH our God.

translation.text: But now, if your land is unclean, cross over into the or rebel against us by building yourselves an altar other than the altar of the LORD our God.

verses.english:
When Achan son of Zerah violated the proscription, anger struck
the whole community of Israel; he was not the only one who
perished for that sin.”
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח מָעַל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וְעַל־כּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה קָצֶף וְהוּא אִישׁ אֶחָד לֹא גָוַע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח מָעַל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וְעַל־כּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה קָצֶף וְהוּא אִישׁ אֶחָד לֹא גָוַע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
When Achan son of Zerah violated the proscription, anger struck
the whole community of Israel; he was not the only one who
perished for that sin.”

translation.text: Did not Achan son of Zerah break faith in the of Israel? And he did not perish alone for his iniquity!'"

verses.english:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
replied to the heads of the contingents of Israel: They said,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
replied to the heads of the contingents of Israel: They said,

translation.text: Then the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh said in answer to the heads of the families of Israel,

verses.english:
“God, YHWH God! God, YHWH God! He knows, and Israel too shall
know! If we acted in rebellion or in treachery against YHWH, do
not vindicate us this day!
verses.hebrew: אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יֹדֵעַ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא יֵדָע אִם־בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם־בְּמַעַל בַּיהֹוָה אַל־תּוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יֹדֵעַ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא יֵדָע אִם־בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם־בְּמַעַל בַּיהֹוָה אַל־תּוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“God, YHWH God! God, YHWH God! He knows, and Israel too shall
know! If we acted in rebellion or in treachery against YHWH, do
not vindicate us this day!

translation.text: "The LORD, God of gods! The LORD, God of gods! He knows; and let Israel itself know! If it was in rebellion or in breach of faith toward the LORD, do not spare us today

verses.english:
If we built an altar to turn away from YHWH, if it was to offer
burnt offerings or meal offerings upon it, or to present
sacrifices of well-being upon it, may YHWH Himself demand [a
reckoning].
verses.hebrew: לִבְנוֹת לָנוּ מִזְבֵּחַ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְאִם־לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְאִם־לַעֲשׂוֹת עָלָיו זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנוֹת לָנוּ מִזְבֵּחַ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְאִם־לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְאִם־לַעֲשׂוֹת עָלָיו זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ׃

english.text:
If we built an altar to turn away from YHWH, if it was to offer
burnt offerings or meal offerings upon it, or to present
sacrifices of well-being upon it, may YHWH Himself demand [a
reckoning].

translation.text: for building an altar to turn away from following the LORD; or if we did so to offer burnt offerings or grain offerings or offerings of well-being on it, may the LORD himself take vengeance.

verses.english:
We did this thing only out of our concern that, in time to come,
your children might say to our children, ‘What have you to do with
YHWH, the God of Israel?
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא מִדְּאָגָה מִדָּבָר עָשִׂינוּ אֶת־זֹאת לֵאמֹר מָחָר יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם לְבָנֵינוּ לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּכֶם וְלַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־לֹא מִדְּאָגָה מִדָּבָר עָשִׂינוּ אֶת־זֹאת לֵאמֹר מָחָר יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם לְבָנֵינוּ לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּכֶם וְלַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
We did this thing only out of our concern that, in time to come,
your children might say to our children, ‘What have you to do with
YHWH, the God of Israel?

translation.text: No! We children, 'What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

verses.english:
YHWH has made the Jordan a boundary between you and us, O
Reubenites and Gadites; you have no share in YHWH!’ Thus your
children might prevent our children from worshiping YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וּגְבוּל נָתַן־יְהֹוָה בֵּינֵנוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה וְהִשְׁבִּיתוּ בְנֵיכֶם אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ לְבִלְתִּי יְרֹא
אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וּגְבוּל נָתַן־יְהֹוָה בֵּינֵנוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה וְהִשְׁבִּיתוּ בְנֵיכֶם אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ לְבִלְתִּי יְרֹא
אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
YHWH has made the Jordan a boundary between you and us, O
Reubenites and Gadites; you have no share in YHWH!’ Thus your
children might prevent our children from worshiping YHWH.

translation.text: For children might make our children cease to worship the LORD.

verses.english:
So we decided to provide [a witness] for ourselves by building an
altar—not for burnt offerings or [other] sacrifices,
verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא לָנוּ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזָבַח׃

hebrew.text: וַנֹּאמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא לָנוּ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזָבַח׃

english.text:
So we decided to provide [a witness] for ourselves by building an
altar—not for burnt offerings or [other] sacrifices,

translation.text: nor for sacrifice,

verses.english:
but as a witness between you and us, and between the generations
to come—that we may perform the service of YHWH before Him with
our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and our offerings of
well-being; and that your children should not say to our children
in time to come, ‘You have no share in YHWH.’
verses.hebrew:
כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין דֹּרוֹתֵינוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת יְהֹוָה לְפָנָיו בְּעֹלוֹתֵינוּ וּבִזְבָחֵינוּ וּבִשְׁלָמֵינוּ וְלֹא־יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם מָחָר
לְבָנֵינוּ אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין דֹּרוֹתֵינוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת יְהֹוָה לְפָנָיו בְּעֹלוֹתֵינוּ וּבִזְבָחֵינוּ וּבִשְׁלָמֵינוּ וְלֹא־יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם מָחָר
לְבָנֵינוּ אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
but as a witness between you and us, and between the generations
to come—that we may perform the service of YHWH before Him with
our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and our offerings of
well-being; and that your children should not say to our children
in time to come, ‘You have no share in YHWH.’

translation.text: but to be a witness between us and you, and children in time to come, "You have no portion in the LORD."'

verses.english:
We reasoned: should they speak thus to us and to our children in
time to come, we would reply, ‘See the replica of YHWH’s altar,
which our fathers made—not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but
as a witness between you and us.’
verses.hebrew:
וַנֹּאמֶר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְאֶל־דֹּרֹתֵינוּ מָחָר וְאָמַרְנוּ רְאוּ אֶת־תַּבְנִית מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזֶבַח כִּי־עֵד הוּא
בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַנֹּאמֶר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְאֶל־דֹּרֹתֵינוּ מָחָר וְאָמַרְנוּ רְאוּ אֶת־תַּבְנִית מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזֶבַח כִּי־עֵד הוּא
בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
We reasoned: should they speak thus to us and to our children in
time to come, we would reply, ‘See the replica of YHWH’s altar,
which our fathers made—not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but
as a witness between you and us.’

translation.text: And which our ancestors made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifice, but to be a witness between us and you.'

verses.english:
Far be it from us to rebel against YHWH, or to turn away this day
from YHWH and build an altar for burnt offerings, meal offerings,
and sacrifices other than the altar of YHWH our God which stands
before His Tabernacle.”
verses.hebrew:
חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִמְרֹד בַּיהֹוָה וְלָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לְעֹלָה לְמִנְחָה וּלְזָבַח מִלְּבַד מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי
מִשְׁכָּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִמְרֹד בַּיהֹוָה וְלָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לְעֹלָה לְמִנְחָה וּלְזָבַח מִלְּבַד מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי
מִשְׁכָּנוֹ׃

english.text:
Far be it from us to rebel against YHWH, or to turn away this day
from YHWH and build an altar for burnt offerings, meal offerings,
and sacrifices other than the altar of YHWH our God which stands
before His Tabernacle.”

translation.text: Far be it from us that we his tabernacle!"

verses.english:
When the priest Phinehas and the chieftains of the community—the
heads of the contingents of Israel—who were with him heard the
explanation given by the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
Manassites, they approved.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע פִּינְחָס הַכֹּהֵן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וְרָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה
וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע פִּינְחָס הַכֹּהֵן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וְרָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה
וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When the priest Phinehas and the chieftains of the community—the
heads of the contingents of Israel—who were with him heard the
explanation given by the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
Manassites, they approved.

translation.text: When the priest Phinehas and the chiefs of the congregation, the were satisfied.

verses.english:
The priest Phinehas son of Eleazar said to the Reubenites, the
Gadites, and the Manassites, “Now we know that YHWH is in our
midst, since you have not committed such treachery against YHWH.
You have indeed saved the Israelites from punishment by YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַיּוֹם יָדַעְנוּ כִּי־בְתוֹכֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מְעַלְתֶּם בַּיהֹוָה
הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אָז הִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַיּוֹם יָדַעְנוּ כִּי־בְתוֹכֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מְעַלְתֶּם בַּיהֹוָה
הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אָז הִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The priest Phinehas son of Eleazar said to the Reubenites, the
Gadites, and the Manassites, “Now we know that YHWH is in our
midst, since you have not committed such treachery against YHWH.
You have indeed saved the Israelites from punishment by YHWH.”

translation.text: The priest Phinehas son of Eleazar said to the the LORD."

verses.english:
Then the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar and the chieftains
returned from the Reubenites and the Gadites in the land of Gilead
to the Israelites in the land of Canaan, and gave them their
report.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהַנְּשִׂיאִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּמֵאֵת בְּנֵי־גָד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשִׁבוּ אוֹתָם
דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהַנְּשִׂיאִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּמֵאֵת בְּנֵי־גָד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשִׁבוּ אוֹתָם
דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Then the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar and the chieftains
returned from the Reubenites and the Gadites in the land of Gilead
to the Israelites in the land of Canaan, and gave them their
report.

translation.text: Then the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar and the chiefs returned from Canaan, to the Israelites, and brought back word to them.

verses.english:
The Israelites were pleased, and the Israelites praised God; and
they spoke no more of going to war against them, to ravage the
land in which the Reubenites and Gadites dwelt.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבָרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָמְרוּ לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן
וּבְנֵי־גָד יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבָרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָמְרוּ לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן
וּבְנֵי־גָד יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

english.text:
The Israelites were pleased, and the Israelites praised God; and
they spoke no more of going to war against them, to ravage the
land in which the Reubenites and Gadites dwelt.

translation.text: The report pleased the Israelites; and the Israelites blessed God and spoke Reubenites and the Gadites were settled.

verses.english:
The Reubenites and the Gadites named the altar [“Witness”],
