meaning, “It is a witness between us and them that YHWH is [our]
God.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֹתֵינוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֹתֵינוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
The Reubenites and the Gadites named the altar [“Witness”],
meaning, “It is a witness between us and them that YHWH is [our]
God.”

translation.text: The Reubenites and the between us that the LORD is God."

verses.english:
Much later, after YHWH had given Israel rest from all the enemies
around them, and when Joshua was old and well advanced in years,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים רַבִּים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים רַבִּים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Much later, after YHWH had given Israel rest from all the enemies
around them, and when Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

translation.text: A long time afterward, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from all years,

verses.english:
Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders and commanders, their
magistrates and officials, and said to them: “I have grown old and
am advanced in years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִזְקֵנָיו וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי בָּאתִי בַּיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִזְקֵנָיו וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי בָּאתִי בַּיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders and commanders, their
magistrates and officials, and said to them: “I have grown old and
am advanced in years.

translation.text: Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders and heads, their advanced in years;

verses.english:
You have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all those nations
on your account, for it was YHWH your God who fought for you.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְכל־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְכל־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all those nations
on your account, for it was YHWH your God who fought for you.

translation.text: and you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake, for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.

verses.english:
See, I have allotted to you, by your tribes, [the territory of]
these nations that still remain, and that of all the nations that
I have destroyed, from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the
west.
verses.hebrew: רְאוּ הִפַּלְתִּי לָכֶם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַחֲלָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְכל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַתִּי וְהַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּ הִפַּלְתִּי לָכֶם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַחֲלָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְכל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַתִּי וְהַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
See, I have allotted to you, by your tribes, [the territory of]
these nations that still remain, and that of all the nations that
I have destroyed, from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the
west.

translation.text: I have allotted to you as an inheritance for your tribes those nations that remain, along with all the nations that I have already cut off, from the Jordan to the Great Sea in the west.

verses.english:
YHWH your God Himself will thrust them out on your account and
drive them out to make way for you, and you shall possess their
land as YHWH your God promised you.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא יֶהְדֳּפֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִישׁ אֹתָם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת־אַרְצָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא יֶהְדֳּפֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִישׁ אֹתָם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת־אַרְצָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
YHWH your God Himself will thrust them out on your account and
drive them out to make way for you, and you shall possess their
land as YHWH your God promised you.

translation.text: The promised you.

verses.english:
“But be most resolute to observe faithfully all that is written in
the Book of the Teaching of Moses, without ever deviating from it
to the right or to the left,
verses.hebrew: וַחֲזַקְתֶּם מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְבִלְתִּי סוּר־מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲזַקְתֶּם מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְבִלְתִּי סוּר־מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

english.text:
“But be most resolute to observe faithfully all that is written in
the Book of the Teaching of Moses, without ever deviating from it
to the right or to the left,

translation.text: Therefore be very steadfast to observe and do all that neither to the right nor to the left,

verses.english:
and without intermingling with these nations that are left among
you. Do not utter the names of their gods or swear by them; do not
serve them or bow down to them.
verses.hebrew: לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא בַּגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וּבְשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם לֹא־תַזְכִּירוּ וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּיעוּ וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא בַּגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וּבְשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם לֹא־תַזְכִּירוּ וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּיעוּ וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
and without intermingling with these nations that are left among
you. Do not utter the names of their gods or swear by them; do not
serve them or bow down to them.

translation.text: so that you may not be mixed yourselves down to them,

verses.english: But hold fast to YHWH your God as you have done to this day.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּדְבָּקוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּדְבָּקוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text: But hold fast to YHWH your God as you have done to this day.

translation.text: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

verses.english:
“YHWH has driven out great, powerful nations on your account, and
not a man has withstood you to this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיכֶם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצוּמִים וְאַתֶּם לֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיכֶם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצוּמִים וְאַתֶּם לֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“YHWH has driven out great, powerful nations on your account, and
not a man has withstood you to this day.

translation.text: For the LORD has driven out before you great you to this day.

verses.english:
A single man of you would put a thousand to flight, for YHWH your
God Himself has been fighting for you, as He promised you.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִכֶּם יִרְדּף־אָלֶף כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִכֶּם יִרְדּף־אָלֶף כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

english.text:
A single man of you would put a thousand to flight, for YHWH your
God Himself has been fighting for you, as He promised you.

translation.text: One of you puts to flight a thousand, since it is the LORD your God who fights for you, as he promised you.

verses.english:
For your own sakes, therefore, be most mindful to love YHWH your
God.
verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
For your own sakes, therefore, be most mindful to love YHWH your
God.

translation.text: Be very careful, therefore, to love the LORD your God.

verses.english:
For should you turn away and attach yourselves to the remnant of
those nations—to those that are left among you—and intermarry with
them, you joining them and they joining you,
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם בְּיֶתֶר הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וְהִתְחַתַּנְתֶּם בָּהֶם וּבָאתֶם בָּהֶם וְהֵם בָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם בְּיֶתֶר הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וְהִתְחַתַּנְתֶּם בָּהֶם וּבָאתֶם בָּהֶם וְהֵם בָּכֶם׃

english.text:
For should you turn away and attach yourselves to the remnant of
those nations—to those that are left among you—and intermarry with
them, you joining them and they joining you,

translation.text: For if you turn back,

verses.english:
know for certain that YHWH your God will not continue to drive
these nations out before you; they shall become a snare and a trap
for you, a scourge to your sides and thorns in your eyes, until
you perish from this good land that YHWH your God has given you.
verses.hebrew:
יָדוֹעַ תֵּדְעוּ כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְלִצְנִנִים
בְּעֵינֵיכֶם עַד־אֲבדְכֶם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
יָדוֹעַ תֵּדְעוּ כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְלִצְנִנִים
בְּעֵינֵיכֶם עַד־אֲבדְכֶם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
know for certain that YHWH your God will not continue to drive
these nations out before you; they shall become a snare and a trap
for you, a scourge to your sides and thorns in your eyes, until
you perish from this good land that YHWH your God has given you.

translation.text: know assuredly that the LORD your God will not continue to drive you, a scourge on your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.

verses.english:
“I am now going the way of all the earth. Acknowledge with all
your heart and soul that not one of the good things that YHWH your
God promised you has failed to happen; they have all come true for
you, not a single one has failed.
verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ הַיּוֹם בְּדֶרֶךְ כּל־הָאָרֶץ וִידַעְתֶּם בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם כִּי לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הַטּוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר
יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם הַכֹּל בָּאוּ לָכֶם לֹא־נָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ הַיּוֹם בְּדֶרֶךְ כּל־הָאָרֶץ וִידַעְתֶּם בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם כִּי לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הַטּוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר
יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם הַכֹּל בָּאוּ לָכֶם לֹא־נָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד׃

english.text:
“I am now going the way of all the earth. Acknowledge with all
your heart and soul that not one of the good things that YHWH your
God promised you has failed to happen; they have all come true for
you, not a single one has failed.

translation.text: "And now I am about to go the way of all the earth, and you know in your hearts and souls, all of you, that not one thing has failed of all have come to pass for you, not one of them has failed.

verses.english:
But just as every good thing that YHWH your God promised you has
been fulfilled for you, so YHWH can bring upon you every evil
thing until He has wiped you off this good land that YHWH your God
has given you.
verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם כּל־הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲלֵיכֶם כֵּן יָבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם אֵת כּל־הַדָּבָר הָרָע עַד־הַשְׁמִידוֹ אוֹתְכֶם מֵעַל
הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם כּל־הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲלֵיכֶם כֵּן יָבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם אֵת כּל־הַדָּבָר הָרָע עַד־הַשְׁמִידוֹ אוֹתְכֶם מֵעַל
הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
But just as every good thing that YHWH your God promised you has
been fulfilled for you, so YHWH can bring upon you every evil
thing until He has wiped you off this good land that YHWH your God
has given you.

translation.text: But just as all your God has given you.

verses.english:
If you break the covenant that YHWH your God enjoined upon you,
and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then YHWH’s
anger will burn against you, and you shall quickly perish from the
good land that He has given you.”
verses.hebrew:
בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת־בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם וְחָרָה אַף־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וַאֲבַדְתֶּם
מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת־בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם וְחָרָה אַף־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וַאֲבַדְתֶּם
מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
If you break the covenant that YHWH your God enjoined upon you,
and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then YHWH’s
anger will burn against you, and you shall quickly perish from the
good land that He has given you.”

translation.text: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD to you."

verses.english:
Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned
Israel’s elders and commanders, magistrates and officers; and they
presented themselves before God.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכֶמָה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכֶמָה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned
Israel’s elders and commanders, magistrates and officers; and they
presented themselves before God.

translation.text: Then Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and summoned the elders, the heads, the judges, and the officers of Israel; and they presented themselves before God.

verses.english:
Then Joshua said to all the people, “Thus said YHWH, the God of
Israel: In olden times, your forefathers—Terah, father of Abraham
and father of Nahor—lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other
gods.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים
אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים
אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
Then Joshua said to all the people, “Thus said YHWH, the God of
Israel: In olden times, your forefathers—Terah, father of Abraham
and father of Nahor—lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other
gods.

translation.text: And Joshua said to all the people, "Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: Long ago your ancestors Euphrates and served other gods.

verses.english:
But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led
him through the whole land of Canaan and multiplied his offspring.
I gave him Isaac,
verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אֹתוֹ בְּכל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן (וארב) [וָאַרְבֶּה] אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אֹתוֹ בְּכל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן (וארב) [וָאַרְבֶּה] אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led
him through the whole land of Canaan and multiplied his offspring.
I gave him Isaac,

translation.text: Then I took your father Abraham made his offspring many. I gave him Isaac;

verses.english:
and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country
of Seir as his possession, while Jacob and his children went down
to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country
of Seir as his possession, while Jacob and his children went down
to Egypt.

translation.text: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Seir to possess, but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.

verses.english:
“Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt with [the
wonders] that I wrought in their midst, after which I freed you—
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וָאֶגֹּף אֶת־מִצְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחַר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלַח אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וָאֶגֹּף אֶת־מִצְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחַר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt with [the
wonders] that I wrought in their midst, after which I freed you—

translation.text: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I you out.

verses.english:
I freed your fathers—from Egypt, and you came to the Sea. But the
Egyptians pursued your fathers to the Sea of Reeds with chariots
and horsemen.
verses.hebrew: וָאוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַתָּבֹאוּ הַיָּמָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים יַם־סוּף׃

hebrew.text: וָאוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַתָּבֹאוּ הַיָּמָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים יַם־סוּף׃

english.text:
I freed your fathers—from Egypt, and you came to the Sea. But the
Egyptians pursued your fathers to the Sea of Reeds with chariots
and horsemen.

translation.text: When I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, you came to horsemen to the Red Sea.

verses.english:
They cried out to YHWH, and He put darkness between you and the
Egyptians; then He brought the Sea upon them, and it covered them.
Your own eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. “After you had
lived a long time in the wilderness,
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׂם מַאֲפֵל בֵּינֵיכֶם וּבֵין הַמִּצְרִים וַיָּבֵא עָלָיו אֶת־הַיָּם וַיְכַסֵּהוּ וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינֵיכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בְּמִצְרָיִם
וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׂם מַאֲפֵל בֵּינֵיכֶם וּבֵין הַמִּצְרִים וַיָּבֵא עָלָיו אֶת־הַיָּם וַיְכַסֵּהוּ וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינֵיכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בְּמִצְרָיִם
וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
They cried out to YHWH, and He put darkness between you and the
Egyptians; then He brought the Sea upon them, and it covered them.
Your own eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. “After you had
lived a long time in the wilderness,

translation.text: When they cried out to the LORD, he put upon them and cover them; and your eyes saw what I did to Egypt. Afterwards you lived in the wilderness a long time.

verses.english:
I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the
Jordan. They gave battle to you, but I delivered them into your
hands; I annihilated them for you, and you took possession of
their land.
verses.hebrew: (ואבאה) [וָאָבִיא] אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אִתְּכֶם וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַתִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם וָאַשְׁמִידֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: (ואבאה) [וָאָבִיא] אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אִתְּכֶם וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַתִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם וָאַשְׁמִידֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the
Jordan. They gave battle to you, but I delivered them into your
hands; I annihilated them for you, and you took possession of
their land.

translation.text: Then I brought took possession of their land, and I destroyed them before you.

verses.english:
Thereupon Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, made ready to
attack Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא לְבִלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר לְקַלֵּל אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא לְבִלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר לְקַלֵּל אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
Thereupon Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, made ready to
attack Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

translation.text: Then sent and invited Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

verses.english:
but I refused to listen to Balaam; he had to bless you, and thus I
saved you from him.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁמֹעַ לְבִלְעָם וַיְבָרֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ אֶתְכֶם וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁמֹעַ לְבִלְעָם וַיְבָרֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ אֶתְכֶם וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

english.text:
but I refused to listen to Balaam; he had to bless you, and thus I
saved you from him.

translation.text: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you; so I rescued you out of his hand.

verses.english:
“Then you crossed the Jordan and you came to Jericho. The citizens
of Jericho and the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites,
Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites fought you, but I delivered
them into your hands.
verses.hebrew:
וַתַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְרִיחוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָכֶם בַּעֲלֵי־יְרִיחוֹ הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי
וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַתַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְרִיחוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָכֶם בַּעֲלֵי־יְרִיחוֹ הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי
וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
“Then you crossed the Jordan and you came to Jericho. The citizens
of Jericho and the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites,
Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites fought you, but I delivered
them into your hands.

translation.text: When you went over the Jordan and came to Jericho, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I handed them over to you.

verses.english:
I sent a plague ahead of you, and it drove them out before
you—[just like] the two Amorite kings—not by your sword or by your
bow.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַצִּרְעָה וַתְּגָרֶשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי לֹא בְחַרְבְּךָ וְלֹא בְקַשְׁתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלַח לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַצִּרְעָה וַתְּגָרֶשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי לֹא בְחַרְבְּךָ וְלֹא בְקַשְׁתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
I sent a plague ahead of you, and it drove them out before
you—[just like] the two Amorite kings—not by your sword or by your
bow.

translation.text: I sent the hornet Amorites; it was not by your sword or by your bow.

verses.english:
I have given you a land for which you did not labor and towns
which you did not build, and you have settled in them; you are
enjoying vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתֵּן לָכֶם אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָגַעְתָּ בָּהּ וְעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְנִיתֶם וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶם כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נְטַעְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֹכְלִים׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתֵּן לָכֶם אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָגַעְתָּ בָּהּ וְעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְנִיתֶם וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶם כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נְטַעְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֹכְלִים׃

english.text:
I have given you a land for which you did not labor and towns
which you did not build, and you have settled in them; you are
enjoying vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.

translation.text: I gave you a land you live in them; you eat the fruit of vineyards and oliveyards that you did not plant.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְעִבְדוּ אֹתוֹ בְּתָמִים וּבֶאֱמֶת וְהָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וּבְמִצְרַיִם וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְעִבְדוּ אֹתוֹ בְּתָמִים וּבֶאֱמֶת וְהָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וּבְמִצְרַיִם וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: "Now therefore revere the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in River and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

verses.english:
Or, if you are loath to serve YHWH, choose this day which ones you
are going to serve—the gods that your forefathers served beyond
the Euphrates, or those of the Amorites in whose land you are
settled; but I and my household will serve YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וְאִם רַע בְּעֵינֵיכֶם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־מִי תַעֲבֹדוּן אִם אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר (בעבר) [מֵעֵבֶר] הַנָּהָר וְאִם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי
הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְאָנֹכִי וּבֵיתִי נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאִם רַע בְּעֵינֵיכֶם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־מִי תַעֲבֹדוּן אִם אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר (בעבר) [מֵעֵבֶר] הַנָּהָר וְאִם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי
הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְאָנֹכִי וּבֵיתִי נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Or, if you are loath to serve YHWH, choose this day which ones you
are going to serve—the gods that your forefathers served beyond
the Euphrates, or those of the Amorites in whose land you are
settled; but I and my household will serve YHWH.”

translation.text: Now if you are unwilling to your ancestors served in the region beyond the River or the gods of the household, we will serve the LORD."

verses.english:
In reply, the people declared, “Far be it from us to forsake YHWH
and serve other gods!
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מֵעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מֵעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
In reply, the people declared, “Far be it from us to forsake YHWH
and serve other gods!

translation.text: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD to serve other gods;

verses.english:
For it was YHWH our God who brought us and our fathers up from the
land of Egypt, the house of bondage, and who wrought those
wondrous signs before our very eyes, and guarded us all along the
way that we traveled and among all the peoples through whose midst
we passed.
verses.hebrew:
כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוּא הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְעֵינֵינוּ אֶת־הָאֹתוֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְרֵנוּ
בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ בָהּ וּבְכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוּא הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְעֵינֵינוּ אֶת־הָאֹתוֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְרֵנוּ
בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ בָהּ וּבְכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

english.text:
For it was YHWH our God who brought us and our fathers up from the
land of Egypt, the house of bondage, and who wrought those
wondrous signs before our very eyes, and guarded us all along the
way that we traveled and among all the peoples through whose midst
we passed.

translation.text: for it is the LORD our God who peoples through whom we passed;

verses.english:
And then YHWH drove out before us all the peoples—the
Amorites—that inhabited the country. We too will serve YHWH, for
He is our God.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־כּל־הָעַמִּים וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ גַּם־אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־כּל־הָעַמִּים וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ גַּם־אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And then YHWH drove out before us all the peoples—the
Amorites—that inhabited the country. We too will serve YHWH, for
He is our God.”

translation.text: and the LORD drove out before us will serve the LORD, for he is our God."

verses.english:
Joshua, however, said to the people, “You will not be able to
serve YHWH, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not
forgive your transgressions and your sins.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם לֹא תוּכְלוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשִׁים הוּא אֵל־קַנּוֹא הוּא לֹא־יִשָּׂא לְפִשְׁעֲכֶם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם לֹא תוּכְלוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשִׁים הוּא אֵל־קַנּוֹא הוּא לֹא־יִשָּׂא לְפִשְׁעֲכֶם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Joshua, however, said to the people, “You will not be able to
serve YHWH, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not
forgive your transgressions and your sins.

translation.text: But Joshua said to the people, "You cannot serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions or your sins.

verses.english:
If you forsake YHWH and serve alien gods, He will turn and deal
harshly with you and make an end of you, after having been
gracious to you.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי תַעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהֵי נֵכָר וְשָׁב וְהֵרַע לָכֶם וְכִלָּה אֶתְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵיטִיב לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תַעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהֵי נֵכָר וְשָׁב וְהֵרַע לָכֶם וְכִלָּה אֶתְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵיטִיב לָכֶם׃

english.text:
If you forsake YHWH and serve alien gods, He will turn and deal
harshly with you and make an end of you, after having been
gracious to you.”

translation.text: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, then he good."

verses.english: But the people replied to Joshua, “No, we will serve YHWH!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא כִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה נַעֲבֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא כִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה נַעֲבֹד׃

english.text: But the people replied to Joshua, “No, we will serve YHWH!”

translation.text: And the people said to Joshua, "No, we will serve the LORD!"

verses.english:
Thereupon Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against
yourselves that you have by your own act chosen to serve YHWH.”
“Yes, we are!” they responded.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם עֵדִים אַתֶּם בָּכֶם כִּי־אַתֶּם בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֵדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם עֵדִים אַתֶּם בָּכֶם כִּי־אַתֶּם בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֵדִים׃

english.text:
Thereupon Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against
yourselves that you have by your own act chosen to serve YHWH.”
“Yes, we are!” they responded.

translation.text: Then Joshua said to the people, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD, to serve him." And they said, "We are witnesses."

verses.english:
“Then put away the alien gods that you have among you and direct
your hearts to YHWH, the God of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְהַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְהַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Then put away the alien gods that you have among you and direct
your hearts to YHWH, the God of Israel.”

translation.text: He said, "Then put away the foreign gods that are among you, and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel."

verses.english:
And the people declared to Joshua, “We will serve none but YHWH
our God, and we will obey none but Him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַעֲבֹד וּבְקוֹלוֹ נִשְׁמָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַעֲבֹד וּבְקוֹלוֹ נִשְׁמָע׃

english.text:
And the people declared to Joshua, “We will serve none but YHWH
our God, and we will obey none but Him.”

translation.text: The people said to Joshua, "The LORD our God we will serve, and him we will obey."

verses.english:
On that day at Shechem, Joshua made a covenant for the people and
he made a fixed rule for them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּרִית לָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּשֶׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּרִית לָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּשֶׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
On that day at Shechem, Joshua made a covenant for the people and
he made a fixed rule for them.

translation.text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made statutes and ordinances for them at Shechem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהִים וַיִּקַּח אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְקִימֶהָ שָּׁם תַּחַת הָאַלָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּמִקְדַּשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהִים וַיִּקַּח אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְקִימֶהָ שָּׁם תַּחַת הָאַלָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּמִקְדַּשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: Joshua stone, and set it up there under the oak in the sanctuary of the LORD.

verses.english:
and Joshua said to all the people, “See, this very stone shall be
a witness against us, for it heard all the words that YHWH spoke
to us; it shall be a witness against you, lest you break faith
with your God.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם הִנֵּה הָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת תִּהְיֶה־בָּנוּ לְעֵדָה כִּי־הִיא שָׁמְעָה אֵת כּל־אִמְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עִמָּנוּ וְהָיְתָה בָכֶם לְעֵדָה
פֶּן־תְּכַחֲשׁוּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם הִנֵּה הָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת תִּהְיֶה־בָּנוּ לְעֵדָה כִּי־הִיא שָׁמְעָה אֵת כּל־אִמְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עִמָּנוּ וְהָיְתָה בָכֶם לְעֵדָה
פֶּן־תְּכַחֲשׁוּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and Joshua said to all the people, “See, this very stone shall be
a witness against us, for it heard all the words that YHWH spoke
to us; it shall be a witness against you, lest you break faith
with your God.”

translation.text: Joshua said to all the people, "See, this stone shall be a witness against us; for it has heard all the words of the LORD that he spoke to us; therefore it shall be a witness against you, if you deal falsely with your God."

verses.english: Joshua then dismissed the people to their allotted portions.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text: Joshua then dismissed the people to their allotted portions.

translation.text: So Joshua sent the people away to their inheritances.

verses.english:
After these events, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died
at the age of one hundred and ten years.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
After these events, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died
at the age of one hundred and ten years.

translation.text: After these things Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

verses.english:
They buried him on his own property, at Timnath-serah in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־סֶרַח אֲשֶׁר בְּהַר־אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־סֶרַח אֲשֶׁר בְּהַר־אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

english.text:
They buried him on his own property, at Timnath-serah in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

translation.text: They buried him in his own north of Mount Gaash.

verses.english:
Israel served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the lifetime
of the elders who lived on after Joshua, and who had experienced
all the deeds that YHWH had wrought for Israel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַאֲשֶׁר יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַאֲשֶׁר יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Israel served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the lifetime
of the elders who lived on after Joshua, and who had experienced
all the deeds that YHWH had wrought for Israel.

translation.text: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the did for Israel.

verses.english:
The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up from
Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the piece of ground which Jacob
had bought for a hundred kesitahs from the children of Hamor,
Shechem’s father, and which had become a heritage of the
Josephites.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם קָבְרוּ בִשְׁכֶם בְּחֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־חֲמוֹר אֲבִי־שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה
וַיִּהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־יוֹסֵף לְנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם קָבְרוּ בִשְׁכֶם בְּחֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־חֲמוֹר אֲבִי־שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה
וַיִּהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־יוֹסֵף לְנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up from
Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the piece of ground which Jacob
had bought for a hundred kesitahs from the children of Hamor,
Shechem’s father, and which had become a heritage of the
Josephites.

translation.text: The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up from descendants of Joseph.

verses.english:
Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him on the hill of
his son Phinehas, which had been assigned to him in the hill
country of Ephraim.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן מֵת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּגִבְעַת פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִתַּן־לוֹ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן מֵת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּגִבְעַת פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִתַּן־לוֹ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him on the hill of
his son Phinehas, which had been assigned to him in the hill
country of Ephraim.

translation.text: Eleazar son of Aaron died; and they buried him at Gibeah, the town Ephraim.

verses.english:
After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of YHWH, “Which
of us shall be the first to go up against the Canaanites and
attack them?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי בַּתְּחִלָּה לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי בַּתְּחִלָּה לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃

english.text:
After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of YHWH, “Which
of us shall be the first to go up against the Canaanites and
attack them?”

translation.text: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the LORD, "Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites, to fight against them?"

verses.english:
YHWH replied, “Let [the tribe of] Judah go up. I now deliver the
land into their hands.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה יַעֲלֶה הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה יַעֲלֶה הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH replied, “Let [the tribe of] Judah go up. I now deliver the
land into their hands.”

translation.text: hand."

verses.english:
Judah then said to their brother-tribe Simeon, “Come up with us to
our allotted territory and let us attack the Canaanites, and then
we will go with you to your allotted territory.” So Simeon joined
them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְשִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו עֲלֵה אִתִּי בְגֹרָלִי וְנִלָּחֲמָה בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וְהָלַכְתִּי גַם־אֲנִי אִתְּךָ בְּגוֹרָלֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְשִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו עֲלֵה אִתִּי בְגֹרָלִי וְנִלָּחֲמָה בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וְהָלַכְתִּי גַם־אֲנִי אִתְּךָ בְּגוֹרָלֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Judah then said to their brother-tribe Simeon, “Come up with us to
our allotted territory and let us attack the Canaanites, and then
we will go with you to your allotted territory.” So Simeon joined
them.

translation.text: Judah said to his brother Simeon, "Come up with me into the territory allotted to me, that we may fight against the Canaanites; then went with him.

verses.english:
When Judah advanced, YHWH delivered the Canaanites and the
Perizzites into their hands, and they defeated ten thousand of
them at Bezek.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוּדָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי בְּיָדָם וַיַּכּוּם בְּבֶזֶק עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יְהוּדָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי בְּיָדָם וַיַּכּוּם בְּבֶזֶק עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃

english.text:
When Judah advanced, YHWH delivered the Canaanites and the
Perizzites into their hands, and they defeated ten thousand of
them at Bezek.

translation.text: Then Judah went up and the LORD gave the thousand of them at Bezek.

verses.english:
At Bezek, they encountered Adoni-bezek, engaged him in battle, and
defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק בְּבֶזֶק וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק בְּבֶזֶק וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי׃

english.text:
At Bezek, they encountered Adoni-bezek, engaged him in battle, and
defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

translation.text: They came upon Adoni-bezek at Bezek, Perizzites.

verses.english:
Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued him and captured him; and they
cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּנס אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־בְּהֹנוֹת יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנס אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־בְּהֹנוֹת יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued him and captured him; and they
cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

translation.text: Adoni-bezek fled; but they pursued him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

verses.english:
And Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings, with thumbs and big toes cut
off, used to pick up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God
has requited me.” They brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק שִׁבְעִים מְלָכִים בְּהֹנוֹת יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם מְקֻצָּצִים הָיוּ מְלַקְּטִים תַּחַת שֻׁלְחָנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן שִׁלַּם־לִי אֱלֹהִים
וַיְבִיאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק שִׁבְעִים מְלָכִים בְּהֹנוֹת יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם מְקֻצָּצִים הָיוּ מְלַקְּטִים תַּחַת שֻׁלְחָנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן שִׁלַּם־לִי אֱלֹהִים
וַיְבִיאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings, with thumbs and big toes cut
off, used to pick up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God
has requited me.” They brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.

translation.text: Adoni-bezek said, "Seventy kings Jerusalem, and he died there.

verses.english:
The Judites attacked Jerusalem and captured it; they put it to the
sword and set the city on fire.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The Judites attacked Jerusalem and captured it; they put it to the
sword and set the city on fire.

translation.text: Then the people of Judah fought against Jerusalem and took it. They put it to the sword and set the city on fire.

verses.english:
After that the Judites went down to attack the Canaanites who
inhabited the hill country, the Negeb, and the Shephelah.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָרְדוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר יָרְדוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה׃

english.text:
After that the Judites went down to attack the Canaanites who
inhabited the hill country, the Negeb, and the Shephelah.

translation.text: Afterward the people of country, in the Negeb, and in the lowland.

verses.english:
The Judites marched against the Canaanites who dwelt in Hebron,
and they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. (The name of Hebron
was formerly Kiriath-arba.)
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְשֵׁם־חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְשֵׁם־חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמָי׃

english.text:
The Judites marched against the Canaanites who dwelt in Hebron,
and they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. (The name of Hebron
was formerly Kiriath-arba.)

translation.text: Judah went against the Kiriath-arba); and they defeated Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.

verses.english:
From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (the name
of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher).
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי דְּבִיר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִיר לְפָנִים קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי דְּבִיר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִיר לְפָנִים קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר׃

english.text:
From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (the name
of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher).

translation.text: From there they went against the inhabitants of Debir (the name of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher).

verses.english:
And Caleb announced, “I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage
to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כָּלֵב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כָּלֵב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Caleb announced, “I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage
to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher.”

translation.text: Then Caleb said, "Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and takes it, I will give him my daughter Achsah as wife."

verses.english:
His younger kinsman, Othniel the Kenizzite, captured it; and Caleb
gave him his daughter Achsah in marriage.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
His younger kinsman, Othniel the Kenizzite, captured it; and Caleb
gave him his daughter Achsah in marriage.

translation.text: And Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; and he gave him his daughter Achsah as wife.

verses.english:
When she came [to him], she induced him to ask her father for some
property. She dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb asked her,
“What is the matter?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִיהָ הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִיהָ הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
When she came [to him], she induced him to ask her father for some
property. She dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb asked her,
“What is the matter?”

translation.text: When she came to from her donkey, Caleb said to her, "What do you wish?"

verses.english:
She replied, “Give me a present, for you have given me away as
Negeb-land; give me springs of water.” And Caleb gave her Upper
and Lower Gulloth.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָבָה־לִּי בְרָכָה כִּי אֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב נְתַתָּנִי וְנָתַתָּה לִי גֻּלֹּת מָיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ כָּלֵב אֵת גֻּלֹּת עִלִּית וְאֵת גֻּלֹּת תַּחְתִּית׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָבָה־לִּי בְרָכָה כִּי אֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב נְתַתָּנִי וְנָתַתָּה לִי גֻּלֹּת מָיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ כָּלֵב אֵת גֻּלֹּת עִלִּית וְאֵת גֻּלֹּת תַּחְתִּית׃

english.text:
She replied, “Give me a present, for you have given me away as
Negeb-land; give me springs of water.” And Caleb gave her Upper
and Lower Gulloth.

translation.text: She said to and Lower Gulloth.

verses.english:
The descendants of the Kenite, the father-in-law of Moses, went up
with the Judites from the City of Palms to the wilderness of
Judah; and they went and settled among the people in the Negeb of
Arad.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קֵינִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עָלוּ מֵעִיר הַתְּמָרִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה מִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר בְּנֶגֶב עֲרָד וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶת־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קֵינִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עָלוּ מֵעִיר הַתְּמָרִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה מִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר בְּנֶגֶב עֲרָד וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶת־הָעָם׃

english.text:
The descendants of the Kenite, the father-in-law of Moses, went up
with the Judites from the City of Palms to the wilderness of
Judah; and they went and settled among the people in the Negeb of
Arad.

translation.text: The descendants of Hobab the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, went up with the Amalekites.

verses.english:
And Judah with its brother-tribe Simeon went on and defeated the
Canaanites who dwelt in Zephath. They proscribed it, and so the
town was named Hormah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶת־שִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב צְפַת וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם־הָעִיר חרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶת־שִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב צְפַת וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם־הָעִיר חרְמָה׃

english.text:
And Judah with its brother-tribe Simeon went on and defeated the
Canaanites who dwelt in Zephath. They proscribed it, and so the
town was named Hormah.

translation.text: Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they destruction. So the city was called Hormah.

verses.english:
And Judah captured Gaza and its territory, Ashkelon and its
territory, and Ekron and its territory.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד יְהוּדָה אֶת־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְלוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־עֶקְרוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד יְהוּדָה אֶת־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְלוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־עֶקְרוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah captured Gaza and its territory, Ashkelon and its
territory, and Ekron and its territory.

translation.text: Judah took Gaza with its territory, Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.

verses.english:
YHWH was with Judah, so that they took possession of the hill
country; but they were not able to dispossess the inhabitants of
the plain, for they had iron chariots.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּרֶשׁ אֶת־הָהָר כִּי לֹא לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעֵמֶק כִּי־רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּרֶשׁ אֶת־הָהָר כִּי לֹא לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעֵמֶק כִּי־רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לָהֶם׃

english.text:
YHWH was with Judah, so that they took possession of the hill
country; but they were not able to dispossess the inhabitants of
the plain, for they had iron chariots.

translation.text: The chariots of iron.

verses.english:
They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had promised; and he drove the
three Anakites out of there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לְכָלֵב אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם אֶת־שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ לְכָלֵב אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם אֶת־שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק׃

english.text:
They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had promised; and he drove the
three Anakites out of there.

translation.text: Hebron was given to Caleb, as Moses had said; and he drove out from it the three sons of Anak.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites did not dispossess the Jebusite inhabitants of
Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have dwelt with the Benjaminites in
Jerusalem to this day.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי יֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֵּשֶׁב הַיְבוּסִי אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי יֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֵּשֶׁב הַיְבוּסִי אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites did not dispossess the Jebusite inhabitants of
Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have dwelt with the Benjaminites in
Jerusalem to this day.

translation.text: But the Benjaminites did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have lived in Jerusalem among the Benjaminites to this day.

verses.english:
The House of Joseph, for their part, advanced against Bethel, and
YHWH was with them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף גַּם־הֵם בֵּית־אֵל וַיהֹוָה עִמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף גַּם־הֵם בֵּית־אֵל וַיהֹוָה עִמָּם׃

english.text:
The House of Joseph, for their part, advanced against Bethel, and
YHWH was with them.

translation.text: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel; and the LORD was with them.

verses.english:
While the House of Joseph were scouting at Bethel (the name of the
town was formerly Luz),
verses.hebrew: וַיָּתִירוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף בְּבֵית־אֵל וְשֵׁם־הָעִיר לְפָנִים לוּז׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּתִירוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף בְּבֵית־אֵל וְשֵׁם־הָעִיר לְפָנִים לוּז׃

english.text:
While the House of Joseph were scouting at Bethel (the name of the
town was formerly Luz),

translation.text: The house of Joseph sent out spies to Bethel (the name of the city was formerly Luz).

verses.english:
their patrols saw a man leaving the town. They said to him, “Just
show us how to get into the town, and we will treat you kindly.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַשֹּׁמְרִים אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַרְאֵנוּ נָא אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ חָסֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ הַשֹּׁמְרִים אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַרְאֵנוּ נָא אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ חָסֶד׃

english.text:
their patrols saw a man leaving the town. They said to him, “Just
show us how to get into the town, and we will treat you kindly.”

translation.text: When the spies saw a man coming out will deal kindly with you."

verses.english:
He showed them how to get into the town; they put the town to the
sword, but they let the man and all his relatives go free.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־כּל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שִׁלֵּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־כּל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שִׁלֵּחוּ׃

english.text:
He showed them how to get into the town; they put the town to the
sword, but they let the man and all his relatives go free.

translation.text: So he showed them the way into the city; family go.

verses.english:
The man went to the Hittite country. He founded a city and named
it Luz, and that has been its name to this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וַיִּבֶן עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לוּז הוּא שְׁמָהּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וַיִּבֶן עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לוּז הוּא שְׁמָהּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The man went to the Hittite country. He founded a city and named
it Luz, and that has been its name to this day.

translation.text: So the man went to the land of the Hittites and built a city, and named it Luz; that is its name to this day.

verses.english:
Manasseh did not dispossess [the inhabitants of] Beth-shean and
its dependencies, or [of] Taanach and its dependencies, or the
inhabitants of Dor and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of
Ibleam and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its
dependencies. The Canaanites persisted in dwelling in this region.
verses.hebrew:
וְלֹא־הוֹרִישׁ מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־בֵּית־שְׁאָן וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־[יוֹשְׁבֵי] (יושב) דוֹר וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יִבְלְעָם
וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text:
וְלֹא־הוֹרִישׁ מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־בֵּית־שְׁאָן וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־[יוֹשְׁבֵי] (יושב) דוֹר וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יִבְלְעָם
וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Manasseh did not dispossess [the inhabitants of] Beth-shean and
its dependencies, or [of] Taanach and its dependencies, or the
inhabitants of Dor and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of
Ibleam and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its
dependencies. The Canaanites persisted in dwelling in this region.

translation.text: Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants that land.

verses.english:
And when Israel gained the upper hand, they subjected the
Canaanites to forced labor; but they did not dispossess them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָזַק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵישׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָזַק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵישׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And when Israel gained the upper hand, they subjected the
Canaanites to forced labor; but they did not dispossess them.

translation.text: When Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not in fact drive them out.

verses.english:
Nor did Ephraim dispossess the Canaanites who inhabited Gezer; so
the Canaanites dwelt in their midst at Gezer.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶפְרַיִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ בְּגָזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶפְרַיִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ בְּגָזֶר׃

english.text:
Nor did Ephraim dispossess the Canaanites who inhabited Gezer; so
the Canaanites dwelt in their midst at Gezer.

translation.text: And Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites lived among them in Gezer.

verses.english:
Zebulun did not dispossess the inhabitants of Kitron or the
inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites dwelt in their midst,
but they were subjected to forced labor.
verses.hebrew: זְבוּלֻן לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִטְרוֹן וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי נַהֲלֹל וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

hebrew.text: זְבוּלֻן לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִטְרוֹן וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי נַהֲלֹל וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

english.text:
Zebulun did not dispossess the inhabitants of Kitron or the
inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites dwelt in their midst,
but they were subjected to forced labor.

translation.text: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, or the became subject to forced labor.

verses.english:
Asher did not dispossess the inhabitants of Acco or the
inhabitants of Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
verses.hebrew: אָשֵׁר לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי עַכּוֹ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן וְאֶת־אַחְלָב וְאֶת־אַכְזִיב וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּה וְאֶת־אֲפִיק וְאֶת־רְחֹב׃

hebrew.text: אָשֵׁר לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי עַכּוֹ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן וְאֶת־אַחְלָב וְאֶת־אַכְזִיב וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּה וְאֶת־אֲפִיק וְאֶת־רְחֹב׃

english.text:
Asher did not dispossess the inhabitants of Acco or the
inhabitants of Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.

translation.text: Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, or the inhabitants of Rehob;

verses.english:
So the Asherites dwelt in the midst of the Canaanites, the
inhabitants of the land, for they did not dispossess them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב הָאָשֵׁרִי בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב הָאָשֵׁרִי בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

english.text:
So the Asherites dwelt in the midst of the Canaanites, the
inhabitants of the land, for they did not dispossess them.

translation.text: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.

verses.english:
Naphtali did not dispossess the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh or the
inhabitants of Beth-anath. But they settled in the midst of the
Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and the inhabitants of
Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath had to perform forced labor for them.
verses.hebrew: נַפְתָּלִי לֹא־הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־עֲנָת וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וּבֵית עֲנָת הָיוּ לָהֶם לָמַס׃

hebrew.text: נַפְתָּלִי לֹא־הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־עֲנָת וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וּבֵית עֲנָת הָיוּ לָהֶם לָמַס׃

english.text:
Naphtali did not dispossess the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh or the
inhabitants of Beth-anath. But they settled in the midst of the
Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and the inhabitants of
Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath had to perform forced labor for them.

translation.text: Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, or the and of Beth-anath became subject to forced labor for them.

verses.english:
The Amorites pressed the Danites into the hill country; they would
not let them come down to the plain.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְחֲצוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן הָהָרָה כִּי־לֹא נְתָנוֹ לָרֶדֶת לָעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְחֲצוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן הָהָרָה כִּי־לֹא נְתָנוֹ לָרֶדֶת לָעֵמֶק׃

english.text:
The Amorites pressed the Danites into the hill country; they would
not let them come down to the plain.

translation.text: The Amorites pressed the Danites back into the hill country; they did not allow them to come down to the plain.

verses.english:
The Amorites also persisted in dwelling in Har-heres, in Aijalon,
and in Shaalbim. But the hand of the House of Joseph bore heavily
on them and they had to perform forced labor.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל הָאֱמֹרִי לָשֶׁבֶת בְּהַר־חֶרֶס בְּאַיָּלוֹן וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וַתִּכְבַּד יַד בֵּית־יוֹסֵף וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹאֶל הָאֱמֹרִי לָשֶׁבֶת בְּהַר־חֶרֶס בְּאַיָּלוֹן וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וַתִּכְבַּד יַד בֵּית־יוֹסֵף וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

english.text:
The Amorites also persisted in dwelling in Har-heres, in Aijalon,
and in Shaalbim. But the hand of the House of Joseph bore heavily
on them and they had to perform forced labor.

translation.text: The Amorites continued forced labor.

verses.english:
The territory of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of
Akrabbim—from Sela—onward.
verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מִמַּעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים מֵהַסֶּלַע וָמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מִמַּעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים מֵהַסֶּלַע וָמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
The territory of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of
Akrabbim—from Sela—onward.

translation.text: The border of the Amorites ran from the ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela and upward.

verses.english:
An angel of YHWH came up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I
brought you up from Egypt and I took you into the land which I had
promised on oath to your fathers. And I said, ‘I will never break
My covenant with you.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל אֶל־הַבֹּכִיםוַיֹּאמֶר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם וָאֹמַר לֹא־אָפֵר
בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל אֶל־הַבֹּכִיםוַיֹּאמֶר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם וָאֹמַר לֹא־אָפֵר
בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
An angel of YHWH came up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I
brought you up from Egypt and I took you into the land which I had
promised on oath to your fathers. And I said, ‘I will never break
My covenant with you.

translation.text: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, had promised to your ancestors. I said, 'I will never break my covenant with you.

verses.english:
And you, for your part, must make no covenant with the inhabitants
of this land; you must tear down their altars.’ But you have not
obeyed Me—look what you have done!
verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם לֹא־תִכְרְתוּ בְרִית לְיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּן וְלֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי מַה־זֹּאת עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם לֹא־תִכְרְתוּ בְרִית לְיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּן וְלֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי מַה־זֹּאת עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

english.text:
And you, for your part, must make no covenant with the inhabitants
of this land; you must tear down their altars.’ But you have not
obeyed Me—look what you have done!

translation.text: For your part, do not make a covenant with the inhabitants command. See what you have done!

verses.english:
Therefore, I have resolved not to drive them out before you; they
shall become your oppressors, and their gods shall be a snare to
you.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אָמַרְתִּי לֹא־אֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְצִדִּים וֵאלֹהֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אָמַרְתִּי לֹא־אֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְצִדִּים וֵאלֹהֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Therefore, I have resolved not to drive them out before you; they
shall become your oppressors, and their gods shall be a snare to
you.”

translation.text: So now I say, I will not drive their gods shall be a snare to you."

verses.english:
As the angel of YHWH spoke these words to all the Israelites, the
people broke into weeping.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

english.text:
As the angel of YHWH spoke these words to all the Israelites, the
people broke into weeping.

translation.text: When the angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the Israelites, the people lifted up their voices and wept.

verses.english:
So they named that place Bochim, and they offered sacrifices there
to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֹּכִים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֹּכִים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So they named that place Bochim, and they offered sacrifices there
to YHWH.

translation.text: So they named that place Bochim, and there they sacrificed to the LORD.

verses.english:
When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites went to their
allotted territories and took possession of the land.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites went to their
allotted territories and took possession of the land.

translation.text: When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites all went to their own inheritances to take possession of the land.

verses.english:
The people served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the
lifetime of the older people who lived on after Joshua and who had
witnessed all the marvelous deeds that YHWH had wrought for
Israel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשׁוּעַ אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשׁוּעַ אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The people served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the
lifetime of the older people who lived on after Joshua and who had
witnessed all the marvelous deeds that YHWH had wrought for
Israel.

translation.text: The people LORD had done for Israel.

verses.english:
Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died at the age of one
hundred and ten years,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died at the age of one
hundred and ten years,

translation.text: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of one hundred ten years.

verses.english:
and was buried on his own property, at Timnath-heres in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־חֶרֶס בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־חֶרֶס בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

english.text:
and was buried on his own property, at Timnath-heres in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

translation.text: So they buried him within Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.english:
And all that generation were likewise gathered to their fathers.
Another generation arose after them, which had not experienced
[the deliverance of] YHWH or the deeds that He had wrought for
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם כּל־הַדּוֹר הַהוּא נֶאֶסְפוּ אֶל־אֲבוֹתָיו וַיָּקם דּוֹר אַחֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְגַם אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם כּל־הַדּוֹר הַהוּא נֶאֶסְפוּ אֶל־אֲבוֹתָיו וַיָּקם דּוֹר אַחֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְגַם אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And all that generation were likewise gathered to their fathers.
Another generation arose after them, which had not experienced
[the deliverance of] YHWH or the deeds that He had wrought for
Israel.

translation.text: Moreover, that whole generation Israel.

verses.english:
And the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH. They worshiped
the Baalim
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃

english.text:
And the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH. They worshiped
the Baalim

translation.text: Then the Israelites did what was evil in the sight of the LORD and worshiped the Baals;

verses.english:
and forsook YHWH, the God of their fathers, who had brought them
out of the land of Egypt. They followed other gods, from among the
gods of the peoples around them, and bowed down to them; they
provoked YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתָם הַמּוֹצִיא אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם
וַיַּכְעִסוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתָם הַמּוֹצִיא אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם
וַיַּכְעִסוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and forsook YHWH, the God of their fathers, who had brought them
out of the land of Egypt. They followed other gods, from among the
gods of the peoples around them, and bowed down to them; they
provoked YHWH.

translation.text: and they abandoned the LORD, the God of their LORD to anger.

verses.english: They forsook YHWH and worshiped Baal and the Ashtaroth.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ לַבַּעַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ לַבַּעַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃

english.text: They forsook YHWH and worshiped Baal and the Ashtaroth.

translation.text: They abandoned the LORD, and worshiped Baal and the Astartes.

verses.english:
Then YHWH was incensed at Israel, and He handed them over to foes
who plundered them. He surrendered them to their enemies on all
sides, and they could no longer hold their own against their
enemies.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אוֹתָם וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ עוֹד לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אוֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אוֹתָם וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ עוֹד לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אוֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then YHWH was incensed at Israel, and He handed them over to foes
who plundered them. He surrendered them to their enemies on all
sides, and they could no longer hold their own against their
enemies.

translation.text: So the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, could no longer withstand their enemies.

verses.english:
In all their campaigns, the hand of YHWH was against them to their
undoing, as YHWH had declared and as YHWH had sworn to them; and
they were in great distress.
verses.hebrew: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ יַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה־בָּם לְרָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם וַיֵּצֶר לָהֶם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ יַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה־בָּם לְרָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם וַיֵּצֶר לָהֶם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
In all their campaigns, the hand of YHWH was against them to their
undoing, as YHWH had declared and as YHWH had sworn to them; and
they were in great distress.

translation.text: Whenever they marched distress.

verses.english:
Then YHWH raised up chieftains who delivered them from those who
plundered them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שֹׁפְטִים וַיּוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד שֹׁסֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שֹׁפְטִים וַיּוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד שֹׁסֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then YHWH raised up chieftains who delivered them from those who
plundered them.

translation.text: Then the LORD raised up judges, who delivered them out of the power of those who plundered them.

verses.english:
But they did not heed their chieftains either; they went astray
after other gods and bowed down to them. They were quick to turn
aside from the way their fathers had followed in obedience to the
commandments of YHWH; they did not do right.
verses.hebrew:
וְגַם אֶל־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי זָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אֲבוֹתָם לִשְׁמֹעַ מִצְוֺת־יְהֹוָה
לֹא־עָשׂוּ כֵן׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם אֶל־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי זָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אֲבוֹתָם לִשְׁמֹעַ מִצְוֺת־יְהֹוָה
לֹא־עָשׂוּ כֵן׃

english.text:
But they did not heed their chieftains either; they went astray
after other gods and bowed down to them. They were quick to turn
aside from the way their fathers had followed in obedience to the
commandments of YHWH; they did not do right.

translation.text: Yet they did not listen even to not follow their example.

verses.english:
When YHWH raised up chieftains for them, YHWH would be with the
chieftain and would save them from their enemies during the
chieftain’s lifetime; for YHWH would be moved to pity by their
moanings because of those who oppressed and crushed them.
verses.hebrew:
וְכִי־הֵקִים יְהֹוָה לָהֶם שֹׁפְטִים וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה עִם־הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהוֹשִׁיעָם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֹּל יְמֵי הַשּׁוֹפֵט כִּי־יִנָּחֵם יְהֹוָה מִנַּאֲקָתָם מִפְּנֵי לֹחֲצֵיהֶם
וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְכִי־הֵקִים יְהֹוָה לָהֶם שֹׁפְטִים וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה עִם־הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהוֹשִׁיעָם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֹּל יְמֵי הַשּׁוֹפֵט כִּי־יִנָּחֵם יְהֹוָה מִנַּאֲקָתָם מִפְּנֵי לֹחֲצֵיהֶם
וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When YHWH raised up chieftains for them, YHWH would be with the
chieftain and would save them from their enemies during the
chieftain’s lifetime; for YHWH would be moved to pity by their
moanings because of those who oppressed and crushed them.

translation.text: Whenever the LORD raised up judges for oppressed them.

verses.english:
But when the chieftain died, they would again act basely, even
more than the preceding generation —following other gods,
worshiping them, and bowing down to them; they omitted none of
their practices and stubborn ways.
verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה בְּמוֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵט יָשֻׁבוּ וְהִשְׁחִיתוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לָהֶם לֹא הִפִּילוּ מִמַּעַלְלֵיהֶם וּמִדַּרְכָּם
הַקָּשָׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה בְּמוֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵט יָשֻׁבוּ וְהִשְׁחִיתוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לָהֶם לֹא הִפִּילוּ מִמַּעַלְלֵיהֶם וּמִדַּרְכָּם
הַקָּשָׁה׃

english.text:
But when the chieftain died, they would again act basely, even
more than the preceding generation —following other gods,
worshiping them, and bowing down to them; they omitted none of
their practices and stubborn ways.

translation.text: But whenever the judge died, they would relapse of their practices or their stubborn ways.

verses.english:
Then YHWH became incensed against Israel, and He said, “Since that
nation has transgressed the covenant that I enjoined upon their
fathers and has not obeyed Me,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ לְקוֹלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ לְקוֹלִי׃

english.text:
Then YHWH became incensed against Israel, and He said, “Since that
nation has transgressed the covenant that I enjoined upon their
fathers and has not obeyed Me,

translation.text: So the anger of the LORD not obeyed my voice,

verses.english:
I for My part will no longer drive out before them any of the
nations that Joshua left when he died.”
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אוֹסִיף לְהוֹרִישׁ אִישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־עָזַב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אוֹסִיף לְהוֹרִישׁ אִישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־עָזַב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
I for My part will no longer drive out before them any of the
nations that Joshua left when he died.”

translation.text: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations that Joshua left when he died."

verses.english:
For it was in order to test Israel by them—[to see] whether or not
they would faithfully walk in the ways of YHWH, as their fathers
had done—
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן נַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲשֹׁמְרִים הֵם אֶת־דֶּרֶךְ יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ אֲבוֹתָם אִם־לֹא׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן נַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲשֹׁמְרִים הֵם אֶת־דֶּרֶךְ יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ אֲבוֹתָם אִם־לֹא׃

english.text:
For it was in order to test Israel by them—[to see] whether or not
they would faithfully walk in the ways of YHWH, as their fathers
had done—

translation.text: In order to test Israel, their ancestors did,

verses.english:
that YHWH had left those nations, instead of driving them out at
once, and had not delivered them into the hands of Joshua.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹרִישָׁם מַהֵר וְלֹא נְתָנָם בְּיַד־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנַּח יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹרִישָׁם מַהֵר וְלֹא נְתָנָם בְּיַד־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
that YHWH had left those nations, instead of driving them out at
once, and had not delivered them into the hands of Joshua.

translation.text: the LORD had left those nations, not driving them out at once, and had not handed them over to Joshua.
