verses.english:
These are the nations that YHWH left so that He might test by them
all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars of Canaan,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ יְהֹוָה לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מִלְחֲמוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ יְהֹוָה לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מִלְחֲמוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
These are the nations that YHWH left so that He might test by them
all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars of Canaan,

translation.text: Now these are the nations that the LORD left to test all those in Israel who had no experience of any war in Canaan

verses.english:
so that succeeding generations of Israelites might be made to
experience war—but only those who had not known the former wars:
verses.hebrew: רַק לְמַעַן דַּעַת דֹּרוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְלַמְּדָם מִלְחָמָה רַק אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנִים לֹא יְדָעוּם׃

hebrew.text: רַק לְמַעַן דַּעַת דֹּרוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְלַמְּדָם מִלְחָמָה רַק אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנִים לֹא יְדָעוּם׃

english.text:
so that succeeding generations of Israelites might be made to
experience war—but only those who had not known the former wars:

translation.text: (it was only that who had no experience of it before):

verses.english:
the five principalities of the Philistines and all the Canaanites,
Sidonians, and Hivites who inhabited the hill country of the
Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.
verses.hebrew: חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַצִּידֹנִי וְהַחִוִּי יֹשֵׁב הַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵהַר בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָת׃

hebrew.text: חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַצִּידֹנִי וְהַחִוִּי יֹשֵׁב הַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵהַר בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָת׃

english.text:
the five principalities of the Philistines and all the Canaanites,
Sidonians, and Hivites who inhabited the hill country of the
Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.

translation.text: the five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.

verses.english:
These served as a means of testing Israel, to learn whether they
would obey the commandments which YHWH had enjoined upon their
fathers through Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
These served as a means of testing Israel, to learn whether they
would obey the commandments which YHWH had enjoined upon their
fathers through Moses.

translation.text: by Moses.

verses.english:
The Israelites settled among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites;
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָשְׁבוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָשְׁבוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
The Israelites settled among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites;

translation.text: So the Israelites lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites;

verses.english:
they took their daughters to wife and gave their own daughters to
their sons, and they worshiped their gods.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם נָתְנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם נָתְנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
they took their daughters to wife and gave their own daughters to
their sons, and they worshiped their gods.

translation.text: and they they gave to their sons; and they worshiped their gods.

verses.english:
The Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH; they ignored YHWH
their God and worshiped the Baalim and the Asheroth.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת׃

english.text:
The Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH; they ignored YHWH
their God and worshiped the Baalim and the Asheroth.

translation.text: The Israelites did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, forgetting the LORD their God, and worshiping the Baals and the Asherahs.

verses.english:
YHWH became incensed at Israel and surrendered them to King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram-naharaim; and the Israelites were
subject to Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרַם נַהֲרָיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרַם נַהֲרָיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
YHWH became incensed at Israel and surrendered them to King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram-naharaim; and the Israelites were
subject to Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.

translation.text: Therefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he sold the Israelites served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.

verses.english:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised a champion for
the Israelites to deliver them: Othniel the Kenizzite, a younger
kinsman of Caleb.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה מוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּשִׁיעֵם אֵת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה מוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּשִׁיעֵם אֵת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised a champion for
the Israelites to deliver them: Othniel the Kenizzite, a younger
kinsman of Caleb.

translation.text: But when the Israelites cried out to the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer for the brother.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH descended upon him and he became Israel’s
chieftain. He went out to war, and YHWH delivered King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram into his hands. He prevailed over
Cushan-rishathaim,
verses.hebrew:
וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַתָּעז יָדוֹ עַל כּוּשַׁן
רִשְׁעָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַתָּעז יָדוֹ עַל כּוּשַׁן
רִשְׁעָתָיִם׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH descended upon him and he became Israel’s
chieftain. He went out to war, and YHWH delivered King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram into his hands. He prevailed over
Cushan-rishathaim,

translation.text: The spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel; Aram into his hand; and his hand prevailed over Cushan-rishathaim.

verses.english:
and the land had peace for forty years. When Othniel the Kenizzite
died,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיָּמת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיָּמת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז׃

english.text:
and the land had peace for forty years. When Othniel the Kenizzite
died,

translation.text: So the land had rest forty years. Then Othniel son of Kenaz died.

verses.english:
the Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH. And because
they did what was offensive to YHWH, YHWH let King Eglon of Moab
prevail over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כִּי־עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כִּי־עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
the Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH. And because
they did what was offensive to YHWH, YHWH let King Eglon of Moab
prevail over Israel.

translation.text: The Israelites again did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; and had done what was evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
[Eglon] brought the Ammonites and the Amalekites together under
his command, and went and defeated Israel and occupied the City of
Palms.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־עִיר הַתְּמָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־עִיר הַתְּמָרִים׃

english.text:
[Eglon] brought the Ammonites and the Amalekites together under
his command, and went and defeated Israel and occupied the City of
Palms.

translation.text: In alliance with the took possession of the city of palms.

verses.english:
The Israelites were subject to King Eglon of Moab for eighteen
years.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites were subject to King Eglon of Moab for eighteen
years.

translation.text: So the Israelites served King Eglon of Moab eighteen years.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised up a
champion for them: the Benjaminite Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed
man. It happened that the Israelites sent tribute to King Eglon of
Moab through him.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־אֵהוּד בֶּן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אִישׁ אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָדוֹ
מִנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־אֵהוּד בֶּן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אִישׁ אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָדוֹ
מִנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised up a
champion for them: the Benjaminite Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed
man. It happened that the Israelites sent tribute to King Eglon of
Moab through him.

translation.text: But when the Israelites cried out to the LORD, the LORD raised up for man. The Israelites sent tribute by him to King Eglon of Moab.

verses.english:
So Ehud made for himself a two-edged dagger, a gomed in length,
which he girded on his right side under his cloak.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אֵהוּד חֶרֶב וְלָהּ שְׁנֵי פֵיוֹת גֹּמֶד ארְכָּהּ וַיַּחְגֹּר אוֹתָהּ מִתַּחַת לְמַדָּיו עַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אֵהוּד חֶרֶב וְלָהּ שְׁנֵי פֵיוֹת גֹּמֶד ארְכָּהּ וַיַּחְגֹּר אוֹתָהּ מִתַּחַת לְמַדָּיו עַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ׃

english.text:
So Ehud made for himself a two-edged dagger, a gomed in length,
which he girded on his right side under his cloak.

translation.text: Ehud fastened it on his right thigh under his clothes.

verses.english:
He presented the tribute to King Eglon of Moab. Now Eglon was a
very stout man.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וְעֶגְלוֹן אִישׁ בָּרִיא מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וְעֶגְלוֹן אִישׁ בָּרִיא מְאֹד׃

english.text:
He presented the tribute to King Eglon of Moab. Now Eglon was a
very stout man.

translation.text: Then he presented the tribute to King Eglon of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

verses.english:
When [Ehud] had finished presenting the tribute, he dismissed the
people who had conveyed the tribute.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְהַקְרִיב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּנְחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְהַקְרִיב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּנְחָה׃

english.text:
When [Ehud] had finished presenting the tribute, he dismissed the
people who had conveyed the tribute.

translation.text: who carried the tribute on their way.

verses.english:
But he himself returned from Pesilim, near Gilgal, and said, “Your
Majesty, I have a secret message for you.” [Eglon] thereupon
commanded, “Silence!” So all those in attendance left his
presence;
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא שָׁב מִן־הַפְּסִילִים אֲשֶׁר אֶת־הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־סֵתֶר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָס וַיֵּצְאוּ מֵעָלָיו כּל־הָעֹמְדִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא שָׁב מִן־הַפְּסִילִים אֲשֶׁר אֶת־הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־סֵתֶר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָס וַיֵּצְאוּ מֵעָלָיו כּל־הָעֹמְדִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
But he himself returned from Pesilim, near Gilgal, and said, “Your
Majesty, I have a secret message for you.” [Eglon] thereupon
commanded, “Silence!” So all those in attendance left his
presence;

translation.text: But he himself turned back at the sculptured stones near Gilgal, and said, "I have a secret message for out from his presence.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵהוּד בָּא אֵלָיו וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בַּעֲלִיַּת הַמְּקֵרָה אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵהוּד דְּבַר־אֱלֹהִים לִי אֵלֶיךָ וַיָּקם מֵעַל הַכִּסֵּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵהוּד בָּא אֵלָיו וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בַּעֲלִיַּת הַמְּקֵרָה אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵהוּד דְּבַר־אֱלֹהִים לִי אֵלֶיךָ וַיָּקם מֵעַל הַכִּסֵּא׃

translation.text: Ehud came to him, while he was sitting alone you." So he rose from his seat.

verses.english:
Reaching with his left hand, Ehud drew the dagger from his right
side and drove it into [Eglon’s] belly.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵהוּד אֶת־יַד שְׂמֹאלוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַחֶרֶב מֵעַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶהָ בְּבִטְנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵהוּד אֶת־יַד שְׂמֹאלוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַחֶרֶב מֵעַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶהָ בְּבִטְנוֹ׃

english.text:
Reaching with his left hand, Ehud drew the dagger from his right
side and drove it into [Eglon’s] belly.

translation.text: Then Ehud reached with his left hand, took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into Eglon's belly;

verses.english:
The fat closed over the blade and the hilt went in after the
blade—for he did not pull the dagger out of his belly—and the
filth came out.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גַם־הַנִּצָּב אַחַר הַלַּהַב וַיִּסְגֹּר הַחֵלֶב בְּעַד הַלַּהַב כִּי לֹא שָׁלַף הַחֶרֶב מִבִּטְנוֹ וַיֵּצֵא הַפַּרְשְׁדֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא גַם־הַנִּצָּב אַחַר הַלַּהַב וַיִּסְגֹּר הַחֵלֶב בְּעַד הַלַּהַב כִּי לֹא שָׁלַף הַחֶרֶב מִבִּטְנוֹ וַיֵּצֵא הַפַּרְשְׁדֹנָה׃

english.text:
The fat closed over the blade and the hilt went in after the
blade—for he did not pull the dagger out of his belly—and the
filth came out.

translation.text: the hilt also went in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, for he did not draw the sword out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

verses.english:
Stepping out into the vestibule, Ehud shut the doors of the upper
chamber on him and locked them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֵהוּד הַמִּסְדְּרוֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּר דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה בַּעֲדוֹ וְנָעָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אֵהוּד הַמִּסְדְּרוֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּר דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה בַּעֲדוֹ וְנָעָל׃

english.text:
Stepping out into the vestibule, Ehud shut the doors of the upper
chamber on him and locked them.

translation.text: Then Ehud went out into the vestibule, and closed the doors of the roof chamber on him, and locked them.

verses.english:
After he left, the courtiers returned. When they saw that the
doors of the upper chamber were locked, they thought, “He must be
relieving himself in the cool chamber.”
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יָצָא וַעֲבָדָיו בָּאוּ וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה נְעֻלוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַךְ מֵסִיךְ הוּא אֶת־רַגְלָיו בַּחֲדַר הַמְּקֵרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא יָצָא וַעֲבָדָיו בָּאוּ וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה נְעֻלוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַךְ מֵסִיךְ הוּא אֶת־רַגְלָיו בַּחֲדַר הַמְּקֵרָה׃

english.text:
After he left, the courtiers returned. When they saw that the
doors of the upper chamber were locked, they thought, “He must be
relieving himself in the cool chamber.”

translation.text: After he had gone, the servants came. When they saw that the relieving himself in the cool chamber."

verses.english:
They waited a long time; and when he did not open the doors of the
chamber, they took the key and opened them—and there their master
was lying dead on the floor!
verses.hebrew: וַיָּחִילוּ עַד־בּוֹשׁ וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ פֹתֵחַ דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַמַּפְתֵּחַ וַיִּפְתָּחוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲדֹנֵיהֶם נֹפֵל אַרְצָה מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחִילוּ עַד־בּוֹשׁ וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ פֹתֵחַ דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַמַּפְתֵּחַ וַיִּפְתָּחוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲדֹנֵיהֶם נֹפֵל אַרְצָה מֵת׃

english.text:
They waited a long time; and when he did not open the doors of the
chamber, they took the key and opened them—and there their master
was lying dead on the floor!

translation.text: So they waited until they lying dead on the floor.

verses.english:
But Ehud had made good his escape while they delayed; he had
passed Pesilim and escaped to Seirah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵהוּד נִמְלַט עַד הִתְמַהְמְהָם וְהוּא עָבַר אֶת־הַפְּסִילִים וַיִּמָּלֵט הַשְּׂעִירָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵהוּד נִמְלַט עַד הִתְמַהְמְהָם וְהוּא עָבַר אֶת־הַפְּסִילִים וַיִּמָּלֵט הַשְּׂעִירָתָה׃

english.text:
But Ehud had made good his escape while they delayed; he had
passed Pesilim and escaped to Seirah.

translation.text: Ehud escaped while they delayed, and passed beyond the sculptured stones, and escaped to Seirah.

verses.english:
When he got there, he had the ram’s horn sounded through the hill
country of Ephraim, and all the Israelites descended with him from
the hill country; and he took the lead.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאוֹ וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיֵּרְדוּ עִמּוֹ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָהָר וְהוּא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאוֹ וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיֵּרְדוּ עִמּוֹ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָהָר וְהוּא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When he got there, he had the ram’s horn sounded through the hill
country of Ephraim, and all the Israelites descended with him from
the hill country; and he took the lead.

translation.text: When he arrived, he sounded the with him from the hill country, having him at their head.

verses.english:
“Follow me closely,” he said, “for YHWH has delivered your
enemies, the Moabites, into your hands.” They followed him down
and seized the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites; they let
no one cross.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רִדְפוּ אַחֲרַי כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם וַיֵּרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְמוֹאָב וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ אִישׁ
לַעֲבֹר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רִדְפוּ אַחֲרַי כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם וַיֵּרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְמוֹאָב וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ אִישׁ
לַעֲבֹר׃

english.text:
“Follow me closely,” he said, “for YHWH has delivered your
enemies, the Moabites, into your hands.” They followed him down
and seized the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites; they let
no one cross.

translation.text: He said to cross over.

verses.english:
On that occasion they slew about 10,000 Moabites; they were all
robust and brave men, yet not one of them escaped.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִיא כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ כּל־שָׁמֵן וְכל־אִישׁ חָיִל וְלֹא נִמְלַט אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִיא כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ כּל־שָׁמֵן וְכל־אִישׁ חָיִל וְלֹא נִמְלַט אִישׁ׃

english.text:
On that occasion they slew about 10,000 Moabites; they were all
robust and brave men, yet not one of them escaped.

translation.text: At that time they killed about ten thousand of the Moabites, all strong, able-bodied men; no one escaped.

verses.english:
On that day, Moab submitted to Israel; and the land was tranquil
for eighty years.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּכָּנַע מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תַּחַת יַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכָּנַע מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תַּחַת יַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
On that day, Moab submitted to Israel; and the land was tranquil
for eighty years.

translation.text: So Moab eighty years.

verses.english:
After him came Shamgar son of Anath, who slew six hundred
Philistines with an oxgoad. He too was a champion of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו הָיָה שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בְּמַלְמַד הַבָּקָר וַיּוֹשַׁע גַּם־הוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרָיו הָיָה שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בְּמַלְמַד הַבָּקָר וַיּוֹשַׁע גַּם־הוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
After him came Shamgar son of Anath, who slew six hundred
Philistines with an oxgoad. He too was a champion of Israel.

translation.text: After him came Shamgar son of Anath, who killed six hundred of the Philistines with an oxgoad. He too delivered Israel.

verses.english:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH—Ehud now being
dead.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְאֵהוּד מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְאֵהוּד מֵת׃

english.text:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH—Ehud now being
dead.

translation.text: The Israelites again did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, after Ehud died.

verses.english:
And YHWH surrendered them to King Jabin of Canaan, who reigned in
Hazor. His army commander was Sisera, whose base was
Harosheth-goiim.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְכְּרֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחָצוֹר וְשַׂר־צְבָאוֹ סִיסְרָא וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בַּחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְכְּרֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחָצוֹר וְשַׂר־צְבָאוֹ סִיסְרָא וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בַּחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH surrendered them to King Jabin of Canaan, who reigned in
Hazor. His army commander was Sisera, whose base was
Harosheth-goiim.

translation.text: So the LORD sold them into the hand of King Jabin of who lived in Harosheth-ha-goiim.

verses.english:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH; for he had nine hundred iron
chariots, and he had oppressed Israel ruthlessly for twenty years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב־בַּרְזֶל לוֹ וְהוּא לָחַץ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחזְקָה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב־בַּרְזֶל לוֹ וְהוּא לָחַץ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחזְקָה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH; for he had nine hundred iron
chariots, and he had oppressed Israel ruthlessly for twenty years.

translation.text: Then the Israelites cried out to the oppressed the Israelites cruelly twenty years.

verses.english:
Deborah, wife of Lappidoth, was a prophetess; she led Israel at
that time.
verses.hebrew: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת לַפִּידוֹת הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת לַפִּידוֹת הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

english.text:
Deborah, wife of Lappidoth, was a prophetess; she led Israel at
that time.

translation.text: At that time Deborah, a prophetess, wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel.

verses.english:
She used to sit under the Palm of Deborah, between Ramah and
Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites would
come to her for decisions.
verses.hebrew: וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בֵּין הָרָמָה וּבֵין בֵּית־אֵל בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בֵּין הָרָמָה וּבֵין בֵּית־אֵל בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
She used to sit under the Palm of Deborah, between Ramah and
Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites would
come to her for decisions.

translation.text: She used to sit under the palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the Israelites came up to her for judgment.

verses.english:
She summoned Barak son of Abinoam, of Kedesh in Naphtali, and said
to him, “YHWH, the God of Israel, has commanded: Go, march up to
Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and
Zebulun.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם מִקֶּדֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלֹא צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵךְ וּמָשַׁכְתָּ בְּהַר תָּבוֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ עִמְּךָ
עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי וּמִבְּנֵי זְבֻלוּן׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם מִקֶּדֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלֹא צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵךְ וּמָשַׁכְתָּ בְּהַר תָּבוֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ עִמְּךָ
עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי וּמִבְּנֵי זְבֻלוּן׃

english.text:
She summoned Barak son of Abinoam, of Kedesh in Naphtali, and said
to him, “YHWH, the God of Israel, has commanded: Go, march up to
Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and
Zebulun.

translation.text: She sent and summoned Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali, and said to him, "The LORD, the God of Israel, thousand from the tribe of Naphtali and the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.english:
And I will draw Sisera, Jabin’s army commander, with his chariots
and his troops, toward you up to the Wadi Kishon; and I will
deliver him into your hands.”
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁכְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן אֶת־סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא יָבִין וְאֶת־רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת־הֲמוֹנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהוּ בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁכְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן אֶת־סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא יָבִין וְאֶת־רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת־הֲמוֹנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהוּ בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
And I will draw Sisera, Jabin’s army commander, with his chariots
and his troops, toward you up to the Wadi Kishon; and I will
deliver him into your hands.”

translation.text: I will hand.'"

verses.english:
But Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; if not,
I will not go.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ בָּרָק אִם־תֵּלְכִי עִמִּי וְהָלָכְתִּי וְאִם־לֹא תֵלְכִי עִמִּי לֹא אֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ בָּרָק אִם־תֵּלְכִי עִמִּי וְהָלָכְתִּי וְאִם־לֹא תֵלְכִי עִמִּי לֹא אֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
But Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; if not,
I will not go.”

translation.text: Barak said to her, "If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go."

verses.english:
“Very well, I will go with you,” she answered. “However, there
will be no glory for you in the course you are taking, for then
YHWH will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.” So Deborah
went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָלֹךְ אֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא תִהְיֶה תִּפְאַרְתְּךָ עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ כִּי בְיַד־אִשָּׁה יִמְכֹּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתָּקם דְּבוֹרָה
וַתֵּלֶךְ עִם־בָּרָק קֶדְשָׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָלֹךְ אֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא תִהְיֶה תִּפְאַרְתְּךָ עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ כִּי בְיַד־אִשָּׁה יִמְכֹּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתָּקם דְּבוֹרָה
וַתֵּלֶךְ עִם־בָּרָק קֶדְשָׁה׃

english.text:
“Very well, I will go with you,” she answered. “However, there
will be no glory for you in the course you are taking, for then
YHWH will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.” So Deborah
went with Barak to Kedesh.

translation.text: And she said, "I will surely go with your glory, for the LORD will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman." Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.english:
Barak then mustered Zebulun and Naphtali at Kedesh; ten thousand
men marched up after him; and Deborah also went up with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּזְעֵק בָּרָק אֶת־זְבוּלֻן וְאֶת־נַפְתָּלִי קֶדְשָׁה וַיַּעַל בְּרַגְלָיו עֲשֶׂרֶת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ וַתַּעַל עִמּוֹ דְּבוֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּזְעֵק בָּרָק אֶת־זְבוּלֻן וְאֶת־נַפְתָּלִי קֶדְשָׁה וַיַּעַל בְּרַגְלָיו עֲשֶׂרֶת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ וַתַּעַל עִמּוֹ דְּבוֹרָה׃

english.text:
Barak then mustered Zebulun and Naphtali at Kedesh; ten thousand
men marched up after him; and Deborah also went up with him.

translation.text: Barak warriors went up behind him; and Deborah went up with him.

verses.english:
Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites,
descendants of Hobab, father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his
tent at Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.
verses.hebrew: וְחֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי נִפְרָד מִקַּיִן מִבְּנֵי חֹבָב חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּט אהֳלוֹ עַד־אֵילוֹן (בצענים) [בְּצַעֲנַנִּים] אֲשֶׁר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְחֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי נִפְרָד מִקַּיִן מִבְּנֵי חֹבָב חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּט אהֳלוֹ עַד־אֵילוֹן (בצענים) [בְּצַעֲנַנִּים] אֲשֶׁר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites,
descendants of Hobab, father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his
tent at Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.

translation.text: Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites, that is, encamped as far away as Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.

verses.english:
Sisera was informed that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount
Tabor.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְסִיסְרָא כִּי עָלָה בָּרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם הַר־תָּבוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְסִיסְרָא כִּי עָלָה בָּרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם הַר־תָּבוֹר׃

english.text:
Sisera was informed that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount
Tabor.

translation.text: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,

verses.english:
So Sisera ordered all his chariots—nine hundred iron chariots—and
all the troops he had to move from Harosheth-goiim to the Wadi
Kishon.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּזְעֵק סִיסְרָא אֶת־כּל־רִכְבּוֹ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מֵחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּזְעֵק סִיסְרָא אֶת־כּל־רִכְבּוֹ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מֵחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃

english.text:
So Sisera ordered all his chariots—nine hundred iron chariots—and
all the troops he had to move from Harosheth-goiim to the Wadi
Kishon.

translation.text: Sisera called out all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the troops who were with him, from Harosheth-hagoiim to the Wadi Kishon.

verses.english:
Then Deborah said to Barak, “Up! This is the day on which YHWH
will deliver Sisera into your hands: YHWH is marching before you.”
Barak charged down Mount Tabor, followed by the ten thousand men,
verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר דְּבֹרָה אֶל־בָּרָק קוּם כִּי זֶה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא בְּיָדֶךָ הֲלֹא יְהֹוָה יָצָא לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֵּרֶד בָּרָק מֵהַר תָּבוֹר וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים
אִישׁ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר דְּבֹרָה אֶל־בָּרָק קוּם כִּי זֶה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא בְּיָדֶךָ הֲלֹא יְהֹוָה יָצָא לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֵּרֶד בָּרָק מֵהַר תָּבוֹר וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים
אִישׁ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Then Deborah said to Barak, “Up! This is the day on which YHWH
will deliver Sisera into your hands: YHWH is marching before you.”
Barak charged down Mount Tabor, followed by the ten thousand men,

translation.text: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Up! For this Tabor with ten thousand warriors following him.

verses.english:
and YHWH threw Sisera and all his chariots and army into a panic
before the onslaught of Barak. Sisera leaped from his chariot and
fled on foot
verses.hebrew: וַיָּהם יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וְאֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְפִי־חֶרֶב לִפְנֵי בָרָק וַיֵּרֶד סִיסְרָא מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה וַיָּנס בְּרַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּהם יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וְאֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְפִי־חֶרֶב לִפְנֵי בָרָק וַיֵּרֶד סִיסְרָא מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה וַיָּנס בְּרַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
and YHWH threw Sisera and all his chariots and army into a panic
before the onslaught of Barak. Sisera leaped from his chariot and
fled on foot

translation.text: And the LORD Barak; Sisera got down from his chariot and fled away on foot,

verses.english:
as Barak pursued the chariots and the soldiers as far as
Harosheth-goiim. All of Sisera’s soldiers fell by the sword; not a
man was left.
verses.hebrew: וּבָרָק רָדַף אַחֲרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאַחֲרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּפֹּל כּל־מַחֲנֵה סִיסְרָא לְפִי־חֶרֶב לֹא נִשְׁאַר עַד־אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וּבָרָק רָדַף אַחֲרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאַחֲרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּפֹּל כּל־מַחֲנֵה סִיסְרָא לְפִי־חֶרֶב לֹא נִשְׁאַר עַד־אֶחָד׃

english.text:
as Barak pursued the chariots and the soldiers as far as
Harosheth-goiim. All of Sisera’s soldiers fell by the sword; not a
man was left.

translation.text: while the army of Sisera fell by the sword; no one was left.

verses.english:
Sisera, meanwhile, had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, wife of
Heber the Kenite; for there was friendship between King Jabin of
Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.
verses.hebrew: וְסִיסְרָא נָס בְּרַגְלָיו אֶל־אֹהֶל יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי כִּי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וּבֵין בֵּית חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וְסִיסְרָא נָס בְּרַגְלָיו אֶל־אֹהֶל יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי כִּי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וּבֵין בֵּית חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי׃

english.text:
Sisera, meanwhile, had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, wife of
Heber the Kenite; for there was friendship between King Jabin of
Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.

translation.text: Now Sisera had fled away on foot to the tent of Jael wife of Heber clan of Heber the Kenite.

verses.english:
Jael came out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord,
come in here, do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she
covered him with a blanket.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרַאת סִיסְרָא וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו סוּרָה אֲדֹנִי סוּרָה אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא וַיָּסַר אֵלֶיהָ הָאֹהֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרַאת סִיסְרָא וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו סוּרָה אֲדֹנִי סוּרָה אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא וַיָּסַר אֵלֶיהָ הָאֹהֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָה׃

english.text:
Jael came out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord,
come in here, do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she
covered him with a blanket.

translation.text: Jael came out to meet Sisera, and said to turned aside to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

verses.english:
He said to her, “Please let me have some water; I am thirsty.” She
opened a skin of milk and gave him some to drink; and she covered
him again.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־נָא מְעַט־מַיִם כִּי צָמֵאתִי וַתִּפְתַּח אֶת־נֹאוד הֶחָלָב וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־נָא מְעַט־מַיִם כִּי צָמֵאתִי וַתִּפְתַּח אֶת־נֹאוד הֶחָלָב וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ׃

english.text:
He said to her, “Please let me have some water; I am thirsty.” She
opened a skin of milk and gave him some to drink; and she covered
him again.

translation.text: covered him.

verses.english:
He said to her, “Stand at the entrance of the tent. If anybody
comes and asks you if there is anybody here, say ‘No.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אִם־אִישׁ יָבֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵךְ וְאָמַר הֲיֵשׁ־פֹּה אִישׁ וְאָמַרְתְּ אָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אִם־אִישׁ יָבֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵךְ וְאָמַר הֲיֵשׁ־פֹּה אִישׁ וְאָמַרְתְּ אָיִן׃

english.text:
He said to her, “Stand at the entrance of the tent. If anybody
comes and asks you if there is anybody here, say ‘No.’”

translation.text: He said to her, "Stand at the entrance of the tent, and if anybody comes and asks you, 'Is anyone here?' say, 'No.'"

verses.english:
Then Jael wife of Heber took a tent pin and grasped the mallet.
When he was fast asleep from exhaustion, she approached him
stealthily and drove the pin through his temple till it went down
to the ground. Thus he died.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקַּח יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת־חֶבֶר אֶת־יְתַד הָאֹהֶל וַתָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמַּקֶּבֶת בְּיָדָהּ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו בַּלָּאט וַתִּתְקַע אֶת־הַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ וַתִּצְנַח בָּאָרֶץ וְהוּא־נִרְדָּם
וַיָּעַף וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקַּח יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת־חֶבֶר אֶת־יְתַד הָאֹהֶל וַתָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמַּקֶּבֶת בְּיָדָהּ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו בַּלָּאט וַתִּתְקַע אֶת־הַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ וַתִּצְנַח בָּאָרֶץ וְהוּא־נִרְדָּם
וַיָּעַף וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
Then Jael wife of Heber took a tent pin and grasped the mallet.
When he was fast asleep from exhaustion, she approached him
stealthily and drove the pin through his temple till it went down
to the ground. Thus he died.

translation.text: But Jael and he died.

verses.english:
Now Barak appeared in pursuit of Sisera. Jael went out to greet
him and said, “Come, I will show you the man you are looking for.”
He went inside with her, and there Sisera was lying dead, with the
pin in his temple.
verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה בָרָק רֹדֵף אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ וְאַרְאֶךָּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וְהִנֵּה סִיסְרָא נֹפֵל מֵת
וְהַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה בָרָק רֹדֵף אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ וְאַרְאֶךָּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וְהִנֵּה סִיסְרָא נֹפֵל מֵת
וְהַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
Now Barak appeared in pursuit of Sisera. Jael went out to greet
him and said, “Come, I will show you the man you are looking for.”
He went inside with her, and there Sisera was lying dead, with the
pin in his temple.

translation.text: Then, as Barak came in pursuit of Sisera, Jael went out lying dead, with the tent peg in his temple.

verses.english:
On that day God subdued King Jabin of Canaan before the
Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְנַע אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכְנַע אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
On that day God subdued King Jabin of Canaan before the
Israelites.

translation.text: So on that day God subdued King Jabin of Canaan before the Israelites.

verses.english:
The hand of the Israelites bore harder and harder on King Jabin of
Canaan, until they destroyed King Jabin of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ יַד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלוֹךְ וְקָשָׁה עַל יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן עַד אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִיתוּ אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ יַד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלוֹךְ וְקָשָׁה עַל יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן עַד אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִיתוּ אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
The hand of the Israelites bore harder and harder on King Jabin of
Canaan, until they destroyed King Jabin of Canaan.

translation.text: Then the hand of the Israelites bore harder and harder on King Jabin of Canaan, until they destroyed King Jabin of Canaan.

verses.english: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang:
verses.hebrew: וַתָּשַׁר דְּבוֹרָה וּבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּשַׁר דְּבוֹרָה וּבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang:

translation.text: Then Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying:

verses.english:
When locks go untrimmed in Israel, When people dedicate
themselves— Bless YHWH!
verses.hebrew: בִּפְרֹעַ פְּרָעוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהִתְנַדֵּב עָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּפְרֹעַ פְּרָעוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהִתְנַדֵּב עָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When locks go untrimmed in Israel, When people dedicate
themselves— Bless YHWH!

translation.text: "When locks are long in Israel, bless the LORD!

verses.english:
Hear, O kings! Give ear, O potentates! I will sing, will sing to
YHWH, Will hymn YHWH, the God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ מְלָכִים הַאֲזִינוּ רֹזְנִים אָנֹכִי לַיהֹוָה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁירָה אֲזַמֵּר לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: שִׁמְעוּ מְלָכִים הַאֲזִינוּ רֹזְנִים אָנֹכִי לַיהֹוָה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁירָה אֲזַמֵּר לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Hear, O kings! Give ear, O potentates! I will sing, will sing to
YHWH, Will hymn YHWH, the God of Israel.

translation.text: "Hear, O kings; give ear, O princes; I will make melody to the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.english:
O LORD, when You came forth from Seir, Advanced from the country
of Edom, The earth trembled; The heavens dripped, Yea, the clouds
dripped water,
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה בְּצֵאתְךָ מִשֵּׂעִיר בְּצַעְדְּךָ מִשְּׂדֵה אֱדוֹם אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה גַּם־שָׁמַיִם נָטָפוּ גַּם־עָבִים נָטְפוּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה בְּצֵאתְךָ מִשֵּׂעִיר בְּצַעְדְּךָ מִשְּׂדֵה אֱדוֹם אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה גַּם־שָׁמַיִם נָטָפוּ גַּם־עָבִים נָטְפוּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
O LORD, when You came forth from Seir, Advanced from the country
of Edom, The earth trembled; The heavens dripped, Yea, the clouds
dripped water,

translation.text: "LORD, when you went out from Seir, the clouds indeed poured water.

verses.english:
The mountains quaked— Before YHWH, Him of Sinai, Before YHWH, God
of Israel.
verses.hebrew: הָרִים נָזְלוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: הָרִים נָזְלוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The mountains quaked— Before YHWH, Him of Sinai, Before YHWH, God
of Israel.

translation.text: The mountains quaked before the LORD, the One of Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.english:
In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, In the days of Jael, caravans
ceased, And wayfarers went By roundabout paths.
verses.hebrew: בִּימֵי שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת בִּימֵי יָעֵל חָדְלוּ אֳרָחוֹת וְהֹלְכֵי נְתִיבוֹת יֵלְכוּ אֳרָחוֹת עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: בִּימֵי שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת בִּימֵי יָעֵל חָדְלוּ אֳרָחוֹת וְהֹלְכֵי נְתִיבוֹת יֵלְכוּ אֳרָחוֹת עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת׃

english.text:
In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, In the days of Jael, caravans
ceased, And wayfarers went By roundabout paths.

translation.text: "In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, and travelers kept to the byways.

verses.english:
Deliverance ceased, Ceased in Israel, Till you arose, O Deborah,
Arose, O mother, in Israel!
verses.hebrew: חָדְלוּ פְרָזוֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָדֵלּוּ עַד שַׁקַּמְתִּי דְּבוֹרָה שַׁקַּמְתִּי אֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: חָדְלוּ פְרָזוֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָדֵלּוּ עַד שַׁקַּמְתִּי דְּבוֹרָה שַׁקַּמְתִּי אֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Deliverance ceased, Ceased in Israel, Till you arose, O Deborah,
Arose, O mother, in Israel!

translation.text: The peasantry prospered in Israel, arose as a mother in Israel.

verses.english:
When they chose new gods, Was there a fighter then in the gates?
No shield or spear was seen Among forty thousand in Israel!
verses.hebrew: יִבְחַר אֱלֹהִים חֲדָשִׁים אָז לָחֶם שְׁעָרִים מָגֵן אִם־יֵרָאֶה וָרֹמַח בְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: יִבְחַר אֱלֹהִים חֲדָשִׁים אָז לָחֶם שְׁעָרִים מָגֵן אִם־יֵרָאֶה וָרֹמַח בְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When they chose new gods, Was there a fighter then in the gates?
No shield or spear was seen Among forty thousand in Israel!

translation.text: When new gods were chosen, then war was in the gates. among forty thousand in Israel?

verses.english:
My heart is with Israel’s leaders, With the dedicated of the
people— Bless YHWH!
verses.hebrew: לִבִּי לְחוֹקְקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְנַדְּבִים בָּעָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לִבִּי לְחוֹקְקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְנַדְּבִים בָּעָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
My heart is with Israel’s leaders, With the dedicated of the
people— Bless YHWH!

translation.text: My heart goes out to the commanders of Israel who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD.

verses.english:
You riders on tawny she-asses, You who sit on saddle rugs, And you
wayfarers, declare it!
verses.hebrew: רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת צְחֹרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי עַל־מִדִּין וְהֹלְכֵי עַל־דֶּרֶךְ שִׂיחוּ׃

hebrew.text: רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת צְחֹרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי עַל־מִדִּין וְהֹלְכֵי עַל־דֶּרֶךְ שִׂיחוּ׃

english.text:
You riders on tawny she-asses, You who sit on saddle rugs, And you
wayfarers, declare it!

translation.text: "Tell of it, you who ride on white donkeys, and you who walk by the way.

verses.english:
Louder than the sound of archers, There among the watering places
Let them chant the gracious acts of YHWH, His gracious deliverance
of Israel. Then did the people of YHWH March down to the gates!
verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מְחַצְצִים בֵּין מַשְׁאַבִּים שָׁם יְתַנּוּ צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה צִדְקֹת פִּרְזוֹנוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אָז יָרְדוּ לַשְּׁעָרִים עַם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִקּוֹל מְחַצְצִים בֵּין מַשְׁאַבִּים שָׁם יְתַנּוּ צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה צִדְקֹת פִּרְזוֹנוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אָז יָרְדוּ לַשְּׁעָרִים עַם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Louder than the sound of archers, There among the watering places
Let them chant the gracious acts of YHWH, His gracious deliverance
of Israel. Then did the people of YHWH March down to the gates!

translation.text: To the sound of musicians at the watering places, the triumphs of his peasantry in Israel. "Then down to the gates marched the people of the LORD.

verses.english:
Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, strike up the chant! Arise,
O Barak; Take your captives, O son of Abinoam!
verses.hebrew: עוּרִי עוּרִי דְּבוֹרָה עוּרִי עוּרִי דַּבְּרִי־שִׁיר קוּם בָּרָק וּשְׁבֵה שֶׁבְיְךָ בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם׃

hebrew.text: עוּרִי עוּרִי דְּבוֹרָה עוּרִי עוּרִי דַּבְּרִי־שִׁיר קוּם בָּרָק וּשְׁבֵה שֶׁבְיְךָ בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם׃

english.text:
Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, strike up the chant! Arise,
O Barak; Take your captives, O son of Abinoam!

translation.text: "Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! O son of Abinoam.

verses.english:
Then was the remnant made victor over the mighty, YHWH’s people
won my victory over the warriors.
verses.hebrew: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהֹוָה יְרַד־לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהֹוָה יְרַד־לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
Then was the remnant made victor over the mighty, YHWH’s people
won my victory over the warriors.

translation.text: Then down marched the remnant of the noble; the mighty.

verses.english:
From Ephraim came they whose roots are in Amalek; After you, your
kin Benjamin; From Machir came down leaders, From Zebulun such as
hold the marshal’s staff.
verses.hebrew: מִנִּי אֶפְרַיִם שׁרְשָׁם בַּעֲמָלֵק אַחֲרֶיךָ בִנְיָמִין בַּעֲמָמֶיךָ מִנִּי מָכִיר יָרְדוּ מְחֹקְקִים וּמִזְּבוּלֻן מֹשְׁכִים בְּשֵׁבֶט סֹפֵר׃

hebrew.text: מִנִּי אֶפְרַיִם שׁרְשָׁם בַּעֲמָלֵק אַחֲרֶיךָ בִנְיָמִין בַּעֲמָמֶיךָ מִנִּי מָכִיר יָרְדוּ מְחֹקְקִים וּמִזְּבוּלֻן מֹשְׁכִים בְּשֵׁבֶט סֹפֵר׃

english.text:
From Ephraim came they whose roots are in Amalek; After you, your
kin Benjamin; From Machir came down leaders, From Zebulun such as
hold the marshal’s staff.

translation.text: From Ephraim they set out into the valley, following you, Benjamin, with your kin; and from Zebulun those who bear the marshal's staff;

verses.english:
And Issachar’s chiefs were with Deborah; As Barak, so was
Issachar— Rushing after him into the valley. Among the clans of
Reuben Were great decisions of heart.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַי בְּיִשָּׂשכָר עִם־דְּבֹרָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר כֵּן בָּרָק בָּעֵמֶק שֻׁלַּח בְּרַגְלָיו בִּפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדֹלִים חִקְקֵי־לֵב׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂרַי בְּיִשָּׂשכָר עִם־דְּבֹרָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר כֵּן בָּרָק בָּעֵמֶק שֻׁלַּח בְּרַגְלָיו בִּפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדֹלִים חִקְקֵי־לֵב׃

english.text:
And Issachar’s chiefs were with Deborah; As Barak, so was
Issachar— Rushing after him into the valley. Among the clans of
Reuben Were great decisions of heart.

translation.text: the chiefs of Issachar came with Deborah, and Issachar faithful to Barak; into the valley they rushed out at his heels. there were great searchings of heart.

verses.english:
Why then did you stay among the sheepfolds And listen as they pipe
for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben Were great searchings of
heart!
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יָשַׁבְתָּ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ שְׁרִקוֹת עֲדָרִים לִפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדוֹלִים חִקְרֵי־לֵב׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה יָשַׁבְתָּ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ שְׁרִקוֹת עֲדָרִים לִפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדוֹלִים חִקְרֵי־לֵב׃

english.text:
Why then did you stay among the sheepfolds And listen as they pipe
for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben Were great searchings of
heart!

translation.text: Why did you tarry among the sheepfolds, to hear the piping for the flocks? there were great searchings of heart.

verses.english:
Gilead tarried beyond the Jordan; And Dan—why did he linger by the
ships? Asher remained at the seacoast And tarried at his landings.
verses.hebrew: גִּלְעָד בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁכֵן וְדָן לָמָּה יָגוּר אֳנִיּוֹת אָשֵׁר יָשַׁב לְחוֹף יַמִּים וְעַל מִפְרָצָיו יִשְׁכּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: גִּלְעָד בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁכֵן וְדָן לָמָּה יָגוּר אֳנִיּוֹת אָשֵׁר יָשַׁב לְחוֹף יַמִּים וְעַל מִפְרָצָיו יִשְׁכּוֹן׃

english.text:
Gilead tarried beyond the Jordan; And Dan—why did he linger by the
ships? Asher remained at the seacoast And tarried at his landings.

translation.text: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan; and Dan, why did he abide with the ships? settling down by his landings.

verses.english:
Zebulun is a people that mocked at death, Naphtali—on the open
heights.
verses.hebrew: זְבֻלוּן עַם חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וְנַפְתָּלִי עַל מְרוֹמֵי שָׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: זְבֻלוּן עַם חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וְנַפְתָּלִי עַל מְרוֹמֵי שָׂדֶה׃

english.text:
Zebulun is a people that mocked at death, Naphtali—on the open
heights.

translation.text: Zebulun is a people that scorned death; Naphtali too, on the heights of the field.

verses.english:
Then the kings came, they fought: The kings of Canaan fought At
Taanach, by Megiddo’s waters— They got no spoil of silver.
verses.hebrew: בָּאוּ מְלָכִים נִלְחָמוּ אָז נִלְחֲמוּ מַלְכֵי כְנַעַן בְּתַעְנַךְ עַל־מֵי מְגִדּוֹ בֶּצַע כֶּסֶף לֹא לָקָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: בָּאוּ מְלָכִים נִלְחָמוּ אָז נִלְחֲמוּ מַלְכֵי כְנַעַן בְּתַעְנַךְ עַל־מֵי מְגִדּוֹ בֶּצַע כֶּסֶף לֹא לָקָחוּ׃

english.text:
Then the kings came, they fought: The kings of Canaan fought At
Taanach, by Megiddo’s waters— They got no spoil of silver.

translation.text: "The kings came, they fought; at Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo; they got no spoils of silver.

verses.english:
The stars fought from heaven, From their courses they fought
against Sisera.
verses.hebrew: מִן־שָׁמַיִם נִלְחָמוּ הַכּוֹכָבִים מִמְּסִלּוֹתָם נִלְחֲמוּ עִם־סִיסְרָא׃

hebrew.text: מִן־שָׁמַיִם נִלְחָמוּ הַכּוֹכָבִים מִמְּסִלּוֹתָם נִלְחֲמוּ עִם־סִיסְרָא׃

english.text:
The stars fought from heaven, From their courses they fought
against Sisera.

translation.text: The stars fought from heaven, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

verses.english:
The torrent Kishon swept them away, The raging torrent, the
torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with courage!
verses.hebrew: נַחַל קִישׁוֹן גְּרָפָם נַחַל קְדוּמִים נַחַל קִישׁוֹן תִּדְרְכִי נַפְשִׁי עֹז׃

hebrew.text: נַחַל קִישׁוֹן גְּרָפָם נַחַל קְדוּמִים נַחַל קִישׁוֹן תִּדְרְכִי נַפְשִׁי עֹז׃

english.text:
The torrent Kishon swept them away, The raging torrent, the
torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with courage!

translation.text: The torrent Kishon swept them away, the onrushing torrent, the torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with might!

verses.english: Then the horses’ hoofs pounded As headlong galloped the steeds.
verses.hebrew: אָז הָלְמוּ עִקְּבֵי־סוּס מִדַּהֲרוֹת דַּהֲרוֹת אַבִּירָיו׃

hebrew.text: אָז הָלְמוּ עִקְּבֵי־סוּס מִדַּהֲרוֹת דַּהֲרוֹת אַבִּירָיו׃

english.text: Then the horses’ hoofs pounded As headlong galloped the steeds.

translation.text: "Then loud beat the horses' hoofs with the galloping, galloping of his steeds.

verses.english:
“Curse Meroz!” said the angel of YHWH. “Bitterly curse its
inhabitants, Because they came not to the aid of YHWH, To the aid
of YHWH among the warriors.”
verses.hebrew: אוֹרוּ מֵרוֹז אָמַר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֹרוּ אָרוֹר יֹשְׁבֶיהָ כִּי לֹא־בָאוּ לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: אוֹרוּ מֵרוֹז אָמַר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֹרוּ אָרוֹר יֹשְׁבֶיהָ כִּי לֹא־בָאוּ לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
“Curse Meroz!” said the angel of YHWH. “Bitterly curse its
inhabitants, Because they came not to the aid of YHWH, To the aid
of YHWH among the warriors.”

translation.text: "Curse Meroz, says the angel of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.

verses.english:
Most blessed of women be Jael, Wife of Heber the Kenite, Most
blessed of women in tents.
verses.hebrew: תְּבֹרַךְ מִנָּשִׁים יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי מִנָּשִׁים בָּאֹהֶל תְּבֹרָךְ׃

hebrew.text: תְּבֹרַךְ מִנָּשִׁים יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי מִנָּשִׁים בָּאֹהֶל תְּבֹרָךְ׃

english.text:
Most blessed of women be Jael, Wife of Heber the Kenite, Most
blessed of women in tents.

translation.text: "Most blessed of women be Jael, of tent-dwelling women most blessed.

verses.english:
He asked for water, she offered milk; In a princely bowl she
brought him curds.
verses.hebrew: מַיִם שָׁאַל חָלָב נָתָנָה בְּסֵפֶל אַדִּירִים הִקְרִיבָה חֶמְאָה׃

hebrew.text: מַיִם שָׁאַל חָלָב נָתָנָה בְּסֵפֶל אַדִּירִים הִקְרִיבָה חֶמְאָה׃

english.text:
He asked for water, she offered milk; In a princely bowl she
brought him curds.

translation.text: He asked water and she gave him milk, she brought him curds in a lordly bowl.

verses.english:
Her [left] hand reached for the tent pin, Her right for the
workmen’s hammer. She struck Sisera, crushed his head, Smashed and
pierced his temple.
verses.hebrew: יָדָהּ לַיָּתֵד תִּשְׁלַחְנָה וִימִינָהּ לְהַלְמוּת עֲמֵלִים וְהָלְמָה סִיסְרָא מָחֲקָה רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָחֲצָה וְחָלְפָה רַקָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יָדָהּ לַיָּתֵד תִּשְׁלַחְנָה וִימִינָהּ לְהַלְמוּת עֲמֵלִים וְהָלְמָה סִיסְרָא מָחֲקָה רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָחֲצָה וְחָלְפָה רַקָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
Her [left] hand reached for the tent pin, Her right for the
workmen’s hammer. She struck Sisera, crushed his head, Smashed and
pierced his temple.

translation.text: She put her hand to the tent peg and her right hand to the workmen's mallet; she shattered and pierced his temple.

verses.english:
At her feet he sank, lay outstretched, At her feet he sank, lay
still; Where he sank, there he lay—destroyed.
verses.hebrew: בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפַל שָׁכָב בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפָל בַּאֲשֶׁר כָּרַע שָׁם נָפַל שָׁדוּד׃

hebrew.text: בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפַל שָׁכָב בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפָל בַּאֲשֶׁר כָּרַע שָׁם נָפַל שָׁדוּד׃

english.text:
At her feet he sank, lay outstretched, At her feet he sank, lay
still; Where he sank, there he lay—destroyed.

translation.text: He sank, he fell, he lay still at her feet; at her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell dead.

verses.english:
Through the window peered Sisera’s mother, Behind the lattice she
whined: “Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why so late the
clatter of his wheels?”
verses.hebrew: בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן נִשְׁקְפָה וַתְּיַבֵּב אֵם סִיסְרָא בְּעַד הָאֶשְׁנָב מַדּוּעַ בֹּשֵׁשׁ רִכְבּוֹ לָבוֹא מַדּוּעַ אֶחֱרוּ פַּעֲמֵי מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן נִשְׁקְפָה וַתְּיַבֵּב אֵם סִיסְרָא בְּעַד הָאֶשְׁנָב מַדּוּעַ בֹּשֵׁשׁ רִכְבּוֹ לָבוֹא מַדּוּעַ אֶחֱרוּ פַּעֲמֵי מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
Through the window peered Sisera’s mother, Behind the lattice she
whined: “Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why so late the
clatter of his wheels?”

translation.text: "Out of the window she peered, the mother of Sisera gazed through the lattice: 'Why is his chariot so long in coming?

verses.english:
The wisest of her ladies give answer; She, too, replies to
herself:
verses.hebrew: חַכְמוֹת שָׂרוֹתֶיהָ תַּעֲנֶינָּה אַף־הִיא תָּשִׁיב אֲמָרֶיהָ לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: חַכְמוֹת שָׂרוֹתֶיהָ תַּעֲנֶינָּה אַף־הִיא תָּשִׁיב אֲמָרֶיהָ לָהּ׃

english.text:
The wisest of her ladies give answer; She, too, replies to
herself:

translation.text: Her wisest ladies make answer, indeed, she answers the question herself:

verses.english:
“They must be dividing the spoil they have found: A damsel or two
for each man, Spoil of dyed cloths for Sisera, Spoil of
embroidered cloths, A couple of embroidered cloths Round every
neck as spoil.”
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יִמְצְאוּ יְחַלְּקוּ שָׁלָל רַחַם רַחֲמָתַיִם לְרֹאשׁ גֶּבֶר שְׁלַל צְבָעִים לְסִיסְרָא שְׁלַל צְבָעִים רִקְמָה צֶבַע רִקְמָתַיִם לְצַוְּארֵי שָׁלָל׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא יִמְצְאוּ יְחַלְּקוּ שָׁלָל רַחַם רַחֲמָתַיִם לְרֹאשׁ גֶּבֶר שְׁלַל צְבָעִים לְסִיסְרָא שְׁלַל צְבָעִים רִקְמָה צֶבַע רִקְמָתַיִם לְצַוְּארֵי שָׁלָל׃

english.text:
“They must be dividing the spoil they have found: A damsel or two
for each man, Spoil of dyed cloths for Sisera, Spoil of
embroidered cloths, A couple of embroidered cloths Round every
neck as spoil.”

translation.text: 'Are they not finding and dividing the spoil? — A girl or two for every man;

verses.english:
So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may His friends be as
the sun rising in might! And the land was tranquil forty years.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ כל־אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהֹוָה וְאֹהֲבָיו כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָתוֹ וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ כל־אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהֹוָה וְאֹהֲבָיו כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָתוֹ וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may His friends be as
the sun rising in might! And the land was tranquil forty years.

translation.text: "So perish all your enemies, O LORD! But may your friends be like the sun as it rises in its might." And the land had rest forty years.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Midianites for seven years.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Midianites for seven years.

translation.text: The Israelites did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD gave them into the hand of Midian seven years.

verses.english:
The hand of the Midianites prevailed over Israel; and because of
Midian, the Israelites provided themselves with refuges in the
caves and strongholds of the mountains.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּעז יַד־מִדְיָן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּנְהָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֶּהָרִים וְאֶת־הַמְּעָרוֹת וְאֶת־הַמְּצָדוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּעז יַד־מִדְיָן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּנְהָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֶּהָרִים וְאֶת־הַמְּעָרוֹת וְאֶת־הַמְּצָדוֹת׃

english.text:
The hand of the Midianites prevailed over Israel; and because of
Midian, the Israelites provided themselves with refuges in the
caves and strongholds of the mountains.

translation.text: The hand of Midian prevailed over Israel; and because of Midian the Israelites provided for themselves hiding places in the mountains, caves and strongholds.

verses.english:
After the Israelites had done their sowing, Midian, Amalek, and
the Kedemites would come up and raid them;
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־זָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָלָה מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְעָלוּ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם־זָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָלָה מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְעָלוּ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
After the Israelites had done their sowing, Midian, Amalek, and
the Kedemites would come up and raid them;

translation.text: For and the people of the east would come up against them.

verses.english:
they would attack them, destroy the produce of the land all the
way to Gaza, and leave no means of sustenance in Israel, not a
sheep or an ox or an ass.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ אֶת־יְבוּל הָאָרֶץ עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ עַזָּה וְלֹא־יַשְׁאִירוּ מִחְיָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֶׂה וָשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ אֶת־יְבוּל הָאָרֶץ עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ עַזָּה וְלֹא־יַשְׁאִירוּ מִחְיָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֶׂה וָשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר׃

english.text:
they would attack them, destroy the produce of the land all the
way to Gaza, and leave no means of sustenance in Israel, not a
sheep or an ox or an ass.

translation.text: They would or ox or donkey.

verses.english:
For they would come up with their livestock and their tents,
swarming as thick as locusts; they and their camels were
innumerable. Thus they would invade the land and ravage it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הֵם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם יַעֲלוּ וְאהֳלֵיהֶם (יבאו) [וּבָאוּ] כְדֵי־אַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלָהֶם וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר וַיָּבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הֵם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם יַעֲלוּ וְאהֳלֵיהֶם (יבאו) [וּבָאוּ] כְדֵי־אַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלָהֶם וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר וַיָּבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃

english.text:
For they would come up with their livestock and their tents,
swarming as thick as locusts; they and their camels were
innumerable. Thus they would invade the land and ravage it.

translation.text: For they and their livestock would come up, and they would even bring their tents, as thick as locusts; neither they nor their camels could be counted; so they wasted the land as they came in.

verses.english:
Israel was reduced to utter misery by the Midianites, and the
Israelites cried out to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדַּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Israel was reduced to utter misery by the Midianites, and the
Israelites cried out to YHWH.

translation.text: Thus Israel was greatly impoverished because of Midian; and the Israelites cried out to the LORD for help.

verses.english: When the Israelites cried to YHWH on account of Midian,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־זָעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה עַל אֹדוֹת מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־זָעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה עַל אֹדוֹת מִדְיָן׃

english.text: When the Israelites cried to YHWH on account of Midian,

translation.text: When the Israelites cried to the LORD on account of the Midianites,

verses.english:
YHWH sent a prophet to the Israelites who said to them, “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I brought you up out of Egypt and freed
you from the house of bondage.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אִישׁ נָבִיא אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִבֵּית
עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אִישׁ נָבִיא אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִבֵּית
עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
YHWH sent a prophet to the Israelites who said to them, “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I brought you up out of Egypt and freed
you from the house of bondage.

translation.text: you out of the house of slavery;

verses.english:
I rescued you from the Egyptians and from all your oppressors; I
drove them out before you, and gave you their land.
verses.hebrew: וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־לֹחֲצֵיכֶם וָאֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וָאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת־אַרְצָם׃

hebrew.text: וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־לֹחֲצֵיכֶם וָאֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וָאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת־אַרְצָם׃

english.text:
I rescued you from the Egyptians and from all your oppressors; I
drove them out before you, and gave you their land.

translation.text: and I delivered you from the hand of them out before you, and gave you their land;

verses.english:
And I said to you, ‘I YHWH am your God. You must not worship the
gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not
obey Me.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִירְאוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יוֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמְרָה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִירְאוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יוֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי׃

english.text:
And I said to you, ‘I YHWH am your God. You must not worship the
gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not
obey Me.”

translation.text: and I said to you, 'I voice."

verses.english:
An angel of YHWH came and sat under the terebinth at Ophrah, which
belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was then beating
out wheat inside a winepress in order to keep it safe from the
Midianites.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעפְרָה אֲשֶׁר לְיוֹאָשׁ אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי וְגִדְעוֹן בְּנוֹ חֹבֵט חִטִּים בַּגַּת לְהָנִיס מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעפְרָה אֲשֶׁר לְיוֹאָשׁ אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי וְגִדְעוֹן בְּנוֹ חֹבֵט חִטִּים בַּגַּת לְהָנִיס מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
An angel of YHWH came and sat under the terebinth at Ophrah, which
belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was then beating
out wheat inside a winepress in order to keep it safe from the
Midianites.

translation.text: Now the angel of the LORD came and sat under the oak at Ophrah, out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH appeared to him and said to him, “YHWH is with
you, valiant warrior!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה עִמְּךָ גִּבּוֹר הֶחָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה עִמְּךָ גִּבּוֹר הֶחָיִל׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH appeared to him and said to him, “YHWH is with
you, valiant warrior!”

translation.text: The you, you mighty warrior."

verses.english:
Gideon said to him, “Please, my lord, if YHWH is with us, why has
all this befallen us? Where are all His wondrous deeds about which
our fathers told us, saying, ‘Truly YHWH brought us up from
Egypt’? Now YHWH has abandoned us and delivered us into the hands
of Midian!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גִּדְעוֹן בִּי אֲדֹנִי וְיֵשׁ יְהֹוָה עִמָּנוּ וְלָמָּה מְצָאַתְנוּ כּל־זֹאת וְאַיֵּה כל־נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֵאמֹר הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם
הֶעֱלָנוּ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה נְטָשָׁנוּ יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵנוּ בְּכַף־מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גִּדְעוֹן בִּי אֲדֹנִי וְיֵשׁ יְהֹוָה עִמָּנוּ וְלָמָּה מְצָאַתְנוּ כּל־זֹאת וְאַיֵּה כל־נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֵאמֹר הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם
הֶעֱלָנוּ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה נְטָשָׁנוּ יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵנוּ בְּכַף־מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
Gideon said to him, “Please, my lord, if YHWH is with us, why has
all this befallen us? Where are all His wondrous deeds about which
our fathers told us, saying, ‘Truly YHWH brought us up from
Egypt’? Now YHWH has abandoned us and delivered us into the hands
of Midian!”

translation.text: Gideon answered him, "But sir, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? And where are all his and given us into the hand of Midian."

verses.english:
YHWH turned to him and said, “Go in this strength of yours and
deliver Israel from the Midianites. I herewith make you My
messenger.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ בְּכֹחֲךָ זֶה וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכַּף מִדְיָן הֲלֹא שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ בְּכֹחֲךָ זֶה וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכַּף מִדְיָן הֲלֹא שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH turned to him and said, “Go in this strength of yours and
deliver Israel from the Midianites. I herewith make you My
messenger.”

translation.text: Then the LORD turned to him and said, "Go in this might of yours and deliver Israel from the hand of Midian; I hereby commission you."

verses.english:
He said to Him, “Please, my lord, how can I deliver Israel? Why,
my clan is the humblest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my
father’s household.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בִּי אֲדֹנָי בַּמָּה אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אַלְפִּי הַדַּל בִּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאָנֹכִי הַצָּעִיר בְּבֵית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בִּי אֲדֹנָי בַּמָּה אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אַלְפִּי הַדַּל בִּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאָנֹכִי הַצָּעִיר בְּבֵית אָבִי׃

english.text:
He said to Him, “Please, my lord, how can I deliver Israel? Why,
my clan is the humblest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my
father’s household.”

translation.text: He responded, "But sir, how can I deliver Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my family."

verses.english:
YHWH replied, “I will be with you, and you shall defeat Midian to
a man.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־מִדְיָן כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־מִדְיָן כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

english.text:
YHWH replied, “I will be with you, and you shall defeat Midian to
a man.”

translation.text: The LORD said to him, "But I will be with you, and you shall strike down the Midianites, every one of them."

verses.english:
And he said to Him, “If I have gained Your favor, give me a sign
that it is You who are speaking to me:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לִּי אוֹת שָׁאַתָּה מְדַבֵּר עִמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לִּי אוֹת שָׁאַתָּה מְדַבֵּר עִמִּי׃

english.text:
And he said to Him, “If I have gained Your favor, give me a sign
that it is You who are speaking to me:

translation.text: Then he said it is you who speak with me.

verses.english:
do not leave this place until I come back to You and bring out my
offering and place it before You.” And He answered, “I will stay
until you return.”
verses.hebrew: אַל־נָא תָמֻשׁ מִזֶּה עַד־בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהֹצֵאתִי אֶת־מִנְחָתִי וְהִנַּחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֵשֵׁב עַד שׁוּבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַל־נָא תָמֻשׁ מִזֶּה עַד־בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהֹצֵאתִי אֶת־מִנְחָתִי וְהִנַּחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֵשֵׁב עַד שׁוּבֶךָ׃

english.text:
do not leave this place until I come back to You and bring out my
offering and place it before You.” And He answered, “I will stay
until you return.”

translation.text: Do not depart from here until I come "I will stay until you return."

verses.english:
So Gideon went in and prepared a kid, and [baked] unleavened bread
from an ephah of flour. He put the meat in a basket and poured the
broth into a pot, and he brought them out to Him under the
terebinth. As he presented them,
verses.hebrew: וְגִדְעוֹן בָּא וַיַּעַשׂ גְּדִי־עִזִּים וְאֵיפַת־קֶמַח מַצּוֹת הַבָּשָׂר שָׂם בַּסַּל וְהַמָּרַק שָׂם בַּפָּרוּר וַיּוֹצֵא אֵלָיו אֶל־תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיַּגַּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְגִדְעוֹן בָּא וַיַּעַשׂ גְּדִי־עִזִּים וְאֵיפַת־קֶמַח מַצּוֹת הַבָּשָׂר שָׂם בַּסַּל וְהַמָּרַק שָׂם בַּפָּרוּר וַיּוֹצֵא אֵלָיו אֶל־תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיַּגַּשׁ׃

english.text:
So Gideon went in and prepared a kid, and [baked] unleavened bread
from an ephah of flour. He put the meat in a basket and poured the
broth into a pot, and he brought them out to Him under the
terebinth. As he presented them,

translation.text: So Gideon went into his house and prepared a kid, and unleavened presented them.

verses.english:
the angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened
bread, put them on yonder rock, and spill out the broth.” He did
so.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים קַח אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת וְהַנַּח אֶל־הַסֶּלַע הַלָּז וְאֶת־הַמָּרַק שְׁפוֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים קַח אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת וְהַנַּח אֶל־הַסֶּלַע הַלָּז וְאֶת־הַמָּרַק שְׁפוֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

english.text:
the angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened
bread, put them on yonder rock, and spill out the broth.” He did
so.

translation.text: The angel of God said to him, "Take the meat and broth." And he did so.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH held out the staff that he carried, and touched
the meat and the unleavened bread with its tip. A fire sprang up
from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread. And
the angel of YHWH vanished from his sight.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־קְצֵה הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּע בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַמַּצּוֹת וַתַּעַל הָאֵשׁ מִן־הַצּוּר וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת
וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הָלַךְ מֵעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־קְצֵה הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּע בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַמַּצּוֹת וַתַּעַל הָאֵשׁ מִן־הַצּוּר וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת
וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הָלַךְ מֵעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH held out the staff that he carried, and touched
the meat and the unleavened bread with its tip. A fire sprang up
from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread. And
the angel of YHWH vanished from his sight.

translation.text: Then the angel of the LORD reached out the from his sight.

verses.english:
Then Gideon realized that it was an angel of YHWH; and Gideon
said, “Alas, O Lord GOD! For I have seen an angel of YHWH face to
face.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא גִּדְעוֹן כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה כִּי־עַל־כֵּן רָאִיתִי מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא גִּדְעוֹן כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה כִּי־עַל־כֵּן רָאִיתִי מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃

english.text:
Then Gideon realized that it was an angel of YHWH; and Gideon
said, “Alas, O Lord GOD! For I have seen an angel of YHWH face to
face.”

translation.text: Then Gideon perceived that it was the angel of the of the LORD face to face."

verses.english:
But YHWH said to him, “All is well; have no fear, you shall not
die.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם לְךָ אַל־תִּירָא לֹא תָּמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם לְךָ אַל־תִּירָא לֹא תָּמוּת׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to him, “All is well; have no fear, you shall not
die.”

translation.text: But the LORD said to him, "Peace be to you; do not fear, you shall not die."

verses.english:
So Gideon built there an altar to YHWH and called it
Adonai-shalom. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם גִּדְעוֹן מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עוֹדֶנּוּ בְּעפְרָת אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם גִּדְעוֹן מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עוֹדֶנּוּ בְּעפְרָת אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃

english.text:
So Gideon built there an altar to YHWH and called it
Adonai-shalom. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

translation.text: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it, The LORD is peace. To this day it still stands at Ophrah, which belongs to the Abiezrites.

verses.english:
That night YHWH said to him: “Take the young bull belonging to
your father and another bull seven years old; pull down the altar
of Baal which belongs to your father, and cut down the sacred post
which is beside it.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה קַח אֶת־פַּר־הַשּׁוֹר אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ וּפַר הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְהָרַסְתָּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ
וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו תִּכְרֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה קַח אֶת־פַּר־הַשּׁוֹר אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ וּפַר הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְהָרַסְתָּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ
וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו תִּכְרֹת׃

english.text:
That night YHWH said to him: “Take the young bull belonging to
your father and another bull seven years old; pull down the altar
of Baal which belongs to your father, and cut down the sacred post
which is beside it.

translation.text: That night the LORD said to him, "Take your father's bull, the second your father, and cut down the sacred pole that is beside it;

verses.english:
Then build an altar to YHWH your God, on the level ground on top
of this stronghold. Take the other bull and offer it as a burnt
offering, using the wood of the sacred post that you have cut
down.”
verses.hebrew: וּבָנִיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל רֹאשׁ הַמָּעוֹז הַזֶּה בַּמַּעֲרָכָה וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי וְהַעֲלִיתָ עוֹלָה בַּעֲצֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּכְרֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּבָנִיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל רֹאשׁ הַמָּעוֹז הַזֶּה בַּמַּעֲרָכָה וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי וְהַעֲלִיתָ עוֹלָה בַּעֲצֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּכְרֹת׃

english.text:
Then build an altar to YHWH your God, on the level ground on top
of this stronghold. Take the other bull and offer it as a burnt
offering, using the wood of the sacred post that you have cut
down.”

translation.text: and build proper order; then take the second bull, and offer it as a burnt offering with the wood of the sacred pole that you shall cut down."

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח גִּדְעוֹן עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרֵא אֶת־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר מֵעֲשׂוֹת יוֹמָם
וַיַּעַשׂ לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח גִּדְעוֹן עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרֵא אֶת־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר מֵעֲשׂוֹת יוֹמָם
וַיַּעַשׂ לָיְלָה׃

translation.text: So by day, he did it by night.

verses.english:
Early the next morning, the townspeople found that the altar of
Baal had been torn down and the sacred post beside it had been cut
down, and that the second bull had been offered on the newly built
altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה נֻתַּץ מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְהָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו כֹּרָתָה וְאֵת הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי הֹעֲלָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַבָּנוּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה נֻתַּץ מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְהָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו כֹּרָתָה וְאֵת הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי הֹעֲלָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַבָּנוּי׃

english.text:
Early the next morning, the townspeople found that the altar of
Baal had been torn down and the sacred post beside it had been cut
down, and that the second bull had been offered on the newly built
altar.

translation.text: When the townspeople rose early in the morning, the altar of Baal second bull was offered on the altar that had been built.

verses.english:
They said to one another, “Who did this thing?” Upon inquiry and
investigation, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did this
thing!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּדְרְשׁוּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּדְרְשׁוּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
They said to one another, “Who did this thing?” Upon inquiry and
investigation, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did this
thing!”

translation.text: So they inquiring, they were told, "Gideon son of Joash did it."

verses.english:
The townspeople said to Joash, “Bring out your son, for he must
die: he has torn down the altar of Baal and cut down the sacred
post beside it!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־יוֹאָשׁ הוֹצֵא אֶת־בִּנְךָ וְיָמֹת כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְכִי כָרַת הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־יוֹאָשׁ הוֹצֵא אֶת־בִּנְךָ וְיָמֹת כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְכִי כָרַת הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃

english.text:
The townspeople said to Joash, “Bring out your son, for he must
die: he has torn down the altar of Baal and cut down the sacred
post beside it!”

translation.text: Then the townspeople said to Joash, "Bring out your son, so that he may die, for beside it."

verses.english:
But Joash said to all who had risen against him, “Do you have to
contend for Baal? Do you have to vindicate him? Whoever fights his
