have you come here now to fight against me?”
verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה כִּי־אֵינְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ וָאָשִׂימָה נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי וָאֶעְבְּרָה אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְלָמָה עֲלִיתֶם אֵלַי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶרְאֶה כִּי־אֵינְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ וָאָשִׂימָה נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי וָאֶעְבְּרָה אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְלָמָה עֲלִיתֶם אֵלַי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי׃

english.text:
When I saw that you were no saviors, I risked my life and advanced
against the Ammonites; and YHWH delivered them into my hands. Why
have you come here now to fight against me?”

translation.text: When I saw that you would not deliver me, I took my life in my fight against me?"

verses.english:
And Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought the
Ephraimites. The men of Gilead defeated the Ephraimites; for they
had said, “You Gileadites are nothing but fugitives from
Ephraim—being in Manasseh is like being in Ephraim.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ יִפְתָּח אֶת־כּל־אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד וַיִּלָּחֶם אֶת־אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּכּוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד אֶת־אֶפְרַיִם כִּי אָמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אַתֶּם גִּלְעָד בְּתוֹךְ אֶפְרַיִם
בְּתוֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ יִפְתָּח אֶת־כּל־אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד וַיִּלָּחֶם אֶת־אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּכּוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד אֶת־אֶפְרַיִם כִּי אָמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אַתֶּם גִּלְעָד בְּתוֹךְ אֶפְרַיִם
בְּתוֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought the
Ephraimites. The men of Gilead defeated the Ephraimites; for they
had said, “You Gileadites are nothing but fugitives from
Ephraim—being in Manasseh is like being in Ephraim.”

translation.text: Then Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead in the heart of Ephraim and Manasseh."

verses.english:
The Gileadites held the fords of the Jordan against the
Ephraimites. And when any fugitive from Ephraim said, “Let me
cross,” the men of Gilead would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?”;
if he said “No,”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד גִּלְעָד אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְאֶפְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֶעֱבֹרָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי־גִלְעָד הַאֶפְרָתִי אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד גִּלְעָד אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְאֶפְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֶעֱבֹרָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי־גִלְעָד הַאֶפְרָתִי אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

english.text:
The Gileadites held the fords of the Jordan against the
Ephraimites. And when any fugitive from Ephraim said, “Let me
cross,” the men of Gilead would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?”;
if he said “No,”

translation.text: Then the Gileadites took the say to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" When he said, "No,"

verses.english:
they would say to him, “Then say shibboleth”; but he would say
“sibboleth,” not being able to pronounce it correctly. Thereupon
they would seize him and slay him by the fords of the Jordan.
Forty-two thousand Ephraimites fell at that time.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֱמר־נָא שִׁבֹּלֶת וַיֹּאמֶר סִבֹּלֶת וְלֹא יָכִין לְדַבֵּר כֵּן וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיִּשְׁחָטוּהוּ אֶל־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּפֹּל בָּעֵת הַהִיא מֵאֶפְרַיִם
אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֱמר־נָא שִׁבֹּלֶת וַיֹּאמֶר סִבֹּלֶת וְלֹא יָכִין לְדַבֵּר כֵּן וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיִּשְׁחָטוּהוּ אֶל־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּפֹּל בָּעֵת הַהִיא מֵאֶפְרַיִם
אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אָלֶף׃

english.text:
they would say to him, “Then say shibboleth”; but he would say
“sibboleth,” not being able to pronounce it correctly. Thereupon
they would seize him and slay him by the fords of the Jordan.
Forty-two thousand Ephraimites fell at that time.

translation.text: they said fords of the Jordan. Forty-two thousand of the Ephraimites fell at that time.

verses.english:
Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died
and he was buried in one of the towns of Gilead.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט יִפְתָּח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּמת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעָרֵי גִלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט יִפְתָּח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּמת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעָרֵי גִלְעָד׃

english.text:
Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died
and he was buried in one of the towns of Gilead.

translation.text: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in his town in Gilead.

verses.english: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִבְצָן מִבֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִבְצָן מִבֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.

translation.text: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

verses.english:
He had thirty sons, and he married off thirty daughters outside
the clan and brought in thirty girls from outside the clan for his
sons. He led Israel seven years.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת שִׁלַּח הַחוּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת הֵבִיא לְבָנָיו מִן־הַחוּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת שִׁלַּח הַחוּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת הֵבִיא לְבָנָיו מִן־הַחוּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
He had thirty sons, and he married off thirty daughters outside
the clan and brought in thirty girls from outside the clan for his
sons. He led Israel seven years.

translation.text: He had thirty sons. He years.

verses.english: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת אִבְצָן וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת אִבְצָן וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵית לָחֶם׃

english.text: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

translation.text: Then Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

verses.english:
After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel; he led Israel for ten
years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel; he led Israel for ten
years.

translation.text: After him Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

verses.english:
Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried in Aijalon, in the
territory of Zebulun.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּאַיָּלוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ זְבוּלֻן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּאַיָּלוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ זְבוּלֻן׃

english.text:
Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried in Aijalon, in the
territory of Zebulun.

translation.text: Then Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried at Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

verses.english: After him, Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite led Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי׃

english.text: After him, Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite led Israel.

translation.text: After him Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

verses.english:
He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy
jackasses. He led Israel for eight years.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בְּנֵי בָנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שִׁבְעִים עֲיָרִם וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בְּנֵי בָנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שִׁבְעִים עֲיָרִם וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy
jackasses. He led Israel for eight years.

translation.text: He judged Israel eight years.

verses.english:
Then Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite died. He was buried in
Pirathon, in the territory of Ephraim, on the hill of the
Amalekites.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם בְּהַר הָעֲמָלֵקִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם בְּהַר הָעֲמָלֵקִי׃

english.text:
Then Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite died. He was buried in
Pirathon, in the territory of Ephraim, on the hill of the
Amalekites.

translation.text: Then Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite country of the Amalekites.

verses.english:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִיפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִיפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

translation.text: The Israelites again did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD gave them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

verses.english:
There was a certain man from Zorah, of the stock of Dan, whose
name was Manoah. His wife was barren and had borne no children.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִצּרְעָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי וּשְׁמוֹ מָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלָדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִצּרְעָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי וּשְׁמוֹ מָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלָדָה׃

english.text:
There was a certain man from Zorah, of the stock of Dan, whose
name was Manoah. His wife was barren and had borne no children.

translation.text: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the tribe of the Danites, whose name was Manoah. His wife was barren, having borne no children.

verses.english:
An angel of YHWH appeared to the woman and said to her, “You are
barren and have borne no children; but you shall conceive and bear
a son.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה־נָא אַתְּ־עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלַדְתְּ וְהָרִית וְיָלַדְתְּ בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה־נָא אַתְּ־עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלַדְתְּ וְהָרִית וְיָלַדְתְּ בֵּן׃

english.text:
An angel of YHWH appeared to the woman and said to her, “You are
barren and have borne no children; but you shall conceive and bear
a son.

translation.text: conceive and bear a son.

verses.english:
Now be careful not to drink wine or other intoxicant, or to eat
anything unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמְרִי נָא וְאַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כּל־טָמֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמְרִי נָא וְאַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כּל־טָמֵא׃

english.text:
Now be careful not to drink wine or other intoxicant, or to eat
anything unclean.

translation.text: Now be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, or to eat anything unclean,

verses.english:
For you are going to conceive and bear a son; let no razor touch
his head, for the boy is to be a nazirite to God from the womb on.
He shall be the first to deliver Israel from the Philistines.”

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַעֲלוֹת הַלַּהַב מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה בְּלַהַב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
As the flames leaped up from the altar toward the sky, the angel
of YHWH ascended in the flames of the altar, while Manoah and his
wife looked on; and they flung themselves on their faces to the
ground.—

translation.text: When the flame they fell on their faces to the ground.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH never appeared again to Manoah and his
wife.—Manoah then realized that it had been an angel of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָסַף עוֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה לְהֵרָאֹה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ וְאֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ אָז יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָסַף עוֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה לְהֵרָאֹה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ וְאֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ אָז יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH never appeared again to Manoah and his
wife.—Manoah then realized that it had been an angel of YHWH.

translation.text: The angel of the LORD did not was the angel of the LORD.

verses.english:
And Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, for we have
seen a divine being.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת נָמוּת כִּי אֱלֹהִים רָאִינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת נָמוּת כִּי אֱלֹהִים רָאִינוּ׃

english.text:
And Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, for we have
seen a divine being.”

translation.text: And Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, for we have seen God."

verses.english:
But his wife said to him, “Had YHWH meant to take our lives, He
would not have accepted a burnt offering and meal offering from
us, nor let us see all these things; and He would not have made
such an announcement to us.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ לוּ חָפֵץ יְהֹוָה לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ לֹא־לָקַח מִיָּדֵנוּ עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְלֹא הֶרְאָנוּ אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה וְכָעֵת לֹא הִשְׁמִיעָנוּ כָּזֹאת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ לוּ חָפֵץ יְהֹוָה לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ לֹא־לָקַח מִיָּדֵנוּ עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְלֹא הֶרְאָנוּ אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה וְכָעֵת לֹא הִשְׁמִיעָנוּ כָּזֹאת׃

english.text:
But his wife said to him, “Had YHWH meant to take our lives, He
would not have accepted a burnt offering and meal offering from
us, nor let us see all these things; and He would not have made
such an announcement to us.”

translation.text: But his wife said to him, "If the and a grain offering at our hands, or shown us all these things, or now announced to us such things as these."

verses.english:
The woman bore a son, and she named him Samson. The boy grew up,
and YHWH blessed him.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד הָאִשָּׁה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד הָאִשָּׁה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The woman bore a son, and she named him Samson. The boy grew up,
and YHWH blessed him.

translation.text: The woman bore a son, and named him Samson. The boy grew, and the LORD blessed him.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH first moved him in the encampment of Dan,
between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּחֶל רוּחַ יְהֹוָה לְפַעֲמוֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־דָן בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּחֶל רוּחַ יְהֹוָה לְפַעֲמוֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־דָן בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH first moved him in the encampment of Dan,
between Zorah and Eshtaol.

translation.text: The spirit of the LORD began to stir him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.english:
Once Samson went down to Timnah; and while in Timnah, he noticed a
girl among the Philistine women.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן תִּמְנָתָה וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה בְּתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן תִּמְנָתָה וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה בְּתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Once Samson went down to Timnah; and while in Timnah, he noticed a
girl among the Philistine women.

translation.text: Once Samson went down to Timnah, and at Timnah he saw a Philistine woman.

verses.english:
On his return, he told his father and mother, “I noticed one of
the Philistine women in Timnah; please get her for me as a wife.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל וַיַּגֵּד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אִשָּׁה רָאִיתִי בְתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־אוֹתָהּ לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל וַיַּגֵּד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אִשָּׁה רָאִיתִי בְתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־אוֹתָהּ לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
On his return, he told his father and mother, “I noticed one of
the Philistine women in Timnah; please get her for me as a wife.”

translation.text: Then he came up, and told his father and mother, "I saw a Philistine woman at Timnah; now get her for me as my wife."

verses.english:
His father and mother said to him, “Is there no one among the
daughters of your own kinsmen and among all our people, that you
must go and take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?” But
Samson answered his father, “Get me that one, for she is the one
that pleases me.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ הַאֵין בִּבְנוֹת אַחֶיךָ וּבְכל־עַמִּי אִשָּׁה כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ לָקַחַת אִשָּׁה מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָעֲרֵלִים וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־אָבִיו אוֹתָהּ
קַח־לִי כִּי־הִיא יָשְׁרָה בְעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ הַאֵין בִּבְנוֹת אַחֶיךָ וּבְכל־עַמִּי אִשָּׁה כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ לָקַחַת אִשָּׁה מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָעֲרֵלִים וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־אָבִיו אוֹתָהּ
קַח־לִי כִּי־הִיא יָשְׁרָה בְעֵינָי׃

english.text:
His father and mother said to him, “Is there no one among the
daughters of your own kinsmen and among all our people, that you
must go and take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?” But
Samson answered his father, “Get me that one, for she is the one
that pleases me.”

translation.text: But his father and mother said to him, "Is there not a woman among "Get her for me, because she pleases me."

verses.english:
His father and mother did not realize that this was YHWH’s doing:
He was seeking a pretext against the Philistines, for the
Philistines were ruling over Israel at that time.
verses.hebrew: וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הִיא כִּי־תֹאֲנָה הוּא־מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבָעֵת הַהִיא פְּלִשְׁתִּים מֹשְׁלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הִיא כִּי־תֹאֲנָה הוּא־מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבָעֵת הַהִיא פְּלִשְׁתִּים מֹשְׁלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
His father and mother did not realize that this was YHWH’s doing:
He was seeking a pretext against the Philistines, for the
Philistines were ruling over Israel at that time.

translation.text: His father and mother did over Israel.

verses.english:
So Samson and his father and mother went down to Timnah. When he
came to the vineyards of Timnah [for the first time], a full-grown
lion came roaring at him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ תִּמְנָתָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־כַּרְמֵי תִמְנָתָה וְהִנֵּה כְּפִיר אֲרָיוֹת שֹׁאֵג לִקְרָאתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ תִּמְנָתָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־כַּרְמֵי תִמְנָתָה וְהִנֵּה כְּפִיר אֲרָיוֹת שֹׁאֵג לִקְרָאתוֹ׃

english.text:
So Samson and his father and mother went down to Timnah. When he
came to the vineyards of Timnah [for the first time], a full-grown
lion came roaring at him.

translation.text: Then Samson went down with his father and mother to Timnah. roared at him.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him, and he tore him asunder with his
bare hands as one might tear a kid asunder; but he did not tell
his father and mother what he had done.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁסְּעֵהוּ כְּשַׁסַּע הַגְּדִי וּמְאוּמָה אֵין בְּיָדוֹ וְלֹא הִגִּיד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁסְּעֵהוּ כְּשַׁסַּע הַגְּדִי וּמְאוּמָה אֵין בְּיָדוֹ וְלֹא הִגִּיד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him, and he tore him asunder with his
bare hands as one might tear a kid asunder; but he did not tell
his father and mother what he had done.

translation.text: The spirit of the LORD rushed on him, and he tore the lion apart barehanded as one might tear apart a kid. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.english: Then he went down and spoke to the woman, and she pleased Samson.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד וַיְדַבֵּר לָאִשָּׁה וַתִּישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד וַיְדַבֵּר לָאִשָּׁה וַתִּישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

english.text: Then he went down and spoke to the woman, and she pleased Samson.

translation.text: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson.

verses.english:
Returning the following year to marry her, he turned aside to look
at the remains of the lion; and in the lion’s skeleton he found a
swarm of bees, and honey.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב מִיָּמִים לְקַחְתָּהּ וַיָּסַר לִרְאוֹת אֵת מַפֶּלֶת הָאַרְיֵה וְהִנֵּה עֲדַת דְּבוֹרִים בִּגְוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב מִיָּמִים לְקַחְתָּהּ וַיָּסַר לִרְאוֹת אֵת מַפֶּלֶת הָאַרְיֵה וְהִנֵּה עֲדַת דְּבוֹרִים בִּגְוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
Returning the following year to marry her, he turned aside to look
at the remains of the lion; and in the lion’s skeleton he found a
swarm of bees, and honey.

translation.text: After a while he lion, and there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

verses.english:
He scooped it into his palms and ate it as he went along. When he
rejoined his father and mother, he gave them some and they ate it;
but he did not tell them that he had scooped the honey out of a
lion’s skeleton.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֵּהוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְאָכֹל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־אָבִיו וְאֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וְלֹא־הִגִּיד לָהֶם כִּי מִגְּוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה רָדָה הַדְּבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֵּהוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְאָכֹל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־אָבִיו וְאֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וְלֹא־הִגִּיד לָהֶם כִּי מִגְּוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה רָדָה הַדְּבָשׁ׃

english.text:
He scooped it into his palms and ate it as he went along. When he
rejoined his father and mother, he gave them some and they ate it;
but he did not tell them that he had scooped the honey out of a
lion’s skeleton.

translation.text: He scraped it out into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. the carcass of the lion.

verses.english:
So his father came down to the woman, and Samson made a feast
there, as young men used to do.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד אָבִיהוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ שָׁם שִׁמְשׁוֹן מִשְׁתֶּה כִּי כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ הַבַּחוּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד אָבִיהוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ שָׁם שִׁמְשׁוֹן מִשְׁתֶּה כִּי כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ הַבַּחוּרִים׃

english.text:
So his father came down to the woman, and Samson made a feast
there, as young men used to do.

translation.text: His father went down to the woman, and Samson made a feast there as the young men were accustomed to do.

verses.english:
When they saw him, they designated thirty companions to be with
him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם אוֹתוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵרֵעִים וַיִּהְיוּ אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם אוֹתוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵרֵעִים וַיִּהְיוּ אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
When they saw him, they designated thirty companions to be with
him.

translation.text: When the people saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אָחוּדָה־נָּא לָכֶם חִידָה אִם־הַגֵּד תַּגִּידוּ אוֹתָהּ לִי שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וּמְצָאתֶם וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים
חֲלִפֹת בְּגָדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אָחוּדָה־נָּא לָכֶם חִידָה אִם־הַגֵּד תַּגִּידוּ אוֹתָהּ לִי שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וּמְצָאתֶם וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים
חֲלִפֹת בְּגָדִים׃

translation.text: Samson said to them, "Let me now put a riddle to you. If you can explain it to me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty festal garments.

verses.english:
but if you are not able to tell it to me, you must give me thirty
linen tunics and thirty sets of clothing.” And they said to him,
“Ask your riddle and we will listen.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תוּכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד לִי וּנְתַתֶּם אַתֶּם לִי שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ חוּדָה חִידָתְךָ וְנִשְׁמָעֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־לֹא תוּכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד לִי וּנְתַתֶּם אַתֶּם לִי שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ חוּדָה חִידָתְךָ וְנִשְׁמָעֶנָּה׃

english.text:
but if you are not able to tell it to me, you must give me thirty
linen tunics and thirty sets of clothing.” And they said to him,
“Ask your riddle and we will listen.”

translation.text: But if you and thirty festal garments." So they said to him, "Ask your riddle; let us hear it."

verses.english:
So he said to them: “Out of the eater came something to eat, Out
of the strong came something sweet.” For three days they could not
answer the riddle.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֵהָאֹכֵל יָצָא מַאֲכָל וּמֵעַז יָצָא מָתוֹק וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד הַחִידָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֵהָאֹכֵל יָצָא מַאֲכָל וּמֵעַז יָצָא מָתוֹק וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד הַחִידָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

english.text:
So he said to them: “Out of the eater came something to eat, Out
of the strong came something sweet.” For three days they could not
answer the riddle.

translation.text: He said to them, "Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet." But for three days they could not explain the riddle.

verses.english:
On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Coax your husband
to provide us with the answer to the riddle; else we shall put you
and your father’s household to the fire; have you invited us here
in order to impoverish us?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְאֵשֶׁת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן פַּתִּי אֶת־אִישֵׁךְ וְיַגֶּד־לָנוּ אֶת־הַחִידָה פֶּן־נִשְׂרֹף אוֹתָךְ וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיךְ בָּאֵשׁ הַלְירְשֵׁנוּ
קְרָאתֶם לָנוּ הֲלֹא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְאֵשֶׁת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן פַּתִּי אֶת־אִישֵׁךְ וְיַגֶּד־לָנוּ אֶת־הַחִידָה פֶּן־נִשְׂרֹף אוֹתָךְ וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיךְ בָּאֵשׁ הַלְירְשֵׁנוּ
קְרָאתֶם לָנוּ הֲלֹא׃

english.text:
On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Coax your husband
to provide us with the answer to the riddle; else we shall put you
and your father’s household to the fire; have you invited us here
in order to impoverish us?”

translation.text: On the fourth day they said to Samson's wife, "Coax your husband to explain the riddle to us, or we will burn you and your father's house with fire. Have you invited us here to impoverish us?"

verses.english:
Then Samson’s wife harassed him with tears, and she said, “You
really hate me, you don’t love me. You asked my countrymen a
riddle, and you didn’t tell me the answer.” He replied, “I haven’t
even told my father and mother; shall I tell you?”
verses.hebrew:
וַתֵּבְךְּ אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר רַק־שְׂנֵאתַנִי וְלֹא אֲהַבְתָּנִי הַחִידָה חַדְתָּ לִבְנֵי עַמִּי וְלִי לֹא הִגַּדְתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הִנֵּה לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי לֹא
הִגַּדְתִּי וְלָךְ אַגִּיד׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֵּבְךְּ אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר רַק־שְׂנֵאתַנִי וְלֹא אֲהַבְתָּנִי הַחִידָה חַדְתָּ לִבְנֵי עַמִּי וְלִי לֹא הִגַּדְתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הִנֵּה לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי לֹא
הִגַּדְתִּי וְלָךְ אַגִּיד׃

english.text:
Then Samson’s wife harassed him with tears, and she said, “You
really hate me, you don’t love me. You asked my countrymen a
riddle, and you didn’t tell me the answer.” He replied, “I haven’t
even told my father and mother; shall I tell you?”

translation.text: So Samson's mother. Why should I tell you?"

verses.english:
During the rest of the seven days of the feast she continued to
harass him with her tears, and on the seventh day he told her,
because she nagged him so. And she explained the riddle to her
countrymen.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ כִּי הֱצִיקַתְהוּ וַתַּגֵּד הַחִידָה לִבְנֵי עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ כִּי הֱצִיקַתְהוּ וַתַּגֵּד הַחִידָה לִבְנֵי עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
During the rest of the seven days of the feast she continued to
harass him with her tears, and on the seventh day he told her,
because she nagged him so. And she explained the riddle to her
countrymen.

translation.text: She wept before him the seven days day he told her. Then she explained the riddle to her people.

verses.english:
On the seventh day, before the sunset, the townsmen said to him:
“What is sweeter than honey, And what is stronger than a lion?” He
responded: “Had you not plowed with my heifer, You would not have
guessed my riddle!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַחַרְסָה מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם
חִידָתִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַחַרְסָה מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם
חִידָתִי׃

english.text:
On the seventh day, before the sunset, the townsmen said to him:
“What is sweeter than honey, And what is stronger than a lion?” He
responded: “Had you not plowed with my heifer, You would not have
guessed my riddle!”

translation.text: The "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" you would not have found out my riddle."

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him. He went down to Ashkelon and
killed thirty of its men. He stripped them and gave the sets of
clothing to those who had answered the riddle. And he left in a
rage for his father’s house.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּרֶד אַשְׁקְלוֹן וַיַּךְ מֵהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חֲלִיצוֹתָם וַיִּתֵּן הַחֲלִיפוֹת לְמַגִּידֵי הַחִידָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַיַּעַל
בֵּית אָבִיהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּרֶד אַשְׁקְלוֹן וַיַּךְ מֵהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חֲלִיצוֹתָם וַיִּתֵּן הַחֲלִיפוֹת לְמַגִּידֵי הַחִידָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַיַּעַל
בֵּית אָבִיהוּ׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him. He went down to Ashkelon and
killed thirty of its men. He stripped them and gave the sets of
clothing to those who had answered the riddle. And he left in a
rage for his father’s house.

translation.text: Then the spirit of the LORD rushed on him, and he went down to anger he went back to his father's house.

verses.english:
Samson’s wife then married one of those who had been his wedding
companions.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ אֲשֶׁר רֵעָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ אֲשֶׁר רֵעָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
Samson’s wife then married one of those who had been his wedding
companions.

translation.text: And Samson's wife was given to his companion, who had been his best man.

verses.english:
Some time later, in the season of the wheat harvest, Samson came
to visit his wife, bringing a kid as a gift. He said, “Let me go
into the chamber to my wife.” But her father would not let him go
in.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים בִּימֵי קְצִיר־חִטִּים וַיִּפְקֹד שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ בִּגְדִי עִזִּים וַיֹּאמֶר אָבֹאָה אֶל־אִשְׁתִּי הֶחָדְרָה וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אָבִיהָ לָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים בִּימֵי קְצִיר־חִטִּים וַיִּפְקֹד שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ בִּגְדִי עִזִּים וַיֹּאמֶר אָבֹאָה אֶל־אִשְׁתִּי הֶחָדְרָה וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אָבִיהָ לָבוֹא׃

english.text:
Some time later, in the season of the wheat harvest, Samson came
to visit his wife, bringing a kid as a gift. He said, “Let me go
into the chamber to my wife.” But her father would not let him go
in.

translation.text: After a while, at the time of the wheat harvest, Samson went to visit room." But her father would not allow him to go in.

verses.english:
“I was sure,” said her father, “that you had taken a dislike to
her, so I gave her to your wedding companion. But her younger
sister is more beautiful than she; let her become your wife
instead.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִיהָ אָמֹר אָמַרְתִּי כִּי־שָׂנֹא שְׂנֵאתָהּ וָאֶתְּנֶנָּה לְמֵרֵעֶךָ הֲלֹא אֲחוֹתָהּ הַקְּטַנָּה טוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה תְּהִי־נָא לְךָ תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִיהָ אָמֹר אָמַרְתִּי כִּי־שָׂנֹא שְׂנֵאתָהּ וָאֶתְּנֶנָּה לְמֵרֵעֶךָ הֲלֹא אֲחוֹתָהּ הַקְּטַנָּה טוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה תְּהִי־נָא לְךָ תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
“I was sure,” said her father, “that you had taken a dislike to
her, so I gave her to your wedding companion. But her younger
sister is more beautiful than she; let her become your wife
instead.”

translation.text: Her father said, "I was sure that you had rejected her; so I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister prettier than she? Why not take her instead?"

verses.english:
Thereupon Samson declared, “Now the Philistines can have no claim
against me for the harm I shall do them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן נִקֵּיתִי הַפַּעַם מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־עֹשֶׂה אֲנִי עִמָּם רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן נִקֵּיתִי הַפַּעַם מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־עֹשֶׂה אֲנִי עִמָּם רָעָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon Samson declared, “Now the Philistines can have no claim
against me for the harm I shall do them.”

translation.text: Samson said to them, "This time, when I do mischief to the Philistines, I will be without blame."

verses.english:
Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. He took torches and,
turning [the foxes] tail to tail, he placed a torch between each
pair of tails.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שׁוּעָלִים וַיִּקַּח לַפִּדִים וַיֶּפֶן זָנָב אֶל־זָנָב וַיָּשֶׂם לַפִּיד אֶחָד בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַזְּנָבוֹת בַּתָּוֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שׁוּעָלִים וַיִּקַּח לַפִּדִים וַיֶּפֶן זָנָב אֶל־זָנָב וַיָּשֶׂם לַפִּיד אֶחָד בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַזְּנָבוֹת בַּתָּוֶךְ׃

english.text:
Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. He took torches and,
turning [the foxes] tail to tail, he placed a torch between each
pair of tails.

translation.text: So Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took some torches; and he turned the foxes tail to tail, and put a torch between each pair of tails.

verses.english:
He lit the torches and turned [the foxes] loose among the standing
grain of the Philistines, setting fire to stacked grain, standing
grain, vineyards, [and] olive trees.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּבְעֶר־אֵשׁ בַּלַּפִּידִים וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּקָמוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּבְעֵר מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד־קָמָה וְעַד־כֶּרֶם זָיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבְעֶר־אֵשׁ בַּלַּפִּידִים וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּקָמוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּבְעֵר מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד־קָמָה וְעַד־כֶּרֶם זָיִת׃

english.text:
He lit the torches and turned [the foxes] loose among the standing
grain of the Philistines, setting fire to stacked grain, standing
grain, vineyards, [and] olive trees.

translation.text: When he had set fire to the torches, he let the foxes go into the standing grain of the Philistines, vineyards and olive groves.

verses.english:
The Philistines asked, “Who did this?” And they were told, “It was
Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, who took Samson’s wife and
gave her to his wedding companion.” Thereupon the Philistines came
up and put her and her father to the fire.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים מִי עָשָׂה זֹאת וַיֹּאמְרוּ שִׁמְשׁוֹן חֲתַן הַתִּמְנִי כִּי לָקַח אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים מִי עָשָׂה זֹאת וַיֹּאמְרוּ שִׁמְשׁוֹן חֲתַן הַתִּמְנִי כִּי לָקַח אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The Philistines asked, “Who did this?” And they were told, “It was
Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, who took Samson’s wife and
gave her to his wedding companion.” Thereupon the Philistines came
up and put her and her father to the fire.

translation.text: Then the Philistines asked, "Who has because he has taken Samson's wife and given her to his companion." So the Philistines came up, and burned her and her father.

verses.english:
Samson said to them, “If that is how you act, I will not rest
until I have taken revenge on you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־תַּעֲשׂוּן כָּזֹאת כִּי אִם־נִקַּמְתִּי בָכֶם וְאַחַר אֶחְדָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־תַּעֲשׂוּן כָּזֹאת כִּי אִם־נִקַּמְתִּי בָכֶם וְאַחַר אֶחְדָּל׃

english.text:
Samson said to them, “If that is how you act, I will not rest
until I have taken revenge on you.”

translation.text: Samson said to them, "If this is what you do, I swear I will not stop until I have taken revenge on you."

verses.english:
He gave them a sound and thorough thrashing. Then he went down and
stayed in the cave of the rock of Etam.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ אוֹתָם שׁוֹק עַל־יָרֵךְ מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֵּרֶד וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּסְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ אוֹתָם שׁוֹק עַל־יָרֵךְ מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֵּרֶד וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּסְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם׃

english.text:
He gave them a sound and thorough thrashing. Then he went down and
stayed in the cave of the rock of Etam.

translation.text: He struck them down hip and thigh with of Etam.

verses.english:
The Philistines came up, pitched camp in Judah and spread out over
Lehi.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּיהוּדָה וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בַּלֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּיהוּדָה וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בַּלֶּחִי׃

english.text:
The Philistines came up, pitched camp in Judah and spread out over
Lehi.

translation.text: Then the Philistines came up and encamped in Judah, and made a raid on Lehi.

verses.english:
The men of Judah asked, “Why have you come up against us?” They
answered, “We have come to take Samson prisoner, and to do to him
as he did to us.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לָמָה עֲלִיתֶם עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֶאֱסוֹר אֶת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלִינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לָמָה עֲלִיתֶם עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֶאֱסוֹר אֶת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלִינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָנוּ׃

english.text:
The men of Judah asked, “Why have you come up against us?” They
answered, “We have come to take Samson prisoner, and to do to him
as he did to us.”

translation.text: The men of Judah said, "Why have you come up him as he did to us."

verses.english:
Thereupon three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave of the
rock of Etam, and they said to Samson, “You knew that the
Philistines rule over us; why have you done this to us?” He
replied, “As they did to me, so I did to them.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּרְדוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִיהוּדָה אֶל־סְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן הֲלֹא יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֹשְׁלִים בָּנוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמַה־זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי כֵּן עָשִׂיתִי לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּרְדוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִיהוּדָה אֶל־סְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן הֲלֹא יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֹשְׁלִים בָּנוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמַה־זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי כֵּן עָשִׂיתִי לָהֶם׃

english.text:
Thereupon three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave of the
rock of Etam, and they said to Samson, “You knew that the
Philistines rule over us; why have you done this to us?” He
replied, “As they did to me, so I did to them.”

translation.text: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to us?" He replied, "As they did to me, so I have done to them."

verses.english:
“We have come down,” they told him, “to take you prisoner and to
hand you over to the Philistines.” “But swear to me,” said Samson
to them, “that you yourselves will not attack me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִשָּׁבְעוּ לִי פֶּן־תִּפְגְּעוּן בִּי אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִשָּׁבְעוּ לִי פֶּן־תִּפְגְּעוּן בִּי אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
“We have come down,” they told him, “to take you prisoner and to
hand you over to the Philistines.” “But swear to me,” said Samson
to them, “that you yourselves will not attack me.”

translation.text: "Swear to me that you yourselves will not attack me."

verses.english:
“We won’t,” they replied. “We will only take you prisoner and hand
you over to them; we will not slay you.” So they bound him with
two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא כִּי־אָסֹר נֶאֱסרְךָ וּנְתַנּוּךָ בְיָדָם וְהָמֵת לֹא נְמִיתֶךָ וַיַּאַסְרֻהוּ בִּשְׁנַיִם עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַיַּעֲלוּהוּ מִן־הַסָּלַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא כִּי־אָסֹר נֶאֱסרְךָ וּנְתַנּוּךָ בְיָדָם וְהָמֵת לֹא נְמִיתֶךָ וַיַּאַסְרֻהוּ בִּשְׁנַיִם עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַיַּעֲלוּהוּ מִן־הַסָּלַע׃

english.text:
“We won’t,” they replied. “We will only take you prisoner and hand
you over to them; we will not slay you.” So they bound him with
two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.

translation.text: They said to up from the rock.

verses.english:
When he reached Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him.
Thereupon the spirit of YHWH gripped him, and the ropes on his
arms became like flax that catches fire; the bonds melted off his
hands.
verses.hebrew:
הוּא־בָא עַד־לֶחִי וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הֵרִיעוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַתִּהְיֶינָה הָעֲבֹתִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרוֹעוֹתָיו כַּפִּשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲרוּ בָאֵשׁ
וַיִּמַּסּוּ אֱסוּרָיו מֵעַל יָדָיו׃

hebrew.text:
הוּא־בָא עַד־לֶחִי וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הֵרִיעוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַתִּהְיֶינָה הָעֲבֹתִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרוֹעוֹתָיו כַּפִּשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲרוּ בָאֵשׁ
וַיִּמַּסּוּ אֱסוּרָיו מֵעַל יָדָיו׃

english.text:
When he reached Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him.
Thereupon the spirit of YHWH gripped him, and the ropes on his
arms became like flax that catches fire; the bonds melted off his
hands.

translation.text: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him; his arms became like flax that has caught fire, and his bonds melted off his hands.

verses.english:
He came upon a fresh jawbone of an ass and he picked it up; and
with it he killed a thousand men.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא לְחִי־חֲמוֹר טְרִיָּה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיַּךְ־בָּהּ אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא לְחִי־חֲמוֹר טְרִיָּה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיַּךְ־בָּהּ אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
He came upon a fresh jawbone of an ass and he picked it up; and
with it he killed a thousand men.

translation.text: Then he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached down and took it, and with it he killed a thousand men.

verses.english:
Then Samson said: “With the jaw of an ass, Mass upon mass! With
the jaw of an ass I have slain a thousand men.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר חֲמוֹר חֲמֹרָתָיִם בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר הִכֵּיתִי אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר חֲמוֹר חֲמֹרָתָיִם בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר הִכֵּיתִי אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Then Samson said: “With the jaw of an ass, Mass upon mass! With
the jaw of an ass I have slain a thousand men.”

translation.text: And I have slain a thousand men."

verses.english:
As he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone away; hence that
place was called Ramath-lehi.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ הַלְּחִי מִיָּדוֹ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא רָמַת לֶחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ הַלְּחִי מִיָּדוֹ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא רָמַת לֶחִי׃

english.text:
As he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone away; hence that
place was called Ramath-lehi.

translation.text: When he had finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and that place was called Ramath-lehi.

verses.english:
He was very thirsty and he called to YHWH, “You Yourself have
granted this great victory through Your servant; and must I now
die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְמָא מְאֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אַתָּה נָתַתָּ בְיַד־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַתְּשׁוּעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְעַתָּה אָמוּת בַּצָּמָא וְנָפַלְתִּי בְּיַד הָעֲרֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְמָא מְאֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אַתָּה נָתַתָּ בְיַד־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַתְּשׁוּעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְעַתָּה אָמוּת בַּצָּמָא וְנָפַלְתִּי בְּיַד הָעֲרֵלִים׃

english.text:
He was very thirsty and he called to YHWH, “You Yourself have
granted this great victory through Your servant; and must I now
die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

translation.text: By then he was very thirsty, and he called on the LORD, saying, "You to die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"

verses.english:
So God split open the hollow which is at Lehi, and the water
gushed out of it; he drank, regained his strength, and revived.
That is why it is called to this day “En-hakkore of Lehi.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְקַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַמַּכְתֵּשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בַּלֶּחִי וַיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ וַיֶּחִי עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ עֵין הַקּוֹרֵא אֲשֶׁר בַּלֶּחִי עַד
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבְקַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַמַּכְתֵּשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בַּלֶּחִי וַיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ וַיֶּחִי עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ עֵין הַקּוֹרֵא אֲשֶׁר בַּלֶּחִי עַד
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
So God split open the hollow which is at Lehi, and the water
gushed out of it; he drank, regained his strength, and revived.
That is why it is called to this day “En-hakkore of Lehi.”

translation.text: So God split open the hollow place that is at Lehi, and water came from it. named En-hakkore, which is at Lehi to this day.

verses.english: He led Israel in the days of the Philistines for twenty years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text: He led Israel in the days of the Philistines for twenty years.

translation.text: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

verses.english: Once Samson went to Gaza; there he met a whore and slept with her.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַזָּתָה וַיַּרְא־שָׁם אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַזָּתָה וַיַּרְא־שָׁם אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text: Once Samson went to Gaza; there he met a whore and slept with her.

translation.text: Once Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute and went in to her.

verses.english:
The Gazites [learned] that Samson had come there, so they gathered
and lay in ambush for him in the town gate the whole night; and
all night long they kept whispering to each other, “When daylight
comes, we’ll kill him.”
verses.hebrew: לַעַזָּתִים לֵאמֹר בָּא שִׁמְשׁוֹן הֵנָּה וַיָּסֹבּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־לוֹ כל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה לֵאמֹר עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וַהֲרַגְנֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: לַעַזָּתִים לֵאמֹר בָּא שִׁמְשׁוֹן הֵנָּה וַיָּסֹבּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־לוֹ כל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה לֵאמֹר עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וַהֲרַגְנֻהוּ׃

english.text:
The Gazites [learned] that Samson had come there, so they gathered
and lay in ambush for him in the town gate the whole night; and
all night long they kept whispering to each other, “When daylight
comes, we’ll kill him.”

translation.text: The Gazites were told, "Samson has come here." So they circled quiet all night, thinking, "Let us wait until the light of the morning; then we will kill him."

verses.english:
But Samson lay in bed only till midnight. At midnight he got up,
grasped the doors of the town gate together with the two
gateposts, and pulled them out along with the bar. He placed them
on his shoulders and carried them off to the top of the hill that
is near Hebron.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁכַּב שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־חֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיָּקם בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹז בְּדַלְתוֹת שַׁעַר־הָעִיר וּבִשְׁתֵּי הַמְּזֻזוֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם עִם־הַבְּרִיחַ וַיָּשֶׂם
עַל־כְּתֵפָיו וַיַּעֲלֵם אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁכַּב שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־חֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיָּקם בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹז בְּדַלְתוֹת שַׁעַר־הָעִיר וּבִשְׁתֵּי הַמְּזֻזוֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם עִם־הַבְּרִיחַ וַיָּשֶׂם
עַל־כְּתֵפָיו וַיַּעֲלֵם אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

is near Hebron.

translation.text: But Samson lay only until midnight. Then at carried them to the top of the hill that is in front of Hebron.

verses.english:
After that, he fell in love with a woman in the Wadi Sorek, named
Delilah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֶּאֱהַב אִשָּׁה בְּנַחַל שֹׂרֵק וּשְׁמָהּ דְּלִילָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֶּאֱהַב אִשָּׁה בְּנַחַל שֹׂרֵק וּשְׁמָהּ דְּלִילָה׃

english.text:
After that, he fell in love with a woman in the Wadi Sorek, named
Delilah.

translation.text: After this he fell in love with a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

verses.english:
The lords of the Philistines went up to her and said, “Coax him
and find out what makes him so strong, and how we can overpower
him, tie him up, and make him helpless; and we’ll each give you
eleven hundred shekels of silver.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ פַּתִּי אוֹתוֹ וּרְאִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחוֹ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה נוּכַל לוֹ וַאֲסַרְנוּהוּ לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִתַּן־לָךְ אִישׁ
אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ פַּתִּי אוֹתוֹ וּרְאִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחוֹ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה נוּכַל לוֹ וַאֲסַרְנוּהוּ לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִתַּן־לָךְ אִישׁ

So Delilah said to Samson, “Tell me, what makes you so strong? And
how could you be tied up and made helpless?”

english.text:
So Delilah said to Samson, “Tell me, what makes you so strong? And
how could you be tied up and made helpless?”

translation.text: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me what makes your subdue you."

verses.english:
Samson replied, “If I were to be tied with seven fresh tendons
that had not been dried, I should become as weak as an ordinary
man.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־יַאַסְרֻנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃

translation.text: Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven fresh like anyone else."

So the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh
tendons that had not been dried. She bound him with them,

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ־לָהּ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָּהֶם׃

So the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh
tendons that had not been dried. She bound him with them,

while an ambush was waiting in her room. Then she called out to

וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב לָהּ בַּחֶדֶר וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיְנַתֵּק אֶת־הַיְתָרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יִנָּתֵק פְּתִיל־הַנְּעֹרֶת בַּהֲרִיחוֹ אֵשׁ וְלֹא נוֹדַע

Do tell me now how you could be tied up.”

Then Delilah said to Samson, “Oh, you deceived me; you lied to me!
Do tell me now how you could be tied up.”

translation.text: Then Delilah said to Samson, "You have mocked me and told me lies; please tell me how you could be bound."

verses.english:
He said, “If I were to be bound with new ropes that had never been
used, I would become as weak as an ordinary man.”

He said, “If I were to be bound with new ropes that had never been

verses.english:
So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, while an ambush
was waiting in a room. And she cried, “Samson, the Philistines are
upon you!” But he tore them off his arms like a thread.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח דְּלִילָה עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָהֶם וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב בֶּחָדֶר וַיְנַתְּקֵם מֵעַל זְרֹעֹתָיו כַּחוּט׃

So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, while an ambush
was waiting in a room. And she cried, “Samson, the Philistines are
upon you!” But he tore them off his arms like a thread.

translation.text: So Delilah took new ropes and snapped the ropes off his arms like a thread.

Then Delilah said to Samson, “You have been deceiving me all
along; you have been lying to me! Tell me, how could you be tied
up?” He answered her, “If you weave seven locks of my head into
the web.”
