verses.english:
Then she said to him, “How can you say you love me, when you don’t
confide in me? This makes three times that you’ve deceived me and
haven’t told me what makes you so strong.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֵיךְ תֹּאמַר אֲהַבְתִּיךְ וְלִבְּךָ אֵין אִתִּי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֵיךְ תֹּאמַר אֲהַבְתִּיךְ וְלִבְּךָ אֵין אִתִּי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
Then she said to him, “How can you say you love me, when you don’t
confide in me? This makes three times that you’ve deceived me and
haven’t told me what makes you so strong.”

translation.text: Then she said to him, "How can you say, 'I love you,' when your not told me what makes your strength so great."

verses.english:
Finally, after she had nagged him and pressed him constantly, he
was wearied to death
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־הֵצִיקָה לּוֹ בִדְבָרֶיהָ כּל־הַיָּמִים וַתְּאַלְצֵהוּ וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־הֵצִיקָה לּוֹ בִדְבָרֶיהָ כּל־הַיָּמִים וַתְּאַלְצֵהוּ וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת׃

english.text:
Finally, after she had nagged him and pressed him constantly, he
was wearied to death

translation.text: Finally, after she was tired to death.

verses.english:
and he confided everything to her. He said to her, “No razor has
ever touched my head, for I have been a nazirite to God since I
was in my mother’s womb. If my hair were cut, my strength would
leave me and I should become as weak as an ordinary man.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מוֹרָה לֹא־עָלָה עַל־רֹאשִׁי כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אִם־גֻּלַּחְתִּי וְסָר מִמֶּנִּי כֹחִי וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי
כְּכל־הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מוֹרָה לֹא־עָלָה עַל־רֹאשִׁי כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אִם־גֻּלַּחְתִּי וְסָר מִמֶּנִּי כֹחִי וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי
כְּכל־הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
and he confided everything to her. He said to her, “No razor has
ever touched my head, for I have been a nazirite to God since I
was in my mother’s womb. If my hair were cut, my strength would
leave me and I should become as weak as an ordinary man.”

translation.text: So he told her his whole secret, and said to her, else."

verses.english:
Sensing that he had confided everything to her, Delilah sent for
the lords of the Philistines, with this message: “Come up once
more, for he has confided everything to me.” And the lords of the
Philistines came up and brought the money with them.
verses.hebrew:
וַתֵּרֶא דְלִילָה כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ הַפַּעַם כִּי־הִגִּיד (לה) [לִי] אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וְעָלוּ אֵלֶיהָ
סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעֲלוּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֵּרֶא דְלִילָה כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ הַפַּעַם כִּי־הִגִּיד (לה) [לִי] אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וְעָלוּ אֵלֶיהָ
סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעֲלוּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדָם׃

english.text:
Sensing that he had confided everything to her, Delilah sent for
the lords of the Philistines, with this message: “Come up once
more, for he has confided everything to me.” And the lords of the
Philistines came up and brought the money with them.

translation.text: When Delilah realized that he had told her his whole secret, she sent and called the lords of the Philistines, saying, "This time come up, for came up to her, and brought the money in their hands.

verses.english:
She lulled him to sleep on her lap. Then she called in a man, and
she had him cut off the seven locks of his head; thus she weakened
him and made him helpless: his strength slipped away from him.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּיַשְּׁנֵהוּ עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ וַתִּקְרָא לָאִישׁ וַתְּגַלַּח אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת רֹאשׁוֹ וַתָּחֶל לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַיָּסַר כֹּחוֹ מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּיַשְּׁנֵהוּ עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ וַתִּקְרָא לָאִישׁ וַתְּגַלַּח אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת רֹאשׁוֹ וַתָּחֶל לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַיָּסַר כֹּחוֹ מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
She lulled him to sleep on her lap. Then she called in a man, and
she had him cut off the seven locks of his head; thus she weakened
him and made him helpless: his strength slipped away from him.

translation.text: She let him fall asleep on her lap; and she called a man, and had him shave off the seven locks of his head. He began to weaken, and his strength left him.

verses.english:
She cried, “Samson, the Philistines are upon you!” And he awoke
from his sleep, thinking he would break loose and shake himself
free as he had the other times. For he did not know that YHWH had
departed from him.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם וְאִנָּעֵר וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע כִּי יְהֹוָה סָר מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם וְאִנָּעֵר וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע כִּי יְהֹוָה סָר מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
She cried, “Samson, the Philistines are upon you!” And he awoke
from his sleep, thinking he would break loose and shake himself
free as he had the other times. For he did not know that YHWH had
departed from him.

translation.text: Then she said, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" When he awoke from his sleep, he thought, "I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free." But he did not know that the LORD had left him.

verses.english:
The Philistines seized him and gouged out his eyes. They brought
him down to Gaza and shackled him in bronze fetters, and he became
a mill slave in the prison.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאחֲזוּהוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְנַקְּרוּ אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיּוֹרִידוּ אוֹתוֹ עַזָּתָה וַיַּאַסְרוּהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְהִי טוֹחֵן בְּבֵית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים]׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאחֲזוּהוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְנַקְּרוּ אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיּוֹרִידוּ אוֹתוֹ עַזָּתָה וַיַּאַסְרוּהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְהִי טוֹחֵן בְּבֵית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים]׃

english.text:
The Philistines seized him and gouged out his eyes. They brought
him down to Gaza and shackled him in bronze fetters, and he became
a mill slave in the prison.

translation.text: ground at the mill in the prison.

verses.english: After his hair was cut off, it began to grow back.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּחֶל שְׂעַר־רֹאשׁוֹ לְצַמֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר גֻּלָּח׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחֶל שְׂעַר־רֹאשׁוֹ לְצַמֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר גֻּלָּח׃

english.text: After his hair was cut off, it began to grow back.

translation.text: But the hair of his head began to grow again after it had been shaved.

verses.english:
Now the lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great
sacrifice to their god Dagon and to make merry. They chanted, “Our
god has delivered into our hands Our enemy Samson.”
verses.hebrew: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לִזְבֹּחַ זֶבַח־גָּדוֹל לְדָגוֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּלְשִׂמְחָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ אֵת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אוֹיְבֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לִזְבֹּחַ זֶבַח־גָּדוֹל לְדָגוֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּלְשִׂמְחָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ אֵת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אוֹיְבֵנוּ׃

english.text:
Now the lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great
sacrifice to their god Dagon and to make merry. They chanted, “Our
god has delivered into our hands Our enemy Samson.”

translation.text: Now the lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great sacrifice to Samson our enemy into our hand."

verses.english:
When the people saw him, they sang praises to their god, chanting,
“Our god has delivered into our hands The enemy who devastated our
land, And who slew so many of us.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ הָעָם וַיְהַלְלוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אָמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְיָדֵנוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבֵנוּ וְאֵת מַחֲרִיב אַרְצֵנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הִרְבָּה אֶת־חֲלָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ הָעָם וַיְהַלְלוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אָמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְיָדֵנוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבֵנוּ וְאֵת מַחֲרִיב אַרְצֵנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הִרְבָּה אֶת־חֲלָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
When the people saw him, they sang praises to their god, chanting,
“Our god has delivered into our hands The enemy who devastated our
land, And who slew so many of us.”

translation.text: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, "Our god has given our enemy into our hand, the ravager of our country, who has killed many of us."

verses.english:
As their spirits rose, they said, “Call Samson here and let him
dance for us.” Samson was fetched from the prison, and he danced
for them. Then they put him between the pillars.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי (כי טוב) [כְּטוֹב] לִבָּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ קִרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן וִישַׂחֶק־לָנוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן מִבֵּית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים] וַיְצַחֵק לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ
אוֹתוֹ בֵּין הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי (כי טוב) [כְּטוֹב] לִבָּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ קִרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן וִישַׂחֶק־לָנוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן מִבֵּית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים] וַיְצַחֵק לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ
אוֹתוֹ בֵּין הָעַמּוּדִים׃

english.text:
As their spirits rose, they said, “Call Samson here and let him
dance for us.” Samson was fetched from the prison, and he danced
for them. Then they put him between the pillars.

translation.text: And performed for them. They made him stand between the pillars;

verses.english:
And Samson said to the boy who was leading him by the hand, “Let
go of me and let me feel the pillars that the temple rests upon,
that I may lean on them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּחֲזִיק בְּיָדוֹ הַנִּיחָה אוֹתִי (והימשני) [וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי] אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶשָּׁעֵן עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּחֲזִיק בְּיָדוֹ הַנִּיחָה אוֹתִי (והימשני) [וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי] אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶשָּׁעֵן עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Samson said to the boy who was leading him by the hand, “Let
go of me and let me feel the pillars that the temple rests upon,
that I may lean on them.”

translation.text: and the pillars on which the house rests, so that I may lean against them."

verses.english:
Now the temple was full of men and women; all the lords of the
Philistines were there, and there were some three thousand men and
women on the roof watching Samson dance.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת מָלֵא הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְשָׁמָּה כֹּל סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְעַל־הַגָּג כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה הָרֹאִים בִּשְׂחוֹק שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת מָלֵא הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְשָׁמָּה כֹּל סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְעַל־הַגָּג כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה הָרֹאִים בִּשְׂחוֹק שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
Now the temple was full of men and women; all the lords of the
Philistines were there, and there were some three thousand men and
women on the roof watching Samson dance.

translation.text: Now the house was full of men and women; all the lords of the thousand men and women, who looked on while Samson performed.

verses.english:
Then Samson called to YHWH, “O Lord GOD! Please remember me, and
give me strength just this once, O God, to take revenge of the
Philistines, if only for one of my two eyes.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה זכְרֵנִי נָא וְחַזְּקֵנִי נָא אַךְ הַפַּעַם הַזֶּה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאִנָּקְמָה נְקַם־אַחַת מִשְּׁתֵי עֵינַי מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה זכְרֵנִי נָא וְחַזְּקֵנִי נָא אַךְ הַפַּעַם הַזֶּה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאִנָּקְמָה נְקַם־אַחַת מִשְּׁתֵי עֵינַי מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Then Samson called to YHWH, “O Lord GOD! Please remember me, and
give me strength just this once, O God, to take revenge of the
Philistines, if only for one of my two eyes.”

translation.text: Then Samson called to the LORD and said, "Lord GOD, remember me revenge I may pay back the Philistines for my two eyes."

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְפֹּת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־שְׁנֵי עַמּוּדֵי הַתָּוֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּסָּמֵךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶחָד בִּימִינוֹ וְאֶחָד בִּשְׂמֹאלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְפֹּת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־שְׁנֵי עַמּוּדֵי הַתָּוֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּסָּמֵךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶחָד בִּימִינוֹ וְאֶחָד בִּשְׂמֹאלוֹ׃

translation.text: And left hand on the other.

verses.english:
Samson cried, “Let me die with the Philistines!” and he pulled
with all his might. The temple came crashing down on the lords and
on all the people in it. Those who were slain by him as he died
outnumbered those who had been slain by him when he lived.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן תָּמוֹת נַפְשִׁי עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּט בְּכֹחַ וַיִּפֹּל הַבַּיִת עַל־הַסְּרָנִים וְעַל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּמוֹתוֹ
רַבִּים מֵאֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּחַיָּיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן תָּמוֹת נַפְשִׁי עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּט בְּכֹחַ וַיִּפֹּל הַבַּיִת עַל־הַסְּרָנִים וְעַל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּמוֹתוֹ
רַבִּים מֵאֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּחַיָּיו׃

english.text:
Samson cried, “Let me die with the Philistines!” and he pulled
with all his might. The temple came crashing down on the lords and
on all the people in it. Those who were slain by him as he died
outnumbered those who had been slain by him when he lived.

translation.text: Then Samson said, "Let me die with the Philistines." He strained with all his might; and the house fell on the lords and all the people who were in it. So those he killed at his death were more than those he had killed during his life.

verses.english:
His brothers and all his father’s household came down and carried
him up and buried him in the tomb of his father Manoah, between
Zorah and Eshtaol. He had led Israel for twenty years.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּרְדוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל בְּקֶבֶר מָנוֹחַ אָבִיו וְהוּא שָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל
עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּרְדוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל בְּקֶבֶר מָנוֹחַ אָבִיו וְהוּא שָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל
עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
His brothers and all his father’s household came down and carried
him up and buried him in the tomb of his father Manoah, between
Zorah and Eshtaol. He had led Israel for twenty years.

translation.text: Then his brothers Manoah. He had judged Israel twenty years.

verses.english:
There was a man in the hill country of Ephraim whose name was
Micah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ מֵהַר־אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָיְהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ מֵהַר־אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָיְהוּ׃

english.text:
There was a man in the hill country of Ephraim whose name was
Micah.

translation.text: There was a man in the hill country of Ephraim whose name was Micah.

verses.english:
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that
were taken from you, so that you uttered an imprecation which you
repeated in my hearing—I have that silver; I took it.” “Blessed of
YHWH be my son,” said his mother.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח־לָךְ (ואתי) [וְאַתְּ] אָלִית וְגַם אָמַרְתְּ בְּאזְנַי הִנֵּה־הַכֶּסֶף אִתִּי אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיו וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ בָּרוּךְ
בְּנִי לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח־לָךְ (ואתי) [וְאַתְּ] אָלִית וְגַם אָמַרְתְּ בְּאזְנַי הִנֵּה־הַכֶּסֶף אִתִּי אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיו וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ בָּרוּךְ
בְּנִי לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that
were taken from you, so that you uttered an imprecation which you
repeated in my hearing—I have that silver; I took it.” “Blessed of
YHWH be my son,” said his mother.

translation.text: He said to his mother, "The eleven hundred pieces of silver spoke it in my hearing, — that silver is in my possession; I took it; but blessed by the LORD!"

verses.english:
He returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother;
but his mother said, “I herewith consecrate the silver to YHWH,
transferring it to my son to make a sculptured image and a molten
image. I now return it to you.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־אֶלֶף־וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ הַקְדֵּשׁ הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לַיהֹוָה מִיָּדִי לִבְנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וְעַתָּה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ
לָךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־אֶלֶף־וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ הַקְדֵּשׁ הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לַיהֹוָה מִיָּדִי לִבְנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וְעַתָּה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ
לָךְ׃

english.text:
He returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother;
but his mother said, “I herewith consecrate the silver to YHWH,
transferring it to my son to make a sculptured image and a molten
image. I now return it to you.”

translation.text: Then he returned the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother; and his mother said, "I consecrate the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son, to make an idol of cast metal."

verses.english:
So when he gave the silver back to his mother, his mother took two
hundred shekels of silver and gave it to a smith. He made of it a
sculptured image and a molten image, which were kept in the house
of Micah.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתִּקַּח אִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם כֶּסֶף וַתִּתְּנֵהוּ לַצּוֹרֵף וַיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָיְהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתִּקַּח אִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם כֶּסֶף וַתִּתְּנֵהוּ לַצּוֹרֵף וַיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָיְהוּ׃

english.text:
So when he gave the silver back to his mother, his mother took two
hundred shekels of silver and gave it to a smith. He made of it a
sculptured image and a molten image, which were kept in the house
of Micah.

translation.text: So into an idol of cast metal; and it was in the house of Micah.

verses.english:
Now the man Micah had a house of God; he had made an ephod and
teraphim and he had inducted one of his sons to be his priest.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ מִיכָה לוֹ בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יַד אַחַד מִבָּנָיו וַיְהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ מִיכָה לוֹ בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יַד אַחַד מִבָּנָיו וַיְהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

english.text:
Now the man Micah had a house of God; he had made an ephod and
teraphim and he had inducted one of his sons to be his priest.

translation.text: This man one of his sons, who became his priest.

verses.english:
In those days there was no king in Israel; every man did as he
pleased.
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
In those days there was no king in Israel; every man did as he
pleased.

translation.text: In those days there was no king in Israel; all the people did what was right in their own eyes.

verses.english:
There was a young man from Bethlehem of Judah, from the clan seat
of Judah; he was a Levite and had resided there as a sojourner.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־נַעַר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וְהוּא לֵוִי וְהוּא גָר־שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־נַעַר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וְהוּא לֵוִי וְהוּא גָר־שָׁם׃

english.text:
There was a young man from Bethlehem of Judah, from the clan seat
of Judah; he was a Levite and had resided there as a sojourner.

translation.text: Now there was a young man of Bethlehem in Judah, of the clan of Judah. He was a Levite residing there.

verses.english:
This man had left the town of Bethlehem of Judah to take up
residence wherever he could find a place. On his way, he came to
the house of Micah in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ מֵהָעִיר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר יִמְצָא וַיָּבֹא הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת דַּרְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ מֵהָעִיר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר יִמְצָא וַיָּבֹא הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת דַּרְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
This man had left the town of Bethlehem of Judah to take up
residence wherever he could find a place. On his way, he came to
the house of Micah in the hill country of Ephraim.

translation.text: This man left the town of the house of Micah in the hill country of Ephraim to carry on his work.

verses.english:
“Where do you come from?” Micah asked him. He replied, “I am a
Levite from Bethlehem of Judah, and I am traveling to take up
residence wherever I can find a place.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ מִיכָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵוִי אָנֹכִי מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וְאָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר אֶמְצָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ מִיכָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵוִי אָנֹכִי מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וְאָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר אֶמְצָא׃

english.text:
“Where do you come from?” Micah asked him. He replied, “I am a
Levite from Bethlehem of Judah, and I am traveling to take up
residence wherever I can find a place.”

translation.text: Micah said to him, "From where do you come?" He replied, "I am a find a place."

verses.english:
“Stay with me,” Micah said to him, “and be a father and a priest
to me, and I will pay you ten shekels of silver a year, an
allowance of clothing, and your food.” The Levite went.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מִיכָה שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי וֶהְיֵה־לִי לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן וְאָנֹכִי אֶתֶּן־לְךָ עֲשֶׂרֶת כֶּסֶף לַיָּמִים וְעֵרֶךְ בְּגָדִים וּמִחְיָתֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ הַלֵּוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מִיכָה שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי וֶהְיֵה־לִי לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן וְאָנֹכִי אֶתֶּן־לְךָ עֲשֶׂרֶת כֶּסֶף לַיָּמִים וְעֵרֶךְ בְּגָדִים וּמִחְיָתֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ הַלֵּוִי׃

english.text:
“Stay with me,” Micah said to him, “and be a father and a priest
to me, and I will pay you ten shekels of silver a year, an
allowance of clothing, and your food.” The Levite went.

translation.text: Then Micah said to him, "Stay with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver a year, a set of clothes, and your living."

verses.english:
The Levite agreed to stay with the man, and the youth became like
one of his own sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל הַלֵּוִי לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיְהִי הַנַּעַר לוֹ כְּאַחַד מִבָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹאֶל הַלֵּוִי לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיְהִי הַנַּעַר לוֹ כְּאַחַד מִבָּנָיו׃

english.text:
The Levite agreed to stay with the man, and the youth became like
one of his own sons.

translation.text: The Levite agreed to stay with the man; and the young man became to him like one of his sons.

verses.english:
Micah inducted the Levite, and the young man became his priest and
remained in Micah’s shrine.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַלֵּא מִיכָה אֶת־יַד הַלֵּוִי וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַנַּעַר לְכֹהֵן וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַלֵּא מִיכָה אֶת־יַד הַלֵּוִי וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַנַּעַר לְכֹהֵן וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָה׃

english.text:
Micah inducted the Levite, and the young man became his priest and
remained in Micah’s shrine.

translation.text: So Micah the house of Micah.

verses.english:
“Now I know,” Micah told himself, “that YHWH will prosper me,
since the Levite has become my priest.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָה עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־יֵיטִיב יְהֹוָה לִי כִּי הָיָה־לִי הַלֵּוִי לְכֹהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָה עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־יֵיטִיב יְהֹוָה לִי כִּי הָיָה־לִי הַלֵּוִי לְכֹהֵן׃

english.text:
“Now I know,” Micah told himself, “that YHWH will prosper me,
since the Levite has become my priest.”

translation.text: Then Micah said, "Now I know that the LORD will prosper me, because the Levite has become my priest."

verses.english:
In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the
tribe of Dan was seeking a territory in which to settle; for to
that day no territory had fallen to their lot among the tribes of
Israel.
verses.hebrew:
בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבַיָּמִים הָהֵם שֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי מְבַקֶּשׁ־לוֹ נַחֲלָה לָשֶׁבֶת כִּי לֹא־נָפְלָה לּוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
בְּנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבַיָּמִים הָהֵם שֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי מְבַקֶּשׁ־לוֹ נַחֲלָה לָשֶׁבֶת כִּי לֹא־נָפְלָה לּוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
בְּנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the
tribe of Dan was seeking a territory in which to settle; for to
that day no territory had fallen to their lot among the tribes of
Israel.

translation.text: In those days there was no king in Israel. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking for itself a territory to live in; for until then no territory among the tribes of Israel had been allotted to them.

verses.english:
The Danites sent out five of their number, from their clan seat at
Zorah and Eshtaol—valiant men—to spy out the land and explore it.
“Go,” they told them, “and explore the land.” When they had
advanced into the hill country of Ephraim as far as the house of
Micah, they stopped there for the night.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־דָן מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מִקְצוֹתָם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּלְחקְרָהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ
חִקְרוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה וַיָּלִינוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־דָן מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מִקְצוֹתָם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּלְחקְרָהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ
חִקְרוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה וַיָּלִינוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
The Danites sent out five of their number, from their clan seat at
Zorah and Eshtaol—valiant men—to spy out the land and explore it.
“Go,” they told them, “and explore the land.” When they had
advanced into the hill country of Ephraim as far as the house of
Micah, they stopped there for the night.

translation.text: So from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to explore it; and country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they stayed there.

verses.english:
While in the vicinity of Micah’s house, they recognized the speech
of the young Levite, so they went over and asked him, “Who brought
you to these parts? What are you doing in this place? What is your
business here?”
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה וְהֵמָּה הִכִּירוּ אֶת־קוֹל הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ מִי־הֱבִיאֲךָ הֲלֹם וּמָה־אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה בָּזֶה וּמַה־לְּךָ פֹה׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה וְהֵמָּה הִכִּירוּ אֶת־קוֹל הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ מִי־הֱבִיאֲךָ הֲלֹם וּמָה־אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה בָּזֶה וּמַה־לְּךָ פֹה׃

english.text:
While in the vicinity of Micah’s house, they recognized the speech
of the young Levite, so they went over and asked him, “Who brought
you to these parts? What are you doing in this place? What is your
business here?”

translation.text: While Levite; so they went over and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? What is your business here?"

verses.english:
He replied, “Thus and thus Micah did for me—he hired me and I
became his priest.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה עָשָׂה לִי מִיכָה וַיִּשְׂכְּרֵנִי וָאֱהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה עָשָׂה לִי מִיכָה וַיִּשְׂכְּרֵנִי וָאֱהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

english.text:
He replied, “Thus and thus Micah did for me—he hired me and I
became his priest.”

translation.text: He have become his priest."

verses.english:
They said to him, “Please, inquire of God; we would like to know
if the mission on which we are going will be successful.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שְׁאַל־נָא בֵאלֹהִים וְנֵדְעָה הֲתַצְלִחַ דַּרְכֵּנוּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ הֹלְכִים עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שְׁאַל־נָא בֵאלֹהִים וְנֵדְעָה הֲתַצְלִחַ דַּרְכֵּנוּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ הֹלְכִים עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
They said to him, “Please, inquire of God; we would like to know
if the mission on which we are going will be successful.”

translation.text: Then they said to him, "Inquire of God that we may know whether the mission we are undertaking will succeed."

verses.english:
“Go in peace,” the priest said to them, “YHWH views with favor the
mission you are going on.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן לְכוּ לְשָׁלוֹם נֹכַח יְהֹוָה דַּרְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן לְכוּ לְשָׁלוֹם נֹכַח יְהֹוָה דַּרְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ׃

english.text:
“Go in peace,” the priest said to them, “YHWH views with favor the
mission you are going on.”

translation.text: eye of the LORD."

verses.english:
The five men went on and came to Laish. They observed the people
in it dwelling carefree, after the manner of the Sidonians, a
tranquil and unsuspecting people, with no one in the land to
molest them and with no hereditary ruler. Moreover, they were
distant from the Sidonians and had no dealings with anybody.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלְכוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ לָיְשָׁה וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בְּקִרְבָּהּ יוֹשֶׁבֶת־לָבֶטַח כְּמִשְׁפַּט צִדֹנִים שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וְאֵין־מַכְלִים דָּבָר בָּאָרֶץ
יוֹרֵשׁ עֶצֶר וּרְחוֹקִים הֵמָּה מִצִּידֹנִים וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלְכוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ לָיְשָׁה וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בְּקִרְבָּהּ יוֹשֶׁבֶת־לָבֶטַח כְּמִשְׁפַּט צִדֹנִים שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וְאֵין־מַכְלִים דָּבָר בָּאָרֶץ
יוֹרֵשׁ עֶצֶר וּרְחוֹקִים הֵמָּה מִצִּידֹנִים וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם׃

english.text:
The five men went on and came to Laish. They observed the people
in it dwelling carefree, after the manner of the Sidonians, a
tranquil and unsuspecting people, with no one in the land to
molest them and with no hereditary ruler. Moreover, they were
distant from the Sidonians and had no dealings with anybody.

translation.text: The five men went on, and when they came to Laish, they observed had no dealings with Aram.

verses.english:
When [the men] came back to their kinsmen at Zorah and Eshtaol,
their kinsmen asked them, “How did you fare?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם צרְעָה וְאֶשְׁתָּאֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶם אֲחֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם צרְעָה וְאֶשְׁתָּאֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶם אֲחֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
When [the men] came back to their kinsmen at Zorah and Eshtaol,
their kinsmen asked them, “How did you fare?”

translation.text: When they came to their kinsfolk at Zorah and Eshtaol, they said to them, "What do you report?"

verses.english:
They replied, “Let us go at once and attack them! For we found
that the land was very good, and you are sitting idle! Don’t
delay; go and invade the land and take possession of it,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה עֲלֵיהֶם כִּי רָאִינוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה טוֹבָה מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם מַחְשִׁים אַל־תֵּעָצְלוּ לָלֶכֶת לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה עֲלֵיהֶם כִּי רָאִינוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה טוֹבָה מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם מַחְשִׁים אַל־תֵּעָצְלוּ לָלֶכֶת לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
They replied, “Let us go at once and attack them! For we found
that the land was very good, and you are sitting idle! Don’t
delay; go and invade the land and take possession of it,

translation.text: They it is very good. Will you do nothing? Do not be slow to go, but enter in and possess the land.

verses.english:
for God has delivered it into your hand. When you come, you will
come to an unsuspecting people; and the land is spacious and
nothing on earth is lacking there.”
verses.hebrew: כְּבֹאֲכֶם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עַם בֹּטֵחַ וְהָאָרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם כִּי־נְתָנָהּ אֱלֹהִים בְּיֶדְכֶם מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֵין־שָׁם מַחְסוֹר כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כְּבֹאֲכֶם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עַם בֹּטֵחַ וְהָאָרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם כִּי־נְתָנָהּ אֱלֹהִים בְּיֶדְכֶם מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֵין־שָׁם מַחְסוֹר כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
for God has delivered it into your hand. When you come, you will
come to an unsuspecting people; and the land is spacious and
nothing on earth is lacking there.”

translation.text: When you go, you will come to an your hands — a place where there is no lack of anything on earth."

verses.english:
They departed from there, from the clan seat of the Danites, from
Zorah and Eshtaol, six hundred strong, girt with weapons of war.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִשָּׁם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חָגוּר כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִשָּׁם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חָגוּר כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
They departed from there, from the clan seat of the Danites, from
Zorah and Eshtaol, six hundred strong, girt with weapons of war.

translation.text: Six hundred men of the Danite clan, armed with weapons of war, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol,

verses.english:
They went up and encamped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why
that place is called “the Camp of Dan” to this day; it lies west
of Kiriath-jearim.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים בִּיהוּדָה עַל־כֵּן קָרְאוּ לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנֵה־דָן עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה אַחֲרֵי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים בִּיהוּדָה עַל־כֵּן קָרְאוּ לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנֵה־דָן עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה אַחֲרֵי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

english.text:
They went up and encamped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why
that place is called “the Camp of Dan” to this day; it lies west
of Kiriath-jearim.

translation.text: and went up and encamped at Kiriathjearim in Judah. On this account that place is called Mahaneh-dan to this day; it is west of Kiriath-jearim.

verses.english:
From there they passed on to the hill country of Ephraim and
arrived at the house of Micah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ מִשָּׁם הַר־אֶפְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ מִשָּׁם הַר־אֶפְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה׃

english.text:
From there they passed on to the hill country of Ephraim and
arrived at the house of Micah.

translation.text: From there they passed on to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.

verses.english:
Here the five men who had gone to spy out the Laish region
remarked to their kinsmen, “Do you know, there is an ephod in
these houses, and teraphim, and a sculptured image and a molten
image? Now you know what you have to do.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲנוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַיִשׁ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי יֵשׁ בַּבָּתִּים הָאֵלֶּה אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וּפֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה
וְעַתָּה דְּעוּ מַה־תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲנוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַיִשׁ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי יֵשׁ בַּבָּתִּים הָאֵלֶּה אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וּפֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה
וְעַתָּה דְּעוּ מַה־תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
Here the five men who had gone to spy out the Laish region
remarked to their kinsmen, “Do you know, there is an ephod in
these houses, and teraphim, and a sculptured image and a molten
image? Now you know what you have to do.”

translation.text: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the land (that is, Laish) what you will do."

verses.english:
So they turned off there and entered the home of the young Levite
at Micah’s house and greeted him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁמָּה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי בֵּית מִיכָה וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

with us and be our father and priest. Would you rather be priest
to one man’s household or be priest to a tribe and clan in
Israel?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַחֲרֵשׁ שִׂים־יָדְךָ עַל־פִּיךָ וְלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ וֶהְיֵה־לָנוּ לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן הֲטוֹב הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְבֵית אִישׁ אֶחָד אוֹ הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְשֵׁבֶט

translation.text: They said to him, "Keep quiet! Put your priest. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one person, or to be priest to a tribe and clan in Israel?"

verses.english:
The priest was delighted. He took the ephod, the household gods,
and the sculptured image, and he joined the people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב לֵב הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַפָּסֶל וַיָּבֹא בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב לֵב הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַפָּסֶל וַיָּבֹא בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם׃

english.text:
The priest was delighted. He took the ephod, the household gods,
and the sculptured image, and he joined the people.

translation.text: Then the priest accepted the with the people.

verses.english:
They set out again, placing the children, the cattle, and their
household goods in front.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־הַטַּף וְאֶת־הַמִּקְנֶה וְאֶת־הַכְּבוּדָּה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־הַטַּף וְאֶת־הַמִּקְנֶה וְאֶת־הַכְּבוּדָּה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
They set out again, placing the children, the cattle, and their
household goods in front.

translation.text: So they resumed their journey, putting the little ones, the livestock, and the goods in front of them.

verses.english:
They had already gone some distance from Micah’s house, when the
men in the houses near Micah’s mustered and caught up with the
Danites.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה הִרְחִיקוּ מִבֵּית מִיכָה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה נִזְעֲקוּ וַיַּדְבִּיקוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה הִרְחִיקוּ מִבֵּית מִיכָה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה נִזְעֲקוּ וַיַּדְבִּיקוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן׃

english.text:
They had already gone some distance from Micah’s house, when the
men in the houses near Micah’s mustered and caught up with the
Danites.

translation.text: When they were some distance Micah's house were called out, and they overtook the Danites.

verses.english:
They called out to the Danites, who turned around and said to
Micah, “What’s the matter? Why have you mustered?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־דָן וַיַּסֵּבּוּ פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמִיכָה מַה־לְּךָ כִּי נִזְעָקְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־דָן וַיַּסֵּבּוּ פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמִיכָה מַה־לְּךָ כִּי נִזְעָקְתָּ׃

english.text:
They called out to the Danites, who turned around and said to
Micah, “What’s the matter? Why have you mustered?”

translation.text: They is the matter that you come with such a company?"

verses.english:
He said, “You have taken my priest and the gods that I made, and
walked off! What do I have left? How can you ask, ‘What’s the
matter’?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־אֱלֹהַי אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי לְקַחְתֶּם וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַתֵּלְכוּ וּמַה־לִּי עוֹד וּמַה־זֶּה תֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי מַה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־אֱלֹהַי אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי לְקַחְתֶּם וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַתֵּלְכוּ וּמַה־לִּי עוֹד וּמַה־זֶּה תֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי מַה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
He said, “You have taken my priest and the gods that I made, and
walked off! What do I have left? How can you ask, ‘What’s the
matter’?”

translation.text: He replied, have I left? How then can you ask me, 'What is the matter?'"

verses.english:
But the Danites replied, “Don’t do any shouting at us, or some
desperate men might attack you, and you and your family would lose
your lives.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי־דָן אַל־תַּשְׁמַע קוֹלְךָ עִמָּנוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים מָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּה נַפְשְׁךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ בֵּיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי־דָן אַל־תַּשְׁמַע קוֹלְךָ עִמָּנוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים מָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּה נַפְשְׁךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ בֵּיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
But the Danites replied, “Don’t do any shouting at us, or some
desperate men might attack you, and you and your family would lose
your lives.”

translation.text: And lose your life and the lives of your household."

verses.english:
So Micah, realizing that they were stronger than he, turned back
and went home; and the Danites went on their way,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־דָן לְדַרְכָּם וַיַּרְא מִיכָה כִּי־חֲזָקִים הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּפֶן וַיָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־דָן לְדַרְכָּם וַיַּרְא מִיכָה כִּי־חֲזָקִים הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּפֶן וַיָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
So Micah, realizing that they were stronger than he, turned back
and went home; and the Danites went on their way,

translation.text: Then the Danites turned and went back to his home.

verses.english:
taking the things Micah had made and the priest he had acquired.
They proceeded to Laish, a people tranquil and unsuspecting, and
they put them to the sword and burned down the town.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה לָקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מִיכָה וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה־לוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל־לַיִשׁ עַל־עַם שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵמָּה לָקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מִיכָה וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה־לוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל־לַיִשׁ עַל־עַם שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
taking the things Micah had made and the priest he had acquired.
They proceeded to Laish, a people tranquil and unsuspecting, and
they put them to the sword and burned down the town.

translation.text: The Danites, having taken what Micah had made, and the priest unsuspecting, put them to the sword, and burned down the city.

verses.english:
There was none to come to the rescue, for it was distant from
Sidon and they had no dealings with anyone; it lay in the valley
of Beth-rehob. They rebuilt the town and settled there,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵין מַצִּיל כִּי רְחוֹקָה־הִיא מִצִּידוֹן וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם וְהִיא בָּעֵמֶק אֲשֶׁר לְבֵית־רְחוֹב וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵין מַצִּיל כִּי רְחוֹקָה־הִיא מִצִּידוֹן וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם וְהִיא בָּעֵמֶק אֲשֶׁר לְבֵית־רְחוֹב וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

english.text:
There was none to come to the rescue, for it was distant from
Sidon and they had no dealings with anyone; it lay in the valley
of Beth-rehob. They rebuilt the town and settled there,

translation.text: dealings with Aram. It was in the valley that belongs to Beth-rehob. They rebuilt the city, and lived in it.

verses.english:
and they named the town Dan, after their ancestor Dan who was
Israel’s son. Originally, however, the name of the town was Laish.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הָעִיר דָּן בְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר יוּלַּד לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְאוּלָם לַיִשׁ שֵׁם־הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הָעִיר דָּן בְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר יוּלַּד לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְאוּלָם לַיִשׁ שֵׁם־הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
and they named the town Dan, after their ancestor Dan who was
Israel’s son. Originally, however, the name of the town was Laish.

translation.text: They named the city Dan, after was formerly Laish.

verses.english:
The Danites set up the sculptured image for themselves; and
Jonathan son of Gershom son of Manasseh, and his descendants,
served as priests to the Danite tribe until the land went into
exile.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקִימוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי־דָן אֶת־הַפָּסֶל וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁם בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה הוּא וּבָנָיו הָיוּ כֹהֲנִים לְשֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי עַד־יוֹם גְּלוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקִימוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי־דָן אֶת־הַפָּסֶל וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁם בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה הוּא וּבָנָיו הָיוּ כֹהֲנִים לְשֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי עַד־יוֹם גְּלוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
The Danites set up the sculptured image for themselves; and

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וַיְנַתְּחֶהָ לַעֲצָמֶיהָ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְתָחִים וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וַיְנַתְּחֶהָ לַעֲצָמֶיהָ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְתָחִים וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When he came home, he picked up a knife, and took hold of his
concubine and cut her up limb by limb into twelve parts. He sent
them throughout the territory of Israel.

translation.text: When he the territory of Israel.

verses.english:
And everyone who saw it cried out, “Never has such a thing
happened or been seen from the day the Israelites came out of the
land of Egypt to this day! Put your mind to this; take counsel and
decide.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כל־הָרֹאֶה וְאָמַר לֹא־נִהְיְתָה וְלֹא־נִרְאֲתָה כָּזֹאת לְמִיּוֹם עֲלוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂימוּ־לָכֶם עָלֶיהָ עֻצוּ וְדַבֵּרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כל־הָרֹאֶה וְאָמַר לֹא־נִהְיְתָה וְלֹא־נִרְאֲתָה כָּזֹאת לְמִיּוֹם עֲלוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂימוּ־לָכֶם עָלֶיהָ עֻצוּ וְדַבֵּרוּ׃

english.text:
And everyone who saw it cried out, “Never has such a thing
happened or been seen from the day the Israelites came out of the
land of Egypt to this day! Put your mind to this; take counsel and
decide.”

translation.text: Then he commanded the men whom he sent, saying, "Thus shall you say to all the Israelites, 'Has such a thing ever Egypt until this day? Consider it, take counsel, and speak out.'"

verses.english:
Thereupon all the Israelites—from Dan to Beer-sheba and [from] the
land of Gilead—marched forth, and the community assembled to a man
before YHWH at Mizpah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לְמִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לְמִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
Thereupon all the Israelites—from Dan to Beer-sheba and [from] the
land of Gilead—marched forth, and the community assembled to a man
before YHWH at Mizpah.

translation.text: Then all the Israelites came out, from Dan to Beer-sheba, including before the LORD at Mizpah.

verses.english:
All the leaders of the people [and] all the tribes of Israel
presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people, 400,000
fighting men on foot.—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ פִּנּוֹת כּל־הָעָם כֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְהַל עַם הָאֱלֹהִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ פִּנּוֹת כּל־הָעָם כֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְהַל עַם הָאֱלֹהִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
All the leaders of the people [and] all the tribes of Israel
presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people, 400,000
fighting men on foot.—

translation.text: The chiefs of all the people, of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand foot-soldiers bearing arms.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites heard that the Israelites had come up to
Mizpah.—The Israelites said, “Tell us, how did this evil thing
happen?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי־עָלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּה וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבְּרוּ אֵיכָה נִהְיְתָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי־עָלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּה וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבְּרוּ אֵיכָה נִהְיְתָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites heard that the Israelites had come up to
Mizpah.—The Israelites said, “Tell us, how did this evil thing
happen?”

translation.text: (Now the Benjaminites heard that the people of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) And the Israelites said, "Tell us, how did this criminal act come about?"

verses.english:
And the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, replied, “My
concubine and I came to Gibeah of Benjamin to spend the night.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הָאִישׁ הַלֵּוִי אִישׁ הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּרְצָחָה וַיֹּאמַר הַגִּבְעָתָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִן בָּאתִי אֲנִי וּפִילַגְשִׁי לָלוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הָאִישׁ הַלֵּוִי אִישׁ הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּרְצָחָה וַיֹּאמַר הַגִּבְעָתָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִן בָּאתִי אֲנִי וּפִילַגְשִׁי לָלוּן׃

english.text:
And the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, replied, “My
concubine and I came to Gibeah of Benjamin to spend the night.

translation.text: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, concubine, to spend the night.

verses.english:
The citizens of Gibeah set out to harm me. They gathered against
me around the house in the night; they meant to kill me, and they
ravished my concubine until she died.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ עָלַי בַּעֲלֵי הַגִּבְעָה וַיָּסֹבּוּ עָלַי אֶת־הַבַּיִת לָיְלָה אוֹתִי דִּמּוּ לַהֲרֹג וְאֶת־פִּילַגְשִׁי עִנּוּ וַתָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ עָלַי בַּעֲלֵי הַגִּבְעָה וַיָּסֹבּוּ עָלַי אֶת־הַבַּיִת לָיְלָה אוֹתִי דִּמּוּ לַהֲרֹג וְאֶת־פִּילַגְשִׁי עִנּוּ וַתָּמֹת׃

english.text:
The citizens of Gibeah set out to harm me. They gathered against
me around the house in the night; they meant to kill me, and they
ravished my concubine until she died.

translation.text: The lords of Gibeah rose up against they raped my concubine until she died.

verses.english:
So I took hold of my concubine and I cut her in pieces and sent
them through every part of Israel’s territory. For an outrageous
act of depravity had been committed in Israel.

hebrew.text: וָאֹחֵז בְּפִילַגְשִׁי וָאֲנַתְּחֶהָ וָאֲשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכל־שְׂדֵה נַחֲלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי עָשׂוּ זִמָּה וּנְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So I took hold of my concubine and I cut her in pieces and sent
them through every part of Israel’s territory. For an outrageous
act of depravity had been committed in Israel.

translation.text: Then I took my concubine Israel's territory; for they have committed a vile outrage in Israel.

verses.english:
Now you are all Israelites; produce a plan of action here and
now!”

english.text:
Now you are all Israelites; produce a plan of action here and
now!”

translation.text: So now, you Israelites, all of you, give your advice and counsel here."

verses.english:
Then all the people rose, as one man, and declared, “We will not
go back to our homes, we will not enter our houses!
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם כּל־הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לֵאמֹר לֹא נֵלֵךְ אִישׁ לְאהֳלוֹ וְלֹא נָסוּר אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם כּל־הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לֵאמֹר לֹא נֵלֵךְ אִישׁ לְאהֳלוֹ וְלֹא נָסוּר אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text:
Then all the people rose, as one man, and declared, “We will not
go back to our homes, we will not enter our houses!

translation.text: All the people got up as one, saying, "We will not any of us go to our tents, nor will any of us return to our houses.

verses.english:
But this is what we will do to Gibeah: [we will wage war] against
it according to lot.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשֶׂה לַגִּבְעָה עָלֶיהָ בְּגוֹרָל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשֶׂה לַגִּבְעָה עָלֶיהָ בְּגוֹרָל׃

english.text:
But this is what we will do to Gibeah: [we will wage war] against
it according to lot.

translation.text: But now this is what we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot.

verses.english:
We will take from all the tribes of Israel ten men to the hundred,
a hundred to the thousand, and a thousand to the ten thousand to
supply provisions for the troops—to prepare for their going to
Geba in Benjamin for all the outrage it has committed in Israel.”
verses.hebrew:
וְלָקַחְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים לַמֵּאָה לְכֹל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֵאָה לָאֶלֶף וְאֶלֶף לָרְבָבָה לָקַחַת צֵדָה לָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְבוֹאָם לְגֶבַע בִּנְיָמִן כְּכל־הַנְּבָלָה
אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְלָקַחְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים לַמֵּאָה לְכֹל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֵאָה לָאֶלֶף וְאֶלֶף לָרְבָבָה לָקַחַת צֵדָה לָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְבוֹאָם לְגֶבַע בִּנְיָמִן כְּכל־הַנְּבָלָה
אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
We will take from all the tribes of Israel ten men to the hundred,
a hundred to the thousand, and a thousand to the ten thousand to
supply provisions for the troops—to prepare for their going to
Geba in Benjamin for all the outrage it has committed in Israel.”

translation.text: We will take ten disgrace that they have done in Israel."

verses.english:
So all the men of Israel, united as one man, massed against the
town.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסֵף כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד חֲבֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאָסֵף כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד חֲבֵרִים׃

english.text:
So all the men of Israel, united as one man, massed against the
town.

translation.text: So all the men of Israel gathered against the city, united as one.

verses.english:
And the tribes of Israel sent men through the whole tribe of
Benjamin, saying, “What is this evil thing that has happened among
you?
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנָשִׁים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר מָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נִהְיְתָה בָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנָשִׁים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר מָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נִהְיְתָה בָּכֶם׃

english.text:
And the tribes of Israel sent men through the whole tribe of
Benjamin, saying, “What is this evil thing that has happened among
you?

translation.text: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What crime is this that has been committed among you?

verses.english:
Come, hand over those scoundrels in Gibeah so that we may put them
to death and stamp out the evil from Israel.” But the Benjaminites
would not yield to the demand of their fellow Israelites.
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וּנְמִיתֵם וּנְבַעֲרָה רָעָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָבוּ [בְּנֵי] בִנְיָמִן לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל אֲחֵיהֶם
בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וּנְמִיתֵם וּנְבַעֲרָה רָעָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָבוּ [בְּנֵי] בִנְיָמִן לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל אֲחֵיהֶם

verses.english:
So the Benjaminites gathered from their towns to Gibeah in order
to take the field against the Israelites.

english.text:
So the Benjaminites gathered from their towns to Gibeah in order
to take the field against the Israelites.

translation.text: The Benjaminites the Israelites.

verses.english:
On that day the Benjaminites mustered from the towns 26,000
fighting men, mustered apart from the inhabitants of Gibeah; 700
picked men

verses.english:
The men of Israel other than Benjamin mustered 400,000 fighting
men, warriors to a man.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְפָּקְדוּ לְבַד מִבִּנְיָמִן אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חָרֶב כּל־זֶה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
The men of Israel other than Benjamin mustered 400,000 fighting
men, warriors to a man.

translation.text: And the Israelites, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand armed men, all of them warriors.

verses.english:
They proceeded to Bethel and inquired of God; the Israelites
asked, “Who of us shall advance first to fight the Benjaminites?”
And YHWH replied, “Judah first.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בֵאלֹהִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ בַתְּחִלָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה
בַתְּחִלָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בֵאלֹהִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ בַתְּחִלָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה
בַתְּחִלָּה׃

english.text:
They proceeded to Bethel and inquired of God; the Israelites
asked, “Who of us shall advance first to fight the Benjaminites?”
And YHWH replied, “Judah first.”

translation.text: The Israelites proceeded to go up to Bethel, where they inquired of God, "Which of us shall go up first to battle against the Benjaminites?" And the LORD answered, "Judah shall go up first."

verses.english:
So the Israelites arose in the morning and encamped against
Gibeah.

english.text:
So the Israelites arose in the morning and encamped against
Gibeah.

translation.text: Then the Israelites got up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

verses.english:
The men of Israel took the field against the Benjaminites; the men
of Israel drew up in battle order against them at Gibeah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בִּנְיָמִן וַיַּעַרְכוּ אִתָּם אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְחָמָה אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

english.text:
The men of Israel took the field against the Benjaminites; the men
of Israel drew up in battle order against them at Gibeah.

translation.text: The Israelites went out to battle against Benjamin; and the Israelites drew up the battle line against them at Gibeah.

verses.english:
But the Benjaminites issued from Gibeah, and that day they struck
down 22,000 men of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן מִן־הַגִּבְעָה וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן מִן־הַגִּבְעָה וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
But the Benjaminites issued from Gibeah, and that day they struck
down 22,000 men of Israel.

translation.text: The Benjaminites came out of Gibeah, and struck down on that day twentytwo thousand of the Israelites.

verses.english:
Now the army—the men of Israel—rallied and again drew up in battle
order at the same place as they had on the first day.

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּק הָעָם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּסִפוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָרְכוּ שָׁם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

Now the army—the men of Israel—rallied and again drew up in battle

translation.text: The place where they had formed it on the first day.

verses.english:
For the Israelites had gone up and wept before YHWH until evening.
They had inquired of YHWH, “Shall we again join battle with our
kinsmen the Benjaminites?” And YHWH had replied, “March against
them.”

וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי־יְהֹוָה עַד־הָעֶרֶב וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאוֹסִיף לָגֶשֶׁת לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אָחִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֲלוּ

The Israelites advanced against the Benjaminites on the second

The Israelites advanced against the Benjaminites on the second
day.

But the Benjaminites came out from Gibeah against them on the
second day and struck down 18,000 more of the Israelites, all of

But the Benjaminites came out from Gibeah against them on the

Then all the Israelites, all the army, went up and came to Bethel
and they sat there, weeping before YHWH. They fasted that day
until evening, and presented burnt offerings and offerings of
well-being to YHWH.

וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּצוּמוּ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא עַד־הָעָרֶב וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים

לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

Then all the Israelites, all the army, went up and came to Bethel
and they sat there, weeping before YHWH. They fasted that day
until evening, and presented burnt offerings and offerings of
well-being to YHWH.

translation.text: Then all the Israelites, the whole army, went back to Bethel evening. Then they offered burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being before the LORD.

And on the third day, the Israelites went up against the
Benjaminites, as before, and engaged them in battle at Gibeah.

And on the third day, the Israelites went up against the
Benjaminites, as before, and engaged them in battle at Gibeah.

translation.text: Then the themselves in array against Gibeah, as before.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites dashed out to meet the army and were drawn away
from the town onto the roads, of which one runs to Bethel and the
other to Gibeah. As before, they started out by striking some of

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כל־הַנֹּפְלִים מִבִּנְיָמִן עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָיִל׃

english.text:
Thus the total number of Benjaminites who fell that day came to
25,000 fighting men, all of them brave.

translation.text: So all who fell that day of courageous fighters.

verses.english:
But 600 men turned and fled to the wilderness, to the Rock of
Rimmon; they remained at the Rock of Rimmon four months.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל־סֶלַע הָרִמּוֹן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל־סֶלַע הָרִמּוֹן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
But 600 men turned and fled to the wilderness, to the Rock of
Rimmon; they remained at the Rock of Rimmon four months.

translation.text: But six hundred turned and fled toward the Rimmon for four months.

verses.english:
The men of Israel, meanwhile, turned back to the rest of the
Benjaminites and put them to the sword—towns, people,
cattle—everything that remained. Finally, they set fire to all the
towns that were left.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁבוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב מֵעִיר מְתֹם עַד־בְּהֵמָה עַד כּל־הַנִּמְצָא גַּם כּל־הֶעָרִים הַנִּמְצָאוֹת שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁבוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב מֵעִיר מְתֹם עַד־בְּהֵמָה עַד כּל־הַנִּמְצָא גַּם כּל־הֶעָרִים הַנִּמְצָאוֹת שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The men of Israel, meanwhile, turned back to the rest of the
Benjaminites and put them to the sword—towns, people,
cattle—everything that remained. Finally, they set fire to all the
towns that were left.

translation.text: Meanwhile, the Israelites turned back they set on fire.

verses.english:
Now the men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: “None of us
will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjaminite.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבַּע בַּמִּצְפָּה לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ לֹא־יִתֵּן בִּתּוֹ לְבִנְיָמִן לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבַּע בַּמִּצְפָּה לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ לֹא־יִתֵּן בִּתּוֹ לְבִנְיָמִן לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Now the men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: “None of us
will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjaminite.”

translation.text: Now the Israelites had sworn at Mizpah, "No one of us shall give his daughter in marriage to Benjamin."

verses.english:
The people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening.
They wailed and wept bitterly,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם בֵּית־אֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד־הָעֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם בֵּית־אֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד־הָעֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
The people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening.
They wailed and wept bitterly,

translation.text: And the people came to Bethel, and sat there until evening before God, and they lifted up their voices and wept bitterly.

verses.english:
and they said, “O LORD God of Israel, why has this happened in
Israel, that one tribe must now be missing from Israel?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָמָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיְתָה זֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהִפָּקֵד הַיּוֹם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָמָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיְתָה זֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהִפָּקֵד הַיּוֹם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד׃

english.text:
and they said, “O LORD God of Israel, why has this happened in
Israel, that one tribe must now be missing from Israel?”

translation.text: They said, "O LORD, the God of Israel, why has it come to pass that today there should be one tribe lacking in Israel?"

verses.english:
Early the next day, the people built an altar there, and they
brought burnt offerings and offerings of well-being.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ הָעָם וַיִּבְנוּ־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ הָעָם וַיִּבְנוּ־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
Early the next day, the people built an altar there, and they
brought burnt offerings and offerings of well-being.

translation.text: On the next day, the people got up early, and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being.

verses.english:
The Israelites asked, “Is there anyone from all the tribes of
Israel who failed to come up to the assembly before YHWH?” For a
solemn oath had been taken concerning anyone who did not go up to
YHWH at Mizpah: “He shall be put to death.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה בַקָּהָל מִכּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי הַשְּׁבוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הָיְתָה לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה
לֵאמֹר מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה בַקָּהָל מִכּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי הַשְּׁבוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הָיְתָה לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה
לֵאמֹר מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
The Israelites asked, “Is there anyone from all the tribes of
Israel who failed to come up to the assembly before YHWH?” For a
solemn oath had been taken concerning anyone who did not go up to
YHWH at Mizpah: “He shall be put to death.”

translation.text: Then the Israelites said, "Which of all the tribes of Israel did not come up in the shall be put to death."

verses.english:
The Israelites now relented toward their kinsmen the Benjaminites,
and they said, “This day one tribe has been cut off from Israel!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּחֲמוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בִּנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִגְדַּע הַיּוֹם שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּחֲמוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בִּנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִגְדַּע הַיּוֹם שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The Israelites now relented toward their kinsmen the Benjaminites,
and they said, “This day one tribe has been cut off from Israel!

translation.text: But the Israelites had compassion for Benjamin their kin, and said, "One tribe is cut off from Israel this day.

verses.english:
What can we do to provide wives for those who are left, seeing
that we have sworn by YHWH not to give any of our daughters to
them in marriage?”
verses.hebrew: מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ בַיהֹוָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת־לָהֶם מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ בַיהֹוָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת־לָהֶם מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
What can we do to provide wives for those who are left, seeing
that we have sworn by YHWH not to give any of our daughters to
them in marriage?”

translation.text: by the LORD that we will not give them any of our daughters as wives?"

verses.english:
They inquired, “Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who did
not go up to YHWH at Mizpah?” Now no one from Jabesh-gilead had
come to the camp, to the assembly.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי אֶחָד מִשִּׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה וְהִנֵּה לֹא בָא־אִישׁ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה מִיָּבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֶל־הַקָּהָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי אֶחָד מִשִּׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה וְהִנֵּה לֹא בָא־אִישׁ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה מִיָּבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֶל־הַקָּהָל׃

english.text:
They inquired, “Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who did
not go up to YHWH at Mizpah?” Now no one from Jabesh-gilead had
come to the camp, to the assembly.

translation.text: Then they said, "Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who did not Jabesh-gilead had come to the camp, to the assembly.

verses.english:
For, when the roll of the troops was taken, not one of the
inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was present.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפָּקֵד הָעָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפָּקֵד הָעָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
For, when the roll of the troops was taken, not one of the
inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was present.

translation.text: For when the roll was called among the people, not one of the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead was there.

verses.english:
So the assemblage dispatched 12,000 of the warriors, instructing
them as follows: “Go and put the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead to
the sword, women and children included.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁם הָעֵדָה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הֶחָיִל וַיְצַוּוּ אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִכִּיתֶם אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁם הָעֵדָה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הֶחָיִל וַיְצַוּוּ אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִכִּיתֶם אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

english.text:
So the assemblage dispatched 12,000 of the warriors, instructing
them as follows: “Go and put the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead to
the sword, women and children included.

translation.text: So the congregation sent twelve thousand soldiers to the sword, including the women and the little ones.

verses.english:
This is what you are to do: Proscribe every man, and every woman
who has known a man carnally.”
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כּל־זָכָר וְכל־אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָר תַּחֲרִימוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כּל־זָכָר וְכל־אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָר תַּחֲרִימוּ׃

english.text:
This is what you are to do: Proscribe every man, and every woman
who has known a man carnally.”

translation.text: This is what you shall devote to destruction."

verses.english:
They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead 400 maidens who
had not known a man carnally; and they brought them to the camp at
Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּמְצְאוּ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר וַיָּבִאוּ אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ
כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּמְצְאוּ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר וַיָּבִאוּ אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ
כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead 400 maidens who
had not known a man carnally; and they brought them to the camp at
Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And they found among the is in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
Then the whole community sent word to the Benjaminites who were at
the Rock of Rimmon, and offered them terms of peace.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ כּל־הָעֵדָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲשֶׁר בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן וַיִּקְרְאוּ לָהֶם שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ כּל־הָעֵדָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲשֶׁר בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן וַיִּקְרְאוּ לָהֶם שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Then the whole community sent word to the Benjaminites who were at
the Rock of Rimmon, and offered them terms of peace.

translation.text: Then the whole congregation sent word to the Benjaminites who were at the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

verses.english:
Thereupon the Benjaminites returned, and they gave them the girls
who had been spared from the women of Jabesh-gilead. But there
were not enough of them.
