verses.english:
The cows went straight ahead along the road to Beth-shemesh. They
went along a single highroad, lowing as they went, and turning off
neither to the right nor to the left; and the lords of the
Philistines walked behind them as far as the border of
Beth-shemesh.

וַיִּשַּׁרְנָה הַפָּרוֹת בַּדֶּרֶךְ עַל־דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ בִּמְסִלָּה אַחַת הָלְכוּ הָלֹךְ וְגָעוֹ וְלֹא־סָרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֹלְכִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם

וַיִּשַּׁרְנָה הַפָּרוֹת בַּדֶּרֶךְ עַל־דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ בִּמְסִלָּה אַחַת הָלְכוּ הָלֹךְ וְגָעוֹ וְלֹא־סָרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֹלְכִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם

english.text:
The cows went straight ahead along the road to Beth-shemesh. They
went along a single highroad, lowing as they went, and turning off
neither to the right nor to the left; and the lords of the
Philistines walked behind them as far as the border of
Beth-shemesh.

translation.text: The cows went straight in the direction of Beth-shemesh right nor to the left, and the lords of the Philistines went after them as far as the border of Beth-shemesh.

verses.english:
The people of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the
valley. They looked up and saw the Ark, and they rejoiced when
they saw [it].
verses.hebrew: וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ קֹצְרִים קְצִיר־חִטִּים בָּעֵמֶק וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרוֹן וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ לִרְאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ קֹצְרִים קְצִיר־חִטִּים בָּעֵמֶק וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרוֹן וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ לִרְאוֹת׃

english.text:
The people of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the
valley. They looked up and saw the Ark, and they rejoiced when
they saw [it].

translation.text: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest rejoicing to meet it.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲגָלָה בָּאָה אֶל־שְׂדֵה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֵּית־הַשִּׁמְשִׁי וַתַּעֲמֹד שָׁם וְשָׁם אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְבַקְּעוּ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָעֲגָלָה וְאֶת־הַפָּרוֹת הֶעֱלוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֲגָלָה בָּאָה אֶל־שְׂדֵה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֵּית־הַשִּׁמְשִׁי וַתַּעֲמֹד שָׁם וְשָׁם אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְבַקְּעוּ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָעֲגָלָה וְאֶת־הַפָּרוֹת הֶעֱלוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה׃

translation.text: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Bethshemesh, and stopped there. A large stone was there; so they split up LORD.

verses.english:
and the Levites took down the Ark of YHWH and the chest beside it
containing the gold objects and placed them on the large stone.
Then the men of Beth-shemesh presented burnt offerings and other
sacrifices to YHWH that day.
verses.hebrew:
וְהַלְוִיִּם הוֹרִידוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הָאַרְגַּז אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ כְלֵי־זָהָב וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶל־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ הֶעֱלוּ עֹלוֹת
וַיִּזְבְּחוּ זְבָחִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַלְוִיִּם הוֹרִידוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הָאַרְגַּז אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ כְלֵי־זָהָב וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶל־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ הֶעֱלוּ עֹלוֹת
וַיִּזְבְּחוּ זְבָחִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and the Levites took down the Ark of YHWH and the chest beside it
containing the gold objects and placed them on the large stone.
Then the men of Beth-shemesh presented burnt offerings and other
sacrifices to YHWH that day.

translation.text: The Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the box that and presented sacrifices on that day to the LORD.

verses.english:
The five lords of the Philistines saw this and returned the same
day to Ekron.
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשָּׁה סַרְנֵי־פְלִשְׁתִּים רָאוּ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ עֶקְרוֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמִשָּׁה סַרְנֵי־פְלִשְׁתִּים רָאוּ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ עֶקְרוֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The five lords of the Philistines saw this and returned the same
day to Ekron.

translation.text: When the five lords of the Philistines saw it, they returned that day to Ekron.

verses.english:
The following were the golden hemorrhoids that the Philistines
paid as an indemnity to YHWH: For Ashdod, one; for Gaza, one; for
Ashkelon, one; for Gath, one; for Ekron, one.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה טְחֹרֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אָשָׁם לַיהֹוָהלְאַשְׁדּוֹד אֶחָדלְעַזָּה אֶחָדלְאַשְׁקְלוֹן אֶחָדלְגַת אֶחָדלְעֶקְרוֹן אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה טְחֹרֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אָשָׁם לַיהֹוָהלְאַשְׁדּוֹד אֶחָדלְעַזָּה אֶחָדלְאַשְׁקְלוֹן אֶחָדלְגַת אֶחָדלְעֶקְרוֹן אֶחָד׃

english.text:
The following were the golden hemorrhoids that the Philistines
paid as an indemnity to YHWH: For Ashdod, one; for Gaza, one; for
Ashkelon, one; for Gath, one; for Ekron, one.

translation.text: These are the gold tumors, which the Philistines returned as a guilt one for Gath, one for Ekron;

verses.english:
As for the golden mice, their number accorded with all the
Philistine towns that belonged to the five lords—both fortified
towns and unwalled villages, as far as the great stone on which
the Ark of YHWH was set down, to this day, in the field of Joshua
of Beth-shemesh.
verses.hebrew:
וְעַכְבְּרֵי הַזָּהָב מִסְפַּר כּל־עָרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחֲמֵשֶׁת הַסְּרָנִים מֵעִיר מִבְצָר וְעַד כֹּפֶר הַפְּרָזִי וְעַד אָבֵל הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחוּ עָלֶיהָ אֵת אֲרוֹן
יְהֹוָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בִּשְׂדֵה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֵּית הַשִּׁמְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַכְבְּרֵי הַזָּהָב מִסְפַּר כּל־עָרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחֲמֵשֶׁת הַסְּרָנִים מֵעִיר מִבְצָר וְעַד כֹּפֶר הַפְּרָזִי וְעַד אָבֵל הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחוּ עָלֶיהָ אֵת אֲרוֹן
יְהֹוָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בִּשְׂדֵה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֵּית הַשִּׁמְשִׁי׃

english.text:
As for the golden mice, their number accorded with all the
Philistine towns that belonged to the five lords—both fortified
towns and unwalled villages, as far as the great stone on which
the Ark of YHWH was set down, to this day, in the field of Joshua
of Beth-shemesh.

translation.text: also the gold mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, which they set down the ark of the LORD, is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.

verses.english:
[YHWH] struck at the men of Beth-shemesh because they looked into
the Ark of YHWH; He struck down seventy men among the people [and]
fifty thousand men. The people mourned, for He had inflicted a
great slaughter upon the population.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּךְ בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ כִּי רָאוּ בַּאֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ בָּעָם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם כִּי־הִכָּה יְהֹוָה בָּעָם מַכָּה
גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּךְ בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ כִּי רָאוּ בַּאֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ בָּעָם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם כִּי־הִכָּה יְהֹוָה בָּעָם מַכָּה
גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
[YHWH] struck at the men of Beth-shemesh because they looked into
the Ark of YHWH; He struck down seventy men among the people [and]
fifty thousand men. The people mourned, for He had inflicted a
great slaughter upon the population.

translation.text: The descendants of Jeconiah did not rejoice with the people of Bethshemesh when they greeted the ark of the LORD; and he killed seventy slaughter among the people.

verses.english:
And the men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in attendance on
YHWH, this holy God? And to whom shall He go up from us?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ מִי יוּכַל לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה וְאֶל־מִי יַעֲלֶה מֵעָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ מִי יוּכַל לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה וְאֶל־מִי יַעֲלֶה מֵעָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And the men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in attendance on
YHWH, this holy God? And to whom shall He go up from us?”

translation.text: Then the people of Beth-shemesh said, he go so that we may be rid of him?"

verses.english:
They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim to say,
“The Philistines have sent back the Ark of YHWH. Come down and
take it into your keeping.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִרְיַת־יְעָרִים לֵאמֹר הֵשִׁבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה רְדוּ הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִרְיַת־יְעָרִים לֵאמֹר הֵשִׁבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה רְדוּ הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim to say,
“The Philistines have sent back the Ark of YHWH. Come down and
take it into your keeping.”

translation.text: So they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, "The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up to you."

verses.english:
The men of Kiriath-jearim came and took up the Ark of YHWH and
brought it into the house of Abinadab on the hill; and they
consecrated his son Eleazar to have charge of the Ark of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־בֵּית אֲבִינָדָב בַּגִּבְעָה וְאֶת־אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ קִדְּשׁוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־בֵּית אֲבִינָדָב בַּגִּבְעָה וְאֶת־אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ קִדְּשׁוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The men of Kiriath-jearim came and took up the Ark of YHWH and
brought it into the house of Abinadab on the hill; and they
consecrated his son Eleazar to have charge of the Ark of YHWH.

translation.text: And son, Eleazar, to have charge of the ark of the LORD.

verses.english:
A long time elapsed from the day that the Ark was housed in
Kiriath-jearim, twenty years in all; and all the House of Israel
yearned after YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיּוֹם שֶׁבֶת הָאָרוֹן בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַיִּהְיוּ עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וַיִּנָּהוּ כּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִיּוֹם שֶׁבֶת הָאָרוֹן בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַיִּהְיוּ עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וַיִּנָּהוּ כּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
A long time elapsed from the day that the Ark was housed in
Kiriath-jearim, twenty years in all; and all the House of Israel
yearned after YHWH.

translation.text: From the day that the ark was lodged at Kiriath-jearim, a long time the LORD.

verses.english:
And Samuel said to all the House of Israel, “If you mean to return
to YHWH with all your heart, you must remove the alien gods and
the Ashtaroth from your midst and direct your heart to YHWH and
serve Him alone. Then He will deliver you from the hands of the
Philistines.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִם־בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם אַתֶּם שָׁבִים אֶל־יְהֹוָה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִתּוֹכְכֶם וְהָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְהָכִינוּ לְבַבְכֶם
אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְעִבְדֻהוּ לְבַדּוֹ וְיַצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִם־בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם אַתֶּם שָׁבִים אֶל־יְהֹוָה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִתּוֹכְכֶם וְהָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְהָכִינוּ לְבַבְכֶם
אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְעִבְדֻהוּ לְבַדּוֹ וְיַצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
And Samuel said to all the House of Israel, “If you mean to return
to YHWH with all your heart, you must remove the alien gods and
the Ashtaroth from your midst and direct your heart to YHWH and
serve Him alone. Then He will deliver you from the hands of the
Philistines.”

translation.text: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, "If you are returning to only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines."

verses.english:
And the Israelites removed the Baalim and Ashtaroth and they
served YHWH alone.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּסִירוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרֹת וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסִירוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרֹת וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the Israelites removed the Baalim and Ashtaroth and they
served YHWH alone.

translation.text: So only.

verses.english:
Samuel said, “Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will pray to
YHWH for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל קִבְצוּ אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּתָה וְאֶתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל קִבְצוּ אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּתָה וְאֶתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Samuel said, “Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will pray to
YHWH for you.”

translation.text: Then Samuel said, "Gather all Israel at Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD for you."

verses.english:
They assembled at Mizpah, and they drew water and poured it out
before YHWH; they fasted that day, and there they confessed that
they had sinned against YHWH. And Samuel acted as chieftain of the
Israelites at Mizpah.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקָּבְצוּ הַמִּצְפָּתָה וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּצוּמוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁם חָטָאנוּ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־בְּנֵי

translation.text: So they gathered at Mizpah, and drew water and at Mizpah.

When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had assembled at
Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines marched out against Israel.
Hearing of this, the Israelites were terrified of the Philistines

וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־הִתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּתָה וַיַּעֲלוּ סַרְנֵי־פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי

Hearing of this, the Israelites were terrified of the Philistines

and they implored Samuel, “Do not neglect us and do not refrain

and they implored Samuel, “Do not neglect us and do not refrain

verses.english:
Thereupon Samuel took a suckling lamb and sacrificed it as a whole
burnt offering to YHWH; and Samuel cried out to YHWH in behalf of
Israel, and YHWH responded to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל טְלֵה חָלָב אֶחָד (ויעלה) [וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ] עוֹלָה כָּלִיל לַיהֹוָה וַיִּזְעַק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה בְּעַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל טְלֵה חָלָב אֶחָד (ויעלה) [וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ] עוֹלָה כָּלִיל לַיהֹוָה וַיִּזְעַק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה בְּעַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon Samuel took a suckling lamb and sacrificed it as a whole
burnt offering to YHWH; and Samuel cried out to YHWH in behalf of
Israel, and YHWH responded to him.

translation.text: So Samuel took a sucking lamb and offered it as a Israel, and the LORD answered him.

verses.english:
For as Samuel was presenting the burnt offering and the
Philistines advanced to attack Israel, YHWH thundered mightily
against the Philistines that day. He threw them into confusion,
and they were routed by Israel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי שְׁמוּאֵל מַעֲלֶה הָעוֹלָה וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִגְּשׁוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּרְעֵם יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל־גָּדוֹל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהֻמֵּם וַיִּנָּגְפוּ
לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי שְׁמוּאֵל מַעֲלֶה הָעוֹלָה וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִגְּשׁוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּרְעֵם יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל־גָּדוֹל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהֻמֵּם וַיִּנָּגְפוּ
לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
For as Samuel was presenting the burnt offering and the
Philistines advanced to attack Israel, YHWH thundered mightily
against the Philistines that day. He threw them into confusion,
and they were routed by Israel.

translation.text: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to attack Israel; but the LORD threw them into confusion; and they were routed before Israel.

verses.english:
The men of Israel sallied out of Mizpah and pursued the
Philistines, striking them down to a point below Beth-car.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הַמִּצְפָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּם עַד־מִתַּחַת לְבֵית כָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הַמִּצְפָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּם עַד־מִתַּחַת לְבֵית כָּר׃

english.text:
The men of Israel sallied out of Mizpah and pursued the
Philistines, striking them down to a point below Beth-car.

translation.text: And struck them down as far as beyond Beth-car.

verses.english:
Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen, and
named it Eben-ezer: “For up to now,” he said, “YHWH has helped
us.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶבֶן אַחַת וַיָּשֶׂם בֵּין־הַמִּצְפָּה וּבֵין הַשֵּׁן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ אֶבֶן הָעָזֶר וַיֹּאמַר עַד־הֵנָּה עֲזָרָנוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶבֶן אַחַת וַיָּשֶׂם בֵּין־הַמִּצְפָּה וּבֵין הַשֵּׁן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ אֶבֶן הָעָזֶר וַיֹּאמַר עַד־הֵנָּה עֲזָרָנוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen, and
named it Eben-ezer: “For up to now,” he said, “YHWH has helped
us.”

translation.text: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and helped us."

verses.english:
The Philistines were humbled and did not invade the territory of
Israel again; and the hand of YHWH was set against the Philistines
as long as Samuel lived.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכָּנְעוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לָבוֹא בִּגְבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי יַד־יְהֹוָה בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכָּנְעוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לָבוֹא בִּגְבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי יַד־יְהֹוָה בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
The Philistines were humbled and did not invade the territory of
Israel again; and the hand of YHWH was set against the Philistines
as long as Samuel lived.

translation.text: So the Philistines were subdued and did not again enter the territory of Israel; the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

verses.english:
The towns which the Philistines had taken from Israel, from Ekron
to Gath, were restored to Israel; Israel recovered all her
territory from the Philistines. There was also peace between
Israel and the Amorites.
verses.hebrew:
וַתָּשֹׁבְנָה הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ־פְלִשְׁתִּים מֵאֵת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֶקְרוֹן וְעַד־גַּת וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָן הִצִּיל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהִי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין
יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין הָאֱמֹרִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּשֹׁבְנָה הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ־פְלִשְׁתִּים מֵאֵת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֶקְרוֹן וְעַד־גַּת וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָן הִצִּיל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהִי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין
יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין הָאֱמֹרִי׃

english.text:
The towns which the Philistines had taken from Israel, from Ekron
to Gath, were restored to Israel; Israel recovered all her
territory from the Philistines. There was also peace between
Israel and the Amorites.

translation.text: The towns that the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron to Gath; and Israel recovered between Israel and the Amorites.

verses.english: Samuel judged Israel as long as he lived.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

english.text: Samuel judged Israel as long as he lived.

translation.text: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

verses.english:
Each year he made the rounds of Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, and
acted as judge over Israel at all those places.
verses.hebrew: וְהָלַךְ מִדֵּי שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה וְסָבַב בֵּית־אֵל וְהַגִּלְגָּל וְהַמִּצְפָּה וְשָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל־הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָלַךְ מִדֵּי שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה וְסָבַב בֵּית־אֵל וְהַגִּלְגָּל וְהַמִּצְפָּה וְשָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל־הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Each year he made the rounds of Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, and
acted as judge over Israel at all those places.

translation.text: He went on a circuit year by year to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all these places.

verses.english:
Then he would return to Ramah, for his home was there, and there
too he would judge Israel. He built an altar there to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּתְשֻׁבָתוֹ הָרָמָתָה כִּי־שָׁם בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁם שָׁפָט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּתְשֻׁבָתוֹ הָרָמָתָה כִּי־שָׁם בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁם שָׁפָט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then he would return to Ramah, for his home was there, and there
too he would judge Israel. He built an altar there to YHWH.

translation.text: Then he would come back to Ramah, for his home was there; he administered justice there to Israel, and built there an altar to the LORD.

verses.english: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons judges over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר זָקֵן שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־בָּנָיו שֹׁפְטִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר זָקֵן שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־בָּנָיו שֹׁפְטִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons judges over Israel.

translation.text: When Samuel became old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

verses.english:
The name of his first-born son was Joel, and his second son’s name
was Abijah; they sat as judges in Beer-sheba.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שֶׁם־בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר יוֹאֵל וְשֵׁם מִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִיָּה שֹׁפְטִים בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי שֶׁם־בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר יוֹאֵל וְשֵׁם מִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִיָּה שֹׁפְטִים בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
The name of his first-born son was Joel, and his second son’s name
was Abijah; they sat as judges in Beer-sheba.

translation.text: The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; they were judges in Beer-sheba.

verses.english:
But his sons did not follow in his ways; they were bent on gain,
they accepted bribes, and they subverted justice.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בָנָיו בִּדְרָכָו וַיִּטּוּ אַחֲרֵי הַבָּצַע וַיִּקְחוּ־שֹׁחַד וַיַּטּוּ מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בָנָיו בִּדְרָכָו וַיִּטּוּ אַחֲרֵי הַבָּצַע וַיִּקְחוּ־שֹׁחַד וַיַּטּוּ מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
But his sons did not follow in his ways; they were bent on gain,
they accepted bribes, and they subverted justice.

translation.text: Yet his sons did not follow in his justice.

verses.english: All the elders of Israel assembled and came to Samuel at Ramah,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה׃

english.text: All the elders of Israel assembled and came to Samuel at Ramah,

translation.text: Then all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah,

verses.english:
and they said to him, “You have grown old, and your sons have not
followed your ways. Therefore appoint a king for us, to govern us
like all other nations.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אַתָּה זָקַנְתָּ וּבָנֶיךָ לֹא הָלְכוּ בִּדְרָכֶיךָ עַתָּה שִׂימָה־לָּנוּ מֶלֶךְ לְשׁפְטֵנוּ כְּכל־הַגּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אַתָּה זָקַנְתָּ וּבָנֶיךָ לֹא הָלְכוּ בִּדְרָכֶיךָ עַתָּה שִׂימָה־לָּנוּ מֶלֶךְ לְשׁפְטֵנוּ כְּכל־הַגּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
and they said to him, “You have grown old, and your sons have not
followed your ways. Therefore appoint a king for us, to govern us
like all other nations.”

translation.text: and said to him, "You are old and your sons do not follow in nations."

verses.english:
Samuel was displeased that they said “Give us a king to govern
us.” Samuel prayed to YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ תְּנָה־לָּנוּ מֶלֶךְ לְשׁפְטֵנוּ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ תְּנָה־לָּנוּ מֶלֶךְ לְשׁפְטֵנוּ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Samuel was displeased that they said “Give us a king to govern
us.” Samuel prayed to YHWH,

translation.text: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to govern us." Samuel prayed to the LORD,

verses.english:
and YHWH replied to Samuel, “Heed the demand of the people in
everything they say to you. For it is not you that they have
rejected; it is Me they have rejected as their king.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמַע בְּקוֹל הָעָם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ כִּי לֹא אֹתְךָ מָאָסוּ כִּי־אֹתִי מָאֲסוּ מִמְּלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמַע בְּקוֹל הָעָם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ כִּי לֹא אֹתְךָ מָאָסוּ כִּי־אֹתִי מָאֲסוּ מִמְּלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
and YHWH replied to Samuel, “Heed the demand of the people in
everything they say to you. For it is not you that they have
rejected; it is Me they have rejected as their king.

translation.text: and the LORD said to Samuel, "Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you; king over them.

verses.english:
Like everything else they have done ever since I brought them out
of Egypt to this day—forsaking Me and worshiping other gods—so
they are doing to you.
verses.hebrew: כְּכל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ מִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אוֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיַּעַזְבֻנִי וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים כֵּן הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים גַּם־לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: כְּכל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ מִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אוֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיַּעַזְבֻנִי וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים כֵּן הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים גַּם־לָךְ׃

english.text:
Like everything else they have done ever since I brought them out
of Egypt to this day—forsaking Me and worshiping other gods—so
they are doing to you.

translation.text: Just as they have done to me, from the day I brought so also they are doing to you.

verses.english:
Heed their demand; but warn them solemnly, and tell them about the
practices of any king who will rule over them.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם אַךְ כִּי־הָעֵד תָּעִיד בָּהֶם וְהִגַּדְתָּ לָהֶם מִשְׁפַּט הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם אַךְ כִּי־הָעֵד תָּעִיד בָּהֶם וְהִגַּדְתָּ לָהֶם מִשְׁפַּט הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Heed their demand; but warn them solemnly, and tell them about the
practices of any king who will rule over them.”

translation.text: Now then, listen to their voice; only — who shall reign over them."

verses.english:
Samuel reported all the words of YHWH to the people, who were
asking him for a king.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָעָם הַשֹּׁאֲלִים מֵאִתּוֹ מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָעָם הַשֹּׁאֲלִים מֵאִתּוֹ מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Samuel reported all the words of YHWH to the people, who were
asking him for a king.

translation.text: So Samuel reported all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking him for a king.

verses.english:
He said, “This will be the practice of the king who will rule over
you: He will take your sons and appoint them as his charioteers
and horsemen, and they will serve as outrunners for his chariots.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה יִהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְשָׂם לוֹ בְּמֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו וְרָצוּ לִפְנֵי מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה יִהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְשָׂם לוֹ בְּמֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו וְרָצוּ לִפְנֵי מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
He said, “This will be the practice of the king who will rule over
you: He will take your sons and appoint them as his charioteers
and horsemen, and they will serve as outrunners for his chariots.

translation.text: He said, horsemen, and to run before his chariots;

verses.english:
He will appoint them as his chiefs of thousands and of fifties; or
they will have to plow his fields, reap his harvest, and make his
weapons and the equipment for his chariots.
verses.hebrew: וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְלַחֲרֹשׁ חֲרִישׁוֹ וְלִקְצֹר קְצִירוֹ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת כְּלֵי־מִלְחַמְתּוֹ וּכְלֵי רִכְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְלַחֲרֹשׁ חֲרִישׁוֹ וְלִקְצֹר קְצִירוֹ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת כְּלֵי־מִלְחַמְתּוֹ וּכְלֵי רִכְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
He will appoint them as his chiefs of thousands and of fifties; or
they will have to plow his fields, reap his harvest, and make his
weapons and the equipment for his chariots.

translation.text: and he will appoint for implements of war and the equipment of his chariots.

verses.english: He will take your daughters as perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם יִקָּח לְרַקָּחוֹת וּלְטַבָּחוֹת וּלְאֹפוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם יִקָּח לְרַקָּחוֹת וּלְטַבָּחוֹת וּלְאֹפוֹת׃

english.text: He will take your daughters as perfumers, cooks, and bakers.

translation.text: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.

verses.english:
He will seize your choice fields, vineyards, and olive groves, and
give them to his courtiers.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־שְׂדוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־כַּרְמֵיכֶם וְזֵיתֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים יִקָּח וְנָתַן לַעֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־שְׂדוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־כַּרְמֵיכֶם וְזֵיתֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים יִקָּח וְנָתַן לַעֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
He will seize your choice fields, vineyards, and olive groves, and
give them to his courtiers.

translation.text: He will take to his courtiers.

verses.english:
He will take a tenth part of your grain and vintage and give it to
his eunuchs and courtiers.
verses.hebrew: וְזַרְעֵיכֶם וְכַרְמֵיכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְנָתַן לְסָרִיסָיו וְלַעֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְזַרְעֵיכֶם וְכַרְמֵיכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְנָתַן לְסָרִיסָיו וְלַעֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
He will take a tenth part of your grain and vintage and give it to
his eunuchs and courtiers.

translation.text: He will take one-tenth of your grain and of your vineyards and give it to his officers and his courtiers.

verses.english:
He will take your male and female slaves, your choice young men,
and your asses, and put them to work for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַבְדֵיכֶם וְאֶת־שִׁפְחוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־בַּחוּרֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים וְאֶת־חֲמוֹרֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְעָשָׂה לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־עַבְדֵיכֶם וְאֶת־שִׁפְחוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־בַּחוּרֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים וְאֶת־חֲמוֹרֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְעָשָׂה לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
He will take your male and female slaves, your choice young men,
and your asses, and put them to work for him.

translation.text: He will take and put them to his work.

verses.english:
He will take a tenth part of your flocks, and you shall become his
slaves.
verses.hebrew: צֹאנְכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ־לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: צֹאנְכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ־לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
He will take a tenth part of your flocks, and you shall become his
slaves.

translation.text: He will take one-tenth of your flocks, and you shall be his slaves.

verses.english:
The day will come when you cry out because of the king whom you
yourselves have chosen; and YHWH will not answer you on that day.”
verses.hebrew: וּזְעַקְתֶּם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מִלִּפְנֵי מַלְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם וְלֹא־יַעֲנֶה יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּזְעַקְתֶּם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מִלִּפְנֵי מַלְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם וְלֹא־יַעֲנֶה יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The day will come when you cry out because of the king whom you
yourselves have chosen; and YHWH will not answer you on that day.”

translation.text: And in that day you will cry out because of answer you in that day."

verses.english:
But the people would not listen to Samuel’s warning. “No,” they
said. “We must have a king over us,
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֲנוּ הָעָם לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹּא כִּי אִם־מֶלֶךְ יִהְיֶה עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֲנוּ הָעָם לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹּא כִּי אִם־מֶלֶךְ יִהְיֶה עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
But the people would not listen to Samuel’s warning. “No,” they
said. “We must have a king over us,

translation.text: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; they said, "No! but we are determined to have a king over us,

verses.english:
that we may be like all the other nations: Let our king rule over
us and go out at our head and fight our battles.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיִינוּ גַם־אֲנַחְנוּ כְּכל־הַגּוֹיִם וּשְׁפָטָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְיָצָא לְפָנֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם אֶת־מִלְחֲמֹתֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִינוּ גַם־אֲנַחְנוּ כְּכל־הַגּוֹיִם וּשְׁפָטָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְיָצָא לְפָנֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם אֶת־מִלְחֲמֹתֵנוּ׃

english.text:
that we may be like all the other nations: Let our king rule over
us and go out at our head and fight our battles.”

translation.text: so that we also before us and fight our battles."

verses.english:
When Samuel heard all that the people said, he reported it to
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי הָעָם וַיְדַבְּרֵם בְּאזְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי הָעָם וַיְדַבְּרֵם בְּאזְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When Samuel heard all that the people said, he reported it to
YHWH.

translation.text: When Samuel had heard all the words of the people, he repeated them in the ears of the LORD.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Samuel, “Heed their demands and appoint a king
for them.” Samuel then said to the men of Israel, “All of you go
home.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם וְהִמְלַכְתָּ לָהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכוּ אִישׁ לְעִירוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם וְהִמְלַכְתָּ לָהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכוּ אִישׁ לְעִירוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Samuel, “Heed their demands and appoint a king
for them.” Samuel then said to the men of Israel, “All of you go
home.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Samuel, "Listen to their voice and set a king over them." Samuel then said to the people of Israel, "Each of you return home."

verses.english:
There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish son of Abiel son
of Zeror son of Becorath son of Aphiah, a Benjaminite, a man of
substance.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ (מבן ימין) [מִבִּנְיָמִין] וּשְׁמוֹ קִישׁ בֶּן־אֲבִיאֵל בֶּן־צְרוֹר בֶּן־בְּכוֹרַת בֶּן־אֲפִיחַ בֶּן־אִישׁ יְמִינִי גִּבּוֹר חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ (מבן ימין) [מִבִּנְיָמִין] וּשְׁמוֹ קִישׁ בֶּן־אֲבִיאֵל בֶּן־צְרוֹר בֶּן־בְּכוֹרַת בֶּן־אֲפִיחַ בֶּן־אִישׁ יְמִינִי גִּבּוֹר חָיִל׃

english.text:
There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish son of Abiel son
of Zeror son of Becorath son of Aphiah, a Benjaminite, a man of
substance.

translation.text: There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish son of Abiel son wealth.

verses.english:
He had a son whose name was Saul, an excellent young man; no one
among the Israelites was handsomer than he; he was a head taller
than any of the people.
verses.hebrew: וְלוֹ־הָיָה בֵן וּשְׁמוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּחוּר וָטוֹב וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכּל־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלוֹ־הָיָה בֵן וּשְׁמוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּחוּר וָטוֹב וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכּל־הָעָם׃

english.text:
He had a son whose name was Saul, an excellent young man; no one
among the Israelites was handsomer than he; he was a head taller
than any of the people.

translation.text: He had a son whose name was Saul, a handsome young man. he; he stood head and shoulders above everyone else.

verses.english:
Once the asses of Saul’s father Kish went astray, and Kish said to
his son Saul, “Take along one of the servants and go out and look
for the asses.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאבַדְנָה הָאֲתֹנוֹת לְקִישׁ אֲבִי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר קִישׁ אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא אִתְּךָ אֶת־אַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקוּם לֵךְ בַּקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאבַדְנָה הָאֲתֹנוֹת לְקִישׁ אֲבִי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר קִישׁ אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא אִתְּךָ אֶת־אַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקוּם לֵךְ בַּקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנֹת׃

english.text:
Once the asses of Saul’s father Kish went astray, and Kish said to
his son Saul, “Take along one of the servants and go out and look
for the asses.”

translation.text: Now the donkeys of Kish, Saul's father, had strayed. So Kish said to donkeys."

verses.english:
He passed into the hill country of Ephraim. He crossed the
district of Shalishah, but they did not find them. They passed
through the district of Shaalim, but they were not there. They
traversed the [entire] territory of Benjamin, and still they did
not find them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּהַר־אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶרֶץ־שָׁלִשָׁה וְלֹא מָצָאוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְאֶרֶץ־שַׁעֲלִים וָאַיִן וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶרֶץ־יְמִינִי וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּהַר־אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶרֶץ־שָׁלִשָׁה וְלֹא מָצָאוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְאֶרֶץ־שַׁעֲלִים וָאַיִן וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶרֶץ־יְמִינִי וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃

english.text:
He passed into the hill country of Ephraim. He crossed the
district of Shalishah, but they did not find them. They passed
through the district of Shaalim, but they were not there. They
traversed the [entire] territory of Benjamin, and still they did
not find them.

translation.text: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim and passed passed through the land of Benjamin, but they did not find them.

verses.english:
When they reached the district of Zuph, Saul said to the servant
who was with him, “Let us turn back, or my father will stop
worrying about the asses and begin to worry about us.”
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה בָּאוּ בְּאֶרֶץ צוּף וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר לְנַעֲרוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ לְכָה וְנָשׁוּבָה פֶּן־יֶחְדַּל אָבִי מִן־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה בָּאוּ בְּאֶרֶץ צוּף וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר לְנַעֲרוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ לְכָה וְנָשׁוּבָה פֶּן־יֶחְדַּל אָבִי מִן־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָנוּ׃

english.text:
When they reached the district of Zuph, Saul said to the servant
who was with him, “Let us turn back, or my father will stop
worrying about the asses and begin to worry about us.”

translation.text: When they came to the land of Zuph, Saul said to the boy who was donkeys and worry about us."

verses.english:
But he replied, “There is a man of God in that town, and the man
is highly esteemed; everything that he says comes true. Let us go
there; perhaps he will tell us about the errand on which we set
out.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנֵּה־נָא אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִים בָּעִיר הַזֹּאת וְהָאִישׁ נִכְבָּד כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יְדַבֵּר בּוֹא יָבוֹא עַתָּה נֵלְכָה שָּׁם אוּלַי יַגִּיד לָנוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּנוּ
אֲשֶׁר־הָלַכְנוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנֵּה־נָא אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִים בָּעִיר הַזֹּאת וְהָאִישׁ נִכְבָּד כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יְדַבֵּר בּוֹא יָבוֹא עַתָּה נֵלְכָה שָּׁם אוּלַי יַגִּיד לָנוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּנוּ
אֲשֶׁר־הָלַכְנוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
But he replied, “There is a man of God in that town, and the man
is highly esteemed; everything that he says comes true. Let us go
there; perhaps he will tell us about the errand on which we set
out.”

translation.text: But he said to him, "There is a man of journey on which we have set out."

verses.english:
“But if we go,” Saul said to his servant, “what can we bring the
man? For the food in our bags is all gone, and there is nothing we
can bring to the man of God as a present. What have we got?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנַעֲרוֹ וְהִנֵּה נֵלֵךְ וּמַה־נָּבִיא לָאִישׁ כִּי הַלֶּחֶם אָזַל מִכֵּלֵינוּ וּתְשׁוּרָה אֵין־לְהָבִיא לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים מָה אִתָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנַעֲרוֹ וְהִנֵּה נֵלֵךְ וּמַה־נָּבִיא לָאִישׁ כִּי הַלֶּחֶם אָזַל מִכֵּלֵינוּ וּתְשׁוּרָה אֵין־לְהָבִיא לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים מָה אִתָּנוּ׃

english.text:
“But if we go,” Saul said to his servant, “what can we bring the
man? For the food in our bags is all gone, and there is nothing we
can bring to the man of God as a present. What have we got?”

translation.text: Then Saul replied to the boy, we?"

verses.english:
The servant answered Saul again, “I happen to have a
quarter-shekel of silver. I can give that to the man of God and he
will tell us about our errand.”—
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף הַנַּעַר לַעֲנוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נִמְצָא בְיָדִי רֶבַע שֶׁקֶל כָּסֶף וְנָתַתִּי לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִגִּיד לָנוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף הַנַּעַר לַעֲנוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נִמְצָא בְיָדִי רֶבַע שֶׁקֶל כָּסֶף וְנָתַתִּי לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִגִּיד לָנוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
The servant answered Saul again, “I happen to have a
quarter-shekel of silver. I can give that to the man of God and he
will tell us about our errand.”—

translation.text: The boy answered Saul again, "Here, I have with me a quarter shekel of silver; I will give it to the man of God, to tell us our way."

verses.english:
Formerly in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he would
say, “Come, let us go to the seer,” for the prophet of today was
formerly called a seer.—
verses.hebrew: לְפָנִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה־אָמַר הָאִישׁ בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לִדְרוֹשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה עַד־הָרֹאֶה כִּי לַנָּבִיא הַיּוֹם יִקָּרֵא לְפָנִים הָרֹאֶה׃

hebrew.text: לְפָנִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה־אָמַר הָאִישׁ בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לִדְרוֹשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה עַד־הָרֹאֶה כִּי לַנָּבִיא הַיּוֹם יִקָּרֵא לְפָנִים הָרֹאֶה׃

english.text:
Formerly in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he would
say, “Come, let us go to the seer,” for the prophet of today was
formerly called a seer.—

translation.text: was formerly called a seer.)

verses.english:
Saul said to his servant, “A good idea; let us go.” And they went
to the town where the man of God lived.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנַעֲרוֹ טוֹב דְּבָרְךָ לְכָה נֵלֵכָה וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנַעֲרוֹ טוֹב דְּבָרְךָ לְכָה נֵלֵכָה וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Saul said to his servant, “A good idea; let us go.” And they went
to the town where the man of God lived.

translation.text: Saul said to the boy, "Good; come, let us go." So they went to the town where the man of God was.

verses.english:
As they were climbing the ascent to the town, they met some girls
coming out to draw water, and they asked them, “Is the seer in
town?”
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה עֹלִים בְּמַעֲלֵה הָעִיר וְהֵמָּה מָצְאוּ נְעָרוֹת יֹצְאוֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶן הֲיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הָרֹאֶה׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה עֹלִים בְּמַעֲלֵה הָעִיר וְהֵמָּה מָצְאוּ נְעָרוֹת יֹצְאוֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶן הֲיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הָרֹאֶה׃

english.text:
As they were climbing the ascent to the town, they met some girls
coming out to draw water, and they asked them, “Is the seer in
town?”

translation.text: As they went up the hill to the town, they met some girls coming out to draw water, and said to them, "Is the seer here?"

verses.english:
“Yes,” they replied. “He is up there ahead of you. Hurry, for he
has just come to the town because the people have a sacrifice at
the shrine today.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה אוֹתָם וַתֹּאמַרְנָה יֵּשׁ הִנֵּה לְפָנֶיךָ מַהֵר עַתָּה כִּי הַיּוֹם בָּא לָעִיר כִּי זֶבַח הַיּוֹם לָעָם בַּבָּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה אוֹתָם וַתֹּאמַרְנָה יֵּשׁ הִנֵּה לְפָנֶיךָ מַהֵר עַתָּה כִּי הַיּוֹם בָּא לָעִיר כִּי זֶבַח הַיּוֹם לָעָם בַּבָּמָה׃

english.text:
“Yes,” they replied. “He is up there ahead of you. Hurry, for he
has just come to the town because the people have a sacrifice at
the shrine today.

translation.text: They answered, "Yes, there he is just ahead of you. Hurry; he has come just now to the town, because the people have a sacrifice today at the shrine.

verses.english:
As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up
to the shrine to eat; the people will not eat until he comes; for
he must first bless the sacrifice and only then will the guests
eat. Go up at once, for you will find him right away.”
verses.hebrew:
כְּבֹאֲכֶם הָעִיר כֵּן תִּמְצְאוּן אֹתוֹ בְּטֶרֶם יַעֲלֶה הַבָּמָתָה לֶאֱכֹל כִּי לֹא־יֹאכַל הָעָם עַד־בֹּאוֹ כִּי־הוּא יְבָרֵךְ הַזֶּבַח אַחֲרֵי־כֵן יֹאכְלוּ הַקְּרֻאִים וְעַתָּה
עֲלוּ כִּי־אֹתוֹ כְהַיּוֹם תִּמְצְאוּן אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
כְּבֹאֲכֶם הָעִיר כֵּן תִּמְצְאוּן אֹתוֹ בְּטֶרֶם יַעֲלֶה הַבָּמָתָה לֶאֱכֹל כִּי לֹא־יֹאכַל הָעָם עַד־בֹּאוֹ כִּי־הוּא יְבָרֵךְ הַזֶּבַח אַחֲרֵי־כֵן יֹאכְלוּ הַקְּרֻאִים וְעַתָּה
עֲלוּ כִּי־אֹתוֹ כְהַיּוֹם תִּמְצְאוּן אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up
to the shrine to eat; the people will not eat until he comes; for
he must first bless the sacrifice and only then will the guests
eat. Go up at once, for you will find him right away.”

translation.text: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him, before he goes up to the shrine to eat. For the people will not eat until he comes, since he must bless the sacrifice; afterward those eat who are invited. Now go up, for you will meet him immediately."

verses.english:
So they went up to the town; and as they were entering the town,
Samuel came out toward them, on his way up to the shrine.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ הָעִיר הֵמָּה בָּאִים בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתָם לַעֲלוֹת הַבָּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ הָעִיר הֵמָּה בָּאִים בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתָם לַעֲלוֹת הַבָּמָה׃

english.text:
So they went up to the town; and as they were entering the town,
Samuel came out toward them, on his way up to the shrine.

translation.text: So they went up to the town. As them on his way up to the shrine.

verses.english:
Now the day before Saul came, YHWH had revealed the following to
Samuel:
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה גָּלָה אֶת־אֹזֶן שְׁמוּאֵל יוֹם אֶחָד לִפְנֵי בוֹא־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה גָּלָה אֶת־אֹזֶן שְׁמוּאֵל יוֹם אֶחָד לִפְנֵי בוֹא־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Now the day before Saul came, YHWH had revealed the following to
Samuel:

translation.text: Now the day before Saul came, the LORD had revealed to Samuel:

verses.english:
“At this time tomorrow, I will send a man to you from the
territory of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him ruler of My people
Israel. He will deliver My people from the hands of the
Philistines; for I have taken note of My people, their outcry has
come to Me.”
verses.hebrew:
כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ אִישׁ מֵאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן וּמְשַׁחְתּוֹ לְנָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־עַמִּי מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי רָאִיתִי אֶת־עַמִּי כִּי בָּאָה
צַעֲקָתוֹ אֵלָי׃

כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ אִישׁ מֵאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן וּמְשַׁחְתּוֹ לְנָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־עַמִּי מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי רָאִיתִי אֶת־עַמִּי כִּי בָּאָה
צַעֲקָתוֹ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
“At this time tomorrow, I will send a man to you from the
territory of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him ruler of My people
Israel. He will deliver My people from the hands of the
Philistines; for I have taken note of My people, their outcry has
come to Me.”

translation.text: Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be ruler over my people Israel. seen the suffering of my people, because their outcry has come to me."

verses.english:
As soon as Samuel saw Saul, YHWH declared to him, “This is the man
that I told you would govern My people.”
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל רָאָה אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיהֹוָה עָנָהוּ הִנֵּה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ זֶה יַעְצֹר בְּעַמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל רָאָה אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיהֹוָה עָנָהוּ הִנֵּה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ זֶה יַעְצֹר בְּעַמִּי׃

english.text:
As soon as Samuel saw Saul, YHWH declared to him, “This is the man
that I told you would govern My people.”

translation.text: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD told him, "Here is the man of whom I spoke to you. He it is who shall rule over my people."

verses.english:
Saul approached Samuel inside the gate and said to him, “Tell me,
please, where is the house of the seer?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ שָׁאוּל אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי אֵי־זֶה בֵּית הָרֹאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ שָׁאוּל אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי אֵי־זֶה בֵּית הָרֹאֶה׃

english.text:
Saul approached Samuel inside the gate and said to him, “Tell me,
please, where is the house of the seer?”

translation.text: Then where is the house of the seer?"

verses.english:
And Samuel answered Saul, “I am the seer. Go up ahead of me to the
shrine, for you shall eat with me today; and in the morning I will
let you go, after telling you whatever may be on your mind.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי הָרֹאֶה עֲלֵה לְפָנַי הַבָּמָה וַאֲכַלְתֶּם עִמִּי הַיּוֹם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ בַבֹּקֶר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי הָרֹאֶה עֲלֵה לְפָנַי הַבָּמָה וַאֲכַלְתֶּם עִמִּי הַיּוֹם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ בַבֹּקֶר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃

english.text:
And Samuel answered Saul, “I am the seer. Go up ahead of me to the
shrine, for you shall eat with me today; and in the morning I will
let you go, after telling you whatever may be on your mind.

translation.text: Samuel answered Saul, "I am the and in the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is on your mind.

verses.english:
As for your asses that strayed three days ago, do not concern
yourself about them, for they have been found. And for whom is all
Israel yearning, if not for you and all your ancestral house?”
verses.hebrew: וְלָאֲתֹנוֹת הָאֹבְדוֹת לְךָ הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים אַל־תָּשֶׂם אֶת־לִבְּךָ לָהֶם כִּי נִמְצָאוּ וּלְמִי כּל־חֶמְדַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלוֹא לְךָ וּלְכֹל בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָאֲתֹנוֹת הָאֹבְדוֹת לְךָ הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים אַל־תָּשֶׂם אֶת־לִבְּךָ לָהֶם כִּי נִמְצָאוּ וּלְמִי כּל־חֶמְדַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלוֹא לְךָ וּלְכֹל בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
As for your asses that strayed three days ago, do not concern
yourself about them, for they have been found. And for whom is all
Israel yearning, if not for you and all your ancestral house?”

translation.text: As for your donkeys that were lost three days ago, give no all Israel's desire fixed, if not on you and on all your ancestral house?"

verses.english:
Saul replied, “But I am only a Benjaminite, from the smallest of
the tribes of Israel, and my clan is the least of all the clans of
the tribe of Benjamin! Why do you say such things to me?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא בֶן־יְמִינִי אָנֹכִי מִקְּטַנֵּי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִשְׁפַּחְתִּי הַצְּעִרָה מִכּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן וְלָמָּה דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלַי
כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא בֶן־יְמִינִי אָנֹכִי מִקְּטַנֵּי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִשְׁפַּחְתִּי הַצְּעִרָה מִכּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן וְלָמָּה דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלַי
כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Saul replied, “But I am only a Benjaminite, from the smallest of
the tribes of Israel, and my clan is the least of all the clans of
the tribe of Benjamin! Why do you say such things to me?”

translation.text: Saul answered, "I am only a Benjaminite, from the least of the tribes of Israel, and my family is the humblest of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin. Why then have you spoken to me in this way?"

verses.english:
Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the hall,
and gave them a place at the head of the guests, who numbered
about thirty.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹ וַיְבִיאֵם לִשְׁכָּתָה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מָקוֹם בְּרֹאשׁ הַקְּרוּאִים וְהֵמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁם אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹ וַיְבִיאֵם לִשְׁכָּתָה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מָקוֹם בְּרֹאשׁ הַקְּרוּאִים וְהֵמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁם אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the hall,
and gave them a place at the head of the guests, who numbered
about thirty.

translation.text: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant-boy and brought them into invited, of whom there were about thirty.

verses.english:
And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you
and told you to set aside.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל לַטַּבָּח תְּנָה אֶת־הַמָּנָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ שִׂים אֹתָהּ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל לַטַּבָּח תְּנָה אֶת־הַמָּנָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ שִׂים אֹתָהּ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you
and told you to set aside.”

translation.text: And Samuel said to the cook, "Bring the portion I gave you, the one I asked you to put aside."

verses.english:
The cook lifted up the thigh and what was on it, and set it before
Saul. And [Samuel] said, “What has been reserved is set before
you. Eat; it has been kept for you for this occasion, when I said
I was inviting the people.” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּרֶם הַטַּבָּח אֶת־הַשּׁוֹק וְהֶעָלֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הַנִּשְׁאָר שִׂים־לְפָנֶיךָ אֱכֹל כִּי לַמּוֹעֵד שָׁמוּר־לְךָ לֵאמֹר הָעָם קָרָאתִי וַיֹּאכַל
שָׁאוּל עִם־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּרֶם הַטַּבָּח אֶת־הַשּׁוֹק וְהֶעָלֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הַנִּשְׁאָר שִׂים־לְפָנֶיךָ אֱכֹל כִּי לַמּוֹעֵד שָׁמוּר־לְךָ לֵאמֹר הָעָם קָרָאתִי וַיֹּאכַל
שָׁאוּל עִם־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The cook lifted up the thigh and what was on it, and set it before
Saul. And [Samuel] said, “What has been reserved is set before
you. Eat; it has been kept for you for this occasion, when I said
I was inviting the people.” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

translation.text: The cook took up the thigh and what went with it and set them before Saul. Samuel said, "See, what was kept is set before you. Eat; with the guests." So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

verses.english:
They then descended from the shrine to the town, and [Samuel]
talked with Saul on the roof.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהַבָּמָה הָעִיר וַיְדַבֵּר עִם־שָׁאוּל עַל־הַגָּג׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהַבָּמָה הָעִיר וַיְדַבֵּר עִם־שָׁאוּל עַל־הַגָּג׃

english.text:
They then descended from the shrine to the town, and [Samuel]
talked with Saul on the roof.

translation.text: When they came down from the shrine into the town, a bed was spread for Saul on the roof, and he lay down to sleep.

verses.english:
Early, at the break of day, Samuel called to Saul on the roof. He
said, “Get up, and I will send you off.” Saul arose, and the two
of them, Samuel and he, went outside.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ וַיְהִי כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל (הגג) [הַגָּגָה] לֵאמֹר קוּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיָּקם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל
הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ וַיְהִי כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל (הגג) [הַגָּגָה] לֵאמֹר קוּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיָּקם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל
הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
Early, at the break of day, Samuel called to Saul on the roof. He
said, “Get up, and I will send you off.” Saul arose, and the two
of them, Samuel and he, went outside.

translation.text: Then at the break of dawn Samuel called to Saul up, and both he and Samuel went out into the street.

verses.english:
As they were walking toward the end of the town, Samuel said to
Saul, “Tell the servant to walk ahead of us”—and he walked
ahead—“but you stop here a moment and I will make known to you the
word of God.”
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה יוֹרְדִים בִּקְצֵה הָעִיר וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱמֹר לַנַּעַר וְיַעֲבֹר לְפָנֵינוּ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאַתָּה עֲמֹד כַּיּוֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת־דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה יוֹרְדִים בִּקְצֵה הָעִיר וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱמֹר לַנַּעַר וְיַעֲבֹר לְפָנֵינוּ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאַתָּה עֲמֹד כַּיּוֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת־דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
As they were walking toward the end of the town, Samuel said to
Saul, “Tell the servant to walk ahead of us”—and he walked
ahead—“but you stop here a moment and I will make known to you the
word of God.”

translation.text: As they were going down to the outskirts of the town, Samuel said of God."

verses.english:
Samuel took a flask of oil and poured some on Saul’s head and
kissed him, and said, “YHWH herewith anoints you ruler over His
own people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּצֹק עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא כִּי־מְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְנָגִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּצֹק עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא כִּי־מְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְנָגִיד׃

english.text:
Samuel took a flask of oil and poured some on Saul’s head and
kissed him, and said, “YHWH herewith anoints you ruler over His
own people.

translation.text: Samuel took a vial of oil and poured it on his heritage:

verses.english:
When you leave me today, you will meet two men near the tomb of
Rachel in the territory of Benjamin, at Zelzah, and they will tell
you that the asses you set out to look for have been found, and
that your father has stopped being concerned about the asses and
is worrying about you, saying: ‘What shall I do about my son?’
verses.hebrew:
בְּלֶכְתְּךָ הַיּוֹם מֵעִמָּדִי וּמָצָאתָ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִם־קְבֻרַת רָחֵל בִּגְבוּל בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֶלְצַח וְאָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְבַקֵּשׁ
וְהִנֵּה נָטַשׁ אָבִיךָ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָכֶם לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לִבְנִי׃

hebrew.text:
בְּלֶכְתְּךָ הַיּוֹם מֵעִמָּדִי וּמָצָאתָ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִם־קְבֻרַת רָחֵל בִּגְבוּל בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֶלְצַח וְאָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְבַקֵּשׁ
וְהִנֵּה נָטַשׁ אָבִיךָ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָכֶם לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לִבְנִי׃

english.text:
When you leave me today, you will meet two men near the tomb of
Rachel in the territory of Benjamin, at Zelzah, and they will tell
you that the asses you set out to look for have been found, and
that your father has stopped being concerned about the asses and
is worrying about you, saying: ‘What shall I do about my son?’

translation.text: When you depart from me today you will meet two men by saying: What shall I do about my son?'

verses.english:
You shall pass on from there until you come to the terebinth of
Tabor. There you will be met by three men making a pilgrimage to
God at Bethel. One will be carrying three kids, another will be
carrying three loaves of bread, and the third will be carrying a
jar of wine.
verses.hebrew:
וְחָלַפְתָּ מִשָּׁם וָהָלְאָה וּבָאתָ עַד־אֵלוֹן תָּבוֹר וּמְצָאוּךָ שָּׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים עֹלִים אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד נֹשֵׂא שְׁלֹשָׁה גְדָיִים וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא
שְׁלֹשֶׁת כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא נֵבֶל־יָיִן׃

hebrew.text:
וְחָלַפְתָּ מִשָּׁם וָהָלְאָה וּבָאתָ עַד־אֵלוֹן תָּבוֹר וּמְצָאוּךָ שָּׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים עֹלִים אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד נֹשֵׂא שְׁלֹשָׁה גְדָיִים וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא
שְׁלֹשֶׁת כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא נֵבֶל־יָיִן׃

english.text:
You shall pass on from there until you come to the terebinth of
Tabor. There you will be met by three men making a pilgrimage to
God at Bethel. One will be carrying three kids, another will be
carrying three loaves of bread, and the third will be carrying a
jar of wine.

translation.text: Then you shall go on from carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.

verses.english:
They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you
shall accept.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאֲלוּ לְךָ לְשָׁלוֹם וְנָתְנוּ לְךָ שְׁתֵּי־לֶחֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ מִיָּדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאֲלוּ לְךָ לְשָׁלוֹם וְנָתְנוּ לְךָ שְׁתֵּי־לֶחֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ מִיָּדָם׃

english.text:
They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you
shall accept.

translation.text: accept from them.

verses.english:
After that, you are to go on to the Hill of God, where the
Philistine prefects reside. There, as you enter the town, you will
encounter a band of prophets coming down from the shrine, preceded
by lyres, timbrels, flutes, and harps, and they will be speaking
in ecstasy.
verses.hebrew:
אַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא גִּבְעַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם נְצִבֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וִיהִי כְבֹאֲךָ שָׁם הָעִיר וּפָגַעְתָּ חֶבֶל נְבִאִים יֹרְדִים מֵהַבָּמָה וְלִפְנֵיהֶם נֵבֶל וְתֹף וְחָלִיל
וְכִנּוֹר וְהֵמָּה מִתְנַבְּאִים׃

hebrew.text:
אַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא גִּבְעַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם נְצִבֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וִיהִי כְבֹאֲךָ שָׁם הָעִיר וּפָגַעְתָּ חֶבֶל נְבִאִים יֹרְדִים מֵהַבָּמָה וְלִפְנֵיהֶם נֵבֶל וְתֹף וְחָלִיל
וְכִנּוֹר וְהֵמָּה מִתְנַבְּאִים׃

english.text:
After that, you are to go on to the Hill of God, where the
Philistine prefects reside. There, as you enter the town, you will
encounter a band of prophets coming down from the shrine, preceded
by lyres, timbrels, flutes, and harps, and they will be speaking
in ecstasy.

translation.text: After that you shall come to Gibeath-elohim, at will be in a prophetic frenzy.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH will grip you, and you will speak in ecstasy
along with them; you will become another man.
verses.hebrew: וְצָלְחָה עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְהִתְנַבִּיתָ עִמָּם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְצָלְחָה עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְהִתְנַבִּיתָ עִמָּם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH will grip you, and you will speak in ecstasy
along with them; you will become another man.

translation.text: Then the spirit of the LORD will possess turned into a different person.

verses.english:
And once these signs have happened to you, act when the occasion
arises, for God is with you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי (תבאינה) [תָבֹאנָה] הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה לָךְ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי (תבאינה) [תָבֹאנָה] הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה לָךְ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And once these signs have happened to you, act when the occasion
arises, for God is with you.

translation.text: Now when these signs meet you, do whatever you see fit to do, for God is with you.

verses.english:
After that, you are to go down to Gilgal ahead of me, and I will
come down to you to present burnt offerings and offer sacrifices
of well-being. Wait seven days until I come to you and instruct
you what you are to do next.”
verses.hebrew:
וְיָרַדְתָּ לְפָנַי הַגִּלְגָּל וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יֹרֵד אֵלֶיךָ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לִזְבֹּחַ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תּוֹחֵל עַד־בּוֹאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי לְךָ אֵת
אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וְיָרַדְתָּ לְפָנַי הַגִּלְגָּל וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יֹרֵד אֵלֶיךָ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לִזְבֹּחַ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תּוֹחֵל עַד־בּוֹאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי לְךָ אֵת
אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
After that, you are to go down to Gilgal ahead of me, and I will
come down to you to present burnt offerings and offer sacrifices
of well-being. Wait seven days until I come to you and instruct
you what you are to do next.”

translation.text: And you shall go burnt offerings and offer sacrifices of well-being. Seven days you shall wait, until I come to you and show you what you shall do."

verses.english:
As [Saul] turned around to leave Samuel, God gave him another
heart; and all those signs were fulfilled that same day.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּהַפְנֹתוֹ שִׁכְמוֹ לָלֶכֶת מֵעִם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּהֲפךְ־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵב אַחֵר וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּהַפְנֹתוֹ שִׁכְמוֹ לָלֶכֶת מֵעִם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּהֲפךְ־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵב אַחֵר וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
As [Saul] turned around to leave Samuel, God gave him another
heart; and all those signs were fulfilled that same day.

translation.text: As he turned away to leave Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all these signs were fulfilled that day.

verses.english:
And when they came there, to the Hill, he saw a band of prophets
coming toward him. Thereupon the spirit of God gripped him, and he
spoke in ecstasy among them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ שָׁם הַגִּבְעָתָה וְהִנֵּה חֶבֶל־נְבִאִים לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ שָׁם הַגִּבְעָתָה וְהִנֵּה חֶבֶל־נְבִאִים לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
And when they came there, to the Hill, he saw a band of prophets
coming toward him. Thereupon the spirit of God gripped him, and he
spoke in ecstasy among them.

translation.text: When they were going from possessed him, and he fell into a prophetic frenzy along with them.

verses.english:
When all who knew him previously saw him speaking in ecstasy
together with the prophets, the people said to one another,
“What’s happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul too among the
prophets?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל־יוֹדְעוֹ מֵאִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עִם־נְבִאִים נִבָּאוַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מַה־זֶּה הָיָה לְבֶן־קִישׁ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל־יוֹדְעוֹ מֵאִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עִם־נְבִאִים נִבָּאוַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מַה־זֶּה הָיָה לְבֶן־קִישׁ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִים׃

english.text:
When all who knew him previously saw him speaking in ecstasy
together with the prophets, the people said to one another,
“What’s happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul too among the
prophets?”

translation.text: son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?"

verses.english:
But another person there spoke up and said, “And who are their
fathers?” Thus the proverb arose: “Is Saul too among the
prophets?”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מִשָּׁם וַיֹּאמֶר וּמִי אֲבִיהֶם עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה לְמָשָׁל הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מִשָּׁם וַיֹּאמֶר וּמִי אֲבִיהֶם עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה לְמָשָׁל הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִאִים׃

english.text:
But another person there spoke up and said, “And who are their
fathers?” Thus the proverb arose: “Is Saul too among the
prophets?”

translation.text: A man of the place "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

verses.english: And when he stopped speaking in ecstasy, he entered the shrine.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֵהִתְנַבּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַבָּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל מֵהִתְנַבּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַבָּמָה׃

english.text: And when he stopped speaking in ecstasy, he entered the shrine.

translation.text: When his prophetic frenzy had ended, he went home.

verses.english:
Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?” “To
look for the asses,” he replied. “And when we saw that they were
not to be found, we went to Samuel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו וְאֶל־נַעֲרוֹ אָן הֲלַכְתֶּם וַיֹּאמֶר לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וַנִּרְאֶה כִי־אַיִן וַנָּבוֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו וְאֶל־נַעֲרוֹ אָן הֲלַכְתֶּם וַיֹּאמֶר לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וַנִּרְאֶה כִי־אַיִן וַנָּבוֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?” “To
look for the asses,” he replied. “And when we saw that they were
not to be found, we went to Samuel.”

translation.text: Saul's uncle said to him and to the boy, "Where did you go?" And be found, we went to Samuel."

verses.english: “Tell me,” said Saul’s uncle, “what did Samuel say to you?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי מָה־אָמַר לָכֶם שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי מָה־אָמַר לָכֶם שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text: “Tell me,” said Saul’s uncle, “what did Samuel say to you?”

translation.text: Saul's uncle said, "Tell me what Samuel said to you."

verses.english:
Saul answered his uncle, “He just told us that the asses had been
found.” But he did not tell him anything of what Samuel had said
about the kingship.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דּוֹדוֹ הַגֵּד הִגִּיד לָנוּ כִּי נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאֶת־דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה לֹא־הִגִּיד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דּוֹדוֹ הַגֵּד הִגִּיד לָנוּ כִּי נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאֶת־דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה לֹא־הִגִּיד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Saul answered his uncle, “He just told us that the asses had been
found.” But he did not tell him anything of what Samuel had said
about the kingship.

translation.text: Saul said to his uncle, "He told us that the which Samuel had spoken, he did not tell him anything.

verses.english: Samuel summoned the people to YHWH at Mizpah
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצְעֵק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצְעֵק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text: Samuel summoned the people to YHWH at Mizpah

translation.text: Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah

verses.english:
and said to them, “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: ‘I brought
Israel out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the hands of the
Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵלכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם וָאַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת
הַלֹּחֲצִים אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text:

Samuel brought forward each of the tribes of Israel, and the lot

chosen? There is none like him among all the people.” And all the
people acclaimed him, shouting, “Long live the king!”

verses.english:
Samuel expounded to the people the rules of the monarchy, and
recorded them in a document which he deposited before YHWH. Samuel
then sent the people back to their homes.

that we may send messengers throughout the territory of Israel; if
no one comes to our aid, we will surrender to you.”

The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days’ respite, so
that we may send messengers throughout the territory of Israel; if
no one comes to our aid, we will surrender to you.”

translation.text: The elders of Jabesh said to him, "Give us seven days' respite if there is no one to save us, we will give ourselves up to you."

verses.english:
When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and gave this report in
the hearing of the people, all the people broke into weeping.

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל וַיְדַבְּרוּ הַדְּבָרִים בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וַיִּשְׂאוּ כל־הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and gave this report in

asked, “Why are the people crying?” And they told him about the
situation of the men of Jabesh.

anger blazed up.
