english.text:
When he heard these things, the spirit of God gripped Saul and his
anger blazed up.

translation.text: And the spirit anger was greatly kindled.

verses.english:
He took a yoke of oxen and cut them into pieces, which he sent by
messengers throughout the territory of Israel, with the warning,
“Thus shall be done to the cattle of anyone who does not follow
Saul and Samuel into battle!” Terror from YHWH fell upon the
people, and they came out as one man.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח צֶמֶד בָּקָר וַיְנַתְּחֵהוּ וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיַד הַמַּלְאָכִים לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ יֹצֵא אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וְאַחַר שְׁמוּאֵל כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה
לִבְקָרוֹ וַיִּפֹּל פַּחַד־יְהֹוָה עַל־הָעָם וַיֵּצְאוּ כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח צֶמֶד בָּקָר וַיְנַתְּחֵהוּ וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיַד הַמַּלְאָכִים לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ יֹצֵא אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וְאַחַר שְׁמוּאֵל כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה
לִבְקָרוֹ וַיִּפֹּל פַּחַד־יְהֹוָה עַל־הָעָם וַיֵּצְאוּ כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

english.text:
He took a yoke of oxen and cut them into pieces, which he sent by
messengers throughout the territory of Israel, with the warning,
“Thus shall be done to the cattle of anyone who does not follow
Saul and Samuel into battle!” Terror from YHWH fell upon the
people, and they came out as one man.

translation.text: He took a yoke of oxen, and cut them in fell upon the people, and they came out as one.

verses.english:
[Saul] mustered them in Bezek, and the Israelites numbered
300,000, the men of Judah 30,000.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקְדֵם בְּבָזֶק וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקְדֵם בְּבָזֶק וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
[Saul] mustered them in Bezek, and the Israelites numbered
300,000, the men of Judah 30,000.

translation.text: When he mustered those from Judah seventy thousand.

verses.english:
The messengers who had come were told, “Thus shall you speak to
the men of Jabesh-gilead: Tomorrow, when the sun grows hot, you
shall be saved.” When the messengers came and told this to the men
of Jabesh-gilead, they rejoiced.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַמַּלְאָכִים הַבָּאִים כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן לְאִישׁ יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד מָחָר תִּהְיֶה־לָכֶם תְּשׁוּעָה (בחם) [כְּחֹם] הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּידוּ
לְאַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ וַיִּשְׂמָחוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַמַּלְאָכִים הַבָּאִים כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן לְאִישׁ יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד מָחָר תִּהְיֶה־לָכֶם תְּשׁוּעָה (בחם) [כְּחֹם] הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּידוּ
לְאַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ וַיִּשְׂמָחוּ׃

english.text:
The messengers who had come were told, “Thus shall you speak to
the men of Jabesh-gilead: Tomorrow, when the sun grows hot, you
shall be saved.” When the messengers came and told this to the men
of Jabesh-gilead, they rejoiced.

translation.text: They said to the messengers who had come, "Thus shall you say to the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead: 'Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you shall have deliverance.'" rejoiced.

verses.english:
The men of Jabesh then told [the Ammonites], “Tomorrow we will
surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you please.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ מָחָר נֵצֵא אֲלֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָנוּ כְּכל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ מָחָר נֵצֵא אֲלֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָנוּ כְּכל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
The men of Jabesh then told [the Ammonites], “Tomorrow we will
surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you please.”

translation.text: So the inhabitants of Jabesh said, "Tomorrow we will give you."

verses.english:
The next day, Saul divided the troops into three columns; at the
morning watch they entered the camp and struck down the Ammonites
until the day grew hot. The survivors scattered; no two were left
together.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּשֶׂם שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ בְתוֹךְ־הַמַּחֲנֶה בְּאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַבֹּקֶר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־עַמּוֹן עַד־חֹם הַיּוֹם וַיְהִי הַנִּשְׁאָרִים
וַיָּפֻצוּ וְלֹא נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָם שְׁנַיִם יָחַד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּשֶׂם שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ בְתוֹךְ־הַמַּחֲנֶה בְּאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַבֹּקֶר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־עַמּוֹן עַד־חֹם הַיּוֹם וַיְהִי הַנִּשְׁאָרִים
וַיָּפֻצוּ וְלֹא נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָם שְׁנַיִם יָחַד׃

english.text:
The next day, Saul divided the troops into three columns; at the
morning watch they entered the camp and struck down the Ammonites
until the day grew hot. The survivors scattered; no two were left
together.

translation.text: The next day Saul put the people in three companies. At the that no two of them were left together.

verses.english:
The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it said, ‘Shall Saul be
king over us?’ Hand the men over and we will put them to death!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל מִי הָאֹמֵר שָׁאוּל יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ תְּנוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וּנְמִיתֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל מִי הָאֹמֵר שָׁאוּל יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ תְּנוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וּנְמִיתֵם׃

english.text:
The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it said, ‘Shall Saul be
king over us?’ Hand the men over and we will put them to death!”

translation.text: The people said to Samuel, "Who is it that said, 'Shall Saul reign over us?' Give them to us so that we may put them to death."

verses.english:
But Saul replied, “No man shall be put to death this day! For this
day YHWH has brought victory to Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לֹא־יוּמַת אִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה־יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לֹא־יוּמַת אִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה־יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Saul replied, “No man shall be put to death this day! For this
day YHWH has brought victory to Israel.”

translation.text: But Saul brought deliverance to Israel."

verses.english:
Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there
inaugurate the monarchy.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה הַגִּלְגָּל וּנְחַדֵּשׁ שָׁם הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה הַגִּלְגָּל וּנְחַדֵּשׁ שָׁם הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text:
Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there
inaugurate the monarchy.”

translation.text: Samuel said to the people, "Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingship."

verses.english:
So all the people went to Gilgal, and there at Gilgal they
declared Saul king before YHWH. They offered sacrifices of
well-being there before YHWH; and Saul and all the men of Israel
held a great celebration there.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הָעָם הַגִּלְגָּל וַיַּמְלִכוּ שָׁם אֶת־שָׁאוּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם זְבָחִים שְׁלָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׂמַח שָׁם שָׁאוּל
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הָעָם הַגִּלְגָּל וַיַּמְלִכוּ שָׁם אֶת־שָׁאוּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם זְבָחִים שְׁלָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׂמַח שָׁם שָׁאוּל
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־מְאֹד׃

english.text:
So all the people went to Gilgal, and there at Gilgal they
declared Saul king before YHWH. They offered sacrifices of
well-being there before YHWH; and Saul and all the men of Israel
held a great celebration there.

translation.text: So all the people went to Gilgal, and there Israelites rejoiced greatly.

verses.english:
Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have yielded to you in all you
have asked of me and have set a king over you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי בְקֹלְכֶם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־אֲמַרְתֶּם לִי וָאַמְלִיךְ עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי בְקֹלְכֶם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־אֲמַרְתֶּם לִי וָאַמְלִיךְ עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have yielded to you in all you
have asked of me and have set a king over you.

translation.text: Samuel said to all Israel, "I have listened to you in all that you have said to me, and have set a king over you.

verses.english:
Henceforth the king will be your leader. “As for me, I have grown
old and gray—but my sons are still with you—and I have been your
leader from my youth to this day.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי וָשַׂבְתִּי וּבָנַי הִנָּם אִתְּכֶם וַאֲנִי הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם מִנְּעֻרַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי וָשַׂבְתִּי וּבָנַי הִנָּם אִתְּכֶם וַאֲנִי הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם מִנְּעֻרַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Henceforth the king will be your leader. “As for me, I have grown
old and gray—but my sons are still with you—and I have been your
leader from my youth to this day.

translation.text: See, it is the king who leads from my youth until this day.

verses.english:
Here I am! Testify against me, in the presence of YHWH and in the
presence of His anointed one: Whose ox have I taken, or whose ass
have I taken? Whom have I defrauded or whom have I robbed? From
whom have I taken a bribe to look the other way? I will return it
to you.”
verses.hebrew:
הִנְנִי עֲנוּ בִי נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה וְנֶגֶד מְשִׁיחוֹ אֶת־שׁוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וַחֲמוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וְאֶת־מִי עָשַׁקְתִּי אֶת־מִי רַצּוֹתִי וּמִיַּד־מִי לָקַחְתִּי כֹפֶר וְאַעְלִים
עֵינַי בּוֹ וְאָשִׁיב לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
הִנְנִי עֲנוּ בִי נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה וְנֶגֶד מְשִׁיחוֹ אֶת־שׁוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וַחֲמוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וְאֶת־מִי עָשַׁקְתִּי אֶת־מִי רַצּוֹתִי וּמִיַּד־מִי לָקַחְתִּי כֹפֶר וְאַעְלִים
עֵינַי בּוֹ וְאָשִׁיב לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Here I am! Testify against me, in the presence of YHWH and in the
presence of His anointed one: Whose ox have I taken, or whose ass
have I taken? Whom have I defrauded or whom have I robbed? From
whom have I taken a bribe to look the other way? I will return it
to you.”

translation.text: Here I am; testify against me before the with it? Testify against me and I will restore it to you."

verses.english:
They responded, “You have not defrauded us, and you have not
robbed us, and you have taken nothing from anyone.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא עֲשַׁקְתָּנוּ וְלֹא רַצּוֹתָנוּ וְלֹא־לָקַחְתָּ מִיַּד־אִישׁ מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא עֲשַׁקְתָּנוּ וְלֹא רַצּוֹתָנוּ וְלֹא־לָקַחְתָּ מִיַּד־אִישׁ מְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
They responded, “You have not defrauded us, and you have not
robbed us, and you have taken nothing from anyone.”

translation.text: They said, the hand of anyone."

verses.english:
He said to them, “YHWH then is witness, and His anointed is
witness, to your admission this day that you have found nothing in
my possession.” They responded, “He is!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם עֵד יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעֵד מְשִׁיחוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא מְצָאתֶם בְּיָדִי מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם עֵד יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעֵד מְשִׁיחוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא מְצָאתֶם בְּיָדִי מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֵד׃

english.text:
He said to them, “YHWH then is witness, and His anointed is
witness, to your admission this day that you have found nothing in
my possession.” They responded, “He is!”

translation.text: He said to them, "The LORD is witness against anything in my hand." And they said, "He is witness."

verses.english:
Samuel said to the people, “YHWH [is witness], He who appointed
Moses and Aaron and who brought your fathers out of the land of
Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַאֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַאֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Samuel said to the people, “YHWH [is witness], He who appointed
Moses and Aaron and who brought your fathers out of the land of
Egypt.

translation.text: Samuel said to the people, "The LORD is witness, who appointed Egypt.

verses.english:
Come, stand before YHWH while I cite against you all the
kindnesses that YHWH has done to you and your fathers.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָה אִתְּכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִתְּכֶם וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָה אִתְּכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִתְּכֶם וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Come, stand before YHWH while I cite against you all the
kindnesses that YHWH has done to you and your fathers.

translation.text: Now therefore take your stand, so that I may enter into ancestors.

verses.english:
“When Jacob came to Egypt,…your fathers cried out to YHWH, and
YHWH sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt
and settled them in this place.
verses.hebrew:
כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא יַעֲקֹב מִצְרָיִם וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיֹּשִׁבוּם בַּמָּקוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא יַעֲקֹב מִצְרָיִם וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיֹּשִׁבוּם בַּמָּקוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“When Jacob came to Egypt,…your fathers cried out to YHWH, and
YHWH sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt
and settled them in this place.

translation.text: When Jacob went into Egypt and the Egyptians oppressed them in this place.

verses.english:
But they forgot YHWH their God; so He delivered them into the
hands of Sisera the military commander of Hazor, into the hands of
the Philistines, and into the hands of the king of Moab; and these
made war upon them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּמְכֹּר אֹתָם בְּיַד סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא חָצוֹר וּבְיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּמְכֹּר אֹתָם בְּיַד סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא חָצוֹר וּבְיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָּם׃

english.text:
But they forgot YHWH their God; so He delivered them into the
hands of Sisera the military commander of Hazor, into the hands of
the Philistines, and into the hands of the king of Moab; and these
made war upon them.

translation.text: But they forgot the LORD their God; and he sold king of Moab; and they fought against them.

verses.english:
They cried to YHWH, ‘We are guilty, for we have forsaken YHWH and
worshiped the Baalim and Ashtaroth. Oh, deliver us from our
enemies and we will serve You.’
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה (ויאמר) [וַיֹּאמְרוּ] חָטָאנוּ כִּי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְעַתָּה הַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד אֹיְבֵינוּ
וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה (ויאמר) [וַיֹּאמְרוּ] חָטָאנוּ כִּי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְעַתָּה הַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד אֹיְבֵינוּ
וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

english.text:
They cried to YHWH, ‘We are guilty, for we have forsaken YHWH and
worshiped the Baalim and Ashtaroth. Oh, deliver us from our
enemies and we will serve You.’

translation.text: Then they cried to the the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.'

verses.english:
And YHWH sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and
delivered you from the enemies around you; and you dwelt in
security.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרֻבַּעַל וְאֶת־בְּדָן וְאֶת־יִפְתָּח וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיכֶם מִסָּבִיב וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בֶּטַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרֻבַּעַל וְאֶת־בְּדָן וְאֶת־יִפְתָּח וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיכֶם מִסָּבִיב וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בֶּטַח׃

english.text:
And YHWH sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and
delivered you from the enemies around you; and you dwelt in
security.

translation.text: And the LORD sent of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.

verses.english:
But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was advancing
against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king reigning
over us’—though YHWH your God is your King.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְאוּ כִּי־נָחָשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לִי לֹא כִּי־מֶלֶךְ יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מַלְכְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּרְאוּ כִּי־נָחָשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לִי לֹא כִּי־מֶלֶךְ יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מַלְכְּכֶם׃

english.text:
But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was advancing
against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king reigning
over us’—though YHWH your God is your King.

translation.text: LORD your God was your king.

verses.english:
“Well, YHWH has set a king over you! Here is the king that you
have chosen, that you have asked for.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם אֲשֶׁר שְׁאֶלְתֶּם וְהִנֵּה נָתַן יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם אֲשֶׁר שְׁאֶלְתֶּם וְהִנֵּה נָתַן יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
“Well, YHWH has set a king over you! Here is the king that you
have chosen, that you have asked for.

translation.text: See, here is the king whom you have you.

verses.english:
“If you will revere YHWH, worship Him, and obey Him, and will not
flout YHWH’s command, if both you and the king who reigns over you
will follow YHWH your God, [well and good].
verses.hebrew:
אִם־תִּירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלוֹ וְלֹא תַמְרוּ אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וִהְיִתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אַחַר יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־תִּירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלוֹ וְלֹא תַמְרוּ אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וִהְיִתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אַחַר יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“If you will revere YHWH, worship Him, and obey Him, and will not
flout YHWH’s command, if both you and the king who reigns over you
will follow YHWH your God, [well and good].

translation.text: If you will fear the LORD and serve him and heed his voice and well;

verses.english:
But if you do not obey YHWH and you flout YHWH’s command, the hand
of YHWH will strike you as it did your fathers.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְרִיתֶם אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהָיְתָה יַד־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְרִיתֶם אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהָיְתָה יַד־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
But if you do not obey YHWH and you flout YHWH’s command, the hand
of YHWH will strike you as it did your fathers.

translation.text: but if you will not heed the voice of the LORD, but rebel against against you and your king.

verses.english:
“Now stand by and see the marvelous thing that YHWH will do before
your eyes.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־עַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־עַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Now stand by and see the marvelous thing that YHWH will do before
your eyes.

translation.text: Now therefore take your stand and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.

verses.english:
It is the season of the wheat harvest. I will pray to YHWH and He
will send thunder and rain; then you will take thought and realize
what a wicked thing you did in the sight of YHWH when you asked
for a king.”
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא קְצִיר־חִטִּים הַיּוֹם אֶקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְיִתֵּן קֹלוֹת וּמָטָר וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־רָעַתְכֶם רַבָּה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לִשְׁאוֹל לָכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא קְצִיר־חִטִּים הַיּוֹם אֶקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְיִתֵּן קֹלוֹת וּמָטָר וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־רָעַתְכֶם רַבָּה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לִשְׁאוֹל לָכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
It is the season of the wheat harvest. I will pray to YHWH and He
will send thunder and rain; then you will take thought and realize
what a wicked thing you did in the sight of YHWH when you asked
for a king.”

translation.text: Is it not the you have done in the sight of the LORD is great in demanding a king for yourselves."

verses.english:
Samuel prayed to YHWH, and YHWH sent thunder and rain that day,
and the people stood in awe of YHWH and of Samuel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה קֹלֹת וּמָטָר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּירָא כל־הָעָם מְאֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה קֹלֹת וּמָטָר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּירָא כל־הָעָם מְאֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Samuel prayed to YHWH, and YHWH sent thunder and rain that day,
and the people stood in awe of YHWH and of Samuel.

translation.text: So Samuel called upon the LORD, and the LORD sent and Samuel.

verses.english:
The people all said to Samuel, “Intercede for your servants with
YHWH your God that we may not die, for we have added to all our
sins the wickedness of asking for a king.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאַל־נָמוּת כִּי־יָסַפְנוּ עַל־כּל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ רָעָה לִשְׁאֹל לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאַל־נָמוּת כִּי־יָסַפְנוּ עַל־כּל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ רָעָה לִשְׁאֹל לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The people all said to Samuel, “Intercede for your servants with
YHWH your God that we may not die, for we have added to all our
sins the wickedness of asking for a king.”

translation.text: All the people said to Samuel, "Pray to the LORD your God for your servants, so that we may not die; for we have added to all our sins the evil of demanding a king for ourselves."

verses.english:
But Samuel said to the people, “Have no fear. You have, indeed,
done all those wicked things. Do not, however, turn away from
YHWH, but serve YHWH with all your heart.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אַל־תִּירָאוּ אַתֶּם עֲשִׂיתֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אַךְ אַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֶת־יְהֹוָה בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אַל־תִּירָאוּ אַתֶּם עֲשִׂיתֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אַךְ אַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֶת־יְהֹוָה בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם׃

english.text:
But Samuel said to the people, “Have no fear. You have, indeed,
done all those wicked things. Do not, however, turn away from
YHWH, but serve YHWH with all your heart.

translation.text: And Samuel said to the people, "Do not be afraid; you have done all this evil, yet do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;

verses.english:
Do not turn away to follow worthless things, which can neither
profit nor save but are worthless.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָּסוּרוּ כִּי אַחֲרֵי הַתֹּהוּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ וְלֹא יַצִּילוּ כִּי־תֹהוּ הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָּסוּרוּ כִּי אַחֲרֵי הַתֹּהוּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ וְלֹא יַצִּילוּ כִּי־תֹהוּ הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
Do not turn away to follow worthless things, which can neither
profit nor save but are worthless.

translation.text: and do not turn aside after useless things that cannot profit or save, for they are useless.

verses.english:
For the sake of His great name, YHWH will never abandon His
people, seeing that YHWH undertook to make you His people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל כִּי הוֹאִיל יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶתְכֶם לוֹ לְעָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל כִּי הוֹאִיל יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶתְכֶם לוֹ לְעָם׃

english.text:
For the sake of His great name, YHWH will never abandon His
people, seeing that YHWH undertook to make you His people.

translation.text: For the LORD will not cast away his people, for people for himself.

verses.english:
“As for me, far be it from me to sin against YHWH and refrain from
praying for you; and I will continue to instruct you in the
practice of what is good and right.
verses.hebrew: גַּם אָנֹכִי חָלִילָה לִּי מֵחֲטֹא לַיהֹוָה מֵחֲדֹל לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם בְּדֶרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה וְהַיְשָׁרָה׃

hebrew.text: גַּם אָנֹכִי חָלִילָה לִּי מֵחֲטֹא לַיהֹוָה מֵחֲדֹל לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם בְּדֶרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה וְהַיְשָׁרָה׃

english.text:
“As for me, far be it from me to sin against YHWH and refrain from
praying for you; and I will continue to instruct you in the
practice of what is good and right.

translation.text: Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I instruct you in the good and the right way.

verses.english:
Above all, you must revere YHWH and serve Him faithfully with all
your heart; and consider how grandly He has dealt with you.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם כִּי רְאוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הִגְדִּל עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם כִּי רְאוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הִגְדִּל עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
Above all, you must revere YHWH and serve Him faithfully with all
your heart; and consider how grandly He has dealt with you.

translation.text: Only fear the LORD, and serve him faithfully with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.

verses.english:
For if you persist in your wrongdoing, both you and your king
shall be swept away.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָרֵעַ תָּרֵעוּ גַּם־אַתֶּם גַּם־מַלְכְּכֶם תִּסָּפוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־הָרֵעַ תָּרֵעוּ גַּם־אַתֶּם גַּם־מַלְכְּכֶם תִּסָּפוּ׃

english.text:
For if you persist in your wrongdoing, both you and your king
shall be swept away.”

translation.text: But if you still do wickedly, you shall be swept away, both you and your king."

verses.english:
Saul was… years old when he became king, and he reigned over
Israel two years.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שָׁנָה שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁתֵּי שָׁנִים מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שָׁנָה שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁתֵּי שָׁנִים מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Saul was… years old when he became king, and he reigned over
Israel two years.

translation.text: Saul was years old when he began to reign; and he reigned and two years over Israel.

verses.english:
Saul picked 3,000 Israelites, of whom 2,000 were with Saul in
Michmas and in the hill country of Bethel, and 1,000 with Jonathan
in Gibeah of Benjamin; the rest of the troops he sent back to
their homes.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְחַר־לוֹ שָׁאוּל שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ עִם־שָׁאוּל אַלְפַּיִם בְּמִכְמָשׂ וּבְהַר בֵּית־אֵל וְאֶלֶף הָיוּ עִם־יוֹנָתָן בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר
הָעָם שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבְחַר־לוֹ שָׁאוּל שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ עִם־שָׁאוּל אַלְפַּיִם בְּמִכְמָשׂ וּבְהַר בֵּית־אֵל וְאֶלֶף הָיוּ עִם־יוֹנָתָן בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר
הָעָם שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃

english.text:
Saul picked 3,000 Israelites, of whom 2,000 were with Saul in
Michmas and in the hill country of Bethel, and 1,000 with Jonathan
in Gibeah of Benjamin; the rest of the troops he sent back to
their homes.

translation.text: Saul chose three thousand out of Israel; two thousand were with Saul to their tents.

verses.english:
Jonathan struck down the Philistine prefect in Geba; and the
Philistines heard about it. Saul had the ram’s horn sounded
throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ יוֹנָתָן אֵת נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּגֶבַע וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְשָׁאוּל תָּקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר יִשְׁמְעוּ הָעִבְרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ יוֹנָתָן אֵת נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּגֶבַע וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְשָׁאוּל תָּקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר יִשְׁמְעוּ הָעִבְרִים׃

english.text:
Jonathan struck down the Philistine prefect in Geba; and the
Philistines heard about it. Saul had the ram’s horn sounded
throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear.”

translation.text: Jonathan defeated the garrison of the Philistines that was at Geba; and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, "Let the Hebrews hear!"

verses.english:
When all Israel heard that Saul had struck down the Philistine
prefect, and that Israel had incurred the wrath of the
Philistines, all the people rallied to Saul at Gilgal.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁמְעוּ לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל אֶת־נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם־נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ הָעָם אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל הַגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁמְעוּ לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל אֶת־נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם־נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ הָעָם אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל הַגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
When all Israel heard that Saul had struck down the Philistine
prefect, and that Israel had incurred the wrath of the
Philistines, all the people rallied to Saul at Gilgal.

translation.text: When all Israel heard that Saul had defeated the garrison of the Philistines, and called out to join Saul at Gilgal.

verses.english:
The Philistines, in turn, gathered to attack Israel: 30,000
chariots and 6,000 horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sands
of the seashore. They marched up and encamped at Michmas, east of
Beth-aven.
verses.hebrew:
וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רֶכֶב וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים פָּרָשִׁים וְעָם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ
בְמִכְמָשׂ קִדְמַת בֵּית אָוֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רֶכֶב וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים פָּרָשִׁים וְעָם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ
בְמִכְמָשׂ קִדְמַת בֵּית אָוֶן׃

english.text:
The Philistines, in turn, gathered to attack Israel: 30,000
chariots and 6,000 horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sands
of the seashore. They marched up and encamped at Michmas, east of
Beth-aven.

translation.text: The Philistines mustered to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, Beth-aven.

verses.english:
When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble—for the
troops were hard pressed—the people hid in caves, among thorns,
among rocks, in tunnels, and in cisterns.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי צַר־לוֹ כִּי נִגַּשׂ הָעָם וַיִּתְחַבְּאוּ הָעָם בַּמְּעָרוֹת וּבַחֲוָחִים וּבַסְּלָעִים וּבַצְּרִחִים וּבַבֹּרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי צַר־לוֹ כִּי נִגַּשׂ הָעָם וַיִּתְחַבְּאוּ הָעָם בַּמְּעָרוֹת וּבַחֲוָחִים וּבַסְּלָעִים וּבַצְּרִחִים וּבַבֹּרוֹת׃

english.text:
When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble—for the
troops were hard pressed—the people hid in caves, among thorns,
among rocks, in tunnels, and in cisterns.

translation.text: When the Israelites saw that they were in distress (for the holes and in rocks and in tombs and in cisterns.

verses.english:
Some Hebrews crossed the Jordan, [to] the territory of Gad and
Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal, and the rest of the people
rallied to him in alarm.d
verses.hebrew: וְעִבְרִים עָבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶרֶץ גָּד וְגִלְעָד וְשָׁאוּל עוֹדֶנּוּ בַגִּלְגָּל וְכל־הָעָם חָרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעִבְרִים עָבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶרֶץ גָּד וְגִלְעָד וְשָׁאוּל עוֹדֶנּוּ בַגִּלְגָּל וְכל־הָעָם חָרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Some Hebrews crossed the Jordan, [to] the territory of Gad and
Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal, and the rest of the people
rallied to him in alarm.d

translation.text: Some Hebrews Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

verses.english:
He waited seven days, the time that Samuel [had set]. But when
Samuel failed to come to Gilgal, and the people began to scatter,
verses.hebrew: (וייחל) [וַיּוֹחֶל ] שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלֹא־בָא שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּלְגָּל וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: (וייחל) [וַיּוֹחֶל ] שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלֹא־בָא שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּלְגָּל וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
He waited seven days, the time that Samuel [had set]. But when
Samuel failed to come to Gilgal, and the people began to scatter,

translation.text: He waited seven days, the time appointed by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and the people began to slip away from Saul.

verses.english:
Saul said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the sacrifice of
well-being”; and he presented the burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַגִּשׁוּ אֵלַי הָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיַּעַל הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַגִּשׁוּ אֵלַי הָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיַּעַל הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
Saul said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the sacrifice of
well-being”; and he presented the burnt offering.

translation.text: So well-being." And he offered the burnt offering.

verses.english:
He had just finished presenting the burnt offering when Samuel
arrived; and Saul went out to meet him and welcome him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְהַעֲלוֹת הָעֹלָה וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל בָּא וַיֵּצֵא שָׁאוּל לִקְרָאתוֹ לְבָרְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְהַעֲלוֹת הָעֹלָה וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל בָּא וַיֵּצֵא שָׁאוּל לִקְרָאתוֹ לְבָרְכוֹ׃

english.text:
He had just finished presenting the burnt offering when Samuel
arrived; and Saul went out to meet him and welcome him.

translation.text: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Samuel arrived; and Saul went out to meet him and salute him.

verses.english:
But Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul replied, “I saw the
people leaving me and scattering; you had not come at the
appointed time, and the Philistines had gathered at Michmas.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל מֶה עָשִׂיתָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כִּי־רָאִיתִי כִי־נָפַץ הָעָם מֵעָלַי וְאַתָּה לֹא־בָאתָ לְמוֹעֵד הַיָּמִים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֱסָפִים מִכְמָשׂ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל מֶה עָשִׂיתָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כִּי־רָאִיתִי כִי־נָפַץ הָעָם מֵעָלַי וְאַתָּה לֹא־בָאתָ לְמוֹעֵד הַיָּמִים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֱסָפִים מִכְמָשׂ׃

english.text:
But Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul replied, “I saw the
people leaving me and scattering; you had not come at the
appointed time, and the Philistines had gathered at Michmas.

translation.text: Samuel said, "What have you done?" Philistines were mustering at Michmash,

verses.english:
I thought the Philistines would march down against me at Gilgal
before I had entreated YHWH, so I forced myself to present the
burnt offering.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר עַתָּה יֵרְדוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֵלַי הַגִּלְגָּל וּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא חִלִּיתִי וָאֶתְאַפַּק וָאַעֲלֶה הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר עַתָּה יֵרְדוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֵלַי הַגִּלְגָּל וּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא חִלִּיתִי וָאֶתְאַפַּק וָאַעֲלֶה הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
I thought the Philistines would march down against me at Gilgal
before I had entreated YHWH, so I forced myself to present the
burnt offering.”

translation.text: I said, 'Now the Philistines of the LORD'; so I forced myself, and offered the burnt offering."

verses.english:

commandments that YHWH your God laid upon you! Otherwise YHWH
would have established your dynasty over Israel forever.

verses.english:
No smith was to be found in all the land of Israel, for the
Philistines were afraid that the Hebrews would make swords or
spears.
verses.hebrew: וְחָרָשׁ לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְּכֹל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־[אָמְרוּ] (אמר) פְלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן יַעֲשׂוּ הָעִבְרִים חֶרֶב אוֹ חֲנִית׃

garrison, there was a rocky crag on one side, and another rocky
crag on the other, the one called Bozez and the other Seneh.

verses.english:
Jonathan said to the attendant who carried his arms, “Come, let us
cross over to the outpost of those uncircumcised fellows. Perhaps
YHWH will act in our behalf, for nothing prevents YHWH from
winning a victory by many or by few.”

english.text:
Jonathan said to the attendant who carried his arms, “Come, let us
cross over to the outpost of those uncircumcised fellows. Perhaps
YHWH will act in our behalf, for nothing prevents YHWH from
winning a victory by many or by few.”

translation.text: Jonathan said to the young man who carried his armor, "Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised; it may be that the LORD will act for us; for nothing can hinder the LORD from saving by many or by few."

verses.english:
His arms-bearer answered him, “Do whatever you like. You go first,
I am with you, whatever you decide.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲשֵׂה כּל־אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבֶךָ נְטֵה לָךְ הִנְנִי עִמְּךָ כִּלְבָבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲשֵׂה כּל־אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבֶךָ נְטֵה לָךְ הִנְנִי עִמְּךָ כִּלְבָבֶךָ׃

english.text:
His arms-bearer answered him, “Do whatever you like. You go first,
I am with you, whatever you decide.”

translation.text: His armor-bearer said to him, "Do all that your mind inclines to. I am with you; as your mind is, so is mine."

verses.english: Jonathan said, “We’ll cross over to those men and let them see us.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹבְרִים אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְלִינוּ אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹבְרִים אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְלִינוּ אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text: Jonathan said, “We’ll cross over to those men and let them see us.

translation.text: Then Jonathan said, "Now we will cross over to those men and will show ourselves to them.

verses.english:
If they say to us, ‘Wait until we get to you,’ then we’ll stay
where we are, and not go up to them.
verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ דֹּמּוּ עַד־הַגִּיעֵנוּ אֲלֵיכֶם וְעָמַדְנוּ תַחְתֵּינוּ וְלֹא נַעֲלֶה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ דֹּמּוּ עַד־הַגִּיעֵנוּ אֲלֵיכֶם וְעָמַדְנוּ תַחְתֵּינוּ וְלֹא נַעֲלֶה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
If they say to us, ‘Wait until we get to you,’ then we’ll stay
where we are, and not go up to them.

translation.text: If they say to us, 'Wait until we come to you,' then we will stand still in our place, and we will not go up to them.

verses.english:
But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for YHWH is
delivering them into our hands. That shall be our sign.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ עֲלוּ עָלֵינוּ וְעָלִינוּ כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ וְזֶה־לָּנוּ הָאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ עֲלוּ עָלֵינוּ וְעָלִינוּ כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ וְזֶה־לָּנוּ הָאוֹת׃

english.text:
But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for YHWH is
delivering them into our hands. That shall be our sign.”

translation.text: But if they say, 'Come hand. That will be the sign for us."

verses.english:
They both showed themselves to the Philistine outpost and the
Philistines said, “Look, some Hebrews are coming out of the holes
where they have been hiding.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגָּלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים הִנֵּה עִבְרִים יֹצְאִים מִן־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַבְּאוּ־שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגָּלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים הִנֵּה עִבְרִים יֹצְאִים מִן־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַבְּאוּ־שָׁם׃

english.text:
They both showed themselves to the Philistine outpost and the
Philistines said, “Look, some Hebrews are coming out of the holes
where they have been hiding.”

translation.text: So both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, themselves."

verses.english:
The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his arms-bearer,
“Come up to us, and we’ll teach you a lesson.” Then Jonathan said
to his arms-bearer, “Follow me, for YHWH will deliver them into
the hands of Israel.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמַּצָּבָה אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְנוֹדִיעָה אֶתְכֶם דָּבָרוַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן אֶל־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲלֵה אַחֲרַי
כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמַּצָּבָה אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְנוֹדִיעָה אֶתְכֶם דָּבָרוַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן אֶל־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲלֵה אַחֲרַי
כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his arms-bearer,
“Come up to us, and we’ll teach you a lesson.” Then Jonathan said
to his arms-bearer, “Follow me, for YHWH will deliver them into
the hands of Israel.”

translation.text: The men of the garrison hailed Jonathan and his the LORD has given them into the hand of Israel."

verses.english:
And Jonathan clambered up on his hands and feet, his arms-bearer
behind him; [the Philistines] fell before Jonathan, and his
arms-bearer finished them off behind him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יוֹנָתָן עַל־יָדָיו וְעַל־רַגְלָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו מְמוֹתֵת אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יוֹנָתָן עַל־יָדָיו וְעַל־רַגְלָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו מְמוֹתֵת אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And Jonathan clambered up on his hands and feet, his arms-bearer
behind him; [the Philistines] fell before Jonathan, and his
arms-bearer finished them off behind him.

translation.text: Then Jonathan coming after him, killed them.

verses.english:
The initial attack that Jonathan and his arms-bearer made
accounted for some twenty men, within a space about half a furrow
long [in] an acre of land.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה הָרִאשֹׁנָה אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כְּעֶשְׂרִים אִישׁ כְּבַחֲצִי מַעֲנָה צֶמֶד שָׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה הָרִאשֹׁנָה אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כְּעֶשְׂרִים אִישׁ כְּבַחֲצִי מַעֲנָה צֶמֶד שָׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The initial attack that Jonathan and his arms-bearer made
accounted for some twenty men, within a space about half a furrow
long [in] an acre of land.

translation.text: In that first slaughter Jonathan and furrow long in an acre of land.

verses.english:
Terror broke out among all the troops both in the camp [and] in
the field; the outposts and the raiders were also terrified. The
very earth quaked, and a terror from God ensued.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי חֲרָדָה בַמַּחֲנֶה בַשָּׂדֶה וּבְכל־הָעָם הַמַּצָּב וְהַמַּשְׁחִית חָרְדוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה וַתִּרְגַּז הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי לְחֶרְדַּת אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי חֲרָדָה בַמַּחֲנֶה בַשָּׂדֶה וּבְכל־הָעָם הַמַּצָּב וְהַמַּשְׁחִית חָרְדוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה וַתִּרְגַּז הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי לְחֶרְדַּת אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Terror broke out among all the troops both in the camp [and] in
the field; the outposts and the raiders were also terrified. The
very earth quaked, and a terror from God ensued.

translation.text: There was a panic in the camp, in the trembled; the earth quaked; and it became a very great panic.

verses.english:
Saul’s scouts in Gibeah of Benjamin saw that the multitude was
scattering in all directions.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַצֹּפִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וְהִנֵּה הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג וַיֵּלֶךְ וַהֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ הַצֹּפִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וְהִנֵּה הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג וַיֵּלֶךְ וַהֲלֹם׃

english.text:
Saul’s scouts in Gibeah of Benjamin saw that the multitude was
scattering in all directions.

translation.text: Saul's lookouts in Gibeah of Benjamin were watching as the multitude was surging back and forth.

verses.english:
And Saul said to the troops with him, “Take a count and see who
has left us.” They took a count and found that Jonathan and his
arms-bearer were missing.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ פִּקְדוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ מִי הָלַךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ וַיִּפְקְדוּ וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ פִּקְדוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ מִי הָלַךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ וַיִּפְקְדוּ וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And Saul said to the troops with him, “Take a count and see who
has left us.” They took a count and found that Jonathan and his
arms-bearer were missing.

translation.text: Then Saul said to the troops that were with him, "Call the roll and see who has gone from us." there.

verses.english:
Thereupon Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the Ark of God here”; for
the Ark of God was at the time among the Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַאֲחִיָּה הַגִּישָׁה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־הָיָה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַאֲחִיָּה הַגִּישָׁה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־הָיָה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thereupon Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the Ark of God here”; for
the Ark of God was at the time among the Israelites.

translation.text: Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God here." For at that time the ark of God went with the Israelites.

verses.english:
But while Saul was speaking to the priest, the confusion in the
Philistine camp kept increasing; and Saul said to the priest,
“Withdraw your hand.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַד דִּבֶּר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶהָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וָרָבוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֱסֹף יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עַד דִּבֶּר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶהָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וָרָבוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֱסֹף יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
But while Saul was speaking to the priest, the confusion in the
Philistine camp kept increasing; and Saul said to the priest,
“Withdraw your hand.”

translation.text: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the camp of the Philistines increased more and more; and Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזָּעֵק שָׁאוּל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה הָיְתָה חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ מְהוּמָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזָּעֵק שָׁאוּל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה הָיְתָה חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ מְהוּמָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד׃

translation.text: Then great confusion.

verses.english:
And the Hebrews who had previously sided with the Philistines, who
had come up with them in the army [from] round about—they too
joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעִבְרִים הָיוּ לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה סָבִיב וְגַם־הֵמָּה לִהְיוֹת עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שָׁאוּל וְיוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעִבְרִים הָיוּ לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה סָבִיב וְגַם־הֵמָּה לִהְיוֹת עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שָׁאוּל וְיוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
And the Hebrews who had previously sided with the Philistines, who
had come up with them in the army [from] round about—they too
joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

translation.text: Now the Hebrews who previously had been with joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

verses.english:
When all the men of Israel who were hiding in the hill country of
Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they too pursued

not die.
