hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת פָּקַדְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֲמָלֵק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם לוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּעֲלֹתוֹ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I am exacting the penalty for what
Amalek did to Israel, for the assault he made upon them on the
road, on their way up from Egypt.

translation.text: Thus says the LORD of hosts, 'I will punish the Amalekites for what they did in opposing the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt.

verses.english:
Now go, attack Amalek, and proscribe all that belongs to him.
Spare no one, but kill alike men and women, infants and sucklings,
oxen and sheep, camels and asses!”
verses.hebrew:
עַתָּה לֵךְ וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְהַחֲרַמְתֶּם אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְלֹא תַחְמֹל עָלָיו וְהֵמַתָּה מֵאִישׁ עַד־אִשָּׁה מֵעֹלֵל וְעַד־יוֹנֵק מִשּׁוֹר וְעַד־שֶׂה מִגָּמָל
וְעַד־חֲמוֹר׃

hebrew.text:
עַתָּה לֵךְ וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְהַחֲרַמְתֶּם אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְלֹא תַחְמֹל עָלָיו וְהֵמַתָּה מֵאִישׁ עַד־אִשָּׁה מֵעֹלֵל וְעַד־יוֹנֵק מִשּׁוֹר וְעַד־שֶׂה מִגָּמָל
וְעַד־חֲמוֹר׃

english.text:
Now go, attack Amalek, and proscribe all that belongs to him.
Spare no one, but kill alike men and women, infants and sucklings,
oxen and sheep, camels and asses!”

translation.text: Now go and camel and donkey.'"

verses.english:
Saul mustered the troops and enrolled them at Telaim: 200,000 men
on foot, and 10,000 men of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּפְקְדֵם בַּטְּלָאִים מָאתַיִם אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּפְקְדֵם בַּטְּלָאִים מָאתַיִם אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Saul mustered the troops and enrolled them at Telaim: 200,000 men
on foot, and 10,000 men of Judah.

translation.text: So Saul summoned the people, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand foot soldiers, and ten thousand soldiers of Judah.

verses.english:
Then Saul advanced as far as the city of Amalek and lay in wait in
the wadi.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל עַד־עִיר עֲמָלֵק וַיָּרֶב בַּנָּחַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל עַד־עִיר עֲמָלֵק וַיָּרֶב בַּנָּחַל׃

english.text:
Then Saul advanced as far as the city of Amalek and lay in wait in
the wadi.

translation.text: Saul came to the city of the Amalekites and lay in wait in the valley.

verses.english:
Saul said to the Kenites, “Come, withdraw at once from among the
Amalekites, that I may not destroy you along with them; for you
showed kindness to all the Israelites when they left Egypt.” So
the Kenites withdrew from among the Amalekites.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַקֵּינִי לְכוּ סֻּרוּ רְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִי פֶּן־אֹסִפְךָ עִמּוֹ וְאַתָּה עָשִׂיתָה חֶסֶד עִם־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲלוֹתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּסַר
קֵינִי מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵק׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַקֵּינִי לְכוּ סֻּרוּ רְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִי פֶּן־אֹסִפְךָ עִמּוֹ וְאַתָּה עָשִׂיתָה חֶסֶד עִם־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲלוֹתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּסַר
קֵינִי מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵק׃

english.text:
Saul said to the Kenites, “Come, withdraw at once from among the
Amalekites, that I may not destroy you along with them; for you
showed kindness to all the Israelites when they left Egypt.” So
the Kenites withdrew from among the Amalekites.

translation.text: Kenites withdrew from the Amalekites.

verses.english:
Saul destroyed Amalek from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is
close to Egypt,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ שָׁאוּל אֶת־עֲמָלֵק מֵחֲוִילָה בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ שָׁאוּל אֶת־עֲמָלֵק מֵחֲוִילָה בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Saul destroyed Amalek from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is
close to Egypt,

translation.text: Saul defeated the Amalekites, from Havilah as far as Shur, which is east of Egypt.

verses.english:
and he captured King Agag of Amalek alive. He proscribed all the
people, putting them to the sword;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ־עֲמָלֵק חָי וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם הֶחֱרִים לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ־עֲמָלֵק חָי וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם הֶחֱרִים לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
and he captured King Agag of Amalek alive. He proscribed all the
people, putting them to the sword;

translation.text: He took King Agag of the Amalekites alive, but utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
but Saul and the troops spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the
oxen, the second-born, the lambs, and all else that was of value.
They would not proscribe them; they proscribed only what was cheap
and worthless.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּחְמֹל שָׁאוּל וְהָעָם עַל־אֲגָג וְעַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר וְהַמִּשְׁנִים וְעַל־הַכָּרִים וְעַל־כּל־הַטּוֹב וְלֹא אָבוּ הַחֲרִימָם וְכל־הַמְּלָאכָה נְמִבְזָה וְנָמֵס
אֹתָהּ הֶחֱרִימוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּחְמֹל שָׁאוּל וְהָעָם עַל־אֲגָג וְעַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר וְהַמִּשְׁנִים וְעַל־הַכָּרִים וְעַל־כּל־הַטּוֹב וְלֹא אָבוּ הַחֲרִימָם וְכל־הַמְּלָאכָה נְמִבְזָה וְנָמֵס
אֹתָהּ הֶחֱרִימוּ׃

english.text:
but Saul and the troops spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the
oxen, the second-born, the lambs, and all else that was of value.
They would not proscribe them; they proscribed only what was cheap
and worthless.

translation.text: Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep and of the cattle and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was valuable, and would not utterly destroy them; all that was despised and worthless they utterly destroyed.

verses.english: The word of YHWH then came to Samuel:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: The word of YHWH then came to Samuel:

translation.text: The word of the LORD came to Samuel:

verses.english:
“I regret that I made Saul king, for he has turned away from Me
and has not carried out My commands.” Samuel was distressed and he
entreated YHWH all night long.
verses.hebrew: נִחַמְתִּי כִּי־הִמְלַכְתִּי אֶת־שָׁאוּל לְמֶלֶךְ כִּי־שָׁב מֵאַחֲרַי וְאֶת־דְּבָרַי לֹא הֵקִים וַיִּחַר לִשְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּזְעַק אֶל־יְהֹוָה כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: נִחַמְתִּי כִּי־הִמְלַכְתִּי אֶת־שָׁאוּל לְמֶלֶךְ כִּי־שָׁב מֵאַחֲרַי וְאֶת־דְּבָרַי לֹא הֵקִים וַיִּחַר לִשְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּזְעַק אֶל־יְהֹוָה כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
“I regret that I made Saul king, for he has turned away from Me
and has not carried out My commands.” Samuel was distressed and he
entreated YHWH all night long.

translation.text: "I regret that I made Saul night.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם שְׁמוּאֵל לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בָּא־שָׁאוּל הַכַּרְמֶלָה וְהִנֵּה מַצִּיב לוֹ יָד וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲבֹר וַיֵּרֶד הַגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם שְׁמוּאֵל לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בָּא־שָׁאוּל הַכַּרְמֶלָה וְהִנֵּה מַצִּיב לוֹ יָד וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲבֹר וַיֵּרֶד הַגִּלְגָּל׃

translation.text: Samuel rose early in the morning to meet Saul, and Samuel himself, and on returning he passed on down to Gilgal."

verses.english:
When Samuel came to Saul, Saul said to him, “Blessed are you of
YHWH! I have fulfilled YHWH’s command.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה הֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה הֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When Samuel came to Saul, Saul said to him, “Blessed are you of
YHWH! I have fulfilled YHWH’s command.”

translation.text: When LORD; I have carried out the command of the LORD."

verses.english:
“Then what,” demanded Samuel, “is this bleating of sheep in my
ears, and the lowing of oxen that I hear?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וּמֶה קוֹל־הַצֹּאן הַזֶּה בְּאזְנָי וְקוֹל הַבָּקָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וּמֶה קוֹל־הַצֹּאן הַזֶּה בְּאזְנָי וְקוֹל הַבָּקָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

english.text:
“Then what,” demanded Samuel, “is this bleating of sheep in my
ears, and the lowing of oxen that I hear?”

translation.text: But Samuel said, cattle that I hear?"

verses.english:
Saul answered, “They were brought from the Amalekites, for the
troops spared the choicest of the sheep and oxen for sacrificing
to YHWH your God. And we proscribed the rest.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִי הֱבִיאוּם אֲשֶׁר חָמַל הָעָם עַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר לְמַעַן זְבֹחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֶת־הַיּוֹתֵר הֶחֱרַמְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִי הֱבִיאוּם אֲשֶׁר חָמַל הָעָם עַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר לְמַעַן זְבֹחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֶת־הַיּוֹתֵר הֶחֱרַמְנוּ׃

english.text:
Saul answered, “They were brought from the Amalekites, for the
troops spared the choicest of the sheep and oxen for sacrificing
to YHWH your God. And we proscribed the rest.”

translation.text: Saul said, "They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and the cattle, destroyed."

verses.english:
Samuel said to Saul, “Stop! Let me tell you what YHWH said to me
last night!” “Speak,” he replied.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הֶרֶף וְאַגִּידָה לְּךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַלָּיְלָה (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] לוֹ דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הֶרֶף וְאַגִּידָה לְּךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַלָּיְלָה (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] לוֹ דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
Samuel said to Saul, “Stop! Let me tell you what YHWH said to me
last night!” “Speak,” he replied.

translation.text: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Stop! I will tell you what the LORD said to me last night." He replied, "Speak."

verses.english:
And Samuel said, “You may look small to yourself, but you are the
head of the tribes of Israel. YHWH anointed you king over Israel,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הֲלוֹא אִם־קָטֹן אַתָּה בְּעֵינֶיךָ רֹאשׁ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָתָּה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הֲלוֹא אִם־קָטֹן אַתָּה בְּעֵינֶיךָ רֹאשׁ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָתָּה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Samuel said, “You may look small to yourself, but you are the
head of the tribes of Israel. YHWH anointed you king over Israel,

translation.text: Samuel said, "Though you are little in your own eyes, are you not the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel.

verses.english:
and YHWH sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and proscribe the
sinful Amalekites; make war on them until you have exterminated
them.’
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֲךָ יְהֹוָה בְּדָרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ וְהַחֲרַמְתָּה אֶת־הַחַטָּאִים אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְנִלְחַמְתָּ בוֹ עַד כַּלּוֹתָם אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֲךָ יְהֹוָה בְּדָרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ וְהַחֲרַמְתָּה אֶת־הַחַטָּאִים אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְנִלְחַמְתָּ בוֹ עַד כַּלּוֹתָם אֹתָם׃

english.text:
and YHWH sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and proscribe the
sinful Amalekites; make war on them until you have exterminated
them.’

translation.text: And the LORD sent you on a mission, and said, 'Go, utterly destroy consumed.'

verses.english:
Why did you disobey YHWH and swoop down on the spoil in defiance
of YHWH’s will?”
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וַתַּעַט אֶל־הַשָּׁלָל וַתַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָמָּה לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וַתַּעַט אֶל־הַשָּׁלָל וַתַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Why did you disobey YHWH and swoop down on the spoil in defiance
of YHWH’s will?”

translation.text: Why then did you not obey the voice of the LORD? Why the LORD?"

verses.english:
Saul said to Samuel, “But I did obey YHWH! I performed the mission
on which YHWH sent me: I captured King Agag of Amalek, and I
proscribed Amalek,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וָאֵלֵךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַנִי יְהֹוָה וָאָבִיא אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־עֲמָלֵק הֶחֱרַמְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וָאֵלֵךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַנִי יְהֹוָה וָאָבִיא אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־עֲמָלֵק הֶחֱרַמְתִּי׃

english.text:
Saul said to Samuel, “But I did obey YHWH! I performed the mission
on which YHWH sent me: I captured King Agag of Amalek, and I
proscribed Amalek,

translation.text: Saul said to Samuel, "I have obeyed the voice of the Amalekites.

verses.english:
and the troops took from the spoil some sheep and oxen—the best of
what had been proscribed—to sacrifice to YHWH your God at Gilgal.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח הָעָם מֵהַשָּׁלָל צֹאן וּבָקָר רֵאשִׁית הַחֵרֶם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח הָעָם מֵהַשָּׁלָל צֹאן וּבָקָר רֵאשִׁית הַחֵרֶם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
and the troops took from the spoil some sheep and oxen—the best of
what had been proscribed—to sacrifice to YHWH your God at Gilgal.”

translation.text: But from the spoil the people took sheep and cattle, the best of the things devoted to destruction, to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal."

verses.english:
But Samuel said: “Does YHWH delight in burnt offerings and
sacrifices As much as in obedience to YHWH’s command? Surely,
obedience is better than sacrifice, Compliance than the fat of
rams.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַחֵפֶץ לַיהֹוָה בְּעֹלוֹת וּזְבָחִים כִּשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַחֵפֶץ לַיהֹוָה בְּעֹלוֹת וּזְבָחִים כִּשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים׃

english.text:
But Samuel said: “Does YHWH delight in burnt offerings and
sacrifices As much as in obedience to YHWH’s command? Surely,
obedience is better than sacrifice, Compliance than the fat of
rams.

translation.text: And Samuel said, as in obedience to the voice of the LORD? and to heed than the fat of rams.

verses.english:
For rebellion is like the sin of divination, Defiance, like the
iniquity of teraphim. Because you rejected YHWH’s command, He has
rejected you as king.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי חַטַּאת־קֶסֶם מֶרִי וְאָוֶן וּתְרָפִים הַפְצַר יַעַן מָאַסְתָּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ מִמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי חַטַּאת־קֶסֶם מֶרִי וְאָוֶן וּתְרָפִים הַפְצַר יַעַן מָאַסְתָּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ מִמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
For rebellion is like the sin of divination, Defiance, like the
iniquity of teraphim. Because you rejected YHWH’s command, He has
rejected you as king.”

translation.text: For rebellion is no less a sin than divination, and stubbornness is like iniquity and idolatry. he has also rejected you from being king."

verses.english:
Saul said to Samuel, “I did wrong to transgress YHWH’s command and
your instructions; but I was afraid of the troops and I yielded to
them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל חָטָאתִי כִּי־עָבַרְתִּי אֶת־פִּי־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ כִּי יָרֵאתִי אֶת־הָעָם וָאֶשְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל חָטָאתִי כִּי־עָבַרְתִּי אֶת־פִּי־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ כִּי יָרֵאתִי אֶת־הָעָם וָאֶשְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Saul said to Samuel, “I did wrong to transgress YHWH’s command and
your instructions; but I was afraid of the troops and I yielded to
them.

translation.text: Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned; for I have transgressed the people and obeyed their voice.

verses.english:
Please, forgive my offense and come back with me, and I will bow
low to YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא אֶת־חַטָּאתִי וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא אֶת־חַטָּאתִי וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Please, forgive my offense and come back with me, and I will bow
low to YHWH.”

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray, pardon my sin, and return with me, so that I may worship the LORD."

verses.english:
But Samuel said to Saul, “I will not go back with you; for you
have rejected YHWH’s command, and YHWH has rejected you as king
over Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֹא אָשׁוּב עִמָּךְ כִּי מָאַסְתָּה אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ יְהֹוָה מִהְיוֹת מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֹא אָשׁוּב עִמָּךְ כִּי מָאַסְתָּה אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ יְהֹוָה מִהְיוֹת מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Samuel said to Saul, “I will not go back with you; for you
have rejected YHWH’s command, and YHWH has rejected you as king
over Israel.”

translation.text: Samuel said to Saul, "I will not return with you; for you have rejected the word Israel."

verses.english:
As Samuel turned to leave, Saul seized the corner of his robe, and
it tore.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּב שְׁמוּאֵל לָלֶכֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּכְנַף־מְעִילוֹ וַיִּקָּרַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסֹּב שְׁמוּאֵל לָלֶכֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּכְנַף־מְעִילוֹ וַיִּקָּרַע׃

english.text:
As Samuel turned to leave, Saul seized the corner of his robe, and
it tore.

translation.text: As Samuel turned to go away, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.

verses.english:
And Samuel said to him, “YHWH has this day torn the kingship over
Israel away from you and has given it to another who is worthier
than you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שְׁמוּאֵל קָרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־מַמְלְכוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ הַטּוֹב מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שְׁמוּאֵל קָרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־מַמְלְכוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ הַטּוֹב מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
And Samuel said to him, “YHWH has this day torn the kingship over
Israel away from you and has given it to another who is worthier
than you.

translation.text: And Samuel said to him, "The LORD has torn neighbor of yours, who is better than you.

verses.english:
Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not deceive or change His mind,
for He is not human that He should change His mind.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם נֵצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יְשַׁקֵּר וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם כִּי לֹא אָדָם הוּא לְהִנָּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם נֵצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יְשַׁקֵּר וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם כִּי לֹא אָדָם הוּא לְהִנָּחֵם׃

english.text:
Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not deceive or change His mind,
for He is not human that He should change His mind.”

translation.text: Moreover the Glory of Israel will not recant or change his mind; for he is not a mortal, that he should change his mind."

verses.english:
But [Saul] pleaded, “I did wrong. Please, honor me in the presence
of the elders of my people and in the presence of Israel, and come
back with me until I have bowed low to YHWH your God.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי עַתָּה כַּבְּדֵנִי נָא נֶגֶד זִקְנֵי־עַמִּי וְנֶגֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי עַתָּה כַּבְּדֵנִי נָא נֶגֶד זִקְנֵי־עַמִּי וְנֶגֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
But [Saul] pleaded, “I did wrong. Please, honor me in the presence
of the elders of my people and in the presence of Israel, and come
back with me until I have bowed low to YHWH your God.”

translation.text: Then Saul said, "I have sinned; yet honor with me, so that I may worship the LORD your God."

verses.english: So Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul bowed low to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב שְׁמוּאֵל אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁאוּל לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב שְׁמוּאֵל אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁאוּל לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text: So Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul bowed low to YHWH.

translation.text: So Samuel turned back after Saul; and Saul worshiped the LORD.

verses.english:
Samuel said, “Bring forward to me King Agag of Amalek.” Agag
approached him with faltering steps; and Agag said, “Ah, bitter
death is at hand!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּישׁוּ אֵלַי אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלָיו אֲגַג מַעֲדַנֹּת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲגָג אָכֵן סָר מַר־הַמָּוֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּישׁוּ אֵלַי אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלָיו אֲגַג מַעֲדַנֹּת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲגָג אָכֵן סָר מַר־הַמָּוֶת׃

english.text:
Samuel said, “Bring forward to me King Agag of Amalek.” Agag
approached him with faltering steps; and Agag said, “Ah, bitter
death is at hand!”

translation.text: Then Samuel said, "Bring Agag king of the Amalekites here to me." bitterness of death."

verses.english:
Samuel said: “As your sword has bereaved women, So shall your
mother be bereaved among women.” And Samuel cut Agag down before
YHWH at Gilgal.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר שִׁכְּלָה נָשִׁים חַרְבֶּךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּל מִנָּשִׁים אִמֶּךָ וַיְשַׁסֵּף שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־אֲגָג לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר שִׁכְּלָה נָשִׁים חַרְבֶּךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּל מִנָּשִׁים אִמֶּךָ וַיְשַׁסֵּף שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־אֲגָג לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
Samuel said: “As your sword has bereaved women, So shall your
mother be bereaved among women.” And Samuel cut Agag down before
YHWH at Gilgal.

translation.text: But Samuel said, so your mother shall be childless among women." And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

verses.english:
Samuel then departed for Ramah, and Saul went up to his home at
Gibeah of Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וְשָׁאוּל עָלָה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וְשָׁאוּל עָלָה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Samuel then departed for Ramah, and Saul went up to his home at
Gibeah of Saul.

translation.text: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house in Gibeah of Saul.

verses.english:
Samuel never saw Saul again to the day of his death. But Samuel
grieved over Saul, because YHWH regretted that He had made Saul
king over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָסַף שְׁמוּאֵל לִרְאוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ כִּי־הִתְאַבֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיהֹוָה נִחָם כִּי־הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָסַף שְׁמוּאֵל לִרְאוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ כִּי־הִתְאַבֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיהֹוָה נִחָם כִּי־הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Samuel never saw Saul again to the day of his death. But Samuel
grieved over Saul, because YHWH regretted that He had made Saul
king over Israel.

translation.text: Samuel did not see Saul again until the day of his had made Saul king over Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Samuel, “How long will you grieve over Saul,
since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with
oil and set out; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I
have decided on one of his sons to be king.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־מָתַי אַתָּה מִתְאַבֵּל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַאֲנִי מְאַסְתִּיו מִמְּלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלֵּא קַרְנְךָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֵךְ אֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל־יִשַׁי
בֵּית־הַלַּחְמִי כִּי־רָאִיתִי בְּבָנָיו לִי מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־מָתַי אַתָּה מִתְאַבֵּל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַאֲנִי מְאַסְתִּיו מִמְּלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלֵּא קַרְנְךָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֵךְ אֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל־יִשַׁי
בֵּית־הַלַּחְמִי כִּי־רָאִיתִי בְּבָנָיו לִי מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Samuel, “How long will you grieve over Saul,
since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with
oil and set out; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I
have decided on one of his sons to be king.”

translation.text: The LORD said to Samuel, "How long will you grieve over Saul? I have rejected him from being king over Israel. Fill your horn with oil and set out; I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided for myself a king among his sons."

verses.english:
Samuel replied, “How can I go? If Saul hears of it, he will kill
me.” YHWH answered, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come
to sacrifice to YHWH.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵיךְ אֵלֵךְ וְשָׁמַע שָׁאוּל וַהֲרָגָנִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֶגְלַת בָּקָר תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵיךְ אֵלֵךְ וְשָׁמַע שָׁאוּל וַהֲרָגָנִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֶגְלַת בָּקָר תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי׃

english.text:
Samuel replied, “How can I go? If Saul hears of it, he will kill
me.” YHWH answered, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come
to sacrifice to YHWH.’

translation.text: Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears of it, he will kill me." And the LORD said, "Take a heifer with you, and say, 'I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.'

verses.english:
Invite Jesse to the sacrificial feast, and then I will make known
to you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I point
out to you.”
verses.hebrew: וְקָרָאתָ לְיִשַׁי בַּזָּבַח וְאָנֹכִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְקָרָאתָ לְיִשַׁי בַּזָּבַח וְאָנֹכִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Invite Jesse to the sacrificial feast, and then I will make known
to you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I point
out to you.”

translation.text: Invite Jesse to the for me the one whom I name to you."

verses.english:
Samuel did what YHWH commanded. When he came to Bethlehem, the
elders of the city went out in alarm to meet him and said, “Do you
come on a peaceful errand?”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֹא בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלֹם בּוֹאֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֹא בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלֹם בּוֹאֶךָ׃

english.text:
Samuel did what YHWH commanded. When he came to Bethlehem, the
elders of the city went out in alarm to meet him and said, “Do you
come on a peaceful errand?”

translation.text: Samuel did what the LORD meet him trembling, and said, "Do you come peaceably?"

verses.english:
“Yes,” he replied, “I have come to sacrifice to YHWH. Purify
yourselves and join me in the sacrificial feast.” He also
instructed Jesse and his sons to purify themselves and invited
them to the sacrificial feast.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ וּבָאתֶם אִתִּי בַּזָּבַח וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־יִשַׁי וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם לַזָּבַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ וּבָאתֶם אִתִּי בַּזָּבַח וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־יִשַׁי וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם לַזָּבַח׃

english.text:
“Yes,” he replied, “I have come to sacrifice to YHWH. Purify
yourselves and join me in the sacrificial feast.” He also
instructed Jesse and his sons to purify themselves and invited
them to the sacrificial feast.

translation.text: He said, "Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD; sanctify yourselves and and invited them to the sacrifice.

verses.english:
When they arrived and he saw Eliab, he thought: “Surely YHWH’s
anointed stands before Him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם וַיַּרְא אֶת־אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם וַיַּרְא אֶת־אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

english.text:
When they arrived and he saw Eliab, he thought: “Surely YHWH’s
anointed stands before Him.”

translation.text: When they came, he looked on Eliab and thought, "Surely the LORD's anointed is now before the LORD."

verses.english:
But YHWH said to Samuel, “Pay no attention to his appearance or
his stature, for I have rejected him. For not as man sees [does
YHWH see]; man sees only what is visible, but YHWH sees into the
heart.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אַל־תַּבֵּט אֶל־מַרְאֵהוּ וְאֶל־גְּבֹהַּ קוֹמָתוֹ כִּי מְאַסְתִּיהוּ כִּי לֹא אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה הָאָדָם כִּי הָאָדָם יִרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם וַיהֹוָה
יִרְאֶה לַלֵּבָב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אַל־תַּבֵּט אֶל־מַרְאֵהוּ וְאֶל־גְּבֹהַּ קוֹמָתוֹ כִּי מְאַסְתִּיהוּ כִּי לֹא אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה הָאָדָם כִּי הָאָדָם יִרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם וַיהֹוָה
יִרְאֶה לַלֵּבָב׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to Samuel, “Pay no attention to his appearance or
his stature, for I have rejected him. For not as man sees [does
YHWH see]; man sees only what is visible, but YHWH sees into the
heart.”

translation.text: But the LORD said to Samuel, "Do on the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart."

verses.english:
Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass before Samuel; but he
said, “YHWH has not chosen this one either.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יִשַׁי אֶל־אֲבִינָדָב וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יִשַׁי אֶל־אֲבִינָדָב וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass before Samuel; but he
said, “YHWH has not chosen this one either.”

translation.text: Then "Neither has the LORD chosen this one."

verses.english:
Next Jesse presented Shammah; and again he said, “YHWH has not
chosen this one either.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שַׁמָּה וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שַׁמָּה וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Next Jesse presented Shammah; and again he said, “YHWH has not
chosen this one either.”

translation.text: Then Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, "Neither has the LORD chosen this one."

verses.english:
Thus Jesse presented seven of his sons before Samuel, and Samuel
said to Jesse, “YHWH has not chosen any of these.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שִׁבְעַת בָּנָיו לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה בָּאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שִׁבְעַת בָּנָיו לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה בָּאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Thus Jesse presented seven of his sons before Samuel, and Samuel
said to Jesse, “YHWH has not chosen any of these.”

translation.text: Jesse "The LORD has not chosen any of these."

verses.english:
Then Samuel asked Jesse, “Are these all the boys you have?” He
replied, “There is still the youngest; he is tending the flock.”
And Samuel said to Jesse, “Send someone to bring him, for we will
not sit down to eat until he gets here.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי הֲתַמּוּ הַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד שָׁאַר הַקָּטָן וְהִנֵּה רֹעֶה בַּצֹּאן וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי שִׁלְחָה וְקָחֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־נָסֹב
עַד־בֹּאוֹ פֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי הֲתַמּוּ הַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד שָׁאַר הַקָּטָן וְהִנֵּה רֹעֶה בַּצֹּאן וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי שִׁלְחָה וְקָחֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־נָסֹב
עַד־בֹּאוֹ פֹה׃

english.text:
Then Samuel asked Jesse, “Are these all the boys you have?” He
replied, “There is still the youngest; he is tending the flock.”
And Samuel said to Jesse, “Send someone to bring him, for we will
not sit down to eat until he gets here.”

translation.text: Samuel said to Jesse, "Are him; for we will not sit down until he comes here."

verses.english:
So they sent and brought him. He was ruddy-cheeked, bright-eyed,
and handsome. And YHWH said, “Rise and anoint him, for this is the
one.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיְבִיאֵהוּ וְהוּא אַדְמוֹנִי עִם־יְפֵה עֵינַיִם וְטוֹב רֹאִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה קוּם מְשָׁחֵהוּ כִּי־זֶה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיְבִיאֵהוּ וְהוּא אַדְמוֹנִי עִם־יְפֵה עֵינַיִם וְטוֹב רֹאִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה קוּם מְשָׁחֵהוּ כִּי־זֶה הוּא׃

english.text:
So they sent and brought him. He was ruddy-cheeked, bright-eyed,
and handsome. And YHWH said, “Rise and anoint him, for this is the
one.”

translation.text: He sent and handsome. The LORD said, "Rise and anoint him; for this is the one."

verses.english:
Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of
his brothers; and the spirit of YHWH gripped David from that day
on. Samuel then set out for Ramah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ הָרָמָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ הָרָמָתָה׃

english.text:
Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of
his brothers; and the spirit of YHWH gripped David from that day
on. Samuel then set out for Ramah.

translation.text: that day forward. Samuel then set out and went to Ramah.

verses.english:
Now the spirit of YHWH had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit
from YHWH began to terrify him.
verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה סָרָה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבִעֲתַתּוּ רוּחַ־רָעָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה סָרָה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבִעֲתַתּוּ רוּחַ־רָעָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Now the spirit of YHWH had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit
from YHWH began to terrify him.

translation.text: Now the spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD tormented him.

verses.english:
Saul’s courtiers said to him, “An evil spirit of God is terrifying
you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה מְבַעִתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה מְבַעִתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Saul’s courtiers said to him, “An evil spirit of God is terrifying
you.

translation.text: And Saul's servants said to him, "See now, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.

verses.english:
Let our lord give the order [and] the courtiers in attendance on
you will look for someone who is skilled at playing the lyre;
whenever the evil spirit of God comes over you, he will play it
and you will feel better.”
verses.hebrew: יֹאמַר־נָא אֲדֹנֵנוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ יְבַקְשׁוּ אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ מְנַגֵּן בַּכִּנּוֹר וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: יֹאמַר־נָא אֲדֹנֵנוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ יְבַקְשׁוּ אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ מְנַגֵּן בַּכִּנּוֹר וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

english.text:
Let our lord give the order [and] the courtiers in attendance on
you will look for someone who is skilled at playing the lyre;
whenever the evil spirit of God comes over you, he will play it
and you will feel better.”

translation.text: Let our lord now skillful in playing the lyre; and when the evil spirit from God is upon you, he will play it, and you will feel better."

verses.english:
So Saul said to his courtiers, “Find me someone who can play well
and bring him to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ־נָא לִי אִישׁ מֵיטִיב לְנַגֵּן וַהֲבִיאוֹתֶם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ־נָא לִי אִישׁ מֵיטִיב לְנַגֵּן וַהֲבִיאוֹתֶם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
So Saul said to his courtiers, “Find me someone who can play well
and bring him to me.”

translation.text: So Saul said to his me."

verses.english:
One of the attendants spoke up, “I have observed a son of Jesse
the Bethlehemite who is skilled in music; he is a stalwart fellow
and a warrior, sensible in speech, and handsome in appearance, and
YHWH is with him.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי בֵּן לְיִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי יֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן וְגִבּוֹר חַיִל וְאִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וּנְבוֹן דָּבָר וְאִישׁ תֹּאַר וַיהֹוָה
עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי בֵּן לְיִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי יֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן וְגִבּוֹר חַיִל וְאִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וּנְבוֹן דָּבָר וְאִישׁ תֹּאַר וַיהֹוָה
עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
One of the attendants spoke up, “I have observed a son of Jesse
the Bethlehemite who is skilled in music; he is a stalwart fellow
and a warrior, sensible in speech, and handsome in appearance, and
YHWH is with him.”

translation.text: One of the young men answered, "I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a man of valor, a warrior, him."

verses.english:
Whereupon Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, “Send me your son
David, who is with the flock.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יִשָׁי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה אֵלַי אֶת־דָּוִד בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר בַּצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יִשָׁי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה אֵלַי אֶת־דָּוִד בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר בַּצֹּאן׃

english.text:
Whereupon Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, “Send me your son
David, who is with the flock.”

translation.text: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, "Send me your son David who is with the sheep."

verses.english:
Jesse took an ass [laden with] bread, a skin of wine, and a kid,
and sent them to Saul by his son David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִשַׁי חֲמוֹר לֶחֶם וְנֹאד יַיִן וּגְדִי עִזִּים אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד־דָּוִד בְּנוֹ אֶל־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יִשַׁי חֲמוֹר לֶחֶם וְנֹאד יַיִן וּגְדִי עִזִּים אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד־דָּוִד בְּנוֹ אֶל־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Jesse took an ass [laden with] bread, a skin of wine, and a kid,
and sent them to Saul by his son David.

translation.text: Jesse took a donkey loaded with Saul.

verses.english:
So David came to Saul and entered his service; [Saul] took a
strong liking to him and made him one of his arms-bearers.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ מְאֹד וַיְהִי־לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ מְאֹד וַיְהִי־לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלִים׃

english.text:
So David came to Saul and entered his service; [Saul] took a
strong liking to him and made him one of his arms-bearers.

translation.text: And David came to Saul, and entered his service. Saul loved him greatly, and he became his armor-bearer.

verses.english:
Saul sent word to Jesse, “Let David remain in my service, for I am
pleased with him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֵאמֹר יַעֲמד־נָא דָוִד לְפָנַי כִּי־מָצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֵאמֹר יַעֲמד־נָא דָוִד לְפָנַי כִּי־מָצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

english.text:
Saul sent word to Jesse, “Let David remain in my service, for I am
pleased with him.”

translation.text: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, "Let David remain in my service, for he has found favor in my sight."

verses.english:
Whenever the [evil] spirit of God came upon Saul, David would take
the lyre and play it; Saul would find relief and feel better, and
the evil spirit would leave him.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְלָקַח דָּוִד אֶת־הַכִּנּוֹר וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְרָוַח לְשָׁאוּל וְטוֹב לוֹ וְסָרָה מֵעָלָיו רוּחַ הָרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְלָקַח דָּוִד אֶת־הַכִּנּוֹר וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְרָוַח לְשָׁאוּל וְטוֹב לוֹ וְסָרָה מֵעָלָיו רוּחַ הָרָעָה׃

english.text:
Whenever the [evil] spirit of God came upon Saul, David would take
the lyre and play it; Saul would find relief and feel better, and
the evil spirit would leave him.

translation.text: better, and the evil spirit would depart from him.

verses.english:
The Philistines assembled their forces for battle; they massed at
Socoh of Judah, and encamped at Ephes-dammim, between Socoh and
Azekah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּאַסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּאָסְפוּ שֹׂכֹה אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בֵּין־שׂוֹכֹה וּבֵין־עֲזֵקָה בְּאֶפֶס דַּמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאַסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּאָסְפוּ שֹׂכֹה אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בֵּין־שׂוֹכֹה וּבֵין־עֲזֵקָה בְּאֶפֶס דַּמִּים׃

english.text:
The Philistines assembled their forces for battle; they massed at
Socoh of Judah, and encamped at Ephes-dammim, between Socoh and
Azekah.

translation.text: Now the Philistines gathered their armies for battle; they were Socoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.

verses.english:
Saul and the men of Israel massed and encamped in the valley of
Elah. They drew up their line of battle against the Philistines,
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל וְאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶאֶסְפוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל וְאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶאֶסְפוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Saul and the men of Israel massed and encamped in the valley of
Elah. They drew up their line of battle against the Philistines,

translation.text: Saul and the Israelites against the Philistines.

verses.english:
with the Philistines stationed on one hill and Israel stationed on
the opposite hill; the ravine was between them.
verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְהַגַּיְא בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְהַגַּיְא בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
with the Philistines stationed on one hill and Israel stationed on
the opposite hill; the ravine was between them.

translation.text: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the valley between them.

verses.english:
A champion of the Philistine forces stepped forward; his name was
Goliath of Gath, and he was six cubits and a span tall.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ־הַבֵּנַיִם מִמַּחֲנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים גּלְיָת שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת גּבְהוֹ שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וָזָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ־הַבֵּנַיִם מִמַּחֲנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים גּלְיָת שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת גּבְהוֹ שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וָזָרֶת׃

english.text:
A champion of the Philistine forces stepped forward; his name was
Goliath of Gath, and he was six cubits and a span tall.

translation.text: And there came out from the camp of the cubits and a span.

verses.english:
He had a bronze helmet on his head, and wore a breastplate of
scale armor, a bronze breastplate weighing five thousand shekels.
verses.hebrew: וְכוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְשִׁרְיוֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂים הוּא לָבוּשׁ וּמִשְׁקַל הַשִּׁרְיוֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים שְׁקָלִים נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְכוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְשִׁרְיוֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂים הוּא לָבוּשׁ וּמִשְׁקַל הַשִּׁרְיוֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים שְׁקָלִים נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
He had a bronze helmet on his head, and wore a breastplate of
scale armor, a bronze breastplate weighing five thousand shekels.

translation.text: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he thousand shekels of bronze.

verses.english:
He had bronze greaves on his legs, and a bronze javelin [slung]
from his shoulders.
verses.hebrew: וּמִצְחַת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רַגְלָיו וְכִידוֹן נְחֹשֶׁת בֵּין כְּתֵפָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמִצְחַת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רַגְלָיו וְכִידוֹן נְחֹשֶׁת בֵּין כְּתֵפָיו׃

english.text:
He had bronze greaves on his legs, and a bronze javelin [slung]
from his shoulders.

translation.text: He had greaves of bronze on his legs and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders.

verses.english:
The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s bar, and the iron head
of his spear weighed six hundred shekels; and the shield-bearer
marched in front of him.
verses.hebrew: (וחץ) [וְעֵץ] חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים וְלַהֶבֶת חֲנִיתוֹ שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת שְׁקָלִים בַּרְזֶל וְנֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה הֹלֵךְ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: (וחץ) [וְעֵץ] חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים וְלַהֶבֶת חֲנִיתוֹ שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת שְׁקָלִים בַּרְזֶל וְנֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה הֹלֵךְ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s bar, and the iron head
of his spear weighed six hundred shekels; and the shield-bearer
marched in front of him.

translation.text: The shaft of his hundred shekels of iron; and his shield-bearer went before him.

verses.english:
He stopped and called out to the ranks of Israel and he said to
them, “Why should you come out to engage in battle? I am the
Philistine [champion], and you are Saul’s servants. Choose one of
your men and let him come down against me.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־מַעַרְכֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תֵצְאוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וְאַתֶּם עֲבָדִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּרוּ־לָכֶם אִישׁ
וְיֵרֵד אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־מַעַרְכֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תֵצְאוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וְאַתֶּם עֲבָדִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּרוּ־לָכֶם אִישׁ
וְיֵרֵד אֵלָי׃

english.text:
He stopped and called out to the ranks of Israel and he said to
them, “Why should you come out to engage in battle? I am the
Philistine [champion], and you are Saul’s servants. Choose one of
your men and let him come down against me.

translation.text: He Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יוּכַל לְהִלָּחֵם אִתִּי וְהִכָּנִי וְהָיִינוּ לָכֶם לַעֲבָדִים וְאִם־אֲנִי אוּכַל־לוֹ וְהִכִּיתִיו וִהְיִיתֶם לָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: אִם־יוּכַל לְהִלָּחֵם אִתִּי וְהִכָּנִי וְהָיִינוּ לָכֶם לַעֲבָדִים וְאִם־אֲנִי אוּכַל־לוֹ וְהִכִּיתִיו וִהְיִיתֶם לָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתָנוּ׃

translation.text: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then we will be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and serve us."

verses.english:
And the Philistine ended, “I herewith defy the ranks of Israel.
Get me a man and let’s fight it out!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲנִי חֵרַפְתִּי אֶת־מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תְּנוּ־לִי אִישׁ וְנִלָּחֲמָה יָחַד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲנִי חֵרַפְתִּי אֶת־מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תְּנוּ־לִי אִישׁ וְנִלָּחֲמָה יָחַד׃

english.text:
And the Philistine ended, “I herewith defy the ranks of Israel.
Get me a man and let’s fight it out!”

translation.text: And the Philistine said, "Today I defy the ranks of Israel! Give me a man, that we may fight together."

verses.english:
When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they
were dismayed and terror-stricken.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחַתּוּ וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחַתּוּ וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they
were dismayed and terror-stricken.

translation.text: When Saul and greatly afraid.

verses.english:
David was the son of a certain Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah
whose name was Jesse. He had eight sons, and in the days of Saul
the man was already old, advanced in years.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בֶּן־אִישׁ אֶפְרָתִי הַזֶּה מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וּשְׁמוֹ יִשַׁי וְלוֹ שְׁמֹנָה בָנִים וְהָאִישׁ בִּימֵי שָׁאוּל זָקֵן בָּא בַאֲנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד בֶּן־אִישׁ אֶפְרָתִי הַזֶּה מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וּשְׁמוֹ יִשַׁי וְלוֹ שְׁמֹנָה בָנִים וְהָאִישׁ בִּימֵי שָׁאוּל זָקֵן בָּא בַאֲנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
David was the son of a certain Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah
whose name was Jesse. He had eight sons, and in the days of Saul
the man was already old, advanced in years.

translation.text: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah, already old and advanced in years.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת בְּנֵי־יִשַׁי הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי־שָׁאוּל לַמִּלְחָמָה וְשֵׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה אֱלִיאָב הַבְּכוֹר וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִינָדָב
וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי שַׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת בְּנֵי־יִשַׁי הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי־שָׁאוּל לַמִּלְחָמָה וְשֵׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה אֱלִיאָב הַבְּכוֹר וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִינָדָב
וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי שַׁמָּה׃

verses.english: and David was the youngest. The three oldest had followed Saul,
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הוּא הַקָּטָן וּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד הוּא הַקָּטָן וּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל׃

english.text: and David was the youngest. The three oldest had followed Saul,

translation.text: David was the youngest; the three eldest followed Saul,

verses.english:
and David would go back and forth from attending on Saul to
shepherd his father’s flock at Bethlehem.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וָשָׁב מֵעַל שָׁאוּל לִרְעוֹת אֶת־צֹאן אָבִיו בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וָשָׁב מֵעַל שָׁאוּל לִרְעוֹת אֶת־צֹאן אָבִיו בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
and David would go back and forth from attending on Saul to
shepherd his father’s flock at Bethlehem.

translation.text: but David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

verses.english:
The Philistine stepped forward morning and evening and took his
stand for forty days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב וַיִּתְיַצֵּב אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב וַיִּתְיַצֵּב אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם׃

english.text:
The Philistine stepped forward morning and evening and took his
stand for forty days.

translation.text: For forty days the Philistine came forward and took his stand, morning and evening.

verses.english:
Jesse said to his son David, “Take an ephah of this parched corn
and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers, and carry them
quickly to your brothers in camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשַׁי לְדָוִד בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא לְאַחֶיךָ אֵיפַת הַקָּלִיא הַזֶּה וַעֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם הַזֶּה וְהָרֵץ הַמַּחֲנֶה לְאַחֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשַׁי לְדָוִד בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא לְאַחֶיךָ אֵיפַת הַקָּלִיא הַזֶּה וַעֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם הַזֶּה וְהָרֵץ הַמַּחֲנֶה לְאַחֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Jesse said to his son David, “Take an ephah of this parched corn
and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers, and carry them
quickly to your brothers in camp.

translation.text: Jesse said to his son David, "Take for your brothers an ephah of this to your brothers;

verses.english:
Take these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand. Find out
how your brothers are and bring some token from them.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת חֲרִצֵי הֶחָלָב הָאֵלֶּה תָּבִיא לְשַׂר־הָאָלֶף וְאֶת־אַחֶיךָ תִּפְקֹד לְשָׁלוֹם וְאֶת־עֲרֻבָּתָם תִּקָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת חֲרִצֵי הֶחָלָב הָאֵלֶּה תָּבִיא לְשַׂר־הָאָלֶף וְאֶת־אַחֶיךָ תִּפְקֹד לְשָׁלוֹם וְאֶת־עֲרֻבָּתָם תִּקָּח׃

english.text:
Take these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand. Find out
how your brothers are and bring some token from them.”

translation.text: also take these ten cheeses to the commander of from them."

verses.english:
Saul and the brothers and all the men of Israel were in the valley
of Elah, in the war against the Philistines.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל וְהֵמָּה וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה נִלְחָמִים עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל וְהֵמָּה וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה נִלְחָמִים עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Saul and the brothers and all the men of Israel were in the valley
of Elah, in the war against the Philistines.

translation.text: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

verses.english:
Early next morning, David left someone in charge of the flock,
took [the provisions], and set out, as his father Jesse had
instructed him. He reached the barricade as the army was going out
to the battle lines shouting the war cry.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֶת־הַצֹּאן עַל־שֹׁמֵר וַיִּשָּׂא וַיֵּלֶךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יִשָׁי וַיָּבֹא הַמַּעְגָּלָה וְהַחַיִל הַיֹּצֵא אֶל־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְהֵרֵעוּ
בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֶת־הַצֹּאן עַל־שֹׁמֵר וַיִּשָּׂא וַיֵּלֶךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יִשָׁי וַיָּבֹא הַמַּעְגָּלָה וְהַחַיִל הַיֹּצֵא אֶל־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְהֵרֵעוּ
בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Early next morning, David left someone in charge of the flock,
took [the provisions], and set out, as his father Jesse had
instructed him. He reached the barricade as the army was going out
to the battle lines shouting the war cry.

translation.text: David rose early in the morning, going forth to the battle line, shouting the war cry.

verses.english:
Israel and the Philistines drew up their battle lines opposite
each other.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲרֹךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפְלִשְׁתִּים מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת מַעֲרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲרֹךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפְלִשְׁתִּים מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת מַעֲרָכָה׃

english.text:
Israel and the Philistines drew up their battle lines opposite
each other.

translation.text: Israel and the Philistines drew up for battle, army against army.

verses.english:
David left his baggage with the man in charge of the baggage and
ran toward the battle line and went to greet his brothers.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּטֹּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֵּלִים מֵעָלָיו עַל־יַד שׁוֹמֵר הַכֵּלִים וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁאַל לְאֶחָיו לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּטֹּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֵּלִים מֵעָלָיו עַל־יַד שׁוֹמֵר הַכֵּלִים וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁאַל לְאֶחָיו לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
David left his baggage with the man in charge of the baggage and
ran toward the battle line and went to greet his brothers.

translation.text: David left the went and greeted his brothers.

verses.english:
While he was talking to them, the champion, whose name was
Goliath, the Philistine of Gath, stepped forward from the
Philistine ranks

and spoke the same words as before
and David heard him.
verses.hebrew:
וְהוּא מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ הַבֵּנַיִם עוֹלֶה גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת (ממערות) [מִמַּעַרְכוֹת] פְּלִשְׁתִּים

וַיְדַבֵּר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה
וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ הַבֵּנַיִם עוֹלֶה גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת (ממערות) [מִמַּעַרְכוֹת] פְּלִשְׁתִּים
וַיְדַבֵּר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה
וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד׃

english.text:
While he was talking to them, the champion, whose name was
Goliath, the Philistine of Gath, stepped forward from the
Philistine ranks
and spoke the same words as before
and David heard him.

verses.translation: As he talked with them, the David heard him.

verses.english: When the men of Israel saw the man, they fled in terror.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text: When the men of Israel saw the man, they fled in terror.

translation.text: All the Israelites, when they saw the man, fled from him and were very much afraid.

verses.english:
And the men of Israel were saying [among themselves], “Do you see
that man coming out? He comes out to defy Israel! The man who
kills him will be rewarded by the king with great riches; he will
also give him his daughter in marriage and grant exemption to his
father’s house in Israel.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְּאִיתֶם הָאִישׁ הָעֹלֶה הַזֶּה כִּי לְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹלֶה וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּנּוּ יַעְשְׁרֶנּוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹשֶׁר גָּדוֹל
וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ יִתֶּן־לוֹ וְאֵת בֵּית אָבִיו יַעֲשֶׂה חפְשִׁי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְּאִיתֶם הָאִישׁ הָעֹלֶה הַזֶּה כִּי לְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹלֶה וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּנּוּ יַעְשְׁרֶנּוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹשֶׁר גָּדוֹל
וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ יִתֶּן־לוֹ וְאֵת בֵּית אָבִיו יַעֲשֶׂה חפְשִׁי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the men of Israel were saying [among themselves], “Do you see
that man coming out? He comes out to defy Israel! The man who
kills him will be rewarded by the king with great riches; he will
also give him his daughter in marriage and grant exemption to his
father’s house in Israel.”

translation.text: The Israelites said, "Have you seen this man who and make his family free in Israel."

verses.english:
David asked the men standing near him, “What will be done for the
man who kills that Philistine and removes the disgrace from
Israel? Who is that uncircumcised Philistine that he dares defy
the ranks of the living God?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹמְדִים עִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּה אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַלָּז וְהֵסִיר חֶרְפָּה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי
הֶעָרֵל הַזֶּה כִּי חֵרֵף מַעַרְכוֹת אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹמְדִים עִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּה אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַלָּז וְהֵסִיר חֶרְפָּה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי
הֶעָרֵל הַזֶּה כִּי חֵרֵף מַעַרְכוֹת אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים׃

english.text:
David asked the men standing near him, “What will be done for the
man who kills that Philistine and removes the disgrace from
Israel? Who is that uncircumcised Philistine that he dares defy
the ranks of the living God?”

translation.text: David said to the men who stood Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?"

verses.english:
The troops told him in the same words what would be done for the
man who killed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָעָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָעָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
The troops told him in the same words what would be done for the
man who killed him.

translation.text: The who kills him."

verses.english:
When Eliab, his oldest brother, heard him speaking to the men,
Eliab became angry with David and said, “Why did you come down
here, and with whom did you leave those few sheep in the
wilderness? I know your impudence and your impertinence: you came
down to watch the fighting!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלִיאָב אָחִיו הַגָּדוֹל בְּדַבְּרוֹ אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר־אַף אֱלִיאָב בְּדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה־זֶּה יָרַדְתָּ וְעַל־מִי נָטַשְׁתָּ מְעַט הַצֹּאן הָהֵנָּה

english.text:
When Eliab, his oldest brother, heard him speaking to the men,
Eliab became angry with David and said, “Why did you come down
here, and with whom did you leave those few sheep in the
wilderness? I know your impudence and your impertinence: you came
down to watch the fighting!”

translation.text: His eldest brother Eliab heard him talking to the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David. He said, "Why have you come down? just to see the battle."

verses.english: But David replied, “What have I done now? I was only asking!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מֶה עָשִׂיתִי עָתָּה הֲלוֹא דָּבָר הוּא׃

english.text: But David replied, “What have I done now? I was only asking!”

translation.text: David said, "What have I done now? It was only a question."

verses.english:
And he turned away from him toward someone else; he asked the same
question, and the troops gave him the same answer as before.

translation.text: He turned away from him toward another and spoke in the same way; and the people answered him again as before.

Philistine shall end up like one of them, for he has defied the
ranks of the living God.

save me from that Philistine.” “Then go,” Saul said to David, “and
may YHWH be with you!”
