flesh to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the field.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה אֵלַי וְאֶתְּנָה אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה אֵלַי וְאֶתְּנָה אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
and the Philistine said to David, “Come here, and I will give your
flesh to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the field.”

translation.text: The Philistine said to David, "Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and to the wild animals of the field."

verses.english:
David replied to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword
and spear and javelin; but I come against you in the name of YHWH
of Hosts, the God of the ranks of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אַתָּה בָּא אֵלַי בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית וּבְכִידוֹן וְאָנֹכִי בָא־אֵלֶיךָ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אַתָּה בָּא אֵלַי בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית וּבְכִידוֹן וְאָנֹכִי בָא־אֵלֶיךָ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתָּ׃

english.text:
David replied to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword
and spear and javelin; but I come against you in the name of YHWH
of Hosts, the God of the ranks of Israel, whom you have defied.

translation.text: But David said to the Philistine, "You come to me with sword and spear and javelin; armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

verses.english:
This very day YHWH will deliver you into my hands. I will kill you
and cut off your head; and I will give the carcasses of the
Philistine camp to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the
earth. All the earth shall know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.hebrew:
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְסַגֶּרְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְהִכִּיתִךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי פֶּגֶר מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְחַיַּת
הָאָרֶץ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי יֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְסַגֶּרְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְהִכִּיתִךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי פֶּגֶר מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְחַיַּת
הָאָרֶץ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי יֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
This very day YHWH will deliver you into my hands. I will kill you
and cut off your head; and I will give the carcasses of the
Philistine camp to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the
earth. All the earth shall know that there is a God in Israel.

translation.text: This very day the LORD will day to the birds of the air and to the wild animals of the earth, so that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

verses.english:
And this whole assembly shall know that YHWH can give victory
without sword or spear. For the battle is YHWH’s, and He will
deliver you into our hands.”
verses.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה כִּי־לֹא בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית יְהוֹשִׁיעַ יְהֹוָה כִּי לַיהֹוָה הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנָתַן אֶתְכֶם בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה כִּי־לֹא בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית יְהוֹשִׁיעַ יְהֹוָה כִּי לַיהֹוָה הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנָתַן אֶתְכֶם בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And this whole assembly shall know that YHWH can give victory
without sword or spear. For the battle is YHWH’s, and He will
deliver you into our hands.”

translation.text: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD does not save by sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD's and he will give you into our hand."

verses.english:
When the Philistine began to advance toward him again, David
quickly ran up to the battle line to face the Philistine.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי־קָם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַב לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיְמַהֵר דָּוִד וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי־קָם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַב לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיְמַהֵר דָּוִד וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
When the Philistine began to advance toward him again, David
quickly ran up to the battle line to face the Philistine.

translation.text: When the Philistine drew nearer to meet David, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet the Philistine.

verses.english:
David put his hand into the bag; he took out a stone and slung it.
It struck the Philistine in the forehead; the stone sank into his
forehead, and he fell face down on the ground.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יָדוֹ אֶל־הַכֶּלִי וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אֶבֶן וַיְקַלַּע וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־מִצְחוֹ וַתִּטְבַּע הָאֶבֶן בְּמִצְחוֹ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יָדוֹ אֶל־הַכֶּלִי וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אֶבֶן וַיְקַלַּע וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־מִצְחוֹ וַתִּטְבַּע הָאֶבֶן בְּמִצְחוֹ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
David put his hand into the bag; he took out a stone and slung it.
It struck the Philistine in the forehead; the stone sank into his
forehead, and he fell face down on the ground.

translation.text: David put his hand in the ground.

verses.english:
Thus David bested the Philistine with sling and stone; he struck
him down and killed him. David had no sword;
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק דָּוִד מִן־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בַּקֶּלַע וּבָאֶבֶן וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ וְחֶרֶב אֵין בְּיַד־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק דָּוִד מִן־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בַּקֶּלַע וּבָאֶבֶן וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ וְחֶרֶב אֵין בְּיַד־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Thus David bested the Philistine with sling and stone; he struck
him down and killed him. David had no sword;

translation.text: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone, David's hand.

verses.english:
so David ran up and stood over the Philistine, grasped his sword
and pulled it from its sheath; and with it he dispatched him and
cut off his head. When the Philistines saw that their warrior was
dead, they ran.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּרץ דָּוִד וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְפָהּ מִתַּעְרָהּ וַיְמֹתְתֵהוּ וַיִּכְרת־בָּהּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מֵת
גִּבּוֹרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּרץ דָּוִד וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְפָהּ מִתַּעְרָהּ וַיְמֹתְתֵהוּ וַיִּכְרת־בָּהּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מֵת
גִּבּוֹרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

english.text:
so David ran up and stood over the Philistine, grasped his sword
and pulled it from its sheath; and with it he dispatched him and
cut off his head. When the Philistines saw that their warrior was
dead, they ran.

translation.text: Then David ran and stood over the Philistine; he grasped his sword, drew it out of its sheath, and killed him; then he cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

verses.english:
The men of Israel and Judah rose up with a war cry and they
pursued the Philistines all the way to Gai and up to the gates of
Ekron; the Philistines fell mortally wounded along the road to
Shaarim up to Gath and Ekron.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וַיָּרִעוּ וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ גַיְא וְעַד שַׁעֲרֵי עֶקְרוֹן וַיִּפְּלוּ חַלְלֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּדֶרֶךְ
שַׁעֲרַיִם וְעַד־גַּת וְעַד־עֶקְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וַיָּרִעוּ וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ גַיְא וְעַד שַׁעֲרֵי עֶקְרוֹן וַיִּפְּלוּ חַלְלֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּדֶרֶךְ
שַׁעֲרַיִם וְעַד־גַּת וְעַד־עֶקְרוֹן׃

english.text:
The men of Israel and Judah rose up with a war cry and they
pursued the Philistines all the way to Gai and up to the gates of
Ekron; the Philistines fell mortally wounded along the road to
Shaarim up to Gath and Ekron.

translation.text: Philistines fell on the way from Shaaraim as far as Gath and Ekron.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines and
looted their camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדְּלֹק אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדְּלֹק אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines and
looted their camp.

translation.text: plundered their camp.

verses.english:
David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem;
and he put his weapons in his own tent.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־רֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְבִאֵהוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־כֵּלָיו שָׂם בְּאהֳלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־רֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְבִאֵהוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־כֵּלָיו שָׂם בְּאהֳלוֹ׃

english.text:
David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem;
and he put his weapons in his own tent.

translation.text: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armor in his tent.

verses.english:
When Saul saw David going out to assault the Philistine, he asked
his army commander Abner, “Whose son is that boy, Abner?” And
Abner replied, “By your life, Your Majesty, I do not know.”
verses.hebrew: וְכִרְאוֹת שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד יֹצֵא לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אָמַר אֶל־אַבְנֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הַנַּעַר אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־יָדָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְכִרְאוֹת שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד יֹצֵא לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אָמַר אֶל־אַבְנֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הַנַּעַר אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־יָדָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
When Saul saw David going out to assault the Philistine, he asked
his army commander Abner, “Whose son is that boy, Abner?” And
Abner replied, “By your life, Your Majesty, I do not know.”

translation.text: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is this young man?" Abner said, "As your soul lives, O king, I do not know."

verses.english: “Then find out whose son that young fellow is,” the king ordered.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁאַל אַתָּה בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הָעָלֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁאַל אַתָּה בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הָעָלֶם׃

english.text: “Then find out whose son that young fellow is,” the king ordered.

translation.text: The king said, "Inquire whose son the stripling is."

verses.english:
So when David returned after killing the Philistine, Abner took
him and brought him to Saul, with the head of the Philistine still
in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וּכְשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ אַבְנֵר וַיְבִאֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וְרֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּכְשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ אַבְנֵר וַיְבִאֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וְרֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
So when David returned after killing the Philistine, Abner took
him and brought him to Saul, with the head of the Philistine still
in his hand.

translation.text: On David's return from with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

verses.english:
Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, my boy?” And David answered,
“The son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שָׁאוּל בֶּן־מִי אַתָּה הַנָּעַר וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בֶּן־עַבְדְּךָ יִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שָׁאוּל בֶּן־מִי אַתָּה הַנָּעַר וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בֶּן־עַבְדְּךָ יִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי׃

english.text:
Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, my boy?” And David answered,
“The son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

translation.text: Saul said to him, "Whose servant Jesse the Bethlehemite."

verses.english:
When [David] finished speaking with Saul, Jonathan’s soul became
bound up with the soul of David; Jonathan loved David as himself.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְנֶפֶשׁ יְהוֹנָתָן נִקְשְׁרָה בְּנֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד (ויאהבו) [וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ] יְהוֹנָתָן כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְנֶפֶשׁ יְהוֹנָתָן נִקְשְׁרָה בְּנֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד (ויאהבו) [וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ] יְהוֹנָתָן כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
When [David] finished speaking with Saul, Jonathan’s soul became
bound up with the soul of David; Jonathan loved David as himself.

translation.text: When David had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was bound to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

verses.english:
Saul took him [into his service] that day and would not let him
return to his father’s house.—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְלֹא נְתָנוֹ לָשׁוּב בֵּית אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְלֹא נְתָנוֹ לָשׁוּב בֵּית אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Saul took him [into his service] that day and would not let him
return to his father’s house.—

translation.text: house.

verses.english:
Jonathan and David made a pact, because [Jonathan] loved him as
himself.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד בְּרִית בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד בְּרִית בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
Jonathan and David made a pact, because [Jonathan] loved him as
himself.

translation.text: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David, because he loved him as his own soul.

verses.english:
Jonathan took off the cloak and tunic he was wearing and gave them
to David, together with his sword, bow, and belt.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּשֵּׁט יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְדָוִד וּמַדָּיו וְעַד־חַרְבּוֹ וְעַד־קַשְׁתּוֹ וְעַד־חֲגֹרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפַּשֵּׁט יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְדָוִד וּמַדָּיו וְעַד־חַרְבּוֹ וְעַד־קַשְׁתּוֹ וְעַד־חֲגֹרוֹ׃

english.text:
Jonathan took off the cloak and tunic he was wearing and gave them
to David, together with his sword, bow, and belt.

translation.text: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that he and his bow and his belt.

verses.english:
David went out [with the troops], and he was successful in every
mission on which Saul sent him, and Saul put him in command of all
the soldiers; this pleased all the troops and Saul’s courtiers as
well.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁלָחֶנּוּ שָׁאוּל יַשְׂכִּיל וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ שָׁאוּל עַל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם וְגַם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁלָחֶנּוּ שָׁאוּל יַשְׂכִּיל וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ שָׁאוּל עַל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם וְגַם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
David went out [with the troops], and he was successful in every
mission on which Saul sent him, and Saul put him in command of all
the soldiers; this pleased all the troops and Saul’s courtiers as
well.

translation.text: David went out and was successful wherever Saul sent him; as a result, Saul set him over the army. And all the people, even the servants of Saul, approved.

verses.english:
When the [troops] came home [and] David returned from killing the
Philistine, the women of all the towns of Israel came out singing
and dancing to greet King Saul with timbrels, shouting, and
sistrums.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם בְּשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַתֵּצֶאנָה הַנָּשִׁים מִכּל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (לשור) [לָשִׁיר] וְהַמְּחֹלוֹת לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתֻפִּים
בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׁלִשִׁים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם בְּשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַתֵּצֶאנָה הַנָּשִׁים מִכּל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (לשור) [לָשִׁיר] וְהַמְּחֹלוֹת לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתֻפִּים
בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׁלִשִׁים׃

english.text:
When the [troops] came home [and] David returned from killing the
Philistine, the women of all the towns of Israel came out singing
and dancing to greet King Saul with timbrels, shouting, and
sistrums.

translation.text: As they were coming home, when David returned from killing the with musical instruments.

verses.english:
The women sang as they danced, and they chanted: Saul has slain
his thousands; David, his tens of thousands!
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה הַנָּשִׁים הַמְשַׂחֲקוֹת וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה הַנָּשִׁים הַמְשַׂחֲקוֹת וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
The women sang as they danced, and they chanted: Saul has slain
his thousands; David, his tens of thousands!

translation.text: And the women sang to one another as and David his ten thousands."

verses.english:
Saul was much distressed and greatly vexed about the matter. For
he said, “To David they have given tens of thousands, and to me
they have given thousands. All that he lacks is the kingship!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְשָׁאוּל מְאֹד וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר נָתְנוּ לְדָוִד רְבָבוֹת וְלִי נָתְנוּ הָאֲלָפִים וְעוֹד לוֹ אַךְ הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְשָׁאוּל מְאֹד וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר נָתְנוּ לְדָוִד רְבָבוֹת וְלִי נָתְנוּ הָאֲלָפִים וְעוֹד לוֹ אַךְ הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text:
Saul was much distressed and greatly vexed about the matter. For
he said, “To David they have given tens of thousands, and to me
they have given thousands. All that he lacks is the kingship!”

translation.text: Saul was very angry, for this saying displeased him. He said, "They thousands; what more can he have but the kingdom?"

verses.english: From that day on Saul kept a jealous eye on David.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל (עון) [עוֹיֵן] אֶת־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָהָלְאָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל (עון) [עוֹיֵן] אֶת־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָהָלְאָה׃

english.text: From that day on Saul kept a jealous eye on David.

translation.text: So Saul eyed David from that day on.

verses.english:
The next day an evil spirit of God gripped Saul and he began to
rave in the house, while David was playing [the lyre], as he did
daily. Saul had a spear in his hand,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ כְּיוֹם בְּיוֹם וְהַחֲנִית בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ כְּיוֹם בְּיוֹם וְהַחֲנִית בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The next day an evil spirit of God gripped Saul and he began to
rave in the house, while David was playing [the lyre], as he did
daily. Saul had a spear in his hand,

translation.text: The next day an evil spirit from God rushed upon Saul, and he raved day. Saul had his spear in his hand;

verses.english:
and Saul threw the spear, thinking to pin David to the wall. But
David eluded him twice.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֲנִית וַיֹּאמֶר אַכֶּה בְדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּסֹּב דָּוִד מִפָּנָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֲנִית וַיֹּאמֶר אַכֶּה בְדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּסֹּב דָּוִד מִפָּנָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

english.text:
and Saul threw the spear, thinking to pin David to the wall. But
David eluded him twice.

translation.text: and Saul threw the spear, for he thought, "I will pin David to the wall." But David eluded him twice.

verses.english:
Saul was afraid of David, for YHWH was with him and had turned
away from Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרָא שָׁאוּל מִלִּפְנֵי דָוִד כִּי־הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמּוֹ וּמֵעִם שָׁאוּל סָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרָא שָׁאוּל מִלִּפְנֵי דָוִד כִּי־הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמּוֹ וּמֵעִם שָׁאוּל סָר׃

english.text:
Saul was afraid of David, for YHWH was with him and had turned
away from Saul.

translation.text: Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him but had departed from Saul.

verses.english:
So Saul removed him from his presence and appointed him chief of a
thousand, to march at the head of the troops.
verses.hebrew: וַיְסִרֵהוּ שָׁאוּל מֵעִמּוֹ וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ לוֹ שַׂר־אָלֶף וַיֵּצֵא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסִרֵהוּ שָׁאוּל מֵעִמּוֹ וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ לוֹ שַׂר־אָלֶף וַיֵּצֵא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
So Saul removed him from his presence and appointed him chief of a
thousand, to march at the head of the troops.

translation.text: So Saul removed him from his presence, and came in, leading the army.

verses.english:
David was successful in all his undertakings, for YHWH was with
him;
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דָוִד לְכל־דְּרָכָו מַשְׂכִּיל וַיהֹוָה עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דָוִד לְכל־דְּרָכָו מַשְׂכִּיל וַיהֹוָה עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David was successful in all his undertakings, for YHWH was with
him;

translation.text: David had success in all his undertakings; for the LORD was with him.

verses.english: and when Saul saw that he was successful, he dreaded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מַשְׂכִּיל מְאֹד וַיָּגר מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מַשְׂכִּיל מְאֹד וַיָּגר מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text: and when Saul saw that he was successful, he dreaded him.

translation.text: When Saul saw that he had great success, he stood in awe of him.

verses.english: All Israel and Judah loved David, for he marched at their head.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה אֹהֵב אֶת־דָּוִד כִּי־הוּא יוֹצֵא וָבָא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה אֹהֵב אֶת־דָּוִד כִּי־הוּא יוֹצֵא וָבָא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text: All Israel and Judah loved David, for he marched at their head.

translation.text: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for it was he who marched out and came in leading them.

verses.english:
Saul said to David, “Here is my older daughter, Merab; I will give
her to you in marriage; in return, you be my warrior and fight the
battles of YHWH.” Saul thought: “Let not my hand strike him; let
the hand of the Philistines strike him.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד הִנֵּה בִתִּי הַגְּדוֹלָה מֵרַב אֹתָהּ אֶתֶּן־לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה אַךְ הֱיֵה־לִי לְבֶן־חַיִל וְהִלָּחֵם מִלְחֲמוֹת יְהֹוָה וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר אַל־תְּהִי יָדִי
בּוֹ וּתְהִי־בוֹ יַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד הִנֵּה בִתִּי הַגְּדוֹלָה מֵרַב אֹתָהּ אֶתֶּן־לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה אַךְ הֱיֵה־לִי לְבֶן־חַיִל וְהִלָּחֵם מִלְחֲמוֹת יְהֹוָה וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר אַל־תְּהִי יָדִי
בּוֹ וּתְהִי־בוֹ יַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Saul said to David, “Here is my older daughter, Merab; I will give
her to you in marriage; in return, you be my warrior and fight the
battles of YHWH.” Saul thought: “Let not my hand strike him; let
the hand of the Philistines strike him.”

translation.text: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my elder daughter Merab; I will battles." For Saul thought, "I will not raise a hand against him; let the Philistines deal with him."

verses.english:
David replied to Saul, “Who am I and what is my life —my father’s
family in Israel—that I should become Your Majesty’s son-in-law?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל מִי אָנֹכִי וּמִי חַיַּי מִשְׁפַּחַת אָבִי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶהְיֶה חָתָן לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל מִי אָנֹכִי וּמִי חַיַּי מִשְׁפַּחַת אָבִי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶהְיֶה חָתָן לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
David replied to Saul, “Who am I and what is my life —my father’s
family in Israel—that I should become Your Majesty’s son-in-law?”

translation.text: David said to Saul, "Who am I and who are my kinsfolk, my father's family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?"

verses.english:
But at the time that Merab, daughter of Saul, should have been
given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel the
Meholathite.

Why then should you incur the guilt of shedding the blood of an
innocent man, killing David without cause?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ בְכַפּוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאִיתָ וַתִּשְׂמָח וְלָמָּה תֶחֱטָא בְּדָם נָקִי לְהָמִית
אֶת־דָּוִד חִנָּם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ בְכַפּוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאִיתָ וַתִּשְׂמָח וְלָמָּה תֶחֱטָא בְּדָם נָקִי לְהָמִית
אֶת־דָּוִד חִנָּם׃

english.text:
He took his life in his hands and killed the Philistine, and YHWH
wrought a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced.
Why then should you incur the guilt of shedding the blood of an
innocent man, killing David without cause?”

translation.text: for he took his life in his hand when he attacked the Philistine, killing David without cause?"

verses.english:
Saul heeded Jonathan’s plea, and Saul swore, “As YHWH lives, he
shall not be put to death!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל בְּקוֹל יְהוֹנָתָן וַיִּשָּׁבַע שָׁאוּל חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל בְּקוֹל יְהוֹנָתָן וַיִּשָּׁבַע שָׁאוּל חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יוּמָת׃

english.text:
Saul heeded Jonathan’s plea, and Saul swore, “As YHWH lives, he
shall not be put to death!”

translation.text: Saul heeded the voice of Jonathan; Saul swore, "As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death."

verses.english:
Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all this. Then
Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he served him as before.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֵא יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיְהִי לְפָנָיו כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֵא יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיְהִי לְפָנָיו כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all this. Then
Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he served him as before.

translation.text: So then brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

verses.english:
Fighting broke out again. David went out and fought the
Philistines. He inflicted a great defeat upon them and they fled
before him.
verses.hebrew: וַתּוֹסֶף הַמִּלְחָמָה לִהְיוֹת וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתּוֹסֶף הַמִּלְחָמָה לִהְיוֹת וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
Fighting broke out again. David went out and fought the
Philistines. He inflicted a great defeat upon them and they fled
before him.

translation.text: Again there was war, and David went out to fight the Philistines. He launched a heavy attack on them, so that they fled before him.

verses.english:
Then an evil spirit of YHWH came upon Saul while he was sitting in
his house with his spear in his hand, and David was playing [the
lyre].
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי רוּחַ יְהֹוָה רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְהוּא בְּבֵיתוֹ יֹשֵׁב וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי רוּחַ יְהֹוָה רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְהוּא בְּבֵיתוֹ יֹשֵׁב וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָד׃

english.text:
Then an evil spirit of YHWH came upon Saul while he was sitting in
his house with his spear in his hand, and David was playing [the
lyre].

translation.text: Then an evil spirit from the LORD came upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand, while David was playing music.

verses.english:
Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he eluded
Saul, so that he drove the spear into the wall. David fled and got
away. That night
verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לְהַכּוֹת בַּחֲנִית בְּדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּפְטַר מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַחֲנִית בַּקִּיר וְדָוִד נָס וַיִּמָּלֵט בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לְהַכּוֹת בַּחֲנִית בְּדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּפְטַר מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַחֲנִית בַּקִּיר וְדָוִד נָס וַיִּמָּלֵט בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

english.text:
Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he eluded
Saul, so that he drove the spear into the wall. David fled and got
away. That night

translation.text: Saul sought to struck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

verses.english:
Saul sent messengers to David’s home to keep watch on him and to
kill him in the morning. But David’s wife Michal told him, “Unless
you run for your life tonight, you will be killed tomorrow.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־בֵּית דָּוִד לְשׁמְרוֹ וְלַהֲמִיתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד מִיכַל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֵאמֹר אִם־אֵינְךָ מְמַלֵּט אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הַלַּיְלָה מָחָר
אַתָּה מוּמָת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־בֵּית דָּוִד לְשׁמְרוֹ וְלַהֲמִיתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד מִיכַל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֵאמֹר אִם־אֵינְךָ מְמַלֵּט אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הַלַּיְלָה מָחָר
אַתָּה מוּמָת׃

english.text:
Saul sent messengers to David’s home to keep watch on him and to
kill him in the morning. But David’s wife Michal told him, “Unless
you run for your life tonight, you will be killed tomorrow.”

translation.text: Saul sent messengers to David's house to keep watch over him, you do not save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed."

verses.english: Michal let David down from the window and he escaped and fled.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּרֶד מִיכַל אֶת־דָּוִד בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּבְרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּרֶד מִיכַל אֶת־דָּוִד בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּבְרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט׃

english.text: Michal let David down from the window and he escaped and fled.

translation.text: So Michal let David down through the window; he fled away and escaped.

verses.english:
Michal then took the household idol, laid it on the bed, and
covered it with a cloth; and at its head she put a net of goat’s
hair.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח מִיכַל אֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וַתָּשֶׂם אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וְאֵת כְּבִיר הָעִזִּים שָׂמָה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַתְּכַס בַּבָּגֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח מִיכַל אֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וַתָּשֶׂם אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וְאֵת כְּבִיר הָעִזִּים שָׂמָה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַתְּכַס בַּבָּגֶד׃

english.text:
Michal then took the household idol, laid it on the bed, and
covered it with a cloth; and at its head she put a net of goat’s
hair.

translation.text: Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed; she put a net of goats' hair on its head, and covered it with the clothes.

verses.english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; but she said, “He is sick.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר חֹלֶה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר חֹלֶה הוּא׃

english.text: Saul sent messengers to seize David; but she said, “He is sick.”

translation.text: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick."

verses.english:
Saul, however, sent back the messengers to see David for
themselves. “Bring him up to me in the bed,” he ordered, “that he
may be put to death.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים לִרְאוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ בַמִּטָּה אֵלַי לַהֲמִתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים לִרְאוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ בַמִּטָּה אֵלַי לַהֲמִתוֹ׃

english.text:
Saul, however, sent back the messengers to see David for
themselves. “Bring him up to me in the bed,” he ordered, “that he
may be put to death.”

translation.text: Then Saul sent the in the bed, that I may kill him."

verses.english:
When the messengers came, they found the household idol in the
bed, with the net of goat’s hair at its head.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וְהִנֵּה הַתְּרָפִים אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וּכְבִיר הָעִזִּים מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וְהִנֵּה הַתְּרָפִים אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וּכְבִיר הָעִזִּים מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו׃

english.text:
When the messengers came, they found the household idol in the
bed, with the net of goat’s hair at its head.

translation.text: When the messengers came in, the idol was in the bed, with the covering of goats' hair on its head.

verses.english:
Saul said to Michal, “Why did you play that trick on me and let my
enemy get away safely?” “Because,” Michal answered Saul, “he said
to me: ‘Help me get away or I’ll kill you.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־מִיכַל לָמָּה כָּכָה רִמִּיתִנִי וַתְּשַׁלְּחִי אֶת־אֹיְבִי וַיִּמָּלֵט וַתֹּאמֶר מִיכַל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הוּא־אָמַר אֵלַי שַׁלְּחִנִי לָמָה אֲמִיתֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־מִיכַל לָמָּה כָּכָה רִמִּיתִנִי וַתְּשַׁלְּחִי אֶת־אֹיְבִי וַיִּמָּלֵט וַתֹּאמֶר מִיכַל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הוּא־אָמַר אֵלַי שַׁלְּחִנִי לָמָה אֲמִיתֵךְ׃

english.text:
Saul said to Michal, “Why did you play that trick on me and let my
enemy get away safely?” “Because,” Michal answered Saul, “he said
to me: ‘Help me get away or I’ll kill you.’”

translation.text: Saul 'Let me go; why should I kill you?'"

verses.english:
David made good his escape, and he came to Samuel at Ramah and
told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and
stayed at Naioth.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בָּרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט וַיָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לוֹ שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת]׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד בָּרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט וַיָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לוֹ שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת]׃

english.text:
David made good his escape, and he came to Samuel at Ramah and
told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and
stayed at Naioth.

translation.text: Now David fled and escaped; he came to Samuel at Ramah, and told Naioth.

verses.english: Saul was told that David was at Naioth in Ramah,
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

english.text: Saul was told that David was at Naioth in Ramah,

translation.text: Saul was told, "David is at Naioth in Ramah."

verses.english:
and Saul sent messengers to seize David. They saw a band of
prophets speaking in ecstasy, with Samuel standing by as their
leader; and the spirit of God came upon Saul’s messengers and they
too began to speak in ecstasy.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַיַּרְא אֶת־לַהֲקַת הַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאִים וּשְׁמוּאֵל עֹמֵד נִצָּב עֲלֵיהֶם וַתְּהִי עַל־מַלְאֲכֵי שָׁאוּל רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים
וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַיַּרְא אֶת־לַהֲקַת הַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאִים וּשְׁמוּאֵל עֹמֵד נִצָּב עֲלֵיהֶם וַתְּהִי עַל־מַלְאֲכֵי שָׁאוּל רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים
וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
and Saul sent messengers to seize David. They saw a band of
prophets speaking in ecstasy, with Samuel standing by as their
leader; and the spirit of God came upon Saul’s messengers and they
too began to speak in ecstasy.

translation.text: Then Saul prophets in a frenzy, with Samuel standing in charge of them, the spirit prophetic frenzy.

verses.english:
When Saul was told about this, he sent other messengers; but they
too spoke in ecstasy. Saul sent a third group of messengers; and
they also spoke in ecstasy.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְשָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּהוַיֹּסֶף שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים שְׁלִשִׁים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְשָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּהוַיֹּסֶף שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים שְׁלִשִׁים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
When Saul was told about this, he sent other messengers; but they
too spoke in ecstasy. Saul sent a third group of messengers; and
they also spoke in ecstasy.

translation.text: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also fell into a frenzy. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also fell into a frenzy.

verses.english:
So he himself went to Ramah. When he came to the great cistern at
Secu, he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” and was told that
they were at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־הוּא הָרָמָתָה וַיָּבֹא עַד־בּוֹר הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר בַּשֶּׂכוּ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיפֹה שְׁמוּאֵל וְדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־הוּא הָרָמָתָה וַיָּבֹא עַד־בּוֹר הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר בַּשֶּׂכוּ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיפֹה שְׁמוּאֵל וְדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

english.text:
So he himself went to Ramah. When he came to the great cistern at
Secu, he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” and was told that
they were at Naioth in Ramah.

translation.text: Then he himself went to Ramah. He and David?" And someone said, "They are at Naioth in Ramah."

verses.english:
He was on his way there, to Naioth in Ramah, when the spirit of
God came upon him too; and he walked on, speaking in ecstasy,
until he reached Naioth in Ramah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם אֶל־[נָיוֹת] (נוית) בָּרָמָה וַתְּהִי עָלָיו גַּם־הוּא רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וַיִּתְנַבֵּא עַד־בֹּאוֹ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם אֶל־[נָיוֹת] (נוית) בָּרָמָה וַתְּהִי עָלָיו גַּם־הוּא רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וַיִּתְנַבֵּא עַד־בֹּאוֹ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

english.text:
He was on his way there, to Naioth in Ramah, when the spirit of
God came upon him too; and he walked on, speaking in ecstasy,
until he reached Naioth in Ramah.

translation.text: He him. As he was going, he fell into a prophetic frenzy, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

verses.english:
Then he too stripped off his clothes and he too spoke in ecstasy
before Samuel; and he lay naked all that day and all night. That
is why people say, “Is Saul too among the prophets?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשַׁט גַּם־הוּא בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְנַבֵּא גַם־הוּא לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּפֹּל עָרֹם כּל־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְשַׁט גַּם־הוּא בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְנַבֵּא גַם־הוּא לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּפֹּל עָרֹם כּל־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִם׃

english.text:
Then he too stripped off his clothes and he too spoke in ecstasy
before Samuel; and he lay naked all that day and all night. That
is why people say, “Is Saul too among the prophets?”

translation.text: He too stripped off his clothes, and he too fell into a frenzy before Samuel. He lay naked all that day and all that night. Therefore it is said, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

verses.english:
David fled from Naioth in Ramah; he came to Jonathan and said,
“What have I done, what is my crime and my guilt against your
father, that he seeks my life?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח דָּוִד (מנוות) [מִנָּיוֹת] בָּרָמָה וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוֹנָתָן מֶה עָשִׂיתִי מֶה־עֲוֺנִי וּמֶה־חַטָּאתִי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כִּי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרַח דָּוִד (מנוות) [מִנָּיוֹת] בָּרָמָה וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוֹנָתָן מֶה עָשִׂיתִי מֶה־עֲוֺנִי וּמֶה־חַטָּאתִי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כִּי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי׃

english.text:
David fled from Naioth in Ramah; he came to Jonathan and said,
“What have I done, what is my crime and my guilt against your
father, that he seeks my life?”

translation.text: David fled from Naioth in Ramah. He came before Jonathan and said, father that he is trying to take my life?"

verses.english:
He replied, “Heaven forbid! You shall not die. My father does not
do anything, great or small, without disclosing it to me; why
should my father conceal this matter from me? It cannot be!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חָלִילָה לֹא תָמוּת הִנֵּה (לו עשה) [לֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה] אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל אוֹ דָּבָר קָטֹן וְלֹא יִגְלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי וּמַדּוּעַ יַסְתִּיר אָבִי מִמֶּנִּי אֶת־הַדָּבָר
הַזֶּה אֵין זֹאת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חָלִילָה לֹא תָמוּת הִנֵּה (לו עשה) [לֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה] אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל אוֹ דָּבָר קָטֹן וְלֹא יִגְלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי וּמַדּוּעַ יַסְתִּיר אָבִי מִמֶּנִּי אֶת־הַדָּבָר
הַזֶּה אֵין זֹאת׃

english.text:
He replied, “Heaven forbid! You shall not die. My father does not
do anything, great or small, without disclosing it to me; why
should my father conceal this matter from me? It cannot be!”

translation.text: He said to him, "Far from it! You shall not die. My father does nothing either great or small without disclosing it to me; and why should my father hide this from me? Never!"

verses.english:
David swore further, “Your father knows well that you are fond of
me and has decided: Jonathan must not learn of this or he will be
grieved. But, as YHWH lives and as you live, there is only a step
between me and death.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשָּׁבַע עוֹד דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר יָדֹעַ יָדַע אָבִיךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֵדַע־זֹאת יְהוֹנָתָן פֶּן־יֵעָצֵב וְאוּלָם חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ כִּי
כְפֶשַׂע בֵּינִי וּבֵין הַמָּוֶת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשָּׁבַע עוֹד דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר יָדֹעַ יָדַע אָבִיךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֵדַע־זֹאת יְהוֹנָתָן פֶּן־יֵעָצֵב וְאוּלָם חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ כִּי
כְפֶשַׂע בֵּינִי וּבֵין הַמָּוֶת׃

english.text:
David swore further, “Your father knows well that you are fond of
me and has decided: Jonathan must not learn of this or he will be
grieved. But, as YHWH lives and as you live, there is only a step
between me and death.”

translation.text: But David also swore, "Your father knows well that you like grieved.' But truly, as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, there is but a step between me and death."

verses.english: Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you want, I will do it for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד מַה־תֹּאמַר נַפְשְׁךָ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד מַה־תֹּאמַר נַפְשְׁךָ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

english.text: Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you want, I will do it for you.”

translation.text: Then Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you say, I will do for you."

verses.english:
David said to Jonathan, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and I am to sit
with the king at the meal. Instead, let me go and I will hide in
the countryside until the third evening.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה־חֹדֶשׁ מָחָר וְאָנֹכִי יָשֹׁב־אֵשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֶאֱכוֹל וְשִׁלַּחְתַּנִי וְנִסְתַּרְתִּי בַשָּׂדֶה עַד הָעֶרֶב הַשְּׁלִשִׁית׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה־חֹדֶשׁ מָחָר וְאָנֹכִי יָשֹׁב־אֵשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֶאֱכוֹל וְשִׁלַּחְתַּנִי וְנִסְתַּרְתִּי בַשָּׂדֶה עַד הָעֶרֶב הַשְּׁלִשִׁית׃

english.text:
David said to Jonathan, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and I am to sit
with the king at the meal. Instead, let me go and I will hide in
the countryside until the third evening.

translation.text: David said to Jonathan, at the meal; but let me go, so that I may hide in the field until the third evening.

verses.english:
If your father notes my absence, you say, ‘David asked my
permission to run down to his home town, Bethlehem, for the whole
family has its annual sacrifice there.’
verses.hebrew: אִם־פָּקֹד יִפְקְדֵנִי אָבִיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי דָוִד לָרוּץ בֵּית־לֶחֶם עִירוֹ כִּי זֶבַח הַיָּמִים שָׁם לְכל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה׃

hebrew.text: אִם־פָּקֹד יִפְקְדֵנִי אָבִיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי דָוִד לָרוּץ בֵּית־לֶחֶם עִירוֹ כִּי זֶבַח הַיָּמִים שָׁם לְכל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה׃

english.text:
If your father notes my absence, you say, ‘David asked my
permission to run down to his home town, Bethlehem, for the whole
family has its annual sacrifice there.’

translation.text: If your father misses me at all, then say, 'David earnestly sacrifice there for all the family.'

verses.english:
If he says ‘Good,’ your servant is safe; but if his anger flares
up, know that he is resolved to do [me] harm.
verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמַר טוֹב שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְאִם־חָרֹה יֶחֱרֶה לוֹ דַּע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמַר טוֹב שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְאִם־חָרֹה יֶחֱרֶה לוֹ דַּע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
If he says ‘Good,’ your servant is safe; but if his anger flares
up, know that he is resolved to do [me] harm.

translation.text: If he says, 'Good!' it will be well with determined by him.

verses.english:
Deal faithfully with your servant, since you have taken your
servant into a covenant of YHWH with you. And if I am guilty, kill
me yourself, but don’t make me go back to your father.”
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בִּבְרִית יְהֹוָה הֵבֵאתָ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ עִמָּךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן הֲמִיתֵנִי אַתָּה וְעַד־אָבִיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה תְבִיאֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בִּבְרִית יְהֹוָה הֵבֵאתָ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ עִמָּךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן הֲמִיתֵנִי אַתָּה וְעַד־אָבִיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה תְבִיאֵנִי׃

english.text:
Deal faithfully with your servant, since you have taken your
servant into a covenant of YHWH with you. And if I am guilty, kill
me yourself, but don’t make me go back to your father.”

translation.text: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you there is guilt in me, kill me yourself; why should you bring me to your father?"

verses.english:
Jonathan replied, “Don’t talk like that! If I learn that my father
has resolved to kill you, I will surely tell you about it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן חָלִילָה לָּךְ כִּי אִם־יָדֹעַ אֵדַע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִם אָבִי לָבוֹא עָלֶיךָ וְלֹא אֹתָהּ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן חָלִילָה לָּךְ כִּי אִם־יָדֹעַ אֵדַע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִם אָבִי לָבוֹא עָלֶיךָ וְלֹא אֹתָהּ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃

english.text:
Jonathan replied, “Don’t talk like that! If I learn that my father
has resolved to kill you, I will surely tell you about it.”

translation.text: Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! If I knew that it was you?"

verses.english:
David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers
you harshly?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן מִי יַגִּיד לִי אוֹ מַה־יַּעַנְךָ אָבִיךָ קָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן מִי יַגִּיד לִי אוֹ מַה־יַּעַנְךָ אָבִיךָ קָשָׁה׃

english.text:
David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers
you harshly?”

translation.text: Then David said to Jonathan, "Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?"

verses.english:
Jonathan said to David, “Let us go into the open”; and they both
went out into the open.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה וְנֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה וְנֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
Jonathan said to David, “Let us go into the open”; and they both
went out into the open.

translation.text: Jonathan replied to David, "Come, let us go out into the field." So they both went out into the field.

verses.english:
Then Jonathan said to David, “By YHWH, the God of Israel! I will
sound out my father at this time tomorrow, [or] on the third day;
and if [his response] is favorable for David, I will send a
message to you at once and disclose it to you.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶחְקֹר אֶת־אָבִי כָּעֵת מָחָר הַשְּׁלִשִׁית וְהִנֵּה־טוֹב אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא־אָז אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי
אֶת־אזְנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶחְקֹר אֶת־אָבִי כָּעֵת מָחָר הַשְּׁלִשִׁית וְהִנֵּה־טוֹב אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא־אָז אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי
אֶת־אזְנֶךָ׃

english.text:
Then Jonathan said to David, “By YHWH, the God of Israel! I will
sound out my father at this time tomorrow, [or] on the third day;
and if [his response] is favorable for David, I will send a
message to you at once and disclose it to you.

translation.text: Jonathan said to David, "By the LORD, the God of Israel! When I have if he is well disposed toward David, shall I not then send and disclose it to you?

verses.english:
But if my father intends to do you harm, may YHWH do thus to
Jonathan and more if I do [not] disclose it to you and send you
off to escape unharmed. May YHWH be with you, as He used to be
with my father.
verses.hebrew:
כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לִיהוֹנָתָן וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי־יֵיטִב אֶל־אָבִי אֶת־הָרָעָה עָלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי אֶת־אזְנֶךָ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ לְשָׁלוֹם וִיהִי יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ
כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אָבִי׃

hebrew.text:
כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לִיהוֹנָתָן וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי־יֵיטִב אֶל־אָבִי אֶת־הָרָעָה עָלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי אֶת־אזְנֶךָ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ לְשָׁלוֹם וִיהִי יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ
כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אָבִי׃

english.text:
But if my father intends to do you harm, may YHWH do thus to
Jonathan and more if I do [not] disclose it to you and send you
off to escape unharmed. May YHWH be with you, as He used to be
with my father.

translation.text: But if my father intends to do you harm, the LORD do so to has been with my father.

verses.english:
Nor shall you fail to show me YHWH’s faithfulness, while I am
alive; nor, when I am dead,
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אִם־עוֹדֶנִּי חָי וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד יְהֹוָה וְלֹא אָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אִם־עוֹדֶנִּי חָי וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד יְהֹוָה וְלֹא אָמוּת׃

english.text:
Nor shall you fail to show me YHWH’s faithfulness, while I am
alive; nor, when I am dead,

translation.text: If I am still alive, show me the faithful love of the LORD; but if I die,

verses.english:
shall you ever discontinue your faithfulness to my house—not even
after YHWH has wiped out every one of David’s enemies from the
face of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תַכְרִית אֶת־חַסְדְּךָ מֵעִם בֵּיתִי עַד־עוֹלָם וְלֹא בְּהַכְרִת יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵי דָוִד אִישׁ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־תַכְרִית אֶת־חַסְדְּךָ מֵעִם בֵּיתִי עַד־עוֹלָם וְלֹא בְּהַכְרִת יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵי דָוִד אִישׁ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
shall you ever discontinue your faithfulness to my house—not even
after YHWH has wiped out every one of David’s enemies from the
face of the earth.

translation.text: never cut off your faithful love from my David from the face of the earth."

verses.english:
Thus has Jonathan covenanted with the house of David; and may YHWH
requite the enemies of David!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן עִם־בֵּית דָּוִד וּבִקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן עִם־בֵּית דָּוִד וּבִקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
Thus has Jonathan covenanted with the house of David; and may YHWH
requite the enemies of David!”

translation.text: Thus Jonathan made a covenant of David."

verses.english:
Jonathan, out of his love for David, adjured him again, for he
loved him as himself.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסֶף יְהוֹנָתָן לְהַשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־דָּוִד בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כִּי־אַהֲבַת נַפְשׁוֹ אֲהֵבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹסֶף יְהוֹנָתָן לְהַשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־דָּוִד בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כִּי־אַהֲבַת נַפְשׁוֹ אֲהֵבוֹ׃

english.text:
Jonathan, out of his love for David, adjured him again, for he
loved him as himself.

translation.text: Jonathan made David swear again by his love for him; for he loved him as he loved his own life.

verses.english:
Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow will be the new moon; and you will
be missed when your seat remains vacant.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן מָחָר חֹדֶשׁ וְנִפְקַדְתָּ כִּי יִפָּקֵד מוֹשָׁבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן מָחָר חֹדֶשׁ וְנִפְקַדְתָּ כִּי יִפָּקֵד מוֹשָׁבֶךָ׃

english.text:
Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow will be the new moon; and you will
be missed when your seat remains vacant.

translation.text: Jonathan said to him, "Tomorrow is the new moon; you will be missed, because your place will be empty.

verses.english:
So the day after tomorrow, go down all the way to the place where
you hid the other time, and stay close to the Ezel stone.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ תֵּרֵד מְאֹד וּבָאתָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נִסְתַּרְתָּ שָּׁם בְּיוֹם הַמַּעֲשֶׂה וְיָשַׁבְתָּ אֵצֶל הָאֶבֶן הָאָזֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ תֵּרֵד מְאֹד וּבָאתָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נִסְתַּרְתָּ שָּׁם בְּיוֹם הַמַּעֲשֶׂה וְיָשַׁבְתָּ אֵצֶל הָאֶבֶן הָאָזֶל׃

english.text:
So the day after tomorrow, go down all the way to the place where
you hid the other time, and stay close to the Ezel stone.

translation.text: On the day after hid yourself earlier, and remain beside the stone there.

verses.english:
Now I will shoot three arrows to one side of it, as though I were
shooting at a mark,
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַחִצִּים צִדָּה אוֹרֶה לְשַׁלַּח־לִי לְמַטָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַחִצִּים צִדָּה אוֹרֶה לְשַׁלַּח־לִי לְמַטָּרָה׃

english.text:
Now I will shoot three arrows to one side of it, as though I were
shooting at a mark,

translation.text: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I shot at a mark.

verses.english:
and I will order the boy to go and find the arrows. If I call to
the boy, ‘Hey! the arrows are on this side of you,’ be reassured
and come, for you are safe and there is no danger—as YHWH lives!
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־הַנַּעַר לֵךְ מְצָא אֶת־הַחִצִּים אִם־אָמֹר אֹמַר לַנַּעַר הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהֵנָּה קָחֶנּוּ וָבֹאָה כִּי־שָׁלוֹם לְךָ וְאֵין דָּבָר חַי־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־הַנַּעַר לֵךְ מְצָא אֶת־הַחִצִּים אִם־אָמֹר אֹמַר לַנַּעַר הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהֵנָּה קָחֶנּוּ וָבֹאָה כִּי־שָׁלוֹם לְךָ וְאֵין דָּבָר חַי־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and I will order the boy to go and find the arrows. If I call to
the boy, ‘Hey! the arrows are on this side of you,’ be reassured
and come, for you are safe and there is no danger—as YHWH lives!

translation.text: Then I will send the boy, saying, 'Go, find the arrows.' If I say to the boy, 'Look, the arrows are on this side of you, collect them,' then you are to come, for, as the LORD lives, it is safe for you and there is no danger.

verses.english:
But if, instead, I call to the lad, ‘Hey! the arrows are beyond
you,’ then leave, for YHWH has sent you away.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־כֹּה אֹמַר לָעֶלֶם הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה לֵךְ כִּי שִׁלַּחֲךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־כֹּה אֹמַר לָעֶלֶם הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה לֵךְ כִּי שִׁלַּחֲךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But if, instead, I call to the lad, ‘Hey! the arrows are beyond
you,’ then leave, for YHWH has sent you away.

translation.text: But if I the LORD has sent you away.

verses.english:
As for the promise we made to each other, may YHWH be [witness]
between you and me forever.”
verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְנוּ אֲנִי וָאָתָּה הִנֵּה יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְנוּ אֲנִי וָאָתָּה הִנֵּה יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
As for the promise we made to each other, may YHWH be [witness]
between you and me forever.”

translation.text: As for the matter about which you and I have spoken, the LORD is witness between you and me forever."

verses.english:
David hid in the field. The new moon came, and the king sat down
to partake of the meal.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּתֵר דָּוִד בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיְהִי הַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ (על) [אֶל־]הַלֶּחֶם לֶאֱכוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסָּתֵר דָּוִד בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיְהִי הַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ (על) [אֶל־]הַלֶּחֶם לֶאֱכוֹל׃

english.text:
David hid in the field. The new moon came, and the king sat down
to partake of the meal.

translation.text: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon came, the king sat at the feast to eat.

verses.english:
When the king took his usual place on the seat by the wall,
Jonathan rose and Abner sat down at Saul’s side; but David’s place
remained vacant.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מוֹשָׁבוֹ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם אֶל־מוֹשַׁב הַקִּיר וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְנֵר מִצַּד שָׁאוּל וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מוֹשָׁבוֹ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם אֶל־מוֹשַׁב הַקִּיר וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְנֵר מִצַּד שָׁאוּל וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִד׃

english.text:
When the king took his usual place on the seat by the wall,
Jonathan rose and Abner sat down at Saul’s side; but David’s place
remained vacant.

translation.text: The king sat upon his seat, as at other Saul's side; but David's place was empty.

verses.english:
That day, however, Saul said nothing. “It’s accidental,” he
thought. “He must be unclean and not yet cleansed.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר שָׁאוּל מְאוּמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אָמַר מִקְרֶה הוּא בִּלְתִּי טָהוֹר הוּא כִּי־לֹא טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר שָׁאוּל מְאוּמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אָמַר מִקְרֶה הוּא בִּלְתִּי טָהוֹר הוּא כִּי־לֹא טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
That day, however, Saul said nothing. “It’s accidental,” he
thought. “He must be unclean and not yet cleansed.”

translation.text: Saul did not say anything that day; for he thought, "Something has befallen him; he is not clean, surely he is not clean."

verses.english:
But on the day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place
was vacant again. So Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why didn’t
the son of Jesse come to the meal yesterday or today?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרַת הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִדוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מַדּוּעַ לֹא־בָא בֶן־יִשַׁי גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־הַיּוֹם אֶל־הַלָּחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרַת הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִדוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מַדּוּעַ לֹא־בָא בֶן־יִשַׁי גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־הַיּוֹם אֶל־הַלָּחֶם׃

english.text:
But on the day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place
was vacant again. So Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why didn’t
the son of Jesse come to the meal yesterday or today?”

translation.text: But on the the feast, either yesterday or today?"

verses.english:
Jonathan answered Saul, “David begged leave of me to go to
Bethlehem.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל דָּוִד מֵעִמָּדִי עַד־בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל דָּוִד מֵעִמָּדִי עַד־בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
Jonathan answered Saul, “David begged leave of me to go to
Bethlehem.

translation.text: Jonathan answered Saul, "David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem;

verses.english:
He said, ‘Please let me go, for we are going to have a family
feast in our town and my brother has summoned me to it. Do me a
favor, let me slip away to see my kinsmen.’ That is why he has not
come to the king’s table.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי נָא כִּי זֶבַח מִשְׁפָּחָה לָנוּ בָּעִיר וְהוּא צִוָּה־לִי אָחִי וְעַתָּה אִם־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אִמָּלְטָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת־אֶחָי עַל־כֵּן לֹא־בָא
אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:

וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים יוֹדַעְתִּי אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמוֹנִי׃

english.text:
David answered the priest Ahimelech, “The king has ordered me on a
mission, and he said to me, ‘No one must know anything about the
mission on which I am sending you and for which I have given you
orders.’ So I have directed [my] young men to such and such a
place.

translation.text: Now then, what have you at hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever is here."

verses.english:
Now then, what have you got on hand? Any loaves of bread? Let me
have them—or whatever is available.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־יֵּשׁ תַּחַת־יָדְךָ חֲמִשָּׁה־לֶחֶם תְּנָה בְיָדִי אוֹ הַנִּמְצָא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה מַה־יֵּשׁ תַּחַת־יָדְךָ חֲמִשָּׁה־לֶחֶם תְּנָה בְיָדִי אוֹ הַנִּמְצָא׃

english.text:
Now then, what have you got on hand? Any loaves of bread? Let me
have them—or whatever is available.”

translation.text: The priest answered David, the young men have kept themselves from women."

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לֶחֶם חֹל אֶל־תַּחַת יָדִי כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם קֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ אִם־נִשְׁמְרוּ הַנְּעָרִים אַךְ מֵאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לֶחֶם חֹל אֶל־תַּחַת יָדִי כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם קֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ אִם־נִשְׁמְרוּ הַנְּעָרִים אַךְ מֵאִשָּׁה׃

translation.text: David answered holy?"

verses.english:
In reply to the priest, David said, “I assure you that women have
been kept from us, as always. Whenever I went on a mission, even
if the journey was a common one, the vessels of the young men were
consecrated; all the more then may consecrated food be put into
their vessels today.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כִּי אִם־אִשָּׁה עֲצֻרָה־לָנוּ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם בְּצֵאתִי וַיִּהְיוּ כְלֵי־הַנְּעָרִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהוּא דֶּרֶךְ חֹל וְאַף כִּי הַיּוֹם
יִקְדַּשׁ בַּכֶּלִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כִּי אִם־אִשָּׁה עֲצֻרָה־לָנוּ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם בְּצֵאתִי וַיִּהְיוּ כְלֵי־הַנְּעָרִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהוּא דֶּרֶךְ חֹל וְאַף כִּי הַיּוֹם
יִקְדַּשׁ בַּכֶּלִי׃

english.text:
In reply to the priest, David said, “I assure you that women have
been kept from us, as always. Whenever I went on a mission, even
if the journey was a common one, the vessels of the young men were
consecrated; all the more then may consecrated food be put into
their vessels today.”

translation.text: So the priest gave him the holy bread; for there was no bread the LORD, to be replaced by hot bread on the day it is taken away.

verses.english:
So the priest gave him consecrated bread, because there was none
there except the bread of display, which had been removed from the
presence of YHWH, to be replaced by warm bread as soon as it was
taken away.—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ כִּי לֹא־הָיָה שָׁם לֶחֶם כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים הַמּוּסָרִים מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּם לֶחֶם חֹם בְּיוֹם הִלָּקְחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ כִּי לֹא־הָיָה שָׁם לֶחֶם כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים הַמּוּסָרִים מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּם לֶחֶם חֹם בְּיוֹם הִלָּקְחוֹ׃

english.text:
So the priest gave him consecrated bread, because there was none
there except the bread of display, which had been removed from the
presence of YHWH, to be replaced by warm bread as soon as it was
taken away.—

translation.text: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, Saul's shepherds.

verses.english:
Now one of Saul’s officials was there that day, detained before
YHWH; his name was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief herdsman.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם אִישׁ מֵעַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נֶעְצָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּשְׁמוֹ דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי אַבִּיר הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁם אִישׁ מֵעַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נֶעְצָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּשְׁמוֹ דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי אַבִּיר הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Now one of Saul’s officials was there that day, detained before
YHWH; his name was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief herdsman.

translation.text: David said to Ahimelech, "Is there no spear or sword here with you? I business required haste."

verses.english:
David said to Ahimelech, “Haven’t you got a spear or sword on
hand? I didn’t take my sword or any of my weapons with me, because
the king’s mission was urgent.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ וְאִין יֶשׁ־פֹּה תַחַת־יָדְךָ חֲנִית אוֹ־חָרֶב כִּי גַם־חַרְבִּי וְגַם־כֵּלַי לֹא־לָקַחְתִּי בְיָדִי כִּי־הָיָה דְבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ נָחוּץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ וְאִין יֶשׁ־פֹּה תַחַת־יָדְךָ חֲנִית אוֹ־חָרֶב כִּי גַם־חַרְבִּי וְגַם־כֵּלַי לֹא־לָקַחְתִּי בְיָדִי כִּי־הָיָה דְבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ נָחוּץ׃

english.text:
David said to Ahimelech, “Haven’t you got a spear or sword on
hand? I didn’t take my sword or any of my weapons with me, because
the king’s mission was urgent.”

translation.text: The priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod; if you will take that, take it, for there is none here except that one." David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."

verses.english:
The priest said, “There is the sword of Goliath the Philistine
whom you slew in the valley of Elah; it is over there, wrapped in
a cloth, behind the ephod. If you want to take that one, take it,
for there is none here but that one.” David replied, “There is
none like it; give it to me.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֹּהֵן חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה הִנֵּה־הִיא לוּטָה בַשִּׂמְלָה אַחֲרֵי הָאֵפוֹד אִם־אֹתָהּ תִּקַּח־לְךָ קָח כִּי אֵין אַחֶרֶת
זוּלָתָהּ בָּזֶהוַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֵין כָּמוֹהָ תְּנֶנָּה לִּי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֹּהֵן חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה הִנֵּה־הִיא לוּטָה בַשִּׂמְלָה אַחֲרֵי הָאֵפוֹד אִם־אֹתָהּ תִּקַּח־לְךָ קָח כִּי אֵין אַחֶרֶת
זוּלָתָהּ בָּזֶהוַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֵין כָּמוֹהָ תְּנֶנָּה לִּי׃

english.text:
The priest said, “There is the sword of Goliath the Philistine
whom you slew in the valley of Elah; it is over there, wrapped in
a cloth, behind the ephod. If you want to take that one, take it,
for there is none here but that one.” David replied, “There is
none like it; give it to me.”

translation.text: David rose and fled that day from Saul; he went to King Achish of Gath.

verses.english:
That day David continued on his flight from Saul and he came to
King Achish of Gath.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיִּבְרַח בַּיּוֹם־הַהוּא מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיִּבְרַח בַּיּוֹם־הַהוּא מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

english.text:
That day David continued on his flight from Saul and he came to
King Achish of Gath.

translation.text: The servants of Achish said to him, "Is this not David the king and David his ten thousands'?"

verses.english:
The courtiers of Achish said to him, “Why, that’s David, king of
the land! That’s the one of whom they sing as they dance: Saul has
slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָכִישׁ אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ הָאָרֶץ הֲלוֹא לָזֶה יַעֲנוּ בַמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָכִישׁ אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ הָאָרֶץ הֲלוֹא לָזֶה יַעֲנוּ בַמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

english.text:
The courtiers of Achish said to him, “Why, that’s David, king of
the land! That’s the one of whom they sing as they dance: Saul has
slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”

translation.text: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of King Achish of Gath.

verses.english:
These words worried David and he became very much afraid of King
Achish of Gath.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בִּלְבָבוֹ וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־גַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בִּלְבָבוֹ וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־גַּת׃

english.text:
These words worried David and he became very much afraid of King
Achish of Gath.

translation.text: So he changed his behavior before them; he the doors of the gate, and let his spittle run down his beard.

verses.english:
So he concealed his good sense from them; he feigned madness for
their benefit. He scratched marks on the doors of the gate and let
his saliva run down his beard.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁנּוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּתְהֹלֵל בְּיָדָם וַיְתָו עַל־דַּלְתוֹת הַשַּׁעַר וַיּוֹרֶד רִירוֹ אֶל־זְקָנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁנּוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּתְהֹלֵל בְּיָדָם וַיְתָו עַל־דַּלְתוֹת הַשַּׁעַר וַיּוֹרֶד רִירוֹ אֶל־זְקָנוֹ׃

english.text:
So he concealed his good sense from them; he feigned madness for
their benefit. He scratched marks on the doors of the gate and let
his saliva run down his beard.

translation.text: Achish brought him to me?

verses.english:
And Achish said to his courtiers, “You see the man is raving; why
bring him to me?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And Achish said to his courtiers, “You see the man is raving; why
bring him to me?

translation.text: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this my house?"

verses.english:
Do I lack madmen that you have brought this fellow to rave for me?
Should this fellow enter my house?”
verses.hebrew: חֲסַר מְשֻׁגָּעִים אָנִי כִּי־הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת־זֶה לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ עָלָי הֲזֶה יָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: חֲסַר מְשֻׁגָּעִים אָנִי כִּי־הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת־זֶה לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ עָלָי הֲזֶה יָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
Do I lack madmen that you have brought this fellow to rave for me?
Should this fellow enter my house?”

verses.english:
David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; and
when his brothers and all his father’s house heard, they joined
him down there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיִּמָּלֵט אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיו וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיִּמָּלֵט אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיו וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; and
when his brothers and all his father’s house heard, they joined
him down there.

translation.text: David left there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; when his brothers and all his father's house heard of it, they went down there to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ אֵלָיו כּל־אִישׁ מָצוֹק וְכל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ נֹשֶׁא וְכל־אִישׁ מַר־נֶפֶשׁ וַיְהִי עֲלֵיהֶם לְשָׂר וַיִּהְיוּ עִמּוֹ כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ אֵלָיו כּל־אִישׁ מָצוֹק וְכל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ נֹשֶׁא וְכל־אִישׁ מַר־נֶפֶשׁ וַיְהִי עֲלֵיהֶם לְשָׂר וַיִּהְיוּ עִמּוֹ כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

translation.text: Everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, hundred.

verses.english:
David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king
of Moab, “Let my father and mother come [and stay] with you, until
I know what God will do for me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם מִצְפֵּה מוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב יֵצֵא־נָא אָבִי וְאִמִּי אִתְּכֶם עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵדַע מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם מִצְפֵּה מוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב יֵצֵא־נָא אָבִי וְאִמִּי אִתְּכֶם עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵדַע מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king
of Moab, “Let my father and mother come [and stay] with you, until
I know what God will do for me.”

translation.text: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab. He said to the king of what God will do for me."

verses.english:
So he led them to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as
long as David remained in the stronghold.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם אֶת־פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ עִמּוֹ כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹת־דָּוִד בַּמְּצוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנְחֵם אֶת־פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ עִמּוֹ כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹת־דָּוִד בַּמְּצוּדָה׃

english.text:
So he led them to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as
long as David remained in the stronghold.

translation.text: He left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גָּד הַנָּבִיא אֶל־דָּוִד לֹא תֵשֵׁב בַּמְּצוּדָה לֵךְ וּבָאתָ־לְּךָ אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא יַעַר חָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר גָּד הַנָּבִיא אֶל־דָּוִד לֹא תֵשֵׁב בַּמְּצוּדָה לֵךְ וּבָאתָ־לְּךָ אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא יַעַר חָרֶת׃

translation.text: Then the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not remain in the stronghold; leave, and go into the land of Judah." So David left, and went into the forest of Hereth.

verses.english:
When Saul heard that David and the men with him had been
located—Saul was then in Gibeah, sitting under the tamarisk tree
on the height, spear in hand, with all his courtiers in attendance
upon him—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל כִּי נוֹדַע דָּוִד וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל יוֹשֵׁב בַּגִּבְעָה תַּחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בָּרָמָה וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְיָדוֹ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל כִּי נוֹדַע דָּוִד וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל יוֹשֵׁב בַּגִּבְעָה תַּחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בָּרָמָה וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְיָדוֹ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
When Saul heard that David and the men with him had been
located—Saul was then in Gibeah, sitting under the tamarisk tree
on the height, spear in hand, with all his courtiers in attendance
upon him—

translation.text: Saul heard that David and those who were with him had been around him.

verses.english:
Saul said to the courtiers standing about him, “Listen, men of
Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give fields and vineyards to every
one of you? And will he make all of you captains of thousands or
captains of hundreds?
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו שִׁמְעוּ־נָא בְּנֵי יְמִינִי גַּם־לְכֻלְּכֶם יִתֵּן בֶּן־יִשַׁי שָׂדוֹת וּכְרָמִים לְכֻלְּכֶם יָשִׂים שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי
מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו שִׁמְעוּ־נָא בְּנֵי יְמִינִי גַּם־לְכֻלְּכֶם יִתֵּן בֶּן־יִשַׁי שָׂדוֹת וּכְרָמִים לְכֻלְּכֶם יָשִׂים שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי
מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
Saul said to the courtiers standing about him, “Listen, men of
Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give fields and vineyards to every
one of you? And will he make all of you captains of thousands or
captains of hundreds?

translation.text: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, "Hear and commanders of hundreds?

verses.english:
Is that why all of you have conspired against me? For no one
informs me when my own son makes a pact with the son of Jesse; no
one is concerned for me and no one informs me when my own son has
set my servant in ambush against me, as is now the case.”
verses.hebrew:
כִּי קְשַׁרְתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם עָלַי וְאֵין־גֹּלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי בִּכְרת־בְּנִי עִם־בֶּן־יִשַׁי וְאֵין־חֹלֶה מִכֶּם עָלַי וְגֹלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי כִּי הֵקִים בְּנִי אֶת־עַבְדִּי עָלַי לְאֹרֵב
כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי קְשַׁרְתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם עָלַי וְאֵין־גֹּלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי בִּכְרת־בְּנִי עִם־בֶּן־יִשַׁי וְאֵין־חֹלֶה מִכֶּם עָלַי וְגֹלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי כִּי הֵקִים בְּנִי אֶת־עַבְדִּי עָלַי לְאֹרֵב
כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Is that why all of you have conspired against me? For no one
informs me when my own son makes a pact with the son of Jesse; no
one is concerned for me and no one informs me when my own son has
set my servant in ambush against me, as is now the case.”

translation.text: Is that why all of you have conspired the son of Jesse, none of you is sorry for me or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as he is doing today."

verses.english:
Doeg the Edomite, who was standing among the courtiers of Saul,
spoke up: “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub
at Nob.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וְהוּא נִצָּב עַל־עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמַר רָאִיתִי אֶת־בֶּן־יִשַׁי בָּא נֹבֶה אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִטוּב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וְהוּא נִצָּב עַל־עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמַר רָאִיתִי אֶת־בֶּן־יִשַׁי בָּא נֹבֶה אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִטוּב׃

english.text:
Doeg the Edomite, who was standing among the courtiers of Saul,
spoke up: “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub
at Nob.

translation.text: Doeg the Edomite, who was in charge of Saul's servants, Ahitub;

verses.english:
He inquired of YHWH on his behalf and gave him provisions; he also
gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל־לוֹ בַּיהֹוָה וְצֵידָה נָתַן לוֹ וְאֵת חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי נָתַן לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל־לוֹ בַּיהֹוָה וְצֵידָה נָתַן לוֹ וְאֵת חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי נָתַן לוֹ׃

english.text:
He inquired of YHWH on his behalf and gave him provisions; he also
gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

translation.text: he inquired of the LORD for him, gave him provisions, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."

verses.english:
Thereupon the king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and
for all the priests belonging to his father’s house at Nob. They
all came to the king,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרֹא אֶת־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר בְּנֹב וַיָּבֹאוּ כֻלָּם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרֹא אֶת־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר בְּנֹב וַיָּבֹאוּ כֻלָּם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Thereupon the king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and
for all the priests belonging to his father’s house at Nob. They
all came to the king,

translation.text: The king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and for all his the king.

verses.english:
and Saul said, “Listen to me, son of Ahitub.” “Yes, my lord,” he
replied.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל שְׁמַע־נָא בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל שְׁמַע־נָא בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
and Saul said, “Listen to me, son of Ahitub.” “Yes, my lord,” he
replied.

translation.text: Saul said, "Listen now, son of Ahitub." He answered, "Here I am, my lord."

verses.english:
And Saul said to him, “Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired
against me? You gave him food and a sword, and inquired of God for
him—that he may rise in ambush against me, as is now the case.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָו שָׁאוּל לָמָּה קְשַׁרְתֶּם עָלַי אַתָּה וּבֶן־יִשָׁי בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ לֶחֶם וְחֶרֶב וְשָׁאוֹל לוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים לָקוּם אֵלַי לְאֹרֵב כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָו שָׁאוּל לָמָּה קְשַׁרְתֶּם עָלַי אַתָּה וּבֶן־יִשָׁי בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ לֶחֶם וְחֶרֶב וְשָׁאוֹל לוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים לָקוּם אֵלַי לְאֹרֵב כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And Saul said to him, “Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired
against me? You gave him food and a sword, and inquired of God for
him—that he may rise in ambush against me, as is now the case.”

translation.text: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against inquiring of God for him, so that he has risen against me, to lie in wait, as he is doing today?"

verses.english:
Ahimelech replied to the king, “But who is there among all your
courtiers as trusted as David, son-in-law of Your Majesty and
obedient to your bidding, and esteemed in your household?
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר וּמִי בְכל־עֲבָדֶיךָ כְּדָוִד נֶאֱמָן וַחֲתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְסָר אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתֶּךָ וְנִכְבָּד בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר וּמִי בְכל־עֲבָדֶיךָ כְּדָוִד נֶאֱמָן וַחֲתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְסָר אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתֶּךָ וְנִכְבָּד בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
Ahimelech replied to the king, “But who is there among all your
courtiers as trusted as David, son-in-law of Your Majesty and
obedient to your bidding, and esteemed in your household?

translation.text: Then Ahimelech answered the king, "Who among all your servants is so faithful as David? He is the king's son-in-law, and is quick to do your bidding, and is honored in your house.

verses.english:
This is the first time that I inquired of God for him; I have done
no wrong. Let not Your Majesty find fault with his servant [or]
with any of my father’s house; for your servant knew nothing
whatever about all this.”
verses.hebrew:
הַיּוֹם הַחִלֹּתִי (לשאול) [לִשְׁאל־]לוֹ בֵאלֹהִים חָלִילָה לִּי אַל־יָשֵׂם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעַבְדּוֹ דָבָר בְּכל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי לֹא־יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ בְּכל־זֹאת דָּבָר קָטֹן אוֹ
גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text:
הַיּוֹם הַחִלֹּתִי (לשאול) [לִשְׁאל־]לוֹ בֵאלֹהִים חָלִילָה לִּי אַל־יָשֵׂם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעַבְדּוֹ דָבָר בְּכל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי לֹא־יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ בְּכל־זֹאת דָּבָר קָטֹן אוֹ
גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
This is the first time that I inquired of God for him; I have done
no wrong. Let not Your Majesty find fault with his servant [or]
with any of my father’s house; for your servant knew nothing
whatever about all this.”

translation.text: Is today the first time that I impute anything to his servant or to any member of my father's house; for your servant has known nothing of all this, much or little."

verses.english:
But the king said, “You shall die, Ahimelech, you and all your
father’s house.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מוֹת תָּמוּת אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אַתָּה וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מוֹת תָּמוּת אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אַתָּה וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
But the king said, “You shall die, Ahimelech, you and all your
father’s house.”

translation.text: The house."

verses.english:
And the king commanded the guards standing by, “Turn about and
kill the priests of YHWH, for they are in league with David; they
knew he was running away and they did not inform me.” But the
king’s servants would not raise a hand to strike down the priests
of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
