down, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go down to
battle and perish.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־יְהֹוָה יִגֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ־יוֹמוֹ יָבוֹא וָמֵת אוֹ בַמִּלְחָמָה יֵרֵד וְנִסְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־יְהֹוָה יִגֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ־יוֹמוֹ יָבוֹא וָמֵת אוֹ בַמִּלְחָמָה יֵרֵד וְנִסְפָּה׃

english.text:
And David went on, “As YHWH lives, YHWH Himself will strike him
down, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go down to
battle and perish.

translation.text: David said, "As the LORD lives, the LORD will strike him down; or his day will come to die; or he will go down into battle and perish.

verses.english:
But YHWH forbid that I should lay a hand on YHWH’s anointed! Just
take the spear and the water jar at his head and let’s be off.”
verses.hebrew: חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִשְּׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה קַח־נָא אֶת־הַחֲנִית אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם וְנֵלְכָה־לָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִשְּׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה קַח־נָא אֶת־הַחֲנִית אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם וְנֵלְכָה־לָּנוּ׃

english.text:
But YHWH forbid that I should lay a hand on YHWH’s anointed! Just
take the spear and the water jar at his head and let’s be off.”

translation.text: The LORD forbid that I should is at his head, and the water jar, and let us go."

verses.english:
So David took away the spear and the water jar at Saul’s head, and
they left. No one saw or knew or woke up; all remained asleep; a
deep sleep from YHWH had fallen upon them.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם מֵרַאֲשֹׁתֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלְכוּ לָהֶם וְאֵין רֹאֶה וְאֵין יוֹדֵעַ וְאֵין מֵקִיץ כִּי כֻלָּם יְשֵׁנִים כִּי תַּרְדֵּמַת יְהֹוָה
נָפְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם מֵרַאֲשֹׁתֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלְכוּ לָהֶם וְאֵין רֹאֶה וְאֵין יוֹדֵעַ וְאֵין מֵקִיץ כִּי כֻלָּם יְשֵׁנִים כִּי תַּרְדֵּמַת יְהֹוָה
נָפְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
So David took away the spear and the water jar at Saul’s head, and
they left. No one saw or knew or woke up; all remained asleep; a
deep sleep from YHWH had fallen upon them.

translation.text: So David took the spear that was at Saul's head and the water jar, and they went away. asleep, because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen upon them.

verses.english:
David crossed over to the other side and stood afar on top of a
hill; there was considerable distance between them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר דָּוִד הָעֵבֶר וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָר מֵרָחֹק רַב הַמָּקוֹם בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר דָּוִד הָעֵבֶר וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָר מֵרָחֹק רַב הַמָּקוֹם בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
David crossed over to the other side and stood afar on top of a
hill; there was considerable distance between them.

translation.text: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on top of a hill far away, with a great distance between them.

verses.english:
And David shouted to the troops and to Abner son of Ner, “Abner,
aren’t you going to answer?” And Abner shouted back, “Who are you
to shout at the king?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד אֶל־הָעָם וְאֶל־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא תַעֲנֶה אַבְנֵר וַיַּעַן אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתָּה קָרָאתָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד אֶל־הָעָם וְאֶל־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא תַעֲנֶה אַבְנֵר וַיַּעַן אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתָּה קָרָאתָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And David shouted to the troops and to Abner son of Ner, “Abner,
aren’t you going to answer?” And Abner shouted back, “Who are you
to shout at the king?”

translation.text: David called to the army and to Abner son of Ner, saying, "Abner! Will you not answer?" Then Abner replied, "Who are you that calls to the king?"

verses.english:
And David answered Abner, “You are a man, aren’t you? And there is
no one like you in Israel! So why didn’t you keep watch over your
lord the king? For one of [our] troops came to do violence to your
lord the king.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אַבְנֵר הֲלוֹא־אִישׁ אַתָּה וּמִי כָמוֹךָ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָמָּה לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־בָא אַחַד הָעָם לְהַשְׁחִית אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אַבְנֵר הֲלוֹא־אִישׁ אַתָּה וּמִי כָמוֹךָ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָמָּה לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־בָא אַחַד הָעָם לְהַשְׁחִית אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And David answered Abner, “You are a man, aren’t you? And there is
no one like you in Israel! So why didn’t you keep watch over your
lord the king? For one of [our] troops came to do violence to your
lord the king.

translation.text: David said people came in to destroy your lord the king.

verses.english:
You have not given a good account of yourself! As YHWH lives, [all
of] you deserve to die, because you did not keep watch over your
lord, YHWH’s anointed. Look around, where are the king’s spear and
the water jar that were at his head?”
verses.hebrew:
לֹא־טוֹב הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בְנֵי־מָוֶת אַתֶּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שְׁמַרְתֶּם עַל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עַל־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה רְאֵה אֵי־חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו׃

hebrew.text:
לֹא־טוֹב הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בְנֵי־מָוֶת אַתֶּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שְׁמַרְתֶּם עַל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עַל־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה רְאֵה אֵי־חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו׃

english.text:
You have not given a good account of yourself! As YHWH lives, [all
of] you deserve to die, because you did not keep watch over your
lord, YHWH’s anointed. Look around, where are the king’s spear and
the water jar that were at his head?”

translation.text: This thing that you where is the king's spear, or the water jar that was at his head?"

verses.english:
Saul recognized David’s voice, and he asked, “Is that your voice,
my son David?” And David replied, “It is, my lord king.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּר שָׁאוּל אֶת־קוֹל דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הֲקוֹלְךָ זֶה בְּנִי דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד קוֹלִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּר שָׁאוּל אֶת־קוֹל דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הֲקוֹלְךָ זֶה בְּנִי דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד קוֹלִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Saul recognized David’s voice, and he asked, “Is that your voice,
my son David?” And David replied, “It is, my lord king.”

translation.text: Saul recognized David's voice, and said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" David said, "It is my voice, my lord, O king."

verses.english:
And he went on, “But why does my lord continue to pursue his
servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֲדֹנִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי עַבְדּוֹ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־בְּיָדִי רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֲדֹנִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי עַבְדּוֹ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־בְּיָדִי רָעָה׃

english.text:
And he went on, “But why does my lord continue to pursue his
servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

translation.text: And he added, guilt is on my hands?

verses.english:
Now let my lord the king hear his servant out. If YHWH has incited
you against me, let Him be appeased by an offering; but if it is
men, may they be accursed of YHWH! For they have driven me out
today, so that I cannot have a share in YHWH’s possession, but am
told, ‘Go and worship other gods.’
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה יִשְׁמַע־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת דִּבְרֵי עַבְדּוֹ אִם־יְהֹוָה הֱסִיתְךָ בִי יָרַח מִנְחָה וְאִם בְּנֵי הָאָדָם אֲרוּרִים הֵם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־גֵרְשׁוּנִי הַיּוֹם
מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ בְּנַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֵךְ עֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה יִשְׁמַע־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת דִּבְרֵי עַבְדּוֹ אִם־יְהֹוָה הֱסִיתְךָ בִי יָרַח מִנְחָה וְאִם בְּנֵי הָאָדָם אֲרוּרִים הֵם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־גֵרְשׁוּנִי הַיּוֹם
מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ בְּנַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֵךְ עֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
Now let my lord the king hear his servant out. If YHWH has incited
you against me, let Him be appeased by an offering; but if it is
men, may they be accursed of YHWH! For they have driven me out
today, so that I cannot have a share in YHWH’s possession, but am
told, ‘Go and worship other gods.’

translation.text: Now therefore let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is the LORD who has stirred you up against me, the heritage of the LORD, saying, 'Go, serve other gods.'

verses.english:
Oh, let my blood not fall to the ground, away from the presence of
YHWH! For the king of Israel has come out to seek a single flea—as
if he were hunting a partridge in the hills.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־יִפֹּל דָּמִי אַרְצָה מִנֶּגֶד פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָצָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־פַּרְעֹשׁ אֶחָד כַּאֲשֶׁר יִרְדֹּף הַקֹּרֵא בֶּהָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל־יִפֹּל דָּמִי אַרְצָה מִנֶּגֶד פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָצָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־פַּרְעֹשׁ אֶחָד כַּאֲשֶׁר יִרְדֹּף הַקֹּרֵא בֶּהָרִים׃

english.text:
Oh, let my blood not fall to the ground, away from the presence of
YHWH! For the king of Israel has come out to seek a single flea—as
if he were hunting a partridge in the hills.”

translation.text: Now single flea, like one who hunts a partridge in the mountains."

verses.english:
And Saul answered, “I am in the wrong. Come back, my son David,
for I will never harm you again, seeing how you have held my life
precious this day. Yes, I have been a fool, and I have erred so
very much.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל חָטָאתִי שׁוּב בְּנִי־דָוִד כִּי לֹא־אָרַע לְךָ עוֹד תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר יָקְרָה נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה הִסְכַּלְתִּי וָאֶשְׁגֶּה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל חָטָאתִי שׁוּב בְּנִי־דָוִד כִּי לֹא־אָרַע לְךָ עוֹד תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר יָקְרָה נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה הִסְכַּלְתִּי וָאֶשְׁגֶּה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Saul answered, “I am in the wrong. Come back, my son David,
for I will never harm you again, seeing how you have held my life
precious this day. Yes, I have been a fool, and I have erred so
very much.”

translation.text: Then Saul said, "I have done wrong; come back, my son David, for I today; I have been a fool, and have made a great mistake."

verses.english:
David replied, “Here is Your Majesty’s spear. Let one of the young
men come over and get it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (החנית) [חֲנִית] הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (החנית) [חֲנִית] הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶהָ׃

english.text:
David replied, “Here is Your Majesty’s spear. Let one of the young
men come over and get it.

translation.text: David over and get it.

verses.english:
And YHWH will requite every man for his right conduct and
loyalty—for this day YHWH delivered you into my hands and I would
not raise a hand against YHWH’s anointed.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה יָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ אֶת־צִדְקָתוֹ וְאֶת־אֱמֻנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָד וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה יָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ אֶת־צִדְקָתוֹ וְאֶת־אֱמֻנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָד וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH will requite every man for his right conduct and
loyalty—for this day YHWH delivered you into my hands and I would
not raise a hand against YHWH’s anointed.

translation.text: The LORD rewards everyone for his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the LORD gave you into my hand today, but I would not raise my hand against the LORD's anointed.

verses.english:
And just as I valued your life highly this day, so may YHWH value
my life and may He rescue me from all trouble.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה כַּאֲשֶׁר גָּדְלָה נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינָי כֵּן תִּגְדַּל נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְיַצִּלֵנִי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה כַּאֲשֶׁר גָּדְלָה נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינָי כֵּן תִּגְדַּל נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְיַצִּלֵנִי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

english.text:
And just as I valued your life highly this day, so may YHWH value
my life and may He rescue me from all trouble.”

translation.text: As your life was the LORD, and may he rescue me from all tribulation."

verses.english:
Saul answered David, “May you be blessed, my son David. You shall
achieve, and you shall prevail.” David then went his way, and Saul
returned home.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּנִי דָוִד גַּם עָשֹׂה תַעֲשֶׂה וְגַם יָכֹל תּוּכָל וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְדַרְכּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שָׁב לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּנִי דָוִד גַּם עָשֹׂה תַעֲשֶׂה וְגַם יָכֹל תּוּכָל וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְדַרְכּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שָׁב לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
Saul answered David, “May you be blessed, my son David. You shall
achieve, and you shall prevail.” David then went his way, and Saul
returned home.

translation.text: Then Saul said place.

verses.english:
David said to himself, “Some day I shall certainly perish at the
hands of Saul. The best thing for me is to flee to the land of the
Philistines; Saul will then give up hunting me throughout the
territory of Israel, and I will escape him.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־לִבּוֹ עַתָּה אֶסָּפֶה יוֹם־אֶחָד בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל אֵין־לִי טוֹב כִּי הִמָּלֵט אִמָּלֵט אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנוֹאַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי שָׁאוּל לְבַקְשֵׁנִי עוֹד
בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִמְלַטְתִּי מִיָּדוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־לִבּוֹ עַתָּה אֶסָּפֶה יוֹם־אֶחָד בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל אֵין־לִי טוֹב כִּי הִמָּלֵט אִמָּלֵט אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנוֹאַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי שָׁאוּל לְבַקְשֵׁנִי עוֹד
בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִמְלַטְתִּי מִיָּדוֹ׃

english.text:
David said to himself, “Some day I shall certainly perish at the
hands of Saul. The best thing for me is to flee to the land of the
Philistines; Saul will then give up hunting me throughout the
territory of Israel, and I will escape him.”

translation.text: David said in his heart, "I shall now perish one day by the hand of Philistines; then Saul will despair of seeking me any longer within the borders of Israel, and I shall escape out of his hand."

verses.english:
So David and the six hundred men with him went and crossed over to
King Achish son of Maoch of Gath.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיַּעֲבֹר הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מָעוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיַּעֲבֹר הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מָעוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

english.text:
So David and the six hundred men with him went and crossed over to
King Achish son of Maoch of Gath.

translation.text: So David set out King Achish son of Maoch of Gath.

verses.english:
David and his men stayed with Achish in Gath, each man with his
family, and David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and
Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד עִם־אָכִישׁ בְּגַת הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ דָּוִד וּשְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת־נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד עִם־אָכִישׁ בְּגַת הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ דָּוִד וּשְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת־נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִית׃

english.text:
David and his men stayed with Achish in Gath, each man with his
family, and David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and
Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

translation.text: David stayed with Achish at Gath, two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail of Carmel, Nabal's widow.

verses.english:
And when Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he did not
pursue him anymore.
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָרַח דָּוִד גַּת וְלֹא־[יָסַף] (יוסף) עוֹד לְבַקְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָרַח דָּוִד גַּת וְלֹא־[יָסַף] (יוסף) עוֹד לְבַקְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And when Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he did not
pursue him anymore.

translation.text: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he no longer sought for him.

verses.english:
David said to Achish, “If you please, let a place be granted me in
one of the country towns where I can live; why should your servant
remain with you in the royal city?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יִתְּנוּ־לִי מָקוֹם בְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְאֵשְׁבָה שָּׁם וְלָמָּה יֵשֵׁב עַבְדְּךָ בְּעִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יִתְּנוּ־לִי מָקוֹם בְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְאֵשְׁבָה שָּׁם וְלָמָּה יֵשֵׁב עַבְדְּךָ בְּעִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
David said to Achish, “If you please, let a place be granted me in
one of the country towns where I can live; why should your servant
remain with you in the royal city?”

translation.text: Then David said to Achish, "If I have found favor in your sight, let a place be given me in one of the country towns, so that I may live there; for why should your servant live in the royal city with you?"

verses.english:
At that time Achish granted him Ziklag; that is how Ziklag came to
belong to the kings of Judah, as is still the case.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אָכִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־צִקְלָג לָכֵן הָיְתָה צִקְלַג לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אָכִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־צִקְלָג לָכֵן הָיְתָה צִקְלַג לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
At that time Achish granted him Ziklag; that is how Ziklag came to
belong to the kings of Judah, as is still the case.

translation.text: So that of Judah to this day.

verses.english:
The length of time that David lived in Philistine territory was a
year and four months.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁב דָּוִד בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים וְאַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁב דָּוִד בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים וְאַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
The length of time that David lived in Philistine territory was a
year and four months.

translation.text: The length of time that David lived in the country of the Philistines was one year and four months.

verses.english:
David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Gizrites,
and the Amalekites—who were the inhabitants of the region of Olam,
all the way to Shur and to the land of Egypt.—
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגְּשׁוּרִי (והגרזי) [וְהַגִּזְרִי] וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי כִּי הֵנָּה יֹשְׁבוֹת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּרָה וְעַד־אֶרֶץ
מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגְּשׁוּרִי (והגרזי) [וְהַגִּזְרִי] וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי כִּי הֵנָּה יֹשְׁבוֹת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּרָה וְעַד־אֶרֶץ
מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Gizrites,
and the Amalekites—who were the inhabitants of the region of Olam,
all the way to Shur and to the land of Egypt.—

translation.text: Now David and his men went up and made raids on the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for these were the landed settlements from Telam on the way to Shur and on to the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
When David attacked a region, he would leave no man or woman
alive; he would take flocks, herds, asses, camels, and clothing.
When he returned and came to Achish,
verses.hebrew: וְהִכָּה דָוִד אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יְחַיֶּה אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה וְלָקַח צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וּגְמַלִּים וּבְגָדִים וַיָּשׁב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִכָּה דָוִד אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יְחַיֶּה אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה וְלָקַח צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וּגְמַלִּים וּבְגָדִים וַיָּשׁב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ׃

english.text:
When David attacked a region, he would leave no man or woman
alive; he would take flocks, herds, asses, camels, and clothing.
When he returned and came to Achish,

translation.text: David came back to Achish.

verses.english:
Achish would ask, “Where did you raid today?” and David would
reply, “The Negeb of Judah,” or “the Negeb of the Jerahmeelites,”
or “the Negeb of the Kenites.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אַל־פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד עַל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִי וְאֶל־נֶגֶב הַקֵּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אַל־פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד עַל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִי וְאֶל־נֶגֶב הַקֵּינִי׃

english.text:
Achish would ask, “Where did you raid today?” and David would
reply, “The Negeb of Judah,” or “the Negeb of the Jerahmeelites,”
or “the Negeb of the Kenites.”

translation.text: When Achish asked, "Against whom have you made a raid today?" David would say, "Against the Negeb of Judah," of the Kenites."

verses.english:
David would leave no man or woman alive to be brought to Gath; for
he thought, “They might tell about us: David did this.” Such was
his practice as long as he stayed in the territory of the
Philistines.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא־יְחַיֶּה דָוִד לְהָבִיא גַת לֵאמֹר פֶּן־יַגִּדוּ עָלֵינוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־עָשָׂה דָוִד וְכֹה מִשְׁפָּטוֹ כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא־יְחַיֶּה דָוִד לְהָבִיא גַת לֵאמֹר פֶּן־יַגִּדוּ עָלֵינוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־עָשָׂה דָוִד וְכֹה מִשְׁפָּטוֹ כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
David would leave no man or woman alive to be brought to Gath; for
he thought, “They might tell about us: David did this.” Such was
his practice as long as he stayed in the territory of the
Philistines.

translation.text: David left neither man nor woman alive to be 'David has done so and so.'" Such was his practice all the time he lived in the country of the Philistines.

verses.english:
Achish trusted David. He thought: “He has aroused the wrath of his
own people Israel, and so he will be my vassal forever.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲמֵן אָכִישׁ בְּדָוִד לֵאמֹר הַבְאֵשׁ הִבְאִישׁ בְּעַמּוֹ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיָה לִי לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאֲמֵן אָכִישׁ בְּדָוִד לֵאמֹר הַבְאֵשׁ הִבְאִישׁ בְּעַמּוֹ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיָה לִי לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Achish trusted David. He thought: “He has aroused the wrath of his
own people Israel, and so he will be my vassal forever.”

translation.text: Achish trusted David, thinking, "He shall always be my servant."

verses.english:
At that time the Philistines mustered their forces for war, to
take the field against Israel. Achish said to David, “You know, of
course, that you and your men must march out with my forces.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְהִלָּחֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי אִתִּי תֵּצֵא בַמַּחֲנֶה אַתָּה
וַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְהִלָּחֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי אִתִּי תֵּצֵא בַמַּחֲנֶה אַתָּה
וַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ׃

english.text:
At that time the Philistines mustered their forces for war, to
take the field against Israel. Achish said to David, “You know, of
course, that you and your men must march out with my forces.”

translation.text: In those days the Philistines gathered their forces for war, to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, "You know, of course, that you and your men are to go out with me in the army."

verses.english:
David answered Achish, “You surely know what your servant will
do.” “In that case,” Achish replied to David, “I will appoint you
my bodyguard for life.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ לָכֵן אַתָּה תֵדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד לָכֵן שֹׁמֵר לְרֹאשִׁי אֲשִׂימְךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

David,

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיָדִי וַיִּקְרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדֶךָ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ לְדָוִד׃

english.text:
YHWH has done for Himself as He foretold through me: YHWH has torn
the kingship out of your hands and has given it to your fellow, to
David,

translation.text: The kingdom out of your hand, and given it to your neighbor, David.

verses.english:
because you did not obey YHWH and did not execute His wrath upon
the Amalekites. That is why YHWH has done this to you today.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־עָשִׂיתָ חֲרוֹן־אַפּוֹ בַּעֲמָלֵק עַל־כֵּן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשָׂה־לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־עָשִׂיתָ חֲרוֹן־אַפּוֹ בַּעֲמָלֵק עַל־כֵּן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשָׂה־לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
because you did not obey YHWH and did not execute His wrath upon
the Amalekites. That is why YHWH has done this to you today.

translation.text: his fierce wrath against Amalek, therefore the LORD has done this thing to you today.

verses.english:
Further, YHWH will deliver the Israelites who are with you into
the hands of the Philistines. Tomorrow your sons and you will be
with me; and YHWH will also deliver the Israelite forces into the
hands of the Philistines.”
verses.hebrew: וְיִתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמָחָר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ עִמִּי גַּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמָחָר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ עִמִּי גַּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Further, YHWH will deliver the Israelites who are with you into
the hands of the Philistines. Tomorrow your sons and you will be
with me; and YHWH will also deliver the Israelite forces into the
hands of the Philistines.”

translation.text: Moreover the LORD will give Israel along with you into with me; the LORD will also give the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines."

verses.english:
At once Saul flung himself prone on the ground, terrified by
Samuel’s words. Besides, there was no strength in him, for he had
not eaten anything all day and all night.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל מְלֹא־קוֹמָתוֹ אַרְצָה וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִדִּבְרֵי שְׁמוּאֵל גַּם־כֹּחַ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ כִּי לֹא אָכַל לֶחֶם כּל־הַיּוֹם וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל מְלֹא־קוֹמָתוֹ אַרְצָה וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִדִּבְרֵי שְׁמוּאֵל גַּם־כֹּחַ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ כִּי לֹא אָכַל לֶחֶם כּל־הַיּוֹם וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
At once Saul flung himself prone on the ground, terrified by
Samuel’s words. Besides, there was no strength in him, for he had
not eaten anything all day and all night.

translation.text: Immediately Saul fell full length on the ground, filled with fear he had eaten nothing all day and all night.

verses.english:
The woman went up to Saul and, seeing how greatly disturbed he
was, she said to him, “Your handmaid listened to you; I took my
life in my hands and heeded the request you made of me.
verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַתֵּרֶא כִּי־נִבְהַל מְאֹד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַתֵּרֶא כִּי־נִבְהַל מְאֹד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
The woman went up to Saul and, seeing how greatly disturbed he
was, she said to him, “Your handmaid listened to you; I took my
life in my hands and heeded the request you made of me.

translation.text: The woman came to listened to what you have said to me.

verses.english:
So now you listen to me: Let me set before you a bit of food. Eat,
and then you will have the strength to go on your way.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע־נָא גַם־אַתָּה בְּקוֹל שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וְאָשִׂמָה לְפָנֶיךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וֶאֱכוֹל וִיהִי בְךָ כֹּחַ כִּי תֵלֵךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע־נָא גַם־אַתָּה בְּקוֹל שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וְאָשִׂמָה לְפָנֶיךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וֶאֱכוֹל וִיהִי בְךָ כֹּחַ כִּי תֵלֵךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
So now you listen to me: Let me set before you a bit of food. Eat,
and then you will have the strength to go on your way.”

translation.text: Now therefore, you also listen to your servant; let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way."

verses.english:
He refused, saying, “I will not eat.” But when his courtiers as
well as the woman urged him, he listened to them; he got up from
the ground and sat on the bed.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל וַיִּפְרְצוּ־בוֹ עֲבָדָיו וְגַם־הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיָּקם מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶל־הַמִּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל וַיִּפְרְצוּ־בוֹ עֲבָדָיו וְגַם־הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיָּקם מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶל־הַמִּטָּה׃

english.text:
He refused, saying, “I will not eat.” But when his courtiers as
well as the woman urged him, he listened to them; he got up from
the ground and sat on the bed.

translation.text: He refused, and said, "I will not eat." But his servants, together with the woman, urged him; on the bed.

verses.english:
The woman had a stall-fed calf in the house; she hastily
slaughtered it, and took flour and kneaded it, and baked some
unleavened cakes.
verses.hebrew: וְלָאִשָּׁה עֵגֶל־מַרְבֵּק בַּבַּיִת וַתְּמַהֵר וַתִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וַתִּקַּח־קֶמַח וַתָּלָשׁ וַתֹּפֵהוּ מַצּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָאִשָּׁה עֵגֶל־מַרְבֵּק בַּבַּיִת וַתְּמַהֵר וַתִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וַתִּקַּח־קֶמַח וַתָּלָשׁ וַתֹּפֵהוּ מַצּוֹת׃

english.text:
The woman had a stall-fed calf in the house; she hastily
slaughtered it, and took flour and kneaded it, and baked some
unleavened cakes.

translation.text: Now the woman had a fatted calf in the house. She unleavened cakes.

verses.english:
She set this before Saul and his courtiers, and they ate. Then
they rose and left the same night.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּגֵּשׁ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּגֵּשׁ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃

english.text:
She set this before Saul and his courtiers, and they ate. Then
they rose and left the same night.

translation.text: She put them before Saul and his servants, and they ate. Then they rose and went away that night.

verses.english:
The Philistines mustered all their forces at Aphek, while Israel
was encamping at the spring in Jezreel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־כּל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲפֵקָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹנִים בַּעַיִן אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־כּל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲפֵקָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹנִים בַּעַיִן אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
The Philistines mustered all their forces at Aphek, while Israel
was encamping at the spring in Jezreel.

translation.text: Now the Philistines gathered all their forces at Aphek, while the Israelites were encamped by the fountain that is in Jezreel.

verses.english:
The Philistine lords came marching, each with his units of
hundreds and of thousands; and David and his men came marching
last, with Achish.
verses.hebrew: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֹבְרִים לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹבְרִים בָּאַחֲרֹנָה עִם־אָכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֹבְרִים לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹבְרִים בָּאַחֲרֹנָה עִם־אָכִישׁ׃

english.text:
The Philistine lords came marching, each with his units of
hundreds and of thousands; and David and his men came marching
last, with Achish.

translation.text: As the and David and his men were passing on in the rear with Achish,

verses.english:
The Philistine officers asked, “Who are those Hebrews?” “Why,
that’s David, the servant of King Saul of Israel,” Achish answered
the Philistine officers. “He has been with me for a year or more,
and I have found no fault in him from the day he defected until
now.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים מָה הָעִבְרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד עֶבֶד שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אִתִּי זֶה יָמִים
אוֹ־זֶה שָׁנִים וְלֹא־מָצָאתִי בוֹ מְאוּמָה מִיּוֹם נפְלוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים מָה הָעִבְרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד עֶבֶד שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אִתִּי זֶה יָמִים

english.text:
The Philistine officers asked, “Who are those Hebrews?” “Why,
that’s David, the servant of King Saul of Israel,” Achish answered
the Philistine officers. “He has been with me for a year or more,
and I have found no fault in him from the day he defected until
now.”

translation.text: the him to this day."

verses.english:
But the Philistine officers were angry with him; and the
Philistine officers said to him, “Send the man back; let him go
back to the place you assigned him. He shall not march down with
us to the battle, or else he may become our adversary in battle.
For with what could that fellow appease his master if not with the
heads of these men?
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְצְפוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הָשֵׁב אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִפְקַדְתּוֹ שָׁם וְלֹא־יֵרֵד עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה
וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ לְשָׂטָן בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּבַמֶּה יִתְרַצֶּה זֶה אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו הֲלוֹא בְּרָאשֵׁי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְצְפוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הָשֵׁב אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִפְקַדְתּוֹ שָׁם וְלֹא־יֵרֵד עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה

But the Philistine officers were angry with him; and the

For with what could that fellow appease his master if not with the

translation.text: But the commanders of the Philistines were angry himself to his lord? Would it not be with the heads of the men here?

verses.english:
Remember, he is the David of whom they sang as they danced: Saul
has slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנוּ־לוֹ בַּמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָיו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנוּ־לוֹ בַּמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָיו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

english.text:
Remember, he is the David of whom they sang as they danced: Saul
has slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”

translation.text: and David his ten thousands'?"

verses.english:
Achish summoned David and said to him, “As YHWH lives, you are an
honest man, and I would like to have you serve in my forces; for I
have found no fault with you from the day you joined me until now.
But you are not acceptable to the other lords.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָשָׁר אַתָּה וְטוֹב בְּעֵינַי צֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ אִתִּי בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי לֹא־מָצָאתִי בְךָ רָעָה מִיּוֹם בֹּאֲךָ
אֵלַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבְעֵינֵי הַסְּרָנִים לֹא־טוֹב אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָשָׁר אַתָּה וְטוֹב בְּעֵינַי צֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ אִתִּי בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי לֹא־מָצָאתִי בְךָ רָעָה מִיּוֹם בֹּאֲךָ
אֵלַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבְעֵינֵי הַסְּרָנִים לֹא־טוֹב אָתָּה׃

english.text:
Achish summoned David and said to him, “As YHWH lives, you are an
honest man, and I would like to have you serve in my forces; for I
have found no fault with you from the day you joined me until now.
But you are not acceptable to the other lords.

translation.text: Then Achish called David and said to him, "As the LORD lives, you lords do not approve of you.

verses.english:
So go back in peace, and do nothing to displease the Philistine
lords.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שׁוּב וְלֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה רָע בְּעֵינֵי סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שׁוּב וְלֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה רָע בְּעֵינֵי סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
So go back in peace, and do nothing to displease the Philistine
lords.”

translation.text: So go back now; and go peaceably; do nothing to displease the lords of the Philistines."

verses.english:
David, however, said to Achish, “But what have I done, what fault
have you found in your servant from the day I appeared before you
to this day, that I should not go and fight against the enemies of
my lord the king?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־מָּצָאתָ בְעַבְדְּךָ מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי לְפָנֶיךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא אָבוֹא וְנִלְחַמְתִּי בְּאֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־מָּצָאתָ בְעַבְדְּךָ מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי לְפָנֶיךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא אָבוֹא וְנִלְחַמְתִּי בְּאֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
David, however, said to Achish, “But what have I done, what fault
have you found in your servant from the day I appeared before you
to this day, that I should not go and fight against the enemies of
my lord the king?”

translation.text: David said to from the day I entered your service until now, that I should not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"

verses.english:
Achish replied to David, “I know; you are as acceptable to me as
an angel of God. But the Philistine officers have decided that you
must not march out with us to the battle.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אָכִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טוֹב אַתָּה בְּעֵינַי כְּמַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אַךְ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים אָמְרוּ לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אָכִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טוֹב אַתָּה בְּעֵינַי כְּמַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אַךְ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים אָמְרוּ לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Achish replied to David, “I know; you are as acceptable to me as
an angel of God. But the Philistine officers have decided that you
must not march out with us to the battle.

translation.text: Achish replied to shall not go up with us to the battle.'

verses.english:
So rise early in the morning, you and your lord’s servants who
came with you—rise early in the morning, and leave as soon as it
is light.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ אִתָּךְ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְאוֹר לָכֶם וָלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ אִתָּךְ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְאוֹר לָכֶם וָלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
So rise early in the morning, you and your lord’s servants who
came with you—rise early in the morning, and leave as soon as it
is light.”

translation.text: Now then rise early in the to the place that I appointed for you. As for the evil report, do not take morning, and leave as soon as you have light."

verses.english:
Accordingly, David and his men rose early in the morning to leave,
to return to the land of the Philistines, while the Philistines
marched up to Jezreel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו לָלֶכֶת בַּבֹּקֶר לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עָלוּ יִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו לָלֶכֶת בַּבֹּקֶר לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עָלוּ יִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
Accordingly, David and his men rose early in the morning to leave,
to return to the land of the Philistines, while the Philistines
marched up to Jezreel.

translation.text: So David set out with his men early in the morning, to return to the land of the Philistines. But the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו צִקְלַג בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַעֲמָלֵקִי פָשְׁטוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב וְאֶל־צִקְלַג וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־צִקְלַג וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָהּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו צִקְלַג בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַעֲמָלֵקִי פָשְׁטוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב וְאֶל־צִקְלַג וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־צִקְלַג וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָהּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

translation.text: Now when David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day, the attacked Ziklag, burned it down,

verses.english:
They had taken the women in it captive, low-born and high-born
alike; they did not kill any, but carried them off and went their
way.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל לֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ וַיִּנְהֲגוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל לֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ וַיִּנְהֲגוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם׃

english.text:
They had taken the women in it captive, low-born and high-born
alike; they did not kill any, but carried them off and went their
way.

translation.text: and taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great; they killed none of them, but carried them off, and went their way.

verses.english:
When David and his men came to the town and found it burned down,
and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ׃

english.text:
When David and his men came to the town and found it burned down,
and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive,

translation.text: When David and his men came daughters taken captive.

verses.english:
David and the troops with him broke into tears, until they had no
strength left for weeping.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא דָוִד וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵין־בָּהֶם כֹּחַ לִבְכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא דָוִד וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵין־בָּהֶם כֹּחַ לִבְכּוֹת׃

english.text:
David and the troops with him broke into tears, until they had no
strength left for weeping.

translation.text: Then David and the people who were with weep.

verses.english:
David’s two wives had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel and
Abigail wife of Nabal from Carmel.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי נְשֵׁי־דָוִד נִשְׁבּוּ אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי נְשֵׁי־דָוִד נִשְׁבּוּ אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

english.text:
David’s two wives had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel and
Abigail wife of Nabal from Carmel.

translation.text: David's two wives also had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֶר לְדָוִד מְאֹד כִּי־אָמְרוּ הָעָם לְסקְלוֹ כִּי־מָרָה נֶפֶשׁ כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ עַל־בָּנָו וְעַל־בְּנֹתָיו וַיִּתְחַזֵּק דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֶר לְדָוִד מְאֹד כִּי־אָמְרוּ הָעָם לְסקְלוֹ כִּי־מָרָה נֶפֶשׁ כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ עַל־בָּנָו וְעַל־בְּנֹתָיו וַיִּתְחַזֵּק דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃

translation.text: David was in strengthened himself in the LORD his God.

verses.english:
David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, “Bring the
ephod up to me.” When Abiathar brought up the ephod to David,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַגִּישָׁה־נָּא לִי הָאֵפוֹד וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֶבְיָתָר אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד אֶל־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַגִּישָׁה־נָּא לִי הָאֵפוֹד וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֶבְיָתָר אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד אֶל־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, “Bring the
ephod up to me.” When Abiathar brought up the ephod to David,

translation.text: David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, "Bring me the ephod." So Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

verses.english:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I pursue those raiders? Will I
overtake them?” And He answered him, “Pursue, for you shall
overtake and you shall rescue.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אֶרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי הַגְּדוּד־הַזֶּה הַאַשִּׂגֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רְדֹף כִּי־הַשֵּׂג תַּשִּׂיג וְהַצֵּל תַּצִּיל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אֶרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי הַגְּדוּד־הַזֶּה הַאַשִּׂגֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רְדֹף כִּי־הַשֵּׂג תַּשִּׂיג וְהַצֵּל תַּצִּיל׃

english.text:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I pursue those raiders? Will I
overtake them?” And He answered him, “Pursue, for you shall
overtake and you shall rescue.”

translation.text: David inquired of rescue."

verses.english:
So David and the six hundred men with him set out, and they came
to the Wadi Besor, where a halt was made by those who were to be
left behind.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וְהַנּוֹתָרִים עָמָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וְהַנּוֹתָרִים עָמָדוּ׃

english.text:
So David and the six hundred men with him set out, and they came
to the Wadi Besor, where a halt was made by those who were to be
left behind.

translation.text: So David set out, he and the six hundred men who were left behind.

verses.english:
David continued the pursuit with four hundred men; two hundred men
had halted, too faint to cross the Wadi Besor.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף דָּוִד הוּא וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר פִּגְּרוּ מֵעֲבֹר אֶת־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֹּף דָּוִד הוּא וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר פִּגְּרוּ מֵעֲבֹר אֶת־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר׃

english.text:
David continued the pursuit with four hundred men; two hundred men
had halted, too faint to cross the Wadi Besor.

translation.text: But David went on with the pursuit, he and four Wadi Besor.

verses.english:
They came upon an Egyptian in the open country and brought him to
David. They gave him food to eat and water to drink;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ־מִצְרִי בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּקְחוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל וַיַּשְׁקֻהוּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ־מִצְרִי בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּקְחוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל וַיַּשְׁקֻהוּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
They came upon an Egyptian in the open country and brought him to
David. They gave him food to eat and water to drink;

translation.text: In the open country they found an Egyptian, and brought him to David. They gave him bread and he ate; they gave him water to drink;

verses.english:
he was also given a piece of pressed fig cake and two cakes of
raisins. He ate and regained his strength, for he had eaten no
food and drunk no water for three days and three nights.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ פֶלַח דְּבֵלָה וּשְׁנֵי צִמֻּקִים וַיֹּאכַל וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ אֵלָיו כִּי לֹא־אָכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־שָׁתָה מַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה לֵילוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ פֶלַח דְּבֵלָה וּשְׁנֵי צִמֻּקִים וַיֹּאכַל וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ אֵלָיו כִּי לֹא־אָכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־שָׁתָה מַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה לֵילוֹת׃

english.text:
he was also given a piece of pressed fig cake and two cakes of
raisins. He ate and regained his strength, for he had eaten no
food and drunk no water for three days and three nights.

translation.text: they also gave him a piece of fig cake and two clusters of raisins. drunk water for three days and three nights.

verses.english:
Then David asked him, “To whom do you belong and where are you
from?” “I am an Egyptian boy,” he answered, “the slave of an
Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I fell ill three days ago.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד לְמִי־אַתָּה וְאֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר נַעַר מִצְרִי אָנֹכִי עֶבֶד לְאִישׁ עֲמָלֵקִי וַיַּעַזְבֵנִי אֲדֹנִי כִּי חָלִיתִי הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד לְמִי־אַתָּה וְאֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר נַעַר מִצְרִי אָנֹכִי עֶבֶד לְאִישׁ עֲמָלֵקִי וַיַּעַזְבֵנִי אֲדֹנִי כִּי חָלִיתִי הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
Then David asked him, “To whom do you belong and where are you
from?” “I am an Egyptian boy,” he answered, “the slave of an
Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I fell ill three days ago.

translation.text: Then David said to him, behind because I fell sick three days ago.

verses.english:
We had raided the Negeb of the Cherethites, and [the Negeb] of
Judah, and the Negeb of Caleb; we also burned down Ziklag.”
verses.hebrew: אֲנַחְנוּ פָּשַׁטְנוּ נֶגֶב הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל־אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב כָּלֵב וְאֶת־צִקְלַג שָׂרַפְנוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אֲנַחְנוּ פָּשַׁטְנוּ נֶגֶב הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל־אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב כָּלֵב וְאֶת־צִקְלַג שָׂרַפְנוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
We had raided the Negeb of the Cherethites, and [the Negeb] of
Judah, and the Negeb of Caleb; we also burned down Ziklag.”

translation.text: We had made a raid on the the Negeb of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag down."

verses.english:
And David said to him, “Can you lead me down to that band?” He
replied, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver
me into my master’s hands, and I will lead you down to that band.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד הֲתוֹרִדֵנִי אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים אִם־תְּמִיתֵנִי וְאִם־תַּסְגִּרֵנִי בְּיַד־אֲדֹנִי וְאוֹרִדְךָ אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד הֲתוֹרִדֵנִי אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים אִם־תְּמִיתֵנִי וְאִם־תַּסְגִּרֵנִי בְּיַד־אֲדֹנִי וְאוֹרִדְךָ אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And David said to him, “Can you lead me down to that band?” He
replied, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver
me into my master’s hands, and I will lead you down to that band.”

translation.text: David said to and I will take you down to them."

verses.english:
So he led him down, and there they were, scattered all over the
ground, eating and drinking and making merry because of all the
vast spoil they had taken from the land of the Philistines and
from the land of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ וְהִנֵּה נְטֻשִׁים עַל־פְּנֵי כל־הָאָרֶץ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וְחֹגְגִים בְּכֹל הַשָּׁלָל הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מֵאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ וְהִנֵּה נְטֻשִׁים עַל־פְּנֵי כל־הָאָרֶץ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וְחֹגְגִים בְּכֹל הַשָּׁלָל הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מֵאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
So he led him down, and there they were, scattered all over the
ground, eating and drinking and making merry because of all the
vast spoil they had taken from the land of the Philistines and
from the land of Judah.

translation.text: When he had taken him down, they were spread out all over the from the land of Judah.

verses.english:
David attacked them from before dawn until the evening of the next
day; none of them escaped, except four hundred young men who
mounted camels and got away.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם דָּוִד מֵהַנֶּשֶׁף וְעַד־הָעֶרֶב לְמחֳרָתָם וְלֹא־נִמְלַט מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם־אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ־נַעַר אֲשֶׁר־רָכְבוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּם דָּוִד מֵהַנֶּשֶׁף וְעַד־הָעֶרֶב לְמחֳרָתָם וְלֹא־נִמְלַט מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם־אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ־נַעַר אֲשֶׁר־רָכְבוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

english.text:
David attacked them from before dawn until the evening of the next
day; none of them escaped, except four hundred young men who
mounted camels and got away.

translation.text: David attacked them from twilight until the hundred young men, who mounted camels and fled.

verses.english:
David rescued everything the Amalekites had taken; David also
rescued his two wives.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּל דָּוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו הִצִּיל דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּל דָּוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו הִצִּיל דָּוִד׃

english.text:
David rescued everything the Amalekites had taken; David also
rescued his two wives.

translation.text: David wives.

verses.english:
Nothing of theirs was missing—young or old, sons or daughters,
spoil or anything else that had been carried off—David recovered
everything.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נֶעְדַּר־לָהֶם מִן־הַקָּטֹן וְעַד־הַגָּדוֹל וְעַד־בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת וּמִשָּׁלָל וְעַד כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּל הֵשִׁיב דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נֶעְדַּר־לָהֶם מִן־הַקָּטֹן וְעַד־הַגָּדוֹל וְעַד־בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת וּמִשָּׁלָל וְעַד כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּל הֵשִׁיב דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Nothing of theirs was missing—young or old, sons or daughters,
spoil or anything else that had been carried off—David recovered
everything.

translation.text: Nothing was missing, whether small or great, sons or everything.

verses.english:
David took all the flocks and herds, which [the troops] drove
ahead of the other livestock; and they declared, “This is David’s
spoil.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר נָהֲגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּקְנֶה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֶה שְׁלַל דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר נָהֲגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּקְנֶה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֶה שְׁלַל דָּוִד׃

english.text:
David took all the flocks and herds, which [the troops] drove
ahead of the other livestock; and they declared, “This is David’s
spoil.”

translation.text: David also captured all the flocks and herds, which were driven ahead of the other cattle; people said, "This is David's spoil."

verses.english:
When David reached the two hundred men who were too faint to
follow David and who had been left at the Wadi Besor, they came
out to welcome David and the troops with him; David came forward
with the troops and greeted them.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־מָאתַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־פִּגְּרוּ מִלֶּכֶת אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֹּשִׁיבֻם בְּנַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וְלִקְרַאת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ
וַיִּגַּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־מָאתַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־פִּגְּרוּ מִלֶּכֶת אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֹּשִׁיבֻם בְּנַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וְלִקְרַאת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ
וַיִּגַּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
When David reached the two hundred men who were too faint to
follow David and who had been left at the Wadi Besor, they came
out to welcome David and the troops with him; David came forward
with the troops and greeted them.

translation.text: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow David, and who had been left at the Wadi Besor. him. When David drew near to the people he saluted them.

verses.english:
But all the mean and churlish fellows among the men who had
accompanied David spoke up, “Since they did not accompany us, we
will not give them any of the spoil that we seized—except that
each may take his wife and children and go.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ־רָע וּבְלִיַּעַל מֵהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִם־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָלְכוּ עִמִּי לֹא־נִתֵּן לָהֶם מֵהַשָּׁלָל אֲשֶׁר הִצַּלְנוּ
כִּי־אִם־אִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְיִנְהֲגוּ וְיֵלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ־רָע וּבְלִיַּעַל מֵהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִם־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָלְכוּ עִמִּי לֹא־נִתֵּן לָהֶם מֵהַשָּׁלָל אֲשֶׁר הִצַּלְנוּ
כִּי־אִם־אִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְיִנְהֲגוּ וְיֵלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
But all the mean and churlish fellows among the men who had
accompanied David spoke up, “Since they did not accompany us, we
will not give them any of the spoil that we seized—except that
each may take his wife and children and go.”

translation.text: Then all take his wife and children, and leave."

verses.english:
David, however, spoke up, “You must not do that, my brothers, in
view of what YHWH has granted us, guarding us and delivering into
our hands the band that attacked us.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ כֵן אֶחָי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָנוּ וַיִּשְׁמֹר אֹתָנוּ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַגְּדוּד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ כֵן אֶחָי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָנוּ וַיִּשְׁמֹר אֹתָנוּ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַגְּדוּד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
David, however, spoke up, “You must not do that, my brothers, in
view of what YHWH has granted us, guarding us and delivering into
our hands the band that attacked us.

translation.text: But David said, "You shall preserved us and handed over to us the raiding party that attacked us.

verses.english:
How could anyone agree with you in this matter? The share of those
who remain with the baggage shall be the same as the share of
those who go down to battle; they shall share alike.”
verses.hebrew: וּמִי יִשְׁמַע לָכֶם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי כְּחֵלֶק הַיֹּרֵד בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּכְחֵלֶק הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־הַכֵּלִים יַחְדָּו יַחֲלֹקוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי יִשְׁמַע לָכֶם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי כְּחֵלֶק הַיֹּרֵד בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּכְחֵלֶק הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־הַכֵּלִים יַחְדָּו יַחֲלֹקוּ׃

english.text:
How could anyone agree with you in this matter? The share of those
who remain with the baggage shall be the same as the share of
those who go down to battle; they shall share alike.”

translation.text: Who would listen to you in this matter? For the share of the one one who stays by the baggage; they shall share alike."

verses.english:
So from that day on it was made a fixed rule for Israel,
continuing to the present day.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיְשִׂמֶהָ לְחֹק וּלְמִשְׁפָּט לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיְשִׂמֶהָ לְחֹק וּלְמִשְׁפָּט לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
So from that day on it was made a fixed rule for Israel,
continuing to the present day.

translation.text: From that continues to the present day.

verses.english:
When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the spoil to the elders
of Judah [and] to his friends, saying, “This is a present for you
from our spoil of the enemies of YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־צִקְלַג וַיְשַׁלַּח מֵהַשָּׁלָל לְזִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְרֵעֵהוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה לָכֶם בְּרָכָה מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־צִקְלַג וַיְשַׁלַּח מֵהַשָּׁלָל לְזִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְרֵעֵהוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה לָכֶם בְּרָכָה מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the spoil to the elders
of Judah [and] to his friends, saying, “This is a present for you
from our spoil of the enemies of YHWH.”

translation.text: When David came to Ziklag, he sent part of the spoil to his friends, the elders of Judah, saying, "Here is a present for you from the spoil of the enemies of the LORD";

verses.english:
[He sent the spoil to the elders] in Bethel, Ramoth-negeb, and
Jattir;
verses.hebrew: לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָמוֹת־נֶגֶבוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּיַתִּר׃

hebrew.text: לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָמוֹת־נֶגֶבוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּיַתִּר׃

english.text:
[He sent the spoil to the elders] in Bethel, Ramoth-negeb, and
Jattir;

translation.text: it was for those in Bethel, in Ramoth of the Negeb, in Jattir,

verses.english: in Aroer, Siphmoth, and Eshtemoa;
verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲרֹעֵרוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּשִׂפְמוֹתוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲרֹעֵרוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּשִׂפְמוֹתוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ׃

english.text: in Aroer, Siphmoth, and Eshtemoa;

translation.text: in Aroer, in Siphmoth, in Eshtemoa,

verses.english:
in Racal, in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, and in the towns of
the Kenites;
verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָכָלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִיוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַקֵּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָכָלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִיוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַקֵּינִי׃

english.text:
in Racal, in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, and in the towns of
the Kenites;

translation.text: in Racal, in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, in the towns of the Kenites,

verses.english: in Hormah, Bor-ashan, and Athach;
verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחרְמָהוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבוֹר־עָשָׁןוְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחרְמָהוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבוֹר־עָשָׁןוְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲתָךְ׃

english.text: in Hormah, Bor-ashan, and Athach;

translation.text: in Hormah, in Bor-ashan, in Athach,

verses.english:
and to those in Hebron—all the places where David and his men had
roamed.
verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וּלְכל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלֶּךְ־שָׁם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וּלְכל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלֶּךְ־שָׁם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
and to those in Hebron—all the places where David and his men had
roamed.

translation.text: in Hebron, all the places where David and his men had roamed.

verses.english:
The Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before
the Philistines and [many] fell on Mount Gilboa.
verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
The Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before
the Philistines and [many] fell on Mount Gilboa.

translation.text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines, and many fell on Mount Gilboa.

verses.english:
The Philistines pursued Saul and his sons, and the Philistines
struck down Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, sons of Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּדְבְּקוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיַּכּוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁוּעַ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּדְבְּקוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיַּכּוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁוּעַ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The Philistines pursued Saul and his sons, and the Philistines
struck down Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, sons of Saul.

translation.text: The Philistines Abinadab and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

verses.english:
The battle raged around Saul, and some of the archers hit him, and
he was severely wounded by the archers.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְבַּד הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ הַמּוֹרִים אֲנָשִׁים בַּקָּשֶׁת וַיָּחֶל מְאֹד מֵהַמּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְבַּד הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ הַמּוֹרִים אֲנָשִׁים בַּקָּשֶׁת וַיָּחֶל מְאֹד מֵהַמּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
The battle raged around Saul, and some of the archers hit him, and
he was severely wounded by the archers.

translation.text: The battle pressed hard upon Saul; the archers found him, and he was badly wounded by them.

verses.english:
Saul said to his arms-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through,
so that the uncircumcised may not run me through and make sport of
me.” But his arms-bearer, in his great awe, refused; whereupon
Saul grasped the sword and fell upon it.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וְדקְרֵנִי בָהּ פֶּן־יָבוֹאוּ הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה וּדְקָרֻנִי וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִי וְלֹא אָבָה נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כִּי יָרֵא מְאֹד
וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֶרֶב וַיִּפֹּל עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וְדקְרֵנִי בָהּ פֶּן־יָבוֹאוּ הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה וּדְקָרֻנִי וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִי וְלֹא אָבָה נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כִּי יָרֵא מְאֹד
וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֶרֶב וַיִּפֹּל עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Saul said to his arms-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through,
so that the uncircumcised may not run me through and make sport of
me.” But his arms-bearer, in his great awe, refused; whereupon
Saul grasped the sword and fell upon it.

translation.text: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and thrust me upon it.

verses.english:
When his arms-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his
sword and died with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא נֹשֵׂא־כֵלָיו כִּי מֵת שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל גַּם־הוּא עַל־חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּמת עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא נֹשֵׂא־כֵלָיו כִּי מֵת שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל גַּם־הוּא עַל־חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּמת עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
When his arms-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his
sword and died with him.

translation.text: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died with him.

verses.english:
Thus Saul and his three sons and his arms-bearer, as well as all
his men, died together on that day.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו גַּם כּל־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יַחְדָּו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו גַּם כּל־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יַחְדָּו׃

english.text:
Thus Saul and his three sons and his arms-bearer, as well as all
his men, died together on that day.

translation.text: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together on the same day.

verses.english:
And when the men of Israel on the other side of the valley and on
the other side of the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled
and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the towns and
fled; the Philistines then came and occupied them.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּרְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־בְּעֵבֶר הָעֵמֶק וַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי־נָסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי־מֵתוּ שָׁאוּל וּבָנָיו וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים
וַיָּנֻסוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּרְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־בְּעֵבֶר הָעֵמֶק וַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי־נָסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי־מֵתוּ שָׁאוּל וּבָנָיו וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים
וַיָּנֻסוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶן׃

english.text:
And when the men of Israel on the other side of the valley and on
the other side of the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled
and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the towns and
fled; the Philistines then came and occupied them.

translation.text: When Philistines came and occupied them.

verses.english:
The next day the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they
found Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְפַשֵּׁט אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו נֹפְלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְפַשֵּׁט אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו נֹפְלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
The next day the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they
found Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa.

translation.text: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

verses.english:
They cut off his head and stripped him of his armor, and they sent
them throughout the land of the Philistines, to spread the news in
the temples of their idols and among the people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּפְשִׁטוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ בְאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּים סָבִיב לְבַשֵּׂר בֵּית עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וְאֶת־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּפְשִׁטוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ בְאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּים סָבִיב לְבַשֵּׂר בֵּית עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וְאֶת־הָעָם׃

english.text:
They cut off his head and stripped him of his armor, and they sent
them throughout the land of the Philistines, to spread the news in
the temples of their idols and among the people.

translation.text: They cut off his head, the people.

verses.english:
They placed his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth, and they impaled
his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־גְּוִיָּתוֹ תָּקְעוּ בְּחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־גְּוִיָּתוֹ תָּקְעוּ בְּחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן׃

english.text:
They placed his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth, and they impaled
his body on the wall of Beth-shan.

translation.text: They put his armor in the temple of Astarte; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

verses.english:
When the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard about it—what the
Philistines had done to Saul—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
When the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard about it—what the
Philistines had done to Saul—

translation.text: But when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.english:
all their stalwart men set out and marched all night; they removed
the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan and
came to Jabesh and burned them there.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ כּל־אִישׁ חַיִל וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־גְּוִיַּת שָׁאוּל וְאֵת גְּוִיֹּת בָּנָיו מֵחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן וַיָּבֹאוּ יָבֵשָׁה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ כּל־אִישׁ חַיִל וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־גְּוִיַּת שָׁאוּל וְאֵת גְּוִיֹּת בָּנָיו מֵחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן וַיָּבֹאוּ יָבֵשָׁה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם שָׁם׃

english.text:
all their stalwart men set out and marched all night; they removed
the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan and
came to Jabesh and burned them there.

translation.text: all the valiant men set out, traveled all night long, and took the body of Saul Jabesh and burned them there.

verses.english:
Then they took the bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree
in Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְבְּרוּ תַחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בְּיָבֵשָׁה וַיָּצֻמוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְבְּרוּ תַחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בְּיָבֵשָׁה וַיָּצֻמוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
Then they took the bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree
in Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.

translation.text: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.english:
And it was after Saul’s death, when David had come back from
striking the Amalekites, and David stayed in Ziklag two days.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד שָׁב מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הָעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בְּצִקְלָג יָמִים שְׁנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד שָׁב מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הָעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בְּצִקְלָג יָמִים שְׁנָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was after Saul’s death, when David had come back from
striking the Amalekites, and David stayed in Ziklag two days.

translation.text: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from defeating the Amalekites, David remained two days in Ziklag.

verses.english:
On the third day, a man came from Saul’s camp, with his clothes
rent and earth on his head; and as he approached David, he flung
himself to the ground and bowed low.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ בָּא מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבְגָדָיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיְהִי בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה
וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ בָּא מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבְגָדָיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיְהִי בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה
וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

english.text:
On the third day, a man came from Saul’s camp, with his clothes
rent and earth on his head; and as he approached David, he flung
himself to the ground and bowed low.

translation.text: On the third day, a man came from Saul's camp, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground and did obeisance.

verses.english:
David said to him, “Where are you coming from?” He answered, “I
have just escaped from the camp of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְלָטְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְלָטְתִּי׃

english.text:
David said to him, “Where are you coming from?” He answered, “I
have just escaped from the camp of Israel.”

translation.text: have escaped from the camp of Israel."

verses.english:
“What happened?” asked David. “Tell me!” And he told him how the
troops had fled the battlefield, and that, moreover, many of the
troops had fallen and died; also that Saul and his son Jonathan
were dead.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַגֶּד־נָא לִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר־נָס הָעָם מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְגַם־הַרְבֵּה נָפַל מִן־הָעָם וַיָּמֻתוּ וְגַם שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ
מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַגֶּד־נָא לִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר־נָס הָעָם מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְגַם־הַרְבֵּה נָפַל מִן־הָעָם וַיָּמֻתוּ וְגַם שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ
מֵתוּ׃

english.text:
“What happened?” asked David. “Tell me!” And he told him how the
troops had fled the battlefield, and that, moreover, many of the
troops had fallen and died; also that Saul and his son Jonathan
were dead.

translation.text: David said to him, "How did also many of the army fell and died; and Saul and his son Jonathan also died."

verses.english:
“How do you know,” David asked the young man who brought him the
news, “that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵיךְ יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֵת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵיךְ יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֵת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
“How do you know,” David asked the young man who brought him the
news, “that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”

translation.text: Then David asked the young man who was reporting to him, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan died?"

verses.english:
The young man who brought him the news answered, “I happened to be
at Mount Gilboa, and I saw Saul leaning on his spear, and the
chariots and horsemen closing in on him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ נִקְרֹא נִקְרֵיתִי בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל נִשְׁעָן עַל־חֲנִיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָרֶכֶב וּבַעֲלֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים הִדְבִּקֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ נִקְרֹא נִקְרֵיתִי בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל נִשְׁעָן עַל־חֲנִיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָרֶכֶב וּבַעֲלֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים הִדְבִּקֻהוּ׃

english.text:
The young man who brought him the news answered, “I happened to be
at Mount Gilboa, and I saw Saul leaning on his spear, and the
chariots and horsemen closing in on him.

translation.text: The young horsemen drew close to him.

verses.english:
He looked around and saw me, and he called to me. When I
responded, ‘At your service,’
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֵלַי וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֵלַי וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
He looked around and saw me, and he called to me. When I
responded, ‘At your service,’

translation.text: When he looked behind him, he saw me, and called to me. I answered, 'Here sir.'

verses.english:
he asked me, ‘Who are you?’ And I told him that I was an
Amalekite.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי מִי־אָתָּה (ויאמר) [וָאֹמַר] אֵלָיו עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי מִי־אָתָּה (ויאמר) [וָאֹמַר] אֵלָיו עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
he asked me, ‘Who are you?’ And I told him that I was an
Amalekite.

translation.text: And he said to me, 'Who are you?' I answered him, 'I am an Amalekite.'

verses.english:
Then he said to me, ‘Stand over me, and finish me off, for I am in
agony and am barely alive.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עֲמד־נָא עָלַי וּמֹתְתֵנִי כִּי אֲחָזַנִי הַשָּׁבָץ כִּי־כל־עוֹד נַפְשִׁי בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עֲמד־נָא עָלַי וּמֹתְתֵנִי כִּי אֲחָזַנִי הַשָּׁבָץ כִּי־כל־עוֹד נַפְשִׁי בִּי׃

english.text:
Then he said to me, ‘Stand over me, and finish me off, for I am in
agony and am barely alive.’

translation.text: He said to me, 'Come, life still lingers.'

verses.english:
So I stood over him and finished him off, for I knew that he would
never rise from where he was lying. Then I took the crown from his
head and the armlet from his arm, and I have brought them here to
my lord.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֶעֱמֹד עָלָיו וַאֲמֹתְתֵהוּ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נִפְלוֹ וָאֶקַּח הַנֵּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶצְעָדָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרֹעוֹ וָאֲבִיאֵם אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶעֱמֹד עָלָיו וַאֲמֹתְתֵהוּ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נִפְלוֹ וָאֶקַּח הַנֵּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶצְעָדָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרֹעוֹ וָאֲבִיאֵם אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
So I stood over him and finished him off, for I knew that he would
never rise from where he was lying. Then I took the crown from his
head and the armlet from his arm, and I have brought them here to
my lord.”

translation.text: So I stood over him, and killed him, for I knew that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his here to my lord."

verses.english:
David took hold of his clothes and rent them, and so did all the
men with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזֵק דָּוִד בִּבְגָדָו וַיִּקְרָעֵם וְגַם כּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲזֵק דָּוִד בִּבְגָדָו וַיִּקְרָעֵם וְגַם כּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
David took hold of his clothes and rent them, and so did all the
men with him.

translation.text: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did the same.

verses.english:
They lamented and wept, and they fasted until evening for Saul and
his son Jonathan, and for the soldiers of YHWH and the House of
Israel who had fallen by the sword.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְפְּדוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיָּצֻמוּ עַד־הָעָרֶב עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְעַל־עַם יְהֹוָה וְעַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נָפְלוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְפְּדוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיָּצֻמוּ עַד־הָעָרֶב עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְעַל־עַם יְהֹוָה וְעַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נָפְלוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
They lamented and wept, and they fasted until evening for Saul and
his son Jonathan, and for the soldiers of YHWH and the House of
Israel who had fallen by the sword.

translation.text: They mourned and wept, and by the sword.

verses.english:
David said to the young man who had brought him the news, “Where
are you from?” He replied, “I am the son of a resident alien, an
Amalekite.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר בֶּן־אִישׁ גֵּר עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר בֶּן־אִישׁ גֵּר עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
David said to the young man who had brought him the news, “Where
are you from?” He replied, “I am the son of a resident alien, an
Amalekite.”

translation.text: David said to the young man who had reported to resident alien, an Amalekite."

verses.english:
“How did you dare,” David said to him, “to lift your hand and kill
YHWH’s anointed?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד אֵיךְ לֹא יָרֵאתָ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדְךָ לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד אֵיךְ לֹא יָרֵאתָ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדְךָ לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“How did you dare,” David said to him, “to lift your hand and kill
YHWH’s anointed?”

translation.text: David said to him, "Were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD's anointed?"

verses.english:
Thereupon David called one of the attendants and said to him,
“Come over and strike him!” He struck him down and he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד לְאַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר גַּשׁ פְּגַע־בּוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד לְאַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר גַּשׁ פְּגַע־בּוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
Thereupon David called one of the attendants and said to him,
“Come over and strike him!” He struck him down and he died.

translation.text: Then David down." So he struck him down and he died.

verses.english:
And David said to him, “Your blood be on your own head! Your own
mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I put YHWH’s anointed
to death.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד (דמיך) [דָּמְךָ] עַל־רֹאשֶׁךָ כִּי פִיךָ עָנָה בְךָ לֵאמֹר אָנֹכִי מֹתַתִּי אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד (דמיך) [דָּמְךָ] עַל־רֹאשֶׁךָ כִּי פִיךָ עָנָה בְךָ לֵאמֹר אָנֹכִי מֹתַתִּי אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And David said to him, “Your blood be on your own head! Your own
mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I put YHWH’s anointed
to death.’”

translation.text: David said to him, against you, saying, 'I have killed the LORD's anointed.'"

verses.english: And David intoned this dirge over Saul and his son Jonathan—
verses.hebrew: וַיְקֹנֵן דָּוִד אֶת־הַקִּינָה הַזֹּאת עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקֹנֵן דָּוִד אֶת־הַקִּינָה הַזֹּאת עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃
