english.text: And David intoned this dirge over Saul and his son Jonathan—

translation.text: David intoned this lamentation over Saul and his son Jonathan.

verses.english:
He ordered the Judites to be taught [The Song of the] Bow. It is
recorded in the Book of Jashar.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְלַמֵּד בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה קָשֶׁת הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְלַמֵּד בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה קָשֶׁת הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר׃

english.text:
He ordered the Judites to be taught [The Song of the] Bow. It is
recorded in the Book of Jashar.

translation.text: Judah; it is written in the Book of Jashar.) He said:

verses.english:
Your glory, O Israel, Lies slain on your heights; How have the
mighty fallen!
verses.hebrew: הַצְּבִי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: הַצְּבִי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
Your glory, O Israel, Lies slain on your heights; How have the
mighty fallen!

translation.text: Your glory, O Israel, lies slain upon your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

verses.english:
Tell it not in Gath, Do not proclaim it in the streets of
Ashkelon, Lest the daughters of the Philistine rejoice, Lest the
daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בְגַת אַל־תְּבַשְּׂרוּ בְּחוּצֹת אַשְׁקְלוֹן פֶּן־תִּשְׂמַחְנָה בְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן־תַּעֲלֹזְנָה בְּנוֹת הָעֲרֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בְגַת אַל־תְּבַשְּׂרוּ בְּחוּצֹת אַשְׁקְלוֹן פֶּן־תִּשְׂמַחְנָה בְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן־תַּעֲלֹזְנָה בְּנוֹת הָעֲרֵלִים׃

english.text:
Tell it not in Gath, Do not proclaim it in the streets of
Ashkelon, Lest the daughters of the Philistine rejoice, Lest the
daughters of the uncircumcised exult.

translation.text: Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon; the daughters of the uncircumcised will exult.

verses.english:
O hills of Gilboa— Let there be no dew or rain on you, Or
bountiful fields, For there the shield of warriors lay rejected,
The shield of Saul, Polished with oil no more.
verses.hebrew: הָרֵי בַגִּלְבֹּעַ אַל־טַל וְאַל־מָטָר עֲלֵיכֶם וּשְׂדֵי תְרוּמֹת כִּי שָׁם נִגְעַל מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרִים מָגֵן שָׁאוּל בְּלִי מָשִׁיחַ בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: הָרֵי בַגִּלְבֹּעַ אַל־טַל וְאַל־מָטָר עֲלֵיכֶם וּשְׂדֵי תְרוּמֹת כִּי שָׁם נִגְעַל מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרִים מָגֵן שָׁאוּל בְּלִי מָשִׁיחַ בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
O hills of Gilboa— Let there be no dew or rain on you, Or
bountiful fields, For there the shield of warriors lay rejected,
The shield of Saul, Polished with oil no more.

translation.text: You mountains of Gilboa, nor bounteous fields! the shield of Saul, anointed with oil no more.

verses.english:
From the blood of slain, From the fat of warriors— The bow of
Jonathan Never turned back; The sword of Saul Never withdrew
empty.
verses.hebrew: מִדַּם חֲלָלִים מֵחֵלֶב גִּבּוֹרִים קֶשֶׁת יְהוֹנָתָן לֹא נָשׂוֹג אָחוֹר וְחֶרֶב שָׁאוּל לֹא תָשׁוּב רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: מִדַּם חֲלָלִים מֵחֵלֶב גִּבּוֹרִים קֶשֶׁת יְהוֹנָתָן לֹא נָשׂוֹג אָחוֹר וְחֶרֶב שָׁאוּל לֹא תָשׁוּב רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
From the blood of slain, From the fat of warriors— The bow of
Jonathan Never turned back; The sword of Saul Never withdrew
empty.

translation.text: From the blood of the slain, nor the sword of Saul return empty.

verses.english:
Saul and Jonathan, Beloved and cherished, Never parted In life or
in death! They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than
lions!
verses.hebrew: שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִם בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵרוּ׃

hebrew.text: שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִם בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵרוּ׃

english.text:
Saul and Jonathan, Beloved and cherished, Never parted In life or
in death! They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than
lions!

translation.text: Saul and Jonathan, beloved and lovely! In life and in death they were not divided; they were stronger than lions.

verses.english:
Daughters of Israel, Weep over Saul, Who clothed you in crimson
and finery, Who decked your robes with jewels of gold.
verses.hebrew: בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּכֶינָה הַמַּלְבִּשְׁכֶם שָׁנִי עִם־עֲדָנִים הַמַּעֲלֶה עֲדִי זָהָב עַל לְבוּשְׁכֶן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּכֶינָה הַמַּלְבִּשְׁכֶם שָׁנִי עִם־עֲדָנִים הַמַּעֲלֶה עֲדִי זָהָב עַל לְבוּשְׁכֶן׃

english.text:
Daughters of Israel, Weep over Saul, Who clothed you in crimson
and finery, Who decked your robes with jewels of gold.

translation.text: O daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who put ornaments of gold on your apparel.

verses.english:
How have the mighty fallen In the thick of battle— Jonathan, slain
on your heights!
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבֹּרִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָה יְהוֹנָתָן עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל׃

hebrew.text: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבֹּרִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָה יְהוֹנָתָן עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל׃

english.text:
How have the mighty fallen In the thick of battle— Jonathan, slain
on your heights!

translation.text: How the mighty have fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan lies slain upon your high places. I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; greatly beloved were you to me; passing the love of women.

verses.english:
I grieve for you, My brother Jonathan, You were most dear to me.
Your love was wonderful to me More than the love of women.
verses.hebrew: צַר־לִי עָלֶיךָ אָחִי יְהוֹנָתָן נָעַמְתָּ לִּי מְאֹד נִפְלְאַתָה אַהֲבָתְךָ לִי מֵאַהֲבַת נָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: צַר־לִי עָלֶיךָ אָחִי יְהוֹנָתָן נָעַמְתָּ לִּי מְאֹד נִפְלְאַתָה אַהֲבָתְךָ לִי מֵאַהֲבַת נָשִׁים׃

english.text:
I grieve for you, My brother Jonathan, You were most dear to me.
Your love was wonderful to me More than the love of women.

verses.english: How have the mighty fallen, The weapons of war perished!
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים וַיֹּאבְדוּ כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים וַיֹּאבְדוּ כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text: How have the mighty fallen, The weapons of war perished!

translation.text: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

verses.english:
Sometime afterward, David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up to one
of the towns of Judah?” YHWH answered, “Yes.” David further asked,
“Which one shall I go up to?” And YHWH replied, “To Hebron.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה בְּאַחַת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אָנָה אֶעֱלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר חֶבְרֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה בְּאַחַת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אָנָה אֶעֱלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר חֶבְרֹנָה׃

english.text:
Sometime afterward, David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up to one
of the towns of Judah?” YHWH answered, “Yes.” David further asked,
“Which one shall I go up to?” And YHWH replied, “To Hebron.”

translation.text: After this David inquired of the LORD, "Shall I go up into any of the shall I go up?" He said, "To Hebron."

verses.english:
So David went up there, along with his two wives, Ahinoam of
Jezreel and Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל שָׁם דָּוִד וְגַם שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל שָׁם דָּוִד וְגַם שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

english.text:
So David went up there, along with his two wives, Ahinoam of
Jezreel and Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

translation.text: So David went up there, along Nabal of Carmel.

verses.english:
David also took the men who were with him, each with his family,
and they settled in the towns about Hebron.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ הֶעֱלָה דָוִד אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ הֶעֱלָה דָוִד אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
David also took the men who were with him, each with his family,
and they settled in the towns about Hebron.

translation.text: David brought up the men who were with him, every one with his household; and they settled in the towns of Hebron.

verses.english:
The men of Judah came and there they anointed David king over the
House of Judah. David was told about the men of Jabesh-gilead who
buried Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־שָׁם אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר קָבְרוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־שָׁם אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר קָבְרוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The men of Judah came and there they anointed David king over the
House of Judah. David was told about the men of Jabesh-gilead who
buried Saul.

translation.text: Then the people of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. Saul,"

verses.english:
So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to
them, “May you be blessed of YHWH because you performed this act
of faithfulness to your lord Saul and buried him.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֻכִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַחֶסֶד הַזֶּה עִם־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עִם־שָׁאוּל וַתִּקְבְּרוּ
אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֻכִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַחֶסֶד הַזֶּה עִם־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עִם־שָׁאוּל וַתִּקְבְּרוּ
אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to
them, “May you be blessed of YHWH because you performed this act
of faithfulness to your lord Saul and buried him.

translation.text: David sent messengers to the people of Jabesh-gilead, and said loyalty to Saul your lord, and buried him!

verses.english:
May YHWH in turn show you true faithfulness; and I too will reward
you generously because you performed this act.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יַעַשׂ־יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת וְגַם אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יַעַשׂ־יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת וְגַם אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
May YHWH in turn show you true faithfulness; and I too will reward
you generously because you performed this act.

translation.text: Now may the LORD show because you have done this thing.

verses.english:
Now take courage and be brave men; for your lord Saul is dead and
the House of Judah have already anointed me king over them.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יְדֵיכֶם וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חַיִל כִּי־מֵת אֲדֹנֵיכֶם שָׁאוּל וְגַם־אֹתִי מָשְׁחוּ בֵית־יְהוּדָה לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יְדֵיכֶם וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חַיִל כִּי־מֵת אֲדֹנֵיכֶם שָׁאוּל וְגַם־אֹתִי מָשְׁחוּ בֵית־יְהוּדָה לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Now take courage and be brave men; for your lord Saul is dead and
the House of Judah have already anointed me king over them.”

translation.text: Therefore let your hands be Judah has anointed me king over them."

verses.english:
But Abner son of Ner, Saul’s army commander, had taken Ish-bosheth
son of Saul and brought him across to Mahanaim
verses.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צָבָא אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל לָקַח אֶת־אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צָבָא אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל לָקַח אֶת־אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

english.text:
But Abner son of Ner, Saul’s army commander, had taken Ish-bosheth
son of Saul and brought him across to Mahanaim

translation.text: But Abner son of Ner, commander of Saul's army, had taken Ishbaal son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim.

verses.english:
and made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites, Jezreel, Ephraim,
and Benjamin—over all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלִכֵהוּ אֶל־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶל־הָאֲשׁוּרִי וְאֶל־יִזְרְעֶאל וְעַל־אֶפְרַיִם וְעַל־בִּנְיָמִן וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּמְלִכֵהוּ אֶל־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶל־הָאֲשׁוּרִי וְאֶל־יִזְרְעֶאל וְעַל־אֶפְרַיִם וְעַל־בִּנְיָמִן וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה׃

english.text:
and made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites, Jezreel, Ephraim,
and Benjamin—over all Israel.

translation.text: He made him king Israel.

verses.english:
Ish-bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king of
Israel, and he reigned two years. But the House of Judah supported
David.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלָךְ אַךְ בֵּית יְהוּדָה הָיוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלָךְ אַךְ בֵּית יְהוּדָה הָיוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
Ish-bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king of
Israel, and he reigned two years. But the House of Judah supported
David.

translation.text: Ishbaal, Saul's son, was forty years old when he began to followed David.

verses.english:
The length of time that David reigned in Hebron over the House of
Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ בְּחֶבְרוֹן עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ בְּחֶבְרוֹן עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
The length of time that David reigned in Hebron over the House of
Judah was seven years and six months.

translation.text: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

verses.english:
Once Abner son of Ner and the soldiers of Ish-bosheth son of Saul
marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְעַבְדֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל מִמַּחֲנַיִם גִּבְעוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְעַבְדֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל מִמַּחֲנַיִם גִּבְעוֹנָה׃

english.text:
Once Abner son of Ner and the soldiers of Ish-bosheth son of Saul
marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon,

translation.text: Abner son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbaal son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

verses.english:
and Joab son of Zeruiah and the soldiers of David [also] came out.
They confronted one another at the pool of Gibeon: one group sat
on one side of the pool, and the other group on the other side of
the pool.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד יָצְאוּ וַיִּפְגְּשׁוּם עַל־בְּרֵכַת גִּבְעוֹן יַחְדָּו וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד יָצְאוּ וַיִּפְגְּשׁוּם עַל־בְּרֵכַת גִּבְעוֹן יַחְדָּו וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
and Joab son of Zeruiah and the soldiers of David [also] came out.
They confronted one another at the pool of Gibeon: one group sat
on one side of the pool, and the other group on the other side of
the pool.

translation.text: Joab son of Zeruiah, and the servants of pool.

verses.english:
Abner said to Joab, “Let the young men come forward and sport
before us.” “Yes, let them,” Joab answered.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב יָקוּמוּ נָא הַנְּעָרִים וִישַׂחֲקוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב יָקֻמוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב יָקוּמוּ נָא הַנְּעָרִים וִישַׂחֲקוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב יָקֻמוּ׃

english.text:
Abner said to Joab, “Let the young men come forward and sport
before us.” “Yes, let them,” Joab answered.

translation.text: Abner said to Joab, "Let the young men come forward and have a contest before us." Joab said, "Let them come forward."

verses.english:
They came forward and were counted off, twelve for Benjamin and
Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of David’s soldiers.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְמִסְפָּר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְבִנְיָמִן וּלְאִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְמִסְפָּר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְבִנְיָמִן וּלְאִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
They came forward and were counted off, twelve for Benjamin and
Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of David’s soldiers.

translation.text: So Benjamin and Ishbaal son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

verses.english:
Each one grasped his opponent’s head [and thrust] his dagger into
his opponent’s side; thus they fell together. That place, which is
in Gibeon, was called Helkath-hazzurim.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזִקוּ אִישׁ בְּרֹאשׁ רֵעֵהוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ בְּצַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ יַחְדָּו וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא חֶלְקַת הַצֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲזִקוּ אִישׁ בְּרֹאשׁ רֵעֵהוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ בְּצַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ יַחְדָּו וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא חֶלְקַת הַצֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Each one grasped his opponent’s head [and thrust] his dagger into
his opponent’s side; thus they fell together. That place, which is
in Gibeon, was called Helkath-hazzurim.

translation.text: Each grasped his opponent by the head, and thrust his sword in his called Helkath-hazzurim, which is at Gibeon.

verses.english:
A fierce battle ensued that day, and Abner and the men of Israel
were routed by David’s soldiers.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה קָשָׁה עַד־מְאֹד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּנָּגֶף אַבְנֵר וְאַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה קָשָׁה עַד־מְאֹד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּנָּגֶף אַבְנֵר וְאַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
A fierce battle ensued that day, and Abner and the men of Israel
were routed by David’s soldiers.

translation.text: The battle was very servants of David.

verses.english:
The three sons of Zeruiah were there—Joab, Abishai, and Asahel.
Asahel was swift of foot, like a gazelle in the open field.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי וַעֲשָׂהאֵל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל קַל בְּרַגְלָיו כְּאַחַד הַצְּבָיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי וַעֲשָׂהאֵל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל קַל בְּרַגְלָיו כְּאַחַד הַצְּבָיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The three sons of Zeruiah were there—Joab, Abishai, and Asahel.
Asahel was swift of foot, like a gazelle in the open field.

translation.text: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Now Asahel was as swift of foot as a wild gazelle.

verses.english:
And Asahel ran after Abner, swerving neither right nor left in his
pursuit of Abner.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף עֲשָׂהאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְלֹא־נָטָה לָלֶכֶת עַל־הַיָּמִין וְעַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֹּף עֲשָׂהאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְלֹא־נָטָה לָלֶכֶת עַל־הַיָּמִין וְעַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר׃

english.text:
And Asahel ran after Abner, swerving neither right nor left in his
pursuit of Abner.

translation.text: Asahel pursued Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he followed him.

verses.english:
Abner looked back and shouted, “Is that you, Asahel?” “Yes, it
is,” he called back.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַבְנֵר אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אַבְנֵר אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
Abner looked back and shouted, “Is that you, Asahel?” “Yes, it
is,” he called back.

translation.text: Then Abner looked back and said, "Is it you, Asahel?" He answered, "Yes, it is."

verses.english:
Abner said to him, “Turn to the right or to the left, and seize
one of our boys and strip off his tunic.” But Asahel would not
leave off.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַבְנֵר נְטֵה לְךָ עַל־יְמִינְךָ אוֹ עַל־שְׂמֹאלֶךָ וֶאֱחֹז לְךָ אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקַח־לְךָ אֶת־חֲלִצָתוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה עֲשָׂהאֵל לָסוּר מֵאַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַבְנֵר נְטֵה לְךָ עַל־יְמִינְךָ אוֹ עַל־שְׂמֹאלֶךָ וֶאֱחֹז לְךָ אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקַח־לְךָ אֶת־חֲלִצָתוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה עֲשָׂהאֵל לָסוּר מֵאַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Abner said to him, “Turn to the right or to the left, and seize
one of our boys and strip off his tunic.” But Asahel would not
leave off.

translation.text: Abner said to him, "Turn to your right or to your left, not turn away from following him.

verses.english:
Abner again begged Asahel, “Stop pursuing me, or I’ll have to
strike you down. How will I look your brother Joab in the face?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אַבְנֵר לֵאמֹר אֶל־עֲשָׂהאֵל סוּר לְךָ מֵאַחֲרָי לָמָּה אַכֶּכָּה אַרְצָה וְאֵיךְ אֶשָּׂא פָנַי אֶל־יוֹאָב אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אַבְנֵר לֵאמֹר אֶל־עֲשָׂהאֵל סוּר לְךָ מֵאַחֲרָי לָמָּה אַכֶּכָּה אַרְצָה וְאֵיךְ אֶשָּׂא פָנַי אֶל־יוֹאָב אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
Abner again begged Asahel, “Stop pursuing me, or I’ll have to
strike you down. How will I look your brother Joab in the face?”

translation.text: Abner said again to Asahel, "Turn away from following me; why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I show my face to your brother Joab?"

verses.english:
When he refused to desist, Abner struck him in the belly with a
backward thrust of his spear and the spear protruded from his
back. He fell there and died on the spot. And all who came to the
place where Asahel fell and died halted;
verses.hebrew:
וַיְמָאֵן לָסוּר וַיַּכֵּהוּ אַבְנֵר בְּאַחֲרֵי הַחֲנִית אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַתֵּצֵא הַחֲנִית מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּפּל־שָׁם וַיָּמת תַּחְתָּו וַיְהִי כּל־הַבָּא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָפַל
שָׁם עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיָּמֹת וַיַּעֲמֹדוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְמָאֵן לָסוּר וַיַּכֵּהוּ אַבְנֵר בְּאַחֲרֵי הַחֲנִית אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַתֵּצֵא הַחֲנִית מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּפּל־שָׁם וַיָּמת תַּחְתָּו וַיְהִי כּל־הַבָּא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָפַל
שָׁם עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיָּמֹת וַיַּעֲמֹדוּ׃

english.text:
When he refused to desist, Abner struck him in the belly with a
backward thrust of his spear and the spear protruded from his
back. He fell there and died on the spot. And all who came to the
place where Asahel fell and died halted;

translation.text: But he of his spear, so that the spear came out at his back. He fell there, and had fallen and died, stood still.

verses.english:
but Joab and Abishai continued to pursue Abner. And the sun was
setting as they reached the hill of Ammah, which faces Giah on the
road to the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בָּאָה וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ עַד־גִּבְעַת אַמָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי־גִיחַ דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר גִּבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בָּאָה וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ עַד־גִּבְעַת אַמָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי־גִיחַ דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר גִּבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
but Joab and Abishai continued to pursue Abner. And the sun was
setting as they reached the hill of Ammah, which faces Giah on the
road to the wilderness of Gibeon.

translation.text: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. As the sun was going down the wilderness of Gibeon.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites rallied behind Abner, forming a single company;
and they took up a position on the top of a hill.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּהְיוּ לַאֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל רֹאשׁ־גִּבְעָה אֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּהְיוּ לַאֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל רֹאשׁ־גִּבְעָה אֶחָת׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites rallied behind Abner, forming a single company;
and they took up a position on the top of a hill.

translation.text: The Benjaminites rallied around Abner and formed a single band; they took their stand on the top of a hill.

verses.english:
Abner then called out to Joab, “Must the sword devour forever? You
know how bitterly it’s going to end! How long will you delay
ordering your troops to stop the pursuit of their kinsmen?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלָנֶצַח תֹּאכַל חֶרֶב הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתָּה כִּי־מָרָה תִהְיֶה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה וְעַד־מָתַי לֹא־תֹאמַר לָעָם לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי אֲחֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלָנֶצַח תֹּאכַל חֶרֶב הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתָּה כִּי־מָרָה תִהְיֶה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה וְעַד־מָתַי לֹא־תֹאמַר לָעָם לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי אֲחֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Abner then called out to Joab, “Must the sword devour forever? You
know how bitterly it’s going to end! How long will you delay
ordering your troops to stop the pursuit of their kinsmen?”

translation.text: Then Abner called to Joab, "Is the sword to keep devouring forever? kinsmen?"

verses.english:
And Joab replied, “As God lives, if you hadn’t spoken up, the
troops would have given up the pursuit of their kinsmen only the
next morning.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב חַי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לוּלֵא דִּבַּרְתָּ כִּי אָז מֵהַבֹּקֶר נַעֲלָה הָעָם אִישׁ מֵאַחֲרֵי אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב חַי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לוּלֵא דִּבַּרְתָּ כִּי אָז מֵהַבֹּקֶר נַעֲלָה הָעָם אִישׁ מֵאַחֲרֵי אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Joab replied, “As God lives, if you hadn’t spoken up, the
troops would have given up the pursuit of their kinsmen only the
next morning.”

translation.text: Joab said, "As God lives, if you had not spoken, the until morning."

verses.english:
Joab then sounded the horn, and all the troops halted; they ceased
their pursuit of Israel and stopped the fighting.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיַּעַמְדוּ כּל־הָעָם וְלֹא־יִרְדְּפוּ עוֹד אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לְהִלָּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיַּעַמְדוּ כּל־הָעָם וְלֹא־יִרְדְּפוּ עוֹד אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לְהִלָּחֵם׃

english.text:
Joab then sounded the horn, and all the troops halted; they ceased
their pursuit of Israel and stopped the fighting.

translation.text: Joab sounded the trumpet and all the people further.

verses.english:
Abner and his men marched through the Arabah all that night and,
after crossing the Jordan, they marched through all of Bithron
until they came to Mahanaim.
verses.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵר וַאֲנָשָׁיו הָלְכוּ בָּעֲרָבָה כֹּל הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיֵּלְכוּ כּל־הַבִּתְרוֹן וַיָּבֹאוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְנֵר וַאֲנָשָׁיו הָלְכוּ בָּעֲרָבָה כֹּל הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיֵּלְכוּ כּל־הַבִּתְרוֹן וַיָּבֹאוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

english.text:
Abner and his men marched through the Arabah all that night and,
after crossing the Jordan, they marched through all of Bithron
until they came to Mahanaim.

translation.text: Abner and his men traveled all that night through the Arabah; they Mahanaim.

verses.english:
After Joab gave up the pursuit of Abner, he assembled all the
troops and found nineteen of David’s soldiers missing, besides
Asahel.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב שָׁב מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפָּקְדוּ מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד תִּשְׁעָה־עָשָׂר אִישׁ וַעֲשָׂהאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב שָׁב מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפָּקְדוּ מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד תִּשְׁעָה־עָשָׂר אִישׁ וַעֲשָׂהאֵל׃

english.text:
After Joab gave up the pursuit of Abner, he assembled all the
troops and found nineteen of David’s soldiers missing, besides
Asahel.

translation.text: Joab returned from the pursuit of Abner; and when he servants nineteen men besides Asahel.

verses.english:
David’s soldiers, on the other hand, defeated the Benjaminites and
the men under Abner and killed three hundred and sixty men.
verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד הִכּוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן וּבְאַנְשֵׁי אַבְנֵר שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד הִכּוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן וּבְאַנְשֵׁי אַבְנֵר שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵתוּ׃

english.text:
David’s soldiers, on the other hand, defeated the Benjaminites and
the men under Abner and killed three hundred and sixty men.

translation.text: But the servants of David had killed of Benjamin three hundred sixty of Abner's men.

verses.english:
They bore Asahel away and buried him in his father’s tomb in
Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night; day broke upon
them in Hebron.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה יוֹאָב וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיֵּאֹר לָהֶם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה יוֹאָב וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיֵּאֹר לָהֶם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
They bore Asahel away and buried him in his father’s tomb in
Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night; day broke upon
them in Hebron.

translation.text: They took up upon them at Hebron.

verses.english:
The war between the House of Saul and the House of David was
long-drawn-out; but David kept growing stronger, while the House
of Saul grew weaker.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲרֻכָּה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק וּבֵית שָׁאוּל הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲרֻכָּה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק וּבֵית שָׁאוּל הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים׃

english.text:
The war between the House of Saul and the House of David was
long-drawn-out; but David kept growing stronger, while the House
of Saul grew weaker.

translation.text: There was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of became weaker and weaker.

verses.english:
Sons were born to David in Hebron: His first-born was Amnon, by
Ahinoam of Jezreel;
verses.hebrew: (וילדו) [וַיִּוָּלְדוּ] לְדָוִד בָּנִים בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיְהִי בְכוֹרוֹ אַמְנוֹן לַאֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת׃

hebrew.text: (וילדו) [וַיִּוָּלְדוּ] לְדָוִד בָּנִים בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיְהִי בְכוֹרוֹ אַמְנוֹן לַאֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת׃

english.text:
Sons were born to David in Hebron: His first-born was Amnon, by
Ahinoam of Jezreel;

translation.text: Sons were born to David at Hebron: his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ כִלְאָב (לאביגל) [לַאֲבִיגַיִל] אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־מַעֲכָה בַּת־תַּלְמַי מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ כִלְאָב (לאביגל) [לַאֲבִיגַיִל] אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־מַעֲכָה בַּת־תַּלְמַי מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר׃

translation.text: his second, Chileab, of Abigail the widow of Talmai of Geshur;

verses.english:
the fourth was Adonijah son of Haggith; the fifth was Shephatiah
son of Abital;
verses.hebrew: וְהָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית וְהַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן־אֲבִיטָל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית וְהַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן־אֲבִיטָל׃

english.text:
the fourth was Adonijah son of Haggith; the fifth was Shephatiah
son of Abital;

translation.text: the fourth, Adonijah son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah son of Abital;

verses.english:
and the sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These were born
to David in Hebron.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְדָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְדָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
and the sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These were born
to David in Hebron.

translation.text: and the sixth, Ithream, of David's wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.

verses.english:
During the war between the House of Saul and the House of David,
Abner supported the House of Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְאַבְנֵר הָיָה מִתְחַזֵּק בְּבֵית שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְאַבְנֵר הָיָה מִתְחַזֵּק בְּבֵית שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
During the war between the House of Saul and the House of David,
Abner supported the House of Saul.

translation.text: While there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner was making himself strong in the house of Saul.

verses.english:
Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, daughter of Aiah; and
[Ish-bosheth] said to Abner, “Why have you lain with my father’s
concubine?”
verses.hebrew: וּלְשָׁאוּל פִּלֶגֶשׁ וּשְׁמָהּ רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אַבְנֵר מַדּוּעַ בָּאתָה אֶל־פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשָׁאוּל פִּלֶגֶשׁ וּשְׁמָהּ רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אַבְנֵר מַדּוּעַ בָּאתָה אֶל־פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִי׃

english.text:
Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, daughter of Aiah; and
[Ish-bosheth] said to Abner, “Why have you lain with my father’s
concubine?”

translation.text: Now concubine?"

verses.english:
Abner was very upset by what Ish-bosheth said, and he replied, “Am
I a dog’s head from Judah? Here I have been loyally serving the
House of your father Saul and his kinsfolk and friends, and I have
not betrayed you into the hands of David; yet this day you
reproach me over a woman!
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּחַר לְאַבְנֵר מְאֹד עַל־דִּבְרֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הֲרֹאשׁ כֶּלֶב אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה הַיּוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ אֶל־אֶחָיו וְאֶל־מֵרֵעֵהוּ
וְלֹא הִמְצִיתִךָ בְּיַד־דָּוִד וַתִּפְקֹד עָלַי עֲוֺן הָאִשָּׁה הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּחַר לְאַבְנֵר מְאֹד עַל־דִּבְרֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הֲרֹאשׁ כֶּלֶב אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה הַיּוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ אֶל־אֶחָיו וְאֶל־מֵרֵעֵהוּ
וְלֹא הִמְצִיתִךָ בְּיַד־דָּוִד וַתִּפְקֹד עָלַי עֲוֺן הָאִשָּׁה הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
Abner was very upset by what Ish-bosheth said, and he replied, “Am
I a dog’s head from Judah? Here I have been loyally serving the
House of your father Saul and his kinsfolk and friends, and I have
not betrayed you into the hands of David; yet this day you
reproach me over a woman!

Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Here Abner
came to you; why did you let him go? Now he has gotten away!
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָה הִנֵּה־בָא אַבְנֵר אֵלֶיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה שִׁלַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָה הִנֵּה־בָא אַבְנֵר אֵלֶיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה שִׁלַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ׃

english.text:
Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Here Abner
came to you; why did you let him go? Now he has gotten away!

translation.text: Then Joab went to the king and him, so that he got away?

verses.english:
Don’t you know that Abner son of Ner came only to deceive you, to
learn your comings and goings and to find out all that you are
planning?”
verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר כִּי לְפַתֹּתְךָ בָּא וְלָדַעַת אֶת־מוֹצָאֲךָ וְאֶת־[מוֹבָאֶךָ] (מבואך) וְלָדַעַת אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר כִּי לְפַתֹּתְךָ בָּא וְלָדַעַת אֶת־מוֹצָאֲךָ וְאֶת־[מוֹבָאֶךָ] (מבואך) וְלָדַעַת אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

english.text:
Don’t you know that Abner son of Ner came only to deceive you, to
learn your comings and goings and to find out all that you are
planning?”

translation.text: You know that Abner son of Ner came to deceive you, and to learn your comings and goings and to learn all that you are doing."

verses.english:
Joab left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought
him back from the cistern of Sirah; but David knew nothing about
it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב מֵעִם דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ מִבּוֹר הַסִּרָה וְדָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב מֵעִם דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ מִבּוֹר הַסִּרָה וְדָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃

english.text:
Joab left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought
him back from the cistern of Sirah; but David knew nothing about
it.

translation.text: When Joab came out from David's presence, he sent messengers David did not know about it.

verses.english:
When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside within the gate
to talk to him privately; there he struck him in the belly. Thus
[Abner] died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joab’s brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אַבְנֵר חֶבְרוֹן וַיַּטֵּהוּ יוֹאָב אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַשַּׁעַר לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בַּשֶּׁלִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיָּמת בְּדַם עֲשָׂהאֵל אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אַבְנֵר חֶבְרוֹן וַיַּטֵּהוּ יוֹאָב אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַשַּׁעַר לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בַּשֶּׁלִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיָּמת בְּדַם עֲשָׂהאֵל אָחִיו׃

english.text:
When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside within the gate
to talk to him privately; there he struck him in the belly. Thus
[Abner] died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joab’s brother.

translation.text: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab Asahel, Joab's brother.

verses.english:
Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, “Both I and my kingdom
are forever innocent before YHWH of shedding the blood of Abner
son of Ner.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיֹּאמֶר נָקִי אָנֹכִי וּמַמְלַכְתִּי מֵעִם יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם מִדְּמֵי אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיֹּאמֶר נָקִי אָנֹכִי וּמַמְלַכְתִּי מֵעִם יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם מִדְּמֵי אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

english.text:
Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, “Both I and my kingdom
are forever innocent before YHWH of shedding the blood of Abner
son of Ner.

translation.text: Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, of Abner son of Ner.

verses.english:
May [the guilt] fall upon the head of Joab and all his father’s
house. May the house of Joab never be without someone suffering
from a discharge or an eruption, or a male who handles the
spindle, or one slain by the sword, or one lacking bread.”—
verses.hebrew: יָחֻלוּ עַל־רֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וְאֶל כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאַל־יִכָּרֵת מִבֵּית יוֹאָב זָב וּמְצֹרָע וּמַחֲזִיק בַּפֶּלֶךְ וְנֹפֵל בַּחֶרֶב וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: יָחֻלוּ עַל־רֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וְאֶל כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאַל־יִכָּרֵת מִבֵּית יוֹאָב זָב וּמְצֹרָע וּמַחֲזִיק בַּפֶּלֶךְ וְנֹפֵל בַּחֶרֶב וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃

english.text:
May [the guilt] fall upon the head of Joab and all his father’s
house. May the house of Joab never be without someone suffering
from a discharge or an eruption, or a male who handles the
spindle, or one slain by the sword, or one lacking bread.”—

translation.text: May the guilt fall on the head of Joab, and on falls by the sword, or who lacks food!"

verses.english:
Now Joab and his brother Abishai had killed Abner because he had
killed their brother Asahel during the battle at Gibeon.—
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו הָרְגוּ לְאַבְנֵר עַל אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל אֲחִיהֶם בְּגִבְעוֹן בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו הָרְגוּ לְאַבְנֵר עַל אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל אֲחִיהֶם בְּגִבְעוֹן בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Now Joab and his brother Abishai had killed Abner because he had
killed their brother Asahel during the battle at Gibeon.—

translation.text: So Joab and his brother the battle at Gibeon.

verses.english:
David then ordered Joab and all the troops with him to rend their
clothes, gird on sackcloth, and make lament before Abner; and King
David himself walked behind the bier.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב וְאֶל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ קִרְעוּ בִגְדֵיכֶם וְחִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְסִפְדוּ לִפְנֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הַמִּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב וְאֶל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ קִרְעוּ בִגְדֵיכֶם וְחִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְסִפְדוּ לִפְנֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הַמִּטָּה׃

english.text:
David then ordered Joab and all the troops with him to rend their
clothes, gird on sackcloth, and make lament before Abner; and King
David himself walked behind the bier.

translation.text: Then David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, King David followed the bier.

verses.english:
And so they buried Abner at Hebron; the king wept aloud by Abner’s
grave, and all the troops wept.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּשָּׂא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־קוֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ אֶל־קֶבֶר אַבְנֵר וַיִּבְכּוּ כּל־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּשָּׂא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־קוֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ אֶל־קֶבֶר אַבְנֵר וַיִּבְכּוּ כּל־הָעָם׃

english.text:
And so they buried Abner at Hebron; the king wept aloud by Abner’s
grave, and all the troops wept.

translation.text: They buried Abner at Hebron. The people wept.

verses.english:
And the king intoned this dirge over Abner, “Should Abner have
died the death of a churl?
verses.hebrew: וַיְקֹנֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמַר הַכְּמוֹת נָבָל יָמוּת אַבְנֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקֹנֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמַר הַכְּמוֹת נָבָל יָמוּת אַבְנֵר׃

english.text:
And the king intoned this dirge over Abner, “Should Abner have
died the death of a churl?

translation.text: The king lamented for Abner, saying, "Should Abner die as a fool dies?

verses.english:
Your hands were not bound, Your feet were not put in fetters; But
you fell as one falls Before treacherous men!” And all the troops
continued to weep over him.
verses.hebrew: יָדֶךָ לֹא־אֲסֻרוֹת וְרַגְלֶיךָ לֹא־לִנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם הֻגָּשׁוּ כִּנְפוֹל לִפְנֵי בְנֵי־עַוְלָה נָפָלְתָּ וַיֹּסִפוּ כל־הָעָם לִבְכּוֹת עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: יָדֶךָ לֹא־אֲסֻרוֹת וְרַגְלֶיךָ לֹא־לִנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם הֻגָּשׁוּ כִּנְפוֹל לִפְנֵי בְנֵי־עַוְלָה נָפָלְתָּ וַיֹּסִפוּ כל־הָעָם לִבְכּוֹת עָלָיו׃

english.text:
Your hands were not bound, Your feet were not put in fetters; But
you fell as one falls Before treacherous men!” And all the troops
continued to weep over him.

translation.text: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered; you have fallen." And all the people wept over him again.

verses.english:
All the troops came to urge David to eat something while it was
still day; but David swore, “May God do thus to me and more if I
eat bread or anything else before sundown.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא כל־הָעָם לְהַבְרוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֶחֶם בְּעוֹד הַיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי בוֹא־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֶטְעַם־לֶחֶם אוֹ
כל־מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא כל־הָעָם לְהַבְרוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֶחֶם בְּעוֹד הַיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי בוֹא־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֶטְעַם־לֶחֶם אוֹ
כל־מְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
All the troops came to urge David to eat something while it was
still day; but David swore, “May God do thus to me and more if I
eat bread or anything else before sundown.”

translation.text: Then all the people came anything else before the sun goes down!"

verses.english:
All the troops took note of it and approved, just as all the
troops approved everything else the king did.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָעָם הִכִּירוּ וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם טוֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָעָם הִכִּירוּ וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם טוֹב׃

english.text:
All the troops took note of it and approved, just as all the
troops approved everything else the king did.

translation.text: All the people took pleased all the people.

verses.english:
That day all the troops and all Israel knew that it was not by the
king’s will that Abner son of Ner was killed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדְעוּ כל־הָעָם וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה מֵהַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמִית אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדְעוּ כל־הָעָם וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה מֵהַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמִית אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

english.text:
That day all the troops and all Israel knew that it was not by the
king’s will that Abner son of Ner was killed.

translation.text: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that the king had no part in the killing of Abner son of Ner.

verses.english:
And the king said to his soldiers, “You well know that a prince, a
great man in Israel, has fallen this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲלוֹא תֵדְעוּ כִּי־שַׂר וְגָדוֹל נָפַל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲלוֹא תֵדְעוּ כִּי־שַׂר וְגָדוֹל נָפַל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the king said to his soldiers, “You well know that a prince, a
great man in Israel, has fallen this day.

translation.text: And the king said to his servants, "Do you not know that a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?

verses.english:
And today I am weak, even though anointed king; those men, the
sons of Zeruiah, are too savage for me. May YHWH requite the
wicked for their wickedness!”
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם רַךְ וּמָשׁוּחַ מֶלֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה קָשִׁים מִמֶּנִּי יְשַׁלֵּם יְהֹוָה לְעֹשֵׂה הָרָעָה כְּרָעָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם רַךְ וּמָשׁוּחַ מֶלֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה קָשִׁים מִמֶּנִּי יְשַׁלֵּם יְהֹוָה לְעֹשֵׂה הָרָעָה כְּרָעָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And today I am weak, even though anointed king; those men, the
sons of Zeruiah, are too savage for me. May YHWH requite the
wicked for their wickedness!”

translation.text: Today I am powerless, accordance with his wickedness!"

verses.english:
When [Ish-bosheth] son of Saul heard that Abner had died in
Hebron, he lost heart and all Israel was alarmed.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־שָׁאוּל כִּי מֵת אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּרְפּוּ יָדָיו וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִבְהָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־שָׁאוּל כִּי מֵת אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּרְפּוּ יָדָיו וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִבְהָלוּ׃

english.text:
When [Ish-bosheth] son of Saul heard that Abner had died in
Hebron, he lost heart and all Israel was alarmed.

translation.text: When Saul's son Ishbaal heard that Abner had died at Hebron, his courage failed, and all Israel was dismayed.

verses.english:
The son of Saul [had] two company commanders, one named Baanah and
the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite—Benjaminites,
since Beeroth too was considered part of Benjamin.
verses.hebrew:
וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים שָׂרֵי־גְדוּדִים הָיוּ בֶן־שָׁאוּל שֵׁם הָאֶחָד בַּעֲנָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי רֵכָב בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי גַּם־בְּאֵרוֹת תֵּחָשֵׁב
עַל־בִּנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text:
וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים שָׂרֵי־גְדוּדִים הָיוּ בֶן־שָׁאוּל שֵׁם הָאֶחָד בַּעֲנָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי רֵכָב בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי גַּם־בְּאֵרוֹת תֵּחָשֵׁב
עַל־בִּנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
The son of Saul [had] two company commanders, one named Baanah and
the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite—Benjaminites,
since Beeroth too was considered part of Benjamin.

translation.text: Saul's son had two from Beeroth — for Beeroth is considered to belong to Benjamin.

verses.english:
The Beerothites had fled to Gittaim, where they have sojourned to
this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרְחוּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִים גִּתָּיְמָה וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם גָּרִים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרְחוּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִים גִּתָּיְמָה וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם גָּרִים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The Beerothites had fled to Gittaim, where they have sojourned to
this day.

translation.text: resident aliens to this day).

verses.english:
(Jonathan son of Saul had a son whose feet were crippled. He was
five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from
Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled; but as she was
fleeing in haste, he fell and was lamed. His name was
Mephibosheth.)
verses.hebrew:
וְלִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בֵּן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים הָיָה בְּבֹא שְׁמֻעַת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ אֹמַנְתּוֹ וַתָּנֹס וַיְהִי בְּחפְזָהּ
לָנוּס וַיִּפֹּל וַיִּפָּסֵחַ וּשְׁמוֹ מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text:
וְלִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בֵּן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים הָיָה בְּבֹא שְׁמֻעַת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ אֹמַנְתּוֹ וַתָּנֹס וַיְהִי בְּחפְזָהּ
לָנוּס וַיִּפֹּל וַיִּפָּסֵחַ וּשְׁמוֹ מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
(Jonathan son of Saul had a son whose feet were crippled. He was
five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from
Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled; but as she was
fleeing in haste, he fell and was lamed. His name was
Mephibosheth.)

translation.text: Saul's son Jonathan had a son who was crippled in his feet. He was Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled; and, in her haste to flee, it happened that he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

verses.english:
Rechab and Baanah, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, started out, and
they reached the home of Ish-bosheth at the heat of the day, when
he was taking his midday rest.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי רֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם אֶל־בֵּית אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב אֵת מִשְׁכַּב הַצּהֳרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי רֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם אֶל־בֵּית אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב אֵת מִשְׁכַּב הַצּהֳרָיִם׃

english.text:
Rechab and Baanah, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, started out, and
they reached the home of Ish-bosheth at the heat of the day, when
he was taking his midday rest.

translation.text: Now the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, set while he was taking his noonday rest.

verses.english:
So they went inside the house, as though fetching wheat, and
struck him in the belly. Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped by,
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנָּה בָּאוּ עַד־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת לֹקְחֵי חִטִּים וַיַּכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וְרֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה אָחִיו נִמְלָטוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנָּה בָּאוּ עַד־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת לֹקְחֵי חִטִּים וַיַּכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וְרֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה אָחִיו נִמְלָטוּ׃

english.text:
So they went inside the house, as though fetching wheat, and
struck him in the belly. Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped by,

translation.text: They came inside the house as Rechab and his brother Baanah escaped.

verses.english:
and entered the house while he was asleep on his bed in his
bedchamber; and they stabbed him to death. They cut off his head
and took his head and made their way all night through the Arabah.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַבַּיִת וְהוּא־שֹׁכֵב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיַּכֻּהוּ וַיְמִתֻהוּ וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה
כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַבַּיִת וְהוּא־שֹׁכֵב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיַּכֻּהוּ וַיְמִתֻהוּ וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה
כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
and entered the house while he was asleep on his bed in his
bedchamber; and they stabbed him to death. They cut off his head
and took his head and made their way all night through the Arabah.

translation.text: Now they had come into the and traveled by way of the Arabah all night long.

verses.english:
They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David in Hebron. “Here,”
they said to the king, “is the head of your enemy, Ish-bosheth son
of Saul, who sought your life. This day YHWH has avenged my lord
the king upon Saul and his offspring.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֹיִבְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה
לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נְקָמוֹת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִשָּׁאוּל וּמִזַּרְעוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֹיִבְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה
לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נְקָמוֹת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִשָּׁאוּל וּמִזַּרְעוֹ׃

english.text:
They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David in Hebron. “Here,”
they said to the king, “is the head of your enemy, Ish-bosheth son
of Saul, who sought your life. This day YHWH has avenged my lord
the king upon Saul and his offspring.”

translation.text: They brought the offspring."

verses.english:
But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of
Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As YHWH lives, who has
rescued me from every trouble:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־רֵכָב וְאֶת־בַּעֲנָה אָחִיו בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־רֵכָב וְאֶת־בַּעֲנָה אָחִיו בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

english.text:
But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of
Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As YHWH lives, who has
rescued me from every trouble:

translation.text: David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon every adversity,

verses.english:
The man who told me in Ziklag that Saul was dead thought he was
bringing good news. But instead of rewarding him for the news, I
seized and killed him.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַמַּגִּיד לִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־מֵת שָׁאוּל וְהוּא־הָיָה כִמְבַשֵּׂר בְּעֵינָיו וָאֹחֲזָה בוֹ וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ בְּצִקְלָג אֲשֶׁר לְתִתִּי־לוֹ בְּשֹׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַמַּגִּיד לִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־מֵת שָׁאוּל וְהוּא־הָיָה כִמְבַשֵּׂר בְּעֵינָיו וָאֹחֲזָה בוֹ וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ בְּצִקְלָג אֲשֶׁר לְתִתִּי־לוֹ בְּשֹׂרָה׃

english.text:
The man who told me in Ziklag that Saul was dead thought he was
bringing good news. But instead of rewarding him for the news, I
seized and killed him.

translation.text: when the one who told me, 'See, Saul is dead,' Ziklag — this was the reward I gave him for his news.

verses.english:
How much more, then, when wicked men have killed a blameless man
in bed in his own house! I will certainly avenge his blood on you,
and I will rid the earth of you.”
verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אֲנָשִׁים רְשָׁעִים הָרְגוּ אֶת־אִישׁ־צַדִּיק בְּבֵיתוֹ עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְעַתָּה הֲלוֹא אֲבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּמוֹ מִיֶּדְכֶם וּבִעַרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: אַף כִּי־אֲנָשִׁים רְשָׁעִים הָרְגוּ אֶת־אִישׁ־צַדִּיק בְּבֵיתוֹ עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְעַתָּה הֲלוֹא אֲבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּמוֹ מִיֶּדְכֶם וּבִעַרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
How much more, then, when wicked men have killed a blameless man
in bed in his own house! I will certainly avenge his blood on you,
and I will rid the earth of you.”

translation.text: How much and destroy you from the earth?"

verses.english:
David gave orders to the young men, who killed them; they cut off
their hands and feet and hung them up by the pool in Hebron. And
they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the grave of
Abner at Hebron.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו דָּוִד אֶת־הַנְּעָרִים וַיַּהַרְגוּם וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְלוּ עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְאֵת רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת לָקָחוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ
בְקֶבֶר־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו דָּוִד אֶת־הַנְּעָרִים וַיַּהַרְגוּם וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְלוּ עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְאֵת רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת לָקָחוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ
בְקֶבֶר־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
David gave orders to the young men, who killed them; they cut off
their hands and feet and hung them up by the pool in Hebron. And
they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the grave of
Abner at Hebron.

translation.text: So David commanded the young took and buried in the tomb of Abner at Hebron.

verses.english:
All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “We are
your own flesh and blood.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר הִנְנוּ עַצְמְךָ וּבְשָׂרְךָ אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר הִנְנוּ עַצְמְךָ וּבְשָׂרְךָ אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “We are
your own flesh and blood.

translation.text: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and said, "Look, we are your bone and flesh.

verses.english:
Long before now, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led
Israel in war; and YHWH said to you: You shall shepherd My people
Israel; you shall be ruler of Israel.”
verses.hebrew:
גַּם־אֶתְמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁוֹם בִּהְיוֹת שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה (הייתה מוציא) [הָיִיתָ הַמּוֹצִיא] וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לְךָ אַתָּה תִרְעֶה אֶת־עַמִּי
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
גַּם־אֶתְמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁוֹם בִּהְיוֹת שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה (הייתה מוציא) [הָיִיתָ הַמּוֹצִיא] וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לְךָ אַתָּה תִרְעֶה אֶת־עַמִּי
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Long before now, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led
Israel in war; and YHWH said to you: You shall shepherd My people
Israel; you shall be ruler of Israel.”

translation.text: For some time, while Saul was king over you: It is you who shall be shepherd of my people Israel, you who shall be ruler over Israel."

verses.english:
All the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King
David made a pact with them in Hebron before YHWH. And they
anointed David king over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד בְּרִית בְּחֶבְרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד בְּרִית בְּחֶבְרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
All the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King
David made a pact with them in Hebron before YHWH. And they
anointed David king over Israel.

translation.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at the LORD, and they anointed David king over Israel.

verses.english:
David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned
forty years.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה דָּוִד בְּמלְכוֹ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה דָּוִד בְּמלְכוֹ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלָךְ׃

english.text:
David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned
forty years.

translation.text: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

verses.english:
In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in
Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.
verses.hebrew: בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה עַל כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה עַל כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in
Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

translation.text: At Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

verses.english:
The king and his men set out for Jerusalem against the Jebusites
who inhabited the region. David was told, “You will never get in
here! Even the blind and the lame will turn you back.” (They
meant: David will never enter here.)
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנָשָׁיו יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַיְבֻסִי יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־תָבוֹא הֵנָּה כִּי אִם־הֱסִירְךָ הַעִוְרִים וְהַפִּסְחִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָבוֹא
דָוִד הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנָשָׁיו יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַיְבֻסִי יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־תָבוֹא הֵנָּה כִּי אִם־הֱסִירְךָ הַעִוְרִים וְהַפִּסְחִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָבוֹא
דָוִד הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
The king and his men set out for Jerusalem against the Jebusites
who inhabited the region. David was told, “You will never get in
here! Even the blind and the lame will turn you back.” (They
meant: David will never enter here.)

translation.text: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who said to David, "You will not come in here, cannot come in here."

verses.english:
But David captured the stronghold of Zion; it is now the City of
David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד אֵת מְצֻדַת צִיּוֹן הִיא עִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד אֵת מְצֻדַת צִיּוֹן הִיא עִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
But David captured the stronghold of Zion; it is now the City of
David.

translation.text: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion, which is now the city of David.

verses.english:
On that occasion David said, “Those who attack the Jebusites shall
reach the water channel and [strike down] the lame and the blind,
who are hateful to David.” That is why they say: “No one who is
blind or lame may enter the House.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כּל־מַכֵּה יְבֻסִי וְיִגַּע בַּצִּנּוֹר וְאֶת־הַפִּסְחִים וְאֶת־הַעִוְרִים (שנאו) [שְׂנוּאֵי] נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ עִוֵּר וּפִסֵּחַ לֹא
יָבוֹא אֶל־הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כּל־מַכֵּה יְבֻסִי וְיִגַּע בַּצִּנּוֹר וְאֶת־הַפִּסְחִים וְאֶת־הַעִוְרִים (שנאו) [שְׂנוּאֵי] נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ עִוֵּר וּפִסֵּחַ לֹא
יָבוֹא אֶל־הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
On that occasion David said, “Those who attack the Jebusites shall
reach the water channel and [strike down] the lame and the blind,
who are hateful to David.” That is why they say: “No one who is
blind or lame may enter the House.”

translation.text: David had said on that day, shaft to attack the lame and the blind, those whom David hates." house."

verses.english:
David occupied the stronghold and renamed it the City of David;
David also fortified the surrounding area, from the Millo inward.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמְּצֻדָה וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ עִיר דָּוִד וַיִּבֶן דָּוִד סָבִיב מִן־הַמִּלּוֹא וָבָיְתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמְּצֻדָה וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ עִיר דָּוִד וַיִּבֶן דָּוִד סָבִיב מִן־הַמִּלּוֹא וָבָיְתָה׃

english.text:
David occupied the stronghold and renamed it the City of David;
David also fortified the surrounding area, from the Millo inward.

translation.text: David occupied the stronghold, and named it the city of David. David built the city all around from the Millo inward.

verses.english:
David kept growing stronger, for YHWH, the God of Hosts, was with
him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David kept growing stronger, for YHWH, the God of Hosts, was with
him.

translation.text: And with him.

verses.english:
King Hiram of Tyre sent envoys to David with cedar logs,
carpenters, and stonemasons; and they built a palace for David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וְחָרָשֵׁי עֵץ וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן קִיר וַיִּבְנוּ־בַיִת לְדָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וְחָרָשֵׁי עֵץ וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן קִיר וַיִּבְנוּ־בַיִת לְדָוִד׃

english.text:
King Hiram of Tyre sent envoys to David with cedar logs,
carpenters, and stonemasons; and they built a palace for David.

translation.text: King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar trees, and carpenters and masons who built David a house.

verses.english:
Thus David knew that YHWH had established him as king over Israel
and had exalted his kingship for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי־הֱכִינוֹ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי נִשֵּׂא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי־הֱכִינוֹ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי נִשֵּׂא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thus David knew that YHWH had established him as king over Israel
and had exalted his kingship for the sake of His people Israel.

translation.text: David then he had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.

verses.english:
After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in
Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד עוֹד פִּלַגְשִׁים וְנָשִׁים מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אַחֲרֵי בֹּאוֹ מֵחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּוָּלְדוּ עוֹד לְדָוִד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד עוֹד פִּלַגְשִׁים וְנָשִׁים מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אַחֲרֵי בֹּאוֹ מֵחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּוָּלְדוּ עוֹד לְדָוִד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in
Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to David.

translation.text: In Jerusalem, after he came from Hebron, David took more David.

verses.english:
These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem:
Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon;
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיִּלֹּדִים לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיִּלֹּדִים לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem:
Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon;

translation.text: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

verses.english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, and Japhia;
verses.hebrew: וְיִבְחָר וֶאֱלִישׁוּעַ וְנֶפֶג וְיָפִיעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִבְחָר וֶאֱלִישׁוּעַ וְנֶפֶג וְיָפִיעַ׃

english.text: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, and Japhia;

translation.text: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וְאֶלְיָדָע וֶאֱלִיפָלֶט׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וְאֶלְיָדָע וֶאֱלִיפָלֶט׃

english.text: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

translation.text: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

verses.english:
When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over
Israel, the Philistines marched up in search of David; but David
heard of it, and he went down to the fastness.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מָשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מָשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃

english.text:
When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over
Israel, the Philistines marched up in search of David; but David
heard of it, and he went down to the fastness.

translation.text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, all the Philistines went up in search of David; but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

verses.english: The Philistines came and spread out over the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

english.text: The Philistines came and spread out over the Valley of Rephaim.

translation.text: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.english:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up against the Philistines?
Will You deliver them into my hands?” And YHWH answered David, “Go
up, and I will deliver the Philistines into your hands.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה אֶל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיָדִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד עֲלֵה כִּי־נָתֹן אֶתֵּן אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה אֶל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיָדִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד עֲלֵה כִּי־נָתֹן אֶתֵּן אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up against the Philistines?
Will You deliver them into my hands?” And YHWH answered David, “Go
up, and I will deliver the Philistines into your hands.”

translation.text: David inquired of the LORD, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you give them into my Philistines into your hand."

verses.english:
Thereupon David marched to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them
there. And he said, “YHWH has broken through my enemies before me
as waters break through [a dam].” That is why that place was named
Baal-perazim.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד בְּבַעַל־פְּרָצִים וַיַּכֵּם שָׁם דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבַי לְפָנַי כְּפֶרֶץ מָיִם עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בַּעַל פְּרָצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד בְּבַעַל־פְּרָצִים וַיַּכֵּם שָׁם דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבַי לְפָנַי כְּפֶרֶץ מָיִם עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בַּעַל פְּרָצִים׃

english.text:
Thereupon David marched to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them
there. And he said, “YHWH has broken through my enemies before me
as waters break through [a dam].” That is why that place was named
Baal-perazim.

translation.text: So David came to Baal-perazim, and called Baal-perazim.

verses.english:
The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men
carried them off.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ שָׁם אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּשָּׂאֵם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ שָׁם אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּשָּׂאֵם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men
carried them off.

translation.text: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them away.

verses.english:
Once again the Philistines marched up and spread out over the
Valley of Rephaim.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַעֲלוֹת וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַעֲלוֹת וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

english.text:
Once again the Philistines marched up and spread out over the
Valley of Rephaim.

translation.text: Once again the Philistines came up, and were spread out in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.english:
David inquired of YHWH, and He answered, “Do not go up, but circle
around behind them and confront them at the baca trees.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲלֶה הָסֵב אֶל־אַחֲרֵיהֶם וּבָאתָ לָהֶם מִמּוּל בְּכָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲלֶה הָסֵב אֶל־אַחֲרֵיהֶם וּבָאתָ לָהֶם מִמּוּל בְּכָאִים׃

english.text:
David inquired of YHWH, and He answered, “Do not go up, but circle
around behind them and confront them at the baca trees.

translation.text: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, "You the balsam trees.

verses.english:
And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baca
trees, then go into action, for YHWH will be going in front of you
to attack the Philistine forces.”
verses.hebrew: וִיהִי (בשמעך) [כְּשׁמְעֲךָ] אֶת־קוֹל צְעָדָה בְּרָאשֵׁי הַבְּכָאִים אָז תֶּחֱרָץ כִּי אָז יָצָא יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ לְהַכּוֹת בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וִיהִי (בשמעך) [כְּשׁמְעֲךָ] אֶת־קוֹל צְעָדָה בְּרָאשֵׁי הַבְּכָאִים אָז תֶּחֱרָץ כִּי אָז יָצָא יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ לְהַכּוֹת בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baca
trees, then go into action, for YHWH will be going in front of you
to attack the Philistine forces.”

translation.text: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines."

verses.english:
David did as YHWH had commanded him; and he routed the Philistines
from Geba all the way to Gezer.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בֹּאֲךָ גָזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בֹּאֲךָ גָזֶר׃

english.text:
David did as YHWH had commanded him; and he routed the Philistines
from Geba all the way to Gezer.

translation.text: David did Philistines from Geba all the way to Gezer.

verses.english:
David again assembled all the picked men of Israel, thirty
thousand strong.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
David again assembled all the picked men of Israel, thirty
thousand strong.

translation.text: David again gathered all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

verses.english:
Then David and all the troops that were with him set out from
Baalim of Judah to bring up from there the Ark of God to which the
Name was attached, the name LORD of Hosts Enthroned on the
Cherubim.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מִבַּעֲלֵי יְהוּדָה לְהַעֲלוֹת מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שֵׁם שֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מִבַּעֲלֵי יְהוּדָה לְהַעֲלוֹת מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שֵׁם שֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
Then David and all the troops that were with him set out from
Baalim of Judah to bring up from there the Ark of God to which the
Name was attached, the name LORD of Hosts Enthroned on the
Cherubim.

translation.text: the LORD of hosts who is enthroned on the cherubim.

verses.english:
They loaded the Ark of God onto a new cart and conveyed it from
the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Abinadab’s sons,
Uzza and Ahio, guided the new cart.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וְעֻזָּא וְאַחְיוֹ בְּנֵי אֲבִינָדָב נֹהֲגִים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וְעֻזָּא וְאַחְיוֹ בְּנֵי אֲבִינָדָב נֹהֲגִים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה׃

english.text:
They loaded the Ark of God onto a new cart and conveyed it from
the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Abinadab’s sons,
Uzza and Ahio, guided the new cart.

translation.text: They carried the Abinadab, were driving the new cart

verses.english:
They conveyed it from Abinadab’s house on the hill, [Uzza walking]
alongside the Ark of God and Ahio walking in front of the Ark.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַחְיוֹ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַחְיוֹ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן׃

english.text:
They conveyed it from Abinadab’s house on the hill, [Uzza walking]
alongside the Ark of God and Ahio walking in front of the Ark.

translation.text: with the ark of God; and Ahio went in front of the ark.

verses.english:
Meanwhile, David and all the House of Israel danced before YHWH to
[the sound of] all kinds of cypress wood [instruments], with
lyres, harps, timbrels, sistrums, and cymbals.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד וְכל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׂחֲקִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּכֹל עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבִנְבָלִים וּבְתֻפִּים וּבִמְנַעַנְעִים וּבְצֶלְצֱלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד וְכל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׂחֲקִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּכֹל עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבִנְבָלִים וּבְתֻפִּים וּבִמְנַעַנְעִים וּבְצֶלְצֱלִים׃

english.text:
Meanwhile, David and all the House of Israel danced before YHWH to
[the sound of] all kinds of cypress wood [instruments], with
lyres, harps, timbrels, sistrums, and cymbals.

translation.text: David and all the house of Israel were harps and tambourines and castanets and cymbals.

verses.english:
But when they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached
out for the Ark of God and grasped it, for the oxen had stumbled.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־גֹּרֶן נָכוֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּה אֶל־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאחֶז בּוֹ כִּי שָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־גֹּרֶן נָכוֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּה אֶל־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאחֶז בּוֹ כִּי שָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר׃

english.text:
But when they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached
out for the Ark of God and grasped it, for the oxen had stumbled.

translation.text: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached out his hand to the ark of God and took hold of it, for the oxen shook it.

verses.english:
YHWH was incensed at Uzzah. And God struck him down on the spot
for his indiscretion, and he died there beside the Ark of God.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּעֻזָּה וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים עַל־הַשַּׁל וַיָּמת שָׁם עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּעֻזָּה וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים עַל־הַשַּׁל וַיָּמת שָׁם עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
YHWH was incensed at Uzzah. And God struck him down on the spot
for his indiscretion, and he died there beside the Ark of God.

translation.text: beside the ark of God.

verses.english:
David was distressed because YHWH had inflicted a breach upon
Uzzah; and that place was named Perez-uzzah, as it is still
called.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְדָוִד עַל אֲשֶׁר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּעֻזָּה וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְדָוִד עַל אֲשֶׁר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּעֻזָּה וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
David was distressed because YHWH had inflicted a breach upon
Uzzah; and that place was named Perez-uzzah, as it is still
called.

translation.text: David was angry because the LORD had burst forth with an outburst upon Uzzah; so that place is called Perez-uzzah, to this day.

verses.english:
David was afraid of YHWH that day; he said, “How can I let the Ark
of YHWH come to me?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרָא דָוִד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיךְ יָבוֹא אֵלַי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרָא דָוִד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיךְ יָבוֹא אֵלַי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David was afraid of YHWH that day; he said, “How can I let the Ark
of YHWH come to me?”

translation.text: David was afraid of the LORD that day; he said, "How can the ark of the LORD come into my care?"

verses.english:
So David would not bring the Ark of YHWH to his place in the City
of David; instead, David diverted it to the house of Obed-edom the
Gittite.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָבָה דָוִד לְהָסִיר אֵלָיו אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה עַל־עִיר דָּוִד וַיַּטֵּהוּ דָוִד בֵּית עֹבֵד־אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־אָבָה דָוִד לְהָסִיר אֵלָיו אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה עַל־עִיר דָּוִד וַיַּטֵּהוּ דָוִד בֵּית עֹבֵד־אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי׃

english.text:
So David would not bring the Ark of YHWH to his place in the City
of David; instead, David diverted it to the house of Obed-edom the
Gittite.

translation.text: So David was unwilling to take the ark of the LORD into his care in the city of David; instead David took it to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.english:
The Ark of YHWH remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
three months, and YHWH blessed Obed-edom and his whole household.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
The Ark of YHWH remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
three months, and YHWH blessed Obed-edom and his whole household.

translation.text: The ark of the LORD the LORD blessed Obed-edom and all his household.

verses.english:
It was reported to King David: “YHWH has blessed Obed-edom’s house
and all that belongs to him because of the Ark of God.” Thereupon
David went and brought up the Ark of God from the house of
Obed-edom to the City of David, amid rejoicing.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בַּעֲבוּר אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית
עֹבֵד אֱדֹם עִיר דָּוִד בְּשִׂמְחָה׃
