hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא יָשַׁבְתִּי בְּבַיִת לְמִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וָאֶהְיֶה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּאֹהֶל וּבְמִשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
From the day that I brought the people of Israel out of Egypt to
this day I have not dwelt in a house, but have moved about in Tent
and Tabernacle.

translation.text: I have not lived in a house since the day I brought about in a tent and a tabernacle.

verses.english:
As I moved about wherever the Israelites went, did I ever reproach
any of the tribal leaders whom I appointed to care for My people
Israel: Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?
verses.hebrew:
בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲדָבָר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי לִרְעוֹת אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה
לֹא־בְנִיתֶם לִי בֵּית אֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text:
בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲדָבָר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי לִרְעוֹת אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה
לֹא־בְנִיתֶם לִי בֵּית אֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
As I moved about wherever the Israelites went, did I ever reproach
any of the tribal leaders whom I appointed to care for My people
Israel: Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?

translation.text: Wherever I have moved about among all the people of Israel, did I ever speak a word with any of the Israel, saying, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"

verses.english:
“Further, say thus to My servant David: Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I
took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler
of My people Israel,
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כֹּה־תֹאמַר לְעַבְדִּי לְדָוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיךָ מִן־הַנָּוֶה מֵאַחַר הַצֹּאן לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה כֹּה־תֹאמַר לְעַבְדִּי לְדָוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיךָ מִן־הַנָּוֶה מֵאַחַר הַצֹּאן לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Further, say thus to My servant David: Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I
took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler
of My people Israel,

translation.text: Now therefore thus you shall say to my servant David: Thus says the LORD of prince over my people Israel;

verses.english:
and I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut down all
your enemies before you. Moreover, I will give you great renown
like that of the greatest men on earth.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ וָאַכְרִתָה אֶת־כּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וְעָשִׂתִי־לְךָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל כְּשֵׁם הַגְּדֹלִים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ וָאַכְרִתָה אֶת־כּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וְעָשִׂתִי־לְךָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל כְּשֵׁם הַגְּדֹלִים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
and I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut down all
your enemies before you. Moreover, I will give you great renown
like that of the greatest men on earth.

translation.text: and I have been with you wherever you earth.

verses.english:
I will establish a home for My people Israel and will plant them
firm, so that they shall dwell secure and shall tremble no more.
Evil men shall not oppress them any more as in the past,
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי מָקוֹם לְעַמִּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְטַעְתִּיו וְשָׁכַן תַּחְתָּיו וְלֹא יִרְגַּז עוֹד וְלֹא־יֹסִיפוּ בְנֵי־עַוְלָה לְעַנּוֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתִּי מָקוֹם לְעַמִּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְטַעְתִּיו וְשָׁכַן תַּחְתָּיו וְלֹא יִרְגַּז עוֹד וְלֹא־יֹסִיפוּ בְנֵי־עַוְלָה לְעַנּוֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה׃

english.text:
I will establish a home for My people Israel and will plant them
firm, so that they shall dwell secure and shall tremble no more.
Evil men shall not oppress them any more as in the past,

translation.text: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel and will plant more; and evildoers shall afflict them no more, as formerly,

verses.english:
ever since I appointed chieftains over My people Israel. I will
give you safety from all your enemies. “YHWH declares to you that
He, YHWH, will establish a house for you.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי שֹׁפְטִים עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲנִיחֹתִי לְךָ מִכּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהִגִּיד לְךָ יְהֹוָה כִּי־בַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי שֹׁפְטִים עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲנִיחֹתִי לְךָ מִכּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהִגִּיד לְךָ יְהֹוָה כִּי־בַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
ever since I appointed chieftains over My people Israel. I will
give you safety from all your enemies. “YHWH declares to you that
He, YHWH, will establish a house for you.

translation.text: from the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel; and I will give you LORD will make you a house.

verses.english:
When your days are done and you lie with your fathers, I will
raise up your offspring after you, one of your own issue, and I
will establish his kingship.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמְלְאוּ יָמֶיךָ וְשָׁכַבְתָּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִי אֶת־מַמְלַכְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִמְלְאוּ יָמֶיךָ וְשָׁכַבְתָּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִי אֶת־מַמְלַכְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
When your days are done and you lie with your fathers, I will
raise up your offspring after you, one of your own issue, and I
will establish his kingship.

translation.text: When your days are fulfilled and you lie down with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring after you, who shall come forth from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.english:
He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish his royal
throne forever.
verses.hebrew: הוּא יִבְנֶה־בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: הוּא יִבְנֶה־בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish his royal
throne forever.

translation.text: He shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְאָב וְהוּא יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבֵן אֲשֶׁר בְּהַעֲוֺתוֹ וְהֹכַחְתִּיו בְּשֵׁבֶט אֲנָשִׁים וּבְנִגְעֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְאָב וְהוּא יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבֵן אֲשֶׁר בְּהַעֲוֺתוֹ וְהֹכַחְתִּיו בְּשֵׁבֶט אֲנָשִׁים וּבְנִגְעֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

translation.text: I will be a father to him, and he shall be a son to mortals use, with blows inflicted by human beings.

verses.english:
but I will never withdraw My favor from him as I withdrew it from
Saul, whom I removed to make room for you.
verses.hebrew: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־יָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מֵעִם שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־יָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מֵעִם שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
but I will never withdraw My favor from him as I withdrew it from
Saul, whom I removed to make room for you.

translation.text: But I will not away from before you.

verses.english:
Your house and your kingship shall ever be secure before you; your
throne shall be established forever.”
verses.hebrew: וְנֶאְמַן בֵּיתְךָ וּמַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּסְאֲךָ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶאְמַן בֵּיתְךָ וּמַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּסְאֲךָ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Your house and your kingship shall ever be secure before you; your
throne shall be established forever.”

translation.text: Your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me; your throne shall be established forever.

verses.english:
Nathan spoke to David in accordance with all these words and all
this prophecy.
verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הַחִזָּיוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הַחִזָּיוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Nathan spoke to David in accordance with all these words and all
this prophecy.

translation.text: In to David.

verses.english:
Then King David came and sat before YHWH, and he said, “What am I,
O Lord GOD, and what is my family, that You have brought me thus
far?
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֵּשֶׁב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אָנֹכִי אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וּמִי בֵיתִי כִּי הֲבִאֹתַנִי עַד־הֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֵּשֶׁב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אָנֹכִי אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וּמִי בֵיתִי כִּי הֲבִאֹתַנִי עַד־הֲלֹם׃

english.text:
Then King David came and sat before YHWH, and he said, “What am I,
O Lord GOD, and what is my family, that You have brought me thus
far?

translation.text: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD, and said, "Who thus far?

verses.english:
Yet even this, O Lord GOD, has seemed too little to You; for You
have spoken of Your servant’s house also for the future. May that
be the law for the people, O Lord GOD.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְטַן עוֹד זֹאת בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וַתְּדַבֵּר גַּם אֶל־בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְמֵרָחוֹק וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָדָם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְטַן עוֹד זֹאת בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וַתְּדַבֵּר גַּם אֶל־בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְמֵרָחוֹק וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָדָם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

english.text:
Yet even this, O Lord GOD, has seemed too little to You; for You
have spoken of Your servant’s house also for the future. May that
be the law for the people, O Lord GOD.

translation.text: And yet this was a small thing in your eyes, O Lord GOD; come. May this be instruction for the people, O Lord GOD!

verses.english: What more can David say to You? You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.
verses.hebrew: וּמַה־יּוֹסִיף דָּוִד עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

hebrew.text: וּמַה־יּוֹסִיף דָּוִד עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

english.text: What more can David say to You? You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.

translation.text: And what more can David say to you? For you know your servant, O Lord GOD!

verses.english:
For Your word’s sake and of Your own accord You have wrought this
great thing, and made it known to Your servant.
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר דְּבָרְךָ וּכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כּל־הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: בַּעֲבוּר דְּבָרְךָ וּכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כּל־הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
For Your word’s sake and of Your own accord You have wrought this
great thing, and made it known to Your servant.

translation.text: wrought all this greatness, so that your servant may know it.

verses.english:
You are great indeed, O Lord GOD! There is none like You and there
is no other God but You, as we have always heard.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן גָּדַלְתָּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים כִּי־אֵין כָּמוֹךָ וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּאזְנֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל־כֵּן גָּדַלְתָּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים כִּי־אֵין כָּמוֹךָ וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּאזְנֵינוּ׃

english.text:
You are great indeed, O Lord GOD! There is none like You and there
is no other God but You, as we have always heard.

translation.text: our ears.

verses.english:
And who is like Your people Israel, a unique nation on earth, whom
God went and redeemed as His people, winning renown for Himself
and doing great and marvelous deeds for them [and] for Your
land—[driving out] nations and their gods before Your people, whom
You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.
verses.hebrew:
וּמִי כְעַמְּךָ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ־אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת־לוֹ לְעָם וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שֵׁם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לָכֶם הַגְּדוּלָּה וְנֹרָאוֹת לְאַרְצֶךָ מִפְּנֵי
עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ לְּךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם גּוֹיִם וֵאלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וּמִי כְעַמְּךָ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ־אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת־לוֹ לְעָם וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שֵׁם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לָכֶם הַגְּדוּלָּה וְנֹרָאוֹת לְאַרְצֶךָ מִפְּנֵי
עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ לְּךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם גּוֹיִם וֵאלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
And who is like Your people Israel, a unique nation on earth, whom
God went and redeemed as His people, winning renown for Himself
and doing great and marvelous deeds for them [and] for Your
land—[driving out] nations and their gods before Your people, whom
You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.

translation.text: Who is like your people, like Israel? Is there another nation driving out before his people nations and their gods?

verses.english:
You have established Your people Israel as Your very own people
forever; and You, O LORD, have become their God.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּכוֹנֵן לְךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ לְעָם עַד־עוֹלָם וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָיִיתָ לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּכוֹנֵן לְךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ לְעָם עַד־עוֹלָם וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָיִיתָ לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
You have established Your people Israel as Your very own people
forever; and You, O LORD, have become their God.

translation.text: And you established your people Israel for yourself to be your people forever; and you, O LORD, became their God.

verses.english:
“And now, O LORD God, fulfill Your promise to Your servant and his
house forever; and do as You have promised.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ עַל־עַבְדְּךָ וְעַל־בֵּיתוֹ הָקֵם עַד־עוֹלָם וַעֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ עַל־עַבְדְּךָ וְעַל־בֵּיתוֹ הָקֵם עַד־עוֹלָם וַעֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
“And now, O LORD God, fulfill Your promise to Your servant and his
house forever; and do as You have promised.

translation.text: And now, O LORD God, as for concerning his house, confirm it forever; do as you have promised.

verses.english:
And may Your name be glorified forever, in that men will say,
‘YHWH of Hosts is God over Israel’; and may the house of Your
servant David be established before You.
verses.hebrew: וְיִגְדַּל שִׁמְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִגְדַּל שִׁמְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And may Your name be glorified forever, in that men will say,
‘YHWH of Hosts is God over Israel’; and may the house of Your
servant David be established before You.

translation.text: established before you.

verses.english:
Because You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed to
Your servant that You will build a house for him, Your servant has
ventured to offer this prayer to You.
verses.hebrew:
כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גָּלִיתָה אֶת־אֹזֶן עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר בַּיִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּךְ עַל־כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־לִבּוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּה
הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גָּלִיתָה אֶת־אֹזֶן עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר בַּיִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּךְ עַל־כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־לִבּוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּה
הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Because You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed to
Your servant that You will build a house for him, Your servant has
ventured to offer this prayer to You.

translation.text: For you, O LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, house'; therefore your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.

verses.english:
And now, O Lord GOD, You are God and Your words will surely come
true, and You have made this gracious promise to Your servant.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּדְבָרֶיךָ יִהְיוּ אֱמֶת וַתְּדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּדְבָרֶיךָ יִהְיוּ אֱמֶת וַתְּדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And now, O Lord GOD, You are God and Your words will surely come
true, and You have made this gracious promise to Your servant.

translation.text: And now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are true, and you have promised this good thing to your servant;

verses.english:
Be pleased, therefore, to bless Your servant’s house, that it
abide before You forever; for You, O Lord GOD, have spoken. May
Your servant’s house be blessed forever by Your blessing.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הוֹאֵל וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית עַבְדְּךָ לִהְיוֹת לְעוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה דִּבַּרְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָתְךָ יְבֹרַךְ בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הוֹאֵל וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית עַבְדְּךָ לִהְיוֹת לְעוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה דִּבַּרְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָתְךָ יְבֹרַךְ בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Be pleased, therefore, to bless Your servant’s house, that it
abide before You forever; for You, O Lord GOD, have spoken. May
Your servant’s house be blessed forever by Your blessing.”

translation.text: now therefore may it please you to bless the house of your servant, so that forever."

verses.english:
Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued
them; and David took Metheg-ammah from the Philistines.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכְנִיעֵם וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכְנִיעֵם וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued
them; and David took Metheg-ammah from the Philistines.

translation.text: Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued them; David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.english:
He also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground
and he measured them off with a cord; he measured out two lengths
of cord for those who were to be put to death, and one length for
those to be spared. And the Moabites became tributary vassals of
David.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּךְ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיְמַדְּדֵם בַּחֶבֶל הַשְׁכֵּב אוֹתָם אַרְצָה וַיְמַדֵּד שְׁנֵי־חֲבָלִים לְהָמִית וּמְלֹא הַחֶבֶל לְהַחֲיוֹת וַתְּהִי מוֹאָב לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נֹשְׂאֵי
מִנְחָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּךְ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיְמַדְּדֵם בַּחֶבֶל הַשְׁכֵּב אוֹתָם אַרְצָה וַיְמַדֵּד שְׁנֵי־חֲבָלִים לְהָמִית וּמְלֹא הַחֶבֶל לְהַחֲיוֹת וַתְּהִי מוֹאָב לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נֹשְׂאֵי
מִנְחָה׃

english.text:
He also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground
and he measured them off with a cord; he measured out two lengths
of cord for those who were to be put to death, and one length for
those to be spared. And the Moabites became tributary vassals of
David.

translation.text: He also defeated the Moabites and, making them lie down on the and brought tribute.

verses.english:
David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who was then
on his way to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהָשִׁיב יָדוֹ (בנהר) [בִּנְהַר־פְּרָת]׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהָשִׁיב יָדוֹ (בנהר) [בִּנְהַר־פְּרָת]׃

english.text:
David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who was then
on his way to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.

translation.text: David also struck down King Hadadezer son of Rehob of Zobah, as he went to restore his monument at the river Euphrates.

verses.english:
David captured 1,700 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers of his
force; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except for 100
which he retained.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד מִמֶּנּוּ אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת פָּרָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי וַיְעַקֵּר דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וַיּוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מֵאָה רָכֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד מִמֶּנּוּ אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת פָּרָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי וַיְעַקֵּר דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וַיּוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מֵאָה רָכֶב׃

english.text:
David captured 1,700 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers of his
force; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except for 100
which he retained.

translation.text: David took thousand foot soldiers. David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough for a hundred chariots.

verses.english:
And when the Arameans of Damascus came to the aid of King
Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 of the Arameans.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק לַעְזֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה וַיַּךְ דָּוִד בַּאֲרָם עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא אֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק לַעְזֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה וַיַּךְ דָּוִד בַּאֲרָם עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
And when the Arameans of Damascus came to the aid of King
Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 of the Arameans.

translation.text: When the Arameans of Damascus thousand men of the Arameans.

verses.english:
David stationed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans
became tributary vassals of David. YHWH gave David victory
wherever he went.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד נְצִבִים בַּאֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַתְּהִי אֲרָם לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נוֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָה וַיֹּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד נְצִבִים בַּאֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַתְּהִי אֲרָם לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נוֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָה וַיֹּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

english.text:
David stationed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans
became tributary vassals of David. YHWH gave David victory
wherever he went.

translation.text: Then David put garrisons among the and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

verses.english:
David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s retinue and
brought them to Jerusalem;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ אֶל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ אֶל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s retinue and
brought them to Jerusalem;

translation.text: David took the gold shields that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
and from Betah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a
vast amount of copper.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבֶּטַח וּמִבֵּרֹתַי עָרֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר לָקַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד נְחֹשֶׁת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבֶּטַח וּמִבֵּרֹתַי עָרֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר לָקַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד נְחֹשֶׁת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
and from Betah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a
vast amount of copper.

translation.text: From Betah and from bronze.

verses.english:
When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire
army of Hadadezer,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע תֹּעִי מֶלֶךְ חֲמָת כִּי הִכָּה דָוִד אֵת כּל־חֵיל הֲדַדְעָזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע תֹּעִי מֶלֶךְ חֲמָת כִּי הִכָּה דָוִד אֵת כּל־חֵיל הֲדַדְעָזֶר׃

english.text:
When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire
army of Hadadezer,

translation.text: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer,

verses.english:
Toi sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and to
congratulate him on his military victory over Hadadezer—for
Hadadezer had been at war with Toi. [Joram] brought with him
objects of silver, gold, and copper.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח תֹּעִי אֶת־יוֹרָם־בְּנוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד לִשְׁאל־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם וּלְבָרְכוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם בַּהֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיַּכֵּהוּ כִּי־אִישׁ מִלְחֲמוֹת תֹּעִי הָיָה
הֲדַדְעָזֶר וּבְיָדוֹ הָיוּ כְּלֵי־כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי־זָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח תֹּעִי אֶת־יוֹרָם־בְּנוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד לִשְׁאל־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם וּלְבָרְכוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם בַּהֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיַּכֵּהוּ כִּי־אִישׁ מִלְחֲמוֹת תֹּעִי הָיָה
הֲדַדְעָזֶר וּבְיָדוֹ הָיוּ כְּלֵי־כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי־זָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Toi sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and to
congratulate him on his military victory over Hadadezer—for
Hadadezer had been at war with Toi. [Joram] brought with him
objects of silver, gold, and copper.

translation.text: Toi sent his son Joram to King David, to greet with Toi. Joram brought with him articles of silver, gold, and bronze;

verses.english:
King David dedicated these to YHWH, along with the other silver
and gold that he dedicated, [taken] from all the nations he had
conquered:
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֹתָם הִקְדִּישׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה עִם־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּישׁ מִכּל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר כִּבֵּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־אֹתָם הִקְדִּישׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה עִם־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּישׁ מִכּל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר כִּבֵּשׁ׃

english.text:
King David dedicated these to YHWH, along with the other silver
and gold that he dedicated, [taken] from all the nations he had
conquered:

translation.text: and gold that he dedicated from all the nations he subdued,

verses.english:
from Edom, Moab, and Ammon; from the Philistines and the
Amalekites, and from the plunder of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king
of Zobah.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֲרָם וּמִמּוֹאָב וּמִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵעֲמָלֵק וּמִשְּׁלַל הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֲרָם וּמִמּוֹאָב וּמִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵעֲמָלֵק וּמִשְּׁלַל הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה׃

english.text:
from Edom, Moab, and Ammon; from the Philistines and the
Amalekites, and from the plunder of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king
of Zobah.

translation.text: from spoil of King Hadadezer son of Rehob of Zobah.

verses.english:
David gained fame when he returned from defeating Edom in the
Valley of Salt, 18,000 in all.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד שֵׁם בְּשֻׁבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹתוֹ אֶת־אֲרָם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד שֵׁם בְּשֻׁבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹתוֹ אֶת־אֲרָם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

english.text:
David gained fame when he returned from defeating Edom in the
Valley of Salt, 18,000 in all.

translation.text: David won a name for himself. When he returned, he killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

verses.english:
He stationed garrisons in Edom—he stationed garrisons in all of
Edom —and all the Edomites became vassals of David. YHWH gave
David victory wherever he went.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם בֶּאֱדוֹם נְצִבִים בְּכל־אֱדוֹם שָׂם נְצִבִים וַיְהִי כל־אֱדוֹם עֲבָדִים לְדָוִד וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם בֶּאֱדוֹם נְצִבִים בְּכל־אֱדוֹם שָׂם נְצִבִים וַיְהִי כל־אֱדוֹם עֲבָדִים לְדָוִד וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

english.text:
He stationed garrisons in Edom—he stationed garrisons in all of
Edom —and all the Edomites became vassals of David. YHWH gave
David victory wherever he went.

translation.text: He put garrisons in Edom; David's servants. And the LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

verses.english:
David reigned over all Israel, and David executed true justice
among all his people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלֹךְ דָּוִד עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי דָוִד עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה לְכל־עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ דָּוִד עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי דָוִד עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה לְכל־עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David reigned over all Israel, and David executed true justice
among all his people.

translation.text: So David reigned over all Israel; and David administered justice and equity to all his people.

verses.english:
Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army; Jehoshaphat son of
Ahilud was recorder;
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה עַל־הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה עַל־הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּיר׃

english.text:
Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army; Jehoshaphat son of
Ahilud was recorder;

translation.text: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.english:
Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests;
Seraiah was scribe;
verses.hebrew: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וּשְׂרָיָה סוֹפֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וּשְׂרָיָה סוֹפֵר׃

english.text:
Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests;
Seraiah was scribe;

translation.text: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;

verses.english:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the
Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיוּ׃

english.text:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the
Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.

translation.text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were priests.

verses.english:
David inquired, “Is there anyone still left of the House of Saul
with whom I can keep faith for the sake of Jonathan?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲכִי יֶשׁ־עוֹד אֲשֶׁר נוֹתַר לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲכִי יֶשׁ־עוֹד אֲשֶׁר נוֹתַר לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
David inquired, “Is there anyone still left of the House of Saul
with whom I can keep faith for the sake of Jonathan?”

translation.text: David asked, "Is there still anyone left of the house of Saul to whom I may show kindness for Jonathan's sake?"

verses.english:
There was a servant of the House of Saul named Ziba, and they
summoned him to David. “Are you Ziba?” the king asked him. “Yes,
sir,” he replied.
verses.hebrew: וּלְבֵית שָׁאוּל עֶבֶד וּשְׁמוֹ צִיבָא וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה צִיבָא וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְבֵית שָׁאוּל עֶבֶד וּשְׁמוֹ צִיבָא וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה צִיבָא וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
There was a servant of the House of Saul named Ziba, and they
summoned him to David. “Are you Ziba?” the king asked him. “Yes,
sir,” he replied.

translation.text: Now there was a servant of service!"

verses.english:
The king continued, “Is there anyone at all left of the House of
Saul with whom I can keep faith as pledged before God?” Ziba
answered the king, “Yes, there is still a son of Jonathan whose
feet are crippled.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַאֶפֶס עוֹד אִישׁ לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עוֹד בֵּן לִיהוֹנָתָן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַאֶפֶס עוֹד אִישׁ לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עוֹד בֵּן לִיהוֹנָתָן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם׃

english.text:
The king continued, “Is there anyone at all left of the House of
Saul with whom I can keep faith as pledged before God?” Ziba
answered the king, “Yes, there is still a son of Jonathan whose
feet are crippled.”

translation.text: The king said, "Is there anyone remaining of the house of "There remains a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in his feet."

verses.english:
“Where is he?” the king asked, and Ziba said to the king, “He is
in the house of Machir son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵיפֹה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־הוּא בֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל בְּלוֹ דְבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵיפֹה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־הוּא בֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל בְּלוֹ דְבָר׃

english.text:
“Where is he?” the king asked, and Ziba said to the king, “He is
in the house of Machir son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.”

translation.text: The king said to him, "Where is he?" Ziba said to the king, "He is in the house of Machir son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar."

verses.english:
King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel,
at Lo-debar;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִבֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלּוֹ דְבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִבֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלּוֹ דְבָר׃

english.text:
King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel,
at Lo-debar;

translation.text: Then King David sent and brought him from the house of Machir son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar.

verses.english:
and when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul came to David,
he flung himself on his face and prostrated himself. David said,
“Mephibosheth!” and he replied, “At your service, sir.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
and when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul came to David,
he flung himself on his face and prostrated himself. David said,
“Mephibosheth!” and he replied, “At your service, sir.”

translation.text: "I am your servant."

verses.english:
David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will keep faith with
you for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will give you back all
the land of your grandfather Saul; moreover, you shall always eat
at my table.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד אַל־תִּירָא כִּי עָשֹׂה אֶעֱשֶׂה עִמְּךָ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן אָבִיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי לְךָ אֶת־כּל־שְׂדֵה שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ וְאַתָּה תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם
עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד אַל־תִּירָא כִּי עָשֹׂה אֶעֱשֶׂה עִמְּךָ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן אָבִיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי לְךָ אֶת־כּל־שְׂדֵה שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ וְאַתָּה תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם
עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will keep faith with
you for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will give you back all
the land of your grandfather Saul; moreover, you shall always eat
at my table.”

translation.text: David said to him, "Do not be afraid, for I will to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you yourself shall eat at my table always."

verses.english:
[Mephibosheth] prostrated himself again, and said, “What is your
servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”

rear. So he made a selection from all the picked men of Israel and
arrayed them against the Arameans,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹאָב כִּי־הָיְתָה אֵלָיו פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִפָּנִים וּמֵאָחוֹר וַיִּבְחַר מִכֹּל בְּחוּרֵי (בישראל) [יִשְׂרָאֵל] וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹאָב כִּי־הָיְתָה אֵלָיו פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִפָּנִים וּמֵאָחוֹר וַיִּבְחַר מִכֹּל בְּחוּרֵי (בישראל) [יִשְׂרָאֵל] וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת אֲרָם׃

english.text:
Joab saw that there was a battle line against him both front and
rear. So he made a selection from all the picked men of Israel and
arrayed them against the Arameans,

translation.text: When Joab saw that the battle was set against him both in front and them against the Arameans;

verses.english:
and the rest of the troops he put under the command of his brother
Abishai and arrayed them against the Ammonites.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
and the rest of the troops he put under the command of his brother
Abishai and arrayed them against the Ammonites.

translation.text: the rest of his men he put in the charge of his brother Abishai, and he arrayed them against the Ammonites.

verses.english:
[Joab] said, “If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you come to
my aid; and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, I will come
to your aid.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַק אֲרָם מִמֶּנִּי וְהָיִתָה לִּי לִישׁוּעָה וְאִם־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן יֶחֶזְקוּ מִמְּךָ וְהָלַכְתִּי לְהוֹשִׁיעַ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַק אֲרָם מִמֶּנִּי וְהָיִתָה לִּי לִישׁוּעָה וְאִם־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן יֶחֶזְקוּ מִמְּךָ וְהָלַכְתִּי לְהוֹשִׁיעַ לָךְ׃

english.text:
[Joab] said, “If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you come to
my aid; and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, I will come
to your aid.

translation.text: help you.

verses.english:
Let us be strong and resolute for the sake of our people and the
land of our God; and YHWH will do what He deems right.”
verses.hebrew: חֲזַק וְנִתְחַזַּק בְּעַד־עַמֵּנוּ וּבְעַד עָרֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה יַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: חֲזַק וְנִתְחַזַּק בְּעַד־עַמֵּנוּ וּבְעַד עָרֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה יַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
Let us be strong and resolute for the sake of our people and the
land of our God; and YHWH will do what He deems right.”

translation.text: Be strong, and let us be courageous for the sake of our good to him."

verses.english:
Joab and the troops with him marched into battle against the
Arameans, who fled before him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה בַּאֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה בַּאֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
Joab and the troops with him marched into battle against the
Arameans, who fled before him.

translation.text: So Joab and the people who were with him moved forward into battle against the Arameans; and they fled before him.

verses.english:
And when the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they fled
before Abishai and withdrew into the city. So Joab broke off the
attack against the Ammonites, and went to Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן רָאוּ כִּי־נָס אֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵי אֲבִישַׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיָּשׁב יוֹאָב מֵעַל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן רָאוּ כִּי־נָס אֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵי אֲבִישַׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיָּשׁב יוֹאָב מֵעַל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
And when the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they fled
before Abishai and withdrew into the city. So Joab broke off the
attack against the Ammonites, and went to Jerusalem.

translation.text: against the Ammonites, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
When the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they
regrouped their forces.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֲרָם כִּי נִגַּף לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּאָסְפוּ יָחַד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֲרָם כִּי נִגַּף לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּאָסְפוּ יָחַד׃

english.text:
When the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they
regrouped their forces.

translation.text: But when the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

verses.english:
Hadadezer sent for and brought out the Arameans from across the
Euphrates; they came to Helam, led by Shobach, Hadadezer’s army
commander.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־אֲרָם אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וַיָּבֹאוּ חֵילָם וְשׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָא הֲדַדְעֶזֶר לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־אֲרָם אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וַיָּבֹאוּ חֵילָם וְשׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָא הֲדַדְעֶזֶר לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Hadadezer sent for and brought out the Arameans from across the
Euphrates; they came to Helam, led by Shobach, Hadadezer’s army
commander.

translation.text: Hadadezer sent and brought their head.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיָּבֹא חֵלָאמָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֲרָם לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיָּבֹא חֵלָאמָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֲרָם לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִמּוֹ׃

translation.text: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, themselves against David and fought with him.

verses.english:
but the Arameans were put to flight by Israel. David killed 700
Aramean charioteers and 40,000 horsemen; he also struck down
Shobach, Hadadezer’s army commander, who died there.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּנס אֲרָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד מֵאֲרָם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת שׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ הִכָּה וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנס אֲרָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד מֵאֲרָם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת שׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ הִכָּה וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
but the Arameans were put to flight by Israel. David killed 700
Aramean charioteers and 40,000 horsemen; he also struck down
Shobach, Hadadezer’s army commander, who died there.

translation.text: The Arameans fled commander of their army, so that he died there.

verses.english:
And when all the vassal kings of Hadadezer saw that they had been
routed by Israel, they submitted to Israel and became their
vassals. And the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites any
more.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ כל־הַמְּלָכִים עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעֶזֶר כִּי נִגְּפוּ לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁלִמוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַבְדוּם וַיִּרְאוּ אֲרָם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ עוֹד אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ כל־הַמְּלָכִים עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעֶזֶר כִּי נִגְּפוּ לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁלִמוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַבְדוּם וַיִּרְאוּ אֲרָם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ עוֹד אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And when all the vassal kings of Hadadezer saw that they had been
routed by Israel, they submitted to Israel and became their
vassals. And the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites any
more.

translation.text: When all the kings Israel, they made peace with Israel, and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites any more.

verses.english:
At the turn of the year, the season when kings go out [to battle],
David sent Joab with his officers and all Israel with him, and
they devastated Ammon and besieged Rabbah; David remained in
Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה לְעֵת צֵאת הַמְּלָאכִים וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וְאֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִתוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ
עַל־רַבָּה וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה לְעֵת צֵאת הַמְּלָאכִים וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וְאֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִתוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ
עַל־רַבָּה וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם

english.text:
At the turn of the year, the season when kings go out [to battle],
David sent Joab with his officers and all Israel with him, and
they devastated Ammon and besieged Rabbah; David remained in
Jerusalem.

translation.text: In the spring of the year, the time when kings go out to battle, David Ammonites, and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem.

verses.english:
Late one afternoon, David rose from his couch and strolled on the
roof of the royal palace; and from the roof he saw a woman
bathing. The woman was very beautiful,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת הָעֶרֶב וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵעַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ עַל־גַּג בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה רֹחֶצֶת מֵעַל הַגָּג וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לְעֵת הָעֶרֶב וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵעַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ עַל־גַּג בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה רֹחֶצֶת מֵעַל הַגָּג וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Late one afternoon, David rose from his couch and strolled on the
roof of the royal palace; and from the roof he saw a woman
bathing. The woman was very beautiful,

translation.text: It happened, late one afternoon, when David rose from his couch and the roof a woman bathing; the woman was very beautiful.

verses.english:
and the king sent someone to make inquiries about the woman. He
reported, “She is Bathsheba daughter of Eliam [and] wife of Uriah
the Hittite.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיִּדְרֹשׁ לָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא־זֹאת בַּת־שֶׁבַע בַּת־אֱלִיעָם אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיִּדְרֹשׁ לָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא־זֹאת בַּת־שֶׁבַע בַּת־אֱלִיעָם אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃

english.text:
and the king sent someone to make inquiries about the woman. He
reported, “She is Bathsheba daughter of Eliam [and] wife of Uriah
the Hittite.”

translation.text: David sent Bathsheba daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite."

verses.english:
David sent messengers to fetch her; she came to him and he lay
with her—she had just purified herself after her period—and she
went back home.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וְהִיא מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת מִטֻּמְאָתָהּ וַתָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וְהִיא מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת מִטֻּמְאָתָהּ וַתָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ׃

english.text:
David sent messengers to fetch her; she came to him and he lay
with her—she had just purified herself after her period—and she
went back home.

translation.text: So David sent messengers to get her, and she came to him, and he lay with her. her house.

verses.english: The woman conceived, and she sent word to David, “I am pregnant.”
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד וַתֹּאמֶר הָרָה אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד וַתֹּאמֶר הָרָה אָנֹכִי׃

english.text: The woman conceived, and she sent word to David, “I am pregnant.”

translation.text: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, "I am pregnant."

verses.english:
Thereupon David sent a message to Joab, “Send Uriah the Hittite to
me”; and Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב שְׁלַח אֵלַי אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב שְׁלַח אֵלַי אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Thereupon David sent a message to Joab, “Send Uriah the Hittite to
me”; and Joab sent Uriah to David.

translation.text: So David sent word to Joab, "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.english:
When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab and the troops
were faring and how the war was going.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אוּרִיָּה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד לִשְׁלוֹם יוֹאָב וְלִשְׁלוֹם הָעָם וְלִשְׁלוֹם הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אוּרִיָּה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד לִשְׁלוֹם יוֹאָב וְלִשְׁלוֹם הָעָם וְלִשְׁלוֹם הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab and the troops

verses.english:
Then David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and bathe your
feet.” When Uriah left the royal palace, a present from the king
followed him.

said to Uriah, “You just came from a journey; why didn’t you go
down to your house?”

Uriah answered David, “The Ark and Israel and Judah are located at

the open; how can I go home and eat and drink and sleep with my
wife? As you live, by your very life, I will not do this!”
