verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְדָוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְדָוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יוֹאָב׃

english.text:
The messenger set out; he came and told David all that Joab had
sent him to say.

translation.text: So the messenger went, and came and told David all that Joab had sent him to tell.

verses.english:
The messenger said to David, “First the men prevailed against us
and sallied out against us into the open; then we drove them back
up to the entrance to the gate.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמַּלְאָךְ אֶל־דָּוִד כִּי־גָבְרוּ עָלֵינוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּצְאוּ אֵלֵינוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וַנִּהְיֶה עֲלֵיהֶם עַד־פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמַּלְאָךְ אֶל־דָּוִד כִּי־גָבְרוּ עָלֵינוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּצְאוּ אֵלֵינוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וַנִּהְיֶה עֲלֵיהֶם עַד־פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר׃

english.text:
The messenger said to David, “First the men prevailed against us
and sallied out against us into the open; then we drove them back
up to the entrance to the gate.

translation.text: The messenger said to David, "The men gained an them back to the entrance of the gate.

verses.english:
But the archers shot at your men from the wall and some of Your
Majesty’s men fell; your servant Uriah the Hittite also fell.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּראוּ הַמּוֹרִאים אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ מֵעַל הַחוֹמָה וַיָּמוּתוּ מֵעַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם עַבְדְּךָ אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּראוּ הַמּוֹרִאים אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ מֵעַל הַחוֹמָה וַיָּמוּתוּ מֵעַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם עַבְדְּךָ אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי מֵת׃

english.text:
But the archers shot at your men from the wall and some of Your
Majesty’s men fell; your servant Uriah the Hittite also fell.”

translation.text: Then the archers shot at your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also."

verses.english:
Whereupon David said to the messenger, “Give Joab this message:
‘Do not be distressed about the matter. The sword always takes its
toll. Press your attack on the city and destroy it!’ Encourage
him!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַמַּלְאָךְ כֹּה־תֹאמַר אֶל־יוֹאָב אַל־יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי־כָזֹה וְכָזֶה תֹּאכַל הֶחָרֶב הַחֲזֵק מִלְחַמְתְּךָ אֶל־הָעִיר וְהרְסָהּ
וְחַזְּקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַמַּלְאָךְ כֹּה־תֹאמַר אֶל־יוֹאָב אַל־יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי־כָזֹה וְכָזֶה תֹּאכַל הֶחָרֶב הַחֲזֵק מִלְחַמְתְּךָ אֶל־הָעִיר וְהרְסָהּ
וְחַזְּקֵהוּ׃

english.text:
Whereupon David said to the messenger, “Give Joab this message:
‘Do not be distressed about the matter. The sword always takes its
toll. Press your attack on the city and destroy it!’ Encourage
him!”

translation.text: David said to the messenger, "Thus you shall say to Joab, 'Do not let this matter trouble attack on the city, and overthrow it.' And encourage him."

verses.english:
When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband Uriah was dead, she
lamented over her husband.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁמַע אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה כִּי־מֵת אוּרִיָּה אִישָׁהּ וַתִּסְפֹּד עַל־בַּעְלָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁמַע אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה כִּי־מֵת אוּרִיָּה אִישָׁהּ וַתִּסְפֹּד עַל־בַּעְלָהּ׃

english.text:
When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband Uriah was dead, she
lamented over her husband.

translation.text: When the wife of Uriah heard that her husband was dead, she made lamentation for him.

verses.english:
After the period of mourning was over, David sent and had her
brought into his palace; she became his wife and she bore him a
son. But YHWH was displeased with what David had done,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָאֵבֶל וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיַּאַסְפָהּ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ בֵּן וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה דָוִד בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָאֵבֶל וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיַּאַסְפָהּ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ בֵּן וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה דָוִד בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
After the period of mourning was over, David sent and had her
brought into his palace; she became his wife and she bore him a
son. But YHWH was displeased with what David had done,

translation.text: When the mourning was over, David sent and brought her to his house, and she became his wife, and bore him a son.

verses.english:
and YHWH sent Nathan to David. He came to him and said, “There
were two men in the same city, one rich and one poor.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים הָיוּ בְּעִיר אֶחָת אֶחָד עָשִׁיר וְאֶחָד רָאשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים הָיוּ בְּעִיר אֶחָת אֶחָד עָשִׁיר וְאֶחָד רָאשׁ׃

english.text:
and YHWH sent Nathan to David. He came to him and said, “There
were two men in the same city, one rich and one poor.

translation.text: and the LORD sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, "There were two men in a certain city, the one rich and the other poor.

verses.english: The rich man had very large flocks and herds,
verses.hebrew: לְעָשִׁיר הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: לְעָשִׁיר הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text: The rich man had very large flocks and herds,

translation.text: The rich man had very many flocks and herds;

verses.english:
but the poor man had only one little ewe lamb that he had bought.
He tended it and it grew up together with him and his children: it
used to share his morsel of bread, drink from his cup, and nestle
in his bosom; it was like a daughter to him.
verses.hebrew:
וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב
וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת׃

hebrew.text:
וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב
וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת׃

english.text:
but the poor man had only one little ewe lamb that he had bought.
He tended it and it grew up together with him and his children: it
used to share his morsel of bread, drink from his cup, and nestle
in his bosom; it was like a daughter to him.

translation.text: but the poor man brought it up, and it grew up with him and with his children; it used to and it was like a daughter to him.

verses.english:
One day, a traveler came to the rich man, but he was loath to take
anything from his own flocks or herds to prepare a meal for the
guest who had come to him; so he took the poor man’s lamb and
prepared it for the man who had come to him.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא הֵלֶךְ לְאִישׁ הֶעָשִׁיר וַיַּחְמֹל לָקַחַת מִצֹּאנוֹ וּמִבְּקָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָאֹרֵחַ הַבָּא־לוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כִּבְשַׂת הָאִישׁ הָרָאשׁ וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ לָאִישׁ הַבָּא
אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא הֵלֶךְ לְאִישׁ הֶעָשִׁיר וַיַּחְמֹל לָקַחַת מִצֹּאנוֹ וּמִבְּקָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָאֹרֵחַ הַבָּא־לוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כִּבְשַׂת הָאִישׁ הָרָאשׁ וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ לָאִישׁ הַבָּא
אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
One day, a traveler came to the rich man, but he was loath to take
anything from his own flocks or herds to prepare a meal for the
guest who had come to him; so he took the poor man’s lamb and
prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

translation.text: Now there came a traveler to the man's lamb, and prepared that for the guest who had come to him."

verses.english:
David flew into a rage against the man, and said to Nathan, “As
YHWH lives, the man who did this deserves to die!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף דָּוִד בָּאִישׁ מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נָתָן חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הָאִישׁ הָעֹשֶׂה זֹאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף דָּוִד בָּאִישׁ מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נָתָן חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הָאִישׁ הָעֹשֶׂה זֹאת׃

english.text:
David flew into a rage against the man, and said to Nathan, “As
YHWH lives, the man who did this deserves to die!

translation.text: Nathan, "As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die;

verses.english:
He shall pay for the lamb four times over, because he did such a
thing and showed no pity.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַכִּבְשָׂה יְשַׁלֵּם אַרְבַּעְתָּיִם עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָמָל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַכִּבְשָׂה יְשַׁלֵּם אַרְבַּעְתָּיִם עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָמָל׃

english.text:
He shall pay for the lamb four times over, because he did such a
thing and showed no pity.”

translation.text: he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity."

verses.english:
And Nathan said to David, “That man is you! Thus said YHWH, the
God of Israel: ‘It was I who anointed you king over Israel and it
was I who rescued you from the hand of Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד אַתָּה הָאִישׁכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי הִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד אַתָּה הָאִישׁכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי הִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
And Nathan said to David, “That man is you! Thus said YHWH, the
God of Israel: ‘It was I who anointed you king over Israel and it
was I who rescued you from the hand of Saul.

translation.text: Nathan said to David, "You are the man! Thus says the LORD, the God hand of Saul;

verses.english:
I gave you your master’s house and possession of your master’s
wives; and I gave you the House of Israel and Judah; and if that
were not enough, I would give you twice as much more.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי אֲדֹנֶיךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וְאִם־מְעָט וְאֹסִפָה לְּךָ כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי אֲדֹנֶיךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וְאִם־מְעָט וְאֹסִפָה לְּךָ כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה׃

english.text:
I gave you your master’s house and possession of your master’s
wives; and I gave you the House of Israel and Judah; and if that
were not enough, I would give you twice as much more.

translation.text: I gave you your master's house, and your master's wives that had been too little, I would have added as much more.

verses.english:
Why then have you flouted the command of YHWH and done what
displeases Him? You have put Uriah the Hittite to the sword; you
took his wife and made her your wife and had him killed by the
sword of the Ammonites.
verses.hebrew:
מַדּוּעַ בָּזִיתָ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע (בעינו) [בְּעֵינַי] אֵת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי הִכִּיתָ בַחֶרֶב וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ לָקַחְתָּ לְּךָ לְאִשָּׁה וְאֹתוֹ הָרַגְתָּ
בְּחֶרֶב בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
מַדּוּעַ בָּזִיתָ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע (בעינו) [בְּעֵינַי] אֵת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי הִכִּיתָ בַחֶרֶב וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ לָקַחְתָּ לְּךָ לְאִשָּׁה וְאֹתוֹ הָרַגְתָּ
בְּחֶרֶב בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
Why then have you flouted the command of YHWH and done what
displeases Him? You have put Uriah the Hittite to the sword; you
took his wife and made her your wife and had him killed by the
sword of the Ammonites.

translation.text: Why have you despised the word of the LORD, to do what is evil in his sight? the Ammonites.

verses.english:
Therefore the sword shall never depart from your House—because you
spurned Me by taking the wife of Uriah the Hittite and making her
your wife.’
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֹא־תָסוּר חֶרֶב מִבֵּיתְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם עֵקֶב כִּי בְזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לֹא־תָסוּר חֶרֶב מִבֵּיתְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם עֵקֶב כִּי בְזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Therefore the sword shall never depart from your House—because you
spurned Me by taking the wife of Uriah the Hittite and making her
your wife.’

translation.text: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.

verses.english:
Thus said YHWH: ‘I will make a calamity rise against you from
within your own house; I will take your wives and give them to
another man before your very eyes and he shall sleep with your
wives under this very sun.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵקִים עָלֶיךָ רָעָה מִבֵּיתֶךָ וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי לְרֵעֶיךָ וְשָׁכַב עִם־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵקִים עָלֶיךָ רָעָה מִבֵּיתֶךָ וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי לְרֵעֶיךָ וְשָׁכַב עִם־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Thus said YHWH: ‘I will make a calamity rise against you from
within your own house; I will take your wives and give them to
another man before your very eyes and he shall sleep with your
wives under this very sun.

translation.text: Thus says the LORD: I will raise up lie with your wives in the sight of this very sun.

verses.english:
You acted in secret, but I will make this happen in the sight of
all Israel and in broad daylight.’”
verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ בַסָּתֶר וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה נֶגֶד כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ בַסָּתֶר וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה נֶגֶד כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
You acted in secret, but I will make this happen in the sight of
all Israel and in broad daylight.’”

translation.text: For you did it secretly; but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun."

verses.english:
David said to Nathan, “I stand guilty before YHWH!” And Nathan
replied to David, “YHWH has remitted your sin; you shall not die.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־נָתָן חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד גַּם־יְהֹוָה הֶעֱבִיר חַטָּאתְךָ לֹא תָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־נָתָן חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד גַּם־יְהֹוָה הֶעֱבִיר חַטָּאתְךָ לֹא תָמוּת׃

english.text:
David said to Nathan, “I stand guilty before YHWH!” And Nathan
replied to David, “YHWH has remitted your sin; you shall not die.

translation.text: David, "Now the LORD has put away your sin; you shall not die.

verses.english:
However, since you have spurned the enemies of YHWH by this deed,
even the child about to be born to you shall die.”
verses.hebrew: אֶפֶס כִּי־נִאֵץ נִאַצְתָּ אֶת־אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה גַּם הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד לְךָ מוֹת יָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: אֶפֶס כִּי־נִאֵץ נִאַצְתָּ אֶת־אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה גַּם הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד לְךָ מוֹת יָמוּת׃

english.text:
However, since you have spurned the enemies of YHWH by this deed,
even the child about to be born to you shall die.”

translation.text: the child that is born to you shall die."

verses.english:
Nathan went home, and YHWH afflicted the child that Uriah’s wife
had borne to David, and it became critically ill.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ נָתָן אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֵשֶׁת־אוּרִיָּה לְדָוִד וַיֵּאָנַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ נָתָן אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֵשֶׁת־אוּרִיָּה לְדָוִד וַיֵּאָנַשׁ׃

english.text:
Nathan went home, and YHWH afflicted the child that Uriah’s wife
had borne to David, and it became critically ill.

translation.text: Then Nathan went to his house. became very ill.

verses.english:
David entreated God for the boy; David fasted, and he went in and
spent the night lying on the ground.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּעַד הַנָּעַר וַיָּצם דָּוִד צוֹם וּבָא וְלָן וְשָׁכַב אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּעַד הַנָּעַר וַיָּצם דָּוִד צוֹם וּבָא וְלָן וְשָׁכַב אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
David entreated God for the boy; David fasted, and he went in and
spent the night lying on the ground.

translation.text: David therefore pleaded with God for the child; David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

verses.english:
The senior servants of his household tried to induce him to get up
from the ground; but he refused, nor would he partake of food with
them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ עָלָיו לַהֲקִימוֹ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא אָבָה וְלֹא־בָרָא אִתָּם לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ עָלָיו לַהֲקִימוֹ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא אָבָה וְלֹא־בָרָא אִתָּם לָחֶם׃

english.text:
The senior servants of his household tried to induce him to get up
from the ground; but he refused, nor would he partake of food with
them.

translation.text: The elders he would not, nor did he eat food with them.

verses.english:
On the seventh day the child died. David’s servants were afraid to
tell David that the child was dead; for they said, “We spoke to
him when the child was alive and he wouldn’t listen to us; how can
we tell him that the child is dead? He might do something
terrible.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיָּמת הַיָּלֶד וַיִּרְאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד לְהַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי־מֵת הַיֶּלֶד כִּי אָמְרוּ הִנֵּה בִהְיוֹת הַיֶּלֶד חַי דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא־שָׁמַע
בְּקוֹלֵנוּ וְאֵיךְ נֹאמַר אֵלָיו מֵת הַיֶּלֶד וְעָשָׂה רָעָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיָּמת הַיָּלֶד וַיִּרְאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד לְהַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי־מֵת הַיֶּלֶד כִּי אָמְרוּ הִנֵּה בִהְיוֹת הַיֶּלֶד חַי דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא־שָׁמַע
בְּקוֹלֵנוּ וְאֵיךְ נֹאמַר אֵלָיו מֵת הַיֶּלֶד וְעָשָׂה רָעָה׃

english.text:
On the seventh day the child died. David’s servants were afraid to
tell David that the child was dead; for they said, “We spoke to
him when the child was alive and he wouldn’t listen to us; how can
we tell him that the child is dead? He might do something
terrible.”

translation.text: On the seventh day the child was dead; for they said, "While the child was still alive, we spoke to him, and he did not listen to us; how then can we tell him the child is dead? He may do himself some harm."

verses.english:
When David saw his servants talking in whispers, David understood
that the child was dead; David asked his servants, “Is the child
dead?” “Yes,” they replied.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי עֲבָדָיו מִתְלַחֲשִׁים וַיָּבֶן דָּוִד כִּי מֵת הַיָּלֶד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲמֵת הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי עֲבָדָיו מִתְלַחֲשִׁים וַיָּבֶן דָּוִד כִּי מֵת הַיָּלֶד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲמֵת הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵת׃

english.text:
When David saw his servants talking in whispers, David understood
that the child was dead; David asked his servants, “Is the child
dead?” “Yes,” they replied.

translation.text: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, he perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, "Is the child dead?" They said, "He is dead."

verses.english:
Thereupon David rose from the ground; he bathed and anointed
himself, and he changed his clothes. He went into the House of
YHWH and prostrated himself. Then he went home and asked for food,
which they set before him, and he ate.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְחַץ וַיָּסֶךְ וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָו וַיָּבֹא בֵית־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְחַץ וַיָּסֶךְ וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָו וַיָּבֹא בֵית־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל׃

english.text:
Thereupon David rose from the ground; he bathed and anointed
himself, and he changed his clothes. He went into the House of
YHWH and prostrated himself. Then he went home and asked for food,
which they set before him, and he ate.

translation.text: Then David rose from the ground, washed, anointed himself, and set food before him and he ate.

verses.english:
His courtiers asked him, “Why have you acted in this manner? While
the child was alive, you fasted and wept; but now that the child
is dead, you rise and take food!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה בַּעֲבוּר הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתָּ וַתֵּבְךְּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר מֵת הַיֶּלֶד קַמְתָּ וַתֹּאכַל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה בַּעֲבוּר הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתָּ וַתֵּבְךְּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר מֵת הַיֶּלֶד קַמְתָּ וַתֹּאכַל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
His courtiers asked him, “Why have you acted in this manner? While
the child was alive, you fasted and wept; but now that the child
is dead, you rise and take food!”

translation.text: Then his servants said to him, "What while it was alive; but when the child died, you rose and ate food."

verses.english:
He replied, “While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept
because I thought: ‘Who knows? YHWH may have pity on me, and the
child may live.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּעוֹד הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה כִּי אָמַרְתִּי מִי יוֹדֵעַ (יחנני) [וְחַנַּנִי] יְהֹוָה וְחַי הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּעוֹד הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה כִּי אָמַרְתִּי מִי יוֹדֵעַ (יחנני) [וְחַנַּנִי] יְהֹוָה וְחַי הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
He replied, “While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept
because I thought: ‘Who knows? YHWH may have pity on me, and the
child may live.’

translation.text: He said, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept; for I said,

verses.english:
But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back
again? I shall go to him, but he will never come back to me.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מֵת לָמָּה זֶּה אֲנִי צָם הַאוּכַל לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ עוֹד אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא לֹא־יָשׁוּב אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה מֵת לָמָּה זֶּה אֲנִי צָם הַאוּכַל לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ עוֹד אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא לֹא־יָשׁוּב אֵלָי׃

english.text:
But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back
again? I shall go to him, but he will never come back to me.”

translation.text: But now he is dead; why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he will not return to me."

verses.english:
David consoled his wife Bathsheba; he went to her and lay with
her. She bore a son and she named him Solomon. YHWH favored him,
verses.hebrew: וַיְנַחֵם דָּוִד אֵת בַּת־שֶׁבַע אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן (ויקרא) [וַתִּקְרָא] אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיהֹוָה אֲהֵבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְנַחֵם דָּוִד אֵת בַּת־שֶׁבַע אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן (ויקרא) [וַתִּקְרָא] אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיהֹוָה אֲהֵבוֹ׃

english.text:
David consoled his wife Bathsheba; he went to her and lay with
her. She bore a son and she named him Solomon. YHWH favored him,

translation.text: Then David consoled his wife Bathsheba, and went to her, and lay loved him,

verses.english:
and He sent a message through the prophet Nathan; and he was named
Jedidiah at the instance of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְדִידְיָהּ בַּעֲבוּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְדִידְיָהּ בַּעֲבוּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and He sent a message through the prophet Nathan; and he was named
Jedidiah at the instance of YHWH.

translation.text: and sent a message by the prophet Nathan; so he named him Jedidiah, because of the LORD.

verses.english: Joab attacked Rabbah of Ammon and captured the royal city.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֶם יוֹאָב בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־עִיר הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלָּחֶם יוֹאָב בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־עִיר הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text: Joab attacked Rabbah of Ammon and captured the royal city.

translation.text: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and took the royal city.

verses.english:
Joab sent messengers to David and said, “I have attacked Rabbah
and I have already captured the water city.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר נִלְחַמְתִּי בְרַבָּה גַּם־לָכַדְתִּי אֶת־עִיר הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר נִלְחַמְתִּי בְרַבָּה גַּם־לָכַדְתִּי אֶת־עִיר הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
Joab sent messengers to David and said, “I have attacked Rabbah
and I have already captured the water city.

translation.text: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, "I have fought against Rabbah; moreover, I have taken the water city.

verses.english:
Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture
it; otherwise I will capture the city myself, and my name will be
connected with it.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱסֹף אֶת־יֶתֶר הָעָם וַחֲנֵה עַל־הָעִיר וְלכְדָהּ פֶּן־אֶלְכֹּד אֲנִי אֶת־הָעִיר וְנִקְרָא שְׁמִי עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֱסֹף אֶת־יֶתֶר הָעָם וַחֲנֵה עַל־הָעִיר וְלכְדָהּ פֶּן־אֶלְכֹּד אֲנִי אֶת־הָעִיר וְנִקְרָא שְׁמִי עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture
it; otherwise I will capture the city myself, and my name will be
connected with it.”

translation.text: Now, then, and take it; or I myself will take the city, and it will be called by my name."

verses.english:
David mustered all the troops and marched on Rabbah, and he
attacked it and captured it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ רַבָּתָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ רַבָּתָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

english.text:
David mustered all the troops and marched on Rabbah, and he
attacked it and captured it.

translation.text: So David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

verses.english:
The crown was taken from the head of their king and it was placed
on David’s head—it weighed a talent of gold, and [on it] were
precious stones. He also carried off a vast amount of booty from
the city.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עֲטֶרֶת־מַלְכָּם מֵעַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמִשְׁקָלָהּ כִּכַּר זָהָב וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתְּהִי עַל־רֹאשׁ דָּוִד וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הוֹצִיא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עֲטֶרֶת־מַלְכָּם מֵעַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמִשְׁקָלָהּ כִּכַּר זָהָב וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתְּהִי עַל־רֹאשׁ דָּוִד וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הוֹצִיא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
The crown was taken from the head of their king and it was placed
on David’s head—it weighed a talent of gold, and [on it] were
precious stones. He also carried off a vast amount of booty from
the city.

translation.text: He took the crown of brought forth the spoil of the city, a very great amount.

verses.english:
He led out the people who lived there and set them to work with
saws, iron threshing boards, and iron axes, or assigned them to
brickmaking; David did this to all the towns of Ammon. Then David
and all the troops returned to Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הוֹצִיא וַיָּשֶׂם בַּמְּגֵרָה וּבַחֲרִצֵי הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרֹת הַבַּרְזֶל וְהֶעֱבִיר אוֹתָם (במלכן) [בַּמַּלְבֵּן] וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל עָרֵי
בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיָּשׁב דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הוֹצִיא וַיָּשֶׂם בַּמְּגֵרָה וּבַחֲרִצֵי הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרֹת הַבַּרְזֶל וְהֶעֱבִיר אוֹתָם (במלכן) [בַּמַּלְבֵּן] וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל עָרֵי
בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיָּשׁב דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He led out the people who lived there and set them to work with
saws, iron threshing boards, and iron axes, or assigned them to
brickmaking; David did this to all the towns of Ammon. Then David
and all the troops returned to Jerusalem.

translation.text: He brought iron picks and iron axes, or sent them to the brickworks. Thus he did to all the cities of the Ammonites. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
This happened sometime afterward: Absalom son of David had a
beautiful sister named Tamar, and Amnon son of David became
infatuated with her.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וּלְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־דָּוִד אָחוֹת יָפָה וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ אַמְנוֹן בֶּן־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וּלְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־דָּוִד אָחוֹת יָפָה וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ אַמְנוֹן בֶּן־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
This happened sometime afterward: Absalom son of David had a
beautiful sister named Tamar, and Amnon son of David became
infatuated with her.

translation.text: Some time passed. David's son Absalom had a beautiful sister whose name was Tamar; and David's son Amnon fell in love with her.

verses.english:
Amnon was so distraught because of his [half-]sister Tamar that he
became sick; for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible to
Amnon to do anything to her.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֶר לְאַמְנוֹן לְהִתְחַלּוֹת בַּעֲבוּר תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ כִּי בְתוּלָה הִיא וַיִּפָּלֵא בְּעֵינֵי אַמְנוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֶר לְאַמְנוֹן לְהִתְחַלּוֹת בַּעֲבוּר תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ כִּי בְתוּלָה הִיא וַיִּפָּלֵא בְּעֵינֵי אַמְנוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ מְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
Amnon was so distraught because of his [half-]sister Tamar that he
became sick; for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible to
Amnon to do anything to her.

translation.text: anything to her.

verses.english:
Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, the son of David’s brother
Shimah; Jonadab was a very clever man.
verses.hebrew: וּלְאַמְנוֹן רֵעַ וּשְׁמוֹ יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי דָוִד וְיוֹנָדָב אִישׁ חָכָם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאַמְנוֹן רֵעַ וּשְׁמוֹ יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי דָוִד וְיוֹנָדָב אִישׁ חָכָם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, the son of David’s brother
Shimah; Jonadab was a very clever man.

translation.text: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab, man.

verses.english:
He asked him, “Why are you so dejected, O prince, morning after
morning? Tell me!” Amnon replied, “I am in love with Tamar, the
sister of my brother Absalom!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה כָּכָה דַּל בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר הֲלוֹא תַּגִּיד לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַמְנוֹן אֶת־תָּמָר אֲחוֹת אַבְשָׁלֹם אָחִי אֲנִי אֹהֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה כָּכָה דַּל בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר הֲלוֹא תַּגִּיד לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַמְנוֹן אֶת־תָּמָר אֲחוֹת אַבְשָׁלֹם אָחִי אֲנִי אֹהֵב׃

english.text:
He asked him, “Why are you so dejected, O prince, morning after
morning? Tell me!” Amnon replied, “I am in love with Tamar, the
sister of my brother Absalom!”

translation.text: He said to him, "O son of the king, why are you so haggard love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister."

verses.english:
Jonadab said to him, “Lie down in your bed and pretend you are
sick. When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Let my
sister Tamar come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare
the food in front of me, so that I may look on, and let her serve
it to me.’”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוֹנָדָב שְׁכַב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְהִתְחָל וּבָא אָבִיךָ לִרְאוֹתֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו תָּבֹא נָא תָמָר אֲחוֹתִי וְתַבְרֵנִי לֶחֶם וְעָשְׂתָה לְעֵינַי
אֶת־הַבִּרְיָה לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶה וְאָכַלְתִּי מִיָּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוֹנָדָב שְׁכַב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְהִתְחָל וּבָא אָבִיךָ לִרְאוֹתֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו תָּבֹא נָא תָמָר אֲחוֹתִי וְתַבְרֵנִי לֶחֶם וְעָשְׂתָה לְעֵינַי
אֶת־הַבִּרְיָה לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶה וְאָכַלְתִּי מִיָּדָהּ׃

english.text:
Jonadab said to him, “Lie down in your bed and pretend you are
sick. When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Let my
sister Tamar come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare
the food in front of me, so that I may look on, and let her serve
it to me.’”

translation.text: Jonadab said to him, "Lie something to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, so that I may see it and eat it from her hand.'"

verses.english:
Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. The king came to see him,
and Amnon said to the king, “Let my sister Tamar come and prepare
a couple of cakes in front of me, and let her bring them to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַמְנוֹן וַיִּתְחָל וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּבוֹא־נָא תָּמָר אֲחֹתִי וּתְלַבֵּב לְעֵינַי שְׁתֵּי לְבִבוֹת וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַמְנוֹן וַיִּתְחָל וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּבוֹא־נָא תָּמָר אֲחֹתִי וּתְלַבֵּב לְעֵינַי שְׁתֵּי לְבִבוֹת וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדָהּ׃

english.text:
Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. The king came to see him,
and Amnon said to the king, “Let my sister Tamar come and prepare
a couple of cakes in front of me, and let her bring them to me.”

translation.text: So Amnon lay down, and pretended to be sight, so that I may eat from her hand."

verses.english:
David sent a message to Tamar in the palace, “Please go to the
house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־תָּמָר הַבַּיְתָה לֵאמֹר לְכִי נָא בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיךְ וַעֲשִׂי־לוֹ הַבִּרְיָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־תָּמָר הַבַּיְתָה לֵאמֹר לְכִי נָא בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיךְ וַעֲשִׂי־לוֹ הַבִּרְיָה׃

english.text:
David sent a message to Tamar in the palace, “Please go to the
house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him.”

translation.text: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, "Go to your brother Amnon's house, and prepare food for him."

verses.english:
Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was in bed. She
took dough and kneaded it into cakes in front of him, and cooked
the cakes.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַבָּצֵק (ותלוש) [וַתָּלשׁ] וַתְּלַבֵּב לְעֵינָיו וַתְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַבָּצֵק (ותלוש) [וַתָּלשׁ] וַתְּלַבֵּב לְעֵינָיו וַתְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת׃

english.text:
Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was in bed. She
took dough and kneaded it into cakes in front of him, and cooked
the cakes.

translation.text: So Tamar went to her kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

verses.english:
She took the pan and set out [the cakes], but Amnon refused to eat
and ordered everyone to withdraw. After everyone had withdrawn,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּשְׂרֵת וַתִּצֹק לְפָנָיו וַיְמָאֵן לֶאֱכוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן הוֹצִיאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלַי וַיֵּצְאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּשְׂרֵת וַתִּצֹק לְפָנָיו וַיְמָאֵן לֶאֱכוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן הוֹצִיאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלַי וַיֵּצְאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
She took the pan and set out [the cakes], but Amnon refused to eat
and ordered everyone to withdraw. After everyone had withdrawn,

translation.text: Then she took the pan and set them out before him, but he refused to eat. from him.

verses.english:
Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food inside and feed me.” Tamar
took the cakes she had made and brought them to her brother
inside.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־תָּמָר הָבִיאִי הַבִּרְיָה הַחֶדֶר וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדֵךְ וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה וַתָּבֵא לְאַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ הֶחָדְרָה׃

Your maidservant had two sons. The two of them came to blows out
in the fields where there was no one to stop them, and one of them
struck the other and killed him.

Then the whole clan confronted your maidservant and said, ‘Hand
over the one who killed his brother, that we may put him to death
for the slaying of his brother, even though we wipe out the heir.’
Thus they would quench the last ember remaining to me, and leave
my husband without name or remnant upon the earth.”

The king said to the woman, “Go home. I will issue an order in

translation.text: Then the king said to the woman, "Go to your house, and I will give orders concerning you."

verses.english:
And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord king, may the
guilt be on me and on my ancestral house; Your Majesty and his
throne are guiltless.”

verses.english:
She replied, “Let Your Majesty be mindful of YHWH your God and
restrain the blood avenger bent on destruction, so that my son may
not be killed.” And he said, “As YHWH lives, not a hair of your
son shall fall to the ground.”

to my lord the king.” “Speak on,” said the king.

And the woman said, “Why then have you planned the like against
God’s people? In making this pronouncement, Your Majesty condemns
himself in that Your Majesty does not bring back his own banished
one.

In reply, the king said to the woman, “Do not withhold from me

has found favor with you, my lord king, for Your Majesty has
granted his servant’s request.”

king.

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר בֹּא הֵנָּה וְאֶשְׁלְחָה אֹתְךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה בָּאתִי מִגְּשׁוּר טוֹב לִי עֹד אֲנִי־שָׁם וְעַתָּה
אֶרְאֶה פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן וֶהֱמִתָנִי׃

english.text:
Absalom replied to Joab, “I sent for you to come here; I wanted to
send you to the king to say [on my behalf]: ‘Why did I leave
Geshur? I would be better off if I were still there. Now let me
appear before the king; and if I am guilty of anything, let him
put me to death!’”

translation.text: Absalom answered Joab, "Look, I sent word to you: Now let me go into the king's presence; if there is guilt in me, let him kill me!"

verses.english:
Joab went to the king and reported to him; whereupon he summoned
Absalom. He came to the king and flung himself face down to the
ground before the king. And the king kissed Absalom.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ עַל־אַפָּיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ
לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ עַל־אַפָּיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ
לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Joab went to the king and reported to him; whereupon he summoned
Absalom. He came to the king and flung himself face down to the
ground before the king. And the king kissed Absalom.

translation.text: Then Joab went to the king and told him; and he Absalom.

verses.english:
Sometime afterward, Absalom provided himself with a chariot,
horses, and fifty outrunners.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם מֶרְכָּבָה וְסֻסִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם מֶרְכָּבָה וְסֻסִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Sometime afterward, Absalom provided himself with a chariot,
horses, and fifty outrunners.

translation.text: After this Absalom got himself a chariot and horses, and fifty men to run ahead of him.

verses.english:
Absalom used to rise early and stand by the road to the city
gates; and whenever a man had a case that was to come before the
king for judgment, Absalom would call out to him, “What town are
you from?” And when he answered, “Your servant is from such and
such a tribe in Israel,”
verses.hebrew:
וְהִשְׁכִּים אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְעָמַד עַל־יַד דֶּרֶךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיְהִי כּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּט וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר
אֵי־מִזֶּה עִיר אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר מֵאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִשְׁכִּים אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְעָמַד עַל־יַד דֶּרֶךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיְהִי כּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּט וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר
אֵי־מִזֶּה עִיר אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר מֵאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Absalom used to rise early and stand by the road to the city
gates; and whenever a man had a case that was to come before the
king for judgment, Absalom would call out to him, “What town are
you from?” And when he answered, “Your servant is from such and
such a tribe in Israel,”

translation.text: Absalom used to rise early and stand beside the in Israel,"

verses.english:
Absalom would say to him, “It is clear that your claim is right
and just, but there is no one assigned to you by the king to hear
it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְשָׁלוֹם רְאֵה דְבָרֶיךָ טוֹבִים וּנְכֹחִים וְשֹׁמֵעַ אֵין־לְךָ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְשָׁלוֹם רְאֵה דְבָרֶיךָ טוֹבִים וּנְכֹחִים וְשֹׁמֵעַ אֵין־לְךָ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Absalom would say to him, “It is clear that your claim is right
and just, but there is no one assigned to you by the king to hear
it.”

translation.text: Absalom would say, "See, your claims are good and right; but there is no one deputed by the king to hear you."

verses.english:
And Absalom went on, “If only I were appointed judge in the land
and everyone with a legal dispute came before me, I would see that
he got his rights.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יְשִׂמֵנִי שֹׁפֵט בָּאָרֶץ וְעָלַי יָבוֹא כּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב וּמִשְׁפָּט וְהִצְדַּקְתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יְשִׂמֵנִי שֹׁפֵט בָּאָרֶץ וְעָלַי יָבוֹא כּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב וּמִשְׁפָּט וְהִצְדַּקְתִּיו׃

english.text:
And Absalom went on, “If only I were appointed judge in the land
and everyone with a legal dispute came before me, I would see that
he got his rights.”

translation.text: Absalom said moreover, "If only I were judge in the land! Then all who had a suit or cause might come to me, and I would give them justice."

verses.english:
And if a man approached to bow to him, [Absalom] would extend his
hand and take hold of him and kiss him.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּקְרב־אִישׁ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ וְשָׁלַח אֶת־יָדוֹ וְהֶחֱזִיק לוֹ וְנָשַׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בִּקְרב־אִישׁ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ וְשָׁלַח אֶת־יָדוֹ וְהֶחֱזִיק לוֹ וְנָשַׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
And if a man approached to bow to him, [Absalom] would extend his
hand and take hold of him and kiss him.

translation.text: Whenever and take hold of them, and kiss them.

verses.english:
Absalom did this to every Israelite who came to the king for
judgment. Thus Absalom won away the hearts of the men of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְשָׁלוֹם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹאוּ לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְגַנֵּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־לֵב אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְשָׁלוֹם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹאוּ לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְגַנֵּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־לֵב אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Absalom did this to every Israelite who came to the king for
judgment. Thus Absalom won away the hearts of the men of Israel.

translation.text: Thus Absalom did to every hearts of the people of Israel.

verses.english:
After a period of forty years had gone by, Absalom said to the
king, “Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow that I made to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלְכָה נָּא וַאֲשַׁלֵּם אֶת־נִדְרִי אֲשֶׁר־נָדַרְתִּי לַיהֹוָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלְכָה נָּא וַאֲשַׁלֵּם אֶת־נִדְרִי אֲשֶׁר־נָדַרְתִּי לַיהֹוָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
After a period of forty years had gone by, Absalom said to the
king, “Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow that I made to YHWH.

translation.text: At the end of four years Absalom said to the king, "Please let me go to Hebron and pay the vow that I have made to the LORD.

verses.english:
For your servant made a vow when I lived in Geshur of Aram: If
YHWH ever brings me back to Jerusalem, I will worship YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נֵדֶר נָדַר עַבְדְּךָ בְּשִׁבְתִּי בִגְשׁוּר בַּאֲרָם לֵאמֹר אִם־[יָשׁוֹב] (ישיב) יְשִׁיבֵנִי יְהֹוָה יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְעָבַדְתִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־נֵדֶר נָדַר עַבְדְּךָ בְּשִׁבְתִּי בִגְשׁוּר בַּאֲרָם לֵאמֹר אִם־[יָשׁוֹב] (ישיב) יְשִׁיבֵנִי יְהֹוָה יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְעָבַדְתִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
For your servant made a vow when I lived in Geshur of Aram: If
YHWH ever brings me back to Jerusalem, I will worship YHWH.”

translation.text: For your Hebron."

verses.english: The king said to him, “Go in peace”; and so he set out for Hebron.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה׃

english.text: The king said to him, “Go in peace”; and so he set out for Hebron.

translation.text: The king said to him, "Go in peace." So he got up, and went to Hebron.

verses.english:
But Absalom sent agents to all the tribes of Israel to say, “When
you hear the blast of the horn, announce that Absalom has become
king in Hebron.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם מְרַגְּלִים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת־קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם מָלַךְ אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם מְרַגְּלִים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת־קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם מָלַךְ אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
But Absalom sent agents to all the tribes of Israel to say, “When
you hear the blast of the horn, announce that Absalom has become
king in Hebron.”

translation.text: But Absalom sent secret messengers throughout all trumpet, then shout: Absalom has become king at Hebron!"

verses.english:
Two hundred men of Jerusalem accompanied Absalom; they were
invited and went in good faith, suspecting nothing.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָלְכוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קְרֻאִים וְהֹלְכִים לְתֻמָּם וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כּל־דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָלְכוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קְרֻאִים וְהֹלְכִים לְתֻמָּם וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כּל־דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Two hundred men of Jerusalem accompanied Absalom; they were
invited and went in good faith, suspecting nothing.

translation.text: Two matter.

verses.english:
Absalom also sent [to fetch] Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s
counselor, from his town, Giloh, when the sacrifices were to be
offered. The conspiracy gained strength, and the people supported
Absalom in increasing numbers.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּילֹנִי יוֹעֵץ דָּוִד מֵעִירוֹ מִגִּלֹה בְּזבְחוֹ אֶת־הַזְּבָחִים וַיְהִי הַקֶּשֶׁר אַמִּץ וְהָעָם הוֹלֵךְ וָרָב אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּילֹנִי יוֹעֵץ דָּוִד מֵעִירוֹ מִגִּלֹה בְּזבְחוֹ אֶת־הַזְּבָחִים וַיְהִי הַקֶּשֶׁר אַמִּץ וְהָעָם הוֹלֵךְ וָרָב אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Absalom also sent [to fetch] Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s
counselor, from his town, Giloh, when the sacrifices were to be
offered. The conspiracy gained strength, and the people supported
Absalom in increasing numbers.

translation.text: While Absalom was offering the sacrifices, he sent for increasing.

verses.english:
Someone came and told David, “The loyalty of the men of Israel has
veered toward Absalom.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּגִּיד אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הָיָה לֶב־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּגִּיד אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הָיָה לֶב־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Someone came and told David, “The loyalty of the men of Israel has
veered toward Absalom.”

translation.text: A messenger came to David, saying, "The hearts of the Israelites have gone after Absalom."

verses.english:
Whereupon David said to all the courtiers who were with him in
Jerusalem, “Let us flee at once, or none of us will escape from
Absalom. We must get away quickly, or he will soon overtake us and
bring down disaster upon us and put the city to the sword.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְכל־עֲבָדָיו אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קוּמוּ וְנִבְרָחָה כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ פְלֵיטָה מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם מַהֲרוּ לָלֶכֶת פֶּן־יְמַהֵר וְהִשִּׂגָנוּ
וְהִדִּיחַ עָלֵינוּ אֶת־הָרָעָה וְהִכָּה הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְכל־עֲבָדָיו אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קוּמוּ וְנִבְרָחָה כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ פְלֵיטָה מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם מַהֲרוּ לָלֶכֶת פֶּן־יְמַהֵר וְהִשִּׂגָנוּ
וְהִדִּיחַ עָלֵינוּ אֶת־הָרָעָה וְהִכָּה הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
Whereupon David said to all the courtiers who were with him in
Jerusalem, “Let us flee at once, or none of us will escape from
Absalom. We must get away quickly, or he will soon overtake us and
bring down disaster upon us and put the city to the sword.”

translation.text: Then David said to all his officials who sword."

verses.english:
The king’s courtiers said to the king, “Whatever our lord the king
decides, your servants are ready.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

english.text:
The king’s courtiers said to the king, “Whatever our lord the king
decides, your servants are ready.”

translation.text: The king's officials said to the king, "Your servants are ready to do whatever our lord the king decides."

verses.english:
So the king left, followed by his entire household, except for ten
concubines whom the king left to mind the palace.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־בֵּיתוֹ בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים לִשְׁמֹר הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־בֵּיתוֹ בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים לִשְׁמֹר הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
So the king left, followed by his entire household, except for ten
concubines whom the king left to mind the palace.

translation.text: So the king left, behind to look after the house.

verses.english:
The king left, followed by all the people, and they stopped at the
last house.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעַמְדוּ בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעַמְדוּ בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק׃

english.text:
The king left, followed by all the people, and they stopped at the
last house.

translation.text: The king left, followed by all the people; and they stopped at the last house.

verses.english:
All his followers marched past him, including all the Cherethites
and all the Pelethites; and all the Gittites, six hundred men who
had accompanied him from Gath, also marched by the king.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עַל־יָדוֹ וְכל־הַכְּרֵתִי וְכל־הַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ בְרַגְלוֹ מִגַּת עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עַל־יָדוֹ וְכל־הַכְּרֵתִי וְכל־הַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ בְרַגְלוֹ מִגַּת עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
All his followers marched past him, including all the Cherethites
and all the Pelethites; and all the Gittites, six hundred men who
had accompanied him from Gath, also marched by the king.

translation.text: All his officials passed by the king.

verses.english:
And the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why should you too go
with us? Go back and stay with the [new] king, for you are a
foreigner and you are also an exile from your country.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי לָמָּה תֵלֵךְ גַּם־אַתָּה אִתָּנוּ שׁוּב וְשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נכְרִי אַתָּה וְגַם־גֹּלֶה אַתָּה לִמְקוֹמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי לָמָּה תֵלֵךְ גַּם־אַתָּה אִתָּנוּ שׁוּב וְשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נכְרִי אַתָּה וְגַם־גֹּלֶה אַתָּה לִמְקוֹמֶךָ׃

english.text:
And the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why should you too go
with us? Go back and stay with the [new] king, for you are a
foreigner and you are also an exile from your country.

translation.text: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, "Why are you also coming also an exile from your home.

verses.english:
You came only yesterday; should I make you wander about with us
today, when I myself must go wherever I can? Go back, and take
your kinsmen with you, [in] true faithfulness.”
verses.hebrew: תְּמוֹל בּוֹאֶךָ וְהַיּוֹם (אנועך) [אֲנִיעֲךָ] עִמָּנוּ לָלֶכֶת וַאֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ עַל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ שׁוּב וְהָשֵׁב אֶת־אַחֶיךָ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: תְּמוֹל בּוֹאֶךָ וְהַיּוֹם (אנועך) [אֲנִיעֲךָ] עִמָּנוּ לָלֶכֶת וַאֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ עַל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ שׁוּב וְהָשֵׁב אֶת־אַחֶיךָ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

english.text:
You came only yesterday; should I make you wander about with us
today, when I myself must go wherever I can? Go back, and take
your kinsmen with you, [in] true faithfulness.”

translation.text: You came only yesterday, and shall I steadfast love and faithfulness to you."

verses.english:
Ittai replied to the king, “As YHWH lives and as my lord the king
lives, wherever my lord the king may be, there your servant will
be, whether for death or for life!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אִתַּי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי (אם) בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְמָוֶת אִם־לְחַיִּים כִּי־שָׁם יִהְיֶה
עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אִתַּי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי (אם) בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְמָוֶת אִם־לְחַיִּים כִּי־שָׁם יִהְיֶה
עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Ittai replied to the king, “As YHWH lives and as my lord the king
lives, wherever my lord the king may be, there your servant will
be, whether for death or for life!”

translation.text: But Ittai answered the king, "As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether for death or for life, there also your servant will be."

verses.english:
And David said to Ittai, “Then march by.” And Ittai the Gittite
and all his men and all the children who were with him marched by.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אִתַּי לֵךְ וַעֲבֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וְכל־אֲנָשָׁיו וְכל־הַטַּף אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אִתַּי לֵךְ וַעֲבֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וְכל־אֲנָשָׁיו וְכל־הַטַּף אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And David said to Ittai, “Then march by.” And Ittai the Gittite
and all his men and all the children who were with him marched by.

translation.text: David said to Ittai, "Go then, march on." So Ittai the Gittite marched on, with all his men and all the little ones who were with him.

verses.english:
The whole countryside wept aloud as the troops marched by. The
king crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the troops crossed by the
road to the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ בּוֹכִים קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי־דֶרֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ בּוֹכִים קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי־דֶרֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
The whole countryside wept aloud as the troops marched by. The
king crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the troops crossed by the
road to the wilderness.

translation.text: The whole country wept aloud as all the people passed by; the king wilderness.

verses.english:
Then Zadok appeared, with all the Levites carrying the Ark of the
Covenant of God; and they set down the Ark of God until all the
people had finished marching out of the city. Abiathar also came
up.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה גַם־צָדוֹק וְכל־הַלְוִיִּם אִתּוֹ נֹשְׂאִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּצִּקוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַל אֶבְיָתָר עַד־תֹּם כּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר מִן־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה גַם־צָדוֹק וְכל־הַלְוִיִּם אִתּוֹ נֹשְׂאִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּצִּקוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַל אֶבְיָתָר עַד־תֹּם כּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר מִן־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
Then Zadok appeared, with all the Levites carrying the Ark of the
Covenant of God; and they set down the Ark of God until all the
people had finished marching out of the city. Abiathar also came
up.

translation.text: Abiathar came up, and Zadok also, with all the Levites, carrying the people had all passed out of the city.

verses.english:
But the king said to Zadok, “Take the Ark of God back to the city.
If I find favor with YHWH, He will bring me back and let me see it
and its abode.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצָדוֹק הָשֵׁב אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים הָעִיר אִם־אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וֶהֱשִׁבַנִי וְהִרְאַנִי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצָדוֹק הָשֵׁב אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים הָעִיר אִם־אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וֶהֱשִׁבַנִי וְהִרְאַנִי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ׃

english.text:
But the king said to Zadok, “Take the Ark of God back to the city.
If I find favor with YHWH, He will bring me back and let me see it
and its abode.

translation.text: Then the king said to Zadok, "Carry the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the eyes of where it stays.

verses.english:
And if He should say, ‘I do not want you,’ I am ready; let Him do
with me as He pleases.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי בָּךְ הִנְנִי יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר טוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי בָּךְ הִנְנִי יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר טוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
And if He should say, ‘I do not want you,’ I am ready; let Him do
with me as He pleases.”

translation.text: But if he says, 'I take no pleasure in you,' here I am, let him do to me what seems good to him."

verses.english:
And the king said to the priest Zadok, “Do you understand? You
return to the safety of the city with your two sons, your own son
Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן הֲרוֹאֶה אַתָּה שֻׁבָה הָעִיר בְּשָׁלוֹם וַאֲחִימַעַץ בִּנְךָ וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר שְׁנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן הֲרוֹאֶה אַתָּה שֻׁבָה הָעִיר בְּשָׁלוֹם וַאֲחִימַעַץ בִּנְךָ וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר שְׁנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
And the king said to the priest Zadok, “Do you understand? You
return to the safety of the city with your two sons, your own son
Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan.

translation.text: The king also said to the with your two sons, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan son of Abiathar.

verses.english:
Look, I shall linger in the steppes of the wilderness until word
comes from you to inform me.”
verses.hebrew: רְאוּ אָנֹכִי מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ (בעברות) [בְּעַרְבוֹת] הַמִּדְבָּר עַד בּוֹא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם לְהַגִּיד לִי׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּ אָנֹכִי מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ (בעברות) [בְּעַרְבוֹת] הַמִּדְבָּר עַד בּוֹא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם לְהַגִּיד לִי׃

english.text:
Look, I shall linger in the steppes of the wilderness until word
comes from you to inform me.”

translation.text: See, I will wait at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me."

verses.english:
Zadok and Abiathar brought the Ark of God back to Jerusalem, and
they stayed there.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
Zadok and Abiathar brought the Ark of God back to Jerusalem, and
they stayed there.

translation.text: So Zadok and Abiathar carried the ark of God back to Jerusalem, and they remained there.

verses.english:
David meanwhile went up the slope of the [Mount of] Olives,
weeping as he went; his head was covered and he walked barefoot.
And all the people who were with him covered their heads and wept
as they went up.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד עֹלֶה בְמַעֲלֵה הַזֵּיתִים עֹלֶה וּבוֹכֶה וְרֹאשׁ לוֹ חָפוּי וְהוּא הֹלֵךְ יָחֵף וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ חָפוּ אִישׁ רֹאשׁוֹ וְעָלוּ עָלֹה וּבָכֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד עֹלֶה בְמַעֲלֵה הַזֵּיתִים עֹלֶה וּבוֹכֶה וְרֹאשׁ לוֹ חָפוּי וְהוּא הֹלֵךְ יָחֵף וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ חָפוּ אִישׁ רֹאשׁוֹ וְעָלוּ עָלֹה וּבָכֹה׃

english.text:
David meanwhile went up the slope of the [Mount of] Olives,
weeping as he went; his head was covered and he walked barefoot.
And all the people who were with him covered their heads and wept
as they went up.

translation.text: But David went up the ascent of the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went.

verses.english:
David [was] told that Ahithophel was among the conspirators with
Absalom, and he prayed, “Please, O LORD, frustrate Ahithophel’s
counsel!”
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הִגִּיד לֵאמֹר אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּקֹּשְׁרִים עִם־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד סַכֶּל־נָא אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד הִגִּיד לֵאמֹר אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּקֹּשְׁרִים עִם־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד סַכֶּל־נָא אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David [was] told that Ahithophel was among the conspirators with
Absalom, and he prayed, “Please, O LORD, frustrate Ahithophel’s
counsel!”

translation.text: David was told that Ahithophel was among the conspirators Ahithophel into foolishness."

verses.english:
When David reached the top, where people would prostrate
themselves to God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him, with
his robe torn and with earth on his head.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דָוִד בָּא עַד־הָרֹאשׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה שָׁם לֵאלֹהִים וְהִנֵּה לִקְרָאתוֹ חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי קָרוּעַ כֻּתּנְתּוֹ וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דָוִד בָּא עַד־הָרֹאשׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה שָׁם לֵאלֹהִים וְהִנֵּה לִקְרָאתוֹ חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי קָרוּעַ כֻּתּנְתּוֹ וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
When David reached the top, where people would prostrate
themselves to God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him, with
his robe torn and with earth on his head.

translation.text: When David came to the summit, where God was worshiped, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat torn and earth on his head.

verses.english:
David said to him, “If you march on with me, you will be a burden
to me.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אִם עָבַרְתָּ אִתִּי וְהָיִתָ עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אִם עָבַרְתָּ אִתִּי וְהָיִתָ עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃

english.text:
David said to him, “If you march on with me, you will be a burden
to me.

translation.text: David said to him, "If you go on with me, you will be a burden to me.

verses.english:
But if you go back to the city and say to Absalom, ‘I will be your
servant, O king; I was your father’s servant formerly, and now I
will be yours,’ then you can nullify Ahithophel’s counsel for me.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָעִיר תָּשׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם עַבְדְּךָ אֲנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶהְיֶה עֶבֶד אָבִיךָ וַאֲנִי מֵאָז וְעַתָּה וַאֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ וְהֵפַרְתָּה לִי אֵת עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־הָעִיר תָּשׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם עַבְדְּךָ אֲנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶהְיֶה עֶבֶד אָבִיךָ וַאֲנִי מֵאָז וְעַתָּה וַאֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ וְהֵפַרְתָּה לִי אֵת עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

english.text:
But if you go back to the city and say to Absalom, ‘I will be your
servant, O king; I was your father’s servant formerly, and now I
will be yours,’ then you can nullify Ahithophel’s counsel for me.

translation.text: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, 'I will be your now I will be your servant,' then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.

verses.english:
You will have the priests Zadok and Abiathar there, and you can
report everything that you hear in the king’s palace to the
priests Zadok and Abiathar.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲלוֹא עִמְּךָ שָׁם צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָיָה כּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמַע מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּגִּיד לְצָדוֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲלוֹא עִמְּךָ שָׁם צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָיָה כּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמַע מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּגִּיד לְצָדוֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

english.text:
You will have the priests Zadok and Abiathar there, and you can
report everything that you hear in the king’s palace to the
priests Zadok and Abiathar.

translation.text: The priests Zadok and Abiathar will be with you there. So whatever you hear from the king's house, tell it to the priests Zadok and Abiathar.

verses.english:
Also, their two sons are there with them, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz and
Abiathar’s son Jonathan; and through them you can report to me
everything you hear.”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־שָׁם עִמָּם שְׁנֵי בְנֵיהֶם אֲחִימַעַץ לְצָדוֹק וִיהוֹנָתָן לְאֶבְיָתָר וּשְׁלַחְתֶּם בְּיָדָם אֵלַי כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמָעוּ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה־שָׁם עִמָּם שְׁנֵי בְנֵיהֶם אֲחִימַעַץ לְצָדוֹק וִיהוֹנָתָן לְאֶבְיָתָר וּשְׁלַחְתֶּם בְּיָדָם אֵלַי כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמָעוּ׃

english.text:
Also, their two sons are there with them, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz and
Abiathar’s son Jonathan; and through them you can report to me
everything you hear.”

translation.text: Their two sons are with them there, Zadok's son me everything you hear."

verses.english:
And so Hushai, the friend of David, reached the city as Absalom
was entering Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי רֵעֶה דָוִד הָעִיר וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם יָבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי רֵעֶה דָוִד הָעִיר וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם יָבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
And so Hushai, the friend of David, reached the city as Absalom
was entering Jerusalem.

translation.text: So Hushai, David's friend, came into the city, just as Absalom was entering Jerusalem.

verses.english:
David had passed a little beyond the summit when Ziba the servant
of Mephibosheth came toward him with a pair of saddled asses
carrying two hundred loaves of bread, one hundred cakes of raisin,
one hundred cakes of figs, and a jar of wine.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד עָבַר מְעַט מֵהָרֹאשׁ וְהִנֵּה צִיבָא נַעַר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת לִקְרָאתוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַעֲלֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּמֵאָה צִמּוּקִים וּמֵאָה קַיִץ וְנֵבֶל יָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד עָבַר מְעַט מֵהָרֹאשׁ וְהִנֵּה צִיבָא נַעַר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת לִקְרָאתוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַעֲלֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּמֵאָה צִמּוּקִים וּמֵאָה קַיִץ וְנֵבֶל יָיִן׃

english.text:
David had passed a little beyond the summit when Ziba the servant
of Mephibosheth came toward him with a pair of saddled asses
carrying two hundred loaves of bread, one hundred cakes of raisin,
one hundred cakes of figs, and a jar of wine.

translation.text: When David had passed a little beyond the summit, Ziba the servant hundred of summer fruits, and one skin of wine.

verses.english:
The king asked Ziba, “What are you doing with these?” Ziba
answered, “The asses are for Your Majesty’s family to ride on, the
bread and figs are for the attendants to eat, and the wine is to
be drunk by any who are exhausted in the wilderness.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הַחֲמוֹרִים לְבֵית־הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְכֹּב (ולהלחם) [וְהַלֶּחֶם] וְהַקַּיִץ לֶאֱכוֹל הַנְּעָרִים וְהַיַּיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת
הַיָּעֵף בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הַחֲמוֹרִים לְבֵית־הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְכֹּב (ולהלחם) [וְהַלֶּחֶם] וְהַקַּיִץ לֶאֱכוֹל הַנְּעָרִים וְהַיַּיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת
הַיָּעֵף בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
The king asked Ziba, “What are you doing with these?” Ziba
answered, “The asses are for Your Majesty’s family to ride on, the
bread and figs are for the attendants to eat, and the wine is to
be drunk by any who are exhausted in the wilderness.”

translation.text: The king said to the wilderness."

verses.english:
“And where is your master’s son?” the king asked. “He is staying
in Jerusalem,” Ziba replied to the king, “for he thinks that the
House of Israel will now give him back the throne of his
grandfather.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַיֵּה בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי אָמַר הַיּוֹם יָשִׁיבוּ לִי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת מַמְלְכוּת אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַיֵּה בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי אָמַר הַיּוֹם יָשִׁיבוּ לִי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת מַמְלְכוּת אָבִי׃

english.text:
“And where is your master’s son?” the king asked. “He is staying
in Jerusalem,” Ziba replied to the king, “for he thinks that the
House of Israel will now give him back the throne of his
grandfather.”

translation.text: The king said, "And where is your master's son?" Ziba said to the king, "He remains in Jerusalem; for he said, 'Today the house of Israel will give me back my grandfather's kingdom.'"

verses.english:
The king said to Ziba, “Then all that belongs to Mephibosheth is
now yours!” And Ziba replied, “I bow low. Your Majesty is most
gracious to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצִבָא הִנֵּה לְךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצִבָא הִנֵּה לְךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The king said to Ziba, “Then all that belongs to Mephibosheth is
now yours!” And Ziba replied, “I bow low. Your Majesty is most
gracious to me.”

translation.text: Then yours." Ziba said, "I do obeisance; let me find favor in your sight, my lord the king."

verses.english:
As King David was approaching Bahurim, a member of Saul’s clan—a
man named Shimei son of Gera—came out from there, hurling insults
as he came.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד עַד־בַּחוּרִים וְהִנֵּה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא יֹצֵא יָצוֹא וּמְקַלֵּל׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד עַד־בַּחוּרִים וְהִנֵּה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא יֹצֵא יָצוֹא וּמְקַלֵּל׃

english.text:
As King David was approaching Bahurim, a member of Saul’s clan—a
man named Shimei son of Gera—came out from there, hurling insults
as he came.

translation.text: When King David came to Bahurim, a man of the family of the house cursing.

verses.english:
He threw stones at David and all King David’s courtiers, while all
the troops and all the warriors were at his right and his left.
verses.hebrew: וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים אֶת־דָּוִד וְאֶת־כּל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים אֶת־דָּוִד וְאֶת־כּל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃

english.text:
He threw stones at David and all King David’s courtiers, while all
the troops and all the warriors were at his right and his left.

translation.text: He threw stones at David and at all the servants of King David; now all the people and all the warriors were on his right and on his left.

verses.english:
And these are the insults that Shimei hurled: “Get out, get out,
you criminal, you villain!
verses.hebrew: וְכֹה־אָמַר שִׁמְעִי בְּקַלְלוֹ צֵא צֵא אִישׁ הַדָּמִים וְאִישׁ הַבְּלִיָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹה־אָמַר שִׁמְעִי בְּקַלְלוֹ צֵא צֵא אִישׁ הַדָּמִים וְאִישׁ הַבְּלִיָּעַל׃

english.text:
And these are the insults that Shimei hurled: “Get out, get out,
you criminal, you villain!

translation.text: Shimei shouted while he cursed, "Out! Out! Murderer! Scoundrel!

verses.english:
YHWH is paying you back for all your crimes against the family of
Saul, whose throne you seized. YHWH is handing over the throne to
your son Absalom; you are in trouble because you are a criminal!”
verses.hebrew:
