fords of the wilderness, but cross over at once; otherwise the
king and all the troops with him will be annihilated.’”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שִׁלְחוּ מְהֵרָה וְהַגִּידוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַל־תָּלֶן הַלַּיְלָה בְּעַרְבוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר וְגַם עָבוֹר תַּעֲבוֹר פֶּן יְבֻלַּע לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שִׁלְחוּ מְהֵרָה וְהַגִּידוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַל־תָּלֶן הַלַּיְלָה בְּעַרְבוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר וְגַם עָבוֹר תַּעֲבוֹר פֶּן יְבֻלַּע לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Now send at once and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the
fords of the wilderness, but cross over at once; otherwise the
king and all the troops with him will be annihilated.’”

translation.text: Therefore send quickly and tell David, 'Do not swallowed up.'"

verses.english:
Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, and a slave girl
would go and bring them word and they in turn would go and inform
King David. For they themselves dared not be seen entering the
city.
verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹנָתָן וַאֲחִימַעַץ עֹמְדִים בְּעֵין־רֹגֵל וְהָלְכָה הַשִּׁפְחָה וְהִגִּידָה לָהֶם וְהֵם יֵלְכוּ וְהִגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת לָבוֹא הָעִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹנָתָן וַאֲחִימַעַץ עֹמְדִים בְּעֵין־רֹגֵל וְהָלְכָה הַשִּׁפְחָה וְהִגִּידָה לָהֶם וְהֵם יֵלְכוּ וְהִגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת לָבוֹא הָעִירָה׃

english.text:
Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, and a slave girl
would go and bring them word and they in turn would go and inform
King David. For they themselves dared not be seen entering the
city.

translation.text: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were waiting at En-rogel; a David; for they could not risk being seen entering the city.

verses.english:
But a boy saw them and informed Absalom. They left at once and
came to the house of a man in Bahurim who had a well in his
courtyard. They got down into it,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֹתָם נַעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְשָׁלֹם וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־אִישׁ בְּבַחוּרִים וְלוֹ בְאֵר בַּחֲצֵרוֹ וַיֵּרְדוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֹתָם נַעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְשָׁלֹם וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־אִישׁ בְּבַחוּרִים וְלוֹ בְאֵר בַּחֲצֵרוֹ וַיֵּרְדוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
But a boy saw them and informed Absalom. They left at once and
came to the house of a man in Bahurim who had a well in his
courtyard. They got down into it,

translation.text: But a boy courtyard; and they went down into it.

verses.english:
and the wife took a cloth, spread it over the mouth of the well,
and scattered groats on top of it, so that nothing would be
noticed.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת־הַמָּסָךְ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבְּאֵר וַתִּשְׁטַח עָלָיו הָרִפוֹת וְלֹא נוֹדַע דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת־הַמָּסָךְ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבְּאֵר וַתִּשְׁטַח עָלָיו הָרִפוֹת וְלֹא נוֹדַע דָּבָר׃

english.text:
and the wife took a cloth, spread it over the mouth of the well,
and scattered groats on top of it, so that nothing would be
noticed.

translation.text: The man's wife took a covering, stretched it over the well's mouth, and spread out grain on it; and nothing was known of it.

verses.english:
When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house and asked
where Ahimaaz and Jonathan were, the woman told them that they had
crossed a bit beyond the water. They searched, but found nothing;
and they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה הַבַּיְתָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַיֵּה אֲחִימַעַץ וִיהוֹנָתָן וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָאִשָּׁה עָבְרוּ מִיכַל הַמָּיִם וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה הַבַּיְתָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַיֵּה אֲחִימַעַץ וִיהוֹנָתָן וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָאִשָּׁה עָבְרוּ מִיכַל הַמָּיִם וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house and asked
where Ahimaaz and Jonathan were, the woman told them that they had
crossed a bit beyond the water. They searched, but found nothing;
and they returned to Jerusalem.

translation.text: When Absalom's servants came to the woman at the house, they said, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" returned to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
After they were gone, [Ahimaaz and Jonathan] came up from the well
and went and informed King David. They said to David, “Go and
cross the water quickly, for Ahithophel has advised thus and thus
concerning you.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי לֶכְתָּם וַיַּעֲלוּ מֵהַבְּאֵר וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד קוּמוּ וְעִבְרוּ מְהֵרָה אֶת־הַמַּיִם כִּי־כָכָה יָעַץ עֲלֵיכֶם
אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי לֶכְתָּם וַיַּעֲלוּ מֵהַבְּאֵר וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד קוּמוּ וְעִבְרוּ מְהֵרָה אֶת־הַמַּיִם כִּי־כָכָה יָעַץ עֲלֵיכֶם
אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

english.text:
After they were gone, [Ahimaaz and Jonathan] came up from the well
and went and informed King David. They said to David, “Go and
cross the water quickly, for Ahithophel has advised thus and thus
concerning you.”

translation.text: After they had gone, the men came up out of the well, and went quickly; for thus and so has Ahithophel counseled against you."

verses.english:
David and all the troops with him promptly crossed the Jordan, and
by daybreak not one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר עַד־אַחַד לֹא נֶעְדָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר עַד־אַחַד לֹא נֶעְדָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
David and all the troops with him promptly crossed the Jordan, and
by daybreak not one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

translation.text: So Jordan; by daybreak not one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

verses.english:
When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he
saddled his ass and went home to his native town. He set his
affairs in order, and then he hanged himself. He was buried in his
ancestral tomb.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל רָאָה כִּי לֹא נֶעֶשְׂתָה עֲצָתוֹ וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־עִירוֹ וַיְצַו אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֵּחָנַק וַיָּמת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל רָאָה כִּי לֹא נֶעֶשְׂתָה עֲצָתוֹ וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־עִירוֹ וַיְצַו אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֵּחָנַק וַיָּמת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו׃

english.text:
When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he
saddled his ass and went home to his native town. He set his
affairs in order, and then he hanged himself. He was buried in his
ancestral tomb.

translation.text: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled father.

verses.english:
David had reached Mahanaim when Absalom and all the men of Israel
with him crossed the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בָּא מַחֲנָיְמָה וְאַבְשָׁלֹם עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד בָּא מַחֲנָיְמָה וְאַבְשָׁלֹם עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David had reached Mahanaim when Absalom and all the men of Israel
with him crossed the Jordan.

translation.text: Then David came to Mahanaim, while Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.

verses.english:
Absalom had appointed Amasa army commander in place of Joab; Amasa
was the son of a man named Ithra the Israelite, who had married
Abigal, daughter of Nahash and sister of Joab’s mother Zeruiah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא שָׂם אַבְשָׁלֹם תַּחַת יוֹאָב עַל־הַצָּבָא וַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־אִישׁ וּשְׁמוֹ יִתְרָא הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־אֲבִיגַל בַּת־נָחָשׁ אֲחוֹת צְרוּיָה אֵם יוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא שָׂם אַבְשָׁלֹם תַּחַת יוֹאָב עַל־הַצָּבָא וַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־אִישׁ וּשְׁמוֹ יִתְרָא הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־אֲבִיגַל בַּת־נָחָשׁ אֲחוֹת צְרוּיָה אֵם יוֹאָב׃

english.text:
Absalom had appointed Amasa army commander in place of Joab; Amasa
was the son of a man named Ithra the Israelite, who had married
Abigal, daughter of Nahash and sister of Joab’s mother Zeruiah.

translation.text: Now Absalom had set Amasa over the Zeruiah, Joab's mother.

verses.english: The Israelites and Absalom encamped in the district of Gilead.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַבְשָׁלֹם אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַבְשָׁלֹם אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text: The Israelites and Absalom encamped in the district of Gilead.

translation.text: The Israelites and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

verses.english:
When David reached Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from
Rabbath-ammon, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai
the Gileadite from Rogelim
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא דָוִד מַחֲנָיְמָה וְשֹׁבִי בֶן־נָחָשׁ מֵרַבַּת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּמָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלֹּא דְבָר וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי מֵרֹגְלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא דָוִד מַחֲנָיְמָה וְשֹׁבִי בֶן־נָחָשׁ מֵרַבַּת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּמָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלֹּא דְבָר וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי מֵרֹגְלִים׃

english.text:
When David reached Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from
Rabbath-ammon, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai
the Gileadite from Rogelim

translation.text: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim,

verses.english:
presented couches, basins, and earthenware; also wheat, barley,
flour, parched grain, beans, lentils, parched grain,
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁכָּב וְסַפּוֹת וּכְלִי יוֹצֵר וְחִטִּים וּשְׂעֹרִים וְקֶמַח וְקָלִי וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְקָלִי׃

hebrew.text: מִשְׁכָּב וְסַפּוֹת וּכְלִי יוֹצֵר וְחִטִּים וּשְׂעֹרִים וְקֶמַח וְקָלִי וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְקָלִי׃

english.text:
presented couches, basins, and earthenware; also wheat, barley,
flour, parched grain, beans, lentils, parched grain,

translation.text: brought beds, basins, and earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans and lentils,

verses.english:
honey, curds, a flock, and cheese from the herd for David and the
troops with him to eat. For they knew that the troops must have
grown hungry, faint, and thirsty in the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וּדְבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה וְצֹאן וּשְׁפוֹת בָּקָר הִגִּישׁוּ לְדָוִד וְלָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ לֶאֱכוֹל כִּי אָמְרוּ הָעָם רָעֵב וְעָיֵף וְצָמֵא בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה וְצֹאן וּשְׁפוֹת בָּקָר הִגִּישׁוּ לְדָוִד וְלָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ לֶאֱכוֹל כִּי אָמְרוּ הָעָם רָעֵב וְעָיֵף וְצָמֵא בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
honey, curds, a flock, and cheese from the herd for David and the
troops with him to eat. For they knew that the troops must have
grown hungry, faint, and thirsty in the wilderness.

translation.text: honey and curds, sheep, and cheese from the herd, for David and weary and thirsty in the wilderness."

verses.english:
David mustered the troops who were with him and set over them
captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עֲלֵיהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עֲלֵיהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
David mustered the troops who were with him and set over them
captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.

translation.text: Then David mustered the men who were with him, and set over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

verses.english:
David sent out the troops, one-third under the command of Joab,
one-third under the command of Joab’s brother Abishai son of
Zeruiah, and one-third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. And
David said to the troops, “I myself will march out with you.”
verses.hebrew:

english.text:
David sent out the troops, one-third under the command of Joab,
one-third under the command of Joab’s brother Abishai son of
Zeruiah, and one-third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. And
David said to the troops, “I myself will march out with you.”

translation.text: And David king said to the men, "I myself will also go out with you."

verses.english:
But the troops replied, “No! For if some of us flee, the rest will
not be concerned about us; even if half of us should die, the
others will not be concerned about us. But you are worth ten
thousand of us. Therefore, it is better for you to support us from
the town.”

verses.english:
The king gave orders to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: “Deal gently
with my boy Absalom, for my sake.” All the troops heard the king
give the order about Absalom to all the officers.

verses.english:
The troops marched out into the open to confront the Israelites,
and the battle was fought in the forest of Ephraim.

The troops marched out into the open to confront the Israelites,
and the battle was fought in the forest of Ephraim.

translation.text: So the army went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was fought in the forest of Ephraim.

verses.english:
The Israelite troops were routed by David’s followers, and a great
slaughter took place there that day—twenty thousand men.

verses.english:
The battle spread out over that whole region, and the forest
devoured more troops that day than the sword.

between heaven and earth as the mule under him kept going.

silver and a belt.”

Then Joab sounded the horn, and the troops gave up their pursuit
of the Israelites; for Joab held the troops in check.

english.text:
Then Joab sounded the horn, and the troops gave up their pursuit
of the Israelites; for Joab held the troops in check.

translation.text: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops came back from pursuing Israel, for Joab restrained the troops.

verses.english:
They took Absalom and flung him into a large pit in the forest,
and they piled up a very great heap of stones over it. Then all
the Israelites fled to their homes.—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ בַיַּעַר אֶל־הַפַּחַת הַגָּדוֹל וַיַּצִּבוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נָסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

They took Absalom and flung him into a large pit in the forest,
and they piled up a very great heap of stones over it. Then all
the Israelites fled to their homes.—

Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, “Let me run and report to the king that
YHWH has vindicated him against his enemies.”

english.text:
Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, “Let me run and report to the king that
YHWH has vindicated him against his enemies.”

translation.text: Then Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, "Let me run, and carry tidings to enemies."

verses.english:
But Joab said to him, “You shall not be the one to bring tidings
today. You may bring tidings some other day, but you’ll not bring
any today; for the king’s son is dead!”

verses.english:
And Joab said to a Cushite, “Go tell the king what you have seen.”
The Cushite bowed to Joab and ran off.

english.text:
And Joab said to a Cushite, “Go tell the king what you have seen.”
The Cushite bowed to Joab and ran off.

translation.text: Then Joab said to a Cushite, "Go, tell the king what you have seen." The Cushite bowed before Joab, and ran.

verses.english:
But Ahimaaz son of Zadok again said to Joab, “No matter what, let
me run, too, behind the Cushite.” Joab asked, “Why should you run,
my boy, when you have no news worth telling?”

translation.text: son, seeing that you have no reward for the tidings?"

“I am going to run anyway.” “Then run,” he said. So Ahimaaz ran by
way of the Plain, and he passed the Cushite.

“I am going to run anyway.” “Then run,” he said. So Ahimaaz ran by

translation.text: "Come what may," he said, "I will run." So he said to him, "Run." Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

verses.english:
David was sitting between the two gates. The watchman on the roof
of the gate walked over to the city wall. He looked up and saw a
man running alone.

son of Zadok”; to which the king replied, “He is a good man, and
he comes with good news.”

The watchman said, “I can see that the first one runs like Ahimaaz

he comes with good news.”

Ahimaaz called out and said to the king, “All is well!” He bowed
low with his face to the ground and said, “Praised be YHWH your
God, who has delivered up the men who raised their hand against my
lord the king.”

low with his face to the ground and said, “Praised be YHWH your
God, who has delivered up the men who raised their hand against my
lord the king.”

translation.text: Then Ahimaaz cried out to the king, "All is well!" He prostrated himself before the king with his face to the ground, and said, "Blessed hand against my lord the king."

verses.english:
The king asked, “Is my boy Absalom safe?” And Ahimaaz answered, “I
saw a large crowd when Your Majesty’s servant Joab was sending
your servant off, but I don’t know what it was about.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִימַעַץ רָאִיתִי הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־עֶבֶד הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִימַעַץ רָאִיתִי הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־עֶבֶד הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מָה׃

english.text:
The king asked, “Is my boy Absalom safe?” And Ahimaaz answered, “I
saw a large crowd when Your Majesty’s servant Joab was sending
your servant off, but I don’t know what it was about.”

translation.text: The king said, "Is it well with the servant, I saw a great tumult, but I do not know what it was."

verses.english:
The king said, “Step aside and stand over there”; he stepped aside

verses.english:
He replied, “My lord the king, my own servant deceived me. Your
servant planned to saddle his ass and ride on it and go with Your
Majesty—for your servant is lame.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַבְדִּי רִמָּנִי כִּי־אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְבְּשָׁה־לִּי הַחֲמוֹר וְאֶרְכַּב עָלֶיהָ וְאֵלֵךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי פִסֵּחַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַבְדִּי רִמָּנִי כִּי־אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְבְּשָׁה־לִּי הַחֲמוֹר וְאֶרְכַּב עָלֶיהָ וְאֵלֵךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי פִסֵּחַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
He replied, “My lord the king, my own servant deceived me. Your
servant planned to saddle his ass and ride on it and go with Your
Majesty—for your servant is lame.

translation.text: He answered, "My lord, O king, my servant deceived me; for your servant said to him, 'Saddle a donkey for me, so that I may ride on it and go with the king.' For your servant is lame.

verses.english:
[Ziba] has slandered your servant to my lord the king. But my lord
the king is like an angel of YHWH; do as you see fit.
verses.hebrew: וַיְרַגֵּל בְּעַבְדְּךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים וַעֲשֵׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְרַגֵּל בְּעַבְדְּךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים וַעֲשֵׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
[Ziba] has slandered your servant to my lord the king. But my lord
the king is like an angel of YHWH; do as you see fit.

translation.text: He has slandered your servant to my lord what seems good to you.

verses.english:
For all the members of my father’s family deserved only death from
my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at
your table. What right have I to appeal further to Your Majesty?”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הָיָה כּל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי אִם־אַנְשֵׁי־מָוֶת לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתָּשֶׁת אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ וּמַה־יֶּשׁ־לִי עוֹד צְדָקָה וְלִזְעֹק עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא הָיָה כּל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי אִם־אַנְשֵׁי־מָוֶת לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתָּשֶׁת אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ וּמַה־יֶּשׁ־לִי עוֹד צְדָקָה וְלִזְעֹק עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
For all the members of my father’s family deserved only death from
my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at
your table. What right have I to appeal further to Your Majesty?”

translation.text: For all my father's house were doomed to who eat at your table. What further right have I, then, to appeal to the king?"

verses.english:
The king said to him, “You need not speak further. I decree that
you and Ziba shall divide the property.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה תְּדַבֵּר עוֹד דְּבָרֶיךָ אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה וְצִיבָא תַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה תְּדַבֵּר עוֹד דְּבָרֶיךָ אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה וְצִיבָא תַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The king said to him, “You need not speak further. I decree that
you and Ziba shall divide the property.”

translation.text: The king said to him, "Why speak any more of your affairs? I have decided: you and Ziba shall divide the land."

verses.english:
And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Let him take it all, as long
as my lord the king has come home safe.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם אֶת־הַכֹּל יִקָּח אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם אֶת־הַכֹּל יִקָּח אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Let him take it all, as long
as my lord the king has come home safe.”

translation.text: Mephibosheth said to the king, "Let him take it all, since my lord the king has arrived home safely."

verses.english:
Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelin and passed on
to the Jordan with the king, to see him off at the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי יָרַד מֵרֹגְלִים וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ אֶת־[הַיַּרְדֵּן] (בירדן)׃

hebrew.text: וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי יָרַד מֵרֹגְלִים וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ אֶת־[הַיַּרְדֵּן] (בירדן)׃

english.text:
Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelin and passed on
to the Jordan with the king, to see him off at the Jordan.

translation.text: Now Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelim; he went on with the king to the Jordan, to escort him over the Jordan.

verses.english:
Barzillai was very old, eighty years of age; and he had provided
the king with food during his stay at Mahanaim, for he was a very
wealthy man.
verses.hebrew: וּבַרְזִלַּי זָקֵן מְאֹד בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְהוּא־כִלְכַּל אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשִׁיבָתוֹ בְמַחֲנַיִם כִּי־אִישׁ גָּדוֹל הוּא מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּבַרְזִלַּי זָקֵן מְאֹד בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְהוּא־כִלְכַּל אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשִׁיבָתוֹ בְמַחֲנַיִם כִּי־אִישׁ גָּדוֹל הוּא מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Barzillai was very old, eighty years of age; and he had provided
the king with food during his stay at Mahanaim, for he was a very
wealthy man.

translation.text: wealthy man.

verses.english:
The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will
provide for you in Jerusalem at my side.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בַּרְזִלָּי אַתָּה עֲבֹר אִתִּי וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ עִמָּדִי בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בַּרְזִלָּי אַתָּה עֲבֹר אִתִּי וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ עִמָּדִי בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will
provide for you in Jerusalem at my side.”

translation.text: The king said to Barzillai, "Come over with me, and I will provide for you in Jerusalem at my side."

verses.english:
But Barzillai said to the king, “How many years are left to me
that I should go up with Your Majesty to Jerusalem?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּרְזִלַּי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי כִּי־אֶעֱלֶה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּרְזִלַּי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי כִּי־אֶעֱלֶה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
But Barzillai said to the king, “How many years are left to me
that I should go up with Your Majesty to Jerusalem?

translation.text: But Barzillai said to the king, "How many years have I still to live, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

verses.english:
I am now eighty years old. Can I tell the difference between good
and bad? Can your servant taste what he eats and drinks? Can I
still listen to the singing of men and women? Why then should your
servant continue to be a burden to my lord the king?
verses.hebrew:
בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם הַאֵדַע בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע אִם־יִטְעַם עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֹכַל וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁתֶּה אִם־אֶשְׁמַע עוֹד בְּקוֹל שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְלָמָּה
יִהְיֶה עַבְדְּךָ עוֹד לְמַשָּׂא אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם הַאֵדַע בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע אִם־יִטְעַם עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֹכַל וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁתֶּה אִם־אֶשְׁמַע עוֹד בְּקוֹל שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְלָמָּה
יִהְיֶה עַבְדְּךָ עוֹד לְמַשָּׂא אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
I am now eighty years old. Can I tell the difference between good
and bad? Can your servant taste what he eats and drinks? Can I
still listen to the singing of men and women? Why then should your
servant continue to be a burden to my lord the king?

translation.text: Today I am eighty years old; can I discern my lord the king?

verses.english:
Your servant could barely cross the Jordan with your Majesty! Why
should Your Majesty reward me so generously?
verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט יַעֲבֹר עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלָמָּה יִגְמְלֵנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגְּמוּלָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כִּמְעַט יַעֲבֹר עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלָמָּה יִגְמְלֵנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגְּמוּלָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Your servant could barely cross the Jordan with your Majesty! Why
should Your Majesty reward me so generously?

translation.text: Your servant will go a little way over the Jordan reward?

verses.english:
Let your servant go back, and let me die in my own town, near the
graves of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham;
let him cross with my lord the king, and do for him as you see
fit.”
verses.hebrew: יָשׁב־נָא עַבְדְּךָ וְאָמֻת בְּעִירִי עִם קֶבֶר אָבִי וְאִמִּי וְהִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ כִמְהָם יַעֲבֹר עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲשֵׂה־לוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: יָשׁב־נָא עַבְדְּךָ וְאָמֻת בְּעִירִי עִם קֶבֶר אָבִי וְאִמִּי וְהִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ כִמְהָם יַעֲבֹר עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲשֵׂה־לוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Let your servant go back, and let me die in my own town, near the
graves of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham;
let him cross with my lord the king, and do for him as you see
fit.”

translation.text: Please let your servant return, so that I may die in my own him whatever seems good to you."

verses.english:
And the king said, “Chimham shall cross with me, and I will do for
him as you see fit; and anything you want me to do, I will do for
you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִתִּי יַעֲבֹר כִּמְהָם וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אֶת־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תִּבְחַר עָלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִתִּי יַעֲבֹר כִּמְהָם וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אֶת־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תִּבְחַר עָלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
And the king said, “Chimham shall cross with me, and I will do for
him as you see fit; and anything you want me to do, I will do for
you.”

translation.text: The king answered, "Chimham you; and all that you desire of me I will do for you."

verses.english:
All the troops crossed the Jordan; and when the king was ready to
cross, the king kissed Barzillai and bade him farewell; and
[Barzillai] returned to his home.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר כּל־הָעָם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עָבָר וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַרְזִלַּי וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר כּל־הָעָם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עָבָר וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַרְזִלַּי וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
All the troops crossed the Jordan; and when the king was ready to
cross, the king kissed Barzillai and bade him farewell; and
[Barzillai] returned to his home.

translation.text: Then all the kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and he returned to his own home.

verses.english:
The king passed on to Gilgal, with Chimham accompanying him; and
all the Judite soldiers and part of the Israelite army escorted
the king across.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְכִמְהָן עָבַר עִמּוֹ וְכל־עַם יְהוּדָה (ויעברו) [הֶעֱבִירוּ] אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם חֲצִי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְכִמְהָן עָבַר עִמּוֹ וְכל־עַם יְהוּדָה (ויעברו) [הֶעֱבִירוּ] אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם חֲצִי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The king passed on to Gilgal, with Chimham accompanying him; and
all the Judite soldiers and part of the Israelite army escorted
the king across.

translation.text: on his way.

verses.english:
Then all the men of Israel came to the king and said to the king,
“Why did our kinsmen, the men of Judah, steal you away and escort
the king and his family across the Jordan, along with all David’s
men?”
verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ גְּנָבוּךָ אַחֵינוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיַּעֲבִרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ גְּנָבוּךָ אַחֵינוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיַּעֲבִרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
Then all the men of Israel came to the king and said to the king,
“Why did our kinsmen, the men of Judah, steal you away and escort
the king and his family across the Jordan, along with all David’s
men?”

translation.text: Then all the people of Israel came to the king, and said to him, men with him?"

verses.english:
All the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “Because the
king is our relative! Why should this upset you? Have we consumed
anything that belongs to the king? Has he given us any gifts?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה עַל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־קָרוֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלַי וְלָמָּה זֶּה חָרָה לְךָ עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הֶאָכוֹל אָכַלְנוּ מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־נִשֵּׂאת נִשָּׂא
לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה עַל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־קָרוֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלַי וְלָמָּה זֶּה חָרָה לְךָ עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הֶאָכוֹל אָכַלְנוּ מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־נִשֵּׂאת נִשָּׂא
לָנוּ׃

english.text:
All the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “Because the
king is our relative! Why should this upset you? Have we consumed
anything that belongs to the king? Has he given us any gifts?”

translation.text: All the people of Judah answered the people of over this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king's expense? Or has he given us any gift?"

verses.english:
But the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, “We have ten
shares in the king, and in David, too, we have more than you. Why
then have you slighted us? Were we not the first to propose that
our king be brought back?” However, the men of Judah prevailed
over the men of Israel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֶשֶׂר־יָדוֹת לִי בַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם־בְּדָוִד אֲנִי מִמְּךָ וּמַדּוּעַ הֱקִלֹּתַנִי וְלֹא־הָיָה דְבָרִי רִאשׁוֹן לִי לְהָשִׁיב
אֶת־מַלְכִּי וַיִּקֶשׁ דְּבַר־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה מִדְּבַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֶשֶׂר־יָדוֹת לִי בַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם־בְּדָוִד אֲנִי מִמְּךָ וּמַדּוּעַ הֱקִלֹּתַנִי וְלֹא־הָיָה דְבָרִי רִאשׁוֹן לִי לְהָשִׁיב
אֶת־מַלְכִּי וַיִּקֶשׁ דְּבַר־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה מִדְּבַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, “We have ten
shares in the king, and in David, too, we have more than you. Why
then have you slighted us? Were we not the first to propose that
our king be brought back?” However, the men of Judah prevailed
over the men of Israel.

translation.text: But the people of Israel answered the people of Judah were fiercer than the words of the people of Israel.

verses.english:
A scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjaminite, happened to
be there. He sounded the horn and proclaimed: “We have no portion
in David, No share in Jesse’s son! Every man to his tent, O
Israel!”
verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁם נִקְרָא אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל וּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי אִישׁ יְמִינִי וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לָנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא נַחֲלָה־לָנוּ בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי אִישׁ
לְאֹהָלָיו יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁם נִקְרָא אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל וּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי אִישׁ יְמִינִי וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לָנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא נַחֲלָה־לָנוּ בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי אִישׁ
לְאֹהָלָיו יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
A scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjaminite, happened to
be there. He sounded the horn and proclaimed: “We have no portion
in David, No share in Jesse’s son! Every man to his tent, O
Israel!”

translation.text: Now a scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjaminite, happened no share in the son of Jesse! Everyone to your tents, O Israel!"

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי דָוִד אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה דָּבְקוּ בְמַלְכָּם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעַד־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי דָוִד אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה דָּבְקוּ בְמַלְכָּם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעַד־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

translation.text: So all the people of Israel withdrew from David and followed Sheba from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
David went to his palace in Jerusalem, and the king took the ten
concubines he had left to mind the palace and put them in a
guarded place; he provided for them, but he did not cohabit with
them. They remained in seclusion until the day they died, in
living widowhood.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר־נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמֹר הַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֵם בֵּית־מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַיְכַלְכְּלֵם
וַאֲלֵיהֶם לֹא־בָא וַתִּהְיֶינָה צְרֻרוֹת עַד־יוֹם מֻתָן אַלְמְנוּת חַיּוּת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר־נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמֹר הַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֵם בֵּית־מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַיְכַלְכְּלֵם
וַאֲלֵיהֶם לֹא־בָא וַתִּהְיֶינָה צְרֻרוֹת עַד־יוֹם מֻתָן אַלְמְנוּת חַיּוּת׃

english.text:
David went to his palace in Jerusalem, and the king took the ten
concubines he had left to mind the palace and put them in a
guarded place; he provided for them, but he did not cohabit with
them. They remained in seclusion until the day they died, in
living widowhood.

translation.text: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten them. So they were shut up until the day of their death, living as if in widowhood.

verses.english:
The king said to Amasa, “Call up the men of Judah to my standard,
and report here three days from now.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲמָשָׂא הַזְעֶק־לִי אֶת־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲמָשָׂא הַזְעֶק־לִי אֶת־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד׃

english.text:
The king said to Amasa, “Call up the men of Judah to my standard,
and report here three days from now.”

translation.text: Then the king said to Amasa, "Call the men of Judah together to me within three days, and be here yourself."

verses.english:
Amasa went to call up Judah, but he took longer than the time set
for him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֲמָשָׂא לְהַזְעִיק אֶת־יְהוּדָה (וייחר) [וַיּוֹחֶר] מִן־הַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר יְעָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֲמָשָׂא לְהַזְעִיק אֶת־יְהוּדָה (וייחר) [וַיּוֹחֶר] מִן־הַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר יְעָדוֹ׃

english.text:
Amasa went to call up Judah, but he took longer than the time set
for him.

translation.text: So Amasa went to summon him.

verses.english:
And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba son of Bichri will cause us
more trouble than Absalom. So take your lord’s servants and pursue
him, before he finds fortified towns and eludes us.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי עַתָּה יֵרַע לָנוּ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי מִן־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה קַח אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ וּרְדֹף אַחֲרָיו פֶּן־מָצָא לוֹ עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וְהִצִּיל
עֵינֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי עַתָּה יֵרַע לָנוּ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי מִן־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה קַח אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ וּרְדֹף אַחֲרָיו פֶּן־מָצָא לוֹ עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וְהִצִּיל
עֵינֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba son of Bichri will cause us
more trouble than Absalom. So take your lord’s servants and pursue
him, before he finds fortified towns and eludes us.”

translation.text: David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba son of Bichri will do us more will find fortified cities for himself, and escape from us."

verses.english:
Joab’s men, the Cherethites and Pelethites, and all the warriors,
marched out behind him. They left Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba
son of Bichri.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַחֲרָיו אַנְשֵׁי יוֹאָב וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים וַיֵּצְאוּ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַחֲרָיו אַנְשֵׁי יוֹאָב וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים וַיֵּצְאוּ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

english.text:
Joab’s men, the Cherethites and Pelethites, and all the warriors,
marched out behind him. They left Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba
son of Bichri.

translation.text: Joab's men went out after him, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all Bichri.

verses.english:
They were near the great stone in Gibeon when Amasa appeared
before them. Joab was wearing his military dress, with his sword
girded over it and fastened around his waist in its sheath; and,
as he stepped forward, it fell out.
verses.hebrew:
הֵם עִם־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן וַעֲמָשָׂא בָּא לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיוֹאָב חָגוּר מִדּוֹ לְבֻשׁוֹ וְעָלָו חֲגוֹר חֶרֶב מְצֻמֶּדֶת עַל־מתְנָיו בְּתַעְרָהּ וְהוּא יָצָא
וַתִּפֹּל׃

hebrew.text:
הֵם עִם־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן וַעֲמָשָׂא בָּא לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיוֹאָב חָגוּר מִדּוֹ לְבֻשׁוֹ וְעָלָו חֲגוֹר חֶרֶב מְצֻמֶּדֶת עַל־מתְנָיו בְּתַעְרָהּ וְהוּא יָצָא
וַתִּפֹּל׃

english.text:
They were near the great stone in Gibeon when Amasa appeared
before them. Joab was wearing his military dress, with his sword
girded over it and fastened around his waist in its sheath; and,
as he stepped forward, it fell out.

translation.text: When they were at the large stone that is in Gibeon, Amasa over it was a belt with a sword in its sheath fastened at his waist; as he went forward it fell out.

verses.english:
Joab said to Amasa, “How are you, brother?” and with his right
hand Joab took hold of Amasa’s beard as if to kiss him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַעֲמָשָׂא הֲשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה אָחִי וַתֹּחֶז יַד־יְמִין יוֹאָב בִּזְקַן עֲמָשָׂא לִנְשׁק־לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַעֲמָשָׂא הֲשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה אָחִי וַתֹּחֶז יַד־יְמִין יוֹאָב בִּזְקַן עֲמָשָׂא לִנְשׁק־לוֹ׃

english.text:
Joab said to Amasa, “How are you, brother?” and with his right
hand Joab took hold of Amasa’s beard as if to kiss him.

translation.text: Joab said to Amasa, "Is it well with you, my kiss him.

verses.english:
Amasa was not on his guard against the sword in Joab’s [left]
hand, and [Joab] drove it into his belly so that his entrails
poured out on the ground and he died; he did not need to strike
him a second time. Joab and his brother Abishai then set off in
pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri,
verses.hebrew:
וַעֲמָשָׂא לֹא־נִשְׁמַר בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וַיַּכֵּהוּ בָהּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁפֹּךְ מֵעָיו אַרְצָה וְלֹא־שָׁנָה לוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו רָדַף אַחֲרֵי
שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַעֲמָשָׂא לֹא־נִשְׁמַר בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וַיַּכֵּהוּ בָהּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁפֹּךְ מֵעָיו אַרְצָה וְלֹא־שָׁנָה לוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו רָדַף אַחֲרֵי
שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

english.text:
Amasa was not on his guard against the sword in Joab’s [left]
hand, and [Joab] drove it into his belly so that his entrails
poured out on the ground and he died; he did not need to strike
him a second time. Joab and his brother Abishai then set off in
pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri,

translation.text: But Amasa did not notice the sword in Joab's hand; Joab and he died. He did not strike a second blow. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bichri.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ עָמַד עָלָיו מִנַּעֲרֵי יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּיוֹאָב וּמִי אֲשֶׁר־לְדָוִד אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ עָמַד עָלָיו מִנַּעֲרֵי יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּיוֹאָב וּמִי אֲשֶׁר־לְדָוִד אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב׃

translation.text: And Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab."

verses.english:
Amasa lay in the middle of the road, drenched in his blood; and
the man saw that everyone stopped. And when he saw that all the
people were stopping, he dragged Amasa from the road into the
field and covered him with a garment.
verses.hebrew:
וַעֲמָשָׂא מִתְגֹּלֵל בַּדָּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמְסִלָּה וַיַּרְא הָאִישׁ כִּי־עָמַד כּל־הָעָם וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־עֲמָשָׂא מִן־הַמְסִלָּה הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה
כּל־הַבָּא עָלָיו וְעָמָד׃

hebrew.text:
וַעֲמָשָׂא מִתְגֹּלֵל בַּדָּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמְסִלָּה וַיַּרְא הָאִישׁ כִּי־עָמַד כּל־הָעָם וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־עֲמָשָׂא מִן־הַמְסִלָּה הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה
כּל־הַבָּא עָלָיו וְעָמָד׃

english.text:
Amasa lay in the middle of the road, drenched in his blood; and
the man saw that everyone stopped. And when he saw that all the
people were stopping, he dragged Amasa from the road into the
field and covered him with a garment.

translation.text: Amasa lay garment over him.

verses.english:
Once he was removed from the road, everybody continued to follow
Joab in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן־הַמְסִלָּה עָבַר כּל־אִישׁ אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן־הַמְסִלָּה עָבַר כּל־אִישׁ אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

english.text:
Once he was removed from the road, everybody continued to follow
Joab in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.

translation.text: Once he was removed from the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bichri.

verses.english:
[Sheba] had passed through all the tribes of Israel up to Abel of
Beth-maacah; and all the Beerites assembled and followed him
inside.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבֵלָה וּבֵית מַעֲכָה וְכל־הַבֵּרִים(ויקלהו) [וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ] וַיָּבֹאוּ אַף־אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבֵלָה וּבֵית מַעֲכָה וְכל־הַבֵּרִים(ויקלהו) [וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ] וַיָּבֹאוּ אַף־אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
[Sheba] had passed through all the tribes of Israel up to Abel of
Beth-maacah; and all the Beerites assembled and followed him
inside.

translation.text: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel of Beth-maacah; and all the Bichrites assembled, and followed him inside.

verses.english:
[Joab’s men] came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah; they
threw up a siegemound against the city and it stood against the
rampart. All the troops with Joab were engaged in battering the
wall,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיָּצֻרוּ עָלָיו בְּאָבֵלָה בֵּית הַמַּעֲכָה וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ סֹלְלָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּחֵל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יוֹאָב מַשְׁחִיתִם לְהַפִּיל הַחוֹמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיָּצֻרוּ עָלָיו בְּאָבֵלָה בֵּית הַמַּעֲכָה וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ סֹלְלָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּחֵל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יוֹאָב מַשְׁחִיתִם לְהַפִּיל הַחוֹמָה׃

english.text:
[Joab’s men] came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah; they
threw up a siegemound against the city and it stood against the
rampart. All the troops with Joab were engaged in battering the
wall,

translation.text: Joab's forces were battering the wall to break it down.

verses.english:
when a clever woman shouted from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell
Joab to come over here so I can talk to him.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה מִן־הָעִיר שִׁמְעוּ שִׁמְעוּ אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־יוֹאָב קְרַב עַד־הֵנָּה וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרָא אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה מִן־הָעִיר שִׁמְעוּ שִׁמְעוּ אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־יוֹאָב קְרַב עַד־הֵנָּה וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
when a clever woman shouted from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell
Joab to come over here so I can talk to him.”

translation.text: Then a wise woman called from the city, "Listen! Listen! Tell Joab, 'Come here, I want to speak to you.'"

verses.english:
He approached her, and the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “Yes,” he
answered; and she said to him, “Listen to what your handmaid has
to say.” “I’m listening,” he replied.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַאַתָּה יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שֹׁמֵעַ אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַאַתָּה יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שֹׁמֵעַ אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
He approached her, and the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “Yes,” he
answered; and she said to him, “Listen to what your handmaid has
to say.” “I’m listening,” he replied.

translation.text: He came near her; and the woman said, "Are you words of your servant." He answered, "I am listening."

verses.english:
And she continued, “In olden times people used to say, ‘Let them
inquire of Abel,’ and that was the end of the matter.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר יְדַבְּרוּ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לֵאמֹר שָׁאוֹל יְשָׁאֲלוּ בְּאָבֵל וְכֵן הֵתַמּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר יְדַבְּרוּ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לֵאמֹר שָׁאוֹל יְשָׁאֲלוּ בְּאָבֵל וְכֵן הֵתַמּוּ׃

english.text:
And she continued, “In olden times people used to say, ‘Let them
inquire of Abel,’ and that was the end of the matter.

translation.text: Then she said, "They used to say in the old days, 'Let them inquire at Abel'; and so they would settle a matter.

verses.english:
I am one of those who seek the welfare of the faithful in Israel.
But you seek to bring death upon a mother city in Israel! Why
should you destroy YHWH’s possession?”
verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי שְׁלֻמֵי אֱמוּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ לְהָמִית עִיר וְאֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה תְבַלַּע נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי שְׁלֻמֵי אֱמוּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ לְהָמִית עִיר וְאֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה תְבַלַּע נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
I am one of those who seek the welfare of the faithful in Israel.
But you seek to bring death upon a mother city in Israel! Why
should you destroy YHWH’s possession?”

translation.text: I am one of those who are peaceable Israel; why will you swallow up the heritage of the LORD?"

verses.english: Joab replied, “Far be it, far be it from me to destroy or to ruin!
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמַר חָלִילָה חָלִילָה לִי אִם־אֲבַלַּע וְאִם־אַשְׁחִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמַר חָלִילָה חָלִילָה לִי אִם־אֲבַלַּע וְאִם־אַשְׁחִית׃

english.text: Joab replied, “Far be it, far be it from me to destroy or to ruin!

translation.text: Joab destroy!

verses.english:
Not at all! But a certain man from the hill country of Ephraim,
named Sheba son of Bichri, has rebelled against King David. Just
hand him alone over to us, and I will withdraw from the city.” The
woman assured Joab, “His head shall be thrown over the wall to
you.”
verses.hebrew:
לֹא־כֵן הַדָּבָר כִּי אִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי שְׁמוֹ נָשָׂא יָדוֹ בַּמֶּלֶךְ בְּדָוִד תְּנוּ־אֹתוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְאֵלְכָה מֵעַל הָעִיר וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־יוֹאָב
הִנֵּה רֹאשׁוֹ מֻשְׁלָךְ אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַד הַחוֹמָה׃

hebrew.text:
לֹא־כֵן הַדָּבָר כִּי אִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי שְׁמוֹ נָשָׂא יָדוֹ בַּמֶּלֶךְ בְּדָוִד תְּנוּ־אֹתוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְאֵלְכָה מֵעַל הָעִיר וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־יוֹאָב
הִנֵּה רֹאשׁוֹ מֻשְׁלָךְ אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַד הַחוֹמָה׃

english.text:
Not at all! But a certain man from the hill country of Ephraim,
named Sheba son of Bichri, has rebelled against King David. Just
hand him alone over to us, and I will withdraw from the city.” The
woman assured Joab, “His head shall be thrown over the wall to
you.”

translation.text: That is not the case! But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, called Sheba son of Bichri, has lifted up his hand against King woman said to Joab, "His head shall be thrown over the wall to you."

verses.english:
The woman came to all the people with her clever plan; and they
cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it down to Joab.
He then sounded the horn; all the men dispersed to their homes,
and Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־כּל־הָעָם בְּחכְמָתָהּ וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּפֻצוּ מֵעַל־הָעִיר אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו
וְיוֹאָב שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־כּל־הָעָם בְּחכְמָתָהּ וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּפֻצוּ מֵעַל־הָעִיר אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו
וְיוֹאָב שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The woman came to all the people with her clever plan; and they
cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it down to Joab.
He then sounded the horn; all the men dispersed to their homes,
and Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem.

translation.text: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise plan. And they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. to their homes, while Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

verses.english:
Joab was commander of the whole army [of] Israel; Benaiah son of
Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב אֶל כּל־הַצָּבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנָיָה בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־(הכרי) [הַכְּרֵתִי] וְעַל־הַפְּלֵתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב אֶל כּל־הַצָּבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנָיָה בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־(הכרי) [הַכְּרֵתִי] וְעַל־הַפְּלֵתִי׃

english.text:
Joab was commander of the whole army [of] Israel; Benaiah son of
Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;

translation.text: Now Joab was in command of all the army of Israel; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;

verses.english:
Adoram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud
was recorder;
verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹרָם עַל־הַמַּס וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲדֹרָם עַל־הַמַּס וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר׃

english.text:
Adoram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud
was recorder;

translation.text: was the recorder;

verses.english: Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests.
verses.hebrew: (ושיא) [וּשְׁוָא] סֹפֵר וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃

hebrew.text: (ושיא) [וּשְׁוָא] סֹפֵר וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃

english.text: Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests.

translation.text: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

verses.english: Ira the Jairite also served David as priest.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם עִירָא הַיָּאִרִי הָיָה כֹהֵן לְדָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם עִירָא הַיָּאִרִי הָיָה כֹהֵן לְדָוִד׃

english.text: Ira the Jairite also served David as priest.

translation.text: and Ira the Jairite was also David's priest.

verses.english:
There was a famine during the reign of David, year after year for
three years. David inquired of YHWH, and YHWH replied, “It is
because of the bloodguilt of Saul and [his] house, for he put some
Gibeonites to death.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי רָעָב בִּימֵי דָוִד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים שָׁנָה אַחֲרֵי שָׁנָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְאֶל־בֵּית הַדָּמִים עַל אֲשֶׁר־הֵמִית
אֶת־הַגִּבְעֹנִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי רָעָב בִּימֵי דָוִד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים שָׁנָה אַחֲרֵי שָׁנָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְאֶל־בֵּית הַדָּמִים עַל אֲשֶׁר־הֵמִית
אֶת־הַגִּבְעֹנִים׃

english.text:
There was a famine during the reign of David, year after year for
three years. David inquired of YHWH, and YHWH replied, “It is
because of the bloodguilt of Saul and [his] house, for he put some
Gibeonites to death.”

translation.text: Now there was a famine in the days of David for three years, year death."

verses.english:
The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.—Now the
Gibeonites were not of Israelite stock, but a remnant of the
Amorites, to whom the Israelites had given an oath; and Saul had
tried to wipe them out in his zeal for the people of Israel and
Judah.—
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ לַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וְהַגִּבְעֹנִים לֹא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מִיֶּתֶר הָאֱמֹרִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם וַיְבַקֵּשׁ
שָׁאוּל לְהַכֹּתָם בְּקַנֹּאתוֹ לִבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ לַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וְהַגִּבְעֹנִים לֹא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מִיֶּתֶר הָאֱמֹרִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם וַיְבַקֵּשׁ
שָׁאוּל לְהַכֹּתָם בְּקַנֹּאתוֹ לִבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.—Now the
Gibeonites were not of Israelite stock, but a remnant of the
Amorites, to whom the Israelites had given an oath; and Saul had
tried to wipe them out in his zeal for the people of Israel and
Judah.—

translation.text: So the king called the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now Saul had tried to wipe them out in his zeal for the people of Israel and Judah.)

verses.english:
David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How shall I
make expiation, so that you may bless YHWH’s own people?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַגִּבְעֹנִים מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם וּבַמָּה אֲכַפֵּר וּבָרְכוּ אֶת־נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַגִּבְעֹנִים מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם וּבַמָּה אֲכַפֵּר וּבָרְכוּ אֶת־נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How shall I
make expiation, so that you may bless YHWH’s own people?”

translation.text: David said to the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? How shall I make expiation, that you may bless the heritage of the LORD?"

verses.english:
The Gibeonites answered him, “We have no claim for silver or gold
against Saul and his household; and we have no claim on the life
of any other man in Israel.” And [David] responded, “Whatever you
say I will do for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַגִּבְעֹנִים אֵין־[לָנוּ] (לי) כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עִם־שָׁאוּל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֵין־לָנוּ אִישׁ לְהָמִית בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר מָה־אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַגִּבְעֹנִים אֵין־[לָנוּ] (לי) כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עִם־שָׁאוּל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֵין־לָנוּ אִישׁ לְהָמִית בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר מָה־אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
The Gibeonites answered him, “We have no claim for silver or gold
against Saul and his household; and we have no claim on the life
of any other man in Israel.” And [David] responded, “Whatever you
say I will do for you.”

translation.text: The Gibeonites said to him, "It is not a matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put anyone to death in Israel." He said, "What do you say that I should do for you?"

verses.english:
Thereupon they said to the king, “The man who massacred us and
planned to exterminate us, so that we should not survive in all
the territory of Israel—
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כִּלָּנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר דִּמָּה־לָנוּ נִשְׁמַדְנוּ מֵהִתְיַצֵּב בְּכל־גְּבֻל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כִּלָּנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר דִּמָּה־לָנוּ נִשְׁמַדְנוּ מֵהִתְיַצֵּב בְּכל־גְּבֻל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thereupon they said to the king, “The man who massacred us and
planned to exterminate us, so that we should not survive in all
the territory of Israel—

translation.text: They us, so that we should have no place in all the territory of Israel —

verses.english:
let seven of his male issue be handed over to us, and we will
impale them before YHWH in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of YHWH.”
And the king replied, “I will do so.”
verses.hebrew: (ינתן) [יֻתַּן־]לָנוּ שִׁבְעָה אֲנָשִׁים מִבָּנָיו וְהוֹקַעֲנוּם לַיהֹוָה בְּגִבְעַת שָׁאוּל בְּחִיר יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן׃

hebrew.text: (ינתן) [יֻתַּן־]לָנוּ שִׁבְעָה אֲנָשִׁים מִבָּנָיו וְהוֹקַעֲנוּם לַיהֹוָה בְּגִבְעַת שָׁאוּל בְּחִיר יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן׃

english.text:
let seven of his male issue be handed over to us, and we will
impale them before YHWH in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of YHWH.”
And the king replied, “I will do so.”

translation.text: let the LORD at Gibeon on the mountain of the LORD." The king said, "I will hand them over."

verses.english:
The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul, because
of the oath before YHWH between the two, between David and
Jonathan son of Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְמֹל הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל עַל־שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּינֹתָם בֵּין דָּוִד וּבֵין יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחְמֹל הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל עַל־שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּינֹתָם בֵּין דָּוִד וּבֵין יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul, because
of the oath before YHWH between the two, between David and
Jonathan son of Saul.

translation.text: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Saul's son Jonathan, David and Jonathan son of Saul.

verses.english:
Instead, the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons that
Rizpah daughter of Aiah bore to Saul, and the five sons that Merab
daughter of Saul bore to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite,
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְשָׁאוּל אֶת־אַרְמֹנִי וְאֶת־מְפִבֹשֶׁת וְאֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת בְּנֵי מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה
לְעַדְרִיאֵל בֶּן־בַּרְזִלַּי הַמְּחֹלָתִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְשָׁאוּל אֶת־אַרְמֹנִי וְאֶת־מְפִבֹשֶׁת וְאֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת בְּנֵי מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה
לְעַדְרִיאֵל בֶּן־בַּרְזִלַּי הַמְּחֹלָתִי׃

english.text:
Instead, the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons that
Rizpah daughter of Aiah bore to Saul, and the five sons that Merab
daughter of Saul bore to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite,

translation.text: The king took the two sons of bore to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite;

verses.english:
and he handed them over to the Gibeonites. They impaled them on
the mountain before YHWH; all seven of them perished at the same
time. They were put to death in the first days of the harvest, the
beginning of the barley harvest.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד הַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּקִיעֻם בָּהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְּלוּ (שבעתים) [שְׁבַעְתָּם] יָחַד (והם) [וְהֵמָּה] הֻמְתוּ בִּימֵי קָצִיר בָּרִאשֹׁנִים (תחלת)
[בִּתְחִלַּת] קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד הַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּקִיעֻם בָּהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְּלוּ (שבעתים) [שְׁבַעְתָּם] יָחַד (והם) [וְהֵמָּה] הֻמְתוּ בִּימֵי קָצִיר בָּרִאשֹׁנִים (תחלת)
[בִּתְחִלַּת] קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִים׃

english.text:
and he handed them over to the Gibeonites. They impaled them on
the mountain before YHWH; all seven of them perished at the same
time. They were put to death in the first days of the harvest, the
beginning of the barley harvest.

translation.text: he gave them into the to death in the first days of harvest, at the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.english:
Then Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it on a
rock for herself, and she stayed there from the beginning of the
harvest until rain from the sky fell on the bodies; she did not
let the birds of the sky settle on them by day or the wild beasts
[approach] by night.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקַּח רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֶת־הַשַּׂק וַתַּטֵּהוּ לָהּ אֶל־הַצּוּר מִתְּחִלַּת קָצִיר עַד נִתַּךְ־מַיִם עֲלֵיהֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנָה עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם לָנוּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם
יוֹמָם וְאֶת־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקַּח רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֶת־הַשַּׂק וַתַּטֵּהוּ לָהּ אֶל־הַצּוּר מִתְּחִלַּת קָצִיר עַד נִתַּךְ־מַיִם עֲלֵיהֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנָה עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם לָנוּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם
יוֹמָם וְאֶת־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
Then Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it on a
rock for herself, and she stayed there from the beginning of the
harvest until rain from the sky fell on the bodies; she did not
let the birds of the sky settle on them by day or the wild beasts
[approach] by night.

translation.text: Then Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it on a rock for herself, from the beginning of harvest until rain fell on them from the heavens; she did not allow the birds of the air to come on the bodies by day, or the wild animals by night.

verses.english:
David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah had
done.
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה פִּלֶגֶשׁ שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה פִּלֶגֶשׁ שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah had
done.

translation.text: When David was told what Rizpah daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done,

verses.english:
And David went and took the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan
from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had made off with them
from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had
hung them up on the day the Philistines killed Saul at Gilboa.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מֵאֵת בַּעֲלֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר גָּנְבוּ אֹתָם מֵרְחֹב בֵּית־שַׁן אֲשֶׁר (תלום שם הפלשתים)
[תְּלָאוּם שָׁמָּה פְּלִשְׁתִּים] בְּיוֹם הַכּוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מֵאֵת בַּעֲלֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר גָּנְבוּ אֹתָם מֵרְחֹב בֵּית־שַׁן אֲשֶׁר (תלום שם הפלשתים)
[תְּלָאוּם שָׁמָּה פְּלִשְׁתִּים] בְּיוֹם הַכּוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
And David went and took the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan
from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had made off with them
from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had
hung them up on the day the Philistines killed Saul at Gilboa.

translation.text: up, on the day the Philistines killed Saul on Gilboa.

verses.english:
He brought up the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan from
there; and he gathered the bones of those who had been impaled.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת הַמּוּקָעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת הַמּוּקָעִים׃

english.text:
He brought up the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan from
there; and he gathered the bones of those who had been impaled.

translation.text: He brought up they gathered the bones of those who had been impaled.

verses.english:
And they buried the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan in Zela,
in the territory of Benjamin, in the tomb of his father Kish. And
when all that the king had commanded was done, God responded to
the plea of the land thereafter.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן־בְּנוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֵלָע בְּקֶבֶר קִישׁ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵר אֱלֹהִים לָאָרֶץ
אַחֲרֵי־כֵן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן־בְּנוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֵלָע בְּקֶבֶר קִישׁ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵר אֱלֹהִים לָאָרֶץ
אַחֲרֵי־כֵן׃

english.text:
And they buried the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan in Zela,
in the territory of Benjamin, in the tomb of his father Kish. And
when all that the king had commanded was done, God responded to
the plea of the land thereafter.

translation.text: They Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of his father Kish; they did all that the king commanded. After that, God heeded supplications for the land.

verses.english:
Again war broke out between the Philistines and Israel, and David
and the men with him went down and fought the Philistines; David
grew weary,
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּרֶד דָּוִד וַעֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּעַף דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּרֶד דָּוִד וַעֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּעַף דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Again war broke out between the Philistines and Israel, and David
and the men with him went down and fought the Philistines; David
grew weary,

translation.text: The Philistines went to war again with Israel, and David went down David grew weary.

verses.english:
and Ishbi-benob tried to kill David.—He was a descendant of the
Raphah; his bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and he wore
new armor.—
verses.hebrew: (וישבו) [וְיִשְׁבִּי] בְנֹב אֲשֶׁר בִּילִידֵי הָרָפָה וּמִשְׁקַל קֵינוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת מִשְׁקַל נְחֹשֶׁת וְהוּא חָגוּר חֲדָשָׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: (וישבו) [וְיִשְׁבִּי] בְנֹב אֲשֶׁר בִּילִידֵי הָרָפָה וּמִשְׁקַל קֵינוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת מִשְׁקַל נְחֹשֶׁת וְהוּא חָגוּר חֲדָשָׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
and Ishbi-benob tried to kill David.—He was a descendant of the
Raphah; his bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and he wore
new armor.—

translation.text: Ishbi-benob, one of the descendants of the who was fitted out with new weapons, said he would kill David.

verses.english:
But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid; he attacked the
Philistine and killed him. It was then that David’s men declared
to him on oath, “You shall not go with us into battle any more,
lest you extinguish the lamp of Israel!”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲזר־לוֹ אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ אָז נִשְׁבְּעוּ אַנְשֵׁי־דָוִד לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֵצֵא עוֹד אִתָּנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלֹא תְכַבֶּה אֶת־נֵר
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲזר־לוֹ אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ אָז נִשְׁבְּעוּ אַנְשֵׁי־דָוִד לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֵצֵא עוֹד אִתָּנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלֹא תְכַבֶּה אֶת־נֵר
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid; he attacked the
Philistine and killed him. It was then that David’s men declared
to him on oath, “You shall not go with us into battle any more,
lest you extinguish the lamp of Israel!”

translation.text: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid, and attacked the Philistine and us to battle any longer, so that you do not quench the lamp of Israel."

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז הִכָּה סִבְּכַי הַחֻשָׁתִי אֶת־סַף אֲשֶׁר בִּילִדֵי הָרָפָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז הִכָּה סִבְּכַי הַחֻשָׁתִי אֶת־סַף אֲשֶׁר בִּילִדֵי הָרָפָה׃

translation.text: After this a battle took place with the Philistines, at Gob; then of the giants.

verses.english:
Again there was fighting with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan
son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite,
whose spear had a shaft like a weaver’s bar.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן־יַעְרֵי אֹרְגִים בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי אֵת גּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן־יַעְרֵי אֹרְגִים בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי אֵת גּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים׃

english.text:
Again there was fighting with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan
son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite,
whose spear had a shaft like a weaver’s bar.

translation.text: Then there was another battle with the Philistines at the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

verses.english:
Once again there was fighting, at Gath. There was a giant of a
man, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot,
twenty-four in all; he too was descended from the Raphah.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה בְּגַת וַיְהִי אִישׁ (מדין) [מָדוֹן] וְאֶצְבְּעֹת יָדָיו וְאֶצְבְּעֹת רַגְלָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מִסְפָּר וְגַם־הוּא יֻלַּד לְהָרָפָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה בְּגַת וַיְהִי אִישׁ (מדין) [מָדוֹן] וְאֶצְבְּעֹת יָדָיו וְאֶצְבְּעֹת רַגְלָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מִסְפָּר וְגַם־הוּא יֻלַּד לְהָרָפָה׃

english.text:
Once again there was fighting, at Gath. There was a giant of a
man, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot,
twenty-four in all; he too was descended from the Raphah.

translation.text: who had six fingers on each hand, and six toes on each foot, twentyfour in number; he too was descended from the giants.

verses.english:
When he taunted Israel, Jonathan, the son of David’s brother
Shimei, killed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־[שִׁמְעָה] (שמעי) אֲחִי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־[שִׁמְעָה] (שמעי) אֲחִי דָוִד׃

english.text:
When he taunted Israel, Jonathan, the son of David’s brother
Shimei, killed him.

translation.text: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of David's brother Shimei, killed him.

verses.english:
Those four were descended from the Raphah in Gath, and they fell
by the hands of David and his men.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־אַרְבַּעַת אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְהָרָפָה בְּגַת וַיִּפְּלוּ בְיַד־דָּוִד וּבְיַד עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־אַרְבַּעַת אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְהָרָפָה בְּגַת וַיִּפְּלוּ בְיַד־דָּוִד וּבְיַד עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
Those four were descended from the Raphah in Gath, and they fell
by the hands of David and his men.

translation.text: hands of David and his servants.

verses.english:
David addressed the words of this song to YHWH, after YHWH had
saved him from the hands of all his enemies and from the hands of
Saul.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ מִכַּף כּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִכַּף שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ מִכַּף כּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִכַּף שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
David addressed the words of this song to YHWH, after YHWH had
saved him from the hands of all his enemies and from the hands of
Saul.

translation.text: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day when the hand of Saul.

verses.english: He said: O LORD, my crag, my fastness, my deliverer!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצֻדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי־לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצֻדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי־לִי׃

english.text: He said: O LORD, my crag, my fastness, my deliverer!

translation.text: He said: my savior; you save me from violence.

verses.english:
O God, the rock wherein I take shelter: My shield, my mighty
champion, my fortress and refuge! My savior, You who rescue me
from violence!
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְנוּסִי מֹשִׁעִי מֵחָמָס תֹּשִׁעֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: אֱלֹהֵי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְנוּסִי מֹשִׁעִי מֵחָמָס תֹּשִׁעֵנִי׃

english.text:
O God, the rock wherein I take shelter: My shield, my mighty
champion, my fortress and refuge! My savior, You who rescue me
from violence!

verses.english: All praise! I called on YHWH, And I was delivered from my enemies.
verses.hebrew: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וּמֵאֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וּמֵאֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃

english.text: All praise! I called on YHWH, And I was delivered from my enemies.

translation.text: I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies.

verses.english:
For the breakers of Death encompassed me, The torrents of Belial
terrified me;
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲפָפֻנִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָוֶת נַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֲפָפֻנִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָוֶת נַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתֻנִי׃

english.text:
For the breakers of Death encompassed me, The torrents of Belial
terrified me;

translation.text: For the waves of death encompassed me, the torrents of perdition assailed me;

verses.english: The snares of Sheol encircled me, The coils of Death engulfed me.
verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סַבֻּנִי קִדְּמֻנִי מֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

hebrew.text: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סַבֻּנִי קִדְּמֻנִי מֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

english.text: The snares of Sheol encircled me, The coils of Death engulfed me.

translation.text: the cords of Sheol entangled me, the snares of death confronted me.

verses.english:
In my anguish I called on YHWH, Cried out to my God; In His Abode
He heard my voice, My cry entered His ears.
verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֶקְרָא וַיִּשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי בְּאזְנָיו׃

hebrew.text: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֶקְרָא וַיִּשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי בְּאזְנָיו׃

english.text:
In my anguish I called on YHWH, Cried out to my God; In His Abode
He heard my voice, My cry entered His ears.

translation.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; to my God I called. and my cry came to his ears.

verses.english:
Then the earth rocked and quaked, The foundations of heaven shook—
Rocked by His indignation.
verses.hebrew: (ותגעש) [וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ מוֹסְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: (ותגעש) [וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ מוֹסְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
Then the earth rocked and quaked, The foundations of heaven shook—
Rocked by His indignation.

translation.text: Then the earth reeled and rocked; and quaked, because he was angry.

verses.english:
Smoke went up from His nostrils, From His mouth came devouring
fire; Live coals blazed forth from Him.
verses.hebrew: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
Smoke went up from His nostrils, From His mouth came devouring
fire; Live coals blazed forth from Him.

translation.text: Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; glowing coals flamed forth from him.

verses.english: He bent the sky and came down, Thick cloud beneath His feet.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃

english.text: He bent the sky and came down, Thick cloud beneath His feet.

translation.text: He bowed the heavens, and came down; thick darkness was under his feet.

verses.english:
He mounted a cherub and flew; He was seen on the wings of the
wind.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּרָא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּרָא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃

english.text:
He mounted a cherub and flew; He was seen on the wings of the
wind.

translation.text: He rode on a cherub, and flew; he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

verses.english:
He made pavilions of darkness about Him, Dripping clouds, huge
thunderheads;
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָיו סֻכּוֹת חַשְׁרַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָיו סֻכּוֹת חַשְׁרַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃

english.text:
He made pavilions of darkness about Him, Dripping clouds, huge
thunderheads;

translation.text: He made darkness around him a canopy, thick clouds, a gathering of water.

verses.english: In the brilliance before Him Blazed fiery coals.
verses.hebrew: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ בָּעֲרוּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ בָּעֲרוּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃

english.text: In the brilliance before Him Blazed fiery coals.

translation.text: Out of the brightness before him coals of fire flamed forth.

verses.english:
YHWH thundered forth from heaven, The Most High sent forth His
voice;
verses.hebrew: יַרְעֵם מִן־שָׁמַיִם יְהֹוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יַרְעֵם מִן־שָׁמַיִם יְהֹוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH thundered forth from heaven, The Most High sent forth His
voice;

translation.text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the Most High uttered his voice.

verses.english:
He let loose bolts, and scattered them; Lightning, and put them to
rout.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצִּים וַיְפִיצֵם בָּרָק (ויהמם) [וַיָּהֹם]׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצִּים וַיְפִיצֵם בָּרָק (ויהמם) [וַיָּהֹם]׃

english.text:
He let loose bolts, and scattered them; Lightning, and put them to
rout.

translation.text: He sent out arrows, and scattered them — lightning, and routed them.

verses.english:
The bed of the sea was exposed, The foundations of the world were
laid bare By the mighty roaring of YHWH, At the blast of the
breath of His nostrils.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִקֵי יָם יִגָּלוּ מֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל בְּגַעֲרַת יְהֹוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִקֵי יָם יִגָּלוּ מֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל בְּגַעֲרַת יְהֹוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
The bed of the sea was exposed, The foundations of the world were
laid bare By the mighty roaring of YHWH, At the blast of the
breath of His nostrils.

translation.text: Then the channels of the sea were seen, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

verses.english:
He reached down from on high, He took me, Drew me out of the
mighty waters;
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃

english.text:
He reached down from on high, He took me, Drew me out of the
mighty waters;

translation.text: He reached from on high, he took me, he drew me out of mighty waters.

verses.english:
He rescued me from my enemy so strong, From foes too mighty for
me.
verses.hebrew: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז מִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

hebrew.text: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז מִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

english.text:
He rescued me from my enemy so strong, From foes too mighty for
me.

translation.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

verses.english: They attacked me on my day of calamity, But YHWH was my stay.
verses.hebrew: יְקַדְּמֻנִי בְּיוֹם אֵידִי וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה מִשְׁעָן לִי׃

hebrew.text: יְקַדְּמֻנִי בְּיוֹם אֵידִי וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה מִשְׁעָן לִי׃

english.text: They attacked me on my day of calamity, But YHWH was my stay.

translation.text: They came upon me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my stay.

verses.english:
He brought me out to freedom, He rescued me because He was pleased
with me.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵא לַמֶּרְחָב אֹתִי יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־חָפֵץ בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצֵא לַמֶּרְחָב אֹתִי יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־חָפֵץ בִּי׃

english.text:
He brought me out to freedom, He rescued me because He was pleased
with me.

translation.text: He brought me out into a broad place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.english:
YHWH rewarded me according to my merit, He requited the cleanness
of my hands.
verses.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהֹוָה כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃

hebrew.text: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהֹוָה כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃

english.text:
YHWH rewarded me according to my merit, He requited the cleanness
of my hands.

translation.text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he recompensed me.

verses.english:
For I have kept the ways of YHWH And have not been guilty before
my God;
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
For I have kept the ways of YHWH And have not been guilty before
my God;

translation.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.english: I am mindful of all His rules And have not departed from His laws.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כל־מִשְׁפָּטָו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסוּר מִמֶּנָּה׃
