english.text:
“Further, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did
to the two commanders of Israel’s forces, Abner son of Ner and
Amasa son of Jether: he killed them, shedding blood of war in
peacetime, staining the girdle of his loins and the sandals on his
feet with blood of war.

translation.text: "Moreover you know also what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, how feet.

verses.english:
So act in accordance with your wisdom, and see that his white hair
does not go down to Sheol in peace.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּחכְמָתֶךָ וְלֹא־תוֹרֵד שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּשָׁלֹם שְׁאֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּחכְמָתֶךָ וְלֹא־תוֹרֵד שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּשָׁלֹם שְׁאֹל׃

english.text:
So act in accordance with your wisdom, and see that his white hair
does not go down to Sheol in peace.

translation.text: Act therefore according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

verses.english:
“But deal graciously with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, for
they befriended me when I fled from your brother Absalom; let them
be among those that eat at your table.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי בַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי תַּעֲשֶׂה־חֶסֶד וְהָיוּ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ כִּי־כֵן קָרְבוּ אֵלַי בְּברְחִי מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי בַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי תַּעֲשֶׂה־חֶסֶד וְהָיוּ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ כִּי־כֵן קָרְבוּ אֵלַי בְּברְחִי מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
“But deal graciously with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, for
they befriended me when I fled from your brother Absalom; let them
be among those that eat at your table.

translation.text: Deal loyally, however, with the sons brother Absalom.

verses.english:
“You must also deal with Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from
Bahurim. He insulted me outrageously when I was on my way to
Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore
to him by YHWH: ‘I will not put you to the sword.’
verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה עִמְּךָ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶן־הַיְמִינִי מִבַּחֻרִים וְהוּא קִלְלַנִי קְלָלָה נִמְרֶצֶת בְּיוֹם לֶכְתִּי מַחֲנָיִם וְהוּא־יָרַד לִקְרָאתִי הַיַּרְדֵּן וָאֶשָּׁבַע לוֹ
בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אִם־אֲמִיתְךָ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה עִמְּךָ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶן־הַיְמִינִי מִבַּחֻרִים וְהוּא קִלְלַנִי קְלָלָה נִמְרֶצֶת בְּיוֹם לֶכְתִּי מַחֲנָיִם וְהוּא־יָרַד לִקְרָאתִי הַיַּרְדֵּן וָאֶשָּׁבַע לוֹ
בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אִם־אֲמִיתְךָ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
“You must also deal with Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from
Bahurim. He insulted me outrageously when I was on my way to
Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore
to him by YHWH: ‘I will not put you to the sword.’

translation.text: There is also with you Shimei son of Gera, the the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD, 'I will not put you to death with the sword.'

verses.english:
So do not let him go unpunished; for you are a wise man and you
will know how to deal with him and send his gray hair down to
Sheol in blood.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־תְּנַקֵּהוּ כִּי אִישׁ חָכָם אָתָּה וְיָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ וְהוֹרַדְתָּ אֶת־שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּדָם שְׁאוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל־תְּנַקֵּהוּ כִּי אִישׁ חָכָם אָתָּה וְיָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ וְהוֹרַדְתָּ אֶת־שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּדָם שְׁאוֹל׃

english.text:
So do not let him go unpunished; for you are a wise man and you
will know how to deal with him and send his gray hair down to
Sheol in blood.”

translation.text: Therefore do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise his gray head down with blood to Sheol."

verses.english:
So David slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the City of
David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
So David slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the City of
David.

translation.text: Then David slept with his ancestors, and was buried in the city of David.

verses.english:
The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years: he
reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years
in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ דָּוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ דָּוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years: he
reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years
in Jerusalem.

translation.text: The time that David reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David, and his rule
was firmly established.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִיו וַתִּכֹּן מַלְכֻתוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹמֹה יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִיו וַתִּכֹּן מַלְכֻתוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David, and his rule
was firmly established.

translation.text: firmly established.

verses.english:
Adonijah son of Haggith came to see Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother.
She said, “Do you come with friendly intent?” “Yes,” he replied;
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם בֹּאֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם בֹּאֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Adonijah son of Haggith came to see Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother.
She said, “Do you come with friendly intent?” “Yes,” he replied;

translation.text: Then Adonijah son of Haggith came to Bathsheba, Solomon's mother. She asked, "Do you come peaceably?" He said, "Peaceably."

verses.english:
and he continued, “I would like to have a word with you.” “Speak
up,” she said.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלָיִךְ וַתֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלָיִךְ וַתֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
and he continued, “I would like to have a word with you.” “Speak
up,” she said.

translation.text: Then he said, "May I have a word with you?" She said, "Go on."

verses.english:
Then he said, “You know that the kingship was rightly mine and
that all Israel wanted me to reign. But the kingship passed on to
my brother; it came to him by the will of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתְּ יָדַעַתְּ כִּי־לִי הָיְתָה הַמְּלוּכָה וְעָלַי שָׂמוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּנֵיהֶם לִמְלֹךְ וַתִּסֹּב הַמְּלוּכָה וַתְּהִי לְאָחִי כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתְּ יָדַעַתְּ כִּי־לִי הָיְתָה הַמְּלוּכָה וְעָלַי שָׂמוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּנֵיהֶם לִמְלֹךְ וַתִּסֹּב הַמְּלוּכָה וַתְּהִי לְאָחִי כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
Then he said, “You know that the kingship was rightly mine and
that all Israel wanted me to reign. But the kingship passed on to
my brother; it came to him by the will of YHWH.

translation.text: He become my brother's, for it was his from the LORD.

verses.english:
And now I have one request to make of you; do not refuse me.” She
said, “Speak up.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשִׁבִי אֶת־פָּנָי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשִׁבִי אֶת־פָּנָי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
And now I have one request to make of you; do not refuse me.” She
said, “Speak up.”

translation.text: And now I have on."

verses.english:
He replied, “Please ask King Solomon—for he won’t refuse you—to
give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִמְרִי־נָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא־יָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ וְיִתֶּן־לִי אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִמְרִי־נָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא־יָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ וְיִתֶּן־לִי אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
He replied, “Please ask King Solomon—for he won’t refuse you—to
give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

translation.text: He said, "Please ask King Solomon — he will not refuse you — to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."

verses.english:
“Very well,” said Bathsheba, “I will speak to the king in your
behalf.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת־שֶׁבַע טוֹב אָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר עָלֶיךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת־שֶׁבַע טוֹב אָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר עָלֶיךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
“Very well,” said Bathsheba, “I will speak to the king in your
behalf.”

translation.text: Bathsheba said, "Very well; I will speak to the king on your behalf."

verses.english:
So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him about Adonijah.
The king rose to greet her and bowed down to her. He sat on his
throne; and he had a throne placed for the queen mother, and she
sat on his right.
verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְדַבֶּר־לוֹ עַל־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהּ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַתֵּשֶׁב לִימִינוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְדַבֶּר־לוֹ עַל־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהּ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַתֵּשֶׁב לִימִינוֹ׃

english.text:
So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him about Adonijah.
The king rose to greet her and bowed down to her. He sat on his
throne; and he had a throne placed for the queen mother, and she
sat on his right.

translation.text: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon, to speak to him on behalf of she sat on his right.

verses.english:
She said, “I have one small request to make of you, do not refuse
me.” He responded, “Ask, Mother; I shall not refuse you.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֶלֶת מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשֶׁב אֶת־פָּנָי וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שַׁאֲלִי אִמִּי כִּי לֹא־אָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֶלֶת מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשֶׁב אֶת־פָּנָי וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שַׁאֲלִי אִמִּי כִּי לֹא־אָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ׃

english.text:
She said, “I have one small request to make of you, do not refuse
me.” He responded, “Ask, Mother; I shall not refuse you.”

translation.text: Then she said, "I have one small request to request, my mother; for I will not refuse you."

verses.english:
Then she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your
brother Adonijah as wife.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר יֻתַּן אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אָחִיךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר יֻתַּן אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אָחִיךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Then she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your
brother Adonijah as wife.”

translation.text: She said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife."

verses.english:
The king replied to his mother, “Why request Abishag the
Shunammite for Adonijah? Request the kingship for him! For he is
my older brother, and the priest Abiathar and Joab son of Zeruiah
are on his side.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ וְלָמָה אַתְּ שֹׁאֶלֶת אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְשַׁאֲלִי־לוֹ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה כִּי הוּא אָחִי הַגָּדוֹל מִמֶּנִּי
וְלוֹ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ וְלָמָה אַתְּ שֹׁאֶלֶת אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְשַׁאֲלִי־לוֹ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה כִּי הוּא אָחִי הַגָּדוֹל מִמֶּנִּי
וְלוֹ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה׃

english.text:
The king replied to his mother, “Why request Abishag the
Shunammite for Adonijah? Request the kingship for him! For he is
my older brother, and the priest Abiathar and Joab son of Zeruiah
are on his side.”

translation.text: my elder brother; ask not only for him but also for the priest Abiathar and for Joab son of Zeruiah!"

verses.english:
Thereupon, King Solomon swore by YHWH, saying, “So may God do to
me and even more, if broaching this matter does not cost Adonijah
his life!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף כִּי בְנַפְשׁוֹ דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף כִּי בְנַפְשׁוֹ דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Thereupon, King Solomon swore by YHWH, saying, “So may God do to
me and even more, if broaching this matter does not cost Adonijah
his life!

translation.text: Then King Solomon swore by the this scheme at the risk of his life!

verses.english:
Now, as YHWH lives, who has established me and set me on the
throne of my father David and who has provided him with a house,
as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this very day!”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הֱכִינַנִי (ויושיביני) [וַיּוֹשִׁיבַנִי] עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִי וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי בַּיִת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר כִּי הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הֱכִינַנִי (ויושיביני) [וַיּוֹשִׁיבַנִי] עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִי וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי בַּיִת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר כִּי הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Now, as YHWH lives, who has established me and set me on the
throne of my father David and who has provided him with a house,
as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this very day!”

translation.text: Now therefore as the LORD lives, shall be put to death."

verses.english:
And Solomon instructed Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who struck
Adonijah down; and so he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּיַד בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּיַד בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And Solomon instructed Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who struck
Adonijah down; and so he died.

translation.text: So King Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he struck him down, and he died.

verses.english:
To the priest Abiathar, the king said, “Go to your estate at
Anathoth! You deserve to die, but I shall not put you to death at
this time, because you carried the Ark of my Lord GOD before my
father David and because you shared all the hardships that my
father endured.”
verses.hebrew:
וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲנָתֹת לֵךְ עַל־שָׂדֶיךָ כִּי אִישׁ מָוֶת אָתָּה וּבַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא אֲמִיתֶךָ כִּי־נָשָׂאתָ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה לִפְנֵי דָּוִד
אָבִי וְכִי הִתְעַנִּיתָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַנָּה אָבִי׃

hebrew.text:
וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲנָתֹת לֵךְ עַל־שָׂדֶיךָ כִּי אִישׁ מָוֶת אָתָּה וּבַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא אֲמִיתֶךָ כִּי־נָשָׂאתָ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה לִפְנֵי דָּוִד
אָבִי וְכִי הִתְעַנִּיתָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַנָּה אָבִי׃

english.text:
To the priest Abiathar, the king said, “Go to your estate at
Anathoth! You deserve to die, but I shall not put you to death at
this time, because you carried the Ark of my Lord GOD before my
father David and because you shared all the hardships that my
father endured.”

translation.text: The king said to the priest Abiathar, "Go to Anathoth, to your David, and because you shared in all the hardships my father endured."

verses.english:
So Solomon dismissed Abiathar from his office of priest of
YHWH—thus fulfilling what YHWH had spoken at Shiloh regarding the
house of Eli.
verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־אֶבְיָתָר מִהְיוֹת כֹּהֵן לַיהֹוָה לְמַלֵּא אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עַל־בֵּית עֵלִי בְּשִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְגָרֶשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־אֶבְיָתָר מִהְיוֹת כֹּהֵן לַיהֹוָה לְמַלֵּא אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עַל־בֵּית עֵלִי בְּשִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
So Solomon dismissed Abiathar from his office of priest of
YHWH—thus fulfilling what YHWH had spoken at Shiloh regarding the
house of Eli.

translation.text: So Solomon banished Abiathar from being priest to the LORD, thus house of Eli in Shiloh.

verses.english:
When the news reached Joab, he fled to the Tent of YHWH and
grasped the horns of the altar—for Joab had sided with Adonijah,
though he had not sided with Absalom.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָּאָה עַד־יוֹאָב כִּי יוֹאָב נָטָה אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה וְאַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא נָטָה וַיָּנס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָּאָה עַד־יוֹאָב כִּי יוֹאָב נָטָה אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה וְאַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא נָטָה וַיָּנס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
When the news reached Joab, he fled to the Tent of YHWH and
grasped the horns of the altar—for Joab had sided with Adonijah,
though he had not sided with Absalom.

translation.text: When the news came to Joab — for Joab had supported Adonijah LORD and grasped the horns of the altar.

verses.english:
King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the Tent of YHWH and
that he was there by the altar; so Solomon sent Benaiah son of
Jehoiada, saying, “Go and strike him down.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי נָס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע לֵאמֹר לֵךְ פְּגַע־בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי נָס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע לֵאמֹר לֵךְ פְּגַע־בּוֹ׃

english.text:
King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the Tent of YHWH and
that he was there by the altar; so Solomon sent Benaiah son of
Jehoiada, saying, “Go and strike him down.”

translation.text: When it was told King down."

verses.english:
Benaiah went to the Tent of YHWH and said to him, “Thus said the
king: Come out!” “No!” he replied; “I will die here.” Benaiah
reported back to the king that Joab had answered thus and thus,
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא בְנָיָהוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ צֵא וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי פֹה אָמוּת וַיָּשֶׁב בְּנָיָהוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה־דִבֶּר יוֹאָב
וְכֹה עָנָנִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא בְנָיָהוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ צֵא וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי פֹה אָמוּת וַיָּשֶׁב בְּנָיָהוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה־דִבֶּר יוֹאָב
וְכֹה עָנָנִי׃

english.text:
Benaiah went to the Tent of YHWH and said to him, “Thus said the
king: Come out!” “No!” he replied; “I will die here.” Benaiah
reported back to the king that Joab had answered thus and thus,

translation.text: So Benaiah came to the tent of the LORD and said to him, "The king commands, 'Come out.'" But he said, "No, I will die here." and thus he answered me."

verses.english:
and the king said, “Do just as he said; strike him down and bury
him, and remove guilt from me and my father’s house for the blood
of the innocent that Joab has shed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר וּפְגַע־בּוֹ וּקְבַרְתּוֹ וַהֲסִירֹתָ דְּמֵי חִנָּם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַךְ יוֹאָב מֵעָלַי וּמֵעַל בֵּית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר וּפְגַע־בּוֹ וּקְבַרְתּוֹ וַהֲסִירֹתָ דְּמֵי חִנָּם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַךְ יוֹאָב מֵעָלַי וּמֵעַל בֵּית אָבִי׃

english.text:
and the king said, “Do just as he said; strike him down and bury
him, and remove guilt from me and my father’s house for the blood
of the innocent that Joab has shed.

translation.text: The king replied to him, "Do as he has cause.

verses.english:
Thus YHWH will bring his blood guilt down upon his own head,
because, unbeknown to my father, he struck down with the sword two
men more righteous and honorable than he—Abner son of Ner, the
army commander of Israel, and Amasa son of Jether, the army
commander of Judah.
verses.hebrew:
וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּמוֹ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר פָּגַע בִּשְׁנֵי־אֲנָשִׁים צַדִּקִים וְטֹבִים מִמֶּנּוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵם בַּחֶרֶב וְאָבִי דָוִד לֹא יָדָע אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר
שַׂר־צְבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּמוֹ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר פָּגַע בִּשְׁנֵי־אֲנָשִׁים צַדִּקִים וְטֹבִים מִמֶּנּוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵם בַּחֶרֶב וְאָבִי דָוִד לֹא יָדָע אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר
שַׂר־צְבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Thus YHWH will bring his blood guilt down upon his own head,
because, unbeknown to my father, he struck down with the sword two
men more righteous and honorable than he—Abner son of Ner, the
army commander of Israel, and Amasa son of Jether, the army
commander of Judah.

translation.text: The LORD will bring back his bloody deeds on his own head, Jether, commander of the army of Judah.

verses.english:
May the guilt for their blood come down upon the head of Joab and
his descendants forever, and may good fortune from YHWH be granted
forever to David and his descendants, his house and his throne.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבוּ דְמֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וּבְרֹאשׁ זַרְעוֹ לְעֹלָם וּלְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְכִסְאוֹ יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם עַד־עוֹלָם מֵעִם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁבוּ דְמֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וּבְרֹאשׁ זַרְעוֹ לְעֹלָם וּלְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְכִסְאוֹ יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם עַד־עוֹלָם מֵעִם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
May the guilt for their blood come down upon the head of Joab and
his descendants forever, and may good fortune from YHWH be granted
forever to David and his descendants, his house and his throne.”

translation.text: So shall their blood come back on the head of Joab and on the head of his descendants forever; throne, there shall be peace from the LORD forevermore."

verses.english:
So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down. And he was
buried at his home in the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down. And he was
buried at his home in the wilderness.

translation.text: Then Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down and killed him; and he was buried at his own house near the wilderness.

verses.english:
In his place, the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the
army, and in place of Abiathar, the king appointed the priest
Zadok.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע תַּחְתָּיו עַל־הַצָּבָא וְאֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּחַת אֶבְיָתָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע תַּחְתָּיו עַל־הַצָּבָא וְאֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּחַת אֶבְיָתָר׃

english.text:
In his place, the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the
army, and in place of Abiathar, the king appointed the priest
Zadok.

translation.text: The king put the priest Zadok in the place of Abiathar.

verses.english:
Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build yourself a
house in Jerusalem and stay there—do not ever go out from there
anywhere else.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בְּנֵה־לְךָ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם וְלֹא־תֵצֵא מִשָּׁם אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בְּנֵה־לְךָ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם וְלֹא־תֵצֵא מִשָּׁם אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃

english.text:
Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build yourself a
house in Jerusalem and stay there—do not ever go out from there
anywhere else.

translation.text: Then the king sent and summoned Shimei, and said to him, "Build there to any place whatever.

verses.english:
On the very day that you go out and cross the Wadi Kidron, you can
be sure that you will die; your blood shall be on your own head.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְעָבַרְתָּ אֶת־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת דָּמְךָ יִהְיֶה בְרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְעָבַרְתָּ אֶת־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת דָּמְךָ יִהְיֶה בְרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
On the very day that you go out and cross the Wadi Kidron, you can
be sure that you will die; your blood shall be on your own head.”

translation.text: For on the day you go out, and cross be on your own head."

verses.english:
“That is fair,” said Shimei to the king, “your servant will do
just as my lord the king has spoken.” And for a long time, Shimei
remained in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעִי לַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב הַדָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּשֶׁב שִׁמְעִי בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעִי לַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב הַדָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּשֶׁב שִׁמְעִי בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
“That is fair,” said Shimei to the king, “your servant will do
just as my lord the king has spoken.” And for a long time, Shimei
remained in Jerusalem.

translation.text: And Shimei said to the king, "The sentence is fair; as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do." So Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

verses.english:
Three years later, two slaves of Shimei ran away to King Achish
son of Maacah of Gath. Shimei was told, “Your slaves are in Gath.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיִּבְרְחוּ שְׁנֵי־עֲבָדִים לְשִׁמְעִי אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מַעֲכָה מֶלֶךְ גַּת וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשִׁמְעִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּגַת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיִּבְרְחוּ שְׁנֵי־עֲבָדִים לְשִׁמְעִי אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מַעֲכָה מֶלֶךְ גַּת וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשִׁמְעִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּגַת׃

english.text:
Three years later, two slaves of Shimei ran away to King Achish
son of Maacah of Gath. Shimei was told, “Your slaves are in Gath.”

translation.text: But it happened at the end of three years that two of Shimei's slaves Shimei, "Your slaves are in Gath,"

verses.english:
Shimei thereupon saddled his ass and went to Achish in Gath to
claim his slaves; and Shimei returned from Gath with his slaves.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם שִׁמְעִי וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּתָה אֶל־אָכִישׁ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְעִי וַיָּבֵא אֶת־עֲבָדָיו מִגַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם שִׁמְעִי וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּתָה אֶל־אָכִישׁ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְעִי וַיָּבֵא אֶת־עֲבָדָיו מִגַּת׃

english.text:
Shimei thereupon saddled his ass and went to Achish in Gath to
claim his slaves; and Shimei returned from Gath with his slaves.

translation.text: Shimei arose and saddled a went and brought his slaves from Gath.

verses.english:
Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and
back,
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־הָלַךְ שִׁמְעִי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם גַּת וַיָּשֹׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־הָלַךְ שִׁמְעִי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם גַּת וַיָּשֹׁב׃

english.text:
Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and
back,

translation.text: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and returned,

verses.english:
and the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not adjure
you by YHWH and warn you, ‘On the very day that you leave and go
anywhere else, you can be sure that you will die,’ and did you not
say to me, ‘It is fair; I accept’?
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא הִשְׁבַּעְתִּיךָ בַיהֹוָה וָאָעִד בְּךָ לֵאמֹר בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אָנֶה וָאָנָה יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת
תָּמוּת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי טוֹב הַדָּבָר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא הִשְׁבַּעְתִּיךָ בַיהֹוָה וָאָעִד בְּךָ לֵאמֹר בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אָנֶה וָאָנָה יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת
תָּמוּת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי טוֹב הַדָּבָר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
and the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not adjure
you by YHWH and warn you, ‘On the very day that you leave and go
anywhere else, you can be sure that you will die,’ and did you not
say to me, ‘It is fair; I accept’?

translation.text: the die'? And you said to me, 'The sentence is fair; I accept.'

verses.english:
Why did you not abide by the oath before YHWH and by the orders
which I gave you?”
verses.hebrew: וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Why did you not abide by the oath before YHWH and by the orders
which I gave you?”

translation.text: Why then which I charged you?"

verses.english:
The king said further to Shimei, “You know all the wrong, which
you remember very well, that you did to my father David. Now YHWH
brings down your wrongdoing upon your own head.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר יָדַע לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְדָוִד אָבִי וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־רָעָתְךָ בְּרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר יָדַע לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְדָוִד אָבִי וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־רָעָתְךָ בְּרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
The king said further to Shimei, “You know all the wrong, which
you remember very well, that you did to my father David. Now YHWH
brings down your wrongdoing upon your own head.

translation.text: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your own heart all the evil that you did to my father David; so the LORD will bring back your evil on your own head.

verses.english:
But King Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall
be established before YHWH forever.”
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּרוּךְ וְכִסֵּא דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּרוּךְ וְכִסֵּא דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
But King Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall
be established before YHWH forever.”

translation.text: But King Solomon shall LORD forever."

verses.english:
The king gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada and he went out
and struck Shimei down; and so he died. Thus the kingdom was
secured in Solomon’s hands.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְהַמַּמְלָכָה נָכוֹנָה בְּיַד־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְהַמַּמְלָכָה נָכוֹנָה בְּיַד־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
The king gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada and he went out
and struck Shimei down; and so he died. Thus the kingdom was
secured in Solomon’s hands.

translation.text: Then the king commanded Benaiah son of Jehoiada; and he went out and struck him down, and he died. So the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

verses.english:
Solomon allied himself by marriage with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He
married Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her to the City of David
[to live there] until he had finished building his palace, and the
House of YHWH, and the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְחַתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־חוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְחַתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־חוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם סָבִיב׃

english.text:
Solomon allied himself by marriage with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He
married Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her to the City of David
[to live there] until he had finished building his palace, and the
House of YHWH, and the walls around Jerusalem.

translation.text: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt; he the wall around Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The people, however, continued to offer sacrifices at the open
shrines, because up to that time no house had been built for the
name of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: רַק הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים בַּבָּמוֹת כִּי לֹא־נִבְנָה בַיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה עַד הַיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text: רַק הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים בַּבָּמוֹת כִּי לֹא־נִבְנָה בַיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה עַד הַיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

english.text:
The people, however, continued to offer sacrifices at the open
shrines, because up to that time no house had been built for the
name of YHWH.

translation.text: The people were sacrificing at the high the LORD.

verses.english:
And Solomon, though he loved YHWH and followed the practices of
his father David, also sacrificed and offered at the shrines.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקּוֹת דָּוִד אָבִיו רַק בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא מְזַבֵּחַ וּמַקְטִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱהַב שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקּוֹת דָּוִד אָבִיו רַק בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא מְזַבֵּחַ וּמַקְטִיר׃

english.text:
And Solomon, though he loved YHWH and followed the practices of
his father David, also sacrificed and offered at the shrines.

translation.text: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of his father David; only, he sacrificed and offered incense at the high places.

verses.english:
The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the
largest shrine; on that altar Solomon presented a thousand burnt
offerings.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּבְעֹנָה לִזְבֹּחַ שָׁם כִּי־הִיא הַבָּמָה הַגְּדוֹלָה אֶלֶף עֹלוֹת יַעֲלֶה שְׁלֹמֹה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּבְעֹנָה לִזְבֹּחַ שָׁם כִּי־הִיא הַבָּמָה הַגְּדוֹלָה אֶלֶף עֹלוֹת יַעֲלֶה שְׁלֹמֹה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the
largest shrine; on that altar Solomon presented a thousand burnt
offerings.

translation.text: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the principal high place; Solomon used to offer a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

verses.english:
At Gibeon YHWH appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God
said, “Ask, what shall I grant you?”
verses.hebrew: בְּגִבְעוֹן נִרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים שְׁאַל מָה אֶתֶּן־לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: בְּגִבְעוֹן נִרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים שְׁאַל מָה אֶתֶּן־לָךְ׃

english.text:
At Gibeon YHWH appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God
said, “Ask, what shall I grant you?”

translation.text: At said, "Ask what I should give you."

verses.english:
Solomon said, “You dealt most graciously with Your servant my
father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness and
righteousness and in integrity of heart. You have continued this
great kindness to him by giving him a son to occupy his throne, as
is now the case.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי חֶסֶד גָּדוֹל כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבִצְדָקָה וּבְיִשְׁרַת לֵבָב עִמָּךְ וַתִּשְׁמר־לוֹ אֶת־הַחֶסֶד
הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה וַתִּתֶּן־לוֹ בֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי חֶסֶד גָּדוֹל כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבִצְדָקָה וּבְיִשְׁרַת לֵבָב עִמָּךְ וַתִּשְׁמר־לוֹ אֶת־הַחֶסֶד
הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה וַתִּתֶּן־לוֹ בֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Solomon said, “You dealt most graciously with Your servant my
father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness and
righteousness and in integrity of heart. You have continued this
great kindness to him by giving him a son to occupy his throne, as
is now the case.

translation.text: And Solomon said, "You have and steadfast love, and have given him a son to sit on his throne today.

verses.english:
And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in place
of my father David; but I am a young lad, with no experience in
leadership.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי אַתָּה הִמְלַכְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וְאָנֹכִי נַעַר קָטֹן לֹא אֵדַע צֵאת וָבֹא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי אַתָּה הִמְלַכְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וְאָנֹכִי נַעַר קָטֹן לֹא אֵדַע צֵאת וָבֹא׃

english.text:
And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in place
of my father David; but I am a young lad, with no experience in
leadership.

translation.text: And now, O LORD my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David, although I am only a little child; I do not know how to go out or come in.

verses.english:
Your servant finds himself in the midst of the people You have
chosen, a people too numerous to be numbered or counted.
verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתָּ עַם־רָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמָּנֶה וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתָּ עַם־רָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמָּנֶה וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

english.text:
Your servant finds himself in the midst of the people You have
chosen, a people too numerous to be numbered or counted.

translation.text: And your servant is in the midst of the people numbered or counted.

verses.english:
Grant, then, Your servant an understanding mind to judge Your
people, to distinguish between good and bad; for who can judge
this vast people of Yours?”
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לֵב שֹׁמֵעַ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ לְהָבִין בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע כִּי מִי יוּכַל לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ הַכָּבֵד הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לֵב שֹׁמֵעַ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ לְהָבִין בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע כִּי מִי יוּכַל לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ הַכָּבֵד הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Grant, then, Your servant an understanding mind to judge Your
people, to distinguish between good and bad; for who can judge
this vast people of Yours?”

translation.text: Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, able to discern between good and evil; for who can govern this your great people?"

verses.english: YHWH was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנָי כִּי שָׁאַל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנָי כִּי שָׁאַל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text: YHWH was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

translation.text: It pleased the Lord that Solomon had asked this.

verses.english:
And God said to him, “Because you asked for this—you did not ask
for long life, you did not ask for riches, you did not ask for the
life of your enemies, but you asked for discernment in dispensing
justice—
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֵלָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ יָמִים רַבִּים וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ עֹשֶׁר וְלֹא שָׁאַלְתָּ נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ
וְשָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ הָבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֵלָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ יָמִים רַבִּים וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ עֹשֶׁר וְלֹא שָׁאַלְתָּ נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ
וְשָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ הָבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And God said to him, “Because you asked for this—you did not ask
for long life, you did not ask for riches, you did not ask for the
life of your enemies, but you asked for discernment in dispensing
justice—

translation.text: God said to him, "Because you have asked this, and have not asked for yourself long life or riches, or for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern what is right,

verses.english:
I now do as you have spoken. I grant you a wise and discerning
mind; there has never been anyone like you before, nor will anyone
like you arise again.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עָשִׂיתִי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ לֵב חָכָם וְנָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹךָ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא־יָקוּם כָּמוֹךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה עָשִׂיתִי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ לֵב חָכָם וְנָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹךָ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא־יָקוּם כָּמוֹךָ׃

english.text:
I now do as you have spoken. I grant you a wise and discerning
mind; there has never been anyone like you before, nor will anyone
like you arise again.

translation.text: I now do according to your has been before you and no one like you shall arise after you.

verses.english:
And I also grant you what you did not ask for—both riches and
glory all your life—the like of which no king has ever had.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ נָתַתִּי לָךְ גַּם־עֹשֶׁר גַּם־כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה כָמוֹךָ אִישׁ בַּמְּלָכִים כּל־יָמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ נָתַתִּי לָךְ גַּם־עֹשֶׁר גַּם־כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה כָמוֹךָ אִישׁ בַּמְּלָכִים כּל־יָמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And I also grant you what you did not ask for—both riches and
glory all your life—the like of which no king has ever had.

translation.text: I give you also what you have not asked, both riches and honor all your life; no other king shall compare with you.

verses.english:
And I will further grant you long life, if you will walk in My
ways and observe My laws and commandments, as did your father
David.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם תֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכַי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקַּי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִיד אָבִיךָ וְהַאֲרַכְתִּי אֶת־יָמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכַי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקַּי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִיד אָבִיךָ וְהַאֲרַכְתִּי אֶת־יָמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And I will further grant you long life, if you will walk in My
ways and observe My laws and commandments, as did your father
David.”

translation.text: If you will walk in my ways, walked, then I will lengthen your life."

verses.english:
Then Solomon awoke: it was a dream! He went to Jerusalem, stood
before the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH, and sacrificed burnt
offerings and presented offerings of well-being; and he made a
banquet for all his courtiers.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַץ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם וַיָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־אֲדֹנָי וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלָמִים וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל־עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַץ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם וַיָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־אֲדֹנָי וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלָמִים וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל־עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
Then Solomon awoke: it was a dream! He went to Jerusalem, stood
before the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH, and sacrificed burnt
offerings and presented offerings of well-being; and he made a
banquet for all his courtiers.

translation.text: Then Solomon awoke; it had been a dream. He came to Jerusalem for all his servants.

verses.english: Later two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָיו׃

english.text: Later two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

translation.text: Later, two women who were prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

verses.english:
The first woman said, “Please, my lord! This woman and I live in
the same house; and I gave birth to a child while she was in the
house.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחַת בִּי אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי וְהָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת יֹשְׁבֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָאֵלֵד עִמָּהּ בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחַת בִּי אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי וְהָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת יֹשְׁבֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָאֵלֵד עִמָּהּ בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The first woman said, “Please, my lord! This woman and I live in
the same house; and I gave birth to a child while she was in the
house.

translation.text: The one woman said, "Please, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house; and I gave birth while she was in the house.

verses.english:
On the third day after I was delivered, this woman also gave birth
to a child. We were alone; there was no one else with us in the
house, just the two of us in the house.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְלִדְתִּי וַתֵּלֶד גַּם־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת וַאֲנַחְנוּ יַחְדָּו אֵין־זָר אִתָּנוּ בַּבַּיִת זוּלָתִי שְׁתַּיִם־אֲנַחְנוּ בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְלִדְתִּי וַתֵּלֶד גַּם־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת וַאֲנַחְנוּ יַחְדָּו אֵין־זָר אִתָּנוּ בַּבַּיִת זוּלָתִי שְׁתַּיִם־אֲנַחְנוּ בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
On the third day after I was delivered, this woman also gave birth
to a child. We were alone; there was no one else with us in the
house, just the two of us in the house.

translation.text: Then on the third day after I gave birth, this woman also gave birth. two of us were in the house.

verses.english: During the night this woman’s child died, because she lay on it.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָיו׃

english.text: During the night this woman’s child died, because she lay on it.

translation.text: Then this woman's son died in the night, because she lay on him.

verses.english:
She arose in the night and took my son from my side while your
maidservant was asleep, and laid him in her bosom; and she laid
her dead son in my bosom.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם בְּתוֹךְ הַלַּיְלָה וַתִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנִי מֵאֶצְלִי וַאֲמָתְךָ יְשֵׁנָה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵהוּ בְּחֵיקָהּ וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ הַמֵּת הִשְׁכִּיבָה בְחֵיקִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם בְּתוֹךְ הַלַּיְלָה וַתִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנִי מֵאֶצְלִי וַאֲמָתְךָ יְשֵׁנָה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵהוּ בְּחֵיקָהּ וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ הַמֵּת הִשְׁכִּיבָה בְחֵיקִי׃

english.text:
She arose in the night and took my son from my side while your
maidservant was asleep, and laid him in her bosom; and she laid
her dead son in my bosom.

translation.text: She got up in the middle of the night at her breast, and laid her dead son at my breast.

verses.hebrew: וָאָקֻם בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֵינִיק אֶת־בְּנִי וְהִנֵּה־מֵת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵן אֵלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָיָה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר יָלָדְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וָאָקֻם בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֵינִיק אֶת־בְּנִי וְהִנֵּה־מֵת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵן אֵלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָיָה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר יָלָדְתִּי׃

translation.text: When I rose in the him closely in the morning, clearly it was not the son I had borne."

verses.english:
The other woman spoke up, “No, the live one is my son, and the
dead one is yours!” But the first insisted, “No, the dead boy is
yours; mine is the live one!” And they went on arguing before the
king.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

The other woman spoke up, “No, the live one is my son, and the

english.text:
The king said, “One says, ‘This is my son, the live one, and the
dead one is yours’; and the other says, ‘No, the dead boy is
yours, mine is the live one.’

translation.text: Then the king said, "The one says, 'This is my son that is alive, and your son is dead'; while the other says, 'Not so! Your son is dead, and my son is the living one.'"

verses.english:
So the king gave the order, “Fetch me a sword.” A sword was
brought before the king,

So the king gave the order, “Fetch me a sword.” A sword was
brought before the king,

and the king said, “Cut the live child in two, and give half to
one and half to the other.”

and the king said, “Cut the live child in two, and give half to
one and half to the other.”

translation.text: The king said, "Divide the living boy in two; then give half to the one, and half to the other."

verses.english:
But the woman whose son was the live one pleaded with the king,
for she was overcome with compassion for her son. “Please, my
lord,” she cried, “give her the live child; only don’t kill it!”
The other insisted, “It shall be neither yours nor mine; cut it in
two!”
verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־בְּנָהּ הַחַי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמֶיהָ עַל־בְּנָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת אַל־תְּמִיתֻהוּ וְזֹאת
אֹמֶרֶת גַּם־לִי גַם־לָךְ לֹא יִהְיֶה גְּזֹרוּ׃

verses.english:
Then the king spoke up. “Give the live child to her,” he said,
“and do not put it to death; she is its mother.”

english.text:
Then the king spoke up. “Give the live child to her,” he said,
“and do not put it to death; she is its mother.”

translation.text: Then the king responded: "Give the first woman the living boy; do not kill him. She is his mother."

verses.english:
When all Israel heard the decision that the king had rendered,
they stood in awe of the king; for they saw that he possessed
divine wisdom to execute justice.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַט הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־חכְמַת אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַט הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־חכְמַת אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
When all Israel heard the decision that the king had rendered,
they stood in awe of the king; for they saw that he possessed
divine wisdom to execute justice.

translation.text: God was in him, to execute justice.

Solomon had twelve prefects governing all Israel, who provided
food for the king and his household; each had to provide food for
one month in the year.
