until YHWH had placed them under the soles of his feet.
verses.hebrew:
אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־דָּוִד אָבִי כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִפְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר סְבָבֻהוּ עַד תֵּת־יְהֹוָה אֹתָם תַּחַת כַּפּוֹת (רגלו)
[רַגְלָי]׃

hebrew.text:
אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־דָּוִד אָבִי כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִפְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר סְבָבֻהוּ עַד תֵּת־יְהֹוָה אֹתָם תַּחַת כַּפּוֹת (רגלו)
[רַגְלָי]׃

english.text:
“You know that my father David could not build a house for the
name of YHWH his God because of the enemies that encompassed him,
until YHWH had placed them under the soles of his feet.

translation.text: At the king's command, they quarried with dressed stones.

verses.english:
But now YHWH my God has given me respite all around; there is no
adversary and no mischance.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָע׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָע׃

english.text:
But now YHWH my God has given me respite all around; there is no
adversary and no mischance.

translation.text: So Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and stone to build the house.

verses.english:
And so I propose to build a house for the name of YHWH my God, as
YHWH promised my father David, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set
on your throne in your place, shall build the house for My name.’
verses.hebrew:
וְהִנְנִי אֹמֵר לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי לֵאמֹר בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן תַּחְתֶּיךָ עַל־כִּסְאֶךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת
לִשְׁמִי׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנְנִי אֹמֵר לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי לֵאמֹר בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן תַּחְתֶּיךָ עַל־כִּסְאֶךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת
לִשְׁמִי׃

english.text:
And so I propose to build a house for the name of YHWH my God, as
YHWH promised my father David, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set
on your throne in your place, shall build the house for My name.’

verses.english:
Please, then, give orders for cedars to be cut for me in the
Lebanon. My servants will work with yours, and I will pay you any
wages you may ask for your servants; for as you know, there is
none among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה צַוֵּה וְיִכְרְתוּ־לִי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן וַעֲבָדַי יִהְיוּ עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ וּשְׂכַר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶתֵּן לְךָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמֵר כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ
אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ לִכְרת־עֵצִים כַּצִּדֹנִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה צַוֵּה וְיִכְרְתוּ־לִי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן וַעֲבָדַי יִהְיוּ עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ וּשְׂכַר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶתֵּן לְךָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמֵר כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ
אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ לִכְרת־עֵצִים כַּצִּדֹנִים׃

english.text:
Please, then, give orders for cedars to be cut for me in the
Lebanon. My servants will work with yours, and I will pay you any
wages you may ask for your servants; for as you know, there is
none among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

verses.english:
When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was overjoyed. “Praised be
YHWH this day,” he said, “for granting David a wise son to govern
this great people.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ חִירָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּשְׂמַח מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְדָוִד בֵּן חָכָם עַל־הָעָם הָרָב הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ חִירָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּשְׂמַח מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְדָוִד בֵּן חָכָם עַל־הָעָם הָרָב הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was overjoyed. “Praised be
YHWH this day,” he said, “for granting David a wise son to govern
this great people.”

verses.english:
So Hiram sent word to Solomon: “I have your message; I will supply
all the cedar and cypress logs you require.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלָי אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־כּל־חֶפְצְךָ בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלָי אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־כּל־חֶפְצְךָ בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
So Hiram sent word to Solomon: “I have your message; I will supply
all the cedar and cypress logs you require.

verses.english:
My servants will bring them down to the sea from the Lebanon; and
at the sea I will make them into floats and [deliver them] to any
place that you designate to me. There I shall break them up for
you to carry away. You, in turn, will supply the food I require
for my household.”
verses.hebrew:
עֲבָדַי יֹרִדוּ מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן יָמָּה וַאֲנִי אֲשִׂימֵם דֹּבְרוֹת בַּיָּם עַד־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁלַח אֵלַי וְנִפַּצְתִּים שָׁם וְאַתָּה תִשָּׂא וְאַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת־חֶפְצִי
לָתֵת לֶחֶם בֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text:
עֲבָדַי יֹרִדוּ מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן יָמָּה וַאֲנִי אֲשִׂימֵם דֹּבְרוֹת בַּיָּם עַד־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁלַח אֵלַי וְנִפַּצְתִּים שָׁם וְאַתָּה תִשָּׂא וְאַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת־חֶפְצִי
לָתֵת לֶחֶם בֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
My servants will bring them down to the sea from the Lebanon; and
at the sea I will make them into floats and [deliver them] to any
place that you designate to me. There I shall break them up for
you to carry away. You, in turn, will supply the food I require
for my household.”

verses.english:
So Hiram kept Solomon provided with all the cedar and cypress wood
he required,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי חִירוֹם נֹתֵן לִשְׁלֹמֹה עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים כּל־חֶפְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי חִירוֹם נֹתֵן לִשְׁלֹמֹה עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים כּל־חֶפְצוֹ׃

english.text:
So Hiram kept Solomon provided with all the cedar and cypress wood
he required,

verses.english:
and Solomon delivered to Hiram 20,000 kors of wheat as provisions
for his household and 20 kors of beaten oil. Such was Solomon’s
annual payment to Hiram.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כֹּר חִטִּים מַכֹּלֶת לְבֵיתוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים כֹּר שֶׁמֶן כָּתִית כֹּה־יִתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כֹּר חִטִּים מַכֹּלֶת לְבֵיתוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים כֹּר שֶׁמֶן כָּתִית כֹּה־יִתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה׃

english.text:
and Solomon delivered to Hiram 20,000 kors of wheat as provisions
for his household and 20 kors of beaten oil. Such was Solomon’s
annual payment to Hiram.

verses.english:
YHWH had given Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was
friendship between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a
treaty.
verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה נָתַן חכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ וַיְהִי שָׁלֹם בֵּין חִירָם וּבֵין שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה נָתַן חכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ וַיְהִי שָׁלֹם בֵּין חִירָם וּבֵין שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
YHWH had given Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was
friendship between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a
treaty.

verses.english:
King Solomon imposed forced labor on all Israel; the levy came to
30,000 men.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מַס מִכּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי הַמַּס שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מַס מִכּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי הַמַּס שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
King Solomon imposed forced labor on all Israel; the levy came to
30,000 men.

verses.english:
He sent them to the Lebanon in shifts of 10,000 a month: they
would spend one month in the Lebanon and two months at home.
Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לְבָנוֹנָה עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ חֲלִיפוֹת חֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ בַלְּבָנוֹן שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים בְּבֵיתוֹ וַאֲדֹנִירָם עַל־הַמַּס׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לְבָנוֹנָה עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ חֲלִיפוֹת חֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ בַלְּבָנוֹן שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים בְּבֵיתוֹ וַאֲדֹנִירָם עַל־הַמַּס׃

english.text:
He sent them to the Lebanon in shifts of 10,000 a month: they
would spend one month in the Lebanon and two months at home.
Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

verses.english: Solomon also had 70,000 porters and 80,000 quarriers in the hills,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף נֹשֵׂא סַבָּל וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף חֹצֵב בָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף נֹשֵׂא סַבָּל וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף חֹצֵב בָּהָר׃

english.text: Solomon also had 70,000 porters and 80,000 quarriers in the hills,

verses.english:
apart from Solomon’s 3,300 officials who were in charge of the
work and supervised the gangs doing the work.
verses.hebrew: לְבַד מִשָּׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: לְבַד מִשָּׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃

english.text:
apart from Solomon’s 3,300 officials who were in charge of the
work and supervised the gangs doing the work.

verses.english:
The king ordered huge blocks of choice stone to be quarried, so
that the foundations of the house might be laid with hewn stones.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּסִּעוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת לְיַסֵּד הַבָּיִת אַבְנֵי גָזִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּסִּעוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת לְיַסֵּד הַבָּיִת אַבְנֵי גָזִית׃

english.text:
The king ordered huge blocks of choice stone to be quarried, so
that the foundations of the house might be laid with hewn stones.

verses.english:
Solomon’s masons, Hiram’s masons, and the men of Gebal shaped
them. Thus the timber and the stones for building the house were
made ready.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְסְלוּ בֹּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וּבֹנֵי חִירוֹם וְהַגִּבְלִים וַיָּכִינוּ הָעֵצִים וְהָאֲבָנִים לִבְנוֹת הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְסְלוּ בֹּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וּבֹנֵי חִירוֹם וְהַגִּבְלִים וַיָּכִינוּ הָעֵצִים וְהָאֲבָנִים לִבְנוֹת הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
Solomon’s masons, Hiram’s masons, and the men of Gebal shaped
them. Thus the timber and the stones for building the house were
made ready.

verses.english:
In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites left
the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv—that is, the second
month—in the fourth year of his reign over Israel, Solomon began
to build the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בִשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְצֵאת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית בְּחֹדֶשׁ זִו הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לִמְלֹךְ שְׁלֹמֹה
עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן הַבַּיִת לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בִשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְצֵאת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית בְּחֹדֶשׁ זִו הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לִמְלֹךְ שְׁלֹמֹה
עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן הַבַּיִת לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites left
the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv—that is, the second
month—in the fourth year of his reign over Israel, Solomon began
to build the House of YHWH.

translation.text: In the four hundred eightieth year after the Israelites came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the of the LORD.

verses.english:
The House which King Solomon built for YHWH was 60 cubits long, 20
cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לַיהֹוָה שִׁשִּׁים־אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים רחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לַיהֹוָה שִׁשִּׁים־אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים רחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
The House which King Solomon built for YHWH was 60 cubits long, 20
cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

translation.text: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

verses.english:
The portico in front of the Great Hall of the House was 20 cubits
long—along the width of the House—and 10 cubits deep to the front
of the House.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵי הֵיכַל הַבַּיִת עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי רֹחַב הַבָּיִת עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵי הֵיכַל הַבַּיִת עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי רֹחַב הַבָּיִת עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The portico in front of the Great Hall of the House was 20 cubits
long—along the width of the House—and 10 cubits deep to the front
of the House.

translation.text: The vestibule width of the house. Its depth was ten cubits in front of the house.

verses.english: He made windows for the House, recessed and latticed.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לַבָּיִת חַלּוֹנֵי שְׁקֻפִים אֲטוּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לַבָּיִת חַלּוֹנֵי שְׁקֻפִים אֲטוּמִים׃

english.text: He made windows for the House, recessed and latticed.

translation.text: For the house he made windows with recessed frames.

verses.english:
Against the outside wall of the House—the outside walls of the
House enclosing the Great Hall and the Shrine—he built a storied
structure; and he made side chambers all around.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן עַל־קִיר הַבַּיִת (יצוע) [יָצִיעַ] סָבִיב אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת סָבִיב לַהֵיכָל וְלַדְּבִיר וַיַּעַשׂ צְלָעוֹת סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן עַל־קִיר הַבַּיִת (יצוע) [יָצִיעַ] סָבִיב אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת סָבִיב לַהֵיכָל וְלַדְּבִיר וַיַּעַשׂ צְלָעוֹת סָבִיב׃

english.text:
Against the outside wall of the House—the outside walls of the
House enclosing the Great Hall and the Shrine—he built a storied
structure; and he made side chambers all around.

translation.text: He also built a chambers all around.

verses.english:
The lowest story was 5 cubits wide, the middle one 6 cubits wide,
and the third 7 cubits wide; for he had provided recesses around
the outside of the House so as not to penetrate the walls of the
House.
verses.hebrew:
(היצוע) [הַיָּצִיעַ] הַתַּחְתֹּנָה חָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְהַתִּיכֹנָה שֵׁשׁ בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית שֶׁבַע בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ כִּי מִגְרָעוֹת נָתַן לַבַּיִת סָבִיב
חוּצָה לְבִלְתִּי אֲחֹז בְּקִירוֹת־הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text:
(היצוע) [הַיָּצִיעַ] הַתַּחְתֹּנָה חָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְהַתִּיכֹנָה שֵׁשׁ בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית שֶׁבַע בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ כִּי מִגְרָעוֹת נָתַן לַבַּיִת סָבִיב
חוּצָה לְבִלְתִּי אֲחֹז בְּקִירוֹת־הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The lowest story was 5 cubits wide, the middle one 6 cubits wide,
and the third 7 cubits wide; for he had provided recesses around
the outside of the House so as not to penetrate the walls of the
House.

translation.text: The lowest story was five cubits wide, the middle one was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; of the house.

verses.english:
When the House was built, only finished stones cut at the quarry
were used, so that no hammer or ax or any iron tool was heard in
the House while it was being built.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ אֶבֶן־שְׁלֵמָה מַסָּע נִבְנָה וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כּל־כְּלִי בַרְזֶל לֹא־נִשְׁמַע בַּבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ אֶבֶן־שְׁלֵמָה מַסָּע נִבְנָה וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כּל־כְּלִי בַרְזֶל לֹא־נִשְׁמַע בַּבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
When the House was built, only finished stones cut at the quarry
were used, so that no hammer or ax or any iron tool was heard in
the House while it was being built.

translation.text: The house was built with stone finished at the quarry, so that neither was being built.

verses.english:
The entrance to the middle [story of] the side chambers was on the
right side of the House; and winding stairs led up to the middle
chambers, and from the middle chambers to the third story.
verses.hebrew: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַעֲלוּ עַל־הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן־הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַעֲלוּ עַל־הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן־הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִׁים׃

english.text:
The entrance to the middle [story of] the side chambers was on the
right side of the House; and winding stairs led up to the middle
chambers, and from the middle chambers to the third story.

translation.text: The entrance for the middle story was on the south side of the house: middle story to the third.

verses.english:
When he finished building the House, he paneled the House with
beams and planks of cedar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת־הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת־הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
When he finished building the House, he paneled the House with
beams and planks of cedar.

translation.text: So he built the house, and finished it; he roofed the house with beams and planks of cedar.

verses.english:
He built the storied structure against the entire House—each story
5 cubits high, so that it encased the House with timbers of cedar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־[הַיָּצִיעַ] (היצוע) עַל־כּל־הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת־הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־[הַיָּצִיעַ] (היצוע) עַל־כּל־הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת־הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
He built the storied structure against the entire House—each story
5 cubits high, so that it encased the House with timbers of cedar.

translation.text: He built the was joined to the house with timbers of cedar.

verses.english: Then the word of YHWH came to Solomon,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Then the word of YHWH came to Solomon,

translation.text: Now the word of the LORD came to Solomon,

verses.english:
“With regard to this House you are building—if you follow My laws
and observe My rules and faithfully keep My commandments, I will
fulfill for you the promise that I gave to your father David:
verses.hebrew:
הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה בֹנֶה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשֶׂה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺתַי לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־דְּבָרִי אִתָּךְ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה בֹנֶה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשֶׂה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺתַי לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־דְּבָרִי אִתָּךְ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
“With regard to this House you are building—if you follow My laws
and observe My rules and faithfully keep My commandments, I will
fulfill for you the promise that I gave to your father David:

translation.text: "Concerning this will establish my promise with you, which I made to your father David.

verses.english:
I will abide among the children of Israel, and I will never
forsake My people Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
I will abide among the children of Israel, and I will never
forsake My people Israel.”

translation.text: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel."

verses.english: When Solomon had completed the construction of the House,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ׃

english.text: When Solomon had completed the construction of the House,

translation.text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

verses.english:
he paneled the walls of the House on the inside with planks of
cedar. He also overlaid the walls on the inside with wood, from
the floor of the House to the ceiling. And he overlaid the floor
of the House with planks of cypress.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מִבַּיְתָה בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִקַּרְקַע הַבַּיִת עַד־קִירוֹת הַסִּפֻּן צִפָּה עֵץ מִבָּיִת וַיְצַף אֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת בְּרוֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מִבַּיְתָה בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִקַּרְקַע הַבַּיִת עַד־קִירוֹת הַסִּפֻּן צִפָּה עֵץ מִבָּיִת וַיְצַף אֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת בְּרוֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
he paneled the walls of the House on the inside with planks of
cedar. He also overlaid the walls on the inside with wood, from
the floor of the House to the ceiling. And he overlaid the floor
of the House with planks of cypress.

translation.text: He lined the walls of house to the rafters of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the house with boards of cypress.

verses.english:
Twenty cubits from the rear of the House, he built [a partition]
of cedar planks from the floor to the walls; he furnished its
interior to serve as a shrine, as the Holy of Holies.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה (מירכותי) [מִיַּרְכְּתֵי] הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן־הַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה (מירכותי) [מִיַּרְכְּתֵי] הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן־הַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Twenty cubits from the rear of the House, he built [a partition]
of cedar planks from the floor to the walls; he furnished its
interior to serve as a shrine, as the Holy of Holies.

translation.text: sanctuary, as the most holy place.

verses.english:
The front part of the House, that is, the Great Hall, measured 40
cubits.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי׃

english.text:
The front part of the House, that is, the Great Hall, measured 40
cubits.

translation.text: The house, that is, the nave in front of the inner sanctuary, was forty cubits long.

verses.english:
The cedar of the interior of the House had carvings of gourds and
calyxes; it was all cedar, no stone was exposed.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶרֶז אֶל־הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶרֶז אֶל־הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָה׃

english.text:
The cedar of the interior of the House had carvings of gourds and
calyxes; it was all cedar, no stone was exposed.

translation.text: The cedar within stone was seen.

verses.english:
In the innermost part of the House, he fixed a Shrine in which to
place the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant.
verses.hebrew: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
In the innermost part of the House, he fixed a Shrine in which to
place the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant.

translation.text: The inner sanctuary he prepared in the innermost part of the house, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

verses.english:
The interior of the Shrine was 20 cubits long, 20 cubits wide, and
20 cubits high. He overlaid it with solid gold; he similarly
overlaid [its] cedar altar.
verses.hebrew: וְלִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רֹחַב וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְצַף מִזְבֵּחַ אָרֶז׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רֹחַב וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְצַף מִזְבֵּחַ אָרֶז׃

english.text:
The interior of the Shrine was 20 cubits long, 20 cubits wide, and
20 cubits high. He overlaid it with solid gold; he similarly
overlaid [its] cedar altar.

translation.text: also overlaid the altar with cedar.

verses.english:
Solomon overlaid the interior of the House with solid gold; and he
inserted golden chains into the door of the Shrine. He overlaid
[the Shrine] with gold,
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר (ברתיקות) [בְּרַתּוּקוֹת] זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר (ברתיקות) [בְּרַתּוּקוֹת] זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב׃

english.text:
Solomon overlaid the interior of the House with solid gold; and he
inserted golden chains into the door of the Shrine. He overlaid
[the Shrine] with gold,

translation.text: Solomon overlaid the inside of the the inner sanctuary, and overlaid it with gold.

verses.english:
so that the entire House was overlaid with gold; he even overlaid
with gold the entire altar of the Shrine. And so the entire House
was completed.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כּל־הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב עַד־תֹּם כּל־הַבָּיִת וְכל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־לַדְּבִיר צִפָּה זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־כּל־הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב עַד־תֹּם כּל־הַבָּיִת וְכל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־לַדְּבִיר צִפָּה זָהָב׃

english.text:
so that the entire House was overlaid with gold; he even overlaid
with gold the entire altar of the Shrine. And so the entire House
was completed.

translation.text: Next he overlaid the overlaid with gold.

verses.english:
In the Shrine he made two cherubim of olive wood, each 10 cubits
high.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
In the Shrine he made two cherubim of olive wood, each 10 cubits
high.

translation.text: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olivewood, each ten cubits high.

verses.english:
[One] had a wing measuring 5 cubits and another wing measuring 5
cubits, so that the spread from wingtip to wingtip was 10 cubits;
verses.hebrew: וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִית עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת מִקְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו וְעַד־קְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִית עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת מִקְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו וְעַד־קְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו׃

english.text:
[One] had a wing measuring 5 cubits and another wing measuring 5
cubits, so that the spread from wingtip to wingtip was 10 cubits;

translation.text: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the was ten cubits from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other.

verses.english:
and the wingspread of the other cherub was also 10 cubits. The two
cherubim had the same measurements and proportions:
verses.hebrew: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

english.text:
and the wingspread of the other cherub was also 10 cubits. The two
cherubim had the same measurements and proportions:

translation.text: The measure and the same form.

verses.english:
the height of the one cherub was 10 cubits, and so was that of the
other cherub.
verses.hebrew: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
the height of the one cherub was 10 cubits, and so was that of the
other cherub.

translation.text: The height of one cherub was ten cubits, and so was that of the other cherub.

verses.english:
He placed the cherubim inside the inner chamber. Since the wings
of the cherubim were extended, a wing of the one touched one wall
and a wing of the other touched the other wall, while their wings
in the center of the chamber touched each other.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַתִּגַּע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד בַּקִּיר וּכְנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי נֹגַעַת בַּקִּיר
הַשֵּׁנִי וְכַנְפֵיהֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת נֹגְעֹת כָּנָף אֶל־כָּנָף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַתִּגַּע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד בַּקִּיר וּכְנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי נֹגַעַת בַּקִּיר
הַשֵּׁנִי וְכַנְפֵיהֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת נֹגְעֹת כָּנָף אֶל־כָּנָף׃

english.text:
He placed the cherubim inside the inner chamber. Since the wings
of the cherubim were extended, a wing of the one touched one wall
and a wing of the other touched the other wall, while their wings
in the center of the chamber touched each other.

translation.text: He put the cherubim in wings toward the center of the house were touching wing to wing.

verses.english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָב׃

english.text: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translation.text: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.

verses.english:
All over the walls of the House, of both the inner area and the
outer area, he carved reliefs of cherubim, palms, and calyxes,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

english.text:
All over the walls of the House, of both the inner area and the
outer area, he carved reliefs of cherubim, palms, and calyxes,

translation.text: He carved the walls of the house all around about with carved outer rooms.

verses.english:
and he overlaid the floor of the House with gold, both the inner
and the outer areas.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

english.text:
and he overlaid the floor of the House with gold, both the inner
and the outer areas.

translation.text: The floor of the house he overlaid with gold, in the inner and outer rooms.

verses.english:
For the entrance of the Shrine he made doors of olive wood, the
pilasters and the doorposts having five sides.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִׁית׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִׁית׃

english.text:
For the entrance of the Shrine he made doors of olive wood, the
pilasters and the doorposts having five sides.

translation.text: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors of olivewood; the lintel and the doorposts were five-sided.

verses.english:
The double doors were of olive wood, and on them he carved reliefs
of cherubim, palms, and calyxes. He overlaid them with gold,
hammering the gold onto the cherubim and the palms.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן וְקָלַע עֲלֵיהֶם מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב וַיָּרֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹרוֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָב׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן וְקָלַע עֲלֵיהֶם מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב וַיָּרֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹרוֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָב׃

english.text:
The double doors were of olive wood, and on them he carved reliefs
of cherubim, palms, and calyxes. He overlaid them with gold,
hammering the gold onto the cherubim and the palms.

translation.text: He covered the two and on the palm trees.

verses.english:
For the entrance of the Great Hall, too, he made doorposts of
oleaster wood, having four sides,
verses.hebrew: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִית׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִית׃

english.text:
For the entrance of the Great Hall, too, he made doorposts of
oleaster wood, having four sides,

translation.text: So also he made for the entrance to the nave doorposts of olivewood, four-sided each,

verses.english:
and the double doors of cypress wood, each door consisting of two
rounded planks.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִים׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִים׃

english.text:
and the double doors of cypress wood, each door consisting of two
rounded planks.

translation.text: and two doors of cypress wood; the two door were folding.

verses.english:
On them he carved cherubim, palms, and calyxes, overlaying them
with gold applied evenly over the carvings.
verses.hebrew: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּה׃

english.text:
On them he carved cherubim, palms, and calyxes, overlaying them
with gold applied evenly over the carvings.

translation.text: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open work.

verses.english:
He built the inner enclosure of three courses of hewn stones and
one course of cedar beams.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
He built the inner enclosure of three courses of hewn stones and
one course of cedar beams.

translation.text: He built the inner court with three courses of dressed stone to one course of cedar beams.

verses.english:
In the fourth year, in the month of Ziv, the foundations of the
House of YHWH were laid;
verses.hebrew: בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהֹוָה בְּיֶרַח זִו׃

hebrew.text: בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהֹוָה בְּיֶרַח זִו׃

english.text:
In the fourth year, in the month of Ziv, the foundations of the
House of YHWH were laid;

translation.text: In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, in the month of Ziv.

verses.english:
and in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul—that is, the eighth
month—the House was completed according to all its details and all
its specifications. It took him seven years to build it.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיֶרַח בּוּל הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי כָּלָה הַבַּיִת לְכל־דְּבָרָיו וּלְכל־מִשְׁפָּטָו וַיִּבְנֵהוּ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיֶרַח בּוּל הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי כָּלָה הַבַּיִת לְכל־דְּבָרָיו וּלְכל־מִשְׁפָּטָו וַיִּבְנֵהוּ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
and in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul—that is, the eighth
month—the House was completed according to all its details and all
its specifications. It took him seven years to build it.

translation.text: In the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, which according to all its specifications. He was seven years in building it.

verses.english:
And it took Solomon thirteen years to build his palace, until his
whole palace was completed.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְכַל אֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְכַל אֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And it took Solomon thirteen years to build his palace, until his
whole palace was completed.

translation.text: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished his entire house.

verses.english:
He built the Lebanon Forest House with four rows of cedar columns,
and with hewn cedar beams above the columns. Its length was 100
cubits, its breadth 50 cubits, and its height 30 cubits.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵאָה אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ עַל אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי עַמּוּדֵי אֲרָזִים וּכְרֻתוֹת אֲרָזִים
עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵאָה אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ עַל אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי עַמּוּדֵי אֲרָזִים וּכְרֻתוֹת אֲרָזִים
עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים׃

english.text:
He built the Lebanon Forest House with four rows of cedar columns,
and with hewn cedar beams above the columns. Its length was 100
cubits, its breadth 50 cubits, and its height 30 cubits.

translation.text: He built the House of the Forest of the Lebanon one hundred cubits cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

verses.english:
It was paneled above with cedar, with the planks that were above
on the 45 columns—15 in each row.
verses.hebrew: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל־הַצְּלָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל־הַצְּלָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּוּר׃

english.text:
It was paneled above with cedar, with the planks that were above
on the 45 columns—15 in each row.

translation.text: It was roofed with cedar on the forty-five rafters, fifteen in each row, which were on the pillars.

verses.english:
And there were three rows of window frames, with three tiers of
windows facing each other.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And there were three rows of window frames, with three tiers of
windows facing each other.

translation.text: There were window frames in the three rows, facing each other in the three rows.

verses.english:
All the doorways and doorposts had square frames—with three tiers
of windows facing each other.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
All the doorways and doorposts had square frames—with three tiers
of windows facing each other.

translation.text: All the doorways and doorposts had foursided frames, opposite, facing each other in the three rows.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אוּלָם הָעַמּוּדִים עָשָׂה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת אוּלָם הָעַמּוּדִים עָשָׂה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃

translation.text: He made the Hall of Pillars fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide. There was a porch in front with pillars, and a canopy in front of them.

verses.english:
He made the throne portico, where he was to pronounce judgment—the
Hall of Judgment. It was paneled with cedar from floor to floor.
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפּט־שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקַּרְקָע׃

hebrew.text: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפּט־שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקַּרְקָע׃

english.text:
He made the throne portico, where he was to pronounce judgment—the
Hall of Judgment. It was paneled with cedar from floor to floor.

translation.text: He made the Hall of the Throne where he was to pronounce judgment, the Hall of Justice, covered with cedar from floor to floor.

verses.english:
The house that he used as a residence, in the rear courtyard, back
of the portico, was of the same construction. Solomon also
constructed a palace like that portico for the daughter of
Pharaoh, whom he had married.
verses.hebrew: וּבֵיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֶׁב שָׁם חָצֵר הָאַחֶרֶת מִבֵּית לָאוּלָם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה הָיָה וּבַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח שְׁלֹמֹה כָּאוּלָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֶׁב שָׁם חָצֵר הָאַחֶרֶת מִבֵּית לָאוּלָם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה הָיָה וּבַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח שְׁלֹמֹה כָּאוּלָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The house that he used as a residence, in the rear courtyard, back
of the portico, was of the same construction. Solomon also
constructed a palace like that portico for the daughter of
Pharaoh, whom he had married.

translation.text: His own house where he would reside, in the other court back of the hall, was of the same construction. Solomon also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken in marriage.

verses.english:
All these buildings, from foundation to coping and all the way out
to the great courtyard, were of choice stones, hewn according to
measure, smooth on all sides.
verses.hebrew: כּל־אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד־הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד־הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
All these buildings, from foundation to coping and all the way out
to the great courtyard, were of choice stones, hewn according to
measure, smooth on all sides.

translation.text: All these were made of costly stones, cut according to measure, and from outside to the great court.

verses.english:
The foundations were huge blocks of choice stone, stones of 10
cubits and stones of 8 cubits;
verses.hebrew: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּוֹת׃

english.text:
The foundations were huge blocks of choice stone, stones of 10
cubits and stones of 8 cubits;

translation.text: The foundation was of costly stones, huge stones, stones of eight and ten cubits.

verses.english:
and above were choice stones, hewn according to measure, and cedar
wood.
verses.hebrew: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָרֶז׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָרֶז׃

english.text:
and above were choice stones, hewn according to measure, and cedar
wood.

translation.text: There were costly stones above, cut to measure, and cedarwood.

verses.english:
The large surrounding courtyard had three tiers of hewn stone and
a row of cedar beams, the same as for the inner court of the House
of YHWH, and for the portico of the House.
verses.hebrew: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The large surrounding courtyard had three tiers of hewn stone and
a row of cedar beams, the same as for the inner court of the House
of YHWH, and for the portico of the House.

translation.text: The great court had three courses of dressed stone to one layer of cedar beams all around; the house.

verses.english: King Solomon sent for Hiram and brought him down from Tyre.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חִירָם מִצֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חִירָם מִצֹּר׃

english.text: King Solomon sent for Hiram and brought him down from Tyre.

translation.text: Now King Solomon invited and received Hiram from Tyre.

verses.english:
He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father
had been a Tyrian, a coppersmith. He was endowed with skill,
ability, and talent for executing all work in bronze. He came to
King Solomon and executed all his work.
verses.hebrew:
בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה הוּא מִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְאָבִיו אִישׁ־צֹרִי חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיִּמָּלֵא אֶת־הַחכְמָה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה וְאֶת־הַדַּעַת לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל־מְלָאכָה בַּנְּחֹשֶׁת
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־כּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה הוּא מִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְאָבִיו אִישׁ־צֹרִי חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיִּמָּלֵא אֶת־הַחכְמָה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה וְאֶת־הַדַּעַת לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל־מְלָאכָה בַּנְּחֹשֶׁת
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־כּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father
had been a Tyrian, a coppersmith. He was endowed with skill,
ability, and talent for executing all work in bronze. He came to
King Solomon and executed all his work.

translation.text: He was Tyre, had been an artisan in bronze; he was full of skill, intelligence, all his work.

verses.english:
He cast two columns of bronze; one column was 18 cubits high and
measured 12 cubits in circumference, [and similarly] the other
column.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּצַר אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּצַר אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
He cast two columns of bronze; one column was 18 cubits high and
measured 12 cubits in circumference, [and similarly] the other
column.

translation.text: He cast two pillars of bronze. Eighteen cubits was the height of the one, and a cord of twelve cubits would encircle it; the second pillar was the same.

verses.english:
He made two capitals, cast in bronze, to be set upon the two
columns, the height of each of the two capitals being 5 cubits;
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הָעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הָעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
He made two capitals, cast in bronze, to be set upon the two
columns, the height of each of the two capitals being 5 cubits;

translation.text: He also made two capitals of molten bronze, to set on the tops of the pillars; the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

verses.english:
also nets of meshwork with festoons of chainwork for the capitals
that were on the top of the columns, seven for each of the two
capitals.
verses.hebrew: שְׂבָכִים מַעֲשֵׂה שְׂבָכָה גְּדִלִים מַעֲשֵׂה שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת לַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְשִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: שְׂבָכִים מַעֲשֵׂה שְׂבָכָה גְּדִלִים מַעֲשֵׂה שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת לַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְשִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
also nets of meshwork with festoons of chainwork for the capitals
that were on the top of the columns, seven for each of the two
capitals.

translation.text: There were nets of of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

verses.english:
He made the columns so that there were two rows [of pomegranates]
encircling the top of the one network, to cover the capitals that
were on the top of the pomegranates; and he did the same for [the
network on] the second capital.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הָעַמּוּדִים וּשְׁנֵי טוּרִים סָבִיב עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָרִמֹּנִים וְכֵן עָשָׂה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הָעַמּוּדִים וּשְׁנֵי טוּרִים סָבִיב עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָרִמֹּנִים וְכֵן עָשָׂה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
He made the columns so that there were two rows [of pomegranates]
encircling the top of the one network, to cover the capitals that
were on the top of the pomegranates; and he did the same for [the
network on] the second capital.

translation.text: He made the columns with two rows around each latticework to with the other capital.

verses.english:
The capitals upon the columns of the portico were of lily design,
4 cubits high;
verses.hebrew: וְכֹתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוּשַׁן בָּאוּלָם אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוּשַׁן בָּאוּלָם אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת׃

english.text:
The capitals upon the columns of the portico were of lily design,
4 cubits high;

translation.text: Now the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars in the vestibule were of lily-work, four cubits high.

verses.english:
so also the capitals upon the two columns extended above and next
to the bulge that was beside the network. There were 200
pomegranates in rows around the top of the second capital.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹתָרֹת עַל־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים גַּם־מִמַּעַל מִלְּעֻמַּת הַבֶּטֶן אֲשֶׁר לְעֵבֶר (שבכה) [הַשְּׂבָכָה] וְהָרִמּוֹנִים מָאתַיִם טֻרִים סָבִיב עַל הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹתָרֹת עַל־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים גַּם־מִמַּעַל מִלְּעֻמַּת הַבֶּטֶן אֲשֶׁר לְעֵבֶר (שבכה) [הַשְּׂבָכָה] וְהָרִמּוֹנִים מָאתַיִם טֻרִים סָבִיב עַל הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
so also the capitals upon the two columns extended above and next
to the bulge that was beside the network. There were 200
pomegranates in rows around the top of the second capital.

translation.text: The pomegranates in rows all around; and so with the other capital.

verses.english:
He set up the columns at the portico of the Great Hall; he set up
one column on the right and named it Jachin, and he set up the
other column on the left and named it Boaz.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים לְאֻלָם הַהֵיכָל וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַיְמָנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יָכִין וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשְּׂמָאלִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בֹּעַז׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים לְאֻלָם הַהֵיכָל וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַיְמָנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יָכִין וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשְּׂמָאלִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בֹּעַז׃

english.text:
He set up the columns at the portico of the Great Hall; he set up
one column on the right and named it Jachin, and he set up the
other column on the left and named it Boaz.

translation.text: He set up the pillars at the vestibule of the temple; he set up the pillar on the south and called it Jachin; and he set up the pillar on the north and called it Boaz.

verses.english:
Upon the top of the columns there was a lily design. Thus the work
of the columns was completed.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוֹשָׁן וַתִּתֹּם מְלֶאכֶת הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוֹשָׁן וַתִּתֹּם מְלֶאכֶת הָעַמּוּדִים׃

english.text:
Upon the top of the columns there was a lily design. Thus the work
of the columns was completed.

translation.text: On the tops of the pillars was lily-work. Thus the work of the pillars was finished.

verses.english:
Then he made the tank of cast metal, 10 cubits across from brim to
brim, completely round; it was 5 cubits high, and it measured 30
cubits in circumference.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּם מוּצָק עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מִשְּׂפָתוֹ עַד־שְׂפָתוֹ עָגֹל סָבִיב וְחָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ (וקוה) [וְקָו] שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה יָסֹב אֹתוֹ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּם מוּצָק עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מִשְּׂפָתוֹ עַד־שְׂפָתוֹ עָגֹל סָבִיב וְחָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ (וקוה) [וְקָו] שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה יָסֹב אֹתוֹ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
Then he made the tank of cast metal, 10 cubits across from brim to
brim, completely round; it was 5 cubits high, and it measured 30
cubits in circumference.

translation.text: Then he made the molten sea; it was round, ten cubits from brim to completely.

verses.english:
There were gourds below the brim completely encircling it—ten to a
cubit, encircling the tank; the gourds were in two rows, cast in
one piece with it.
verses.hebrew: וּפְקָעִים מִתַּחַת לִשְׂפָתוֹ סָבִיב סֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מַקִּפִים אֶת־הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנֵי טוּרִים הַפְּקָעִים יְצֻקִים בִּיצֻקָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְקָעִים מִתַּחַת לִשְׂפָתוֹ סָבִיב סֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מַקִּפִים אֶת־הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנֵי טוּרִים הַפְּקָעִים יְצֻקִים בִּיצֻקָתוֹ׃

english.text:
There were gourds below the brim completely encircling it—ten to a
cubit, encircling the tank; the gourds were in two rows, cast in
one piece with it.

translation.text: Under its brim were panels all around it, each of ten it was cast.

verses.english:
It stood upon twelve oxen: three facing north, three facing west,
three facing south, and three facing east, with the tank resting
upon them; their haunches were all turned inward.
verses.hebrew:
עֹמֵד עַל־שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר שְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים צָפוֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים יָמָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים נֶגְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים מִזְרָחָה וְהַיָּם עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה
וְכל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶם בָּיְתָה׃

hebrew.text:
עֹמֵד עַל־שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר שְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים צָפוֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים יָמָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים נֶגְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים מִזְרָחָה וְהַיָּם עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה
וְכל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶם בָּיְתָה׃

english.text:
It stood upon twelve oxen: three facing north, three facing west,
three facing south, and three facing east, with the tank resting
upon them; their haunches were all turned inward.

translation.text: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing them. The hindquarters of each were toward the inside.

verses.english:
It was a handbreadth thick, and its brim was made like that of a
cup, like the petals of a lily. Its capacity was 2,000 baths.
verses.hebrew: וְעבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת־כּוֹס פֶּרַח שׁוֹשָׁן אַלְפַּיִם בַּת יָכִיל׃

hebrew.text: וְעבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת־כּוֹס פֶּרַח שׁוֹשָׁן אַלְפַּיִם בַּת יָכִיל׃

english.text:
It was a handbreadth thick, and its brim was made like that of a
cup, like the petals of a lily. Its capacity was 2,000 baths.

translation.text: Its thickness flower of a lily; it held two thousand baths.

verses.english:
He made the ten laver stands of bronze. The length of each laver
stand was 4 cubits and the width 4 cubits, and the height was 3
cubits.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עֶשֶׂר נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְשָׁלֹשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עֶשֶׂר נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְשָׁלֹשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ׃

english.text:
He made the ten laver stands of bronze. The length of each laver
stand was 4 cubits and the width 4 cubits, and the height was 3
cubits.

translation.text: He also made the ten stands of bronze; each stand was four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.

verses.english:
The structure of the laver stands was as follows: They had insets,
and there were insets within the frames;
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּכוֹנָה מִסְגְּרֹת לָהֶם וּמִסְגְּרֹת בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּכוֹנָה מִסְגְּרֹת לָהֶם וּמִסְגְּרֹת בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים׃

english.text:
The structure of the laver stands was as follows: They had insets,
and there were insets within the frames;

translation.text: This was the the frames;

verses.english:
and on the insets within the frames were lions, oxen, and
cherubim. Above the frames was a stand; and both above and below
the lions and the oxen were spirals of hammered metal.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים אֲרָיוֹת בָּקָר וּכְרוּבִים וְעַל־הַשְׁלַבִּים כֵּן מִמָּעַל וּמִתַּחַת לַאֲרָיוֹת וְלַבָּקָר לֹיוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה מוֹרָד׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים אֲרָיוֹת בָּקָר וּכְרוּבִים וְעַל־הַשְׁלַבִּים כֵּן מִמָּעַל וּמִתַּחַת לַאֲרָיוֹת וְלַבָּקָר לֹיוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה מוֹרָד׃

english.text:
and on the insets within the frames were lions, oxen, and
cherubim. Above the frames was a stand; and both above and below
the lions and the oxen were spirals of hammered metal.

translation.text: on the borders that were set in the frames were lions, and oxen, there were wreaths of beveled work.

verses.english:
Each laver stand had four bronze wheels and [two] bronze
axletrees. Its four legs had brackets; the brackets were under the
laver, cast with spirals beyond each.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעָה אוֹפַנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת וְסַרְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָה פַעֲמֹתָיו כְּתֵפֹת לָהֶם מִתַּחַת לַכִּיֹּר הַכְּתֵפוֹת יְצֻקוֹת מֵעֵבֶר אִישׁ לֹיוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעָה אוֹפַנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת וְסַרְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָה פַעֲמֹתָיו כְּתֵפֹת לָהֶם מִתַּחַת לַכִּיֹּר הַכְּתֵפוֹת יְצֻקוֹת מֵעֵבֶר אִישׁ לֹיוֹת׃

english.text:
Each laver stand had four bronze wheels and [two] bronze
axletrees. Its four legs had brackets; the brackets were under the
laver, cast with spirals beyond each.

translation.text: Each stand had four for a basin. The supports were cast with wreaths at the side of each.

verses.english:
Its funnel, within the crown, rose a cubit above it; this funnel
was round, in the fashion of a stand, a cubit and a half in
diameter. On the funnel too there were carvings. But the insets
were square, not round.
verses.hebrew: וּפִיהוּ מִבֵּית לַכֹּתֶרֶת וָמַעְלָה בָּאַמָּה וּפִיהָ עָגֹל מַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה וְגַם־עַל־פִּיהָ מִקְלָעוֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם מְרֻבָּעוֹת לֹא עֲגֻלּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּפִיהוּ מִבֵּית לַכֹּתֶרֶת וָמַעְלָה בָּאַמָּה וּפִיהָ עָגֹל מַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה וְגַם־עַל־פִּיהָ מִקְלָעוֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם מְרֻבָּעוֹת לֹא עֲגֻלּוֹת׃

english.text:
Its funnel, within the crown, rose a cubit above it; this funnel
was round, in the fashion of a stand, a cubit and a half in
diameter. On the funnel too there were carvings. But the insets
were square, not round.

translation.text: not round.

verses.english:
And below the insets were the four wheels. The axletrees of the
wheels were [fixed] in the laver stand, and the height of each
wheel was a cubit and a half.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּעַת הָאוֹפַנִּים לְמִתַּחַת לַמִּסְגְּרוֹת וִידוֹת הָאוֹפַנִּים בַּמְּכוֹנָה וְקוֹמַת הָאוֹפַן הָאֶחָד אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבַּעַת הָאוֹפַנִּים לְמִתַּחַת לַמִּסְגְּרוֹת וִידוֹת הָאוֹפַנִּים בַּמְּכוֹנָה וְקוֹמַת הָאוֹפַן הָאֶחָד אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה׃

english.text:
And below the insets were the four wheels. The axletrees of the
wheels were [fixed] in the laver stand, and the height of each
wheel was a cubit and a half.

translation.text: The four wheels were underneath the borders; the axles of the wheels were in the stands; and the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half.

verses.english:
The structure of the wheels was like the structure of chariot
wheels; and their axletrees, their rims, their spokes, and their
hubs were all of cast metal.
verses.hebrew: וּמַעֲשֵׂה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אוֹפַן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה יְדוֹתָם וְגַבֵּיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶם הַכֹּל מוּצָק׃

hebrew.text: וּמַעֲשֵׂה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אוֹפַן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה יְדוֹתָם וְגַבֵּיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶם הַכֹּל מוּצָק׃

english.text:
The structure of the wheels was like the structure of chariot
wheels; and their axletrees, their rims, their spokes, and their
hubs were all of cast metal.

translation.text: The wheels were made like a chariot wheel; their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all cast.

verses.english:
Four brackets ran to the four corners of each laver stand; the
brackets were of a piece with the laver stand.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּע כְּתֵפוֹת אֶל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַמְּכֹנָה הָאֶחָת מִן־הַמְּכֹנָה כְּתֵפֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבַּע כְּתֵפוֹת אֶל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַמְּכֹנָה הָאֶחָת מִן־הַמְּכֹנָה כְּתֵפֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Four brackets ran to the four corners of each laver stand; the
brackets were of a piece with the laver stand.

translation.text: There were one piece with the stands.

verses.english:
At the top of the laver stand was a round band half a cubit high,
and together with the top of the laver stand; its sides and its
insets were of one piece with it.
verses.hebrew: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָה חֲצִי הָאַמָּה קוֹמָה עָגֹל סָבִיב וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה יְדֹתֶיהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָה חֲצִי הָאַמָּה קוֹמָה עָגֹל סָבִיב וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה יְדֹתֶיהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
At the top of the laver stand was a round band half a cubit high,
and together with the top of the laver stand; its sides and its
insets were of one piece with it.

translation.text: On the top of the stand there was a round band half a cubit high; on the top of the stand, its stays and its borders were of one piece with it.

verses.english:
On its surface—on its sides—and on its insets [Hiram] engraved
cherubim, lions, and palms, as the clear space on each allowed,
with spirals round about.
verses.hebrew: וַיְפַתַּח עַל־הַלֻּחֹת יְדֹתֶיהָ וְעַל (ומסגרתיה) [מִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ] כְּרוּבִים אֲרָיוֹת וְתִמֹרֹת כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ וְלֹיוֹת סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְפַתַּח עַל־הַלֻּחֹת יְדֹתֶיהָ וְעַל (ומסגרתיה) [מִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ] כְּרוּבִים אֲרָיוֹת וְתִמֹרֹת כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ וְלֹיוֹת סָבִיב׃

english.text:
On its surface—on its sides—and on its insets [Hiram] engraved
cherubim, lions, and palms, as the clear space on each allowed,
with spirals round about.

translation.text: On the surfaces of its stays and on space, with wreaths all around.

verses.english:
It was after this manner that he made the ten laver stands, all of
them cast alike, of the same measure and the same form.
verses.hebrew: כָּזֹאת עָשָׂה אֵת עֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת מוּצָק אֶחָד מִדָּה אַחַת קֶצֶב אֶחָד לְכֻלָּהְנָה׃

hebrew.text: כָּזֹאת עָשָׂה אֵת עֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת מוּצָק אֶחָד מִדָּה אַחַת קֶצֶב אֶחָד לְכֻלָּהְנָה׃

english.text:
It was after this manner that he made the ten laver stands, all of
them cast alike, of the same measure and the same form.

translation.text: In this way he made the ten stands; all of them were cast alike, with the same size and the same form.

verses.english:
Then he made ten bronze lavers, one laver on each of the ten laver
stands, each laver measuring 4 cubits and each laver containing
forty baths.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ עֲשָׂרָה כִיֹּרוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבָּעִים בַּת יָכִיל הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד כִּיּוֹר אֶחָד עַל־הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת לְעֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ עֲשָׂרָה כִיֹּרוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבָּעִים בַּת יָכִיל הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד כִּיּוֹר אֶחָד עַל־הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת לְעֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

english.text:
Then he made ten bronze lavers, one laver on each of the ten laver
stands, each laver measuring 4 cubits and each laver containing
forty baths.

translation.text: He made ten basins of bronze; each basin held forty baths, each stands.

verses.english:
He disposed the laver stands, five at the right side of the House
and five at its left side; and the tank he placed on the right
side of the House, at the southeast [corner].
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת חָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ וְאֶת־הַיָּם נָתַן מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית קֵדְמָה מִמּוּל נֶגֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת חָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ וְאֶת־הַיָּם נָתַן מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית קֵדְמָה מִמּוּל נֶגֶב׃

english.text:
He disposed the laver stands, five at the right side of the House
and five at its left side; and the tank he placed on the right
side of the House, at the southeast [corner].

translation.text: He set five of the stands on the south side of the house, and corner of the house.

verses.english:
Hiram also made the lavers, the scrapers, and the sprinkling
bowls. So Hiram finished all the work that he had been doing for
King Solomon on the House of YHWH:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ חִירוֹם אֶת־הַכִּיֹּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ חִירוֹם אֶת־הַכִּיֹּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Hiram also made the lavers, the scrapers, and the sprinkling
bowls. So Hiram finished all the work that he had been doing for
King Solomon on the House of YHWH:

translation.text: Hiram also made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram LORD:

verses.hebrew: עַמֻּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְגֻלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: עַמֻּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְגֻלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים׃

translation.text: the two pillars, the two bowls of the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars, the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָרִמֹּנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנֵי־טוּרִים רִמֹּנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הָרִמֹּנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנֵי־טוּרִים רִמֹּנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים׃

translation.text: the four hundred the pillars;

verses.english: the ten stands and the ten lavers upon the stands;
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשֶׂר וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּרֹת עֲשָׂרָה עַל־הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשֶׂר וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּרֹת עֲשָׂרָה עַל־הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

english.text: the ten stands and the ten lavers upon the stands;

translation.text: the ten stands, the ten basins on the stands;

verses.english: the one tank with the twelve oxen underneath the tank;
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר תַּחַת הַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר תַּחַת הַיָּם׃

english.text: the one tank with the twelve oxen underneath the tank;

translation.text: the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath the sea.

verses.english:
the pails, the scrapers, and the sprinkling bowls. All those
vessels in the House of YHWH that Hiram made for King Solomon were
of burnished bronze.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים (האהל) [הָאֵלֶּה] אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מְמֹרָט׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים (האהל) [הָאֵלֶּה] אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מְמֹרָט׃

english.text:
the pails, the scrapers, and the sprinkling bowls. All those
vessels in the House of YHWH that Hiram made for King Solomon were
of burnished bronze.

translation.text: The pots, the shovels, and the basins, all these vessels that Hiram bronze.

verses.english:
The king had them cast in earthen molds, in the plain of the
Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.
verses.hebrew: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צָרְתָן׃

hebrew.text: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צָרְתָן׃

english.text:
The king had them cast in earthen molds, in the plain of the
Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

translation.text: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

verses.english:
Solomon left all the vessels [unweighed] because of their very
great quantity; the weight of the bronze was not reckoned.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־הַכֵּלִים מֵרֹב מְאֹד מְאֹד לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־הַכֵּלִים מֵרֹב מְאֹד מְאֹד לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Solomon left all the vessels [unweighed] because of their very
great quantity; the weight of the bronze was not reckoned.

translation.text: Solomon left all the vessels bronze was not determined.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים זָהָב׃

translation.text: So Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of the LORD: the golden altar, the golden table for the bread of the Presence,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹאול לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹאול לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָב׃

translation.text: the in front of the inner sanctuary; the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

verses.english:
the basins, snuffers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and fire pans, of
solid gold; and the hinge sockets for the doors of the innermost
part of the House, the Holy of Holies, and for the doors of the
Great Hall of the House, of gold.
verses.hebrew:
וְהַסִּפּוֹת וְהַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים לְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל
זָהָב׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַסִּפּוֹת וְהַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים לְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל
זָהָב׃

english.text:
the basins, snuffers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and fire pans, of
solid gold; and the hinge sockets for the doors of the innermost
part of the House, the Holy of Holies, and for the doors of the
Great Hall of the House, of gold.

translation.text: the cups, snuffers, basins, dishes for incense, and firepans, temple, of gold.

verses.english:
When all the work that King Solomon had done in the House of YHWH
was completed, Solomon brought in the sacred donations of his
father David—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and deposited
them in the treasury of the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּשְׁלַם כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֵא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־קדְשֵׁי דָּוִד אָבִיו אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים נָתַן בְּאֹצְרוֹת
בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּשְׁלַם כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֵא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־קדְשֵׁי דָּוִד אָבִיו אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים נָתַן בְּאֹצְרוֹת
בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When all the work that King Solomon had done in the House of YHWH
was completed, Solomon brought in the sacred donations of his
father David—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and deposited
them in the treasury of the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Thus all the work that King Solomon did on the house of the LORD dedicated, the silver, the gold, and the vessels, and stored them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
Then Solomon convoked the elders of Israel—all the heads of the
tribes and the ancestral chieftains of the Israelites—before King
Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH
from the City of David, that is, Zion.
verses.hebrew:
אָז יַקְהֵל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת נְשִׂיאֵי הָאָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לְהַעֲלוֹת אֶת־אֲרוֹן
בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד הִיא צִיּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
אָז יַקְהֵל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת נְשִׂיאֵי הָאָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לְהַעֲלוֹת אֶת־אֲרוֹן
בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד הִיא צִיּוֹן׃

english.text:
Then Solomon convoked the elders of Israel—all the heads of the
tribes and the ancestral chieftains of the Israelites—before King
Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH
from the City of David, that is, Zion.

translation.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the ancestral houses of the Israelites, before King out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.english:
All the men of Israel gathered before King Solomon at the Feast,
in the month of Ethanim—that is, the seventh month.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיֶרַח הָאֵתָנִים בֶּחָג הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיֶרַח הָאֵתָנִים בֶּחָג הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

english.text:
All the men of Israel gathered before King Solomon at the Feast,
in the month of Ethanim—that is, the seventh month.

translation.text: All the people of Israel which is the seventh month.

verses.english: When all the elders of Israel had come, the priests lifted the Ark
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָאָרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָאָרוֹן׃

english.text: When all the elders of Israel had come, the priests lifted the Ark

translation.text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests carried the ark.

verses.english:
and carried up the Ark of YHWH. Then the priests and the Levites
brought the Tent of Meeting and all the holy vessels that were in
the Tent.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־כּל־כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־כּל־כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
and carried up the Ark of YHWH. Then the priests and the Levites
brought the Tent of Meeting and all the holy vessels that were in
the Tent.

translation.text: So they brought up the ark of the LORD, the priests and the Levites brought them up.

verses.english:
Meanwhile, King Solomon and the whole community of Israel, who
were assembled with him before the Ark, were sacrificing sheep and
oxen in such abundance that they could not be numbered or counted.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְכל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָיו אִתּוֹ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן מְזַבְּחִים צֹאן וּבָקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִסָּפְרוּ וְלֹא יִמָּנוּ מֵרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְכל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָיו אִתּוֹ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן מְזַבְּחִים צֹאן וּבָקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִסָּפְרוּ וְלֹא יִמָּנוּ מֵרֹב׃

english.text:
Meanwhile, King Solomon and the whole community of Israel, who
were assembled with him before the Ark, were sacrificing sheep and
oxen in such abundance that they could not be numbered or counted.

translation.text: King Solomon and all the be counted or numbered.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֶל־דְּבִיר הַבַּיִת אֶל־קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֶל־תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֶל־דְּבִיר הַבַּיִת אֶל־קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֶל־תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים׃

translation.text: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, in the inner sanctuary of the house, in the most holy place, underneath the wings of the cherubim.

verses.english:
for the cherubim had their wings spread out over the place of the
Ark, so that the cherubim shielded the Ark and its poles from
above.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַכְּרוּבִים פֹּרְשִׂים כְּנָפַיִם אֶל־מְקוֹם הָאָרוֹן וַיָּסֹכּוּ הַכְּרֻבִים עַל־הָאָרוֹן וְעַל־בַּדָּיו מִלְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַכְּרוּבִים פֹּרְשִׂים כְּנָפַיִם אֶל־מְקוֹם הָאָרוֹן וַיָּסֹכּוּ הַכְּרֻבִים עַל־הָאָרוֹן וְעַל־בַּדָּיו מִלְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
for the cherubim had their wings spread out over the place of the
Ark, so that the cherubim shielded the Ark and its poles from
above.

translation.text: For the cherubim made a covering above the ark and its poles.

verses.english:
The poles projected so that the ends of the poles were visible in
the sanctuary in front of the Shrine, but they could not be seen
outside; and there they remain to this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲרִכוּ הַבַּדִּים וַיֵּרָאוּ רָאשֵׁי הַבַּדִּים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַדְּבִיר וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ הַחוּצָה וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאֲרִכוּ הַבַּדִּים וַיֵּרָאוּ רָאשֵׁי הַבַּדִּים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַדְּבִיר וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ הַחוּצָה וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The poles projected so that the ends of the poles were visible in
the sanctuary in front of the Shrine, but they could not be seen
outside; and there they remain to this day.

translation.text: The poles outside; they are there to this day.

verses.english:
There was nothing inside the Ark but the two tablets of stone
which Moses placed there at Horeb, when YHWH made [a covenant]
with the Israelites after their departure from the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: אֵין בָּאָרוֹן רַק שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּחַ שָׁם מֹשֶׁה בְּחֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֵין בָּאָרוֹן רַק שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּחַ שָׁם מֹשֶׁה בְּחֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
There was nothing inside the Ark but the two tablets of stone
which Moses placed there at Horeb, when YHWH made [a covenant]
with the Israelites after their departure from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: There was nothing in the ark out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
When the priests came out of the sanctuary—for the cloud had
filled the House of YHWH
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת הַכֹּהֲנִים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת הַכֹּהֲנִים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When the priests came out of the sanctuary—for the cloud had
filled the House of YHWH

translation.text: And when the priests came out of the holy place, a cloud filled the house of the LORD,

verses.english:
and the priests were not able to remain and perform the service
because of the cloud, for the Presence of YHWH filled the House of
YHWH—
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת מִפְּנֵי הֶעָנָן כִּי־מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת מִפְּנֵי הֶעָנָן כִּי־מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and the priests were not able to remain and perform the service
because of the cloud, for the Presence of YHWH filled the House of
YHWH—

translation.text: so that the priests could filled the house of the LORD.

verses.english: then Solomon declared: “YHWH has chosen To abide in a thick cloud:
verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהֹוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכֹּן בָּעֲרָפֶל׃

hebrew.text: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהֹוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכֹּן בָּעֲרָפֶל׃

english.text: then Solomon declared: “YHWH has chosen To abide in a thick cloud:

translation.text: Then Solomon said, "The LORD has said that he would dwell in thick darkness.

verses.english:
I have now built for You A stately House, A place where You May
dwell forever.”
verses.hebrew: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי בֵּית זְבֻל לָךְ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי בֵּית זְבֻל לָךְ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִים׃

english.text:
I have now built for You A stately House, A place where You May
dwell forever.”

translation.text: I have built you an exalted house, a place for you to dwell in forever."

verses.english:
Then, with the whole congregation of Israel standing, the king
faced about and blessed the whole congregation of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסֵּב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמֵד׃

english.text:
Then, with the whole congregation of Israel standing, the king
faced about and blessed the whole congregation of Israel.

translation.text: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel stood.

verses.english:
He said: “Praised be YHWH, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled
with deeds the promise He made to my father David. For He said,

before You this day.

people Israel offer toward this place, give heed in Your heavenly

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע אֶל־מְקוֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ
