וְסָלָחְתָּ׃

english.text:
And when You hear the supplications which Your servant and Your
people Israel offer toward this place, give heed in Your heavenly
abode—give heed and pardon.

translation.text: Hear the plea of place; O hear in heaven your dwelling place; heed and forgive.

verses.english:
“Whenever one man commits an offense against another, and the
latter utters an imprecation to bring a curse upon him, and comes
with his imprecation before Your altar in this House,

hebrew.text: אֵת אֲשֶׁר יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וְנָשָׁא־בוֹ אָלָה לְהַאֲלֹתוֹ וּבָא אָלָה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּחֲךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“Whenever one man commits an offense against another, and the
latter utters an imprecation to bring a curse upon him, and comes
with his imprecation before Your altar in this House,

translation.text: "If someone sins against a neighbor and is given an oath to swear, and comes and swears before your altar in this house,

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven and take action to judge Your servants,
condemning him who is in the wrong and bringing down the
punishment of his conduct on his head, vindicating him who is in
the right by rewarding him according to his righteousness.

oh, hear in heaven and take action to judge Your servants,

the right by rewarding him according to his righteousness.

translation.text: then hear in righteous by rewarding them according to their righteousness.

verses.english:
“Should Your people Israel be routed by an enemy because they have
sinned against You, and then turn back to You and acknowledge Your
name, and they offer prayer and supplication to You in this House,
verses.hebrew: בְּהִנָּגֵף עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב אֲשֶׁר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּהִנָּגֵף עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב אֲשֶׁר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“Should Your people Israel be routed by an enemy because they have
sinned against You, and then turn back to You and acknowledge Your
name, and they offer prayer and supplication to You in this House,

translation.text: "When your people Israel, having sinned against you, are defeated plead with you in this house,

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your people Israel, and
restore them to the land that You gave to their fathers.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָם אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָם אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָם׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your people Israel, and
restore them to the land that You gave to their fathers.

translation.text: then hear in heaven, forgive the sin of their ancestors.

verses.english:
“Should the heavens be shut up and there be no rain, because they
have sinned against You, and then they pray toward this place and
acknowledge Your name and repent of their sins, when You answer
them,
verses.hebrew: בְּהֵעָצֵר שָׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָם יְשׁוּבוּן כִּי תַעֲנֵם׃

hebrew.text: בְּהֵעָצֵר שָׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָם יְשׁוּבוּן כִּי תַעֲנֵם׃

english.text:
“Should the heavens be shut up and there be no rain, because they
have sinned against You, and then they pray toward this place and
acknowledge Your name and repent of their sins, when You answer
them,

translation.text: "When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they have name, and turn from their sin, because you punish them,

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your servants, Your
people Israel, after You have shown them the proper way in which
they are to walk; and send down rain upon the land which You gave
to Your people as their heritage.
verses.hebrew:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תוֹרֵם אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ וְנָתַתָּה מָטָר עַל־אַרְצְךָ
אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לְעַמְּךָ לְנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תוֹרֵם אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ וְנָתַתָּה מָטָר עַל־אַרְצְךָ
אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לְעַמְּךָ לְנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your servants, Your
people Israel, after You have shown them the proper way in which
they are to walk; and send down rain upon the land which You gave
to Your people as their heritage.

translation.text: then hear inheritance.

verses.english:
So, too, if there is a famine in the land, if there is pestilence,
blight, mildew, locusts or caterpillars, or if an enemy oppresses
them in any of the settlements of the land. “In any plague and in
any disease,

hebrew.text: רָעָב כִּי־יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ דֶּבֶר כִּי־יִהְיֶה שִׁדָּפוֹן יֵרָקוֹן אַרְבֶּה חָסִיל כִּי יִהְיֶה כִּי יָצַר־לוֹ אֹיְבוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ שְׁעָרָיו כּל־נֶגַע כּל־מַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
So, too, if there is a famine in the land, if there is pestilence,
blight, mildew, locusts or caterpillars, or if an enemy oppresses
them in any of the settlements of the land. “In any plague and in
any disease,

translation.text: "If there is famine in the land, if there is plague, blight, mildew, locust, or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in any of their cities; whatever plague, whatever sickness there is;

verses.english:
in any prayer or supplication offered by any person among all Your
people Israel—each of whom knows his own affliction—when he
spreads his palms toward this House,
verses.hebrew: כּל־תְּפִלָּה כל־תְּחִנָּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה לְכל־הָאָדָם לְכֹל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יֵדְעוּן אִישׁ נֶגַע לְבָבוֹ וּפָרַשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־תְּפִלָּה כל־תְּחִנָּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה לְכל־הָאָדָם לְכֹל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יֵדְעוּן אִישׁ נֶגַע לְבָבוֹ וּפָרַשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
in any prayer or supplication offered by any person among all Your
people Israel—each of whom knows his own affliction—when he
spreads his palms toward this House,

translation.text: whatever prayer, stretch out their hands toward this house;

verses.english:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode, and pardon and take action!
Render to each man according to his ways as You know his heart to
be—for You alone know the hearts of all men—
verses.hebrew:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְסָלַחְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ וְנָתַתָּ לָאִישׁ כְּכל־דְּרָכָיו אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע אֶת־לְבָבוֹ כִּי־אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ אֶת־לְבַב
כּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְסָלַחְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ וְנָתַתָּ לָאִישׁ כְּכל־דְּרָכָיו אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע אֶת־לְבָבוֹ כִּי־אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ אֶת־לְבַב
כּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

oh, hear in Your heavenly abode, and pardon and take action!
Render to each man according to his ways as You know his heart to

verses.english:
so that they may revere You all the days that they live on the

english.text:
so that they may revere You all the days that they live on the
land that You gave to our fathers.

translation.text: so that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land that you gave to our ancestors.

verses.english:
“Or if a foreigner who is not of Your people Israel comes from a
distant land for the sake of Your name—
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶל־הַנּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וּבָא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶל־הַנּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וּבָא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Or if a foreigner who is not of Your people Israel comes from a
distant land for the sake of Your name—

translation.text: "Likewise when a foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, comes from a distant land because of your name

verses.english:
for they shall hear about Your great name and Your mighty hand and
Your outstretched arm—when he comes to pray toward this House,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִשְׁמְעוּן אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה וּבָא וְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִשְׁמְעוּן אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה וּבָא וְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
for they shall hear about Your great name and Your mighty hand and
Your outstretched arm—when he comes to pray toward this House,

translation.text: — for they shall hear of when a foreigner comes and prays toward this house,

verses.english:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode and grant all that the foreigner
asks You for. Thus all the peoples of the earth will know Your
name and revere You, as does Your people Israel; and they will
recognize that Your name is attached to this House that I have
built.

אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ הַנּכְרִי לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ לְיִרְאָה אֹתְךָ כְּעַמְּךָ

hebrew.text:
אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ הַנּכְרִי לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ לְיִרְאָה אֹתְךָ כְּעַמְּךָ
יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָדַעַת כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃

english.text:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode and grant all that the foreigner
asks You for. Thus all the peoples of the earth will know Your
name and revere You, as does Your people Israel; and they will
recognize that Your name is attached to this House that I have
built.

translation.text: then hear in your name has been invoked on this house that I have built.

verses.english:
“When Your people take the field against their enemy by whatever
way You send them, and they pray to YHWH in the direction of the
city which You have chosen, and of the House which I have built to
Your name,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יֵצֵא עַמְּךָ לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל־אֹיְבוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ בָּהּ וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִתִי לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־יֵצֵא עַמְּךָ לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל־אֹיְבוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ בָּהּ וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִתִי לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
“When Your people take the field against their enemy by whatever
way You send them, and they pray to YHWH in the direction of the
city which You have chosen, and of the House which I have built to
Your name,

translation.text: "If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever that you have chosen and the house that I have built for your name,

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven their prayer and supplication and uphold their
cause.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven their prayer and supplication and uphold their
cause.

translation.text: cause.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ כִּי אֵין אָדָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֶחֱטָא וְאָנַפְתָּ בָם וּנְתַתָּם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב וְשָׁבוּם שֹׁבֵיהֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאוֹיֵב רְחוֹקָה אוֹ קְרוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ כִּי אֵין אָדָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֶחֱטָא וְאָנַפְתָּ בָם וּנְתַתָּם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב וְשָׁבוּם שֹׁבֵיהֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאוֹיֵב רְחוֹקָה אוֹ קְרוֹבָה׃

translation.text: "If they sin against you — for there is no one who does not sin — are carried away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

verses.english:
and then they take it to heart in the land to which they have been
carried off, and they repent and make supplication to You in the
land of their captors, saying: ‘We have sinned, we have acted
perversely, we have acted wickedly,’
verses.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶל־לִבָּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁם וְשָׁבוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ שֹׁבֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ וְהֶעֱוִינוּ רָשָׁעְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶל־לִבָּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁם וְשָׁבוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ שֹׁבֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ וְהֶעֱוִינוּ רָשָׁעְנוּ׃

english.text:
and then they take it to heart in the land to which they have been
carried off, and they repent and make supplication to You in the
land of their captors, saying: ‘We have sinned, we have acted
perversely, we have acted wickedly,’

translation.text: wickedly';

verses.english:
and they turn back to You with all their heart and soul, in the
land of the enemies who have carried them off, and they pray to
You in the direction of their land which You gave to their
fathers, of the city which You have chosen, and of the House which
I have built to Your name—
verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכל־לְבָבָם וּבְכל־נַפְשָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁבוּ אֹתָם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֵלֶיךָ דֶּרֶךְ אַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבוֹתָם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ
וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־[בָּנִיתִי] (בנית) לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכל־לְבָבָם וּבְכל־נַפְשָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁבוּ אֹתָם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֵלֶיךָ דֶּרֶךְ אַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבוֹתָם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ
וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־[בָּנִיתִי] (בנית) לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
and they turn back to You with all their heart and soul, in the
land of the enemies who have carried them off, and they pray to
You in the direction of their land which You gave to their
fathers, of the city which You have chosen, and of the House which
I have built to Your name—

translation.text: if they repent with all their heart and soul in the land of land, which you gave to their ancestors, the city that you have chosen, and the house that I have built for your name;

verses.english:
oh, give heed in Your heavenly abode to their prayer and
supplication, uphold their cause,
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

english.text:
oh, give heed in Your heavenly abode to their prayer and
supplication, uphold their cause,

translation.text: then hear in heaven your dwelling place their prayer and their plea, maintain their cause

verses.english:
and pardon Your people who have sinned against You for all the
transgressions that they have committed against You. Grant them
mercy in the sight of their captors that they may be merciful to
them.
verses.hebrew: וְסָלַחְתָּ לְעַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ־לָךְ וּלְכל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָךְ וּנְתַתָּם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי שֹׁבֵיהֶם וְרִחֲמוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְסָלַחְתָּ לְעַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ־לָךְ וּלְכל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָךְ וּנְתַתָּם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי שֹׁבֵיהֶם וְרִחֲמוּם׃

english.text:
and pardon Your people who have sinned against You for all the
transgressions that they have committed against You. Grant them
mercy in the sight of their captors that they may be merciful to
them.

translation.text: compassion on them

verses.english:
For they are Your very own people that You freed from Egypt, from
the midst of the iron furnace.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִתּוֹךְ כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִתּוֹךְ כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל׃

english.text:
For they are Your very own people that You freed from Egypt, from
the midst of the iron furnace.

translation.text: (for they are your people and heritage, which you brought out of Egypt, from the midst of the iron-smelter).

verses.english:
May Your eyes be open to the supplication of Your servant and the
supplication of Your people Israel, and may You heed them whenever
they call upon You.
verses.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶיךָ פְתֻחֹת אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁמֹעַ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּכֹל קרְאָם אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶיךָ פְתֻחֹת אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁמֹעַ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּכֹל קרְאָם אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
May Your eyes be open to the supplication of Your servant and the
supplication of Your people Israel, and may You heed them whenever
they call upon You.

translation.text: Let people Israel, listening to them whenever they call to you.

verses.english:
For You, O Lord GOD, have set them apart for Yourself from all the
peoples of the earth as Your very own, as You promised through
Moses Your servant when You freed our fathers from Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה הִבְדַּלְתָּם לְךָ לְנַחֲלָה מִכֹּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־אַתָּה הִבְדַּלְתָּם לְךָ לְנַחֲלָה מִכֹּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

english.text:
For You, O Lord GOD, have set them apart for Yourself from all the
peoples of the earth as Your very own, as You promised through
Moses Your servant when You freed our fathers from Egypt.”

translation.text: For you you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, O Lord GOD."

verses.english:
When Solomon finished offering to YHWH all this prayer and
supplication, he rose from where he had been kneeling, in front of
the altar of YHWH, his hands spread out toward heaven.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַתְּפִלָּה וְהַתְּחִנָּה הַזֹּאת קָם מִלִּפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה מִכְּרֹעַ עַל־בִּרְכָּיו וְכַפָּיו פְּרֻשׂוֹת
הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַתְּפִלָּה וְהַתְּחִנָּה הַזֹּאת קָם מִלִּפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה מִכְּרֹעַ עַל־בִּרְכָּיו וְכַפָּיו פְּרֻשׂוֹת
הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
When Solomon finished offering to YHWH all this prayer and
supplication, he rose from where he had been kneeling, in front of
the altar of YHWH, his hands spread out toward heaven.

translation.text: Now when Solomon finished offering all this prayer and this plea to knelt with hands outstretched toward heaven;

verses.english:
He stood, and in a loud voice blessed the whole congregation of
Israel:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
He stood, and in a loud voice blessed the whole congregation of
Israel:

translation.text: he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice:

verses.english:
“Praised be YHWH who has granted a haven to His people Israel,
just as He promised; not a single word has failed of all the
gracious promises that He made through His servant Moses.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל דְּבָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל דְּבָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Praised be YHWH who has granted a haven to His people Israel,
just as He promised; not a single word has failed of all the
gracious promises that He made through His servant Moses.

translation.text: "Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel good promise, which he spoke through his servant Moses.

verses.english:
May YHWH our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He
never abandon or forsake us.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עִמָּנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל־יִטְּשֵׁנוּ׃

hebrew.text: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עִמָּנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל־יִטְּשֵׁנוּ׃

english.text:
May YHWH our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He
never abandon or forsake us.

translation.text: The LORD or abandon us,

verses.english:
May He incline our hearts to Him, that we may walk in all His ways
and keep the commandments, the laws, and the rules, which He
enjoined upon our fathers.
verses.hebrew: לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבֵנוּ אֵלָיו לָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבֵנוּ אֵלָיו לָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
May He incline our hearts to Him, that we may walk in all His ways
and keep the commandments, the laws, and the rules, which He
enjoined upon our fathers.

translation.text: but incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, he commanded our ancestors.

verses.english:
And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication
before YHWH, be close to YHWH our God day and night, that He may
provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to
each day’s needs—
verses.hebrew:
וְיִהְיוּ דְבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרֹבִים אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְיִהְיוּ דְבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרֹבִים אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication
before YHWH, be close to YHWH our God day and night, that He may
provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to
each day’s needs—

translation.text: Let these words of mine, with which I people Israel, as each day requires;

verses.english:
to the end that all the peoples of the earth may know that YHWH
alone is God, there is no other.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד׃

english.text:
to the end that all the peoples of the earth may know that YHWH
alone is God, there is no other.

translation.text: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD is God; there is no other.

verses.english:
And may you be wholehearted with YHWH our God, to walk in His ways
and keep His commandments, even as now.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְבַבְכֶם שָׁלֵם עִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקָּיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לְבַבְכֶם שָׁלֵם עִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקָּיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And may you be wholehearted with YHWH our God, to walk in His ways
and keep His commandments, even as now.”

translation.text: Therefore statutes and keeping his commandments, as at this day."

verses.english: The king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: The king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before YHWH.

translation.text: Then the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

verses.english:
Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep as sacrifices of
well-being to YHWH. Thus the king and all the Israelites dedicated
the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּזְבַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר זָבַח לַיהֹוָה בָּקָר עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף וַיַּחְנְכוּ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּזְבַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר זָבַח לַיהֹוָה בָּקָר עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף וַיַּחְנְכוּ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep as sacrifices of
well-being to YHWH. Thus the king and all the Israelites dedicated
the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Solomon offered as sacrifices of well-being to the LORD twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. LORD.

verses.english:
That day the king consecrated the center of the court that was in
front of the House of YHWH. For it was there that he presented the
burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the fat parts of the
offerings of well-being, because the bronze altar that was before
YHWH was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the meal
offerings, and the fat parts of the offerings of well-being.
verses.hebrew:
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קִדַּשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־תּוֹךְ הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי בֵית־יְהֹוָה כִּי־עָשָׂה שָׁם אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים כִּי־מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת
אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קָטֹן מֵהָכִיל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קִדַּשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־תּוֹךְ הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי בֵית־יְהֹוָה כִּי־עָשָׂה שָׁם אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים כִּי־מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת
אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קָטֹן מֵהָכִיל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
That day the king consecrated the center of the court that was in
front of the House of YHWH. For it was there that he presented the
burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the fat parts of the
offerings of well-being, because the bronze altar that was before
YHWH was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the meal
offerings, and the fat parts of the offerings of well-being.

translation.text: The same day the king consecrated the middle of the court offerings and the fat pieces of the sacrifices of well-being.

verses.english:
So Solomon and all Israel with him—a great assemblage, [coming]
from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt—observed the Feast at that
time before YHWH our God, seven days and again seven days,
fourteen days in all.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה בָעֵת־הַהִיא אֶת־הֶחָג וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ קָהָל גָּדוֹל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־נַחַל מִצְרַיִם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים
אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה בָעֵת־הַהִיא אֶת־הֶחָג וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ קָהָל גָּדוֹל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־נַחַל מִצְרַיִם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים
אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם׃

english.text:
So Solomon and all Israel with him—a great assemblage, [coming]
from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt—observed the Feast at that
time before YHWH our God, seven days and again seven days,
fourteen days in all.

translation.text: So Solomon held the festival at that time, and all Israel with him — before the LORD our God, seven days.

verses.english:
On the eighth day he let the people go. They bade the king
good-bye and went to their homes, joyful and glad of heart over
all the goodness that YHWH had shown to His servant David and His
people Israel.
verses.hebrew:
בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שִׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְאהֳלֵיהֶם שְׂמֵחִים וְטוֹבֵי לֵב עַל כּל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ
וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שִׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְאהֳלֵיהֶם שְׂמֵחִים וְטוֹבֵי לֵב עַל כּל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ
וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
On the eighth day he let the people go. They bade the king
good-bye and went to their homes, joyful and glad of heart over
all the goodness that YHWH had shown to His servant David and His
people Israel.

translation.text: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents, joyful shown to his servant David and to his people Israel.

verses.english:
When Solomon had finished building the House of YHWH and the royal
palace and everything that Solomon had set his heart on
constructing,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כּל־חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כּל־חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
When Solomon had finished building the House of YHWH and the royal
palace and everything that Solomon had set his heart on
constructing,

translation.text: When Solomon had finished building the house of the LORD and the king's house and all that Solomon desired to build,

verses.english:
YHWH appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared to him
at Gibeon.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה שֵׁנִית כַּאֲשֶׁר נִרְאָה אֵלָיו בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה שֵׁנִית כַּאֲשֶׁר נִרְאָה אֵלָיו בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
YHWH appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared to him
at Gibeon.

translation.text: the LORD Gibeon.

verses.english:
YHWH said to him, “I have heard the prayer and the supplication
which you have offered to Me. I consecrate this House which you
have built and I set My name there forever. My eyes and My heart
shall ever be there.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתְךָ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתָּה לְפָנַי הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִתָה לָשׂוּם־שְׁמִי שָׁם
עַד־עוֹלָם וְהָיוּ עֵינַי וְלִבִּי שָׁם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתְךָ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתָּה לְפָנַי הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִתָה לָשׂוּם־שְׁמִי שָׁם
עַד־עוֹלָם וְהָיוּ עֵינַי וְלִבִּי שָׁם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
YHWH said to him, “I have heard the prayer and the supplication
which you have offered to Me. I consecrate this House which you
have built and I set My name there forever. My eyes and My heart
shall ever be there.

translation.text: The LORD said to him, "I have heard your prayer and your will be there for all time.

verses.english:
As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked
before Me, wholeheartedly and with uprightness, doing all that I
have commanded you [and] keeping My laws and My rules,
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִד אָבִיךָ בְּתם־לֵבָב וּבְיֹשֶׁר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ חֻקַּי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִד אָבִיךָ בְּתם־לֵבָב וּבְיֹשֶׁר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ חֻקַּי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמֹר׃

english.text:
As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked
before Me, wholeheartedly and with uprightness, doing all that I
have commanded you [and] keeping My laws and My rules,

translation.text: As for you, if you will walk before me, as statutes and my ordinances,

verses.english:
then I will establish your throne of kingship over Israel forever,
as I promised your father David, saying, ‘Your line on the throne
of Israel shall never end.’
verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
then I will establish your throne of kingship over Israel forever,
as I promised your father David, saying, ‘Your line on the throne
of Israel shall never end.’

translation.text: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised your father David, saying, 'There shall

verses.english:
[But] if you and your descendants turn away from Me and do not
keep the commandments [and] the laws which I have set before you,
and go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.hebrew:
אִם־שׁוֹב תְּשֻׁבוּן אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם מֵאַחֲרַי וְלֹא תִשְׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם
לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־שׁוֹב תְּשֻׁבוּן אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם מֵאַחֲרַי וְלֹא תִשְׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם
לָהֶם׃

english.text:
[But] if you and your descendants turn away from Me and do not
keep the commandments [and] the laws which I have set before you,
and go and serve other gods and worship them,

translation.text: "If you turn aside from following me, you or your children, and do you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

verses.english:
then I will sweep Israel off the land which I gave them; I will
reject the House which I have consecrated to My name; and Israel
shall become a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
verses.hebrew:
וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִי אֲשַׁלַּח מֵעַל פָּנָי וְהָיָה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמָשָׁל
וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכל־הָעַמִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִי אֲשַׁלַּח מֵעַל פָּנָי וְהָיָה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמָשָׁל
וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכל־הָעַמִּים׃

english.text:
then I will sweep Israel off the land which I gave them; I will
reject the House which I have consecrated to My name; and Israel
shall become a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

translation.text: then I will cut have consecrated for my name I will cast out of my sight; and Israel will become a proverb and a taunt among all peoples.

verses.english:
And as for this House, once so exalted, everyone passing by it
shall be appalled and shall hiss. And when they ask, ‘Why did YHWH
do thus to the land and to this House?’
verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת הַזֶּה יִהְיֶה עֶלְיוֹן כּל־עֹבֵר עָלָיו יִשֹּׁם וְשָׁרָק וְאָמְרוּ עַל־מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְלַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת הַזֶּה יִהְיֶה עֶלְיוֹן כּל־עֹבֵר עָלָיו יִשֹּׁם וְשָׁרָק וְאָמְרוּ עַל־מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְלַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And as for this House, once so exalted, everyone passing by it
shall be appalled and shall hiss. And when they ask, ‘Why did YHWH
do thus to the land and to this House?’

translation.text: This house will will hiss; and they will say, 'Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this house?'

verses.english:
they shall be told, ‘It is because they forsook YHWH their God who
freed them from the land of Egypt, and they embraced other gods
and worshiped them and served them; therefore YHWH has brought all
this calamity upon them.’”
verses.hebrew:
וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּחֲזִקוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לָהֶם וַיַּעַבְדֻם
עַל־כֵּן הֵבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text:
וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּחֲזִקוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לָהֶם וַיַּעַבְדֻם
עַל־כֵּן הֵבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
they shall be told, ‘It is because they forsook YHWH their God who
freed them from the land of Egypt, and they embraced other gods
and worshiped them and served them; therefore YHWH has brought all
this calamity upon them.’”

translation.text: Then they will say, 'Because they have them; therefore the LORD has brought this disaster upon them.'"

verses.english:
At the end of the twenty years during which Solomon constructed
the two buildings, YHWH’s House and the royal palace—
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַבָּתִּים אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַבָּתִּים אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
At the end of the twenty years during which Solomon constructed
the two buildings, YHWH’s House and the royal palace—

translation.text: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD and the king's house,

verses.english:
since King Hiram of Tyre had supplied Solomon with all the cedar
and cypress timber and gold that he required—King Solomon in turn
gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of Galilee.
verses.hebrew: חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר נִשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבַזָּהָב לְכל־חֶפְצוֹ אָז יִתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים עִיר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגָּלִיל׃

hebrew.text: חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר נִשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבַזָּהָב לְכל־חֶפְצוֹ אָז יִתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים עִיר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגָּלִיל׃

english.text:
since King Hiram of Tyre had supplied Solomon with all the cedar
and cypress timber and gold that he required—King Solomon in turn
gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of Galilee.

translation.text: King Hiram of land of Galilee.

verses.english:
But when Hiram came from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon
had given him, he was not pleased with them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא חִירָם מִצֹּר לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וְלֹא יָשְׁרוּ בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא חִירָם מִצֹּר לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וְלֹא יָשְׁרוּ בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
But when Hiram came from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon
had given him, he was not pleased with them.

translation.text: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the cities that Solomon had given him, they did not please him.

verses.english:
“My brother,” he said, “what sort of towns are these you have
given me?” So they were named the land of Cabul, as is still the
case.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לִּי אָחִי וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם אֶרֶץ כָּבוּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לִּי אָחִי וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם אֶרֶץ כָּבוּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“My brother,” he said, “what sort of towns are these you have
given me?” So they were named the land of Cabul, as is still the
case.

translation.text: Therefore he brother?" So they are called the land of Cabul to this day.

verses.english:
However, Hiram sent the king one hundred and twenty talents of
gold.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

english.text:
However, Hiram sent the king one hundred and twenty talents of
gold.

translation.text: But Hiram had sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

verses.english:
This was the purpose of the forced labor which Solomon imposed: It
was to build the House of YHWH, his own palace, the Millo, and the
wall of Jerusalem, and [to fortify] Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה דְבַר־הַמַּס אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא וְאֵת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־חָצֹר וְאֶת־מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־גָּזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה דְבַר־הַמַּס אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא וְאֵת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־חָצֹר וְאֶת־מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־גָּזֶר׃

english.text:
This was the purpose of the forced labor which Solomon imposed: It
was to build the House of YHWH, his own palace, the Millo, and the
wall of Jerusalem, and [to fortify] Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

translation.text: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon Millo and the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, Gezer

verses.english:
(Pharaoh king of Egypt had come up and captured Gezer; he
destroyed it by fire, killed the Canaanites who dwelt in the town,
and gave it as dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.)
verses.hebrew: פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עָלָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־גֶּזֶר וַיִּשְׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעִיר הָרָג וַיִּתְּנָהּ שִׁלֻּחִים לְבִתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עָלָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־גֶּזֶר וַיִּשְׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעִיר הָרָג וַיִּתְּנָהּ שִׁלֻּחִים לְבִתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
(Pharaoh king of Egypt had come up and captured Gezer; he
destroyed it by fire, killed the Canaanites who dwelt in the town,
and gave it as dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.)

translation.text: (Pharaoh dowry to his daughter, Solomon's wife;

verses.english: So Solomon fortified Gezer, lower Beth-horon,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־גָּזֶר וְאֶת־בֵּית חֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־גָּזֶר וְאֶת־בֵּית חֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

english.text: So Solomon fortified Gezer, lower Beth-horon,

translation.text: so Solomon rebuilt Gezer), Lower Beth-horon,

verses.english: Baalith, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land [of Judah],
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בַּעֲלָת וְאֶת־[תַּדְמֹר] (תמר) בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בַּעֲלָת וְאֶת־[תַּדְמֹר] (תמר) בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text: Baalith, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land [of Judah],

translation.text: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness, within the land,

verses.english:
and all of Solomon’s garrison towns, chariot towns, and cavalry
towns—everything that Solomon set his heart on building in
Jerusalem and in the Lebanon, and throughout the territory that he
ruled.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֵת כּל־עָרֵי הַמִּסְכְּנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לִשְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת עָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאֵת עָרֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁק לִבְנוֹת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וּבַלְּבָנוֹן
וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵת כּל־עָרֵי הַמִּסְכְּנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לִשְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת עָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאֵת עָרֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁק לִבְנוֹת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וּבַלְּבָנוֹן
וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
and all of Solomon’s garrison towns, chariot towns, and cavalry
towns—everything that Solomon set his heart on building in
Jerusalem and in the Lebanon, and throughout the territory that he
ruled.

translation.text: as well as all of Solomon's storage cities, the cities for his build, in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

verses.english:
All the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were not of the Israelite
stock—
verses.hebrew: כּל־הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן־הָאֱמֹרִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן־הָאֱמֹרִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
All the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were not of the Israelite
stock—

translation.text: of Israel —

verses.english:
those of their descendants who remained in the land and whom the
Israelites were not able to annihilate—of these Solomon made a
slave force, as is still the case.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נֹתְרוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַחֲרִימָם וַיַּעֲלֵם שְׁלֹמֹה לְמַס־עֹבֵד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נֹתְרוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַחֲרִימָם וַיַּעֲלֵם שְׁלֹמֹה לְמַס־עֹבֵד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
those of their descendants who remained in the land and whom the
Israelites were not able to annihilate—of these Solomon made a
slave force, as is still the case.

translation.text: their descendants who were still left in the land, whom conscripted for slave labor, and so they are to this day.

verses.english:
But he did not reduce any Israelites to slavery; they served,
rather, as warriors and as his attendants, officials, and
officers, and as commanders of his chariotry and cavalry.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה עָבֶד כִּי־הֵם אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְשָׁלִישָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה עָבֶד כִּי־הֵם אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְשָׁלִישָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
But he did not reduce any Israelites to slavery; they served,
rather, as warriors and as his attendants, officials, and
officers, and as commanders of his chariotry and cavalry.

translation.text: But of the Israelites Solomon made no slaves; they were the soldiers, they were his chariotry and cavalry.

verses.english:
These were the prefects that were in charge of Solomon’s works and
were foremen over the people engaged in the work, who numbered
550.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃

english.text:
These were the prefects that were in charge of Solomon’s works and
were foremen over the people engaged in the work, who numbered
550.

translation.text: These were the chief officers who were over Solomon's work: five hundred fifty, who had charge of the people who carried on the work.

verses.english:
As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the City of David to
the palace that he had built for her, he built the Millo.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּת־פַּרְעֹה עָלְתָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה־לָהּ אָז בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בַּת־פַּרְעֹה עָלְתָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה־לָהּ אָז בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא׃

english.text:
As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the City of David to
the palace that he had built for her, he built the Millo.

translation.text: But Pharaoh's daughter went up from the city of David to her own house that Solomon had built for her; then he built the Millo.

verses.english:
Solomon used to offer burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being
three times a year on the altar that he had built for YHWH, and he
used to offer incense on the one that was before YHWH. And he kept
the House in repair.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱלָה שְׁלֹמֹה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה לַיהֹוָה וְהַקְטֵיר אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשִׁלַּם אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱלָה שְׁלֹמֹה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה לַיהֹוָה וְהַקְטֵיר אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשִׁלַּם אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
Solomon used to offer burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being
three times a year on the altar that he had built for YHWH, and he
used to offer incense on the one that was before YHWH. And he kept
the House in repair.

translation.text: Three times a year Solomon used to offer up burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being on the altar that he built for the LORD, offering incense before the LORD. So he completed the house.

verses.english:
King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is
near Eloth on the shore of the Sea of Reeds in the land of Edom.
verses.hebrew: ואֳנִי עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּעֶצְיוֹן־גֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־אֵלוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת יַם־סוּף בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: ואֳנִי עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּעֶצְיוֹן־גֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־אֵלוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת יַם־סוּף בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is
near Eloth on the shore of the Sea of Reeds in the land of Edom.

translation.text: King Solomon built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

verses.english:
Hiram sent servants of his with the fleet, mariners who were
experienced on the sea, to serve with Solomon’s men.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם בּאֳנִי אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אַנְשֵׁי אֳנִיּוֹת יֹדְעֵי הַיָּם עִם עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם בּאֳנִי אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אַנְשֵׁי אֳנִיּוֹת יֹדְעֵי הַיָּם עִם עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
Hiram sent servants of his with the fleet, mariners who were
experienced on the sea, to serve with Solomon’s men.

translation.text: Hiram sent together with the servants of Solomon.

verses.english:
They came to Ophir; there they obtained gold in the amount of four
hundred and twenty talents, which they delivered to King Solomon.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אוֹפִירָה וַיִּקְחוּ מִשָּׁם זָהָב אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אוֹפִירָה וַיִּקְחוּ מִשָּׁם זָהָב אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
They came to Ophir; there they obtained gold in the amount of four
hundred and twenty talents, which they delivered to King Solomon.

translation.text: They went to Ophir, and delivered to King Solomon.

verses.english:
The queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, through the name of
YHWH, and she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא שֹׁמַעַת אֶת־שֵׁמַע שְׁלֹמֹה לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַתָּבֹא לְנַסֹּתוֹ בְּחִידוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא שֹׁמַעַת אֶת־שֵׁמַע שְׁלֹמֹה לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַתָּבֹא לְנַסֹּתוֹ בְּחִידוֹת׃

english.text:
The queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, through the name of
YHWH, and she came to test him with hard questions.

translation.text: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon (fame due to the name of the LORD), she came to test him with hard questions.

verses.english:
She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large retinue, with camels
bearing spices, a great quantity of gold, and precious stones.
When she came to Solomon, she asked him all that she had in mind.
verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ְמָה בְּחַיִל כָּבֵד מְאֹד גְּמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִים בְּשָׂמִים וְזָהָב רַב־מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָיָה
עִם־לְבָבָהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ְמָה בְּחַיִל כָּבֵד מְאֹד גְּמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִים בְּשָׂמִים וְזָהָב רַב־מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָיָה
עִם־לְבָבָהּ׃

english.text:
She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large retinue, with camels
bearing spices, a great quantity of gold, and precious stones.
When she came to Solomon, she asked him all that she had in mind.

translation.text: Solomon, she told him all that was on her mind.

verses.english:
Solomon had answers for all her questions; there was nothing that
the king did not know, [nothing] to which he could not give her an
answer.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־דְּבָרֶיהָ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר נֶעְלָם מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הִגִּיד לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־דְּבָרֶיהָ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר נֶעְלָם מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הִגִּיד לָהּ׃

english.text:
Solomon had answers for all her questions; there was nothing that
the king did not know, [nothing] to which he could not give her an
answer.

translation.text: Solomon answered could not explain to her.

verses.english:
When the queen of Sheba observed all of Solomon’s wisdom, and the
palace he had built,
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֵת כּל־חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֵת כּל־חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה׃

english.text:
When the queen of Sheba observed all of Solomon’s wisdom, and the
palace he had built,

translation.text: When the queen of Sheba had observed all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

verses.english:
the fare of his table, the seating of his courtiers, the service
and attire of his attendants, and his wine service, and the burnt
offerings that he offered at the House of YHWH, she was left
breathless.
verses.hebrew: וּמַאֲכַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ וּמוֹשַׁב עֲבָדָיו וּמַעֲמַד מְשָׁרְתָו וּמַלְבֻּשֵׁיהֶם וּמַשְׁקָיו וְעֹלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהּ עוֹד רוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַאֲכַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ וּמוֹשַׁב עֲבָדָיו וּמַעֲמַד מְשָׁרְתָו וּמַלְבֻּשֵׁיהֶם וּמַשְׁקָיו וְעֹלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהּ עוֹד רוּחַ׃

english.text:
the fare of his table, the seating of his courtiers, the service
and attire of his attendants, and his wine service, and the burnt
offerings that he offered at the House of YHWH, she was left
breathless.

translation.text: the food of his table, the seating of his officials, and the attendance of his servants, their clothing, his valets, and his burnt offerings that he offered at the house of the LORD, there was no more spirit in her.

verses.english:
She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own land about you
and your wisdom was true.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֱמֶת הָיָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּאַרְצִי עַל־דְּבָרֶיךָ וְעַל־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֱמֶת הָיָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּאַרְצִי עַל־דְּבָרֶיךָ וְעַל־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own land about you
and your wisdom was true.

translation.text: So she said to the king, "The report was true that I heard in my own land of your accomplishments and of your wisdom,

verses.english:
But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own
eyes that not even the half had been told me; your wisdom and
wealth surpass the reports that I heard.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לַדְּבָרִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינַי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הֻגַּד־לִי הַחֵצִי הוֹסַפְתָּ חכְמָה וָטוֹב אֶל־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לַדְּבָרִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינַי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הֻגַּד־לִי הַחֵצִי הוֹסַפְתָּ חכְמָה וָטוֹב אֶל־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own
eyes that not even the half had been told me; your wisdom and
wealth surpass the reports that I heard.

translation.text: but I did not report that I had heard.

verses.english:
How fortunate are your men and how fortunate are these your
courtiers, who are always in attendance on you and can hear your
wisdom!
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ אַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ אַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
How fortunate are your men and how fortunate are these your
courtiers, who are always in attendance on you and can hear your
wisdom!

translation.text: Happy are your wives! Happy are these your servants, who continually attend you and hear your wisdom!

verses.english:
Praised be YHWH your God, who delighted in you and set you on the
throne of Israel. It is because of YHWH’s everlasting love for
Israel that He made you king to administer justice and
righteousness.”
verses.hebrew: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּךָ לְתִתְּךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם וַיְשִׂימְךָ לְמֶלֶךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה׃

hebrew.text: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּךָ לְתִתְּךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם וַיְשִׂימְךָ לְמֶלֶךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה׃

english.text:
Praised be YHWH your God, who delighted in you and set you on the
throne of Israel. It is because of YHWH’s everlasting love for
Israel that He made you king to administer justice and
righteousness.”

translation.text: Blessed you king to execute justice and righteousness."

verses.english:
She presented the king with one hundred and twenty talents of
gold, and a large quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never
again did such a vast quantity of spices arrive as that which the
queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.—
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּתֵּן לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב וּבְשָׂמִים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה לֹא בָא כַבֹּשֶׂם הַהוּא עוֹד לָרֹב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנָה מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא לַמֶּלֶךְ
שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּתֵּן לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב וּבְשָׂמִים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה לֹא בָא כַבֹּשֶׂם הַהוּא עוֹד לָרֹב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנָה מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא לַמֶּלֶךְ
שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
She presented the king with one hundred and twenty talents of
gold, and a large quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never
again did such a vast quantity of spices arrive as that which the
queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.—

translation.text: Then she gave the that which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.english:
Moreover, Hiram’s fleet, which carried gold from Ophir, brought in
from Ophir a huge quantity of almug wood and precious stones.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֳנִי חִירָם אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂא זָהָב מֵאוֹפִיר הֵבִיא מֵאֹפִיר עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֳנִי חִירָם אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂא זָהָב מֵאוֹפִיר הֵבִיא מֵאֹפִיר עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה׃

english.text:
Moreover, Hiram’s fleet, which carried gold from Ophir, brought in
from Ophir a huge quantity of almug wood and precious stones.

translation.text: Moreover, the fleet of Hiram, which carried gold from Ophir, stones.

verses.english:
The king used the almug wood for decorations in the House of YHWH
and in the royal palace, and for harps and lyres for the
musicians. Such a quantity of almug wood has never arrived or been
seen to this day.—
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָאַלְמֻגִּים מִסְעָד לְבֵית־יְהֹוָה וּלְבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִנֹּרוֹת וּנְבָלִים לַשָּׁרִים לֹא בָא־כֵן עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים וְלֹא נִרְאָה עַד הַיּוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָאַלְמֻגִּים מִסְעָד לְבֵית־יְהֹוָה וּלְבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִנֹּרוֹת וּנְבָלִים לַשָּׁרִים לֹא בָא־כֵן עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים וְלֹא נִרְאָה עַד הַיּוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The king used the almug wood for decorations in the House of YHWH
and in the royal palace, and for harps and lyres for the
musicians. Such a quantity of almug wood has never arrived or been
seen to this day.—

translation.text: From the almug wood the king made supports for the house singers; no such almug wood has come or been seen to this day.

verses.english:
King Solomon, in turn, gave the queen of Sheba everything she
wanted and asked for, in addition to what King Solomon gave her
out of his royal bounty. Then she and her attendants left and
returned to her own land.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֶת־כּל־חֶפְצָהּ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָלָה מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָהּ כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֵּפֶן וַתֵּלֶךְ לְאַרְצָהּ הִיא וַעֲבָדֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֶת־כּל־חֶפְצָהּ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָלָה מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָהּ כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֵּפֶן וַתֵּלֶךְ לְאַרְצָהּ הִיא וַעֲבָדֶיהָ׃

english.text:
King Solomon, in turn, gave the queen of Sheba everything she
wanted and asked for, in addition to what King Solomon gave her
out of his royal bounty. Then she and her attendants left and
returned to her own land.

translation.text: Meanwhile King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba every desire bounty. Then she returned to her own land, with her servants.

verses.english:
The weight of the gold which Solomon received every year was 666
talents of gold,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר־בָּא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּשָׁנָה אֶחָת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר־בָּא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּשָׁנָה אֶחָת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

english.text:
The weight of the gold which Solomon received every year was 666
talents of gold,

translation.text: The weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

verses.english:
besides what came from tradesmen, from the traffic of the
merchants, and from all the kings of Arabia and the governors of
the regions.
verses.hebrew: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וּמִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים וְכל־מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב וּפַחוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וּמִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים וְכל־מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב וּפַחוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
besides what came from tradesmen, from the traffic of the
merchants, and from all the kings of Arabia and the governors of
the regions.

translation.text: besides that which came from the of Arabia and the governors of the land.

verses.english:
King Solomon made 200 shields of beaten gold—600 shekels of gold
to each shield—
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מָאתַיִם צִנָּה זָהָב שָׁחוּט שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַצִּנָּה הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מָאתַיִם צִנָּה זָהָב שָׁחוּט שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַצִּנָּה הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
King Solomon made 200 shields of beaten gold—600 shekels of gold
to each shield—

translation.text: King Solomon made two into each large shield.

verses.english:
and 300 bucklers of beaten gold—three minas of gold to each
buckler. The king placed them in the Lebanon Forest House.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת מָגִנִּים זָהָב שָׁחוּט שְׁלֹשֶׁת מָנִים זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַמָּגֵן הָאֶחָת וַיִּתְּנֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת מָגִנִּים זָהָב שָׁחוּט שְׁלֹשֶׁת מָנִים זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַמָּגֵן הָאֶחָת וַיִּתְּנֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

english.text:
and 300 bucklers of beaten gold—three minas of gold to each
buckler. The king placed them in the Lebanon Forest House.

translation.text: He made three hundred shields of beaten in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.english:
The king also made a large throne of ivory, and he overlaid it
with refined gold.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא־שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב מוּפָז׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא־שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב מוּפָז׃

english.text:
The king also made a large throne of ivory, and he overlaid it
with refined gold.

translation.text: The king also made a great ivory throne, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

verses.english:
Six steps led up to the throne, and the throne had a back with a
rounded top, and arms on either side of the seat. Two lions stood
beside the arms,
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ מַעֲלוֹת לַכִּסֵּה וְרֹאשׁ־עָגֹל לַכִּסֵּה מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָדֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה אֶל־מְקוֹם הַשָּׁבֶת וּשְׁנַיִם אֲרָיוֹת עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַיָּדוֹת׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשׁ מַעֲלוֹת לַכִּסֵּה וְרֹאשׁ־עָגֹל לַכִּסֵּה מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָדֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה אֶל־מְקוֹם הַשָּׁבֶת וּשְׁנַיִם אֲרָיוֹת עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַיָּדוֹת׃

english.text:
Six steps led up to the throne, and the throne had a back with a
rounded top, and arms on either side of the seat. Two lions stood
beside the arms,

translation.text: The throne had six of the seat were arm rests and two lions standing beside the arm rests,

verses.english:
and twelve lions stood on the six steps, six on either side. No
such throne was ever made for any other kingdom.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲרָיִים עֹמְדִים שָׁם עַל־שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה כֵן לְכל־מַמְלָכוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲרָיִים עֹמְדִים שָׁם עַל־שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה כֵן לְכל־מַמְלָכוֹת׃

english.text:
and twelve lions stood on the six steps, six on either side. No
such throne was ever made for any other kingdom.

translation.text: while twelve lions were standing, one on each end of a step on the six steps. Nothing like it was ever made in any kingdom.

verses.english:
All King Solomon’s drinking cups were of gold, and all the
utensils of the Lebanon Forest House were of pure gold: silver did
not count for anything in Solomon’s days.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כְּלֵי מַשְׁקֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה זָהָב וְכֹל כְּלֵי בֵּית־יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן זָהָב סָגוּר אֵין כֶּסֶף לֹא נֶחְשָׁב בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִמְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל כְּלֵי מַשְׁקֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה זָהָב וְכֹל כְּלֵי בֵּית־יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן זָהָב סָגוּר אֵין כֶּסֶף לֹא נֶחְשָׁב בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִמְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
All King Solomon’s drinking cups were of gold, and all the
utensils of the Lebanon Forest House were of pure gold: silver did
not count for anything in Solomon’s days.

translation.text: All King — it was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon.

verses.english:
For the king had a Tarshish fleet on the sea, along with Hiram’s
fleet. Once every three years, the Tarshish fleet came in, bearing
gold and silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם עִם אֳנִי חִירָם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבוֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ נֹשְׂאֵת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּים וְקֹפִים וְתֻכִּיִּים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם עִם אֳנִי חִירָם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבוֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ נֹשְׂאֵת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּים וְקֹפִים וְתֻכִּיִּים׃

english.text:
For the king had a Tarshish fleet on the sea, along with Hiram’s
fleet. Once every three years, the Tarshish fleet came in, bearing
gold and silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

translation.text: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with the fleet of Hiram. bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

verses.english:
King Solomon excelled all the kings on earth in wealth and in
wisdom.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וּלְחכְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וּלְחכְמָה׃

english.text:
King Solomon excelled all the kings on earth in wealth and in
wisdom.

translation.text: Thus King Solomon excelled all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

verses.english:
All the world came to pay homage to Solomon and to listen to the
wisdom with which God had endowed him;
verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־חכְמָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־חכְמָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
All the world came to pay homage to Solomon and to listen to the
wisdom with which God had endowed him;

translation.text: The whole earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put into his mind.

verses.english:
and each one would bring his tribute—silver and gold objects,
robes, weapons and spices, horses and mules—in the amount due each
year.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה מְבִאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת וְנֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר־שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵמָּה מְבִאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת וְנֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר־שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה׃

english.text:
and each one would bring his tribute—silver and gold objects,
robes, weapons and spices, horses and mules—in the amount due each
year.

translation.text: Every one of them spices, horses, and mules, so much year by year.

verses.english:
Solomon assembled chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and
12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot towns and with
the king in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף שְׁלֹמֹה רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַיְהִי־לוֹ אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וַיַּנְחֵם בְּעָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף שְׁלֹמֹה רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַיְהִי־לוֹ אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וַיַּנְחֵם בְּעָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Solomon assembled chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and
12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot towns and with
the king in Jerusalem.

translation.text: Solomon gathered together chariots and horses; he had fourteen the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and
cedars as plentiful as sycamores in the Shephelah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹב׃

english.text:
The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and
cedars as plentiful as sycamores in the Shephelah.

translation.text: The king made numerous as the sycamores of the Shephelah.

verses.english:
Solomon’s horses were procured from Mizraim and Kue. The king’s
dealers would buy them from Kue at a fixed price.
verses.hebrew: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵה סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְחוּ מִקְוֵה בִּמְחִיר׃

hebrew.text: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵה סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְחוּ מִקְוֵה בִּמְחִיר׃

english.text:
Solomon’s horses were procured from Mizraim and Kue. The king’s
dealers would buy them from Kue at a fixed price.

translation.text: Solomon's import of from Kue at a price.

verses.english:
A chariot imported from Mizraim cost 600 shekels of silver, and a
horse 150; these in turn were exported by them to all the kings of
the Hittites and the kings of the Arameans.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֶה וַתֵּצֵא מֶרְכָּבָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְסוּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וּמֵאָה וְכֵן לְכל־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים וּלְמַלְכֵי אֲרָם בְּיָדָם יֹצִאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲלֶה וַתֵּצֵא מֶרְכָּבָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְסוּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וּמֵאָה וְכֵן לְכל־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים וּלְמַלְכֵי אֲרָם בְּיָדָם יֹצִאוּ׃

english.text:
A chariot imported from Mizraim cost 600 shekels of silver, and a
horse 150; these in turn were exported by them to all the kings of
the Hittites and the kings of the Arameans.

translation.text: A chariot could be imported from Egypt for six Hittites and the kings of Aram.

verses.english:
King Solomon loved many foreign women in addition to Pharaoh’s
daughter—Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Phoenician, and Hittite
women,
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אָהַב נָשִׁים נכְרִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וְאֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה מוֹאֲבִיּוֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת אֲדֹמִיֹּת צֵדְנִיֹּת חִתִּיֹּת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אָהַב נָשִׁים נכְרִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וְאֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה מוֹאֲבִיּוֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת אֲדֹמִיֹּת צֵדְנִיֹּת חִתִּיֹּת׃

english.text:
King Solomon loved many foreign women in addition to Pharaoh’s
daughter—Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Phoenician, and Hittite
women,

translation.text: King Solomon loved many foreign women along with the daughter women,

verses.english:
from the nations of which YHWH had said to the Israelites, “None
of you shall join them and none of them shall join you, lest they
turn your heart away to follow their gods.” Such Solomon clung to
and loved.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־תָבֹאוּ בָהֶם וְהֵם לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בָכֶם אָכֵן יַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּהֶם דָּבַק שְׁלֹמֹה לְאַהֲבָה׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־תָבֹאוּ בָהֶם וְהֵם לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בָכֶם אָכֵן יַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּהֶם דָּבַק שְׁלֹמֹה לְאַהֲבָה׃

english.text:
from the nations of which YHWH had said to the Israelites, “None
of you shall join them and none of them shall join you, lest they
turn your heart away to follow their gods.” Such Solomon clung to
and loved.

translation.text: from the nations concerning which the LORD had said to the Israelites, "You shall not enter into marriage with them, neither shall gods"; Solomon clung to these in love.

verses.english:
He had seven hundred royal wives and three hundred concubines; and
his wives turned his heart away.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ נָשִׁים שָׂרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּפִלַגְשִׁים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיַּטּוּ נָשָׁיו אֶת־לִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ נָשִׁים שָׂרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּפִלַגְשִׁים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיַּטּוּ נָשָׁיו אֶת־לִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
He had seven hundred royal wives and three hundred concubines; and
his wives turned his heart away.

translation.text: Among his wives were seven turned away his heart.

verses.english:
In his old age, his wives turned away Solomon’s heart after other
gods, and he was not as wholeheartedly devoted to YHWH his God as
his father David had been.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת זִקְנַת שְׁלֹמֹה נָשָׁיו הִטּוּ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִיד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לְעֵת זִקְנַת שְׁלֹמֹה נָשָׁיו הִטּוּ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִיד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
In his old age, his wives turned away Solomon’s heart after other
gods, and he was not as wholeheartedly devoted to YHWH his God as
his father David had been.

translation.text: For when Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not true to the LORD his God, as was the heart of his father David.

verses.english:
Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Phoenicians, and
Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אַחֲרֵי עַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִים וְאַחֲרֵי מִלְכֹּם שִׁקֻּץ עַמֹּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אַחֲרֵי עַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִים וְאַחֲרֵי מִלְכֹּם שִׁקֻּץ עַמֹּנִים׃

english.text:
Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Phoenicians, and
Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

translation.text: For Solomon followed the Ammonites.

verses.english:
Solomon did what was displeasing to YHWH and did not remain loyal
to YHWH like his father David.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Solomon did what was displeasing to YHWH and did not remain loyal
to YHWH like his father David.

translation.text: So Solomon did what was evil in the sight of the done.

verses.english:
At that time, Solomon built a shrine for Chemosh the abomination
of Moab on the hill near Jerusalem, and one for Molech the
abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.hebrew: אָז יִבְנֶה שְׁלֹמֹה בָּמָה לִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ מוֹאָב בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וּלְמֹלֶךְ שִׁקֻּץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אָז יִבְנֶה שְׁלֹמֹה בָּמָה לִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ מוֹאָב בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וּלְמֹלֶךְ שִׁקֻּץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
At that time, Solomon built a shrine for Chemosh the abomination
of Moab on the hill near Jerusalem, and one for Molech the
abomination of the Ammonites.

translation.text: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination mountain east of Jerusalem.

verses.english:
And he did the same for all his foreign wives who offered and
sacrificed to their gods.
verses.hebrew: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְכל־נָשָׁיו הַנּכְרִיּוֹת מַקְטִירוֹת וּמְזַבְּחוֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְכל־נָשָׁיו הַנּכְרִיּוֹת מַקְטִירוֹת וּמְזַבְּחוֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And he did the same for all his foreign wives who offered and
sacrificed to their gods.

translation.text: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who offered incense and sacrificed to their gods.

verses.english:
YHWH was angry with Solomon, because his heart turned away from
YHWH, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־נָטָה לְבָבוֹ מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּרְאָה אֵלָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־נָטָה לְבָבוֹ מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּרְאָה אֵלָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

english.text:
YHWH was angry with Solomon, because his heart turned away from
YHWH, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice

translation.text: Then the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned

verses.english:
and had commanded him about this matter, not to follow other gods;
he did not obey what YHWH had commanded.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה אֵלָיו עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי־לֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא שָׁמַר אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה אֵלָיו עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי־לֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא שָׁמַר אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and had commanded him about this matter, not to follow other gods;
he did not obey what YHWH had commanded.

translation.text: and had commanded him concerning this matter, that he should not follow other gods; but he did not observe what the LORD commanded.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Solomon, “Because you are guilty of this —you
have not kept My covenant and the laws which I enjoined upon you—I
will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your
servants.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה־זֹּאת עִמָּךְ וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ בְּרִיתִי וְחֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ קָרֹעַ אֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מֵעָלֶיךָ
וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה־זֹּאת עִמָּךְ וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ בְּרִיתִי וְחֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ קָרֹעַ אֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מֵעָלֶיךָ
וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Solomon, “Because you are guilty of this —you
have not kept My covenant and the laws which I enjoined upon you—I
will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your
servants.

translation.text: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, "Since this has been your mind your servant.

verses.english:
But, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it in your
lifetime; I will tear it away from your son.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּיָמֶיךָ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה לְמַעַן דָּוִד אָבִיךָ מִיַּד בִּנְךָ אֶקְרָעֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ־בְּיָמֶיךָ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה לְמַעַן דָּוִד אָבִיךָ מִיַּד בִּנְךָ אֶקְרָעֶנָּה׃

english.text:
But, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it in your
lifetime; I will tear it away from your son.

translation.text: Yet for the sake of your father David I will not do it in your lifetime; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.

verses.english:
However, I will not tear away the whole kingdom; I will give your
son one tribe, for the sake of My servant David and for the sake
of Jerusalem which I have chosen.”
verses.hebrew: רַק אֶת־כּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה לֹא אֶקְרָע שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד אֶתֵּן לִבְנֶךָ לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: רַק אֶת־כּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה לֹא אֶקְרָע שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד אֶתֵּן לִבְנֶךָ לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתִּי׃

english.text:
However, I will not tear away the whole kingdom; I will give your
son one tribe, for the sake of My servant David and for the sake
of Jerusalem which I have chosen.”

translation.text: I will not, which I have chosen."

verses.english:
So YHWH raised up an adversary against Solomon, the Edomite Hadad,
who was of the royal family of Edom.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שָׂטָן לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֵת הֲדַד הָאֲדֹמִי מִזֶּרַע הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּא בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שָׂטָן לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֵת הֲדַד הָאֲדֹמִי מִזֶּרַע הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּא בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
So YHWH raised up an adversary against Solomon, the Edomite Hadad,
who was of the royal family of Edom.

translation.text: Then the LORD raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was of the royal house in Edom.

verses.english:
When David was in Edom, Joab the army commander went up to bury
the slain, and he killed every male in Edom;
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת דָּוִד אֶת־אֱדוֹם בַּעֲלוֹת יוֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא לְקַבֵּר אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיַּךְ כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת דָּוִד אֶת־אֱדוֹם בַּעֲלוֹת יוֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא לְקַבֵּר אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיַּךְ כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
When David was in Edom, Joab the army commander went up to bury
the slain, and he killed every male in Edom;

translation.text: For when David was in he killed every male in Edom

verses.english:
for Joab and all Israel stayed there for six months until he had
killed off every male in Edom.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת חֳדָשִׁים יָשַׁב־שָׁם יוֹאָב וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־הִכְרִית כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת חֳדָשִׁים יָשַׁב־שָׁם יוֹאָב וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־הִכְרִית כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
for Joab and all Israel stayed there for six months until he had
killed off every male in Edom.

translation.text: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had eliminated every male in Edom);

verses.english:
But Hadad, together with some Edomite men, servants of his father,
escaped and headed for Egypt; Hadad was then a young boy.
