verses.english:
There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their
days.
verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their
days.

translation.text: There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their days.

verses.english:
In the third year of King Asa of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah
became king in Tirzah over all Israel—for twenty-four years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the third year of King Asa of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah
became king in Tirzah over all Israel—for twenty-four years.

translation.text: In the third year of King Asa of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel at Tirzah; he reigned twenty-four years.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he followed the ways of
Jeroboam and the sins which he caused Israel to commit.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he followed the ways of
Jeroboam and the sins which he caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: He Jeroboam and in the sin that he caused Israel to commit.

verses.english: The word of YHWH came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי עַל־בַּעְשָׁא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי עַל־בַּעְשָׁא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: The word of YHWH came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha:

translation.text: The word of the LORD came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

verses.english:
“Because I lifted you up from the dust and made you a ruler over
My people Israel, but you followed the way of Jeroboam and caused
My people Israel to sin, vexing Me with their sins—
verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִימֹתִיךָ מִן־הֶעָפָר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּחַטֹּאתָם׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִימֹתִיךָ מִן־הֶעָפָר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּחַטֹּאתָם׃

english.text:
“Because I lifted you up from the dust and made you a ruler over
My people Israel, but you followed the way of Jeroboam and caused
My people Israel to sin, vexing Me with their sins—

translation.text: "Since I exalted you out of the dust and made you leader over sins,

verses.english:
I am going to sweep away Baasha and his house. I will make your
house like the House of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מַבְעִיר אַחֲרֵי בַעְשָׁא וְאַחֲרֵי בֵיתוֹ וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי מַבְעִיר אַחֲרֵי בַעְשָׁא וְאַחֲרֵי בֵיתוֹ וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃

english.text:
I am going to sweep away Baasha and his house. I will make your
house like the House of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

translation.text: therefore, I will consume Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

verses.english:
Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the town shall be devoured
by dogs, and anyone belonging to him who dies in the open country
shall be devoured by the birds of the sky.”
verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְבַעְשָׁא בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת לוֹ בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: הַמֵּת לְבַעְשָׁא בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת לוֹ בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the town shall be devoured
by dogs, and anyone belonging to him who dies in the open country
shall be devoured by the birds of the sky.”

translation.text: Anyone anyone of his who dies in the field the birds of the air shall eat."

verses.english:
The other events of Baasha’s reign and his actions and his
exploits are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי בַעְשָׁא וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי בַעְשָׁא וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Baasha’s reign and his actions and his
exploits are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, what he did, and his power, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. His son
Elah succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּעְשָׁא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּתִרְצָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵלָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּעְשָׁא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּתִרְצָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵלָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. His son
Elah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Elah succeeded him.

verses.english:
But the word of YHWH had come through the prophet Jehu son of
Hanani against Baasha and against his house, that it would fare
like the House of Jeroboam, which he himself had struck down,
because of all the evil he did which was displeasing to YHWH,
vexing him with his deeds.
verses.hebrew:
וְגַם בְּיַד־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי הַנָּבִיא דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו
לִהְיוֹת כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם וְעַל אֲשֶׁר־הִכָּה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם בְּיַד־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי הַנָּבִיא דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו
לִהְיוֹת כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם וְעַל אֲשֶׁר־הִכָּה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
But the word of YHWH had come through the prophet Jehu son of
Hanani against Baasha and against his house, that it would fare
like the House of Jeroboam, which he himself had struck down,
because of all the evil he did which was displeasing to YHWH,
vexing him with his deeds.

translation.text: Moreover the word of the LORD came by the because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, provoking Jeroboam, and also because he destroyed it.

verses.english:
In the twenty-sixth year of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha
became king over Israel, at Tirzah—for two years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֵׁשׁ שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ אֵלָה בֶן־בַּעְשָׁא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה שְׁנָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֵׁשׁ שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ אֵלָה בֶן־בַּעְשָׁא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה שְׁנָתָיִם׃

english.text:
In the twenty-sixth year of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha
became king over Israel, at Tirzah—for two years.

translation.text: In the twenty-sixth year of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah; he reigned two years.

verses.english:
His officer Zimri, commander of half the chariotry, committed
treason against him while he was at Tirzah drinking himself drunk
in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the palace at Tirzah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו עַבְדּוֹ זִמְרִי שַׂר מַחֲצִית הָרָכֶב וְהוּא בְתִרְצָה שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בֵּית אַרְצָא אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבַּיִת בְּתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו עַבְדּוֹ זִמְרִי שַׂר מַחֲצִית הָרָכֶב וְהוּא בְתִרְצָה שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בֵּית אַרְצָא אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבַּיִת בְּתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
His officer Zimri, commander of half the chariotry, committed
treason against him while he was at Tirzah drinking himself drunk
in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the palace at Tirzah.

translation.text: But his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him. who was in charge of the palace at Tirzah,

verses.english:
Zimri entered, struck him down, and killed him; he succeeded him
as king in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא זִמְרִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא זִמְרִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Zimri entered, struck him down, and killed him; he succeeded him
as king in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah.

translation.text: Zimri came in and struck Judah, and succeeded him.

verses.english:
No sooner had he become king and ascended the throne than he
struck down all the House of Baasha; he did not leave a single
male of his, nor any kinsman or friend.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְמלְכוֹ כְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְגֹאֲלָיו וְרֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְמלְכוֹ כְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְגֹאֲלָיו וְרֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
No sooner had he become king and ascended the throne than he
struck down all the House of Baasha; he did not leave a single
male of his, nor any kinsman or friend.

translation.text: When he began to reign, as soon as he had seated himself on his throne, he killed all the house of Baasha; he did not leave him a single male of his kindred or his friends.

verses.english:
Thus Zimri destroyed all the House of Baasha, in accordance with
the word that YHWH had spoken through the prophet Jehu—
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמֵד זִמְרִי אֵת כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא בְּיַד יֵהוּא הַנָּבִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁמֵד זִמְרִי אֵת כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא בְּיַד יֵהוּא הַנָּבִיא׃

english.text:
Thus Zimri destroyed all the House of Baasha, in accordance with
the word that YHWH had spoken through the prophet Jehu—

translation.text: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house Baasha by the prophet Jehu —

verses.english:
because of the sinful acts which Baasha and his son Elah
committed, and which they caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH,
the God of Israel, with their false gods.
verses.hebrew: אֶל כּל־חַטֹּאות בַּעְשָׁא וְחַטֹּאות אֵלָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיאוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֶל כּל־חַטֹּאות בַּעְשָׁא וְחַטֹּאות אֵלָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיאוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
because of the sinful acts which Baasha and his son Elah
committed, and which they caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH,
the God of Israel, with their false gods.

translation.text: because of all the sins of Baasha and idols.

verses.english:
The other events of Elah’s reign and all his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֵלָה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֵלָה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Elah’s reign and all his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
During the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, Zimri reigned
in Tirzah for seven days. At the time, the troops were encamped at
Gibbethon of the Philistines.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זִמְרִי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּתִרְצָה וְהָעָם חֹנִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זִמְרִי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּתִרְצָה וְהָעָם חֹנִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
During the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, Zimri reigned
in Tirzah for seven days. At the time, the troops were encamped at
Gibbethon of the Philistines.

translation.text: In the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, Zimri reigned Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines,

verses.english:
When the troops who were encamped there learned that Zimri had
committed treason and had struck down the king, that very day, in
the camp, all Israel acclaimed the army commander Omri king over
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם הַחֹנִים לֵאמֹר קָשַׁר זִמְרִי וְגַם הִכָּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּמְלִכוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עמְרִי שַׂר־צָבָא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם הַחֹנִים לֵאמֹר קָשַׁר זִמְרִי וְגַם הִכָּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּמְלִכוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עמְרִי שַׂר־צָבָא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
When the troops who were encamped there learned that Zimri had
committed treason and had struck down the king, that very day, in
the camp, all Israel acclaimed the army commander Omri king over
Israel.

translation.text: and the troops who king over Israel that day in the camp.

verses.english:
Omri and all Israel then withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to
Tirzah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֶה עמְרִי וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִגִּבְּתוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־תִּרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלֶה עמְרִי וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִגִּבְּתוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־תִּרְצָה׃

english.text:
Omri and all Israel then withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to
Tirzah.

translation.text: So Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

verses.english:
When Zimri saw that the town was taken, he went into the citadel
of the royal palace and burned down the royal palace over himself.
And so he died—
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת זִמְרִי כִּי־נִלְכְּדָה הָעִיר וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַרְמוֹן בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׂרֹף עָלָיו אֶת־בֵּית־מֶלֶךְ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת זִמְרִי כִּי־נִלְכְּדָה הָעִיר וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַרְמוֹן בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׂרֹף עָלָיו אֶת־בֵּית־מֶלֶךְ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
When Zimri saw that the town was taken, he went into the citadel
of the royal palace and burned down the royal palace over himself.
And so he died—

translation.text: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the king's died —

verses.english:
because of the sins which he committed and caused Israel to
commit, doing what was displeasing to YHWH and following the ways
of Jeroboam.
verses.hebrew: עַל־חַטֹּאתָיו אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְהַחֲטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עַל־חַטֹּאתָיו אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְהַחֲטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
because of the sins which he committed and caused Israel to
commit, doing what was displeasing to YHWH and following the ways
of Jeroboam.

translation.text: because of the sins that he committed, doing evil in the sight committed, causing Israel to sin.

verses.english:
The other events of Zimri’s reign, and the treason which he
committed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זִמְרִי וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זִמְרִי וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Zimri’s reign, and the treason which he
committed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Then the people of Israel split into two factions: a part of the
people followed Tibni son of Ginath to make him king, and the
other part followed Omri.
verses.hebrew: אָז יֵחָלֵק הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחֵצִי חֲצִי הָעָם הָיָה אַחֲרֵי תִבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת לְהַמְלִיכוֹ וְהַחֲצִי אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי׃

hebrew.text: אָז יֵחָלֵק הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחֵצִי חֲצִי הָעָם הָיָה אַחֲרֵי תִבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת לְהַמְלִיכוֹ וְהַחֲצִי אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי׃

english.text:
Then the people of Israel split into two factions: a part of the
people followed Tibni son of Ginath to make him king, and the
other part followed Omri.

translation.text: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts; half of the followed Omri.

verses.english:
Those who followed Omri proved stronger than those who followed
Tibni son of Ginath; Tibni died and Omri became king.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי תִּבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת וַיָּמת תִּבְנִי וַיִּמְלֹךְ עמְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי תִּבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת וַיָּמת תִּבְנִי וַיִּמְלֹךְ עמְרִי׃

english.text:
Those who followed Omri proved stronger than those who followed
Tibni son of Ginath; Tibni died and Omri became king.

translation.text: But the people who followed Omri overcame the became king.

verses.english:
In the thirty-first year of King Asa of Judah, Omri became king
over Israel—for twelve years. He reigned in Tirzah six years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּתִרְצָה מָלַךְ שֵׁשׁ־שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּתִרְצָה מָלַךְ שֵׁשׁ־שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
In the thirty-first year of King Asa of Judah, Omri became king
over Israel—for twelve years. He reigned in Tirzah six years.

translation.text: In the thirty-first year of King Asa of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel; he reigned for twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.

verses.english:
Then he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of
silver; he built [a town] on the hill and named the town which he
built Samaria, after Shemer, the owner of the hill.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֶן אֶת־הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן מֵאֶת שֶׁמֶר בְּכִכְּרַיִם כָּסֶף וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה עַל שֶׁם־שֶׁמֶר אֲדֹנֵי הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֶן אֶת־הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן מֵאֶת שֶׁמֶר בְּכִכְּרַיִם כָּסֶף וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה עַל שֶׁם־שֶׁמֶר אֲדֹנֵי הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
Then he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of
silver; he built [a town] on the hill and named the town which he
built Samaria, after Shemer, the owner of the hill.

translation.text: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver; he fortified the hill, and called the city that he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

verses.english:
Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH; he was worse than all who
preceded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH; he was worse than all who
preceded him.

translation.text: Omri did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; he did more evil than all who were before him.

verses.english:
He followed all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and the sins
which he committed and caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH, the
God of Israel, with their futilities.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (ובחטאתיו) [וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ] אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (ובחטאתיו) [וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ] אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
He followed all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and the sins
which he committed and caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH, the
God of Israel, with their futilities.

translation.text: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and in the sins that he caused Israel to commit, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger by their idols.

verses.english:
The other events of Omri’s reign, [and] his actions, and the
exploits he performed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עמְרִי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עמְרִי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Omri’s reign, [and] his actions, and the
exploits he performed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Omri that he did, and the power that he showed, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria; and his son
Ahab succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עמְרִי עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עמְרִי עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria; and his son
Ahab succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Omri slept with his ancestors, and was buried in Samaria; his son Ahab succeeded him.

verses.english:
Ahab son of Omri became king over Israel in the thirty-eighth year
of King Asa of Judah, and Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in
Samaria for twenty-two years.
verses.hebrew:
וְאַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים
וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים
וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Ahab son of Omri became king over Israel in the thirty-eighth year
of King Asa of Judah, and Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in
Samaria for twenty-two years.

translation.text: In the thirty-eighth year of King Asa of Judah, Ahab son of Omri Samaria twenty-two years.

verses.english:
Ahab son of Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH, more than all
who preceded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Ahab son of Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH, more than all
who preceded him.

translation.text: Ahab son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD more than all who were before him.

verses.english:
Not content to follow the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he took
as wife Jezebel daughter of King Ethbaal of the Phoenicians, and
he went and served Baal and worshiped him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֲנָקֵל לֶכְתּוֹ בְּחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בַּת־אֶתְבַּעַל מֶלֶךְ צִידֹנִים וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הֲנָקֵל לֶכְתּוֹ בְּחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בַּת־אֶתְבַּעַל מֶלֶךְ צִידֹנִים וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ׃

english.text:
Not content to follow the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he took
as wife Jezebel daughter of King Ethbaal of the Phoenicians, and
he went and served Baal and worshiped him.

translation.text: And as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of him.

verses.english:
He erected an altar to Baal in the temple of Baal which he built
in Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לַבָּעַל בֵּית הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לַבָּעַל בֵּית הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
He erected an altar to Baal in the temple of Baal which he built
in Samaria.

translation.text: He erected an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.

verses.english:
Ahab also made a sacred post. Ahab did more to vex YHWH, the God
of Israel, than all the kings of Israel who preceded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיּוֹסֶף אַחְאָב לַעֲשׂוֹת לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיּוֹסֶף אַחְאָב לַעֲשׂוֹת לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Ahab also made a sacred post. Ahab did more to vex YHWH, the God
of Israel, than all the kings of Israel who preceded him.

translation.text: Ahab also made a sacred pole. Ahab did more to provoke the anger of the LORD, the God of Israel, than had all the kings of Israel who were before him.

verses.english:
During his reign, Hiel the Bethelite fortified Jericho. He laid
its foundations at the cost of Abiram his first-born, and set its
gates in place at the cost of Segub his youngest, in accordance
with the words that YHWH had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.
verses.hebrew:
בְּיָמָיו בָּנָה חִיאֵל בֵּית הָאֱלִי אֶת־יְרִיחֹה בַּאֲבִירָם בְּכֹרוֹ יִסְּדָהּ (ובשגיב) [וּבִשְׂגוּב] צְעִירוֹ הִצִּיב דְּלָתֶיהָ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

hebrew.text:
בְּיָמָיו בָּנָה חִיאֵל בֵּית הָאֱלִי אֶת־יְרִיחֹה בַּאֲבִירָם בְּכֹרוֹ יִסְּדָהּ (ובשגיב) [וּבִשְׂגוּב] צְעִירוֹ הִצִּיב דְּלָתֶיהָ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

english.text:
During his reign, Hiel the Bethelite fortified Jericho. He laid
its foundations at the cost of Abiram his first-born, and set its
gates in place at the cost of Segub his youngest, in accordance
with the words that YHWH had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.

translation.text: In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho; he laid its foundation at the cost of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke by Joshua son of Nun.

verses.english:
Elijah the Tishbite, an inhabitant of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As
YHWH lives, the God of Israel whom I serve, there will be no dew
or rain except at my bidding.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי מִתֹּשָׁבֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־אַחְאָב חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁנִים הָאֵלֶּה טַל וּמָטָר כִּי
אִם־לְפִי דְבָרִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי מִתֹּשָׁבֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־אַחְאָב חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁנִים הָאֵלֶּה טַל וּמָטָר כִּי
אִם־לְפִי דְבָרִי׃

english.text:
Elijah the Tishbite, an inhabitant of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As
YHWH lives, the God of Israel whom I serve, there will be no dew
or rain except at my bidding.”

translation.text: Now Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the LORD the God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."

verses.english: The word of YHWH came to him:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: The word of YHWH came to him:

translation.text: The word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.english:
“Leave this place; turn eastward and go into hiding by the Wadi
Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: לֵךְ מִזֶּה וּפָנִיתָ לְּךָ קֵדְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ מִזֶּה וּפָנִיתָ לְּךָ קֵדְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
“Leave this place; turn eastward and go into hiding by the Wadi
Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

translation.text: "Go from here and turn eastward, and hide yourself by the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

verses.english:
You will drink from the wadi, and I have commanded the ravens to
feed you there.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה מֵהַנַּחַל תִּשְׁתֶּה וְאֶת־הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה מֵהַנַּחַל תִּשְׁתֶּה וְאֶת־הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ שָׁם׃

english.text:
You will drink from the wadi, and I have commanded the ravens to
feed you there.”

translation.text: You shall there."

verses.english:
He proceeded to do as YHWH had bidden: he went, and he stayed by
the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
He proceeded to do as YHWH had bidden: he went, and he stayed by
the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

translation.text: So he went and did according to the word of the LORD; he went and lived by the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

verses.english:
The ravens brought him bread and meat every morning and every
evening, and he drank from the wadi.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹרְבִים מְבִאִים לוֹ לֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בַּבֹּקֶר וְלֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בָּעָרֶב וּמִן־הַנַּחַל יִשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֹרְבִים מְבִאִים לוֹ לֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בַּבֹּקֶר וְלֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בָּעָרֶב וּמִן־הַנַּחַל יִשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
The ravens brought him bread and meat every morning and every
evening, and he drank from the wadi.

translation.text: The meat in the evening; and he drank from the wadi.

verses.english:
After some time the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in
the land.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיִּיבַשׁ הַנָּחַל כִּי לֹא־הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיִּיבַשׁ הַנָּחַל כִּי לֹא־הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
After some time the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in
the land.

translation.text: But after a while the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

verses.english: And the word of YHWH came to him:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And the word of YHWH came to him:

translation.text: Then the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.english:
“Go at once to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there; I have
designated a widow there to feed you.”
verses.hebrew: קוּם לֵךְ צָרְפַתָה אֲשֶׁר לְצִידוֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם הִנֵּה צִוִּיתִי שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה לְכַלְכְּלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: קוּם לֵךְ צָרְפַתָה אֲשֶׁר לְצִידוֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם הִנֵּה צִוִּיתִי שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה לְכַלְכְּלֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Go at once to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there; I have
designated a widow there to feed you.”

translation.text: "Go now to commanded a widow there to feed you."

verses.english:
So he went at once to Zarephath. When he came to the entrance of
the town, a widow was there gathering wood. He called out to her,
“Please bring me a little water in your pitcher, and let me
drink.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ צָרְפַתָה וַיָּבֹא אֶל־פֶּתַח הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת עֵצִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר קְחִי־נָא לִי מְעַט־מַיִם בַּכְּלִי
וְאֶשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ צָרְפַתָה וַיָּבֹא אֶל־פֶּתַח הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת עֵצִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר קְחִי־נָא לִי מְעַט־מַיִם בַּכְּלִי
וְאֶשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
So he went at once to Zarephath. When he came to the entrance of
the town, a widow was there gathering wood. He called out to her,
“Please bring me a little water in your pitcher, and let me
drink.”

translation.text: So he set out and went to gathering sticks; he called to her and said, "Bring me a little water in a vessel, so that I may drink."

verses.english:
As she went to fetch it, he called out to her, “Please bring along
a piece of bread for me.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ לָקַחַת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר לִקְחִי־נָא לִי פַּת־לֶחֶם בְּיָדֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ לָקַחַת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר לִקְחִי־נָא לִי פַּת־לֶחֶם בְּיָדֵךְ׃

english.text:
As she went to fetch it, he called out to her, “Please bring along
a piece of bread for me.”

translation.text: As she was going to bring it, he called to her and said, "Bring me a morsel of bread in your hand."

verses.english:
“As YHWH your God lives,” she replied, “I have nothing baked,
nothing but a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug.
I am just gathering a couple of sticks, so that I can go home and
prepare it for me and my son; we shall eat it and then we shall
die.”
verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־לִי מָעוֹג כִּי אִם־מְלֹא כַף־קֶמַח בַּכַּד וּמְעַט־שֶׁמֶן בַּצַּפָּחַת וְהִנְנִי מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת שְׁנַיִם עֵצִים וּבָאתִי וַעֲשִׂיתִיהוּ לִי
וְלִבְנִי וַאֲכַלְנֻהוּ וָמָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text:

english.text:
“As YHWH your God lives,” she replied, “I have nothing baked,
nothing but a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug.
I am just gathering a couple of sticks, so that I can go home and
prepare it for me and my son; we shall eat it and then we shall
die.”

translation.text: But she said, "As the LORD your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jug; I am now gathering a couple of that we may eat it, and die."

“Don’t be afraid,” said Elijah to her. “Go and do as you have
said; but first make me a small cake from what you have there, and
bring it out to me; then make some for yourself and your son.

“Don’t be afraid,” said Elijah to her. “Go and do as you have

bring it out to me; then make some for yourself and your son.

translation.text: Elijah said to her, "Do not be afraid; go and do as you have said; but first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterwards make something for yourself and your son.

For thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: The jar of flour shall not

She went and did as Elijah had spoken, and she and he and her
household had food for a long time.

She went and did as Elijah had spoken, and she and he and her
household had food for a long time.

The jar of flour did not give out, nor did the jug of oil fail,

The jar of flour did not give out, nor did the jug of oil fail,

translation.text: The jar of meal was not emptied, neither did the jug of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD that he spoke by Elijah.

verses.english:
After a while, the son of the mistress of the house fell sick, and
his illness grew worse, until he had no breath left in him.

After a while, the son of the mistress of the house fell sick, and
his illness grew worse, until he had no breath left in him.

translation.text: After this the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became ill; his illness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

verses.english:
She said to Elijah, “What harm have I done you, O man of God, that
you should come here to recall my sin and cause the death of my
son?”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּאתָ אֵלַי לְהַזְכִּיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי וּלְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּאתָ אֵלַי לְהַזְכִּיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי וּלְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנִי׃

english.text:
She said to Elijah, “What harm have I done you, O man of God, that
you should come here to recall my sin and cause the death of my
son?”

translation.text: She death of my son!"

“Give me the boy,” he said to her; and taking him from her arms,
he carried him to the upper chamber where he was staying, and laid
him down on his own bed.

“Give me the boy,” he said to her; and taking him from her arms,

He cried out to YHWH and said, “O LORD my God, will You bring
calamity upon this widow whose guest I am, and let her son die?”

He cried out to YHWH and said, “O LORD my God, will You bring

Then he stretched out over the child three times, and cried out to

body!”

Then he stretched out over the child three times, and cried out to

and he revived.

Elijah picked up the child and brought him down from the upper
room into the main room, and gave him to his mother. “See,” said

God and that the word of YHWH is truly in your mouth.”

english.text:
And the woman answered Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of
God and that the word of YHWH is truly in your mouth.”

translation.text: So the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know mouth is truth."

Much later, in the third year, the word of YHWH came to Elijah:
“Go, appear before Ahab; then I will send rain upon the earth.”

וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר עַד־מָתַי אַתֶּם פֹּסְחִים עַל־שְׁתֵּי הַסְּעִפִּים אִם־יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְאִם־הַבַּעַל לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־עָנוּ
הָעָם אֹתוֹ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long will you keep
hopping between two opinions? If YHWH is God, follow Him; and if
Baal, follow him!” But the people answered him not a word.

translation.text: Elijah then came near to all the people, and said, answer him a word.

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to the people, “I am the only prophet of YHWH
left, while the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־הָעָם אֲנִי נוֹתַרְתִּי נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה לְבַדִּי וּנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־הָעָם אֲנִי נוֹתַרְתִּי נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה לְבַדִּי וּנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to the people, “I am the only prophet of YHWH
left, while the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.

translation.text: Then Elijah said to the people, "I, even I only, hundred fifty.

verses.english:
Let two young bulls be given to us. Let them choose one bull, cut
it up, and lay it on the wood, but let them not apply fire; I will
prepare the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and will not apply
fire.
verses.hebrew:
וְיִתְּנוּ־לָנוּ שְׁנַיִם פָּרִים וְיִבְחֲרוּ לָהֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וִינַתְּחֻהוּ וְיָשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא יָשִׂימוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וְנָתַתִּי
עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא אָשִׂים׃

hebrew.text:
וְיִתְּנוּ־לָנוּ שְׁנַיִם פָּרִים וְיִבְחֲרוּ לָהֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וִינַתְּחֻהוּ וְיָשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא יָשִׂימוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וְנָתַתִּי
עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא אָשִׂים׃

english.text:
Let two young bulls be given to us. Let them choose one bull, cut
it up, and lay it on the wood, but let them not apply fire; I will
prepare the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and will not apply
fire.

translation.text: Let two bulls be given to us; let them choose one bull for themselves, cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, but put no fire to it; I will prepare the other bull and lay it on the wood, but put no fire to it.

verses.english:
You will then invoke your god by name, and I will invoke YHWH by
name; and let us agree: the god who responds with fire, that one
is God.” And all the people answered, “Very good!”
verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי אֶקְרָא בְשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶה בָאֵשׁ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַן כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי אֶקְרָא בְשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶה בָאֵשׁ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַן כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר׃

english.text:
You will then invoke your god by name, and I will invoke YHWH by
name; and let us agree: the god who responds with fire, that one
is God.” And all the people answered, “Very good!”

translation.text: Then you call on the name of your god and I will call on the people answered, "Well spoken!"

verses.english:
Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull and prepare
it first, for you are the majority; invoke your god by name, but
apply no fire.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לִנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וַעֲשׂוּ רִאשֹׁנָה כִּי אַתֶּם הָרַבִּים וְקִרְאוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְאֵשׁ לֹא תָשִׂימוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לִנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וַעֲשׂוּ רִאשֹׁנָה כִּי אַתֶּם הָרַבִּים וְקִרְאוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְאֵשׁ לֹא תָשִׂימוּ׃

english.text:
Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull and prepare
it first, for you are the majority; invoke your god by name, but
apply no fire.”

translation.text: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first, for you are many; then call on the name of your god, but put no fire to it."

verses.english:
They took the bull that was given them; they prepared it, and
invoked Baal by name from morning until noon, shouting, “O Baal,
answer us!” But there was no sound, and none who responded; so
they performed a hopping dance about the altar that had been set
up.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַפָּר אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁם־הַבַּעַל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־הַצּהֳרַיִם לֵאמֹר הַבַּעַל עֲנֵנוּ וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיְפַסְּחוּ
עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַפָּר אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁם־הַבַּעַל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־הַצּהֳרַיִם לֵאמֹר הַבַּעַל עֲנֵנוּ וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיְפַסְּחוּ
עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
They took the bull that was given them; they prepared it, and
invoked Baal by name from morning until noon, shouting, “O Baal,
answer us!” But there was no sound, and none who responded; so
they performed a hopping dance about the altar that had been set
up.

translation.text: So they took the bull that was given them, prepared it, and the altar that they had made.

verses.english:
When noon came, Elijah mocked them, saying, “Shout louder! After
all, he is a god. But he may be in conversation, he may be
detained, or he may be on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep and
will wake up.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַצּהֳרַיִם וַיְהַתֵּל בָּהֶם אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל כִּי־אֱלֹהִים הוּא כִּי שִׂיחַ וְכִי־שִׂיג לוֹ וְכִי־דֶרֶךְ לוֹ אוּלַי יָשֵׁן הוּא וְיִקָץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַצּהֳרַיִם וַיְהַתֵּל בָּהֶם אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל כִּי־אֱלֹהִים הוּא כִּי שִׂיחַ וְכִי־שִׂיג לוֹ וְכִי־דֶרֶךְ לוֹ אוּלַי יָשֵׁן הוּא וְיִקָץ׃

english.text:
When noon came, Elijah mocked them, saying, “Shout louder! After
all, he is a god. But he may be in conversation, he may be
detained, or he may be on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep and
will wake up.”

translation.text: At noon Elijah mocked them, saying, be awakened."

verses.english:
So they shouted louder, and gashed themselves with knives and
spears, according to their practice, until the blood streamed over
them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַיִּתְגֹּדְדוּ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בַּחֲרָבוֹת וּבָרְמָחִים עַד־שְׁפךְ־דָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַיִּתְגֹּדְדוּ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בַּחֲרָבוֹת וּבָרְמָחִים עַד־שְׁפךְ־דָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
So they shouted louder, and gashed themselves with knives and
spears, according to their practice, until the blood streamed over
them.

translation.text: Then they cried aloud and, as was their custom, they them.

verses.english:
When noon passed, they kept raving until the hour of presenting
the meal offering. Still there was no sound, and none who
responded or heeded.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּעֲבֹר הַצּהֳרַיִם וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ עַד לַעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵין־קוֹל וְאֵין־עֹנֶה וְאֵין קָשֶׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּעֲבֹר הַצּהֳרַיִם וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ עַד לַעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵין־קוֹל וְאֵין־עֹנֶה וְאֵין קָשֶׁב׃

english.text:
When noon passed, they kept raving until the hour of presenting
the meal offering. Still there was no sound, and none who
responded or heeded.

translation.text: As midday passed, they raved on until the time of the response.

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come closer to me”; and all
the people came closer to him. He repaired the damaged altar of
YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְכל־הָעָם גְּשׁוּ אֵלַי וַיִּגְּשׁוּ כל־הָעָם אֵלָיו וַיְרַפֵּא אֶת־מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה הֶהָרוּס׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְכל־הָעָם גְּשׁוּ אֵלַי וַיִּגְּשׁוּ כל־הָעָם אֵלָיו וַיְרַפֵּא אֶת־מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה הֶהָרוּס׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come closer to me”; and all
the people came closer to him. He repaired the damaged altar of
YHWH.

translation.text: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come closer to me"; and all the people came closer to him. First he repaired the altar of the LORD that had been thrown down;

verses.english:
Then Elijah took twelve stones, corresponding to the number of the
tribes of the sons of Jacob—to whom the word of YHWH had come:
“Israel shall be your name”—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים כְּמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים כְּמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
Then Elijah took twelve stones, corresponding to the number of the
tribes of the sons of Jacob—to whom the word of YHWH had come:
“Israel shall be your name”—

translation.text: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the LORD came, saying, "Israel shall be your name";

verses.english:
and with the stones he built an altar in the name of YHWH. Around
the altar he made a trench large enough for two seahs of seed.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַשׂ תְּעָלָה כְּבֵית סָאתַיִם זֶרַע סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַשׂ תְּעָלָה כְּבֵית סָאתַיִם זֶרַע סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
and with the stones he built an altar in the name of YHWH. Around
the altar he made a trench large enough for two seahs of seed.

translation.text: with the stones he the altar, large enough to contain two measures of seed.

verses.english:
He laid out the wood, and he cut up the bull and laid it on the
wood.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיְנַתַּח אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיְנַתַּח אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

english.text:
He laid out the wood, and he cut up the bull and laid it on the
wood.

translation.text: Next he put the wood in order, cut the bull in pieces, and laid it on the wood. He said, "Fill four jars with water and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood."

verses.english:
And he said, “Fill four jars with water and pour it over the burnt
offering and the wood.” Then he said, “Do it a second time”; and
they did it a second time. “Do it a third time,” he said; and they
did it a third time.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִלְאוּ אַרְבָּעָה כַדִּים מַיִם וְיִצְקוּ עַל־הָעֹלָה וְעַל־הָעֵצִים וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁנוּ וַיִּשְׁנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלֵּשׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִלְאוּ אַרְבָּעָה כַדִּים מַיִם וְיִצְקוּ עַל־הָעֹלָה וְעַל־הָעֵצִים וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁנוּ וַיִּשְׁנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלֵּשׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Fill four jars with water and pour it over the burnt
offering and the wood.” Then he said, “Do it a second time”; and
they did it a second time. “Do it a third time,” he said; and they
did it a third time.

translation.text: Then he said, "Do it a second time"; and they did it a second time. Again he said, "Do it a third time"; and they did it a third time,

verses.english:
The water ran down around the altar, and even the trench was
filled with water.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּיִם סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְגַם אֶת־הַתְּעָלָה מִלֵּא־מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּיִם סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְגַם אֶת־הַתְּעָלָה מִלֵּא־מָיִם׃

english.text:
The water ran down around the altar, and even the trench was
filled with water.

translation.text: so that the water ran all around the altar, and filled the trench also with water.

verses.english:
When it was time to present the meal offering, the prophet Elijah
came forward and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel!
Let it be known today that You are God in Israel and that I am
Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your
bidding.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי
עַבְדֶּךָ (ובדבריך) [וּבִדְבָרְךָ] עָשִׂיתִי אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי
עַבְדֶּךָ (ובדבריך) [וּבִדְבָרְךָ] עָשִׂיתִי אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
When it was time to present the meal offering, the prophet Elijah
came forward and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel!
Let it be known today that You are God in Israel and that I am
Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your
bidding.

translation.text: At the time of the offering of the oblation, the prophet Elijah came that I have done all these things at your bidding.

verses.english:
Answer me, O LORD, answer me, that this people may know that You,
O LORD, are God; for You have turned their hearts backward.”
verses.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנִי וְיֵדְעוּ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַתָּה הֲסִבֹּתָ אֶת־לִבָּם אֲחֹרַנִּית׃

hebrew.text: עֲנֵנִי יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנִי וְיֵדְעוּ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַתָּה הֲסִבֹּתָ אֶת־לִבָּם אֲחֹרַנִּית׃

english.text:
Answer me, O LORD, answer me, that this people may know that You,
O LORD, are God; for You have turned their hearts backward.”

translation.text: Answer me, O God, and that you have turned their hearts back."

verses.english:
Then fire from YHWH descended and consumed the burnt offering, the
wood, the stones, and the earth; and it licked up the water that
was in the trench.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל אֵשׁ־יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הָעֵצִים וְאֶת־הָאֲבָנִים וְאֶת־הֶעָפָר וְאֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר־בַּתְּעָלָה לִחֵכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפֹּל אֵשׁ־יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הָעֵצִים וְאֶת־הָאֲבָנִים וְאֶת־הֶעָפָר וְאֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר־בַּתְּעָלָה לִחֵכָה׃

english.text:
Then fire from YHWH descended and consumed the burnt offering, the
wood, the stones, and the earth; and it licked up the water that
was in the trench.

translation.text: Then the fire of and the dust, and even licked up the water that was in the trench.

verses.english:
When they saw this, all the people flung themselves on their faces
and cried out: “YHWH alone is God, YHWH alone is God!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
When they saw this, all the people flung themselves on their faces
and cried out: “YHWH alone is God, YHWH alone is God!”

translation.text: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces and said, "The LORD indeed is God; the LORD indeed is God."

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal, let not a
single one of them get away.” They seized them, and Elijah took
them down to the Wadi Kishon and slaughtered them there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לָהֶם תִּפְשׂוּ אֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אִישׁ אַל־יִמָּלֵט מֵהֶם וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם וַיּוֹרִדֵם אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לָהֶם תִּפְשׂוּ אֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אִישׁ אַל־יִמָּלֵט מֵהֶם וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם וַיּוֹרִדֵם אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם שָׁם׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal, let not a
single one of them get away.” They seized them, and Elijah took
them down to the Wadi Kishon and slaughtered them there.

translation.text: Elijah said to them, "Seize them there.

verses.english:
Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is a
rumbling of [approaching] rain,”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְאַחְאָב עֲלֵה אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה כִּי־קוֹל הֲמוֹן הַגָּשֶׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְאַחְאָב עֲלֵה אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה כִּי־קוֹל הֲמוֹן הַגָּשֶׁם׃

english.text:
Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is a
rumbling of [approaching] rain,”

translation.text: Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of rushing rain."

verses.english:
and Ahab went up to eat and drink. Elijah meanwhile climbed to the
top of Mount Carmel, crouched on the ground, and put his face
between his knees.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֶה אַחְאָב לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְאֵלִיָּהוּ עָלָה אֶל־רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל וַיִּגְהַר אַרְצָה וַיָּשֶׂם פָּנָיו בֵּין בִּרְכָּו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלֶה אַחְאָב לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְאֵלִיָּהוּ עָלָה אֶל־רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל וַיִּגְהַר אַרְצָה וַיָּשֶׂם פָּנָיו בֵּין בִּרְכָּו׃

english.text:
and Ahab went up to eat and drink. Elijah meanwhile climbed to the
top of Mount Carmel, crouched on the ground, and put his face
between his knees.

translation.text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up and put his face between his knees.

verses.english:
And he said to his servant, “Go up and look toward the Sea.” He
went up and looked and reported, “There is nothing.” Seven times
[Elijah] said, “Go back,”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרוֹ עֲלֵה־נָא הַבֵּט דֶּרֶךְ־יָם וַיַּעַל וַיַּבֵּט וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר שֻׁב שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרוֹ עֲלֵה־נָא הַבֵּט דֶּרֶךְ־יָם וַיַּעַל וַיַּבֵּט וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר שֻׁב שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And he said to his servant, “Go up and look toward the Sea.” He
went up and looked and reported, “There is nothing.” Seven times
[Elijah] said, “Go back,”

translation.text: He said to his servant, "Go up nothing." Then he said, "Go again seven times."

verses.english:
and the seventh time, [the servant] reported, “A cloud as small as
a man’s hand is rising in the west.” Then [Elijah] said, “Go say
to Ahab, ‘Hitch up [your chariot] and go down before the rain
stops you.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשְּׁבִעִית וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָב קְטַנָּה כְּכַף־אִישׁ עֹלָה מִיָּם וַיֹּאמֶר עֲלֵה אֱמֹר אֶל־אַחְאָב אֱסֹר וָרֵד וְלֹא יַעֲצרְכָה הַגָּשֶׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּשְּׁבִעִית וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָב קְטַנָּה כְּכַף־אִישׁ עֹלָה מִיָּם וַיֹּאמֶר עֲלֵה אֱמֹר אֶל־אַחְאָב אֱסֹר וָרֵד וְלֹא יַעֲצרְכָה הַגָּשֶׁם׃

english.text:
and the seventh time, [the servant] reported, “A cloud as small as
a man’s hand is rising in the west.” Then [Elijah] said, “Go say
to Ahab, ‘Hitch up [your chariot] and go down before the rain
stops you.’”

translation.text: At the seventh chariot and go down before the rain stops you.'"

verses.english:
Meanwhile the sky grew black with clouds; there was wind, and a
heavy downpour fell; Ahab mounted his chariot and drove off to
Jezreel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַד־כֹּה וְעַד־כֹּה וְהַשָּׁמַיִם הִתְקַדְּרוּ עָבִים וְרוּחַ וַיְהִי גֶּשֶׁם גָּדוֹל וַיִּרְכַּב אַחְאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עַד־כֹּה וְעַד־כֹּה וְהַשָּׁמַיִם הִתְקַדְּרוּ עָבִים וְרוּחַ וַיְהִי גֶּשֶׁם גָּדוֹל וַיִּרְכַּב אַחְאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

english.text:
Meanwhile the sky grew black with clouds; there was wind, and a
heavy downpour fell; Ahab mounted his chariot and drove off to
Jezreel.

translation.text: In a little while the heavens grew black with clouds and wind; there was a heavy rain. Ahab rode off and went to Jezreel.

verses.english:
The hand of YHWH had come upon Elijah. He tied up his skirts and
ran in front of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
verses.hebrew: וְיַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְשַׁנֵּס מתְנָיו וַיָּרץ לִפְנֵי אַחְאָב עַד־בֹּאֲכָה יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְשַׁנֵּס מתְנָיו וַיָּרץ לִפְנֵי אַחְאָב עַד־בֹּאֲכָה יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

english.text:
The hand of YHWH had come upon Elijah. He tied up his skirts and
ran in front of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

translation.text: But the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; he girded up his loins and ran in front of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

verses.english:
When Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done and how he had put
all the prophets to the sword,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד אַחְאָב לְאִיזֶבֶל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֵלִיָּהוּ וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אֶת־כּל־הַנְּבִיאִים בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד אַחְאָב לְאִיזֶבֶל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֵלִיָּהוּ וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אֶת־כּל־הַנְּבִיאִים בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
When Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done and how he had put
all the prophets to the sword,

translation.text: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

verses.english:
Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “Thus and more may the
gods do if by this time tomorrow I have not made you like one of
them.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁלַח אִיזֶבֶל מַלְאָךְ אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּן כִּי־כָעֵת מָחָר אָשִׂים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ כְּנֶפֶשׁ אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁלַח אִיזֶבֶל מַלְאָךְ אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּן כִּי־כָעֵת מָחָר אָשִׂים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ כְּנֶפֶשׁ אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “Thus and more may the
gods do if by this time tomorrow I have not made you like one of
them.”

translation.text: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, your life like the life of one of them by this time tomorrow."

verses.english:
Frightened, he fled at once for his life. He came to Beer-sheba,
which is in Judah, and left his servant there;
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־נַפְשׁוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־נַפְשׁוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
Frightened, he fled at once for his life. He came to Beer-sheba,
which is in Judah, and left his servant there;

translation.text: Then he which belongs to Judah; he left his servant there.

verses.english:
he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a
broom bush and sat down under it, and prayed that he might die.
“Enough!” he cried. “Now, O LORD, take my life, for I am no better
than my fathers.”
verses.hebrew:
וְהוּא־הָלַךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת רֹתֶם (אחת) [אֶחָד] וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וַיֹּאמֶר רַב עַתָּה יְהֹוָה קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי־לֹא־טוֹב
אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי׃

hebrew.text:
וְהוּא־הָלַךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת רֹתֶם (אחת) [אֶחָד] וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וַיֹּאמֶר רַב עַתָּה יְהֹוָה קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי־לֹא־טוֹב
אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי׃

english.text:
he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a
broom bush and sat down under it, and prayed that he might die.
“Enough!” he cried. “Now, O LORD, take my life, for I am no better
than my fathers.”

translation.text: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a solitary broom tree. He asked that he might die: my ancestors."

verses.english:
He lay down and fell asleep under a broom bush. Suddenly an angel
touched him and said to him, “Arise and eat.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב וַיִּישַׁן תַּחַת רֹתֶם אֶחָד וְהִנֵּה־זֶה מַלְאָךְ נֹגֵעַ בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ קוּם אֱכוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב וַיִּישַׁן תַּחַת רֹתֶם אֶחָד וְהִנֵּה־זֶה מַלְאָךְ נֹגֵעַ בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ קוּם אֱכוֹל׃

english.text:
He lay down and fell asleep under a broom bush. Suddenly an angel
touched him and said to him, “Arise and eat.”

translation.text: Then he lay down under the broom tree and fell eat."

verses.english:
He looked about; and there, beside his head, was a cake baked on
hot stones and a jar of water! He ate and drank, and lay down
again.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּבֵּט וְהִנֵּה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו עֻגַת רְצָפִים וְצַפַּחַת מָיִם וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבֵּט וְהִנֵּה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו עֻגַת רְצָפִים וְצַפַּחַת מָיִם וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃

english.text:
He looked about; and there, beside his head, was a cake baked on
hot stones and a jar of water! He ate and drank, and lay down
again.

translation.text: He looked, and there at his head was a cake baked on hot stones, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH came a second time and touched him and said,
“Arise and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה שֵׁנִית וַיִּגַּע־בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם אֱכֹל כִּי רַב מִמְּךָ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה שֵׁנִית וַיִּגַּע־בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם אֱכֹל כִּי רַב מִמְּךָ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH came a second time and touched him and said,
“Arise and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.”

translation.text: The and eat, otherwise the journey will be too much for you."

verses.english:
He arose and ate and drank; and with the strength from that meal
he walked forty days and forty nights as far as the mountain of
God at Horeb.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיֹּאכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכֹחַ הָאֲכִילָה הַהִיא אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה עַד הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיֹּאכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכֹחַ הָאֲכִילָה הַהִיא אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה עַד הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵב׃

english.text:
He arose and ate and drank; and with the strength from that meal
he walked forty days and forty nights as far as the mountain of
God at Horeb.

translation.text: He got up, days and forty nights to Horeb the mount of God.

verses.english:
There he went into a cave, and there he spent the night. Then the
word of YHWH came to him. He said to him, “Why are you here,
Elijah?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא־שָׁם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה וַיָּלֶן שָׁם וְהִנֵּה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא־שָׁם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה וַיָּלֶן שָׁם וְהִנֵּה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
There he went into a cave, and there he spent the night. Then the
word of YHWH came to him. He said to him, “Why are you here,
Elijah?”

translation.text: At that place he came to a cave, and spent the night there. here, Elijah?"

verses.english:
He replied, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts, for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they are
out to take my life.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
He replied, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts, for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they are
out to take my life.”

translation.text: He answered, "I have been very zealous for the LORD, alone am left, and they are seeking my life, to take it away."

verses.english:
“Come out,” He called, “and stand on the mountain before YHWH.”
And lo, YHWH passed by. There was a great and mighty wind,
splitting mountains and shattering rocks by the power of YHWH; but
YHWH was not in the wind. After the wind—an earthquake; but YHWH
was not in the earthquake.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר צֵא וְעָמַדְתָּ בָהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה עֹבֵר וְרוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה וְחָזָק מְפָרֵק הָרִים וּמְשַׁבֵּר סְלָעִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא בָרוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר
הָרוּחַ רַעַשׁ לֹא בָרַעַשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר צֵא וְעָמַדְתָּ בָהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה עֹבֵר וְרוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה וְחָזָק מְפָרֵק הָרִים וּמְשַׁבֵּר סְלָעִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא בָרוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר
הָרוּחַ רַעַשׁ לֹא בָרַעַשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Come out,” He called, “and stand on the mountain before YHWH.”
And lo, YHWH passed by. There was a great and mighty wind,
splitting mountains and shattering rocks by the power of YHWH; but
YHWH was not in the wind. After the wind—an earthquake; but YHWH
was not in the earthquake.

translation.text: He said, "Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD, for the LORD is about to pass by." Now there was a great wind, so strong that it but the LORD was not in the earthquake;

verses.english:
After the earthquake—fire; but YHWH was not in the fire. And after
the fire—a soft murmuring sound.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר הָרַעַשׁ אֵשׁ לֹא בָאֵשׁ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר הָרַעַשׁ אֵשׁ לֹא בָאֵשׁ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה׃

english.text:
After the earthquake—fire; but YHWH was not in the fire. And after
the fire—a soft murmuring sound.

translation.text: and after the earthquake a sheer silence.

verses.english:
When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his mantle about his face and
went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. Then a voice
addressed him: “Why are you here, Elijah?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיָּלֶט פָּנָיו בְּאַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הַמְּעָרָה וְהִנֵּה אֵלָיו קוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיָּלֶט פָּנָיו בְּאַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הַמְּעָרָה וְהִנֵּה אֵלָיו קוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his mantle about his face and
went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. Then a voice
addressed him: “Why are you here, Elijah?”

translation.text: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle voice to him that said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

verses.english:
He answered, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts; for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and have put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they
are out to take my life.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
He answered, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts; for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and have put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they
are out to take my life.”

translation.text: He answered, "I have been very zealous for the LORD, the God of hosts; for seeking my life, to take it away."

verses.english:
YHWH said to him, “Go back by the way you came, [and] on to the
wilderness of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael as king
of Aram.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵךְ שׁוּב לְדַרְכְּךָ מִדְבַּרָה דַמָּשֶׂק וּבָאתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵךְ שׁוּב לְדַרְכְּךָ מִדְבַּרָה דַמָּשֶׂק וּבָאתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃

english.text:
YHWH said to him, “Go back by the way you came, [and] on to the
wilderness of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael as king
of Aram.

translation.text: Then the LORD said to him, "Go, you shall anoint Hazael as king over Aram.

verses.english:
Also anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king of Israel, and anoint
Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי תִּמְשַׁח לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט מֵאָבֵל מְחוֹלָה תִּמְשַׁח לְנָבִיא תַּחְתֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי תִּמְשַׁח לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט מֵאָבֵל מְחוֹלָה תִּמְשַׁח לְנָבִיא תַּחְתֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
Also anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king of Israel, and anoint
Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.

translation.text: Also you shall anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel; and you shall anoint Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah as prophet in your place.

verses.english:
Whoever escapes the sword of Hazael shall be slain by Jehu, and
whoever escapes the sword of Jehu shall be slain by Elisha.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב חֲזָאֵל יָמִית יֵהוּא וְהַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב יֵהוּא יָמִית אֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב חֲזָאֵל יָמִית יֵהוּא וְהַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב יֵהוּא יָמִית אֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
Whoever escapes the sword of Hazael shall be slain by Jehu, and
whoever escapes the sword of Jehu shall be slain by Elisha.

translation.text: Whoever from the sword of Jehu, Elisha shall kill.

verses.english:
I will leave in Israel only seven thousand—every knee that has not
knelt to Baal and every mouth that has not kissed him.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּי בְיִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כּל־הַבִּרְכַּיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כָרְעוּ לַבַּעַל וְכל־הַפֶּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשַׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּי בְיִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כּל־הַבִּרְכַּיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כָרְעוּ לַבַּעַל וְכל־הַפֶּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשַׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
I will leave in Israel only seven thousand—every knee that has not
knelt to Baal and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

translation.text: Yet I will leave seven every mouth that has not kissed him."

verses.english:
He set out from there and came upon Elisha son of Shaphat as he
was plowing. There were twelve yoke of oxen ahead of him, and he
was with the twelfth. Elijah came over to him and threw his mantle
over him.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט וְהוּא חֹרֵשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר צְמָדִים לְפָנָיו וְהוּא בִּשְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֵלָיו וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ
אַדַּרְתּוֹ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט וְהוּא חֹרֵשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר צְמָדִים לְפָנָיו וְהוּא בִּשְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֵלָיו וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ
אַדַּרְתּוֹ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
He set out from there and came upon Elisha son of Shaphat as he
was plowing. There were twelve yoke of oxen ahead of him, and he
was with the twelfth. Elijah came over to him and threw his mantle
over him.

translation.text: So he set out from there, and found Elisha son of Shaphat, who was with the twelfth. Elijah passed by him and threw his mantle over him.

verses.english:
He left the oxen and ran after Elijah, saying: “Let me kiss my
father and mother good-by, and I will follow you.” And he answered
him, “Go back. What have I done to you?”

english.text:
He left the oxen and ran after Elijah, saying: “Let me kiss my
father and mother good-by, and I will follow you.” And he answered
him, “Go back. What have I done to you?”

translation.text: He left the oxen, ran after Elijah, and said, "Let me kiss my father "Go back again; for what have I done to you?"

verses.english:
He turned back from him and took the yoke of oxen and slaughtered
them; he boiled their meat with the gear of the oxen and gave it
to the people, and they ate. Then he arose and followed Elijah and
became his attendant.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּקַּח אֶת־צֶמֶד הַבָּקָר וַיִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וּבִכְלִי הַבָּקָר בִּשְּׁלָם הַבָּשָׂר וַיִּתֵּן לָעָם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ
וַיְשָׁרְתֵהוּ׃

וַיָּשׁב מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּקַּח אֶת־צֶמֶד הַבָּקָר וַיִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וּבִכְלִי הַבָּקָר בִּשְּׁלָם הַבָּשָׂר וַיִּתֵּן לָעָם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ

translation.text: He returned from his servant.

verses.english:
King Ben-hadad of Aram gathered his whole army; thirty-two kings
accompanied him with horses and chariots. He advanced against
Samaria, laid siege to it, and attacked it.

hebrew.text: וּבֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם קָבַץ אֶת־כּל־חֵילוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ אִתּוֹ וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

King Ben-hadad of Aram gathered his whole army; thirty-two kings

Samaria, laid siege to it, and attacked it.

translation.text: King Ben-hadad of Aram gathered all his army together; thirty-two against Samaria, laid siege to it, and attacked it.

verses.english: And he sent messengers to Ahab inside the city
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעִירָה׃
