english.text: And he sent messengers to Ahab inside the city

translation.text: Then he sent messengers into the city to King Ahab of Israel, and said to him: "Thus says Ben-hadad:

verses.english:
to say to him, “Thus said Ben-hadad: Your silver and gold are
mine, and your beautiful wives and children are mine.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ לִי־הוּא וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים לִי־הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ לִי־הוּא וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים לִי־הֵם׃

english.text:
to say to him, “Thus said Ben-hadad: Your silver and gold are
mine, and your beautiful wives and children are mine.”

translation.text: Your silver and gold are mine; your fairest wives and children also are mine."

verses.english:
The king of Israel replied, “As you say, my lord king: I and all I
have are yours.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְךָ אֲנִי וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְךָ אֲנִי וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־לִי׃

english.text:
The king of Israel replied, “As you say, my lord king: I and all I
have are yours.”

translation.text: The king of Israel answered, "As you say, my lord, O king, I am yours, and all that I have."

verses.english:
Then the messengers came again and said, “Thus said Ben-hadad:
When I sent you the order to give me your silver and gold, and
your wives and children,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּה־אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד לֵאמֹר כִּי־שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ לִי תִתֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּה־אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד לֵאמֹר כִּי־שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ לִי תִתֵּן׃

english.text:
Then the messengers came again and said, “Thus said Ben-hadad:
When I sent you the order to give me your silver and gold, and
your wives and children,

translation.text: The messengers came again and said: "Thus says Ben-hadad: I sent to you, saying, 'Deliver to me your silver and gold, your wives and children';

verses.english:
I meant that tomorrow at this time I will send my servants to you
and they will search your house and the houses of your courtiers
and seize everything you prize and take it away.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־עֲבָדַי אֵלֶיךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ וְאֵת בָּתֵּי עֲבָדֶיךָ וְהָיָה כּל־מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ יָשִׂימוּ בְיָדָם וְלָקָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־עֲבָדַי אֵלֶיךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ וְאֵת בָּתֵּי עֲבָדֶיךָ וְהָיָה כּל־מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ יָשִׂימוּ בְיָדָם וְלָקָחוּ׃

english.text:
I meant that tomorrow at this time I will send my servants to you
and they will search your house and the houses of your courtiers
and seize everything you prize and take it away.”

translation.text: nevertheless I will whatever pleases them, and take it away."

verses.english:
Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land, and
he said, “See for yourselves how that man is bent on evil! For
when he demanded my wives and my children, my silver and my gold,
I did not refuse him.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכל־זִקְנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי רָעָה זֶה מְבַקֵּשׁ כִּי־שָׁלַח אֵלַי לְנָשַׁי וּלְבָנַי וּלְכַסְפִּי וְלִזְהָבִי וְלֹא
מָנַעְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכל־זִקְנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי רָעָה זֶה מְבַקֵּשׁ כִּי־שָׁלַח אֵלַי לְנָשַׁי וּלְבָנַי וּלְכַסְפִּי וְלִזְהָבִי וְלֹא
מָנַעְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land, and
he said, “See for yourselves how that man is bent on evil! For
when he demanded my wives and my children, my silver and my gold,
I did not refuse him.”

translation.text: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, him."

verses.english:
All the elders and all the people said, “Do not obey and do not
submit!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כּל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְכל־הָעָם אַל־תִּשְׁמַע וְלוֹא תֹאבֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כּל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְכל־הָעָם אַל־תִּשְׁמַע וְלוֹא תֹאבֶה׃

english.text:
All the elders and all the people said, “Do not obey and do not
submit!”

translation.text: Then all the elders and all the people said to him, "Do not listen or consent."

verses.english:
So he said to Ben-hadad’s messengers, “Tell my lord the king: All
that you first demanded of your servant I shall do, but this thing
I cannot do.” The messengers went and reported this to him.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵי בֶן־הֲדַד אִמְרוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ בָרִאשֹׁנָה אֶעֱשֶׂה וְהַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים
וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵי בֶן־הֲדַד אִמְרוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ בָרִאשֹׁנָה אֶעֱשֶׂה וְהַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים
וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
So he said to Ben-hadad’s messengers, “Tell my lord the king: All
that you first demanded of your servant I shall do, but this thing
I cannot do.” The messengers went and reported this to him.

translation.text: So he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, "Tell my lord the king: All that you first demanded of your servant I will do; again.

verses.english:
Thereupon Ben-hadad sent him this message: “May the gods do thus
to me and even more, if the dust of Samaria will provide even a
handful for each of the men who follow me!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן לִי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּ אִם־יִשְׂפֹּק עֲפַר שֹׁמְרוֹן לִשְׁעָלִים לְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן לִי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּ אִם־יִשְׂפֹּק עֲפַר שֹׁמְרוֹן לִשְׁעָלִים לְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי׃

english.text:
Thereupon Ben-hadad sent him this message: “May the gods do thus
to me and even more, if the dust of Samaria will provide even a
handful for each of the men who follow me!”

translation.text: Ben-hadad sent to him and said, "The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will provide a handful for each of the people who follow me."

verses.english:
The king of Israel replied, “Tell him: Let not him who girds on
his sword boast like him who ungirds it!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבְּרוּ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל חֹגֵר כִּמְפַתֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבְּרוּ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל חֹגֵר כִּמְפַתֵּחַ׃

english.text:
The king of Israel replied, “Tell him: Let not him who girds on
his sword boast like him who ungirds it!”

translation.text: The king of Israel answered, "Tell him: One who puts on armor should not brag like one who takes it off."

verses.english:
On hearing this reply—while he and the other kings were drinking
together at Succoth—he commanded his followers, “Advance!” And
they advanced against the city.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְהוּא שֹׁתֶה הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו שִׂימוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְהוּא שֹׁתֶה הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו שִׂימוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
On hearing this reply—while he and the other kings were drinking
together at Succoth—he commanded his followers, “Advance!” And
they advanced against the city.

translation.text: When they took their positions against the city.

verses.english:
Then a certain prophet went up to King Ahab of Israel and said,
“Thus said YHWH: Do you see that great host? I will deliver it
into your hands today, and you shall know that I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה נָבִיא אֶחָד נִגַּשׁ אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲרָאִיתָ אֵת כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה הִנְנִי נֹתְנוֹ בְיָדְךָ הַיּוֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ
כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה נָבִיא אֶחָד נִגַּשׁ אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲרָאִיתָ אֵת כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה הִנְנִי נֹתְנוֹ בְיָדְךָ הַיּוֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ
כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then a certain prophet went up to King Ahab of Israel and said,
“Thus said YHWH: Do you see that great host? I will deliver it
into your hands today, and you shall know that I am YHWH.”

translation.text: Then a certain prophet came up to King Ahab of Israel and said, "Thus says the LORD, Have you seen all this great multitude? Look, I will give it into your hand today; and you shall know that I am the LORD."

verses.english:
“Through whom?” asked Ahab. He answered, “Thus said YHWH: Through
the aides of the provincial governors.” He asked, “Who shall begin
the battle?” And he answered, “You.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב בְּמִי וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־יֶאְסֹר הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב בְּמִי וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־יֶאְסֹר הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָתָּה׃

english.text:
“Through whom?” asked Ahab. He answered, “Thus said YHWH: Through
the aides of the provincial governors.” He asked, “Who shall begin
the battle?” And he answered, “You.”

translation.text: Ahab said, "By whom?" He said, "Thus says the LORD, By the young the battle?" He answered, "You."

verses.english:
So he mustered the aides of the provincial governors, 232 strong,
and then he mustered all the troops—all the Israelites—7,000
strong.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ מָאתַיִם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם פָּקַד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ מָאתַיִם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם פָּקַד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים׃

english.text:
So he mustered the aides of the provincial governors, 232 strong,
and then he mustered all the troops—all the Israelites—7,000
strong.

translation.text: Then he mustered the young men he mustered all the people of Israel, seven thousand.

verses.english:
They marched out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself
drunk at Succoth together with the thirty-two kings allied with
him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בַּצּהֳרָיִם וּבֶן־הֲדַד שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בַּסֻּכּוֹת הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים־וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ עֹזֵר אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ בַּצּהֳרָיִם וּבֶן־הֲדַד שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בַּסֻּכּוֹת הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים־וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ עֹזֵר אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
They marched out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself
drunk at Succoth together with the thirty-two kings allied with
him.

translation.text: They went out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the booths, he and the thirty-two kings allied with him.

verses.english:
The aides of the provincial governors rushed out first. Ben-hadad
sent [scouts], who told him, “Some men have come out from
Samaria.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּשְׁלַח בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר אֲנָשִׁים יָצְאוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּשְׁלַח בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר אֲנָשִׁים יָצְאוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
The aides of the provincial governors rushed out first. Ben-hadad
sent [scouts], who told him, “Some men have come out from
Samaria.”

translation.text: The from Samaria."

verses.english:
He said, “If they have come out to surrender, take them alive; and
if they have come out for battle, take them alive anyhow.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־לְשָׁלוֹם יָצָאוּ תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וְאִם לְמִלְחָמָה יָצָאוּ חַיִּים תִּפְשׂוּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־לְשָׁלוֹם יָצָאוּ תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וְאִם לְמִלְחָמָה יָצָאוּ חַיִּים תִּפְשׂוּם׃

english.text:
He said, “If they have come out to surrender, take them alive; and
if they have come out for battle, take them alive anyhow.”

translation.text: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive."

verses.english:
But the others—the aides of the provincial governors, with the
army behind them—had already rushed out of the city,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
But the others—the aides of the provincial governors, with the
army behind them—had already rushed out of the city,

translation.text: But these had already come out of the city: the young men who served the district governors, and the army that followed them.

verses.english:
and each of them struck down his opponent. The Arameans fled, and
Israel pursued them; but King Ben-hadad of Aram escaped on a horse
with other horsemen.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אִישׁוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ אֲרָם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמָּלֵט בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עַל־סוּס וּפָרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אִישׁוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ אֲרָם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמָּלֵט בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עַל־סוּס וּפָרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
and each of them struck down his opponent. The Arameans fled, and
Israel pursued them; but King Ben-hadad of Aram escaped on a horse
with other horsemen.

translation.text: King Ben-hadad of Aram escaped on a horse with the cavalry.

verses.english:
The king of Israel came out and attacked the horses and chariots,
and inflicted a great defeat on the Arameans.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַסּוּס וְאֶת־הָרָכֶב וְהִכָּה בַאֲרָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַסּוּס וְאֶת־הָרָכֶב וְהִכָּה בַאֲרָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
The king of Israel came out and attacked the horses and chariots,
and inflicted a great defeat on the Arameans.

translation.text: The king of Israel went out, attacked the horses and chariots, and defeated the Arameans with a great slaughter.

verses.english:
Then the prophet approached the king of Israel and said to him,
“Go, keep up your efforts, and consider well what you must do; for
the king of Aram will attack you at the turn of the year.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הִתְחַזַּק וְדַע וּרְאֵה אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עֹלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הִתְחַזַּק וְדַע וּרְאֵה אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עֹלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Then the prophet approached the king of Israel and said to him,
“Go, keep up your efforts, and consider well what you must do; for
the king of Aram will attack you at the turn of the year.”

translation.text: Then the prophet approached the king of Israel and said to him, "Come, strengthen yourself, and consider well what you have to do; for in the spring the king of Aram will come up against you."

verses.english:
Now the ministers of the king of Aram said to him, “Their God is a
God of mountains; that is why they got the better of us. But if we
fight them in the plain, we will surely get the better of them.
verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אָמְרוּ אֵלָיו אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל־כֵּן חָזְקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאוּלָם נִלָּחֵם אִתָּם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אָמְרוּ אֵלָיו אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל־כֵּן חָזְקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאוּלָם נִלָּחֵם אִתָּם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
Now the ministers of the king of Aram said to him, “Their God is a
God of mountains; that is why they got the better of us. But if we
fight them in the plain, we will surely get the better of them.

translation.text: The servants of the king of Aram said to him, "Their gods are gods of the hills, and so they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

verses.english:
Do this: Remove all the kings from their posts and appoint
governors in their place.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עֲשֵׂה הָסֵר הַמְּלָכִים אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ וְשִׂים פַּחוֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עֲשֵׂה הָסֵר הַמְּלָכִים אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ וְשִׂים פַּחוֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
Do this: Remove all the kings from their posts and appoint
governors in their place.

translation.text: Also do place of them;

verses.english:
Then muster for yourself an army equal to the army you lost, horse
for horse and chariot for chariot. And let us fight them in the
plain, and we will surely get the better of them.” He took their
advice and acted accordingly.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִמְנֶה־לְךָ חַיִל כַּחַיִל הַנֹּפֵל מֵאוֹתָךְ וְסוּס כַּסּוּס וְרֶכֶב כָּרֶכֶב וְנִלָּחֲמָה אוֹתָם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תִמְנֶה־לְךָ חַיִל כַּחַיִל הַנֹּפֵל מֵאוֹתָךְ וְסוּס כַּסּוּס וְרֶכֶב כָּרֶכֶב וְנִלָּחֲמָה אוֹתָם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

english.text:
Then muster for yourself an army equal to the army you lost, horse
for horse and chariot for chariot. And let us fight them in the
plain, and we will surely get the better of them.” He took their
advice and acted accordingly.

translation.text: and muster an army like the army that you have lost, heeded their voice, and did so.

verses.english:
At the turn of the year, Ben-hadad mustered the Arameans and
advanced on Aphek to fight Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה וַיִּפְקֹד בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶת־אֲרָם וַיַּעַל אֲפֵקָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה וַיִּפְקֹד בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶת־אֲרָם וַיַּעַל אֲפֵקָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
At the turn of the year, Ben-hadad mustered the Arameans and
advanced on Aphek to fight Israel.

translation.text: In the spring Ben-hadad mustered the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

verses.english:
Now the Israelites had been mustered and provisioned, and they
went out against them; but when the Israelites encamped against
them, they looked like two flocks of goats, while the Arameans
covered the land.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל התְפָּקְדוּ וְכלְכְּלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגְדָּם כִּשְׁנֵי חֲשִׂפֵי עִזִּים וַאֲרָם מִלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל התְפָּקְדוּ וְכלְכְּלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגְדָּם כִּשְׁנֵי חֲשִׂפֵי עִזִּים וַאֲרָם מִלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Now the Israelites had been mustered and provisioned, and they
went out against them; but when the Israelites encamped against
them, they looked like two flocks of goats, while the Arameans
covered the land.

translation.text: After the Israelites had been mustered Arameans filled the country.

verses.english:
Then the man of God approached and spoke to the king of Israel,
“Thus said YHWH: Because the Arameans have said, ‘YHWH is a God of
mountains, but He is not a God of lowlands,’ I will deliver that
great host into your hands; and you shall know that I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּגַּשׁ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ אֲרָם אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־אֱלֹהֵי עֲמָקִים הוּא וְנָתַתִּי
אֶת־כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּגַּשׁ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ אֲרָם אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־אֱלֹהֵי עֲמָקִים הוּא וְנָתַתִּי
אֶת־כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then the man of God approached and spoke to the king of Israel,
“Thus said YHWH: Because the Arameans have said, ‘YHWH is a God of
mountains, but He is not a God of lowlands,’ I will deliver that
great host into your hands; and you shall know that I am YHWH.”

translation.text: A man of God approached and said to said, 'The LORD is a god of the hills but he is not a god of the valleys,' shall know that I am the LORD."

verses.english:
For seven days they were encamped opposite each other. On the
seventh day, the battle was joined and the Israelites struck down
100,000 Aramean foot soldiers in one day.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ אֵלֶּה נֹכַח־אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַתִּקְרַב הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אֲרָם מֵאָה־אֶלֶף רַגְלִי בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ אֵלֶּה נֹכַח־אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַתִּקְרַב הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אֲרָם מֵאָה־אֶלֶף רַגְלִי בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

english.text:
For seven days they were encamped opposite each other. On the
seventh day, the battle was joined and the Israelites struck down
100,000 Aramean foot soldiers in one day.

translation.text: They encamped opposite one day.

verses.english:
The survivors fled to Aphek, inside the town, and the wall fell on
the 27,000 survivors. Ben-hadad also fled and took refuge inside
the town, in an inner chamber.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּנֻסוּ הַנּוֹתָרִים אֲפֵקָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה עַל־עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף אִישׁ הַנּוֹתָרִים וּבֶן־הֲדַד נָס וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנֻסוּ הַנּוֹתָרִים אֲפֵקָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה עַל־עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף אִישׁ הַנּוֹתָרִים וּבֶן־הֲדַד נָס וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃

english.text:
The survivors fled to Aphek, inside the town, and the wall fell on
the 27,000 survivors. Ben-hadad also fled and took refuge inside
the town, in an inner chamber.

translation.text: The rest fled into the city of Aphek; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men that were left. Ben-hadad also fled, and entered the city to hide.

verses.english:
His ministers said to him, “We have heard that the kings of the
House of Israel are magnanimous kings. Let us put sackcloth on our
loins and ropes on our heads, and surrender to the king of Israel;
perhaps he will spare your life.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה־נָא שָׁמַעְנוּ כִּי מַלְכֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־מַלְכֵי חֶסֶד הֵם נָשִׂימָה נָּא שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵינוּ וַחֲבָלִים בְּרֹאשֵׁנוּ וְנֵצֵא
אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אוּלַי יְחַיֶּה אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה־נָא שָׁמַעְנוּ כִּי מַלְכֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־מַלְכֵי חֶסֶד הֵם נָשִׂימָה נָּא שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵינוּ וַחֲבָלִים בְּרֹאשֵׁנוּ וְנֵצֵא
אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אוּלַי יְחַיֶּה אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
His ministers said to him, “We have heard that the kings of the
House of Israel are magnanimous kings. Let us put sackcloth on our
loins and ropes on our heads, and surrender to the king of Israel;
perhaps he will spare your life.”

translation.text: His servants said merciful kings; let us put sackcloth around our waists and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel; perhaps he will spare your life."

verses.english:
So they girded sackcloth on their loins and wound ropes around
their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, “Your
servant Ben-hadad says, ‘I beg you, spare my life.’” He replied,
“Is he still alive? He is my brother.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּחְגְּרוּ שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵיהֶם וַחֲבָלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדְּךָ בֶן־הֲדַד אָמַר תְּחִי־נָא נַפְשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי
אָחִי הוּא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּחְגְּרוּ שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵיהֶם וַחֲבָלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדְּךָ בֶן־הֲדַד אָמַר תְּחִי־נָא נַפְשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי
אָחִי הוּא׃

english.text:
So they girded sackcloth on their loins and wound ropes around
their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, “Your
servant Ben-hadad says, ‘I beg you, spare my life.’” He replied,
“Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

translation.text: So they tied sackcloth around their waists, put ropes on their heads, 'Please let me live.'" And he said, "Is he still alive? He is my brother."

verses.english:
The men divined his meaning and quickly caught the word from him,
saying, “Yes, Ben-hadad is your brother.” “Go, bring him,” he
said. Ben-hadad came out to him, and he invited him into his
chariot.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יְנַחֲשׁוּ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּחְלְטוּ הֲמִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָחִיךָ בֶן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאוּ קָחֻהוּ וַיֵּצֵא אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עַל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יְנַחֲשׁוּ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּחְלְטוּ הֲמִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָחִיךָ בֶן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאוּ קָחֻהוּ וַיֵּצֵא אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עַל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

english.text:
The men divined his meaning and quickly caught the word from him,
saying, “Yes, Ben-hadad is your brother.” “Go, bring him,” he
said. Ben-hadad came out to him, and he invited him into his
chariot.

translation.text: into the chariot.

verses.english:
Ben-hadad said to him, “I will give back the towns that my father
took from your father, and you may set up bazaars for yourself in
Damascus as my father did in Samaria.” “And I, for my part,” [said
Ahab,] “will let you go home under these terms.” So he made a
treaty with him and dismissed him.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־לָקַח־אָבִי מֵאֵת אָבִיךָ אָשִׁיב וְחֻצוֹת תָּשִׂים לְךָ בְדַמֶּשֶׂק כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂם אָבִי בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַאֲנִי בַּבְּרִית אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ
וַיִּכְרת־לוֹ בְרִית וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־לָקַח־אָבִי מֵאֵת אָבִיךָ אָשִׁיב וְחֻצוֹת תָּשִׂים לְךָ בְדַמֶּשֶׂק כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂם אָבִי בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַאֲנִי בַּבְּרִית אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ
וַיִּכְרת־לוֹ בְרִית וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃

english.text:
Ben-hadad said to him, “I will give back the towns that my father
took from your father, and you may set up bazaars for yourself in
Damascus as my father did in Samaria.” “And I, for my part,” [said
Ahab,] “will let you go home under these terms.” So he made a
treaty with him and dismissed him.

translation.text: Ben-hadad said to him, "I will restore the towns treaty with him and let him go.

verses.english:
A certain man, a disciple of the prophets, said to another, at the
word of YHWH, “Strike me”; but the man refused to strike him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֶחָד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים אָמַר אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיְמָאֵן הָאִישׁ לְהַכֹּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֶחָד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים אָמַר אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיְמָאֵן הָאִישׁ לְהַכֹּתוֹ׃

english.text:
A certain man, a disciple of the prophets, said to another, at the
word of YHWH, “Strike me”; but the man refused to strike him.

translation.text: At the command of the LORD a certain member of a company of him.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Because you have not obeyed YHWH, a lion will
strike you dead as soon as you leave me.” And when he left, a lion
came upon him and killed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנְּךָ הוֹלֵךְ מֵאִתִּי וְהִכְּךָ הָאַרְיֵה וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאֶצְלוֹ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ הָאַרְיֵה וַיַּכֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנְּךָ הוֹלֵךְ מֵאִתִּי וְהִכְּךָ הָאַרְיֵה וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאֶצְלוֹ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ הָאַרְיֵה וַיַּכֵּהוּ׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Because you have not obeyed YHWH, a lion will
strike you dead as soon as you leave me.” And when he left, a lion
came upon him and killed him.

translation.text: Then he said to him, "Because you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, as soon as you have left me, a lion will kill you." And when he had left him, a lion met him and killed him.

verses.english:
Then he met another man and said, “Come, strike me.” So the man
struck him and wounded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא אִישׁ אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיַּכֵּהוּ הָאִישׁ הַכֵּה וּפָצֹעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא אִישׁ אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיַּכֵּהוּ הָאִישׁ הַכֵּה וּפָצֹעַ׃

english.text:
Then he met another man and said, “Come, strike me.” So the man
struck him and wounded him.

translation.text: Then he found wounding him.

verses.english:
Then the prophet, disguised by a cloth over his eyes, went and
waited for the king by the road.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנָּבִיא וַיַּעֲמֹד לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בָּאֲפֵר עַל־עֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנָּבִיא וַיַּעֲמֹד לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בָּאֲפֵר עַל־עֵינָיו׃

english.text:
Then the prophet, disguised by a cloth over his eyes, went and
waited for the king by the road.

translation.text: Then the prophet departed, and waited for the king along the road, disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes.

verses.english:
As the king passed by, he cried out to the king and said, “Your
servant went out into the thick of the battle. Suddenly a man came
over and brought a man to me, saying, ‘Guard this man! If he is
missing, it will be your life for his, or you will have to pay a
talent of silver.’
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר וְהוּא צָעַק אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ יָצָא בְקֶרֶב־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ סָר וַיָּבֵא אֵלַי אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמֹר אֶת־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה
אִם־הִפָּקֵד יִפָּקֵד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ אוֹ כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף תִּשְׁקוֹל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר וְהוּא צָעַק אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ יָצָא בְקֶרֶב־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ סָר וַיָּבֵא אֵלַי אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמֹר אֶת־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה
אִם־הִפָּקֵד יִפָּקֵד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ אוֹ כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף תִּשְׁקוֹל׃

english.text:
As the king passed by, he cried out to the king and said, “Your
servant went out into the thick of the battle. Suddenly a man came
over and brought a man to me, saying, ‘Guard this man! If he is
missing, it will be your life for his, or you will have to pay a
talent of silver.’

translation.text: As man to me, and said, 'Guard this man; if he is missing, your life shall be given for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.'

verses.english:
While your servant was busy here and there, [the man] got away.”
The king of Israel responded, “You have your verdict; you
pronounced it yourself.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַבְדְּךָ עֹשֵׂה הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהוּא אֵינֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ אַתָּה חָרָצְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עַבְדְּךָ עֹשֵׂה הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהוּא אֵינֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ אַתָּה חָרָצְתָּ׃

english.text:
While your servant was busy here and there, [the man] got away.”
The king of Israel responded, “You have your verdict; you
pronounced it yourself.”

translation.text: While your to him, "So shall your judgment be; you yourself have decided it."

verses.english:
Quickly he removed the cloth from his eyes, and the king
recognized him as one of the prophets.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר וַיָּסַר אֶת־הָאֲפֵר (מעל) [מֵעֲלֵי] עֵינָיו וַיַּכֵּר אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵהַנְּבִיאִים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר וַיָּסַר אֶת־הָאֲפֵר (מעל) [מֵעֲלֵי] עֵינָיו וַיַּכֵּר אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵהַנְּבִיאִים הוּא׃

english.text:
Quickly he removed the cloth from his eyes, and the king
recognized him as one of the prophets.

translation.text: Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Because you have set free the man
whom I doomed, your life shall be forfeit for his life and your
people for his people.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן שִׁלַּחְתָּ אֶת־אִישׁ־חֶרְמִי מִיָּד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְעַמְּךָ תַּחַת עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן שִׁלַּחְתָּ אֶת־אִישׁ־חֶרְמִי מִיָּד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְעַמְּךָ תַּחַת עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Because you have set free the man
whom I doomed, your life shall be forfeit for his life and your
people for his people.”

translation.text: Then he said to him, devoted to destruction, therefore your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people.'"

verses.english:
Dispirited and sullen, the king of Israel left for home and came
to Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

english.text:
Dispirited and sullen, the king of Israel left for home and came
to Samaria.

translation.text: The king of Israel set out toward home, resentful and sullen, and came to Samaria.

verses.english:
[The following events] occurred sometime afterward: Naboth the
Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel, adjoining the palace of
King Ahab of Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כֶּרֶם הָיָה לְנָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל אֵצֶל הֵיכַל אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כֶּרֶם הָיָה לְנָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל אֵצֶל הֵיכַל אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
[The following events] occurred sometime afterward: Naboth the
Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel, adjoining the palace of
King Ahab of Samaria.

translation.text: Later the following events took place: Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard in Jezreel, beside the palace of King Ahab of Samaria.

verses.english:
Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard, so that I may have it
as a vegetable garden, since it is right next to my palace. I will
give you a better vineyard in exchange; or, if you prefer, I will
pay you the price in money.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְדַבֵּר אַחְאָב אֶל־נָבוֹת לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ וִיהִי־לִי לְגַן־יָרָק כִּי הוּא קָרוֹב אֵצֶל בֵּיתִי וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ תַּחְתָּיו כֶּרֶם טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ אִם טוֹב
בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶסֶף מְחִיר זֶה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְדַבֵּר אַחְאָב אֶל־נָבוֹת לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ וִיהִי־לִי לְגַן־יָרָק כִּי הוּא קָרוֹב אֵצֶל בֵּיתִי וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ תַּחְתָּיו כֶּרֶם טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ אִם טוֹב
בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶסֶף מְחִיר זֶה׃

english.text:
Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard, so that I may have it
as a vegetable garden, since it is right next to my palace. I will
give you a better vineyard in exchange; or, if you prefer, I will
pay you the price in money.”

translation.text: And a vegetable garden, because it is near my house; I will give you a better vineyard for it; or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its value in money."

verses.english:
But Naboth replied, “YHWH forbid that I should give up to you what
I have inherited from my fathers!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָבוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִתִּתִּי אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתַי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָבוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִתִּתִּי אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתַי לָךְ׃

english.text:
But Naboth replied, “YHWH forbid that I should give up to you what
I have inherited from my fathers!”

translation.text: But Naboth said to Ahab, "The LORD forbid that I should give you my ancestral inheritance."

verses.english:
Ahab went home dispirited and sullen because of the answer that
Naboth the Jezreelite had given him: “I will not give up to you
what I have inherited from my fathers!” He lay down on his bed and
turned away his face, and he would not eat.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא אַחְאָב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף עַל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבוֹתָי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ
וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו וְלֹא־אָכַל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא אַחְאָב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף עַל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבוֹתָי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ
וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו וְלֹא־אָכַל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
Ahab went home dispirited and sullen because of the answer that
Naboth the Jezreelite had given him: “I will not give up to you
what I have inherited from my fathers!” He lay down on his bed and
turned away his face, and he would not eat.

translation.text: Ahab went home resentful and on his bed, turned away his face, and would not eat.

verses.english:
His wife Jezebel came to him and asked him, “Why are you so
dispirited that you won’t eat?”
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו מַה־זֶּה רוּחֲךָ סָרָה וְאֵינְךָ אֹכֵל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו מַה־זֶּה רוּחֲךָ סָרָה וְאֵינְךָ אֹכֵל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
His wife Jezebel came to him and asked him, “Why are you so
dispirited that you won’t eat?”

translation.text: His wife Jezebel came to him and said, "Why are you so depressed that you will not eat?"

verses.english:
So he told her, “I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and proposed to
him, ‘Sell me your vineyard for money, or if you prefer, I’ll give
you another vineyard in exchange’; but he answered, ‘I will not
give my vineyard to you.’”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ כִּי־אֲדַבֵּר אֶל־נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וָאֹמַר לוֹ תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ בְּכֶסֶף אוֹ אִם־חָפֵץ אַתָּה אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶרֶם תַּחְתָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן
לְךָ אֶת־כַּרְמִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ כִּי־אֲדַבֵּר אֶל־נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וָאֹמַר לוֹ תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ בְּכֶסֶף אוֹ אִם־חָפֵץ אַתָּה אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶרֶם תַּחְתָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן
לְךָ אֶת־כַּרְמִי׃

english.text:
So he told her, “I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and proposed to
him, ‘Sell me your vineyard for money, or if you prefer, I’ll give
you another vineyard in exchange’; but he answered, ‘I will not
give my vineyard to you.’”

translation.text: He said to her, "Because I spoke to Naboth answered, 'I will not give you my vineyard.'"

verses.english:
His wife Jezebel said to him, “Now is the time to show yourself
king over Israel. Rise and eat something, and be cheerful; I will
get the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ אַתָּה עַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה מְלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל קוּם אֱכל־לֶחֶם וְיִטַב לִבֶּךָ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ אַתָּה עַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה מְלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל קוּם אֱכל־לֶחֶם וְיִטַב לִבֶּךָ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃

english.text:
His wife Jezebel said to him, “Now is the time to show yourself
king over Israel. Rise and eat something, and be cheerful; I will
get the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite for you.”

translation.text: His wife Jezebel said to cheerful; I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."

verses.english:
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal,
and sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who lived in the
same town with Naboth.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְתֹּב סְפָרִים בְּשֵׁם אַחְאָב וַתַּחְתֹּם בְּחֹתָמוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח (הספרים) [סְפָרִים] אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעִירוֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶת־נָבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְתֹּב סְפָרִים בְּשֵׁם אַחְאָב וַתַּחְתֹּם בְּחֹתָמוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח (הספרים) [סְפָרִים] אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעִירוֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶת־נָבוֹת׃

english.text:
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal,
and sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who lived in the
same town with Naboth.

translation.text: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal; she sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.

verses.english:
In the letters she wrote as follows: “Proclaim a fast and seat
Naboth at the front of the assembly.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְתֹּב בַּסְּפָרִים לֵאמֹר קִרְאוּ־צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְתֹּב בַּסְּפָרִים לֵאמֹר קִרְאוּ־צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

english.text:
In the letters she wrote as follows: “Proclaim a fast and seat
Naboth at the front of the assembly.

translation.text: She wrote in the letters, "Proclaim a fast, and seat Naboth at the head of the assembly;

verses.english:
And seat two scoundrels opposite him, and let them testify against
him: ‘You have reviled God and king!’ Then take him out and stone
him to death.”
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻהוּ וְסִקְלֻהוּ וְיָמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻהוּ וְסִקְלֻהוּ וְיָמֹת׃

english.text:
And seat two scoundrels opposite him, and let them testify against
him: ‘You have reviled God and king!’ Then take him out and stone
him to death.”

translation.text: seat two scoundrels opposite him, and and the king.' Then take him out, and stone him to death."

verses.english:
His townsmen—the elders and nobles who lived in his town—did as
Jezebel had instructed them, just as was written in the letters
she had sent them:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעִירוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם אִיזָבֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בַּסְּפָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעִירוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם אִיזָבֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בַּסְּפָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
His townsmen—the elders and nobles who lived in his town—did as

she had sent them:

translation.text: The men of his city, the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had sent word to them. Just as it was written in the letters that she had sent to them,

They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the front of the
assembly.

english.text:
They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the front of the

Then the two scoundrels came and sat down opposite him; and the

וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיְעִדֻהוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַבְּלִיַּעַל אֶת־נָבוֹת נֶגֶד הָעָם לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ נָבוֹת אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ

Then the two scoundrels came and sat down opposite him; and the

english.text:
In the third year, King Jehoshaphat of Judah came to visit the
king of Israel.

translation.text: But in the third year King Jehoshaphat of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

verses.english:
The king of Israel said to his courtiers, “You know that
Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, and yet we do nothing to recover it
from the hands of the king of Aram.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי־לָנוּ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים מִקַּחַת אֹתָהּ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי־לָנוּ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים מִקַּחַת אֹתָהּ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

english.text:
The king of Israel said to his courtiers, “You know that
Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, and yet we do nothing to recover it
from the hands of the king of Aram.”

translation.text: The king of Israel said to his servants, "Do you know that Ramothgilead belongs to us, yet we are doing nothing to take it out of the hand of the king of Aram?"

verses.english:
And he said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you come with me to battle at
Ramoth-gilead?” Jehoshaphat answered the king of Israel, “I will
do what you do; my troops shall be your troops, my horses shall be
your horses.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי לַמִּלְחָמָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי לַמִּלְחָמָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And he said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you come with me to battle at
Ramoth-gilead?” Jehoshaphat answered the king of Israel, “I will
do what you do; my troops shall be your troops, my horses shall be
your horses.”

translation.text: He said to Jehoshaphat, "Will you go your horses."

verses.english:
But Jehoshaphat said further to the king of Israel, “Please, first
inquire of YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּרשׁ־נָא כַיּוֹם אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּרשׁ־נָא כַיּוֹם אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But Jehoshaphat said further to the king of Israel, “Please, first
inquire of YHWH.”

translation.text: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "Inquire first for the word of the LORD."

verses.english:
So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred
men, and asked them, “Shall I march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle,
or shall I not?” “March,” they said, “and YHWH will deliver [it]
into Your Majesty’s hands.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הַאֵלֵךְ עַל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־אֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלֵה וְיִתֵּן אֲדֹנָי
בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הַאֵלֵךְ עַל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־אֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלֵה וְיִתֵּן אֲדֹנָי
בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred
men, and asked them, “Shall I march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle,
or shall I not?” “March,” they said, “and YHWH will deliver [it]
into Your Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets battle against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I refrain?" They said, "Go up; for the LORD will give it into the hand of the king."

verses.english:
Then Jehoshaphat asked, “Isn’t there another prophet of YHWH here
through whom we can inquire?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
Then Jehoshaphat asked, “Isn’t there another prophet of YHWH here
through whom we can inquire?”

translation.text: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no other prophet of the LORD here of whom we may inquire?"

verses.english:
And the king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is one more
man through whom we can inquire of YHWH; but I hate him, because
he never prophesies anything good for me, but only
misfortune—Micaiah son of Imlah.” But King Jehoshaphat said,
“Don’t say that, Your Majesty.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט עוֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָד לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה מֵאֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע מִיכָיְהוּ בֶּן־יִמְלָה
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אַל־יֹאמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט עוֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָד לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה מֵאֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע מִיכָיְהוּ בֶּן־יִמְלָה
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אַל־יֹאמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן׃

english.text:
And the king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is one more
man through whom we can inquire of YHWH; but I hate him, because
he never prophesies anything good for me, but only
misfortune—Micaiah son of Imlah.” But King Jehoshaphat said,
“Don’t say that, Your Majesty.”

translation.text: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is still one other by disaster." Jehoshaphat said, "Let the king not say such a thing."

verses.english:
So the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, “Bring Micaiah
son of Imlah at once.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרָה מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרָה מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָה׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, “Bring Micaiah
son of Imlah at once.”

translation.text: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, "Bring quickly Micaiah son of Imlah."

verses.english:
The king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah were seated on
their thrones, arrayed in their robes, on the threshing floor at
the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were
prophesying before them.
verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים אִישׁ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁים בְּגָדִים בְּגֹרֶן פֶּתַח שַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן וְכל־הַנְּבִיאִים מִתְנַבְּאִים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים אִישׁ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁים בְּגָדִים בְּגֹרֶן פֶּתַח שַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן וְכל־הַנְּבִיאִים מִתְנַבְּאִים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
The king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah were seated on
their thrones, arrayed in their robes, on the threshing floor at
the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were
prophesying before them.

translation.text: Now the king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of prophets were prophesying before them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֹּתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֹּתָם׃

translation.text: Zedekiah son of destroyed."

verses.english:
And all the other prophets were prophesying similarly, “March upon
Ramoth-gilead and triumph! YHWH will deliver it into Your
Majesty’s hands.”
verses.hebrew: וְכל־הַנְּבִאִים נִבְּאִים כֵּן לֵאמֹר עֲלֵה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הַנְּבִאִים נִבְּאִים כֵּן לֵאמֹר עֲלֵה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And all the other prophets were prophesying similarly, “March upon
Ramoth-gilead and triumph! YHWH will deliver it into Your
Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: All the prophets were prophesying the same and saying, hand of the king."

verses.english:
The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him: “Look,
the words of the prophets are with one accord favorable to the
king. Let your word be like that of the rest of them; speak a
favorable word.”
verses.hebrew:
וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא מִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־נָא דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִיאִים פֶּה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהִי־נָא (דבריך) [דְבָרְךָ] כִּדְבַר אַחַד
מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּוֹב׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא מִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־נָא דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִיאִים פֶּה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהִי־נָא (דבריך) [דְבָרְךָ] כִּדְבַר אַחַד
מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּוֹב׃

english.text:
The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him: “Look,
the words of the prophets are with one accord favorable to the
king. Let your word be like that of the rest of them; speak a
favorable word.”

translation.text: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, favorably."

verses.english:
“As YHWH lives,” Micaiah answered, “I will speak only what YHWH
tells me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
“As YHWH lives,” Micaiah answered, “I will speak only what YHWH
tells me.”

translation.text: But Micaiah said, "As the LORD lives, whatever the LORD says to me, that I will speak."

verses.english:
When he came before the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah,
shall we march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall we not?” He
answered him, “March and triumph! YHWH will deliver [it] into Your
Majesty’s hands.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו מִיכָיְהוּ הֲנֵלֵךְ אֶל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־נֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו מִיכָיְהוּ הֲנֵלֵךְ אֶל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־נֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
When he came before the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah,
shall we march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall we not?” He
answered him, “March and triumph! YHWH will deliver [it] into Your
Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall king."

verses.english:
The king said to him, “How many times must I adjure you to tell me
nothing but the truth in the name of YHWH?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים אֲנִי מַשְׁבִּיעֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְדַבֵּר אֵלַי רַק־אֱמֶת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים אֲנִי מַשְׁבִּיעֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְדַבֵּר אֵלַי רַק־אֱמֶת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The king said to him, “How many times must I adjure you to tell me
nothing but the truth in the name of YHWH?”

translation.text: But the king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?"

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר רָאִיתִי אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נְפֹצִים אֶל־הֶהָרִים כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לֹא־אֲדֹנִים לָאֵלֶּה יָשׁוּבוּ אִישׁ־לְבֵיתוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
[Meanwhile,] Ahaziah son of Ahab had become king of Israel, in
Samaria, in the seventeenth year of King Jehoshaphat of Judah; he
reigned over Israel two years.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, and Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following in the footsteps of
his father and his mother, and in those of Jeroboam son of Nebat
who had caused Israel to sin.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְדֶרֶךְ אִמּוֹ וּבְדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְדֶרֶךְ אִמּוֹ וּבְדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following in the footsteps of
his father and his mother, and in those of Jeroboam son of Nebat
who had caused Israel to sin.

translation.text: He served Baal and as his father had done.

verses.english:
He worshiped Baal and bowed down to him; he vexed YHWH, the God of
Israel, just as his father had done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיַּכְעֵס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיַּכְעֵס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He worshiped Baal and bowed down to him; he vexed YHWH, the God of
Israel, just as his father had done.

verses.english: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשַׁע מוֹאָב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַחְאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְשַׁע מוֹאָב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַחְאָב׃

english.text: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.

translation.text: After the death of Ahab, Moab rebelled against Israel.

verses.english:
Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber at Samaria
and was injured. So he sent messengers, whom he instructed: “Go
inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover
from this injury.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּפֹּל אֲחַזְיָה בְּעַד הַשְּׂבָכָה בַּעֲלִיָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּחַל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן
אִם־אֶחְיֶה מֵחֳלִי זֶה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּפֹּל אֲחַזְיָה בְּעַד הַשְּׂבָכָה בַּעֲלִיָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּחַל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן
אִם־אֶחְיֶה מֵחֳלִי זֶה׃

Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber at Samaria
and was injured. So he sent messengers, whom he instructed: “Go
inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover
from this injury.”

translation.text: Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice in his upper chamber in this injury."

verses.english:
But an angel of YHWH said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Go and confront
the messengers of the king of Samaria and say to them, ‘Is there
no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of
Ekron?
verses.hebrew:
וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי קוּם עֲלֵה לִקְרַאת מַלְאֲכֵי מֶלֶךְ־שֹׁמְרוֹן וְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם הֹלְכִים לִדְרֹשׁ
בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן׃

וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי קוּם עֲלֵה לִקְרַאת מַלְאֲכֵי מֶלֶךְ־שֹׁמְרוֹן וְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם הֹלְכִים לִדְרֹשׁ
בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן׃

english.text:
But an angel of YHWH said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Go and confront
the messengers of the king of Samaria and say to them, ‘Is there
no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of
Ekron?

translation.text: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Get inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?'

verses.english:
Assuredly, thus said YHWH: You shall not rise from the bed you are
lying on, but you shall die.’” And Elijah went.

hebrew.text: וְלָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּה׃

english.text:
Assuredly, thus said YHWH: You shall not rise from the bed you are
lying on, but you shall die.’” And Elijah went.

translation.text: Now therefore thus says shall surely die.'" So Elijah went.

verses.english:
The messengers returned to Ahaziah; and he asked, “Why have you
come back?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מַה־זֶּה שַׁבְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מַה־זֶּה שַׁבְתֶּם׃

english.text:
The messengers returned to Ahaziah; and he asked, “Why have you
come back?”

translation.text: The messengers returned to the king, who said to them, "Why have you returned?"

verses.english:
They answered him, “A man came toward us and said to us, ‘Go back
to the king who sent you, and say to him: Thus said YHWH: Is there
no God in Israel that you must send to inquire of Baal-zebub, the
god of Ekron? Assuredly, you shall not rise from the bed you are
lying on, but shall die.’”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ עָלָה לִקְרָאתֵנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֵינוּ לְכוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם וְדִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים
בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה שֹׁלֵחַ לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן לָכֵן הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ עָלָה לִקְרָאתֵנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֵינוּ לְכוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם וְדִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים
בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה שֹׁלֵחַ לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן לָכֵן הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת׃

english.text:
They answered him, “A man came toward us and said to us, ‘Go back
to the king who sent you, and say to him: Thus said YHWH: Is there
no God in Israel that you must send to inquire of Baal-zebub, the
god of Ekron? Assuredly, you shall not rise from the bed you are
lying on, but shall die.’”

translation.text: They answered him, "There came a man to meet us, who said to us, 'Go back to the king who sent you, and say to him: Thus says the LORD: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are shall not leave the bed to which you have gone, but shall surely die.'"

verses.english:
“What sort of man was it,” he asked them, “who came toward you and
said these things to you?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם מֶה מִשְׁפַּט הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָה לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם מֶה מִשְׁפַּט הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָה לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
“What sort of man was it,” he asked them, “who came toward you and
said these things to you?”

translation.text: told you these things?"

verses.english:
“A hairy man,” they replied, “with a leather belt tied around his
waist.” “That’s Elijah the Tishbite!” he said.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ בַּעַל שֵׂעָר וְאֵזוֹר עוֹר אָזוּר בְּמתְנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ בַּעַל שֵׂעָר וְאֵזוֹר עוֹר אָזוּר בְּמתְנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי הוּא׃

english.text:
“A hairy man,” they replied, “with a leather belt tied around his
waist.” “That’s Elijah the Tishbite!” he said.

translation.text: They answered him, "A hairy man, with a leather belt around his waist." He said, "It is Elijah the Tishbite."

verses.english:
Then he sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men. He
climbed up to him, and found him sitting at the top of a hill.
“Man of God,” he said to him, “by order of the king, come down!”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַל אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה יֹשֵׁב עַל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הַמֶּלֶךְ דִּבֶּר רֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַל אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה יֹשֵׁב עַל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הַמֶּלֶךְ דִּבֶּר רֵדָה׃

english.text:
Then he sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men. He
climbed up to him, and found him sitting at the top of a hill.
“Man of God,” he said to him, “by order of the king, come down!”

translation.text: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men. He went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "O man of God, the king says, 'Come down.'"

verses.english:
Elijah replied to the captain of the fifty, “If I am a man of God,
let fire come down from heaven and consume you with your fifty
men!” And fire came down from heaven and consumed him and his
fifty men.

וַיַּעֲנֶה אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל־שַׂר הַחֲמִשִּׁים וְאִם־אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים אָנִי תֵּרֶד אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתֹאכַל אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־חֲמִשֶּׁיךָ וַתֵּרֶד אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם
וַתֹּאכַל אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־חֲמִשָּׁיו׃
