Gehazi, the attendant of Elisha the man of God, thought: “My
master has let that Aramean Naaman off without accepting what he
brought! As YHWH lives, I will run after him and get something
from him.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּיחֲזִי נַעַר אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה חָשַׂךְ אֲדֹנִי אֶת־נַעֲמָן הָאֲרַמִּי הַזֶּה מִקַּחַת מִיָּדוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי־אִם־רַצְתִּי אַחֲרָיו
וְלָקַחְתִּי מֵאִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּיחֲזִי נַעַר אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה חָשַׂךְ אֲדֹנִי אֶת־נַעֲמָן הָאֲרַמִּי הַזֶּה מִקַּחַת מִיָּדוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי־אִם־רַצְתִּי אַחֲרָיו

english.text:
Gehazi, the attendant of Elisha the man of God, thought: “My
master has let that Aramean Naaman off without accepting what he
brought! As YHWH lives, I will run after him and get something
from him.”

translation.text: Gehazi, the offered. As the LORD lives, I will run after him and get something out of him."

verses.english:
So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw someone running
after him, he alighted from his chariot to meet him and said, “Is
all well?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף גֵּיחֲזִי אַחֲרֵי נַעֲמָן וַיִּרְאֶה נַעֲמָן רָץ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֹּף גֵּיחֲזִי אַחֲרֵי נַעֲמָן וַיִּרְאֶה נַעֲמָן רָץ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw someone running
after him, he alighted from his chariot to meet him and said, “Is
all well?”

translation.text: So Gehazi went after Naaman. When Naaman saw someone said, "Is everything all right?"

verses.english:
“All is well,” he replied. “My master has sent me to say: Two
youths, disciples of the prophets, have just come to me from the
hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and
two changes of clothing.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם אֲדֹנִי שְׁלָחַנִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַתָּה זֶה בָּאוּ אֵלַי שְׁנֵי־נְעָרִים מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים תְּנָה־נָּא לָהֶם כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף וּשְׁתֵּי חֲלִפוֹת

Naaman said, “Please take two talents.” He urged him, and he
wrapped the two talents of silver in two bags and gave them, along

translation.text: Naaman said, "Please accept servants, who carried them in front of Gehazi.

verses.english:
When [Gehazi] arrived at the citadel, he took [the things] from
them and deposited them in the house. Then he dismissed the men
and they went their way.

english.text:
When [Gehazi] arrived at the citadel, he took [the things] from
them and deposited them in the house. Then he dismissed the men
and they went their way.

translation.text: When he came to the dismissed the men, and they left.

verses.english:
He entered and stood before his master; and Elisha said to him,
“Where have you been, Gehazi?” He replied, “Your servant has not
gone anywhere.”
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא־בָא וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע (מאן) [מֵאַיִן] גֵּחֲזִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־הָלַךְ עַבְדְּךָ אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא־בָא וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע (מאן) [מֵאַיִן] גֵּחֲזִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־הָלַךְ עַבְדְּךָ אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃

english.text:
He entered and stood before his master; and Elisha said to him,
“Where have you been, Gehazi?” He replied, “Your servant has not
gone anywhere.”

translation.text: He went in and stood before his master; and Elisha said to him, gone anywhere at all."

verses.english:
Then [Elisha] said to him, “Did not my spirit go along when a man
got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this a time to take
money in order to buy clothing and olive groves and vineyards,
sheep and oxen, and male and female slaves?
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֹא־לִבִּי הָלַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ־אִישׁ מֵעַל מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ לִקְרָאתֶךָ הַעֵת לָקַחַת אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְלָקַחַת בְּגָדִים וְזֵיתִים וּכְרָמִים וְצֹאן וּבָקָר
וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֹא־לִבִּי הָלַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ־אִישׁ מֵעַל מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ לִקְרָאתֶךָ הַעֵת לָקַחַת אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְלָקַחַת בְּגָדִים וְזֵיתִים וּכְרָמִים וְצֹאן וּבָקָר
וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת׃

english.text:
Then [Elisha] said to him, “Did not my spirit go along when a man
got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this a time to take
money in order to buy clothing and olive groves and vineyards,
sheep and oxen, and male and female slaves?

translation.text: But he said to him, "Did I not go with you in sheep and oxen, and male and female slaves?

verses.english:
Surely, the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your
descendants forever.” And as [Gehazi] left his presence, he was
snow-white with leprosy.
verses.hebrew: וְצָרַעַת נַעֲמָן תִּדְבַּק־בְּךָ וּבְזַרְעֲךָ לְעוֹלָם וַיֵּצֵא מִלְּפָנָיו מְצֹרָע כַּשָּׁלֶג׃

hebrew.text: וְצָרַעַת נַעֲמָן תִּדְבַּק־בְּךָ וּבְזַרְעֲךָ לְעוֹלָם וַיֵּצֵא מִלְּפָנָיו מְצֹרָע כַּשָּׁלֶג׃

english.text:
Surely, the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your
descendants forever.” And as [Gehazi] left his presence, he was
snow-white with leprosy.

translation.text: Therefore the leprosy left his presence leprous, as white as snow.

verses.english:
The disciples of the prophets said to Elisha, “See, the place
where we live under your direction is too cramped for us.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע הִנֵּה־נָא הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם לְפָנֶיךָ צַר מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע הִנֵּה־נָא הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם לְפָנֶיךָ צַר מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
The disciples of the prophets said to Elisha, “See, the place
where we live under your direction is too cramped for us.

translation.text: Now the company of prophets said to Elisha, "As you see, the place where we live under your charge is too small for us.

verses.english:
Let us go to the Jordan, and let us each get a log there and build
quarters there for ourselves to live in.” “Do so,” he replied.

hebrew.text: נֵלְכָה־נָּא עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְנִקְחָה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ קוֹרָה אֶחָת וְנַעֲשֶׂה־לָּנוּ שָׁם מָקוֹם לָשֶׁבֶת שָׁם וַיֹּאמֶר לֵכוּ׃

english.text:
Let us go to the Jordan, and let us each get a log there and build
quarters there for ourselves to live in.” “Do so,” he replied.

translation.text: Let us go to the place there for us to live." He answered, "Do so."

verses.english:
Then one of them said, “Will you please come along with your
servants?” “Yes, I will come,” he said;
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאֶחָד הוֹאֶל נָא וְלֵךְ אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאֶחָד הוֹאֶל נָא וְלֵךְ אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
Then one of them said, “Will you please come along with your
servants?” “Yes, I will come,” he said;

and he accompanied them. So they went to the Jordan and cut
timber.

and he accompanied them. So they went to the Jordan and cut

As one of them was felling a trunk, the iron ax head fell into the

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָרֶם לָךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ׃

english.text: “Pick it up,” he said; so he reached out and took it.

translation.text: He said, "Pick it up." So he reached out his hand and took it.

verses.english:
While the king of Aram was waging war against Israel, he took
counsel with his officers and said, “I will encamp in such and
such a place.”
verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הָיָה נִלְחָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמֹנִי תַּחֲנֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הָיָה נִלְחָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמֹנִי תַּחֲנֹתִי׃

english.text:
While the king of Aram was waging war against Israel, he took
counsel with his officers and said, “I will encamp in such and
such a place.”

translation.text: Once when the king of Aram was at war with Israel, he took counsel with his officers. He said, "At such and such a place shall be my camp."

verses.english:
But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, “Take care not
to pass through that place, for the Arameans are encamped there.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר מֵעֲבֹר הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי־שָׁם אֲרָם נְחִתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר מֵעֲבֹר הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי־שָׁם אֲרָם נְחִתִּים׃

english.text:
But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, “Take care not
to pass through that place, for the Arameans are encamped there.”

translation.text: But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, "Take care not to pass this place, because the Arameans are going down there."

verses.english:
So the king of Israel sent word to the place of which the man of
God had told him. Time and again he alerted such a place and took
precautions there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִזְהִירֹה וְנִשְׁמַר שָׁם לֹא אַחַת וְלֹא שְׁתָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִזְהִירֹה וְנִשְׁמַר שָׁם לֹא אַחַת וְלֹא שְׁתָּיִם׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel sent word to the place of which the man of
God had told him. Time and again he alerted such a place and took
precautions there.

translation.text: The king of Israel sent word to the place of which the man of God spoke. alert.

verses.english:
Greatly agitated about this matter, the king of Aram summoned his
officers and said to them, “Tell me! Who of us is on the side of
the king of Israel?”

“Go find out where he is,” he said, “so that I can have him
seized.” It was reported to him that [Elisha] was in Dothan;

so he sent horses and chariots there and a strong force. They

so he sent horses and chariots there and a strong force. They

verses.english:
When the attendant of the man of God rose early and went outside,
he saw a force, with horses and chariots, surrounding the town.
“Alas, master, what shall we do?” his servant asked him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מְשָׁרֵת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לָקוּם וַיֵּצֵא וְהִנֵּה־חַיִל סוֹבֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲרוֹ אֵלָיו אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנִי אֵיכָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מְשָׁרֵת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לָקוּם וַיֵּצֵא וְהִנֵּה־חַיִל סוֹבֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲרוֹ אֵלָיו אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנִי אֵיכָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
When the attendant of the man of God rose early and went outside,
he saw a force, with horses and chariots, surrounding the town.
“Alas, master, what shall we do?” his servant asked him.

translation.text: When an attendant of the man of God rose early in the morning and went out, an army with horses and chariots was all around the city. His servant said, "Alas, master! What shall we do?"

verses.english:
“Have no fear,” he replied. “There are more on our side than on
theirs.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּירָא כִּי רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּנוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּירָא כִּי רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּנוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
“Have no fear,” he replied. “There are more on our side than on
theirs.”

translation.text: He replied, "Do not be afraid, for there are more with us than there are with them."

verses.english:
Then Elisha prayed: “LORD, open his eyes and let him see.” And
YHWH opened the servant’s eyes and he saw the hills all around
Elisha covered with horses and chariots of fire.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה פְּקַח־נָא אֶת־עֵינָיו וְיִרְאֶה וַיִּפְקַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֵינֵי הַנַּעַר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָהָר מָלֵא סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב אֵשׁ סְבִיבֹת
אֱלִישָׁע׃

וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה פְּקַח־נָא אֶת־עֵינָיו וְיִרְאֶה וַיִּפְקַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֵינֵי הַנַּעַר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָהָר מָלֵא סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב אֵשׁ סְבִיבֹת

Then Elisha prayed: “LORD, open his eyes and let him see.” And
YHWH opened the servant’s eyes and he saw the hills all around
Elisha covered with horses and chariots of fire.

translation.text: was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

verses.english:
[The Arameans] came down against him, and Elisha prayed to YHWH:
“Please strike this people with a blinding light.” And He struck
them with a blinding light, as Elisha had asked.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַךְ־נָא אֶת־הַגּוֹי־הַזֶּה בַּסַּנְוֵרִים וַיַּכֵּם בַּסַּנְוֵרִים כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע׃

Elisha said to them, “This is not the road, and that is not the
town; follow me, and I will lead you to the man you want.” And he
led them to Samaria.

Elisha said to them, “This is not the road, and that is not the

led them to Samaria.

translation.text: Elisha said to them, "This is not the way, and this is not the city; follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek." And he led them to Samaria.

verses.english:
When they entered Samaria, Elisha said, “O LORD, open the eyes of
these men so that they may see.” YHWH opened their eyes and they
saw that they were inside Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבֹאָם שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְהֹוָה פְּקַח אֶת־עֵינֵי־אֵלֶּה וְיִרְאוּ וַיִּפְקַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה בְּתוֹךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבֹאָם שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְהֹוָה פְּקַח אֶת־עֵינֵי־אֵלֶּה וְיִרְאוּ וַיִּפְקַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה בְּתוֹךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
When they entered Samaria, Elisha said, “O LORD, open the eyes of
these men so that they may see.” YHWH opened their eyes and they
saw that they were inside Samaria.

translation.text: As soon as they entered Samaria, Elisha said, "O LORD, open the eyes they saw that they were inside Samaria.

verses.english:
When the king of Israel saw them, he said to Elisha, “Father,
shall I strike them down?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע כִּרְאֹתוֹ אוֹתָם הַאַכֶּה אַכֶּה אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע כִּרְאֹתוֹ אוֹתָם הַאַכֶּה אַכֶּה אָבִי׃

english.text:
When the king of Israel saw them, he said to Elisha, “Father,
shall I strike them down?”

translation.text: When the king of Israel saw them he said to Elisha, "Father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?"

verses.english:
“No, do not,” he replied. “Did you take them captive with your
sword and bow that you would strike them down? Rather, set food
and drink before them, and let them eat and drink and return to
their master.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַכֶּה הַאֲשֶׁר שָׁבִיתָ בְּחַרְבְּךָ וּבְקַשְׁתְּךָ אַתָּה מַכֶּה שִׂים לֶחֶם וָמַיִם לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיֹאכְלוּ וְיִשְׁתּוּ וְיֵלְכוּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַכֶּה הַאֲשֶׁר שָׁבִיתָ בְּחַרְבְּךָ וּבְקַשְׁתְּךָ אַתָּה מַכֶּה שִׂים לֶחֶם וָמַיִם לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיֹאכְלוּ וְיִשְׁתּוּ וְיֵלְכוּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“No, do not,” he replied. “Did you take them captive with your
sword and bow that you would strike them down? Rather, set food
and drink before them, and let them eat and drink and return to
their master.”

translation.text: they may eat and drink; and let them go to their master."

verses.english:
So he prepared a lavish feast for them and, after they had eaten
and drunk, he let them go, and they returned to their master. And
the Aramean bands stopped invading the land of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֶה לָהֶם כֵּרָה גְדוֹלָה וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד גְּדוּדֵי אֲרָם לָבוֹא בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֶה לָהֶם כֵּרָה גְדוֹלָה וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד גְּדוּדֵי אֲרָם לָבוֹא בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So he prepared a lavish feast for them and, after they had eaten
and drunk, he let them go, and they returned to their master. And
the Aramean bands stopped invading the land of Israel.

translation.text: So he no longer came raiding into the land of Israel.

verses.english:
Sometime later, King Ben-hadad of Aram mustered his entire army
and marched upon Samaria and besieged it.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּקְבֹּץ בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־כּל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּקְבֹּץ בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־כּל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
Sometime later, King Ben-hadad of Aram mustered his entire army
and marched upon Samaria and besieged it.

translation.text: Some time later King Ben-hadad of Aram mustered his entire army; he marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.

verses.english:
There was a great famine in Samaria, and the siege continued until
a donkey’s head sold for eighty [shekels] of silver and a quarter
of a kab of doves’ dung for five shekels.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי רָעָב גָּדוֹל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וְהִנֵּה צָרִים עָלֶיהָ עַד הֱיוֹת רֹאשׁ־חֲמוֹר בִּשְׁמֹנִים כֶּסֶף וְרֹבַע הַקַּב (חרי) [דִּב־]יוֹנִים בַּחֲמִשָּׁה־כָסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי רָעָב גָּדוֹל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וְהִנֵּה צָרִים עָלֶיהָ עַד הֱיוֹת רֹאשׁ־חֲמוֹר בִּשְׁמֹנִים כֶּסֶף וְרֹבַע הַקַּב (חרי) [דִּב־]יוֹנִים בַּחֲמִשָּׁה־כָסֶף׃

english.text:
There was a great famine in Samaria, and the siege continued until
a donkey’s head sold for eighty [shekels] of silver and a quarter
of a kab of doves’ dung for five shekels.

translation.text: As the siege was sold for eighty shekels of silver, and one-fourth of a kab of dove's dung for five shekels of silver.

verses.english:
Once, when the king of Israel was walking on the city wall, a
woman cried out to him: “Help me, Your Majesty!”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹבֵר עַל־הַחֹמָה וְאִשָּׁה צָעֲקָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הוֹשִׁיעָה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹבֵר עַל־הַחֹמָה וְאִשָּׁה צָעֲקָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הוֹשִׁיעָה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Once, when the king of Israel was walking on the city wall, a
woman cried out to him: “Help me, Your Majesty!”

translation.text: Now as the king of Israel was walking on the city wall, a woman cried out to him, "Help, my lord king!"

verses.english:
“Don’t [ask me],” he replied. “Let YHWH help you! Where could I
get help for you, from the threshing floor or from the winepress?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יוֹשִׁעֵךְ יְהֹוָה מֵאַיִן אוֹשִׁיעֵךְ הֲמִן־הַגֹּרֶן אוֹ מִן־הַיָּקֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יוֹשִׁעֵךְ יְהֹוָה מֵאַיִן אוֹשִׁיעֵךְ הֲמִן־הַגֹּרֶן אוֹ מִן־הַיָּקֶב׃

english.text:
“Don’t [ask me],” he replied. “Let YHWH help you! Where could I
get help for you, from the threshing floor or from the winepress?

translation.text: He threshing floor or from the wine press?"

verses.english:
But what troubles you?” the king asked her. The woman answered,
“That woman said to me, ‘Give up your son and we will eat him
today; and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת אָמְרָה אֵלַי תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַיּוֹם וְאֶת־בְּנִי נֹאכַל מָחָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת אָמְרָה אֵלַי תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַיּוֹם וְאֶת־בְּנִי נֹאכַל מָחָר׃

english.text:
But what troubles you?” the king asked her. The woman answered,
“That woman said to me, ‘Give up your son and we will eat him
today; and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’

translation.text: But then the king asked tomorrow.'

verses.english:
So we cooked my son and we ate him. The next day I said to her,
‘Give up your son and let’s eat him’; but she hid her son.”
verses.hebrew: וַנְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־בְּנִי וַנֹּאכְלֵהוּ וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ בַּיּוֹם הָאַחֵר תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ וַתַּחְבִּא אֶת־בְּנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַנְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־בְּנִי וַנֹּאכְלֵהוּ וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ בַּיּוֹם הָאַחֵר תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ וַתַּחְבִּא אֶת־בְּנָהּ׃

english.text:
So we cooked my son and we ate him. The next day I said to her,
‘Give up your son and let’s eat him’; but she hid her son.”

translation.text: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I said to son."

verses.english:
When the king heard what the woman said, he rent his clothes; and
as he walked along the wall, the people could see that he was
wearing sackcloth underneath.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְהוּא עֹבֵר עַל־הַחֹמָה וַיַּרְא הָעָם וְהִנֵּה הַשַּׂק עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ מִבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְהוּא עֹבֵר עַל־הַחֹמָה וַיַּרְא הָעָם וְהִנֵּה הַשַּׂק עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ מִבָּיִת׃

english.text:
When the king heard what the woman said, he rent his clothes; and
as he walked along the wall, the people could see that he was
wearing sackcloth underneath.

translation.text: When the king heard the words of the woman he tore his see that he had sackcloth on his body underneath —

verses.english:
He said, “Thus and more may God do to me if the head of Elisha son
of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִף אִם־יַעֲמֹד רֹאשׁ אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט עָלָיו הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִף אִם־יַעֲמֹד רֹאשׁ אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט עָלָיו הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
He said, “Thus and more may God do to me if the head of Elisha son
of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today.”

translation.text: and he said, stays on his shoulders today."

verses.english:
Now Elisha was sitting at home and the elders were sitting with
him. The king had sent ahead one of his men; but before the
messenger arrived, [Elisha] said to the elders, “Do you see—that
murderer has sent someone to cut off my head! Watch when the
messenger comes, and shut the door and hold the door fast against
him. No doubt the sound of his master’s footsteps will follow.”
verses.hebrew:
וֶאֱלִישָׁע יֹשֵׁב בְּבֵיתוֹ וְהַזְּקֵנִים יֹשְׁבִים אִתּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ מִלְּפָנָיו בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא אָמַר אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים הַרְּאִיתֶם כִּי־שָׁלַח
בֶּן־הַמְרַצֵּחַ הַזֶּה לְהָסִיר אֶת־רֹאשִׁי רְאוּ כְּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ סִגְרוּ הַדֶּלֶת וּלְחַצְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בַּדֶּלֶת הֲלוֹא קוֹל רַגְלֵי אֲדֹנָיו אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וֶאֱלִישָׁע יֹשֵׁב בְּבֵיתוֹ וְהַזְּקֵנִים יֹשְׁבִים אִתּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ מִלְּפָנָיו בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא אָמַר אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים הַרְּאִיתֶם כִּי־שָׁלַח
בֶּן־הַמְרַצֵּחַ הַזֶּה לְהָסִיר אֶת־רֹאשִׁי רְאוּ כְּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ סִגְרוּ הַדֶּלֶת וּלְחַצְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בַּדֶּלֶת הֲלוֹא קוֹל רַגְלֵי אֲדֹנָיו אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Now Elisha was sitting at home and the elders were sitting with
him. The king had sent ahead one of his men; but before the
messenger arrived, [Elisha] said to the elders, “Do you see—that
murderer has sent someone to cut off my head! Watch when the
messenger comes, and shut the door and hold the door fast against
him. No doubt the sound of his master’s footsteps will follow.”

translation.text: So he dispatched a man from his presence. against him. Is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?"

verses.english:
While he was still talking to them, the messenger came to him and
said, “This calamity is from YHWH. What more can I hope for from
YHWH?”
verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה הַמַּלְאָךְ יֹרֵד אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־זֹאת הָרָעָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה מָה־אוֹחִיל לַיהֹוָה עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה הַמַּלְאָךְ יֹרֵד אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־זֹאת הָרָעָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה מָה־אוֹחִיל לַיהֹוָה עוֹד׃

english.text:
While he was still talking to them, the messenger came to him and
said, “This calamity is from YHWH. What more can I hope for from
YHWH?”

translation.text: said, "This trouble is from the LORD! Why should I hope in the LORD any longer?"

verses.english:
And Elisha replied, “Hear the word of YHWH. Thus said YHWH: This
time tomorrow, a seah of choice flour shall sell for a shekel at
the gate of Samaria, and two seahs of barley for a shekel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה כָּעֵת מָחָר סְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה כָּעֵת מָחָר סְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
And Elisha replied, “Hear the word of YHWH. Thus said YHWH: This
time tomorrow, a seah of choice flour shall sell for a shekel at
the gate of Samaria, and two seahs of barley for a shekel.”

translation.text: But Elisha said, "Hear the word of the LORD: thus shall be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, at the gate of Samaria.'

verses.english:
The aide on whose arm the king was leaning spoke up and said to
the man of God, “Even if YHWH were to make windows in the sky,
could this come to pass?” And he retorted, “You shall see it with
your own eyes, but you shall not eat of it.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לַמֶּלֶךְ נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדוֹ אֶת־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמַר הִנֵּה יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה אֲרֻבּוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֲיִהְיֶה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְּכָה
רֹאֶה בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לַמֶּלֶךְ נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדוֹ אֶת־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמַר הִנֵּה יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה אֲרֻבּוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֲיִהְיֶה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְּכָה
רֹאֶה בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
The aide on whose arm the king was leaning spoke up and said to
the man of God, “Even if YHWH were to make windows in the sky,
could this come to pass?” And he retorted, “You shall see it with
your own eyes, but you shall not eat of it.”

translation.text: Then the captain on whose hand the king shall see it with your own eyes, but you shall not eat from it."

verses.english:
There were four men, lepers, outside the gate. They said to one
another, “Why should we sit here waiting for death?
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעָה אֲנָשִׁים הָיוּ מְצֹרָעִים פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מָה אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים פֹּה עַד־מָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעָה אֲנָשִׁים הָיוּ מְצֹרָעִים פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מָה אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים פֹּה עַד־מָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
There were four men, lepers, outside the gate. They said to one
another, “Why should we sit here waiting for death?

translation.text: Now there were four leprous men outside the city gate, who said to one another, "Why should we sit here until we die?

verses.english:
If we decide to go into the town, what with the famine in the
town, we shall die there; and if we just sit here, still we die.
Come, let us desert to the Aramean camp. If they let us live, we
shall live; and if they put us to death, we shall but die.”
verses.hebrew:
אִם־אָמַרְנוּ נָבוֹא הָעִיר וְהָרָעָב בָּעִיר וָמַתְנוּ שָׁם וְאִם־יָשַׁבְנוּ פֹה וָמָתְנוּ וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנִפְּלָה אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם אִם־יְחַיֻּנוּ נִחְיֶה וְאִם־יְמִיתֻנוּ
וָמָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־אָמַרְנוּ נָבוֹא הָעִיר וְהָרָעָב בָּעִיר וָמַתְנוּ שָׁם וְאִם־יָשַׁבְנוּ פֹה וָמָתְנוּ וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנִפְּלָה אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם אִם־יְחַיֻּנוּ נִחְיֶה וְאִם־יְמִיתֻנוּ
וָמָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
If we decide to go into the town, what with the famine in the
town, we shall die there; and if we just sit here, still we die.
Come, let us desert to the Aramean camp. If they let us live, we
shall live; and if they put us to death, we shall but die.”

translation.text: If we say, 'Let us enter the city,' the famine is in the city, and we shall die there; but if we sit here, we shall also die. Therefore, let us desert to the Aramean camp; if they spare our lives, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die."

verses.english:
They set out at twilight for the Aramean camp; but when they came
to the edge of the Aramean camp, there was no one there.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף לָבוֹא אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־קְצֵה מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף לָבוֹא אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־קְצֵה מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ׃

english.text:
They set out at twilight for the Aramean camp; but when they came
to the edge of the Aramean camp, there was no one there.

translation.text: So they arose at twilight to go to the Aramean camp; but there at all.

verses.english:
For YHWH had caused the Aramean camp to hear a sound of chariots,
a sound of horses—the din of a huge army. They said to one
another, “The king of Israel must have hired the kings of the
Hittites and the kings of Mizraim to attack us!”
verses.hebrew:
וַאדֹנָי הִשְׁמִיעַ אֶת־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם קוֹל רֶכֶב קוֹל סוּס קוֹל חַיִל גָּדוֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו הִנֵּה שָׂכַר־עָלֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים
וְאֶת־מַלְכֵי מִצְרַיִם לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַאדֹנָי הִשְׁמִיעַ אֶת־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם קוֹל רֶכֶב קוֹל סוּס קוֹל חַיִל גָּדוֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו הִנֵּה שָׂכַר־עָלֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים
וְאֶת־מַלְכֵי מִצְרַיִם לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
For YHWH had caused the Aramean camp to hear a sound of chariots,
a sound of horses—the din of a huge army. They said to one
another, “The king of Israel must have hired the kings of the
Hittites and the kings of Mizraim to attack us!”

translation.text: For the Lord had caused the Aramean army to hear the they said to one another, "The king of Israel has hired the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt to fight against us."

verses.english:
And they fled headlong in the twilight, abandoning their tents and
horses and asses—the [entire] camp just as it was—as they fled for
their lives.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ וַיָּנוּסוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־אהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵיהֶם הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר־הִיא וַיָּנֻסוּ אֶל־נַפְשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ וַיָּנוּסוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־אהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵיהֶם הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר־הִיא וַיָּנֻסוּ אֶל־נַפְשָׁם׃

english.text:
And they fled headlong in the twilight, abandoning their tents and
horses and asses—the [entire] camp just as it was—as they fled for
their lives.

translation.text: So they fled away donkeys leaving the camp just as it was, and fled for their lives.

verses.english:
When those lepers came to the edge of the camp, they went into one
of the tents and ate and drank; then they carried off silver and
gold and clothing from there and buried it. They came back and
went into another tent, and they carried off what was there and
buried it.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמְצֹרָעִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־קְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל אֶחָד וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּבְגָדִים וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּטְמִנוּ
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל אַחֵר וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּטְמִנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמְצֹרָעִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־קְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל אֶחָד וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּבְגָדִים וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּטְמִנוּ
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל אַחֵר וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּטְמִנוּ׃

english.text:
When those lepers came to the edge of the camp, they went into one
of the tents and ate and drank; then they carried off silver and
gold and clothing from there and buried it. They came back and
went into another tent, and they carried off what was there and
buried it.

translation.text: When tent, ate and drank, carried off silver, gold, and clothing, and went and things from it, and went and hid them.

verses.english:
Then they said to one another, “We are not doing right. This is a
day of good news, and we are keeping silent! If we wait until the
light of morning, we shall incur guilt. Come, let us go and inform
the king’s palace.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ לֹא־כֵן אֲנַחְנוּ עֹשִׂים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יוֹם־בְּשֹׂרָה הוּא וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים וְחִכִּינוּ עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וּמְצָאָנוּ עָווֹן וְעַתָּה לְכוּ
וְנָבֹאָה וְנַגִּידָה בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ לֹא־כֵן אֲנַחְנוּ עֹשִׂים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יוֹם־בְּשֹׂרָה הוּא וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים וְחִכִּינוּ עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וּמְצָאָנוּ עָווֹן וְעַתָּה לְכוּ
וְנָבֹאָה וְנַגִּידָה בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then they said to one another, “We are not doing right. This is a
day of good news, and we are keeping silent! If we wait until the
light of morning, we shall incur guilt. Come, let us go and inform
the king’s palace.”

translation.text: Then they said to one another, "What we are doing is wrong. This is household."

verses.english:
They went and called out to the gatekeepers of the city and told
them, “We have been to the Aramean camp. There is not a soul
there, nor any human sound; but the horses are tethered and the
asses are tethered and the tents are undisturbed.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־שֹׁעֵר הָעִיר וַיַּגִּידוּ לָהֶם לֵאמֹר בָּאנוּ אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ וְקוֹל אָדָם כִּי אִם־הַסּוּס אָסוּר וְהַחֲמוֹר אָסוּר
וְאֹהָלִים כַּאֲשֶׁר־הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־שֹׁעֵר הָעִיר וַיַּגִּידוּ לָהֶם לֵאמֹר בָּאנוּ אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ וְקוֹל אָדָם כִּי אִם־הַסּוּס אָסוּר וְהַחֲמוֹר אָסוּר
וְאֹהָלִים כַּאֲשֶׁר־הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
They went and called out to the gatekeepers of the city and told
them, “We have been to the Aramean camp. There is not a soul
there, nor any human sound; but the horses are tethered and the
asses are tethered and the tents are undisturbed.”

translation.text: So they came and called to the gatekeepers of the city, tied, and the tents as they were."

verses.english:
The gatekeepers called out, and the news was passed on into the
king’s palace.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַשֹּׁעֲרִים וַיַּגִּידוּ בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּנִימָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא הַשֹּׁעֲרִים וַיַּגִּידוּ בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּנִימָה׃

english.text:
The gatekeepers called out, and the news was passed on into the
king’s palace.

translation.text: Then the gatekeepers called out and proclaimed it to the king's household.

verses.english:
The king rose in the night and said to his courtiers, “I will tell
you what the Arameans have done to us. They know that we are
starving, so they have gone out of camp and hidden in the fields,
thinking: When they come out of the town, we will take them alive
and get into the town.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו אַגִּידָה־נָּא לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ לָנוּ אֲרָם יָדְעוּ כִּי־רְעֵבִים אֲנַחְנוּ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְהֵחָבֵה (בהשדה)
[בַשָּׂדֶה] לֵאמֹר כִּי־יֵצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר וְנִתְפְּשֵׂם חַיִּים וְאֶל־הָעִיר נָבֹא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו אַגִּידָה־נָּא לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ לָנוּ אֲרָם יָדְעוּ כִּי־רְעֵבִים אֲנַחְנוּ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְהֵחָבֵה (בהשדה)
[בַשָּׂדֶה] לֵאמֹר כִּי־יֵצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר וְנִתְפְּשֵׂם חַיִּים וְאֶל־הָעִיר נָבֹא׃

english.text:
The king rose in the night and said to his courtiers, “I will tell
you what the Arameans have done to us. They know that we are
starving, so they have gone out of camp and hidden in the fields,
thinking: When they come out of the town, we will take them alive
and get into the town.”

translation.text: The king got up in the night, and said to his servants, "I will tell you what the Arameans have come out of the city, we shall take them alive and get into the city.'"

verses.english:
But one of the courtiers spoke up, “Let a few of the remaining
horses that are still here be taken—they are like those that are
left here of the whole multitude of Israel, out of the whole
multitude of Israel that have perished—and let us send and find
out.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר וְיִקְחוּ־נָא חֲמִשָּׁה מִן־הַסּוּסִים הַנִּשְׁאָרִים אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָהּ הִנָּם כְּכל־[הֲמוֹן] (ההמון) יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָהּ
הִנָּם כְּכל־הֲמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־תָּמּוּ וְנִשְׁלְחָה וְנִרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר וְיִקְחוּ־נָא חֲמִשָּׁה מִן־הַסּוּסִים הַנִּשְׁאָרִים אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָהּ הִנָּם כְּכל־[הֲמוֹן] (ההמון) יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָהּ
הִנָּם כְּכל־הֲמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־תָּמּוּ וְנִשְׁלְחָה וְנִרְאֶה׃

english.text:
But one of the courtiers spoke up, “Let a few of the remaining
horses that are still here be taken—they are like those that are
left here of the whole multitude of Israel, out of the whole
multitude of Israel that have perished—and let us send and find
out.”

translation.text: horses, since those left here will suffer the fate of the whole multitude of Israel that have perished already; let us send and find out."

verses.english:
They took two teams of horses and the king sent them after the
Aramean army, saying, “Go and find out.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי רֶכֶב סוּסִים וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מַחֲנֵה־אֲרָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וּרְאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי רֶכֶב סוּסִים וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מַחֲנֵה־אֲרָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וּרְאוּ׃

english.text:
They took two teams of horses and the king sent them after the
Aramean army, saying, “Go and find out.”

translation.text: So Aramean army, saying, "Go and find out."

verses.english:
They followed them as far as the Jordan, and found the entire road
full of clothing and gear which the Arameans had thrown away in
their haste; and the messengers returned and told the king.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהִנֵּה כל־הַדֶּרֶךְ מְלֵאָה בְגָדִים וְכֵלִים אֲשֶׁר־הִשְׁלִיכוּ אֲרָם (בהחפזם) [בְּחפְזָם] וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהִנֵּה כל־הַדֶּרֶךְ מְלֵאָה בְגָדִים וְכֵלִים אֲשֶׁר־הִשְׁלִיכוּ אֲרָם (בהחפזם) [בְּחפְזָם] וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
They followed them as far as the Jordan, and found the entire road
full of clothing and gear which the Arameans had thrown away in
their haste; and the messengers returned and told the king.

translation.text: So they went after them messengers returned, and told the king.

verses.english:
The people then went out and plundered the Aramean camp. So a seah
of choice flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a
shekel—as YHWH had spoken.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם וַיָּבֹזּוּ אֵת מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיְהִי סְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם וַיָּבֹזּוּ אֵת מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיְהִי סְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The people then went out and plundered the Aramean camp. So a seah
of choice flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a
shekel—as YHWH had spoken.

translation.text: Then the people went out, and plundered the camp of the measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
Now the king had put the aide on whose arm he leaned in charge of
the gate; and he was trampled to death in the gate by the
people—just as the man of God had spoken, as he had spoken when
the king came down to him.
verses.hebrew:
וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הִפְקִיד אֶת־הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדוֹ עַל־הַשַּׁעַר וַיִּרְמְסֻהוּ הָעָם בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּרֶדֶת
הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הִפְקִיד אֶת־הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדוֹ עַל־הַשַּׁעַר וַיִּרְמְסֻהוּ הָעָם בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּרֶדֶת
הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
Now the king had put the aide on whose arm he leaned in charge of
the gate; and he was trampled to death in the gate by the
people—just as the man of God had spoken, as he had spoken when
the king came down to him.

translation.text: just as the man of God had said when the king came down to him.

verses.english:
For when the man of God said to the king, “This time tomorrow two
seahs of barley shall sell at the gate of Samaria for a shekel,
and a seah of choice flour for a shekel,”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל וּסְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל יִהְיֶה כָּעֵת מָחָר בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל וּסְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל יִהְיֶה כָּעֵת מָחָר בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
For when the man of God said to the king, “This time tomorrow two
seahs of barley shall sell at the gate of Samaria for a shekel,
and a seah of choice flour for a shekel,”

translation.text: shekel, about this time tomorrow in the gate of Samaria,"

verses.english:
the aide answered the man of God and said, “Even if YHWH made
windows in the sky, could this come to pass?” And he retorted,
“You shall see it with your own eyes, but you shall not eat of
it.”
verses.hebrew:

Elisha arrived in Damascus at a time when King Ben-hadad of Aram

of God, and through him inquire of YHWH: Will I recover from this
illness?”

Hazael went to meet him, taking with him as a gift forty
camel-loads of all the bounty of Damascus. He came and stood
before him and said, “Your son, King Ben-hadad of Aram, has sent

וַיֵּלֶךְ חֲזָאֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיִּקַּח מִנְחָה בְיָדוֹ וְכל־טוּב דַּמֶּשֶׂק מַשָּׂא אַרְבָּעִים גָּמָל וַיָּבֹא וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר בִּנְךָ בֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם

The man of God kept his face expressionless for a long time; and
then he wept.

english.text:
The man of God kept his face expressionless for a long time; and
then he wept.

translation.text: He fixed his gaze and stared at him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

verses.english:
“Why does my lord weep?” asked Hazael. “Because I know,” he
replied, “what harm you will do to the Israelite people: you will
set their fortresses on fire, put their young men to the sword,
dash their little ones in pieces, and rip open their pregnant
women.”

וַיֹּאמֶר חֲזָאֵל מַדּוּעַ אֲדֹנִי בֹכֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רָעָה מִבְצְרֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּח בָּאֵשׁ וּבַחֻרֵיהֶם בַּחֶרֶב תַּהֲרֹג
וְעֹלְלֵיהֶם תְּרַטֵּשׁ וְהָרֹתֵיהֶם תְּבַקֵּעַ׃

verses.english:
“But how,” asked Hazael, “can your servant, who is a mere dog,
perform such a mighty deed?” Elisha replied, “YHWH has shown me a
vision of you as king of Aram.”

recover.”

In the fifth year of King Joram son of Ahab of Israel—Jehoshaphat
had been king of Judah—Joram son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
became king.

In the fifth year of King Joram son of Ahab of Israel—Jehoshaphat

became king.

translation.text: In the fifth year of King Joram son of Ahab of Israel, Jehoram son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah began to reign.

verses.english:
He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in
Jerusalem eight years.

english.text:
He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in
Jerusalem eight years.

translation.text: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He followed the practices of the kings of Israel—whatever the
House of Ahab did, for he had married a daughter of Ahab—and he
did what was displeasing to YHWH.

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ בֵּית אַחְאָב כִּי בַּת־אַחְאָב הָיְתָה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

He followed the practices of the kings of Israel—whatever the
House of Ahab did, for he had married a daughter of Ahab—and he
did what was displeasing to YHWH.

verses.english:
However, YHWH refrained from destroying Judah, for the sake of His
servant David, in accordance with His promise to maintain a lamp
for his descendants for all time.

However, YHWH refrained from destroying Judah, for the sake of His
servant David, in accordance with His promise to maintain a lamp
for his descendants for all time.

verses.english:
During his reign, the Edomites rebelled against Judah’s rule and
set up a king of their own.
verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו פָּשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד־יְהוּדָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
During his reign, the Edomites rebelled against Judah’s rule and
set up a king of their own.

translation.text: In his days Edom revolted against the rule of Judah, and set up a king of their own.

verses.english:
Joram crossed over to Zair with all his chariotry. He arose by
night and attacked the Edomites, who were surrounding him and the
chariot commanders; but his troops fled to their homes.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יוֹרָם צָעִירָה וְכל־הָרֶכֶב עִמּוֹ וַיְהִי־הוּא קָם לַיְלָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם הַסֹּבֵיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב וַיָּנס הָעָם לְאֹהָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יוֹרָם צָעִירָה וְכל־הָרֶכֶב עִמּוֹ וַיְהִי־הוּא קָם לַיְלָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם הַסֹּבֵיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב וַיָּנס הָעָם לְאֹהָלָיו׃

english.text:
Joram crossed over to Zair with all his chariotry. He arose by
night and attacked the Edomites, who were surrounding him and the
chariot commanders; but his troops fled to their homes.

translation.text: Then Joram crossed over to Zair with all his chariot commanders who had surrounded him; but his army fled home.

verses.english:
Thus Edom fell away from Judah, as is still the case. Libnah
likewise fell away at that time.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד־יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָז תִּפְשַׁע לִבְנָה בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד־יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָז תִּפְשַׁע לִבְנָה בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

english.text:
Thus Edom fell away from Judah, as is still the case. Libnah
likewise fell away at that time.

translation.text: So Edom has been in revolt against the rule of Judah to this day. Libnah also revolted at the same time.

verses.english:
The other events of Joram’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

english.text:
The other events of Joram’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
Joram slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in
the City of David; his son Ahaziah succeeded him as king.

english.text:
Joram slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in

In the twelfth year of King Joram son of Ahab of Israel, Ahaziah
son of Joram became king of Judah.

verses.english:
Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he
reigned in Jerusalem one year; his mother’s name was Athaliah
daughter of King Omri of Israel.

Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he
reigned in Jerusalem one year; his mother’s name was Athaliah
daughter of King Omri of Israel.

verses.english:
He walked in the ways of the House of Ahab and did what was
displeasing to YHWH, like the House of Ahab, for he was related by
marriage to the House of Ahab.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּבֵית אַחְאָב כִּי חֲתַן בֵּית־אַחְאָב הוּא׃

english.text:
He walked in the ways of the House of Ahab and did what was
displeasing to YHWH, like the House of Ahab, for he was related by
marriage to the House of Ahab.

translation.text: He also walked in the way of the house of Ahab, doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for he was son-in-law to the house of Ahab.

verses.english:
He marched with Joram son of Ahab to battle against King Hazael of
Aram at Ramoth-gilead, but the Arameans wounded Joram.

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶת־יוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיַּכּוּ אֲרַמִּים אֶת־יוֹרָם׃

english.text:
He marched with Joram son of Ahab to battle against King Hazael of
Aram at Ramoth-gilead, but the Arameans wounded Joram.

translation.text: He went with Joram son of Ahab to wage war against King Hazael of Aram at Ramoth-gilead, where the Arameans wounded Joram.

verses.english:
King Joram retired to Jezreel to recover from the wounds which the
Arameans had inflicted upon him at Ramah, when he fought against
King Hazael of Aram. And King Ahaziah son of Joram of Judah went
down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab while he was ill.

וַיָּשׁב יוֹרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּא בְיִזְרְעֶאל מִן־הַמַּכִּים אֲשֶׁר יַכֻּהוּ אֲרַמִּים בָּרָמָה בְּהִלָּחֲמוֹ אֶת־חֲזָהאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ
יְהוּדָה יָרַד לִרְאוֹת אֶת־יוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב יוֹרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּא בְיִזְרְעֶאל מִן־הַמַּכִּים אֲשֶׁר יַכֻּהוּ אֲרַמִּים בָּרָמָה בְּהִלָּחֲמוֹ אֶת־חֲזָהאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ
יְהוּדָה יָרַד לִרְאוֹת אֶת־יוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא׃

english.text:
King Joram retired to Jezreel to recover from the wounds which the
Arameans had inflicted upon him at Ramah, when he fought against
King Hazael of Aram. And King Ahaziah son of Joram of Judah went
down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab while he was ill.

translation.text: see Joram son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was wounded.

verses.english:
Then the prophet Elisha summoned one of the disciples of the
prophets and said to him, “Tie up your skirts, and take along this
flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע הַנָּבִיא קָרָא לְאַחַד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חֲגֹר מתְנֶיךָ וְקַח פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וְלֵךְ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע הַנָּבִיא קָרָא לְאַחַד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חֲגֹר מתְנֶיךָ וְקַח פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וְלֵךְ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
Then the prophet Elisha summoned one of the disciples of the
prophets and said to him, “Tie up your skirts, and take along this
flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.

translation.text: Then the prophet Elisha called a member of the company of prophets and said to him, "Gird up your loins; take this flask of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.english:
When you arrive there, go and see Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of
Nimshi; get him to leave his comrades, and take him into an inner
room.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאתָ־שָּׁמָּה וּרְאֵה־שָׁם יֵהוּא בֶן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁי וּבָאתָ וַהֲקֵמֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ אֶחָיו וְהֵבֵיאתָ אֹתוֹ חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאתָ־שָּׁמָּה וּרְאֵה־שָׁם יֵהוּא בֶן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁי וּבָאתָ וַהֲקֵמֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ אֶחָיו וְהֵבֵיאתָ אֹתוֹ חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃

english.text:
When you arrive there, go and see Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of
Nimshi; get him to leave his comrades, and take him into an inner
room.

translation.text: When you arrive, look there for Jehu son companions, and take him into an inner chamber.

verses.english:
Then take the flask of oil and pour some on his head, and say,
‘Thus said YHWH: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the
door and flee without delay.”
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ פַךְ־הַשֶּׁמֶן וְיָצַקְתָּ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָתַחְתָּ הַדֶּלֶת וְנַסְתָּה וְלֹא תְחַכֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ פַךְ־הַשֶּׁמֶן וְיָצַקְתָּ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָתַחְתָּ הַדֶּלֶת וְנַסְתָּה וְלֹא תְחַכֶּה׃

english.text:
Then take the flask of oil and pour some on his head, and say,
‘Thus said YHWH: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the
door and flee without delay.”

translation.text: Then take the flask of oil, pour it on his head, and say, 'Thus says the LORD: I anoint you king over Israel.' Then open the door and flee; do not linger."

verses.english: The young man, the servant of the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנַּעַר הַנַּעַר הַנָּבִיא רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנַּעַר הַנַּעַר הַנָּבִיא רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃

english.text: The young man, the servant of the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

translation.text: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.english:
When he arrived, the army commanders were sitting together. He
said, “Commander, I have a message for you.” “For which one of
us?” Jehu asked. He answered, “For you, commander.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וְהִנֵּה שָׂרֵי הַחַיִל יֹשְׁבִים וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַשָּׂר וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא אֶל־מִי מִכֻּלָּנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיךָ הַשָּׂר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא וְהִנֵּה שָׂרֵי הַחַיִל יֹשְׁבִים וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַשָּׂר וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא אֶל־מִי מִכֻּלָּנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיךָ הַשָּׂר׃

english.text:
When he arrived, the army commanders were sitting together. He
said, “Commander, I have a message for you.” “For which one of
us?” Jehu asked. He answered, “For you, commander.”

translation.text: He of us?" asked Jehu. "For you, commander."

verses.english:
So [Jehu] arose and went inside; and [the disciple] poured the oil
on his head, and said to him, “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel:
I anoint you king over the people of YHWH, over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיָּבֹא הַבַּיְתָה וַיִּצֹק הַשֶּׁמֶן אֶל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־עַם יְהֹוָה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיָּבֹא הַבַּיְתָה וַיִּצֹק הַשֶּׁמֶן אֶל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־עַם יְהֹוָה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So [Jehu] arose and went inside; and [the disciple] poured the oil
on his head, and said to him, “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel:
I anoint you king over the people of YHWH, over Israel.

translation.text: So Jehu got up and went the LORD, over Israel.

verses.english:
You shall strike down the House of Ahab your master; thus will I
avenge on Jezebel the blood of My servants the prophets, and the
blood of the other servants of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־בֵּית אַחְאָב אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְנִקַּמְתִּי דְּמֵי עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים וּדְמֵי כּל־עַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אִיזָבֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־בֵּית אַחְאָב אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְנִקַּמְתִּי דְּמֵי עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים וּדְמֵי כּל־עַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אִיזָבֶל׃

english.text:
You shall strike down the House of Ahab your master; thus will I
avenge on Jezebel the blood of My servants the prophets, and the
blood of the other servants of YHWH.

translation.text: You shall strike down the house of your master prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD.

verses.english:
The whole House of Ahab shall perish, and I will cut off every
male belonging to Ahab, bond and free in Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאָבַד כּל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאָבַד כּל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The whole House of Ahab shall perish, and I will cut off every
male belonging to Ahab, bond and free in Israel.

translation.text: For the whole or free, in Israel.

verses.english:
I will make the House of Ahab like the House of Jeroboam son of
Nebat, and like the House of Baasha son of Ahijah.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּית אַחְאָב כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וּכְבֵית בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּית אַחְאָב כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וּכְבֵית בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה׃

english.text:
I will make the House of Ahab like the House of Jeroboam son of
Nebat, and like the House of Baasha son of Ahijah.

translation.text: I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.

verses.english:
The dogs shall devour Jezebel in the field of Jezreel, with none
to bury her.” Then he opened the door and fled.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אִיזֶבֶל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל וְאֵין קֹבֵר וַיִּפְתַּח הַדֶּלֶת וַיָּנֹס׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־אִיזֶבֶל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל וְאֵין קֹבֵר וַיִּפְתַּח הַדֶּלֶת וַיָּנֹס׃

english.text:
The dogs shall devour Jezebel in the field of Jezreel, with none
to bury her.” Then he opened the door and fled.

translation.text: The dogs shall eat Jezebel in the territory of Jezreel, and no one shall bury her." Then he opened the door and fled.

verses.english:
Jehu went out to the other officers of his master, and they asked
him, “Is all well? What did that madman come to you for?” He said
to them, “You know the man and his ranting!”
verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא יָצָא אֶל־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲשָׁלוֹם מַדּוּעַ בָּא־הַמְשֻׁגָּע הַזֶּה אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־שִׂיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא יָצָא אֶל־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲשָׁלוֹם מַדּוּעַ בָּא־הַמְשֻׁגָּע הַזֶּה אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־שִׂיחוֹ׃

english.text:
Jehu went out to the other officers of his master, and they asked
him, “Is all well? What did that madman come to you for?” He said
to them, “You know the man and his ranting!”

translation.text: When Jehu came back to his master's officers, they said to him, "Is answered them, "You know the sort and how they babble."

verses.english:
“You’re lying,” they said. “Tell us [the truth].” Then he replied,
“Thus and thus he said: Thus said YHWH: I anoint you king over
Israel!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שֶׁקֶר הַגֶּד־נָא לָנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת אָמַר אֵלַי לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שֶׁקֶר הַגֶּד־נָא לָנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת אָמַר אֵלַי לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“You’re lying,” they said. “Tell us [the truth].” Then he replied,
“Thus and thus he said: Thus said YHWH: I anoint you king over
Israel!”

translation.text: They said, "Liar! Come on, tell us!" So he said, "This is just what he said to me: 'Thus says the LORD, I anoint you king over Israel.'"

verses.english:
Quickly each man took his cloak and placed it under him, on the
top step. They sounded the horn and proclaimed, “Jehu is king!”
verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ בִּגְדוֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ תַחְתָּיו אֶל־גֶּרֶם הַמַּעֲלוֹת וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָלַךְ יֵהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ בִּגְדוֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ תַחְתָּיו אֶל־גֶּרֶם הַמַּעֲלוֹת וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָלַךְ יֵהוּא׃

english.text:
Quickly each man took his cloak and placed it under him, on the
top step. They sounded the horn and proclaimed, “Jehu is king!”

translation.text: Then bare steps; and they blew the trumpet, and proclaimed, "Jehu is king."

verses.english:
Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi conspired against
Joram. Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth-gilead
against King Hazael of Aram,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַשֵּׁר יֵהוּא בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁי אֶל־יוֹרָם וְיוֹרָם הָיָה שֹׁמֵר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד הוּא וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַשֵּׁר יֵהוּא בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁי אֶל־יוֹרָם וְיוֹרָם הָיָה שֹׁמֵר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד הוּא וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם׃

english.text:
Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi conspired against
Joram. Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth-gilead
against King Hazael of Aram,

translation.text: Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi conspired against against King Hazael of Aram;

verses.english:
but King Joram had gone back to Jezreel to recover from the wounds
which the Arameans had inflicted on him in his battle with King
Hazael of Aram. Jehu said, “If such is your wish, allow no one to
slip out of the town to go and report this in Jezreel.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּא בְיִזְרְעֶאל מִן־הַמַּכִּים אֲשֶׁר יַכֻּהוּ אֲרַמִּים בְּהִלָּחֲמוֹ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא אִם־יֵשׁ נַפְשְׁכֶם אַל־יֵצֵא
פָלִיט מִן־הָעִיר לָלֶכֶת (לגיד) [לְהַגִּיד] בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּא בְיִזְרְעֶאל מִן־הַמַּכִּים אֲשֶׁר יַכֻּהוּ אֲרַמִּים בְּהִלָּחֲמוֹ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא אִם־יֵשׁ נַפְשְׁכֶם אַל־יֵצֵא
פָלִיט מִן־הָעִיר לָלֶכֶת (לגיד) [לְהַגִּיד] בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
but King Joram had gone back to Jezreel to recover from the wounds
which the Arameans had inflicted on him in his battle with King
Hazael of Aram. Jehu said, “If such is your wish, allow no one to
slip out of the town to go and report this in Jezreel.”

translation.text: but King Joram had returned to be this is your wish, then let no one slip out of the city to go and tell the news in Jezreel."

verses.english:
Then Jehu mounted his chariot and drove to Jezreel; for Joram was
lying ill there, and King Ahaziah of Judah had gone down to visit
Joram.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב יֵהוּא וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה כִּי יוֹרָם שֹׁכֵב שָׁמָּה וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה יָרַד לִרְאוֹת אֶת־יוֹרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְכַּב יֵהוּא וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה כִּי יוֹרָם שֹׁכֵב שָׁמָּה וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה יָרַד לִרְאוֹת אֶת־יוֹרָם׃

english.text:
Then Jehu mounted his chariot and drove to Jezreel; for Joram was
lying ill there, and King Ahaziah of Judah had gone down to visit
Joram.

translation.text: Then Jehu mounted his chariot and went to down to visit Joram.

verses.english:
The lookout was stationed on the tower in Jezreel, and he saw the
troop of Jehu as he approached. He called out, “I see a troop!”
Joram said, “Dispatch a horseman to meet them and let him ask: Is
all well?”
verses.hebrew:
וְהַצֹּפֶה עֹמֵד עַל־הַמִּגְדָּל בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וַיַּרְא אֶת־שִׁפְעַת יֵהוּא בְּבֹאוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁפְעַת אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹרָם קַח רַכָּב וּשְׁלַח לִקְרָאתָם וְיֹאמַר
הֲשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַצֹּפֶה עֹמֵד עַל־הַמִּגְדָּל בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וַיַּרְא אֶת־שִׁפְעַת יֵהוּא בְּבֹאוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁפְעַת אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹרָם קַח רַכָּב וּשְׁלַח לִקְרָאתָם וְיֹאמַר
הֲשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
The lookout was stationed on the tower in Jezreel, and he saw the
troop of Jehu as he approached. He called out, “I see a troop!”
Joram said, “Dispatch a horseman to meet them and let him ask: Is
all well?”

translation.text: In Jezreel, the sentinel standing on the tower spied the company of horseman; send him to meet them, and let him say, 'Is it peace?'"

verses.english:
The horseman went to meet him, and he said, “The king inquires: Is
all well?” Jehu replied, “What concern of yours is it whether all
is well? Fall in behind me.” The lookout reported: “The messenger
has reached them, but has not turned back.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ רֹכֵב הַסּוּס לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא מַה־לְּךָ וּלְשָׁלוֹם סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרָי וַיַּגֵּד הַצֹּפֶה לֵאמֹר בָּא־הַמַּלְאָךְ
עַד־הֵם וְלֹא־שָׁב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ רֹכֵב הַסּוּס לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא מַה־לְּךָ וּלְשָׁלוֹם סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרָי וַיַּגֵּד הַצֹּפֶה לֵאמֹר בָּא־הַמַּלְאָךְ
עַד־הֵם וְלֹא־שָׁב׃

english.text:
The horseman went to meet him, and he said, “The king inquires: Is
all well?” Jehu replied, “What concern of yours is it whether all
is well? Fall in behind me.” The lookout reported: “The messenger
has reached them, but has not turned back.”

translation.text: So them, but he is not coming back."

verses.english:
So he sent out a second horseman. He came to them and said, “Thus
says the king: Is all well?” Jehu answered, “What concern of yours
is it whether all is well? Fall in behind me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח רֹכֵב סוּס שֵׁנִי וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא מַה־לְּךָ וּלְשָׁלוֹם סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח רֹכֵב סוּס שֵׁנִי וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא מַה־לְּךָ וּלְשָׁלוֹם סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרָי׃

english.text:
So he sent out a second horseman. He came to them and said, “Thus
says the king: Is all well?” Jehu answered, “What concern of yours
is it whether all is well? Fall in behind me.”

translation.text: Then he sent out a second behind me."

verses.english:
And the lookout reported, “The messenger has reached them, but has
not turned back. And it looks like the driving of Jehu son of
Nimshi, who drives wildly.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד הַצֹּפֶה לֵאמֹר בָּא עַד־אֲלֵיהֶם וְלֹא־שָׁב וְהַמִּנְהָג כְּמִנְהַג יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי כִּי בְשִׁגָּעוֹן יִנְהָג׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד הַצֹּפֶה לֵאמֹר בָּא עַד־אֲלֵיהֶם וְלֹא־שָׁב וְהַמִּנְהָג כְּמִנְהַג יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי כִּי בְשִׁגָּעוֹן יִנְהָג׃

english.text:
And the lookout reported, “The messenger has reached them, but has
not turned back. And it looks like the driving of Jehu son of
Nimshi, who drives wildly.”

translation.text: Again the sentinel reported, "He reached them, but he is not coming back. It looks like the driving of Jehu son of Nimshi; for he drives like a maniac."

verses.english:
Joram ordered, “Hitch up [the chariot]!” They hitched up his
chariot; and King Joram of Israel and King Ahaziah of Judah went
out, each in his own chariot, to meet Jehu. They met him at the
field of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹרָם אֱסֹר וַיֶּאְסֹר רִכְבּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אִישׁ בְּרִכְבּוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת יֵהוּא וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ
בְּחֶלְקַת נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹרָם אֱסֹר וַיֶּאְסֹר רִכְבּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אִישׁ בְּרִכְבּוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת יֵהוּא וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ
בְּחֶלְקַת נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃

english.text:
Joram ordered, “Hitch up [the chariot]!” They hitched up his
chariot; and King Joram of Israel and King Ahaziah of Judah went
out, each in his own chariot, to meet Jehu. They met him at the
field of Naboth the Jezreelite.

translation.text: Joram said, "Get ready." And they got his chariot ready. Then King Joram of Israel and King Ahaziah of Judah set out, each in his chariot, Jezreelite.

verses.english:
When Joram saw Jehu, he asked, “Is all well, Jehu?” But Jehu
replied, “How can all be well as long as your mother Jezebel
carries on her countless harlotries and sorceries?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת יְהוֹרָם אֶת־יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַשָּׁלוֹם עַד־זְנוּנֵי אִיזֶבֶל אִמְּךָ וּכְשָׁפֶיהָ הָרַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת יְהוֹרָם אֶת־יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַשָּׁלוֹם עַד־זְנוּנֵי אִיזֶבֶל אִמְּךָ וּכְשָׁפֶיהָ הָרַבִּים׃

english.text:
When Joram saw Jehu, he asked, “Is all well, Jehu?” But Jehu
replied, “How can all be well as long as your mother Jezebel
carries on her countless harlotries and sorceries?”

translation.text: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, "Is it peace, Jehu?" He and sorceries of your mother Jezebel continue?"

verses.english:
Thereupon Joram turned his horses around and fled, crying out to
Ahaziah, “Treason, Ahaziah!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהוֹרָם יָדָיו וַיָּנֹס וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מִרְמָה אֲחַזְיָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהוֹרָם יָדָיו וַיָּנֹס וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מִרְמָה אֲחַזְיָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon Joram turned his horses around and fled, crying out to
Ahaziah, “Treason, Ahaziah!”

translation.text: Then Joram reined about and fled, saying to Ahaziah, "Treason, Ahaziah!"

verses.english:
But Jehu drew his bow and hit Joram between the shoulders, so that
the arrow pierced his heart; and he collapsed in his chariot.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא מִלֵּא יָדוֹ בַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּךְ אֶת־יְהוֹרָם בֵּין זְרֹעָיו וַיֵּצֵא הַחֵצִי מִלִּבּוֹ וַיִּכְרַע בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא מִלֵּא יָדוֹ בַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּךְ אֶת־יְהוֹרָם בֵּין זְרֹעָיו וַיֵּצֵא הַחֵצִי מִלִּבּוֹ וַיִּכְרַע בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
But Jehu drew his bow and hit Joram between the shoulders, so that
the arrow pierced his heart; and he collapsed in his chariot.

translation.text: Jehu drew his bow with all his strength, and shot Joram between the shoulders, so that the arrow pierced his heart; and he sank in his chariot.

verses.english:
Jehu thereupon ordered his officer Bidkar, “Pick him up and throw
him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. Remember how you and
I were riding side by side behind his father Ahab, when YHWH made
this pronouncement about him:
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בִּדְקַר שָׁלִשֹׁה שָׂא הַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּחֶלְקַת שְׂדֵה נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי כִּי־זְכֹר אֲנִי וָאַתָּה אֵת רֹכְבִים צְמָדִים אַחֲרֵי אַחְאָב אָבִיו וַיהֹוָה נָשָׂא
עָלָיו אֶת־הַמַּשָּׂא הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בִּדְקַר שָׁלִשֹׁה שָׂא הַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּחֶלְקַת שְׂדֵה נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי כִּי־זְכֹר אֲנִי וָאַתָּה אֵת רֹכְבִים צְמָדִים אַחֲרֵי אַחְאָב אָבִיו וַיהֹוָה נָשָׂא
עָלָיו אֶת־הַמַּשָּׂא הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Jehu thereupon ordered his officer Bidkar, “Pick him up and throw
him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. Remember how you and
I were riding side by side behind his father Ahab, when YHWH made
this pronouncement about him:

translation.text: Jehu this oracle against him:

verses.english:
‘I swear, I have taken note of the blood of Naboth and the blood
of his sons yesterday—declares YHWH. And I will requite you in
this plot—declares YHWH.’ So pick him up and throw him unto the
plot in accordance with the word of YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
אִם־לֹא אֶת־דְּמֵי נָבוֹת וְאֶת־דְּמֵי בָנָיו רָאִיתִי אֶמֶשׁ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה וְשִׁלַּמְתִּי לְךָ בַּחֶלְקָה הַזֹּאת נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה שָׂא הַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בַּחֶלְקָה כִּדְבַר
יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־לֹא אֶת־דְּמֵי נָבוֹת וְאֶת־דְּמֵי בָנָיו רָאִיתִי אֶמֶשׁ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה וְשִׁלַּמְתִּי לְךָ בַּחֶלְקָה הַזֹּאת נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה שָׂא הַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בַּחֶלְקָה כִּדְבַר
יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
‘I swear, I have taken note of the blood of Naboth and the blood
of his sons yesterday—declares YHWH. And I will requite you in
this plot—declares YHWH.’ So pick him up and throw him unto the
plot in accordance with the word of YHWH.”

translation.text: 'For the blood of Naboth and for the blood of his children that I saw yesterday, says the LORD, I swear I will repay him on the plot of ground, in accordance with the word of the LORD."

verses.english:
On seeing this, King Ahaziah of Judah fled along the road to
Beth-haggan. Jehu pursued him and said, “Shoot him down too!” [And
they shot him] in his chariot at the ascent of Gur, which is near
Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo and died there.
verses.hebrew:
וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָאָה וַיָּנס דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַגָּן וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֹתוֹ הַכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה בְּמַעֲלֵה־גוּר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יִבְלְעָם
וַיָּנס מְגִדּוֹ וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָאָה וַיָּנס דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַגָּן וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֹתוֹ הַכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה בְּמַעֲלֵה־גוּר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יִבְלְעָם
וַיָּנס מְגִדּוֹ וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
On seeing this, King Ahaziah of Judah fled along the road to
Beth-haggan. Jehu pursued him and said, “Shoot him down too!” [And
they shot him] in his chariot at the ascent of Gur, which is near
Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo and died there.

translation.text: When King Ahaziah of Judah saw this, he fled in the direction of he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

verses.english:
His servants conveyed him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and they
buried him in his grave with his fathers, in the City of David.

He looked up toward the window and said, “Who is on my side, who?”

“Throw her down,” he said. They threw her down; and her blood

Then he went inside and ate and drank. And he said, “Attend to

So they went to bury her; but all they found of her were the
skull, the feet, and the hands.

So they went to bury her; but all they found of her were the

and the carcass of Jezebel shall be like dung on the ground, in
the field of Jezreel, so that none will be able to say: ‘This was
Jezebel.’”

verses.english:
Ahab had seventy descendants in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and
sent them to Samaria, to the elders and officials of Jezreel and
to the guardians of [the children] of Ahab, as follows:
verses.hebrew: וּלְאַחְאָב שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב יֵהוּא סְפָרִים וַיִּשְׁלַח שֹׁמְרוֹן אֶל־שָׂרֵי יִזְרְעֶאל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הָאֹמְנִים אַחְאָב לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאַחְאָב שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב יֵהוּא סְפָרִים וַיִּשְׁלַח שֹׁמְרוֹן אֶל־שָׂרֵי יִזְרְעֶאל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הָאֹמְנִים אַחְאָב לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Ahab had seventy descendants in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and
sent them to Samaria, to the elders and officials of Jezreel and
to the guardians of [the children] of Ahab, as follows:

translation.text: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying,

verses.english:
“Now, when this letter reaches you—since your master’s sons are
with you and you also have chariots and horses, and a fortified
city and weapons—
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֲלֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם בְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם הָרֶכֶב וְהַסּוּסִים וְעִיר מִבְצָר וְהַנָּשֶׁק׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֲלֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם בְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם הָרֶכֶב וְהַסּוּסִים וְעִיר מִבְצָר וְהַנָּשֶׁק׃

english.text:
“Now, when this letter reaches you—since your master’s sons are
with you and you also have chariots and horses, and a fortified
city and weapons—

translation.text: "Since your master's sons are with you and you have at your disposal chariots and horses, a fortified city, and weapons,

verses.english:
select the best and the most suitable of your master’s sons and
set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s
house.”
verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתֶם הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר מִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל־כִּסֵּא אָבִיו וְהִלָּחֲמוּ עַל־בֵּית אֲדֹנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּרְאִיתֶם הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר מִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל־כִּסֵּא אָבִיו וְהִלָּחֲמוּ עַל־בֵּית אֲדֹנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
select the best and the most suitable of your master’s sons and
set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s
house.”

translation.text: select the son of your master who is the best house."

verses.english:
But they were overcome by fear, for they thought, “If the two
kings could not stand up to him, how can we?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
But they were overcome by fear, for they thought, “If the two
kings could not stand up to him, how can we?”

translation.text: But they were utterly terrified and said, "Look, two kings could not withstand him; how then can we stand?"

verses.english:
The steward of the palace and the governor of the city and the
elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: “We are your
subjects, and we shall do whatever you tell us to. We shall not
proclaim anyone king; do whatever you like.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעִיר וְהַזְּקֵנִים וְהָאֹמְנִים אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמַר אֵלֵינוּ נַעֲשֶׂה לֹא־נַמְלִךְ אִישׁ

But when the letter reached them, they took the princes and
slaughtered all seventy of them; they put their heads in baskets
and sent them to him in Jezreel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶם בַּדּוּדִים וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶם בַּדּוּדִים וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

english.text:
But when the letter reached them, they took the princes and
slaughtered all seventy of them; they put their heads in baskets
and sent them to him in Jezreel.

translation.text: When the letter reached them, their heads in baskets and sent them to him at Jezreel.

verses.english:
A messenger came and reported to him: “They have brought the heads
of the princes.” He said, “Pile them up in two heaps at the
entrance of the gate before morning.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הֵבִיאוּ רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ אֹתָם שְׁנֵי צִבֻּרִים פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הֵבִיאוּ רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ אֹתָם שְׁנֵי צִבֻּרִים פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
A messenger came and reported to him: “They have brought the heads
of the princes.” He said, “Pile them up in two heaps at the
entrance of the gate before morning.”

translation.text: When the gate until the morning."

verses.english:
In the morning he went out and stood there; and he said to all the
people, “Are you blameless? True, I conspired against my master
and killed him; but who struck down all of these?
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כּל־הָעָם צַדִּקִים אַתֶּם הִנֵּה אֲנִי קָשַׁרְתִּי עַל־אֲדֹנִי וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ וּמִי הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כּל־הָעָם צַדִּקִים אַתֶּם הִנֵּה אֲנִי קָשַׁרְתִּי עַל־אֲדֹנִי וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ וּמִי הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
In the morning he went out and stood there; and he said to all the
people, “Are you blameless? True, I conspired against my master
and killed him; but who struck down all of these?

translation.text: Then in the morning when he went out, he these?

verses.english:
Know, then, that nothing that YHWH has spoken concerning the House
of Ahab shall remain unfulfilled, for YHWH has done what he
announced through His servant Elijah.”
verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ אֵפוֹא כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל מִדְּבַר יְהֹוָה אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עַל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיהֹוָה עָשָׂה אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: דְּעוּ אֵפוֹא כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל מִדְּבַר יְהֹוָה אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עַל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיהֹוָה עָשָׂה אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Know, then, that nothing that YHWH has spoken concerning the House
of Ahab shall remain unfulfilled, for YHWH has done what he
announced through His servant Elijah.”

translation.text: Know then that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spoke concerning the house of Ahab; for the LORD has done what he said through his servant Elijah."

verses.english:
And Jehu struck down all that were left of the House of Ahab in
Jezreel—and all his notables, intimates, and priests—till he left
him no survivor.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ יֵהוּא אֵת כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְבֵית־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וְכל־גְּדֹלָיו וּמְיֻדָּעָיו וְכֹהֲנָיו עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ יֵהוּא אֵת כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְבֵית־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וְכל־גְּדֹלָיו וּמְיֻדָּעָיו וְכֹהֲנָיו עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
And Jehu struck down all that were left of the House of Ahab in
Jezreel—and all his notables, intimates, and priests—till he left
him no survivor.

translation.text: So leaders, close friends, and priests, until he left him no survivor.

verses.english:
He then set out for Samaria. On the way, when he was at Beth-eked
of the shepherds,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן הוּא בֵּית־עֵקֶד הָרֹעִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן הוּא בֵּית־עֵקֶד הָרֹעִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
He then set out for Samaria. On the way, when he was at Beth-eked
of the shepherds,

translation.text: Then he set out and went to Samaria. On the way, when he was at Beth-eked of the Shepherds,

verses.english:
Jehu came upon the kinsmen of King Ahaziah of Judah. “Who are
you?” he asked. They replied, “We are the kinsmen of Ahaziah, and
we have come to pay our respects to the sons of the king and the
sons of the queen mother.”
verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא מָצָא אֶת־אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וַנֵּרֶד לִשְׁלוֹם בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבְנֵי הַגְּבִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא מָצָא אֶת־אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וַנֵּרֶד לִשְׁלוֹם בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבְנֵי הַגְּבִירָה׃

english.text:
Jehu came upon the kinsmen of King Ahaziah of Judah. “Who are
you?” he asked. They replied, “We are the kinsmen of Ahaziah, and
we have come to pay our respects to the sons of the king and the
sons of the queen mother.”

translation.text: Jehu met relatives of King Ahaziah of the queen mother."

verses.english:
