“Take them alive!” he said. They took them alive and then
slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two of them; he
did not spare a single one.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּשְׁחָטוּם אֶל־בּוֹר בֵּית־עֵקֶד אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְלֹא־הִשְׁאִיר אִישׁ מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּשְׁחָטוּם אֶל־בּוֹר בֵּית־עֵקֶד אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְלֹא־הִשְׁאִיר אִישׁ מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
“Take them alive!” he said. They took them alive and then
slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two of them; he
did not spare a single one.

translation.text: He said, "Take them alive." They took them alive, and slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two in all; he spared none of them.

verses.english:
He went on from there, and he met Jehonadab son of Rechab coming
toward him. He greeted him and said to him, “Are you as
wholehearted with me as I am with you?” “I am,” Jehonadab replied.
“If so,” [said Jehu,] “give me your hand.” He gave him his hand
and [Jehu] helped him into the chariot.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־יְהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲיֵשׁ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ יָשָׁר כַּאֲשֶׁר לְבָבִי עִם־לְבָבֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָדָב יֵשׁ
וָיֵשׁ תְּנָה אֶת־יָדֶךָ וַיִּתֵּן יָדוֹ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֵלָיו אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־יְהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲיֵשׁ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ יָשָׁר כַּאֲשֶׁר לְבָבִי עִם־לְבָבֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָדָב יֵשׁ
וָיֵשׁ תְּנָה אֶת־יָדֶךָ וַיִּתֵּן יָדוֹ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֵלָיו אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

english.text:
He went on from there, and he met Jehonadab son of Rechab coming
toward him. He greeted him and said to him, “Are you as
wholehearted with me as I am with you?” “I am,” Jehonadab replied.
“If so,” [said Jehu,] “give me your hand.” He gave him his hand
and [Jehu] helped him into the chariot.

translation.text: When he left there, he met Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to mine as mine is to yours?" Jehonadab answered, "It is." Jehu said, "If it with him into the chariot.

verses.english:
“Come with me,” he said, “and see my zeal for YHWH.” And he was
taken along in the chariot.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכָה אִתִּי וּרְאֵה בְּקִנְאָתִי לַיהֹוָה וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכָה אִתִּי וּרְאֵה בְּקִנְאָתִי לַיהֹוָה וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Come with me,” he said, “and see my zeal for YHWH.” And he was
taken along in the chariot.

translation.text: He said, "Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD." So he had him ride in his chariot.

verses.english:
Arriving in Samaria, [Jehu] struck down all the survivors of [the
House of] Ahab in Samaria, until he wiped it out, fulfilling the
word that YHWH had spoken to Elijah.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְאַחְאָב בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְאַחְאָב בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Arriving in Samaria, [Jehu] struck down all the survivors of [the
House of] Ahab in Samaria, until he wiped it out, fulfilling the
word that YHWH had spoken to Elijah.

translation.text: When he came to Elijah.

verses.english:
Jehu assembled all the people and said to them, “Ahab served Baal
little; Jehu shall serve him much!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ יֵהוּא אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַחְאָב עָבַד אֶת־הַבַּעַל מְעָט יֵהוּא יַעַבְדֶנּוּ הַרְבֵּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּץ יֵהוּא אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַחְאָב עָבַד אֶת־הַבַּעַל מְעָט יֵהוּא יַעַבְדֶנּוּ הַרְבֵּה׃

english.text:
Jehu assembled all the people and said to them, “Ahab served Baal
little; Jehu shall serve him much!

translation.text: Then Jehu assembled all the people and said to them, "Ahab offered Baal small service; but Jehu will offer much more.

verses.english:
Therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his
worshipers, and all his priests: let no one fail to come, for I am
going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever fails to come
shall forfeit his life.” Jehu was acting with guile in order to
exterminate the worshipers of Baal.
verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה כל־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל כּל־עֹבְדָיו וְכל־כֹּהֲנָיו קִרְאוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יִפָּקֵד כִּי זֶבַח גָּדוֹל לִי לַבַּעַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יִפָּקֵד לֹא יִחְיֶה וְיֵהוּא עָשָׂה
בְעקְבָּה לְמַעַן הַאֲבִיד אֶת־עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה כל־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל כּל־עֹבְדָיו וְכל־כֹּהֲנָיו קִרְאוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יִפָּקֵד כִּי זֶבַח גָּדוֹל לִי לַבַּעַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יִפָּקֵד לֹא יִחְיֶה וְיֵהוּא עָשָׂה
בְעקְבָּה לְמַעַן הַאֲבִיד אֶת־עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל׃

english.text:
Therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his
worshipers, and all his priests: let no one fail to come, for I am
going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever fails to come
shall forfeit his life.” Jehu was acting with guile in order to
exterminate the worshipers of Baal.

translation.text: Now and all his priests; let none be missing, for I have a great sacrifice to with cunning in order to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

verses.english:
Jehu gave orders to convoke a solemn assembly for Baal, and one
was proclaimed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא קַדְּשׁוּ עֲצָרָה לַבַּעַל וַיִּקְרָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא קַדְּשׁוּ עֲצָרָה לַבַּעַל וַיִּקְרָאוּ׃

english.text:
Jehu gave orders to convoke a solemn assembly for Baal, and one
was proclaimed.

translation.text: Jehu decreed, "Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal." So they proclaimed it.

verses.english:
Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the worshipers of Baal
came, not a single one remained behind. They came into the temple
of Baal, and the temple of Baal was filled from end to end.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יֵהוּא בְּכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בָא וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיִּמָּלֵא בֵית־הַבַּעַל פֶּה לָפֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יֵהוּא בְּכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בָא וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיִּמָּלֵא בֵית־הַבַּעַל פֶּה לָפֶה׃

english.text:
Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the worshipers of Baal
came, not a single one remained behind. They came into the temple
of Baal, and the temple of Baal was filled from end to end.

translation.text: Jehu sent word throughout all Israel; all the worshipers of Baal wall.

verses.english:
He said to the man in charge of the wardrobe, “Bring out the
vestments for all the worshipers of Baal”; and he brought
vestments out for them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמֶּלְתָּחָה הוֹצֵא לְבוּשׁ לְכֹל עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל וַיֹּצֵא לָהֶם הַמַּלְבּוּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמֶּלְתָּחָה הוֹצֵא לְבוּשׁ לְכֹל עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל וַיֹּצֵא לָהֶם הַמַּלְבּוּשׁ׃

english.text:
He said to the man in charge of the wardrobe, “Bring out the
vestments for all the worshipers of Baal”; and he brought
vestments out for them.

translation.text: He said to the keeper of the wardrobe, "Bring out the vestments for them.

verses.english:
Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab came into the temple of
Baal, and they said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search and make
sure that there are no worshipers of YHWH among you, but only
worshipers of Baal.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יֵהוּא וִיהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב בֵּית הַבָּעַל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל חַפְּשׂוּ וּרְאוּ פֶּן־יֶשׁ־פֹּה עִמָּכֶם מֵעַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל לְבַדָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יֵהוּא וִיהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב בֵּית הַבָּעַל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל חַפְּשׂוּ וּרְאוּ פֶּן־יֶשׁ־פֹּה עִמָּכֶם מֵעַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל לְבַדָּם׃

english.text:
Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab came into the temple of
Baal, and they said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search and make
sure that there are no worshipers of YHWH among you, but only
worshipers of Baal.”

translation.text: Then Jehu entered the temple of Baal with only worshipers of Baal."

verses.english:
So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. But Jehu
had stationed eighty of his men outside and had said, “Whoever
permits the escape of a single one of the men I commit to your
charge shall forfeit life for life.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים וְעֹלוֹת וְיֵהוּא שָׂם־לוֹ בַחוּץ שְׁמֹנִים אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּלֵט מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־יְדֵיכֶם נַפְשׁוֹ תַּחַת
נַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים וְעֹלוֹת וְיֵהוּא שָׂם־לוֹ בַחוּץ שְׁמֹנִים אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּלֵט מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־יְדֵיכֶם נַפְשׁוֹ תַּחַת
נַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. But Jehu
had stationed eighty of his men outside and had said, “Whoever
permits the escape of a single one of the men I commit to your
charge shall forfeit life for life.”

translation.text: Then they proceeded to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. any of those to escape whom I deliver into your hands shall forfeit his life."

verses.english:
When Jehu had finished presenting the burnt offering, he said to
the guards and to the officers, “Come in and strike them down; let
no man get away!” The guards and the officers struck them down
with the sword and left them lying where they were; then they
proceeded to the interior of the temple of Baal.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָעֹלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא לָרָצִים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁים בֹּאוּ הַכּוּם אִישׁ אַל־יֵצֵא וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ הָרָצִים וְהַשָּׁלִשִׁים
וַיֵּלְכוּ עַד־עִיר בֵּית־הַבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָעֹלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא לָרָצִים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁים בֹּאוּ הַכּוּם אִישׁ אַל־יֵצֵא וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ הָרָצִים וְהַשָּׁלִשִׁים
וַיֵּלְכוּ עַד־עִיר בֵּית־הַבָּעַל׃

english.text:
When Jehu had finished presenting the burnt offering, he said to
the guards and to the officers, “Come in and strike them down; let
no man get away!” The guards and the officers struck them down
with the sword and left them lying where they were; then they
proceeded to the interior of the temple of Baal.

translation.text: As soon as he had finished presenting the burnt offering, Jehu of Baal.

verses.english:
They brought out the pillars of the temple of Baal and burned
them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצִאוּ אֶת־מַצְּבוֹת בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׂרְפוּהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצִאוּ אֶת־מַצְּבוֹת בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׂרְפוּהָ׃

english.text:
They brought out the pillars of the temple of Baal and burned
them.

translation.text: They brought out the pillar that was in the temple of Baal, and burned it.

verses.english:
They destroyed the pillar of Baal, and they tore down the temple
of Baal and turned it into latrines, as is still the case.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּצוּ אֵת מַצְּבַת הַבָּעַל וַיִּתְּצוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיְשִׂמֻהוּ (למחראות) [לְמוֹצָאוֹת] עַד־הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּצוּ אֵת מַצְּבַת הַבָּעַל וַיִּתְּצוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיְשִׂמֻהוּ (למחראות) [לְמוֹצָאוֹת] עַד־הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
They destroyed the pillar of Baal, and they tore down the temple
of Baal and turned it into latrines, as is still the case.

translation.text: Then they demolished the pillar of Baal, and destroyed the temple of Baal, and made it a latrine to this day.

verses.english: Thus Jehu eradicated the Baal from Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמֵד יֵהוּא אֶת־הַבַּעַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁמֵד יֵהוּא אֶת־הַבַּעַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: Thus Jehu eradicated the Baal from Israel.

translation.text: Thus Jehu wiped out Baal from Israel.

verses.english:
However, Jehu did not turn away from the sinful objects by which
Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to sin, namely, the golden
calves at Bethel and at Dan.
verses.hebrew: רַק חֲטָאֵי יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר יֵהוּא מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם עֶגְלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־אֵל וַאֲשֶׁר בְּדָן׃

hebrew.text: רַק חֲטָאֵי יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר יֵהוּא מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם עֶגְלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־אֵל וַאֲשֶׁר בְּדָן׃

english.text:
However, Jehu did not turn away from the sinful objects by which
Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to sin, namely, the golden
calves at Bethel and at Dan.

translation.text: But Jehu did not turn aside commit — the golden calves that were in Bethel and in Dan.

verses.english:
YHWH said to Jehu, “Because you have acted well and done what was
pleasing to Me, having carried out all that I desired upon the
House of Ahab, four generations of your descendants shall occupy
the throne of Israel.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־הֱטִיבֹתָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי עָשִׂיתָ לְבֵית אַחְאָב בְּנֵי רְבִעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־הֱטִיבֹתָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי עָשִׂיתָ לְבֵית אַחְאָב בְּנֵי רְבִעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Jehu, “Because you have acted well and done what was
pleasing to Me, having carried out all that I desired upon the
House of Ahab, four generations of your descendants shall occupy
the throne of Israel.”

translation.text: The sit on the throne of Israel."

verses.english:
But Jehu was not careful to follow the Teaching of YHWH, the God
of Israel, with all his heart; he did not turn away from the sins
that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא לֹא שָׁמַר לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרַת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא לֹא שָׁמַר לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרַת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Jehu was not careful to follow the Teaching of YHWH, the God
of Israel, with all his heart; he did not turn away from the sins
that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: But Jehu was not careful to follow the from the sins of Jeroboam, which he caused Israel to commit.

verses.english:
In those days YHWH began to reduce Israel; and Hazael harassed
them throughout the territory of Israel
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְקַצּוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם חֲזָאֵל בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְקַצּוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם חֲזָאֵל בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
In those days YHWH began to reduce Israel; and Hazael harassed
them throughout the territory of Israel

translation.text: In those days the LORD began to trim off parts of Israel. Hazael defeated them throughout the territory of Israel:

verses.english:
east of the Jordan, all the land of Gilead—the Gadites, the
Reubenites, and the Manassites—from Aroer, by the Wadi Arnon, up
to Gilead and Bashan.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הַגָּדִי וְהָראוּבֵנִי וְהַמְנַשִּׁי מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הַגָּדִי וְהָראוּבֵנִי וְהַמְנַשִּׁי מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
east of the Jordan, all the land of Gilead—the Gadites, the
Reubenites, and the Manassites—from Aroer, by the Wadi Arnon, up
to Gilead and Bashan.

translation.text: from the Jordan Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the Wadi Arnon, that is, Gilead and Bashan.

verses.english:
The other events of Jehu’s reign, and all his actions, and all his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֵהוּא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֵהוּא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehu’s reign, and all his actions, and all his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, all that he did, and all his Israel?

verses.english:
Jehu slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; he was
succeeded as king by his son Jehoahaz.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יֵהוּא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יֵהוּא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehu slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; he was
succeeded as king by his son Jehoahaz.

translation.text: So Jehu slept with his ancestors, and they buried him in Samaria. His son Jehoahaz succeeded him.

verses.english: Jehu reigned over Israel for twenty-eight years in Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text: Jehu reigned over Israel for twenty-eight years in Samaria.

translation.text: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

verses.english:
When Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, learned that her son was
dead, she promptly killed off all who were of royal stock.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲתַלְיָה אֵם אֲחַזְיָהוּ (וראתה) [רָאֲתָה] כִּי מֵת בְּנָהּ וַתָּקם וַתְּאַבֵּד אֵת כּל־זֶרַע הַמַּמְלָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲתַלְיָה אֵם אֲחַזְיָהוּ (וראתה) [רָאֲתָה] כִּי מֵת בְּנָהּ וַתָּקם וַתְּאַבֵּד אֵת כּל־זֶרַע הַמַּמְלָכָה׃

english.text:
When Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, learned that her son was
dead, she promptly killed off all who were of royal stock.

translation.text: Now when Athaliah, Ahaziah's mother, saw that her son was dead, she set about to destroy all the royal family.

verses.english:
But Jehosheba, daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah,
secretly took Ahaziah’s son Joash away from among the princes who
were being slain, and [put] him and his nurse in a bedroom. And
they kept him hidden from Athaliah so that he was not put to
death.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקַּח יְהוֹשֶׁבַע בַּת־הַמֶּלֶךְ־יוֹרָם אֲחוֹת אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָה וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ (הממותתים) [הַמּוּמָתִים] אֹתוֹ
וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּוֹ בַּחֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת וַיַּסְתִּרוּ אֹתוֹ מִפְּנֵי עֲתַלְיָהוּ וְלֹא הוּמָת׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקַּח יְהוֹשֶׁבַע בַּת־הַמֶּלֶךְ־יוֹרָם אֲחוֹת אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָה וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ (הממותתים) [הַמּוּמָתִים] אֹתוֹ
וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּוֹ בַּחֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת וַיַּסְתִּרוּ אֹתוֹ מִפְּנֵי עֲתַלְיָהוּ וְלֹא הוּמָת׃

english.text:
But Jehosheba, daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah,
secretly took Ahaziah’s son Joash away from among the princes who
were being slain, and [put] him and his nurse in a bedroom. And
they kept him hidden from Athaliah so that he was not put to
death.

translation.text: But Jehosheba, King Athaliah, so that he was not killed;

verses.english:
He stayed with her for six years, hidden in the House of YHWH,
while Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִתָּהּ בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִתְחַבֵּא שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַעֲתַלְיָה מֹלֶכֶת עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אִתָּהּ בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִתְחַבֵּא שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַעֲתַלְיָה מֹלֶכֶת עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
He stayed with her for six years, hidden in the House of YHWH,
while Athaliah reigned over the land.

translation.text: he remained with her six years, hidden in the house of the LORD, while Athaliah reigned over the land.

verses.english:
In the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the chiefs of the hundreds
of the Carites and of the guards, and had them come to him in the
House of YHWH. He made a pact with them, exacting an oath from
them in the House of YHWH, and he showed them the king’s son.
verses.hebrew:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַח יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] לַכָּרִי וְלָרָצִים וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֵלָיו בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיַּשְׁבַּע
אֹתָם בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה וַיַּרְא אֹתָם אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַח יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] לַכָּרִי וְלָרָצִים וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֵלָיו בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיַּשְׁבַּע
אֹתָם בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה וַיַּרְא אֹתָם אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
In the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the chiefs of the hundreds
of the Carites and of the guards, and had them come to him in the
House of YHWH. He made a pact with them, exacting an oath from
them in the House of YHWH, and he showed them the king’s son.

translation.text: But in the seventh year Jehoiada summoned the captains of the the house of the LORD; then he showed them the king's son.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁית מִכֶּם בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁית מִכֶּם בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

translation.text: He who go off duty on the sabbath and guard the king's house

verses.english:
another third shall be [stationed] at the Sur Gate; and the other
third shall be at the gate behind the guards; you shall keep guard
over the House on every side.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּשַׁעַר סוּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בַּשַּׁעַר אַחַר הָרָצִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מַסָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּשַׁעַר סוּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בַּשַּׁעַר אַחַר הָרָצִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מַסָּח׃

english.text:
another third shall be [stationed] at the Sur Gate; and the other
third shall be at the gate behind the guards; you shall keep guard
over the House on every side.

translation.text: (another third being at the gate Sur and a third at the gate behind the guards), shall guard the palace;

verses.english:
The two divisions of yours who are off duty this week shall keep
guard over the House of YHWH for the protection of the king.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי הַיָּדוֹת בָּכֶם כֹּל יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי הַיָּדוֹת בָּכֶם כֹּל יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The two divisions of yours who are off duty this week shall keep
guard over the House of YHWH for the protection of the king.

translation.text: and your two divisions that come on duty in force on the sabbath and guard the house of the LORD

verses.english:
You shall surround the king on every side, every man with his
weapons at the ready; and whoever breaks through the ranks shall
be killed. Stay close to the king in his comings and goings.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִקַּפְתֶּם עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ וְהַבָּא אֶל־הַשְּׂדֵרוֹת יוּמָת וִהְיוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּצֵאתוֹ וּבְבֹאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקַּפְתֶּם עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ וְהַבָּא אֶל־הַשְּׂדֵרוֹת יוּמָת וִהְיוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּצֵאתוֹ וּבְבֹאוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall surround the king on every side, every man with his
weapons at the ready; and whoever breaks through the ranks shall
be killed. Stay close to the king in his comings and goings.”

translation.text: shall surround ranks is to be killed. Be with the king in his comings and goings."

verses.english:
The chiefs of hundreds did just as Jehoiada ordered: Each took his
men—those who were on duty that week and those who were off duty
that week—and they presented themselves to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת עִם יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹיָדָע
הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת עִם יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹיָדָע
הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
The chiefs of hundreds did just as Jehoiada ordered: Each took his
men—those who were on duty that week and those who were off duty
that week—and they presented themselves to Jehoiada the priest.

translation.text: The captains did according to all that the priest Jehoiada came to the priest Jehoiada.

verses.english:
The priest gave the chiefs of hundreds King David’s spears and
quivers that were kept in the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The priest gave the chiefs of hundreds King David’s spears and
quivers that were kept in the House of YHWH.

translation.text: The priest delivered to the captains the of the LORD;

verses.english:
The guards, each with his weapons at the ready, stationed
themselves—from the south end of the House to the north end of the
House, at the altar and the House—to guard the king on every side.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הָרָצִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הָרָצִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
The guards, each with his weapons at the ready, stationed
themselves—from the south end of the House to the north end of the
House, at the altar and the House—to guard the king on every side.

translation.text: the guards stood, every man with his weapons in his around the altar and the house, to guard the king on every side.

verses.english:
[Jehoiada] then brought out the king’s son, and placed upon him
the crown and the insignia. They anointed him and proclaimed him
king; they clapped their hands and shouted, “Long live the king!”
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת־הַנֵּזֶר וְאֶת־הָעֵדוּת וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻהוּ וַיַּכּוּ־כָף וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצִא אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת־הַנֵּזֶר וְאֶת־הָעֵדוּת וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻהוּ וַיַּכּוּ־כָף וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
[Jehoiada] then brought out the king’s son, and placed upon him
the crown and the insignia. They anointed him and proclaimed him
king; they clapped their hands and shouted, “Long live the king!”

translation.text: clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"

verses.english:
When Athaliah heard the shouting of the guards [and] the people,
she came out to the people in the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁמַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת־קוֹל הָרָצִין הָעָם וַתָּבֹא אֶל־הָעָם בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁמַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת־קוֹל הָרָצִין הָעָם וַתָּבֹא אֶל־הָעָם בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When Athaliah heard the shouting of the guards [and] the people,
she came out to the people in the House of YHWH.

translation.text: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she went into the house of the LORD to the people;

verses.english:
She looked about and saw the king standing by the pillar, as was
the custom, the chiefs with their trumpets beside the king, and
all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets.
Athaliah rent her garments and cried out, “Treason, treason!”
verses.hebrew:
וַתֵּרֶא וְהִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹמֵד עַל־הָעַמּוּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַשָּׂרִים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עַם הָאָרֶץ שָׂמֵחַ וְתֹקֵעַ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וַתִּקְרַע עֲתַלְיָה
אֶת־בְּגָדֶיהָ וַתִּקְרָא קֶשֶׁר קָשֶׁר׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֵּרֶא וְהִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹמֵד עַל־הָעַמּוּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַשָּׂרִים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עַם הָאָרֶץ שָׂמֵחַ וְתֹקֵעַ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וַתִּקְרַע עֲתַלְיָה
אֶת־בְּגָדֶיהָ וַתִּקְרָא קֶשֶׁר קָשֶׁר׃

english.text:
She looked about and saw the king standing by the pillar, as was
the custom, the chiefs with their trumpets beside the king, and
all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets.
Athaliah rent her garments and cried out, “Treason, treason!”

translation.text: when she looked, cried, "Treason! Treason!"

verses.english:
Then the priest Jehoiada gave the command to the army officers,
the chiefs of hundreds, and said to them, “Take her out between
the ranks and, if anyone follows her, put him to the sword.” For
the priest thought: “Let her not be put to death in the House of
YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת ] פְּקֻדֵי הַחַיִל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל־מִבֵּית לַשְּׂדֵרֹת וְהַבָּא אַחֲרֶיהָ הָמֵת בֶּחָרֶב כִּי
אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן אַל־תּוּמַת בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת ] פְּקֻדֵי הַחַיִל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל־מִבֵּית לַשְּׂדֵרֹת וְהַבָּא אַחֲרֶיהָ הָמֵת בֶּחָרֶב כִּי
אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן אַל־תּוּמַת בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then the priest Jehoiada gave the command to the army officers,
the chiefs of hundreds, and said to them, “Take her out between
the ranks and, if anyone follows her, put him to the sword.” For
the priest thought: “Let her not be put to death in the House of
YHWH.”

translation.text: Then the priest Jehoiada commanded the said, "Let her not be killed in the house of the LORD."

verses.english:
They cleared a passageway for her and she entered the royal palace
through the horses’ entrance: there she was put to death.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂמוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא דֶּרֶךְ־מְבוֹא הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתּוּמַת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂמוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא דֶּרֶךְ־מְבוֹא הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתּוּמַת שָׁם׃

english.text:
They cleared a passageway for her and she entered the royal palace
through the horses’ entrance: there she was put to death.

translation.text: So they laid house, and there she was put to death.

verses.english:
And Jehoiada solemnized the covenant between YHWH, on the one
hand, and the king and the people, on the other—as well as between
the king and the people—that they should be the people of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַבְּרִית בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַבְּרִית בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Jehoiada solemnized the covenant between YHWH, on the one
hand, and the king and the people, on the other—as well as between
the king and the people—that they should be the people of YHWH.

translation.text: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and and the people.

verses.english:
Thereupon all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal.
They tore it down and smashed its altars and images to bits, and
they slew Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.
[Jehoiada] the priest then placed guards over the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ כל־עַם הָאָרֶץ בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּתְּצֻהוּ אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָו וְאֶת־צְלָמָיו שִׁבְּרוּ הֵיטֵב וְאֵת מַתָּן כֹּהֵן הַבַּעַל הָרְגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם
הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדֹּת עַל־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ כל־עַם הָאָרֶץ בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּתְּצֻהוּ אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָו וְאֶת־צְלָמָיו שִׁבְּרוּ הֵיטֵב וְאֵת מַתָּן כֹּהֵן הַבַּעַל הָרְגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם
הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדֹּת עַל־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal.
They tore it down and smashed its altars and images to bits, and
they slew Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.
[Jehoiada] the priest then placed guards over the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Then all the people of the land went to the house pieces, and they killed Mattan, the priest of Baal, before the altars. The priest posted guards over the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
He took the chiefs of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all
the people of the land, and they escorted the king from the House
of YHWH into the royal palace by the gate of the guards. And he
ascended the royal throne.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־הַכָּרִי וְאֶת־הָרָצִים וְאֵת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבוֹאוּ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר הָרָצִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־הַכָּרִי וְאֶת־הָרָצִים וְאֵת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבוֹאוּ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר הָרָצִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים׃

english.text:
He took the chiefs of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all
the people of the land, and they escorted the king from the House
of YHWH into the royal palace by the gate of the guards. And he
ascended the royal throne.

translation.text: He took the captains, the Carites, the guards, and all the people of the land; then through the gate of the guards to the king's house. He took his seat on the throne of the kings.

verses.english:
All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. As
for Athaliah, she had been put to the sword in the royal palace.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂמַח כּל־עַם־הָאָרֶץ וְהָעִיר שָׁקָטָה וְאֶת־עֲתַלְיָהוּ הֵמִיתוּ בַחֶרֶב בֵּית (מלך) [הַמֶּלֶךְ]׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂמַח כּל־עַם־הָאָרֶץ וְהָעִיר שָׁקָטָה וְאֶת־עֲתַלְיָהוּ הֵמִיתוּ בַחֶרֶב בֵּית (מלך) [הַמֶּלֶךְ]׃

english.text:
All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. As
for Athaliah, she had been put to the sword in the royal palace.

translation.text: So all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet after Athaliah had been killed with the sword at the king's house.

verses.english: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים יְהוֹאָשׁ בְּמלְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים יְהוֹאָשׁ בְּמלְכוֹ׃

english.text: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.

translation.text: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

verses.english:
Jehoash began his reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he
reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah of
Beer-sheba.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְיֵהוּא מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צִבְיָה מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְיֵהוּא מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צִבְיָה מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
Jehoash began his reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he
reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah of
Beer-sheba.

translation.text: In the seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash began to reign; he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

verses.english:
All his days Jehoash did what was pleasing to YHWH, as the priest
Jehoiada instructed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כּל־יָמָיו אֲשֶׁר הוֹרָהוּ יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כּל־יָמָיו אֲשֶׁר הוֹרָהוּ יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
All his days Jehoash did what was pleasing to YHWH, as the priest
Jehoiada instructed him.

translation.text: because the priest Jehoiada instructed him.

verses.english:
The shrines, however, were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and offer at the shrines.
verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
The shrines, however, were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and offer at the shrines.

translation.text: Nevertheless the high make offerings on the high places.

verses.english:
Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money, current money,
brought into the House of YHWH as sacred donations—any money a man
may pay as the money equivalent of persons, or any other money
that a man may be minded to bring to the House of YHWH—
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹאָשׁ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־יוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה כֶּסֶף עוֹבֵר אִישׁ כֶּסֶף נַפְשׁוֹת עֶרְכּוֹ כּל־כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עַל לֶב־אִישׁ
לְהָבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹאָשׁ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־יוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה כֶּסֶף עוֹבֵר אִישׁ כֶּסֶף נַפְשׁוֹת עֶרְכּוֹ כּל־כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עַל לֶב־אִישׁ
לְהָבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money, current money,
brought into the House of YHWH as sacred donations—any money a man
may pay as the money equivalent of persons, or any other money
that a man may be minded to bring to the House of YHWH—

translation.text: Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money offered as sacred the house of the LORD,

verses.english:
let the priests receive it, each from his benefactor; they, in
turn, shall make repairs on the House, wherever damage may be
found.”
verses.hebrew: יִקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ מֵאֵת מַכָּרוֹ וְהֵם יְחַזְּקוּ אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבַּיִת לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּצֵא שָׁם בָּדֶק׃

hebrew.text: יִקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ מֵאֵת מַכָּרוֹ וְהֵם יְחַזְּקוּ אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבַּיִת לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּצֵא שָׁם בָּדֶק׃

english.text:
let the priests receive it, each from his benefactor; they, in
turn, shall make repairs on the House, wherever damage may be
found.”

translation.text: let the priests receive from each of the donors; discovered."

verses.english:
But in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, [it was found that]
the priests had not made the repairs on the House.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לֹא־חִזְּקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לֹא־חִזְּקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
But in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, [it was found that]
the priests had not made the repairs on the House.

translation.text: But by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had made no repairs on the house.

verses.english:
So King Jehoash summoned the priest Jehoiada and the other priests
and said to them, “Why have you not kept the House in repair? Now
do not accept money from your benefactors any more, but have it
donated for the repair of the House.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לִיהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מַדּוּעַ אֵינְכֶם מְחַזְּקִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּקְחוּ־כֶסֶף מֵאֵת מַכָּרֵיכֶם
כִּי־לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת תִּתְּנֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לִיהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מַדּוּעַ אֵינְכֶם מְחַזְּקִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּקְחוּ־כֶסֶף מֵאֵת מַכָּרֵיכֶם
כִּי־לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת תִּתְּנֻהוּ׃

english.text:
So King Jehoash summoned the priest Jehoiada and the other priests
and said to them, “Why have you not kept the House in repair? Now
do not accept money from your benefactors any more, but have it
donated for the repair of the House.”

translation.text: Therefore King Jehoash the house."

verses.english:
The priests agreed that they would neither accept money from the
people nor make repairs on the House.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאֹתוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבִלְתִּי קְחַת־כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת הָעָם וּלְבִלְתִּי חַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאֹתוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבִלְתִּי קְחַת־כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת הָעָם וּלְבִלְתִּי חַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The priests agreed that they would neither accept money from the
people nor make repairs on the House.

translation.text: So the priests agreed that they would neither accept more money from the people nor repair the house.

verses.english:
And the priest Jehoiada took a chest and bored a hole in its lid.
He placed it at the right side of the altar as one entered the
House of YHWH, and the priestly guards of the threshold deposited
there all the money that was brought into the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֲרוֹן אֶחָד וַיִּקֹּב חֹר בְּדַלְתּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ (בימין) [מִיָּמִין] בְּבוֹא־אִישׁ בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְנָתְנוּ־שָׁמָּה
הַכֹּהֲנִים שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֲרוֹן אֶחָד וַיִּקֹּב חֹר בְּדַלְתּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ (בימין) [מִיָּמִין] בְּבוֹא־אִישׁ בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְנָתְנוּ־שָׁמָּה
הַכֹּהֲנִים שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest Jehoiada took a chest and bored a hole in its lid.
He placed it at the right side of the altar as one entered the
House of YHWH, and the priestly guards of the threshold deposited
there all the money that was brought into the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Then the priest Jehoiada took a chest, made a hole in its lid, and set that was brought into the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
Whenever they saw that there was much money in the chest, the
royal scribe and the high priest would come up and put the money
accumulated in the House of YHWH into bags, and they would count
it.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם כִּי־רַב הַכֶּסֶף בָּאָרוֹן וַיַּעַל סֹפֵר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וַיָּצֻרוּ וַיִּמְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם כִּי־רַב הַכֶּסֶף בָּאָרוֹן וַיַּעַל סֹפֵר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וַיָּצֻרוּ וַיִּמְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Whenever they saw that there was much money in the chest, the
royal scribe and the high priest would come up and put the money
accumulated in the House of YHWH into bags, and they would count
it.

translation.text: Whenever they saw that there was a great deal of money in the chest, the king's secretary house of the LORD, and tied it up in bags.

verses.english:
Then they would deliver the money that was weighed out to the
overseers of the work, who were in charge of the House of YHWH.
These, in turn, used to pay the carpenters and the laborers who
worked on the House of YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמְתֻכָּן עַל־[יְדֵי] (יד) עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה (הפקדים) [הַמֻּפְקָדִים] בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִיאֻהוּ לְחָרָשֵׁי הָעֵץ וְלַבֹּנִים הָעֹשִׂים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמְתֻכָּן עַל־[יְדֵי] (יד) עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה (הפקדים) [הַמֻּפְקָדִים] בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִיאֻהוּ לְחָרָשֵׁי הָעֵץ וְלַבֹּנִים הָעֹשִׂים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then they would deliver the money that was weighed out to the
overseers of the work, who were in charge of the House of YHWH.
These, in turn, used to pay the carpenters and the laborers who
worked on the House of YHWH,

translation.text: They would give the money carpenters and the builders who worked on the house of the LORD,

verses.english:
and the masons and the stonecutters. They also paid for wood and
for quarried stone with which to make the repairs on the House of
YHWH, and for every other expenditure that had to be made in
repairing the House.
verses.hebrew: וְלַגֹּדְרִים וּלְחֹצְבֵי הָאֶבֶן וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא עַל־הַבַּיִת לְחזְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלַגֹּדְרִים וּלְחֹצְבֵי הָאֶבֶן וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא עַל־הַבַּיִת לְחזְקָה׃

english.text:
and the masons and the stonecutters. They also paid for wood and
for quarried stone with which to make the repairs on the House of
YHWH, and for every other expenditure that had to be made in
repairing the House.

translation.text: for any outlay for repairs of the house.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בֵּית יְהֹוָה סִפּוֹת כֶּסֶף מְזַמְּרוֹת מִזְרָקוֹת חֲצֹצְרוֹת כּל־כְּלִי זָהָב וּכְלִי־כָסֶף מִן־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בֵּית יְהֹוָה סִפּוֹת כֶּסֶף מְזַמְּרוֹת מִזְרָקוֹת חֲצֹצְרוֹת כּל־כְּלִי זָהָב וּכְלִי־כָסֶף מִן־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: But for the house of the LORD no basins of silver, snuffers, bowls, trumpets, or any vessels of gold, or of the LORD,

verses.english:
this was given only to the overseers of the work for the repair of
the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה יִתְּנֻהוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־בוֹ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה יִתְּנֻהוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־בוֹ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
this was given only to the overseers of the work for the repair of
the House of YHWH.

translation.text: for that was given to the workers who were repairing the house of the LORD with it.

verses.english:
No check was kept on the men to whom the money was delivered to
pay the workers; for they dealt honestly.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַשְּׁבוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יָדָם לָתֵת לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה כִּי בֶאֱמֻנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יְחַשְּׁבוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יָדָם לָתֵת לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה כִּי בֶאֱמֻנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

english.text:
No check was kept on the men to whom the money was delivered to
pay the workers; for they dealt honestly.

translation.text: They did not ask an accounting from workers, for they dealt honestly.

verses.english:
Money brought as a guilt offering or as a sin offering was not
deposited in the House of YHWH; it went to the priests.
verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף אָשָׁם וְכֶסֶף חַטָּאוֹת לֹא יוּבָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה לַכֹּהֲנִים יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: כֶּסֶף אָשָׁם וְכֶסֶף חַטָּאוֹת לֹא יוּבָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה לַכֹּהֲנִים יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
Money brought as a guilt offering or as a sin offering was not
deposited in the House of YHWH; it went to the priests.

translation.text: The money from the guilt offerings of the LORD; it belonged to the priests.

verses.english:
At that time, King Hazael of Aram came up and attacked Gath and
captured it; and Hazael proceeded to march on Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: אָז יַעֲלֶה חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיִּלָּחֶם עַל־גַּת וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וַיָּשֶׂם חֲזָאֵל פָּנָיו לַעֲלוֹת עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַעֲלֶה חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיִּלָּחֶם עַל־גַּת וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וַיָּשֶׂם חֲזָאֵל פָּנָיו לַעֲלוֹת עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
At that time, King Hazael of Aram came up and attacked Gath and
captured it; and Hazael proceeded to march on Jerusalem.

translation.text: At that time King Hazael of Aram went up, fought against Gath, and took it. But when Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem,

verses.english:
Thereupon King Joash of Judah took all the objects that had been
consecrated by his fathers, Kings Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and
Ahaziah of Judah, and by himself, and all the gold that there was
in the treasuries of the Temple of YHWH and in the royal palace,
and he sent them to King Hazael of Aram, who then turned back from
his march on Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֵת כּל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־הִקְדִּישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָט וִיהוֹרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲבֹתָיו מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־קֳדָשָׁיו וְאֵת כּל־הַזָּהָב
הַנִּמְצָא בְּאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיַּעַל מֵעַל יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֵת כּל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־הִקְדִּישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָט וִיהוֹרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲבֹתָיו מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־קֳדָשָׁיו וְאֵת כּל־הַזָּהָב
הַנִּמְצָא בְּאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיַּעַל מֵעַל יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Thereupon King Joash of Judah took all the objects that had been
consecrated by his fathers, Kings Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and
Ahaziah of Judah, and by himself, and all the gold that there was
in the treasuries of the Temple of YHWH and in the royal palace,
and he sent them to King Hazael of Aram, who then turned back from
his march on Jerusalem.

translation.text: dedicated, as well as his own votive gifts, all the gold that was found in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
His courtiers formed a conspiracy against Joash and assassinated
him at Beth-millo that leads down to Silla.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ־קָשֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֵּית מִלֹּא הַיֹּרֵד סִלָּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ־קָשֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֵּית מִלֹּא הַיֹּרֵד סִלָּא׃

english.text:
His courtiers formed a conspiracy against Joash and assassinated
him at Beth-millo that leads down to Silla.

translation.text: His Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

verses.english:
The courtiers who assassinated him were Jozacar son of Shimeath
and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his
fathers in the City of David; and his son Amaziah succeeded him as
king.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹזָכָר בֶּן־שִׁמְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָד בֶּן־שֹׁמֵר עֲבָדָיו הִכֻּהוּ וַיָּמֹת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲמַצְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹזָכָר בֶּן־שִׁמְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָד בֶּן־שֹׁמֵר עֲבָדָיו הִכֻּהוּ וַיָּמֹת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲמַצְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
The courtiers who assassinated him were Jozacar son of Shimeath
and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his
fathers in the City of David; and his son Amaziah succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: It was Jozacar son of David; then his son Amaziah succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the twenty-third year of King Joash son of Ahaziah of Judah,
Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria—for
seventeen years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the twenty-third year of King Joash son of Ahaziah of Judah,
Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria—for
seventeen years.

translation.text: In the twenty-third year of King Joash son of Ahaziah of Judah, seventeen years.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH. He persisted in the sins
which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did
not depart from them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחַר חַטֹּאת יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחַר חַטֹּאת יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH. He persisted in the sins
which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did
not depart from them.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, and sin; he did not depart from them.

verses.english:
YHWH was angry with Israel and He repeatedly delivered them into
the hands of King Hazael of Aram and into the hands of Ben-hadad
son of Hazael.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּבְיַד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּבְיַד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
YHWH was angry with Israel and He repeatedly delivered them into
the hands of King Hazael of Aram and into the hands of Ben-hadad
son of Hazael.

translation.text: The anger of the LORD was kindled Hazael of Aram, then into the hand of Ben-hadad son of Hazael.

verses.english:
But Jehoahaz pleaded with YHWH; and YHWH listened to him, for He
saw the suffering that the king of Aram inflicted upon Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחַל יְהוֹאָחָז אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי רָאָה אֶת־לַחַץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־לָחַץ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַל יְהוֹאָחָז אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי רָאָה אֶת־לַחַץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־לָחַץ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

english.text:
But Jehoahaz pleaded with YHWH; and YHWH listened to him, for He
saw the suffering that the king of Aram inflicted upon Israel.

translation.text: But oppression of Israel, how the king of Aram oppressed them.

verses.english:
So YHWH granted Israel a deliverer, and they gained their freedom
from Aram; and Israel dwelt in its homes as before.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִתַּחַת יַד־אֲרָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאהֳלֵיהֶם כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִתַּחַת יַד־אֲרָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאהֳלֵיהֶם כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
So YHWH granted Israel a deliverer, and they gained their freedom
from Aram; and Israel dwelt in its homes as before.

translation.text: formerly.

verses.english:
However, they did not depart from the sins which the House of
Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit; they persisted in them. Even
the sacred post stood in Samaria.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־סָרוּ מֵחַטֹּאת בֵּית־יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ וְגַם הָאֲשֵׁרָה עָמְדָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא־סָרוּ מֵחַטֹּאת בֵּית־יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ וְגַם הָאֲשֵׁרָה עָמְדָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
However, they did not depart from the sins which the House of
Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit; they persisted in them. Even
the sacred post stood in Samaria.

translation.text: Nevertheless they did not depart from the sins of the house sacred pole also remained in Samaria.

verses.english:
In fact, Jehoahaz was left with a force of only fifty horsemen,
ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers; for the king of Aram
had decimated them and trampled them like the dust under his feet.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הִשְׁאִיר לִיהוֹאָחָז עָם כִּי אִם־חֲמִשִּׁים פָּרָשִׁים וַעֲשָׂרָה רֶכֶב וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים רַגְלִי כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂמֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדֻשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא הִשְׁאִיר לִיהוֹאָחָז עָם כִּי אִם־חֲמִשִּׁים פָּרָשִׁים וַעֲשָׂרָה רֶכֶב וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים רַגְלִי כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂמֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדֻשׁ׃

english.text:
In fact, Jehoahaz was left with a force of only fifty horsemen,
ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers; for the king of Aram
had decimated them and trampled them like the dust under his feet.

translation.text: So Jehoahaz was left with an like the dust at threshing.

verses.english:
The other events of Jehoahaz’s reign, and all his actions and his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָחָז וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָחָז וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehoahaz’s reign, and all his actions and his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz and all that he did, including his might, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Jehoahaz slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; his
son Joash succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehoahaz slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; his
son Joash succeeded him as king.

translation.text: So Jehoahaz slept with his succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the thirty-seventh year of King Joash of Judah, Jehoash son of
Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria—for sixteen years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the thirty-seventh year of King Joash of Judah, Jehoash son of
Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria—for sixteen years.

translation.text: In the thirty-seventh year of King Joash of Judah, Jehoash son of years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ׃

translation.text: He also did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; he did not Israel to sin, but he walked in them.

verses.english:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, and his
exploits in his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, and his
exploits in his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Joash slept with his fathers and Jeroboam occupied his throne;
Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְיָרבְעָם יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיִּקָּבֵר יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְיָרבְעָם יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיִּקָּבֵר יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Joash slept with his fathers and Jeroboam occupied his throne;
Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

translation.text: So Joash slept with his ancestors, and kings of Israel.

verses.english:
Elisha had been stricken with the illness of which he was to die,
and King Joash of Israel went down to see him. He wept over him
and cried, “Father, father! Israel’s chariots and horsemen!”
verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
Elisha had been stricken with the illness of which he was to die,
and King Joash of Israel went down to see him. He wept over him
and cried, “Father, father! Israel’s chariots and horsemen!”

translation.text: Now when Elisha had fallen sick with the illness of which he was to crying, "My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"

verses.english:
Elisha said to him, “Get a bow and arrows”; and he brought him a
bow and arrows.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלִישָׁע קַח קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים וַיִּקַּח אֵלָיו קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלִישָׁע קַח קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים וַיִּקַּח אֵלָיו קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים׃

english.text:
Elisha said to him, “Get a bow and arrows”; and he brought him a
bow and arrows.

translation.text: Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and arrows"; so he took a bow and arrows.

verses.english:
Then he said to the king of Israel, “Grasp the bow!” And when he
had grasped it, Elisha put his hands over the king’s hands.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְכֵּב יָדְךָ עַל־הַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּב יָדוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֱלִישָׁע יָדָיו עַל־יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְכֵּב יָדְךָ עַל־הַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּב יָדוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֱלִישָׁע יָדָיו עַל־יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then he said to the king of Israel, “Grasp the bow!” And when he
had grasped it, Elisha put his hands over the king’s hands.

translation.text: Then he said to the king of Israel, "Draw the bow"; and he drew it. Elisha laid his hands on the king's hands.

verses.english:
“Open the window toward the east,” he said; and he opened it.
Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. Then he said, “An arrow of
victory for YHWH! An arrow of victory over Aram! You shall rout
Aram completely at Aphek.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר פְּתַח הַחַלּוֹן קֵדְמָה וַיִּפְתָּח וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְרֵה וַיּוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר חֵץ־תְּשׁוּעָה לַיהֹוָה וְחֵץ תְּשׁוּעָה בַאֲרָם וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם בַּאֲפֵק
עַד־כַּלֵּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר פְּתַח הַחַלּוֹן קֵדְמָה וַיִּפְתָּח וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְרֵה וַיּוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר חֵץ־תְּשׁוּעָה לַיהֹוָה וְחֵץ תְּשׁוּעָה בַאֲרָם וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם בַּאֲפֵק
עַד־כַּלֵּה׃

english.text:
“Open the window toward the east,” he said; and he opened it.
Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. Then he said, “An arrow of
victory for YHWH! An arrow of victory over Aram! You shall rout
Aram completely at Aphek.”

translation.text: Then he said, "Open the window eastward"; and he opened it. Elisha said, "Shoot"; have made an end of them."

verses.english:
He said, “Now pick up the arrows.” And he picked them up. “Strike
the ground!” he said to the king of Israel; and he struck three
times and stopped.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח הַחִצִּים וַיִּקָּח וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַךְ־אַרְצָה וַיַּךְ שָׁלֹשׁ־פְּעָמִים וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח הַחִצִּים וַיִּקָּח וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַךְ־אַרְצָה וַיַּךְ שָׁלֹשׁ־פְּעָמִים וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

english.text:
He said, “Now pick up the arrows.” And he picked them up. “Strike
the ground!” he said to the king of Israel; and he struck three
times and stopped.

translation.text: He continued, "Take the arrows"; and them"; he struck three times, and stopped.

verses.english:
The man of God was angry with him and said to him, “If only you
had struck five or six times! Then you would have annihilated
Aram; as it is, you shall defeat Aram only three times.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף עָלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת חָמֵשׁ אוֹ־שֵׁשׁ פְּעָמִים אָז הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֵּה וְעַתָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים תַּכֶּה אֶת־אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְצֹף עָלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת חָמֵשׁ אוֹ־שֵׁשׁ פְּעָמִים אָז הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֵּה וְעַתָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים תַּכֶּה אֶת־אֲרָם׃

english.text:
The man of God was angry with him and said to him, “If only you
had struck five or six times! Then you would have annihilated
Aram; as it is, you shall defeat Aram only three times.”

translation.text: Then the man of God was angry with him, and said, "You should have struck five or six times; it, but now you will strike down Aram only three times."

verses.english:
Elisha died and he was buried. Now bands of Moabites used to
invade the land at the coming of every year.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת אֱלִישָׁע וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ וּגְדוּדֵי מוֹאָב יָבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ בָּא שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת אֱלִישָׁע וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ וּגְדוּדֵי מוֹאָב יָבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ בָּא שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Elisha died and he was buried. Now bands of Moabites used to
invade the land at the coming of every year.

translation.text: So Elisha died, and they buried him. Now bands of Moabites used to invade the land in the spring of the year.

verses.english:
Once a man was being buried, when the people caught sight of such
a band; so they threw the corpse into Elisha’s grave and made off.
When the [dead] man came in contact with Elisha’s bones, he came
to life and stood up.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי הֵם קֹבְרִים אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה רָאוּ אֶת־הַגְּדוּד וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ בְּקֶבֶר אֱלִישָׁע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּגַּע הָאִישׁ בְּעַצְמוֹת אֱלִישָׁע וַיְחִי וַיָּקם
עַל־רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי הֵם קֹבְרִים אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה רָאוּ אֶת־הַגְּדוּד וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ בְּקֶבֶר אֱלִישָׁע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּגַּע הָאִישׁ בְּעַצְמוֹת אֱלִישָׁע וַיְחִי וַיָּקם
עַל־רַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
Once a man was being buried, when the people caught sight of such
a band; so they threw the corpse into Elisha’s grave and made off.
When the [dead] man came in contact with Elisha’s bones, he came
to life and stood up.

translation.text: As a man was being came to life and stood on his feet.

verses.english:
King Hazael of Aram had oppressed the Israelites throughout the
reign of Jehoahaz.
verses.hebrew: וַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם לָחַץ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹאָחָז׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם לָחַץ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹאָחָז׃

english.text:
King Hazael of Aram had oppressed the Israelites throughout the
reign of Jehoahaz.

translation.text: Now King Hazael of Aram oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

verses.english:
But YHWH was gracious and merciful to them, and He turned back to
them for the sake of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
He refrained from destroying them, and He still did not cast them
out from His presence.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּחן יְהֹוָה אֹתָם וַיְרַחֲמֵם וַיִּפֶן אֲלֵיהֶם לְמַעַן בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא אָבָה הַשְׁחִיתָם וְלֹא־הִשְׁלִיכָם מֵעַל־פָּנָיו עַד־עָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחן יְהֹוָה אֹתָם וַיְרַחֲמֵם וַיִּפֶן אֲלֵיהֶם לְמַעַן בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא אָבָה הַשְׁחִיתָם וְלֹא־הִשְׁלִיכָם מֵעַל־פָּנָיו עַד־עָתָּה׃

english.text:
But YHWH was gracious and merciful to them, and He turned back to
them for the sake of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
He refrained from destroying them, and He still did not cast them
out from His presence.

translation.text: But the LORD was gracious to them and had compassion on them; he presence until now.

verses.english:
When King Hazael of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad succeeded him as
king;
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּן־הֲדַד בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּן־הֲדַד בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
When King Hazael of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad succeeded him as
king;

translation.text: When King Hazael of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad succeeded him.

verses.english:
and then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recovered from Ben-hadad son of
Hazael the towns which had been taken from his father Jehoahaz in
war. Three times Joash defeated him, and he recovered the towns of
Israel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הֶעָרִים מִיַּד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִיַּד יְהוֹאָחָז אָבִיו בַּמִּלְחָמָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הִכָּהוּ יוֹאָשׁ
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הֶעָרִים מִיַּד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִיַּד יְהוֹאָחָז אָבִיו בַּמִּלְחָמָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הִכָּהוּ יוֹאָשׁ
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recovered from Ben-hadad son of
Hazael the towns which had been taken from his father Jehoahaz in
war. Three times Joash defeated him, and he recovered the towns of
Israel.

translation.text: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz took again from Ben-hadad son of Hazael the towns that he had taken from his father Jehoahaz in war. Three times Joash defeated him and recovered the towns of Israel.

verses.english:
In the second year of King Joash son of Joahaz of Israel, Amaziah
son of King Joash of Judah became king.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the second year of King Joash son of Joahaz of Israel, Amaziah
son of King Joash of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the second year of King Joash son of Joahaz of Israel, King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah, began to reign.

verses.english:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of
Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (יהועדין) [יְהוֹעַדָּן] מִן־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (יהועדין) [יְהוֹעַדָּן] מִן־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of
Jerusalem.

translation.text: He was twenty-five Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, but not like his ancestor David;
he did just as his father Joash had done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּדָוִד אָבִיו כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּדָוִד אָבִיו כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, but not like his ancestor David;
he did just as his father Joash had done.

translation.text: He did what was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like his ancestor David; in all things he did as his father Joash had done.

verses.english:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.
verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.

translation.text: But the high places the high places.

verses.english:
Once he had the kingdom firmly in his grasp, he put to death the
courtiers who had assassinated his father the king.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Once he had the kingdom firmly in his grasp, he put to death the
courtiers who had assassinated his father the king.

translation.text: As soon as the royal power was firmly in his hand he killed his servants who had murdered his father the king.

verses.english:
But he did not put to death the children of the assassins, in
accordance with what is written in the Book of the Teaching of
Moses, where YHWH commanded, “Parents shall not be put to death
for children, nor children be put to death for parents; a person
shall be put to death only for his own crime.”
verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־בְּנֵי הַמַּכִּים לֹא הֵמִית כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר־תּוֹרַת־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל־בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא־יוּמְתוּ עַל־אָבוֹת כִּי אִם־אִישׁ
בְּחֶטְאוֹ (ימות) [יוּמָת]׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־בְּנֵי הַמַּכִּים לֹא הֵמִית כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר־תּוֹרַת־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל־בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא־יוּמְתוּ עַל־אָבוֹת כִּי אִם־אִישׁ
בְּחֶטְאוֹ (ימות) [יוּמָת]׃

english.text:
But he did not put to death the children of the assassins, in
accordance with what is written in the Book of the Teaching of
Moses, where YHWH commanded, “Parents shall not be put to death
for children, nor children be put to death for parents; a person
shall be put to death only for his own crime.”

translation.text: But he did "The parents shall not be put to death for the children, or the children be put to death for the parents; but all shall be put to death for their own sins."

verses.english:
He defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and he
captured Sela in battle and renamed it Joktheel, as is still the
case.
verses.hebrew: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵי־[מֶלַח] (המלח) עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְתָפַשׂ אֶת־הַסֶּלַע בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ יקְתְאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵי־[מֶלַח] (המלח) עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְתָפַשׂ אֶת־הַסֶּלַע בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ יקְתְאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
He defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and he
captured Sela in battle and renamed it Joktheel, as is still the
case.

translation.text: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and took Sela by storm; he called it Jokthe-el, which is its name to this day.

verses.english:
Then Amaziah sent envoys to King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of
Jehu of Israel, with this message: “Come, let us confront each
other.”
verses.hebrew: אָז שָׁלַח אֲמַצְיָה מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לְכָה נִתְרָאֶה פָנִים׃

hebrew.text: אָז שָׁלַח אֲמַצְיָה מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לְכָה נִתְרָאֶה פָנִים׃

english.text:
Then Amaziah sent envoys to King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of
Jehu of Israel, with this message: “Come, let us confront each
other.”

translation.text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, of Israel, saying, "Come, let us look one another in the face."

verses.english:
King Jehoash of Israel sent back this message to King Amaziah of
Judah: “The thistle in Lebanon sent this message to the cedar in
Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ But a wild
beast in Lebanon went by and trampled down the thistle.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר הַחוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן שָׁלַח אֶל־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־אֶת־בִּתְּךָ לִבְנִי
לְאִשָּׁה וַתַּעֲבֹר חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וַתִּרְמֹס אֶת־הַחוֹחַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר הַחוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן שָׁלַח אֶל־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־אֶת־בִּתְּךָ לִבְנִי
לְאִשָּׁה וַתַּעֲבֹר חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וַתִּרְמֹס אֶת־הַחוֹחַ׃

english.text:
King Jehoash of Israel sent back this message to King Amaziah of
Judah: “The thistle in Lebanon sent this message to the cedar in
Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ But a wild
beast in Lebanon went by and trampled down the thistle.

translation.text: and trampled down the thornbush.

verses.english:
Because you have defeated Edom, you have become arrogant. Stay
home and enjoy your glory, rather than provoke disaster and fall,
dragging Judah down with you.”
verses.hebrew: הַכֵּה הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֱדוֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ לִבֶּךָ הִכָּבֵד וְשֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ וְלָמָּה תִתְגָּרֶה בְּרָעָה וְנָפַלְתָּה אַתָּה וִיהוּדָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: הַכֵּה הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֱדוֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ לִבֶּךָ הִכָּבֵד וְשֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ וְלָמָּה תִתְגָּרֶה בְּרָעָה וְנָפַלְתָּה אַתָּה וִיהוּדָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Because you have defeated Edom, you have become arrogant. Stay
home and enjoy your glory, rather than provoke disaster and fall,
dragging Judah down with you.”

translation.text: You have indeed defeated you and Judah with you?"

verses.english:
But Amaziah paid no heed; so King Jehoash of Israel advanced, and
he and King Amaziah of Judah confronted each other at Beth-shemesh
in Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע אֲמַצְיָהוּ וַיַּעַל יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְרָאוּ פָנִים הוּא וַאֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בְּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע אֲמַצְיָהוּ וַיַּעַל יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְרָאוּ פָנִים הוּא וַאֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בְּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
But Amaziah paid no heed; so King Jehoash of Israel advanced, and
he and King Amaziah of Judah confronted each other at Beth-shemesh
in Judah.

translation.text: But Amaziah would not listen. So King Jehoash of Israel went up; he and King Amaziah of Judah faced one another in battle at Bethshemesh, which belongs to Judah.

verses.english:
The Judites were routed by Israel, and they all fled to their
homes.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

english.text:
The Judites were routed by Israel, and they all fled to their
homes.

translation.text: Judah was defeated by Israel; everyone fled home.

verses.english:
King Jehoash of Israel captured King Amaziah son of Jehoash son of
Ahaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh. He marched on Jerusalem, and he
made a breach of four hundred cubits in the wall of Jerusalem,
from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֵת אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בֶּן־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ תָּפַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ (ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּפְרֹץ בְּחוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁעַר אֶפְרַיִם עַד־שַׁעַר הַפִּנָּה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אַמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵת אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בֶּן־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ תָּפַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ (ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּפְרֹץ בְּחוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁעַר אֶפְרַיִם עַד־שַׁעַר הַפִּנָּה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אַמָּה׃

english.text:
King Jehoash of Israel captured King Amaziah son of Jehoash son of
Ahaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh. He marched on Jerusalem, and he
made a breach of four hundred cubits in the wall of Jerusalem,
from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.

translation.text: King Jehoash of Israel captured King Amaziah Gate to the Corner Gate, a distance of four hundred cubits.

verses.english:
He carried off all the gold and silver and all the vessels that
there were in the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal
palace, as well as hostages; and he returned to Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת־כּל־הַזָּהָב־וְהַכֶּסֶף וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִים בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת בְּנֵי הַתַּעֲרֻבוֹת וַיָּשׁב שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֶת־כּל־הַזָּהָב־וְהַכֶּסֶף וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִים בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת בְּנֵי הַתַּעֲרֻבוֹת וַיָּשׁב שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

english.text:
He carried off all the gold and silver and all the vessels that
there were in the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal
palace, as well as hostages; and he returned to Samaria.

translation.text: He seized all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the king's house, as well as hostages; then he returned to Samaria.

verses.english:
The other events of Jehoash’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, and his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehoash’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, and his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
