translation.text: Now the rest of the acts that Jehoash did, his might, and how he of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the
kings of Israel; his son Jeroboam succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ יָרבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ יָרבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the
kings of Israel; his son Jeroboam succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Jehoash slept with his ancestors, Jeroboam succeeded him.

verses.english:
King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah lived fifteen years after the
death of King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah lived fifteen years after the
death of King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz of Israel.

translation.text: King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah lived fifteen years after the death of King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz of Israel.

verses.english:
The other events of Amaziah’s reign are recorded in the Annals of
the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲמַצְיָהוּ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲמַצְיָהוּ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Amaziah’s reign are recorded in the Annals of
the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
A conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem and he fled to
Lachish; but they sent men after him to Lachish, and they killed
him there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו קֶשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּנס לָכִישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַחֲרָיו לָכִישָׁה וַיְמִתֻהוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו קֶשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּנס לָכִישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַחֲרָיו לָכִישָׁה וַיְמִתֻהוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
A conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem and he fled to
Lachish; but they sent men after him to Lachish, and they killed
him there.

translation.text: They made a conspiracy against him in and killed him there.

verses.english:
They brought back his body on horses, and he was buried with his
fathers in Jerusalem, in the City of David.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּקָּבֵר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּקָּבֵר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
They brought back his body on horses, and he was buried with his
fathers in Jerusalem, in the City of David.

translation.text: They brought him on horses; he was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors in the city of David.

verses.english:
Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years
old, and proclaimed him king to succeed his father Amaziah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ כּל־עַם יְהוּדָה אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וְהוּא בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו אֲמַצְיָהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ כּל־עַם יְהוּדָה אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וְהוּא בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו אֲמַצְיָהוּ׃

english.text:
Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years
old, and proclaimed him king to succeed his father Amaziah.

translation.text: All the people of succeed his father Amaziah.

verses.english:
It was he who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah, after King
[Amaziah] slept with his fathers.
verses.hebrew: הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אֵילַת וַיְשִׁבֶהָ לִיהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי שְׁכַב־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אֵילַת וַיְשִׁבֶהָ לִיהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי שְׁכַב־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
It was he who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah, after King
[Amaziah] slept with his fathers.

translation.text: He rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah, after King Amaziah slept with his ancestors.

verses.english:
In the fifteenth year of King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah, King
Jeroboam son of Joash of Israel became king in Samaria—for
forty-one years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַאֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַאֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the fifteenth year of King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah, King
Jeroboam son of Joash of Israel became king in Samaria—for
forty-one years.

translation.text: In the fifteenth year of King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah, King forty-one years.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from all
the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from all
the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; he did Israel to sin.

verses.english:
It was he who restored the territory of Israel from Lebo-hamath to
the sea of the Arabah, in accordance with the promise that YHWH,
the God of Israel, had made through His servant, the prophet Jonah
son of Amittai from Gath-hepher.
verses.hebrew:
הוּא הֵשִׁיב אֶת־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־יָם הָעֲרָבָה כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ יוֹנָה בֶן־אֲמִתַּי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר מִגַּת
הַחֵפֶר׃

hebrew.text:
הוּא הֵשִׁיב אֶת־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־יָם הָעֲרָבָה כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ יוֹנָה בֶן־אֲמִתַּי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר מִגַּת
הַחֵפֶר׃

english.text:
It was he who restored the territory of Israel from Lebo-hamath to
the sea of the Arabah, in accordance with the promise that YHWH,
the God of Israel, had made through His servant, the prophet Jonah
son of Amittai from Gath-hepher.

translation.text: He restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath as prophet, who was from Gath-hepher.

verses.english:
For YHWH saw the very bitter plight of Israel, with neither bond
nor free left, and with none to help Israel.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָאָה יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֳנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֹרֶה מְאֹד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְאֶפֶס עָזוּב וְאֵין עֹזֵר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־רָאָה יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֳנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֹרֶה מְאֹד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְאֶפֶס עָזוּב וְאֵין עֹזֵר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
For YHWH saw the very bitter plight of Israel, with neither bond
nor free left, and with none to help Israel.

translation.text: For the LORD saw that the distress of Israel was very bitter; there was no one left, bond or free, and no one to help Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH resolved not to blot out the name of Israel from under
heaven; and he delivered them through Jeroboam son of Joash.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר יְהֹוָה לִמְחוֹת אֶת־שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם בְּיַד יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר יְהֹוָה לִמְחוֹת אֶת־שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם בְּיַד יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ׃

english.text:
And YHWH resolved not to blot out the name of Israel from under
heaven; and he delivered them through Jeroboam son of Joash.

translation.text: But the LORD had not said that he would the hand of Jeroboam son of Joash.

verses.english:
The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, how he fought and recovered Damascus and Hamath for
Judah in Israel, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.
verses.hebrew:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרבְעָם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחָם וַאֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיב אֶת־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וְאֶת־חֲמָת לִיהוּדָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי
הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרבְעָם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחָם וַאֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיב אֶת־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וְאֶת־חֲמָת לִיהוּדָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי
הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, how he fought and recovered Damascus and Hamath for
Judah in Israel, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Jeroboam slept with his fathers, the kings of Israel, and his son
Zechariah succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יָרבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ זְכַרְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יָרבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ זְכַרְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jeroboam slept with his fathers, the kings of Israel, and his son
Zechariah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Jeroboam slept with his ancestors, the kings of Israel; his son Zechariah succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the twenty-seventh year of King Jeroboam of Israel, Azariah son
of King Amaziah of Judah became king.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיָרבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיָרבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the twenty-seventh year of King Jeroboam of Israel, Azariah son
of King Amaziah of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the twenty-seventh year of King Jeroboam of Israel King Azariah son of Amaziah of Judah began to reign.

verses.english:
He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jecoliah of
Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְכלְיָהוּ מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְכלְיָהוּ מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jecoliah of
Jerusalem.

translation.text: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Amaziah had
done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אֲמַצְיָהוּ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אֲמַצְיָהוּ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Amaziah had
done.

translation.text: He did what was right in the sight of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

verses.english:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.
verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.

translation.text: sacrificed and made offerings on the high places.

verses.english:
YHWH struck the king with a plague, and he was a leper until the
day of his death; he lived in isolated quarters, while Jotham, the
king’s son, was in charge of the palace and governed the people of
the land.
verses.hebrew: וַיְנַגַּע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְהִי מְצֹרָע עַד־יוֹם מֹתוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית הַחפְשִׁית וְיוֹתָם בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַבַּיִת שֹׁפֵט אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְנַגַּע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְהִי מְצֹרָע עַד־יוֹם מֹתוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית הַחפְשִׁית וְיוֹתָם בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַבַּיִת שֹׁפֵט אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
YHWH struck the king with a plague, and he was a leper until the
day of his death; he lived in isolated quarters, while Jotham, the
king’s son, was in charge of the palace and governed the people of
the land.

translation.text: The LORD struck the governing the people of the land.

verses.english:
The other events of Azariah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עֲזַרְיָהוּ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עֲזַרְיָהוּ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Azariah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
Azariah slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the City of David; his son Jotham succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עֲזַרְיָה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹתָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עֲזַרְיָה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹתָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Azariah slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the City of David; his son Jotham succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Azariah slept with his ancestors; they succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the thirty-eighth year of King Azariah of Judah, Zechariah son
of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria—for six months.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זְכַרְיָהוּ בֶן־יָרבְעָם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זְכַרְיָהוּ בֶן־יָרבְעָם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
In the thirty-eighth year of King Azariah of Judah, Zechariah son
of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria—for six months.

translation.text: In the thirty-eighth year of King Azariah of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, as his fathers had done; he
did not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had
caused Israel to commit.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, as his fathers had done; he
did not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had
caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: He did what was to sin.

verses.english:
Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him and struck him down
before the people and killed him, and succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־יָבֵשׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ קבל־עָם וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־יָבֵשׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ קבל־עָם וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him and struck him down
before the people and killed him, and succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him down in public and killed him, and reigned in place of him.

verses.english:
The other events of Zechariah’s reign are recorded in the Annals
of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זְכַרְיָה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זְכַרְיָה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Zechariah’s reign are recorded in the Annals
of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the deeds of Zechariah are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.english:
This was in accord with the word that YHWH had spoken to Jehu:
“Four generations of your descendants shall occupy the throne of
Israel.” And so it came about.
verses.hebrew: הוּא דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר בְּנֵי רְבִיעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי־כֵן׃

hebrew.text: הוּא דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר בְּנֵי רְבִיעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי־כֵן׃

english.text:
This was in accord with the word that YHWH had spoken to Jehu:
“Four generations of your descendants shall occupy the throne of
Israel.” And so it came about.

translation.text: This was the promise of the LORD that he gave to generation." And so it happened.

verses.english:
Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of King
Uzziah of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.

english.text:
Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of King

translation.text: Shallum son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of King Uzziah of Judah; he reigned one month in Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי מִתִּרְצָה וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי מִתִּרְצָה וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

translation.text: Then Menahem Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria and killed him; he reigned in place of him.

verses.english:
The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy that he
formed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.english:
At that time, [marching] from Tirzah, Menahem subdued Tiphsah and
all who were in it, and its territory; and because it did not
surrender, he massacred [its people] and ripped open all its
pregnant women.

hebrew.text: אָז יַכֶּה־מְנַחֵם אֶת־תִּפְסַח וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִתִּרְצָה כִּי לֹא פָתַח וַיַּךְ אֵת כּל־הֶהָרוֹתֶיהָ בִּקֵּעַ׃

translation.text: At that time Menahem sacked Tiphsah, all who were in it and sacked it. He ripped open all the pregnant women in it.

verses.english:
In the thirty-ninth year of King Azariah of Judah, Menahem son of
Gadi became king over Israel in Samaria—for ten years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
In the thirty-ninth year of King Azariah of Judah, Menahem son of
Gadi became king over Israel in Samaria—for ten years.

translation.text: In the thirty-ninth year of King Azariah of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi began to reign over Israel; he reigned ten years in Samaria.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; throughout his days he did
not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused
Israel to commit.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יָמָיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; throughout his days he did
not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused
Israel to commit.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; he did not depart all his days to sin.

verses.english:
King Pul of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a
thousand talents of silver that he might support him and
strengthen his hold on the kingdom.
verses.hebrew: בָּא פוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן מְנַחֵם לְפוּל אֶלֶף כִּכַּר־כָּסֶף לִהְיוֹת יָדָיו אִתּוֹ לְהַחֲזִיק הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בָּא פוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן מְנַחֵם לְפוּל אֶלֶף כִּכַּר־כָּסֶף לִהְיוֹת יָדָיו אִתּוֹ לְהַחֲזִיק הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
King Pul of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a
thousand talents of silver that he might support him and
strengthen his hold on the kingdom.

translation.text: King Pul of Assyria came against the land; Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, so that he might help him confirm his hold on the royal power.

verses.english:
Menahem exacted the money from Israel: every man of means had to
pay fifty shekels of silver for the king of Assyria. The king of
Assyria withdrew and did not remain in the land.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּצֵא מְנַחֵם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל לָתֵת לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף לְאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיָּשׁב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא־עָמַד שָׁם
בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּצֵא מְנַחֵם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל לָתֵת לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף לְאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיָּשׁב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא־עָמַד שָׁם
בָּאָרֶץ׃

Menahem exacted the money from Israel: every man of means had to

Assyria withdrew and did not remain in the land.

translation.text: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, that is, from all the wealthy, fifty shekels of silver from each one, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and did not stay there in the land.

verses.english:
The other events of Menahem’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

english.text:
The other events of Menahem’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the deeds of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?

verses.english:
Menahem slept with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him
as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַחֵם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ פְּקַחְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Menahem slept with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him
as king.

translation.text: Menahem slept with his ancestors, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the fiftieth year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekahiah son of
Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria—for two years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פְּקַחְיָה בֶן־מְנַחֵם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁנָתָיִם׃

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he caused Israel to sin.

verses.english:
His aide, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him and struck
him down in the royal palace in Samaria; with him were fifty
Gileadites, with men from Argob and Arieh; and he killed him and
succeeded him as king.

וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ שָׁלִישׁוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ בְשֹׁמְרוֹן בְּאַרְמוֹן בֵּית־[הַמֶּלֶךְ] (מלך) אֶת־אַרְגֹּב וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי

verses.english:
In the fifty-second year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekah son of
Remaliah became king over Israel and Samaria—for twenty years.

sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD; he did not to sin.

verses.english:
In the days of King Pekah of Israel, King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel- beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh,
Hazor—Gilead, Galilee, the entire region of Naphtali; and he
deported the inhabitants to Assyria.
verses.hebrew:
בִּימֵי פֶּקַח מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֶת־יָנוֹחַ וְאֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־הַגִּלְעָד
וְאֶת־הַגָּלִילָה כֹּל אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי וַיַּגְלֵם אַשּׁוּרָה׃

hebrew.text:
בִּימֵי פֶּקַח מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֶת־יָנוֹחַ וְאֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־הַגִּלְעָד
וְאֶת־הַגָּלִילָה כֹּל אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי וַיַּגְלֵם אַשּׁוּרָה׃

english.text:
In the days of King Pekah of Israel, King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel- beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh,
Hazor—Gilead, Galilee, the entire region of Naphtali; and he
deported the inhabitants to Assyria.

translation.text: In the days of King Pekah of Israel, King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried the people captive to Assyria.

verses.english:
Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah,
attacked him, and killed him. He succeeded him as king in the
twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשׁר־קֶשֶׁר הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה עַל־פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשׁר־קֶשֶׁר הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה עַל־פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּה׃

english.text:
Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah,
attacked him, and killed him. He succeeded him as king in the
twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

translation.text: Then Hoshea son of Elah made a conspiracy reigned in place of him, in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

verses.english:
The other events of Pekah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי־פֶקַח וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי־פֶקַח וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Pekah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.english:
In the second year of King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel, Jotham
son of King Uzziah of Judah became king.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ יוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ יוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the second year of King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel, Jotham
son of King Uzziah of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the second year of King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel, King Jotham son of Uzziah of Judah began to reign.

verses.english:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jerusha daughter
of Zadok.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְרוּשָׁא בַּת־צָדוֹק׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְרוּשָׁא בַּת־צָדוֹק׃

english.text:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jerusha daughter
of Zadok.

translation.text: He was twenty-five Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Uzziah had
done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֻזִּיָּהוּ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֻזִּיָּהוּ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Uzziah had
done.

translation.text: He had done.

verses.english:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines. It was he who built
the Upper Gate of the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הָעֶלְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הָעֶלְיוֹן׃

english.text:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines. It was he who built
the Upper Gate of the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Nevertheless the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
The other events of Jotham’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Jotham’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
In those days, YHWH began to incite King Rezin of Aram and Pekah
son of Remaliah against Judah.
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְהַשְׁלִיחַ בִּיהוּדָה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וְאֵת פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְהַשְׁלִיחַ בִּיהוּדָה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וְאֵת פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ׃

english.text:
In those days, YHWH began to incite King Rezin of Aram and Pekah
son of Remaliah against Judah.

translation.text: In those days the LORD began to send King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.

verses.english:
Jotham slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the city of his ancestor David; his son Ahaz succeeded him as
king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹתָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹתָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jotham slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the city of his ancestor David; his son Ahaz succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: the city of David, his ancestor; his son Ahaz succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of King
Jotham of Judah became king.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מָלַךְ אָחָז בֶּן־יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מָלַךְ אָחָז בֶּן־יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of King
Jotham of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, King Ahaz son of Jotham of Judah began to reign.

verses.english:
Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was pleasing to
YHWH his God, as his ancestor David had done,
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָחָז בְּמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְלֹא־עָשָׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָחָז בְּמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְלֹא־עָשָׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was pleasing to
YHWH his God, as his ancestor David had done,

translation.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he had done,

verses.english:
but followed the ways of the kings of Israel. He even consigned
his son to the fire, in the abhorrent fashion of the nations which
YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם אֶת־בְּנוֹ הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ כְּתֹעֲבוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם אֶת־בְּנוֹ הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ כְּתֹעֲבוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
but followed the ways of the kings of Israel. He even consigned
his son to the fire, in the abhorrent fashion of the nations which
YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelites.

translation.text: but he walked in the way of the kings of Israel. He even of the nations whom the LORD drove out before the people of Israel.

verses.english:
He sacrificed and made offerings at the shrines, on the hills, and
under every leafy tree.
verses.hebrew: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

english.text:
He sacrificed and made offerings at the shrines, on the hills, and
under every leafy tree.

translation.text: under every green tree.

verses.english:
Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel
advanced on Jerusalem for battle. They besieged Ahaz, but could
not overcome [him].
verses.hebrew: אָז יַעֲלֶה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־אָחָז וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִלָּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַעֲלֶה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־אָחָז וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִלָּחֵם׃

english.text:
Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel
advanced on Jerusalem for battle. They besieged Ahaz, but could
not overcome [him].

translation.text: Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel conquer him.

verses.english:
At that time King Rezin of Aram recovered Elath for Aram; he drove
out the Judites from Elath, and Edomites came to Elath and settled
there, as is still the case.
verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא הֵשִׁיב רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־אֵילַת לַאֲרָם וַיְנַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים מֵאֵילוֹת (וארמים) [וַאֲדֹמִים] בָּאוּ אֵילַת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא הֵשִׁיב רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־אֵילַת לַאֲרָם וַיְנַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים מֵאֵילוֹת (וארמים) [וַאֲדֹמִים] בָּאוּ אֵילַת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
At that time King Rezin of Aram recovered Elath for Aram; he drove
out the Judites from Elath, and Edomites came to Elath and settled
there, as is still the case.

translation.text: At that time the king of Edom recovered Elath for Elath, where they live to this day.

verses.english:
Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria to say, “I
am your servant and your son; come and deliver me from the hands
of the king of Aram and from the hands of the king of Israel, who
are attacking me.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אָחָז מַלְאָכִים אֶל־תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ וּבִנְךָ אָנִי עֲלֵה וְהוֹשִׁעֵנִי מִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַקּוֹמִים
עָלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אָחָז מַלְאָכִים אֶל־תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ וּבִנְךָ אָנִי עֲלֵה וְהוֹשִׁעֵנִי מִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַקּוֹמִים
עָלָי׃

english.text:
Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria to say, “I
am your servant and your son; come and deliver me from the hands
of the king of Aram and from the hands of the king of Israel, who
are attacking me.”

translation.text: Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria, saying, "I am your servant and your son. the hand of the king of Israel, who are attacking me."

verses.english:
Ahaz took the gold and silver that were on hand in the House of
YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent them as a
gift to the king of Assyria.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אָחָז אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב הַנִּמְצָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לְמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שֹׁחַד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אָחָז אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב הַנִּמְצָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לְמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שֹׁחַד׃

english.text:
Ahaz took the gold and silver that were on hand in the House of
YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent them as a
gift to the king of Assyria.

translation.text: Ahaz also took the silver and gold found in the house of the LORD and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent a present to the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
The king of Assyria responded to his request; the king of Assyria
marched against Damascus and captured it. He deported its
inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶל־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיִּתְפְּשֶׂהָ וַיַּגְלֶהָ קִירָה וְאֶת־רְצִין הֵמִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶל־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיִּתְפְּשֶׂהָ וַיַּגְלֶהָ קִירָה וְאֶת־רְצִין הֵמִית׃

english.text:
The king of Assyria responded to his request; the king of Assyria
marched against Damascus and captured it. He deported its
inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.

translation.text: The king of Assyria listened to him; the king of Assyria marched up against Damascus, and took it, carrying its people captive to Kir; then he killed Rezin.

verses.english:
When King Ahaz went to Damascus to greet King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria, he saw the altar in Damascus. King Ahaz sent the priest
Uriah a sketch of the altar and a detailed plan of its
construction.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז לִקְרַאת תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר דּוּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּדַמָּשֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן
אֶת־דְּמוּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת־תַּבְנִיתוֹ לְכל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז לִקְרַאת תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר דּוּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּדַמָּשֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן
אֶת־דְּמוּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת־תַּבְנִיתוֹ לְכל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

english.text:
When King Ahaz went to Damascus to greet King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria, he saw the altar in Damascus. King Ahaz sent the priest
Uriah a sketch of the altar and a detailed plan of its
construction.

translation.text: When King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet King Tiglath-pileser of priest Uriah a model of the altar, and its pattern, exact in all its details.

verses.english:
The priest Uriah did just as King Ahaz had instructed him from
Damascus; the priest Uriah built the altar before King Ahaz
returned from Damascus.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק כֵּן עָשָׂה אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן עַד־בּוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז מִדַּמָּשֶׂק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק כֵּן עָשָׂה אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן עַד־בּוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז מִדַּמָּשֶׂק׃

english.text:
The priest Uriah did just as King Ahaz had instructed him from
Damascus; the priest Uriah built the altar before King Ahaz
returned from Damascus.

translation.text: The priest Uriah built the altar; in accordance with all that King Ahaz King Ahaz arrived from Damascus.

verses.english:
When the king returned from Damascus, and when the king saw the
altar, the king drew near the altar, ascended it,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעַל עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעַל עָלָיו׃

english.text:
When the king returned from Damascus, and when the king saw the
altar, the king drew near the altar, ascended it,

translation.text: When the king came from altar, went up on it,

verses.english:
and offered his burnt offering and meal offering; he poured his
libation, and he dashed the blood of his offering of well-being
against the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וַיַּסֵּךְ אֶת־נִסְכּוֹ וַיִּזְרֹק אֶת־דַּם־הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וַיַּסֵּךְ אֶת־נִסְכּוֹ וַיִּזְרֹק אֶת־דַּם־הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
and offered his burnt offering and meal offering; he poured his
libation, and he dashed the blood of his offering of well-being
against the altar.

translation.text: and offered his burnt offering and his grain offerings of well-being against the altar.

verses.english:
As for the bronze altar which had been before YHWH, he moved it
from its place in front of the Temple, between the [new] altar and
the House of YHWH, and placed it on the north side of the [new]
altar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַמִּזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּקְרֵב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת מִבֵּין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִבֵּין בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ עַל־יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הַמִּזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּקְרֵב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת מִבֵּין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִבֵּין בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ עַל־יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפוֹנָה׃

english.text:
As for the bronze altar which had been before YHWH, he moved it
from its place in front of the Temple, between the [new] altar and
the House of YHWH, and placed it on the north side of the [new]
altar.

translation.text: The bronze altar that was north side of his altar.

verses.english:
And King Ahaz commanded the priest Uriah: “On the great altar you
shall offer the morning burnt offering and the evening meal
offering and the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with
the burnt offerings of all the people of the land, their meal
offerings and their libations. And against it you shall dash the
blood of all the burnt offerings and all the blood of the
sacrifices. And I will decide about the bronze altar.”
verses.hebrew:
(ויצוהו) [וַיְצַוֶּה] הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַגָּדוֹל הַקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלַת־הַבֹּקֶר וְאֶת־מִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב וְאֶת־עֹלַת הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֵת עֹלַת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם וְכל־דַּם עֹלָה וְכל־דַּם־זֶבַח עָלָיו תִּזְרֹק וּמִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבַקֵּר׃

hebrew.text:
(ויצוהו) [וַיְצַוֶּה] הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַגָּדוֹל הַקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלַת־הַבֹּקֶר וְאֶת־מִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב וְאֶת־עֹלַת הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֵת עֹלַת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם וְכל־דַּם עֹלָה וְכל־דַּם־זֶבַח עָלָיו תִּזְרֹק וּמִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבַקֵּר׃

english.text:
And King Ahaz commanded the priest Uriah: “On the great altar you
shall offer the morning burnt offering and the evening meal
offering and the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with
the burnt offerings of all the people of the land, their meal
offerings and their libations. And against it you shall dash the
blood of all the burnt offerings and all the blood of the
sacrifices. And I will decide about the bronze altar.”

translation.text: King Ahaz commanded the priest Uriah, the evening grain offering, and the king's burnt offering, and his grain blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by."

verses.english: Uriah did just as King Ahaz commanded.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז׃

english.text: Uriah did just as King Ahaz commanded.

translation.text: The priest Uriah did everything that King Ahaz commanded.

verses.english:
King Ahaz cut off the insets—the laver stands—and removed the
lavers from them. He also removed the tank from the bronze oxen
that supported it and set it on a stone pavement—
verses.hebrew:
וַיְקַצֵּץ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶת־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת הַמְּכוֹנֹת וַיָּסַר מֵעֲלֵיהֶם (ואת) [אֶת־]הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת־הַיָּם הוֹרִד מֵעַל הַבָּקָר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיִּתֵּן
אֹתוֹ עַל מַרְצֶפֶת אֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְקַצֵּץ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶת־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת הַמְּכוֹנֹת וַיָּסַר מֵעֲלֵיהֶם (ואת) [אֶת־]הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת־הַיָּם הוֹרִד מֵעַל הַבָּקָר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיִּתֵּן
אֹתוֹ עַל מַרְצֶפֶת אֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
King Ahaz cut off the insets—the laver stands—and removed the
lavers from them. He also removed the tank from the bronze oxen
that supported it and set it on a stone pavement—

translation.text: Then King Ahaz cut off the frames of the stands, and removed the under it, and put it on a pediment of stone.

verses.english:
on account of the king of Assyria. He also extended to the House
of YHWH the sabbath passage that had been built in the palace and
the king’s outer entrance.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־[מוּסַךְ] (מיסך) הַשַּׁבָּת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנוּ בַבַּיִת וְאֶת־מְבוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחִיצוֹנָה הֵסֵב בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־[מוּסַךְ] (מיסך) הַשַּׁבָּת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנוּ בַבַּיִת וְאֶת־מְבוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחִיצוֹנָה הֵסֵב בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
on account of the king of Assyria. He also extended to the House
of YHWH the sabbath passage that had been built in the palace and
the king’s outer entrance.

translation.text: The covered portal for use on the sabbath that had been built inside the palace, and the outer this because of the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
The other events of Ahaz’s reign, and his actions, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָחָז אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָחָז אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Ahaz’s reign, and his actions, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the
City of David; his son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the
City of David; his son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: Ahaz slept with his ancestors, and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David; his son Hezekiah succeeded him.

verses.english:
In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah
became king over Israel in Samaria—for nine years.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לְאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה בְשֹׁמְרוֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לְאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה בְשֹׁמְרוֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah
became king over Israel in Samaria—for nine years.

translation.text: In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel; he reigned nine years.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, though not as much as the
kings of Israel who preceded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, though not as much as the
kings of Israel who preceded him.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, yet not like the kings of Israel who were before him.

verses.english:
King Shalmaneser marched against him, and Hoshea became his vassal
and paid him tribute.
verses.hebrew: עָלָיו עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיְהִי־לוֹ הוֹשֵׁעַ עֶבֶד וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ מִנְחָה׃

hebrew.text: עָלָיו עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיְהִי־לוֹ הוֹשֵׁעַ עֶבֶד וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ מִנְחָה׃

english.text:
King Shalmaneser marched against him, and Hoshea became his vassal
and paid him tribute.

translation.text: King Shalmaneser of Assyria came up against him; Hoshea became his vassal, and paid him tribute.

verses.english:
But the king of Assyria caught Hoshea in an act of treachery: he
had sent envoys to King So of Egypt, and he had not paid the
tribute to the king of Assyria, as in previous years. And the king
of Assyria arrested him and put him in prison.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּמְצָא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּהוֹשֵׁעַ קֶשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סוֹא מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְלֹא־הֶעֱלָה מִנְחָה לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר כְּשָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה וַיַּעְצְרֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ
אַשּׁוּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בֵּית כֶּלֶא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּמְצָא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּהוֹשֵׁעַ קֶשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סוֹא מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְלֹא־הֶעֱלָה מִנְחָה לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר כְּשָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה וַיַּעְצְרֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ
אַשּׁוּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בֵּית כֶּלֶא׃

english.text:
But the king of Assyria caught Hoshea in an act of treachery: he
had sent envoys to King So of Egypt, and he had not paid the
tribute to the king of Assyria, as in previous years. And the king
of Assyria arrested him and put him in prison.

translation.text: But the king of imprisoned him.

verses.english:
Then the king of Assyria marched against the whole land; he came
to Samaria and besieged it for three years.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעַל שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעַל שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
Then the king of Assyria marched against the whole land; he came
to Samaria and besieged it for three years.

translation.text: Then the king of Assyria invaded all the land and came to Samaria; for three years he besieged it.

verses.english:
In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria.
He deported the Israelites to Assyria and settled them in Halah,
at the [River] Habor, at the River Gozan, and in the towns of
Media.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ לָכַד מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיֹּשֶׁב אוֹתָם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ לָכַד מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיֹּשֶׁב אוֹתָם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃

english.text:
In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria.
He deported the Israelites to Assyria and settled them in Halah,
at the [River] Habor, at the River Gozan, and in the towns of
Media.

translation.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria captured Samaria; he carried the Israelites away to Assyria. He cities of the Medes.

verses.english:
This happened because the Israelites sinned against YHWH their
God, who had freed them from the land of Egypt, from the hand of
Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָטְאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִתַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרָיִם וַיִּירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָטְאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִתַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרָיִם וַיִּירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
This happened because the Israelites sinned against YHWH their
God, who had freed them from the land of Egypt, from the hand of
Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

translation.text: This occurred because the people of Israel had sinned against the other gods

verses.english:
and followed the customs of the nations which YHWH had
dispossessed before the Israelites and the customs which the kings
of Israel had practiced.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
and followed the customs of the nations which YHWH had
dispossessed before the Israelites and the customs which the kings
of Israel had practiced.

translation.text: and walked in the customs of the nations whom the LORD drove out before the people of Israel, and in the customs that the kings of Israel had introduced.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַפְּאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כֵן עַל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּבְנוּ לָהֶם בָּמוֹת בְּכל־עָרֵיהֶם מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַפְּאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כֵן עַל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּבְנוּ לָהֶם בָּמוֹת בְּכל־עָרֵיהֶם מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃

translation.text: The people of Israel secretly did things that high places at all their towns, from watchtower to fortified city;

verses.english:
they set up pillars and sacred posts for themselves on every lofty
hill and under every leafy tree;
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצִּבוּ לָהֶם מַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצִּבוּ לָהֶם מַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

english.text:
they set up pillars and sacred posts for themselves on every lofty
hill and under every leafy tree;

translation.text: they under every green tree;

verses.english:
and they offered sacrifices there, at all the shrines, like the
nations whom YHWH had driven into exile before them. They
committed wicked acts to vex YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־שָׁם בְּכל־בָּמוֹת כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הֶגְלָה יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ דְּבָרִים רָעִים לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־שָׁם בְּכל־בָּמוֹת כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הֶגְלָה יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ דְּבָרִים רָעִים לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and they offered sacrifices there, at all the shrines, like the
nations whom YHWH had driven into exile before them. They
committed wicked acts to vex YHWH,

translation.text: there they made offerings on all the high places, as the nations did whom the LORD carried away before them. They did wicked things, provoking the LORD to anger;

verses.english:
and they worshiped fetishes concerning which YHWH had said to
them, “You must not do this thing.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and they worshiped fetishes concerning which YHWH had said to
them, “You must not do this thing.”

translation.text: they served idols, of which the LORD had said to them, "You shall not do this."

verses.english:
YHWH warned Israel and Judah by every prophet [and] every seer,
saying: “Turn back from your wicked ways, and observe My
commandments and My laws, according to all the Teaching that I
commanded your fathers and that I transmitted to you through My
servants the prophets.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּעַד יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִיהוּדָה בְּיַד כּל־[נְבִיאֵי] (נביאו) כל־חֹזֶה לֵאמֹר שֻׁבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם הָרָעִים וְשִׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי כְּכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר
צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּעַד יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִיהוּדָה בְּיַד כּל־[נְבִיאֵי] (נביאו) כל־חֹזֶה לֵאמֹר שֻׁבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם הָרָעִים וְשִׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי כְּכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר
צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים׃

english.text:
YHWH warned Israel and Judah by every prophet [and] every seer,
saying: “Turn back from your wicked ways, and observe My
commandments and My laws, according to all the Teaching that I
commanded your fathers and that I transmitted to you through My
servants the prophets.”

translation.text: ancestors and that I sent to you by my servants the prophets."

verses.english:
But they did not obey; they stiffened their necks, like their
fathers who did not have faith in YHWH their God;
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־ערְפָּם כְּעֹרֶף אֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־ערְפָּם כְּעֹרֶף אֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
But they did not obey; they stiffened their necks, like their
fathers who did not have faith in YHWH their God;

translation.text: They did not believe in the LORD their God.

verses.english:
they spurned His laws and the covenant that He had made with their
fathers, and the warnings He had given them. They went after
delusion and were deluded; [they imitated] the nations that were
about them, which YHWH had forbidden them to emulate.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּמְאֲסוּ אֶת־חֻקָּיו וְאֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְאֵת עֵדְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֵעִיד בָּם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהֶבֶל וַיֶּהְבָּלוּ וְאַחֲרֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר
סְבִיבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתָם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּמְאֲסוּ אֶת־חֻקָּיו וְאֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְאֵת עֵדְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֵעִיד בָּם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהֶבֶל וַיֶּהְבָּלוּ וְאַחֲרֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר
סְבִיבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתָם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּהֶם׃

english.text:
they spurned His laws and the covenant that He had made with their
fathers, and the warnings He had given them. They went after
delusion and were deluded; [they imitated] the nations that were
about them, which YHWH had forbidden them to emulate.

translation.text: They despised his statutes, and LORD had commanded them that they should not do as they did.

verses.english:
They rejected all the commandments of YHWH their God; they made
molten idols for themselves—two calves—and they made a sacred post
and they bowed down to all the host of heaven, and they worshiped
Baal.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה (שנים) [שְׁנֵי] עֲגָלִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֲשֵׁירָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ
אֶת־הַבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה (שנים) [שְׁנֵי] עֲגָלִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֲשֵׁירָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ
אֶת־הַבָּעַל׃

english.text:
They rejected all the commandments of YHWH their God; they made
molten idols for themselves—two calves—and they made a sacred post
and they bowed down to all the host of heaven, and they worshiped
Baal.

translation.text: worshiped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

verses.english:
They consigned their sons and daughters to the fire; they
practiced augury and divination, and gave themselves over to what
was displeasing to YHWH and vexed Him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּקְסְמוּ קְסָמִים וַיְנַחֵשׁוּ וַיִּתְמַכְּרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּקְסְמוּ קְסָמִים וַיְנַחֵשׁוּ וַיִּתְמַכְּרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

english.text:
They consigned their sons and daughters to the fire; they
practiced augury and divination, and gave themselves over to what
was displeasing to YHWH and vexed Him.

translation.text: They made their provoking him to anger.

verses.english:
YHWH was incensed at Israel and He banished them from His
presence; none was left but the tribe of Judah alone.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְסִרֵם מֵעַל פָּנָיו לֹא נִשְׁאַר רַק שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְסִרֵם מֵעַל פָּנָיו לֹא נִשְׁאַר רַק שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH was incensed at Israel and He banished them from His
presence; none was left but the tribe of Judah alone.

translation.text: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel and removed them out of his sight; none was left but the tribe of Judah alone.

verses.english:
Nor did Judah keep the commandments of YHWH their God; they
followed the customs that Israel had practiced.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוּדָה לֹא שָׁמַר אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־יְהוּדָה לֹא שָׁמַר אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
Nor did Judah keep the commandments of YHWH their God; they
followed the customs that Israel had practiced.

translation.text: Judah also did not keep the commandments of the LORD their God but walked in the customs that Israel had introduced.

verses.english:
So YHWH spurned all the offspring of Israel, and He afflicted them
and delivered them into the hands of plunderers, and finally He
cast them out from His presence.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאַס יְהֹוָה בְּכל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְעַנֵּם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים עַד אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכָם מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְאַס יְהֹוָה בְּכל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְעַנֵּם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים עַד אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכָם מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
So YHWH spurned all the offspring of Israel, and He afflicted them
and delivered them into the hands of plunderers, and finally He
cast them out from His presence.

translation.text: The LORD presence.

verses.english:
For Israel broke away from the House of David, and they made
Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam caused Israel to stray from
YHWH and to commit great sin,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל בֵּית דָּוִד וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (וידא) [וַיַּדַּח] יָרבְעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְהֶחֱטִיאָם חֲטָאָה גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־קָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל בֵּית דָּוִד וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (וידא) [וַיַּדַּח] יָרבְעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְהֶחֱטִיאָם חֲטָאָה גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
For Israel broke away from the House of David, and they made
Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam caused Israel to stray from
YHWH and to commit great sin,

translation.text: When he had torn Israel from the house of David, they made LORD and made them commit great sin.

verses.english:
and the Israelites persisted in all the sins which Jeroboam had
committed; they did not depart from them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לֹא־סָרוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לֹא־סָרוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
and the Israelites persisted in all the sins which Jeroboam had
committed; they did not depart from them.

translation.text: The people of Israel from them

verses.english:
In the end, YHWH removed Israel from His presence, as He had
warned them through all His servants the prophets. So the
Israelites were deported from their land to Assyria, as is still
the case.
verses.hebrew: עַד אֲשֶׁר־הֵסִיר יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פָּנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד כּל־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים וַיִּגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ אַשּׁוּרָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: עַד אֲשֶׁר־הֵסִיר יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פָּנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד כּל־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים וַיִּגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ אַשּׁוּרָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
In the end, YHWH removed Israel from His presence, as He had
warned them through all His servants the prophets. So the
Israelites were deported from their land to Assyria, as is still
the case.

translation.text: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had foretold through all his servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from their own land to Assyria until this day.

verses.english:
The king of Assyria brought [people] from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva,
Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and he settled them in the towns of
Samaria in place of the Israelites; they took possession of
Samaria and dwelt in its towns.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֵא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר מִבָּבֶל וּמִכּוּתָה וּמֵעַוָּא וּמֵחֲמָת וּסְפַרְוַיִם וַיֹּשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן תַּחַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ
בְּעָרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֵא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר מִבָּבֶל וּמִכּוּתָה וּמֵעַוָּא וּמֵחֲמָת וּסְפַרְוַיִם וַיֹּשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן תַּחַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ
בְּעָרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
The king of Assyria brought [people] from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva,
Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and he settled them in the towns of
Samaria in place of the Israelites; they took possession of
Samaria and dwelt in its towns.

translation.text: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, settled in its cities.

verses.english:
When they first settled there, they did not worship YHWH; so YHWH
sent lions against them which killed some of them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּתְחִלַּת שִׁבְתָּם שָׁם לֹא יָרְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ הֹרְגִים בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּתְחִלַּת שִׁבְתָּם שָׁם לֹא יָרְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ הֹרְגִים בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
When they first settled there, they did not worship YHWH; so YHWH
sent lions against them which killed some of them.

translation.text: When they first settled there, they did not killed some of them.

verses.english:
They said to the king of Assyria: “The nations which you deported
and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know the rules of the
God of the land; therefore He has let lions loose against them
which are killing them—for they do not know the rules of the God
of the land.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתָ וַתּוֹשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיְשַׁלַּח־בָּם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וְהִנָּם
מְמִיתִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֵינָם יֹדְעִים אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתָ וַתּוֹשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיְשַׁלַּח־בָּם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וְהִנָּם
מְמִיתִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֵינָם יֹדְעִים אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
They said to the king of Assyria: “The nations which you deported
and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know the rules of the
God of the land; therefore He has let lions loose against them
which are killing them—for they do not know the rules of the God
of the land.”

translation.text: So the king of Assyria was told, "The nations of the god of the land."

verses.english:
The king of Assyria gave an order: “Send there one of the priests
whom you have deported; let him go and dwell there, and let him
teach them the practices of the God of the land.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הֹלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתֶם מִשָּׁם וְיֵלְכוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ שָׁם וְיֹרֵם אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הֹלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתֶם מִשָּׁם וְיֵלְכוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ שָׁם וְיֹרֵם אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
The king of Assyria gave an order: “Send there one of the priests
whom you have deported; let him go and dwell there, and let him
teach them the practices of the God of the land.”

translation.text: Then the king of Assyria commanded, him go and live there, and teach them the law of the god of the land."

verses.english:
So one of the priests whom they had exiled from Samaria came and
settled in Bethel; he taught them how to worship YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיְהִי מוֹרֶה אֹתָם אֵיךְ יִירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיְהִי מוֹרֶה אֹתָם אֵיךְ יִירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So one of the priests whom they had exiled from Samaria came and
settled in Bethel; he taught them how to worship YHWH.

translation.text: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria LORD.

verses.english:
However, each nation continued to make its own gods and to set
them up in the cult places which had been made by the people of
Samaria; each nation [set them up] in the towns in which it lived.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים גּוֹי גּוֹי אֱלֹהָיו וַיַּנִּיחוּ בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הַשֹּׁמְרֹנִים גּוֹי גּוֹי בְּעָרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים גּוֹי גּוֹי אֱלֹהָיו וַיַּנִּיחוּ בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הַשֹּׁמְרֹנִים גּוֹי גּוֹי בְּעָרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם׃

english.text:
However, each nation continued to make its own gods and to set
them up in the cult places which had been made by the people of
Samaria; each nation [set them up] in the towns in which it lived.

translation.text: But every nation still made gods of its own and put them in the nation in the cities in which they lived;

Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

They worshiped YHWH, but they also appointed from their own ranks

places.

the descendants of Jacob—who was given the name Israel—

Do not forget the covenant that I made with you; do not worship
other gods.

Do not forget the covenant that I made with you; do not worship

Those nations worshiped YHWH, but they also served their idols. To
this day their children and their children’s children do as their
ancestors did.

verses.english:
In the third year of King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, Hezekiah
son of King Ahaz of Judah became king.

verses.english:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
in Jerusalem twenty-nine years; his mother’s name was Abi daughter
of Zechariah.

verses.english:

done.

done.

sacred post. He also broke into pieces the bronze serpent that
Moses had made, for until that time the Israelites had been
offering sacrifices to it; it was called Nehushtan.

He trusted only in YHWH the God of Israel; there was none like him
among all the kings of Judah after him, nor among those before
him.

verses.english:
He clung to YHWH; he did not turn away from following Him, but
kept the commandments that YHWH had given to Moses.

kept the commandments that YHWH had given to Moses.

translation.text: For he held fast to the commandments that the LORD commanded Moses.

turned. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and would not
serve him.

In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of
Assyria marched against all the fortified towns of Judah and
seized them.

english.text:
In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of
Assyria marched against all the fortified towns of Judah and
seized them.

translation.text: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

verses.english:
King Hezekiah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish:
“I have done wrong; withdraw from me; and I shall bear whatever
you impose on me.” So the king of Assyria imposed upon King
Hezekiah of Judah a payment of three hundred talents of silver and
thirty talents of gold.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לָכִישָׁה לֵאמֹר חָטָאתִי שׁוּב מֵעָלַי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תִּתֵּן עָלַי אֶשָּׂא וַיָּשֶׂם מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־חִזְקִיָּה
מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

Temple of YHWH, which King Hezekiah had overlaid [with gold], and
gave them to the king of Assyria.

The Rabshakeh said to them, “You tell Hezekiah: Thus said the
Great King, the King of Assyria: What makes you so confident?

verses.english:
You must think that mere talk is counsel and valor for war! Look,
on whom are you relying, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתָּ אַךְ־דְּבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עַתָּה עַל־מִי בָטַחְתָּ כִּי מָרַדְתָּ בִּי׃

hebrew.text: אָמַרְתָּ אַךְ־דְּבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עַתָּה עַל־מִי בָטַחְתָּ כִּי מָרַדְתָּ בִּי׃

english.text:
You must think that mere talk is counsel and valor for war! Look,
on whom are you relying, that you have rebelled against me?

translation.text: Do you think that mere words are strategy and power for war? On whom do you now rely, that you have rebelled against me?

verses.english:
You rely, of all things, on Egypt, that splintered reed of a
staff, which enters and punctures the palm of anyone who leans on
it! That’s what Pharaoh king of Egypt is like to all who rely on
him.
verses.hebrew:
עַתָּה הִנֵּה בָטַחְתָּ לְּךָ עַל־מִשְׁעֶנֶת הַקָּנֶה הָרָצוּץ הַזֶּה עַל־מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יִסָּמֵךְ אִישׁ עָלָיו וּבָא בְכַפּוֹ וּנְקָבָהּ כֵּן פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם
לְכל־הַבֹּטְחִים עָלָיו׃

You rely, of all things, on Egypt, that splintered reed of a

And if you tell me that you are relying on YHWH your God, He is
the very one whose shrines and altars Hezekiah did away with,
telling Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship only at this altar
in Jerusalem.’
verses.hebrew:
וְכִי־תֹאמְרוּן אֵלַי אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בָּטָחְנוּ הֲלוֹא־הוּא אֲשֶׁר הֵסִיר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־בָּמֹתָיו וְאֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לִיהוּדָה וְלִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִפְנֵי
הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַזֶּה תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

translation.text: But if you say to me, 'We rely on the this altar in Jerusalem'?

verses.english:
Come now, make this wager with my master, the king of Assyria:
I’ll give you two thousand horses if you can produce riders to
mount them.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִתְעָרֶב נָא אֶת־אֲדֹנִי אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אַלְפַּיִם סוּסִים אִם־תּוּכַל לָתֶת לְךָ רֹכְבִים עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִתְעָרֶב נָא אֶת־אֲדֹנִי אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אַלְפַּיִם סוּסִים אִם־תּוּכַל לָתֶת לְךָ רֹכְבִים עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Come now, make this wager with my master, the king of Assyria:
I’ll give you two thousand horses if you can produce riders to
mount them.

translation.text: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

verses.english:
So how could you refuse anything even to the deputy of one of my
master’s lesser servants, relying on Egypt for chariots and
horsemen?
verses.hebrew: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְּטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל־מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְּטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל־מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
So how could you refuse anything even to the deputy of one of my
master’s lesser servants, relying on Egypt for chariots and
horsemen?

translation.text: How then can you repulse a on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.english:
And do you think I have marched against this land to destroy it
without YHWH? YHWH Himself told me: Go up against that land and
destroy it.”
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה עָלִיתִי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַשְׁחִתוֹ יְהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי עֲלֵה עַל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה עָלִיתִי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַשְׁחִתוֹ יְהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי עֲלֵה עַל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ׃

english.text:
And do you think I have marched against this land to destroy it
without YHWH? YHWH Himself told me: Go up against that land and
destroy it.”

translation.text: Moreover, is it without the LORD that I have come up against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it."

verses.english:
Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah replied to the Rabshakeh,
“Please, speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it;
do not speak to us in Judean in the hearing of the people on the
wall.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ וְשֶׁבְנָה וְיוֹאָח אֶל־רַבְשָׁקֵה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲרָמִית כִּי שֹׁמְעִים אֲנָחְנוּ וְאַל־תְּדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ יְהוּדִית בְּאזְנֵי
הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַחֹמָה׃

verses.english:
And the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in Judean:
“Hear the words of the Great King, the King of Assyria.
