english.text:
And the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in Judean:
“Hear the words of the Great King, the King of Assyria.

translation.text: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the Assyria!

verses.english:
Thus said the king: Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will
not be able to deliver you from my hands.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַשִּׁא לָכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־לֹא יוּכַל לְהַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַשִּׁא לָכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־לֹא יוּכַל לְהַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

english.text:
Thus said the king: Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will
not be able to deliver you from my hands.

translation.text: Thus says the king: 'Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of my hand.

verses.english:
Don’t let Hezekiah make you rely on YHWH, saying: YHWH will surely
save us: this city will not fall into the hands of the king of
Assyria.
verses.hebrew: וְאַל־יַבְטַח אֶתְכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַצֵּל יַצִּילֵנוּ יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תִנָּתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַל־יַבְטַח אֶתְכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַצֵּל יַצִּילֵנוּ יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תִנָּתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
Don’t let Hezekiah make you rely on YHWH, saying: YHWH will surely
save us: this city will not fall into the hands of the king of
Assyria.

translation.text: Do not let Hezekiah and this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.'

verses.english:
Don’t listen to Hezekiah. For thus said the king of Assyria: Make
your peace with me and come out to me, so that you may all eat
from your vines and your fig trees and drink water from your
cisterns,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עֲשׂוּ־אִתִּי בְרָכָה וּצְאוּ אֵלַי וְאִכְלוּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ וְאִישׁ תְּאֵנָתוֹ וּשְׁתוּ אִישׁ מֵי־בֹרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עֲשׂוּ־אִתִּי בְרָכָה וּצְאוּ אֵלַי וְאִכְלוּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ וְאִישׁ תְּאֵנָתוֹ וּשְׁתוּ אִישׁ מֵי־בֹרוֹ׃

english.text:
Don’t listen to Hezekiah. For thus said the king of Assyria: Make
your peace with me and come out to me, so that you may all eat
from your vines and your fig trees and drink water from your
cisterns,

translation.text: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: 'Make your own cistern,

verses.english:
until I come and take you away to a land like your own, a land of
grain [fields] and vineyards, of bread and wine, of olive oil and
honey, so that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah,
who misleads you by saying, ‘YHWH will save us.’
verses.hebrew:
עַד־בֹּאִי וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶם אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אֶרֶץ לֶחֶם וּכְרָמִים אֶרֶץ זֵית יִצְהָר וּדְבַשׁ וִחְיוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְאַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ
אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־יַסִּית אֶתְכֶם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה יַצִּילֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
עַד־בֹּאִי וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶם אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אֶרֶץ לֶחֶם וּכְרָמִים אֶרֶץ זֵית יִצְהָר וּדְבַשׁ וִחְיוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְאַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ
אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־יַסִּית אֶתְכֶם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה יַצִּילֵנוּ׃

english.text:
until I come and take you away to a land like your own, a land of
grain [fields] and vineyards, of bread and wine, of olive oil and
honey, so that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah,
who misleads you by saying, ‘YHWH will save us.’

translation.text: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of Hezekiah when he misleads you by saying, The LORD will deliver us.

verses.english:
Did any of the gods of other nations save his land from the king
of Assyria?
verses.hebrew: הַהַצֵּל הִצִּילוּ אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אִישׁ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: הַהַצֵּל הִצִּילוּ אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אִישׁ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
Did any of the gods of other nations save his land from the king
of Assyria?

translation.text: hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.english:
Where were the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where were the gods of
Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? [And] did they save Samaria from me?
verses.hebrew: אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי חֲמָת וְאַרְפָּד אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי סְפַרְוַיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה כִּי־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן מִיָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי חֲמָת וְאַרְפָּד אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי סְפַרְוַיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה כִּי־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן מִיָּדִי׃

english.text:
Where were the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where were the gods of
Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? [And] did they save Samaria from me?

translation.text: Where are the gods of Hamath and delivered Samaria out of my hand?

verses.english:
Which among all the gods of [those] countries saved their
countries from me, that YHWH should save Jerusalem from me?”
verses.hebrew: מִי בְּכל־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם מִיָּדִי כִּי־יַצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מִיָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: מִי בְּכל־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם מִיָּדִי כִּי־יַצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מִיָּדִי׃

english.text:
Which among all the gods of [those] countries saved their
countries from me, that YHWH should save Jerusalem from me?”

translation.text: Who among all the gods of the should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?'"

verses.english:
But the people were silent and did not say a word in reply; for
the king’s order was: “Do not answer him.”
verses.hebrew: וְהֶחֱרִישׁוּ הָעָם וְלֹא־עָנוּ אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ הִיא לֵאמֹר לֹא תַעֲנֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶחֱרִישׁוּ הָעָם וְלֹא־עָנוּ אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ הִיא לֵאמֹר לֹא תַעֲנֻהוּ׃

english.text:
But the people were silent and did not say a word in reply; for
the king’s order was: “Do not answer him.”

translation.text: But the people were silent and answered him not a word, for the king's command was, "Do not answer him."

verses.english:
And so Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace,
Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder came to
Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and they reported to him what
the Rabshakeh had said.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ קְרוּעֵי בְגָדִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ קְרוּעֵי בְגָדִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה׃

english.text:
And so Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace,
Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder came to
Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and they reported to him what
the Rabshakeh had said.

translation.text: Then Eliakim son of clothes torn and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.

verses.english:
When King Hezekiah heard this, he rent his clothes, and covered
himself with sackcloth, and went into the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When King Hezekiah heard this, he rent his clothes, and covered
himself with sackcloth, and went into the House of YHWH.

translation.text: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
He also sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the
scribe, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the
prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת זִקְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים מִתְכַּסִּים בַּשַּׂקִּים אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא בֶּן־אָמוֹץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת זִקְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים מִתְכַּסִּים בַּשַּׂקִּים אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא בֶּן־אָמוֹץ׃

english.text:
He also sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the
scribe, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the
prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

translation.text: And he sent son of Amoz.

verses.english:
They said to him, “Thus said Hezekiah: This day is a day of
distress, of chastisement, and of disgrace. The babes have reached
the birthstool, but the strength to give birth is lacking.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר חִזְקִיָּהוּ יוֹם־צָרָה וְתוֹכֵחָה וּנְאָצָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי בָאוּ בָנִים עַד־מַשְׁבֵּר וְכֹחַ אַיִן לְלֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר חִזְקִיָּהוּ יוֹם־צָרָה וְתוֹכֵחָה וּנְאָצָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי בָאוּ בָנִים עַד־מַשְׁבֵּר וְכֹחַ אַיִן לְלֵדָה׃

english.text:
They said to him, “Thus said Hezekiah: This day is a day of
distress, of chastisement, and of disgrace. The babes have reached
the birthstool, but the strength to give birth is lacking.

translation.text: They said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace; children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to bring them forth.

verses.english:
Perhaps YHWH your God will take note of all the words of the
Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to
blaspheme the living God, and will mete out judgment for the words
that YHWH your God has heard—if you will offer up prayer for the
surviving remnant.”
verses.hebrew:
אוּלַי יִשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֲדֹנָיו לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חַי וְהוֹכִיחַ בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ
וְנָשָׂאתָ תְפִלָּה בְּעַד הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּמְצָאָה׃

hebrew.text:
אוּלַי יִשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֲדֹנָיו לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חַי וְהוֹכִיחַ בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ
וְנָשָׂאתָ תְפִלָּה בְּעַד הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּמְצָאָה׃

english.text:
Perhaps YHWH your God will take note of all the words of the
Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to
blaspheme the living God, and will mete out judgment for the words
that YHWH your God has heard—if you will offer up prayer for the
surviving remnant.”

translation.text: It may be that the LORD for the remnant that is left."

verses.english: When King Hezekiah’s ministers came to Isaiah,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ׃

english.text: When King Hezekiah’s ministers came to Isaiah,

translation.text: When the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah,

verses.english:
Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master as follows: Thus said YHWH:
Do not be frightened by the words of blasphemy against Me that you
have heard from the minions of the king of Assyria.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְשַׁעְיָהוּ כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵי הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּפוּ נַעֲרֵי מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְשַׁעְיָהוּ כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵי הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּפוּ נַעֲרֵי מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֹתִי׃

english.text:
Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master as follows: Thus said YHWH:
Do not be frightened by the words of blasphemy against Me that you
have heard from the minions of the king of Assyria.

translation.text: Isaiah said to them, "Say to your master, 'Thus says with which the servants of the king of Assyria have reviled me.

verses.english:
I will delude him; he will hear a rumor and return to his land,
and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.”
verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי נֹתֵן בּוֹ רוּחַ וְשָׁמַע שְׁמוּעָה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּיו בַּחֶרֶב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי נֹתֵן בּוֹ רוּחַ וְשָׁמַע שְׁמוּעָה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּיו בַּחֶרֶב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
I will delude him; he will hear a rumor and return to his land,
and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.”

translation.text: I myself will put a spirit in him, so that he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land; I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.'"

verses.english:
The Rabshakeh, meanwhile, heard that [the king] had left Lachish;
he turned back and found the king of Assyria attacking Libnah.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב רַבְשָׁקֵה וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר נִלְחָם עַל־לִבְנָה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי נָסַע מִלָּכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב רַבְשָׁקֵה וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר נִלְחָם עַל־לִבְנָה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי נָסַע מִלָּכִישׁ׃

english.text:
The Rabshakeh, meanwhile, heard that [the king] had left Lachish;
he turned back and found the king of Assyria attacking Libnah.

translation.text: The Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah; for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.

verses.english:
But [the king of Assyria] learned that King Tirhakah of Nubia had
come out to fight him; so he again sent messengers to Hezekiah,
saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶל־תִּרְהָקָה מֶלֶךְ־כּוּשׁ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָצָא לְהִלָּחֵם אִתָּךְ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶל־תִּרְהָקָה מֶלֶךְ־כּוּשׁ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָצָא לְהִלָּחֵם אִתָּךְ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
But [the king of Assyria] learned that King Tirhakah of Nubia had
come out to fight him; so he again sent messengers to Hezekiah,
saying,

translation.text: Hezekiah, saying,

verses.english:
“Tell this to King Hezekiah of Judah: Do not let your God, on whom
you are relying, mislead you into thinking that Jerusalem will not
be delivered into the hands of the king of Assyria.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר אַל־יַשִּׁאֲךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא תִנָּתֵן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר אַל־יַשִּׁאֲךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא תִנָּתֵן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
“Tell this to King Hezekiah of Judah: Do not let your God, on whom
you are relying, mislead you into thinking that Jerusalem will not
be delivered into the hands of the king of Assyria.

translation.text: "Thus shall you speak to King Hezekiah of Judah: Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
You yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all
the lands, how they have annihilated them; and can you escape?
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר לְכל־הָאֲרָצוֹת לְהַחֲרִימָם וְאַתָּה תִּנָּצֵל׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה אַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר לְכל־הָאֲרָצוֹת לְהַחֲרִימָם וְאַתָּה תִּנָּצֵל׃

english.text:
You yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all
the lands, how they have annihilated them; and can you escape?

translation.text: See, destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

verses.english:
Were the nations that my predecessors destroyed—Gozan, Haran,
Rezeph, and the Beth-edenites in Telassar—saved by their gods?
verses.hebrew: הַהִצִּילוּ אֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שִׁחֲתוּ אֲבוֹתַי אֶת־גּוֹזָן וְאֶת־חָרָן וְרֶצֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶדֶן אֲשֶׁר בִּתְלַאשָּׂר׃

hebrew.text: הַהִצִּילוּ אֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שִׁחֲתוּ אֲבוֹתַי אֶת־גּוֹזָן וְאֶת־חָרָן וְרֶצֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶדֶן אֲשֶׁר בִּתְלַאשָּׂר׃

english.text:
Were the nations that my predecessors destroyed—Gozan, Haran,
Rezeph, and the Beth-edenites in Telassar—saved by their gods?

translation.text: Have the gods of Telassar?

verses.english:
Where is the king of Hamath? And the king of Arpad? And the kings
of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?”
verses.hebrew: אַיּוֹ מֶלֶךְ־חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַיּוֹ מֶלֶךְ־חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה׃

english.text:
Where is the king of Hamath? And the king of Arpad? And the kings
of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?”

translation.text: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, the king of Hena, or the king of Ivvah?"

verses.english:
Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers and read it. Hezekiah
then went up to the House of YHWH and spread it out before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִים מִיַּד הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיִּקְרָאֵם וַיַּעַל בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂהוּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִים מִיַּד הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיִּקְרָאֵם וַיַּעַל בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂהוּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers and read it. Hezekiah
then went up to the House of YHWH and spread it out before YHWH.

translation.text: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and before the LORD.

verses.english:
And Hezekiah prayed to YHWH and said, “O LORD of Hosts, Enthroned
on the Cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the
earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ
אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ
אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Hezekiah prayed to YHWH and said, “O LORD of Hosts, Enthroned
on the Cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the
earth. You made the heavens and the earth.

translation.text: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said: "O heaven and earth.

verses.english:
O LORD, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see. Hear
the words that Sennacherib has sent to blaspheme the living God!
verses.hebrew: הַטֵּה יְהֹוָה אזְנְךָ וּשְׁמָע פְּקַח יְהֹוָה עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי סַנְחֵרִיב אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חָי׃

hebrew.text: הַטֵּה יְהֹוָה אזְנְךָ וּשְׁמָע פְּקַח יְהֹוָה עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי סַנְחֵרִיב אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חָי׃

english.text:
O LORD, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see. Hear
the words that Sennacherib has sent to blaspheme the living God!

translation.text: Incline your ear, O LORD, and hear; open your sent to mock the living God.

verses.english:
True, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have annihilated the nations
and their lands,
verses.hebrew: אמְנָם יְהֹוָה הֶחֱרִיבוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת־אַרְצָם׃

hebrew.text: אמְנָם יְהֹוָה הֶחֱרִיבוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת־אַרְצָם׃

english.text:
True, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have annihilated the nations
and their lands,

translation.text: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

verses.english:
and have committed their gods to the flames and have destroyed
them; for they are not gods, but man’s handiwork of wood and
stone.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ כִּי לֹא אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי־אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן וַיְאַבְּדוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ כִּי לֹא אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי־אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן וַיְאַבְּדוּם׃

english.text:
and have committed their gods to the flames and have destroyed
them; for they are not gods, but man’s handiwork of wood and
stone.

translation.text: and have hurled their gods — wood and stone — and so they were destroyed.

verses.english:
But now, O LORD our God, deliver us from his hands, and let all
the kingdoms of the earth know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ נָא מִיָּדוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ נָא מִיָּדוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
But now, O LORD our God, deliver us from his hands, and let all
the kingdoms of the earth know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”

translation.text: So now, O LORD our God, save us, I pray you, from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, O LORD, are God alone."

verses.english:
Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I have heard the prayer you have offered
to Me concerning King Sennacherib of Assyria.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִתְפַּלַּלְתָּ אֵלַי אֶל־סַנְחֵרִב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִתְפַּלַּלְתָּ אֵלַי אֶל־סַנְחֵרִב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I have heard the prayer you have offered
to Me concerning King Sennacherib of Assyria.

translation.text: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the Sennacherib of Assyria.

verses.english:
This is the word that YHWH has spoken concerning him: “Fair Maiden
Zion despises you, She mocks at you; Fair Jerusalem shakes Her
head at you.
verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עָלָיו בָּזָה לְךָ לָעֲגָה לְךָ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן אַחֲרֶיךָ רֹאשׁ הֵנִיעָה בַּת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עָלָיו בָּזָה לְךָ לָעֲגָה לְךָ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן אַחֲרֶיךָ רֹאשׁ הֵנִיעָה בַּת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
This is the word that YHWH has spoken concerning him: “Fair Maiden
Zion despises you, She mocks at you; Fair Jerusalem shakes Her
head at you.

translation.text: This is the word that the LORD has spoken concerning him: virgin daughter Zion; daughter Jerusalem.

verses.english:
Whom have you blasphemed and reviled? Against whom made loud your
voice And haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of
Israel!
verses.hebrew: אֶת־מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל־מִי הֲרִימוֹתָ קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ עַל־קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל־מִי הֲרִימוֹתָ קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ עַל־קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Whom have you blasphemed and reviled? Against whom made loud your
voice And haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of
Israel!

translation.text: "Whom have you mocked and reviled? and haughtily lifted your eyes? Against the Holy One of Israel!

verses.english:
Through your envoys you have blasphemed my Lord. Because you
thought, ‘Thanks to my vast chariotry, It is I who have climbed
the highest mountains, To the remotest parts of the Lebanon, And
have cut down its loftiest cedars, Its choicest cypresses, And
have reached its remotest lodge, Its densest forest.
verses.hebrew:
בְּיַד מַלְאָכֶיךָ חֵרַפְתָּ אֲדֹנָי וַתֹּאמֶר (ברכב) [בְּרֹב] רִכְבִּי אֲנִי עָלִיתִי מְרוֹם הָרִים יַרְכְּתֵי לְבָנוֹן וְאֶכְרֹת קוֹמַת אֲרָזָיו מִבְחוֹר בְּרֹשָׁיו וְאָבוֹאָה
מְלוֹן קִצֹּה יַעַר כַּרְמִלּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
בְּיַד מַלְאָכֶיךָ חֵרַפְתָּ אֲדֹנָי וַתֹּאמֶר (ברכב) [בְּרֹב] רִכְבִּי אֲנִי עָלִיתִי מְרוֹם הָרִים יַרְכְּתֵי לְבָנוֹן וְאֶכְרֹת קוֹמַת אֲרָזָיו מִבְחוֹר בְּרֹשָׁיו וְאָבוֹאָה
מְלוֹן קִצֹּה יַעַר כַּרְמִלּוֹ׃

english.text:
Through your envoys you have blasphemed my Lord. Because you
thought, ‘Thanks to my vast chariotry, It is I who have climbed
the highest mountains, To the remotest parts of the Lebanon, And
have cut down its loftiest cedars, Its choicest cypresses, And
have reached its remotest lodge, Its densest forest.

translation.text: By your messengers you have mocked the Lord, to the far recesses of Lebanon; its choicest cypresses; its densest forest.

verses.english:
It is I who have drawn and drunk the waters of strangers; I have
dried up with the soles of my feet All the streams of Egypt.’
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם זָרִים וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף־פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצוֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם זָרִים וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף־פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצוֹר׃

english.text:
It is I who have drawn and drunk the waters of strangers; I have
dried up with the soles of my feet All the streams of Egypt.’

translation.text: I dug wells

verses.english:
Have you not heard? Of old I planned that very thing, I designed
it long ago, And now have fulfilled it. And it has come to pass,
Laying waste fortified towns In desolate heaps.
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ לְמֵרָחוֹק אֹתָהּ עָשִׂיתִי לְמִימֵי קֶדֶם וִיצַרְתִּיהָ עַתָּה הֲבֵיאתִיהָ וּתְהִי לַהְשׁוֹת גַּלִּים נִצִּים עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ לְמֵרָחוֹק אֹתָהּ עָשִׂיתִי לְמִימֵי קֶדֶם וִיצַרְתִּיהָ עַתָּה הֲבֵיאתִיהָ וּתְהִי לַהְשׁוֹת גַּלִּים נִצִּים עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת׃

english.text:
Have you not heard? Of old I planned that very thing, I designed
it long ago, And now have fulfilled it. And it has come to pass,
Laying waste fortified towns In desolate heaps.

translation.text: "Have you not heard that I determined it long ago?

verses.english:
Their inhabitants are helpless, Dismayed and shamed. They were but
grass of the field And green herbage, Grass of the roofs that is
blasted Before the standing grain.
verses.hebrew: וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶן קִצְרֵי־יָד חַתּוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ הָיוּ עֵשֶׂב שָׂדֶה וִירַק דֶּשֶׁא חֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת וּשְׁדֵפָה לִפְנֵי קָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶן קִצְרֵי־יָד חַתּוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ הָיוּ עֵשֶׂב שָׂדֶה וִירַק דֶּשֶׁא חֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת וּשְׁדֵפָה לִפְנֵי קָמָה׃

english.text:
Their inhabitants are helpless, Dismayed and shamed. They were but
grass of the field And green herbage, Grass of the roofs that is
blasted Before the standing grain.

translation.text: while their inhabitants, shorn of strength, are dismayed and confounded; blighted before it is grown.

verses.english:
I know your stayings And your goings and comings, And how you have
raged against Me.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ וְצֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ יָדָעְתִּי וְאֵת הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ וְצֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ יָדָעְתִּי וְאֵת הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
I know your stayings And your goings and comings, And how you have
raged against Me.

translation.text: "But I know your rising and your sitting, and your raging against me.

verses.english:
Because you have raged against Me, And your tumult has reached My
ears, I will place My hook in your nose And My bit between your
jaws; And I will make you go back by the road By which you came.
verses.hebrew: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ בָּהּ׃

english.text:
Because you have raged against Me, And your tumult has reached My
ears, I will place My hook in your nose And My bit between your
jaws; And I will make you go back by the road By which you came.

translation.text: Because you have raged against me and my bit in your mouth; by which you came.

verses.english:
“And this is the sign for you: This year you eat what grows of
itself, and the next year what springs from that; and in the third
year, sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אָכוֹל הַשָּׁנָה סָפִיחַ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית סָחִישׁ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית זִרְעוּ וְקִצְרוּ וְנִטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְאִכְלוּ פִרְיָם׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אָכוֹל הַשָּׁנָה סָפִיחַ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית סָחִישׁ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית זִרְעוּ וְקִצְרוּ וְנִטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְאִכְלוּ פִרְיָם׃

english.text:
“And this is the sign for you: This year you eat what grows of
itself, and the next year what springs from that; and in the third
year, sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

translation.text: "And this shall be the sign for you: This year you shall eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that; then in the third year sow, reap, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

verses.english:
And the survivors of the House of Judah that have escaped shall
regenerate its stock below and produce boughs above.
verses.hebrew: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית־יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית־יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
And the survivors of the House of Judah that have escaped shall
regenerate its stock below and produce boughs above.

translation.text: The downward, and bear fruit upward;

verses.english:
For a remnant shall come forth from Jerusalem, Survivors from
Mount Zion. The zeal of YHWH of Hosts Shall bring this to pass.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהֹוָה [צְבָאוֹת] תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהֹוָה [צְבָאוֹת] תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּאת׃

english.text:
For a remnant shall come forth from Jerusalem, Survivors from
Mount Zion. The zeal of YHWH of Hosts Shall bring this to pass.

translation.text: for from Jerusalem a remnant LORD of hosts will do this.

verses.english:
Assuredly, thus said YHWH concerning the king of Assyria: He shall
not enter this city: He shall not shoot an arrow at it, Or advance
upon it with a shield, Or pile up a siege mound against it.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֹא יָבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְלֹא־יוֹרֶה שָׁם חֵץ וְלֹא־יְקַדְּמֶנָּה מָגֵן וְלֹא־יִשְׁפֹּךְ עָלֶיהָ סֹלְלָה׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֹא יָבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְלֹא־יוֹרֶה שָׁם חֵץ וְלֹא־יְקַדְּמֶנָּה מָגֵן וְלֹא־יִשְׁפֹּךְ עָלֶיהָ סֹלְלָה׃

english.text:
Assuredly, thus said YHWH concerning the king of Assyria: He shall
not enter this city: He shall not shoot an arrow at it, Or advance
upon it with a shield, Or pile up a siege mound against it.

translation.text: "Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come into this city, shoot an arrow there, come before it with a shield, or cast up a siege ramp against it.

verses.english:
He shall go back By the way he came; He shall not enter this city
—declares YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹא בָּהּ יָשׁוּב וְאֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לֹא יָבֹא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹא בָּהּ יָשׁוּב וְאֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לֹא יָבֹא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He shall go back By the way he came; He shall not enter this city
—declares YHWH.

translation.text: By the way that he came, by the same he shall return; he shall not come into this city, says the LORD.

verses.english:
I will protect and save this city for My sake, And for the sake of
My servant David.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַנּוֹתִי אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְהוֹשִׁיעָהּ לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְגַנּוֹתִי אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְהוֹשִׁיעָהּ לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

english.text:
I will protect and save this city for My sake, And for the sake of
My servant David.”

translation.text: For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David."

verses.english:
That night an angel of YHWH went out and struck down one hundred
and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp, and the following
morning they were all dead corpses.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֵּצֵא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה אַשּׁוּר מֵאָה שְׁמוֹנִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אָלֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה כֻלָּם פְּגָרִים מֵתִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֵּצֵא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה אַשּׁוּר מֵאָה שְׁמוֹנִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אָלֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה כֻלָּם פְּגָרִים מֵתִים׃

english.text:
That night an angel of YHWH went out and struck down one hundred
and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp, and the following
morning they were all dead corpses.

translation.text: That very night the angel of the LORD set out and struck down one morning dawned, they were all dead bodies.

verses.english:
So King Sennacherib of Assyria broke camp and retreated, and
stayed in Nineveh.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִינְוֵה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִינְוֵה׃

english.text:
So King Sennacherib of Assyria broke camp and retreated, and
stayed in Nineveh.

translation.text: Then King Sennacherib of Assyria left, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

verses.english:
While he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons
Adrammelech and Sarezer struck him down with the sword. They fled
to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon succeeded him as
king.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי הוּא מִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה בֵּית נִסְרֹךְ אֱלֹהָיו וְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶצֶר [בָּנָיו] הִכֻּהוּ בַחֶרֶב וְהֵמָּה נִמְלְטוּ אֶרֶץ אֲרָרָט וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵסַר־חַדֹּן בְּנוֹ
תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי הוּא מִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה בֵּית נִסְרֹךְ אֱלֹהָיו וְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶצֶר [בָּנָיו] הִכֻּהוּ בַחֶרֶב וְהֵמָּה נִמְלְטוּ אֶרֶץ אֲרָרָט וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵסַר־חַדֹּן בְּנוֹ
תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
While he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons
Adrammelech and Sarezer struck him down with the sword. They fled
to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: As he was Ararat. His son Esar-haddon succeeded him.

verses.english:
In those days Hezekiah fell dangerously ill. The prophet Isaiah
son of Amoz came and said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Set your
affairs in order, for you are going to die; you will not get
well.”
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ לָמוּת וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה צַו לְבֵיתֶךָ כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ לָמוּת וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה צַו לְבֵיתֶךָ כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה׃

english.text:
In those days Hezekiah fell dangerously ill. The prophet Isaiah
son of Amoz came and said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Set your
affairs in order, for you are going to die; you will not get
well.”

translation.text: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death. says the LORD: Set your house in order, for you shall die; you shall not recover."

verses.english:
Thereupon Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to YHWH.
He said,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו אֶל־הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו אֶל־הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Thereupon Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to YHWH.
He said,

translation.text: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD:

verses.english:
“Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You sincerely
and wholeheartedly, and have done what is pleasing to You.” And
Hezekiah wept profusely.
verses.hebrew: אָנָּה יְהֹוָה זְכר־נָא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי וַיֵּבְךְּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: אָנָּה יְהֹוָה זְכר־נָא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי וַיֵּבְךְּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
“Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You sincerely
and wholeheartedly, and have done what is pleasing to You.” And
Hezekiah wept profusely.

translation.text: "Remember now, O LORD, I implore you, how I have walked good in your sight." Hezekiah wept bitterly.

verses.english:
Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of YHWH
came to him:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לֹא יָצָא (העיר) [חָצֵר] הַתִּיכֹנָה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לֹא יָצָא (העיר) [חָצֵר] הַתִּיכֹנָה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of YHWH
came to him:

translation.text: Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of the LORD came to him:

verses.english:
“Go back and say to Hezekiah, the ruler of My people: Thus said
YHWH, the God of your father David: I have heard your prayer, I
have seen your tears. I am going to heal you; on the third day you
shall go up to the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
שׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ נְגִיד־עַמִּי כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי דָּוִד אָבִיךָ שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶךָ רָאִיתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶךָ הִנְנִי רֹפֶא לָךְ בַּיּוֹם
הַשְּׁלִישִׁי תַּעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
שׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ נְגִיד־עַמִּי כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי דָּוִד אָבִיךָ שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶךָ רָאִיתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶךָ הִנְנִי רֹפֶא לָךְ בַּיּוֹם
הַשְּׁלִישִׁי תַּעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Go back and say to Hezekiah, the ruler of My people: Thus said
YHWH, the God of your father David: I have heard your prayer, I
have seen your tears. I am going to heal you; on the third day you
shall go up to the House of YHWH.

translation.text: "Turn tears; indeed, I will heal you; on the third day you shall go up to the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
And I will add fifteen years to your life. I will also rescue you
and this city from the hands of the king of Assyria. I will
protect this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant
David.”—
verses.hebrew: וְהֹסַפְתִּי עַל־יָמֶיךָ חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אַצִּילְךָ וְאֵת הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְגַנּוֹתִי עַל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהֹסַפְתִּי עַל־יָמֶיךָ חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אַצִּילְךָ וְאֵת הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְגַנּוֹתִי עַל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

english.text:
And I will add fifteen years to your life. I will also rescue you
and this city from the hands of the king of Assyria. I will
protect this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant
David.”—

translation.text: I will add fifteen years to your life. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; I will defend this city for my own sake and for my servant David's sake."

verses.english:
Then Isaiah said, “Get a cake of figs.” And they got one, and they
applied it to the rash, and he recovered.—
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ קְחוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וַיִּקְחוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַשְּׁחִין וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ קְחוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וַיִּקְחוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַשְּׁחִין וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
Then Isaiah said, “Get a cake of figs.” And they got one, and they
applied it to the rash, and he recovered.—

translation.text: Then Isaiah said, "Bring a lump of figs. Let them take it and apply it to the boil, so that he may recover."

verses.english:
Hezekiah asked Isaiah, “What is the sign that YHWH will heal me
and that I shall go up to the House of YHWH on the third day?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ מָה אוֹת כִּי־יִרְפָּא יְהֹוָה לִי וְעָלִיתִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ מָה אוֹת כִּי־יִרְפָּא יְהֹוָה לִי וְעָלִיתִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Hezekiah asked Isaiah, “What is the sign that YHWH will heal me
and that I shall go up to the House of YHWH on the third day?”

verses.english:
Isaiah replied, “This is the sign for you from YHWH that YHWH will
do the thing that He has promised: Shall the shadow advance ten
steps or recede ten steps?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ זֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה כִּי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר הָלַךְ הַצֵּל עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת אִם־יָשׁוּב עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ זֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה כִּי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר הָלַךְ הַצֵּל עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת אִם־יָשׁוּב עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

Isaiah replied, “This is the sign for you from YHWH that YHWH will
do the thing that He has promised: Shall the shadow advance ten
steps or recede ten steps?”

translation.text: Isaiah said, "This is the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD ten intervals; shall it retreat ten intervals?"

verses.english:
Hezekiah said, “It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,
but not for the shadow to recede ten steps.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ נָקֵל לַצֵּל לִנְטוֹת עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת לֹא כִי יָשׁוּב הַצֵּל אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ נָקֵל לַצֵּל לִנְטוֹת עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת לֹא כִי יָשׁוּב הַצֵּל אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

english.text:
Hezekiah said, “It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,
but not for the shadow to recede ten steps.”

translation.text: Hezekiah answered, "It is retreat ten intervals."

verses.english:
So the prophet Isaiah called to YHWH, and He made the shadow which
had descended on the dial of Ahaz recede ten steps.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַצֵּל בַּמַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָרְדָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת אָחָז אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַצֵּל בַּמַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָרְדָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת אָחָז אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

english.text:
So the prophet Isaiah called to YHWH, and He made the shadow which
had descended on the dial of Ahaz recede ten steps.

translation.text: The prophet Isaiah cried to the LORD; and he declined on the dial of Ahaz.

verses.english:
At that time, King Berodach-baladan son of Baladan of Babylon sent
[envoys with] a letter and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard
about Hezekiah’s illness.
verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא שָׁלַח בְּרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאֲדָן בֶּן־בַּלְאֲדָן מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל סְפָרִים וּמִנְחָה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא שָׁלַח בְּרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאֲדָן בֶּן־בַּלְאֲדָן מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל סְפָרִים וּמִנְחָה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
At that time, King Berodach-baladan son of Baladan of Babylon sent
[envoys with] a letter and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard
about Hezekiah’s illness.

translation.text: At that time King Merodach-baladan son of Baladan of Babylon sent Hezekiah had been sick.

verses.english:
Hezekiah heard about them and he showed them all his
treasure-house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fragrant
oil—and his armory, and everything that was to be found in his
storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his realm
that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע עֲלֵיהֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־כּל־בֵּית נְכֹתֹה אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב וְאֵת בֵּית כֵּלָיו וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא
בְּאוֹצְרֹתָיו לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֶרְאָם חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ וּבְכל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע עֲלֵיהֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־כּל־בֵּית נְכֹתֹה אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב וְאֵת בֵּית כֵּלָיו וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא
בְּאוֹצְרֹתָיו לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֶרְאָם חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ וּבְכל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Hezekiah heard about them and he showed them all his
treasure-house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fragrant
oil—and his armory, and everything that was to be found in his
storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his realm
that Hezekiah did not show them.

translation.text: Hezekiah welcomed them; he showed them all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil, his armory, all that was found in his storehouses; there was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.

verses.english:
Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah. “What,” he demanded
of him, “did those men say to you? Where have they come to you
from?” “They have come,” Hezekiah replied, “from a far country,
from Babylon.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מָה אָמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה וּמֵאַיִן יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה
בָּאוּ מִבָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מָה אָמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה וּמֵאַיִן יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה
בָּאוּ מִבָּבֶל׃

english.text:
Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah. “What,” he demanded
of him, “did those men say to you? Where have they come to you
from?” “They have come,” Hezekiah replied, “from a far country,
from Babylon.”

translation.text: Then answered, "They have come from a far country, from Babylon."

verses.english:
Next he asked, “What have they seen in your palace?” And Hezekiah
replied, “They have seen everything that is in my palace. There
was nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה רָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתִי רָאוּ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִרְאִיתִם בְּאֹצְרֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה רָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתִי רָאוּ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִרְאִיתִם בְּאֹצְרֹתָי׃

english.text:
Next he asked, “What have they seen in your palace?” And Hezekiah
replied, “They have seen everything that is in my palace. There
was nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them.”

translation.text: He that I did not show them."

verses.english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of YHWH:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of YHWH:

translation.text: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the LORD:

verses.english:
A time is coming when everything in your palace which your
ancestors have stored up to this day will be carried off to
Babylon; nothing will remain behind, said YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְנִשָּׂא כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר אָצְרוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּבֶלָה לֹא־יִוָּתֵר דָּבָר אָמַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְנִשָּׂא כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר אָצְרוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּבֶלָה לֹא־יִוָּתֵר דָּבָר אָמַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
A time is coming when everything in your palace which your
ancestors have stored up to this day will be carried off to
Babylon; nothing will remain behind, said YHWH.

translation.text: Days ancestors have stored up until this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left, says the LORD.

verses.english:
And some of your sons, your own issue, whom you will have
fathered, will be taken to serve as eunuchs in the palace of the
king of Babylon.”
verses.hebrew: וּמִבָּנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצְאוּ מִמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תּוֹלִיד (יקח) [יִקָּחוּ] וְהָיוּ סָרִיסִים בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבָּנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצְאוּ מִמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תּוֹלִיד (יקח) [יִקָּחוּ] וְהָיוּ סָרִיסִים בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

english.text:
And some of your sons, your own issue, whom you will have
fathered, will be taken to serve as eunuchs in the palace of the
king of Babylon.”

translation.text: Some of your own sons who are born to you shall be taken away; they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

verses.english:
Hezekiah declared to Isaiah, “The word of YHWH that you have
spoken is good.” For he thought, “It means that safety is assured
for my time.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ טוֹב דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא אִם־שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶת יִהְיֶה בְיָמָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ טוֹב דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא אִם־שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶת יִהְיֶה בְיָמָי׃

english.text:
Hezekiah declared to Isaiah, “The word of YHWH that you have
spoken is good.” For he thought, “It means that safety is assured
for my time.”

translation.text: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of there will be peace and security in my days?"

verses.english:
The other events of Hezekiah’s reign, and all his exploits, and
how he made the pool and the conduit and brought the water into
the city, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַבְּרֵכָה וְאֶת־הַתְּעָלָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־הַמַּיִם הָעִירָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים
לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַבְּרֵכָה וְאֶת־הַתְּעָלָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־הַמַּיִם הָעִירָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים
לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Hezekiah’s reign, and all his exploits, and
how he made the pool and the conduit and brought the water into
the city, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: The rest of the deeds of Hezekiah, all his power, how he made the written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and his son Manasseh succeeded
him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and his son Manasseh succeeded
him as king.

translation.text: Hezekiah slept with his ancestors; and his son Manasseh succeeded him.

verses.english:
Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-five years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hephzibah.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מְנַשֶּׁה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֶפְצִי־בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מְנַשֶּׁה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֶפְצִי־בָהּ׃

english.text:
Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-five years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hephzibah.

translation.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign; he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Hephzibah.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following the abhorrent
practices of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed before the
Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following the abhorrent
practices of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed before the
Israelites.

translation.text: He Israel.

verses.english:
He rebuilt the shrines that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he
erected altars for Baal and made a sacred post, as King Ahab of
Israel had done. He bowed down to all the host of heaven and
worshiped them,
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר אִבַּד חִזְקִיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיָּקֶם מִזְבְּחֹת לַבַּעַל וַיַּעַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ
לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹד אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר אִבַּד חִזְקִיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיָּקֶם מִזְבְּחֹת לַבַּעַל וַיַּעַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ
לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹד אֹתָם׃

english.text:
He rebuilt the shrines that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he
erected altars for Baal and made a sacred post, as King Ahab of
Israel had done. He bowed down to all the host of heaven and
worshiped them,

translation.text: For he rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he erected altars for Baal, made a sacred pole, as King Ahab of Israel had done, worshiped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.english:
and he built altars for them in the House of YHWH, of which YHWH
had said, “I will establish My name in Jerusalem.”
verses.hebrew: וּבָנָה מִזְבְּחֹת בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבָנָה מִזְבְּחֹת בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי׃

english.text:
and he built altars for them in the House of YHWH, of which YHWH
had said, “I will establish My name in Jerusalem.”

translation.text: He built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, "In Jerusalem I will put my name."

verses.english:
He built altars for all the hosts of heaven in the two courts of
the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He built altars for all the hosts of heaven in the two courts of
the House of YHWH.

translation.text: He built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
He consigned his son to the fire; he practiced soothsaying and
divination, and consulted ghosts and familiar spirits; he did much
that was displeasing to YHWH, to vex Him.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱבִיר אֶת־בְּנוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִים הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיס׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱבִיר אֶת־בְּנוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִים הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיס׃

english.text:
He consigned his son to the fire; he practiced soothsaying and
divination, and consulted ghosts and familiar spirits; he did much
that was displeasing to YHWH, to vex Him.

translation.text: He made his son provoking him to anger.

verses.english:
The sculptured image of Asherah that he made he placed in the
House concerning which YHWH had said to David and to his son
Solomon, “In this House and in Jerusalem, which I chose out of all
the tribes of Israel, I will establish My name forever.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי
יִשְׂרָאֵל אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי
יִשְׂרָאֵל אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
The sculptured image of Asherah that he made he placed in the
House concerning which YHWH had said to David and to his son
Solomon, “In this House and in Jerusalem, which I chose out of all
the tribes of Israel, I will establish My name forever.

translation.text: The carved image of Asherah that he had of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

verses.english:
And I will not again cause the feet of Israel to wander from the
land that I gave to their fathers, if they will but faithfully
observe all that I have commanded them—all the Teachings with
which My servant Moses charged them.”
verses.hebrew:
וְלֹא אֹסִיף לְהָנִיד רֶגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם רַק אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִים וּלְכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֹתָם עַבְדִּי
מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וְלֹא אֹסִיף לְהָנִיד רֶגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם רַק אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִים וּלְכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֹתָם עַבְדִּי
מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And I will not again cause the feet of Israel to wander from the
land that I gave to their fathers, if they will but faithfully
observe all that I have commanded them—all the Teachings with
which My servant Moses charged them.”

translation.text: I will not cause their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do according to all that I Moses commanded them."

verses.english:
But they did not obey, and Manasseh led them astray to do greater
evil than the nations that YHWH had destroyed before the
Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּתְעֵם מְנַשֶּׁה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הָרָע מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּתְעֵם מְנַשֶּׁה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הָרָע מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But they did not obey, and Manasseh led them astray to do greater
evil than the nations that YHWH had destroyed before the
Israelites.

translation.text: But they did not listen; Manasseh misled destroyed before the people of Israel.

verses.english: Therefore YHWH spoke through His servants the prophets:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Therefore YHWH spoke through His servants the prophets:

translation.text: The LORD said by his servants the prophets,

verses.english:
“Because King Manasseh of Judah has done these abhorrent things—he
has outdone in wickedness all that the Amorites did before his
time—and because he led Judah to sin with his fetishes,
verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֵרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וַיַּחֲטִא גַם־אֶת־יְהוּדָה בְּגִלּוּלָיו׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֵרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וַיַּחֲטִא גַם־אֶת־יְהוּדָה בְּגִלּוּלָיו׃

english.text:
“Because King Manasseh of Judah has done these abhorrent things—he
has outdone in wickedness all that the Amorites did before his
time—and because he led Judah to sin with his fetishes,

translation.text: "Because King him, and has caused Judah also to sin with his idols;

verses.english:
assuredly, thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: I am going to bring
such a disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that both ears of everyone
who hears about it will tingle.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וִיהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר כּל־[שֹׁמְעָהּ] (שמעיו) תִּצַּלְנָה שְׁתֵּי אזְנָיו׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וִיהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר כּל־[שֹׁמְעָהּ] (שמעיו) תִּצַּלְנָה שְׁתֵּי אזְנָיו׃

english.text:
assuredly, thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: I am going to bring
such a disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that both ears of everyone
who hears about it will tingle.

translation.text: therefore thus Judah such evil that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.

verses.english:
I will apply to Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the
weights of the House of Ahab; I will wipe Jerusalem clean as one
wipes a dish and turns it upside down.
verses.hebrew: וְנָטִיתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֵת קָו שֹׁמְרוֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹלֶת בֵּית אַחְאָב וּמָחִיתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶה אֶת־הַצַּלַּחַת מָחָה וְהָפַךְ עַל־פָּנֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָטִיתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֵת קָו שֹׁמְרוֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹלֶת בֵּית אַחְאָב וּמָחִיתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶה אֶת־הַצַּלַּחַת מָחָה וְהָפַךְ עַל־פָּנֶיהָ׃

english.text:
I will apply to Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the
weights of the House of Ahab; I will wipe Jerusalem clean as one
wipes a dish and turns it upside down.

translation.text: I dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

verses.english:
And I will cast off the remnant of My own people and deliver them
into the hands of their enemies. They shall be plunder and prey to
all their enemies
verses.hebrew: וְנָטַשְׁתִּי אֵת שְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתִי וּנְתַתִּים בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבַז וְלִמְשִׁסָּה לְכל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָטַשְׁתִּי אֵת שְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתִי וּנְתַתִּים בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבַז וְלִמְשִׁסָּה לְכל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And I will cast off the remnant of My own people and deliver them
into the hands of their enemies. They shall be plunder and prey to
all their enemies

translation.text: I will cast off the remnant of my heritage, and give them into the hand of their enemies; they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies,

verses.english:
because they have done what is displeasing to Me and have been
vexing Me from the day that their fathers came out of Egypt to
this day.”

Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of
his palace, in the garden of Uzza; and his son Amon succeeded him
as king.

Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of
his palace, in the garden of Uzza; and his son Amon succeeded him
as king.

verses.english:
Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned
two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Meshullemeth
daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

He walked in all the ways of his father, worshiping the fetishes
which his father had worshiped and bowing down to them.

He forsook YHWH, the God of his fathers, and did not follow the

Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned
thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah
daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

his ancestor David; he did not deviate to the right or to the
left.

his ancestor David; he did not deviate to the right or to the
left.

to the carpenters, the laborers, and the masons, and for the

However, no check is to be kept on them for the silver that is

Then the high priest Hilkiah said to the scribe Shaphan, “I have

Then the high priest Hilkiah said to the scribe Shaphan, “I have

translation.text: The high priest Hilkiah said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found book to Shaphan, he read it.

verses.english:
The scribe Shaphan then went to the king and reported to the king:
“Your servants have melted down the silver that was deposited in
the House, and they have delivered it to the overseers of the work
who are in charge at the House of YHWH.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר הִתִּיכוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֻהוּ עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה
הַמֻּפְקָדִים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

וַיָּבֹא שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר הִתִּיכוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֻהוּ עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה

translation.text: Then Shaphan the secretary came to the hand of the workers who have oversight of the house of the LORD."

verses.english:
The scribe Shaphan also told the king, “The high priest Hilkiah
has given me a scroll”; and Shaphan read it to the king.

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סֵפֶר נָתַן לִי חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ שָׁפָן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

The scribe Shaphan also told the king, “The high priest Hilkiah
has given me a scroll”; and Shaphan read it to the king.

translation.text: me a book." Shaphan then read it aloud to the king.

verses.english:
When the king heard the words of the scroll of the Teaching, he
rent his clothes.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו׃

english.text:
When the king heard the words of the scroll of the Teaching, he
rent his clothes.

translation.text: When the king heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

verses.english:
And the king gave orders to the priest Hilkiah, and to Ahikam son
of Shaphan, Achbor son of Michaiah, the scribe Shaphan, and Asaiah
the king’s minister:
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן וְאֶת־עַכְבּוֹר בֶּן־מִיכָיָה וְאֵת שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת עֲשָׂיָה עֶבֶד־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן וְאֶת־עַכְבּוֹר בֶּן־מִיכָיָה וְאֵת שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת עֲשָׂיָה עֶבֶד־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And the king gave orders to the priest Hilkiah, and to Ahikam son
of Shaphan, Achbor son of Michaiah, the scribe Shaphan, and Asaiah
the king’s minister:

translation.text: Then the king commanded the priest Hilkiah, Ahikam son of servant Asaiah, saying,

verses.english:
“Go, inquire of YHWH on my behalf, and on behalf of the people,
and on behalf of all Judah, concerning the words of this scroll
that has been found. For great indeed must be the wrath of YHWH
that has been kindled against us, because our fathers did not obey
the words of this scroll to do all that has been prescribed for
us.”
verses.hebrew:
לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדִי וּבְעַד־הָעָם וּבְעַד כּל־יְהוּדָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַנִּמְצָא הַזֶּה כִּי־גְדוֹלָה חֲמַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא נִצְּתָה בָנוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר
לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב עָלֵינוּ׃

לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדִי וּבְעַד־הָעָם וּבְעַד כּל־יְהוּדָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַנִּמְצָא הַזֶּה כִּי־גְדוֹלָה חֲמַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא נִצְּתָה בָנוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר

“Go, inquire of YHWH on my behalf, and on behalf of the people,

translation.text: "Go, inquire of the LORD for me, for the according to all that is written concerning us."

verses.english:
So the priest Hilkiah, and Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah
went to the prophetess Huldah—the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah
son of Harhas, the keeper of the wardrobe—who was living in
Jerusalem in the Mishneh, and they spoke to her.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָם וְעַכְבּוֹר וְשָׁפָן וַעֲשָׂיָה אֶל־חֻלְדָּה הַנְּבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־תִּקְוָה בֶּן־חַרְחַס שֹׁמֵר הַבְּגָדִים וְהִיא יֹשֶׁבֶת
בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּמִּשְׁנֶה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָם וְעַכְבּוֹר וְשָׁפָן וַעֲשָׂיָה אֶל־חֻלְדָּה הַנְּבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־תִּקְוָה בֶּן־חַרְחַס שֹׁמֵר הַבְּגָדִים וְהִיא יֹשֶׁבֶת
בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּמִּשְׁנֶה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
So the priest Hilkiah, and Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah
went to the prophetess Huldah—the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah
son of Harhas, the keeper of the wardrobe—who was living in
Jerusalem in the Mishneh, and they spoke to her.

translation.text: So the priest Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Quarter, where they consulted her.

verses.english:
She responded: “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: Say to the man
who sent you to me:
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִמְרוּ לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִמְרוּ לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
She responded: “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: Say to the man
who sent you to me:

translation.text: She declared to them, "Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: Tell the man who sent you to me,

verses.english:
Thus said YHWH: I am going to bring disaster upon this place and
its inhabitants, in accordance with all the words of the scroll
which the king of Judah has read.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Thus said YHWH: I am going to bring disaster upon this place and
its inhabitants, in accordance with all the words of the scroll
which the king of Judah has read.

translation.text: Thus read.

verses.english:
Because they have forsaken Me and have made offerings to other
gods and vexed Me with all their deeds, My wrath is kindled
against this place and it shall not be quenched.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיְקַטְּרוּ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם וְנִצְּתָה חֲמָתִי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיְקַטְּרוּ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם וְנִצְּתָה חֲמָתִי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

english.text:
Because they have forsaken Me and have made offerings to other
gods and vexed Me with all their deeds, My wrath is kindled
against this place and it shall not be quenched.

translation.text: Because they have abandoned me and have made offerings to and it will not be quenched.

verses.english:
But say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of
YHWH: Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: As for the words which
you have heard—
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אֶתְכֶם לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אֶתְכֶם לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתָּ׃

english.text:
But say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of
YHWH: Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: As for the words which
you have heard—

translation.text: But as to the king of Judah, who sent LORD, the God of Israel: Regarding the words that you have heard,

verses.english:
because your heart was softened and you humbled yourself before
YHWH when you heard what I decreed against this place and its
inhabitants—that it will become a desolation and a curse—and
because you rent your clothes and wept before Me, I for My part
have listened—declares YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
יַעַן רַךְ־לְבָבְךָ וַתִּכָּנַע מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשׁמְעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו לִהְיוֹת לְשַׁמָּה וְלִקְלָלָה וַתִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדֶיךָ
וַתִּבְכֶּה לְפָנָי וְגַם אָנֹכִי שָׁמַעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
יַעַן רַךְ־לְבָבְךָ וַתִּכָּנַע מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשׁמְעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו לִהְיוֹת לְשַׁמָּה וְלִקְלָלָה וַתִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדֶיךָ
וַתִּבְכֶּה לְפָנָי וְגַם אָנֹכִי שָׁמַעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
because your heart was softened and you humbled yourself before
YHWH when you heard what I decreed against this place and its
