because you rent your clothes and wept before Me, I for My part
have listened—declares YHWH.

translation.text: heard you, says the LORD.

verses.english:
Assuredly, I will gather you to your fathers and you will be laid
in your tomb in peace. Your eyes shall not see all the disaster
which I will bring upon this place.” So they brought back the
reply to the king.
verses.hebrew:
לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֹסִפְךָ עַל־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל־קִבְרֹתֶיךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תִרְאֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ בְּכֹל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשִׁבוּ
אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֹסִפְךָ עַל־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל־קִבְרֹתֶיךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תִרְאֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ בְּכֹל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשִׁבוּ
אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Assuredly, I will gather you to your fathers and you will be laid
in your tomb in peace. Your eyes shall not see all the disaster
which I will bring upon this place.” So they brought back the
reply to the king.

translation.text: Therefore, I will gather you to your shall not see all the disaster that I will bring on this place." They took the message back to the king.

verses.english:
At the king’s summons, all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem
assembled before him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
At the king’s summons, all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem
assembled before him.

translation.text: Then the king directed that all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem should be gathered to him.

verses.english:
The king went up to the House of YHWH, together with all the men
of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and
prophets—all the people, young and old. And he read to them the
entire text of the covenant scroll which had been found in the
House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְכל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְכל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אִתּוֹ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַנְּבִיאִים וְכל־הָעָם לְמִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וַיִּקְרָא בְאזְנֵיהֶם
אֶת־כּל־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַנִּמְצָא בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְכל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְכל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אִתּוֹ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַנְּבִיאִים וְכל־הָעָם לְמִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וַיִּקְרָא בְאזְנֵיהֶם
אֶת־כּל־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַנִּמְצָא בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The king went up to the House of YHWH, together with all the men
of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and
prophets—all the people, young and old. And he read to them the
entire text of the covenant scroll which had been found in the
House of YHWH.

translation.text: The king went up to the house of the LORD, and with him went all the people of Judah, all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
The king stood by the pillar and solemnized the covenant before
YHWH: that they would follow YHWH and observe His commandments,
His injunctions, and His laws with all their heart and soul; that
they would fulfill all the terms of this covenant as inscribed
upon the scroll. And all the people entered into the covenant.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָעַמּוּד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הַבְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת אַחַר יְהֹוָה וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־עֵדְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָיו בְּכל־לֵב וּבְכל־נֶפֶשׁ
לְהָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וַיַּעֲמֹד כּל־הָעָם בַּבְּרִית׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָעַמּוּד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הַבְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת אַחַר יְהֹוָה וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־עֵדְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָיו בְּכל־לֵב וּבְכל־נֶפֶשׁ
לְהָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וַיַּעֲמֹד כּל־הָעָם בַּבְּרִית׃

english.text:
The king stood by the pillar and solemnized the covenant before
YHWH: that they would follow YHWH and observe His commandments,
His injunctions, and His laws with all their heart and soul; that
they would fulfill all the terms of this covenant as inscribed
upon the scroll. And all the people entered into the covenant.

translation.text: The king LORD, keeping his commandments, his decrees, and his statutes, with all were written in this book. All the people joined in the covenant.

verses.english:
Then the king ordered the high priest Hilkiah, the priests of the
second rank, and the guards of the threshold to bring out of the
Temple of YHWH all the objects made for Baal and Asherah and all
the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields
of Kidron, and he removed the ashes to Bethel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף לְהוֹצִיא מֵהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָעֲשׂוּיִם לַבַּעַל
וְלָאֲשֵׁרָה וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּשְׂרְפֵם מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁדְמוֹת קִדְרוֹן וְנָשָׂא אֶת־עֲפָרָם בֵּית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף לְהוֹצִיא מֵהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָעֲשׂוּיִם לַבַּעַל
וְלָאֲשֵׁרָה וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּשְׂרְפֵם מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁדְמוֹת קִדְרוֹן וְנָשָׂא אֶת־עֲפָרָם בֵּית־אֵל׃

english.text:
Then the king ordered the high priest Hilkiah, the priests of the
second rank, and the guards of the threshold to bring out of the
Temple of YHWH all the objects made for Baal and Asherah and all
the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields
of Kidron, and he removed the ashes to Bethel.

translation.text: The king commanded the high priest Hilkiah, the priests of the of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.

verses.english:
He suppressed the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had
appointed to make offerings at the shrines in the towns of Judah
and in the environs of Jerusalem, and those who made offerings to
Baal, to the sun and moon and constellations—all the host of
heaven.
verses.hebrew:
וְהִשְׁבִּית אֶת־הַכְּמָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּמְסִבֵּי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־הַמְקַטְּרִים לַבַּעַל לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵחַ
וְלַמַּזָּלוֹת וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִשְׁבִּית אֶת־הַכְּמָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּמְסִבֵּי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־הַמְקַטְּרִים לַבַּעַל לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵחַ
וְלַמַּזָּלוֹת וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
He suppressed the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had
appointed to make offerings at the shrines in the towns of Judah
and in the environs of Jerusalem, and those who made offerings to
Baal, to the sun and moon and constellations—all the host of
heaven.

translation.text: He deposed the moon, the constellations, and all the host of the heavens.

verses.english:
He brought out the [image of] Asherah from the House of YHWH to
the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and burned it in the Kidron
Valley; he beat it to dust and scattered its dust over the burial
ground of the common people.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה מִבֵּית יְהֹוָה מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֹתָהּ בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וַיָּדֶק לְעָפָר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת־עֲפָרָהּ עַל־קֶבֶר בְּנֵי
הָעָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה מִבֵּית יְהֹוָה מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֹתָהּ בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וַיָּדֶק לְעָפָר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת־עֲפָרָהּ עַל־קֶבֶר בְּנֵי
הָעָם׃

english.text:
He brought out the [image of] Asherah from the House of YHWH to
the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and burned it in the Kidron
Valley; he beat it to dust and scattered its dust over the burial
ground of the common people.

translation.text: He brought Jerusalem, to the Wadi Kidron, burned it at the Wadi Kidron, beat it to dust and threw the dust of it upon the graves of the common people.

verses.english:
He tore down the cubicles of the male prostitutes in the House of
YHWH, at the place where the women wove coverings for Asherah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־בָּתֵּי הַקְּדֵשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הַנָּשִׁים אֹרְגוֹת שָׁם בָּתִּים לָאֲשֵׁרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־בָּתֵּי הַקְּדֵשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הַנָּשִׁים אֹרְגוֹת שָׁם בָּתִּים לָאֲשֵׁרָה׃

english.text:
He tore down the cubicles of the male prostitutes in the House of
YHWH, at the place where the women wove coverings for Asherah.

translation.text: the house of the LORD, where the women did weaving for Asherah.

verses.english:
He brought all the priests from the towns of Judah [to Jerusalem]
and defiled the shrines where the priests had been making
offerings—from Geba to Beer-sheba. He also demolished the shrines
of the gates, which were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua,
the city prefect—which were on a person’s left [as he entered] the
city gate.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֵא אֶת־כּל־הַכֹּהֲנִים מֵעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְטַמֵּא אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר קִטְּרוּ־שָׁמָּה הַכֹּהֲנִים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע וְנָתַץ אֶת־בָּמוֹת הַשְּׁעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־פֶּתַח
שַׁעַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שַׂר־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־שְׂמֹאול אִישׁ בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֵא אֶת־כּל־הַכֹּהֲנִים מֵעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְטַמֵּא אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר קִטְּרוּ־שָׁמָּה הַכֹּהֲנִים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע וְנָתַץ אֶת־בָּמוֹת הַשְּׁעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־פֶּתַח
שַׁעַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שַׂר־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־שְׂמֹאול אִישׁ בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר׃

english.text:
He brought all the priests from the towns of Judah [to Jerusalem]
and defiled the shrines where the priests had been making
offerings—from Geba to Beer-sheba. He also demolished the shrines
of the gates, which were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua,
the city prefect—which were on a person’s left [as he entered] the
city gate.

translation.text: high places where the priests had made offerings, from Geba to Beersheba; he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the the left at the gate of the city.

verses.english:
The priests of the shrines, however, did not ascend the altar of
YHWH in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread along with their
kinsmen.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא יַעֲלוּ כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֶל־מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם כִּי אִם־אָכְלוּ מַצּוֹת בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא יַעֲלוּ כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֶל־מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם כִּי אִם־אָכְלוּ מַצּוֹת בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
The priests of the shrines, however, did not ascend the altar of
YHWH in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread along with their
kinsmen.

translation.text: The priests of the high places, however, did not come up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but ate unleavened bread among their kindred.

verses.english:
He also defiled Topheth, which is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, so
that no one might consign his son or daughter to the fire of
Molech.
verses.hebrew: וְטִמֵּא אֶת־הַתֹּפֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּגֵי (בני) [בֶן־]הִנֹּם לְבִלְתִּי לְהַעֲבִיר אִישׁ אֶת־בְּנוֹ וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ בָּאֵשׁ לַמֹּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְטִמֵּא אֶת־הַתֹּפֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּגֵי (בני) [בֶן־]הִנֹּם לְבִלְתִּי לְהַעֲבִיר אִישׁ אֶת־בְּנוֹ וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ בָּאֵשׁ לַמֹּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
He also defiled Topheth, which is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, so
that no one might consign his son or daughter to the fire of
Molech.

translation.text: He defiled Topheth, which daughter pass through fire as an offering to Molech.

verses.english:
He did away with the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated
to the sun, at the entrance of the House of YHWH, near the chamber
of the eunuch Nathan-melech, which was in the precincts. He burned
the chariots of the sun.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּשְׁבֵּת אֶת־הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מִבֹּא בֵית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־לִשְׁכַּת נְתַן־מֶלֶךְ הַסָּרִיס אֲשֶׁר בַּפַּרְוָרִים וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבוֹת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ
שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּשְׁבֵּת אֶת־הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מִבֹּא בֵית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־לִשְׁכַּת נְתַן־מֶלֶךְ הַסָּרִיס אֲשֶׁר בַּפַּרְוָרִים וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבוֹת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ
שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
He did away with the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated
to the sun, at the entrance of the House of YHWH, near the chamber
of the eunuch Nathan-melech, which was in the precincts. He burned
the chariots of the sun.

translation.text: He removed chariots of the sun with fire.

verses.english:
And the king tore down the altars made by the kings of Judah on
the roof by the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars made by
Manasseh in the two courts of the House of YHWH. He removed them
quickly from there and scattered their rubble in the Kidron
Valley.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַגָּג עֲלִיַּת אָחָז אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה נָתַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיָּרץ מִשָּׁם וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶת־עֲפָרָם אֶל־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַגָּג עֲלִיַּת אָחָז אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה נָתַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיָּרץ מִשָּׁם וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶת־עֲפָרָם אֶל־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן׃

english.text:
And the king tore down the altars made by the kings of Judah on
the roof by the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars made by
Manasseh in the two courts of the House of YHWH. He removed them
quickly from there and scattered their rubble in the Kidron
Valley.

translation.text: The altars on the roof of the upper into the Wadi Kidron.

verses.english:
The king also defiled the shrines facing Jerusalem, to the south
of the Mount of the Destroyer, which King Solomon of Israel had
built for Ashtoreth, the abomination of the Sidonians, for
Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom, the detestable
thing of the Ammonites.
verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר מִימִין לְהַר־הַמַּשְׁחִית אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת שִׁקֻּץ צִידֹנִים וְלִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ
מוֹאָב וּלְמִלְכֹּם תּוֹעֲבַת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן טִמֵּא הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר מִימִין לְהַר־הַמַּשְׁחִית אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת שִׁקֻּץ צִידֹנִים וְלִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ
מוֹאָב וּלְמִלְכֹּם תּוֹעֲבַת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן טִמֵּא הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The king also defiled the shrines facing Jerusalem, to the south
of the Mount of the Destroyer, which King Solomon of Israel had
built for Ashtoreth, the abomination of the Sidonians, for
Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom, the detestable
thing of the Ammonites.

translation.text: The king defiled the high places that were abomination of the Ammonites.

verses.english:
He shattered their pillars and cut down their sacred posts and
covered their sites with human bones.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבַּר אֶת־הַמַּצֵּבוֹת וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־מְקוֹמָם עַצְמוֹת אָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁבַּר אֶת־הַמַּצֵּבוֹת וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־מְקוֹמָם עַצְמוֹת אָדָם׃

english.text:
He shattered their pillars and cut down their sacred posts and
covered their sites with human bones.

translation.text: He broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the sacred poles, and covered the sites with human bones.

verses.english:
As for the altar in Bethel [and] the shrine made by Jeroboam son
of Nebat who caused Israel to sin—that altar, too, and the shrine
as well, he tore down. He burned down the shrine and beat it to
dust, and he burned the sacred post.
verses.hebrew:
וְגַם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל הַבָּמָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא וְאֶת־הַבָּמָה נָתָץ וַיִּשְׂרֹף
אֶת־הַבָּמָה הֵדַק לְעָפָר וְשָׂרַף אֲשֵׁרָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל הַבָּמָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא וְאֶת־הַבָּמָה נָתָץ וַיִּשְׂרֹף
אֶת־הַבָּמָה הֵדַק לְעָפָר וְשָׂרַף אֲשֵׁרָה׃

english.text:
As for the altar in Bethel [and] the shrine made by Jeroboam son
of Nebat who caused Israel to sin—that altar, too, and the shrine
as well, he tore down. He burned down the shrine and beat it to
dust, and he burned the sacred post.

translation.text: Moreover, the altar at Bethel, the high place erected by Jeroboam dust; he also burned the sacred pole.

verses.english:
Josiah turned and saw the graves that were there on the hill; and
he had the bones taken out of the graves and burned on the altar.
Thus he defiled it, in fulfillment of the word of YHWH foretold by
the man of God who foretold these happenings.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּפֶן יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַקְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בָּהָר וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָעֲצָמוֹת מִן־הַקְּבָרִים וַיִּשְׂרֹף עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְטַמְּאֵהוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה
אֲשֶׁר קָרָא אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּפֶן יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַקְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בָּהָר וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָעֲצָמוֹת מִן־הַקְּבָרִים וַיִּשְׂרֹף עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְטַמְּאֵהוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה
אֲשֶׁר קָרָא אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Josiah turned and saw the graves that were there on the hill; and
he had the bones taken out of the graves and burned on the altar.
Thus he defiled it, in fulfillment of the word of YHWH foretold by
the man of God who foretold these happenings.

translation.text: As Josiah turned, he saw the stood by the altar at the festival; he turned and looked up at the tomb of the man of God who had predicted these things.

verses.english:
He asked, “What is the marker I see there?” And the men of the
town replied, “That is the grave of the man of God who came from
Judah and foretold these things that you have done to the altar of
Bethel.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַצִּיּוּן הַלָּז אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר הַקֶּבֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר
עָשִׂיתָ עַל הַמִּזְבַּח בֵּית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַצִּיּוּן הַלָּז אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר הַקֶּבֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר
עָשִׂיתָ עַל הַמִּזְבַּח בֵּית־אֵל׃

english.text:
He asked, “What is the marker I see there?” And the men of the
town replied, “That is the grave of the man of God who came from
Judah and foretold these things that you have done to the altar of
Bethel.”

translation.text: Then he said, these things that you have done against the altar at Bethel."

verses.english:
“Let him be,” he said, “let no one disturb his bones.” So they
left his bones undisturbed together with the bones of the prophet
who came from Samaria.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנִּיחוּ לוֹ אִישׁ אַל־יָנַע עַצְמוֹתָיו וַיְמַלְּטוּ עַצְמוֹתָיו אֵת עַצְמוֹת הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנִּיחוּ לוֹ אִישׁ אַל־יָנַע עַצְמוֹתָיו וַיְמַלְּטוּ עַצְמוֹתָיו אֵת עַצְמוֹת הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
“Let him be,” he said, “let no one disturb his bones.” So they
left his bones undisturbed together with the bones of the prophet
who came from Samaria.

translation.text: He alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

verses.english:
Josiah also abolished all the cult places in the towns of Samaria,
which the kings of Israel had built, vexing [YHWH]. He dealt with
them just as he had done to Bethel:
verses.hebrew:
וְגַם אֶת־כּל־בָּתֵּי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס הֵסִיר יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כְּכל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
בְּבֵית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם אֶת־כּל־בָּתֵּי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס הֵסִיר יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כְּכל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
בְּבֵית־אֵל׃

english.text:
Josiah also abolished all the cult places in the towns of Samaria,
which the kings of Israel had built, vexing [YHWH]. He dealt with
them just as he had done to Bethel:

translation.text: LORD to anger; he did to them just as he had done at Bethel.

verses.english:
He slew on the altars all the priests of the shrines who were
there, and he burned human bones on them. Then he returned to
Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח אֶת־כּל־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם עַל־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־עַצְמוֹת אָדָם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיָּשׁב יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְבַּח אֶת־כּל־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם עַל־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־עַצְמוֹת אָדָם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיָּשׁב יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He slew on the altars all the priests of the shrines who were
there, and he burned human bones on them. Then he returned to
Jerusalem.

translation.text: He Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The king commanded all the people, “Offer the passover sacrifice
to YHWH your God as prescribed in this scroll of the covenant.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כּל־הָעָם לֵאמֹר עֲשׂוּ פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּכָּתוּב עַל סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כּל־הָעָם לֵאמֹר עֲשׂוּ פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּכָּתוּב עַל סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The king commanded all the people, “Offer the passover sacrifice
to YHWH your God as prescribed in this scroll of the covenant.”

translation.text: The king commanded all the people, "Keep the passover to the LORD your God as prescribed in this book of the covenant."

verses.english:
Now the passover sacrifice had not been offered in that manner in
the days of the chieftains who ruled Israel, or during the days of
the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נַעֲשָׂה כַּפֶּסַח הַזֶּה מִימֵי הַשֹּׁפְטִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁפְטוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹל יְמֵי מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא נַעֲשָׂה כַּפֶּסַח הַזֶּה מִימֵי הַשֹּׁפְטִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁפְטוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹל יְמֵי מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Now the passover sacrifice had not been offered in that manner in
the days of the chieftains who ruled Israel, or during the days of
the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.

translation.text: No such Judah;

verses.english:
Only in the eighteenth year of King Josiah was such a passover
sacrifice offered in that manner to YHWH in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־בִּשְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ נַעֲשָׂה הַפֶּסַח הַזֶּה לַיהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־בִּשְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ נַעֲשָׂה הַפֶּסַח הַזֶּה לַיהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Only in the eighteenth year of King Josiah was such a passover
sacrifice offered in that manner to YHWH in Jerusalem.

translation.text: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
Josiah also did away with the necromancers and the mediums, the
idols and the fetishes—all the detestable things that were to be
seen in the land of Judah and Jerusalem. Thus he fulfilled the
terms of the Teaching recorded in the scroll that the priest
Hilkiah had found in the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וְגַם אֶת־הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים וְאֵת כּל־הַשִּׁקֻּצִים אֲשֶׁר נִרְאוּ בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בִּעֵר יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ לְמַעַן
הָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר מָצָא חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם אֶת־הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים וְאֵת כּל־הַשִּׁקֻּצִים אֲשֶׁר נִרְאוּ בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בִּעֵר יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ לְמַעַן
הָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר מָצָא חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Josiah also did away with the necromancers and the mediums, the
idols and the fetishes—all the detestable things that were to be
seen in the land of Judah and Jerusalem. Thus he fulfilled the
terms of the Teaching recorded in the scroll that the priest
Hilkiah had found in the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Moreover Josiah put away the mediums, wizards, teraphim, idols, the LORD.

verses.english:
There was no king like him before who turned back to YHWH with all
his heart and soul and might, in full accord with the Teaching of
Moses; nor did any like him arise after him.
verses.hebrew: וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנָיו מֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁב אֶל־יְהֹוָה בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ וּבְכל־נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְכל־מְאֹדוֹ כְּכֹל תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא־קָם כָּמֹהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנָיו מֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁב אֶל־יְהֹוָה בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ וּבְכל־נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְכל־מְאֹדוֹ כְּכֹל תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא־קָם כָּמֹהוּ׃

english.text:
There was no king like him before who turned back to YHWH with all
his heart and soul and might, in full accord with the Teaching of
Moses; nor did any like him arise after him.

translation.text: Before him there was no king like him, who turned to the according to all the law of Moses; nor did any like him arise after him.

verses.english:
However, YHWH did not turn away from His awesome wrath which had
blazed up against Judah because of all the things Manasseh did to
vex Him.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־שָׁב יְהֹוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר־חָרָה אַפּוֹ בִּיהוּדָה עַל כּל־הַכְּעָסִים אֲשֶׁר הִכְעִיסוֹ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא־שָׁב יְהֹוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר־חָרָה אַפּוֹ בִּיהוּדָה עַל כּל־הַכְּעָסִים אֲשֶׁר הִכְעִיסוֹ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
However, YHWH did not turn away from His awesome wrath which had
blazed up against Judah because of all the things Manasseh did to
vex Him.

translation.text: Still the LORD did not turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, by provocations with which Manasseh had provoked him.

verses.english:
YHWH said, “I will also banish Judah from My presence as I
banished Israel; and I will reject the city of Jerusalem which I
chose and the House where I said My name would abide.”
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה גַּם אֶת־יְהוּדָה אָסִיר מֵעַל פָּנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָאַסְתִּי אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַרְתִּי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת
אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי יִהְיֶה שְׁמִי שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה גַּם אֶת־יְהוּדָה אָסִיר מֵעַל פָּנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָאַסְתִּי אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַרְתִּי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת
אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי יִהְיֶה שְׁמִי שָׁם׃

english.text:
YHWH said, “I will also banish Judah from My presence as I
banished Israel; and I will reject the city of Jerusalem which I
chose and the House where I said My name would abide.”

translation.text: The LORD Israel; and I will reject this city that I have chosen, Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there."

verses.english:
The other events of Josiah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Josiah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
In his days, Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, marched against the king
of Assyria to the River Euphrates; King Josiah marched toward him,
but when he confronted him at Megiddo, [Pharaoh Neco] slew him.
verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו עָלָה פַרְעֹה נְכֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עַל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עַל־נְהַר־פְּרָת וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּמְגִדּוֹ כִּרְאֹתוֹ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בְּיָמָיו עָלָה פַרְעֹה נְכֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עַל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עַל־נְהַר־פְּרָת וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּמְגִדּוֹ כִּרְאֹתוֹ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
In his days, Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, marched against the king
of Assyria to the River Euphrates; King Josiah marched toward him,
but when he confronted him at Megiddo, [Pharaoh Neco] slew him.

translation.text: In his days him at Megiddo, he killed him.

verses.english:
His servants conveyed his body in a chariot from Megiddo to
Jerusalem, and they buried him in his tomb. Then the people of the
land took Jehoahaz; they anointed him and made him king in place
of his father.
verses.hebrew:
וַיַּרְכִּבֻהוּ עֲבָדָיו מֵת מִמְּגִדּוֹ וַיְבִאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ וַיִּקַּח עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֹתוֹ
וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּרְכִּבֻהוּ עֲבָדָיו מֵת מִמְּגִדּוֹ וַיְבִאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ וַיִּקַּח עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֹתוֹ
וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו׃

english.text:
His servants conveyed his body in a chariot from Megiddo to
Jerusalem, and they buried him in his tomb. Then the people of the
land took Jehoahaz; they anointed him and made him king in place
of his father.

translation.text: His servants carried him dead in a anointed him, and made him king in place of his father.

verses.english:
Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he
reigned three months in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hamutal
daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה יְהוֹאָחָז בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֲמוּטַל בַּת־יִרְמְיָהוּ מִלִּבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה יְהוֹאָחָז בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֲמוּטַל בַּת־יִרְמְיָהוּ מִלִּבְנָה׃

english.text:
Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he
reigned three months in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hamutal
daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

translation.text: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; he daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.english: He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as his fathers had done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text: He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as his fathers had done.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his ancestors had done.

verses.english:
Pharaoh Neco imprisoned him in Riblah in the region of Hamath, to
keep him from reigning in Jerusalem. And he imposed on the land an
indemnity of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ פַרְעֹה נְכֹה בְרִבְלָה בְּאֶרֶץ חֲמָת (במלך) [מִמְּלֹךְ] בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיִּתֶּן־עֹנֶשׁ עַל־הָאָרֶץ מֵאָה כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ פַרְעֹה נְכֹה בְרִבְלָה בְּאֶרֶץ חֲמָת (במלך) [מִמְּלֹךְ] בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיִּתֶּן־עֹנֶשׁ עַל־הָאָרֶץ מֵאָה כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר זָהָב׃

english.text:
Pharaoh Neco imprisoned him in Riblah in the region of Hamath, to
keep him from reigning in Jerusalem. And he imposed on the land an
indemnity of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

translation.text: Pharaoh Neco confined him silver and a talent of gold.

verses.english:
Then Pharaoh Neco appointed Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of
his father Josiah, changing his name to Jehoiakim. He took
Jehoahaz and brought him to Egypt, where he died.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלֵךְ פַּרְעֹה נְכֹה אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ תַּחַת יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְהוֹיָקִים וְאֶת־יְהוֹאָחָז לָקַח וַיָּבֹא מִצְרַיִם וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּמְלֵךְ פַּרְעֹה נְכֹה אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ תַּחַת יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְהוֹיָקִים וְאֶת־יְהוֹאָחָז לָקַח וַיָּבֹא מִצְרַיִם וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
Then Pharaoh Neco appointed Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of
his father Josiah, changing his name to Jehoiakim. He took
Jehoahaz and brought him to Egypt, where he died.

translation.text: Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz away; he came to Egypt, and died there.

verses.english:
Jehoiakim gave Pharaoh the silver and the gold, and he made an
assessment on the land to pay the money demanded by Pharaoh. He
exacted from the people of the land the silver and gold to be paid
Pharaoh Neco, according to each man’s assessment.
verses.hebrew:
וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נָתַן יְהוֹיָקִים לְפַרְעֹה אַךְ הֶעֱרִיךְ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לָתֵת אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־פִּי פַרְעֹה אִישׁ כְּעֶרְכּוֹ נָגַשׂ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב אֶת־עַם
הָאָרֶץ לָתֵת לְפַרְעֹה נְכֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נָתַן יְהוֹיָקִים לְפַרְעֹה אַךְ הֶעֱרִיךְ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לָתֵת אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־פִּי פַרְעֹה אִישׁ כְּעֶרְכּוֹ נָגַשׂ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב אֶת־עַם
הָאָרֶץ לָתֵת לְפַרְעֹה נְכֹה׃

english.text:
Jehoiakim gave Pharaoh the silver and the gold, and he made an
assessment on the land to pay the money demanded by Pharaoh. He
exacted from the people of the land the silver and gold to be paid
Pharaoh Neco, according to each man’s assessment.

translation.text: their assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Neco.

verses.english:
Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he
reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Zebudah
daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה יְהוֹיָקִים בְּמלְכוֹ וְאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (זבידה) [זְבוּדָּה] בַת־פְּדָיָה מִן־רוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה יְהוֹיָקִים בְּמלְכוֹ וְאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (זבידה) [זְבוּדָּה] בַת־פְּדָיָה מִן־רוּמָה׃

english.text:
Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he
reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Zebudah
daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

translation.text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; he daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as his ancestors had
done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as his ancestors had
done.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, just as all his ancestors had done.

verses.english:
In his days, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim
became his vassal for three years. Then he turned and rebelled
against him.
verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו עָלָה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיְהִי־לוֹ יְהוֹיָקִים עֶבֶד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּשׁב וַיִּמְרד־בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בְּיָמָיו עָלָה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיְהִי־לוֹ יְהוֹיָקִים עֶבֶד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּשׁב וַיִּמְרד־בּוֹ׃

english.text:
In his days, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim
became his vassal for three years. Then he turned and rebelled
against him.

translation.text: In his days King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came up; Jehoiakim became his servant for three years; then he turned and rebelled against him.

verses.english:
YHWH let loose against him the raiding bands of the Chaldeans,
Arameans, Moabites, and Ammonites; He let them loose against Judah
to destroy it, in accordance with the word that YHWH had spoken
through His servants the prophets.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בּוֹ אֶת־גְּדוּדֵי כַשְׂדִּים וְאֶת־גְּדוּדֵי אֲרָם וְאֵת גְּדוּדֵי מוֹאָב וְאֵת גְּדוּדֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם בִּיהוּדָה לְהַאֲבִידוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה
אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בּוֹ אֶת־גְּדוּדֵי כַשְׂדִּים וְאֶת־גְּדוּדֵי אֲרָם וְאֵת גְּדוּדֵי מוֹאָב וְאֵת גְּדוּדֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם בִּיהוּדָה לְהַאֲבִידוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה
אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים׃

english.text:
YHWH let loose against him the raiding bands of the Chaldeans,
Arameans, Moabites, and Ammonites; He let them loose against Judah
to destroy it, in accordance with the word that YHWH had spoken
through His servants the prophets.

translation.text: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the LORD that he spoke by his servants the prophets.

verses.english:
All this befell Judah at the command of YHWH, who banished [them]
from His presence because of all the sins that Manasseh had
committed,
verses.hebrew: אַךְ עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בִּיהוּדָה לְהָסִיר מֵעַל פָּנָיו בְּחַטֹּאת מְנַשֶּׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בִּיהוּדָה לְהָסִיר מֵעַל פָּנָיו בְּחַטֹּאת מְנַשֶּׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
All this befell Judah at the command of YHWH, who banished [them]
from His presence because of all the sins that Manasseh had
committed,

translation.text: Surely this came sight, for the sins of Manasseh, for all that he had committed,

verses.english:
and also because of the blood of the innocent that he shed. For he
filled Jerusalem with the blood of the innocent, and YHWH would
not forgive.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם דַּם־הַנָּקִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁפָךְ וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם דָּם נָקִי וְלֹא־אָבָה יְהֹוָה לִסְלֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם דַּם־הַנָּקִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁפָךְ וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם דָּם נָקִי וְלֹא־אָבָה יְהֹוָה לִסְלֹחַ׃

english.text:
and also because of the blood of the innocent that he shed. For he
filled Jerusalem with the blood of the innocent, and YHWH would
not forgive.

translation.text: and with innocent blood, and the LORD was not willing to pardon.

verses.english:
The other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all of his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹיָקִים וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹיָקִים וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all of his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?

verses.english:
Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin succeeded
him as king.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹיָקִים עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹיָכִין בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹיָקִים עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹיָכִין בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin succeeded
him as king.

translation.text: So him.

verses.english:
The king of Egypt did not venture out of his country again, for
the king of Babylon had seized all the land that had belonged to
the king of Egypt, from the Wadi of Egypt to the River Euphrates.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הֹסִיף עוֹד מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לָצֵאת מֵאַרְצוֹ כִּי־לָקַח מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל מִנַּחַל מִצְרַיִם עַד־נְהַר־פְּרָת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־הֹסִיף עוֹד מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לָצֵאת מֵאַרְצוֹ כִּי־לָקַח מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל מִנַּחַל מִצְרַיִם עַד־נְהַר־פְּרָת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
The king of Egypt did not venture out of his country again, for
the king of Babylon had seized all the land that had belonged to
the king of Egypt, from the Wadi of Egypt to the River Euphrates.

translation.text: The king of Egypt did not come again out of his land, for the from the Wadi of Egypt to the River Euphrates.

verses.english:
Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he
reigned three months in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Nehushta
daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה יְהוֹיָכִין בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּא בַת־אֶלְנָתָן מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה יְהוֹיָכִין בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּא בַת־אֶלְנָתָן מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he
reigned three months in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Nehushta
daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

translation.text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign; he daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

verses.english: He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as his father had done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

english.text: He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as his father had done.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his father had done.

verses.english:
At that time, the troops of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon marched
against Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא (עלה) [עָלוּ] עַבְדֵי נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא (עלה) [עָלוּ] עַבְדֵי נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר׃

english.text:
At that time, the troops of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon marched
against Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.

translation.text: At that time the servants of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

verses.english:
King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon advanced against the city while his
troops were besieging it.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל עַל־הָעִיר וַעֲבָדָיו צָרִים עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל עַל־הָעִיר וַעֲבָדָיו צָרִים עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon advanced against the city while his
troops were besieging it.

translation.text: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to the city, while his servants were besieging it;

verses.english:
Thereupon King Jehoiachin of Judah, along with his mother, and his
courtiers, commanders, and officers, surrendered to the king of
Babylon. The king of Babylon took him captive in the eighth year
of his reign.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה עַל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל הוּא וְאִמּוֹ וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְסָרִיסָיו וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה לְמלְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה עַל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל הוּא וְאִמּוֹ וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְסָרִיסָיו וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה לְמלְכוֹ׃

english.text:
Thereupon King Jehoiachin of Judah, along with his mother, and his
courtiers, commanders, and officers, surrendered to the king of
Babylon. The king of Babylon took him captive in the eighth year
of his reign.

translation.text: King his mother, his servants, his officers, and his palace officials. The king of Babylon took him prisoner in the eighth year of his reign.

verses.english:
He carried off from Jerusalem all the treasures of the House of
YHWH and the treasures of the royal palace; he stripped off all
the golden decorations in the Temple of YHWH—which King Solomon of
Israel had made—as YHWH had warned.
verses.hebrew:
וַיּוֹצֵא מִשָּׁם אֶת־כּל־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְקַצֵּץ אֶת־כּל־כְּלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה
כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיּוֹצֵא מִשָּׁם אֶת־כּל־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְקַצֵּץ אֶת־כּל־כְּלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה
כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He carried off from Jerusalem all the treasures of the House of
YHWH and the treasures of the royal palace; he stripped off all
the golden decorations in the Temple of YHWH—which King Solomon of
Israel had made—as YHWH had warned.

translation.text: He carried off all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he cut in pieces all the vessels of gold in the temple of the LORD, which King Solomon of Israel had made, all this as the LORD had foretold.

verses.english:
He exiled all of Jerusalem: all the commanders and all the
warriors—ten thousand exiles—as well as all the craftsmen and
smiths; only the poorest people in the land were left.
verses.hebrew:
וְהִגְלָה אֶת־כּל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְאֶת־כּל־הַשָּׂרִים וְאֵת כּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל (עשרה) [עֲשֶׂרֶת] אֲלָפִים גּוֹלֶה וְכל־הֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר לֹא נִשְׁאַר זוּלַת דַּלַּת
עַם־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִגְלָה אֶת־כּל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְאֶת־כּל־הַשָּׂרִים וְאֵת כּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל (עשרה) [עֲשֶׂרֶת] אֲלָפִים גּוֹלֶה וְכל־הֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר לֹא נִשְׁאַר זוּלַת דַּלַּת
עַם־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
He exiled all of Jerusalem: all the commanders and all the
warriors—ten thousand exiles—as well as all the craftsmen and
smiths; only the poorest people in the land were left.

translation.text: He carried away all Jerusalem, all the officials, all the warriors, ten thousand captives, all the artisans and the smiths; no one remained, except the poorest people of the land.

verses.english:
He deported Jehoiachin to Babylon; and the king’s mother and wives
and officers and the notables of the land were brought as exiles
from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יְהוֹיָכִין בָּבֶלָה וְאֶת־אֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־סָרִיסָיו וְאֵת (אולי) [אֵילֵי] הָאָרֶץ הוֹלִיךְ גּוֹלָה מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בָּבֶלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יְהוֹיָכִין בָּבֶלָה וְאֶת־אֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־סָרִיסָיו וְאֵת (אולי) [אֵילֵי] הָאָרֶץ הוֹלִיךְ גּוֹלָה מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בָּבֶלָה׃

english.text:
He deported Jehoiachin to Babylon; and the king’s mother and wives
and officers and the notables of the land were brought as exiles
from Jerusalem to Babylon.

translation.text: He wives, his officials, and the elite of the land, he took into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.english:
All the able men, to the number of seven thousand—all of them
warriors, trained for battle—and a thousand craftsmen and smiths
were brought to Babylon as exiles by the king of Babylon.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וְהֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר אֶלֶף הַכֹּל גִּבּוֹרִים עֹשֵׂי מִלְחָמָה וַיְבִיאֵם מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל גּוֹלָה בָּבֶלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וְהֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר אֶלֶף הַכֹּל גִּבּוֹרִים עֹשֵׂי מִלְחָמָה וַיְבִיאֵם מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל גּוֹלָה בָּבֶלָה׃

english.text:
All the able men, to the number of seven thousand—all of them
warriors, trained for battle—and a thousand craftsmen and smiths
were brought to Babylon as exiles by the king of Babylon.

translation.text: The king of Babylon brought captive to smiths, one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war.

verses.english:
And the king of Babylon appointed Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle,
king in his place, changing his name to Zedekiah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלֵךְ מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־מַתַּנְיָה דֹדוֹ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־שְׁמוֹ צִדְקִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּמְלֵךְ מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־מַתַּנְיָה דֹדוֹ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־שְׁמוֹ צִדְקִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
And the king of Babylon appointed Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle,
king in his place, changing his name to Zedekiah.

translation.text: The king of changed his name to Zedekiah.

verses.english:
Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he
reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hamutal
daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְמלְכוֹ וְאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (חמיטל) [חֲמוּטַל] בַּת־יִרְמְיָהוּ מִלִּבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְמלְכוֹ וְאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (חמיטל) [חֲמוּטַל] בַּת־יִרְמְיָהוּ מִלִּבְנָה׃

english.text:
Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he
reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hamutal
daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

translation.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; he daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.english: He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as Jehoiakim had done.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יְהוֹיָקִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יְהוֹיָקִים׃

english.text: He did what was displeasing to YHWH, just as Jehoiakim had done.

translation.text: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.

verses.english:
Indeed, Jerusalem and Judah were a cause of anger for YHWH, so
that He cast them out of His presence. Zedekiah rebelled against
the king of Babylon.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עַל־אַף יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וּבִיהוּדָה עַד־הִשְׁלִכוֹ אֹתָם מֵעַל פָּנָיו וַיִּמְרֹד צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְּמֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עַל־אַף יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וּבִיהוּדָה עַד־הִשְׁלִכוֹ אֹתָם מֵעַל פָּנָיו וַיִּמְרֹד צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְּמֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

english.text:
Indeed, Jerusalem and Judah were a cause of anger for YHWH, so
that He cast them out of His presence. Zedekiah rebelled against
the king of Babylon.

translation.text: Indeed, Jerusalem and Judah so angered the LORD that he expelled them from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.english:
And in the ninth year of his reign, on the tenth day of the tenth
month, Nebuchadnezzar moved against Jerusalem with his whole army.
He besieged it; and they built towers against it all around.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בִשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁיעִית לְמלְכוֹ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּא נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל הוּא וְכל־חֵילוֹ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּבְנוּ
עָלֶיהָ דָּיֵק סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בִשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁיעִית לְמלְכוֹ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּא נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל הוּא וְכל־חֵילוֹ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּבְנוּ
עָלֶיהָ דָּיֵק סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And in the ninth year of his reign, on the tenth day of the tenth
month, Nebuchadnezzar moved against Jerusalem with his whole army.
He besieged it; and they built towers against it all around.

translation.text: And in the against Jerusalem, and laid siege to it; they built siegeworks against it all around.

verses.english:
The city continued in a state of siege until the eleventh year of
King Zedekiah.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר עַד עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ צִדְקִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר עַד עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ צִדְקִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
The city continued in a state of siege until the eleventh year of
King Zedekiah.

translation.text: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.english:
By the ninth day [of the fourth month] the famine had become acute
in the city; there was no food left for the common people.
verses.hebrew: בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בָּעִיר וְלֹא־הָיָה לֶחֶם לְעַם הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בָּעִיר וְלֹא־הָיָה לֶחֶם לְעַם הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
By the ninth day [of the fourth month] the famine had become acute
in the city; there was no food left for the common people.

translation.text: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine became so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.

verses.english:
Then [the wall of] the city was breached. All the soldiers [left
the city] by night through the gate between the double walls,
which is near the king’s garden—the Chaldeans were all around the
city; and [the king] set out for the Arabah.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּבָּקַע הָעִיר וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַלַּיְלָה דֶּרֶךְ שַׁעַר בֵּין הַחֹמֹתַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל־גַּן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכַשְׂדִּים עַל־הָעִיר סָבִיב וַיֵּלֶךְ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּבָּקַע הָעִיר וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַלַּיְלָה דֶּרֶךְ שַׁעַר בֵּין הַחֹמֹתַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל־גַּן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכַשְׂדִּים עַל־הָעִיר סָבִיב וַיֵּלֶךְ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה׃

english.text:
Then [the wall of] the city was breached. All the soldiers [left
the city] by night through the gate between the double walls,
which is near the king’s garden—the Chaldeans were all around the
city; and [the king] set out for the Arabah.

translation.text: Then a breach was made in the city wall; the king with all the soldiers went in the direction of the Arabah.

verses.english:
But the Chaldean troops pursued the king, and they overtook him in
the steppes of Jericho as his entire force left him and scattered.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ חֵיל־כַּשְׂדִּים אַחַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂגוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרֵחוֹ וְכל־חֵילוֹ נָפֹצוּ מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ חֵיל־כַּשְׂדִּים אַחַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂגוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרֵחוֹ וְכל־חֵילוֹ נָפֹצוּ מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
But the Chaldean troops pursued the king, and they overtook him in
the steppes of Jericho as his entire force left him and scattered.

translation.text: But the army of the Chaldeans army was scattered, deserting him.

verses.english:
They captured the king and brought him before the king of Babylon
at Riblah; and they put him on trial.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָתָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אִתּוֹ מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָתָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אִתּוֹ מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
They captured the king and brought him before the king of Babylon
at Riblah; and they put him on trial.

translation.text: Then they captured the king and on him.

verses.english:
They slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes; then Zedekiah’s
eyes were put out. He was chained in bronze fetters and he was
brought to Babylon.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ שָׁחֲטוּ לְעֵינָיו וְאֶת־עֵינֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ עִוֵּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְבִאֵהוּ בָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בְּנֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ שָׁחֲטוּ לְעֵינָיו וְאֶת־עֵינֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ עִוֵּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְבִאֵהוּ בָּבֶל׃

english.text:
They slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes; then Zedekiah’s
eyes were put out. He was chained in bronze fetters and he was
brought to Babylon.

translation.text: They slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, then to Babylon.

verses.english:
On the seventh day of the fifth month—that was the nineteenth year
of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon—Nebuzaradan, the chief of the
guards, an officer of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew:
וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בְּשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הִיא שְׁנַת תְּשַׁע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל בָּא נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים עֶבֶד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל
יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בְּשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הִיא שְׁנַת תְּשַׁע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל בָּא נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים עֶבֶד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל
יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
On the seventh day of the fifth month—that was the nineteenth year
of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon—Nebuzaradan, the chief of the
guards, an officer of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

translation.text: In the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month — which was Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He burned the House of YHWH, the king’s palace, and all the houses
of Jerusalem; he burned down the house of every notable person.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כּל־בָּתֵּי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְאֶת־כּל־בֵּית גָּדוֹל שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כּל־בָּתֵּי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְאֶת־כּל־בֵּית גָּדוֹל שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
He burned the House of YHWH, the king’s palace, and all the houses
of Jerusalem; he burned down the house of every notable person.

translation.text: He burned the house of the LORD, the burned down.

verses.english:
The entire Chaldean force that was with the chief of the guard
tore down the walls of Jerusalem on every side.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חוֹמֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם סָבִיב נָתְצוּ כּל־חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר רַב־טַבָּחִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־חוֹמֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם סָבִיב נָתְצוּ כּל־חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר רַב־טַבָּחִים׃

english.text:
The entire Chaldean force that was with the chief of the guard
tore down the walls of Jerusalem on every side.

translation.text: All the army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The remnant of the people that was left in the city, the defectors
who had gone over to the king of Babylon—and the remnant of the
population—were taken into exile by Nebuzaradan, the chief of the
guards.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּעִיר וְאֶת־הַנֹּפְלִים אֲשֶׁר נָפְלוּ עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְאֵת יֶתֶר הֶהָמוֹן הֶגְלָה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּעִיר וְאֶת־הַנֹּפְלִים אֲשֶׁר נָפְלוּ עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְאֵת יֶתֶר הֶהָמוֹן הֶגְלָה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים׃

english.text:
The remnant of the people that was left in the city, the defectors
who had gone over to the king of Babylon—and the remnant of the
population—were taken into exile by Nebuzaradan, the chief of the
guards.

translation.text: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried into exile the rest of the the king of Babylon — all the rest of the population.

verses.english:
But some of the poorest in the land were left by the chief of the
guards, to be vinedressers and field hands.
verses.hebrew: וּמִדַּלַּת הָאָרֶץ הִשְׁאִיר רַב־טַבָּחִים לְכֹרְמִים וּלְיֹגְבִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִדַּלַּת הָאָרֶץ הִשְׁאִיר רַב־טַבָּחִים לְכֹרְמִים וּלְיֹגְבִים׃

english.text:
But some of the poorest in the land were left by the chief of the
guards, to be vinedressers and field hands.

translation.text: But the captain vinedressers and tillers of the soil.

verses.english:
The Chaldeans broke up the bronze columns of the House of YHWH,
the stands, and the bronze tank that was in the House of YHWH; and
they carried the bronze away to Babylon.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת וְאֶת־יָם הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָה שִׁבְּרוּ כַשְׂדִּים וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־נְחֻשְׁתָּם בָּבֶלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת וְאֶת־יָם הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָה שִׁבְּרוּ כַשְׂדִּים וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־נְחֻשְׁתָּם בָּבֶלָה׃

english.text:
The Chaldeans broke up the bronze columns of the House of YHWH,
the stands, and the bronze tank that was in the House of YHWH; and
they carried the bronze away to Babylon.

translation.text: The bronze pillars that were in the house of the LORD, as well as the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried the bronze to Babylon.

verses.english:
They also took all the pails, scrapers, snuffers, ladles, and all
the other bronze vessels used in the service.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַכַּפּוֹת וְאֵת כּל־כְּלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ־בָם לָקָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַכַּפּוֹת וְאֵת כּל־כְּלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ־בָם לָקָחוּ׃

english.text:
They also took all the pails, scrapers, snuffers, ladles, and all
the other bronze vessels used in the service.

translation.text: They and all the bronze vessels used in the temple service,

verses.english:
The chief of the guards took whatever was of gold and whatever was
of silver: firepans and sprinkling bowls.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתּוֹת וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר זָהָב זָהָב וַאֲשֶׁר־כֶּסֶף כָּסֶף לָקַח רַב־טַבָּחִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתּוֹת וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר זָהָב זָהָב וַאֲשֶׁר־כֶּסֶף כָּסֶף לָקַח רַב־טַבָּחִים׃

english.text:
The chief of the guards took whatever was of gold and whatever was
of silver: firepans and sprinkling bowls.

translation.text: as well as the silver.

verses.english:
The two columns, the one tank, and the stands that Solomon
provided for the House of YHWH—all these objects contained bronze
beyond weighing.
verses.hebrew: הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁנַיִם הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְהַמְּכֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה לְבֵית יְהֹוָה לֹא־הָיָה מִשְׁקָל לִנְחֹשֶׁת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁנַיִם הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְהַמְּכֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה לְבֵית יְהֹוָה לֹא־הָיָה מִשְׁקָל לִנְחֹשֶׁת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
The two columns, the one tank, and the stands that Solomon
provided for the House of YHWH—all these objects contained bronze
beyond weighing.

translation.text: As for the two pillars, the one sea, and the stands, which vessels was beyond weighing.

verses.english:
The one column was eighteen cubits high. It had a bronze capital
above it; the height of the capital was three cubits, and there
was a meshwork [decorated] with pomegranates about the capital,
all made of bronze. And the like was true of the other column with
its meshwork.
verses.hebrew:
שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְכֹתֶרֶת עָלָיו נְחֹשֶׁת וְקוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת שָׁלֹשׁ (אמה) [אַמּוֹת] וּשְׂבָכָה וְרִמֹּנִים עַל־הַכֹּתֶרֶת סָבִיב הַכֹּל נְחֹשֶׁת
וְכָאֵלֶּה לַעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה׃

hebrew.text:
שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְכֹתֶרֶת עָלָיו נְחֹשֶׁת וְקוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת שָׁלֹשׁ (אמה) [אַמּוֹת] וּשְׂבָכָה וְרִמֹּנִים עַל־הַכֹּתֶרֶת סָבִיב הַכֹּל נְחֹשֶׁת
וְכָאֵלֶּה לַעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה׃

english.text:
The one column was eighteen cubits high. It had a bronze capital
above it; the height of the capital was three cubits, and there
was a meshwork [decorated] with pomegranates about the capital,
all made of bronze. And the like was true of the other column with
its meshwork.

translation.text: The height of the one pillar was the latticework.

verses.english:
The chief of the guards also took Seraiah, the chief priest,
Zephaniah, the deputy priest, and the three guardians of the
threshold.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח רַב־טַבָּחִים אֶת־שְׂרָיָה כֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָהוּ כֹּהֵן מִשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח רַב־טַבָּחִים אֶת־שְׂרָיָה כֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָהוּ כֹּהֵן מִשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף׃

english.text:
The chief of the guards also took Seraiah, the chief priest,
Zephaniah, the deputy priest, and the three guardians of the
threshold.

translation.text: The captain of the guard took the chief priest Seraiah, the second priest Zephaniah, and the three guardians of the threshold;

verses.english:
And from the city he took a eunuch who was in command of the
soldiers; five royal privy councillors who were present in the
city; the scribe of the army commander, who was in charge of
mustering the people of the land; and sixty of the common people
who were inside the city.
verses.hebrew:
וּמִן־הָעִיר לָקַח סָרִיס אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר־הוּא פָקִיד עַל־אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מֵרֹאֵי פְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצְאוּ בָעִיר וְאֵת הַסֹּפֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא
הַמַּצְבִּא אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵעַם הָאָרֶץ הַנִּמְצְאִים בָּעִיר׃

hebrew.text:
וּמִן־הָעִיר לָקַח סָרִיס אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר־הוּא פָקִיד עַל־אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מֵרֹאֵי פְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצְאוּ בָעִיר וְאֵת הַסֹּפֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא
הַמַּצְבִּא אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵעַם הָאָרֶץ הַנִּמְצְאִים בָּעִיר׃

english.text:
And from the city he took a eunuch who was in command of the
soldiers; five royal privy councillors who were present in the
city; the scribe of the army commander, who was in charge of
mustering the people of the land; and sixty of the common people
who were inside the city.

translation.text: from the five men of the king's council who were found in the city; the secretary city.

verses.english:
Nebuzaradan, the chief of the guards, took them and brought them
to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֹתָם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים וַיֹּלֶךְ אֹתָם עַל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֹתָם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים וַיֹּלֶךְ אֹתָם עַל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָתָה׃

english.text:
Nebuzaradan, the chief of the guards, took them and brought them
to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

translation.text: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

verses.english:
The king of Babylon had them struck down and put to death at
Riblah, in the region of Hamath. Thus Judah was exiled from its
land.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיְמִיתֵם בְּרִבְלָה בְּאֶרֶץ חֲמָת וַיִּגֶל יְהוּדָה מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיְמִיתֵם בְּרִבְלָה בְּאֶרֶץ חֲמָת וַיִּגֶל יְהוּדָה מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
The king of Babylon had them struck down and put to death at
Riblah, in the region of Hamath. Thus Judah was exiled from its
land.

translation.text: The king of Babylon struck Judah went into exile out of its land.

verses.english:
King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon put Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of
Shaphan in charge of the people whom he left in the land of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעָם הַנִּשְׁאָר בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁאִיר נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיַּפְקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ בֶּן־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעָם הַנִּשְׁאָר בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁאִיר נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיַּפְקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ בֶּן־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן׃

english.text:
King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon put Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of
Shaphan in charge of the people whom he left in the land of Judah.

translation.text: He appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan as governor Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon had left.

verses.english:
When the officers of the troops and their men heard that the king
of Babylon had put Gedaliah in charge, they came to Gedaliah at
Mizpah with Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah,
Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of
the Maachite, together with their men.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כל־שָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים הֵמָּה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי־הִפְקִיד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּדַלְיָהוּ הַמִּצְפָּה וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה וְיוֹחָנָן
בֶּן־קָרֵחַ וּשְׂרָיָה בֶן־תַּנְחֻמֶת הַנְּטֹפָתִי וְיַאֲזַנְיָהוּ בֶּן־הַמַּעֲכָתִי הֵמָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כל־שָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים הֵמָּה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי־הִפְקִיד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּדַלְיָהוּ הַמִּצְפָּה וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה וְיוֹחָנָן
בֶּן־קָרֵחַ וּשְׂרָיָה בֶן־תַּנְחֻמֶת הַנְּטֹפָתִי וְיַאֲזַנְיָהוּ בֶּן־הַמַּעֲכָתִי הֵמָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶם׃

english.text:
When the officers of the troops and their men heard that the king
of Babylon had put Gedaliah in charge, they came to Gedaliah at
Mizpah with Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah,
Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of
the Maachite, together with their men.

translation.text: Now when all the captains of Maacathite.

verses.english:
Gedaliah reassured them and their men, saying, “Do not be afraid
of the servants of the Chaldeans. Stay in the land and serve the
king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע לָהֶם גְּדַלְיָהוּ וּלְאַנְשֵׁיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אַל־תִּירְאוּ מֵעַבְדֵי הַכַּשְׂדִּים שְׁבוּ בָאָרֶץ וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְיִטַב לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע לָהֶם גְּדַלְיָהוּ וּלְאַנְשֵׁיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אַל־תִּירְאוּ מֵעַבְדֵי הַכַּשְׂדִּים שְׁבוּ בָאָרֶץ וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְיִטַב לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Gedaliah reassured them and their men, saying, “Do not be afraid
of the servants of the Chaldeans. Stay in the land and serve the
king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.”

translation.text: Gedaliah swore to them and their men, saying, "Do not be afraid because of the Chaldean officials; live in the land, serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you."

verses.english:
In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama,
who was of royal descent, came with ten men, and they struck down
Gedaliah and he died; [they also killed] the Judeans and the
Chaldeans who were present with him at Mizpah.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בָּא יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה בֶּן־אֱלִישָׁמָע מִזֶּרַע הַמְּלוּכָה וַעֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים אִתּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ וַיָּמֹת
וְאֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים וְאֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ אִתּוֹ בַּמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בָּא יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה בֶּן־אֱלִישָׁמָע מִזֶּרַע הַמְּלוּכָה וַעֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים אִתּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ וַיָּמֹת
וְאֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים וְאֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ אִתּוֹ בַּמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama,
who was of royal descent, came with ten men, and they struck down
Gedaliah and he died; [they also killed] the Judeans and the
Chaldeans who were present with him at Mizpah.

translation.text: But in the seventh with the Judeans and Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.

verses.english:
And all the people, young and old, and the officers of the troops
set out and went to Egypt because they were afraid of the
Chaldeans.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ כל־הָעָם מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וְשָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיִם כִּי יָרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי כַשְׂדִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ כל־הָעָם מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וְשָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיִם כִּי יָרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי כַשְׂדִּים׃

english.text:
And all the people, young and old, and the officers of the troops
set out and went to Egypt because they were afraid of the
Chaldeans.

translation.text: out and went to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

verses.english:
In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin of
Judah, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, King
Evil-merodach of Babylon, in the year he became king, took note of
King Jehoiachin of Judah and released him from prison.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בִשְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְגָלוּת יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ נָשָׂא אֱוִיל מְרֹדַךְ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בִּשְׁנַת
מלְכוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה מִבֵּית כֶּלֶא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בִשְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְגָלוּת יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ נָשָׂא אֱוִיל מְרֹדַךְ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בִּשְׁנַת
מלְכוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה מִבֵּית כֶּלֶא׃

english.text:
In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin of
Judah, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, King
Evil-merodach of Babylon, in the year he became king, took note of
King Jehoiachin of Judah and released him from prison.

translation.text: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, King Evilmerodach of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released King Jehoiachin of Judah from prison;

verses.english:
He spoke kindly to him, and gave him a throne above those of other
kings who were with him in Babylon.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ טֹבוֹת וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְּבָבֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ טֹבוֹת וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְּבָבֶל׃

english.text:
He spoke kindly to him, and gave him a throne above those of other
kings who were with him in Babylon.

translation.text: he spoke kindly to him, and gave Babylon.

verses.english:
His prison garments were removed, and [Jehoiachin] received
regular rations by his favor for the rest of his life.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁנָּא אֵת בִּגְדֵי כִלְאוֹ וְאָכַל לֶחֶם תָּמִיד לְפָנָיו כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁנָּא אֵת בִּגְדֵי כִלְאוֹ וְאָכַל לֶחֶם תָּמִיד לְפָנָיו כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

english.text:
His prison garments were removed, and [Jehoiachin] received
regular rations by his favor for the rest of his life.

translation.text: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes. Every day of his life he dined regularly in the king's presence.

verses.english:
A regular allotment of food was given him at the instance of the
king—an allotment for each day—all the days of his life.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲרֻחָתוֹ אֲרֻחַת תָּמִיד נִתְּנָה־לּוֹ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּו׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲרֻחָתוֹ אֲרֻחַת תָּמִיד נִתְּנָה־לּוֹ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּו׃

english.text:
A regular allotment of food was given him at the instance of the
king—an allotment for each day—all the days of his life.

translation.text: For his allowance, a long as he lived.

verses.english:
It happened in the days of Ahasuerus—that Ahasuerus who reigned
over a hundred and twenty-seven provinces from India to Nubia.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הוּא אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הַמֹּלֵךְ מֵהֹדּוּ וְעַד־כּוּשׁ שֶׁבַע וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמֵאָה מְדִינָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הוּא אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הַמֹּלֵךְ מֵהֹדּוּ וְעַד־כּוּשׁ שֶׁבַע וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמֵאָה מְדִינָה׃

english.text:
It happened in the days of Ahasuerus—that Ahasuerus who reigned
over a hundred and twenty-seven provinces from India to Nubia.

verses.english:
In those days, when King Ahasuerus occupied the royal throne in
the fortress Shushan,
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם כְּשֶׁבֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ עַל כִּסֵּא מַלְכוּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם כְּשֶׁבֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ עַל כִּסֵּא מַלְכוּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה׃

english.text:
In those days, when King Ahasuerus occupied the royal throne in
the fortress Shushan,

verses.english:
in the third year of his reign, he gave a banquet for all the
officials and courtiers—the administration of Persia and Media,
the nobles and the governors of the provinces in his service.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלוֹשׁ לְמלְכוֹ עָשָׂה מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל־שָׂרָיו וַעֲבָדָיו חֵיל פָּרַס וּמָדַי הַפַּרְתְּמִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלוֹשׁ לְמלְכוֹ עָשָׂה מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל־שָׂרָיו וַעֲבָדָיו חֵיל פָּרַס וּמָדַי הַפַּרְתְּמִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
in the third year of his reign, he gave a banquet for all the
officials and courtiers—the administration of Persia and Media,
the nobles and the governors of the provinces in his service.

verses.english:
For no fewer than a hundred and eighty days he displayed the vast
riches of his kingdom and the splendid glory of his majesty.
verses.hebrew: בְּהַרְאֹתוֹ אֶת־עֹשֶׁר כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ וְאֶת־יְקָר תִּפְאֶרֶת גְּדוּלָּתוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים שְׁמוֹנִים וּמְאַת יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: בְּהַרְאֹתוֹ אֶת־עֹשֶׁר כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ וְאֶת־יְקָר תִּפְאֶרֶת גְּדוּלָּתוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים שְׁמוֹנִים וּמְאַת יוֹם׃

english.text:
For no fewer than a hundred and eighty days he displayed the vast
riches of his kingdom and the splendid glory of his majesty.

verses.english:
At the end of this period, the king gave a banquet for seven days
in the court of the king’s palace garden for all the people who
lived in the fortress Shushan, high and low alike.
verses.hebrew: וּבִמְלוֹאת הַיָּמִים הָאֵלֶּה עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ לְכל־הָעָם הַנִּמְצְאִים בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה לְמִגָּדוֹל וְעַד־קָטָן מִשְׁתֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּחֲצַר גִּנַּת בִּיתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּבִמְלוֹאת הַיָּמִים הָאֵלֶּה עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ לְכל־הָעָם הַנִּמְצְאִים בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה לְמִגָּדוֹל וְעַד־קָטָן מִשְׁתֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּחֲצַר גִּנַּת בִּיתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
At the end of this period, the king gave a banquet for seven days
in the court of the king’s palace garden for all the people who
lived in the fortress Shushan, high and low alike.

verses.english:
[There were hangings of] white cotton and blue wool, caught up by
cords of fine linen and purple wool to silver rods and alabaster
columns; and there were couches of gold and silver on a pavement
of marble, alabaster, mother-of-pearl, and mosaics.
verses.hebrew: חוּר כַּרְפַּס וּתְכֵלֶת אָחוּז בְּחַבְלֵי־בוּץ וְאַרְגָּמָן עַל־גְּלִילֵי כֶסֶף וְעַמּוּדֵי שֵׁשׁ מִטּוֹת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף עַל רִצְפַת בַּהַט־וָשֵׁשׁ וְדַר וְסֹחָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: חוּר כַּרְפַּס וּתְכֵלֶת אָחוּז בְּחַבְלֵי־בוּץ וְאַרְגָּמָן עַל־גְּלִילֵי כֶסֶף וְעַמּוּדֵי שֵׁשׁ מִטּוֹת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף עַל רִצְפַת בַּהַט־וָשֵׁשׁ וְדַר וְסֹחָרֶת׃

english.text:
[There were hangings of] white cotton and blue wool, caught up by
cords of fine linen and purple wool to silver rods and alabaster
columns; and there were couches of gold and silver on a pavement
of marble, alabaster, mother-of-pearl, and mosaics.

verses.english:
Royal wine was served in abundance, as befits a king, in golden
beakers, beakers of varied design.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשְׁקוֹת בִּכְלֵי זָהָב וְכֵלִים מִכֵּלִים שׁוֹנִים וְיֵין מַלְכוּת רָב כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְׁקוֹת בִּכְלֵי זָהָב וְכֵלִים מִכֵּלִים שׁוֹנִים וְיֵין מַלְכוּת רָב כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Royal wine was served in abundance, as befits a king, in golden
beakers, beakers of varied design.

verses.english:
And the rule for the drinking was, “No restrictions!” For the king
had given orders to every palace steward to comply with each man’s
wishes.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁתִיָּה כַדָּת אֵין אֹנֵס כִּי־כֵן יִסַּד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל כּל־רַב בֵּיתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת כִּרְצוֹן אִישׁ־וָאִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְּׁתִיָּה כַדָּת אֵין אֹנֵס כִּי־כֵן יִסַּד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל כּל־רַב בֵּיתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת כִּרְצוֹן אִישׁ־וָאִישׁ׃

english.text:
And the rule for the drinking was, “No restrictions!” For the king
had given orders to every palace steward to comply with each man’s
wishes.

verses.english:
In addition, Queen Vashti gave a banquet for women, in the royal
palace of King Ahasuerus.
verses.hebrew: גַּם וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה עָשְׂתָה מִשְׁתֵּה נָשִׁים בֵּית הַמַּלְכוּת אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה עָשְׂתָה מִשְׁתֵּה נָשִׁים בֵּית הַמַּלְכוּת אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ׃

english.text:
In addition, Queen Vashti gave a banquet for women, in the royal
palace of King Ahasuerus.

verses.english:
On the seventh day, when the king was merry with wine, he ordered
Mehuman, Bizzetha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas,
the seven eunuchs in attendance on King Ahasuerus,
verses.hebrew:
בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי כְּטוֹב לֵב־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּיִן אָמַר לִמְהוּמָן בִּזְּתָא חַרְבוֹנָא בִּגְתָא וַאֲבַגְתָא זֵתַר וְכַרְכַּס שִׁבְעַת הַסָּרִיסִים הַמְשָׁרְתִים אֶת־פְּנֵי
הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי כְּטוֹב לֵב־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּיִן אָמַר לִמְהוּמָן בִּזְּתָא חַרְבוֹנָא בִּגְתָא וַאֲבַגְתָא זֵתַר וְכַרְכַּס שִׁבְעַת הַסָּרִיסִים הַמְשָׁרְתִים אֶת־פְּנֵי
הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ׃

english.text:
On the seventh day, when the king was merry with wine, he ordered
Mehuman, Bizzetha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas,
the seven eunuchs in attendance on King Ahasuerus,

verses.english:
to bring Queen Vashti before the king wearing a royal diadem, to
display her beauty to the peoples and the officials; for she was a
beautiful woman.

verses.english:
But Queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s command conveyed by
the eunuchs. The king was greatly incensed, and his fury burned
within him.

“What,” [he asked,] “shall be done, according to law, to Queen

“What,” [he asked,] “shall be done, according to law, to Queen

verses.english:
Thereupon Memucan declared in the presence of the king and the
ministers: “Queen Vashti has committed an offense not only against
Your Majesty but also against all the officials and against all
the peoples in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר (מומכן) [מְמוּכָן] לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים לֹא עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַדּוֹ עָוְתָה וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה כִּי עַל־כּל־הַשָּׂרִים וְעַל־כּל־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר
בְּכל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ׃
