וַיֹּאמֶר (מומכן) [מְמוּכָן] לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים לֹא עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַדּוֹ עָוְתָה וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה כִּי עַל־כּל־הַשָּׂרִים וְעַל־כּל־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר
בְּכל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ׃

english.text:
Thereupon Memucan declared in the presence of the king and the
ministers: “Queen Vashti has committed an offense not only against
Your Majesty but also against all the officials and against all
the peoples in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus.

verses.english:
For the queen’s behavior will make all wives despise their
husbands, as they reflect that King Ahasuerus himself ordered
Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she would not come.
verses.hebrew:
כִּי־יֵצֵא דְבַר־הַמַּלְכָּה עַל־כּל־הַנָּשִׁים לְהַבְזוֹת בַּעְלֵיהֶן בְּעֵינֵיהֶן בְּאמְרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אָמַר לְהָבִיא אֶת־וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה לְפָנָיו
וְלֹא־בָאָה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי־יֵצֵא דְבַר־הַמַּלְכָּה עַל־כּל־הַנָּשִׁים לְהַבְזוֹת בַּעְלֵיהֶן בְּעֵינֵיהֶן בְּאמְרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אָמַר לְהָבִיא אֶת־וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה לְפָנָיו
וְלֹא־בָאָה׃

For the queen’s behavior will make all wives despise their
husbands, as they reflect that King Ahasuerus himself ordered
Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she would not come.

verses.english:
This very day the ladies of Persia and Media, who have heard of
the queen’s behavior, will cite it to all Your Majesty’s
officials, and there will be no end of scorn and provocation!
verses.hebrew: וְהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תֹּאמַרְנָה שָׂרוֹת פָּרַס־וּמָדַי אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־דְּבַר הַמַּלְכָּה לְכֹל שָׂרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּכְדַי בִּזָּיוֹן וָקָצֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תֹּאמַרְנָה שָׂרוֹת פָּרַס־וּמָדַי אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־דְּבַר הַמַּלְכָּה לְכֹל שָׂרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּכְדַי בִּזָּיוֹן וָקָצֶף׃

english.text:
This very day the ladies of Persia and Media, who have heard of
the queen’s behavior, will cite it to all Your Majesty’s
officials, and there will be no end of scorn and provocation!

verses.english:
“If it please Your Majesty, let a royal edict be issued by you,
and let it be written into the laws of Persia and Media, so that
it cannot be abrogated, that Vashti shall never enter the presence
of King Ahasuerus. And let Your Majesty bestow her royal state
upon another who is more worthy than she.
verses.hebrew:
אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב יֵצֵא דְבַר־מַלְכוּת מִלְּפָנָיו וְיִכָּתֵב בְּדָתֵי פָרַס־וּמָדַי וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תָבוֹא וַשְׁתִּי לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ וּמַלְכוּתָהּ
יִתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְעוּתָהּ הַטּוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב יֵצֵא דְבַר־מַלְכוּת מִלְּפָנָיו וְיִכָּתֵב בְּדָתֵי פָרַס־וּמָדַי וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תָבוֹא וַשְׁתִּי לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ וּמַלְכוּתָהּ

english.text:
“If it please Your Majesty, let a royal edict be issued by you,

verses.english:
Then will the judgment executed by Your Majesty resound throughout

husbands with respect, high and low alike.”
verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַע פִּתְגָם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה בְּכל־מַלְכוּתוֹ כִּי רַבָּה הִיא וְכל־הַנָּשִׁים יִתְּנוּ יְקָר לְבַעְלֵיהֶן לְמִגָּדוֹל וְעַד־קָטָן׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁמַע פִּתְגָם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה בְּכל־מַלְכוּתוֹ כִּי רַבָּה הִיא וְכל־הַנָּשִׁים יִתְּנוּ יְקָר לְבַעְלֵיהֶן לְמִגָּדוֹל וְעַד־קָטָן׃

verses.english:
The proposal was approved by the king and the ministers, and the

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּדְבַר מְמוּכָן׃

english.text:
The proposal was approved by the king and the ministers, and the
king did as Memucan proposed.

verses.english:
Dispatches were sent to all the provinces of the king, to every
province in its own script and to every nation in its own
language, that every man should wield authority in his home and
speak the language of his own people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח סְפָרִים אֶל־כּל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה כִּכְתָבָהּ וְאֶל־עַם וָעָם כִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ לִהְיוֹת כּל־אִישׁ שֹׂרֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ וּמְדַבֵּר כִּלְשׁוֹן עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח סְפָרִים אֶל־כּל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה כִּכְתָבָהּ וְאֶל־עַם וָעָם כִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ לִהְיוֹת כּל־אִישׁ שֹׂרֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ וּמְדַבֵּר כִּלְשׁוֹן עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english:
In the first year of King Cyrus of Persia, when the word of YHWH
spoken by Jeremiah was fulfilled, YHWH roused the spirit of King
Cyrus of Persia to issue a proclamation throughout his realm by
word of mouth and in writing as follows:

וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת לְכוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס לִכְלוֹת דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה מִפִּי יִרְמְיָה הֵעִיר יְהֹוָה אֶת־רוּחַ כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס וַיַּעֲבֶר־קוֹל בְּכל־מַלְכוּתוֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּב
לֵאמֹר׃

וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת לְכוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס לִכְלוֹת דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה מִפִּי יִרְמְיָה הֵעִיר יְהֹוָה אֶת־רוּחַ כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס וַיַּעֲבֶר־קוֹל בְּכל־מַלְכוּתוֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּב

english.text:
In the first year of King Cyrus of Persia, when the word of YHWH
spoken by Jeremiah was fulfilled, YHWH roused the spirit of King
Cyrus of Persia to issue a proclamation throughout his realm by
word of mouth and in writing as follows:

verses.english:
“Thus said King Cyrus of Persia: YHWH God of Heaven has given me
all the kingdoms of the earth and has charged me with building Him
a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס כֹּל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהוּא־פָקַד עָלַי לִבְנוֹת־לוֹ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס כֹּל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהוּא־פָקַד עָלַי לִבְנוֹת־לוֹ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
“Thus said King Cyrus of Persia: YHWH God of Heaven has given me
all the kingdoms of the earth and has charged me with building Him
a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

verses.hebrew: מִי־בָכֶם מִכּל־עַמּוֹ יְהִי אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וְיַעַל לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וְיִבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: מִי־בָכֶם מִכּל־עַמּוֹ יְהִי אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וְיַעַל לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וְיִבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

verses.english:
and all who stay behind, wherever he may be living, let the people
of his place assist him with silver, gold, goods, and livestock,
besides the freewill offering to the House of God that is in
Jerusalem.”
verses.hebrew:
וְכל־הַנִּשְׁאָר מִכּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר הוּא גָר־שָׁם יְנַשְּׂאוּהוּ אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמוֹ בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִרְכוּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָה עִם־הַנְּדָבָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר
בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וְכל־הַנִּשְׁאָר מִכּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר הוּא גָר־שָׁם יְנַשְּׂאוּהוּ אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמוֹ בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִרְכוּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָה עִם־הַנְּדָבָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר
בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
and all who stay behind, wherever he may be living, let the people
of his place assist him with silver, gold, goods, and livestock,
besides the freewill offering to the House of God that is in
Jerusalem.”

verses.english:
So the chiefs of the clans of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests
and Levites, all whose spirit had been roused by God, got ready to
go up to build the House of YHWH that is in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לִיהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְכֹל הֵעִיר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־רוּחוֹ לַעֲלוֹת לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לִיהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְכֹל הֵעִיר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־רוּחוֹ לַעֲלוֹת לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
So the chiefs of the clans of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests
and Levites, all whose spirit had been roused by God, got ready to
go up to build the House of YHWH that is in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
All their neighbors supported them with silver vessels, with gold,
with goods, with livestock, and with precious objects, besides
what had been given as a freewill offering.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם חִזְּקוּ בִידֵיהֶם בִּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף בַּזָּהָב בָּרְכוּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבַמִּגְדָּנוֹת לְבַד עַל־כּל־הִתְנַדֵּב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם חִזְּקוּ בִידֵיהֶם בִּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף בַּזָּהָב בָּרְכוּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבַמִּגְדָּנוֹת לְבַד עַל־כּל־הִתְנַדֵּב׃

english.text:
All their neighbors supported them with silver vessels, with gold,
with goods, with livestock, and with precious objects, besides
what had been given as a freewill offering.

verses.english:
King Cyrus released the vessels of YHWH’s house which
Nebuchadnezzar had taken away from Jerusalem and had put in the
house of his god.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ כּוֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִיא אֶת־כְּלֵי בֵית־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּבֵית אֱלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ כּוֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִיא אֶת־כְּלֵי בֵית־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּבֵית אֱלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
King Cyrus released the vessels of YHWH’s house which
Nebuchadnezzar had taken away from Jerusalem and had put in the
house of his god.

verses.english:
These King Cyrus of Persia released through the office of
Mithredath the treasurer, who gave an inventory of them to
Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס עַל־יַד מִתְרְדָת הַגִּזְבָּר וַיִּסְפְּרֵם לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר הַנָּשִׂיא לִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס עַל־יַד מִתְרְדָת הַגִּזְבָּר וַיִּסְפְּרֵם לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר הַנָּשִׂיא לִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
These King Cyrus of Persia released through the office of
Mithredath the treasurer, who gave an inventory of them to
Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

verses.english:
This is the inventory: 30 gold basins, 1,000 silver basins, 29
knives,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מִסְפָּרָם אֲגַרְטְלֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־כֶסֶף אָלֶף מַחֲלָפִים תִּשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה מִסְפָּרָם אֲגַרְטְלֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־כֶסֶף אָלֶף מַחֲלָפִים תִּשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

english.text:
This is the inventory: 30 gold basins, 1,000 silver basins, 29
knives,

verses.english: 30 gold bowls, 410 silver double bowls, 1,000 other vessels;
verses.hebrew: כְּפוֹרֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים כְּפוֹרֵי כֶסֶף מִשְׁנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַעֲשָׂרָה כֵּלִים אֲחֵרִים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: כְּפוֹרֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים כְּפוֹרֵי כֶסֶף מִשְׁנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַעֲשָׂרָה כֵּלִים אֲחֵרִים אָלֶף׃

english.text: 30 gold bowls, 410 silver double bowls, 1,000 other vessels;

verses.english:
in all, 5,400 gold and silver vessels. Sheshbazzar brought all
these back when the exiles came back from Babylon to Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: כּל־כֵּלִים לַזָּהָב וְלַכֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת הַכֹּל הֶעֱלָה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר עִם הֵעָלוֹת הַגּוֹלָה מִבָּבֶל לִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: כּל־כֵּלִים לַזָּהָב וְלַכֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת הַכֹּל הֶעֱלָה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר עִם הֵעָלוֹת הַגּוֹלָה מִבָּבֶל לִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
in all, 5,400 gold and silver vessels. Sheshbazzar brought all
these back when the exiles came back from Babylon to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The narrative of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: In the month of Kislev
of the twentieth year, when I was in the fortress of Shushan,
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי נְחֶמְיָה בֶּן־חֲכַלְיָה וַיְהִי בְחֹדֶשׁ־כִּסְלֵו שְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה׃

hebrew.text: דִּבְרֵי נְחֶמְיָה בֶּן־חֲכַלְיָה וַיְהִי בְחֹדֶשׁ־כִּסְלֵו שְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה׃

english.text:
The narrative of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: In the month of Kislev
of the twentieth year, when I was in the fortress of Shushan,

verses.english:
Hanani, one of my brothers, together with some men of Judah,
arrived, and I asked them about the Jews, the remnant who had
survived the captivity, and about Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חֲנָנִי אֶחָד מֵאַחַי הוּא וַאֲנָשִׁים מִיהוּדָה וָאֶשְׁאָלֵם עַל־הַיְּהוּדִים הַפְּלֵיטָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁאֲרוּ מִן־הַשֶּׁבִי וְעַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא חֲנָנִי אֶחָד מֵאַחַי הוּא וַאֲנָשִׁים מִיהוּדָה וָאֶשְׁאָלֵם עַל־הַיְּהוּדִים הַפְּלֵיטָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁאֲרוּ מִן־הַשֶּׁבִי וְעַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Hanani, one of my brothers, together with some men of Judah,
arrived, and I asked them about the Jews, the remnant who had
survived the captivity, and about Jerusalem.

verses.english:
They replied, “The survivors who have survived the captivity there
in the province are in dire trouble and disgrace; Jerusalem’s wall
is full of breaches, and its gates have been destroyed by fire.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לִי הַנִּשְׁאָרִים אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁאֲרוּ מִן־הַשְּׁבִי שָׁם בַּמְּדִינָה בְּרָעָה גְדֹלָה וּבְחֶרְפָּה וְחוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מְפֹרָצֶת וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ נִצְּתוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לִי הַנִּשְׁאָרִים אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁאֲרוּ מִן־הַשְּׁבִי שָׁם בַּמְּדִינָה בְּרָעָה גְדֹלָה וּבְחֶרְפָּה וְחוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מְפֹרָצֶת וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ נִצְּתוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
They replied, “The survivors who have survived the captivity there
in the province are in dire trouble and disgrace; Jerusalem’s wall
is full of breaches, and its gates have been destroyed by fire.”

verses.english:
When I heard that, I sat and wept, and was in mourning for days,
fasting and praying to the God of Heaven.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּשׁמְעִי אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה יָשַׁבְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה וָאֶתְאַבְּלָה יָמִים וָאֱהִי צָם וּמִתְפַּלֵּל לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּשׁמְעִי אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה יָשַׁבְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה וָאֶתְאַבְּלָה יָמִים וָאֱהִי צָם וּמִתְפַּלֵּל לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
When I heard that, I sat and wept, and was in mourning for days,
fasting and praying to the God of Heaven.

verses.english:
I said, “O YHWH, God of Heaven, great and awesome God, who stays
faithful to His covenant with those who love Him and keep His
commandments!
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אָנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וָחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אָנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וָחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָיו׃

english.text:
I said, “O YHWH, God of Heaven, great and awesome God, who stays
faithful to His covenant with those who love Him and keep His
commandments!

verses.english:
Let Your ear be attentive and Your eyes open to receive the prayer
of Your servant that I am praying to You now, day and night, on
behalf of the Israelites, Your servants, confessing the sins that
we Israelites have committed against You, sins that I and my
father’s house have committed.
verses.hebrew:
תְּהִי נָא אזְנְךָ־קַשֶּׁבֶת וְעֵינֶיךָ פְתוּחוֹת לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ
וּמִתְוַדֶּה עַל־חַטֹּאות בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ וַאֲנִי וּבֵית־אָבִי חָטָאנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
תְּהִי נָא אזְנְךָ־קַשֶּׁבֶת וְעֵינֶיךָ פְתוּחוֹת לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ
וּמִתְוַדֶּה עַל־חַטֹּאות בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ וַאֲנִי וּבֵית־אָבִי חָטָאנוּ׃

english.text:
Let Your ear be attentive and Your eyes open to receive the prayer
of Your servant that I am praying to You now, day and night, on
behalf of the Israelites, Your servants, confessing the sins that
we Israelites have committed against You, sins that I and my
father’s house have committed.

verses.english:
We have offended You by not keeping the commandments, the laws,
and the rules that You gave to Your servant Moses.
verses.hebrew: חֲבֹל חָבַלְנוּ לָךְ וְלֹא־שָׁמַרְנוּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוֺת וְאֶת־הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: חֲבֹל חָבַלְנוּ לָךְ וְלֹא־שָׁמַרְנוּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוֺת וְאֶת־הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
We have offended You by not keeping the commandments, the laws,
and the rules that You gave to Your servant Moses.

verses.english:
Be mindful of the promise You gave to Your servant Moses: ‘If you
are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples;
verses.hebrew: זְכר־נָא אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם תִּמְעָלוּ אֲנִי אָפִיץ אֶתְכֶם בָּעַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: זְכר־נָא אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם תִּמְעָלוּ אֲנִי אָפִיץ אֶתְכֶם בָּעַמִּים׃

english.text:
Be mindful of the promise You gave to Your servant Moses: ‘If you
are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples;

verses.english:
but if you turn back to Me, faithfully keep My commandments, even
if your dispersed are at the ends of the earth, I will gather them
from there and bring them to the place where I have chosen to
establish My name.’
verses.hebrew:
וְשַׁבְתֶּם אֵלַי וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אִם־יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲכֶם בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם מִשָּׁם אֲקַבְּצֵם (והבואתים) [וַהֲבִיאוֹתִים] אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר
בָּחַרְתִּי לְשַׁכֵּן אֶת־שְׁמִי שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וְשַׁבְתֶּם אֵלַי וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אִם־יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲכֶם בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם מִשָּׁם אֲקַבְּצֵם (והבואתים) [וַהֲבִיאוֹתִים] אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר
בָּחַרְתִּי לְשַׁכֵּן אֶת־שְׁמִי שָׁם׃

english.text:
but if you turn back to Me, faithfully keep My commandments, even
if your dispersed are at the ends of the earth, I will gather them
from there and bring them to the place where I have chosen to
establish My name.’

verses.english:
For they are Your servants and Your people whom You redeemed by
Your great power and Your mighty hand.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵם עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדוֹל וּבְיָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵם עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדוֹל וּבְיָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
For they are Your servants and Your people whom You redeemed by
Your great power and Your mighty hand.

verses.english:
O YHWH! Let Your ear be attentive to the prayer of Your servant,
and to the prayer of Your servants who desire to hold Your name in
awe. Grant Your servant success today, and dispose that man to be
compassionate toward him!” I was the king’s cupbearer at the time.
verses.hebrew:
אָנָּא אֲדֹנָי תְּהִי נָא אזְנְךָ־קַשֶּׁבֶת אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּפִלַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ הַחֲפֵצִים לְיִרְאָה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצְלִיחָה־נָּא לְעַבְדְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּתְנֵהוּ
לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי מַשְׁקֶה לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
אָנָּא אֲדֹנָי תְּהִי נָא אזְנְךָ־קַשֶּׁבֶת אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּפִלַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ הַחֲפֵצִים לְיִרְאָה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצְלִיחָה־נָּא לְעַבְדְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּתְנֵהוּ
לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי מַשְׁקֶה לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
O YHWH! Let Your ear be attentive to the prayer of Your servant,
and to the prayer of Your servants who desire to hold Your name in
awe. Grant Your servant success today, and dispose that man to be
compassionate toward him!” I was the king’s cupbearer at the time.

verses.english: "Who is Nehemiah?"
verses.hebrew: מן הו נחמיה?

hebrew.text: מן הו נחמיה?

tense.

tense.

"Why does this trouble you?"
he asked.

verses.english: Remember me, my god, for good?
verses.hebrew: זכְרָה־לִּי אֱלֹהַי לְטוֹבָה

hebrew.text: זכְרָה־לִּי אֱלֹהַי לְטוֹבָה

english.text: Remember me, my god, for good?

verses.english:
Some time afterward, when the anger of King Ahasuerus subsided, he
thought of Vashti and what she had done and what had been decreed
against her.
verses.hebrew: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כְּשֹׁךְ חֲמַת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ זָכַר אֶת־וַשְׁתִּי וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂתָה וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־נִגְזַר עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כְּשֹׁךְ חֲמַת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ זָכַר אֶת־וַשְׁתִּי וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂתָה וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־נִגְזַר עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Some time afterward, when the anger of King Ahasuerus subsided, he
thought of Vashti and what she had done and what had been decreed
against her.

verses.english:
The king’s servants who attended him said, “Let beautiful young
virgins be sought out for Your Majesty.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נַעֲרֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ מְשָׁרְתָיו יְבַקְשׁוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ נְעָרוֹת בְּתוּלוֹת טוֹבוֹת מַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נַעֲרֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ מְשָׁרְתָיו יְבַקְשׁוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ נְעָרוֹת בְּתוּלוֹת טוֹבוֹת מַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
The king’s servants who attended him said, “Let beautiful young
virgins be sought out for Your Majesty.

verses.english:
Let Your Majesty appoint officers in every province of your realm
to assemble all the beautiful young virgins at the fortress
Shushan, in the harem under the supervision of Hege, the king’s
eunuch, guardian of the women. Let them be provided with their
cosmetics.
verses.hebrew:
וְיַפְקֵד הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּקִידִים בְּכל־מְדִינוֹת מַלְכוּתוֹ וְיִקְבְּצוּ אֶת־כּל־נַעֲרָה־בְתוּלָה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה אֶל־שׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה אֶל־בֵּית הַנָּשִׁים אֶל־יַד הֵגֶא סְרִיס
הַמֶּלֶךְ שֹׁמֵר הַנָּשִׁים וְנָתוֹן תַּמְרֻקֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וְיַפְקֵד הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּקִידִים בְּכל־מְדִינוֹת מַלְכוּתוֹ וְיִקְבְּצוּ אֶת־כּל־נַעֲרָה־בְתוּלָה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה אֶל־שׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה אֶל־בֵּית הַנָּשִׁים אֶל־יַד הֵגֶא סְרִיס
הַמֶּלֶךְ שֹׁמֵר הַנָּשִׁים וְנָתוֹן תַּמְרֻקֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
Let Your Majesty appoint officers in every province of your realm
to assemble all the beautiful young virgins at the fortress
Shushan, in the harem under the supervision of Hege, the king’s
eunuch, guardian of the women. Let them be provided with their
cosmetics.

verses.english:
And let the maiden who pleases Your Majesty be queen instead of
Vashti.” The proposal pleased the king, and he acted upon it.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעֲרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ תִּמְלֹךְ תַּחַת וַשְׁתִּי וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעֲרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ תִּמְלֹךְ תַּחַת וַשְׁתִּי וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

english.text:
And let the maiden who pleases Your Majesty be queen instead of
Vashti.” The proposal pleased the king, and he acted upon it.

verses.english:
In the fortress Shushan lived a Jew by the name of Mordecai, son
of Jair son of Shimei son of Kish, a Benjaminite.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ יְהוּדִי הָיָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וּשְׁמוֹ מרְדֳּכַי בֶּן יָאִיר בֶּן־שִׁמְעִי בֶּן־קִישׁ אִישׁ יְמִינִי׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ יְהוּדִי הָיָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וּשְׁמוֹ מרְדֳּכַי בֶּן יָאִיר בֶּן־שִׁמְעִי בֶּן־קִישׁ אִישׁ יְמִינִי׃

english.text:
In the fortress Shushan lived a Jew by the name of Mordecai, son
of Jair son of Shimei son of Kish, a Benjaminite.

verses.english:
[Kish] had been exiled from Jerusalem in the group that was
carried into exile along with King Jeconiah of Judah, which had
been driven into exile by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הגְלָה מִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִם־הַגֹּלָה אֲשֶׁר הגְלְתָה עִם יְכנְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר הגְלָה מִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִם־הַגֹּלָה אֲשֶׁר הגְלְתָה עִם יְכנְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

english.text:
[Kish] had been exiled from Jerusalem in the group that was
carried into exile along with King Jeconiah of Judah, which had
been driven into exile by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

verses.english:
He was foster father to Hadassah—that is, Esther—his uncle’s
daughter, for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was
shapely and beautiful; and when her father and mother died,
Mordecai adopted her as his own daughter.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אֹמֵן אֶת־הֲדַסָּה הִיא אֶסְתֵּר בַּת־דֹּדוֹ כִּי אֵין לָהּ אָב וָאֵם וְהַנַּעֲרָה יְפַת־תֹּאַר וְטוֹבַת מַרְאֶה וּבְמוֹת אָבִיהָ וְאִמָּהּ לְקָחָהּ מרְדֳּכַי לוֹ לְבַת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אֹמֵן אֶת־הֲדַסָּה הִיא אֶסְתֵּר בַּת־דֹּדוֹ כִּי אֵין לָהּ אָב וָאֵם וְהַנַּעֲרָה יְפַת־תֹּאַר וְטוֹבַת מַרְאֶה וּבְמוֹת אָבִיהָ וְאִמָּהּ לְקָחָהּ מרְדֳּכַי לוֹ לְבַת׃

english.text:
He was foster father to Hadassah—that is, Esther—his uncle’s
daughter, for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was
shapely and beautiful; and when her father and mother died,
Mordecai adopted her as his own daughter.

verses.english:
When the king’s order and edict was proclaimed, and when many
girls were assembled in the fortress Shushan under the supervision
of Hegai, Esther too was taken into the king’s palace under the
supervision of Hegai, guardian of the women.
verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בְּהִשָּׁמַע דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדָתוֹ וּבְהִקָּבֵץ נְעָרוֹת רַבּוֹת אֶל־שׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה אֶל־יַד הֵגָי וַתִּלָּקַח אֶסְתֵּר אֶל־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יַד הֵגַי שֹׁמֵר
הַנָּשִׁים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בְּהִשָּׁמַע דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדָתוֹ וּבְהִקָּבֵץ נְעָרוֹת רַבּוֹת אֶל־שׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה אֶל־יַד הֵגָי וַתִּלָּקַח אֶסְתֵּר אֶל־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יַד הֵגַי שֹׁמֵר
הַנָּשִׁים׃

english.text:
When the king’s order and edict was proclaimed, and when many
girls were assembled in the fortress Shushan under the supervision
of Hegai, Esther too was taken into the king’s palace under the
supervision of Hegai, guardian of the women.

verses.english:
The girl pleased him and won his favor, and he hastened to furnish
her with her cosmetics and her rations, as well as with the seven
maids who were her due from the king’s palace; and he treated her
and her maids with special kindness in the harem.
verses.hebrew:
וַתִּיטַב הַנַּעֲרָה בְעֵינָיו וַתִּשָּׂא חֶסֶד לְפָנָיו וַיְבַהֵל אֶת־תַּמְרוּקֶיהָ וְאֶת־מָנוֹתֶהָ לָתֵת לָהּ וְאֵת שֶׁבַע הַנְּעָרוֹת הָרְאֻיוֹת לָתֶת־לָהּ מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיְשַׁנֶּהָ וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹתֶיהָ לְטוֹב בֵּית הַנָּשִׁים׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּיטַב הַנַּעֲרָה בְעֵינָיו וַתִּשָּׂא חֶסֶד לְפָנָיו וַיְבַהֵל אֶת־תַּמְרוּקֶיהָ וְאֶת־מָנוֹתֶהָ לָתֵת לָהּ וְאֵת שֶׁבַע הַנְּעָרוֹת הָרְאֻיוֹת לָתֶת־לָהּ מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיְשַׁנֶּהָ וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹתֶיהָ לְטוֹב בֵּית הַנָּשִׁים׃

english.text:
The girl pleased him and won his favor, and he hastened to furnish
her with her cosmetics and her rations, as well as with the seven
maids who were her due from the king’s palace; and he treated her
and her maids with special kindness in the harem.

verses.english:
Esther did not reveal her people or her kindred, for Mordecai had
told her not to reveal it.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִגִּידָה אֶסְתֵּר אֶת־עַמָּהּ וְאֶת־מוֹלַדְתָּהּ כִּי מרְדֳּכַי צִוָּה עָלֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תַגִּיד׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־הִגִּידָה אֶסְתֵּר אֶת־עַמָּהּ וְאֶת־מוֹלַדְתָּהּ כִּי מרְדֳּכַי צִוָּה עָלֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תַגִּיד׃

english.text:
Esther did not reveal her people or her kindred, for Mordecai had
told her not to reveal it.

verses.english:
Every single day Mordecai would walk about in front of the court
of the harem, to learn how Esther was faring and what was
happening to her.
verses.hebrew: וּבְכל־יוֹם וָיוֹם מרְדֳּכַי מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי חֲצַר בֵּית־הַנָּשִׁים לָדַעַת אֶת־שְׁלוֹם אֶסְתֵּר וּמַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְכל־יוֹם וָיוֹם מרְדֳּכַי מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי חֲצַר בֵּית־הַנָּשִׁים לָדַעַת אֶת־שְׁלוֹם אֶסְתֵּר וּמַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה בָּהּ׃

english.text:
Every single day Mordecai would walk about in front of the court
of the harem, to learn how Esther was faring and what was
happening to her.

verses.english:
When each girl’s turn came to go to King Ahasuerus at the end of
the twelve months’ treatment prescribed for women (for that was
the period spent on beautifying them: six months with oil of myrrh
and six months with perfumes and women’s cosmetics,
verses.hebrew:
וּבְהַגִּיעַ תֹּר נַעֲרָה וְנַעֲרָה לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ מִקֵּץ הֱיוֹת לָהּ כְּדָת הַנָּשִׁים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ כִּי כֵּן יִמְלְאוּ יְמֵי מְרוּקֵיהֶן שִׁשָּׁה
חֳדָשִׁים בְּשֶׁמֶן הַמֹּר וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים בַּבְּשָׂמִים וּבְתַמְרוּקֵי הַנָּשִׁים׃

hebrew.text:
וּבְהַגִּיעַ תֹּר נַעֲרָה וְנַעֲרָה לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ מִקֵּץ הֱיוֹת לָהּ כְּדָת הַנָּשִׁים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ כִּי כֵּן יִמְלְאוּ יְמֵי מְרוּקֵיהֶן שִׁשָּׁה
חֳדָשִׁים בְּשֶׁמֶן הַמֹּר וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים בַּבְּשָׂמִים וּבְתַמְרוּקֵי הַנָּשִׁים׃

english.text:
When each girl’s turn came to go to King Ahasuerus at the end of
the twelve months’ treatment prescribed for women (for that was
the period spent on beautifying them: six months with oil of myrrh
and six months with perfumes and women’s cosmetics,

verses.english:
and it was after that that the girl would go to the king),
whatever she asked for would be given her to take with her from
the harem to the king’s palace.
verses.hebrew: וּבָזֶה הַנַּעֲרָה בָּאָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר יִנָּתֵן לָהּ לָבוֹא עִמָּהּ מִבֵּית הַנָּשִׁים עַד־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָזֶה הַנַּעֲרָה בָּאָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר יִנָּתֵן לָהּ לָבוֹא עִמָּהּ מִבֵּית הַנָּשִׁים עַד־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
and it was after that that the girl would go to the king),
whatever she asked for would be given her to take with her from
the harem to the king’s palace.

verses.english:
She would go in the evening and leave in the morning for a second
harem in charge of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, guardian of the
concubines. She would not go again to the king unless the king
wanted her, when she would be summoned by name.
verses.hebrew:
בָּעֶרֶב הִיא בָאָה וּבַבֹּקֶר הִיא שָׁבָה אֶל־בֵּית הַנָּשִׁים שֵׁנִי אֶל־יַד שַׁעַשְׁגַז סְרִיס הַמֶּלֶךְ שֹׁמֵר הַפִּילַגְשִׁים לֹא־תָבוֹא עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אִם־חָפֵץ
בָּהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְנִקְרְאָה בְשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text:
בָּעֶרֶב הִיא בָאָה וּבַבֹּקֶר הִיא שָׁבָה אֶל־בֵּית הַנָּשִׁים שֵׁנִי אֶל־יַד שַׁעַשְׁגַז סְרִיס הַמֶּלֶךְ שֹׁמֵר הַפִּילַגְשִׁים לֹא־תָבוֹא עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אִם־חָפֵץ
בָּהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְנִקְרְאָה בְשֵׁם׃

english.text:
She would go in the evening and leave in the morning for a second
harem in charge of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, guardian of the
concubines. She would not go again to the king unless the king
wanted her, when she would be summoned by name.

verses.english:
When the turn came for Esther daughter of Abihail—the uncle of
Mordecai, who had adopted her as his own daughter—to go to the
king, she did not ask for anything but what Hegai, the king’s
eunuch, guardian of the women, advised. Yet Esther won the
admiration of all who saw her.
verses.hebrew:
וּבְהַגִּיעַ תֹּר־אֶסְתֵּר בַּת־אֲבִיחַיִל דֹּד מרְדֳּכַי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח־לוֹ לְבַת לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא בִקְשָׁה דָּבָר כִּי אִם אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר הֵגַי סְרִיס־הַמֶּלֶךְ שֹׁמֵר
הַנָּשִׁים וַתְּהִי אֶסְתֵּר נֹשֵׂאת חֵן בְּעֵינֵי כּל־רֹאֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וּבְהַגִּיעַ תֹּר־אֶסְתֵּר בַּת־אֲבִיחַיִל דֹּד מרְדֳּכַי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח־לוֹ לְבַת לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא בִקְשָׁה דָּבָר כִּי אִם אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר הֵגַי סְרִיס־הַמֶּלֶךְ שֹׁמֵר
הַנָּשִׁים וַתְּהִי אֶסְתֵּר נֹשֵׂאת חֵן בְּעֵינֵי כּל־רֹאֶיהָ׃

english.text:
When the turn came for Esther daughter of Abihail—the uncle of
Mordecai, who had adopted her as his own daughter—to go to the
king, she did not ask for anything but what Hegai, the king’s
eunuch, guardian of the women, advised. Yet Esther won the
admiration of all who saw her.

verses.english:
Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus, in his royal palace, in the
tenth month, which is the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of
his reign.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּלָּקַח אֶסְתֵּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֶל־בֵּית מַלְכוּתוֹ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ טֵבֵת בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְמַלְכוּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּלָּקַח אֶסְתֵּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֶל־בֵּית מַלְכוּתוֹ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ טֵבֵת בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְמַלְכוּתוֹ׃

english.text:
Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus, in his royal palace, in the
tenth month, which is the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of
his reign.

verses.english:
The king loved Esther more than all the other women, and she won
his grace and favor more than all the virgins. So he set a royal
diadem on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־אֶסְתֵּר מִכּל־הַנָּשִׁים וַתִּשָּׂא־חֵן וָחֶסֶד לְפָנָיו מִכּל־הַבְּתוּלוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם כֶּתֶר־מַלְכוּת בְּרֹאשָׁהּ וַיַּמְלִיכֶהָ תַּחַת וַשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱהַב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־אֶסְתֵּר מִכּל־הַנָּשִׁים וַתִּשָּׂא־חֵן וָחֶסֶד לְפָנָיו מִכּל־הַבְּתוּלוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם כֶּתֶר־מַלְכוּת בְּרֹאשָׁהּ וַיַּמְלִיכֶהָ תַּחַת וַשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
The king loved Esther more than all the other women, and she won
his grace and favor more than all the virgins. So he set a royal
diadem on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.english:
The king gave a great banquet for all his officials and courtiers,
“the banquet of Esther.” He proclaimed a remission of taxes for
the provinces and distributed gifts as befits a king.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל לְכל־שָׂרָיו וַעֲבָדָיו אֵת מִשְׁתֵּה אֶסְתֵּר וַהֲנָחָה לַמְּדִינוֹת עָשָׂה וַיִּתֵּן מַשְׂאֵת כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל לְכל־שָׂרָיו וַעֲבָדָיו אֵת מִשְׁתֵּה אֶסְתֵּר וַהֲנָחָה לַמְּדִינוֹת עָשָׂה וַיִּתֵּן מַשְׂאֵת כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The king gave a great banquet for all his officials and courtiers,
“the banquet of Esther.” He proclaimed a remission of taxes for
the provinces and distributed gifts as befits a king.

verses.english:
When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai sat in the
palace gate.
verses.hebrew: וּבְהִקָּבֵץ בְּתוּלוֹת שֵׁנִית וּמרְדֳּכַי יֹשֵׁב בְּשַׁעַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהִקָּבֵץ בְּתוּלוֹת שֵׁנִית וּמרְדֳּכַי יֹשֵׁב בְּשַׁעַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai sat in the
palace gate.

verses.english:
But Esther still did not reveal her kindred or her people, as
Mordecai had instructed her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai’s bidding,
as she had done when she was under his tutelage.
verses.hebrew: אֵין אֶסְתֵּר מַגֶּדֶת מוֹלַדְתָּהּ וְאֶת־עַמָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה עָלֶיהָ מרְדֳּכָי וְאֶת־מַאֲמַר מרְדֳּכַי אֶסְתֵּר עֹשָׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה בְאמְנָה אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵין אֶסְתֵּר מַגֶּדֶת מוֹלַדְתָּהּ וְאֶת־עַמָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה עָלֶיהָ מרְדֳּכָי וְאֶת־מַאֲמַר מרְדֳּכַי אֶסְתֵּר עֹשָׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה בְאמְנָה אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
But Esther still did not reveal her kindred or her people, as
Mordecai had instructed her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai’s bidding,
as she had done when she was under his tutelage.

verses.english:
At that time, when Mordecai was sitting in the palace gate,
Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the
threshold, became angry, and plotted to do away with King
Ahasuerus.
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּמרְדֳּכַי יוֹשֵׁב בְּשַׁעַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ קָצַף בִּגְתָן וָתֶרֶשׁ שְׁנֵי־סָרִיסֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ מִשֹּׁמְרֵי הַסַּף וַיְבַקְשׁוּ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּמרְדֳּכַי יוֹשֵׁב בְּשַׁעַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ קָצַף בִּגְתָן וָתֶרֶשׁ שְׁנֵי־סָרִיסֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ מִשֹּׁמְרֵי הַסַּף וַיְבַקְשׁוּ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ׃

english.text:
At that time, when Mordecai was sitting in the palace gate,
Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the
threshold, became angry, and plotted to do away with King
Ahasuerus.

verses.english:
Mordecai learned of it and told it to Queen Esther, and Esther
reported it to the king in Mordecai’s name.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּדַע הַדָּבָר לְמרְדֳּכַי וַיַּגֵּד לְאֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּה וַתֹּאמֶר אֶסְתֵּר לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֵׁם מרְדֳּכָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּדַע הַדָּבָר לְמרְדֳּכַי וַיַּגֵּד לְאֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּה וַתֹּאמֶר אֶסְתֵּר לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֵׁם מרְדֳּכָי׃

english.text:
Mordecai learned of it and told it to Queen Esther, and Esther
reported it to the king in Mordecai’s name.

verses.english:
The matter was investigated and found to be so, and the two were
impaled on stakes. This was recorded in the book of annals at the
instance of the king.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבֻקַּשׁ הַדָּבָר וַיִּמָּצֵא וַיִּתָּלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם עַל־עֵץ וַיִּכָּתֵב בְּסֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The matter was investigated and found to be so, and the two were
impaled on stakes. This was recorded in the book of annals at the
instance of the king.

into exile to Babylon, who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each
to his own city,

verses.english:
The following were those who came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha,
Cherub, Addan, and Immer—they were unable to tell whether their
father’s house and descent were Israelite:
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדָּן אִמֵּר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדָּן אִמֵּר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵם׃

verses.english:
Of the sons of the priests, the sons of Habaiah, the sons of
Hakkoz, the sons of Barzillai who had married a daughter of
Barzillai and had taken his name—
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי חֳבַיָּה בְּנֵי הַקּוֹץ בְּנֵי בַרְזִלַּי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִבְּנוֹת בַּרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי אִשָּׁה וַיִּקָּרֵא עַל־שְׁמָם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי חֳבַיָּה בְּנֵי הַקּוֹץ בְּנֵי בַרְזִלַּי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִבְּנוֹת בַּרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי אִשָּׁה וַיִּקָּרֵא עַל־שְׁמָם׃

english.text:
Of the sons of the priests, the sons of Habaiah, the sons of
Hakkoz, the sons of Barzillai who had married a daughter of
Barzillai and had taken his name—

verses.english:
these searched for their genealogical records, but they could not
be found, so they were disqualified for the priesthood.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָאוּ וַיְגֹאֲלוּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָאוּ וַיְגֹאֲלוּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּה׃

english.text:
these searched for their genealogical records, but they could not
be found, so they were disqualified for the priesthood.

verses.english:
The Tirshatha ordered them not to eat of the most holy things
until a priest with Urim and Thummim should appear.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד כֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וּלְתֻמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד כֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וּלְתֻמִּים׃

english.text:
The Tirshatha ordered them not to eat of the most holy things
until a priest with Urim and Thummim should appear.

verses.english: The sum of the entire community was 42,360,

hebrew.text: כּל־הַקָּהָל כְּאֶחָד אַרְבַּע רִבּוֹא אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים׃

english.text: The sum of the entire community was 42,360,

verses.english:
not counting their male and female servants, those being 7,337;
they also had 200 male and female singers.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיהֶם אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה וְלָהֶם מְשֹׁרְרִים וּמְשֹׁרְרוֹת מָאתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: מִלְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיהֶם אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה וְלָהֶם מְשֹׁרְרִים וּמְשֹׁרְרוֹת מָאתָיִם׃

english.text:
not counting their male and female servants, those being 7,337;
they also had 200 male and female singers.

verses.hebrew: סוּסֵיהֶם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה פִּרְדֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: סוּסֵיהֶם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה פִּרְדֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

english.text: Their horses—736; their mules—245;

verses.english: their camels—435; their asses—6,720.
verses.hebrew: גְּמַלֵּיהֶם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

hebrew.text: גְּמַלֵּיהֶם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

english.text: their camels—435; their asses—6,720.

verses.english:
Some of the chiefs of the clans, on arriving at the House of YHWH
in Jerusalem, gave a freewill offering to erect the House of God
on its site.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת בְּבוֹאָם לְבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הִתְנַדְּבוּ לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים לְהַעֲמִידוֹ עַל־מְכוֹנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת בְּבוֹאָם לְבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הִתְנַדְּבוּ לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים לְהַעֲמִידוֹ עַל־מְכוֹנוֹ׃

english.text:
Some of the chiefs of the clans, on arriving at the House of YHWH
in Jerusalem, gave a freewill offering to erect the House of God
on its site.

verses.english:
In accord with their means, they donated to the treasury of the
work: gold—61,000 drachmas, silver—5,000 minas, and priestly
robes—100.
verses.hebrew: כְּכֹחָם נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר הַמְּלָאכָה זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּאות וָאֶלֶף וְכֶסֶף מָנִים חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְכתְנֹת כֹּהֲנִים מֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹחָם נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר הַמְּלָאכָה זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּאות וָאֶלֶף וְכֶסֶף מָנִים חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְכתְנֹת כֹּהֲנִים מֵאָה׃

english.text:
In accord with their means, they donated to the treasury of the
work: gold—61,000 drachmas, silver—5,000 minas, and priestly
robes—100.

verses.english:
The priests, the Levites and some of the people, and the singers,
gatekeepers, and the temple servants took up residence in their
towns and all Israel in their towns.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וּמִן־הָעָם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַנְּתִינִים בְּעָרֵיהֶם וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וּמִן־הָעָם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַנְּתִינִים בְּעָרֵיהֶם וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
The priests, the Levites and some of the people, and the singers,
gatekeepers, and the temple servants took up residence in their
towns and all Israel in their towns.

verses.english:
In the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes,
wine was set before him; I took the wine and gave it to the king—I
had never been out of sorts in his presence.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּחֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן שְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ יַיִן לְפָנָיו וָאֶשָּׂא אֶת־הַיַּיִן וָאֶתְּנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־הָיִיתִי רַע לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּחֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן שְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ יַיִן לְפָנָיו וָאֶשָּׂא אֶת־הַיַּיִן וָאֶתְּנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־הָיִיתִי רַע לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
In the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes,
wine was set before him; I took the wine and gave it to the king—I
had never been out of sorts in his presence.

verses.english:
The king said to me, “How is it that you look bad, though you are
not ill? It must be bad thoughts.” I was very frightened,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ פָּנֶיךָ רָעִים וְאַתָּה אֵינְךָ חוֹלֶה אֵין זֶה כִּי־אִם רֹעַ לֵב וָאִירָא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ פָּנֶיךָ רָעִים וְאַתָּה אֵינְךָ חוֹלֶה אֵין זֶה כִּי־אִם רֹעַ לֵב וָאִירָא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
The king said to me, “How is it that you look bad, though you are
not ill? It must be bad thoughts.” I was very frightened,

verses.english:
but I answered the king, “May the king live forever! How should I
not look bad when the city of the graveyard of my ancestors lies
in ruins, and its gates have been consumed by fire?”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ לְעוֹלָם יִחְיֶה מַדּוּעַ לֹא־יֵרְעוּ פָנַי אֲשֶׁר הָעִיר בֵּית־קִבְרוֹת אֲבֹתַי חֲרֵבָה וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ אֻכְּלוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ לְעוֹלָם יִחְיֶה מַדּוּעַ לֹא־יֵרְעוּ פָנַי אֲשֶׁר הָעִיר בֵּית־קִבְרוֹת אֲבֹתַי חֲרֵבָה וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ אֻכְּלוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
but I answered the king, “May the king live forever! How should I
not look bad when the city of the graveyard of my ancestors lies
in ruins, and its gates have been consumed by fire?”

verses.english:
The king said to me, “What is your request?” With a prayer to the
God of Heaven,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מַה־זֶּה אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וָאֶתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מַה־זֶּה אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וָאֶתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
The king said to me, “What is your request?” With a prayer to the
God of Heaven,

verses.english:
I answered the king, “If it please the king, and if your servant
has found favor with you, send me to Judah, to the city of my
ancestors’ graves, to rebuild it.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב וְאִם־יִיטַב עַבְדְּךָ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵנִי אֶל־יְהוּדָה אֶל־עִיר קִבְרוֹת אֲבֹתַי וְאֶבְנֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב וְאִם־יִיטַב עַבְדְּךָ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵנִי אֶל־יְהוּדָה אֶל־עִיר קִבְרוֹת אֲבֹתַי וְאֶבְנֶנָּה׃

english.text:
I answered the king, “If it please the king, and if your servant
has found favor with you, send me to Judah, to the city of my
ancestors’ graves, to rebuild it.”

verses.english:
With the consort seated at his side, the king said to me, “How
long will you be gone and when will you return?” So it was
agreeable to the king to send me, and I gave him a date.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשֵּׁגַל יוֹשֶׁבֶת אֶצְלוֹ עַד־מָתַי יִהְיֶה מַהֲלָכְךָ וּמָתַי תָּשׁוּב וַיִּיטַב לִפְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי וָאֶתְּנָה לוֹ זְמָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשֵּׁגַל יוֹשֶׁבֶת אֶצְלוֹ עַד־מָתַי יִהְיֶה מַהֲלָכְךָ וּמָתַי תָּשׁוּב וַיִּיטַב לִפְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי וָאֶתְּנָה לוֹ זְמָן׃

english.text:
With the consort seated at his side, the king said to me, “How
long will you be gone and when will you return?” So it was
agreeable to the king to send me, and I gave him a date.

verses.hebrew: וָאוֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב אִגְּרוֹת יִתְּנוּ־לִי עַל־פַּחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבִירוּנִי עַד אֲשֶׁר־אָבוֹא אֶל־יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאוֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב אִגְּרוֹת יִתְּנוּ־לִי עַל־פַּחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבִירוּנִי עַד אֲשֶׁר־אָבוֹא אֶל־יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english:
likewise, a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the King’s Park,
directing him to give me timber for roofing the gatehouses of the
temple fortress and the city walls and for the house I shall
occupy.” The king gave me these, thanks to my God’s benevolent
care for me.
verses.hebrew:
וְאִגֶּרֶת אֶל־אָסָף שֹׁמֵר הַפַּרְדֵּס אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִתֶּן־לִי עֵצִים לְקָרוֹת אֶת־שַׁעֲרֵי הַבִּירָה אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּיִת וּלְחוֹמַת הָעִיר וְלַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־אָבוֹא אֵלָיו
וַיִּתֶּן־לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהַי הַטּוֹבָה עָלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וְאִגֶּרֶת אֶל־אָסָף שֹׁמֵר הַפַּרְדֵּס אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִתֶּן־לִי עֵצִים לְקָרוֹת אֶת־שַׁעֲרֵי הַבִּירָה אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּיִת וּלְחוֹמַת הָעִיר וְלַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־אָבוֹא אֵלָיו
וַיִּתֶּן־לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהַי הַטּוֹבָה עָלָי׃

english.text:
likewise, a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the King’s Park,
directing him to give me timber for roofing the gatehouses of the
temple fortress and the city walls and for the house I shall
occupy.” The king gave me these, thanks to my God’s benevolent
care for me.

verses.english:
When I came to the governors of the province of Beyond the River I
gave them the king’s letters. The king also sent army officers and
cavalry with me.
verses.hebrew: וָאָבוֹא אֶל־פַּחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאֶתְּנָה לָהֶם אֵת אִגְּרוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂרֵי חַיִל וּפָרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וָאָבוֹא אֶל־פַּחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאֶתְּנָה לָהֶם אֵת אִגְּרוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂרֵי חַיִל וּפָרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
When I came to the governors of the province of Beyond the River I
gave them the king’s letters. The king also sent army officers and
cavalry with me.

verses.english:
When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard,
it displeased them greatly that someone had come, intent on
improving the condition of the Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע סַנְבַלַּט הַחֹרֹנִי וְטוֹבִיָּה הָעֶבֶד הָעַמֹּנִי וַיֵּרַע לָהֶם רָעָה גְדֹלָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אָדָם לְבַקֵּשׁ טוֹבָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע סַנְבַלַּט הַחֹרֹנִי וְטוֹבִיָּה הָעֶבֶד הָעַמֹּנִי וַיֵּרַע לָהֶם רָעָה גְדֹלָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אָדָם לְבַקֵּשׁ טוֹבָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard,
it displeased them greatly that someone had come, intent on
improving the condition of the Israelites.

verses.english: I arrived in Jerusalem. After I was there three days
verses.hebrew: וָאָבוֹא אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וָאֱהִי־שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וָאָבוֹא אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וָאֱהִי־שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text: I arrived in Jerusalem. After I was there three days

verses.english:
I got up at night, I and a few men with me, and telling no one
what my God had put into my mind to do for Jerusalem, and taking
no other beast than the one on which I was riding,
verses.hebrew:
וָאָקוּם לַיְלָה אֲנִי וַאֲנָשִׁים מְעַט עִמִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתִּי לְאָדָם מָה אֱלֹהַי נֹתֵן אֶל־לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת לִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וּבְהֵמָה אֵין עִמִּי כִּי אִם־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר
אֲנִי רֹכֵב בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וָאָקוּם לַיְלָה אֲנִי וַאֲנָשִׁים מְעַט עִמִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתִּי לְאָדָם מָה אֱלֹהַי נֹתֵן אֶל־לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת לִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וּבְהֵמָה אֵין עִמִּי כִּי אִם־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר
אֲנִי רֹכֵב בָּהּ׃

english.text:
I got up at night, I and a few men with me, and telling no one
what my God had put into my mind to do for Jerusalem, and taking
no other beast than the one on which I was riding,

verses.english:
I went out by the Valley Gate, at night, toward the Jackals’
Spring and the Dung Gate; and I surveyed the walls of Jerusalem
that were breached, and its gates, consumed by fire.
verses.hebrew:
וָאֵצְאָה בְשַׁעַר־הַגַּיְא לַיְלָה וְאֶל־פְּנֵי עֵין הַתַּנִּין וְאֶל־שַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפֹּת וָאֱהִי שֹׂבֵר בְּחוֹמֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר־[הֵם פְּרוּצִים] (המפרוצים) וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ
אֻכְּלוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וָאֵצְאָה בְשַׁעַר־הַגַּיְא לַיְלָה וְאֶל־פְּנֵי עֵין הַתַּנִּין וְאֶל־שַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפֹּת וָאֱהִי שֹׂבֵר בְּחוֹמֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר־[הֵם פְּרוּצִים] (המפרוצים) וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ
אֻכְּלוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
I went out by the Valley Gate, at night, toward the Jackals’
Spring and the Dung Gate; and I surveyed the walls of Jerusalem
that were breached, and its gates, consumed by fire.

verses.english:
I proceeded to the Fountain Gate and to the King’s Pool, where
there was no room for the beast under me to continue.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶעֱבֹר אֶל־שַׁעַר הָעַיִן וְאֶל־בְּרֵכַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵין־מָקוֹם לַבְּהֵמָה לַעֲבֹר תַּחְתָּי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶעֱבֹר אֶל־שַׁעַר הָעַיִן וְאֶל־בְּרֵכַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵין־מָקוֹם לַבְּהֵמָה לַעֲבֹר תַּחְתָּי׃

english.text:
I proceeded to the Fountain Gate and to the King’s Pool, where
there was no room for the beast under me to continue.

verses.english:
So I went up the wadi by night, surveying the wall, and, entering
again by the Valley Gate, I returned.
verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי עֹלֶה בַנַּחַל לַיְלָה וָאֱהִי שֹׂבֵר בַּחוֹמָה וָאָשׁוּב וָאָבוֹא בְּשַׁעַר הַגַּיְא וָאָשׁוּב׃

hebrew.text: וָאֱהִי עֹלֶה בַנַּחַל לַיְלָה וָאֱהִי שֹׂבֵר בַּחוֹמָה וָאָשׁוּב וָאָבוֹא בְּשַׁעַר הַגַּיְא וָאָשׁוּב׃

english.text:
So I went up the wadi by night, surveying the wall, and, entering
again by the Valley Gate, I returned.

verses.english:
The prefects knew nothing of where I had gone or what I had done,
since I had not yet divulged it to the Jews—the priests, the
nobles, the prefects, or the rest of the officials.
verses.hebrew: וְהַסְּגָנִים לֹא יָדְעוּ אָנָה הָלַכְתִּי וּמָה אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה וְלַיְּהוּדִים וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַחֹרִים וְלַסְּגָנִים וּלְיֶתֶר עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה עַד־כֵּן לֹא הִגַּדְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהַסְּגָנִים לֹא יָדְעוּ אָנָה הָלַכְתִּי וּמָה אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה וְלַיְּהוּדִים וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַחֹרִים וְלַסְּגָנִים וּלְיֶתֶר עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה עַד־כֵּן לֹא הִגַּדְתִּי׃

english.text:
The prefects knew nothing of where I had gone or what I had done,
since I had not yet divulged it to the Jews—the priests, the
nobles, the prefects, or the rest of the officials.

verses.english:
Then I said to them, “You see the bad state we are in—Jerusalem
lying in ruins and its gates destroyed by fire. Come, let us
rebuild the wall of Jerusalem and suffer no more disgrace.”
verses.hebrew:
וָאוֹמַר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם רֹאִים הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ בָהּ אֲשֶׁר יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם חֲרֵבָה וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ נִצְּתוּ בָאֵשׁ לְכוּ וְנִבְנֶה אֶת־חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְלֹא־נִהְיֶה עוֹד
חֶרְפָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וָאוֹמַר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם רֹאִים הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ בָהּ אֲשֶׁר יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם חֲרֵבָה וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ נִצְּתוּ בָאֵשׁ לְכוּ וְנִבְנֶה אֶת־חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְלֹא־נִהְיֶה עוֹד
חֶרְפָּה׃

english.text:
Then I said to them, “You see the bad state we are in—Jerusalem
lying in ruins and its gates destroyed by fire. Come, let us
rebuild the wall of Jerusalem and suffer no more disgrace.”

verses.english:
I told them of my God’s benevolent care for me, also of the things
that the king had said to me, and they said, “Let us start
building!” They were encouraged by [His] benevolence.
verses.hebrew: וָאַגִּיד לָהֶם אֶת־יַד אֱלֹהַי אֲשֶׁר־הִיא טוֹבָה עָלַי וְאַף־דִּבְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָקוּם וּבָנִינוּ וַיְחַזְּקוּ יְדֵיהֶם לַטּוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאַגִּיד לָהֶם אֶת־יַד אֱלֹהַי אֲשֶׁר־הִיא טוֹבָה עָלַי וְאַף־דִּבְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָקוּם וּבָנִינוּ וַיְחַזְּקוּ יְדֵיהֶם לַטּוֹבָה׃

english.text:
I told them of my God’s benevolent care for me, also of the things
that the king had said to me, and they said, “Let us start
building!” They were encouraged by [His] benevolence.

verses.english:
When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant and
Geshem the Arab heard, they mocked us and held us in contempt and
said, “What is this that you are doing? Are you rebelling against
the king?”
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע סַנְבַלַּט הַחֹרֹנִי וְטֹבִיָּה הָעֶבֶד הָעַמּוֹנִי וְגֶשֶׁם הָעַרְבִי וַיַּלְעִגוּ לָנוּ וַיִּבְזוּ עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים
הַעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ אַתֶּם מֹרְדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע סַנְבַלַּט הַחֹרֹנִי וְטֹבִיָּה הָעֶבֶד הָעַמּוֹנִי וְגֶשֶׁם הָעַרְבִי וַיַּלְעִגוּ לָנוּ וַיִּבְזוּ עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים
הַעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ אַתֶּם מֹרְדִים׃

english.text:
When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant and
Geshem the Arab heard, they mocked us and held us in contempt and
said, “What is this that you are doing? Are you rebelling against
the king?”

verses.english:
I said to them in reply, “The God of Heaven will grant us success,
and we, His servants, will start building. But you have no share
or claim or stake in Jerusalem!”
verses.hebrew: וָאָשִׁיב אוֹתָם דָּבָר וָאוֹמַר לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם הוּא יַצְלִיחַ לָנוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עֲבָדָיו נָקוּם וּבָנִינוּ וְלָכֶם אֵין־חֵלֶק וּצְדָקָה וְזִכָּרוֹן בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וָאָשִׁיב אוֹתָם דָּבָר וָאוֹמַר לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם הוּא יַצְלִיחַ לָנוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עֲבָדָיו נָקוּם וּבָנִינוּ וְלָכֶם אֵין־חֵלֶק וּצְדָקָה וְזִכָּרוֹן בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
I said to them in reply, “The God of Heaven will grant us success,
and we, His servants, will start building. But you have no share
or claim or stake in Jerusalem!”

verses.english:
Some time afterward, King Ahasuerus promoted Haman son of
Hammedatha the Agagite; he advanced him and seated him higher than
any of his fellow officials.
verses.hebrew: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה גִּדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֶת־הָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי וַיְנַשְּׂאֵהוּ וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כּל־הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה גִּדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֶת־הָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי וַיְנַשְּׂאֵהוּ וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כּל־הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Some time afterward, King Ahasuerus promoted Haman son of
Hammedatha the Agagite; he advanced him and seated him higher than
any of his fellow officials.

verses.english:
All the king’s courtiers in the palace gate knelt and bowed low to
Haman, for such was the king’s order concerning him; but Mordecai
would not kneel or bow low.
verses.hebrew: וְכל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהָמָן כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וּמרְדֳּכַי לֹא יִכְרַע וְלֹא יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהָמָן כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וּמרְדֳּכַי לֹא יִכְרַע וְלֹא יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה׃

english.text:
All the king’s courtiers in the palace gate knelt and bowed low to
Haman, for such was the king’s order concerning him; but Mordecai
would not kneel or bow low.

verses.english:
Then the king’s courtiers who were in the palace gate said to
Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s order?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְמרְדֳּכָי מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה עוֹבֵר אֵת מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְמרְדֳּכָי מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה עוֹבֵר אֵת מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then the king’s courtiers who were in the palace gate said to
Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s order?”

verses.english:
When they spoke to him day after day and he would not listen to
them, they told Haman, in order to see whether Mordecai’s resolve
would prevail; for he had explained to them that he was a Jew.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי (באמרם) [כְּאמְרָם] אֵלָיו יוֹם וָיוֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּגִּידוּ לְהָמָן לִרְאוֹת הֲיַעַמְדוּ דִּבְרֵי מרְדֳּכַי כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יְהוּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי (באמרם) [כְּאמְרָם] אֵלָיו יוֹם וָיוֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּגִּידוּ לְהָמָן לִרְאוֹת הֲיַעַמְדוּ דִּבְרֵי מרְדֳּכַי כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יְהוּדִי׃

english.text:
When they spoke to him day after day and he would not listen to
them, they told Haman, in order to see whether Mordecai’s resolve
would prevail; for he had explained to them that he was a Jew.

verses.english:
When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel or bow low to him,
Haman was filled with rage.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא הָמָן כִּי־אֵין מרְדֳּכַי כֹּרֵעַ וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיִּמָּלֵא הָמָן חֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא הָמָן כִּי־אֵין מרְדֳּכַי כֹּרֵעַ וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיִּמָּלֵא הָמָן חֵמָה׃

english.text:
When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel or bow low to him,
Haman was filled with rage.

verses.english:
But he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone; having been told
who Mordecai’s people were, Haman plotted to do away with all the
Jews, Mordecai’s people, throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבֶז בְּעֵינָיו לִשְׁלֹחַ יָד בְּמרְדֳּכַי לְבַדּוֹ כִּי־הִגִּידוּ לוֹ אֶת־עַם מרְדֳּכָי וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הָמָן לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים אֲשֶׁר בְּכל־מַלְכוּת אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ
עַם מרְדֳּכָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבֶז בְּעֵינָיו לִשְׁלֹחַ יָד בְּמרְדֳּכַי לְבַדּוֹ כִּי־הִגִּידוּ לוֹ אֶת־עַם מרְדֳּכָי וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הָמָן לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים אֲשֶׁר בְּכל־מַלְכוּת אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ
עַם מרְדֳּכָי׃

english.text:
But he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone; having been told
who Mordecai’s people were, Haman plotted to do away with all the
Jews, Mordecai’s people, throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus.

verses.english:
In the first month, that is, the month of Nisan, in the twelfth
year of King Ahasuerus, pur—which means “the lot”—was cast before
Haman concerning every day and every month, [until it fell on] the
twelfth month, that is, the month of Adar.
verses.hebrew:
בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הִפִּיל פּוּר הוּא הַגּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי הָמָן מִיּוֹם לְיוֹם וּמֵחֹדֶשׁ לְחֹדֶשׁ
שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר׃

hebrew.text:
בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הִפִּיל פּוּר הוּא הַגּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי הָמָן מִיּוֹם לְיוֹם וּמֵחֹדֶשׁ לְחֹדֶשׁ
שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר׃

english.text:
In the first month, that is, the month of Nisan, in the twelfth
year of King Ahasuerus, pur—which means “the lot”—was cast before
Haman concerning every day and every month, [until it fell on] the
twelfth month, that is, the month of Adar.

verses.english:
Haman then said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people,
scattered and dispersed among the other peoples in all the
provinces of your realm, whose laws are different from those of
any other people and who do not obey the king’s laws; and it is
not in Your Majesty’s interest to tolerate them.
verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָמָן לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ יֶשְׁנוֹ עַם־אֶחָד מְפֻזָּר וּמְפֹרָד בֵּין הָעַמִּים בְּכֹל מְדִינוֹת מַלְכוּתֶךָ וְדָתֵיהֶם שֹׁנוֹת מִכּל־עָם וְאֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֵינָם עֹשִׂים וְלַמֶּלֶךְ אֵין־שֹׁוֶה לְהַנִּיחָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָמָן לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ יֶשְׁנוֹ עַם־אֶחָד מְפֻזָּר וּמְפֹרָד בֵּין הָעַמִּים בְּכֹל מְדִינוֹת מַלְכוּתֶךָ וְדָתֵיהֶם שֹׁנוֹת מִכּל־עָם וְאֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֵינָם עֹשִׂים וְלַמֶּלֶךְ אֵין־שֹׁוֶה לְהַנִּיחָם׃

english.text:
Haman then said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people,
scattered and dispersed among the other peoples in all the
provinces of your realm, whose laws are different from those of
any other people and who do not obey the king’s laws; and it is
not in Your Majesty’s interest to tolerate them.

verses.english:
If it please Your Majesty, let an edict be drawn for their
destruction, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the
stewards for deposit in the royal treasury.”
verses.hebrew: אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב יִכָּתֵב לְאַבְּדָם וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל עַל־יְדֵי עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה לְהָבִיא אֶל־גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב יִכָּתֵב לְאַבְּדָם וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל עַל־יְדֵי עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה לְהָבִיא אֶל־גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
If it please Your Majesty, let an edict be drawn for their
destruction, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the
stewards for deposit in the royal treasury.”

verses.english:
Thereupon the king removed his signet ring from his hand and gave
it to Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the foe of the Jews.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּסַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְהָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי צֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְהָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי צֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִים׃

english.text:
Thereupon the king removed his signet ring from his hand and gave
it to Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the foe of the Jews.

verses.english:
And the king said, “The money and the people are yours to do with
as you see fit.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמָן הַכֶּסֶף נָתוּן לָךְ וְהָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמָן הַכֶּסֶף נָתוּן לָךְ וְהָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And the king said, “The money and the people are yours to do with
as you see fit.”

verses.english:
On the thirteenth day of the first month, the king’s scribes were
summoned and a decree was issued, as Haman directed, to the king’s
satraps, to the governors of every province, and to the officials
of every people, to every province in its own script and to every
people in its own language. The orders were issued in the name of
King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s signet.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקָּרְאוּ סֹפְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בּוֹ וַיִּכָּתֵב כְּכל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הָמָן אֶל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶל־הַפַּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר
עַל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה וְאֶל־שָׂרֵי עַם וָעָם מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה כִּכְתָבָהּ וְעַם וָעָם כִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ בְּשֵׁם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ נִכְתָּב וְנֶחְתָּם בְּטַבַּעַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקָּרְאוּ סֹפְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בּוֹ וַיִּכָּתֵב כְּכל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הָמָן אֶל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶל־הַפַּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר
עַל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה וְאֶל־שָׂרֵי עַם וָעָם מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה כִּכְתָבָהּ וְעַם וָעָם כִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ בְּשֵׁם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ נִכְתָּב וְנֶחְתָּם בְּטַבַּעַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
On the thirteenth day of the first month, the king’s scribes were
summoned and a decree was issued, as Haman directed, to the king’s
satraps, to the governors of every province, and to the officials
of every people, to every province in its own script and to every
people in its own language. The orders were issued in the name of
King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s signet.

verses.english:
Accordingly, written instructions were dispatched by couriers to
all the king’s provinces to destroy, massacre, and exterminate all
the Jews, young and old, children and women, on a single day, on
the thirteenth day of the twelfth month—that is, the month of
Adar—and to plunder their possessions.
verses.hebrew:
וְנִשְׁלוֹחַ סְפָרִים בְּיַד הָרָצִים אֶל־כּל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַשְׁמִיד לַהֲרֹג וּלְאַבֵּד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן טַף וְנָשִׁים בְּיוֹם אֶחָד בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה
עָשָׂר לְחֹדֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז׃

hebrew.text:
וְנִשְׁלוֹחַ סְפָרִים בְּיַד הָרָצִים אֶל־כּל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַשְׁמִיד לַהֲרֹג וּלְאַבֵּד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן טַף וְנָשִׁים בְּיוֹם אֶחָד בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה
עָשָׂר לְחֹדֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז׃

english.text:
Accordingly, written instructions were dispatched by couriers to
all the king’s provinces to destroy, massacre, and exterminate all
the Jews, young and old, children and women, on a single day, on
the thirteenth day of the twelfth month—that is, the month of
Adar—and to plunder their possessions.

verses.english:
The text of the document was to the effect that a law should be
proclaimed in every single province; it was to be publicly
displayed to all the peoples, so that they might be ready for that
day.
verses.hebrew: פַּתְשֶׁגֶן הַכְּתָב לְהִנָּתֵן דָּת בְּכל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה גָּלוּי לְכל־הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת עֲתִדִים לַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: פַּתְשֶׁגֶן הַכְּתָב לְהִנָּתֵן דָּת בְּכל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה גָּלוּי לְכל־הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת עֲתִדִים לַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The text of the document was to the effect that a law should be
proclaimed in every single province; it was to be publicly
displayed to all the peoples, so that they might be ready for that
day.

verses.english:
The couriers went out posthaste on the royal mission, and the
decree was proclaimed in the fortress Shushan. The king and Haman
sat down to feast, but the city of Shushan was dumfounded.
verses.hebrew: הָרָצִים יָצְאוּ דְחוּפִים בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַדָּת נִתְּנָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן יָשְׁבוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת וְהָעִיר שׁוּשָׁן נָבוֹכָה׃

hebrew.text: הָרָצִים יָצְאוּ דְחוּפִים בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַדָּת נִתְּנָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן יָשְׁבוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת וְהָעִיר שׁוּשָׁן נָבוֹכָה׃

english.text:
The couriers went out posthaste on the royal mission, and the
decree was proclaimed in the fortress Shushan. The king and Haman
sat down to feast, but the city of Shushan was dumfounded.

verses.english:
When the seventh month arrived—the Israelites being settled in
their towns—the entire people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּעָרִיםוַיֵּאָסְפוּ הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּעָרִיםוַיֵּאָסְפוּ הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
When the seventh month arrived—the Israelites being settled in
their towns—the entire people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brother priests, and Zerubbabel
son of Shealtiel and his brothers set to and built the altar of
the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings upon it as is written
in the Teaching of Moses, the man of God.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וּזְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְאֶחָיו וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עֹלוֹת כַּכָּתוּב
בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וּזְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְאֶחָיו וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עֹלוֹת כַּכָּתוּב
בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brother priests, and Zerubbabel
son of Shealtiel and his brothers set to and built the altar of
the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings upon it as is written
in the Teaching of Moses, the man of God.

verses.english:
They set up the altar on its site because they were in fear of the
peoples of the land, and they offered burnt offerings on it to
YHWH, burnt offerings each morning and evening.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּכִינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל־מְכוֹנֹתָיו כִּי בְּאֵימָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת (ויעל) [וַיַּעֲלוּ] עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה עֹלוֹת לַבֹּקֶר וְלָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּכִינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל־מְכוֹנֹתָיו כִּי בְּאֵימָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת (ויעל) [וַיַּעֲלוּ] עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה עֹלוֹת לַבֹּקֶר וְלָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
They set up the altar on its site because they were in fear of the
peoples of the land, and they offered burnt offerings on it to
YHWH, burnt offerings each morning and evening.

verses.english:
Then they celebrated the festival of Tabernacles as is written,
with its daily burnt offerings in the proper quantities, on each
day as is prescribed for it,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת כַּכָּתוּב וְעֹלַת יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפַּט דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת כַּכָּתוּב וְעֹלַת יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפַּט דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
Then they celebrated the festival of Tabernacles as is written,
with its daily burnt offerings in the proper quantities, on each
day as is prescribed for it,

verses.english:
followed by the regular burnt offering and the offerings for the
new moons and for all the sacred fixed times of YHWH, and whatever
freewill offerings were made to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן עֹלַת תָּמִיד וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וּלְכל־מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁים וּלְכֹל מִתְנַדֵּב נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן עֹלַת תָּמִיד וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וּלְכל־מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁים וּלְכֹל מִתְנַדֵּב נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
followed by the regular burnt offering and the offerings for the
new moons and for all the sacred fixed times of YHWH, and whatever
freewill offerings were made to YHWH.

verses.english:
From the first day of the seventh month they began to make burnt
offerings to YHWH, though the foundation of the Temple of YHWH had
not been laid.
verses.hebrew: מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵחֵלּוּ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה וְהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה לֹא יֻסָּד׃

hebrew.text: מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵחֵלּוּ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה וְהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה לֹא יֻסָּד׃

english.text:
From the first day of the seventh month they began to make burnt
offerings to YHWH, though the foundation of the Temple of YHWH had
not been laid.

verses.english:
They paid the hewers and craftsmen with money, and the Sidonians
and Tyrians with food, drink, and oil to bring cedarwood from
Lebanon by sea to Joppa, in accord with the authorization granted
them by King Cyrus of Persia.
verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְּנוּ־כֶסֶף לַחֹצְבִים וְלֶחָרָשִׁים וּמַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה וָשֶׁמֶן לַצִּדֹנִים וְלַצֹּרִים לְהָבִיא עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן אֶל־יָם יָפוֹא כְּרִשְׁיוֹן כּוֹרֶשׁ
מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְּנוּ־כֶסֶף לַחֹצְבִים וְלֶחָרָשִׁים וּמַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה וָשֶׁמֶן לַצִּדֹנִים וְלַצֹּרִים לְהָבִיא עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן אֶל־יָם יָפוֹא כְּרִשְׁיוֹן כּוֹרֶשׁ
מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
They paid the hewers and craftsmen with money, and the Sidonians
and Tyrians with food, drink, and oil to bring cedarwood from
Lebanon by sea to Joppa, in accord with the authorization granted
them by King Cyrus of Persia.

verses.english:
In the second year after their arrival at the House of God, at
Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and
Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brother priests and
Levites, and all who had come from the captivity to Jerusalem, as
their first step appointed Levites from the age of twenty and
upward to supervise the work of the House of YHWH.
verses.hebrew:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְבוֹאָם אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי הֵחֵלּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּשְׁאָר אֲחֵיהֶם
הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְכל־הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְבוֹאָם אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי הֵחֵלּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּשְׁאָר אֲחֵיהֶם
הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְכל־הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
In the second year after their arrival at the House of God, at
Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and
Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brother priests and
Levites, and all who had come from the captivity to Jerusalem, as
their first step appointed Levites from the age of twenty and
upward to supervise the work of the House of YHWH.

verses.english:
Jeshua, his sons and brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of
Judah, together were appointed in charge of those who did the work
in the House of God; also the sons of Henadad, their sons and
brother Levites.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד יֵשׁוּעַ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵל וּבָנָיו בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה כְּאֶחָד לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִיםבְּנֵי חֵנָדָד בְּנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד יֵשׁוּעַ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵל וּבָנָיו בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה כְּאֶחָד לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִיםבְּנֵי חֵנָדָד בְּנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
Jeshua, his sons and brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of
Judah, together were appointed in charge of those who did the work
in the House of God; also the sons of Henadad, their sons and
brother Levites.

verses.english:
When the builders had laid the foundation of the Temple of YHWH,
priests in their vestments with trumpets, and Levites sons of
Asaph with cymbals were stationed to give praise to YHWH, as King
David of Israel had ordained.
verses.hebrew:
וְיִסְּדוּ הַבֹּנִים אֶת־הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְלֻבָּשִׁים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־אָסָף בַּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְהַלֵּל אֶת־יְהֹוָה עַל־יְדֵי דָּוִיד
מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְיִסְּדוּ הַבֹּנִים אֶת־הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְלֻבָּשִׁים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־אָסָף בַּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְהַלֵּל אֶת־יְהֹוָה עַל־יְדֵי דָּוִיד
מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When the builders had laid the foundation of the Temple of YHWH,
priests in their vestments with trumpets, and Levites sons of
Asaph with cymbals were stationed to give praise to YHWH, as King
David of Israel had ordained.

verses.english:
They sang songs extolling and praising YHWH, “For He is good, His
steadfast love for Israel is eternal.” All the people raised a
great shout extolling YHWH because the foundation of the House of
YHWH had been laid.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדֹת לַיהֹוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי־לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם הֵרִיעוּ תְרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בְהַלֵּל לַיהֹוָה עַל הוּסַד בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדֹת לַיהֹוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי־לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם הֵרִיעוּ תְרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בְהַלֵּל לַיהֹוָה עַל הוּסַד בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
They sang songs extolling and praising YHWH, “For He is good, His
steadfast love for Israel is eternal.” All the people raised a
great shout extolling YHWH because the foundation of the House of
YHWH had been laid.

verses.english:
Many of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of the clans, the
old men who had seen the first house, wept loudly at the sight of
the founding of this house. Many others shouted joyously at the
top of their voices.
verses.hebrew:
וְרַבִּים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּיסְדוֹ זֶה הַבַּיִת בְּעֵינֵיהֶם בֹּכִים בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וְרַבִּים
בִּתְרוּעָה בְשִׂמְחָה לְהָרִים קוֹל׃

hebrew.text:
וְרַבִּים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּיסְדוֹ זֶה הַבַּיִת בְּעֵינֵיהֶם בֹּכִים בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וְרַבִּים
בִּתְרוּעָה בְשִׂמְחָה לְהָרִים קוֹל׃

english.text:
Many of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of the clans, the
old men who had seen the first house, wept loudly at the sight of
the founding of this house. Many others shouted joyously at the
top of their voices.

verses.english:
The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the
people’s weeping, for the people raised a great shout, the sound
of which could be heard from afar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵין הָעָם מַכִּירִים קוֹל תְּרוּעַת הַשִּׂמְחָה לְקוֹל בְּכִי הָעָם כִּי הָעָם מְרִיעִים תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְהַקּוֹל נִשְׁמַע עַד־לְמֵרָחוֹק׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵין הָעָם מַכִּירִים קוֹל תְּרוּעַת הַשִּׂמְחָה לְקוֹל בְּכִי הָעָם כִּי הָעָם מְרִיעִים תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְהַקּוֹל נִשְׁמַע עַד־לְמֵרָחוֹק׃

english.text:
The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the
people’s weeping, for the people raised a great shout, the sound
of which could be heard from afar.

verses.english:
Then Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests set to and
rebuilt the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and set up its doors,
consecrating it as far as the Hundred’s Tower, as far as the Tower
of Hananel.
verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־שַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֵמָּה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו וְעַד־מִגְדַּל הַמֵּאָה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ עַד
מִגְדַּל חֲנַנְאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־שַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֵמָּה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו וְעַד־מִגְדַּל הַמֵּאָה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ עַד
מִגְדַּל חֲנַנְאֵל׃

english.text:
Then Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests set to and
rebuilt the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and set up its doors,
consecrating it as far as the Hundred’s Tower, as far as the Tower
of Hananel.

verses.english:
Next to him, the men of Jericho built. Next to them, Zaccur son of
Imri.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְרֵחוֹ וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנָה זַכּוּר בֶּן־אִמְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְרֵחוֹ וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנָה זַכּוּר בֶּן־אִמְרִי׃

english.text:
Next to him, the men of Jericho built. Next to them, Zaccur son of
Imri.

verses.english:
The sons of Hassenaah rebuilt the Fish Gate; they roofed it and
set up its doors, locks, and bars.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַדָּגִים בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הַסְּנָאָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעוּלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַדָּגִים בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הַסְּנָאָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעוּלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

english.text:
The sons of Hassenaah rebuilt the Fish Gate; they roofed it and
set up its doors, locks, and bars.

verses.english:
Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired; and
next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabel. Next to
him, Zadok son of Baana repaired.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה בֶּן־הַקּוֹץוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵלוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק צָדוֹק בֶּן־בַּעֲנָא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה בֶּן־הַקּוֹץוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵלוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק צָדוֹק בֶּן־בַּעֲנָא׃

english.text:
Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired; and
next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabel. Next to
him, Zadok son of Baana repaired.

verses.english:
Next to him, the Tekoites repaired, though their nobles would not
take upon their shoulders the work of their lord.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִים וְאַדִּירֵיהֶם לֹא־הֵבִיאוּ צַוָּרָם בַּעֲבֹדַת אֲדֹנֵיהֶם׃
